items.title: 高清写实豹纹 T 恤身份绑定成年女性 PAP 自拍
items.description: 身份绑定的 9:16 PAP 风格近距离自拍肖像，以豹纹 T 恤、灰褐长发、湿润妆容和室内花丝窗帘为视觉重点。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical ultra-realistic PAP-style selfie portrait using the uploaded identity reference to preserve the same explicitly adult woman’s original facial features, facial proportions, and recognizable identity exactly. Give her very fair but realistic porcelain-like skin with visible pores and fine skin texture. Her long glossy ash-brown hair is neatly tied with a transparent butterfly clip, with a few loose strands falling below the chin to frame the face. Place the camera very close with a pronounced tilted angle; let the face nearly fill the frame. Use a close-up to medium-close selfie from slightly above the upper-left, focusing on the face and upper shoulders. Dress her in a fitted but non-revealing cream, brown, and black leopard-print short-sleeve women’s T-shirt made of stretchy fabric that follows natural curves, with a moderately open U-neck; keep the clothing complete. Add a delicate thin gold necklace with a small gemstone pendant. Her expression is soft and calm, looking directly into the lens with a natural subtle smile. Use a dewy luminous makeup finish: defined eyeliner, soft pink eyeshadow, peach-pink blush, controlled highlighter, thick curled lashes, defined lower lashes, gentle facial contour, nude-to-glossy-cherry-red ombré lips, natural black contact lenses, and a soft pink highlight on the nose bridge. Preserve realistic skin texture without plastic smoothing or excessive filters. Soft natural frontal light evenly illuminates the face, with the subject slightly brighter than the dimmer background for depth. The upper background has cream or white fabric curtains with elegant black or dark-brown filigree swirl patterns; the left side transitions to a neutral gray wall and the right side shows a darker furniture or wall-panel surface. Keep the atmosphere warm, natural, soft, and highly photorealistic, like an authentic smartphone selfie rather than an AI-generated image. Negative: minor-like appearance, unreadable identity, obscured face, revealing clothing, sexualized pose, exaggerated body shape, excessive smoothing, plastic or waxy skin, incorrect fingers, distorted anatomy, wrong tilted perspective, excessive HDR, artificial filters, AI-drawing look, text, logos, watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖幅、超写实的 PAP 风格自拍肖像：使用上传的身份参考图精确保留同一位明确成年女性的原始面部特征、面部比例和自然身份，不改变身份。她有非常白皙但真实的瓷感皮肤、清晰可见的毛孔和细腻皮肤纹理；长而有光泽的灰褐色头发用透明蝴蝶发夹整齐扎起，几缕散发自然垂到下巴下方修饰脸型。镜头靠近主体并带明显倾斜角度，脸部几乎占据画面，采用从左上方略高位置的特写到中特写自拍，聚焦面部和上肩部。她穿合身但不暴露的奶油色、棕色和黑色斑点豹纹女装短袖 T 恤，弹性面料自然贴合身体曲线，U 领适度开口、服装完整；佩戴精细细金项链和小宝石吊坠。她表情柔和冷静，直视镜头并带自然微笑。妆容为水润光泽感：清晰眼线、柔粉眼影、桃粉腮红、适度提亮、浓密卷翘睫毛、清晰下睫毛、轻柔面部修容、裸色底渐变至中心樱桃红的唇色、自然黑色美瞳和鼻梁柔粉高光；保持真实肤质，避免塑料磨皮和过度滤镜。柔和正面自然光均匀照亮脸部，主体光线稍强而背景稍暗以形成层次；背景上方为奶油或白色织物窗帘，带优雅黑色或深褐色花丝涡卷图案，左侧过渡至中性灰墙，右侧为较暗家具或墙板。整体温暖、自然、柔和、高度写实，像真实智能手机自拍而非 AI 生成。负面：未成年外观、身份不可辨、面部被遮挡、暴露服装、色情化姿势、过度夸张身材、过度磨皮、塑料或蜡状皮肤、错误手指、畸形解剖、倾斜透视错误、过度 HDR、人工滤镜、AI 绘画感、文字、Logo、水印。

items.title: 深夜海底捞餐厅刷手机的东亚成年女性
items.description: 9:16 深夜海底捞火锅餐厅生活纪实抓拍，成年东亚女性在用餐间隙刷手机，采用 iPhone 16 Pro 夜景质感与温暖室内光。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical ultra-photorealistic mobile-phone documentary snapshot: late at night inside a premium Haidilao hotpot restaurant, an explicitly adult East Asian woman sits at a dining table and is casually captured by a friend. She has long straight black hair falling naturally over her shoulders, light makeup, natural refined adult facial proportions, and a fair natural complexion. Dress her in a fitted but non-revealing white short-sleeve T-shirt and light-gray shorts; keep the outfit complete and the body proportions realistic. She sits slightly back in her chair, looking down at her phone while scrolling: her left hand holds it close to her body, her right hand rests naturally on her lap, shoulders and neck relaxed, head slightly lowered, eyes focused on the screen rather than the camera. Her expression is quiet and mildly absent-minded, like an unposed moment during a meal break, with no sense of staging. On the table are a red-oil hotpot, dipping-sauce bowls, chopsticks, a platter of sliced meat, and a tissue box. The background is a black glass wall with warm yellow lights and natural reflections of people on the left, creating a premium private restaurant atmosphere. Capture it casually with an iPhone 16 Pro from a slight high angle, using realistic mobile night-scene processing, automatic exposure, warm indoor light, shadow noise, real skin texture, and slight motion blur. Keep a candid documentary feeling rather than a studio shoot. Keep a low-key artistic signature “DeepBlue” in the lower-left corner. Negative: minor-like appearance, sexualized pose, revealing clothing, exaggerated body proportions, incorrect fingers, deformed phone, malformed arms, incorrect reflections, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, strong HDR, oversharpening, cluttered background, garbled text, extra text, logos, watermarks (except the lower-left DeepBlue signature).
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖幅超写实手机生活纪实照片：深夜的高级 Haidilao（海底捞）火锅餐厅内，一位明确成年的东亚女性坐在餐桌旁，被朋友自然随手记录。她留黑色长直发，自然披在肩头，淡妆、清秀自然的成年面部比例和白皙自然肤色；穿合身但不暴露的白色短袖 T 恤和浅灰色短裤，服装完整，身体比例真实。她微微靠后坐在椅子上，低头刷手机，左手把手机拿在身体附近，右手自然放在腿上，肩颈放松，头部轻微低垂，眼睛专注屏幕而不看镜头；表情安静、略发呆，像吃饭间隙被朋友偶然拍下，没有摆拍感。桌面有红油火锅、蘸料碗、筷子、肉片拼盘和纸巾盒；背景为黑色玻璃墙与暖黄色灯光，左侧玻璃有自然人物倒影，营造高级而私密的餐厅氛围。使用 iPhone 16 Pro 随手拍摄，轻微俯拍角度、真实手机夜景效果、自动曝光、暖色室内光、暗部噪点、真实肤质和轻微运动模糊，保持生活纪实感而非棚拍。左下角保留低调艺术签名“DeepBlue”。负面：未成年外观、色情化姿势、暴露服装、夸张身体比例、错误手指、手机变形、手臂畸形、错误倒影、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、强 HDR、过度锐化、杂乱背景、乱码、额外文字、Logo、水印（左下角 DeepBlue 除外）。

items.title: 超写实东亚成年女性欧洲秋季街头时尚大片
items.description: 成年东亚女性坐在历史欧洲建筑石阶上的奢华秋季街头时尚编辑肖像，融合老钱、暗黑学院和静奢风格。
items.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic luxury autumn street-fashion editorial photograph of an explicitly adult East Asian woman sitting gracefully on wide stone steps outside an elegant historic European building. Give her long chestnut-brown hair in soft voluminous curls with full wispy curtain bangs, a half-up style secured by a cream ribbon clip, fair skin with a natural satin glow, soft rosy cheeks, subtle brown eye makeup, long curled lashes, naturally full brows, and muted rose lips. Dress her in a crisp ivory button-up shirt tucked into a high-waisted brown plaid pleated short skirt, paired with a slim chocolate-brown necktie; add sheer dark espresso tights and glossy dark-burgundy knee-high leather boots with square toes and elegant block heels. Keep the tights and skirt as complete adult fashion styling without exposure or sexualization. A luxurious burgundy leather shoulder bag rests beside her; she searches through it with one hand while casually holding a hardcover book and takeaway coffee in the other. Add small pearl studs and delicate minimal jewelry. Seat her naturally on the stone staircase with one knee slightly bent and her body leaning forward as she looks down into the handbag, creating a relaxed, candid everyday moment. Behind her is a grand dark-walnut doorway with classic European architectural details, aged stone walls, and wide granite steps, suggesting a quiet autumn morning in Paris, London, or Milan. Use soft overcast daylight with diffused natural illumination, gentle shadows, muted highlights, and rich earthy colors. Grade with espresso brown, burgundy, ivory, taupe, charcoal, and warm gray. The overall mood combines a luxury autumn campaign, old-money aesthetic, dark-academia fashion, European street style, Korean fashion editorial, vintage city lifestyle, and quiet luxury. Shoot on a Leica M11 with a Summilux-M 50mm f/1.4 ASPH lens, shallow depth of field, Kodak Portra 400 color grading, soft analogue film grain, RAW photography, ultra-realistic skin texture, and an authentic photographic finish. Negative: minor-like appearance, school-uniform roleplay, sexualized pose, transparent or revealing clothing, incorrect fingers, deformed limbs, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, cluttered background, oversaturation, low detail, garbled text, text, logos, watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张超写实奢华秋季街头时尚社论照片：一位明确成年的东亚女性优雅地坐在历史悠久欧洲建筑外的宽大石阶上。她有长栗褐色蓬松卷发、轻盈空气刘海、半扎发和奶油色丝带发夹；皮肤白皙并带自然缎面光泽，脸颊微红，配棕色眼妆、长睫毛、自然眉毛和柔和玫瑰色嘴唇。她穿整洁廓形象牙色纽扣衬衫，扎进高腰棕色格子百褶短裙，搭配细巧克力棕领带；穿深浓缩咖啡色连裤袜和亮面深酒红色过膝皮靴，方头、优雅粗跟。连裤袜和裙装属于完整成人时尚造型，不呈现暴露或色情化。身旁放奢华酒红色皮革肩背包，她一只手在包里翻找，另一只手自然拿着硬皮书和外带咖啡杯；配小珍珠耳钉和精致极简首饰。她坐在石梯上，一膝微弯，身体前倾，低头看向手提包，形成放松、自然、毫不费力的日常瞬间。背景为深胡桃木大门、古典欧洲建筑细节、陈旧石墙和宽阔花岗岩台阶，氛围可联想到巴黎、伦敦或米兰的安静秋日早晨。使用柔和阴天漫射光、细腻阴影、柔和高光和丰富土地色调；配色为浓缩咖啡棕、酒红、象牙、灰褐、炭灰和暖灰。整体为奢华秋季广告大片、老钱风、暗黑学院风、欧洲街头、韩国时尚社论、复古城市生活方式和静奢风。使用 Leica M11 配合 Summilux-M 50mm f/1.4 ASPH 镜头，浅景深、Kodak Portra 400 色彩分级、柔和模拟胶片颗粒、RAW 摄影、超写实皮肤纹理和真实照片质感。负面：未成年外观、校服角色化、色情化姿势、透明暴露服装、错误手指、畸形肢体、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、杂乱背景、过饱和、低细节、乱码、文字、Logo、水印。

items.title: 超写实东方古风成人女性自拍写真
items.description: 16:9 横构图的原创东方成年女性古风自拍，结合手机前置自拍空间、江南古院、浅色汉服和专业摄影级真实质感。
items.prompt: Create a 16:9 landscape hyper-realistic cinematic Oriental ancient-style portrait photograph of an original explicitly adult woman over 22. Give her a delicate natural East Asian face, soft bright eyes, fine realistic skin texture, understated natural makeup, and a gentle fresh classical temperament. Dress her in light-colored high-end Hanfu in moon white, pale cyan, and mist blue: a soft flowing wide-sleeved long dress with a complete opaque lining, refined traditional embroidery on cuffs and lapels, small floral tonal patterns, a woven waist belt, and classical accessories. Keep the clothing dignified, complete, opaque, and non-revealing. Tie her long black hair into an elegant traditional bun with pearl floral hairpins, white flower ornaments, and slender tassel earrings; retain naturally fluffy strands and realistic hair texture. Maintain a first-person mobile front-camera selfie viewpoint: both hands extend naturally toward the lens as if recording a travel moment, with one arm close to the camera creating slight foreground blur and a convincing selfie spatial relationship. She tilts her head slightly, smiles gently, and looks toward the phone lens with friendly natural intimacy rather than a model pose. Set the background in a Chinese classical garden courtyard with blue-tile eaves, wooden corridor pillars, carved window lattices, stone paths, a pond, weeping willows, spring foliage, and distant traditional architecture, creating a quiet elegant Jiangnan atmosphere. Use close-range wide-angle selfie perspective, slight depth of field, naturally blurred foreground arm, a clear face, and soft background bokeh. Use real professional photography, Sony A7R V / Leica SL3 imaging character, and 85mm portrait rendering as detail and tonal references without changing the mobile front-camera viewpoint. Let early-morning or dusk natural light enter from the side and rear, creating a soft warm rim light, slight atmospheric haze, and natural grain for a cinematic still-frame feeling. Preserve RAW photo texture, realistic skin, natural hands, believable fabric folds, and fine hair detail; use high dynamic range without excessive HDR. No illustration, anime, game CG, plastic skin, exaggerated beauty filters, text, or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张 16:9 横构图、超写实电影感东方古风人像摄影：主体是一位明确成年的原创东方女性角色（22 岁以上），拥有清秀自然的东方面容、柔和明亮的眼睛、真实细腻的皮肤纹理和淡雅自然妆容，呈现温婉清新的古典气质。她穿浅色高级汉服，使用月白、淡青、雾蓝色调，轻盈飘逸的宽袖长裙内有完整不透明衬层，袖口和衣襟带精致传统刺绣与小面积花卉暗纹，腰间系织带并搭配古典配饰；服装端庄、完整、不暴露。乌黑长发盘成优雅发髻，搭配珍珠花簪、白色花朵发饰和细长流苏耳饰，发丝自然蓬松且具有真实毛发质感。保持第一视角手机前置摄像头自拍：双手自然向前伸展，像在记录旅途瞬间，一只手臂靠近镜头形成轻微前景虚化遮挡，增强真实自拍空间感。她微微歪头，嘴角带温柔浅笑，眼神看向手机镜头，亲近自然而非模特摆拍。背景为中国古典园林庭院，包含青瓦屋檐、木质廊柱、雕花窗格、石板路、池塘、垂柳、春日花木和远处传统建筑轮廓，营造宁静雅致的江南古院。采用近距离广角自拍透视、轻微景深、前景手臂自然虚化、清晰面部和柔和背景散景；以真实专业摄影、Sony A7R V / Leica SL3 成像风格和 85mm 人像质感作为细节与色彩参考，但不改变手机前置自拍的视角关系。清晨或黄昏自然光从侧后方照入，形成柔和暖色轮廓光、轻微光雾和自然颗粒，呈现电影静帧。保留 RAW 照片质感、真实肤质、自然手部结构、可信布料褶皱和发丝细节，高动态范围但不过度 HDR；不要插画、动漫、游戏 CG、塑料皮肤、夸张美颜或文字水印。

items.title: 印度尼西亚成年女性复古 35mm 胶片六格拼贴
items.description: 同一位成年印度尼西亚女性在六个随性生活瞬间中的复古 Kodak Portra 400 胶片 contact sheet，带黑色胶片边框、时间戳和模拟瑕疵。
items.prompt: Create a 2:3 vertical photorealistic vintage analog 35mm film collage featuring the same explicitly adult Indonesian woman across six different candid moments. Use the uploaded identity reference to preserve her facial identity, long silky black hair, expressive eyes, effortless fashion, and realistic skin texture while changing the scene and action in each frame. The six moments are: relaxing indoors by a window; browsing vinyl records in a retro music store; sitting alone in a cozy café at night; walking through a city street illuminated by warm streetlights; taking a mirror selfie with a classic 35mm film camera; and sitting beside the beach at sunset. Make every frame feel like an authentic candid life moment, with natural facial proportions, visible pores, and tiny imperfections. Use Kodak Portra 400 35mm film, authentic analogue photography, disposable-camera character, warm nostalgic color grading, soft flash, fine film grain, faded colors, halation around highlights, light leaks, dust particles, tiny scratches, vignette, authentic film borders, timestamp imprints, and imperfect casual framing for a dreamy cinematic editorial narrative. Layout one 2:3 six-photo contact sheet, with clear black film borders and restrained Kodak Portra 400 markings in each frame. Keep the six frames clearly separated; do not add extra people, images outside the collage, complex text, or watermarks. Negative: minor-like appearance, inconsistent identity, different person in each frame, copied identity from another reference, excessive beauty retouching, plastic skin, modern digital-photo look, low detail, severe distortion, garbled text, extra readable text, logos, watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张 2:3 竖幅的逼真复古模拟 35mm 胶片六格拼贴，六个画面中始终是同一位明确成年的印度尼西亚女性；使用上传的身份参考保持她的面部身份、长而顺滑的黑发、富有表现力的眼睛、自然时尚感和真实皮肤纹理，同时让每格场景与动作不同。六个随性瞬间分别为：窗边室内放松；复古音乐店浏览黑胶唱片；深夜独坐温馨咖啡馆；走过被暖街灯照亮的城市街道；使用经典 35mm 胶片相机进行镜前自拍；日落时坐在海滩边。每格都像真实生活中的抓拍，保持自然面部比例、可见毛孔和微小瑕疵。采用 Kodak Portra 400 35mm 胶片、真实模拟摄影、一次性相机美学、温暖怀旧调色、柔和闪光、细腻胶片颗粒、褪色、亮部晕染、漏光、灰尘颗粒、微小划痕、暗角、真实胶片边框、时间戳印记和不完美随性构图，形成梦幻怀旧、电影化叙事的编辑摄影。布局为单张 2:3 六照片 contact sheet，每格有黑色胶片边框和适度的 Kodak Portra 400 标记；保持六格清晰分隔，不要额外人物、拼贴外的图像、复杂文字或水印。负面：未成年外观、身份不一致、每格不同人物、复制其他参考人物、过度美颜、塑料肌肤、现代数码照片质感、低细节、严重变形、乱码、额外可读文字、Logo、水印。

items.title: 夸张漫画风格幽默对决插画
items.description: 两个动画化漫画角色在充满动态线、气泡和手绘涂鸦的现代波普艺术场景中进行幽默戏剧性对决。
items.prompt: Create a playful comic-style digital illustration of two original animated, caricature-inspired characters in a humorous dramatic showdown. On the left, one character wears a sleek formal outfit and looks surprised, shocked, and slightly off-balance while reacting to the other character’s mischievous action. On the right, the second character wears a stylish oversized outfit with a confident, mischievous expression and a dynamic pose. Use exaggerated but clear facial expressions, energetic gestures, vibrant colors, and a modern pop-art comic aesthetic. Add two comic speech bubbles with bold, legible dialogue reading “OH NO!” and “GOTCHA!”; include a small crown, symbolic motion lines, swirls, arrows, and playful doodles so the dialogue and icons add personality. Use a textured paper background with soft pastel color splashes, filled with hand-drawn hearts, stars, lightning bolts, motion lines, swirls, arrows, and other playful doodles. Keep a clear face-off relationship, action direction, and visual hierarchy; make the image humorous, lively, detailed, and suitable for a social-media cartoon illustration. Do not include any readable text, logos, or watermarks other than “OH NO!” and “GOTCHA!”.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张充满趣味的漫画风格数字插画，表现两个动画化、漫画启发的原创角色进行一场幽默而戏剧性的对决。左侧角色穿修身正式服装，在回应对方调皮动作时显得惊讶、震惊并略微失去平衡；右侧角色穿时髦的大码服装，表情自信、调皮，姿势充满动感。使用夸张但清晰的面部表情、活泼姿势、鲜艳色彩和现代波普艺术漫画美学。添加两个带粗体可读对白的漫画气泡，分别写“OH NO!”和“GOTCHA!”；加入小皇冠、象征性运动线、漩涡、箭头和有趣涂鸦，让对白和图标增强角色个性。背景为带柔和粉彩色块飞溅的纹理纸张，填充手绘爱心、星星、闪电、运动线、漩涡、箭头和其他俏皮涂鸦。构图应有清晰的角色对峙关系、动作方向和视觉层次，幽默、生动、细腻，适合社交媒体卡通插画。除“OH NO!”和“GOTCHA!”外不要出现其他可读文字、Logo 或水印。

items.title: 波斯女骑兵与高跟鞋起源写实摄影
items.description: 身份绑定的 9:16 历史复原纪实摄影海报，以成年女性波斯骑兵在马背使用马镫和早期高跟骑兵靴的场景解释高跟鞋的骑兵用途。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical hyper-realistic historical reconstruction photograph in a National Geographic-style documentary and museum-restoration setting. Use a real full-frame camera, natural evening sunlight, auto exposure, auto white balance, real HDR, slight aerial perspective, subtle lens dust and motion blur. Preserve real leather texture, believable horse musculature, skin pores, and small imperfections; no skin smoothing, beautification, AI-drawing look, game CG, or movie-poster treatment. Use the uploaded identity reference to maintain the same 20-year-old explicitly adult fictional East Asian woman, with long straight black hair, natural refined features, and a firm gaze, while emphasizing historical reconstruction and functional cavalry action rather than sexualizing her body. Dress her in 10th-century Persian cavalry leather light armor with a deep red cloak and early high-heeled cavalry leather boots. She rides a fast-running black horse, drawing a bow toward the distance while standing securely in the stirrups; clearly show the boot heel firmly locked in the stirrup so the audience understands the historical narrative of high heels being used for cavalry combat. Set the scene in Persian wasteland with yellow sand, distant mountains, and sunset, like a real historical documentary reconstruction. At the top, use a restrained museum exhibition-board layout with clearly legible text: 高跟鞋的起源 / The Origin of High Heels. Below it show: 战争，而不是增高 / Created for War, Not Height. At the bottom show: 公元10世纪 波斯帝国 / 10th Century Persia. Keep all text clean, legible, restrained, and free of garbling. Keep a low-key artistic signature DeepBlue in the lower-left. Negative: minor-like appearance, sexualized pose, exaggerated body proportions, modern clothing or objects, incorrect horse anatomy, incorrect fingers, deformed weapon, incorrect heel-to-stirrup relationship, excessive HDR, smoothing, beautification, AI-drawing look, game CG, movie-poster treatment, extra text, garbled text, logos, watermarks (except the lower-left DeepBlue signature).
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖幅的超写实真人历史复原摄影图，采用 National Geographic 式历史纪录片摄影和博物馆复原现场质感；使用真实全画幅相机、自然傍晚阳光、自动曝光、自动白平衡、真实 HDR、轻微空气透视、镜头灰尘和运动模糊，保留真实皮革纹理、马匹肌肉结构、皮肤毛孔和细小瑕疵，不磨皮、不美颜、不像 AI 绘画、游戏 CG 或电影海报。使用上传的身份参考图保持同一位 20 岁明确成年的虚构东亚女性，保留黑色长直发、自然精致五官和坚定眼神，但以历史复原和功能性骑兵姿态为重点，不色情化身体。她身穿 10 世纪波斯骑兵皮革轻甲和深红披风，脚穿早期高跟骑兵皮靴，骑一匹高速奔跑的黑马；她一边拉弓瞄准远方，一边稳稳踩住马镫，镜头清晰捕捉靴跟牢牢卡在马镫中的功能关系，使观众理解高跟鞋与骑兵作战的历史叙事。背景为波斯荒原、黄沙、远山和夕阳，像真实历史纪录片复原现场。画面顶部采用博物馆展览牌风格，清晰显示以下文字：高跟鞋的起源 / The Origin of High Heels；下方显示：战争，而不是增高 / Created for War, Not Height；底部显示：公元10世纪 波斯帝国 / 10th Century Persia。所有文字清晰、排版克制、无乱码。左下角保留低调艺术签名 DeepBlue。负面：未成年外观、色情化姿势、夸张身体比例、现代服装或物件、错误马匹解剖、错误手指、武器变形、马镫与靴跟关系错误、过度 HDR、磨皮、美颜、AI 绘画感、游戏 CG、电影海报、额外文字、乱码、Logo、水印（左下角 DeepBlue 除外）。

items.title: 复古 1990s 高级时尚工作室成人女性人像
items.description: 同一位成年女性在豪华专业影棚中的 1990s 高端时尚特写，以栗色法式波波头、黑奶油条纹针织衫、柔光箱和 Portra 400 胶片质感为核心。
items.prompt: Create an ultra-photorealistic high-end fashion studio close-up of the same explicitly adult woman, using the uploaded identity reference to preserve her original facial identity, natural facial proportions, and lifelike skin detail; draw from iconic 1990s fashion advertising while remaining an original editorial image. Use intimate close-up framing, eye-level composition, and a relaxed playful pose. Give her an elegant oval face, naturally luminous skin, visible pores, and subtle facial dimension. Style a chin-length, no-bangs classic 1990s French bob in rich chestnut brown, with natural volume and softly inward-curved ends; a few wispy strands are gently moved onto the forehead, cheeks, and near the lips by a studio fan. Use natural soft-glam makeup: upward-brushed feathered brows, sharp winged eyeliner, dramatic black lashes, warm peach blush, soft contour, and nude matte lips with realistic detail. Dress her in an oversized deep off-shoulder fuzzy knit sweater with black-and-cream abstract stripes, moderately revealing one shoulder and the collarbone; give the knit realistic fibers, soft folds, and elegant drape, keeping the styling adult, dignified, and non-sexualized. Add a rose-gold Alhambra necklace, layered delicate rose-gold chains, Pandora bracelets, and long square nails with a clear base and small black-and-white rhinestone accents. She looks directly at the camera with relaxed confidence and slightly parted lips; one shoulder angles toward the lens, her head tilts gently, one hand touches the sweater collar, and the other rests out of frame. Add strong but controlled motion blur around the moving hair and sweater edges while keeping the face and eyes razor sharp. Use a luxury minimalist studio setup with one oversized softbox positioned at 45° to the side, subtle rim light, and gentle warm reflector fill; no harsh flash, with creamy highlights and delicate shadows. Set a seamless matte charcoal-black background fading into deep shadow with a barely visible floor reflection and soft atmospheric haze. Use a professional medium-format studio camera, 80mm portrait lens, f/1.8, extremely shallow depth of field, and precise focus on the eyes. Grade with warm golden-pink muted nostalgia, rich warm shadows, soft faded blacks, and natural skin tones. Apply Kodak Portra 400 film emulation, fine natural grain, organic analogue noise, soft bloom, gentle halation, slight lens softness, subtle vignette, and very light chromatic aberration for a timeless 1990s fashion-magazine aesthetic. Negative: minor-like appearance, copied identity from any other person, sexualized or overly revealing pose, harsh flash, generic modern commercial studio look, excessive smoothing, plastic skin, incorrect fingers, distorted anatomy, garbled text, piled-up logos, watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张同一位明确成年女性的超写实高端时尚工作室特写肖像，使用上传的身份参考保持她原本的面部身份、自然五官比例和真实皮肤细节；灵感来自 1990s 标志性时尚广告，但为原创编辑影像。采用亲密特写、眼平构图和轻松俏皮的姿势。她有优雅鹅蛋脸、自然透亮肤质、可见毛孔和细腻脸部立体感；发型为齐下巴、无刘海的经典 1990s 法式波波头，浓郁栗色、自然蓬松、发尾向内微卷，几缕碎发被柔和影棚风扇吹到额头、脸颊和嘴唇附近。妆容为自然柔光妆：向上梳理的羽毛眉、锐利翼形眼线、戏剧性黑色睫毛、暖桃色腮红、柔和修容和带真实细节的裸色哑光唇。穿大尺寸深落肩毛茸茸针织毛衣，黑白或黑奶油色抽象条纹，适度露出一侧肩膀和锁骨，针织物有真实纤维、柔软褶皱和优雅垂感；造型保持成人时尚、端庄而不色情化。配戴玫瑰金 Alhambra 项链、叠戴细玫瑰金链条、Pandora 手链和透明底长方形美甲，黑白水钻为小面积点缀。她放松直视镜头，嘴唇微张，一侧肩膀略朝镜头，头部轻倾，一只手轻触衣领，另一只手自然出画；头发和毛衣边缘有明显但受控的动态模糊，脸部和眼睛保持锐利清晰。影棚使用一只位于 45° 侧面的巨大柔光箱、微妙轮廓光和暖色反光板补光，无强烈闪光，形成奶油亮部与细腻阴影。背景为无缝哑光炭黑，渐入深影并带极轻微地面反射和柔和大气雾。使用专业中画幅影棚相机、80mm 肖像镜头、f/1.8、极浅景深，眼睛精准对焦。色彩为暖金粉、怀旧柔和色调、浓郁暖阴影、褪黑和自然肤色。使用 Kodak Portra 400 胶片模拟、细腻颗粒、有机模拟噪声、柔和光晕、高光晕染、轻微镜头柔和度、暗角和极轻微色差，呈现永恒的 1990s 时尚杂志美学。负面：未成年外观、复制其他人物身份、色情化或过度裸露姿势、刺眼闪光、现代商业棚拍感、过度磨皮、塑料肌肤、错误手指、畸形解剖、乱码、标志堆叠、水印。

items.title: 高信号双色品牌视觉海报
items.description: 可配置品牌、产品或原创人物 IP 的 3:4 双色视觉海报模板，以不平等的色彩权力、瑞士网格、运动轨迹和技术注释建立强记忆点。
items.prompt: Design a 3:4 vertical “High-Signal Two-Color Branding” poster for a futuristic electric vehicle. Electric Magenta is the absolute main color at about 75% of the image; Speed Blue is a scarce accent at no more than 10%; use only pure black and cool white for the remainder, and prohibit equal color distribution. Use a Swiss grid and bold asymmetrical composition, with an oversized title entering from the frame edges and allowed to crop naturally in places. Place the core subject off-center at about 45% of the frame, adding high-speed motion blur, scanning tracks, or directional ghosting to express ambition, speed, and upward momentum. Use bold geometric sans-serif type for the title, and monospaced type for numbers, coordinates, dates, and technical annotations. Add fine coordinate lines, arrows, sequence numbers, and a very small amount of data, but do not create a complex dashboard. Render a futuristic electric vehicle as high-finish photography or refined 3D visual, avoiding clichés such as handshakes, office buildings, and business meetings. Combine the visual systems of cutting-edge technology brands, trend magazines, and quantitative-finance graphics: eye-catching, precise, young, and impactful. Clearly display the title “High-Signal Two-Color Branding”; keep the small amount of technical text legible, concise, and free of garbling. The core logic is unequal color power: 75% main color builds memory, 10% accent color creates scarce focus, black and white provide information and breathing space, monospaced type conveys technical character, and motion imagery expresses brand personality. Negative: equal color distribution, complex dashboard, cheap template look, handshakes, office buildings, business meetings, cluttered data, unreadable text, garbled text, bad typography, a third oversaturated color, low detail, plastic materials, watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 为 a futuristic electric vehicle 设计一张 3:4 竖版“高信号双色品牌视觉”海报，标题逻辑为 High-Signal Two-Color Branding。电光洋红（Electric Magenta）作为绝对主色，占画面约 75%；速度蓝（Speed Blue）作为稀缺强调色，占比不超过 10%；其余只使用纯黑和冷白，禁止平均分配颜色。采用瑞士网格与大胆非对称构图，超大标题从画面边缘切入并允许自然局部裁切；核心主体偏离中心，占画面约 45%，带高速运动模糊、扫描轨迹或方向性拖影，表达野心、速度和上升感。标题使用粗体几何无衬线字体，数字、坐标、日期和技术注释使用等宽字体。加入细线坐标、箭头、序列编号和极少量数据，但不要复杂仪表盘。将 a futuristic electric vehicle 呈现为高完成度摄影或精致 3D 视觉，避免握手、写字楼和商务会议等陈词滥调。整体结合前沿科技品牌、潮流杂志与量化金融视觉系统，醒目、精准、年轻、有冲击力。画面清晰显示标题“High-Signal Two-Color Branding”，并让少量技术文字保持可读、简洁且无乱码。核心逻辑是颜色权力不平等：75% 主色建立记忆，10% 辅色制造稀缺焦点，黑白负责信息和呼吸感，等宽字体传递技术属性，运动图像表达品牌性格。负面：平均分配颜色、复杂仪表盘、廉价模板感、握手、办公楼、商务会议、杂乱数据、不可读文字、乱码、错误排版、过度饱和的第三颜色、低细节、塑料材质、水印。

items.title: 唐风女子石桌白梅清晨告别图
items.description: 连续四幕故事第 4 幕：同一位成年虚构东方女性在清晨庭院将白梅放在空石桌上，完成克制而释然的告别。
items.prompt: Generate one new independent image strictly at 941x1672 pixels in a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio; create only one image, with no collage, grid, long image, contact sheet, or multi-frame layout. Use the uploaded identity reference to maintain the same 26-year-old clearly adult fictional Oriental woman and visual system: soft oval face, slender phoenix eyes, long black hair partly draped and partly tied in a low bun, silver hairpin and small pearls, a complete moon-white and pale cyan-green Tang-style wide-sleeved robe, cyan-green embroidered waistband, long skirt, and light gauze shawl; the scene and action must change. This is image 4 of a continuous four-act story: an ancient-style Xianxia beauty image with a gentle older-sister mood, rendered as a realistic Oriental cinematic still, not an illustration or poster layout. Just after the morning mist dissipates, she returns alone to a quiet courtyard and places a small branch of white plum blossom on an empty light-gray stone table, like leaving a final farewell for a date that never happened. Only this one woman appears, with no other characters. She stands beside the stone table, body slightly turned toward the tabletop, left hand just released the flower branch, right hand gathering the light gauze shawl, frozen at the moment after the branch lands. Her shoulders and neck are relaxed, balance stable, head slightly lowered, gaze resting on the white plum branch rather than the camera; her expression is gentle, restrained, subtly disappointed but a little relieved, with no crying or melodrama. Keep the same moon-white and pale cyan-green Tang-style robe, hairstyle, silver hairpin, and small pearls. Add a slight dew feeling along the garment edges, while the clothing remains complete, dignified, opaque, and non-revealing. Retain only an empty light-gray stone table, one white plum branch on it, a half-open wooden window, and a few moist bamboo shadows; no flower sea, complex courtyard, or extra people. Use an upper-body-to-above-knees composition from eye level to slightly low angle, with the woman on the left and the table and white plum at lower right as the emotional focal point. Add a small patch of blurred leaf shadow in the foreground, keep the woman and table in the middle ground, and blur the background with shallow depth of field. Soft cool-white early-morning daylight enters from the right through the wooden window, illuminating her cheek, fingers, white plum, and silver hairpin while keeping shadows clean and readable. Use low-saturation moon white, pale cyan, gray-green, and very little warm beige, with realistic skin, stone, petal, and fabric texture, like the quiet lingering final frame of an Oriental film. No text, watermarks, logos, or gibberish.
items.prompt_zh: 生成一张新的独立图片，严格为 941x1672 像素、9:16 竖幅；只生成单图，不要拼图、网格、长图、联系人表或多画面。使用上传的身份参考图保持同一位 26 岁明确成年的虚构东方女性及其视觉系统：柔和鹅蛋脸、细长丹凤眼、黑色长发半披半挽的低位发髻、银色簪子和小珍珠、月白与淡青碧色完整唐风大袖衫、青碧刺绣腰封、长裙与轻纱披帛；必须改变场景和动作。这是连续四幕故事的第 4 张，主题为古风仙侠美人图、温柔姐姐感、写实东方电影剧照，不是插画或海报排版。清晨薄雾刚散，她独自回到安静庭院，把一枝小小白梅放在空着的浅灰石桌上，像给一场没有发生的约会留下最后告别。画面只有这一位女性，没有其他人物。她站在石桌旁，身体微侧向桌面，左手刚松开花枝，右手收拢轻纱披帛，动作停在花枝落下后的瞬间；肩颈舒展、重心稳定、头部微低，视线落在石桌上的白梅，不看镜头；表情温柔、克制、含蓄失落但带一点释然，不哭泣，不过度悲情。保持同一套月白淡青碧唐风大袖衫、同一发型、银簪和小珍珠；衣料边缘有轻微露水感，但服装完整、端庄、不透明、不暴露。场景只保留空旷浅灰石桌、桌上一枝白梅、背景半开的木窗和少量湿润竹影，不要花海、复杂庭院或额外人物。采用大半身到膝上构图、平视略低机位，人物位于左侧，石桌和白梅位于右下方作为情绪落点；前景有一小片虚化叶影，中景为人物和石桌，背景浅景深虚化。清晨右侧柔和冷白天光穿过木窗，照亮她的脸侧、手指、白梅和银簪，暗部干净可读。整体低饱和月白、淡青、灰绿和极少暖米色，呈现真实皮肤、石材、花瓣和衣料纹理，像东方电影最后一帧安静而有余韵的清晨。无文字、水印、logo 或乱码。

items.title: 2026 盛夏粉色救生塔成人女性
items.description: 韩国独立夏日美学的梦幻生活方式照片：成年女性坐在褪色珊瑚粉救生塔上，配合海滩物件、风筝和夏日日记文字。
items.prompt: Create a 3:4 vertical ultra-realistic cinematic dreamy lifestyle photograph celebrating the summer of 2026. An explicitly adult Korean woman sits alone on the upper platform of a faded coral-pink vintage lifeguard tower on a quiet seaside beach, captured from a close low-angle perspective; she is an adult lifestyle subject, not in a school uniform and not portrayed as a minor. Use tight framing focused on her upper body, dangling legs, and the weathered wooden platform. The tower feels naturally aged and sun-faded rather than newly painted. She sits casually on the edge wearing a pale blue-and-white striped sleeveless romper and lightweight white canvas sneakers, with a soft cream bucket hat resting loosely behind her head. A small vintage film camera hangs from one wrist while she holds a half-melted pastel popsicle in the other hand. She looks toward the distant ocean with a gentle, unposed smile expressing quiet freedom, summer anticipation, and a long carefree holiday. Her dark hair is tied in a loose low ponytail; wispy strands, striped fabric, and the hat ribbon flutter together in the warm coastal breeze. A translucent yellow kite is tied to the side railing, while a folded striped beach towel, small seashell pouch, and retro sunglasses sit beside her. Integrate cute hand-drawn doodles of tiny shells, smiling suns, waves, stars, hearts, sparkles, seagulls, and miniature fish. Across the open sky, clearly add white handwritten diary text: “SUMMER ’26”, “sea you soon”, “salt in the air”, and “stay golden”. Let a vast pale-blue sky and generous negative space dominate, with only a thin sparkling ocean horizon near the lower edge. Use bright coastal daylight, soft overexposed highlights, hazy dreamy glow, subtle lens bloom, pastel film tones, low contrast, smooth highlight roll-off, and naturally luminous textured skin. Use faded coral pink, powder blue, seafoam, translucent yellow, warm white, and sandy cream. The overall style is cinematic editorial lifestyle photography, Korean indie summer aesthetic, nostalgic youth-diary mood, Kodak Portra 160 film look, delicate grain, and dreamy photorealism. Negative: minor-like appearance, school uniform or student roleplay, sexualized pose, cheap illustration, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, excessive HDR, cluttered sky, garbled text, misspellings, extra text, logos, watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张 3:4 竖幅的超写实电影感梦幻生活方式照片，庆祝 2026 年夏季。画面中一位明确成年的韩国女性独自坐在安静海滨沙滩上一座褪色珊瑚粉色复古救生塔的上层平台，采用近距离低角度透视；她是成年生活方式人物，不穿校服、不呈现未成年角色。构图紧凑，集中表现她的上半身、悬空双腿和风化木质平台，救生塔自然老化、被阳光晒褪色而非新刷漆。她随意坐在平台边缘，穿淡蓝白条纹无袖连体短裤和轻便白色帆布运动鞋，奶油色渔夫帽松松挂在脑后；一只手腕挂小型复古胶片相机，另一只手拿半融化的马卡龙色冰棒。她带温和自然的微笑望向远方大海，表达宁静自由、夏日期待与悠长假期的感觉。深色头发扎成松散低马尾，发丝、条纹面料和帽子织带随温暖海风向同一方向轻摆。侧面栏杆系着半透明黄色风筝，身边有折叠条纹沙滩巾、贝壳小包和复古太阳镜。将贝壳、微笑太阳、波浪、星星、爱心、闪光、海鸥和迷你鱼等可爱手绘涂鸦自然融入场景。开阔天空中清晰加入白色手写日记文字：“SUMMER ’26”“sea you soon”“salt in the air”“stay golden”。大部分背景为淡蓝色夏季天空和宽阔留白，底部仅露一点闪烁海平线。使用明亮海岸日光、柔和过曝高光、朦胧光泽、细微镜头晕光、马卡龙胶片色调、低对比和平滑高光衰减，皮肤自然透亮并保留纹理。色彩为褪珊瑚粉、粉蓝、海沫绿、半透明黄、暖白和沙奶油。整体是电影感编辑生活方式摄影、韩国独立夏日美学、怀旧青春日记情绪、Kodak Portra 160 胶片感和细腻颗粒的梦幻写实主义。负面：未成年外观、校服或学生角色化、色情化姿势、廉价插画、塑料肌肤、过度磨皮、过度 HDR、杂乱天空、文字乱码、错误拼写、额外文字、标志、水印。

items.title: Y2K 夜店风东亚成人女性 CCD 直闪人像
items.description: 昏暗夜店或镜面电梯厅中的成人女性 Y2K 直闪肖像，强调真实 CCD 颗粒、蓝色轮廓光与早期数码相机的不完美感。
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic Y2K nightclub fashion portrait of an explicitly adult East Asian woman in a dim nightclub or mirrored elevator lobby. Frame her from the top of her head to mid-thigh, centered and facing the camera. She stands naturally upright with a slightly relaxed waist, left arm at her side, and right hand raised near her ear to touch an earring or tidy her hair. She looks directly into the lens with a calm, confident, slightly aloof expression and naturally parted lips. Give her a refined oval face, deep-brown almond eyes, natural thin brows, a slender nose bridge, and hydrated nude-pink lips. Use early 2000s nightclub makeup: thin black eyeliner, naturally full lashes, subtle warm eyeshadow, soft blush, and clear gloss. Preserve real pores, fine vellus hair, natural tone variation, slight post-dance moisture, and oily highlights; prohibit plastic smoothing. Her deep-black long hair falls naturally with a slightly wet, messy feel, strands touching her forehead, cheeks, neck, and shoulders, with blue light outlining the crown. Style her with large silver hoops, layered thin silver necklaces and a small pendant, a silver watch, a simple ring, and a small metallic silver underarm bag on her left shoulder. Dress her in a white fitted cropped crew-neck short-sleeve T-shirt with a low-saturation pale-pink vintage East Asian-inspired pattern, paired with a light-blue low-waist pleated denim skirt and silver studded belt with a large square buckle; keep the outfit complete, fitted, and adult-fashion appropriate. Set a black mirrored wall with vertical metal dividers behind her, showing repeated reflections, a blurred crowd, and scattered white sparkles. Capture the scene with an early 2000s portable digital camera and direct flash: strong frontal flash illuminates the subject, making skin slightly overexposed while the background is severely underexposed; add a small amount of blue nightclub light at the top. Include real CCD grain, subtle color noise, slight sharpening, edge vignetting, and on-site snapshot texture. Use a close-range 35mm or 50mm lens, low saturation, medium contrast. Negative: minor-like appearance, modern commercial studio look, soft beauty lighting, cartoon, CG, excessive smoothing, excessive HDR, exaggerated body shape, incorrect fingers, deformed arms, duplicated figures, incorrect mirror reflections, readable text, watermarks, logos.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张写实的 Y2K 夜店时尚肖像：一位明确成年的东亚女性站在昏暗夜店或镜面电梯厅内，画面从头顶到大腿中部，人物居中正面面对镜头。她自然站直，腰部微放松，左臂垂下，右手抬到耳边轻触耳环或整理头发；她直视镜头，神情冷静、自信而略带疏离，嘴唇自然微启。她有精致鹅蛋脸、深棕杏眼、自然细眉、纤细鼻梁和裸粉色水润唇，妆容为早 2000 年代夜店风：细黑眼线、自然睫毛、暖色眼影、柔和腮红和透明唇蜜。皮肤保留毛孔、细绒毛、自然色差、轻微汗意与油润高光，禁止塑料磨皮。深黑长发自然披散，略湿且凌乱，发丝贴在额头、脸侧、颈部和肩膀，头顶有蓝色灯光轮廓。佩戴银色圆环耳环、叠戴细银项链和小吊坠、银色腕表、简约戒指，左肩背小型金属银色腋下包。穿白色修身短款圆领短袖 T 恤，布面有低饱和浅粉色复古东方图案；搭配浅蓝色低腰百褶牛仔短裙、银色铆钉腰带和大号方扣，服装保持完整、合身且为成人时尚。背景为黑色镜面墙和竖向金属分隔条，可见重复反射、模糊人群与零散白色闪光点。使用早 2000 年代便携数码相机直闪，强烈正面闪光照亮主体，主体略微过曝而背景严重欠曝，顶部有少量蓝色夜店光。加入真实 CCD 颗粒、细微彩色噪点、轻微锐化、边缘暗角和现场抓拍质感；使用 35mm 或 50mm 近距离镜头，低饱和、中等对比。负面：未成年外观、现代商业棚拍、柔光美容灯、卡通、CG、过度磨皮、过度 HDR、夸张身材、错误手指、畸形手臂、重复人物、错误镜像、可读文字、水印、Logo。

items.title: 写实东亚女性蜘蛛主题紧身衣低角度人像
items.description: 3:4 低角度写实 cosplay 肖像，以原创蜘蛛主题英雄连体衣、可信解剖和暗色工业背景为重点。
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 3:4 low-angle cosplay portrait of an explicitly adult East Asian woman standing against a dark gray concrete wall. She has a refined sweet face, naturally fair skin, soft red lips, subtle eyeliner, a sleek chin-length black bob, and long side-swept bangs partly covering one eye; her expression is calm, confident, and slightly playful. She has a tall, naturally balanced figure with a narrow waist, natural hip curves, and believable proportions. She wears an original, non-franchise red, blue, and black spider-themed superhero bodysuit with long sleeves, integrated gloves, detailed white web lines, and a simple abstract white spider emblem centered on the chest rather than any existing branded logo. The material shows realistic elastic tension, seams, and soft reflective highlights. Turn her body slightly sideways with one hip toward the camera, gently tilted shoulders, and both arms opened outward; one gloved hand gives a relaxed thumbs-up. Shoot from waist height with a mild upward perspective so the foreground hip and thigh appear slightly closer while anatomy remains believable. Use dim indoor light, soft frontal illumination, subdued shadows, and a dark industrial atmosphere for realistic smartphone cosplay photography. Preserve natural skin and fabric detail. No mask, extra text, watermark, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, existing superhero insignia, or brand marks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张写实的 3:4 低角度 cosplay 肖像：一位明确成年的东亚女性站在深灰色混凝土墙前。她有精致甜美的脸、白皙自然的皮肤、柔和红唇、细微眼线、齐颔黑色短发和长侧分刘海，表情冷静、自信而略带俏皮。她身形高挑且自然匀称，腰部纤细、臀胯有自然曲线，比例可信。她穿原创、非特定授权角色的红蓝黑三色蜘蛛主题超级英雄连体衣，长袖、连体手套和精致白色蛛网纹路，胸口中央是简洁的抽象白色蜘蛛徽记而非现有品牌标志；面料呈现真实弹性张力、缝线和柔和反光。身体略侧向一边，一侧臀部朝向相机，肩膀微倾，双臂向外张开，一只戴手套的手做放松的点赞手势。以腰部高度拍摄并采用轻微向上视角，让前景髋部和大腿略近，同时保持可信解剖。室内光线昏暗，柔和正面光、克制阴影和深色工业氛围，呈现真实智能手机 cosplay 摄影；保留自然皮肤与织物细节。无面具、无额外文字、无水印、无畸形解剖、无多余手指、无现有超级英雄标志或品牌。

items.title: 极高质感台湾深度旅行规划叙事海报
items.description: 第一人称俯视旅行规划板海报，以台湾路线、纸张与旅行物件的触觉现实主义讲述出发前的旅程。
items.prompt: Create a 4:5 vertical ultra-premium Taiwan travel-planning narrative poster in a strict first-person overhead flat-lay view: the viewer stands inside the composition, with their own legs and shoes visible at the bottom center, surrounded by a carefully edited physical journey board. Use a dark weathered stone or charcoal pavement-like base. Arrange a Taiwan map cutout with one elegant route and destination pins, a route drawing, itinerary sheet, date card, boarding-pass-style papers, handwritten route notes, a premium travel camera, a worn leather or canvas shoulder bag, ticket slips, postcard fragments, a Jiufen lantern-street sketch card, a tea-house stop note, an Alishan sunrise reminder, and a railway timetable fragment; every object must feel tactile, intentional, and editorially placed, never random. The map must clearly communicate Taiwan and a poetic route connecting Taipei, Jiufen, Alishan, Tainan, and a final coastal or city return, with subtle cues for old streets, rail travel, tea culture, mountain sunrise, temples, and night markets. Add refined hand-drawn dotted routes, arrows, circles, direction marks, and light handwritten English travel notes. Clearly show the main title “TAIWAN Journey” and the supporting words “EXPLORE / WANDER / TASTE / SUNRISE / RETURN”. Give paper crisp fibers, folded edges, tape marks, slight warping, tiny tears, and print texture; give the map visible thickness, lifted shadows, and wear; give the bag leather or canvas grain and stitching; give the camera metal reflections, lens depth, tiny scratches, and premium mechanical detail; give denim and shoes believable folds, laces, rubber edges, and subtle wear. Frame the poster with torn paper, transit-map fragments, tea-stained paper, and warm orange-muted-red collage accents while keeping it clean and premium. Use soft warm directional cinematic light from above to reveal material textures, with delicate refined shadows. Use burnt orange, lantern amber, warm cream, charcoal black, weathered gray, leather brown, aged-paper beige, faded denim blue, moss green, muted rail red, and tea brown, with tiny restrained night-market glow accents only. The result is hyper-real, immersive, handcrafted, cinematic, culturally grounded, exploratory, and slightly nostalgic—the moment before departure. Negative: cheap scrapbook look, cluttered layout, cartoon icons, low-detail objects, unreadable handwriting, Cambodia references, generic tropical cliches, flat lighting, plastic materials, bad typography, oversaturation, random props, weak Taiwan identity, digital UI, low-resolution textures.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张 4:5 竖幅的超高质感台湾旅行规划叙事海报，严格采用第一人称俯视平铺视角：观众站在构图内部，底部中心可见自己的双腿和鞋子，周围是被精心编辑排列的实体旅行规划板。底面为深色风化石材或炭黑人行道纹理。放置台湾地图剪纸、带一条优雅路线和目的地别针的路线图、行程表、日期卡、登机牌风格纸张、手写路线笔记、优质旅行相机、磨损皮革或帆布单肩包、票据、明信片碎片、九份灯笼街素描卡、茶馆停留笔记、阿里山日出提醒和铁路时刻表碎片；每件物品真实、触感丰富、经过有意编排，绝不随机。地图清楚呈现台湾轮廓和连接台北、九份、阿里山、台南以及最终海岸或城市回归的诗意路线，辅以老街、铁路旅行、茶文化、山间日出、寺庙和夜市的细微视觉线索。整幅海报加入精致手绘虚线路线、箭头、圈选、方向标记和轻盈的英文手写提示。主标题必须清晰显示“TAIWAN Journey”，并显示“EXPLORE / WANDER / TASTE / SUNRISE / RETURN”。纸张呈现纤维、折痕、胶带痕迹、轻微翘曲、细小撕裂和印刷纹理；地图有厚度、阴影与磨损，包有皮革或帆布纹理和缝线，相机有金属反射、镜片深度和细小划痕，牛仔裤和鞋子有可信褶皱、鞋带、橡胶边缘与轻微磨损。边缘使用撕裂纸、交通地图碎片、茶渍纸和温暖橙红色拼贴，但保持干净高级。使用上方落下的柔和暖色定向电影光，细致揭示材料纹理，阴影柔和精致。配色为焦橙、灯笼琥珀、暖奶油、炭黑、风化灰、皮革棕、旧纸米、褪色牛仔蓝、苔藓绿、柔和铁路红和茶褐色，仅以微小细节加入克制夜市光泽。整体超写实、沉浸、手工制作、电影化、文化底蕴浓厚、充满探索感和出发前的怀旧浪漫。负面：廉价剪贴簿感、凌乱布局、卡通图标、低细节、难以辨认的手写、柬埔寨参考、泛化热带陈词滥调、平淡光线、塑料材质、糟糕排版、过饱和、随机道具、微弱台湾身份、数字 UI、低分辨率纹理。

items.title: 国际主义平面设计风格蜈蚣的妙用
items.description: 以蜈蚣为核心的知识型编辑海报，将国际主义网格与构成主义、达达拼贴和信息可视化融合。
items.prompt: Design a knowledge-driven editorial poster about “蜈蚣的妙用”, titled “The Uses of Centipedes”, using a synthesis of International Typographic Style, Bauhaus, Constructivism, Dada collage, postmodern deconstruction, editorial design, information visualization, Gestalt psychology, and visual semiotics. Make a carefully observed centipede with clear anatomy the central visual anchor, surrounded by modular grids, numbered annotations, concise linear diagrams, and layered information cards explaining its body structure, ecological role, and symbolic meaning in traditional culture; do not depict gore, harm, or dangerous procedures. Integrate the grid order associated with Josef Müller-Brockmann, Jan Tschichold’s typographic discipline, Wolfgang Weingart’s experimental typography, David Carson’s deconstructive tension, Kohei Sugiura’s layered information organization, and Kenya Hara’s awareness of white space. Use an extremely restrained achromatic base with one high-brightness, high-saturation accent color, controlled color-area proportions, brightness collision, figure-ground reversal, and a local visual burst. Build the composition with asymmetrical balance, scale shifts, local boundary breaks, density gradients, layered collage, diagonal momentum, visual anchors, golden-ratio relationships, white-space cuts, rhythmic repetition, and an off-center focus. Contrast serif and sans-serif type, oversized display lettering with miniature explanatory text, coordinated Chinese and Latin type structures, mixed horizontal and vertical layout, italic emphasis, and alternating tight tracking and generous leading to create a magazine-like multi-layer reading path. Keep the overall mood rational, avant-garde, academic, experimental, sharp, restrained, unfamiliar, retro-futurist, knowledge-dense, and intellectually lively. Clearly show the Chinese title “蜈蚣的妙用” and the English subtitle “The Uses of Centipedes”; keep all other explanatory copy minimal, legible, and free of garbling.
items.prompt_zh: 设计一张关于“蜈蚣的妙用”的知识型编辑海报，采用国际主义平面设计、包豪斯、构成主义、达达拼贴、后现代解构、编辑设计、信息可视化、格式塔心理学与视觉符号学的综合语言。画面以一只经过准确观察、结构清晰的蜈蚣作为中央视觉锚点，用模块化网格、编号标注、简洁线性图示和分层信息卡片解释其身体结构、生态角色与传统文化中的象征意义；不表现血腥、伤害或危险操作。融合 Josef Müller-Brockmann 式网格秩序、Jan Tschichold 式字体纪律、Wolfgang Weingart 式实验排版、David Carson 式解构张力、杉浦康平式多层信息组织与原研哉式留白意识。使用极度克制的无彩基底，搭配单一高明度高纯度强调色，控制色块比例，形成明度对撞、图底反转和局部视觉爆破。采用非对称平衡、尺度突变、局部越界、密度梯度、层叠拼贴、斜向动势、黄金分割、留白切割、节奏重复与中心偏移。使用衬线体和无衬线体强对比，超大展示字与微型说明字并置，中英文字体骨架协调，横竖混排、倾斜强调、紧密字距与疏朗行距交替，建立杂志式多层阅读路径。整体理性、前卫、学术、实验、锐利、克制、陌生、复古未来、知识密集而充满生命力。明确显示中文标题“蜈蚣的妙用”和英文副标题“The Uses of Centipedes”；其余说明文字保持清晰、少量、可读且不生成乱码。

items.title: 东方古典成年女性电影肖像摄影
items.description: 一张 9:16 写实古装电影感人像，原创 22 岁以上成年女性身着月白冰蓝汉服，在深色冷雾空间中以 45° 侧身、左侧白色主光和东方古典发饰呈现清冷叙事氛围。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical ultra-photorealistic Oriental classical female cinematic portrait featuring a completely original, clearly adult Oriental woman over 22. Her temperament is cool, quiet, restrained, and elegant, with the still narrative feeling of a real historical-film character. Give her a natural Oriental face, realistic skin texture and fine pores, a small natural mole near the eye, gently closed light-pink lips, and a calm thoughtful expression. Keep the face basically toward the camera, tilt the head down about 5°–10° with the chin slightly tucked, show both eyes fully, and direct the gaze toward the far right. Rotate the body about 45° toward frame-left, with the left shoulder slightly closer and the right shoulder back; keep the torso upright but relaxed. Both hands rest naturally in front of the body, softly covered by wide Hanfu sleeves, with a foreground sleeve close to the lens. Style long black hair in a dignified Oriental high bun with a few face-framing strands, white pearls, light-blue jade, golden filigree hairpins, white-jade flowers, and slender tassels. Dress her in moon-white and light ice-blue Hanfu: a light ice-blue cross-collar long skirt with a white lightweight wide-sleeved outer layer; keep the inner layer opaque while the outer gauze sleeves have natural translucent light transmission. Show realistic silk texture, natural folds, and restrained three-dimensional floral embroidery on shoulders, cuffs, and chest. Set the scene in a dark gray-black Oriental fantasy film space with no clear architecture or identifiable environment, only continuous cold-white cinematic fog. The fog diffuses from behind and is highly blurred, creating slight foreground haze, a clear subject, and disappearing cold fog in the background. Use Low Key Cinematic Lighting with the main light clearly from about 45° front-left and slightly above eye level, softly illuminating forehead, nose bridge, cheeks, chin, neck, shoulders, chest Hanfu, and foreground sleeve; create a white highlight on the left while keeping the background dark with only a faint cool hair edge light, never making backlight dominant. Use ARRI ALEXA 65 cinematic-camera texture, an 85mm cinematic portrait lens, F1.4, shallow depth of field, precise eye focus, Kodak Vision3 film color, natural film grain, and high dynamic range. Preserve realistic film exposure, cold soft fog, silk, and embroidery; no text, logo, or watermark. Avoid sharp head turns, 90-degree profile, direct camera gaze, raised head, overly dark face, body facing right or front, clear architecture, clumped smoke, anime, CG, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, HDR halo, oversaturation, studio costume-photo styling, malformed fingers, and deformed limbs.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张 9:16 竖幅超写实东方古典女性电影肖像，主体为一位 22 岁以上、完全原创且明确成年的东方女性角色。她气质清冷、安静、克制、优雅，具有真实古装电影中的沉静叙事感；自然东方脸型、真实皮肤纹理与细小毛孔，眼角保留一颗自然小痣，浅粉嘴唇轻闭，表情平静而若有所思。脸部基本朝向镜头，头部向下约 5°–10°，下巴轻收，双眼完整可见，目光偏向画面右侧远方。身体向画面左侧旋转约 45°，左肩略近镜头，右肩向后，身体挺拔但放松；双手自然位于身前，被宽大汉服衣袖柔和覆盖，前景衣袖靠近镜头。黑色长发盘成端庄东方高髻，带少量脸侧碎发，配白色珍珠、淡蓝玉石、金色花丝发簪、白玉花饰和细长流苏。身穿月白与浅冰蓝汉服：浅冰蓝交领长裙搭配白色轻薄广袖外层，内层保持不透明，外层纱袖呈自然半透明透光效果；丝绸质感、自然褶皱和肩部/袖口/胸前真实立体花卉刺绣清晰可见，装饰克制不过度华丽。背景为深灰黑色东方幻想电影空间，取消清晰建筑和可识别环境，只保留连续冷白电影雾气；雾气从人物背后扩散并高度虚化，形成前景轻雾、人物清晰、背景冷雾消失的层次。使用 Low Key Cinematic Lighting，明确主光从人物左前方约 45°、略高于眼睛的位置照入，柔和白光照亮额头、鼻梁、双颊、下巴、颈肩、胸前汉服和前景衣袖，左侧形成白色高光，背景低亮并仅有极轻冷色发丝边缘光；不是逆光主导。使用 ARRI ALEXA 65 电影摄影机质感、85mm 电影人像镜头、F1.4、浅景深、眼睛精准对焦、Kodak Vision3 电影胶片色彩、自然胶片颗粒和高动态范围。保持真实电影曝光、冷色柔雾、真实丝绸与刺绣；无文字、logo、水印。避免大幅转头、90° 侧脸、直视镜头、抬头、面部过暗、身体朝右或正面站立、清晰建筑、块状烟雾、动漫、CG、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、HDR 光晕、过饱和、影楼古装感、错误手指和肢体。

items.title: 棕榈树下果绿蝴蝶针织裙身份一致性夜间人像
items.description: 一张绑定上传参考外貌的 4:5 夜间智能手机肖像，成年女性站在多风热带棕榈树下，果绿色蓬松针织裙、黑色蝴蝶图案、银色水钻肩带与直接闪光构成真实随手抓拍。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the primary facial and appearance reference, preserving recognizable identity, facial proportions, natural asymmetry, realistic skin texture, and Korean glass-skin glow, but do not carry over the reference background. Create a 4:5 vertical realistic iPhone 17 Pro rear-camera night portrait of a clearly adult woman beneath tall palm trees on a windy tropical night. A companion holds the phone just outside the frame at upper-torso height with a subtle approximately 7° Dutch tilt. Frame from the top of the head to the upper thighs, place her slightly camera-left, keep a thick palm trunk prominent on the right, and show readable palm fronds, bark, distant city or waterfront lights, and comfortable dark-sky headroom. Most weight rests on the rear left leg; the right foot steps half a foot forward with almost no weight, the pelvis shifts toward the left hip and naturally counter-rotates against the ribcage, and the spine follows a relaxed S-curve. Her neck turns toward the phone; she looks through a few windswept strands with a calm, quietly confident expression and naturally closed coral-rose lips. Her right hand lightly holds a slim silver rhinestone crossbody strap near the sternum while her left hand rests by the upper thigh, partly covered by the sleeve; keep exactly two arms and two hands with natural fingers and wrists. Long voluminous deep espresso-black hair with a soft off-center part blows toward the right while at least one eye remains clear. She wears an oversized lime-green fuzzy mohair-like knitted mini sweater dress with a relaxed round neckline, dropped shoulders, voluminous sleeves, elongated cuffs, handmade yarn irregularity, and clear fiber texture. Arrange distinct black knitted butterfly motifs asymmetrically across the chest, sleeves, waist, and lower body. Add minimalist silver jewelry and a small crystal tassel. Use strong direct iPhone flash as the key light on face, hair, yarn, butterfly motifs, hands, jewelry, and nearby bark; let the distant tropical environment recede naturally into darkness. Keep realistic flash falloff, deep focus, mild low-light noise, true color, slight wide-angle perspective, and natural handheld distortion, with no cinematic rim light, studio lighting, Portrait Mode blur, or cinematic grading. Focus on the eyes, identity-consistent face, windblown hair, knit fibers, butterfly motifs, hand placement, and rhinestone strap. No text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传参考图作为主要面部与外貌依据，保持可识别身份、面部比例、自然不对称、真实肤质和韩国水光肌，但不要把参考图背景带入。创建一张 4:5 竖幅真实 iPhone 17 Pro 后置摄像头夜间肖像：一位明确成年的女性站在多风的热带夜晚高大棕榈树下，由同伴在画外以上半身高度手持拍摄，保持约 7° 的轻微荷兰倾斜。主体从头顶构图到大腿上部，稍偏画面左侧；粗壮棕榈树干在右侧突出，棕榈叶、树皮和远处城市或海滨灯光清晰可辨，保留舒适深色天空空间。身体大部分重量落在后方左腿，右脚向前半步几乎不承重，骨盆向左髋移动并与肋骨形成自然反向旋转；脊柱为放松 S 曲线。颈部转向手机，眼神透过少量风吹发丝看向镜头，表情平静、内敛而自信，珊瑚玫瑰色嘴唇自然闭合。右手在胸骨附近轻握纤细银色水钻斜挎带，左手放在大腿上部并部分被袖子遮盖；严格保持两条手臂和两只手，手指与手腕自然。长而浓密的深咖啡黑色发丝带柔和偏分，被热带风吹向右侧并保持至少一只眼睛清晰。穿超大号果绿色蓬松马海毛质感针织迷你毛衣裙，宽松圆领、落肩、蓬松袖口和真实手工纱线纹理；胸部、袖子、腰部和下身不对称分布清晰的黑色蝴蝶针织图案。搭配简约银饰、耳饰和小水晶流苏。使用强烈直接 iPhone 闪光作为主光源，照亮面部、头发、针织纱线、蝴蝶图案、双手、珠宝和近处树皮；远处自然退入深色，保持真实闪光衰减、深焦、轻微低光噪点、真实色彩、轻微广角透视和自然手持畸变，不使用电影轮廓光、棚灯、人像模式虚化或电影调色。画面重点为眼睛、身份一致的面部、风吹发丝、针织纤维、蝴蝶图案、手部放置与水钻肩带；无文字、logo、水印。

items.title: 未来女性四种温柔坚定独立的概念肖像
items.description: 一组四张独立的成年女性概念肖像，以不同姿势和气质表达温柔而不软弱、迷人而坚韧、敢于不同及坚定选择自我道路的未来女性主题。
items.prompt: Generate 4 independent conceptual portraits of future women; do not combine the four images into a collage or a single canvas. Keep a unified premium editorial-photography language while giving each image a clearly different pose, body language, expression, and composition. All subjects are clearly adult women with modern individualized styling rather than stereotyped gender symbols; preserve natural proportions, realistic skin, and clear facial features. Image 1 expresses “gentle yet not weak” through an open relaxed posture, soft gaze, and grounded stance. Image 2 expresses “charming yet full of vigor” through a confident dynamic pose, clear weight shift, and energized expression. Image 3 expresses “daring to be different” through asymmetrical styling, an unconventional pose, or an unexpected composition that communicates an active choice of difference. Image 4 expresses “firmly choosing her own path” through facing the distance or stepping forward with a clear gaze, independence, and resolve. Backgrounds, clothing, palettes, and props may vary by theme, but the series must remain modern, realistic, refined, and subtly futuristic. Do not reduce women’s value to beauty; emphasize wisdom, confidence, resilience, difference, and independence. Use natural or controlled editorial lighting, tactile materials, and readable gestures to create a premium conceptual portrait series that celebrates self-determined identity.
items.prompt_zh: 请生成 4 张独立的未来女性概念肖像，不要拼图或把四张画面合并在同一画布；四张保持统一的高级编辑摄影语言，但每张使用明显不同的姿势、身体语言、表情和构图。主体均为明确成年的女性，造型现代、个性化且不依赖刻板性别符号，保持自然比例、真实皮肤和清晰面部。第一张表达“温柔却不软弱”：放松开放的姿态、柔和目光与坚定站姿。第二张表达“迷人却充满魄力”：自信动态姿态、明确的身体重心和有能量的表情。第三张表达“敢于与众不同”：不对称造型、非传统姿势或独特构图，呈现主动选择差异的态度。第四张表达“坚定选择自己的道路”：面向远方或向前迈步的姿态，目光清晰，体现独立与决心。背景、服装、配色和道具可随主题变化，但整体应现代、真实、精致而具有未来感；避免把女性价值简化为美貌，重点表现智慧、自信、韧性、差异和独立精神。使用自然或受控编辑光线、细腻材质和清晰动作，形成一组鼓励自我选择的高端概念人像系列。

items.title: 街边旧店门槛东亚成年女性生活方式人像
items.description: 一张 1:1 方形街头生活方式抓拍，成年东亚女性坐在旧店门槛边用吸管饮用汽水，强烈夏日光、深色门洞、飞扬长发和便携数码相机质感构成冷清自然的画面。
items.prompt: Create a 1:1 square single-person street-side lifestyle portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman sitting in the open threshold of an old street shop, using an eye-level slightly high angle and an approximately 28–35mm portable digital-camera view with a two-thirds-body seated composition. She leans slightly forward with knees naturally together; one hand hangs relaxed before the knees while the other holds a dark glass soda bottle and gently drinks through a thin straw, looking quietly at the camera. Keep her eyes naturally open, brow relaxed, lips lightly holding the straw, and expression restrained with a summer-daydreaming feeling of being photographed by chance. Strong wind blows her deep-black long hair to the right, with lifted crown and face-side strands and clearly separated individual locks. She wears a loose lightweight white short-sleeve dress in matte cotton with natural cuff and hem folds and no complex decoration. Place her center-bottom, framed by the deep blue-black shop doorway; retain old walls, metal door frames, transparent sliding doors, and a small amount of blurred goods at both sides, with all package text blurred and unreadable. Strong direct summer sunlight enters from the upper left front, putting face, white dress, forearms, and legs in bright highlights while preserving features, knees, and garment edges; keep the doorway in deep blue-black shadow. Use an overall cool-blue cast: approximately 40% cool-white/light-blue highlights, 30% deep blue-black doorway and hair, 20% gray-blue cement and frames, balanced by warm ivory skin and soft pink lips. Preserve early portable-digital-camera straight-out-of-camera texture, slight low-resolution compression, limited dynamic range, local edge sharpening, and no obvious portrait-mode blur. Keep it a real candid summer street snapshot, cool, natural, windy, and lived-in. Avoid an underage or childlike appearance, heavy makeup, plastic skin, warm-yellow filter, studio feel, HDR, over-sharpening or saturation, pure white background, fully blurred background, overbright doorway, blown-out face, transparent clothing, incorrect fingers or bottle/straw intersections, extra limbs, regular fan-shaped hair, clear brand logos, text, and watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张 1:1 方形单人街边生活方式人像，主体为一位明确成年的东亚女性，坐在旧式街边小店敞开的门槛中央，采用平视略高机位和约 28–35mm 便携数码相机视角，呈现三分之二身坐姿。她身体微微前倾、双膝自然并拢，一只手在膝前松弛垂落，另一只手握深色玻璃汽水瓶，通过细吸管轻轻饮用，正面安静地看向镜头；双眼自然睁开、眉间舒展、嘴唇轻含吸管，表情克制，带夏日放空和偶然被拍到的感觉。深黑色长发被强风吹向画面右侧，发顶和脸侧碎发向上扬起，独立发束清楚可见，形成横向动态。她穿宽松轻薄白色短袖连衣裙，哑光棉质面料，袖口和裙摆有自然褶皱，无复杂装饰。人物位于画面中央偏下，深蓝黑色店内门洞从身后框住脸部和白衣，左右保留旧墙、金属门框、透明推拉门和少量模糊货物，包装文字全部模糊不可读；门框构成竖向边界，人物形成稳定中轴，向右飞扬的头发打破对称。强烈夏日直射日光从前方偏左上照射，面部、白衣、前臂和双腿处于明亮高光区但保留五官、膝盖与衣物轮廓，门洞内部保持深蓝黑阴影。整体冷蓝色调，冷白和浅蓝高光约 40%，深蓝黑门洞与头发约 30%，灰蓝水泥和门框约 20%，浅暖象牙肤色与柔粉唇色平衡画面。保持早期便携数码相机直出、轻微低分辨率压缩、有限动态范围、局部边缘锐化和非人像模式背景；真实夏日街头抓拍，清冷、自然、有风感和生活气息。避免未成年感、儿童脸、浓妆、塑料皮肤、暖黄滤镜、棚拍、HDR、过度锐化/饱和、纯白背景、背景完全虚化、门洞过亮、脸部过曝、透明衣物、手指或瓶子穿插错误、多余肢体、规则扇形发丝、清晰品牌标志、文字和水印。

items.title: 绑定参考外貌的地铁早高峰通勤补觉成年女性
items.description: 一张 3:4 竖幅真实手机通勤抓拍，仅使用上传参考图的人物外貌，在普通早高峰地铁车厢中重建成年女性抱帆布包短暂补觉的生活瞬间。
items.prompt: Create a 3:4 vertical single real mobile-phone commute snapshot with no collage, four-grid, infographic, or text. Use only the facial features, face shape, long straight black hair, and realistic skin texture of the adult Asian woman in the uploaded reference image, preserving her consistent appearance; completely reconstruct an ordinary morning-peak subway carriage and do not carry over the reference background. In the early morning, she sits on an ordinary city subway seat wearing a light-gray sleeveless knit top, dark-gray loose long skirt, and flat shoes, with a light canvas bag on her lap. She leans naturally against the seat back, gently hugs the bag with both hands, tilts her head slightly to one side, and keeps her eyes closed as if taking a brief nap for a few stops. She is not deeply asleep: brows and eyes relaxed, lips naturally closed, breathing steady. Long black hair falls over her shoulders and chest with a few stray strands at the side of her face. Keep the posture relaxed and realistic; she must not lean on a stranger, snore with her mouth open, or drool. The background is an ordinary morning-peak subway carriage with handrails, route maps, doors, cool-white ceiling lights, and several normal commuters; some look at their phones and some rest with eyes closed, all seated facing the front or back of the carriage without staring at her. Use an ordinary rear mobile-phone camera with an approximately 26mm wide-angle view, shot from an obliquely opposite seat or the side of the aisle in a medium composition. Retain slight carriage shake and natural motion blur while keeping her face clear, with realistic skin texture, mild under-eye fatigue, stray hair, clothing wrinkles, and everyday commute clutter. Avoid posing, commercial subway-ad styling, an empty or luxury carriage, all passengers looking at the camera, wrong passenger orientation, face swap, facial drift, changed hair, disappearing canvas bag, extra arms, malformed fingers, text, and watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张 3:4 竖幅单张真实手机通勤抓拍，不要拼贴、四宫格、信息图或文字。仅参考上传参考图中成年亚洲女性的五官、脸型、黑色长直发和真实肤质，保持人物外貌一致；完全重建普通早高峰地铁车厢场景，不把参考图背景带入。清晨通勤时间，主体坐在普通城市地铁座位上，穿浅灰色无袖针织上衣、深灰色宽松长裙和平底鞋，浅色帆布包放在腿上。她自然靠着座椅靠背，双手轻轻抱住帆布包，头略偏向一侧，双眼闭合，像趁几站路短暂补觉；不是深度睡着，眉眼放松、嘴唇自然闭合、呼吸平稳。黑色长发自然落在肩膀和胸前，少量碎发遮住脸侧；姿态松弛真实，不歪倒在陌生人身上，不张嘴打呼或流口水。背景是普通早高峰地铁车厢，包含扶手、路线图、车门、冷白顶灯和几位正常通勤乘客；乘客有人低头看手机、有人闭眼休息，统一朝车厢前后方向坐着，不围观主体。使用普通手机后置摄像头、约 26mm 广角，从斜对面座位或车厢过道侧面拍摄中景；保留轻微车厢晃动和自然运动模糊，但主体面部清晰，保留真实皮肤纹理、轻微眼下疲惫感、碎发、衣服褶皱和通勤环境的生活化杂乱。避免摆拍、商业地铁广告、空车厢、豪华地铁、所有乘客看镜头、乘客方向错误、换脸、五官漂移、发型变化、帆布包消失、多余手臂、手指畸形、文字和水印。

items.title: 敦煌美学新中式极简飘带丝路意境海报
items.description: 一张 9:16 新中式东方艺术海报，以朱砂红留白背景、右上巨大透明飘带、工笔燕子和左下微小白衣旅人构成诗意的敦煌丝路尺度叙事。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical minimalist New Chinese-style Oriental art poster, merging Dunhuang mural aesthetics, modern Guochao visual language, and a classical Silk Road mood. Let high-saturation cinnabar red and crimson gradients dominate, with generous pure negative space across the upper and left areas. The lower area is open warm white and ivory ground, with only faint light-gray ink-wash hills and mist in the distance. From the upper right, suspend huge light transparent silk and gauze ribbons forming elegant S-curves and layered overlapping rotations; make the material resemble glazed glass, organza, and pearlescent film, with softly glowing edges and pale-pink, moon-white, light-gold, turquoise, and iridescent refractions. Embed Dunhuang and traditional brocade motifs inside some ribbons: turquoise vines, Baoxiang flowers, auspicious clouds, lotus, cinnabar peonies, and gilded outlines in azurite blue, malachite green, cinnabar, gold, and beige. Several black-blue swallows weave around the ribbons in delicate Gongbi linework, with deep indigo feathers, white bellies, cinnabar beaks, and varied flight directions. Near the lower-left horizon, place a tiny ancient traveler in white riding slowly on a white horse, wearing a simple ancient crown and moon-white or light-beige robe; use minimal cinnabar and turquoise saddlery and a soft slender gray ground shadow. Combine traditional Gongbi painting with modern flat illustration. Keep the composition top-heavy and bottom-light, dense on the right and sparse on the left, creating strong scale contrast between the enormous ribbons and tiny traveler and a poetic feeling of wind from beyond the heavens and a solitary journey into mountains and rivers. Use clear but non-dazzling red, turquoise, moon white, and gilding with mineral-pigment texture, slight rock-color grain, soft halo, delicate gold outlining, and refined graphic design. Clean background, no text, no border, polished Oriental decorative-poster finish.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张 9:16 竖版新中式东方美学极简插画海报，融合敦煌壁画、现代国潮视觉和古典丝路意境。画面以高饱和朱砂红与赤红渐变为主，上半部和左侧保留大面积纯净留白；下方是暖白与象牙白空旷地面，远处仅有若隐若现的淡灰水墨山丘和轻雾。右上方垂落一组巨大、轻盈、飘逸的透明丝绸与薄纱，形成优雅 S 形曲线和多层交叠旋转结构；材质像琉璃、欧根纱和珍珠薄膜，边缘柔软发光，表面有淡粉、月白、浅金、青绿和虹彩折射。部分丝带内部嵌入青绿色缠枝花卉、宝相花、祥云、莲花、朱红牡丹、鎏金描边等敦煌与传统织锦纹样，以石青、石绿、朱砂、鎏金和米黄为主。数只黑蓝色燕子围绕丝带飞翔，采用简洁细腻的工笔线描，深靛蓝羽毛、白腹、朱红喙和舒展长尾，飞行动势各不相同，形成节奏引导。左下地平线附近安排一个极小比例的古代白衣旅人骑白马缓慢前行，戴简洁古冠、穿月白或浅米长袍，白马配少量朱红与青蓝鞍具，马下有柔和细长灰影；人物和马简洁精致，结合工笔画与现代扁平插画。构图上重下轻、右密左疏，巨大飘带与微小旅人形成强烈尺度对比和“风从天外来、孤旅入山河”的诗意叙事。使用清透但不刺眼的红、青绿、月白和鎏金，加入矿物颜料质感、轻微岩彩颗粒、柔和光晕、细腻描金和高级平面设计。画面干净，无文字、无边框，保持东方装饰画的高完成度。

items.title: 新中式写实古风成年女性清冷生活方式人像
items.description: 一张 9:16 竖幅新中式生活方式人像，成年东亚女性在荷塘或园林空间整理白色发带，青灰荷叶前景、墨绿背景与柔和侧光营造清冷克制氛围。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical single-person realistic New Chinese-style lifestyle portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman positioned slightly left of center, using a medium half-body framing, eye-level camera, an approximately 50mm to 85mm portrait perspective, and shallow depth of field. Her body turns slightly right while her face looks back toward the camera with a quiet direct gaze, calm restrained eyes, naturally parted lips, and no smile. Her deep-black long hair is center- or slightly side-parted and tied low, with a long white ribbon attached to one side. Both hands rest before the chest and abdomen, gently arranging, pulling, or playing with the ribbon in an unfinished natural gesture, without stereotyped ancient-style hand poses. She wears ivory, moon-white, or light-beige wide-sleeved ancient-style clothing in lightweight matte fabric, loose drape, natural folds, and minimal decoration, with no ornate embroidery, complex headwear, or exaggerated jewelry; the styling is plain, scholarly, and lived-in. The lens foreground must include two obvious defocused large lotus leaves, one cyan-gray or dark green at bottom left and one at bottom right, partially obscuring the lower body, lower arms, and table area; a pale white lotus or lotus-leaf vessel may appear as a low-emphasis accent at bottom right. Set the background in a low-information garden tea setting, lotus-pond edge, corridor, or indoor-outdoor transition space, using deep gray-green, dark green, and gray-black tones; blurred plants and furnishings retain a quiet Oriental atmosphere without becoming empty, and the subject separates clearly from the background. Use soft natural side light from the front-left or upper-left, illuminating cheeks, nose bridge, forehead, and white clothing while the opposite side is slightly darker; keep shadows soft with no hard light or flash feel. Skin is cool white with a gray-pink cast, never orange or oily. Maintain low saturation, low contrast, light grain, and a subtle film texture, emphasizing ivory subject, cyan-gray leaves, and dark green-gray background. Avoid modern clothing or jewelry, palace headwear, heavy makeup, saturated red and gold, exaggerated seduction, stiff posing, malformed fingers, broken or floating ribbon, incorrect sleeves, plastic lotus leaves, bright background, clear background faces, distracting modern furniture, over-sharpening, HDR, strong contrast, studio feel, text, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张 9:16 竖幅单人写实新中式生活方式人像，主体为一位明确成年的东亚女性，位于画面中央略偏左，采用中景偏半身、平视机位和接近 50mm 到 85mm 的人像视角，浅景深。她的身体轻微侧向右侧，脸部回看镜头，安静直视，眼神平静克制，嘴唇自然微张，不微笑；深黑色长发中分或轻微偏分，低位束发，发束一侧系有白色长带。双手位于胸腹前方，轻轻整理、牵引或把玩白色发带，动作未完成且自然，不做标准古风手势。她穿象牙白、月白或浅米白色宽袖古风服装，轻薄哑光、宽松垂坠、自然褶皱、低装饰度，无华丽刺绣、复杂头饰或夸张珠宝，整体素净、文人感、生活化。镜头前景必须有明显失焦荷叶：左下和右下各一片青灰或墨绿色大荷叶，部分遮挡人物下半身、手臂下缘和桌面区域；右下可有一朵浅白荷花或荷叶器皿作为低权重点缀。背景为低信息密度的园林茶席、荷塘边、回廊或室内外过渡空间，深灰绿、墨绿和灰黑色调，植物与陈设模糊但不空白，人物与背景清晰分离。使用左前方或左上方柔和自然侧光，照亮脸颊、鼻梁、额头和白色衣物，另一侧略暗，阴影柔和，无硬光或闪光灯感；肤色为冷白带灰粉，不偏橙黄、不油亮。整体低饱和、低对比、轻颗粒、轻胶片化，突出象牙白人物、青灰荷叶和墨绿灰背景的层次；避免现代服装首饰、宫廷头饰、浓妆、红金高饱和、夸张媚态、僵硬摆拍、错误手指、发带断裂漂浮、袖子错误、塑料荷叶、过亮背景、背景清晰人脸、现代家具抢镜、过度锐化、HDR、强对比、棚拍感、文字和水印。

items.title: 街头早餐摊前的成年亚洲女性写实抓拍
items.description: 一张 3:4 竖幅真实手机街头抓拍，成年亚洲女性在清晨早餐摊前一手付款、一手接过豆浆包子，前景路人肩膀和城市晨光强化现场感。
items.prompt: Create a 3:4 vertical single real street smartphone snapshot with no collage and no poster feel. In the early morning, a clearly adult Asian woman stands at an ordinary street breakfast stall, wearing a light-gray sleeveless knit top, dark loose long skirt, and white sneakers. She holds a mobile phone ready to pay in one hand and takes a transparent plastic bag containing soy milk and steamed buns with the other. She has recently woken up; her long black hair is slightly fluffy, her expression quiet and mildly sleepy, with no heavy makeup, no direct gaze at the camera, and no obvious smile. The stall contains steamers, plastic bags, paper cups, a folding table, and naturally rising steam. The city street behind is just waking up, with electric bikes, commuting pedestrians, and faint morning light. Shoot diagonally from behind the queue, keeping part of a passerby’s shoulder in the foreground for authentic presence. Keep the scene ordinary, candid, and non-commercial; do not let steam obscure the face, and keep fingers, plastic bag, and food boundaries natural and clear. Avoid breakfast-ad styling, posing with food toward the camera, an overly polished stall, a luxury neighborhood, malformed fingers, fused plastic bag, text, and watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张 3:4 竖幅单张真实街头手机抓拍，不要拼贴或海报感。清晨，一位明确成年的亚洲女性站在普通街边早餐摊前，穿浅灰色无袖针织上衣、深色宽松长裙和白色运动鞋；一只手拿手机准备付款，另一只手接过装有豆浆和包子的透明塑料袋。她刚醒不久，黑色长发略显蓬松，神情安静、轻微困倦，不化浓妆，不看镜头，也没有明显微笑。摊位上有蒸笼、塑料袋、纸杯、折叠桌和自然升起的热气；背景是刚刚苏醒的城市街道，包含电动车、上班行人和微弱晨光。镜头从排队人群后方斜侧拍摄，前景保留一部分路人肩膀，增强真实现场感。保持普通、生活化、非广告的街头摄影，不让蒸汽遮住脸部，确保手指、塑料袋和食物边界自然清晰。避免早餐广告式摆拍、举食物看镜头、过度精致摊位、豪华街区、手指畸形、塑料袋融合、文字和水印。

items.title: 赛博故障粉红短上衣成年女性古装风肖像
items.description: 一张极简白棚中的概念时尚肖像，成年女性以古装风发型、粉色短上衣、护臂与双手托腮姿态呈现赛博故障和灰雾柔焦氛围，并配两个食物造型玩偶。
items.prompt: Create a conceptual fashion portrait featuring a clearly adult woman in a pure white seamless studio. She wears a pink cropped top with deep bean-paste-colored lips, an ancient-style hairdo, and an arm guard held near her face. One hand rests under her chin while the other stays naturally near the face, with clear finger anatomy. Include two cute food-shaped dolls held by or placed beside her, and give her a restrained, melancholy expression. Blend cyber-glitch visual effects, golden-brown accents, gray mist, soft focus, and light atmospheric diffusion into an editorial concept image. Keep the white background clean, the woman and dolls sharply legible, and the glitch treatment controlled so it does not obscure the face.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张概念时尚肖像，主体为一位明确成年的女性，置于纯白无缝摄影棚中。她穿粉红色短上衣，配深豆沙色嘴唇、古装风发型和一只靠近脸部的护臂；一只手托腮，另一只手自然靠近面部，手指结构清晰。她怀抱或放置两个可爱的食物造型玩偶，表情惆怅而克制。整体融合赛博故障视觉、金棕色细节、灰雾柔焦与轻微雾化，形成时装编辑式概念画面；白色背景保持干净，人物和玩偶轮廓清晰，故障效果受控且不遮挡面部。

items.title: 超写实鼠尾草绿眼眸质感皮肤特写人像
items.description: 一张超写实极致特写美妆人像，明确成年女性拥有鼠尾草绿眼睛与金色星状虹膜纹理，湿润黑发、金色时段窗光和真实皮肤细节共同形成高级美妆编辑视觉。
items.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic extreme close-up beauty portrait of a clearly adult woman with mesmerizing sage-green eyes, luminous golden starburst patterns around the pupils, and crystal-clear catchlights. She gazes directly into the camera with a calm intimate expression and slightly parted glossy blush-pink lips. Her porcelain-fair skin has a natural satin glow, visible pores, delicate freckles across the nose and cheeks, soft peach undertones, and authentic texture without excessive retouching. Thick feathered jet-black brows, naturally long curled lashes, a refined straight nose, and softly sculpted features remain sharply defined. Her shoulder-length jet-black hair is slightly wet with glossy textured strands around her face; wispy bangs and loose damp locks partially cover one eye, while tiny highlights catch the sunlight for a mysterious, effortless cinematic effect. Golden-hour sunlight streams through a nearby window across her face, producing dramatic natural shadows, warm highlights, and refined contrast. A softly blurred neutral background melts into creamy bokeh, keeping focus on the eyes, skin, and damp-hair texture. Aim for a luxury skincare campaign and high-end beauty-editorial quiet-luxury aesthetic with cinematic realism, an 85mm prime lens, f/1.4, HDR, razor-sharp eye focus, shallow depth of field, and premium color grading. Avoid plastic skin, excessive smoothing, vacant AI eyes, exaggerated makeup, blurred eyes, distorted features, and extra text.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张超写实极致特写美妆人像，主体为一位明确成年的女性，拥有迷人的鼠尾草绿眼眸，瞳孔周围带发光的金色星状图案和晶莹清晰的眼神光。她以平静、亲密的表情直视镜头，双唇微张，涂有光泽的粉色唇彩。她的瓷白肌肤呈自然绸面光泽，清晰可见毛孔，鼻梁和脸颊有精致雀斑与柔和桃色底调，保留真实皮肤纹理，避免过度修饰；浓密羽毛状乌黑眉毛、自然纤长卷翘睫毛、挺拔鼻梁和柔和面部轮廓清晰可见。齐肩乌黑头发微湿且有光泽，细碎刘海和松散湿发部分遮住一只眼睛，湿发高光捕捉阳光，营造神秘、松弛而电影感的效果。黄金时段阳光透过附近窗户洒在脸上，形成戏剧性自然阴影、温暖高光和高级对比；中性背景柔和虚化为奶油般散景，焦点始终在眼睛、皮肤和湿发质感上。整体为奢侈护肤品广告与高端美妆社论的静奢自然美学，使用电影级写实主义、85mm 定焦镜头、f/1.4、HDR、锐利眼睛对焦、浅景深和高级调色。避免塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、AI 空洞眼神、过分夸张妆容、模糊眼睛、畸形五官和多余文字。

items.title: 华丽歌剧院内浅金发成年东亚女性半身像
items.description: 一张 16:9 写实编辑半身肖像，成年东亚女性在华丽歌剧院内以左后方四分之三视角站立，浅金发、柔和高调光线与歌剧院细节构成轻盈高级画面。
items.prompt: Create a 16:9 photorealistic editorial portrait: a waist-up composition at waist level, seen from a rear-left three-quarter view, featuring a clearly adult East Asian woman who may have Japanese or Korean background. She has medium-to-long light-blonde hair with a center part, mostly smooth texture, subtle natural bends through the lengths, and softly curved ends. Her head tilts gently toward one shoulder in a natural standing pose; her expression is poised, alluring, and confident without being overly sexualized. Place her inside an opulent opera house with chandelier fixtures and rows of velvet seats cropped in from one side. Use an airy high-key contemporary Japanese editorial photography language, luminous natural skin, transparent soft shadows, and high-dynamic-range digital imaging. Keep the opera-house materials readable without competing with the subject, with an elegant, light-filled, editorial atmosphere.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张 16:9 写实编辑人像，采用腰部以上半身构图和腰部高度视角，从左后方四分之三视图拍摄一位明确成年的东亚女性。她可以是日本或韩国背景，留中长浅金发，中分，发丝整体顺滑并在长度中带自然微弯和柔和发梢；头部向一侧肩膀轻轻倾斜，保持自然站立姿态，表情迷人、从容且自信，避免过度性化。场景为华丽歌剧院内部，包含吊灯装置和从一侧裁切入画的丝绒座椅排。使用轻盈高调的当代日式编辑摄影语言、明亮自然肤色、透明柔和阴影和高动态范围数字成像；让歌剧院材质保持可读，背景不过度抢夺人物注意力，整体精致、空气感强且具有社论品质。

items.title: 室内沙发上的涅槃乐队背心成年东亚女性人像
items.description: 一张室内夜间写实肖像，成年东亚女性坐在米色织物沙发上举臂束发，穿印有 Nirvana 图案的宽松白色背心，以柔和光线和 85mm 镜头感呈现自然音乐文化氛围。
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman sitting on a beige fabric couch indoors at night. She has long straight black hair, looks directly at the camera with a soft confident expression and naturally parted lips, and raises both arms above her head while gathering and holding her long hair back. She wears a loose white sleeveless music-culture tank top with complete, non-revealing armholes; the top features a yellow “NIRVANA” text logo above a red-and-gold winged humanoid figure graphic. Use soft natural indoor light, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, subtle film grain, high detail, and an 85mm lens look. Keep the nighttime interior quiet and natural with a lived-in music-lifestyle atmosphere, and render the garment graphic crisp and legible. Avoid nudity, sexualized posing, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, malformed fingers, extra limbs, and unreadable lettering.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张写实肖像，一位明确成年的东亚女性在深夜室内坐在米色织物沙发上。她留长直黑发，直视镜头，表情柔和而自信，嘴巴自然微张；双臂举过头顶，双手聚拢并向后整理长发。她穿宽松的白色无袖音乐文化背心，采用完整且不暴露身体的袖窿设计；背心上印有黄色“NIRVANA”文字标志，下方是红金相间的有翼类人形象图案。使用柔和的室内自然光、浅景深、真实皮肤纹理、细微胶片颗粒和高细节，呈现 85mm 镜头感。夜间室内保持安静、自然的音乐生活方式氛围，服装图案清晰可辨；避免裸露、性化姿态、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、畸形手指、额外肢体和模糊文字。

items.title: 户外侧身低头超长卷发东亚成年女性写真
items.description: 一张 3:4 竖幅户外生活方式人像，成年东亚女性在浅色栏杆前侧身低头整理超长蓬松卷发，绿色树木背景与柔和散射光营造安静梦幻气质。
items.prompt: Create a 3:4 vertical single-person realistic outdoor portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman standing before a light-colored metal railing. Place her center-right in a medium shot with an eye-level slightly high angle and an approximately 50–85mm lens feel. Her body faces left; her head is lowered and gently turned toward the lower left, not looking at the camera, with a quiet, detached, slightly contemplative expression. She has extremely long, voluminous dark brown-black wavy curls, a fluffy crown, curls framing both sides of the face and falling below the waist, with naturally turned ends; the hair is the largest visual mass. She wears a loose black short-sleeve top in soft matte fabric as a dark base. Both hands rest in front of the left side of the body, gently pinching or tidying one strand of hair in a small natural everyday gesture. The background is dense green trees and shrubs with a unified hue and moderate saturation, softened but without excessive portrait-mode blur; the light railing crosses horizontally near the waist behind her. Use soft natural outdoor light like cloudy diffusion or leaf-filtered daylight, bright facial highlights, shallow shadows, low contrast, and a subtly dreamy retouched feel. Keep the three-part color relationship of green background, dark hair and top, and light warm skin. Emphasize the side-facing bowed-head pose, extra-long fluffy curls, black matte top, and softened green background. Avoid direct eye contact, juvenile facial appearance, heavy makeup, plastic skin, clumped or body-penetrating hair, hair covering the whole face, fingers stuck to hair, malformed fingers, leather or glossy top, oversaturated or overly sharp plants, HDR, strong blur, hard flash, high contrast, body deformation, and distorted side profile.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张 3:4 竖幅单人户外写实人像，主体为一位明确成年的东亚女性，站在浅色金属栏杆前，位于画面中央偏右，采用大半身构图、平视略高机位和约 50–85mm 镜头观感。身体侧向画面左侧，头部低垂并轻轻转向左下方，不看镜头，神态安静、游离且略带沉思。她拥有深棕黑色超长蓬松波浪卷发，发量极大，两侧卷发包围脸部并垂落至腰部以下，发尾自然翻卷，头发是画面最大视觉体量；穿宽松黑色短袖上衣，柔软哑光面料作为深色基底。双手位于身体左前方，轻轻捏住或整理一缕发丝，动作细小自然。背景为色相统一、饱和度适中的密集绿色树木和灌木，略微柔化但不过度人像模式虚化；浅色栏杆横向穿过腰部附近，提供稳定结构。使用接近阴天散射光或树叶过滤日光的柔和自然光，面部高光偏亮、阴影浅、整体低对比并带轻微梦幻精修感。保持绿色背景、深色头发与上衣、浅暖肤色的三组色彩关系，突出侧身低头姿态、超长蓬松卷发、黑色哑光上衣和柔和绿色背景。避免直视镜头、幼态脸、浓妆、塑料皮肤、发丝成块或穿过身体、头发遮住整张脸、手发粘连、错误手指、皮革亮面上衣、过饱和或过锐背景、HDR、强烈虚化、硬闪、强对比和身体变形。

items.title: 唯美山景东亚成年女性慵懒针织衫人像
items.description: 一张明亮自然的山景生活方式人像，成年东亚女性倚靠观景台木栏杆、下巴靠在折叠双臂上，淡紫针织衫、黑色圆框眼镜和远山蓝天营造宁静旅行美学。
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic outdoor lifestyle portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman leaning on a rustic wooden railing at a scenic mountain viewpoint beneath a crystal-clear blue sky. She has long silky dark-brown hair, naturally luminous skin with realistic texture, soft peach blush, subtle brown eye makeup, naturally defined brows, and glossy nude-pink lips. She wears a cozy oversized lavender knit sweater, rests her chin gently on folded arms, and looks directly into the camera with a warm peaceful smile while casually holding black round-frame eyeglasses in one hand. The background shows breathtaking mountains, a distant horizon, and vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds; thin suspension cables create elegant leading lines and depth. Use bright natural daylight, a soft breeze moving her hair, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, cinematic color grading, ultra-realistic DSLR photography, premium lifestyle-editorial quality, an 85mm lens, f/1.8, HDR, highly detailed natural skin texture, and crisp clean light. Keep a serene travel aesthetic and avoid youthful ambiguity, plastic skin, excessive beauty retouching, or distracting background clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张写实户外生活方式人像，主体是一位明确成年的东亚女性，靠在风景优美的山间观景台原木栏杆上，头顶是清澈湛蓝的天空。她有丝滑的长深棕色头发、自然发光且保留纹理的皮肤、柔和桃色腮红、细致棕色眼妆、自然清晰眉毛和亮泽裸粉色嘴唇。她穿舒适的宽松淡紫色针织毛衣，将下巴轻轻靠在叠放的双臂上，带温暖宁静的微笑直视镜头，一只手随性拿着黑色圆框眼镜。背景展示壮丽山脉、遥远地平线和散布白云的鲜艳蓝天，细长悬索形成优雅引导线并增加深度。明亮自然日光，微风吹动头发，浅景深和奶油般散景，电影级调色，超写实 DSLR 摄影，奢华生活方式社论品质，85mm 镜头，f/1.8，HDR，细节丰富的自然皮肤纹理和清爽光线。构图保持宁静旅行美学，避免幼态、塑料皮肤、过度美颜和不可读的背景杂乱。

items.title: 沸宴火锅高端自助商业海报
items.description: 一张高端自助火锅商业海报：顶部两块精选食材/锅底展示，底部为大幅招牌自助火锅盛宴，结合中英品牌、菜品说明和手写风格价格。
items.prompt: Create an ultra-premium commercial poster for the fictional all-you-can-eat hotpot brand 沸宴火锅 / FEASTPOT HOTPOT BUFFET. Merge extreme food realism with a distinctive buffet story in a tall vertical layout divided into three zones: a smaller featured broth at top left, a smaller Seafood Selection / 海鲜拼盘 highlight at top right, and a large signature all-you-can-eat hotpot feast spanning most of the bottom. The top sections are curated highlights and the bottom is the main appetite shock; keep the whole composition balanced, editorial, premium, and instantly readable. At top left, show 牛油麻辣锅底 / Spicy Tallow Broth with vivid red-gold bubbling broth, chili, peppercorns, garlic, scallion, aromatics, shimmering oil, steam, and believable heat. At top right, show a fresh premium self-service ingredient highlight, defaulting to a Seafood Selection with shrimp, scallop, fish cake, squid, greens, and ice-fresh presentation; the variable may instead describe a Signature Dipping Bar with sesame paste, chili oil, herbs, garlic, scallion, and sauce bowls, but it must clearly belong to the self-service hotpot experience. At the bottom, show one impressive hotpot vessel or broad buffet spread with bubbling broth, visible steam, premium sliced meats, shrimp, fish balls, tofu, mushrooms, leafy greens, lotus root, noodles, chili, herbs, seafood, and dipping ingredients arranged abundantly around the pot. Make it panoramic, generous, lively, indulgent, and controlled like a premium dining campaign. Include the brand names, the campaign line “Unlimited Heat, Unlimited Flavor”, names and short descriptions for the top features, the bottom title 招牌自助火锅盛宴 / Signature Hotpot Feast, and clearly legible handwritten or brush-style prices ¥58, ¥88, and ¥168. Use a warm dark restaurant palette: deep chili brown-red for the broth, muted olive or slate green for the ingredient feature, and smoky amber-brown for the bottom feast. Make oil shimmer, meat, seafood, vegetables, sauces, steam, and liquids physically convincing. Use soft high-end cinematic food lighting with enough side or backlight to reveal steam while keeping shadows rich and elegant. Avoid cheap flyer styling, cartoon food, low-detail broth, unreadable prices, plastic-looking meat, weak steam, low-resolution textures, and cluttered composition.
items.prompt_zh: 为虚构的高端自助火锅品牌创建一张超高端商业海报，品牌名为“沸宴火锅”与“FEASTPOT HOTPOT BUFFET”。采用高端食物写实与品牌化自助餐叙事：高耸的竖幅版式分为三个区域，左上为较小的精选锅底，右上为较小的 Seafood Selection / 海鲜拼盘，下方大半区域为一锅丰盛的招牌自助火锅盛宴。顶部两区像精心策划的亮点，底部主菜形成最大食欲冲击；整体平衡、社论化、高级且一眼可读。左上展示“牛油麻辣锅底 / Spicy Tallow Broth”：沸腾的红金色汤底、辣椒、花椒、大蒜、葱、香料、发亮油层、蒸汽和真实气泡。右上展示新鲜高端的自助食材精选区，以海鲜拼盘为默认方向，包含虾、扇贝、鱼糕、鱿鱼、蔬菜和冰鲜质感；也可将变量替换为带芝麻酱、辣油、香草、大蒜、葱和酱料碗的秘制蘸料台，必须明确属于自助火锅体验。底部展示一个大型火锅器皿或宽阔的自助火锅盛宴：沸腾汤底、蒸汽、优质肉片、虾、鱼丸、豆腐、蘑菇、叶菜、莲藕、面条、辣椒、香草、海鲜和蘸料围绕锅具丰富排列，呈现全景般丰盛、热烈、诱人但受控的高端餐饮体验。加入品牌名、短语“Unlimited Heat, Unlimited Flavor”、顶部两区名称与简短说明、底部“招牌自助火锅盛宴 / Signature Hotpot Feast”，以及清晰可读的手写或笔刷风格价格 ¥58、¥88、¥168。使用深辣椒棕红、橄榄/石板绿和烟熏琥珀棕的暖暗餐厅色系，让菜品与文字成为焦点。汤底油光、肉片、海鲜、蔬菜、酱料、蒸汽和液体必须具有真实物理质感；使用柔和高端电影感食物光，侧逆光凸显蒸汽，阴影丰富而优雅。避免廉价传单、卡通食物、低细节汤底、不可读价格、塑料肉、弱蒸汽、低分辨率纹理和凌乱布局。

items.title: 复古拼贴剪纸风格旅行海报
items.description: 一张高细节复古旅行海报模板，以羊皮纸、撕裂纸张和分层剪纸拼贴呈现可配置目的地的地标、自然、文化、美食与野生动物。
items.prompt: Create a highly detailed vintage travel poster for Paris, France in a torn-paper scrapbook collage aesthetic: textured parchment, layered paper cutouts, soft shadows, distressed edges, and warm earthy tones. Feature iconic landmarks, landscapes, cultural symbols, native wildlife, local cuisine, and heritage elements of the destination. Place decorative title badges at the top, a bold 3D centerpiece title reading “DISCOVER PARIS”, an elegant subtitle “A Journey Through Time”, and a themed tagline “History, Flavor, and Wonder”. Arrange scenic illustrations, destination signposts, traditional foods, and native wildlife in a balanced collage composition. Finish with a vintage footer ribbon containing minimalist icons and category labels for history, nature, culture, adventure, cuisine, and wildlife. Keep every required text element crisp and legible; use rich colors, intricate detail, realistic illustration, premium travel-poster quality, and a nostalgic handcrafted paper-cut aesthetic.
