items.prompt_zh: 创建一张细节丰富的复古旅行海报，采用撕裂纸张剪贴簿拼贴美学：纹理羊皮纸、分层纸张剪纸、柔和阴影、磨损边缘和温暖泥土色调。展示 Paris, France 的标志性地标、景观、文化符号、原生野生动物、当地美食和遗产元素。在顶部放置装饰性标题徽章，中间放置醒目的 3D 标题“DISCOVER PARIS”，并配优雅副标题“A Journey Through Time”和主题标语“History, Flavor, and Wonder”。将风景插图、目的地路标、传统食物和原生野生动物以均衡拼贴构图排列，底部以复古丝带收束，加入代表历史、自然、文化、冒险、美食和野生动物的极简图标与分类标签。文字必须清晰可读；色彩浓郁、细节复杂、插图写实，整体具有优质旅行海报品质和怀旧手工剪纸质感。

items.title: 高冲击力机械圆环汽车海报
items.description: 一张 4:5 竖幅汽车海报模板，以车辆三分之二侧前视角为主体，结合同心轨道圆环、机械模块、超大数字和可配置品牌文字形成高冲击力编辑构图。
items.prompt: Create a high-impact automotive poster featuring a midnight-blue 1970s-inspired sports coupe in a sharp side-front three-quarter view across the lower half of the frame. Surround it with a dense orbital composition of concentric wheel-sized circles, segmented signal orange discs, black radial lines, white circular windows, and offset mechanical rings. Use midnight blue, signal orange, black, white, and warm gray; let the circular modules expand from the rear wheel and continue beyond the poster edges. Place an oversized cropped numeral “07” behind the main body, add NORTHLINE MOTORSPORT near the upper-left corner, and set the slogan “MOTION IS PRECISION” in tightly controlled uppercase typography. Maintain accurate a midnight-blue 1970s-inspired sports coupe proportions, crisp technical illustration, layered flat shapes, subtle lithographic grain, tiny registration marks, selective ink outlines, and clean editorial hierarchy. Vertical 4:5 format; keep the logo and slogan crisp and legible, with the orbital graphics never obscuring the vehicle hero.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张高冲击力的汽车海报，主体为 a midnight-blue 1970s-inspired sports coupe，采用犀利的侧前三分之二视角，放置在画面下半部分。用密集的轨道构图环绕车辆：同心轮径圆圈、分段的 signal orange 圆盘、黑色径向线、白色圆形窗口和偏移机械环。使用 midnight blue, signal orange, black, white, and warm gray，让圆形模块从后轮向外扩展并延伸出海报边缘。在车身后方放置超大的裁剪数字“07”，左上角加入 NORTHLINE MOTORSPORT，并用严谨控制的大写排版呈现标语“MOTION IS PRECISION”。保持 a midnight-blue 1970s-inspired sports coupe 比例准确，使用清晰技术插图、分层扁平形状、微妙平版印刷纹理、微小套印标记、选择性墨线和整洁编辑层级。4:5 竖幅，品牌标志和标语必须清晰可读，圆环不得遮挡车辆主体。

items.title: 角色一致性人像灯光对比九宫格
items.description: 一张深灰背景的 3x3 人像灯光对比网格，九格均使用上传参考图中的同一主体、服装和姿势，仅改变指定灯光，并在每格下方显示编号与灯光名称。
items.prompt: Create a single 3x3 photo grid on a dark gray background. Every cell uses the same subject from the uploaded reference image, preserving identity, outfit, pose, perspective, and facial features perfectly; below each portrait, show a clean legible sans-serif label with its number and lighting name. Use a strict three-by-three arrangement, changing only the lighting according to the labels. Top row left to right: Loop Lighting (flattering 3/4 light with a small nose-shadow loop on the cheek), Hardlight Frontal Flash (direct hard frontal flash with deep frontal shadows), Split Lighting (dramatic light on one side of the face while the other side is completely dark). Middle row: Butterfly Lighting (classic slightly high symmetrical frontal light with a small shadow under the nose), Gobo Pattern (Venetian Blind) (linear blind shadows across face, clothing, and background), Under-Lighting (Uplight) (light from below creating reverse shadows and a moody look). Bottom row: Golden Hour / Warm Light (soft golden warm side light), Dramatic Spotlight (hard narrow circular beam with deep chiaroscuro and crushed blacks), Neutral Kelvin Rim Light (intense backlight with no front fill, glowing outline around hair and shoulders, face in darkness against a black background). Keep labels crisp and correctly matched to their lighting setups.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张置于深灰背景上的单张 3x3 照片网格。九个网格单元都使用上传参考图中的同一主体，保持人物身份、服装、姿势、透视和面部特征完全一致；每格下方用清晰整洁的无衬线文字显示编号和灯光名称。严格按三行三列排列，且只有灯光按标签改变：顶行从左到右为 Loop Lighting（讨喜的 3/4 光线，鼻子在脸颊留下小圈阴影）、Hardlight Frontal Flash（正面硬闪光与深沉正面阴影）、Split Lighting（只照亮一侧脸部，另一侧完全黑暗）；中行为 Butterfly Lighting（略高位置的经典对称前光，鼻下小阴影）、Gobo Pattern (Venetian Blind)（百叶窗投影在脸部、服装和背景形成线性阴影）、Under-Lighting (Uplight)（从下方打光，产生反向阴影和忧郁感）；底行为 Golden Hour / Warm Light（侧角柔和金色暖光）、Dramatic Spotlight（硬而窄的圆形光束、深沉明暗对照和压低黑色）、Neutral Kelvin Rim Light（无正面补光的强逆光，在头发和肩膀周围形成发光轮廓，脸部处于黑暗，背景为黑色）。标签文字必须清晰可读，且只与对应灯光匹配。

items.title: 动漫碎片系列排印视觉动作海报
items.description: 一张 9:16 动漫社论动作海报模板，以超大裁剪英文排印、动态角色和嵌入式环境构成强烈视觉层级；可切换四种角色动作与特效主题。
items.prompt: Create a high-impact 9:16 anime editorial poster featuring an original adult anime swordswoman in a dynamic action moment. Use oversized cropped English typography, WATER TRACE, as the main structure; let the letters fill most of the poster and extend beyond the frame, embedding elements of mountain waterfall inside the letterforms. Place the character in front of and partially inside the typography, with at least one body part, weapon, garment, or action effect breaking beyond the letter boundaries for strong foreground perspective. Use a dramatic low-angle or close wide-angle composition with one clear foreground element; keep the action readable, energetic, and anatomically coherent. Set the action to sword strike, the main typography theme to WATER TRACE, and the palette to deep blue, aqua, and silver; adapt effects with flowing water, pink motion ribbons, golden lightning, or restrained butterflies as appropriate. Use the series label ANIME FRAGMENTS and the year 2026; keep the English title, label, and numerals crisp and legible. The overall result is a polished, dynamic, layered premium anime editorial poster with the environment fused into the letterforms.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张高冲击力的 9:16 动漫社论海报，展示一名 an original adult anime swordswoman 在动态动作瞬间。使用超大、裁剪过的英文主排版 WATER TRACE，让字母填充大部分画面并延伸出边框；在字母内部嵌入 mountain waterfall 的环境元素。将角色置于排版前方并部分位于字母内部，至少一个身体部位、武器、服装或动作特效突破字母边界，形成强烈前景透视。采用戏剧性的低角度或近距离广角构图，突出清晰的前景元素，保持动作易读、充满活力且解剖结构连贯。动作设为 sword strike，主排版为 WATER TRACE，使用 deep blue, aqua, and silver 调色板；根据主题加入相应的水流、粉色动态丝带、金色闪电或克制蝴蝶元素。系列标签使用 ANIME FRAGMENTS，年份使用 2026；英文标题、标签和数字必须清晰可读。整体为高端动漫编辑海报，环境与字母形态融合，画面精致、动感、层次分明。

items.title: 高端西式快餐六宫格促销海报
items.description: 一张严格 2x3 六格的虚构品牌快餐促销海报，以六种高端写实食物为视觉主角，结合清晰英文标题、价格标签和克制的手写商业点缀。
items.prompt: Create an ultra-premium photorealistic six-panel promotional poster for the fictional Western fast-food brand BRISK BITE. Arrange six equal square panels in a strict 2x3 grid with consistent spacing. Each panel contains only one main food hero, one bold stacked English title, one clearly readable price tag, and one short English supporting line; food remains the visual focus. The six product tiers are SIGNATURE BURGER, CRISPY WRAP, LOADED FRIES, FRIED CHICKEN, COMBO DEAL, and LIMITED DROP, represented by a burger, crispy wrap, loaded fries, fried chicken, combo meal, and limited special with clearly varied silhouettes and ingredients but one unified brand system. Use a modern bold legible English-only logo and repeat a small official-style BRISK BITE mark. Use the prices $8.90, $11.50, $6.90, $9.90, $13.90, and $10.90; keep them readable and naturally integrated into the advertising layout. Add short supporting lines such as Hot. Fresh. Fast., Made for Cravings., Today’s Best Combo., Big Flavor, Quick Fix., and Weekend Favorite. Use a high-contrast promotional palette of bright orange, warm yellow, cream beige, deep brown, red, and soft off-white; vary panel backgrounds and graphic blocks while keeping the system clean and intentional. Add only sparse handwritten arrows, emphasis marks, or small circles near prices or selling points. Make the food hyper-realistic, clean, and craveable: soft glossy buns, crisp textured fried chicken, hot stretchy melted cheese, golden salted fries, toasted slightly blistered wrap bread, rich glossy sauces, and fresh vivid vegetables. Use soft high-end commercial food lighting with controlled short shadows and refined highlights. The whole poster should feel like a world-class fast-food launch campaign or digital menu promotion: bright, graphic, youthful, and commercial. Avoid cheap takeaway-flyer styling, cartoon or 3D food, messy typography, unreadable prices, oversaturated chaos, and low-resolution textures.
items.prompt_zh: 为虚构西式快餐品牌 BRISK BITE 创建超高端写实六面促销海报。六个等比例正方形面板严格排列为 2x3 网格，间距一致；每格只保留一个主要食物、一个醒目的堆叠英文标题、一个清晰价格标签和一行简短英文辅助说明，食物始终是视觉主角。六格产品层级依次为 SIGNATURE BURGER、CRISPY WRAP、LOADED FRIES、FRIED CHICKEN、COMBO DEAL、LIMITED DROP，分别使用汉堡、脆皮卷饼、丰富配料薯条、炸鸡、组合套餐和限量特供，轮廓与配料明显不同但共享统一品牌视觉系统。品牌使用现代、粗体、易读的纯英文标志，并持续出现小型官方风格 BRISK BITE 标志。价格标签使用 $8.90、$11.50、$6.90、$9.90、$13.90、$10.90，必须可读且自然融入快餐广告。配以 Hot. Fresh. Fast.、Made for Cravings.、Today’s Best Combo.、Big Flavor, Quick Fix.、Weekend Favorite. 等简短英文辅助语。使用亮橙、暖黄、乳米色、深棕、红色和柔和米白的高对比促销调色板，变化各格背景与图形块但保持整洁统一；仅在价格或卖点附近加入少量手写箭头、强调标记或小圆圈。食物超写实、干净、诱人：柔软有光泽的面包、酥脆炸鸡、融化拉丝奶酪、金黄薯条、烘烤起泡卷饼、浓郁发亮酱汁和新鲜蔬菜；使用柔和高端商业食物光，短促受控阴影和精细材质高光。整体像世界级快餐发布活动或数字菜单促销系列，明亮、图形化、年轻且商业化；避免廉价传单、卡通或 3D 食物、凌乱排版、不可读价格、过饱和混乱和低分辨率纹理。

items.title: 23岁日系女性居家束发晨光人像
items.description: 一幅 3:4 竖幅生活方式人像：成年日本女性在明亮晨光中抬手束起马尾，白色细肩带居家服与慵懒自然的居家氛围形成简洁画面。
items.prompt: Hyper-realistic natural lifestyle portrait of a 23-year-old adult Japanese woman wearing fitted but opaque white spaghetti-strap homewear, raising both hands to tie her hair into a ponytail. The action naturally lengthens the waist and captures a relaxed morning grooming moment; keep the composition tasteful and non-revealing, with no exposure of sensitive areas and no deliberate emphasis on the body. Bright morning sunlight enters from the side, creating soft natural light and a lazy lived-in atmosphere. Realistic skin tone, natural skin texture, and authentic fabric detail; avoid studio stiffness, excessive retouching, and plastic-looking skin. 3:4 vertical format.
items.prompt_zh: 超写实自然生活方式人像，一名 23 岁的成年日本女性穿着合身但不透视的白色细肩带居家服，抬起双手将头发束成马尾。动作自然地拉伸腰线并呈现轻松的晨间整理瞬间，保持端庄构图，不暴露敏感部位，不刻意强调身体。明亮的早晨阳光从侧面照入，形成柔和自然的光影和慵懒生活感；真实肤色、自然皮肤纹理、真实布料质感，避免影棚感、过度修图和塑料皮肤。3:4 竖幅。

items.title: 超写实机场韩系甜妹生活照
items.description: 一张 3:4 竖幅机场生活抓拍：成年东亚女性蹲在候机大厅整理手提包，冷白 LED 环境光、旅行物件和手机摄影质感共同营造自然的旅途瞬间。
items.prompt: Hyper-realistic real-person mobile snapshot of an adult East Asian woman around 22, squatting on the floor of a modern airport departure hall in a Korean sweet-style lifestyle-photo mood. Light gray marble floor and yellow tactile paving cross the frame; distant check-in counters, travelers, and suitcases are naturally blurred. Cool-white ceiling LED lighting is even and soft, with no obvious shadows and an overall cool-white tone. Place a black backpack in the lower left, a lavender suitcase on the right, a transparent cup of iced Americano on the floor, and a naturally scattered boarding pass. She has an oval face, large deep-brown eyes with visible aegyo-sal, slender Korean-style eyeliner, light pink eyeshadow, long eyelashes, pink moist lips, broad pink cheek blush, a slightly red nose tip, and a small amount of fine glitter under the eyes; cool fair pink-leaning skin retains pores and realistic texture without excessive smoothing. Dark-brown long hair falls over her shoulders with air bangs, smooth strands, and pink bow-ribbon clips on both sides. She wears a lavender slim-fit round-neck short-sleeve T-shirt, light-pink plaid pleated short skirt, silver navel piercing, and white sneakers, with realistic fabric stretch texture. Her body faces the camera at about 45°; left foot flat, right leg naturally tucked; left hand holds the suitcase pull rod while the right opens an off-white handbag to look for something, as if rummaging during travel. Mouth slightly puffed and pouting, no smile; eyes look to the right side of the frame rather than at the camera, with a dazed, cute, slightly spaced-out expression. Vertical 3:4, photographer about 1 meter away, 24mm mobile wide-angle lens, slight high-angle view, full head-to-shoes framing, subject center-right occupying about 75% of the frame. iPhone lifestyle photography, native mobile HDR, natural exposure, slight phone sharpening, slight JPEG compression and noise reduction, natural skin tone, slight background blur; no cinematic filter, studio lighting, AI plastic skin, CG texture, excessive smoothing, or commercial-ad feel.
items.prompt_zh: 超写实真人手机抓拍，一位约 22 岁的成年东亚女性，以韩系甜美生活照风格蹲在现代机场候机大厅地面。浅灰色大理石地面和横穿画面的黄色导盲砖，远处值机柜台、旅客与行李箱自然虚化；顶部冷白 LED 均匀照明，柔和环境光，无明显阴影，整体冷白色调。左下角放黑色双肩包，右侧放淡紫色登机箱，地面有透明塑料杯冰美式咖啡和一张自然散落的登机牌。主体椭圆脸、深棕大眼睛、卧蚕、细长韩系眼线、淡粉眼影、纤长睫毛、粉嫩嘴唇和大面积粉嫩腮红，鼻尖微红，眼下少量细闪；冷白偏粉肤色保留毛孔和真实皮肤纹理，不过度磨皮。深棕色长发自然披肩，空气刘海，两侧粉色蝴蝶结丝带发夹自然垂落，发顶略蓬松。穿淡紫色修身圆领短袖 T 恤、浅粉色格纹百褶短裙、银色脐钉和白色运动鞋；服装保持真实布料拉伸纹理。身体朝向镜头约 45°，左脚完全着地，右腿自然收起；左手握行李箱拉杆，右手打开米白色手提包寻找物品，像旅行途中临时翻包。嘴巴轻轻鼓起并微微嘟嘴，不微笑；眼睛看向画面右侧，不直视镜头，神情呆萌又略微放空。竖版 3:4，摄影师距离约 1 米，24mm 手机广角镜头，略微俯拍，从头部完整拍到鞋子，人物位于画面中央偏右并占约 75% 画面。iPhone 生活摄影、手机原生 HDR、自然曝光、轻微手机锐化、轻微 JPEG 压缩和降噪、自然肤色、背景轻微虚化；避免电影滤镜、摄影棚布光、AI 塑料皮肤、CG 质感、过度磨皮和商业广告感。

items.title: 真实感东亚女性旅行连拍
items.description: 四张独立的 9:16 夏日旅行照片，保持同一位成年东亚女性的连续身份，同时通过自拍高度、角度、身体朝向、表情、眼神和构图形成一眼可辨的差异。
items.prompt: Generate 4 independent 9:16 vertical photos, with no collage, four-grid layout, or multiple scenes on one canvas. The four photos form a continuous record of the same young adult East Asian woman on one summer seaside trip; keep her identity, hairstyle, makeup, and outfit consistent, while changing at least six of these in every adjacent pair: phone height, shooting angle, body orientation, head direction, eye direction, facial expression, hand actions, and composition ratio. No consecutive photos may repeat pose, angle, expression, gaze, gesture, or composition. Unified style: ultra-realistic mobile travel photography, authentic iPhone 17 Pro front-facing selfie texture, Apple Smart HDR, natural exposure and automatic white balance, slight handheld shake and motion blur, natural skin tone and real hair texture; a casually captured moment by a friend, with no studio or commercial-ad feel. Subject: young adult East Asian woman with light collarbone-length hair, clear natural makeup, and realistic skin texture; white or light-pink suspender dress with a light knit cardigan, or a short off-shoulder top with a high-waisted skirt, accented with lace and bows, healthy and natural overall. Photo 1: seaside railing, high-angle selfie about 30° downward, leaning against the railing, looking back at the camera with a closed-mouth light smile and relaxed shoulders. Photo 2: seaside cafe street corner, phone at chest height for a slight low angle, body in a 45° profile, one hand holding sunglasses or a small camera and the other taking a selfie, slight sunlight squint and pursed-lip smile. Photo 3: a friend’s snapshot, not a selfie; body in about a 30° profile while walking forward, one hand adjusting hair and the other swinging naturally, looking toward the distant street instead of the camera with a slightly shy natural smile. Photo 4: sunset beach, phone held above the head for a selfie, body turned about 80°, wind lifting hair and skirt, direct gaze with a natural brilliant smile, one foot lightly touching the edge of the waves, relaxed happy end-of-trip mood. Retain the low-key artistic signature “DeepBlue” in the bottom-left corner. Negative constraints: collage, four-grid, multiple characters, repeated actions, repeated selfie angles, studio photography, commercial advertisement, CG, 3D, anime, excessive smoothing, plastic skin, AI face, empty eyes, malformed fingers, face deformation, low resolution, or extra text watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 请生成 4 张独立输出的 9:16 竖幅照片，不要拼图、四宫格或同一画布中的多画面。四张照片表现同一位年轻成年东亚女性在同一次夏日海滨旅行中的连续记录，保持身份和发型、妆容、穿搭一致；每张必须明显改变至少六项：手机持机高度、拍摄角度、身体朝向、头部方向、眼神方向、面部表情、双手动作、构图比例，连续两张不得重复姿势、角度、表情、眼神、手势或构图。统一为超写实手机旅行摄影，真实 iPhone 17 Pro 前置自拍质感，Apple Smart HDR，自然曝光和自动白平衡，轻微手持晃动与运动模糊，自然肤色和真实毛发纹理；像朋友随手记录的旅行瞬间，没有影楼感或商业广告感。主体为年轻成年东亚女性，轻盈锁骨短发、清透自然妆容和真实皮肤纹理；穿白色或浅粉色吊带连衣裙配轻薄针织开衫，或短款露肩上衣配高腰半身裙，带蕾丝和蝴蝶结点缀，整体健康自然。照片 1：海边栏杆，高机位约 30° 俯拍，身体靠栏杆，回头看镜头，闭嘴浅笑，肩膀放松。照片 2：海边咖啡店街角，胸口高度微仰拍，身体 45° 侧身，一手拿太阳镜或小相机、另一手自拍，迎光眯眼并抿嘴笑。照片 3：朋友抓拍而非自拍，身体约 30° 侧身向前走，一手整理头发、另一手自然摆动，不看镜头而望向街道远方，带轻微害羞的自然浅笑。照片 4：落日海滩，手机举过头顶自拍，身体约 80° 转身，风吹起头发和裙摆，眼神看镜头并露出自然灿烂笑容，一只脚轻踩海浪边缘，呈现旅行结束时轻松快乐的氛围。画面左下角保留低调艺术签名“DeepBlue”。负面约束：拼图、四宫格、多人物、重复动作、重复自拍角度、影楼写真、商业广告、CG、3D、动漫风、过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、AI 脸、空洞眼神、错误手指、脸部变形、低清晰度和额外文字水印。

items.title: 真实手机闪光灯女性写实自拍
items.description: 可配置六字段的9:16写实iPhone自拍模板，以低角度近距离透视、昏暗室内直接闪光和墙上与姿势一致的大型人影为核心。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical highly realistic iPhone selfie using these parameters: character a clearly adult East Asian woman in her late 20s with a natural everyday appearance; hair shoulder-length dark hair with a loose natural wave; outfit a simple dark knit top with minimal silver accessories; expression direct calm eye contact with a relaxed neutral expression; setting a dim apartment corner with a plain light wall; mood cool, relaxed, and quietly mysterious. The subject is an adult woman photographed from a subtle low angle with the phone held slightly below her face. One arm naturally extends toward the camera for believable close-range perspective without excessive enlargement. Use direct calm eye contact with a relaxed neutral expression to create clear eye contact with the lens; keep the posture relaxed and spontaneous like a real selfie rather than a professional fashion pose. In the dim indoor a dim apartment corner with a plain light wall, use strong direct phone flash to clearly illuminate her face, shoulders, clothing, and accessories. A large visible human shadow appears on the plain wall behind her, showing the correct outline of her head, hair, shoulders, and upper body; make its direction match her pose and the flash. The image should feel like a real iPhone photo with slight wide-angle perspective, imperfect framing, natural exposure, subtle digital noise, and no studio lighting. Keep skin highly realistic with visible pores, fine facial texture, slight uneven tone, natural under-eye detail, and authentic flash reflections; no beauty filter, excessive smoothing, porcelain skin, CGI or silicone texture, anime features, or over-polished AI face. Maintain accurate anatomy, natural arm proportions, correct hands and fingers, realistic hair strands, authentic fabric folds, and stable accessories. Show only two arms and two hands; no extra limbs, distorted shadow, warped background, or commercial glamour photography. Apply the defined a clearly adult East Asian woman in her late 20s with a natural everyday appearance, shoulder-length dark hair with a loose natural wave, a simple dark knit top with minimal silver accessories, and cool, relaxed, and quietly mysterious without changing the subject's adult presentation.
items.prompt_zh: 用以下参数创建一张9:16竖版高度写实iPhone自拍：角色a clearly adult East Asian woman in her late 20s with a natural everyday appearance；头发shoulder-length dark hair with a loose natural wave；服装a simple dark knit top with minimal silver accessories；表情direct calm eye contact with a relaxed neutral expression；场景a dim apartment corner with a plain light wall；情绪cool, relaxed, and quietly mysterious。主体为成年女性，手机握在脸部稍下方，以微妙低角度拍摄；一只手臂自然伸向镜头，形成可信近距离透视但不过度放大手臂。她按direct calm eye contact with a relaxed neutral expression与镜头建立清晰眼神交流，姿势轻松自然，像真实自拍而非专业时尚摆拍。在a dim apartment corner with a plain light wall的昏暗室内使用强烈手机直接闪光，清晰照亮脸部、肩膀、服装和配饰；身后素色墙上出现一个巨大可见的人影，正确呈现头部、头发、肩膀和上半身轮廓，阴影方向与姿势及闪光方向一致。画面应像真实iPhone照片：轻微广角透视、不完美构图、自然曝光、细微数字噪点、无影棚灯光。皮肤高度写实，保留毛孔、细腻面部纹理、轻微不均匀肤色、自然眼下细节和真实闪光反射；无美颜滤镜、过度平滑、瓷肌、CGI/硅胶皮肤、动漫特征或过度修饰AI脸。保持准确解剖、自然手臂比例、正确双手与手指、真实发丝、织物褶皱和稳定配饰；只有两条手臂和两只手，无额外肢体、扭曲阴影、变形背景或商业魅力摄影。

items.title: 科技感3D路径叙事视觉海报
items.description: 可配置主题与四阶段节点的3D Journey Mapping海报模板，以深海军蓝至黑色背景、S形立体路径和冷白终点成果构建科技叙事。
items.prompt: Design a 3:4 vertical “Path Narrative 3D Scene” visual poster for a sustainable product launch workflow, titled 3D Journey Mapping. Use a gradient background from deep navy blue to pure black. At the center, build a three-dimensional path that enters from the bottom left and spirals upward into the distance, forming a clear S-shaped visual movement. Give the path real spatial thickness, soft chamfers, and precise engineering structure. Place four sequential key nodes along it: 01 SOURCE, 02 DESIGN, 03 BUILD, and 04 LAUNCH. Express each stage with miniature architecture, equipment, abstract installations, or people only when necessary; place the final outcome 04 LAUNCH at the path endpoint, make it the largest element, and illuminate it with a cold-white spotlight as the focal point. Use isometric perspective and miniature sandbox texture with matte metal, frosted glass, and low-reflection plastic. Use deep blue, graphite black, and cold white as the main palette, with only a small amount of electric cyan to mark path direction. Put a bold sans-serif title, 3D Journey Mapping, in approximately the upper 20% of the image. Show node information through small numbers, coordinates, arrows, and extremely short labels, keeping typography sparse and legible. Make the result feel like a combination of a future transportation system, a technology-brand website, and cinematic 3D information visual language. Avoid an ordinary flowchart, flat arrows, dense text, cartoon-toy styling, neon cities, meaningless mechanical parts, broken paths, confused node order, and an underemphasized final outcome.
items.prompt_zh: 为a sustainable product launch workflow设计一张3:4竖版“路径叙事式3D场景”视觉海报，标题为3D Journey Mapping。整体背景为深海军蓝到纯黑的渐变。画面中心是一条从左下进入、向远处盘旋上升的立体路径，形成清晰S形视觉动线；路径具有真实空间厚度、柔和倒角和精密工程结构。沿路径依次设置四个关键节点：01 SOURCE、02 DESIGN、03 BUILD、04 LAUNCH。每个节点使用微缩建筑、设备、抽象装置或必要人物表达对应阶段；最终成果04 LAUNCH位于路径终点，尺寸最大，并由冷白聚光照亮成为全画面焦点。采用等距透视与微缩沙盘质感，材质结合哑光金属、磨砂玻璃和低反射塑料。主色为深蓝、石墨黑和冷白，仅用少量电光青标记路径方向。上方约20%区域放置粗体无衬线标题3D Journey Mapping；节点信息使用小型编号、坐标、箭头和极短标签，保持文字稀疏清晰。整体像未来交通系统、科技品牌官网和电影级3D信息视觉的结合。避免普通流程图、扁平箭头、密集文字、卡通玩具感、霓虹城市、无意义机械零件、路径断裂、节点顺序混乱和终点成果不突出。

items.title: 坐在蓝色折叠椅上的东亚女性
items.description: 户外自然光下的成年东亚女性全身时尚肖像，坐在亮蓝木折叠椅上，以蓝白水泥墙、蕨类植物和白色小桌构成清爽生活场景。
items.prompt: A clearly adult East Asian woman with fair skin and long straight black hair styled in a loose side braid over her left shoulder, sitting gracefully outdoors on a bright blue wooden folding chair. She wears a fitted black square-neck mini dress with short puffed sleeves and a delicate gold pendant necklace; soft white ankle socks and chunky white platform sneakers complete the look. Her eyes are gently closed with a naturally shy smile, her right hand lightly raised near her cheek in a cute but not childish gesture, and her left hand resting on her thigh. To her left, place a small round white table holding a tiny white handbag with pink bow and pearl details. Use a two-tone blue-and-white painted concrete wall with lush green ferns and broad-leaf plants beside it, plus gravel ground. Use natural soft daylight and realistic photography in a full-body shot from a slightly low angle. Keep contact between body and chair natural, anatomy believable, and clothing, bag, concrete, foliage, and gravel physically realistic. Make the image fresh, gentle, and lived-in. Avoid an underage-looking subject, a cartoon face, excessive beautification, plastic skin, wrong fingers, deformed joints, a floating chair, a distorted handbag, a cluttered background, text, watermarks, and logos.
items.prompt_zh: 一位明确成年东亚女性，皮肤白皙，黑色长直发在左肩编成松散侧编发，优雅地坐在户外一张亮蓝木质折叠椅上。她穿修身黑色方领迷你连衣裙，带短泡泡袖，佩戴精致金色吊坠项链；柔软白色短袜与厚底白色运动鞋完成造型。双眼轻闭，带羞涩自然的微笑，右手轻抬在脸颊旁做可爱但不低幼的姿势，左手放在大腿上。她左侧有一张白色小圆桌，桌上放着小巧白色手提包，带粉色蝴蝶结和珍珠装饰。背景是蓝白双色彩绘水泥墙，旁边生长茂盛绿色蕨类和阔叶植物，地面为碎石。使用自然柔和日光和写实摄影，略低角度全身照，保持人物与椅子接触自然、解剖结构可信、服装和植物材质真实。画面清爽、温柔、生活化，避免未成年观感、卡通脸、过度美颜、塑料皮肤、错误手指、畸形关节、漂浮椅子、包袋变形、杂乱背景、文字、水印和Logo。

items.title: 超写实古寺东亚女性奢华时尚人像
items.description: 成年东亚女性坐在百年佛教寺庙石阶上的奢华旅行时尚肖像，黑色亚洲风礼服、金红刺绣与蜡染丝绸披肩在暖金阳光下形成史诗般的历史氛围。
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic cinematic luxury travel portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman seated elegantly on the ancient stone steps of a magnificent centuries-old Buddhist temple. She turns gracefully over her shoulder toward the camera with a calm, confident, mysterious magnetic gaze. Give her naturally refined porcelain-like skin, delicate blush, glossy soft-rose lips, a refined nose, neat brows, and deep-brown eyes with natural cinematic catchlights. Loose silky chestnut strands move around her face while an elegant updo is adorned with intricate gold floral ornaments. Dress her in an exquisite off-shoulder black luxury gown inspired by traditional Asian fashion, richly embroidered with deep crimson, burgundy, and antique-gold floral beadwork that catches the sunlight; drape a premium batik-patterned silk wrap across her lap for graceful movement and rich texture. Show ancient volcanic-stone architecture, dramatic temple walls, weathered stone staircases, and towering sacred structures in the background to create an epic historical atmosphere. Use warm golden sunlight for cinematic highlights, soft shadows, and extraordinary depth while preserving realistic colors and materials. Capture it from a slightly low angle with a full-frame mirrorless camera and an 85mm f/1.4 portrait lens, ultra-shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the eyes, creamy background bokeh, natural HDR lighting, and a refined blend of documentary travel realism and high-end fashion editorial composition. Render photorealistic skin pores, lifelike fabrics, restrained cinematic grading, and premium luxury storytelling. Avoid infantilization, identity confusion, cartoon or CG styling, plastic skin, excessive retouching, excessive exposure, modern casual clothing, cluttered jewelry, deformed hands, blurry eyes, incorrect perspective, excessive blur, text, watermarks, logos, distortion, and unnatural structures.
items.prompt_zh: 超写实电影感奢华旅行人像，一位明确成年东亚女性优雅坐在宏伟百年佛教寺庙的古老石阶上，回眸看向镜头，神情冷静、自信、神秘而有磁性。她有自然细腻的瓷感皮肤、柔和腮红、光泽玫瑰色嘴唇、精致鼻型、整齐眉形和深棕色眼睛，眼中有自然电影感眼神光；松散丝滑的栗色发丝在脸侧轻拂，优雅盘发配精致金色花朵饰物。她穿露肩黑色奢华礼服，灵感来自传统亚洲时尚，装饰深红、勃艮第红和古金色花卉珠绣，在阳光下有细碎光泽；高级蜡染图案丝绸披肩披在膝上，形成柔和动感与丰富纹理。背景展示古老火山石建筑、戏剧性寺庙墙壁、风化石梯和高耸神圣结构，营造史诗历史氛围。温暖金色阳光产生电影般亮部、柔和阴影和深度，同时保持真实色彩与材质。使用全画幅无反相机、85mm f/1.4人像镜头和略低角度，超浅景深，眼睛锐利对焦，奶油般背景虚化，自然HDR照明，高端旅行纪实与时尚社论构图，超写实照片级真实，细腻皮肤毛孔、逼真面料、克制电影调色和高级奢华叙事。避免低幼化、身份混淆、卡通、CG、塑料皮肤、过度美颜、过度暴露、现代休闲服、杂乱首饰、畸形手、模糊眼睛、错误透视、过度虚化、文字、水印、Logo、失真和不自然结构。

items.title: 简约现代扁平矢量人像插画
items.description: 身份参考绑定的现代扁平矢量肖像，保留参考人物的面部、黑色圆框眼镜、蓬松上扫发型与浓密胡须，置于纯活力绿背景。
items.prompt: Using the uploaded reference image, create a clean modern flat vector portrait illustration of the same person. Precisely preserve the person's facial features, face shape, expression, black round eyeglasses, and overall hairstyle. Keep the natural jet-black hair thick, voluminous, slightly messy, and swept upward as in the reference, with believable highlights and texture. Make the beard full, neatly trimmed, and natural black. Dress the person in a plain black crew-neck T-shirt. Replace the background with a solid vibrant green #2E7D32. Use smooth gradients, crisp edges, minimal shadows, and a professional Adobe Illustrator flat-vector aesthetic with refined Dribbble-style finish. Center the portrait in a front-facing symmetrical composition with shoulders visible, clean lines, clear detail, and a high-resolution-ready finish. Include no text, logos, watermarks, or extra objects. Preserve the reference identity without changing facial proportions, glasses, hairstyle, or beard characteristics.
items.prompt_zh: 根据已上传的参考图，为参考图中的同一个人创作一幅干净现代的扁平矢量肖像插画。精确保留其面部特征、脸型、表情、黑色圆框眼镜和整体发型；天然乌黑头发应有真实高光与质感，保持参考图中的厚实、蓬松、略显凌乱且向上扫的造型。胡须浓密、修剪整齐、自然黑色。人物穿纯黑色圆领T恤。将背景替换为纯色活力绿色#2E7D32。使用平滑渐变、清晰边缘、极简阴影和专业Adobe Illustrator风格的平面矢量美学，结合精炼Dribbble式视觉完成度。人像居中、正面、对称构图，露出肩膀，线条干净、细节清楚、适合高分辨率输出。无文字、徽标、水印或多余物品。保留参考身份，不改变面部比例、眼镜、发型或胡须特征。

items.title: 静奢风精品店胡桃木内饰时尚人像
items.description: 高端精品咖啡馆或酒店休息室中的成年女性静奢时尚肖像，胡桃木、黄铜、大理石与深靛蓝穿搭构成温暖克制的社论画面。
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic quiet-luxury fashion portrait photographed inside an elegant boutique café or luxury hotel lounge with warm walnut interiors, contemporary old-money restraint, and polished editorial photography attributes. A clearly adult woman stands naturally beside a polished walnut wall in a relaxed three-quarter stance, one leg casually crossed in front of the other to create a long elegant silhouette. Both hands rest comfortably behind her waist beneath a relaxed leather jacket, while her head turns slightly left as if quietly observing someone across the room. Give her warm olive skin, softly sculpted cheekbones, feathered brows, subtle brown eyes, naturally glossy nude lips, and understated luxury makeup. Her expression is calm, confident, effortless, and sophisticated, without smiling. Long chestnut-brown hair falls straight with soft face-framing layers and subtle caramel highlights near the ends, silky and naturally reflective under warm ambient light. Dress her in a fitted ivory long-sleeve bodysuit tucked into high-waisted deep-indigo flared jeans with a 1970s-inspired elongated silhouette, defined by a wide chocolate-brown leather belt with a polished rectangular buckle. Drape an oversized black buttery leather bomber jacket loosely across her shoulders. Build the background from floor-to-ceiling walnut paneling, vertical wood slats, framed black-and-white photography, brushed brass hardware, marble flooring, warm architectural lighting, and a simple wooden café stool beside her. Mix soft warm hotel ambient light with subtle window daylight for natural skin tones, gentle shadows, realistic leather reflections, and cinematic editorial depth. Use espresso brown, warm walnut, ivory, deep indigo, matte black, aged brass, cream marble, and soft amber light. Shoot with a Leica Q3 and 50mm Summilux lens, shallow depth of field, natural perspective, Vogue editorial composition, realistic skin texture, luxury fashion campaign, effortless elegance, quiet-luxury lifestyle, and cinematic realism. Avoid an underage-looking subject, cartoon styling, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, modern athletic clothing, oversized jewelry, wrong anatomy, incorrect fingers, a cluttered background, cheap gold, oversaturation, text, watermarks, and logos.
items.prompt_zh: 一张超写实静奢风时尚肖像，拍摄于雅致精品咖啡馆或奢华酒店休息室，温暖胡桃木内饰、当代老钱审美和克制高级的编辑摄影属性。一位明确成年女性自然站在抛光胡桃木墙旁，身体呈放松三分之二姿态，一条腿随意交叉在另一条腿前，形成修长优雅轮廓；双手舒适地放在宽松皮夹克下的腰后，头部略转向左侧，像在安静观察房间对面的人。她有温暖橄榄色皮肤、柔和雕塑感颧骨、羽毛状眉毛、含蓄棕色眼睛、自然光泽裸色嘴唇和低调奢华妆容，表情平静、自信、从容、老练，不微笑。栗褐色长发直落，带柔和修颜层次和细微焦糖色挑染，温暖环境光下丝滑且有自然反光。穿合身象牙色长袖连体衣，塞入受1970年代启发的高腰深靛蓝喇叭牛仔裤，腰间为带抛光矩形扣的宽巧克力色皮带；外搭特大号黑色细腻皮革飞行员夹克，松松披在肩上。背景包含落地胡桃木墙板、垂直木条、装裱黑白摄影、拉丝黄铜五金、大理石地板、温暖建筑照明和身旁简洁木制咖啡馆凳。柔和温暖酒店环境光结合细微窗光，塑造自然肤色、柔和阴影、皮夹克真实反射和电影般社论深度。使用浓缩咖啡棕、暖胡桃木、象牙、深靛蓝、哑光黑、陈年黄铜、奶油大理石和柔和琥珀光。使用Leica Q3与50mm Summilux镜头，浅景深、自然透视、Vogue社论构图、逼真皮肤纹理、奢华时尚广告和静奢生活方式质感。避免未成年观感、卡通、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、现代运动服、夸张珠宝、错误肢体、手指错误、杂乱背景、廉价金色、过饱和、文字、水印和Logo。

items.title: iPhone17俯拍视角韩系水光肌江边夜景人像
items.description: 身份参考绑定的深夜江边生活方式肖像：人物在狭窄石阶上坐姿自然，抬高手机以陡峭俯拍配合直接闪光，保留可辨识面部、钩针包和真实户外细节。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded facial reference as the primary face reference, precisely preserving recognizable identity, facial proportions, natural asymmetry, and authentic features; render Korean glass skin with a pinkish glow, dewy supple texture, and visible fine pores. Create a candid outdoor portrait late at night beside a dark riverside or lakeside stone ledge, captured with the RAW iPhone 17 Pro rear camera and direct built-in flash. Hold the phone unusually high at approximately 55–65° above the subject, angle it steeply downward, and add a subtle 7° handheld Dutch tilt. Include the full head-to-shoes seated pose, long deep-black hair, colorful crochet shoulder bag, narrow weathered stone ledge, rough pathway, pink-and-white wildflowers, and nearly black water. Place the subject slightly below center and toward camera-left, let the path recede diagonally toward the upper right, and preserve generous dark negative space across the water and upper-left frame. Make it feel like an accidental authentic smartphone capture rather than a professional pose. Keep body mechanics physically believable: pelvis rotated about 35° toward the water, ribcage independently rotated about 40° back toward camera-left and upward to the phone, and neck rotated about 45° upward to the phone. Use a relaxed anatomical S-curve, weight on the rear right pelvis, slightly reduced pressure on the left hip, realistic leg separation, and stable foot support. Maintain exactly two arms and two hands: left hand low near the left knee, right hand low near the right thigh or bag strap and mostly concealed by hair and clothing, with no additional hidden hands or duplicated limbs. Use loose natural espresso-black waves with windblown strands crossing the forehead, cheek, and one eye without fully obscuring identity. Dress her in a relaxed white long-sleeve top with deep-red shoulder panels and medium-wash blue denim jeans. Add a handmade crochet shoulder bag with bold horizontal red, orange, cobalt-blue, turquoise, yellow, and white stripes, visible yarn fibers, realistic stitch definition, natural sag, and a strap following the shoulder and ribcage; place a small olive-green pouch near the legs. Add white sneakers, small silver earrings, a pendant necklace, slim rings, and bracelets. Direct flash should illuminate the face, readable eyes, hair, crochet yarn, denim, and shoes; flowers and stone edges catch scattered highlights while water remains nearly black with restrained reflections. No cinematic grading, Portrait Mode blur, DSLR bokeh, or creamy background separation. Use a 1× lens, authentic iPhone computational photography, natural HDR, deep focus, realistic edge sharpening, warm-neutral nighttime white balance, mild low-light digital noise, and realistic JPEG processing. --ar 4:5. Preserve identity reference, realistic anatomy, shoulder attachment, 35°/40° counter-rotation, 45° neck direction, correct finger count, seated weight, bag-strap tension, and contact with the stone ledge. Prohibit altered identity, an empty black backdrop, extra arms, duplicated hands, deformed joints, floating feet, fused fingers, warped crochet patterns, text, watermarks, timestamps, and app UI.
items.prompt_zh: 使用已上传的面部参考图作为主要面部参考，精确保留可辨识身份、面部比例、自然不对称和真实特征；呈现带粉色光泽的韩国水光肌、润泽皮肤与细微毛孔。创作一张深夜黑暗河岸或湖边石阶旁的自然户外肖像，使用RAW iPhone 17 Pro后置摄像头和直接内置闪光灯。手机位于人物上方约55–65°，陡峭向下并带约7°手持荷兰式倾斜；完整纳入头顶至鞋子、坐姿、深黑长发、彩色钩针单肩包、狭窄风化石阶、粗糙小径、粉白野花和近乎漆黑的水面。人物置于中心略下方偏左，石径向右上方对角线延伸，水面与左上方保留大面积深色负空间；画面要像偶然真实的智能手机抓拍而非摆拍。身体力学必须可信：骨盆朝水面旋转约35°，肋骨独立向左并向手机旋转约40°，颈部向手机旋转约45°；脊柱为自然S曲线，重量落在后侧右骨盆，左髋略减压，双腿有真实分离与稳定脚部支撑。保持正好两只手臂和两只手：左手低垂在左膝附近，右手低垂在右大腿或包带附近且大部分被头发衣服遮挡，无额外隐藏手或重复肢体。长而深的浓缩咖啡黑色自然波浪发，几缕被风吹过额头、脸颊和一只眼睛但不完全遮挡身份。穿宽松白色长袖上衣，肩部有深红色拼块，搭配中洗蓝牛仔裤；彩色手工钩针单肩包有红、橙、钴蓝、绿松石、黄、白粗横条纹和清晰纱线纤维，包带正确贴合肩肋，腿边有小橄榄绿布袋；配白色运动鞋、小银耳环、吊坠项链、细戒指和手镯。直接闪光照亮面部、眼睛、发丝、钩针纱线、牛仔布和鞋，花草与石阶有零星高光，水面近黑仅有克制倒影；禁止电影调色、Portrait Mode模糊、DSLR焦外和奶油背景分离。使用1×镜头，真实iPhone计算摄影、自然HDR、深焦、真实边缘锐化、暖中性夜间白平衡、轻微低光噪点和JPEG处理。--ar 4:5。保持身份参考、真实解剖、肩部连接、35°/40°反向躯干旋转、45°颈部方向、正确手指数量、坐姿重量、包带张力与石阶接触。禁止改变身份、空洞黑背景、额外手臂、重复手、畸形关节、悬浮脚、融合手指、错误钩针图案、文字、水印、时间戳和应用界面。

items.title: 资深品牌设计师四图视觉识别提案
items.description: 可配置品牌信息与设计方向的四图品牌视觉识别提案模板，输出统一但版式各异的品牌世界观、Logo逻辑、视觉系统和应用落地四张独立海报。
items.prompt: Directly generate a proposal of 4 independent images in a default 4:5 vertical format; do not output image prompts first and do not merge them into one collage. Brand information: Chinese brand name 澄屿; English brand name CLEAR ISLE; industry premium tea and lifestyle goods; products or services loose-leaf tea, gift sets, and a tasting space; positioning and audience quiet luxury for design-conscious urban adults; core concept clarity, ritual, and a calm connection to nature; personality keywords quiet, refined, contemporary, tactile; brand slogan A Clearer Ritual; logo inspiration waterline, folded paper, and a small island horizon; logo type abstract geometric symbol with bilingual wordmark; logo meaning a clear horizon and a pause in the day; avoid elements literal tea leaves, generic lotus, incense burner, and traditional seal; visual style quiet luxury, editorial, tactile minimalism; primary color deep ink blue; secondary and accent colors warm ivory, mineral grey, muted jade, and champagne accent; materials uncoated paper, pale stone, brushed metal, frosted glass, and woven fabric; photography or spatial atmosphere soft morning light, calm shadows, and a quiet contemporary tasting room; products, packaging, and applications tea tins, gift box, paper bag, tasting card, cup, apron, storefront sign, and wayfinding; text language Chinese-English combination; supplementary requirements keep the logo legible at small scale and preserve generous whitespace. If non-critical fields are empty, infer a coherent solution from the industry, positioning, and concept. First lock one original logo system: an independently recognizable Symbol and Chinese/English wordmarks, colors, typography, materials, photographic language, and secondary patterns derived from the logo outline, curves, or negative space. The Symbol must not be text-only; give it clear geometry or negative space suitable for embossing, gold stamping, embroidery, engraving, and spatial signage. Abstract common industry icons rather than copying them. Keep the logo outline, internal structure, wordmarks, and lockup consistent across all four images. Generate four independent images in order: 1. Brand Worldview and Concept Cover—large key visual, complete logo, Chinese and English names, concept title, manifesto, 3–5 mood or material images, and a few meaningful handwritten notes; 2. Logo Concept and Symbol Generation Logic—oversized Symbol, complete logo, bilingual wordmarks, horizontal and vertical lockups, simplified version, source sketches, negative-space and structural relationships, with a few arrows and circles; 3. Brand Visual Language and Design System—primary and secondary colors, fonts, real materials, photographic language, logo crops, and secondary patterns extracted from the logo, combining an orderly grid with free collage; 4. Brand Application and Experience Scenarios—show 5–7 industry-appropriate touchpoints with one large product or spatial key visual plus 4–6 application details, layering the complete logo, independent Symbol, and secondary patterns without repeating the full brand name on every item. Every image needs a striking large title, short subtitle, core description, 2–4 keywords, 2–4 meaningful handwritten notes, a clear visual center, and approximately 25%–35% white space. Unify brand name, logo, typography, colors, materials, photographic atmosphere, margins, and guide lines, while varying the four layouts as key-visual collage, logo-structure research, color/type/material system, and product-space application. Use high-end brand proposal, Editorial magazine, and modern visual-identity case-study language. Avoid ordinary PPTs, traditional VI tables, stock mockup collections, long body text, crowded information, low-quality 3D, cheap gold, color drift, logo-structure changes, garbled text, watermarks, and unreadable typography.
items.prompt_zh: 请直接生成一套4 independent images、默认4:5竖版的品牌视觉识别提案，不先输出生图提示词，也不要合并成一张拼图。品牌信息：中文品牌名澄屿；英文品牌名CLEAR ISLE；行业premium tea and lifestyle goods；产品或服务loose-leaf tea, gift sets, and a tasting space；定位与目标人群quiet luxury for design-conscious urban adults；核心理念clarity, ritual, and a calm connection to nature；性格关键词quiet, refined, contemporary, tactile；品牌标语A Clearer Ritual；Logo灵感waterline, folded paper, and a small island horizon；Logo类型abstract geometric symbol with bilingual wordmark；Logo含义a clear horizon and a pause in the day；避免元素literal tea leaves, generic lotus, incense burner, and traditional seal；整体视觉风格quiet luxury, editorial, tactile minimalism；主色deep ink blue；辅助/点缀色warm ivory, mineral grey, muted jade, and champagne accent；主要材质uncoated paper, pale stone, brushed metal, frosted glass, and woven fabric；摄影或空间氛围soft morning light, calm shadows, and a quiet contemporary tasting room；产品、包装和应用tea tins, gift box, paper bag, tasting card, cup, apron, storefront sign, and wayfinding；文字语言Chinese-English combination；补充要求keep the logo legible at small scale and preserve generous whitespace。若非关键字段为空，结合行业、定位和理念补充合理方案。先锁定一个原创Logo系统：独立可识别的Symbol与中英文品牌字标、颜色、字体、材质、摄影语言、由Logo轮廓/曲线/负空间延展的辅助纹样；Symbol不可只是文字，应有清晰轮廓、负空间或几何结构，适合压印、烫金、刺绣、雕刻和空间标识。避免未经抽象的普通行业图标。四图中的Logo轮廓、内部结构、字标和组合方式必须一致。直接按顺序生成四张独立图：1. Brand Worldview and Concept Cover：大型主视觉、完整Logo、中英文名、概念标题、品牌宣言、3–5张情绪/材质图和少量有意义手写注释；2. Logo Concept and Symbol Generation Logic：超大Symbol、完整Logo、中英字标、横竖组合、简化版、来源草图、负空间/结构关系和少量箭头圈选注释；3. Brand Visual Language and Design System：主辅色、字体、真实材质、摄影语言、Logo局部裁切和从Logo提取的辅助纹样，规整网格结合自由拼贴；4. Brand Application and Experience Scenarios：根据行业展示5–7个真实触点，使用一张大型产品/空间主视觉加4–6张应用细节，分层使用完整Logo、独立Symbol和辅助纹样，避免每件物料重复全品牌名。每张图必须有醒目大型主标题、短副标题、核心说明、2–4个关键词、2–4处有意义手写注释、明确视觉中心和约25%–35%留白。四图统一品牌名、Logo、字体、配色、材质、摄影氛围、边距和辅助线，但版式分别为主视觉拼贴、Logo结构研究、色彩字体材质系统、产品空间应用。使用高级品牌提案、Editorial杂志设计和现代视觉识别案例语言；避免普通PPT、传统VI表格、素材Mockup合集、大段正文、信息拥挤、低质3D、廉价金色、颜色漂移、Logo结构变化、乱码、水印和不可读文字。

items.title: 东方女性临水棋亭生活摄影海报
items.description: 4:5东方生活方式社论海报，虚构成年东亚女性在盛夏蓝调时刻的临水棋亭中夹起白色棋子，围棋盘与冷暖灯光构成安静几何焦点。
items.prompt: Generate an independent 4:5 vertical Oriental women's lifestyle editorial photography poster. The subject is a clearly adult fictional East Asian woman aged 20–30, mature, quiet, and intelligent, with real skin and natural makeup, a low bun with very few thin gold hairpins, and deep-jade ear ornaments. Set her in an open waterside Go pavilion during the midsummer blue hour, with blurred bamboo shadows and a narrow deep-blue water surface behind her. Make the black-and-white Go board on an ebony low chess table the clear geometric anchor; place only one low-brightness paper-covered lamp at the table corner and no handheld lanterns. Dress her in a neatly structured ink-jade sleeveless long beizi over an ivory-white cross-collar top and a low-saturation deep-pink long skirt, with restrained details and no large jewelry. Use a more-than-half-body seated pose with a left-leaning composition: one hand clearly pinches a white Go stone and pauses above the board, while the other hand is completely hidden under the table or inside the sleeve. Keep the action simple and joints natural. Use a 50–85mm lens, eye-level slightly side-on view, and shallow depth of field. Let cold-blue ambient light enter from outside while the warm paper lamp lightly outlines the face and hands, creating restrained cool-warm layering. Leave 35% dark breathing space in the frame, combining an Oriental cinematic mood with high-end fashion editorial photography. No text, logos, or watermarks. Avoid fantasy glow, excessive palace ornament, oversaturated neon, plastic skin, sexual hints, modern board games, floating Go stones, incorrect board perspective, extra arms, multiple hands or fingers, and deformed fingers.
items.prompt_zh: 生成一张独立的4:5竖版东方女性生活方式editorial摄影海报。主体为明确成年的20–30岁虚构东亚女性，成熟、安静、聪慧，真实皮肤与自然妆容，低盘发配极少量细金簪和深玉耳饰。场景是盛夏蓝调时刻的临水开敞棋亭，背景为模糊竹影与一线深蓝水面；乌木矮棋案上的黑白围棋棋盘成为清晰几何视觉锚点，桌角只有一盏低亮度纸罩灯，不出现手持灯笼。她穿结构利落的墨玉色无袖长褙子，内搭象牙白交领上衣与低饱和绛粉长裙，细节克制、无大片珠宝。人物为大半身坐姿，偏左构图，一只手清楚夹住一枚白色棋子并停在棋盘上方，另一只手完全藏于桌面下或衣袖内，动作简洁、关节自然。使用50–85mm镜头，平视略侧拍，浅景深；冷蓝环境光从亭外进入，暖色纸灯只轻轻勾亮脸部与手部，形成不过度戏剧化的冷暖分层。画面保留35%深色呼吸空间，融合东方电影感与高端fashion editorial。无文字、无logo、无水印。避免玄幻发光、宫廷堆砌、过饱和霓虹、塑料皮肤、性感暗示、现代桌游、棋子漂浮、棋盘透视错误、额外手臂、多手多指和畸形手指。

items.title: 顶级西餐品牌四宫格宣传海报

items.prompt: Create an ultra-premium four-panel promotional poster for the fictional upscale Western dining brand VELORA TABLE, using a strict 2x2 grid with equal panel proportions and elegant consistent spacing. Feature four dishes: HERB BUTTER RIBEYE at $28, TRUFFLE MUSHROOM PASTA at $22, GARLIC PRAWN RISOTTO at $24, and CITRUS GLAZED SALMON at $26. All four plates or bowls must appear at exactly the same scale, position, and framing logic in their grid cells; every vessel must be fully visible, complete, and never cropped or randomly shifted. Each panel includes one dominant plated hero dish, an elegant English dish title, one very short supporting line, a subtle readable price, and a small refined brand mark, while food remains the strongest visual element. Give the menu a tasting-course rhythm: steak bold, juicy, and butter-luminous; pasta creamy with truffle depth; risotto delicately grained and glossy with seafood character; salmon moist, finely grilled, and citrus-glazed. Use a dark premium restaurant atmosphere with soft warm highlights, subtle bokeh, and controlled cinematic shadows. Make the steak panel deeper and richer, pasta warm and creamy, risotto composed neutral-warm, and salmon slightly brighter and cleaner, while keeping one unified brand world. Use elegant dark ceramic or refined modern plates with realistic sauces, seared proteins, vegetables, pasta, grains, plate-edge highlights, subtle steam, oil sheen, and fresh premium garnishes. Use restrained elegant English typography with VELORA TABLE clearly legible and prices visible but not loud discount graphics; limit handwritten or sketch accents to one or two tiny flourishes. Aim for soft cinematic commercial food lighting, hyper-realistic food texture, and collector-grade fine-dining editorial aesthetics. Prohibit cropped plates, inconsistent plate sizes, off-center placement, a cheap menu board, cartoon food, loud discount design, fake sauce texture, plastic-looking meat or seafood, messy typography, unreadable prices, generic cafe styling, flat lighting, oversaturated chaos, and low-resolution textures.
items.prompt_zh: 为虚构高档西式餐饮品牌VELORA TABLE制作一张超高端四格促销海报，采用严格2x2网格，四个等比例面板间距优雅统一，每格是一张精致餐饮社交媒体英雄视觉。四格分别展示HERB BUTTER RIBEYE、TRUFFLE MUSHROOM PASTA、GARLIC PRAWN RISOTTO、CITRUS GLAZED SALMON；对应价格为$28、$22、$24、$26。所有四个盘子或碗必须以完全相同的比例、位置和取景逻辑出现在各自网格单元，容器完整可见，不能被边缘裁切或随机偏移。每格包含一款主导摆盘菜肴、精致英文菜名、极短辅助文字、清晰但克制的价格和小型精致品牌标志，食品始终是最强视觉元素。菜肴应具有品鉴菜单节奏：牛排大胆多汁、黄油发光；意面奶油浓郁并有松露深度；烩饭颗粒细腻、富有海鲜光泽；三文鱼滋润精细烧烤并带柑橘釉光。使用深色高级餐厅氛围与柔和暖色高光、细腻散景和受控阴影；牛排面板更深更浓郁，意面温暖乳白，烩饭中性暖感，三文鱼略明亮洁净，但四格保持统一品牌氛围。使用深色陶瓷或现代精致餐盘，真实呈现酱汁、煎制蛋白质、蔬菜、面条、米粒、盘缘高光、蒸汽、油光和新鲜装饰。使用优雅英文排版，品牌VELORA TABLE清晰可读，价格可见但不像折扣广告；手写/草图点缀最多一两处且极简。采用柔和电影感商业食物光线、超写实食物纹理、收藏级高端餐厅社论美学。禁止裁切盘子、不一致盘子尺寸、偏离中心、廉价菜单板、卡通食物、响亮折扣设计、虚假酱汁纹理、塑料肉类或海鲜、凌乱排版、不可读价格、普通咖啡馆风格、平淡光照、过饱和混乱和低分辨率纹理。

items.prompt: 3:4 vertical solo indoor sports portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman in an archery training scene, using an almost two-thirds-body side composition from an eye-level, slightly high camera angle with a 35–50mm lens feel. Place her center-right, body sideways to the camera and facing frame left. Her left arm extends horizontally forward to hold the bow steadily; her right hand draws the string close to the mouth corner and cheek, with the arrow perfectly aligned with her line of sight at full draw and aim. Let a black modern bow run vertically along the left edge, naturally cropped at top and bottom, while the arrow crosses horizontally from left to right in front of the face, forming a clear force line with the straight forearm. Keep her gaze focused and calm, not toward the camera, eyelids slightly lowered, brow subtly gathered, lips slightly parted or gently closed. Use a dark high ponytail with natural wisps at the forehead and sides and slightly loose ends for believable movement. Dress her in a black sleeveless fitted sports top and black bottoms with clear shoulder and back lines, plus black forearm guards; keep equipment and clothing in a low-saturation black system. Use a clean lightly textured light grey-beige indoor wall with no complex range information or clutter. Soft diffused indoor light evenly illuminates face, shoulders, and forearms with moderate contrast and no hard shadows. Let the palette be about 50% light grey-beige background, 30% black bow, clothes, hair, and protective gear, and 20% warm ivory skin, with yellow arrow feathers and a trace of lip color as tiny accents. Make the face, arrow nock, and drawing hand the tightest focus; motion comes from the full-draw posture, horizontal arrow, vertical bow, and tension across the shoulders and arms. Use realistic photography, light mobile portrait retouching, natural skin, clear equipment structure, and a restrained background. Avoid an underage-looking subject, incorrect bow grip, an unattached nock, floating arrows, broken bowstrings, distorted bows, toy-like equipment, clipped guards, abnormal limbs, a gaze misaligned with the arrow, looking at the camera, exaggerated expressions, plastic skin, wig-like hair, shiny leather or latex clothing, excessive metal reflections, complex target papers, text, audiences, clutter, strong portrait-mode blur, hard flash, HDR, over-sharpening, oversaturation, high contrast, and a cheap posed look.

items.prompt_zh: 一张电影感街头风格肖像，一位明确成年东亚女性站在饱经风霜的混凝土墙前，墙面覆盖五彩斑斓的城市涂鸦与层叠街头艺术。她有黑色丝滑长发和柔和修饰脸型的层次，皮肤自然透亮，暖色调妆容、清晰眉形、猫眼眼线和哑光裸桃色口红。她神情平静自信，若有所思地抬头仰望，一只手轻抚头发，另一只手随意插在口袋里。她穿大廓形白色棒球球衣，带大胆黑色几何与部落风格图案，搭配宽松米色工装裤。采用戏剧性的夜间闪光摄影，产生明亮高光、深邃阴影和复古电影美学，强调原始城市氛围；纹理丰富的涂鸦墙、暗淡色彩与粗粝背景和整洁现代时尚形成对比。使用编辑级街头服饰摄影、电影般构图、浅景深、柔和电影颗粒、忧郁色彩分级、超写实自然皮肤纹理与高级时尚杂志质感，85mm镜头，f/1.8，HDR。禁止低幼化、卡通、动漫、CG、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、错误或多余手指、手部畸形、杂乱姿势、扭曲背景、平淡棚拍光、过度饱和、文字、水印和Logo。

items.title: 唯美旅行目的地3D黏土微缩景观
items.description: 可配置目的地与剪贴簿文案的纵向旅行纪念品视觉：自然容器内展开目的地微缩景观，水流至复古地图并配旅行配件。
items.prompt: Create a vertical luxury travel keepsake visual for PARIS, featuring the taglines Wander with Wonder, Postcards from Paris, and Made for Memories, and the date JUNE 2026. Build a highly detailed whimsical 3D handcrafted polymer-clay diorama inside an opened natural container that matches PARIS, such as a coconut, shell, geode, treasure chest, flower, or another destination-appropriate object. Reveal a breathtaking miniature landscape of PARIS with its most iconic landmarks, natural scenery, architecture, vegetation, beaches, mountains, lakes, rivers, wildlife, cultural heritage, and signature local elements. Everything should show realistic texture, tiny detail, soft sculpted edges, intricate miniature craftsmanship, and believable handcrafted imperfections. Let water overflow naturally from the container into a magical cascading waterfall over an antique vintage map centered on PARIS. Arrange a vintage passport, boarding pass, retro camera, compass, a suitcase with PARIS-themed stickers, a travel notebook, seashells or local decorations, native flowers or plants, and a tiny sailboat, canoe, or other destination-appropriate vehicle. Add elegant scrapbook typography on the right: My Travel Diary, PARIS, Wander with Wonder, Postcards from Paris, Made for Memories, and Date badge: JUNE 2026. Put Adventure Awaits on the boarding pass and Collecting memories, not things in the notebook. Use warm golden light, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, soft shadows, premium travel-poster composition, vibrant turquoise water where appropriate, ultra-detailed polymer-clay texture, cinematic product photography, and a luxury travel-souvenir aesthetic in a centered portrait frame. Keep all typography legible and secondary to the diorama.
items.prompt_zh: 为PARIS制作一张纵向旅行纪念品视觉，包含标语Wander with Wonder、Postcards from Paris、Made for Memories和日期JUNE 2026。创建高度详细、异想天开的3D手工聚合物黏土透视模型，放置在一个与PARIS主题匹配的开口自然容器中，例如椰子、贝壳、晶洞、宝箱或花朵；容器内展开PARIS的惊艳微缩景观。加入该目的地最具代表性的地标、自然风光、建筑、植被、海滩、山脉、湖泊、河流、野生动物、文化遗产和当地元素，全部呈现真实纹理、微小细节、柔软雕刻边缘、细腻手工瑕疵和复杂微型工艺。水从容器自然溢出，在以PARIS为中心的复古地图上形成神奇级联瀑布。周围摆放复古护照、登机牌、复古相机、指南针、贴有PARIS主题贴纸的行李箱、写有旅行名言的笔记本、贝壳或当地装饰物、当地花卉植物，以及小帆船、独木舟或其他适合目的地的交通工具。右侧加入优雅剪贴簿排版：My Travel Diary、PARIS、Wander with Wonder、Postcards from Paris、Made for Memories、Date badge: JUNE 2026；登机牌文字为Adventure Awaits，笔记本名言为Collecting memories, not things。使用温暖金光、浅景深、奶油色虚化背景、柔和阴影、优质旅行海报构图、适度活力青绿色水、超详细黏土纹理、电影级产品摄影、奢侈旅行纪念品美学、居中纵向取景。排版文字清晰可读且不遮挡微缩景观。

items.title: 仰拍视角白色卫衣日本女性街拍写真

items.prompt: Photorealistic full-body portrait of a completely fictional 20-year-old adult Japanese woman with long platinum-blonde hair, soft natural makeup, large expressive light-brown eyes, and a cute yet realistic face. She stands confidently on a low metal guardrail in a quiet Japanese residential street beneath a vivid blue summer sky, calmly looking down toward the camera while lightly touching the edge of her oversized hood with one hand; a gentle breeze lifts loose hair strands and the hoodie hem. Use an extreme worm's-eye perspective from almost ground level, vertical 9:16 composition, and a smartphone ultra-wide 18–20mm equivalent view. Place the camera directly below her for dramatic foreshortening: long legs extend toward the sky while the upper body stays naturally proportioned, feet fill the lower foreground, the body rises diagonally through the frame, and the face sits near the upper third. Keep utility poles, overhead power lines, rooftops, and residential buildings softly recognizable without distracting from the subject. Dress her in an oversized white streetwear hoodie with subtle black graphic prints, realistic cotton texture, visible stitching, natural wrinkles, oversized sleeves, and soft folds; add a black pleated mini skirt moving gently in the breeze, white crew socks, and chunky white-and-pink fashion sneakers. Use bright midday sunlight as key light and the blue sky as cool ambient fill; let white pavement and nearby buildings bounce soft light onto the lower face and legs. Keep most skin naturally matte and textured, with restrained highlights only on the forehead, nose bridge, cheekbones, collarbones, thighs, knees, and light-facing planes. Show individual hair strands with soft golden highlights only where illuminated, and distinct reflective responses from skin, hair, cotton, leather, rubber soles, painted metal, and concrete. Preserve natural pores, fine vellus hair, subtle skin variation, realistic fabric weave, authentic smartphone HDR, slight handheld tilt, mild ultra-wide lens distortion, restrained sharpening, faint JPEG compression, and slight highlight bloom, with realistic depth without studio lighting. Avoid cartoon, anime, CGI, plastic skin, perfect symmetry, excessive retouching, overexposed highlights, unreadable logos, watermarks, social-media interfaces, and text.
items.prompt_zh: 一位完全虚构的20岁成年日本女性写实全身肖像，白金色长发、柔和自然妆容、大而富有表现力的淡褐色眼睛与可爱但真实的面孔。她自信地站在宁静日本住宅区街道的低金属护栏上，置于生动蓝色夏日天空下，平静俯视相机，一只手轻触宽大兜帽边缘；微风吹起散落发丝和连帽衫下摆。使用几乎从地面高度拍摄的极度虫眼透视，垂直9:16构图，智能手机超广角18–20mm等效视角，相机直接位于她下方，产生戏剧性透视夸张；长腿向天空延伸，上半身保持自然比例，双脚占据下前景，身体沿画面对角线升起，脸部位于上三分之一。电线杆、架空电线、屋顶和住宅建筑在背景中柔和可辨但不抢主体。她穿宽大白色街头连帽衫，带细微黑色图形印花、真实棉质纹理、可见缝线、自然皱褶、宽松袖子与柔软褶皱；黑色百褶短裙随风轻摆，搭配白色中筒袜和笨重白粉色时尚运动鞋。明亮正午阳光为主光，蓝天提供冷色环境填充，白色人行道与建筑反射柔光至下脸部和腿部；皮肤大部分自然哑光有纹理，仅额头、鼻梁、颧骨、锁骨、大腿、膝盖和受光面有克制亮部。显示单根发丝、局部柔和金色高光，以及皮肤、头发、棉织物、皮革、橡胶鞋底、涂漆金属和混凝土的不同反射。保留自然毛孔、细胎毛、肤色变化、织物纹理、真实智能手机HDR、轻微手持倾斜、超广角轻微畸变、克制锐化、微弱JPEG压缩和亮部轻微溢光，避免影棚灯光。禁止卡通、动漫、CGI、塑料皮肤、完美对称、过度修图、过曝高光、不可辨认标志、水印、社交媒体界面和文字。

items.description: 超写实奢华旅游杂志封面，成年韩国女性穿驼色定制旅行装穿越金色欧洲车站，携带Louis Vuitton Horizon 55与LV Keepall。
items.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic luxury travel magazine cover featuring a clearly adult, elegant Korean woman in a chic travel outfit of a camel tailored coat, silk blouse, and wide-leg trousers, striding confidently through an iconic terminal. She pulls a Louis Vuitton Horizon 55 rolling case in classic Monogram canvas with gold hardware and carries a matching LV Keepall duffle on her shoulder. Give her glowing polished skin, travel-chic makeup, glossy nude lips, and sleek low-ponytail hair tied at the base with an LV silk scarf. Set the background in a stunning golden-light European train station with an iron-arch glass ceiling, softly blurred crowds, and warm station light. The cover must clearly include the refined serif masthead “CONDÉ NAST TRAVELLER” and the callout “JOURNEY IN STYLE ISSUE”; keep spelling accurate and typography secondary to the woman and luggage. Use a 35mm lens feel and render the LV Monogram pattern, polished hardware, fabrics, and skin with fine realistic detail, natural anatomy, and true commercial photography texture. Make the result a clean, luxurious, dynamic high-end travel-fashion cover. Prohibit cartoon styling, blur, incorrect Monogram, watermarks, distortion, extra people competing with the subject, garbled text, and low-quality packaging-ad aesthetics.
items.prompt_zh: 制作一张超写实奢华旅游杂志封面，主体为一位明确成年、优雅的韩国女性，穿驼色定制大衣、丝绸衬衫和阔腿裤，自信大步穿过标志性航站楼。她拖着经典Monogram帆布与金色五金件的Louis Vuitton Horizon 55拉杆箱，肩背配套LV Keepall旅行包；皮肤光泽透亮，旅行时尚妆容，亮泽裸色嘴唇，头发梳成光滑低马尾，底端系LV丝巾。背景是金光闪耀的欧洲火车站，带铁拱玻璃屋顶、模糊人群和温暖车站光线。封面必须包含精美衬线字体刊头“CONDÉ NAST TRAVELLER”和呼吁文字“JOURNEY IN STYLE ISSUE”，文字清晰、拼写准确且次于人物与行李。使用35mm镜头观感，细致呈现LV Monogram图案与抛光五金件、织物和皮肤材质，保持自然解剖与真实商业摄影质感。整体像高端旅游时尚杂志封面，构图干净、奢华而有旅行动势。禁止卡通、模糊、错误Monogram、水印、扭曲、额外人物抢占主体、乱码文字和低质量包装感。

items.title: 木廊下看相机的东亚女性旧数码私摄影
items.description: 1:1旧数码生活方式肖像，成年东亚女性在木构廊道旁低头调整便携相机，碎发遮脸、青绿庭院和低饱和退化质感共同形成安静瞬间。
items.prompt: 1:1 square single-person lifestyle realistic portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman standing beside a wooden corridor or old courtyard entrance. Place her center-right in a waist-up medium shot from an eye-level, slightly low camera angle with a 35–50mm lens feel. She looks down at a small portable camera in her hands, naturally holding and gently adjusting it in a quiet loop of attention; she does not look at the camera and does not pose. Her deep-black long hair is tied in a loose low ponytail, with abundant messy strands over the forehead and sides of the face, some naturally crossing the eyes, nose bridge, and cheeks for an unstyled lived-in feeling. Keep her expression quiet and relaxed, eyelids naturally lowered, brow relaxed, lips slightly parted or gently closed. Dress her in a loose old-washed grey-blue or washed-grey sleeveless tank top with soft matte fabric, a large neckline, natural slack at the shoulders and armpits, and a faint glimpse of light thin straps underneath. Keep a close foreground wooden pillar and wall on the right, with the left opening to a courtyard and softened cyan-green plants, contrasting the wooden boundary with natural greenery. Use outdoor natural light from the front-left filtered through eaves, soft and even, with slightly brighter face, backs of hands, and collarbones and shallow shadow edges. Use cyan-green environmental reflections, grey-blue clothing mid-tones, deep grey-black hair shadows, and cool ivory skin in a low-saturation, low-contrast, cold quiet palette. Preserve old-digital private-photography texture: soft focus across the image, slight softening of facial features, fingers, camera, and background leaves, fine grain, light scanning noise, faint halo, mild vignette, and low-resolution compression, evoking 2000s East Asian private photography and old digital snapshots. Keep the subject slightly clearer than the background but avoid strong modern portrait-mode blur. Negative prompts: looking directly at the camera, deliberate posing, sugary smile, heavy or influencer makeup, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, warm yellow skin, oversaturated plants, ultra-clear features, extreme sharpening, HDR, high contrast, modern mobile high-definition look, strong depth-of-field blur, studio lighting, hard flash, clean commercial or high-fashion feel, wrong or extra fingers, hand deformities, fused camera and palm, wig-like hair, thick black-line flyaways, hair passing through the face, distorted nose or chin from looking down, tight or shiny tank top, incorrect wooden-pillar perspective, cluttered or overly sharp background, and clean luxurious interior.
items.prompt_zh: 1:1方形单人生活方式写实人像，一位明确成年东亚女性站在木构廊道或旧式庭院入口旁，人物中央偏右，腰部以上中景，平视略低机位，35–50mm镜头观感。她低头看向双手中的小型便携相机，双手自然托住并轻微调整相机，形成安静专注的注意力回路；不看镜头，不摆拍。深黑长发扎成松散低马尾，额前和脸侧有大量凌乱碎发，部分发丝自然遮过眼睛、鼻梁和脸颊，呈现未整理的真实生活感。神态放松，上眼睑自然下落，眉间松弛，嘴唇微张或轻闭。穿宽松旧洗感灰蓝或水洗灰无袖背心，柔软哑光面料、较大领口、肩腋自然余量，内侧可隐约露出浅色细肩带。右侧紧贴近景木柱与木墙，左侧通向开放院落和柔化青绿色植物背景，形成木构边界与自然绿景对照。左前方户外自然光经屋檐过滤，柔和均匀地照亮脸部、手背和锁骨，阴影浅且无硬边。整体为青绿色环境反射、灰蓝服装中间调、深灰黑头发暗部和偏冷象牙肤色，低饱和低对比、冷淡安静。保留旧数码私摄影质感：整体柔焦，五官、手指、相机和背景叶片略微软化，叠加细颗粒、轻微扫描噪点、淡光晕、轻暗角和低分辨率压缩感，呈现2000年代东亚私摄影与旧数码抓拍氛围。人物清楚度略高于背景，但不要现代人像模式的强烈虚化。禁止直视镜头、刻意摆拍、甜腻笑容、浓妆、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、暖黄肤色、过饱和植物、超清五官、极致锐化、HDR、高对比、现代手机高清感、强景深虚化、棚拍灯光、硬闪光、商业大片感、手指错误、手部畸形、相机与手掌粘连、假发感、粗黑线状碎发、发丝穿脸、低头变形、紧身或亮面背心、木柱透视错误、杂乱或过清晰背景、豪华室内和精致时尚大片感。

items.title: 夏日清透呼吸感商业广告视觉
items.description: 明亮清透的商业广告视觉模板，以主体穿过透明发光浅层介质的错觉、海天线、大面积高明度空间和从边缘裁切的半透明文字层建立轻盈呼吸感。
items.prompt: Generate a bright, clear advertising-style visual in 3:4, centered on a clearly adult woman walking through shallow seaside water in a clean summer fashion look in the season and mood bright summer, airy, refreshing, and quietly optimistic, with subject-related phrases or symbols 夏の透明感. Place the subject as a restrained medium-close-up slightly off-center, with contours as if just passing through a transparent glowing shallow medium. Keep a large low-contrast, high-brightness transparent area with fine reflective texture below, and a clean open high-brightness background above. Let a few soft cloud-like or mist-like forms pass behind the subject to create a spacious sky-meets-water breathing sensation. Keep the subject edges clear but natural, with surface textures derived from the subject's own material. Break 夏の透明感 into oversized, slender, semi-transparent glyph layers around the subject, cropped by the frame edges; some glyphs should approach the background highlights while others use clear subject-derived accents. The glyphs should feel like floating information in air and water vapor and must not obscure the main form. Let the background base color dominate with high brightness, clean cool-warm balance, and an airy feel; use clear light-and-shadow structure on the subject, with accents only in the text, edge reflections, and tiny information points. Keep the result bright, light, clean, and transparent, avoiding muddy grey fog, nostalgic dirtiness, and heavy shadows. Use fine realistic photographic texture, direct but soft light, and clear water highlights and transparent-medium reflections. By default, stage this as a shopping-mall summer clothing hero poster: a clearly adult woman walking in shallow seaside water, blue sky, white clouds, and a horizontal sea-sky line, using cold blue, water white, silver-grey highlights, and low-saturation cyan; crop transparent Japanese character layers from the edges of the vertical poster for a refreshing commercial look.
items.prompt_zh: 生成一张明亮清透的广告式视觉，画面比例为3:4，主题对象为a clearly adult woman walking through shallow seaside water in a clean summer fashion look，季节与情绪为bright summer, airy, refreshing, and quietly optimistic，主题相关短语或符号为夏の透明感。主体以克制的中近景主形体略偏中心出现，轮廓像刚从透明发光的浅层介质中穿过；下部保留大块低反差、高亮度、带细碎反射纹理的通透空间，上部是干净开阔的高明度背景，少量柔软云状或雾状体块位于主体后方，形成水天相接般的呼吸感与空旷感。主体边缘清晰但自然，表面纹理从自身材料提取，形成明暗分明的图案节奏。将夏の透明感拆成超大、细长、半透明的字形层，分布在主体周围并从画面边缘裁切；部分字色接近背景亮部，部分为主题派生的清澈强调色，像空气与水汽中的漂浮信息，不遮挡主形体。背景底色主导并保持高明度、冷暖干净和通风感，主体有清晰明暗结构，强调色仅出现在文字、边缘反光和细小信息点。整体明亮轻快、清洁透明，避免浑浊灰雾、怀旧脏感和厚重阴影。使用精细真实的摄影质感，直接而柔和的光线，清晰的水光亮纹与透明介质反射。默认将场景表现为商场夏季服饰主视觉：一位明确成年女性在海边浅水中行走，蓝天白云与水平海天线作为背景，使用冷蓝、水白、银灰高光和低饱和青色；透明日文字层从竖版边缘裁切，保持清爽商业海报感。

items.title: 超写实东亚女性时尚摄影棚人像
items.description: 2:3竖幅高级时尚摄影棚人像，成年东亚女性以自然蹲姿置于纯白无缝背景，蓝白条纹针织衫与深蓝微喇牛仔裤强调真实材质。
items.prompt: Photorealistic high-end fashion studio portrait, vertical 2:3, full-body medium-shot composition. An adult East Asian woman in her 20s holds a natural squat, body turned slightly left, right knee raised, left leg naturally tucked in, both feet barefoot on the ground; one hand gently pulls the collar and the other rests naturally in front of the knee. Her head tilts slightly forward as she looks directly at the camera with a quiet, soft, natural expression, no forced smile, and a mildly relaxed approachable mood. She has an exquisite oval face, small chin, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, soft flat brows, natural long lashes, small nose bridge, and nude-pink lips. Keep a cool fair-to-warm skin tone with real pores, fine vellus hair, subtle tone variation, and natural texture; no smoothing or plastic feel. Long straight black hair is naturally center-parted with a slight offset, draped smoothly over the shoulders, with a few loose strands and gently moving ends. She wears a loose blue-and-white horizontal striped cropped knit sweater, one side naturally slipping to reveal the left shoulder and collarbone, sleeves slightly covering the palms; pair it with deep-blue high-waisted micro-flare jeans with naturally stacked cuffs. Barefoot, no shoes, socks, or accessories. Use a pure white seamless studio background with no props, low saturation, low contrast, and subtle warm-grey layering in the white. High-end commercial fashion portrait, Sony A7R V, 85mm f/2, ISO100; softbox key light at 45° front-left, white reflector fill on the right, weak top rim light, soft natural shadows, shallow depth of field while the figure remains clear, realistic fabric, denim, hair, and skin transitions, high dynamic range, real photography rather than CG. Photorealistic, ultra realistic, editorial fashion photography, subtle film grain, natural imperfections, soft highlight roll-off, accurate anatomy. Negative prompts: AI feeling, CG, anime, illustration, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, overly strong HDR, over-sharpening, wrong or extra fingers, deformed limbs, wrong proportions, low resolution, noise, text, watermark, logo, or border.
items.prompt_zh: 超写实高级时尚摄影棚人像，竖幅2:3，全身偏中景。一位20多岁的成年东亚女性自然蹲姿，身体微向左，右膝抬起、左腿自然收起，双脚赤足踩地；一只手轻拉领口，另一只手自然搭在膝前，头部略前倾直视镜头，神情安静柔和自然，不刻意微笑，带轻微慵懒与亲和力。她有精致鹅蛋脸、小巧下巴、杏仁形深棕眼睛、柔和平直眉、自然细长睫毛、小巧鼻梁和裸粉嘴唇；冷白偏暖肤色保留真实毛孔、细小绒毛、轻微肤色变化与自然纹理，不磨皮、不塑料感。长直黑发自然中分略偏分，顺滑披肩，少量碎发散落，发尾轻微飘动。穿宽松蓝白横条纹短款针织毛衣，一侧自然滑落露出左肩锁骨，长袖覆盖部分手掌；搭配深蓝色高腰微喇牛仔裤，裤脚自然堆叠，赤脚、无鞋袜、无饰品。背景为纯白无缝摄影棚背景，无道具，整体低饱和低对比，白色略带暖灰层次。高级商业时尚肖像，Sony A7R V，85mm f/2，ISO100；柔光箱主光位于左前45°，右侧白色反光板补光，顶部弱轮廓光，阴影柔和自然，浅景深但人物整体清晰，真实织物、牛仔、发丝和肤色过渡，高动态范围，真实摄影而非CG。Photorealistic，ultra realistic，editorial fashion photography，subtle film grain，natural imperfections，soft highlight roll-off，accurate anatomy。禁止AI感、CG、动漫、插画、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、过强HDR、过度锐化、错误或多余手指、畸形四肢、比例错误、低清晰度、噪点、文字、水印、Logo和边框。

items.title: 唐风仙侠贵女精修写真海报
items.description: 9:16竖版唐风仙侠贵女角色海报，成年东方女性端坐雕花椅，以白红金华丽妆造、团扇、朱砂屏风和暖宫灯营造高位感。
items.prompt: 9:16 vertical, high-precision Tang-style Xianxia noble-lady refined character poster. The subject is an original Oriental woman aged 20–28 with a clearly adult appearance, classic oval face, smooth refined contours, long phoenix eyes, a steady restrained gaze with commanding presence, delicate natural features, and fair translucent skin; not Westernized, child-like, or an influencer face. Use rouge noble-lady makeup: fair transparent base, rouge red, red-brown, warm brown, and a little gold-brown concentrated around the outer eyes and back of the upper lids, fine slightly elongated eyeliner, long distinct lashes, weak-to-medium blush, full soft rouge-red, warm true-red, or dark-red lips with clear edges, and a small sharply defined gold-red Huadian between the brows. Keep red concentrated on the lips, outer eyes, and Huadian rather than flushing the whole face. Style dark brown-black hair in a dignified, full high bun with a few side strands, plus an ornate gold hair crown, rubies, pearl tassels, gold chains, floral ornaments, detailed Buyao, and long gold drop earrings. Dress her in a gorgeous Tang-style big-sleeve robe with refined metal waist ornaments. Use ivory, pearl white, and warm white as the main colors, with cinnabar, rouge red, and dark red only as local edging and lining, accented by gold, champagne gold, and a small amount of ruby; add gold-thread embroidery of phoenix, Baoxiang, cloud, or palace motifs to the collar, sleeve edges, shoulders, and chest, with dangling waist chains and small white-jade and ruby ornaments. Avoid making the entire garment red. Seat her upright in a carved chair in a frontal composition, photographed from a slightly low angle. Her shoulders and neck are open, back straight, and she holds a circular fan half-covering the chest, with white-and-gold or light silk surface and red-gold details. Set the scene before a vermilion screen in a palace-lamp interior with a gold-patterned carpet; keep the background blurred but retain screen contours, warm gold lamp light, and delicate interior layers. Combine warm palace light with soft frontal fill for a clear luminous face and fine highlights on jewelry, embroidery, and waist ornaments. Noble, bright, restrained, highly finished ancient-style Xianxia character-poster aesthetics. Avoid infantilization, Westernized features, modern clothing, cluttered jewelry, plastic skin, exaggerated beauty retouching, incorrect fingers, text watermarks, and an overly red image.
items.prompt_zh: 9:16竖版，高精度唐风仙侠贵女精修写真海报。主体是一位20–28岁、明确成年外观的原创东方女性，古典鹅蛋脸、流畅秀美轮廓、偏长丹凤眼、沉稳克制且有压场感的眼神，精致自然五官与细腻通透皮肤，不欧美化、不幼态化、不网红脸。妆容为胭脂贵女妆：白皙通透底妆，胭脂红、红棕、暖棕和少量金棕集中晕染在眼尾与上眼睑后段，细长眼线、纤长睫毛，弱至中等腮红，胭脂红或暖正红/绛红柔润唇妆，额间有清晰但小面积的金红花钿；红色主要集中在唇妆、眼尾和花钿，避免全脸泛红。棕黑长发盘成端正蓬松高髻，两侧少量垂发，佩戴华丽金饰发冠、红宝石、珍珠流苏、金链、花饰与细致步摇，配金饰长坠耳环。穿华丽唐风大袖衫与精致金属腰饰，白金为主色，象牙白、珍珠白、暖白为底，朱红、胭脂红、绛红为局部边饰和内衬，金色、香槟金及少量红宝石为点缀；袖缘、衣襟、肩部和胸前有金线刺绣、凤凰纹、宝相纹、云纹或宫廷花纹，腰链垂坠白玉与红宝石小饰件，避免整件服装泛红。人物正面端坐雕花椅，镜头略低角度，肩颈打开、背部挺直，手持白底金纹或浅色绢面配红金细节的圆形团扇，半遮胸前，神情端庄沉稳。场景为朱砂屏风、宫灯内室与金纹地毯，背景虚化但保留屏风轮廓、暖金宫灯光和细腻内室层次；正面柔光使面部通透清晰，首饰、金线刺绣和腰饰产生细碎高光。整体贵气、明艳、克制、高完成度，像古风仙侠角色海报。避免低幼化、欧美化、现代服装、杂乱首饰、塑料皮肤、夸张美颜、错误手指、文字水印与过度泛红。

items.title: 迪尔玛茶系列高端四格写实产品海报
items.description: 严格2x2四格的迪尔玛茶系列高端静物海报，以花茶、红茶、果茶和绿茶/抹茶四种饮品形成克制而清晰的风味差异。
items.prompt: Create an ultra-premium Dilmah Tea series product poster in a strict 2x2 layout with four equal, perfectly spaced panels. Each panel presents one real Dilmah tea beverage as a clean, isolated, refined still life; avoid a chaotic collage or infographic. Feature floral tea, classic black tea, fruit tea, and green tea or a matcha-inspired variation, with the beverages as the absolute heroes. Place one drink on a small elevated stone, plaster, or matte pedestal in each panel, using at most one tiny accent or none. Keep the backgrounds warm, soft, neutral, smooth, luminous, and premium, with restrained but distinct panel hues: pale cream-beige with warm ivory for floral tea, deeper oat-beige or soft caramel-beige for black tea, blush sand or warm peach-beige for fruit tea, and pale stone-beige with a cool green undertone for green or matcha tea. Make the floral tea pale and translucent with quiet floral elegance; the black tea dark and layered with amber-brown density; the fruit tea glowing, warm, bright, and juicy-clear; and the green or matcha drink soft and creamy-pure. Use sculptural, beautifully proportioned premium glassware. Show believable transparency, density, layering, condensation, foam or crema when appropriate, meniscus detail, and accurate reflections. Use delicate high-end studio lighting with elegant highlights on glass rims, liquid surfaces, pedestals, and minimal garnishes; keep shadows short, soft, and clean. Use minimal premium English typography only, clearly include DILMAH TEA SERIES, optionally add Crafted in Purity, and place a small restrained official-style Dilmah logo. Keep typography secondary to the products. Overall style: hyper-realistic, pure, quiet, refined luxury beverage editorial advertising. Prohibit a cheap cafe poster, cluttered props, cartoon drinks, low-detail glass, poor liquid transparency, messy garnish, oversaturation, noisy backgrounds, too much text, and supermarket drink styling.
items.prompt_zh: 制作一张超高端迪尔玛（Dilmah）茶系列产品海报，严格2x2四格布局，四个等比例且间距完美的面板，每格展示一款真实迪尔玛茶饮的干净孤立静物构图；不要拼贴式混乱，不要信息图。四格分别为花茶、经典红茶、果茶、绿茶或抹茶灵感茶品种，产品本身是绝对主角。每格将一杯饮品置于小型石头、石膏或哑光抬高底座上，辅助元素最多一个小点缀，也可完全省略。面板背景保持温暖柔和的高端中性材质，并分别使用淡奶油米色、深燕麦或柔和焦糖米色、胭脂沙或暖桃米色、带冷绿色底色的淡石米色，和谐但差异明显。花茶淡透明且有安静花卉优雅，红茶深色分层并有琥珀褐色密度，果茶温暖明亮且清透多汁，绿茶/抹茶柔和并具有奶油般纯净感。玻璃杯高端、雕塑感、比例优美；液体呈现真实透明度、密度、分层、冷凝、泡沫或克丽玛（如适用）、液面边缘和反射。使用柔和细腻的高端摄影棚光，玻璃边缘、液面、底座和少量装饰物出现优雅高光，阴影短而干净。仅使用极简英文排版，清晰包含DILMAH TEA SERIES，可加一行Crafted in Purity；添加小而克制的官方风格Dilmah标志位置，文字次于产品。整体为超写实、纯净、宁静、精致的豪华饮品社论广告。禁止廉价咖啡馆海报、杂乱道具、卡通饮料、低细节玻璃、差的液体透明度、凌乱装饰、过饱和、嘈杂背景、过多文字和超市饮料造型。

items.title: 黑色长裙内藏微缩发光城市人像
items.description: 傍晚都市街头的单张超现实创意人像：成年亚洲女性展开黑色长裙，裙摆内部呈现一座温暖发光、具有街道与楼宇纵深的微缩夜城。
items.prompt: Vertical 3:4, single creative portrait image combining realistic photographic texture with restrained surreal animation elements; no collage, no four-grid layout, no infographic, no text. The subject is an original adult Asian woman aged 22 or older, standing on an urban street at dusk, slightly looking back over her shoulder, tall and slender with a quiet, high-end temperament. She wears an elegant black long dress and naturally lifts and spreads its hem with both hands. Keep the person in realistic portrait-photography texture with delicate natural skin, hair in an updo or low ponytail, and a clean high-end look. The inside of the skirt is not ordinary fabric but an entire clearly visible glowing miniature night city: streets, traffic, buildings, window lights, intersections, and layered depth between high-rises must be distinct, as if a bustling city were packed into the dress. Preserve the drape of real fabric along the hem, while the interior becomes an independent night-scene universe with warm lights, rich detail, and clear layers. Use a real but slightly blurred urban street background in a cool dusk environment, with distant street lamps and bokeh spots for a cinematic feel. Place the subject slightly low and centered, making the skirt the visual focus. Combine fashion-editorial grandeur, high-end dreaminess, and narrative atmosphere. Prohibit a cartoon face, childish illustration feel, cheap effects, deformed hands, extra people, text watermarks, exaggerated sci-fi mecha styling, wedding-dress styling, and a messy background.
items.prompt_zh: 竖版3:4，单张创意人像图片，真实摄影质感与克制的超现实动画元素结合；不要拼贴、不要四宫格、不要信息图、不要文字。主体为一位22岁以上原创成年亚洲女性，站在傍晚都市街头，背对镜头后微微回头，身形修长，气质安静高级。她穿优雅黑色长裙，双手自然轻轻提起并展开裙摆；人物保持真实人像摄影质感，皮肤细腻自然，头发盘起或低扎，造型简洁高级。裙摆内部不是普通布料，而是一整座清晰可见的发光微缩夜城：街道、车流、楼宇、窗户灯光、十字路口与高楼之间的纵深层次都应明确呈现，仿佛繁华城市被装进裙子里。裙摆边缘保留真实布料的垂坠感，内部世界像独立的夜景宇宙，灯光温暖、细节丰富、层次分明。背景是真实但略微虚化的都市街道，冷色傍晚环境，远处路灯和散景光斑营造电影感。人物居中偏下，裙摆为视觉焦点，整体兼具时尚大片、高级梦幻与故事感。禁止卡通脸、低幼插画感、廉价特效、畸形手、多余人物、文字水印、夸张科幻机甲感、婚纱感和杂乱背景。

items.title: 冰蓝网球俱乐部成年女性都市运动清亮CCD风
items.description: 明确成年的女性站在露天网球俱乐部看台边回头扶发，穿冰蓝方领针织上衣与白色高腰百褶短裙，使用清亮冷白蓝 CCD 生活照质感。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical daytime urban-sports lifestyle photo in a bright high-key CCD smartphone style. A clearly adult woman stands beside the stands of an outdoor tennis club, in the bright semi-lit edge of a white awning; a light-blue court, white stands, and white fences form a clean background. Her body turns slightly sideways, one hand gently touches her hair, and she looks back at the camera with a pure, bright, energetic, clean, attractive expression and a soft first-love-inspired natural look. She is light and slender, wearing an ice-blue square-neck fitted short-sleeve knit top and a white high-waisted opaque pleated short skirt; the knit naturally outlines shoulders, neck, collarbone, chest line, and waist while remaining tasteful and fashion-focused. Frame from half body to thighs with a crisp readable subject. Sunny bright natural light dominates: side-front sunlight clearly illuminates her, white stands and fences provide reflected fill, and an extremely weak soft flash adds only catchlight and slightly lifts facial shadows. Use high-key clear cool white-blue CCD colors, clean white highlights, clear midtones, stable blacks, light grain, very light digital noise, and slight digital sharpness. Keep the overall image bright, clear, and transparent without gray haze; maintain a clean blue-white relationship and do not turn the whole frame gray. Avoid juvenile appearance, excessive beauty filter, plastic skin, blur, hard flash, cluttered background, malformed hands, transparent clothing, text, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 9:16竖幅日间都市运动生活照，采用清亮高光CCD手机摄影风格。明确成年的女性站在露天网球俱乐部看台边，位于白色遮阳棚边缘的明亮半受光区域；浅蓝球场、白色看台与围栏形成干净背景。她身体轻微侧身，一只手轻扶头发，回头看向镜头，神态清纯、明亮、元气、干净而有吸引力，带自然的初恋感淡颜气质。她身形轻盈纤细，穿冰蓝色方领修身针织短袖上衣和白色高腰不透明百褶短裙；贴身针织自然勾勒肩颈、锁骨、胸线和腰线，保持时尚得体。画面从半身到大腿，主体清晰。晴天明亮自然光为主，侧前方阳光照亮人物，白色看台与围栏提供自然反射补光，极弱柔闪只补充眼神光并轻微提亮面部阴影。使用高亮清晰冷白蓝CCD色彩、干净白色高光、清晰中间调、稳定黑位、轻颗粒、极轻数码噪点和轻微数码锐度；整体明亮、清晰、通透，无灰雾，蓝白关系干净，不让全画面变灰。避免未成年感、过度美颜、塑料皮肤、模糊、硬闪光、背景杂乱、错误手部、透明服装、文字、水印和徽标。

items.title: 户外露台浅紫色上衣成年东亚女性时尚写真
items.description: 明确成年的东亚女性坐在热带现代建筑露台的奶油色石台上，穿浅紫针织上衣与白色短裤，阴天漫射光和绿植营造清爽真实的全身生活方式人像。
items.prompt: Ultra-photorealistic outdoor lifestyle fashion portrait of a clearly adult slim East Asian woman with long straight dark-brown hair, sitting casually on the edge of a large round cream-colored stone platform on a wooden deck. She faces the camera with a gentle genuine smile and natural direct eye contact; a light breeze moves her hair. She wears a fitted light-lavender short-sleeve ribbed knit V-neck top, high-waisted opaque white shorts, and transparent PVC slim-heeled mule sandals; keep clothing colors and design consistent, with the sandals visibly transparent and heels slender. Her legs extend naturally forward and cross slightly at the ankles; one hand rests beside her on the stone edge and the other lightly supports her body. Keep the relaxed elegant pose and accurate hand, foot, and leg anatomy. Set the tropical outdoor environment with a large decorative stone planter of green plants on the left, dense palm leaves, a partly visible modern glass-and-brick building in the distance, and realistically textured wood flooring. Bright overcast daylight is soft and diffused, evenly illuminating the subject with subtle background bokeh, natural skin texture, and realistic shadows. Use natural perspective, full-body composition, ample headroom, soft neutral colors, and editorial lifestyle fashion photography. Photorealistic only: no illustration, anime, CGI, or painterly style; no text, watermark, logo, border, or UI. Avoid plastic skin, excessive smoothing, malformed limbs, distorted hands or feet, or incorrect perspective.
items.prompt_zh: 超写实户外生活方式时尚肖像：一位明确成年的苗条东亚女性留长直深棕色头发，随意坐在木甲板上大型圆形奶油色石台的边缘。她面向镜头，带温柔真诚的微笑和自然直接的眼神交流，微风轻轻吹动头发。她穿修身浅紫色短袖罗纹针织V领上衣、高腰白色不透明短裤和透明PVC细高跟穆勒凉鞋；服装设计与颜色清晰一致，鞋子保持透明材质和细鞋跟。她双腿自然向前伸展并在脚踝处微微交叉，一只手放在身侧石台边缘，另一只手轻轻支撑身体，姿势优雅放松，手脚解剖准确。背景是热带户外环境：左侧大型装饰石质花盆中有绿色植物，茂密棕榈叶构成背景，远处部分可见现代玻璃砖建筑；木地板有真实纹理。明亮阴天日光柔和弥散，均匀照亮主体，轻微背景散景，保留自然肤质和真实阴影；自然透视、全身构图、头顶留白充足、柔和中性色调、社论生活方式时尚摄影。仅限写实摄影，无插画、动漫、CGI或绘画风格；无文字、水印、logo、边框或UI元素，避免塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、错误肢体、扭曲手脚和透视错误。

items.title: 新中式成年女性时尚大片海报
items.description: 4:5 竖幅独立新中式时尚编辑摄影：虚构成年东亚女性站在画面右侧整理袖口，墨黑圆形漆屏、青瓷瓶和白玉兰构成低饱和东方视觉锚点。
items.prompt: Create an independent 4:5 vertical New Chinese-style fashion editorial poster featuring a clearly adult fictional East Asian woman aged 20–30. She is mature, restrained, and confident, with a classical natural face and realistic skin; style her dark hair in a low bun with one minimalist jade hairpin and no elaborate court headpiece. Set her in a minimalist New Chinese interior with a large ink-black circular lacquer screen, beside only one tall celadon vase and a branch of white magnolia. Let the circular screen, white flowers, and subject form a strong clean visual anchor. Dress her in a modern New Chinese look: an ivory stand-collar structured top, low-saturation jade-green high-waisted wide-leg trousers, and a very pale peach narrow belt, with premium fabric and a small amount of champagne-gold dark patterning; no revealing design. Show a full or near-full body figure standing on the right side of frame, with a slight natural S-curve. One hand gently adjusts a cuff while the other hangs relaxed on the opposite side; keep the hands spatially separated with clear joints and no overlap. Use a 50–85mm lens at eye level with shallow depth of field. Large window light from upper left gives clear direction; the lacquer screen absorbs shadows while the magnolia and face are softly lit. Use an ivory-white, ink-black, jade-green, and very pale peach low-saturation Eastern palette with about 40% negative space, balancing luxury advertising and cultural editorial photography. No text, logo, or watermark. Avoid costume-studio styling, xianxia, modern office furniture, emptiness from excessive minimalism, plastic skin, fake model face, exaggerated pose, overlapping hands, extra arms, multiple hands or fingers, or incorrect limb connections.
items.prompt_zh: 生成一张独立的4:5竖版新中式女性时尚编辑摄影海报。主体是一位明确成年的20–30岁虚构东亚女性，成熟、克制、自信，拥有古典自然脸型和真实皮肤；黑发低盘，配一枚极简玉簪，不戴繁复宫廷头饰。室内为极简新中式空间，背景是一面大面积墨黑圆形漆屏，旁边仅有一只高挑青瓷瓶和一枝白玉兰；圆形漆屏、白花与人物共同形成强烈而干净的视觉锚点。穿现代新中式服装：象牙白立领结构上衣、低饱和玉绿色高腰阔腿裤、极淡桃色窄腰带，高级面料带少量香槟金暗纹，无暴露设计。人物全身或接近全身，站在画面右侧，身体轻微S形但姿态自然；一只手轻整理袖口，另一只手放松垂在身体另一侧，两手空间分离、关节清楚、不交叠。使用50–85mm镜头、平视、浅景深；左上方大面积窗光提供明确方向，漆屏吸收阴影，白玉兰和面部被柔和照亮。象牙白、墨黑、玉绿和极淡桃色构成现代东方低饱和配色，保留约40%负空间，气质位于奢侈品广告与文化编辑摄影之间。无任何文字、logo或水印；避免古装影楼感、仙侠、现代办公家具、空洞过度极简、塑料皮肤、假脸、夸张姿势、交叠手、额外手臂、多手多指和错误肢体连接。

items.title: 极简光影下的奢华成年男士时尚杂志大片
items.description: 以上传参考图严格保持成年男性身份、面部和姿势，在极简深灰影棚中靠白色矩形基座完成 4:5 竖幅时尚编辑肖像。
items.prompt: Ultra-photorealistic high-end fashion editorial portrait of a clearly adult man. Use the uploaded reference image as the sole identity, facial-expression, and pose reference; do not change his facial structure, identity, or pose.
