items.prompt_zh: 2:3竖幅单人室内写实人像摄影；一位明确成年的东亚女性坐在明亮窗边的极简白色房间内，人物位于画面中央偏右，采用坐姿大半身构图，平视略高机位，约50至85毫米人像镜头观感。她抬起双臂自然整理并束起深黑色长发，头部轻微低垂并转向画面左侧，视线落向左下方，神态安静专注，不看镜头、不刻意摆拍；自然黑色薄刘海，脸侧有几缕松散碎发。她穿柔软哑光白色无袖短款棉质上衣和宽松浅蓝灰水洗牛仔背带裤，一侧背带自然滑落，衣物褶皱符合坐姿受力；左腿弯曲进入左下前景，与上半身形成斜向视觉动线。右侧窗户进入柔和自然侧光，面部、肩颈、手臂与上衣均匀受光，阴影浅淡，窗边保留明亮留白，白墙背景干净克制。整体低饱和、低反差、高明度，米白暖白约占五成，浅蓝灰牛仔约占三成，深色头发与阴影约占一成半，暖象牙肤色作柔和点缀；中等偏浅景深，背景轻微柔化，保留自然皮肤、发丝和衣物纹理但不过度锐化。清淡日系自然光私摄影，安静生活感，真实人物摄影，轻微柔和后期，干净通透。负向提示：多余或缺失手指、粘连手指、手掌扭曲、重复手臂、肢体错位、肩部畸形、头发穿过手指、发丝边缘融化、僵硬摆拍、直视镜头、夸张表情、甜腻笑容、浓妆、模板网红脸、幼态未成年感、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、蜡像质感、夸张胸腰比例、亮面化纤、塑料反光、僵硬牛仔布、错误褶皱、缺乏受力逻辑、硬闪光、强硬阴影、冷白棚灯、HDR、过度锐化、超高对比、过饱和、背景杂乱、复杂家具、过曝窗户、商业时装棚拍感。

items.title: 极简厨房木台面上的双成年女性生活人像
items.description: 两位明确成年的东亚女性并坐在明亮极简公寓厨房的小木台面上，穿得体泳装/夏日造型，冷白窗光、白纱帘与浅木色构成日系全身生活方式摄影。
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic Japanese lifestyle photography: two clearly adult East Asian women sit side by side on a small wooden countertop in a bright minimalist apartment kitchen. Use a centered full-body seated composition with the two identities and actions clearly separated. The woman on the left turns slightly toward frame right; one leg bends and lifts while the other extends naturally downward, bare feet hanging over the counter edge. The woman on the right sits beside her in a relaxed natural pose, with both legs and feet complete and anatomically accurate; never confuse or merge the two bodies. Dress both in tasteful, secure, opaque summer swimwear or resort-lounge styling with realistic fabric texture, folds, and coverage; no erotic action or transparent swimwear. Keep their hair, facial features, and poses distinct. Clean kitchen background: a silver-white small refrigerator at left, a white espresso machine and small plant above it, broad white sheer curtains and bright window light at right, light-gray floor, no clutter. Soft cool natural diffuse light enters from the right window. High-key, low-saturation, low-contrast palette of cool white, light gray, pale wood, navy, and natural skin. Use a 50 mm lens at f/3.2, eye-level camera, medium depth of field; keep both people and hanging feet clear while the background stays softly blurred. Preserve realistic swimwear, skin, wood, refrigerator, and metal textures with slight ISO 200 digital grain, photorealistic. Maintain credible hip-to-counter, foot-to-edge, arm-to-body, and hand contacts; expressions relaxed and natural. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, nudity, transparent swimwear, erotic poses, exaggerated proportions, confused faces, extra people, wrong or fused fingers, fused arms, duplicated legs or feet, floating limbs, incorrect toes, strong HDR, oversharpening, cluttered kitchen, modern text, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 超写实日系生活方式摄影：两位明确成年的东亚女性肩并肩坐在明亮极简公寓厨房的小木台面上，采用居中的全身坐姿构图，双人身份和动作清晰区分。左侧女性身体略朝画面右方，她的一条腿弯曲抬起，另一条腿自然向下伸展，赤脚悬在台面边缘；右侧女性以自然放松的坐姿与她并列，双腿和脚部完整、结构准确，避免两人肢体混淆。两人穿得体、稳定且不透明的夏日泳装或度假休闲造型，保留真实面料纹理、褶皱和自然覆盖，不要色情动作或透明泳装；头发、面部特征和姿态彼此不同。厨房背景干净整洁：左侧银白色小冰箱，上方白色意式咖啡机和小型绿植；右侧大面积白色纱帘与明亮窗光，浅灰地面，无杂物。柔和冷调自然漫射光从右侧窗户进入，整体高键、低饱和、低对比，以冷白、浅灰、浅木色、海军蓝和自然肤色为主。使用50mm镜头、f/3.2、平视机位、中等景深；人物和悬空脚部清晰，背景轻柔虚化。真实泳装、皮肤、木材、冰箱和金属纹理，轻微ISO 200数码颗粒，photorealistic。保持臀部与台面、脚部与边缘、手臂与身体接触可信；两人表情自然放松。避免未成年或幼态形象、裸体、透明泳装、色情动作、夸张身材、双人脸部混淆、额外人物、错误或融合手指、融合手臂、重复腿脚、悬浮肢体、错误脚趾、强HDR、过度锐化、杂乱厨房、现代文字、水印和Logo。

items.title: 东京晴空塔河滨极简马克笔旅行海报
items.description: 一张3:4竖幅东京极简旅行海报，情侣站在隅田川河滨栏杆旁，晴空塔作为地点线索，暖象牙纸与粗钴蓝马克笔线条保留大量未着色留白。
items.prompt: Create a 3:4 vertical minimalist marker-pen travel poster of TOKYO on warm ivory paper. Use a rough hand-drawn marker illustration style with thick cobalt-blue contours, broken edges, visible stroke direction, dry-skip texture, and incomplete flat fills. Keep the image graphic, clean, and naturally unfinished, with large uncolored areas where the warm ivory paper remains visible. Add only the title “TOKYO” at the top in bold hand-drawn uppercase marker letters, slightly irregular, spontaneous, and organic. Depict a quiet riverside promenade overlooking the Sumida River: a couple of clearly adult people stands near the riverside railing in the lower third, with one lightly leaning toward the other. Tokyo Skytree appears in the mid-distance as the main landmark, accompanied by a simple bridge hint across the river, a few minimal water lines, and a faint skyline silhouette behind. Use the railing as a simple foreground anchor, the couple as emotional focus, and Skytree as the central location cue. Keep river and sky minimal with generous blank paper around them. Include only four background cues: riverside railing, Tokyo Skytree, river suggestion, and faint skyline silhouette. Keep the couple and railing moderately resolved; Skytree and skyline simplified, partially colored, and lightly outlined. No crowds, vehicles, boats, dense buildings, cluttered city detail, logo, readable signage, any text other than TOKYO, photorealism, or polished digital rendering.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张3:4竖幅极简马克笔旅行海报，主题为东京，绘制在暖象牙色纸张上。采用粗手绘马克笔插画风格：厚重钴蓝色轮廓、断裂边缘、清晰笔触方向、干笔跳墨纹理和不完整的平涂填色；画面图形化、干净、自然未完成，让大面积暖象牙纸留白可见。顶部只添加标题“`TOKYO`”，使用粗体手绘大写马克笔字母，略不规则、自发、有机。场景为俯瞰隅田川的安静河滨步道：下方三分之一的河滨栏杆旁站着一对成年情侣，其中一人轻轻向另一人倾斜；中景出现东京晴空塔作为主要地标，河面有简单桥梁提示、少量极简水纹线，后方延伸淡淡城市天际线轮廓。栏杆是简单前景锚点，情侣是情感焦点，晴空塔是中心地点线索；河流和天空保持极简，周围留出大量纸张空白。背景只包含四个线索：河滨栏杆、东京晴空塔、河流暗示和模糊天际线。情侣和栏杆中等清晰；晴空塔与天际线简化、部分着色并带轻微轮廓。禁止人群、车辆、船只、密集建筑、杂乱城市细节、Logo、可读标志、其他文字、写实主义、精致数字渲染和抛光商业外观。

items.title: 郊区后院野餐的正午复古胶片人像
items.description: 一位明确成年的女性在过度生长的美国郊区后院坐在浅色野餐毯上，穿淡粉色吊带上衣与牛仔短裤，正午硬光和Portra 400胶片质感呈现自由怀旧的生活片段。
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic candid lifestyle portrait: a clearly adult woman with naturally messy chestnut-brown hair, softly sun-kissed skin, gentle freckles, and delicate natural features sits on a light picnic blanket in the middle of an overgrown American suburban backyard. She wears a pale blush-pink fitted spaghetti-strap camisole and tasteful faded denim shorts, securely worn with realistic fabric and folds; do not emphasize body parts. The pose feels casual and unplanned, like a friend spontaneously capturing a backyard picnic fragment from a coming-of-age film—free, warm, quiet, and nostalgic. Preserve weeds, shrubs, trees, old fence, and ordinary suburban-yard details without clutter. Brilliant midday summer sun creates firm natural shadows, warm skin highlights, and believable outdoor contrast; avoid blowing out the skin. Use an American-suburban independent-summer, Y2K-nostalgic, lifestyle-editorial, cinematic-realist mood. Photograph with a Contax T3 35 mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, 35 mm lens, f/2.8, delicate film grain, authentic analog imperfections, soft pastel tones, shallow depth of field, and RAW film-scan texture; high resolution without oversharpening. Keep body, hands, and blanket contact natural; background softened but recognizable. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, transparent or displaced clothing, excessive exposure, sexualized posing, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, strong HDR, oversharpening, oversaturation, cartoon, CG, low resolution, studio-like background, distorted body or fingers, extra limbs, text, watermark, logo, or advertising-style staging.
items.prompt_zh: 超写实自发抓拍式生活方式人像：一位明确成年的女性长发自然凌乱、呈栗棕色，皮肤被阳光轻轻晒成暖色并带柔和雀斑，坐在过度生长的美国郊区后院中央的浅色野餐毯上。她穿淡腮红粉色合身细肩带吊带上衣和得体的褪色牛仔短裤，服装安全稳定、布料和褶皱真实，不强调身体局部。姿态随意自然，像成长题材电影中朋友偶然拍下的后院野餐片段，气质自由、温暖、宁静而怀旧。背景保留杂草、灌木、树木、旧围栏和普通郊区庭院细节，环境有生活感但不杂乱。灿烂的正午夏日阳光形成硬朗自然阴影、暖皮肤高光和真实户外对比；色彩过渡自然，不让皮肤过曝。整体为美国郊区独立夏日、Y2K怀旧、生活片段社论和电影写实主义氛围，使用Contax T3 35mm胶片相机、Kodak Portra 400、35mm镜头、f/2.8、细腻胶片颗粒、真实模拟瑕疵、柔和粉彩色调、浅景深和RAW胶片扫描质感；高分辨率但不过度锐化。保持手、身体与野餐毯接触真实，背景适度柔化但可辨认。避免未成年或幼态形象、透明或移位衣物、过度暴露、性化姿势、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、强HDR、过度锐化、过饱和、卡通、CG、低清晰度、背景棚拍感、身体或手指变形、多余肢体、文字、水印、Logo和广告式摆拍。

items.title: 白色无缝影棚中的低机位高时尚人像
items.description: 一位成年亚洲女性在无缝白色影棚中坐姿环抱抬起的膝盖，透过散落发丝直视镜头，白色露肩雪纺与长裙、奶油高光和85mm镜头构成超现实高时尚人像。
items.prompt: Surreal high-fashion photorealistic portrait: a clearly adult Asian woman sits in a clean seamless white studio, photographed from a dramatic low camera angle. One knee is raised close to the lens while both arms naturally wrap around it; her chin rests lightly near the forearm. She stares directly into the camera through scattered strands of hair, cinematic but not exaggerated. Her body forms an elegant natural curve and one shoulder is naturally bare, with tasteful non-explicit coverage. She wears a white off-shoulder chiffon top with a long flowing white skirt; the fabric is light, weighted, and softly wrinkled, never transparent or plastic. Keep natural adult proportions and accurate finger, knee, foot, and garment contacts. The background is pure seamless white with no extra objects. Use soft volumetric light and creamy highlights while preserving facial and white-clothing layers, natural skin texture, and gentle shadows. Shallow depth of field, 85 mm portrait lens, luxury editorial photography, realistic high-resolution 8K character. Emphasize the low-angle perspective and near-lens knee without making any body part a sexualized focal point. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, excessive exposure, transparent clothing, facial or body distortion, wrong fingers, extra limbs, malformed knee, fused arms, clothing clipping, severe wide-angle distortion, non-white background objects, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, strong HDR, oversharpening, cartoon, CG, text, watermark, logo, or cheap studio staging.
items.prompt_zh: 超现实高时尚写实人像：一位明确成年的亚洲女性坐在干净无缝的白色摄影棚中，从戏剧性的低机位拍摄。一条膝盖抬起并靠近镜头，双臂自然环抱膝盖，下巴轻轻靠近前臂；她透过散落的发丝直视镜头，眼神有电影感但不夸张。身体略形成优雅自然的曲线，肩膀一侧自然裸露，保持得体非暴露。穿白色露肩雪纺上衣，搭配长款飘逸白色长裙；面料轻盈、有真实垂坠和细微褶皱，不透明、不塑料。人物为自然成年比例，手指、膝盖、脚和衣物接触关系准确。背景纯净无缝，没有额外物体。使用柔和体积光与奶油般高光，保持面部和白色服装的层次、自然皮肤纹理和柔和阴影；浅景深、85mm肖像镜头、奢华编辑摄影、真实高分辨率8K质感。构图突出低机位透视和靠近镜头的膝盖，但不把身体局部做成性化焦点。避免未成年或幼态形象、过度暴露、透明服装、脸部或身体变形、错误手指、多余肢体、膝盖结构错误、手臂融合、衣物穿模、强烈广角畸变、空白以外的背景物体、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、强HDR、过度锐化、卡通、CG、文字、水印、Logo和廉价棚拍感。

items.title: 夏日橙花树荫咖啡街角人像
items.description: 一位成年女性在夏日街角花荫下倚靠粗糙米白柱子，右手端纸杯，左侧枝叶形成斜向框景，右侧含指定灭火器标识牌，呈现真实膝上街拍。
items.prompt: 3:4 vertical high-resolution realistic summer street-fashion portrait: a clearly adult woman stands at a summer street corner beneath vivid orange flowers, leaning against a rough uneven off-white pillar, placed center-right. Use a knee-up frame ending naturally below the thighs; head upper center, upper body and short skirt middle/lower frame. Her right hand raises a lidded paper cup to chest height, thumb and fingers naturally wrapping the brown sleeve; her left arm hangs along the body and left hand rests loosely in front of the thigh. Upper body leans slightly toward the pillar while face and gaze turn toward the street at frame left. Closed lips and a calm, slightly distant expression. Small oval face, bright ivory skin, neat brown brows, light-brown eyes, thin liner, long lashes, pale pink cheeks, coral-orange lips. Shoulder-length light ash-brown hair has thin bangs and face-framing layers, ends softly flipped outward; fine dappled sunlight lands across crown, bangs, cheeks, nose bridge, shoulders, and collarbone. Add a thin gold chain with a single-stone pendant and understated studs. Wear an ecru thin-strap ribbed knit top with deep-V lace edging and a matching thin silk ribbon tied at front; show fine vertical ribs, side seams, and length near the hip bone while maintaining tasteful opaque coverage. Pair with a pale cream-beige high-waisted floral short skirt, thin elastic waistband, pleats slanting toward her left, and a double-tier ruffled hem with scattered blue-gray and orange motifs. Left half of the frame is filled with fine green branches, leaves, many small orange flowers, occasional white flowers, and a large brown hanging basket upper center. Street, lamps, and red flashing traffic lights deep in the gaps are softly blurred. Right half is the rough off-white pillar; above her head is an old beige button box, and beside her right shoulder a red-framed vertical sign. Its upper red panel must clearly display the white text `Fire Extinguisher` (`灭火器`); the lower white panel has small black-and-red usage diagrams side by side. Only the upper half of a red fire extinguisher appears lower right. The cup has a white lid, white body, brown sleeve, and small dark circular center pattern; brand name remains unreadable. Strong warm natural light enters from upper left, making fine dappled highlights on flowers, hair, face, chest, arms, skirt, and legs while leaving soft pillar-side shadows. Use natural standard-to-short-telephoto compression, camera near chest height, cup center-left, sign center-right, flower branches foreground/background left. Subject occupies about 80% of frame, with air around hair and shoulders. Distant road and buildings are significantly blurred; face/eyes, right hand/cup, and top lace are sharp. Preserve skin, hair, knit ribs, lace, thin skirt folds, cup, rough pillar coating, aged sign metal, leaf gloss, and petal thickness. Palette is ecru, cream, warm skin, deep green, vivid orange-red accents; retain bright highlights without overexposing skin. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, distorted face or gaze, extra fingers, fused cup-holding hand, deformed wrists or arms, unnatural shoulder-pillar contact, clothing clipping, broken skirt motifs or ruffles, duplicated branches or flowers, distorted pillar or sign perspective, any readable text other than the specified sign, incorrect brand, logo, watermark, horizontal flip, unnatural dappled light, or excessive skin smoothing.
items.prompt_zh: 3:4竖幅高分辨率写实夏日街头时尚人像：一位明确成年的女性站在开满鲜艳橙色小花的夏日街角，倚靠粗糙不平的米白色柱子，人物位于画面中央偏右。构图为膝上至大腿下缘，头部在上方中央，上半身与短裙在中下部，腿部自然裁切。她右手将带盖纸杯举到胸前高度，拇指和手指自然环绕棕色纸套；左臂沿身体下垂，左手松弛地放在大腿前方。上身略向柱子倾斜，但脸和视线转向画面左侧街道，嘴唇闭合，神情平静而略带距离感。她有小椭圆脸、明亮象牙肤色、整齐棕眉、浅棕眼睛、细眼线、长睫毛、淡粉面颊和珊瑚橙唇。浅灰棕色齐肩中长发带薄刘海和脸周层次，发尾柔和外翻；细碎斑驳阳光落在头顶、刘海、脸颊、鼻梁、肩膀和锁骨。佩戴细金链单石吊坠和低调小耳钉。穿接近米白的细肩带罗纹针织上衣，深V领边缘有细蕾丝和同色细丝带结，细密竖向罗纹、侧缝和接近髋骨的衣长清楚可见；搭配浅奶油米色高腰花卉短裙，细松紧腰头、向左侧倾斜的褶皱和双层荷叶边裙摆，轻薄面料上散布蓝灰与橙色小图案，保持得体不透明。左半画面是绿色细枝叶与大量橙花，夹杂少量白花，上方中央有棕色吊篮；叶缝深处虚化街道、路灯和红色闪烁交通灯。右半是米白粗柱；头顶上方有旧米色按钮盒，肩膀右侧有红框纵向标识牌，上方红底白字必须清晰写着 `Fire Extinguisher`（`灭火器`），下方白底有并列黑红使用示意图；右下仅露出红色灭火器上半部。纸杯为白盖、白杯身和棕色纸套，中央有小深色圆形图案，品牌名不可辨认。强烈暖自然光从左上方进入，在花、头发、脸、胸前、手臂、裙子和腿上形成细碎斑驳高光，柱子一侧保留柔和阴影。标准至短长焦的自然压缩，镜头高度接近站立者胸口，纸杯位于左中、标识牌右中、花枝在左侧前后景；人物约占画面80%，头发肩膀周围留出叶片间隙，远处道路建筑明显虚化。脸和眼睛、右手与纸杯、上衣蕾丝清晰，保留皮肤、发丝、针织竖纹、蕾丝、薄裙褶皱、纸杯、粗柱涂层、老旧金属、叶片光泽和花瓣厚度。色彩以米白、奶油和暖肤色为主，深绿叶片与橙红花朵、标牌作强调；保持明亮高光但不让皮肤过曝。避免未成年或幼态形象、脸部或视线变形、多余手指、握杯手融合、手腕手臂变形、肩柱接触不自然、衣物穿模、裙纹和荷叶边错误、枝叶花朵重复或重叠、柱子和标牌透视错误、除指定标牌外的可辨认文字、错误品牌、Logo、水印、水平翻转、不自然斑驳光和过度磨皮。

items.title: 冷峻仙侠剑修女主的藏剑阁人像
items.description: 一位明确成年的东方女性侧坐于藏剑阁木窗边，回头凝视镜头并扶住剑柄，月光白、冰蓝与银玉古风服饰在冷白窗光中呈现角色海报级精致人像。
items.prompt: 9:16 vertical high-precision ancient-style xianxia sword-cultivator lead portrait, cold, firm, restrained, aloof, neat, and highly finished, with no added typography. The subject is a clearly adult Eastern woman, visual age 20–28, with natural clear Eastern features, not Westernized, childlike, or influencer-like. Refined clean bone structure, sharp contours, slender almond eyes, heroic brows, calm lucid gaze with distance, natural straight nose, soft restrained lips, and a cold composed sword-cultivator temperament. Cool-white delicate skin retains realistic texture and a slight moonlit highlight. Makeup is cold moonlight style: thin translucent base, finely blended pale gray-pink, cool brown, misty blue-gray, and a little silver-white pearlescence; restrained elongated outer corners, natural long lashes, slight aegyo-sal highlight, faint cool-pink blush, and low-saturation cool rose or bean-paste lips. Keep highlights on nose bridge, tip, under-eyes, and cheekbones; never sweet, greasy, or modern influencer-like. Black long hair is high-tied and half-down with clear crown structure; some length falls naturally and a few loose strands brush the face, forming a clean rim under side-backlight. Add a gorgeous but cold restrained silver hair crown, white-jade hairpin, ice-blue gems, thin silver chains, a few pearl tassels, and slender white-jade or silver earrings. Wear a cross-collar ancient long robe with cloak-like outer layer in moonlight white, ice blue, and cold white, supported by misty silver, pale cyan, and blue-gray. Use silver, white jade, ice-blue gems, and pearl cold highlights as accents. Fabrics include silk, lightly stiff gauze, soft layers, and densely embroidered thin gauze; add restrained cloud, ice, flowing-wind, or sect-emblem dark embroidery, plus a silver-white waistband, cold-silver ornaments, jade pendant, and thin chain tassels. Keep the costume elegant, layered, neat, and clearly sword-cultivator. Sit sideways beside a wooden window in a sword pavilion, body toward window or interior, face turned back to camera. One hand rests naturally on the sword hilt; the other rests lightly by sleeve, waist, or knee. Stable but relaxed pose, open shoulders and neck. Show only part of hilt, guard, and scabbard opening as a temperament prop, never stealing focus from the face. Background is a softly blurred sword rack, wooden window, and quiet pavilion space with cold-white window light and layered interior shadows. Combine cold window light with side-backlight; keep face clear and clean, with controlled reflections on hair, cloak edge, silver ornaments, and sword hilt. Maintain credible fingers, sword contact, sleeves, and seated posture. High-precision realistic photography, clear clothing layers, and character-poster completion without text. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, Westernized or influencer face, sweet makeup, modern clothing, gaudy styling, distorted features or hands, extra fingers, hand fused with sword, floating ornaments, hair clipping, fused garments, wrong perspective, overly sharp or distracting background, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, strong HDR, oversharpening, cartoon, CG, text, watermark, logo, or incorrect 9:16 crop.
items.prompt_zh: 9:16竖幅高精度古风仙侠剑修女主角色人像，整体冷峻、坚定、克制、疏离而整洁，具有高完成度但不添加文字。主体是一位视觉年龄20–28岁、明确成年的东方女性，面部为自然清晰的东方特征，不西化、不幼态化、不是网红脸；骨相精致干净，轮廓利落，细长杏眼与英气眉眼，目光清醒平静且有距离感，鼻梁自然挺直，嘴唇柔和克制，呈现冷静坚定的剑修气质。肤色冷白细腻，保留自然纹理和轻微月光高光。妆容为冷白月光风，底妆薄透；眼影细腻融合浅灰粉、冷棕、极淡雾蓝灰和少量银白珠光，眼尾略拉长但克制，睫毛自然纤长，卧蚕轻微提亮，腮红极淡冷粉，唇色为低饱和冷粉豆沙或玫瑰粉；高光轻点鼻梁、鼻尖、眼下和颧骨，整体清冷干净，不甜腻、不现代网红化。黑色长发高束半披，头顶结构清晰，部分长发自然落下，少量碎发擦过脸侧；发丝顺滑细致，在侧逆光下形成干净轮廓光。佩戴华丽但冷静克制的银色发冠、白玉发簪、冰蓝宝石、细银链和少量珍珠流苏，耳饰为纤细白玉或银色垂坠。穿交领古风长袍并叠加斗篷式外层，月光白、冰蓝、冷白为主，雾银、浅青和青白灰蓝为辅，银饰、白玉、冰蓝宝石和珍珠提供冷光点缀。面料包含丝质、轻挺薄纱、柔软叠层和密绣薄纱；衣身有云纹、冰纹、流风纹或宗门徽记般的暗纹，腰间有银白腰带、冷银金属饰件、白玉坠和细链流苏，层次清晰、优雅整洁，体现剑修身份。人物侧坐在藏剑阁木窗边，身体朝向窗边或阁内，脸回头看镜头；一只手自然扶在剑柄上，另一只轻放在袖边、腰间或膝侧，姿态稳而不僵，肩颈打开。剑仅作为气质道具，露出部分剑柄、护手与鞘口，不抢脸部视觉中心。背景为虚化剑架、木窗和安静阁内空间，可见冷白窗光、深浅交叠阴影和门派氛围但不喧宾夺主。冷白窗光与侧逆光共同照亮人物，脸部清透，发丝、斗篷边缘、银饰和剑柄有适度冷光反射。保持手指、剑柄、衣袖和坐姿接触可信；高精度真实摄影质感、清晰服装层次和角色海报级完成度。避免未成年或幼态形象、西化脸、网红脸、甜腻妆容、现代服装、华丽俗艳、五官或手部变形、多余手指、剑与手融合、发饰悬浮、头发穿模、衣物融合、错误透视、背景过锐或喧宾夺主、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、强HDR、过度锐化、卡通、CG、文字、水印、Logo和错误9:16裁切。

items.title: 复古胶片单眼遮脸暖金特写
items.description: 以身份参考保持面部特征的9:16复古胶片近景：长而蓬松的波浪发遮住大部分脸，只露出一只被阳光照亮的眼睛、睫毛与干枯玫瑰色嘴唇。
items.prompt: 9:16 vertical vintage-film identity-bound close portrait: use the uploaded identity reference as the sole likeness source and do not change face shape, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, or overall identity. Long voluminous wavy hair falls naturally across the face, obscuring most of it; the subject peeks through the strands with only one eye clearly visible. The remaining face is softly blurred and naturally cropped out of frame. Warm sunlight creates a golden glow along the visible eyelashes, making the single eye and lashes the focus. Lips are dusty rose; makeup is refined but natural. Skin has a naturally tanned tone with real texture, pores, and slight tonal variation, soft and refined but never plastic or excessively smoothed. Use a slight tilt, warm golden light leaks, and authentic vintage film grain for a nostalgic quiet atmosphere. Keep the visible eye, lashes, lips, hair strands, and light interaction realistic. Use a close portrait composition with abundant hair as an obscuring layer and edge frame; natural crop, no added scene, props, or text. Avoid identity change, face compositing, minor or juvenile appearance, both eyes clearly visible, chunky hair or hair crossing through facial features, distorted features, incorrect lashes, extra eyes, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, strong HDR, oversharpening, severe distortion, cartoon, CG, text, watermark, logo, or incorrect 9:16 framing.
items.prompt_zh: 9:16竖幅复古胶片质感身份绑定近距离肖像：仅使用上传身份参考保持人物面部特征，不改变脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色或整体身份。长而蓬松的波浪发自然垂落并遮住大部分脸，人物从发丝之间窥视，画面只清楚露出一只眼睛；其余脸部柔和虚化并自然裁切出画面。眼睫捕捉来自阳光的温暖金色光芒，眼睛与可见睫毛成为焦点；唇部为干枯玫瑰色，妆容精致但自然，皮肤呈自然晒后色调并保留真实纹理、毛孔和轻微色差，细腻柔和但不塑料或过度磨皮。轻微画面倾斜、温暖金色漏光和复古胶片颗粒营造怀旧、安静的氛围；主体局部清晰，发丝、睫毛、唇部和光线细节真实。使用近距离人像构图，大量头发形成遮挡层与边缘框景，保持自然裁切，不添加场景、道具或文字。避免身份改变、合成脸、未成年或幼态形象、两只眼睛同时清晰可见、头发块状或穿过五官、五官变形、错误睫毛、多余眼睛、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、强HDR、过度锐化、严重畸变、卡通、CG、文字、水印、Logo和错误9:16构图。

items.title: 城市早安与今日宜忌旅行刊物海报模板
items.description: 16:9十张旅行刊物风多图海报模板，以不同城市和色相展示横向核心对象、超大标题、越层手写线、镜像倒影与底部信息带，主题默认包含早安、今日宜忌和日期。
items.prompt: Create a set of ten 16:9 landscape premium travel-publication posters around the theme 城市元素 + 早安 + 今日宜忌 and date 2026-07-30. Each poster represents a different city with a distinct but coordinated hue logic—red, green, blue, yellow, purple, and so on—while the whole set shares one consistent layout system. Let a city's defining travel object provide one core object that can unfold laterally, has clear contours, and shows realistic material detail. Place the object horizontally in the lower-middle area to form a stable visual horizon, leaving a vast clear sky or environmental negative space above. Interlock the object, misty environment, mirrored reflection, and typography as one visual statement rather than unrelated decorations. Build an oversized cropped title “CITY MORNING” from the object's reflection or environmental form; let the letters act as structural windows revealing the surrounding scene. Add one handwritten line “take the long way” crossing the object and reflection, plus restrained side notes, a small badge, and a bottom information band that clearly includes the information “早安” and “今日宜忌”. Establish a clear information hierarchy: first read the object and giant type as a travel declaration, then discover the annotation, badge, and bottom band. Keep clouds, sky, object, and reflection clear; introduce subtle ink-density variation in solid areas, occasional extremely slight color-registration shift and compressed roughness at edges, while keeping subject contours, letter interiors, and highlights relatively clean. Never dirty the entire sky or flatten bright color tiers. Use even spacing and invisible-grid alignment, with no overlap, random scattering, or cheap-flyer feel. Each poster may use only city- and object-relevant environmental elements; add no unprovided brand logo, fake link, unrelated text, or UI. Keep theme, title logic, and visual system consistent across all ten images while making each city's hue and environmental detail clearly distinct.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一组16:9横幅、共10张的高端旅行刊物感海报，主题为：城市元素 + 早安 + 今日宜忌；日期：2026-07-30。每张对应不同城市，并使用不同但协调的色相逻辑（红、绿、蓝、黄、紫等），保持整组版式系统一致。每张画面让a city's defining travel object提供一个可横向展开、轮廓清晰、材质真实的核心对象，将其水平放在画面下方偏中位置，形成稳定视觉地平线；上方保留大面积清澈天空或环境留白。让对象、云雾环境、镜像倒影和排版彼此咬合，而不是互不关联的装饰。使用对象反射或环境形态形成超大裁剪标题“CITY MORNING”，让字母/文字既是结构框架又展示周围环境；加入一条越过对象和倒影的手写线“take the long way”，并设置克制的边注、徽章和底部信息带，明确包含“早安”和“今日宜忌”信息。所有信息层级清楚，第一眼读到对象与大字共同形成的旅行宣言，随后才发现边注、徽章和底部信息。保留云雾、天空、对象和倒影的清澈层次，实色区域有微弱墨量起伏，边缘偶有极轻色版偏移与压缩粗粝，但主体轮廓、文字内区和高光相对干净；不要用全局污渍破坏天空或鲜亮色阶。版式间距均匀、对齐隐形网格，不重叠、不随机散落、不像廉价传单。每张只生成与城市和对象相关的环境元素，不添加未提供的品牌Logo、虚假链接、无关文字或UI；10张之间保持主题、标题逻辑和视觉系统一致，同时城市、色相和环境细节有明确差异。

items.title: 雨天日式旅馆缘侧的暖琥珀时尚人像
items.description: 一位成年日本或韩国女性站在传统日式旅馆缘侧走廊，左前三分之二腰部以上构图，雨天冷灰环境与暖金琥珀光、蜂蜜橙投影和135mm压缩构成大胆叙事时尚人像。
items.prompt: Realistic fashion editorial portrait, waist-up at waist-level viewpoint, front-left three-quarter view: a clearly adult Japanese or Korean woman stands on the engawa veranda of a traditional Japanese ryokan. Behind her are a raised wooden platform edge, sliding-door frames, and a gray-blue rainy sky. She has a chin-length bob curving inward at the ends, airy straight bangs, and soft rounded face-framing tips; facial features are natural and makeup refined but not heavy. Turn her slightly toward camera with confident natural posture and a narrative expression, never an exaggerated seductive pose. She wears a loose ruffled top or bodice-style inner layer beneath a lightly striped short dress or camisole dress; use tasteful opaque layered construction with believable folds, stripes, and fabric drape, never transparent or exposing. Cool rainy ambient light and gray-blue sky create the restrained environment. Warm golden-amber key light enters from one side, casting honey-orange projections across skin and clothing, with peach highlights on face and hair. Use bold narrative vintage fashion-image language, a 135 mm telephoto lens with strong background compression, simulated film-leak artifacts, and crisp quick-focus snapshot rendering. Preserve realistic skin texture, individual hair, stitching, wet wood, and fabric detail. Keep architecture recognizable but subordinate to the subject, with dramatic retro rainy cinematic atmosphere. Maintain natural shoulders, arms, garment edges, and platform relationships. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, exact body measurements, sexualized body-part emphasis, transparent clothing, nudity, displaced garments, exaggerated seductive expression, distorted features or hands, extra fingers, hair clipping, incorrect sliding-door or platform perspective, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, strong HDR, oversharpening, cartoon, CG, text, watermark, logo, or cheap studio feel.
items.prompt_zh: 写实主义时尚编辑肖像，腰部以上、腰部水平视角、左前方三分之二构图：一位明确成年的日本或韩国女性站在传统日式旅馆的缘侧走廊，身后是抬高的木制平台边缘、推拉门框和阴雨天气的灰蓝天空。她有齐颔长度、发尾向内弯曲的波波头，空气感直刘海和柔和修饰脸型的圆润发尾；面容自然，妆容精致但不过度。她的身体略朝镜头，姿态自信而自然，表情具有叙事感，不夸张挑逗。穿宽松荷叶边上衣或胸衣式内搭，并叠穿带细条纹的轻盈短裙/连衣裙；服装为不透明、得体的多层结构，保留褶皱、条纹和真实布料垂坠，不透视或暴露。阴雨环境照明与灰蓝雨天天空形成冷静背景，温暖金琥珀色主光从一侧照入，在皮肤和衣物上投下蜂蜜橙色投影，桃色高光点亮面部与发丝。灵感来自大胆叙事的复古时尚图像语言，使用135mm长焦镜头、强烈背景压缩、模拟胶片漏光伪影和快速对焦的高锐度快照渲染；保留真实皮肤纹理、发丝、缝线和木材湿润质感。背景不喧宾夺主但建筑结构清楚，整体为戏剧性、复古、雨天电影氛围。保持手臂、肩颈、服装边缘和平台接触自然。避免未成年或幼态形象、精确身体数字、身体局部性化、透明服装、裸露、衣物移位、过度挑逗表情、五官或手部变形、多余手指、头发穿模、错误推拉门或木平台透视、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、强HDR、过度锐化、卡通、CG、文字、水印、Logo和廉价影棚感。

items.title: 韩系卧室藏发自拍与手写告白
items.description: 一位成年东亚女性在温馨韩系卧室中用手机自拍，一手将蓬松刘海和碎发别到耳后，穿宽松海军蓝针织衫，左下角配乳白色手写韩文浪漫文字。
items.prompt: Ultra-photorealistic 9:16 Korean lifestyle bedroom selfie: a clearly adult East Asian woman sits inside a cozy Korean-style bedroom. She has naturally refined light porcelain skin, expressive dark-brown eyes, soft full pink lips, a small straight nose, and delicate oval features. Her medium-length dark-brown hair is slightly messy, with airy wispy bangs and loose strands framing the face for a fresh just-woke-up feeling. The background contains a white bookshelf filled with books, glowing candles, small decorative glass jars, framed artwork, vintage-style photographs, cute room accessories, and a subtle green plant. Capture casually at arm's length with a modern smartphone slightly above eye level, approximately 26 mm equivalent, mild realistic wide-angle distortion, authentic exposure, auto white balance, slight smartphone HDR, tiny sensor noise, realistic pores, fine facial vellus hair, individual strands, and imperfect everyday social-media framing. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, excessive smoothing, plastic skin, distorted features, wrong fingers, hair clipping, malformed sweater, excessive shoulder exposure, duplicated bookshelf or props, misspelled or corrupted Korean, substituted or garbled text, extra captions, logo, watermark, strong HDR, oversharpening, cartoon, CG, or incorrect 9:16 framing.
items.prompt_zh: 9:16竖幅超写实韩系生活方式自拍：一位明确成年的东亚女性坐在温馨的韩式卧室里，拥有自然细腻的浅瓷色皮肤、富有表现力的深棕眼睛、柔和饱满的粉色嘴唇、小巧直鼻和精致椭圆脸。中长深棕色头发略显凌乱，空气感碎刘海和松散发丝自然修饰脸部，呈现刚睡醒般清新状态。她头部向一侧轻倾，用空着的手轻轻触碰并将头发别到一只耳后；她直视手机镜头，带细微浪漫微笑和放松神情。穿宽松蓬松的海军蓝针织露肩毛衣，一侧肩部自然滑落，露出肩膀和锁骨但保持得体；羊毛纤维、宽大袖子和松弛褶皱真实可见。背景有白色书架，摆放书籍、发光蜡烛、小玻璃装饰罐、相框艺术、复古照片、可爱房间小物和一株低调绿植。柔和室内自然环境光与金黄色烛光混合，形成舒适阴影和温馨气氛。现代手机在手臂长度处随意拍摄，略高于眼睛水平，约26mm等效手机镜头，轻微真实广角畸变、自然曝光、自动白平衡、轻微手机HDR、微小传感器噪点、真实毛孔、面部细汗毛、单根发丝和略不完美的社交媒体构图。左下方添加小型手写韩文浪漫文字“오늘도 보고싶어 ♡”，使用精致乳白色手写韩文字体，文字清晰但不抢主体，不能添加其他文字。没有专业影棚灯光、美颜滤镜或过度化妆，保持自然真实、无塑料感、面部比例可信、无明显AI痕迹。避免未成年或幼态形象、过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、五官变形、错误手指、头发穿模、毛衣结构错误、肩部过度裸露、书架或装饰物重复、文字拼写错误、韩文被替换或乱码、额外字幕、Logo、水印、强HDR、过度锐化、卡通、CG和错误9:16构图。

items.title: 俯拍竹筏入水的青绿古风成年女子
items.description: 从高处透过前景绿叶俯拍一位成年女性坐在斜向竹筏上，赤脚探入池水形成涟漪，青绿多层古风衣物与森林水面构成安静诗意的人像。
items.prompt: 2:3 single vertical outdoor ancient-style environmental portrait: shoot downward from a high position on shore or a bridge. Emerald leaves and hanging branches near the upper-right lens form an irregular top frame, covering part of the water and space above the head but never the face. An old-and-new green bamboo raft tied side by side runs diagonally from upper left to lower right; bamboo nodes, horizontal fixing strips, and rope knots remain continuous and believable. A clearly adult East Asian woman sits center-right on the raft, upper body slightly toward frame left, head lifted toward the high camera, eyes naturally open, brows relaxed, lips slightly parted, expression quiet, soft, and mildly curious. Hips visibly contact the raft; one leg bends and retracts on its surface, the other hangs naturally over the edge, bare feet gently exploring the water with small ripples and realistic disturbance at entry. Deep-black long hair is arranged in a traditional low bun with pale jade hairpins, metal leaf ornaments, and a few thin hanging pieces; two long straight strands fall below the waist. Dress her in layered cyan-green, peacock-blue, gray-blue, and light-gray ancient-style clothing: a light close-fitting inner layer, deep cyan-green high-waisted loose skirt, and outer translucent gradient wide sleeves and silk drape layered in cyan, blue, and gray-purple gauze, subtly revealing inner fabric and raft color. The drape falls naturally from shoulders and arms; the skirt forms large gravity-driven folds on the raft supported by bamboo nodes, never floating. One hand rests beside the knee or on the raft edge while the other is partly covered by the wide sleeve; shoulders relax and the raised head slightly extends the neck. Low-saturation bamboo-leaf, plant, or water-ripple patterns deform naturally with fabric folds. Inner fabric is soft and matte with weighted drape, deep-cyan skirt has only a weak silk reflection, and outer gauze is light and translucent, never plastic. Background: a tree-ringed garden pond, slow river channel, or forest stream pool with deep green-gray water, natural ripples, tree-shadow reflections, and local cool-blue reflections. Water below and around the figure remains discernible; distance is moderately softened. Soft overcast scatter or canopy-filtered natural light from front-above evenly illuminates face, neck, hands, and light layers without hard shadows. Low-saturation jade-green poetic grading: water about 40%, cyan-yellow raft and brown nodes 25%, clothing 20%, dark hair/shadows 10%, warm ivory skin and gray-white highlights 5%. Medium depth of field, figure slightly clearer than water and leaves, realistic ancient-style environment photography, quiet and serene. Avoid low or eye-level camera, horizontal raft, missing leaf frame, leaves covering face, floating subject, missing hip contact, impossible sitting weight, abnormal knees or legs, deformed or extra toes, feet passing through water, no entry ripples, solid-looking water, broken tubes or misaligned nodes, floating knots, disconnected beams, extra or fused fingers, fingers through clothing, hair fused with drape, floating ornaments, confused bun, robe fused into green cloth, opaque or plastic gauze, hard organza, cheap stage satin, gravity-free streamers, sticker patterns, modern raincoat, all-green filter, green skin, excessive smoothing, heavy makeup, exaggerated expression, modern clothing, modern architecture, tourists, boats, text, watermark, brand mark, HDR, oversharpening, hard flash, strong portrait blur, or commercial costume-studio staging.
items.prompt_zh: 2:3竖幅单张户外古风环境人像：从岸边或桥上高机位向下拍摄，镜头附近右上方的翠绿叶片和垂枝形成不规则顶部框景，遮住部分水面和头顶空间但绝不遮挡脸。由新旧绿色竹筒并排捆扎而成的竹筏从左上斜向右下，竹节、横向固定木条和绳结结构连续且可信。画面中央偏右坐着一位明确成年的东亚女性，上身略朝左，抬头看向高处镜头，双眼自然睁开，眉毛放松，嘴唇微启，神情安静、柔和而略带好奇。臀部与竹筏清楚接触，一条腿在筏面弯曲收起，另一条从筏边自然垂下，赤脚轻轻试探水面，脚趾入水处形成小涟漪和真实扰动。深黑长发扎成传统低髻，配浅色玉簪、金属叶形发饰和少量细长垂饰；两缕长直发从肩侧落到腰下。穿青绿色、孔雀蓝、灰蓝和浅灰叠层古风服装：浅色贴身内层、深青绿高腰宽松长裙，外层为半透明渐变宽袖和披帛，青、蓝、灰紫纱层叠并可隐约透出内层和竹筏颜色。披帛从肩臂自然垂向两侧，裙摆因坐姿、重力和竹节支撑在筏面形成大面积真实褶皱，不悬浮。另一只手放在膝侧或筏边，另一只被宽袖部分遮住，肩线放松，抬头使颈部略伸展；衣物带低饱和竹叶、植物或水波纹样，纹样随褶皱自然变形。内层柔软哑光且有垂坠重量，深青长裙只有极弱丝光，外层薄纱轻盈半透明，不要塑料感。背景为树木环绕的庭院池塘、缓流河道或森林溪池，水面深绿和灰绿，保留自然涟漪、树影反射和局部冷蓝反光；筏下与人物周围水面清晰可见，远景适度柔化。柔和阴天散射光或树冠滤光从前上方进入，均匀照亮脸、颈部、手背和浅色衣层，不产生硬阴影。整体低饱和青绿诗意调色：水面约40%、竹筏与竹节约25%、衣物约20%、黑发和阴影约10%、暖象牙肤色与灰白高光约5%。中等景深，人物清晰度略高于水面和叶片，真实古风环境摄影，安静、空灵。避免低机位、平视、竹筏横放、缺少前景叶框、叶片遮脸、人物漂浮、臀部未接触竹筏、坐姿受力错误、膝盖或腿脚结构异常、脚趾畸形或多余脚趾、脚穿过水面、入水无涟漪、水面像固体、竹筒断裂或竹节错位、绳结悬浮、横梁不连接、多余或融合手指、手指穿衣、长发与披帛粘连、发饰悬浮、盘发混乱、外袍融合成绿布团、薄纱不透明、塑料薄纱、硬欧根纱、廉价舞台缎、无重力飘带、贴纸纹样、现代雨衣、全图绿滤镜、皮肤发绿、过度磨皮、浓妆、夸张表情、现代服装、现代建筑、游客、船只、文字、水印、品牌标识、HDR、过度锐化、强闪光、强人像虚化和商业影楼古装感。

items.title: 临出门取耳环盒的夜间手机抓拍
items.description: 朋友在暗色室内意外拍下成年日本女性临出门前弯身取耳环盒的未完成动作，近距离9:16手机构图、琥珀间接光和轻微运动瑕疵营造私密生活片段感。
items.prompt: 9:16 highly realistic close smartphone snapshot: a clearly adult fictional Japanese woman is getting ready to go out when a nearby friend unexpectedly photographs her. She occupies about 95% of the frame; the top of her head, outer hair, parts of both shoulders, and part of one arm naturally crop beyond the frame. Capture the instant before the next movement, never a completed pose. She leans forward to reach for an earring case on a low table, fingertips not yet touching it, while the other hand stays near her waist. She has not prepared her expression or posture and has not fully turned toward the friend who called her name. Her gaze is away from camera, directed toward a small object beside the earring case in the lower-right; she has just begun noticing the photographer. One brow shifts slightly and one corner of closed rose-beige lips loosens; avoid posed smiles or deliberate glamour. Give her a slightly long oval face, narrow straight bridge, small nose tip, horizontally elongated almond eyes, gray-brown irises, and soft straight dark-brown brows. Thick dark-chocolate-brown hair extends below the chest, slightly off-center parted with broad loose S-waves; the forward lean pulls strands across cheek, shoulder, and collarbone, with flyaways and ends continuing beyond frame. Light neutral-beige skin retains pores and subtle tonal variation; mild phone beauty processing may soften cheek pores but never create uniform porcelain or plastic skin. Makeup: beige-brown shadow, thin dark-brown liner, separated lashes, coral-beige blush, rose-beige satin lips. Wear a muted taupe/greige/olive-brown short draped top with ultra-thin straps and a deep V cowl neckline; fabric is limited but opaque and securely worn, forming fine gravity-driven folds. Pair with secure dark charcoal-brown ultra-low-rise trousers; the waistband sits below the hip bones without slipping, with only an incidental lower-abdomen edge entering the bottom crop, never the focal point. Add one dangling earring of transparent stones and elongated silver elements, one thin silver ring, and no necklace. The earring moves slightly with minimal blur at its tip. At the extreme lower edge, partially show only portions of a low black table, open small earring case, face-down smartphone, and lightweight cardigan; none is fully visible, merely explaining the downward reach. Main light is a large warm indirect source above front-left, making broad soft highlights on nose bridge, cheekbones, upper lip, shoulders, collarbones, fabric, and hair. Weak neutral-gray ambient light enters from the right; retain natural deeper shadows under neck, inside hair, between fabric layers, and along the waist. Set a dark luxurious interior lounge in dark brown, charcoal, and near-black olive, with a narrow amber indirect glow upper-left. Strongly blur distant wall panels, low sofa, and glass table without making the background blank; retain a displaced cushion, faint glass reflections, and small table light points. Use a high-end rear smartphone camera, about 26 mm equivalent, 45–55 cm distance, roughly 7 cm above eye level and angled slightly downward, auto exposure/white balance, about ISO 320 and 1/80 s. A one-handed quick capture tilts the horizon about 1.5 degrees and places her slightly left of center. Use smartphone portrait-like separation without a perfect cutout; preserve slight highlight clipping, weak dark-area noise, subtle JPEG compression, mild edge distortion, and extremely slight motion blur in reaching hand and fingertips. Place the face just above center with lower-right gaze space; prioritize face and upper body, keep waist away from exact center. This is a private fragment of ongoing time, never a luxury advertisement. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, face substitution, sexualized body-part emphasis, transparent or displaced clothing, deliberate posing, direct camera gaze, heavy makeup, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, wrong fingers, incorrect earring-case contact, floating objects, hair clipping, strong HDR, uniform sharpening, severe distortion, blank or completely sharp background, text, watermark, logo, or studio feel.
items.prompt_zh: 9:16竖幅超写实近距离智能手机抓拍：一位明确成年的虚构日本女性正准备出门，被站在斜前方的朋友意外拍下。她占画面约95%，头顶、长发外缘、双肩部分和一侧手臂自然越出画幅；捕捉下一动作开始前的瞬间，而非完成的摆拍。她上身向前倾，正伸手去取低桌上的耳环盒，指尖尚未触碰；另一只手靠近腰部。她还没有整理表情或姿态，也尚未完全转向叫她名字的朋友。眼神不看镜头，而是落在画面右下方耳环盒附近的小物件上，像刚刚注意到摄影者；一侧眉毛轻微移动，闭合玫瑰米色嘴唇的一角略放松，避免摆拍笑容或刻意魅惑表情。她有略长椭圆脸、细直鼻梁、小鼻尖、横向偏长的杏仁眼、灰棕虹膜和柔和深棕直眉。浓密深巧克力棕长发过胸，略偏分、宽松S形波浪，前倾时有发丝垂过脸颊、肩和锁骨，保留碎发与画幅外延伸。中性米色皮肤带真实毛孔和细微色差，轻微手机美颜只柔化脸颊，不要均匀瓷塑皮肤；妆容为米棕眼影、细深棕眼线、分明睫毛、珊瑚米腮红和玫瑰米缎面唇。穿灰褐/橄榄棕之间的哑光短款垂坠上衣，极细肩带、深V垂领，布料有限但不透明并安全穿着，随重力形成细褶；搭配稳固的深炭棕色极低腰长裤，腰头低于髋骨但不松脱，低腰线和少量下腹只在下缘偶然出现，不成为中心。佩戴一只透明石与细长银色元素组成的垂坠耳环，单枚细银戒指，不戴项链；耳环因动作轻微晃动，尖端有极轻运动模糊。画面下缘只局部露出低黑桌、打开的小耳环盒、屏幕朝下的手机和轻薄开衫边缘，它们都不完整出现，只解释向下伸手的日常原因。暖色间接光从脸部左前上方照射，勾勒鼻梁、颧骨、上唇、肩膀、锁骨、布料和长发；右侧有弱中性灰环境光，颈下、发内、布料层间和腰侧保留深而自然的阴影。暗色豪华室内休息厅以深棕、炭灰和近黑橄榄色为主，左上有窄条琥珀间接光，远处墙板、低沙发和玻璃桌强烈虚化但不空白，保留轻微错位的沙发垫、玻璃反射和桌面光点。高端手机后置镜头，约26mm等效，距离45–55厘米，约高于眼睛7厘米略向下，自动曝光和白平衡，约ISO320、1/80秒；朋友单手快速拍摄使水平线约倾斜1.5度，人物略偏左。背景分离类似手机人像模式，但轮廓不完美抠图；保留高光轻微裁切、暗部弱噪点、细微JPEG压缩、边缘轻微畸变和极轻手部/指尖运动模糊。构图让脸在略高于中心，右下留出视线空间，重点是脸和上身，腰部远离正中心。真实私密生活片段，不是奢侈广告。避免未成年或幼态形象、替换脸、过度性化身体局部、透明或移位衣物、刻意摆拍、直视镜头、浓妆、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、错误手指、耳环盒接触错误、悬浮物件、发丝穿模、强HDR、全图统一锐化、过度畸变、空白或完全清晰背景、文字、水印、Logo和影棚感。

items.title: 黄金时刻热气球节的牛仔连身衣人像
items.description: 一位成年东亚女性在热闹的热气球节草地上对镜头甜笑，穿蓝色牛仔短袖连身衣与黑色内搭，彩虹热气球和金色装饰雕像在黄金时刻背景中升起。
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic outdoor travel-lifestyle editorial portrait: a clearly adult East Asian woman stands at a hot-air balloon festival during golden hour, smiling sweetly toward camera with hands gently clasped in front and head slightly tilted, conveying a warm happy mood. Her long silky light-brown hair flows naturally in the breeze; skin is bright and real, cheeks softly rosy, eyes warm brown, makeup subtle and natural, lips glossy pink. She wears a stylish blue denim short-sleeve romper layered over a black camisole, cinched with a black belt, plus a small black round crossbody bag with sunglasses tucked into the chest pocket. Preserve realistic denim, belt, bag, and metal textures. Behind her, a huge rainbow-striped hot-air balloon rises from a crowded festival lawn; a golden decorative statue and distant balloon shapes add to the celebration. Keep visitors as natural background atmosphere without stealing focus. Use bright natural sunset light, soft shadows, vivid but believable color, shallow depth of field, and creamy bokeh. 85 mm lens, f/1.8, ultra-realistic DSLR photography, Korean fashion travel editorial character, cinematic composition, highly detailed skin texture, premium grading, joyful summer festival atmosphere. Keep body proportions, fingers, bag strap, and clothing contact natural; subject face clear while the festival remains recognizable. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, distorted features or hands, extra fingers, hair clipping, transparent or malformed clothing, background faces competing for focus, deformed balloons, strong HDR, oversharpening, oversaturation, cartoon, CG, text, watermark, logo, low resolution, or studio-advertising staging.
items.prompt_zh: 超写实户外旅行生活方式编辑人像：一位明确成年的东亚女性站在黄金时刻的热气球节现场，面向镜头甜美微笑，双手在身前轻轻合拢，头部微微倾斜，表情愉快温暖。她有长而柔顺的浅棕色头发，在风中自然流动；肤色明亮自然，脸颊柔和红润，眼睛温暖棕色，妆容自然含蓄，嘴唇粉嫩透亮。她穿时尚蓝色牛仔短袖连身衣，内搭黑色吊带背心，系黑色腰带，背黑色小圆斜挎包，胸袋中插着太阳镜；牛仔布、腰带、包和金属细节保留真实纹理。身后巨大的彩虹条纹热气球从挤满游客的草地上升起，另有金色装饰雕像与远处球体增强节日气氛；游客只作为自然背景人群，不要喧宾夺主。明亮自然夕阳照明、柔和阴影、鲜艳但真实的色彩、浅景深与奶油般散景，85mm镜头、f/1.8、超写实单反摄影、韩国时尚旅行社论、电影级构图、高细节皮肤纹理和高级调色，营造愉快夏季节日氛围。保持身体比例、手指、包带和衣物接触自然，人物面部清晰而背景可辨认。避免未成年或幼态形象、五官或手部变形、多余手指、头发穿模、衣物透明或结构错误、背景游客脸部抢焦、热气球变形、强HDR、过度锐化、过饱和、卡通、CG、文字、水印、Logo、低分辨率和影棚广告摆拍感。

items.title: 校园自动售货机前的成年夏日纪实人像
items.description: 一位明确成年的东亚大学生刚从校园自动售货机取出冰汽水，穿白衬衫、浅蓝百褶裙和深蓝过膝袜，在树影与教学楼间呈现自然朋友抓拍的夏日纪实人像。
items.prompt: 9:16 vertical ultra-realistic Japanese summer documentary photograph: a clearly adult East Asian university student stands at a campus vending machine just after taking out a chilled soda bottle, wearing a relaxed smile as if a friend pressed the shutter unexpectedly rather than posing. She has smooth medium-length black hair, clean natural makeup, and realistic natural human proportions. One leg supports her comfortably while the other relaxes with a slight bend; the skirt hem moves gently with the action. Pair with a beige high-waisted short skirt and slim belt. Slightly twist the torso left. Both hands hold the open book, fingertips touching page edges with visible paper layers and slight curl. Cross the legs elegantly: the right-side leg extends toward the wooden chair with foot resting lightly on the seat, while the other leg drops naturally. Ivory pointed-toe pumps have small metallic-gold tip details. Keep natural adult proportions, realistic weight distribution, and credible feet. Shoot slightly above waist level at a near-horizontal angle with 70–85 mm perspective compression. Focus on face, upper body, and book; foreground architecture, window exterior, and furniture remain softly blurred. Leave ample headroom and space around the feet and chair. Quiet asymmetry: bright window on the left, subject on the right. Use a low-saturation palette of ivory, beige, milk-tea brown, and dark wood. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, over-idealized anatomy, transparent or excessively displaced clothing, facial or body distortion, wrong fingers, fused pages, floating book, broken leg or foot anatomy, shoes fused to chair, incorrect window or furniture perspective, cluttered modern background, excessive blur, strong HDR, oversharpening, plastic skin, cartoon, CG, text, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 竖幅全身写实编辑人像：一位明确成年的女性独自坐在大理石窗台上阅读一本打开的薄书，人物略偏画面右侧，占画面约60%，全身可见。左、右和上方有柔和虚化的米色建筑元素；背景是老式白色窗框，右侧有奶油色花卉窗帘和金色叶形流苏，左侧窗台放几本书，左下是深色木柜，右下是经典木椅。窗外可见虚化的红褐色墙和栏杆。漫射日光从左上方照亮人物左侧，窗帘和墙面反射的暖光照向右侧，柔和阴影落向右下。皮肤为浅象牙米色、带细微粉色底调，脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨和前腿有柔和高光，保留自然毛孔。妆容为柔和玫瑰腮红、香槟米与粉棕眼影、细长睫毛、自然泪沟、明亮棕色眉毛和半透明粉米色唇。头部向左下方轻倾，视线平静落在书页上，嘴部放松。奶茶灰棕色中长发过肩，带轻薄透气刘海和修饰脸型的层次，发尾柔和向内卷，沿右肩和胸前流落；保留细微高光、独立发丝和少量碎发。穿象牙色缎面与蕾丝深V领吊带上衣，一条细肩带自然滑到上臂、另一条保持在肩上，面料顺着身体形成真实张力和细褶；搭配米色高腰短裙和细腰带。上身略向左扭转，双手共同拿着打开的书，指尖接触书页边缘，纸张层次和轻微卷曲清晰可见。双腿优雅交叉：右侧腿伸向木椅，脚轻放在椅面，另一条腿自然下垂；穿象牙色尖头高跟鞋，鞋尖有细小金属金色细节。保持自然成年身材比例、真实重心和可信脚部结构。相机略高于腰部、近水平角度，70–85mm透视压缩；焦点落在脸部、上半身和书本，窗外、前景建筑与家具柔和虚化。头顶和脚部包括椅子周围留足空间，左侧明窗、右侧主体形成安静不对称；低饱和象牙、米色、奶茶棕和深木色调。保留自然皮肤通透感、发丝细节、缎面微光、蕾丝图案、薄纸和陈年木材纹理，柔和对比和浅景深。避免未成年或幼态形象、过度理想化身体、衣物透明或过度移位、脸部或身体变形、错误手指、书页融合、悬浮书本、腿脚结构错误、鞋子与椅子融合、错误窗框或家具透视、背景现代杂乱、过度虚化、强HDR、过度锐化、塑料皮肤、卡通、CG、文字、水印和Logo。

items.title: 隐宴黑椒和牛粒奢华招牌海报
items.description: 虚构高端中式餐饮品牌隐宴的收藏级招牌海报，以画面正中心的单盘黑椒和牛粒为绝对主体，结合克制品牌排版、深色高级环境和电影感食物真实质感。
items.prompt: Create a 2:3 vertical collector-grade restaurant hero poster for the fictional luxury Chinese dining brand 隐宴, with the English subtitle YIN FEAST. Center exactly one complete, uncropped round matte-black ceramic plate as the absolute visual focus. The signature dish is 黑椒和牛粒: caramelized black-pepper wagyu cubes, thick, juicy and lacquered, with seared edges, subtle marbling, and glossy dark-soy reduction clinging naturally to the meat. Add restrained charred scallion knots, crisp garlic chips, micro herbs, and tiny amber sauce accents. Contemporary Chinese fine-dining plating: compact, sculptural, elegant, never buffet-like and never with another hero dish. Use a slightly low table-level or subtly elevated dining-camera angle; keep the plate precisely centered, fully visible, with strong clean negative space. Typography must include the Chinese main title 黑椒和牛粒, the smaller English subtitle Black Pepper Wagyu Signature, the brand name 隐宴, the subtitle YIN FEAST, and one discreet official brand mark. Make the Chinese title more dominant than the English subtitle; typography is artistic, restrained, aligned, and premium, like a flagship restaurant campaign rather than a retail flyer. Place the plate in a minimal luxurious Chinese dining environment with dark stone, smoked wood, or deep lacquer table surface. Allow only a few distant secondary vessels such as a teapot, wine glass, sauce vessel, or ceramic item, heavily softened so they read as atmosphere only. Soft directional cinematic light from upper front-left grazes sauce, wagyu, ceramic rim, and tiny oil reflections; shadows are rich but not harsh. Maximize material realism: seared crust, tender juicy interior, thick smooth sauce, crisp fragile garlic, blistered scallion texture, tactile ceramic, subtle steam, micro oil shimmer, and tiny light particles. Palette: matte black, charcoal, warm brown, lacquered umber, dark-soy gloss, muted gold reflections, restrained jade or deep-green garnish. Quiet, exclusive, refined, appetite-driven luxury. Avoid cropped or off-center plate, multiple hero dishes, buffet or messy banquet table, cheap flyer styling, loud discount graphics, crude fonts, flat light, plastic food, low-detail meat, weak sauce realism, cluttered props, sharp distracting vessels, low resolution, cartoon, greasy mess, oversaturated garnish, extra text, corrupted brand wording, watermark, or distorted logo.
items.prompt_zh: 为虚构高端中式餐饮品牌“隐宴”创建一张收藏级2:3竖幅餐厅主视觉海报。画面正中心只放一只完整、未裁切的圆形深哑黑陶瓷盘，盘中是绝对主体的招牌菜“黑椒和牛粒”：焦糖化黑椒和牛肉块，肉块厚实多汁、边缘煎焦、带细微大理石纹理，裹着有光泽的深色酱油浓缩汁；搭配轻炙葱结、酥脆蒜片、微型香草和少量琥珀色酱汁点缀。摆盘紧凑、雕塑感强、现代中式精致餐饮风格，绝不出现第二个主菜或自助餐感。使用略低于桌面或轻微俯视的用餐机位，盘子处于精确视觉中心且完整可见，周围有强烈干净留白，所有元素服务于英雄餐盘。品牌与标题系统必须包含虚构品牌主名“隐宴”和较小英文副标题“YIN FEAST”，主标题使用“黑椒和牛粒”，副标题使用“Black Pepper Wagyu Signature”，另有克制的官方品牌标记；中文主标题比英文副标题更醒目，排版精致、艺术、整洁，像高级餐厅活动主视觉，不像零售传单。将餐盘置于极简奢华的中式用餐环境，桌面可为深色石材、烟熏木或深色漆面；远处最多出现少量茶壶、酒杯、酱汁器或陶瓷器皿，并强烈柔化为氛围，不抢主体。上方偏左的柔和方向光轻触酱汁、和牛表面、陶瓷盘沿和微小油光，阴影深邃但不生硬，呈现昂贵、安静、电影感的食欲氛围。最大化材料真实：焦脆表面、嫩肉汁感、浓稠顺滑且自然附着的酱汁、脆弱蒜片、起泡葱纹理、陶瓷触感；加入极细蒸汽、微油光和光线中的微粒。配色为哑黑、炭灰、暖棕、漆面赭色、深酱油光、低调金色反射和少量玉色或深绿色配菜。整体极简、有力、精致、安静奢华。避免盘子裁切或偏心、多只主菜、宴席或杂乱餐桌、廉价传单、促销图形、粗俗黑体、平光、塑料食物、低细节肉质、酱汁不真实、道具过多、背景器皿清晰抢镜、低分辨率、卡通、油腻脏乱、过饱和配菜、额外文字、错误品牌字样、水印和Logo变形。

items.title: 春日公园长椅上的粉色亚麻人像
items.description: 一位成年东亚女性在明媚春日下午坐在公园长椅上，一手梳理长发并对镜头微笑，周围有绿树、花坛和斑驳阳光，呈现宁静优雅的生活方式编辑人像。
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic outdoor lifestyle editorial portrait: a clearly adult East Asian woman sits gracefully on a wooden park bench on a bright spring afternoon, surrounded by lush green trees, blooming flowers, and a peaceful walking path. She has long voluminous black hair with soft waves, realistic luminous skin, rosy cheeks, naturally defined brows, warm brown eyes, subtle peach makeup, and glossy coral-pink lips. She wears an oversized pastel-pink linen button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, high-waisted white wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, a delicate wristwatch, and minimal accessories. One hand gently brushes her hair while the other rests naturally; she smiles softly toward the camera in a relaxed, elegant pose. Sunlight filters through the canopy, casting natural dappled light and soft shadows across the path and bench. The recognizable background includes trimmed bushes, vivid flower beds, tall trees, and a charming walkway; keep it present but subordinate to the subject. Use shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, cinematic color grading, ultra-realistic DSLR photography, Korean fashion-lifestyle editorial character, 85 mm lens, f/1.4, detailed skin texture, natural light, and a serene spring atmosphere. Keep body proportions, fingers, clothing folds, and bench contact realistic. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, distorted features or hands, extra fingers, hair clipping, incorrect clothing construction, a completely blurred or overly sharp background, strong HDR, oversharpening, oversaturation, studio staging, cartoon, CG, text, watermark, logo, or incorrect perspective.
items.prompt_zh: 超写实户外生活方式编辑人像：一位明确成年的东亚女性在明媚的春日下午优雅地坐在木质公园长椅上，周围是茂盛绿树、盛开花朵和宁静步道。她有蓬松的长黑发与柔和波浪、真实细腻且带自然光泽的皮肤、红润面颊、自然清晰眉毛、温暖棕色眼睛、淡桃色妆容和光泽珊瑚粉唇。她穿宽松淡粉色亚麻扣钮衫，袖口卷起，搭配高腰白色阔腿裤、白色运动鞋、精致手表和简约配饰。一只手轻轻梳理头发，另一只手自然放松，同时对镜头温柔微笑，姿态放松优雅。阳光穿过树冠，在小径和长椅上投下自然斑驳光影与柔和阴影。背景包含修剪整齐的灌木、明亮花坛、高大树木和迷人步行道；环境可辨认但不过度抢主体。浅景深、奶油色散景、电影色调、超写实单反摄影、韩式时尚生活方式审美、85mm镜头、f/1.4、高细节皮肤纹理、自然采光与宁静春日氛围，保持人物比例、手指、衣物褶皱和长椅接触真实。避免未成年或幼态形象、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、五官或手部变形、多余手指、头发穿模、服装结构错误、背景完全虚化或过度锐利、强HDR、过度锐化、过饱和、棚拍感、卡通、CG、文字、水印、Logo和错误透视。

items.title: 韩系后台直闪的实体照片拼贴
items.description: 一张略顺时针倾斜的9:16竖向人像照片铺在白色褶皱布料上，照片内是黑白造型成年女性的韩系后台直闪俏皮瞬间，人物头肩和手臂越出照片边界形成放大拼贴效果。
items.prompt: 9:16 physical photo collage: lay a vertical portrait photograph on white wrinkled fabric at a slight clockwise tilt, with the surrounding fabric creating irregular negative space and secondary framing. Inside the photograph is a dim indoor corridor or K-pop backstage space dominated by a black-gray background. The subject is a clearly adult Korean woman with an oval face, black hair tied back at the rear, thin wispy straight bangs, and a few curved strands beside the face. Give her sweet-cool millennium Korean flash makeup: silver-gray eyeshadow highlights, thin slightly upturned eyeliner, visible aegyo-sal, pale-pink blush, dewy pink lips, cool light realistic skin, and one gently squinting eye. She wears a white slim-fit sleeveless dress or long top with a round neck and clear black stitching details, layered with a black hollow mesh-knit cardigan and a glossy black shoulder bag, creating a clean black-and-white contrast. She is close to camera facing forward, squinting one eye, smiling with teeth and lightly sticking out the tongue tip; one hand rises beside the face with the index finger lightly touching the right cheek, head slightly tilted, opposite shoulder relaxed. Keep the playful action lively but not exaggerated. Use a close medium-close eye-level view: face in the upper center of the photo, finger near the right cheek as the foreground action focus, shoulders and upper body in the lower half. Let head, shoulders, and arms extend beyond the inner photo edge for a magnified effect and ultra-wide-angle perspective. Use cold-white CCD direct flash with bright facial highlights, slight overexposure and low-contrast softening, deep gray-black shadows, mild digital edge sharpening and compression, evoking a millennium Korean backstage snapshot. Preserve realistic skin, hair, knit, bag, and wrinkled-fabric texture. Very small gray-black text may appear on the left edge of the photo, but its content is unconfirmed: do not interpret, reconstruct, enlarge, or turn it into a personal watermark. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, formal commercial studio staging, heavy beauty retouching, plastic skin, anime, CG, excessive HDR, oversharpening, oversaturation, incorrect fingers, deformed arms or neck/shoulders, hair clipping, incorrect clothing construction, level or heavy photo borders, overlapping frames, empty black or overly sharp background, extra text, readable logo, watermark, ad labels, numbering, circled numbers, unrelated modern settings, or an incorrect 9:16 ratio.
items.prompt_zh: 9:16竖幅实体照片拼贴：将一张竖向人像照片以轻微顺时针倾斜角度铺在白色褶皱布料上，照片四周的白布形成不规则留白和二次框景。照片内部是昏暗室内走廊或K-pop后台空间，黑灰背景占大部分区域。主体是一位明确成年的韩国女性，椭圆脸，黑发后侧束起，轻薄碎齐刘海，脸侧有少量弯曲发丝；甜酷千禧韩系闪光妆，银灰眼影提亮，细长微上扬眼线，明显卧蚕，淡粉腮红和水光粉唇，冷白但真实的皮肤质感，一只眼轻眯。她穿白色修身无袖连衣裙或长款上衣，圆领和黑色缝线细节清楚，外搭黑色镂空网眼针织开衫，肩上背黑色亮面单肩包，形成干净黑白撞色。人物正面靠近镜头，一只眼眯起，露齿微笑并轻吐舌尖，一只手抬到脸侧，食指轻触右侧面颊，头部微微侧倾，另一侧肩膀自然放松，动作活泼俏皮而不夸张。近距离中近景平视，脸位于照片上半部中央，手指靠近右侧面颊作为前景动作焦点，肩部和上半身占下半部；头、肩、手臂越出内层照片边界，产生放大效果和超广角透视。采用CCD冷白直闪，面部高光明亮、可有轻微过曝和低反差柔化，阴影偏深灰黑，边缘带轻微数字锐化与压缩感，呈现千禧年韩系后台快照质感；保留真实皮肤、头发、针织、包和皱布纹理。照片左侧边缘可有极小号灰黑色文字，但内容无法确认，不要尝试解读、补写或放大，也不要形成明显个人水印。避免未成年或幼态形象、正经商业棚拍、强美颜、塑料皮肤、动漫、CG、过度HDR、过度锐化、过饱和、错误手指、手臂或肩颈变形、头发穿模、服装结构错误、照片框水平或厚重、框架重叠、背景纯黑或过度清晰、额外文字、可读Logo、水印、广告标签、编号、圆圈数字、现代后台之外的场景和错误9:16比例。

items.title: 夜间室内直闪的成年东亚美妆近像

items.prompt: Ultra-realistic ultra-close beauty editorial portrait: a clearly adult East Asian woman looks directly into the camera in a softly lit indoor room at night. Her warm expressive dark-brown eyes hold clear natural catchlights; her expression is calm, intimate, and restrained. Give her naturally refined light porcelain-warm skin with visible pores and soft luster, never plastic smoothing. Her long silky jet-black hair is straight with a clean center part, cascading over the shoulders; a few delicate face-framing strands fall naturally over the forehead and cheeks. Makeup is minimal and polished: softly defined brows, subtle eyeliner, long natural wispy lashes, gentle peach blush, and hydrated glossy rose-pink lips. She lightly rests her chin on her own bare shoulder; the shoulder is prominent in the foreground for depth, and the pose is graceful and natural rather than overtly sexualized. Use direct high-end smartphone flash to create crisp yet natural eye catchlights, luminous skin texture, soft hair highlights, and gentle contour shadows; never harsh or blown out. Keep the background intentionally dark and softly blurred, revealing only faint room traces so the face is the absolute focus. High-resolution smartphone portrait mode, shallow depth of field, sharp but not oversharpened facial detail, realistic skin and hair texture, cinematic flash photography, natural color grading, and a premium beauty-editorial aesthetic. Use an ultra-close shoulder-forward composition with the complete face in frame and accurate eyes, nose, lips, ears, shoulder, and neck proportions. Avoid minor or juvenile appearance, mannequin face, excessive smoothing, plastic or wax skin, distorted features, misaligned eyes, extra or fused fingers, deformed shoulder or neck, hair clipping through the body, heavy makeup, exaggerated seductive expression, overexposure, hard shadows, strong HDR, oversharpening, oversaturation, cartoon, CG, low resolution, blank background, text, watermark, logo, or incorrect cropping.
items.prompt_zh: 超写实超近景美妆编辑人像：一位明确成年的东亚女性在夜晚柔和的室内房间中直视镜头，温暖深褐色眼睛有丰富眼神光，表情平静、亲密而克制。她有自然细腻、带真实毛孔和柔和光泽的浅瓷暖肤色，不要塑料磨皮；长而丝滑的乌黑直发整齐中分，平滑披在肩上，少量脸周发丝自然落在额头和脸颊。妆容极简精致：柔和眉形、含蓄眼线、纤长自然睫毛、淡桃色腮红和水润亮泽的玫瑰粉唇。她将下巴轻轻抵在自己的裸肩上，裸肩位于前景并增加层次，姿势优雅自然，不夸张性感。使用高端智能手机直闪，产生清晰但自然的眼神光、皮肤纹理亮点、头发柔和高光和增强面部轮廓的轻柔阴影；闪光不能生硬或过曝。背景故意调暗并柔和虚化，只保留模糊的室内房间痕迹，主体面部为绝对焦点。高分辨率手机肖像模式，浅景深、锐利但不锐化过度的面部细节、真实皮肤与发丝质感、电影感闪光摄影、自然色彩分级、高端美容杂志审美。构图为肩部突出的超近景，面部完整入画，眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、耳朵和肩颈比例准确。避免未成年或幼态形象、假人脸、过度磨皮、塑料或蜡像皮肤、失真的五官、错位眼睛、额外或融合手指、肩颈变形、头发穿过身体、浓妆、夸张诱惑表情、过曝、硬阴影、强HDR、过度锐化、过饱和、卡通、CG、低清晰度、背景空白、文字、水印、Logo和错误裁切。

items.title: 户外强日光下的自然街拍
items.description: 一位成年东亚女性在户外石阶旁用右手遮挡强烈阳光，呈现9:16 iPhone 16 Pro日常手持街拍的真实皮肤、头发和针织纹理。
items.prompt: 9:16 vertical, ultra-realistic everyday outdoor smartphone street snapshot: a clearly adult East Asian woman in her early twenties stands facing forward and looks slightly upward. items.prompt: Cinematic photorealistic editorial portrait: a fictional young adult East Asian woman stands in the thermal pool of the real Roman Baths in Bath, UK. Frame from above the head to near the underwater hips; center the subject with her back to camera, lower body submerged in grayish-green water. Oval face, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, thin natural brows, slender nose bridge, nude-rose lips, light makeup; warm-white skin retains pores, fine down, natural variation, steam, and soft sun highlights, without plastic smoothing. Deep brown-black hair is loosely tied in a slightly messy low bun, with wet stray hairs on forehead, ears, neck, cheeks, and shoulders; small gold earrings. She wears a bronze-gold or warm brown-gold high-end silk slip dress with ultra-thin straps and a large low-draped open back. The fabric gathers into soft natural folds with fine metallic sequins, embroidery, or shimmering woven texture; it fits the waist and hips, while the lower half is fully submerged. Keep the wet fabric opaque, with realistic weight and dark-gold underwater layers, and avoid excessive exposure. Background must remain the recognizable real Roman Baths: creamy-yellow ancient stone walls, arcades, columns, statue railings, central arch, and the tall Gothic Abbey tower in the upper left. Gray-green thermal water forms natural ripples, waves, and reflections around the figure; stone has cracks, weathering, and wet dark spots. Low-saturation warm gold, ancient stone gray, and gray-green palette; quiet and classical. items.prompt_zh: 7:10竖幅、接近全身的真实夏日私摄影生活方式人像：一位虚构的年轻成年东亚女性坐在旧木楼梯与庭院连廊的转角，人物位于中央偏左，平视至略高机位，约50–85毫米人像镜头观感。木质扶手从左上向人物身侧斜伸，身后是粗糙木栏、木台阶和缝隙间明亮的绿色庭院，形成半室内半户外的阴凉角落。她的身体略朝画面右侧转，臀部稳定接触木阶，双腿自然屈曲并被宽裙摆覆盖，白色低帮运动鞋从裙摆下露出。左臂弯曲，左手掌根轻托脸颊，手指自然靠近耳侧，下巴微抬，安静望向画面右上方，不看镜头；眉眼放松、嘴唇自然闭合，神情发呆而松弛，像夏日下午短暂停顿。右手准确握住膝侧一只带透明杯盖和吸管的塑料饮料杯，深琥珀色冰红茶或果茶的液面保持水平。身侧木阶上放自然麦色草编托特包，清楚呈现编织纹理、圆绳提手和柔软袋身。深棕黑色超长直发自然披散至腰下，带轻微波纹，发量丰盈但不夸张；大量长发沿肩侧垂落成贯穿上身和裙摆的深色纵线，脸侧有几缕柔软碎发。她穿奶白色无袖或短袖宽松长裙，腰部轻微收束，下身是多层棉布裙片、窄蕾丝拼接和荷叶边；裙身有稀疏不规则的黄白小花、紫色花枝和绿色叶片刺绣。裙摆因坐姿和重力铺在木阶上，形成真实堆叠、压褶和错落边缘；衣料哑光、透气，保留棉布织纹、蕾丝和垂坠重量。自然日光从木栏外和右上方进入，照亮面部、手臂、裙摆、饮料杯和庭院绿植；人物所在木阶保持柔和阴影，外部草叶较亮，形成阴凉木廊到阳光庭院的空间过渡。配色为奶白裙、深棕木结构、绿色庭院、深色长发、暖象牙肤色和琥珀茶色，低饱和低反差、自然清淡。保留木纹、落叶、泥土、栏杆和绿植细节，人物清晰度略高于环境，不使用强人像虚化。人物与木阶、杯子、草编包保持可信接触；真实手指、杯壁、吸管、鞋子、裙摆和编织结构。避免直视镜头、夸张笑容、浓妆、网红脸、未成年或幼态形象、过大眼睛、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、过曝或发绿肤色、五官或头颈变形、悬浮或压入脸部的托腮手、错误手指/手腕、右手与杯体融合、手指穿杯壁、变形杯子、歪杯盖、悬浮吸管、倾斜液面、漏液、玻璃高脚杯、腿膝脚结构错误、鞋裙融合、多余脚、无结构裙布、悬浮裙片、重复刺绣、塑料蕾丝、亮面婚纱、硬裙撑、块状头发、发丝穿过身体、悬浮草包、断裂提手、楼梯或栏杆透视错误、现代建筑、游客、车辆、广告牌、文字、水印、品牌标识、背景过锐或完全虚化、硬闪光、强电影光、HDR、过度锐化、过饱和绿色和商业棚拍感。

items.title: 海边入水前的防晒手机快照
items.description: 朋友在海边休息区随手拍下的成年女性入水前从沙滩包取防晒霜的日常SNS瞬间，保留强烈海边光线、海风、真实皮肤与未摆拍的动作。
items.prompt: A candid SNS smartphone photo taken by a friend: a fictional Japanese woman in her twenties, clearly an adult, at a shaded rest area beside a small wooden platform by the sea, getting ready to enter the water with a friend. She twists toward an open natural-material beach bag and reaches for a half-used sunscreen bottle; her other hand lightly touches the side of her faded blue low-rise denim shorts without pulling the clothing. An asymmetrical standing pose: weight on one leg, the other knee relaxed, with natural shoulder and waist asymmetry. The friend stands about 1.3 m away and shoots one-handed on a smartphone with a 1x lens, about 26 mm equivalent, slightly above eye level and angled downward, with an accidental tilt of about 3 degrees. 4:5 vertical frame, head to mid-thigh, subject slightly left of center; face, upper body, waist, reaching hand, and beach bag read as one continuous action, with the hip-bone line naturally visible but not the focal point. She is unaware of the camera, looking down toward the bag and sunscreen, mouth slightly open as if answering her friend. Calm Japanese adult face, thin base makeup, natural brows, eyes gently squinting in bright sun. Near-black deep-brown hair just past the shoulders, irregular fine strands blown across the forehead and cheeks, some sticking to the cheeks and shoulders; not salon-perfect. She wears a tasteful deep espresso-brown triangle bikini with sufficient lining and opaque fabric, thin straps with small wooden beads, and appropriately covered front coverage; the low-rise cut naturally reveals the hip-bone line. A thin white linen shirt rests on the bag. Fine silver anklet, small hoop earrings, black hair tie on her wrist; sunglasses are placed casually on the woven bag, not worn. Natural adult proportions with realistic gravity, wrinkles, and fabric tension in the swimwear. Healthy bright skin with natural tan-line differences around shoulders, collarbones, arms, abdomen, and waist; visible pores, fine hair, a thin layer of sweat, and dry texture where sunscreen has not yet been applied. No skin smoothing, plastic gloss, or uniform whitening. The open bag is loosely filled with the white linen shirt, half-used sunscreen, sand-stained flip-flops, folded towel, and a transparent drink bottle still carrying droplets, arranged as items in use rather than a product display. Strong dry afternoon seaside light; dappled parasol or leaf-gap shadows across shoulders, arms, and abdomen; soft sand and sea bounce lifting the shadow side, with slight highlight clipping but no uniformly lit face or body. Natural smartphone color: warm sand, calm brown swimwear, slightly blue shadows; weak HDR, preserving bright-dark differences and avoiding skin-only grading. Background: small wooden platform, shaded rest area, distant green-blue sea and white waves, several ordinary beachgoers, wind-tilted parasols, and footprints. Distant people are merely carrying luggage or spreading towels; moderately in focus, never a South Pacific resort advertisement. Extremely slight motion blur in the reaching hand, mild sensor noise in dark areas, weak phone-lens distortion near outlines, and subtle compression; retain natural denim-waistband distortion, swimwear wrinkles, hair crossing the face, and real sand, wood, skin, and fabric texture. On the lower-right wooden platform, condensation droplets from the transparent bottle and a wet wood stain accidentally form the recognizable environmental lettering “@Live_life_style”. It is not an overlaid caption or digital logo: uneven, interrupted by droplets and wood grain, slightly inset and clear of the body so an SNS crop will not cut it, initially reading as an ordinary wet mark and legible only on close attention. Moisture darkens the wood, droplets catch the same light, and tree shadows cross the mark naturally; it must not be the brightest element. This is the only text. No floating captions, white digital type, bold logos, glow or outline, text on skin or swimwear, UI icons, product logos, minors, schoolwear, nudity, transparent swimwear, displaced clothing, exaggerated proportions, body-part close-ups, extreme low angle, provocative posing, real-person or celebrity resemblance, plastic skin, heavy beauty processing, strong blur, or studio advertising light.
items.prompt_zh: 真实的朋友随手拍摄的SNS手机照片：一位虚构的二十多岁成年日本女性在海边木平台旁的遮荫休息区，正准备和朋友下海；她弯身并向敞开的天然材质沙滩包伸手取半用过的防晒霜，另一只手轻触低腰褪色蓝色牛仔短裤侧面，不拉扯衣物。她站姿不对称，一条腿承重，另一膝微松，上身向沙滩包扭转，肩线和腰线自然不对称；朋友离她约1.3米，用单手手机1x镜头拍摄，约26mm等效焦段，略高于眼睛向下斜拍，约3度倾斜，4:5竖幅，画面从头部到大腿中段，人物略偏左，脸、上身、腰、伸出的手和沙滩包形成连续动作，臀部和髋骨自然出现但不是中心。她没有意识到镜头，视线落在包和脚边的防晒霜上，嘴微张像在回应朋友；平静的日本女性面孔，薄底妆、自然眉毛，阳光下略眯眼。近黑深棕色、略过肩的头发被海风吹乱，额头和脸旁有细碎发丝，部分贴在脸颊和肩上，不要沙龙式完美。她穿有足够里衬和不透明材质的深浓咖啡棕色三角比基尼，细肩带带小木珠；低腰裤头前方适当遮盖，淡淡露出髋骨线；外搭的白色薄亚麻衬衫放在包上。佩戴细银脚链、小圈耳环，手腕有黑色发圈；墨镜随意放在编织包上而不是戴着。身体比例与成年身材自然，泳装有真实重力、褶皱和布料张力；皮肤健康明亮但有肩膀、锁骨、手臂、腹部和腰部的自然晒痕差异，保留毛孔、细汗、汗毛和尚未涂匀防晒霜的干燥质感，不磨皮、不塑料光泽、不统一美白。包内松散放着白亚麻衬衫、半用过的防晒霜、沾沙的人字拖、折叠毛巾和仍有水珠的透明饮料瓶，像正在使用而非陈列。强烈的午后海边光线，木伞或树叶缝隙在肩膀、手臂和腹部投下斑驳光影；沙滩与海面的反光抬亮阴影面，局部轻微高光溢出，脸和身体不要均匀受光。自然手机色调：温暖沙色、平静棕色泳装、略带蓝色的阴影；弱HDR，保留明暗差，不能只对皮肤调色。背景有小木平台、遮荫休息区、远处绿蓝色海水和白浪、几位普通海滩游客、被风吹斜的遮阳伞与脚印；远处人物只做提行李、铺毛巾等日常动作，背景中等清晰，不能像南太平洋度假广告。伸出的手有极轻微运动模糊，暗部有轻微传感器噪点，轮廓边缘有很弱的手机镜头畸变和压缩感；保留牛仔裤腰部自然变形、泳装褶皱、头发遮脸，不要过度锐化或平滑沙子、木头、皮肤和布料。下方右侧木平台上，透明瓶凝结水珠和湿木痕迹意外形成可辨认但不规则、断续、被木纹和水珠打断的环境湿痕文字“@Live_life_style”；它不是叠加字幕或数字Logo，略微内嵌并避开身体，SNS裁切也不截断，起初像普通湿痕，需仔细看才读得出，树影自然穿过，亮度不高于主体。画面只出现这一处文字；禁止漂浮字幕、白色数字字体、粗体Logo、发光描边、皮肤或泳装上的文字、UI图标、产品Logo、未成年人、校服、裸露、透明泳装、衣物移位、夸张身材、身体局部特写、极端低机位、挑逗姿势、真人或名人相貌、塑料皮肤、强美颜、强模糊和棚拍广告光线。

items.title: 超写实香槟亮片裙成年女性动态时尚广告
items.description: 奢华酒店氛围的动态时尚广告：成年女性沿米色墙面缓行并回头，香槟亮片裙在柔和午后光中闪耀，突出自然运动与极简构图。
items.prompt: Photorealistic dynamic fashion advertisement of a young adult woman walking slowly past the camera along a minimalist beige wall. One hand gently brushes the wall while a champagne-colored sequined dress moves naturally with every step. Midway through, she turns her head to look back at the camera, capturing a memorable final glance. Place the camera slightly below waist height and capture an elegant natural stride rather than a stiff posed shoot. Create a luxury-hotel editorial atmosphere with a simple background and broad negative space. Soft afternoon sunlight illuminates the dress so the sequins shimmer with restrained highlights. Use an approximately 85mm portrait-lens compression and a slightly low-angle full-body moving composition. Preserve real skin pores, hair, sequins, fabric folds, and believable garment motion. Aim for premium DSLR realism, RAW sensibility, refined Leica-like color response, and high-detail rendering without promising a specific device or output resolution. Use beige, champagne gold, warm skin, and soft shadows with cinematic restraint rather than excessive grading. Keep the outfit tasteful, opaque, and non-explicit. Avoid underage appearance, body or facial distortion, static posing, exaggerated expression, excessive sequin glare, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, strong HDR, oversharpening, CG, anime, text, watermark, logo, or cluttered background.
items.prompt_zh: 照片级写实的动态时尚广告，一位年轻成年女性沿着极简米色墙壁缓缓走过镜头。她一只手轻轻掠过墙面，香槟色亮片裙随着每一步自然摆动；走到途中，她转头回望镜头，捕捉一个令人难忘的最后一眼。相机位置略低于腰部高度，采用自然捕捉运动的优雅步伐，不是僵硬摆拍。场景具有奢华酒店编辑氛围，背景简洁、留有大量负空间，柔和午后自然光照亮裙面并让亮片产生克制闪烁。使用约85mm人像镜头的压缩透视和略低机位全身动态构图，清晰保留真实皮肤毛孔、头发、亮片、织物褶皱和自然服装运动；以高级单反写实质感、RAW观感、细腻模拟徕卡式色彩响应和轻微高分辨率细节为目标，但不承诺具体设备或输出分辨率。整体色调以米色、香槟金、暖肤色和柔和阴影为主，电影感但不过度调色。服装得体、不透明、非情色。避免未成年感、身体或脸部变形、静止摆拍、夸张表情、亮片过度反光、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、强HDR、过度锐化、CG、动漫、文字、水印、Logo和杂乱背景。

items.prompt: Vertical 3:4 single-person photorealistic night-interior portrait of a young adult East Asian woman seated in a dark-gray high-back booth. Place her center-right in a half-body to three-quarter-body composition, using an eye-level to slightly high camera and a 50–85mm portrait-lens feel. Her upper body leans slightly forward and she looks directly into the lens with a quiet, steady, slightly cool gaze, relaxed brows, naturally closed lips, and a restrained expression rather than an exaggerated smile. Give her deep brown-black long straight hair, thin airy bangs, and fine strands falling naturally beside the face to the front of the shoulders; use light natural makeup and authentic skin texture. She wears a black thin-strap camisole under a black fitted top with a subtle shimmer from fine sequins, bead-chain texture, or woven glossy silk, never excessive reflection. Add a thin silver necklace and small earrings, with natural collarbone and shoulder-neck lines. Set her in a private bar booth, lounge, karaoke room, or night dining space. Her frame-left arm extends naturally down-left, hand lightly resting on a black handbag or seat edge; her frame-right arm hangs relaxed with hand near the leg. Use dark skirt or black bottoms. A very small playing card may appear in the lower-right corner as a casual prop with negligible visual weight. Keep the low-illumination room dark, with booths on both sides and a finely textured warm brown-gold wall or light panel behind, preserving a soft warm backdrop and visible depth.
