items.prompt_zh: 3:4竖幅单人夜间室内写实肖像，一位年轻成年东亚女性坐在深灰色高靠背卡座中，人物位于画面中央偏右，半身至大半身构图，平视略高机位，约50至85mm人像镜头观感。上半身微微前倾，正面直视镜头，眼神安静、稳定、略带冷感，眉间放松，嘴唇自然闭合，表情克制，不夸张微笑。她有深棕近黑色长直发、轻薄空气刘海和脸侧自然垂到肩前的细发束；妆容自然，保留真实皮肤纹理。穿黑色细肩带吊带内搭，外层为黑色贴身上衣，带低调细密闪片、珠链纹理或亮丝编织感，不作过度反光；佩戴细银项链和小巧耳饰，锁骨与肩颈线条自然。她坐在私密酒吧、KTV包厢、清吧或夜间餐饮卡座中，左臂自然向左下伸，手轻搭黑色手包或座位边缘，右臂放松下垂，手靠近腿面；下身为深色裙装或黑色下装，右下角可放一张很小的扑克牌作为随手拍道具，不抢主体。背景低照度，深色卡座包围两侧，后方是带细腻纹理的暖棕金色墙面或灯光墙板，形成柔和暖色背衬，背景暗但保留层次。柔和前向补光或轻微直闪从低照度环境中照亮脸部、锁骨、肩膀和项链，形成细腻高光与柔和阴影；整体以黑灰、暖棕和浅暖肤色为主，低饱和、安静、私密、真实。保持人物清晰、背景克制、发丝细节和自然肤质，避免未成年感、多人、陪衬人物、夸张笑容、浓妆、网红模板脸、眼睛过大、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、脸部过曝、肤色发灰发黄、五官不对称、头发成块、刘海僵硬、发丝穿模、项链悬浮、肩带断裂、服装纹理糊成纯黑块、亮片过度反光、廉价舞台服、胸肩结构错误、缺失或多余手指、手与包粘连、包体变形、扑克牌过大、卡座透视错误、背景过亮、暖墙过曝、环境杂乱、文字、水印、Logo、HDR、过度锐化、过饱和、强广角畸变和廉价影楼感。

items.title: 极简3D粘土艺术字与角色插画模板
items.description: 纯白背景上的极简3D粘土字标与手工角色插画模板，强调哑光橡皮泥材质、清晰字标、前后层次和可编辑装饰变量。
items.prompt: Minimalist 3D clay illustration on a pure white background, with giant bold typography reading “PLAY” lying flat behind the character. Build the letters as thick chunky extrusions in one single saturated matte plasticine color, cobalt blue, with soft rounded edges and bevels, subtle fingerprint texture, no gloss, and a faint soft drop shadow beneath. A cute stylized clay character, “a tiny cheerful mail carrier with a yellow cap”, stands IN FRONT of and overlaps the letters, fully visible from head to sneakers. The letters stay behind the character, complete and clearly readable; the character never sits on, climbs, or merges into them. Use chubby handmade proportions, an oversized round head, big glossy black dot eyes, a tiny smiling mouth, soft blush cheeks, and mitten hands. The character must use contrasting colors rather than any colors matching the letters, so it separates cleanly from the typography. The action is “waving while taking one energetic step forward”: the body overlaps the first and middle letters while the final letter remains clear on the right. Character height is about 65% of letter height and centered slightly left. Add 3 small hand-drawn coral red motion dashes trailing behind the character, plus one tiny doodled “a small star” arcing in the upper right. These accents are thin flat 2D marks, not 3D. Render with soft diffused studio light from upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, matte clay surfaces throughout, clean white seamless backdrop, and a slightly elevated eye-level camera. Format 3:4. Avoid glossy plastic, metallic sheen, gradients on letters, obscured or broken letters, character standing on or inside letters, extra text, readable text on props, misspellings, brand or commercial logos, realistic skin, harsh shadows, or colored background.
items.prompt_zh: 极简3D粘土插画，纯白背景前平放巨大加粗文字“PLAY”。字母为厚实粗壮的挤压造型，所有字母使用单一固定的饱和cobalt blue哑光橡皮泥色，边缘与倒角圆润，带细微指纹纹理，无光泽，下方有微弱柔软投影。一个可爱的风格化粘土角色“a tiny cheerful mail carrier with a yellow cap”站在字母前方并与其重叠，全身从头到运动鞋可见；字母留在角色后方并保持完整、清晰可读，角色绝不坐在、攀爬或融入字母。角色采用圆润手工比例、巨大圆头、大而闪亮的黑点眼睛、微小微笑嘴巴、柔和腮红脸颊和连指手套式双手。角色不穿任何匹配字母的颜色，仅使用对比色，使角色与排版清楚分离。动作是“waving while taking one energetic step forward”，身体重叠第一个和中间字母，最后一个字母在右侧保持清晰。角色高度约为字母高度的65%，位置略偏左。角色身后拖曳3个小的手绘coral red运动虚线，右上方有一个微小涂鸦“a small star”弧线；运动线与涂鸦是薄而扁平的2D标记，不是3D。使用左上方柔和漫射影棚光、温和环境遮挡、全程哑光粘土表面、干净白色无缝背景和略高于视线的机位，画幅3:4。避免亮面塑料、金属光泽、字母渐变、字母被遮挡或破碎、角色站在字母上或字母内部、额外文字、道具可读文字、拼写错误、品牌或商业标志、写实皮肤、硬阴影和彩色背景。

items.title: H&M 2026秋冬现代主义时尚海报
items.description: 4:5高端时尚竞选海报，以全身成年女性模特、H&M红色图形条、瑞士现代主义网格和超大黑色排版构成完整艺术指导画面。
items.prompt: Vertical 4:5 finished graphic-design poster for a premium international H&M Autumn/Winter 2026 fashion campaign. Combine high-fashion editorial photography, bold modernist typography, a Swiss-inspired grid, and strong red, black, and warm-ivory color blocking. The result must be a complete professionally art-directed campaign poster, not a fashion photograph with text merely placed on top. A full-body adult female fashion model dominates the composition, slightly right of center against a warm-ivory studio background, captured mid-stride from a subtly low angle for a confident elongated silhouette. Her dark-brown shoulder-length hair moves naturally across her face as if in a soft studio wind; expression neutral and confident, makeup minimal and natural, with understated gold hoop earrings. She wears an oversized vivid H&M-red wool coat with broad relaxed shoulders, open front, and dramatic flowing movement, over a fitted clean white tank tucked into charcoal-black wide-leg tailored trousers with a black leather belt, finished with polished pointed black leather shoes. The red coat sweeps diagonally behind her and connects visually to a red geometric field in the lower left. Use premium European fashion-editorial photography, hard but refined directional studio light, controlled shadows, natural skin, crisp textile detail, subtle analogue fashion-film grain, realistic garment movement, and warm-ivory background; aim for high detail without promising a specific output resolution. Run a strong vertical H&M-red strip along the full left edge. Place a red H&M logo upper-left, with “AUTUMN / WINTER 2026” and “NEW COLLECTION” directly beneath. Along the strip, rotated 90 degrees, set “MOVE   CHANGE   2026”. Upper-right: “WOMEN” and “LOOK 01”, with “01” highlighted red. Fine black horizontal rules cross the middle and intersect the model. Add a small outlined season marker on the right reading “26” and “AW”. A thin rule near the coat carries tiny repeated typography “MOVE MOVE MOVE MOVE MOVE”. The lower half is dominated by enormous condensed black sans-serif “NEW” above “ENERGY”; “ENERGY” is extremely oversized, bold, tightly spaced, and cropped by left, right, and bottom boundaries. Let the model overlap and interrupt the type for editorial depth. A saturated red geometric field rises diagonally from lower-left behind the giant typography and model. Lower-left: registration crosshair/grid, “AW26 / 001”, “STOCKHOLM”, and tiny technical text “59.3293° N 18.0686° E”. Lower-right: “001_26_01”, minimal registration lines, “http://”, “HM.COM”, and red “NEW ENERGY”. Use H&M Scandinavian fashion identity, Swiss modernist grid, extreme scale contrast, asymmetry, fine technical rules, microtype, bold negative space, precise alignment, and print-ready campaign finish. Avoid generic advertising layouts, excessive effects, gradients, glossy 3D typography, decorative clutter, artificial skin, distorted anatomy, extra models, streetwear aesthetics, random or incorrect text, text watermark, or extra logo.
items.prompt_zh: 4:5竖幅、成品平面设计海报，高级国际H&M Autumn/Winter 2026时尚宣传活动。采用高端时尚社论摄影、现代主义排版、瑞士风格网格和红、黑、暖象牙色色块，必须是完整专业艺术指导的活动海报，而不是在照片上简单叠字。一位成年女性全身时尚模特主导画面，位于暖象牙工作室背景中央略偏右，正处于大步行走瞬间；略低机位拉出自信修长轮廓。深棕齐肩发被柔和风吹过脸，表情中性自信，妆容极简自然，佩戴低调金色圈耳环。她穿廓形鲜艳H&M红羊毛大衣，宽松肩部、敞开前襟、动态流动；内搭洁白修身背心，配炭黑宽腿西装裤、黑色皮带和抛光尖头黑皮鞋。红大衣向后方对角线掠过，并连接左下红色图形区域。使用高级欧洲时尚社论摄影，硬朗但精致的定向棚光、受控阴影、自然皮肤、清晰织物、微妙模拟胶片颗粒、真实服装运动和暖象牙背景；85mm感、全身略低角度、人物锐利，目标为高细节但不承诺实际输出分辨率。画布左边缘贯穿H&M红色竖条，左上放红色H&M标志，其下原样清晰排版“AUTUMN / WINTER 2026”和“NEW COLLECTION”；竖条上旋转90度排版“MOVE   CHANGE   2026”。右上放“WOMEN”和“LOOK 01”，其中“01”为红色。细黑水平线横穿中部并与模特交叠，右侧小轮廓季节标记写“26”和“AW”；大衣附近细线带有“MOVE MOVE MOVE MOVE MOVE”。下半部用巨大紧凑黑色无衬线字“NEW”与“ENERGY”，“ENERGY”极大、粗重、紧字距，并被左右下边界裁切；模特穿插中断文字。饱和红色几何场从左下斜升至巨型排版和模特背后。左下放套准十字/网格、“AW26 / 001”和“STOCKHOLM”，其下技术小字“59.3293° N 18.0686° E”；右下放“001_26_01”、套准线、“http://”和“HM.COM”，并以红色显示“NEW ENERGY”。整体采用H&M斯堪的纳维亚时尚身份、瑞士现代主义网格、极端尺度对比、不对称构图、技术标尺线、微型排版、大胆负空间和印刷就绪质感。避免通用广告布局、过度特效、渐变、光滑3D排版、装饰杂乱、人造皮肤、解剖变形、额外模特、街头服饰风格、随机或错漏文字、文字水印和额外Logo。

items.title: 日本便利店街头融合泳装成年女性人像
items.description: 日本便利店外的半身生活方式肖像，以成年女性、瓶装饮料前景、玻璃反射和蓝调冷暖混光表现自发的都市街头时尚。
items.prompt: Photorealistic 9:16 half-body street-lifestyle portrait of a Japanese adult woman in her 20s standing outside a brightly lit Japanese convenience store during daytime or blue hour. Give her natural pores and authentic skin texture, soft glossy makeup, expressive eyes, relaxed confidence, and a stylish approachable presence. Use a slightly off-center candid half-body composition, with bottled drinks and snack wrappers near the lens partially framing the foreground and creating layered depth. Convenience-store glass reflections add texture and movement. Let the background softly reveal glowing beverage coolers, Japanese signage with no required exact wording, snack wrappers, drink shelves, pavement, and small urban details without clutter. She stands naturally, one hand lightly touching an open shirt or jacket, shoulders relaxed, gaze slightly off-camera or softly toward the lens, with a gentle stylish expression and playful slightly cheeky mood. Dress her in a tasteful mint, pale-pink, or warm-white bikini under a casual cropped jacket, open shirt, or lightweight streetwear cover-up; keep the swimwear and cover-up opaque, appropriately covered, and non-explicit, with subtle accessories. Use a 35mm or 50mm lens, natural perspective, shallow depth of field, close-lens bokeh from bottled drinks and wrappers, crisp face and upper body, and soft falloff into the background. Mix blue-hour daylight with warm convenience-store interior lighting; cool glow reflects in the glass, while soft highlights and gentle shadows shape the skin. Balance mint and pink accents with warm-white illumination. The energy is spontaneous, playful, urban, fashionable, authentic, and polished without feeling staged. Avoid underage appearance, vulgar exposure, transparent clothing, overly sexualized posing, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, template influencer face, incorrect fingers, body distortion, duplicate figures in reflections, cluttered background, garbled text, hard flash, HDR, anime, CG, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 照片级写实的9:16半身街头生活方式肖像，一位20多岁的成年日本女性站在白天或蓝调时刻明亮的日本便利店外。她有自然毛孔和真实皮肤纹理、柔和光泽妆容、有神采的眼睛、轻松自信且平易近人的气质。画面为略偏离中心的半身随性构图，靠近镜头的瓶装饮料和零食包装部分框住前景，形成层叠深度；便利店玻璃反射增加纹理和动态，背景隐约可见饮料冷藏柜、日文招牌、零食包装、饮料架、街道路面与少量城市细节，但背景不过度杂乱。她轻松站立，一只手轻触敞开的衬衫或夹克，肩膀自然，目光稍偏离相机或柔和看向镜头，表情温和时尚、俏皮且略带淘气。穿薄荷色、淡粉色或暖白色的得体比基尼泳装，外搭休闲短款夹克、敞开衬衫或轻便街头罩衫，服装不透明、覆盖得体，配少量微妙饰品，呈现街头与泳装融合的时尚造型。使用35mm或50mm镜头、自然透视、浅景深，瓶装饮料和包装袋在近镜头形成前景散景，面部和上半身清晰，背景柔和衰减。蓝调时刻日光与温暖便利店室内照明混合，玻璃反射冷色光，皮肤有柔和高光和轻微阴影，薄荷与粉色点缀平衡暖白照明。整体自发、俏皮、都市、时尚、真实而不刻意。避免未成年感、低俗暴露、透明衣物、过度性化姿势、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、模板网红脸、错误手指、身体变形、玻璃反射中的重复人物、背景过乱、文字乱码、过强闪光、HDR、动漫、CG、水印和Logo。

items.title: CCD直闪冷感猫系妆夜色成年女性肖像
items.description: 夜间室内低照度 CCD 直闪时尚肖像，以冷感猫系妆、深色背景和硬阴影突出肩颈与上半身线条。
items.prompt: Vertical 9:16 single-person low-light indoor fashion portrait of a young adult woman centered in frame, cropped above the waist with the figure occupying about 70%. Select the hair style “long straight black hair with a slight soft wave”, top “a black silk camisole with thin straps”, pose “leaning slightly toward the camera with one hand against the wall and looking upward”, and a small set of accessories “a fine metal necklace and a silver choker” according to the composition; do not cram every option into one frame. Give her a cool, restrained, slightly provocative cat-like presence without vulgarity. Use semi-matte base makeup, restrained narrow-T-zone highlights, tipsy reddish-brown under-eye tones, glassy lips, and authentic skin texture. Her long black hair is “long straight black hair with a slight soft wave” with natural strands. The top is “a black silk camisole with thin straps”, tasteful and opaque; keep the visual center of gravity on the upper body, clearly describing shoulder and neck lines and a natural waistline. Set the background as a dark leather sofa and deep wall, rapidly darkened. Use a low eye-level viewpoint or close slightly high-angle view with a realistic handheld snapshot composition. Direct top-mounted CCD flash illuminates face and upper body from the front, striking collarbones, fabric highlights, shoulder lines, and lips; hard shadows cut the contours while the background falls into darkness. Allow slight local skin highlight blowout but retain real texture. Use low-saturation dark tones, CCD snapshot quality, realistic color response, and subtle digital grain. Avoid plastic skin, excessive smoothing, infantilization, underage appearance, vulgar exposure, extra limbs, strong HDR, oversharpening, background stealing focus, transparent clothing, incorrect hands, CG, anime, text, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 9:16竖幅单人室内低照度时尚写实肖像，一位年轻成年女性位于画面中央，上半身裁切至腰线以上，人物约占画面70%。选择发型“long straight black hair with a slight soft wave”、上衣“a black silk camisole with thin straps”、姿势“leaning slightly toward the camera with one hand against the wall and looking upward”和少量配饰“a fine metal necklace and a silver choker”；这些选项只按当前构图选择，不要全部堆叠。她呈现冷感、克制、略带挑衅但不低俗的猫系气质，使用半哑光底妆、窄T区克制高光、眼下微醺红棕、玻璃感嘴唇和自然真实皮肤纹理。黑色长直发带轻微弯曲或大波浪，发丝自然。上衣可为黑色丝质细肩带、豹纹修身细肩带或金属链条细肩带，服装得体、不透明；视觉重心放在上半身，清晰表现肩颈线条与自然腰线。背景为皮质沙发和深色墙面，整体压暗。采用低机位平视或近距离略高机位，真实手持快照构图。机顶直闪从正面打亮面部与上半身，光线落在锁骨、衣料高光、肩线和嘴唇，硬阴影切割轮廓，背景快速沉入黑暗，皮肤局部可有轻微闪光过曝但保留真实纹理。低饱和深色调、CCD快照质感、真实肤色与细微数字颗粒。避免塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、幼态化、低俗暴露、未成年感、多余肢体、过强HDR、过度锐化、背景抢主体、透明衣物、错误手部、CG、动漫、文字、水印和Logo。

items.title: 极简豪华浴室成年女性白色浴袍肖像
items.description: 现代极简豪华浴室里的成年女性生活方式人像，表现刚洗完澡后的自然低发髻、白色毛圈浴袍与左侧柔和晨光。
items.prompt: Photorealistic 9:16 indoor lifestyle portrait of a young adult woman in a modern minimalist luxury bathroom, framed from the top of her head to near her waist and hips with a clean restrained composition. Give her an exquisite natural oval face, soft jawline, slender dark-brown eyes with slight aegyo-sal, natural straight brows, elegant nose bridge, and soft nude-pink lips. Use extremely light makeup: transparent base, light-brown eyeshadow, natural lashes, pale pink blush, and nude lips, retaining pores, subtle texture, and natural blood tone. Her long black hair is naturally tied into a slightly loose low bun with fine airy bangs and a few broken strands around both ears, suggesting the natural state just after a shower. She is calm, quiet, and slightly thoughtful, not smiling; her eyes look gently toward frame left rather than directly at camera. Her right hand lightly flicks the hair near her ear while her left hand is hidden inside the robe, in a natural restrained action. She wears a thick, soft pure-white five-star-hotel towel bathrobe with a loose lapel and naturally tightened belt; retain real terry-fiber texture and soft volume, with no brand mark. Keep the outfit tasteful and opaque. The setting is a modern minimalist luxury bathroom with broad cream-white natural marble walls, warm-gold faucets and hardware, a completely blurred white freestanding bathtub at frame left, and a narrow champagne-gold mirror frame. Keep the background simple and uncluttered. Soft natural morning sunlight enters from the left window and blends with very weak warm indoor ambient light, creating gentle side-backlight. Show realistic subsurface skin scattering, natural eye catchlights, low contrast, low saturation, warm beige cinematic color, and airy atmosphere. Use an 85mm lens at f/1.8, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, sharp eyes and lashes, realistic skin, hair, terry robe, marble, and metal textures, and slight ISO 100 film grain. High-end soft-light lifestyle editorial photography. Avoid CG appearance, AI plastic skin, excessive HDR, oversharpening, anime, illustration, smoothing, exaggerated makeup, underage appearance, incorrect fingers, malformed features, duplicate reflections, text, watermark, logo, or border.
items.prompt_zh: 照片级写实的9:16室内生活方式肖像，一位年轻成年女性站在现代极简豪华浴室中，画面从头顶至腰胯，构图简洁。她有精致自然的鹅蛋脸、柔和流畅的下颌线、细长深棕眼睛、浅卧蚕、自然直眉、秀气鼻梁和柔和裸粉唇；妆容极淡，仅透明底妆、浅棕眼影、自然睫毛、淡粉腮红和裸色唇妆，保留毛孔、轻微肌理与自然血色。黑色长发自然盘成略松散的低发髻，额前细碎空气刘海，两侧耳边有少量碎发，呈现刚洗完澡后的自然状态。她神情平静、安静、略带思考感，不微笑，目光轻轻望向画面左侧，不直视镜头；右手轻轻拨动耳边发丝，左手隐藏在浴袍内，动作自然克制。穿厚实柔软的纯白色五星级酒店毛圈浴袍，宽松翻领、腰带自然系紧，保留真实毛圈纤维和柔软体积感，无品牌标识，服装得体、不透明。背景是现代极简高级浴室：大面积米白天然大理石墙面、暖金色龙头和五金，左侧背景有一只完全虚化的白色独立浴缸，细窄香槟金镜框，背景简洁无杂物。柔和自然晨光从画面左侧窗户进入，与极弱室内暖色环境光融合，形成柔和侧逆光；皮肤呈真实次表面散射，眼睛有自然高光，整体低对比、低饱和、暖米色电影色调且空气感充足。85mm镜头，f/1.8，浅景深，背景奶油化虚化，眼睛和睫毛锐利，真实皮肤、发丝、毛圈浴袍、大理石和金属纹理，轻微ISO100胶片颗粒，高级柔光生活方式编辑摄影。避免CG感、AI塑料皮肤、过度HDR、过度锐化、动漫、插画、磨皮、夸张妆容、未成年感、错误手指、畸形五官、重复倒影、文字、水印、Logo和边框。

items.title: 二维另类手绘角色海报插画模板
items.description: 可复用的4:5二维另类角色插画模板，以粗黑轮廓、平涂色块、赛璐璐阴影、旧纸套印和可编辑海报文字构成独特手绘视觉。
items.prompt: Create a 4:5 vertical two-dimensional alternative character illustration: a lanky fictional adult street performer shown in a relaxed three-quarter stance, occupying about 75% of the frame, with short angular black hair with uneven strands and a mischievous asymmetrical grin. Give the character an oversized rounded cranium, short flattened lower face, narrow jaw, long thin neck, slightly oversized ears, huge pale oval eyes with tiny off-center pupils, extremely thick horizontal black eyebrows, heavy black upper eyelids, muted mauve under-eye rings, a tiny broad triangular nose, and a wide asymmetrical grin. Show individually drawn irregular rectangular teeth, including one clearly missing upper tooth, one chipped tooth, and deep black gaps. Dress the character in an oversized mustard jacket with graphic patches, simplified into broad graphic shapes with chunky seams, minimal folds, and small hand-drawn accessories. Use confident black-ink contours: thick outer silhouette, medium-weight facial lines, and thin angular hair strands, with only a few short scratch marks around eyes, hair, and clothing seams. Apply flat opaque color fields, one hard-edged cel shadow per form, sparse pencil hatching, subtle ink wobble, slight color misregistration, and restrained worn-paper texture. Use a controlled mustard, brick red, faded teal, cream, and black palette, keeping colors clearly separated and moderately saturated. Place the character against a flat brick-red wall with a few rough geometric marks, reduced to large flat shapes and a few loosely drawn environmental details, with oversized rough hand-painted lettering reading “ODD JOY”. Use an off-center waist-up composition, slight camera tilt, cropped background typography, loose poster margins, and lightly weathered printed edges. Keep the result alternative, odd, and strongly handmade rather than realistic photography or complex 3D rendering.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张4:5纵向二维另类角色插画：a lanky fictional adult street performer以a relaxed three-quarter stance呈现，占据画面约75%，带有short angular black hair with uneven strands和a mischievous asymmetrical grin。角色拥有特大圆形颅骨、短而扁平的下脸、狭窄下颌、细长脖子、略大的耳朵、巨大浅色椭圆眼和微小偏心瞳孔、极厚水平黑眉、沉重黑色上眼睑、淡紫色眼圈、微小宽三角鼻子，以及宽阔不对称的笑容。笑容露出单独绘制的不规则矩形牙齿，其中一颗明显上牙缺失、一颗牙有缺口，牙齿间是深黑色间隙。让角色穿an oversized mustard jacket with graphic patches，服装简化成宽阔图形形状，带粗大接缝、极少褶皱和小型手绘配饰。使用自信的黑色墨水轮廓：粗外轮廓、中等粗细面部线、细长棱角发丝；只在眼睛、头发和衣服接缝周围加入少量短抓痕。使用平铺不透明色域，每个形体配一个硬边赛璐璐阴影，辅以稀疏铅笔排线、微妙墨线抖动、轻微颜色套印偏移和克制的旧纸纹理。采用受控的mustard, brick red, faded teal, cream, and black，每种颜色清晰分离、饱和度适中。将角色放在a flat brick-red wall with a few rough geometric marks前，背景简化为大色块和少量松散环境细节，并加入超大粗糙手绘字体“ODD JOY”；采用偏离中心的半身构图、轻微相机倾斜、被裁切的背景排版、松散海报边距和轻微磨损印刷边缘。整体应是另类、诡趣而手工感强的平面插画，不使用写实摄影质感或复杂立体渲染。

items.title: 高端时尚饮品商业大片垂直广告模板
items.description: 可复用的9:16原创饮品或食品品牌广告模板，以超大产品装置、成年模特自然互动、风味材质标题与高调影棚场景构成商业主视觉。
items.prompt: Create the final image directly as a premium 9:16 vertical fashion campaign for an original trendy drink or food brand. Product type: “sparkling tea”. Original fictional brand: “Lumen Orchard”. Product name: “Citrus Bloom”. Flavor: “jasmine tea, yuzu, and white peach”. Main headline: the original two-word phrase “Bright Ritual”. The young adult model is “a cheerful adult woman with a short dark bob and a calm expressive gaze”, using the pose “sitting lightly against the oversized can”, wearing “a clean pale-yellow modern fashion look”, with the palette “citrus yellow, cream, and cobalt accent”, foreground ingredients “yuzu slices, jasmine flowers, ice, and green leaves”, and atmosphere “fine bubbles, cool condensation, and sunlit glass reflections”. Turn the product into an oversized installation occupying about 40–50% of the frame. Let the adult model interact naturally by sitting, leaning, stepping, or balancing on the packaging, with believable weight, contact, perspective, and body proportions. She should feel youthful, sweet, bright, and photorealistic, with natural skin texture, realistic hair, and an expressive gaze slightly toward camera. Use a different pose for each image so the series does not feel repetitive. Keep product and model as the clear primary subjects. Place fruit, flowers, herbs, ice, leaves, or other flavor ingredients around the foreground and lower edges, occupying only about 10–15% of visual attention; use partial cropping and soft foreground blur for depth. Add the oversized two-word headline “Bright Ritual” behind model and product. Give the typography a flavor-inspired material effect such as translucent glass, jelly, acrylic, condensation, bubbles, soft gradients, refraction, or glossy highlights; let parts of the letters overlap naturally with model and product for spatial depth. Arrange 3–5 short original brand-copy lines asymmetrically along frame edge, product contour, light direction, or circular graphics. Do not use VOL.1, ISSUE 01, decorative numbering, or generic template labels. Use a clean high-key studio, soft color-gradient background, subtle reflective floor, controlled sunlight, and product-specific atmospheric effect. Keep the layout rich but uncluttered. Render realistic liquid, ice, fruit, condensation, packaging, skin, accurate hands and feet, strong hierarchy, refined typography, and polished commercial advertising quality. Avoid underage appearance, malformed proportions, product-person fusion, floating contact, garbled packaging or headline text, extra brands, vulgar posing, cluttered background, cheap compositing, plastic CG, anime, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 将最终图像直接创作为原创趋势饮料或食品品牌的高端9:16竖版时尚竞选广告。产品类型为“sparkling tea”，原创虚构品牌为“Lumen Orchard”，产品名称为“Citrus Bloom”，核心风味为“jasmine tea, yuzu, and white peach”；主标题使用原创双词短语“Bright Ritual”。年轻成年模特为“a cheerful adult woman with a short dark bob and a calm expressive gaze”，采用“sitting lightly against the oversized can”姿势，穿“a clean pale-yellow modern fashion look”，画面主配色为“citrus yellow, cream, and cobalt accent”，前景装饰成分为“yuzu slices, jasmine flowers, ice, and green leaves”，氛围效果为“fine bubbles, cool condensation, and sunlit glass reflections”。将产品变成占据画幅约40至50%的超大装置，模特通过坐、倚靠、踩踏或保持平衡自然互动；准确表现重量、接触、透视和身体比例。模特要年轻、甜美、明亮且照片级写实，保留自然皮肤纹理、真实发丝和略微看向镜头的表现力眼神；每张系列图使用不同姿势，避免重复。产品与模特是主要主体。水果、花朵、草本、冰块、叶子或其他风味成分放在前景和下缘，仅占约10至15%的视觉注意力，使用局部裁剪和柔和前景虚化增加深度。模特和产品背后放置超大双词标题“Bright Ritual”，文字材质从风味获得灵感，可使用半透明玻璃、果冻、亚克力、冷凝水、气泡、柔和渐变、折射或光泽高光；字母部分自然叠压模特和产品以形成空间深度。沿画面边缘、产品轮廓、光线方向或圆形图形元素不对称安排3至5条简短原创品牌文案，不使用VOL.1、ISSUE 01、装饰编号或通用模板标签。使用干净高调影棚、柔和色彩渐变背景、微妙反光地板、受控阳光和产品专属氛围效果，布局丰富但不拥挤。商业摄影级真实液体、冰块、水果、冷凝水、包装材料、准确手脚、清晰视觉层级、精制排版和 polished advertising quality。避免未成年感、比例变形、产品与人物融合、浮空接触、包装乱码、标题文字错漏、额外品牌、低俗姿势、杂乱背景、廉价合成、CG塑料感、动漫、水印和Logo。

items.prompt: Vertical 9:16 single-person photorealistic indoor lifestyle portrait of a young adult East Asian woman standing before a dark-brown wooden TV cabinet. Center her in a three-quarter body composition naturally cropped below the knees, using an eye-level to slightly low camera and a 50–70mm portrait-lens feel. Her body faces the camera; both arms extend backward and downward, with each hand lightly supporting a different side of the cabinet surface and both palms making real contact. Her shoulders push naturally back and her center of gravity is stable. Turn her head toward frame right, gaze quietly outside the frame rather than at camera, with relaxed brows and eyes, closed lips, and a light restrained slightly detached expression. Her deep brown-black long straight hair is in a loose low half-up style secured with a large white fabric tie at the back, center-parted at the forehead, with two fine strands by the face. Add a thin silver necklace and small pendant, light natural makeup, real facial structure, pores, and subtle skin texture. She wears a light misty-blue fine-ribbed knit cardigan, snug but not tight, long sleeves slightly covering the backs of the hands, open at the chest and lightly joined with thin white ties. Under it is a white lace or thin-strap top; below is a white layered irregular long skirt made of light cotton, chiffon, lace, and soft tulle. Shape the waist naturally, vary the left and right panel lengths slightly, and retain lace edges, draped folds, and controlled translucent layering while keeping the outfit tasteful and private areas covered. The simple residential interior has a large closed black screen behind head and shoulders as a clean dark rectangle, a dark-brown wood cabinet below, and a broad low-saturation beige-gray wall above. Add no complex decoration, screen content, or strong reflections. Soft natural window light enters from front-left, evenly illuminating face, neck, cardigan, and skirt with shallow soft shadows. Keep the white skirt bright but preserve lace, folds, and fabric layers; let the black screen and dark hair anchor the frame. Use low saturation and low contrast in beige-gray, black-gray, misty blue, creamy white, dark brown, and light ivory skin. Real indoor natural-light photography, medium depth of field, background not strongly blurred. items.prompt_zh: 超现实照片级写实人像，一位年轻成年女性坐在安静的室内空间，神情出神、沉浸思绪，视线偏离镜头。她有蓝灰色长发，柔软发丝自然垂落，部分前景发丝靠近镜头并保持锐利清晰，其他发丝轻轻散落在肩部和脸侧；妆容自然，肤色呈温暖的浅米粉色调，保留真实毛孔、细微绒毛和自然高光。她穿简洁的低领露肩上衣，露肩边界得体，指甲为较长的杏仁形并保持精致自然。画面中放一只白色茶杯作为生活化前景道具。采用直闪快照语言，闪光轻轻照亮面部、前景发丝与上半身，同时叠加斑驳日光和柔和暖光，使局部肌肤呈温暖米粉色偏移。构图突出前景锐利发丝与人物，背景形成奶油般的浅景深虚化，保留梦幻、略不真实的空间感；现实摄影质感与超现实氛围并存。使用自然手持视角、适度高光和轻微数字颗粒，服装不透明且非情色。避免未成年感、夸张裸露、错误手部、发丝粘连、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、过曝、强HDR、背景杂乱、CG、动漫、文字、水印和Logo。

Retain realistic skin, hair strands, knit fibers, denim texture, mirror reflections, and phone detail in a lifestyle editorial palette of warm gold, deep blue, and pale denim. Avoid altered face, identity, or hairstyle, underage appearance, excessive beauty filters, plastic skin, incorrect mirror orientation, malformed phone, extra fingers, fused hands, garbled or missing initials, transparent clothing, exposure of private areas, CG, anime, watermark, or extra logo.
items.prompt_zh: 仅使用上传的参考照片作为面部与身份依据，严格保持相同的面部结构、五官、肤色、表情与整体身份，不换脸、不美化、不改变年龄或发型身份特征。创作照片级写实的黄金时刻镜前自拍：一位成年女性优雅地坐在地板上，面前是一面大型流行风格全身镜；她的左手轻轻托住脸颊，右手拿着 iPhone 17 Pro Max 拍摄镜中自拍。窗边落日从她身后照入，营造空灵柔和的午后氛围。她有深褐色长波浪发，带刘海和被风吹动的细碎发丝，妆容自然，嘴唇带光泽。她穿浅色高腰牛仔短裤和深蓝色露脐背心，肩膀与手臂外搭一件深蓝色超大针织开衫，带清晰麻花编织、刺绣星星和可编辑姓名缩写“AB”；服装得体、不透明。镜面、人物和手机构成自然层次，保留真实皮肤、发丝、针织纤维、牛仔纹理、镜面反射与手机细节，整体为温暖金色、深蓝和浅色牛仔的生活方式编辑摄影。避免改变面部、身份或发型、未成年感、过度美颜、塑料皮肤、错误镜像方向、手机变形、额外手指、手部融合、文字乱码、缩写遗漏、透明衣物、暴露私密部位、CG、动漫、水印和额外Logo。

items.title: 酒红街头时尚成年女性地下车库肖像
items.description: 深夜工业地下车库中的酒红街头时尚成年女性侧面肖像，以离机闪光和戏剧阴影突出城市高级编辑质感。
items.prompt: Cinematic photorealistic streetwear fashion portrait of a young adult East Asian woman in an underground parking garage at night. Capture her in a graceful side profile as she gently adjusts the brim of a burgundy baseball cap, creating a confident yet restrained pose. Give her long silky dark-brown hair, authentic skin texture, soft natural makeup, defined brows, subtle eyeliner, warm brown eyes, and matte rosy lips. She wears an oversized burgundy hoodie with a large embroidered star design on the back, a matching burgundy cap, silver wristwatch, delicate chain bracelet, and small hoop earrings. Set the scene in a dark industrial garage with dramatic shadows and minimal ambient light. A soft off-camera flash illuminates her face and outfit, producing strong contrast, crisp detail, and a premium urban editorial feel. Use shallow depth of field, an 85mm lens at f/1.8, realistic skin texture and fabric folds, rich burgundy tones, modern minimalist composition, refined color grading, and high-end lifestyle fashion photography. Aim for high-detail rendering without promising a specific output resolution. Keep the outfit opaque, tasteful, and non-explicit. Avoid underage appearance, exaggerated or malformed anatomy, transparent clothing, plastic skin, excessive beauty filters, strong HDR, oversharpening, CG, anime, text, watermark, or extra logos.
items.prompt_zh: 电影感照片级写实街头时尚肖像，一位年轻成年东亚女性站在深夜地下停车场中，优雅地以侧面轮廓入镜，轻轻调整酒红色棒球帽帽檐，姿态自信而克制。她有长而柔滑的深棕色头发、自然真实的肤质、柔和淡妆、清晰眉形、细微眼线、温暖棕色眼睛和哑玫瑰色嘴唇。穿大廓形酒红色连帽衫，背面有大面积刺绣星形图案，搭配同色酒红帽子、银色腕表、精致链条手镯和小型圈状耳环。背景是昏暗工业地下车库，戏剧性阴影与极简环境光构成深色城市氛围；柔和离机闪光照亮脸部与服装，形成强烈对比、清晰细节和高级街头编辑感。浅景深、85mm镜头、f/1.8，真实皮肤纹理与织物褶皱，浓郁酒红色调，现代极简构图、精致调色和高端生活方式时尚摄影。保留高细节目标但不承诺实际输出分辨率。服装得体、不透明、非情色。避免未成年感、夸张或变形解剖、透明衣物、塑料皮肤、过度美颜、强HDR、过度锐化、CG、动漫、文字、水印和额外Logo。

items.title: 职场成年女性与焦虑怪兽创意摄影
items.description: 真实职场女性与身后巨大焦虑怪兽的创意海报式肖像，以摄影与手绘毛绒立体风格对比表现被看见的情绪压力。
items.prompt: Vertical 3:4 single creative portrait combining realistic portrait photography with hand-drawn animated monster elements; no collage, four-grid layout, infographic, or readable text. A young adult Asian woman sits at an office desk in a simple clean white shirt, black hair naturally tied or in a low ponytail. One hand supports her face and the other rests beside a laptop. Her surface expression is quiet and tired, while her eyes clearly show work-related anxiety, mental pressure, and suppressed emotion; her temperament suggests commuting, workplace, and urban life. Keep her face and skin in authentic photographic texture with natural features, pores, and fine variation. Behind her stands a giant “Emotion Monster” combining hand-drawn animation language with a plush 3D texture: gray-blue or light blue-gray, large, soft, slightly clumsy yet oppressive, with big round eyes and an innocent-but-annoying expression like lingering anxiety. It pokes out from behind her and follows closely. Cover its body with irregular sticky notes, to-do papers, meeting reminders, deadline marks, and unread-message symbols, but keep every mark abstract and non-readable with no invented wording. Include only a few realistic office details on the desk, such as computer, documents, papers, and coffee cup, keeping the image simple and uncluttered. Use a softly lit indoor office with cool gray tones. Create a clear contrast: the woman is restrained and realistic, the monster exaggerated and animated. The atmosphere has a touch of humor, while the emotional core is “anxiety has been seen”; make it story-rich, empathetic to workplace life, and suitable for a creative poster. Avoid horror, suspense, blood, children’s picture-book feel, overly cute chibi style, underage appearance, multiple people, messy office, exaggerated or broken expressions, sharp teeth or aggressive monster behavior, incorrect fingers, text watermark, logo, plastic CG, or excessive HDR.
items.prompt_zh: 竖版3:4单张创意人像，将真实人物摄影与手绘动画怪兽元素结合，不要拼贴、四宫格、信息图或文字。一位年轻成年亚洲女性坐在办公桌前，穿简单干净的白色衬衫，黑发自然扎起或低马尾；一只手托脸，另一只手放在笔记本电脑旁，表面平静疲惫，眼神明显流露工作带来的焦虑、精神压力与情绪压抑，气质偏通勤、职场和都市生活。她的面部与皮肤保持真实摄影质感、自然五官、真实毛孔和细微纹理。她身后站着一只巨大的“情绪怪兽”，整体是手绘动画语言与毛绒立体材质的结合：灰蓝或浅蓝灰色，体型大而柔软，略笨拙却有压迫感，圆大眼睛和无辜又烦人的表情，像挥之不去的焦虑。怪兽从人物背后探出并紧跟着她，身体贴有不规则便利贴、待办事项纸条、会议提醒、截止日期标记和未读消息图形，但全部为抽象不可读符号，不添加具体文字。办公桌保留电脑、文件、纸张和咖啡杯等少量真实细节，画面简洁不杂乱；背景为冷灰调室内办公室，光线柔和。人物必须克制、写实，怪兽夸张、动画化，形成明显反差；整体有一点幽默感，情绪核心是“焦虑被看见了”，具有故事感、职场共鸣和创意海报质感。避免恐怖惊悚、血腥、儿童绘本感、过度可爱Q版、未成年感、多人、办公室杂乱、表情夸张崩坏、怪兽尖牙或攻击性、错误手指、文字水印、Logo、CG塑料感和过度HDR。

items.title: 未来数字连接中空粒子光环科技论坛海报
items.description: 横版科技论坛主视觉，以暗色负空间、中心偏右的中空粒子光环和左侧几何字标表现数字连接与行业交流。
items.prompt: Horizontal 16:9 main visual poster for a technology forum titled “Frontier Technology Forum”, retaining small forum time “2026.10.18”, location “Shanghai”, and three relevant information points: “Digital Connectivity”, “Industry Exchange”, and “Future Networks”. Create a strong sense of future communication around digital connectivity and industry exchange. Use a dark low-brightness base with a large quiet negative-space field. Translate the concept into a huge hollow particle halo positioned center-right. The halo is not a uniform circle: weave it from thousands of extremely fine radial lines, needle-like filaments, tiny light dots, and short particle trajectories. Keep the inner edge tight and sharp; make the outer edge elongate rapidly and thin out in every direction, creating impact, acceleration, and fling-out momentum. One arc side is highly focused with a clean flare while the other sinks into darkness, preserving a recognizable dark vortex and layered front-to-back interleaving. Several slender horizontal light beams pass through halo, lettering, and background, some reaching the frame edges; overlay extremely faint scan lines and distant light trails to make the static ring feel like high-speed transmission. Make the compact subject wordmark on the left a clear secondary focus, combining large geometric symbols, bold sans-serif short titles, and slender digital characters with strong scale jumps, loose tracking, and precise baselines. Use a long sharp diagonal divider to connect short right-side messages in columns or separate lines. Let text lightly touch particle edges without blocking the halo; place only tiny dates, slogans, and auxiliary details in corners for high-density micro-typography. Derive colors from the technology theme: cool dark low-brightness colors dominate, saturated glowing primaries concentrate on halo and beams, adjacent transition colors shift naturally along particle flow, and restrained cool-warm highlights strengthen the explosive arc. Clean bright neutrals are reserved for the core wordmark and brightest light centers. Keep dark areas deep but clean, bright areas distinct but not blown out, and color transparent and luminous rather than muddy. Use precision digital-optical texture, crisp lines, fine particles, and glow boundaries that are soft yet sharp, with only slight chromatic aberration and screen-scan traces; no paper fibers, aged wear, or heavy fog. At thumbnail size, the first read is the confrontation between glowing ring impact and white wordmark; up close, reveal particle density, filament layers, and micro-information. Avoid ordinary neon circles, soft smoke, evenly scattered decorative grains, garbled lettering, flat hierarchy, overcrowding, muddy shadows, blown-out centers, plastic CG, anime, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 横版16:9科技论坛主视觉海报，主题为“Frontier Technology Forum”，保留小型论坛时间“2026.10.18”、地点“Shanghai”和3个相关信息点“Digital Connectivity”“Industry Exchange”“Future Networks”。围绕数字连接与行业交流建立强烈未来传播感：以深色低明度背景和大面积安静负空间承托画面，将主题核心概念转译为中心偏右、尺度巨大的中空粒子光环。光环不是均匀圆圈，而是由数千条极细放射线、针状光丝、微小光点和短促粒子轨迹编织而成；内缘紧密锐利，外缘向四周快速拉长并逐渐稀疏，形成瞬间冲击、加速和甩出的动势。一侧弧段高度聚焦并形成洁净耀斑，另一侧沉入暗部，让空心区域保持清晰深色漩涡和前后穿插。数束纤细水平光束穿过光环、字标和背景，部分延伸至画面边缘；叠加极淡扫描线与远距离光迹，让静态环体产生高速传输感。左侧紧凑主题字标是清晰次焦点：用大型几何符号、粗体无衬线短标题和纤细数字字符组合，设置明显尺度跳变、宽松字距和精确基线。用一条长而锐利的斜向分隔笔画连接右侧竖排或分行的短信息，让文字轻压粒子边缘、与光环共享空间而不互相遮死；角落仅放小型日期、口号和辅助信息，形成高密度微排版。色彩由科技语义派生：冷暗低明度底色覆盖大部分画面，高饱和发光主色集中于光环和光束，邻近过渡色沿粒子流自然换相，少量冷暖对照高光强化爆发弧段；洁净高亮中性色只用于核心字标和极亮光心。暗部深而不脏、亮部鲜明不过曝，色彩透明发光不浑浊，亮度集中在焦点。精密数字光学质感，线条清晰、粒子细密、辉光边界柔中带锐，仅有极轻微色散和屏幕扫描痕迹，不要纸张纤维、陈旧磨损或厚重雾气。缩小观看时先读到发光环冲击与白色字标的对抗关系，近看再显现粒子密度、光丝层次和微型信息。避免普通霓虹圆线、柔软烟雾、平均撒开的装饰颗粒、文字乱码、无层级排版、过度拥挤、低对比暗部、过曝光心、CG塑料感、动漫、水印和Logo。

items.title: 户外花园草帽针织衫成年女性写真
items.description: 明亮花园中的成年女性户外生活方式肖像，突出浅麦色草帽、雾蓝针织开衫、扶帽动作与柔和自然光。
items.prompt: Vertical 2:3 single-person outdoor lifestyle portrait of a young adult East Asian woman standing in a bright spring-summer garden, framed naturally below the knees in a three-quarter body composition. Center her with an eye-level to slightly low camera and a 70–100mm medium-telephoto feel. Her body turns slightly toward frame left, head naturally lowered, gaze falling toward lower left, mouth corners slightly raised in a relaxed, subtle natural smile; she does not look at camera. She wears a natural light-wheat straw boater hat with a soft white lace ring around the brim. Her frame-right hand is raised, fingers lightly pinching the brim, elbow bent outward naturally; her frame-left arm relaxes downward while lightly holding a cream cloth-bag strap, with a small straw crossbody bag visible at lower left. Deep brown-black long hair is braided into a loose side braid falling in front of her body on frame right, with thin bangs and a few wind-blown flyaways; add a thin silver necklace with a small heart pendant. She wears an open light misty-blue cable-knit cardigan with clear round neck, ribbed cuffs, and hem, decorated with several low-saturation yellow and pink flower brooches. Under it is a light white long dress with natural fit, slight shaping below the bust, and a softly falling skirt. Make the dress from fine cotton, vertical lace, and understated jacquard, retaining weave, slight translucency, and draped folds while staying tasteful and opaque. Set the background in a layered but softened garden of deep-green trees, light-green shrubs, yellow flower clusters, grass, and a light beige low wall. Warm sunlight from upper-right front creates soft highlights on hat, cheeks, shoulders, sleeves, and white-dress edges; the brim naturally shades forehead and eyes, keeping the face bright but not overexposed. Use deep green, misty blue, milky white, warm wheat, and warm ivory skin in a low-saturation, bright, fresh, softly sweet palette. Keep person and clothing textures clear, with soft shallow-depth garden bokeh, realistic skin, hair, knit, lace, brooch, straw, flowers, and leaves. Natural French-pastoral spring-summer garden portrait, a lived-in moment rather than a deliberate pose. Avoid underage traits, looking at camera, exaggerated laughter, stiff expression, heavy makeup, template influencer face, oversized eyes, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, bloodless or green skin, blown-out face, extra or missing fingers, fused fingers, hand passing through brim, broken wrist, abnormal arm, deformed or plastic hat, lace fused with hair, repeated braid, hair passing through clothes, chaotic knit, floating buttons, malformed brooch, shiny synthetic cardigan, overexposed or detail-free white dress, stiff skirt, floating strap, damaged straw bag, oversharp background, tourists, modern billboard, text, watermark, brand logo, hard flash, strong shadows, HDR, oversharpening, oversaturated green, or cheap studio-photo feel.
items.prompt_zh: 2:3竖幅单人户外生活方式写实人像，一位年轻成年东亚女性站在阳光明亮的春夏花园中，采用膝下自然裁切的七分身构图，人物居中，平视略低机位，约70至100mm中长焦观感。她身体轻微转向画面左侧，头部自然低垂，视线落向左下方，嘴角微微上扬，呈现放松含蓄而自然的笑意，不看镜头。她戴天然浅麦色草编平顶帽，帽檐围绕柔软白色蕾丝；画面右侧的手抬起，手指轻捏帽檐边缘，肘部自然向外弯曲，形成真实扶帽动作；画面左侧手臂放松向下，轻提米白色布包带，左下角可见小型草编斜挎包。深棕近黑长发编成松散侧辫，垂在身体右侧胸前，少量碎发和薄刘海被风吹动；佩戴细银链和小心形吊坠。穿浅雾蓝麻花针织开衫，敞开穿着，圆领、罗纹袖口和衣摆清楚，胸前点缀数枚低饱和黄色与粉色花朵胸针；内搭白色轻盈长裙，上身自然贴合、胸下略收束，裙摆柔软下垂。白裙由细棉布、竖向蕾丝和低调提花构成，保留自然织纹、轻微透光和垂坠褶皱，服装得体不透明。背景为层次丰富但柔和的花园：深绿树木、浅绿灌木、黄色花丛、草地和浅米色矮墙。暖阳从人物右前上方照射，在草帽、脸颊、肩膀、袖子和白裙边缘形成柔和高光，帽檐为额头和眼睛遮光，脸部明亮但不过曝。配色以深绿、浅雾蓝、奶白、暖麦色和暖象牙肤色为主，低饱和、明亮、清新、柔甜；人物和衣物纹理清楚，背景柔和浅景深散景，保留真实肤质、发丝、针织、蕾丝、胸针、草包和花叶细节，自然生活感，不刻意摆拍。避免未成年特征、直视镜头、夸张大笑、僵硬表情、浓妆、模板网红脸、过大眼睛、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、惨白或发绿肤色、面部过曝、多余或缺失手指、手指粘连、扶帽手穿过帽檐、断腕、异常手臂、草帽变形或塑料感、蕾丝与头发粘连、辫子重复、头发穿衣、针织纹理错乱、漂浮纽扣、胸针变形、化纤亮面、白裙过曝或无蕾丝褶皱、僵硬裙摆、悬浮包带、草包破损、背景过锐、杂乱游客、现代广告牌、文字、水印、品牌Logo、硬闪光、强阴影、HDR、过度锐化、过饱和绿和廉价影楼感。

items.title: 她在月亮背面醒来的立体纸雕艺术海报
items.description: 现代东方女性梦境纸雕海报：成年女性从巨型镂空月牙后醒来，纸层、星云、飞鸟与远山构成明亮通透的纵向叙事。
items.prompt: Vertical 9:16 single modern Eastern 3D paper-cut art poster combining layered paper-cut illustration, paper-carved landscape, and a poetic female dream. The theme is “She Awakens Behind the Moon”: an adult Eastern woman with a visual age around 24 wakes from behind a giant hollow paper-carved crescent moon, as if she has finally crossed a long-suppressed old dream and found a new world that belongs to her. She is cool, ethereal, quiet, awake, and carries a slight strength of reawakening. Give her a delicate narrow oval face, slightly upturned slender almond eyes, a clear gaze, and a quiet expression with subtle relief after waking. Model the face in exquisite Eastern paper-art illustration language, neither real-person photography nor childish cartoon. Her long black hair is half-draped and half-pinned, extending backward into flowing paper ribbons, with small pale-gold crescent and star hair ornaments. She wears a layered ultramarine-blue and silver-white paper-art long dress, with moon, cloud, and star cutouts inside the skirt and a light semi-transparent paper-art shawl outside. Show clear cut edges, hollow decoration, slight creases, soft paper curves, and fiber texture. Place her center-right and slightly low, slowly stepping out from inside the fully visible giant crescent, holding a glowing paper seed in one hand and elegantly reaching with the other as if touching birds and starlight. Let skirt and shawl flow layer by layer in the wind for strong vertical extension. Include the complete crescent, stars, clouds, birds, distant mountains, lake surface, and glowing seeds; every element uses a consistent paper-cut and 3D paper-carving language. Clearly separate foreground, middle ground, and background with soft shadows, hollow light transmission, paper thickness, fiber texture, and hand-cut edges. Main colors are ultramarine blue, silver-white, and light purple with small pale-gold accents. Cool white moonlight enters from upper right, creating delicate layered shadows between paper sheets; the crescent edges transmit a little light. Keep the night scene bright and clear rather than blackened. The result feels like a modern Eastern female art poster, a paper-carving display case, and a high-end art installation: the woman is the first visual center, her face is clear, spatial layers are rich, the mood is dreamy and refined, and no text appears.
items.prompt_zh: 9:16竖版单张现代东方立体剪纸艺术海报，将层叠纸雕、纸雕景观与诗意女性梦境结合。主题是“她在月亮背面醒来”：一位视觉约24岁的东方成年女性从巨大的纸雕镂空月牙后苏醒，像终于穿过长期压抑的旧梦，看见真正属于自己的新世界。她清冷空灵、安静清醒，带有刚重新觉醒的力量感；窄鹅蛋脸、微微上挑的细长杏眼、清亮目光和惊醒后轻微释然的安静表情。面部采用精致东方纸艺插画塑形，不是真人摄影，也不过度卡通化。黑色长发半披半挽，发丝向后延展成流动纸带，佩戴小型浅金月牙与星片发饰。服装为群青蓝与银白色多层纸艺长裙，裙内层镂刻月亮、云和星星纹样，外搭轻薄半透明纸艺披帛；纸层有清晰裁切边缘、镂空装饰、轻微折痕、柔和弧度和纤维质感。人物位于中央偏右且略偏下，正从完整的巨大月牙内部缓缓走出，一手托发光纸种子，另一手优雅伸出，像要触碰飞鸟和星光；裙摆与披帛随风逐层流动，形成纵向延展。画面包含完整月牙、星星、云层、飞鸟、远山、湖面和发光种子，所有元素统一采用剪纸与立体纸雕语言。前景、中景、背景层次清楚，具有柔和投影、镂空透光、纸张厚度、纤维纹理和手工裁切边缘。主色为群青蓝、银白和淡紫，少量浅金点缀；冷白月光从右上方照入，在纸层间形成细腻层叠阴影，月牙边缘轻微透光。夜景保持清晰明亮，不压暗成黑色。整体兼具现代东方女性艺术海报、纸雕展柜和高级艺术装置展示感，人物为第一视觉中心，面部清晰，空间层次丰富，梦幻高级，不出现文字。

items.title: 树荫下旋转浅米色蕾丝裙的成年女性
items.description: 公园石板路上的全身夏日时尚肖像，成年女性提起多层薄纱蕾丝裙旋转，捕捉裙摆弧线与树叶逆光。
items.prompt: Vertical approximately 2:3 photorealistic summer fashion portrait of a young adult woman on a park flagstone path surrounded by summer greenery. She lifts the pale beige-to-pale-champagne layered tulle-and-lace mermaid dress with both hands and spins lightly. Center her at about 80% of image height: head upper center, waist center, flared skirt filling most of the width, crossed legs and bare feet lower center. Her upper body and face tilt slightly toward her own right; the right leg is the axis, the left leg crosses behind with left toes extended downward and slightly lifted, while the sole of the right foot stays firmly on the flagstones. Her own right hand pinches the skirt on frame left and her left hand pinches frame right, arms opening softly on diagonals. During the turn, light milk-tea-brown long hair and the thin hem stream toward frame right. Give her a small oval face, ivory skin, slender light-brown brows, downcast brown eyes, long lashes, pale-pink cheeks, soft coral-beige lips, slightly raised chin, and a relaxed expression mixing concentration and joy; add a thin chain and small pendant. The dress has a wide lace-edged neckline tied with a thin front ribbon, transparent white short flared gauze sleeves with lace and ruffles, fine pleats and pintucks from chest to waist, a thigh-covering inner layer, and a flowing transparent outer hem from below the knees to the calves. Decorate the hem with white floral embroidery, vertical texture, and layered wavy ruffles; keep the styling tasteful and private areas covered. Foreground: taupe pebbled path with leaf shadows and narrow gaps. Add a wooden-seat black-metal chair at middle left, grass and a small purple-white flower bed at middle right, a rough gray stone pillar in the right foreground, thick trunks and dark green leaves to the left, many branches overhead, a gray-roofed wooden hexagonal pavilion in the right distance, and low black posts with thin ropes receding along the path. Strong natural backlight from upper-right rims hair, cheeks, shoulders, sleeves, translucent skirt layers, legs, and stones in gold. Circular leaf-filtered shadows fall on ground and clothing; trees show dark green shade and bright circular bokeh. Shoot from slightly below the standing figure's waist, keeping face, upper body, hands, and lace sharp while short-focus portrait blur softens chair, pavilion, and trees; retain only slight motion in hem and hair tips. Palette: pale beige, champagne, warm skin, vivid green, taupe. Render realistic skin, hair strands, layered tulle, embroidery, lace threads, pleats, ruffles, bare feet, stone, leaves, and flowers; keep the backlit silhouette and tree-shadow contrast without washing out the white layers. Avoid face or downcast-eye corruption, extra fingers, fused hands and skirt, deformed wrists or arms, fused legs, bent-back knees or ankles, added or missing toes, poor right-foot contact, gravity-inconsistent lifted foot, excessive skirt flipping, damaged hem or lace, distorted pavilion or tree perspective, repeated shadows, left-right reversal, text, logo, watermark, or excessive skin smoothing.
items.prompt_zh: 近似2:3竖幅的照片级写实夏季时尚全身肖像：一位年轻成年女性在夏日绿荫环绕的公园石板小径上，双手提起浅米色渐至淡香槟色的多层薄纱蕾丝鱼尾裙，轻盈旋转。人物居中约占画面高度八成，头部在上方中央、腰部在中央、展开的裙摆占据大部分宽度，交叉双腿和赤足位于下方中央；上身与脸微向她自己的右侧倾斜，以右腿为轴，左腿向后交叉，左脚趾向下并微微离地，右脚脚底平稳贴在石板路。她用自己的右手捏住画面左侧裙摆、左手捏住右侧裙摆，双臂柔和斜向展开；旋转使浅奶茶棕长发和薄裙摆向画面右侧流动。她有小巧椭圆脸、象牙色肌肤、浅棕细眉、低垂棕眼、细长睫毛、淡粉脸颊和柔和珊瑚米唇，嘴角放松，神情兼具专注与愉悦，下巴微抬；佩戴细链和小吊坠。裙装有宽蕾丝深领边、前中央细丝带，透明白纱短喇叭袖带蕾丝褶边，胸下至腰部细褶与纵向褶饰，外层为膝下至小腿的流动透明裙摆，内层覆盖大腿，裙摆饰白色花卉刺绣、纵向纹理和多层波浪褶边，保持得体并不露私密部位。背景前景为灰褐小石子小径、叶影和缝隙；左中景有木座黑金属脚座椅，右中景有细草与紫白花坛，右前景有粗糙灰石柱，左后方是粗树干深绿叶，右远处是灰顶木柱六角凉亭，低矮黑柱和细绳延向远方。强烈自然光从画面右上后方进入，在头发、肩、袖、透明裙层、腿和石板路形成金色轮廓光；叶隙圆形树影洒在地面与衣物，背景为深绿阴影和明亮圆形散景。机位略低于站立人物腰部，脸、上身、双手和蕾丝清晰，背景座椅、凉亭和树木以短焦肖像镜头柔和虚化，保留极轻微裙摆与发梢动感。基调为浅米、香槟、暖肤、鲜绿和灰褐，真实呈现皮肤纹理、发丝、薄纱层叠、刺绣、蕾丝线、褶皱、赤足、石板、叶花质感；逆光轮廓与树影对比清晰但不冲白。避免脸或低垂眼神崩坏、多余手指、手与裙融合、腕臂变形、双腿融合、膝踝反折、脚趾增减、右脚不贴地、左脚抬起违背重力、裙摆过度翻卷、裙摆或蕾丝破损、背景透视扭曲、重复树影、左右反转、文字、Logo、水印和过度美肌。

items.title: 史诗古装成年女性漫步透明丝绸与古城夜景
items.description: 史诗级写实奇幻场景：古装成年女性沿高空透明丝绸行走，丝绸承载苍劲书法纹样，下方展开月夜古城与山川。
items.prompt: Epic photorealistic fantasy scene of an adult woman in ancient costume walking upright on transparent silk suspended high in the night sky. The silk stretches from the upper-left sky into the distance like a soft aerial path. Its surface is covered with grand abstract calligraphic brushwork, powerful and vigorous against the silk's delicate translucent texture; do not add a specified readable sentence or modern logo. Below, show an aerial ancient city and mountain nightscape: the city is brilliantly lit, with orderly solemn buildings glowing in warm yellow light, while distant mountains disappear into hazy night mist for a remote poetic atmosphere. A luminous moon in the black sky emits soft light. Volumetric rays pass through the transparent silk and coat it with a transparent golden glow. Make the image expansive, mysterious, and epic, with strong depth and a long sweeping narrative. Render silk refraction and folds, calligraphic strokes, layered city lights, mountain mist, and moonlight in highly detailed photorealistic materials and natural light; aim for high-resolution detail without promising a specific output resolution. Avoid modern clothing, underage appearance, cartoon, anime, plastic CG appearance, malformed anatomy, opaque silk, unreadable calligraphy clutter, modern buildings, chaotic light sources, excessive HDR, text watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 史诗级照片写实奇幻场景，一位身穿古代服饰的成年女性以挺拔姿态行走在高空透明丝绸上。透明丝绸从画面左上方高空延伸至远方，像一条悬在夜空中的柔软道路；丝绸表面布满大气磅礴的抽象书法纹样，笔触苍劲有力，与丝绸柔美通透的质感形成鲜明对比，但不要添加指定的可读句子或现代标志。下方是航拍视角的古城与山川夜景：古城灯火辉煌，建筑错落有致，在暖黄色灯光下古朴庄重；远山笼罩夜雾，营造悠远意境。黑色夜空中一轮发光月亮散发柔和光芒，体积光穿透丝绸，为其镀上透明金色光层。整体画面宏大、延展、神秘，具有史诗纵深和长幅叙事感。以高细节照片级写实表现透明丝绸的折射与褶皱、书法笔触、古城灯光层次、山雾和月光；高分辨率质感、真实材质、自然光影，不承诺实际输出分辨率。避免现代服装、未成年感、卡通、动漫、CG塑料感、错误人体、丝绸不透明、书法乱码堆叠、现代建筑、杂乱光源、过度HDR、文字水印和Logo。

items.title: 蝴蝶苏醒创意成年女性人像
items.description: 真实摄影质感的成年女性侧身肖像中，裙面蝴蝶印花逐渐脱离布料变成立体蝴蝶，形成轻盈诗意的梦幻叙事。
items.prompt: Vertical 3:4, one single creative portrait image combining real portrait photography with dreamy butterfly animation elements; no collage, four-grid layout, infographic, or text. A young adult Asian woman stands before a clean, soft indoor background, turned sideways with her head slightly lowered, natural and elegant posture, quiet and gentle temperament. She wears a light, airy dress whose surface originally carries butterfly or floral-and-butterfly motifs. Keep the woman in authentic photographic texture with natural skin, clear makeup, black hair loosely tied up or falling naturally, and an overall high-end soft feminine feeling. The key creative idea is that the butterfly motifs on her dress gradually detach from the fabric and become real three-dimensional butterflies with a subtle animated quality, flying around her. Some butterflies remain on the skirt like printed motifs; some have just broken free from the fabric edge with wings unfolding; others have already entered the air and circle lightly around her shoulders, arms, and surrounding space. Make the transformation natural and dreamy, like a waking life-world hidden inside the clothes. Use mainly blue, white, black-gold, and light orange butterflies, light and agile with rich layers but never gaudy. Keep the background clean and soft with restrained light and shadow that highlights the woman and butterflies. The overall style blends fashion photography and fantasy illustration: airy, poetic, dreamy, healing, and evocative of dynamic life hidden inside a static photograph. Avoid insect horror, overly dense butterflies, childish cartoon style, malformed butterfly shapes, exaggerated wing proportions, cluttered background, wedding-photo-studio style, text, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 竖版3:4单张创意人像，将真实人像摄影与梦幻蝴蝶动画元素结合，不要拼贴、四宫格、信息图或文字。一位年轻成年亚洲女性站在干净柔和的室内背景前，身体侧向镜头并微微低头，姿态自然优雅，气质安静温柔。她穿浅色轻盈连衣裙，裙面原本带有蝴蝶或花卉与蝴蝶元素；人物保持真实摄影质感、自然皮肤和清透妆容，黑发松散盘起或自然垂落，整体高级而柔和。核心创意是裙上的蝴蝶图案一点点脱离布料，变成真实立体、带轻微动画感的蝴蝶围绕她飞舞：部分仍停留在裙面像印花，部分刚从布料边缘挣脱并展开翅膀，部分已经飞入空中，在肩膀、手臂和周围空气中轻盈盘旋。变化过程自然梦幻，像衣服里藏着正在苏醒的生命世界。蝴蝶以蓝色、白色、黑金和淡橘色为主，轻盈灵动、层次丰富而不过分花哨。背景干净柔和，带少量光影，突出人物与蝴蝶；整体是时尚摄影与奇幻插画的结合，画面轻盈、诗意、梦幻、治愈，呈现静态照片里藏着动态生命。避免昆虫恐怖感、蝴蝶过密、低幼卡通、错误蝴蝶形态、夸张翅膀比例、杂乱背景、婚纱影楼风、文字、水印。

items.title: 电影级落日转头动态成年女性肖像
items.description: 黄昏田野中成年女性突然转头的动态手机闪光肖像，突出头发拖影、强烈明暗对比和原始社论摄影质感。
items.prompt: Ultra-detailed cinematic portrait of a young adult woman standing in an open field at dusk. She suddenly turns her head sharply over her shoulder toward the camera, captured at the instant of movement: long hair sweeps across the frame in dynamic motion trails, the face edges have slight motion blur while remaining recognizable, lips are slightly parted, gloss catches the flash, and the expression feels alive and unexpected. Her body turns slightly away from camera; very long loose hair falls down her back, with the sharp turn creating energetic hair trails. She wears a black crop top and a black cap with worn distressed edges, shifted slightly by the head movement. Direct phone flash hits the face and upper body, illuminating skin and creating highlights on cheekbones, nose, forehead, and lip gloss. The background falls into darkness, creating strong contrast between the lit figure and the dark field. Show dark grass, distant tree silhouettes, and a dramatic sunset sky transitioning from warm orange to deep blue; the flash overpowers ambient light for a moody cinematic atmosphere. Use close portrait framing of shoulders and face, sunset sky filling the background, shallow depth of field, high contrast, light film grain, no beauty filter, no plastic skin, no AI look. Add short square milky-white manicure. Vertical 9:16, direct phone flash, RAW aesthetic, Pinterest evening editorial, motion style 50. Avoid underage appearance, static passport-photo effect, excessive smoothing, excessive HDR, cartoon, anime, CG, text, watermark, or malformed hands.
items.prompt_zh: 超细腻电影感肖像，一位年轻成年女性在黄昏的开阔田野中突然猛地转头看向镜头，捕捉转头动作瞬间：长发扫过画面形成动态拖影，面部边缘有轻微运动模糊但面部仍可辨，嘴唇微启，唇彩捕捉闪光，表情充满生命力且出人意料。身体略微背向镜头并处于转身中，极长散发垂在背后，黑色短款上衣，黑色帽子带磨损做旧边缘并因头部动作略微偏移。手机直闪击中面部和上半身，照亮皮肤并在颧骨、鼻子、额头和唇彩上形成高光；背景没入黑暗，人物亮部与深色田野形成强烈对比。深色草地、远处树木剪影和戏剧性落日天空从暖橙过渡到深蓝，闪光盖过环境光，氛围深沉而电影化。特写肩膀与面部构图，落日天空填充背景，背景浅景深。高对比度、轻微胶片颗粒、无美颜滤镜、无塑料皮肤、无AI感；短方形奶白色美甲。竖幅9:16，RAW原始美学、Pinterest晚间社论风、动态风格50。避免未成年感、静止证件照效果、过度平滑、过度HDR、卡通、动漫、CG、文字、水印和畸形手部。

items.title: 固定身份的黄金时刻咖啡馆浪漫肖像
items.description: 以上传参考图像严格保持面部身份与发型特征，在黄金时刻室外咖啡馆创作奢华浪漫的超写实人像。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image only for facial and identity reference. Preserve the same facial structure, eyes, eyebrows, eyelashes, nose, lips, gentle smile, jawline, chin, skin tone, expression, hairline, hair color, hair texture, and overall identity; retain the elegant messy updo, wispy curtain bangs, and curled face-framing strands. Do not beautify, stylize, age, reshape, or modify the face; do not face-swap, apply AI beauty enhancement, change identity, retouch the face, or replace the hairstyle. Create an ultra-realistic luxury romantic portrait with the subject seated gracefully at an outdoor café table during golden hour, maintaining the same gentle downward gaze and elegant pose. She wears a dusty rose off-shoulder floral chiffon dress with sheer puff sleeves, delicate ruffle details, and soft embroidered flowers. Her voluminous messy updo is adorned with a pink floral hairpiece and pearl accents; add sparkling crystal drop earrings, a butterfly pendant necklace, a delicate floral bracelet, a rose-gold wristwatch, and elegant rings. Warm golden sunlight illuminates the face and hair, creating soft rim light and natural highlights. Set the background in an upscale outdoor café with creamy bokeh lights, blurred flowers, and a refined romantic atmosphere. Emphasize realistic skin pores, glossy natural lips, authentic hair strands, detailed jewelry reflections, premium cinematic color grading, and realistic fabric texture. Use controlled HDR, shallow depth of field, an 85mm lens at f/1.4, photorealistic ultra-detailed masterpiece quality, 8K resolution. Avoid altered face or identity, different hairstyle or expression, different outfit, plastic skin, heavy beauty filter, cartoon, anime, CGI, painting, blur, low resolution, bad anatomy, extra fingers, distorted hands, text, logo, watermark, artifacts, oversaturated colors, unrealistic lighting, duplicate face, or cropped head.
items.prompt_zh: 仅将上传的参考图像用于面部与身份参考，严格保持相同的面部结构、眼睛、眉毛、睫毛、鼻子、嘴唇、温柔微笑、下颌线、下巴、肤色、表情、发际线、发色、发丝纹理与整体身份；保留优雅的凌乱盘发、轻盈的法式刘海和修饰脸型的卷曲碎发。不要美化、风格化、改变年龄、重塑或修改面部，不换脸、不做AI美颜增强、不改变身份、不进行面部修饰或发型替换。创作超写实奢华浪漫肖像，主体在黄金时段优雅地坐在室外咖啡馆桌旁，保持温柔向下注视和优雅姿势。她穿灰粉色一字肩碎花雪纺连衣裙，带透明感泡泡袖、精致荷叶边和柔软刺绣花朵；蓬松凌乱盘发上点缀粉色花朵头饰与珍珠，佩戴闪亮水晶垂坠耳环、蝴蝶吊坠项链、精致花卉手链、玫瑰金腕表和优雅戒指。温暖金色阳光照亮脸部与头发，形成柔和轮廓光和自然高光；背景为高档室外咖啡馆，奶油色焦外灯光、模糊花卉和精致浪漫氛围。强调真实皮肤毛孔、水润自然嘴唇、真实发丝、珠宝反光和写实织物纹理；高级电影级调色，HDR但不过度，浅景深，85mm镜头，f/1.4，照片级写实、极致细节、杰作画质、8K分辨率。避免改变面部或身份、不同发型或表情、不同服装、塑料皮肤、厚重美颜、卡通、动漫、CGI、绘画、模糊、低分辨率、错误解剖、多余手指、扭曲手部、文字、标志、水印、瑕疵、过饱和、不真实照明、重复面部和裁剪头部。

items.title: 河边树荫下夏日野餐成年女性写真
items.description: 树荫下河边夏日野餐的纵向写实时尚肖像，突出人物、银色薯片袋、藤篮与自然光斑构成的稳定三角布局。
items.prompt: A young adult woman in her 20s sits on a reddish-brown and ecru checkered picnic mat under a tree beside a river in midsummer, in a vertical slightly wide seated portrait framed from the top of her head to near her ankles. Place her in the center-right with knees raised near her chest and legs folded diagonally across each other; both hands lightly hold the lower left and right ends of a silver potato-chip bag in front of her knees. Her upper body is almost front-facing, her face tilts slightly toward her own right while looking directly at the camera, and her expression is soft and quietly conversational. Give her fair skin, a slim healthy adult build, soft taupe chest-length hair in fine-stranded loose waves, thin natural bangs, and delicate leaf-filtered sunlight outlining the crown and ends. She has rounded dark-brown eyes, natural parallel brows, pale coral cheeks, and slightly parted moist pink-beige lips. Add a small silver hoop and white four-flower dangling earrings on her right ear, a thin silver chain with a white four-flower pendant, and a slender matching flower bracelet on her own left wrist. Retain natural blood color, pores, fine vellus hair, and subtle texture without excessive highlights or retouching. She wears an ivory-white ribbed knit camisole with thin ecru-colored straps and matching soft short hot pants; the camisole has a deeper round neck, the shorts have fine frills at the leg openings, and a drawstring is visible at her own left underarm. Keep the summer outfit tasteful, with harmonious clothing boundaries and leg overlap; show slender fingers, pale-pink nails, accurate joints, and the correct number of fingers. The glossy silver chip bag occupies much of the lower-left foreground and clearly shows the black bold text “Calbee” and “ポテトチップス”, white text “コンソメパンチ”, the small upper-left phrase “Vegetable of 5 types of vegetables”, and “55g” at the bottom, all readable from the front. In the lower right, place a light rattan basket containing a transparent plastic bottle of sugar-free black tea, a small silver-black film camera, bluish-white fabric, and yellow-green grapes. Behind them are bright green lawn, calm blue river, a low concrete bridge, and distant gray-blue city buildings; a thick trunk and branches enter from the upper right with green leaves creating cool shade. On a clear afternoon, strong natural light from upper left illuminates the lawn and water, while leaf gaps create small soft spots on the hair, shoulders, arms, knees, and mat. Keep the face evenly diffused in shade with catchlights in the eyes and subtle highlights on nose bridge, lips, and fine hair; add slight shimmering river reflections. Use a natural 50mm perspective, around F2.8, close camera slightly above eye level, sharp detail on face and foreground bag, smooth shallow-depth blur on river, bridge, and buildings, leaf and pale-blue-sky bokeh above, and checkered cloth and object detail below. High-precision photorealistic fashion photography with a clean translucent Japanese summer magazine aesthetic; render individual hair strands, ribbed knit weave, shorts stitching, creases and reflections on silver packaging, rattan texture, pale amber tea inside the transparent bottle, translucent grapes, and cloth fibers. Palette of ivory, vivid yellow-green, pale blue, and silver balances warm sun with cool shade, moderate micro-contrast, soft highlight gradients, low noise, natural dynamic range, refined film finish. Avoid underage-looking or childlike figures, extra arms or legs, fused legs, missing or extra fingers, broken hands, reversed left-right accessories, excessive HDR, anime, 3DCG feel, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 一位20多岁的年轻成年女性坐在盛夏河边树荫下的红褐与米色格子野餐垫上，纵向稍宽坐姿肖像，从头顶拍至脚踝附近。人物位于画面中央偏右，双膝抬至胸前附近，双腿斜向交叠，双手在膝前轻握银色薯片袋左右下端；上半身几乎正面朝向镜头，脸部略向她自己的右侧倾斜并直视镜头，表情柔和安静。她肤色白皙，身材苗条健康，灰褐色长发至胸部，细束松散波浪，前额薄刘海自然垂落，叶隙阳光勾勒头顶和发梢；深棕色眼睛、自然眉、淡珊瑚粉脸颊、微启的粉米色湿润嘴唇。佩戴小银圈、白色四朵花耳坠、配花朵吊坠的细银链，以及她自己左手腕上的同花朵手链；皮肤保留自然血色、毛孔、细微绒毛和真实纹理，不过度高光或磨皮。穿象牙白细肩带罗纹针织吊带背心与同色短热裤，背心较深圆领、自然贴合，裤脚有细褶边，她自己左侧腋下可见系带；手指修长、淡粉色指甲、关节和手指数量准确，夏日服装得体，衣物边界与腿部重叠解剖协调。银色光泽薯片袋位于左下方的大面积区域，正面清晰显示黑色粗体文字“Calbee”“ポテトチップス”、白色文字“コンソメパンチ”、左上角小字“Vegetable of 5 types of vegetables”和底部“55g”。右下方放浅色藤编篮，内含透明无糖黑茶塑料瓶、银黑小型胶片相机、青白色布料和黄绿色葡萄。背景为明亮草坪、平静蓝色河面、低矮混凝土桥和远处灰青色城市建筑；右上方有粗树干、枝条和绿叶形成凉爽树荫。晴朗午后，左上方强烈自然光照亮草坪和水面，叶隙光在头发、肩膀、手臂、膝盖和格子垫上形成细小柔和光斑，脸部在漫射阴影中均匀受光并保留瞳孔、鼻梁、嘴唇和发丝高光，河面有细微闪烁反射。50mm视角，约F2.8，略高于视线的近距离机位，自然透视，脸部和前景袋子清晰，河、桥、建筑平滑浅景深虚化，上方是叶子和淡蓝天空的散景，下方以格子布和小物件细节增加密度。高精度照片级写实时尚摄影，干净通透的日本夏日杂志风；真实呈现头发丝、罗纹编织、热裤缝线、包装折痕反射、藤编纹理、瓶内淡琥珀色黑茶、葡萄半透明感和格子布纤维，象牙白、鲜黄绿、淡蓝、银色为主，平衡暖阳与冷阴影，适度微对比、柔和高光渐变、低噪点、自然动态范围、精致胶片质感。避免看起来未成年、幼小体格、多余手臂或腿、融合腿、缺失或多余手指、崩坏的手、左右饰品反转、过度HDR、动画、3DCG感和水印。

items.title: 复古模块化旅游海报信息图设计
items.description: A 2:3 retro travel-poster infographic with one central landmark and coordinated cultural panels for a configurable country.
items.prompt: Create a highly detailed vintage travel-poster infographic for JAPAN in a clean modular collage layout, portrait 2:3. Use a warm retro palette of cream, beige, muted orange, olive green, teal, navy blue, and soft red accents. Combine flat vector illustration with subtle textured paper grain, mid-century tourism-poster aesthetics, minimalist geometric shapes, crisp outlines, balanced spacing, premium editorial design, and a symmetrical modular grid. Feature one large central landmark illustration, surrounded by evenly spaced square and rectangular panels showcasing the country's most recognizable landmarks, architecture, landscapes, wildlife, traditional culture, cuisine, festivals, transportation, art, historical monuments, iconic symbols, nature, modern skyline, and everyday cultural elements. Use culturally accurate details inferred from JAPAN and avoid invented specifics. Add decorative borders, traditional patterns, ornamental dividers, stamps, icons, and cultural motifs without crowding the grid. At the bottom, display JAPAN in large bold uppercase lettering, the native-language name 日本 beneath it, and the exact short tourism slogan Discover Japan. Add small coordinate text 35.6762° N, 139.6503° E, establishment-year text 1868, minimalist icons, and neatly aligned typography modeled on classic tourism posters. Keep every illustration in one consistent flat-vector style with soft gradients, muted vintage colors, subtle paper texture, geometric clarity, high detail, premium travel-brochure quality, museum-grade print design, and ultra-sharp edges. No photorealism, clutter, unsupported landmarks, illegible text, random cultural stereotypes, watermarks, or unrelated logos.
items.prompt_zh: 为JAPAN创作一张高度详细的复古旅游海报信息图，采用整洁的模块化拼贴布局，纵向2:3。使用奶油色、米色、柔和橙色、橄榄绿、青色、海军蓝和柔和红色点缀构成暖色复古调色板。将扁平矢量插画与细微纹理纸张颗粒结合，呈现中世纪旅游海报美学、极简几何形状、清晰轮廓、平衡间距、高级编辑设计和对称模块网格。中心放置一个大型标志性地标插图，周围等距安排方形和长方形面板，展示该国最具代表性的地标、建筑、景观、野生动物、传统文化、美食、节日、交通、艺术、历史遗迹、标志性符号、自然、现代天际线和日常文化元素。依据JAPAN推导真实且文化准确的细节，不虚构无根据的具体内容。加入装饰边框、传统图案、装饰分隔线、邮票、图标和文化母题，但不要挤满网格。底部用大号粗体大写准确显示JAPAN，下方显示母语名称日本，并显示准确短旅游口号Discover Japan。加入小号坐标文字35.6762° N, 139.6503° E、建成年份文字1868、极简图标和类似经典旅游海报的整齐排版。所有插图保持一致的扁平矢量风格，带柔和渐变、柔和复古色彩、细微纸张纹理、几何清晰度、高细节、高级旅游手册质感、博物馆级印刷设计和超清晰边缘。不要写实摄影、杂乱、无依据地标、文字难辨、随机文化刻板印象、水印或无关Logo。

items.title: 3D黏土动画风格数字插画
items.description: A playful clean-white 3D claymation illustration template with a cheerful configurable character, glossy message text, and floating motion accents.
items.prompt: Create a high-quality 3D claymation-style digital illustration on a clean plain white background. Feature a cheerful a cheerful clay bear with soft tactile clay texture, wearing a bright yellow raincoat, captured in a dynamic a joyful jump while holding or interacting with a small red umbrella. Place large glossy 3D text reading exactly "HAVE FUN" behind the character in sunny yellow. Add small colorful stars and paper confetti around the text, plus subtle motion lines, sparkles, and playful graphic accents to emphasize movement and energy. Use soft lighting, smooth rounded clay-like materials, rounded shapes, vibrant colors, and a clean modern composition with a fun whimsical aesthetic. Keep the character, prop, text, and floating objects clearly separated, legible, and physically coherent. Avoid rough unfinished clay, harsh shadows, muddy colors, illegible text, distorted lettering, clutter, unrelated objects, flat 2D rendering, photorealistic material mismatch, watermarks, and logos.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张高质量的3D黏土动画风格数字插画，背景为干净纯白。展示一个快乐的a cheerful clay bear，具有柔软可触的黏土质感，穿着a bright yellow raincoat，以动态的a joyful jump呈现，同时拿着或与a small red umbrella互动。在角色身后放置大型光泽3D文字，准确显示“HAVE FUN”，颜色为sunny yellow。文字周围添加small colorful stars and paper confetti，并加入细微运动线、闪光和俏皮图形点缀来强调动作与能量。使用柔和光线、光滑圆润的类黏土材质、圆形造型、鲜艳色彩和简洁现代构图，营造有趣奇幻的美感。保持角色、道具、文字和漂浮物彼此清晰分离、文字可读且物理关系连贯。避免粗糙未完成的黏土、硬阴影、浑浊色彩、文字难辨、字形变形、杂乱、无关物体、扁平2D渲染、与黏土质感不匹配的写实材质、水印和Logo。

items.title: 曼城球衣3D皮克斯风格卡通角色
items.description: A centered full-body premium 3D collectible figure of a relaxed adult man in a Manchester City jersey and sage-green oversized denim sweatpants.
items.prompt: Create a full-body stylized 3D cartoon collectible figure of an adult white man with a deliberately large head but realistic body proportions, inspired by modern Pixar-style high-end CGI animation. He has a short black fade haircut, neatly trimmed short beard, black oval sunglasses, relaxed confident stance, both hands in pockets, subtle smile, and friendly charismatic expression. Dress him in a white Manchester City football jersey with realistic stitching, embroidered club crest, specified sponsor mark, subtle fabric weave, sleeve trim, collar details, and premium athletic material. Pair it with sage-green oversized denim sweatpants featuring natural folds, washed denim texture, oversized fit, and detailed stitching, plus clean matte-black sneakers with realistic leather and subtle sole details. Render a premium 3D figurine with smooth skin shading, detailed facial features, expressive eyes behind the sunglasses, groomed hair, soft global illumination, cinematic studio lighting, gentle shadows, ambient occlusion, subsurface scattering, and photorealistic fabric and material textures. Place him centered and full-body before a smooth pastel light-green seamless studio backdrop with soft gradient and minimal distractions. Use shallow depth of field, professional portrait framing, sharp focus, clean luxury CGI composition, and restrained cinematic color grading. Octane/Unreal Engine/Redshift/ray-tracing quality may guide the visual finish, without requiring a specific renderer. Keep the 3:4 vertical format. Avoid distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed hands, warped sunglasses, illegible or duplicated jersey marks, changed club identity, plastic materials, clutter, harsh shadows, low detail, watermarks, and unrelated text or logos.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一个全身风格化3D卡通收藏人偶：一名成年白人男性，头部比例刻意较大但身体比例写实，灵感来自现代皮克斯风格的高端CGI动画。他留黑色渐变短发和修剪整齐的短胡须，戴黑色椭圆太阳镜，姿态放松自信，双手插兜，带微妙微笑，表情友好且富有魅力。穿白色曼城足球队球衣，呈现写实缝线、刺绣俱乐部徽章、指定赞助商标识、细腻织物纹理、袖口饰边、衣领细节和高级运动面料；搭配鼠尾草绿大廓形牛仔运动裤，具有自然褶皱、水洗牛仔纹理、宽松版型和精细缝线，再配干净哑光黑运动鞋，呈现真实皮革与细微鞋底细节。将角色渲染为高级3D收藏人偶，具有平滑皮肤阴影、精细面部特征、太阳镜后的富有表现力的眼睛、真实头发梳理、柔和全局光照、电影级棚拍光、柔和阴影、环境光遮蔽、次表面散射以及照片级面料和材质纹理。将角色居中全身置于平滑淡浅绿色无缝摄影棚背景前，背景带柔和渐变和极简干扰。使用浅景深、专业人像取景、清晰焦点、干净奢华CGI构图和克制电影调色。Octane、虚幻引擎、Redshift和光线追踪的品质可作为视觉完成度参考，不要求特定渲染器。保持3:4竖幅。避免解剖变形、多余肢体、手部畸形、太阳镜扭曲、球衣标识难辨或重复、俱乐部身份改变、塑料材质、杂乱、硬阴影、低细节、水印和无关文字或Logo。

items.title: 现代主义包豪斯展览海报设计指令
items.description: A 2x2 16:9 presentation sheet of four coordinated modernist exhibition posters for underrated international brands or a configurable topic set.
items.prompt: Create a 2x2 grid on a 16:9 canvas containing four coordinated premium modernist exhibition posters for four underrated international brands. Treat each quadrant as one distinct poster in the same visual system. Use Swiss modernism and Bauhaus editorial poster principles: strict asymmetric grids, large intentional negative space, museum-grade typography, and clear hierarchy. For each brand or topic, infer a bold 3–5 color palette from its mood and cultural context, one short powerful title, a 2–5 word exhibition subtitle, an index number or archive code, small location/date/collection microcopy, and geometric rectangles, circles, bars, rules, margins, or color blocks that echo the subject. Infer one dominant hero image per quadrant—the most iconic visual representation of the subject, such as a portrait, object, silhouette, artifact, architecture, animal, machine, landscape, symbol, or scene—and make it the focal point without crowding the layout. Use oversized condensed sans-serif or elegant modern serif typography, disciplined alignment, balanced asymmetry, and crisp image-to-type relationships. Keep the four quadrants coherent but allow each brand's inferred colors and hero image to differ. Render as a polished modernist exhibition sheet with bold color geometry, strong negative space, refined print-like texture, clean edges, and museum-quality editorial design. Ensure all four posters are visible, readable, and distinct within the 16:9 frame. Avoid generic template repetition, chaotic decoration, excessive text, weak hierarchy, crowded layouts, illegible microcopy, low-resolution imagery, random colors unrelated to the subjects, photorealistic clutter, watermarks, and unrelated logos.
items.prompt_zh: 在16:9画布上创建一个2x2网格，包含四张为four underrated international brands制作的协调高级现代主义展览海报。将每个象限视为同一视觉系统中的一张独立海报。采用瑞士现代主义与包豪斯编辑海报原则：严格的不对称网格、大面积有意留白、博物馆级排版和清晰层级。为每个品牌或主题根据其情绪和文化背景推导3–5种大胆配色、一个简短有力的标题、一个2–5词展览副标题、系列编号或档案代码、位置/日期/收藏风格的小号信息，以及呼应主题的矩形、圆形、条形、标尺、边距或色块几何。为每个象限推导一个主体最具标志性的英雄图像，例如肖像、物体、剪影、文物、建筑、动物、机器、景观、符号或场景，使其成为焦点但不挤满版面。使用超大紧凑无衬线体或优雅现代衬线体，保持严谨对齐、平衡非对称和清晰图文关系。四个象限保持系统统一，同时允许各品牌的推导色彩和英雄图像不同。渲染为精致的现代主义展览总表，具有大胆色彩几何、强留白、细腻印刷质感、清晰边缘和博物馆级编辑设计。确保16:9画面内四张海报都完整可见、文字可读且彼此清晰区分。避免模板重复、装饰混乱、文字过多、层级弱、布局拥挤、微文案难读、低分辨率图像、与主题无关的随机配色、写实杂乱、水印和无关Logo。

items.title: 夏空下的西瓜劈
items.description: A bright photorealistic 2:3 summer beach portrait capturing an adult woman splitting a watermelon with a wooden stick amid frozen droplets.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 2:3 vertical summer beach lifestyle portrait. A fictional adult East Asian woman kneels on bright midsummer sand, leaning her upper body far forward and gripping a wooden stick firmly with both hands as it presses into a large watermelon already splitting open in the lower-left foreground. Freeze the peak action with the hands and stick centered, vivid red flesh and transparent water droplets splashing around the crack, and the woman's brilliant laughing face farther back along a continuous diagonal depth path. She has bright ivory natural skin with visible moisture and droplets, a soft oval face, slender taupe brows, brown eyes, light beige and moss-green eye makeup, pale rose blush, coral gloss lips, and a happy open laugh with natural teeth. Wear large rounded translucent green sunglasses with a thin silver frame and double bridge; bright platinum-blonde waist-near hair with sparse uneven bangs and long layered strands blown strongly left by the sea breeze. Dress her in a modest lavender, lilac, white, and green floral chiffon camisole dress with thin straps, soft near-V neckline, small under-chest knot and ribbons, layered ruffles and wavy hem; allow the right side skirt to move in wind while retaining appropriate coverage. Add a short silver bead chain, small round and clear drop pendants, small silver earrings, thin bracelet, and light-lavender nails. Keep elbows nearly straight, fingers naturally wrapped around the stick, knees supported in a believable kneeling posture, and anatomy stable. Include a blue-and-white striped leisure mat at lower right, beige sand, turquoise sea and low horizon, distant tiny unidentifiable beachgoers and umbrellas, few clouds in vivid blue sky, and softly blurred white gulls. Use strong natural noon sunlight from upper-left, bright hair/skin/watermelon highlights, natural shadows, cool blue sky/sea fill, and a high-speed shutter freezing droplets and hair. Use a low slightly upward wide-angle-style viewpoint, subject center-right, watermelon and stick enlarged in foreground, diagonal watermelon-stick-hands-face composition, subject from head to near knees, sharp face/hands/stick/crack and natural optical blur in distance. Preserve realistic skin moisture, wet rind, water, chiffon, hair, jewelry, and sand texture; bright refreshing summer color with purple, green, and red accents. Avoid short or dark hair, opaque black sunglasses, swimwear or plain clothing, intact watermelon, one-handed stick grip, disconnected stick, extra limbs or fingers, loose grip, malformed face or teeth, excessive body emphasis, fisheye distortion, dim twilight, illustration, text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张照片级真实的2:3竖幅夏日海滩生活肖像：一位完全虚构的成年东亚女性双膝跪在明亮盛夏沙滩上，上身大幅前倾，双手牢牢握住木棒，将其压向左下前景已经裂开的巨大西瓜。冻结动作巅峰：双手和木棒位于中央，鲜红果肉与透明水滴围绕裂缝飞溅，女性灿烂大笑的面部位于更远处，西瓜、木棒、双手和脸形成连续对角线纵深。她有明亮自然的象牙肤色，保留水润感与细小水滴；柔和鹅蛋脸、细灰褐眉、棕色眼睛、淡米色与苔绿色眼妆、淡玫瑰腮红和珊瑚色唇彩，张口快乐大笑且牙齿自然可见。佩戴大而圆润的半透明绿色太阳镜，细银框和双桥；明亮铂金色长发接近腰部，稀疏不齐刘海与长层次发束被海风强劲吹向左侧。穿端庄有包覆感的薰衣草、淡紫、白和绿色小花图案雪纺吊带裙，细肩带、柔和近V领、胸下小结和垂带，多层荷叶边与波浪裙摆；允许右侧裙摆随风飘动但保持适当遮挡。佩戴短银珠链、小圆吊坠和透明水滴吊坠、小银耳环、细手链，指甲为淡薰衣草色。肘部近乎伸直，手指自然缠绕木棒，膝盖和跪姿受力可信，解剖稳定。右下前景加入蓝白粗条纹休闲垫，背景有米色沙滩、碧绿海水和低地平线、很小且无法辨认的游客与阳伞、少云鲜蓝天空，以及柔和虚化的白色海鸥。强烈正午自然光从左上方照射，形成头发、皮肤、西瓜和水滴的明亮高光、自然阴影及天空海水的冷色补光；用高速快门冻结水滴与飞发。采用低机位略仰的广角式视角，人物位于中央偏右，前景西瓜与木棒透视放大，画面从头部至膝部附近，脸、双手、木棒和裂缝清晰，远景自然光学虚化。真实呈现皮肤水分、湿西瓜皮、水滴、雪纺、发丝、金属饰品和沙粒纹理；整体明亮清爽，紫、绿、红作为鲜明点缀。避免短发或暗色头发、不透明黑色太阳镜、泳装或素色服装、完整西瓜、单手握棒、木棒与手脱离、多余肢体或手指、松散握姿、脸或牙齿变形、过度身体强调、鱼眼变形、昏暗黄昏、插图、文字、Logo和水印。

items.title: 极简实验室风格鲜切柑橘产品视觉
items.description: A vertical 9:10 instructional product poster presenting fresh-cut citrus pulp as a verifiable quality checklist with floating slices and material evidence.
items.prompt: Create a minimalist vertical 9:10 product-instructional poster for fresh-cut citrus pulp. Reserve more than half the top area as calm blank space. In the upper-left, place two restrained, powerful Chinese title lines exactly as 鲜切柑橘 and 清爽可见的新鲜, using thin black sans-serif type, natural character spacing, and loose line spacing like a rational statement rather than an emotional slogan. Below them, draw a thin horizontal checklist table with short phrases separated by vertical rules; precede each item with a small circle, and use gray crosses plus warm-gold checkmarks to create a subtle information rhythm. Keep checklist text significantly smaller than the titles. At the center, show fresh-cut citrus pulp in a clearly sliced-open structure: a stable semicircular or block-like lower support with authentic peel, pulp, veins, fibers, particles, and moist internal tissue; above it, separate round slices, long strips, and small squares float upward along a slightly tilted vertical axis, with clear spacing and cut faces toward the viewer. A slender metal tool enters diagonally from the right into the lower support, its tip acting as a structural fulcrum; cold-gray highlights contrast with the citrus's fresh warm colors. Use a near-white or very-light neutral background, light as the dominant field, medium-to-high saturation concentrated on the object, pure black text, warm-gold symbols, and cold-gray metal. Add the clear new-product selling point 清晰呈现果皮与果肉质感 as a small amount of promotional text in the checklist or footnote area. Use clean high-key hard photographic light from upper-left, crisp highlights, small moist edge reflections, and short clear shadows cast rightward. Keep all materials fresh, clean, realistic, and free of yellowing or aging. Anchor the bottom with a thin horizontal rule and one line of tiny gray footnotes, creating a calm reading path from titles to checklist, floating cuts, and footnotes. The image must remain rational, laboratory-like, bright, and uncluttered; slicing, floating, and tool support must read immediately. Avoid unsliced subject, grounded slices, tool unrelated to support, decorative checklist without information function, muddy background, excessive props, oversized text, illegible characters, plastic texture, fake juice, chaotic splashes, low resolution, cartoon rendering, watermarks, and unrelated logos.
items.prompt_zh: 围绕fresh-cut citrus pulp创作一张极简产品说明式海报，竖版9:10。上方超过一半区域保留安静的大面积空白。左上方准确放置两行克制有力的中文标题鲜切柑橘和清爽可见的新鲜，使用黑色细瘦无衬线字体、自然字距和宽松行距，像理性声明而非情绪口号。标题下方用细线构成横向品质清单栏，短语以竖线分隔，每项前有小圆形符号，灰色叉号与暖金色勾号形成轻微信息节奏；清单文字明显小于标题。画面中央让fresh-cut citrus pulp呈现清晰的整颗切开结构：底部为稳重的半圆或块状承托体，显示真实果皮、果肉、脉络、纤维、颗粒和湿润内部组织；上方分离出圆片、长条切面和小方块，沿轻微倾斜的垂直轴向上悬浮，彼此有清晰间距，切面朝向观者。一件细长金属工具从右侧斜插入底部承托体，尖端作为结构支点；冷灰高光与柑橘清爽暖色形成干净对比。背景接近纯白或极浅中性色，浅色为主，主体中高饱和度集中在物体本身，文字纯黑，符号暖金，金属冷灰。将清晰的新品卖点清晰呈现果皮与果肉质感作为少量促销文字放入清单或脚注区域。使用左上方高调硬净摄影光，边缘有明确高光和细小湿润反射，底部向右投下短而清晰的阴影。所有材质新鲜、洁净、真实，不泛黄、不旧化。底部用一条细横线压住版面，再放一行极小灰色脚注，形成从标题、品质清单、悬浮切面到脚注的冷静阅读路径。画面必须明快、整洁、理性且具有实验室般的产品广告气质；切分、悬浮和工具支撑关系必须一眼可读。避免主体未切开、切片落地、工具不参与支撑、清单变成无信息装饰、背景厚重浑浊、过多道具、过大文字、文字难辨、塑料质感、虚假果汁、混乱飞溅、低分辨率、卡通渲染、水印和无关Logo。

items.title: 皇冠丹麦曲奇至臻奢华海报
items.description: A collector-grade vertical commercial poster centered on one authentic DANISA Danish butter cookie captured at the peak of a clean break.
items.prompt: Create an ultra-premium tall vertical commercial poster for authentic DANISA Danish butter cookies. Center one elegant butter cookie exactly in frame, delicately held by two clean, natural fingertips entering from left and right. Freeze the precise peak of a clean snap: two balanced halves separated by a narrow high-tension central gap, with crisp fracture lines and a controlled sculptural cascade of fine buttery dust, suspended crumbs, and a few larger broken pieces falling into a refined crumb bed below. Keep the cookie as the absolute hero in a tight central zone surrounded by significantly enlarged luxurious negative space. Show rich ridged butter-cookie surface, baked golden edges, dense sandy crumb structure, delicate crispness, and a beautiful broken interior; make cookie, crumbs, fingertips, and porcelain or serving base tactile and physically believable. Use a deeper royal-blue, cocoa-charcoal, or dark warm-brown luxury background with warm ivory and champagne-gold accents, so the warm biscuit glows against a jewel-like field. Use disciplined English-first brand hierarchy, a discreet official DANISA logo only, and compact secondary typography with exactly one short line, either "Butter Crafted Elegance" or "The Taste of Danish Tradition". Use delicate high-end commercial lighting with warm cinematic shaping and graceful highlight rolloff across fracture edges, crumb dust, fingertips, and plate. Maintain rich blue-gold prestige, appetite-driven warmth, premium tin-box heritage mood, extreme photorealistic texture, and image-led composition. Avoid clutter, oversized text, cheap supermarket styling, messy hands, fake cookie texture, plastic crumbs, weak fracture detail, greasy look, chaotic splashes, excessive props, distorted branding, weak product focus, insufficient negative space, cartoon rendering, low resolution, watermarks, and logos other than the specified DANISA mark.
items.prompt_zh: 为正宗 DANISA 丹麦黄油曲奇创作一张超高端高耸竖幅商业海报。将一块优雅黄油曲奇准确置于画面中央，由从左右边缘伸入的两个干净自然的指尖轻轻捏住。冻结干净折断的精确巅峰：两半均衡分开，中间形成窄而高张力的缝隙，断裂线清晰，细腻黄油粉尘、悬浮碎屑和少量较大碎块以受控雕塑般的瀑布落入下方精制碎屑堆。让曲奇保持绝对主角，位于紧凑中心区域，四周大幅扩展奢华留白。呈现丰富棱纹黄油曲奇表面、烘烤金色边缘、致密沙质碎屑结构、细腻酥脆感和漂亮断面；曲奇、碎屑、指尖以及瓷器或底座都要具有可触且符合物理的真实质感。背景使用更深的皇室蓝、可可炭黑或深暖褐色奢华色场，配暖象牙色和香槟金点缀，使温暖饼干在珠宝般背景中发光。使用严谨的英语优先品牌层级，仅加入低调的官方 DANISA Logo，并配一条紧凑的次级英文短句，准确选择“Butter Crafted Elegance”或“The Taste of Danish Tradition”之一。使用细腻高端商业灯光和温暖电影感塑造，在断裂边缘、碎屑粉尘、指尖和盘面形成优雅高光衰减。保持浓郁蓝金威望、激发食欲的温暖、高级铁盒传承感、极致照片级纹理和图像主导构图。避免杂乱、过大文字、廉价超市传单风、凌乱手部、虚假曲奇质感、塑料碎屑、断裂细节弱、油腻感、混乱飞溅、过多道具、扭曲品牌、产品焦点弱、留白不足、卡通渲染、低分辨率、水印和除指定 DANISA 标志外的Logo。

items.title: 东亚女性黑背影棚电影感人像
items.description: A photorealistic fine-art editorial portrait of a fictional adult East Asian woman against a black-to-charcoal studio gradient.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic fine-art editorial beauty portrait of a fictional adult East Asian woman against a pure-black to deep-charcoal studio gradient with no props. Frame from the top of her head to above the hips, placing her slightly right of center. Turn her body slightly toward frame-left with the right shoulder back and waist gently rotated; tilt and turn her head slightly down-left toward the camera, with calm direct eye contact and a very faint restrained smile. Her expression is gentle, confident, quiet, and cinematic. Give her an elongated oval face, clear soft jawline, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, natural thin brows, straight slender nose, low-saturation nude-pink lips, extremely light makeup, and fair neutral-warm skin retaining pores, vellus hair, natural tone gradients, and soft collarbone and shoulder highlights. Her extra-long deep-black straight hair is side-parted with rich volume, mostly falling over the left shoulder and chest while the other side falls down the back; preserve natural layers, weight, flyaways, and slight messiness. Dress her in a creamy-white or ivory asymmetrical one-shoulder cropped top of opaque soft stretch cotton or thin knit: the fabric wraps diagonally from the left shoulder across the chest, leaves the right shoulder exposed, and forms a naturally draped short sleeve or covering on the right arm. Include realistic horizontal wrinkles and a gently cinched fit, ending below the ribs so a small natural waist area and only a little black high-waisted denim waistband are visible; keep full secure coverage and no transparent exposure. Use a large softbox 45 degrees above front-left to softly shape face, collarbones, shoulders, fabric, and waist, with extremely weak right fill and slight hair-edge separation.
