Keep low saturation, low contrast, and rich shadow detail. Use an 85mm or 105mm portrait lens, f/2, eye-level to slightly high position, shallow depth of field, sharp eyes and face, completely softened background, realistic skin/hair/fabric, slight ISO 400 grain, and Black Pro-Mist 1/8 diffusion. Avoid overexposure, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, heavy makeup, short or curly hair, altered garment structure, transparent clothing, nudity, distorted anatomy, malformed hands, extra limbs, harsh HDR, oversharpening, clutter, CG, anime, text, watermarks, and logos.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张照片级真实的fine-art editorial美容肖像：一位完全虚构的成年东亚女性站在纯黑到深炭灰渐变的摄影棚背景前，无道具。画面从头顶拍至胯部上方，人物位于中央略偏右。身体微微朝画面左侧转动，右肩靠后，腰部轻柔转动；头部略向左下方倾斜并转向镜头，双眼平静直视，嘴角带极淡克制的微笑。神情温柔、自信、安静且具有电影感。她有偏长鹅蛋脸、柔和清晰下颌线、深棕杏仁眼、自然细眉、纤细直鼻梁和低饱和裸粉唇；妆容极淡，白皙中性暖调皮肤保留毛孔、细小绒毛、自然肤色渐变和锁骨肩部柔和高光。深黑超长直发偏分、发量丰富，大部分垂落在左肩和胸前，另一侧落在背后；保留真实层次、重量、碎发和轻微自然凌乱感。穿乳白或象牙白不对称斜肩短款上衣，使用不透明的柔软弹力棉或薄针织面料；布料从左肩斜向包裹胸前，露出右肩，并在右臂形成自然垂落的短袖或披覆。衣身带真实横向褶皱和轻微收拢感，长度至肋骨下方，露出少量自然腰部，并仅露出一点黑色高腰牛仔裤腰头；保持稳妥完整覆盖，禁止透明暴露。大型柔光箱从左前上方45度照射，柔和塑造脸部、锁骨、肩膀、布料和腰部；右侧极弱补光，头发边缘保留轻微分离。整体低饱和、低对比、暗部细节丰富。使用85mm或105mm人像镜头，f/2，平视略高机位，浅景深，眼睛和面部清晰，背景完全柔化，真实皮肤、发丝和布料纹理，轻微ISO400颗粒与Black Pro-Mist 1/8扩散。避免过曝、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、浓妆、短发或卷发、服装结构改变、透明衣物、裸露、解剖变形、手部错误、多余肢体、强HDR、过度锐化、杂乱、CG、动漫、文字、水印和Logo。

items.title: 阳台夕阳下身着宋制改良汉服的女孩
items.description: A candid 9:16 home-balcony smartphone photograph of a fictional adult woman relaxing with a canned Coca-Cola at sunset.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 9:16 vertical smartphone snapshot from a friend's perspective: a fictional 26-year-old adult East Asian woman sits in a rattan chair on an authentic home balcony, drinking from a canned Coca-Cola. Side-rear evening sunset light casts warm natural illumination and gentle highlights, with a slight handheld feel and no studio polish. She wears a light gray-blue improved Song-style Hanfu short shirt with a small stand collar and buttoned front, narrow tied placket, waist-to-hip length, loose short sleeves, soft cotton-linen texture, natural wrinkles, dark ink-bamboo embroidery, and a cute sperm-whale motif on the chest, paired with a cream-white lace-edged camisole underlayer and white wide-leg pants. Present a tall, well-proportioned adult figure with a slender neck, visible collarbones, naturally rounded curves, a defined waist-to-hip relationship, and realistic anatomy without exaggerated sexual emphasis. Preserve real skin texture, relaxed everyday posture, warm sunset atmosphere, believable balcony materials, and candid lifestyle photography quality. Keep the Coca-Cola can recognizable as the specified beverage; any branding should be limited to the real can and not expanded into extra advertising text. Avoid studio lighting, glamour posing, excessive body idealization, transparent clothing, nudity, plastic skin, heavy retouching, distorted hands, extra limbs, malformed can, clutter, harsh HDR, text artifacts, watermarks, and unrelated logos.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张照片级真实的9:16竖幅智能手机生活抓拍：从朋友视角拍摄，一位完全虚构的26岁成年东亚女性坐在真实居家阳台的藤椅上，正在喝易拉罐可口可乐。傍晚夕阳从侧后方照入，形成温暖自然光和柔和高光，带轻微手持感，不要影楼式精致。她穿浅灰蓝色宋式改良汉服短衫，小立领、对襟扣合、窄门襟系带，衣长至腰胯，宽松短袖，柔软棉麻质感和自然褶皱，衣身有水墨竹暗纹刺绣，胸前有可爱抹香鲸图案；内搭米白蕾丝边背心，搭配白色阔腿裤。呈现高挑匀称的成年体态、修长颈部、清晰锁骨、自然圆润曲线和明确腰臀关系，保持真实人体比例，不做夸张性化强调。保留真实皮肤纹理、放松日常姿态、暖色夕阳氛围、可信阳台材质和生活摄影质感。易拉罐应辨识为指定的可口可乐饮料；品牌文字仅限真实罐体，不额外扩展广告文字。避免影棚光、魅惑摆拍、过度身材理想化、透明衣物、裸露、塑料皮肤、过度修图、手部变形、多余肢体、罐体畸形、杂乱、强HDR、文字伪影、水印和无关Logo。

items.title: 豪华户外温泉冰湖人像
items.description: A photorealistic winter spa lifestyle portrait of an adult woman relaxing in a hot spring beside a turquoise alpine lake.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic luxury travel-editorial spa portrait of an adult woman relaxing in an outdoor hot spring beside a frozen turquoise mountain lake. She rests both forearms on the jacuzzi edge and turns toward the camera for direct, captivating but calm eye contact; her expression is elegant and composed. Her wet black swimsuit fits naturally and remains secure and non-explicit. Her black hair is loosely tied in a soft bun with a few strands framing her face. Behind her, snow-capped mountains are perfectly reflected on the turquoise lake, with delicate mist floating above the warm water. Use a medium close-up, 50mm lens, eye-level composition, creamy bokeh, realistic travel photography, high-end spa lifestyle, natural skin texture, cinematic winter tones, and soft volumetric light. Preserve believable water droplets, wet hair, swimsuit fabric, skin, steam, snow, and mountain reflections. Use refined cool blue, turquoise, snow-white, charcoal, and warm skin tones with controlled HDR-like dynamic range and high-resolution detail. Keep the mood serene, luxurious, and restorative. Avoid nudity, accidental exposure, sexualized posing, plastic skin, distorted arms or hands, incorrect reflections, fake steam, oversaturation, harsh lighting, clutter, text, watermarks, logos, and artificial CGI.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张照片级真实的奢华旅行编辑水疗肖像：一位成年女性在冰冻的碧绿色山湖旁户外温泉中放松。她将双前臂搭在按摩浴缸边缘，同时转向镜头进行直接、吸引人但平静的眼神交流，表情优雅而沉着。湿润的黑色泳衣自然贴合并保持稳固、非露骨；黑发松松扎成柔软发髻，几缕发丝围住脸庞。背景中，白雪覆盖的山脉完美倒映在碧绿色湖面上，温暖水面上方漂浮细腻雾气。使用中等特写、50mm镜头、平视构图和奶油般背景虚化，呈现真实旅行摄影、高端水疗生活方式、自然皮肤纹理、电影感冬季色调与柔和体积光。保留可信的水滴、湿发、泳衣面料、皮肤、蒸汽、雪景和山体倒影。色调精致，以冷蓝、碧绿、雪白、炭黑和暖肤色为主，控制HDR式动态范围并保留高分辨率细节。整体氛围宁静、奢华、疗愈。避免裸露、意外暴露、性化姿势、塑料皮肤、手臂或手部变形、错误倒影、虚假蒸汽、过饱和、刺眼光线、杂乱、文字、水印、Logo和人工CG感。

items.title: 现实人物与Q版墙绘互动写实摄影
items.description: A mixed-media portrait pairing the uploaded person with a colorful 2D chibi wall painting of the same identity in a playful indoor scene.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the strict identity and outfit reference. Preserve the adult person's exact recognizable face, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, visible accessories, outfit, colors, styling, and overall identity; do not invent traits absent from the reference. Create a high-quality vertical 4:5 mixed-style image showing the realistic full-body or nearly full-body uploaded person beside a large colorful 2D chibi wall illustration of the same person. The real person performs one natural cute playful pose, such as hands near cheeks, a tiny heart gesture, a slight leg lift, a gentle lean, or a balanced playful bounce; the wall chibi performs a more exaggerated version of the same pose idea. Keep the person relaxed and active, not stiff, and do not replace the reference outfit with unrelated fashion. The chibi is polished but hand-drawn anime/chibi wall art painted directly on the wall, not a realistic second person, 3D character, black shadow, stick figure, or unrelated anime girl. Match the real person's hairstyle silhouette, hair color, visible accessories, outfit silhouette, palette, and recognizable vibe. Use soft clean linework, warm pastel colors, subtle shading, hand-drawn texture, expressive eyes, motion lines, small hearts, stars, and sparkles. Place the real person on one side and the wall illustration on the other, both fully visible with enough negative space; the chibi is similar in height or slightly larger. Use a clean white, cream, pale-beige, or light-gray wall, simple floor, minimal indoor room or studio, soft natural light, realistic grounding shadow under the person, and natural wall integration. Bright, charming, trendy, social-media-friendly composition with realistic photography plus colorful 2D art. No social-media UI or text overlay. Avoid black doodle shadows, realistic second people, 3D rendering, weak resemblance, changed hairstyle or outfit, hardcoded traits not in the reference, clutter, cropped feet or chibi, stiff pose, distorted anatomy, extra fingers or limbs, pasted face, creepy mood, plastic skin, logos, watermarks, and unrelated text.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为严格的身份和服装参考。保留成年人物确切的可识别面部、面部比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、发型、发色、可见配饰、服装、颜色、造型和整体身份；不要虚构参考图中不存在的特征。创作一张高质量的4:5竖幅混合风格画面，展示上传人物的真实全身或接近全身形象，以及旁边墙上同一人物的大型彩色2D Q版插图。真人做出一个自然可爱的俏皮姿势，例如双手靠近脸颊、小爱心手势、轻抬一条腿、轻轻倾斜或保持平衡的俏皮弹跳；墙上Q版做出同一姿势想法的更夸张版本。真人应放松且主动，不要僵硬站立，也不要把参考服装换成无关时装。Q版必须是直接画在墙上的精致手绘动漫/Q版墙绘，不是真实第二个人、3D角色、黑色影子、简笔画或无关动漫女孩。通过发型轮廓、发色、可见配饰、服装轮廓、调色板和整体气质与真人保持清晰相似。使用柔和干净线条、温暖粉彩、微妙阴影、手绘纹理、富有表现力的眼睛、运动线、小爱心、星星和闪光。真人位于一侧，墙绘位于另一侧，两者都完整可见并留有足够留白；Q版高度与真人相近或略大。使用干净白色、奶油色、浅米色或浅灰色墙面、简单地板、极简室内或工作室、柔和自然光、真人脚下写实落地阴影和自然墙面融合。整体明亮、迷人、时髦、适合社交媒体，结合真实摄影与彩色2D艺术。不要社交媒体界面或文字叠加。避免黑色涂鸦阴影、真实第二人物、3D渲染、相似度弱、发型或服装改变、参考中没有的硬编码特征、杂乱、裁剪脚或Q版、僵硬姿势、解剖变形、多余手指或肢体、粘贴脸、阴森氛围、塑料皮肤、Logo、水印和无关文字。

items.title: 简约日系棚拍白衬衫东亚女性肖像
items.description: A quiet photorealistic editorial portrait of a fictional adult East Asian woman turning back toward the camera in an oversized white shirt.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic Japanese minimalist editorial studio portrait of a fictional adult East Asian woman against a seamless light warm-gray to beige-gray gradient, with no props. Frame from the top of her head to the upper thighs; place her slightly right of center, body facing frame-left, shoulders relaxed, upper body slightly forward, and arms hanging naturally mostly hidden by oversized sleeves. Capture the moment she slowly turns from side profile to look back at the camera, head slightly tilted right, chin gently lowered, lips closed, gaze calm, restrained, subtly detached, and gentle. Give her a delicate elongated oval face, clear soft jawline, deep-brown almond eyes, straight thin brows, slender nose, low-saturation nude-pink lips, extremely light makeup, and fair neutral-warm skin retaining pores, vellus hair, slight tone variation, and natural highlights. Her extra-long deep-brown hair is loose and side-parted with soft waves, mostly behind her back, a few strands over the shoulders, near waist length, with natural layers, weight, flyaways, and slight messiness rather than strong curls. Dress her in a pure-white or ivory oversized boyfriend-style long-sleeve shirt with dropped shoulders, natural front buttons, long body near the thighs, and sleeves partly covering the hands. Use light cotton-linen or washed cotton with realistic wrinkles and soft drape; any translucency must remain subtle with all key areas fully covered. No patterns or logos; bottoms remain visually minimal and unobtrusive. Light with a large softbox from upper front-left and a white reflector on the right for gentle fill; keep very shallow floor and background shadows and soft layers on face, hair, and shirt edges. Low saturation, low contrast, warm gray-white, ivory, deep brown hair, and natural skin. Use an 85mm or 105mm lens, f/2.8, eye-level slightly high camera, medium-shallow depth of field, sharp eyes, lips, hair strands, and shirt texture, softly blurred background, slight ISO 200 grain, and Black Pro-Mist 1/8 diffusion. Avoid exaggerated expression, heavy makeup, short hair, strong curls, transparent exposure, incorrect shirt construction, wrong shoulder-neck proportions, malformed fingers, repeated arms, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, HDR, oversharpening, clutter, CG, anime, text, watermarks, and logos.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张照片级真实的日系极简编辑棚拍肖像：一位完全虚构的成年东亚女性站在浅暖灰至米灰色无缝渐变背景前，无道具。画面从头顶拍至大腿上部；人物位于中央略偏右，身体朝向画面左侧，肩膀放松，上半身略微前倾，双臂自然垂落并大部分隐藏在宽大衣袖中。捕捉她从侧脸缓慢转头回望镜头的瞬间：头部略向右倾，下巴轻轻下压，嘴唇闭合，目光平静、克制、略带疏离而温柔。她有精致偏长鹅蛋脸、柔和清晰下颌线、深棕杏仁眼、自然平直细眉、纤细鼻梁和低饱和裸粉唇；妆容极淡，白皙中性暖调皮肤保留毛孔、细小绒毛、轻微肤色变化和自然高光。深棕色超长发自然披散、偏分、带柔和波浪，大部分垂在背后，少量发丝落在肩前，长度接近腰部；保留真实层次、重量、碎发和轻微凌乱感，不要强卷曲。穿纯白或象牙白宽松男友风长袖衬衫，落肩设计，前襟自然扣合，衣身接近大腿，袖子部分覆盖双手。面料为轻薄棉麻或水洗棉，呈现真实褶皱和柔软垂坠；透光层次必须克制，关键部位完全遮挡。无图案、无Logo，下装仅保留极简不显眼轮廓。大型柔光箱从左前上方照射，右侧白色反光板轻微补光，脸部、头发和衬衫边缘形成柔和层次，地面与背景阴影极浅。整体低饱和低对比，以暖灰白、象牙白、深棕发色和自然肤色为主。使用85mm或105mm镜头，f/2.8，平视略高机位，中浅景深，眼睛、嘴唇、发丝和衬衫纹理清晰，背景柔化，轻微ISO200颗粒和Black Pro-Mist 1/8扩散。避免夸张表情、浓妆、短发、强卷发、透明暴露、衬衫结构错误、肩颈比例错误、畸形手指、重复手臂、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、HDR、过度锐化、杂乱、CG、动漫、文字、水印和Logo。

items.title: 林间树后探身的古风写实人像
items.description: A quiet 9:16 photorealistic outdoor portrait of a fictional adult East Asian woman leaning from behind an old tree to touch tender leaves.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 9:16 vertical outdoor ancient-style portrait of a fictional adult East Asian woman in a warm forest courtyard or natural garden. A thick tree trunk stands on the right side of the frame, blocking the right side of her body and most of her lower body while leaving her face clear; she gently leans out from the left side of the trunk. Thin branches and tender green leaves cross the upper-left foreground and pass naturally in front of the scene without covering her face. She slightly pokes her head out and looks toward the leaves on the left rather than at the camera, with relaxed brows, lips slightly parted, and a quiet, focused, mildly curious expression. Her deep-black ultra-long hair flows naturally with a few flyaways near her face, outlined by a soft warm rim light. Dress her in a simple elegant off-white, ivory, or light-apricot ancient-style long robe with a cross-collar or diagonal lapel, wide structured sleeves, soft fabric, natural drape, and fine folds; no elaborate headwear. Raise one hand with naturally separated fingers gently approaching or touching a tender leaf, creating a clear spatial relationship between the tree, hand, and foliage. Use warm golden light from upper-left or behind, filtering through leaves to illuminate hair, fingers, forehead, nose tip, and sleeve edges. Keep bark texture clear, branches slender, background softly blurred yellow-green plants and bokeh, and face, hand, and bark relatively sharp. Palette: deep brown trunk, yellow-green leaves, off-white clothing, black hair, and light warm skin. Quiet, natural, slightly ethereal Eastern garden atmosphere, realistic photography texture. Avoid multiple people, direct gaze, exaggerated smile, heavy makeup, underage appearance, oversized eyes, plastic skin, yellow-green skin, face-covering foliage, tree covering the whole face, wrong fingers, fingers passing through leaves, twisted wrist, broken neck-shoulder anatomy, clumped hair, hair intersecting arms or trunk, shapeless sleeves, ornate costume, modern clothing or accessories, modern architecture or props, over-sharp background, overexposure, HDR, oversharpening, oversaturated green, cheap costume photography, text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张照片级真实的9:16竖幅户外古风人像：一位完全虚构的成年东亚女性置身暖色林间庭院或自然园林。画面右侧有一根粗大树干，遮挡人物右侧身体和大部分下半身，但保持脸部清晰；她从树干左侧轻轻探身而出。左上前景有细枝和嫩绿叶片，自然交错并经过场景前方，但不要遮住脸。她微微探头，视线看向左侧枝叶而非镜头，眉间放松，嘴唇微启，神情安静、专注、略带好奇。深黑色超长发自然披散，脸侧有少量碎发，被暖色柔和轮廓光勾勒。穿简洁素雅的米白、象牙白或淡杏色古风长衣，交领或斜襟，宽大且有结构的长袖，面料柔软，带自然垂坠和细腻褶皱，不戴繁复头饰。抬起一只手，手指自然分开，轻轻靠近或触碰嫩叶，让树干、手部和枝叶形成清晰空间关系。使用来自左上方或人物后侧的暖金色光线，穿过叶片照亮发丝、手指、额头、鼻尖和袖缘。树皮纹理清晰，枝叶轻盈细长，背景为黄绿色植物和柔和散景，人物脸部、手部与树皮相对清晰。色调以深棕树干、黄绿色嫩叶、米白衣装、黑发和浅暖肤色为主，气质清静自然，带轻微空灵的东方庭院氛围和真实摄影质感。避免多人、直视镜头、夸张笑容、浓妆、幼态未成年感、眼睛过大、塑料皮肤、黄绿色肤色、枝叶遮住整张脸、树干遮脸、错误手指、手指穿过叶片、手腕扭曲、肩颈连接错误、头发成块或穿过手臂和树干、无结构宽袖、繁复服装、现代服装或配饰、现代建筑或道具、背景过度锐利、过曝、HDR、强烈锐化、过饱和绿色、廉价古装写真感、文字、Logo和水印。

items.title: iPhone抓拍海边新中式汉服女性
items.description: An accidental travel-album-style smartphone snapshot of an adult East Asian woman pausing with a drink on an evening seaside boardwalk.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 9:16 vertical candid smartphone snapshot of an adult East Asian woman on an evening seaside boardwalk. She has natural skin texture with slight pores and no makeup, and a naturally healthy, softly rounded adult figure presented non-sexually. Dress her in refreshing cyan-green modern Chinese Hanfu: light, flowing, modest, minimalist Oriental design, with soft fabric moving slightly in the sea breeze. She has just stopped to drink and holds a beverage cup. A friend has suddenly pressed the shutter; she does not look at the camera, instead gazing naturally into the distance or toward the drink with a relaxed expression, as if caught accidentally in a travel album. Use realistic handheld smartphone photography texture, slight framing offset, spontaneous everyday composition, and a softly blurred background showing the seaside walkway and evening atmosphere. Keep the moment unposed and ordinary, with believable fabric motion, natural anatomy, and true-to-life color. An iPhone snapshot look may guide the visual character, but do not add device interface elements. Avoid heavy makeup, sexualized posing, revealing clothing, distorted hands, extra limbs, artificial studio lighting, excessive retouching, plastic skin, oversaturation, text, watermarks, logos, and staged fashion-editorial composition.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张照片级真实的9:16竖幅手机生活抓拍：傍晚海边步道上，一位成年东亚女性停下来喝饮料。她拥有带轻微毛孔的自然皮肤纹理，不化妆，呈现自然健康、柔和圆润且非性化的成年体态。她穿青绿色新中式汉服，轻薄飘逸、端庄有包覆感，采用简约东方设计，柔软面料随海风轻轻飘动。她手持饮料杯，刚停下喝饮料；朋友突然按下快门。她不看镜头，视线自然落向远处或手中的饮料，表情放松，像旅行相册中偶然留下的一刻。使用真实手持智能手机摄影质感、轻微取景偏移和随机生活化构图，背景轻微虚化，能看到海边步道与傍晚氛围。保持未经摆拍的普通瞬间，呈现可信的面料运动、自然解剖和真实色彩。可用iPhone随手拍质感作为视觉参考，但不要加入设备界面元素。避免浓妆、性化姿势、暴露服装、手部变形、多余肢体、人工棚拍光、过度美化、塑料皮肤、过饱和、文字、水印、Logo和刻意的时尚摆拍构图。

items.title: 唐风美学古典美人国风CG人像
items.description: A refined 9:16 hyper-realistic CG portrait of a fictional adult East Asian classical beauty in ornate Tang-inspired styling.
items.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic CG portrait illustration of a completely fictional adult East Asian woman with Tang-dynasty-inspired classical styling. Use a 9:16 vertical half-body close-up with the visual focus on her face and upper body, cinematic lens language, and elegant spatial perspective. Give her cool fair luminous skin with delicate realistic texture and a soft sheen; refined natural features, narrow phoenix-shaped eyes with slightly lifted outer corners, long lashes casting subtle shadows, rouge-like lip color, slightly parted lips, and a soft, shy, mildly hazy expression conveying restrained Eastern beauty. Dress her in layered pink-toned Tang-style clothing that follows the body gracefully without excessive stacking, with a moderate modest neckline emphasizing the collarbone and neck-shoulder line tastefully. Add an exquisitely crafted phoenix crown with realistic metal, pearl, gemstone, and tassel materials; let the tassels move subtly. Pose her body slightly sideways or gently rotating, with an elongated neck, relaxed shoulders, and hands forming soft guiding lines. Use cinematic lighting: warm golden front-side key light on the face and skin, cool ambient fill shaping volume, and a subtle rim light along hair and neck/shoulders. Control highlights to avoid overexposure, retain shadow detail, and keep facial transitions soft. Blend high-end photoreal CG with an Eastern freehand sensibility and slight dreamy haze; blur the background to prioritize the character, with restrained film grain and soft-focus glow. Palette: low-saturation rouge pink and gilded gold with cold blue-gray accents. Use an 85mm portrait-lens look, f/1.4–f/2, shallow depth of field, cinematic framing, and ultra-detailed realistic materials. Avoid vulgar styling, exaggerated facial features, plastic skin, harsh shadows, overexposure, distorted hands, extra limbs, clutter, cartoon flatness, text, watermarks, and logos.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张照片级超写实CG人像插画：一位完全虚构的成年东亚女性，采用唐代美学灵感的古典造型。使用9:16竖幅半身近景，视觉重心集中在面部和上半身，带有电影感镜头语言与优雅空间透视。她拥有冷白明亮、带细腻真实纹理和柔润微光的皮肤；五官精致但自然，狭长凤眼、微挑眼尾、长睫毛投下细微阴影，唇色如胭脂晕染，嘴唇微启，神情柔和、含羞、略带微醺朦胧感，传达含蓄东方美。穿粉色系分层唐风服饰，柔和贴合身形但不过度堆叠，领口适度端庄，优雅强调锁骨与颈肩线条。佩戴精工凤冠，真实呈现金属、珍珠、宝石和流苏材质，流苏随动作轻微摆动。身体微侧或轻柔旋转，颈部延展，肩线放松，双手形成柔和引导线。使用电影级布光：暖金色侧前方主光塑造面部和皮肤高光，冷色环境辅光建立体积与空间，细微轮廓光勾勒发丝和颈肩。控制高光避免过曝，保留暗部细节，面部光影柔和过渡。将高端写实CG与东方写意气韵结合，带轻微朦胧感；背景虚化以突出人物，加入克制胶片颗粒与柔焦辉光。整体低饱和，以胭脂粉和鎏金为主色，冷青蓝灰为辅色。使用85mm人像镜头质感，f/1.4–f/2，浅景深和电影感构图，呈现超细节真实材质。避免艳俗造型、夸张五官、塑料皮肤、硬阴影、过曝、手部变形、多余肢体、杂乱、扁平卡通感、文字、水印和Logo。

items.title: 现代模块化国际主义柠檬主题PPT系统
items.description: A bright modular 10-slide presentation system for explaining the marvelous uses of lemons through an international typographic grid and editorial rhythm.
items.prompt: Design a bright, modular modern presentation system for The marvelous uses of lemons with 10 slides, using International Typographic Style and modular grids as the core. Unify all pages with repeating units, stable baselines, multi-column grids, and generous margins. Use Gestalt proximity and common regions to group related information in rounded color blocks; use dynamic equilibrium so large color fields, photos, and white space counterbalance asymmetrically; use editorial rhythm through changes in image scale, density, and white space to create chapter breathing. Draw synergistically, not mechanically, on precise objective grids, limited typeface systems, adjacent-color perception, and cropping/scale contrast/white-space editorial dialogue. Default palette: warm white #F7F7F3 about 45%, fluorescent yellow-green #E5EA45 about 22%, light lavender #C5ADD7 about 18%, near-black #1D1D1D about 12%, and fog blue #AFC8EC about 3%. If the user supplies colors, prioritize them while preserving role hierarchy, approximate area balance, lightness contrast, and projection readability. Establish first-, second-, and third-level reading order among titles, focal visuals, information cards, and annotations. Align regular elements strictly; allow at most one rounded color field or focal visual to break across columns, while keeping thumbnails recognizable. Keep a flat matte warm-white background. Combine natural soft-light photography and geometric vectors: unify photo color temperature subtly, crop with rounded hard-edge masks, overlay low-saturation translucent color blocks, and add a low-contrast isometric vertical-line texture only at the bottom as a rhythmic band. Avoid meaningless shadows and decorative noise. Use paired sans-serif typefaces with compatible skeletons; medium-bold titles with tight leading and large scale jumps; regular body text with wider leading and short lines. Align Chinese and Western text by visual grayness, shared baselines, optical kerning, and common edges with image masks rather than mechanically matching font sizes. Overall tone: rational, bright, friendly, agile, clear, and modern. Build all 10 slides around the content of The marvelous uses of lemons. Ensure the deck feels coherent, readable at a distance, and presentation-ready.
items.prompt_zh: 为The marvelous uses of lemons设计一套明快、模块化的现代PPT视觉系统，共10张，以国际主义排版体系和模块网格为核心。使用重复单元、稳定基线、多栏网格和充足外边距统一所有页面。运用格式塔接近律与共同区域，把相关信息组织在圆角色块中；以动态均衡让大色场、照片和留白在非对称中互为配重；通过图像尺度、密度和空白变化形成章节编辑节奏。协同借鉴精确客观网格、有限字体系统、相邻色彩感知以及裁切/尺度反差/留白的编辑图文对话，但不要机械复刻任何单一设计师。默认配色为暖白#F7F7F3约45%、荧光黄绿#E5EA45约22%、浅薰衣草紫#C5ADD7约18%、近黑#1D1D1D约12%、雾蓝#AFC8EC约3%。若用户后续指定颜色，以用户颜色为准，同时保留角色层级、近似面积平衡、明度对比和投影可读性。让标题、焦点视觉、信息卡和注释形成清晰的第一、第二、第三阅读顺序。常规元素严格对齐；最多允许一个圆角色场或焦点视觉跨栏破格，同时保证缩略图一眼可识别。背景保持平整哑光暖白。混合自然柔光摄影与几何矢量：先克制统一照片色温，再用圆角硬边蒙版裁切，叠加低饱和半透明色块，仅在最底层加入低对比等距竖线纹理作为节奏带；避免无意义阴影和装饰噪声。使用骨架相容的无衬线字体配对，标题用中粗字重、紧凑行距和大尺度跳变，正文用常规字重、较宽行距和短行长。中西文按视觉灰度、共享基线、光学校正字距及与图像蒙版共用边线来对齐，不机械匹配字号。整体气质理性、明快、亲和、敏捷、清晰、现代。围绕The marvelous uses of lemons的内容完成全部10张，使整套演示连贯、远距可读并可直接展示。

items.title: 真人摄影手绘线条角色品牌插画
items.description: A warm fantasy-realism brand visual where an adult real person interacts with a cute black-line character in a real environment.
items.prompt: Create a fantasy-realism brand image featuring an adult person in a real-world environment interacting with a cute 2D character made from fluid black lines and irregular hand-drawn brushstrokes. The line character should appear to emerge naturally from a comic book, wall graffiti, or the air, creating a believable visual collision between live-action photography and an independent animation character. Preserve the real subject's photographic skin texture, natural hair strands, clothing materials, expressions, and movements. The line character has a simple cute design, independent animation personality, and may sit on the subject's shoulder, palm, or a nearby tabletop, or stand near the body; show clear eye contact, communication, play, and a convincing spatial relationship. Use a real environment such as a modern street, café, bedroom, workspace, park, or art gallery, with authentic environmental light, reflections, aerial perspective, and shallow depth of field. Let the line character interact with walls, tabletops, or floors and cast a slight shadow consistent with the real light direction. Use a cinematic close-up medium or half-body composition, keeping both subjects together at center; add slight foreground obstruction for immersion and allow some linework to extend into real space. Add a simple modern upper-left logo combining a stylized V with cat elements, and the exact restrained lower-right signature "voxCAT" with vox lowercase and CAT uppercase. If clothing, bags, or props appear, optional low-profile VOXCAT woven labels, metal nameplates, embossing, or hidden patterns may be used without dominating the scene. Warm, healing, childlike, imaginative companionship-in-loneliness mood; clean image, natural proportions, accurate hands, stable detail, high-quality commercial photography, filmic grading, and delicate realistic texture. Avoid clutter, distorted anatomy, inaccurate hands, harsh light, plastic skin, flat pasted-on line art, extra people, extra logos, watermarks, or unrelated text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张奇幻现实主义品牌画面：让an adult person出现在真实现实环境中，并与一个由流畅黑色线条和不规则手绘笔触组成的可爱二维角色互动。线条角色应像从漫画本、墙面涂鸦或空气中自然浮现，在真人摄影与独立动画角色之间形成可信的视觉碰撞。保留真人的真实摄影皮肤纹理、自然发丝、服装材质、表情和动作。线条角色造型简洁可爱、具有独立动画性格，可以坐在真人肩膀、手掌或附近桌面，或站在身体旁边；表现明确的对视、交流、玩耍和可信的空间关系。使用现代街道、咖啡馆、卧室、工作空间、公园或艺术展厅等真实环境，呈现真实环境光、材质反射、空气透视和浅景深。让线条角色与墙面、桌面或地面产生互动，并投下符合真实光源方向的轻微阴影。采用电影感近距离中景或半身构图，让两者共同位于画面中心；加入轻微前景遮挡增强沉浸感，并允许部分线条延伸进入现实空间。左上角加入由 stylized V 与猫元素结合的简洁现代图形Logo；右下角准确加入尺寸克制的签名“voxCAT”，其中 vox 小写、CAT 大写。若出现服装、包袋或道具，可加入低调VOXCAT织标、金属铭牌、压纹或暗纹，但不得喧宾夺主。整体温暖、治愈、童趣、富有想象力，表达孤独中的陪伴；画面干净，人物比例自然，手部准确，细节稳定，具有高质量商业摄影、电影级调色和细腻真实质感。避免杂乱、解剖结构变形、错误手部、刺眼光线、塑料皮肤、像贴纸一样脱离环境的线稿、额外人物、额外Logo、水印或无关文字。

items.title: 日式温情治愈四格漫画手绘风格
items.description: A square 2x2 hand-drawn Japanese-style comic about a consistent young adult couple sharing gentle daily moments.
items.prompt: Create a square 1:1 Japanese-style heartwarming four-panel comic in a standard 2x2 layout, with thin dark-brown borders between panels. Use clean hand-drawn anime line art, warm rice-brown and light-brown monochrome tones, a soft cream background, simple soft shadows, and an overall healing everyday atmosphere. At the top, place the exact handwritten-feel dark-brown title "夫婦の日" with one small heart on each side. Panel 1: a young adult Asian couple in a standing portrait; the man stands behind the woman with both hands gently on her shoulders, and both smile toward the camera. Panel 2: the couple sits in a cozy interior, each holding a mug with both hands, looking at each other and smiling; include a white rounded speech bubble containing the exact Chinese text "谢谢你一直陪着我。" in clear black characters. Panel 3: they cook together side by side at a kitchen stove; the man stirs while the woman helps, both focused and happy. Panel 4: they hug tightly; the man bows to gently kiss the woman's forehead while the woman closes her eyes and smiles. Keep exactly the same two characters across all panels: same faces, hairstyles, clothing, and body proportions. The man has short hair, a gentle appearance, and a simple sweater or shirt; the woman has medium-long hair, a gentle appearance, and home-style clothing. Keep backgrounds simple and readable. Ensure all Chinese characters are correct, crisp, and undistorted. Avoid realistic photography, 3D rendering, vivid colors, complex backgrounds, face collapse, character drift, garbled text, sticker-like cheapness, watermarks, and logos.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一组正方形1:1日式温情四格漫画，采用标准2x2布局，每格之间用细深棕色边框分隔。使用干净手绘动漫线稿、温暖米棕与浅棕单色调、柔和奶油色背景和简单软阴影，整体氛围温馨治愈。顶部放置准确的手写感深棕色标题“夫婦の日”，左右各有一颗小心心。第1格：年轻成年亚洲情侣站立肖像，男人站在女人身后，双手轻放在她肩上，两人微笑看向镜头。第2格：情侣坐在温馨室内，各自双手捧着马克杯，相视微笑；加入白色圆角对话框，清晰以黑色文字显示准确中文“谢谢你一直陪着我。”第3格：两人在厨房灶台前并肩做饭，男人搅拌，女人帮忙，表情专注而幸福。第4格：两人紧紧拥抱，男人低头轻轻亲吻女人额头，女人闭眼微笑。四格中的两位角色必须完全一致：同一张脸、同一发型、同一服装和同一身材比例。男人短发、长相温和，穿简单毛衣或衬衫；女人中长发、气质温柔，穿家居感服装。背景保持简洁易读。确保所有中文字符正确、清晰、无乱码和变形。避免写实摄影、3D渲染、鲜艳色彩、复杂背景、角色脸崩、角色漂移、文字乱码、廉价贴纸感、水印和Logo。

items.title: 奢华提拉米苏品牌商业海报设计
items.description: Ultra-premium English-first dessert campaign poster with one tiramisu hero and a sculptural chocolate pour.
items.prompt: Create an ultra-premium vertical commercial dessert poster for the fictional tiramisu brand VELORA DOLCE. Make one elegant tiramisu serving in the lower-middle center the absolute hero, on a refined plate or serving base, with generous luxurious negative space around it. From the upper edge, a clean elegant hand and simple premium porcelain sauce vessel pour one dense glossy chocolate milkshake-like stream directly onto the dessert. The stream must be continuous, sculptural, physically weighted, and wrap over the tiramisu's top edge with controlled folds, premium drips, and restrained pooling. Build the tiramisu with distinct silky mascarpone layers, moist espresso-soaked sponge, fine velvety cocoa dust, a beautiful cut edge, and strong contrast between cream, sponge, cocoa, porcelain, and glossy liquid. Use a deep espresso-black, cocoa-charcoal, or dark warm-brown background so the dessert glows; keep the composition spacious, iconic, cinematic, and rollout-ready as part of a mature luxury brand system. Use disciplined title hierarchy, logo lockup, plate spacing, vessel design, and compact English-first typography secondary to the dessert. Display the exact brand VELORA DOLCE and one exact headline, either POUR THE DESIRE or DROWN IN TIRAMISU. Use delicate high-end commercial lighting with soft cinematic shaping and graceful highlight rolloff across the mascarpone, cocoa, sauce, porcelain, hand, and plate. Refined palette of deep cocoa brown, espresso black-brown, mascarpone cream, soft ivory, and restrained caramel highlights. Photorealistic luxury dessert advertising, tactile materials, collector-grade finish, appetizing warmth, shallow depth of field, 8K-quality detail. Avoid cheap café-menu styling, messy plate, fake liquid physics, weak layers, plastic cream, clutter, oversized text, cartoon rendering, low-resolution texture, awkward hand anatomy, excessive props, chaotic splashes, weak product focus, flat background, watermarks, and logos other than the specified brand.
items.prompt_zh: 为虚构提拉米苏品牌 VELORA DOLCE 创作一张超高级竖幅商业甜点海报。让一份优雅提拉米苏位于画面中下方中心，作为绝对主角，置于精致盘子或底座上，周围保留奢华而宽阔的留白。画面上边缘伸入一只干净优雅的手和简洁高级的瓷质酱汁容器，将一股浓稠闪亮的巧克力奶昔状液体直接浇在甜点上。流线必须连续、具有雕塑感、物理上有重量，并以受控褶皱、高级滴落和克制汇聚包裹提拉米苏顶缘。提拉米苏要有清晰丝滑的马斯卡彭层、湿润的浓缩咖啡浸泡海绵、细腻如天鹅绒的可可粉、漂亮切边，以及奶油、海绵、可可、瓷器和闪亮液体之间鲜明的材质对比。背景使用浓缩咖啡黑、可可炭黑或深暖褐色，使甜点发光；构图宽敞、标志性、电影感强，并像成熟奢侈品牌系统的一部分。使用严谨的标题层级、Logo组合、盘面间距、容器设计和紧凑的英语优先排版，文字从属于甜点。准确显示品牌 VELORA DOLCE，并准确显示以下标题之一：POUR THE DESIRE 或 DROWN IN TIRAMISU。使用细腻高端商业光线，以柔和电影感塑造马斯卡彭、可可、酱汁、瓷器、手部和盘边，并形成优雅高光衰减。色彩为深可可棕、浓缩咖啡黑褐、马斯卡彭奶油色、柔和象牙白和克制焦糖高光。照片级真实的奢华甜点广告，材质可触、收藏级完成度，温暖诱人，浅景深，8K级细节。避免廉价咖啡馆菜单风、凌乱盘面、虚假液体物理、单薄夹层、塑料奶油、杂乱、过大文字、卡通渲染、低分辨率纹理、尴尬手部解剖、过多道具、混乱飞溅、产品焦点弱、平淡背景、水印，以及除指定品牌外的Logo。

items.title: 手机实拍质感东亚女性街头写真
items.description: An ultra-realistic 9:16 everyday street candid of an adult East Asian woman in a white floral ruffled dress, captured with a natural handheld smartphone look.
items.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic 9:16 vertical everyday street candid captured with a handheld smartphone, not a studio shoot. Show an adult East Asian woman in her early 20s standing in simple side profile with a calm expression, long straight black hair and bangs. She wears a white floral-pattern ruffled slip dress with a square neckline, large shoulder ruffles, multiple overlapping ruffle layers at the chest and hem, delicate floral details, natural fabric folds, and realistic modest opacity. She holds a black smartphone in her left hand and wears a white hair tie and thin bracelet on her wrist. Use blurred pedestrians and red-brick buildings in the background, bright daytime natural light, soft sunlight, and natural shadows. Emulate a realistic 28–35mm smartphone perspective with slight depth of field, natural grain, and a subtle handheld motion feel, with an iPhone 16 Pro candid aesthetic as a visual reference only. Render believable skin texture, hair flow, and the transparency and folds of the ruffled fabric. Preserve an unposed, ordinary street moment. Avoid studio lighting, fashion posing, exaggerated beauty retouching, plastic skin, distorted profile, malformed fingers, extra limbs, excessive fabric transparency, clutter, oversaturation, CG, anime, text, watermarks, and logos.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张照片级真实的9:16竖幅日常街头抓拍，使用手持智能手机拍摄，不是摄影棚作品。一位20岁出头的成年东亚女性以简洁侧脸站立，神情沉静，留长直黑发和刘海。她穿白色花卉图案荷叶边吊带连衣裙，方形领口，肩部有大荷叶边，胸口和裙摆叠有多层荷叶边，带精致花卉细节与自然面料褶皱，保持真实且端庄的不透明度。她左手拿黑色智能手机，手腕佩戴白色发圈和细手链。背景为虚化行人和红砖建筑，明亮白天自然光，带柔和阳光与自然阴影。模拟28–35mm真实手机视角、轻微景深、自然颗粒和轻微手持动态感，以iPhone 16 Pro抓拍质感作为视觉参考，不作设备能力保证。细腻呈现可信皮肤纹理、头发流动、荷叶边面料的透光感和褶皱，保持未经摆拍的普通街头瞬间。避免摄影棚灯光、时尚摆拍、夸张美化、塑料皮肤、侧脸畸形、手指错误、多余肢体、过度透视面料、杂乱、过饱和、CG、动漫、文字、水印和Logo。

items.title: 皮克斯风格3D立体Q版人物早安场景
items.description: A warm premium greeting-card composition transforming the uploaded person into a recognizable 3D chibi character surrounded by cheerful morning miniatures.
items.prompt: Transform the uploaded person into a warm, premium Pixar-inspired 3D chibi greeting-card scene while preserving the exact facial identity, facial structure, hairstyle, skin tone, expression, body proportions, outfit, shoes, colors, and recognizable appearance from the reference image. Use a bright centered vertical 3:4 composition on a clean white seamless studio background. Make the giant pastel 3D letters spelling "GOOD MORNING." the central structure. Place the main chibi version of the uploaded person comfortably sitting on the letters, smiling warmly, relaxed, and holding a simple ceramic coffee mug with no visible text or logo. Surround the main character with multiple adorable miniature versions of the same person, each preserving the same recognizable identity while performing a different cheerful morning activity: pouring coffee, holding an encouraging sign, enjoying coffee, reading a book, watering a small plant, hugging a pink heart, serving a cupcake, or raising a motivational chalkboard. Add cute coffee cups, latte art, tiny plants, tulips, a small orange kitten, positive-message wooden signs, soft hearts, subtle doodles, and cozy decorations, balanced and uncluttered. Use soft natural studio light, warm pastel colors, expressive faces, high-quality textures, cozy morning atmosphere, minimal yet vibrant composition, and luxury animated-film rendering. Keep the typography legible and limited to the specified greeting text and positive signs. Avoid low quality, blur, distorted or changed identity, altered outfit, extra limbs, duplicate main character, bad anatomy, plastic textures, clutter, dark lighting, harsh shadows, logos, watermarks, text artifacts, and unrealistic 3D rendering.
items.prompt_zh: 将上传的人物转换为温馨、高级的皮克斯灵感3D Q版贺卡场景，同时保留参考图中的确切面部身份、面部结构、发型、肤色、表情、身体比例、服装、鞋子、颜色和可识别外观。使用明亮居中的3:4竖幅构图，背景为干净的白色无缝摄影棚。让拼写为“GOOD MORNING.”的巨大淡彩3D字母成为场景核心结构。将上传人物的主Q版形象舒适地放在字母上，带温暖微笑、姿势放松，手持简洁的陶瓷咖啡杯，杯面无可见文字或Logo。主角周围安排多个同一人物的可爱迷你版本，每个都保留相同的可识别身份，并分别进行愉快的早晨活动：倒咖啡、举鼓励标牌、享用咖啡、读书、给小植物浇水、拥抱粉色爱心、端纸杯蛋糕或举起励志黑板。加入可爱的咖啡杯、拉花、小植物、郁金香、一只橙色小猫、写有积极信息的木牌、柔软爱心、微妙涂鸦和温馨装饰，保持平衡、干净、不凌乱。使用柔和自然摄影棚光、温暖淡彩、富有表现力的面部和高质量纹理，营造温馨早晨氛围，采用简约而有活力的构图和奢华动画电影渲染。文字清晰可读，并限制为指定问候语和积极信息标牌。避免低质量、模糊、面部畸形或身份改变、服装变更、多余肢体、重复主角、解剖错误、塑料质感、凌乱构图、阴暗光线、硬阴影、Logo、水印、文字伪影和不真实的3D渲染。

items.title: 旅游城市立体明信片微缩景观摄影
items.description: A photorealistic 3:4 travel-editorial scene of an open pop-up postcard diorama featuring a configurable destination.
items.prompt: Create a highly detailed, photorealistic 3:4 vertical travel-editorial diorama: an open vintage pop-up postcard standing upright on an authentic local stone or pavement ledge, featuring Kyoto, Japan. Use a static eye-level camera 25 degrees left of axis for a three-quarter view. Keep the entire card in frame, occupying about 65% with generous space on every side and open sky above; never crop it. The vertical fold is slightly left of center: the flat printed left panel carries all text and ink work, while layered papercraft rises on the right and remains strictly inside the card silhouette, with no element above its top edge. Show paper thickness, forward curve, and the horizontal base folding toward the viewer. The card has rounded corners, aged paper, a subtle destination-inspired border, an authentic local postage stamp, handwritten travel note, circular Kyoto · Japan postmark, and two small ink illustrations of iconic local symbols low on the left panel. The right panel forms a layered paper world of authentic local architecture, streets, vegetation, textures, decorative details, and cultural elements, with at most two recognizable landmarks or iconic local features, naturally integrated. Include one stylized collectible 3D traveler figure with realistic proportions and cinematic figurine quality, destination-appropriate clothing and subtle travel accessories, standing naturally and facing away while admiring the scenery; hair and clothing react to a local breeze. Around the card, show a softly blurred realistic panorama of Kyoto with creamy bokeh while the card is razor sharp. Use destination-authentic architecture, materials, roof styles, urban character, and natural cultural colors. The flat panel must display the exact headline 'Kyoto.' and 'Japan.' in a modern handwritten font, the exact paragraph 'Some places don't ask for attention — they simply stay in memory.', and the exact closing line 'Go where the maps fall quiet.'. Use clear warm afternoon light from the left, shallow depth of field, cinematic grading, and a realistic cast shadow on the ledge. Luxury travel magazine cover quality, ultra-detailed papercraft, legible text, photorealistic materials. No extra people, vehicles, objects, or text beyond the specified destination elements.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅高度详细、照片级真实的3:4竖幅旅行编辑场景：一张打开的复古弹出式明信片立在当地真实的石板或人行道边缘，展示Kyoto、Japan。使用视线高度的静态相机，向左偏离轴线25度形成四分之三视图。整张卡片必须完整入镜，占画面约65%，四周留出宽阔空间，顶边上方有开阔天空，禁止裁剪。垂直折痕略偏中心左侧：平铺的左面板承载全部文字和墨水插图，右侧升起层叠纸艺；所有纸艺严格位于卡片轮廓内，最高元素不得超过卡片顶边。清楚呈现纸张厚度、向前弯曲和向观众折叠的水平底板。卡片有圆角、陈旧纸张、受目的地启发的微妙边框、真实当地邮票、手写旅行笔记和圆形Kyoto·Japan邮戳；左面板下方有两个当地标志的精细墨水插图。右面板展开为层次分明的纸艺世界，包含符合当地的建筑、街道、植被、纹理、装饰与文化元素，最多两个可辨认地标或当地特色并自然融入。加入一个具有写实比例和电影级模型质感的可收藏3D旅行者人物，穿符合目的地气候的服装并带精致旅行配件，自然站在纸艺环境中背对镜头欣赏景色，头发和衣物随当地微风自然变化。卡片四周是Kyoto的柔焦写实全景，带奶油般散景；卡片本身极其锐利。使用目的地真实建筑、材料、屋顶样式、城市气质及自然文化色彩。左面板用现代手写字体准确显示标题“Kyoto。”和“Japan。”，准确显示段落“有些地方并不寻求关注——它们只是留在记忆中。”，以及准确显示结束语“去地图沉默的地方。”。左侧清晰温暖的午后光线、浅景深、电影级调色，并在石板或人行道边缘投下真实阴影。奢华旅行杂志封面质感，超精细纸艺，文字清晰可辨，材质写实。除指定的目的地元素外，不要额外人物、车辆、物体或文字。

items.title: 东亚时尚编辑风格拼贴构图李子色旗袍长裙
items.description: A polished 9:16 fashion lookbook composite centered on an adult East Asian woman in a plum qipao-inspired dress with coordinated alternate-look thumbnails.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 9:16 vertical fashion lookbook collage on a plain very-light-gray to white studio background. The main subject is an adult East Asian woman in her mid-20s, centered in a medium full-length frontal portrait, with four smaller cropped thumbnails of the same woman and consistent face, long straight black middle-parted hair, gold geometric drop earrings, and elegant slender silhouette arranged around her. Keep a clean collage cutout structure with white dashed outlines, spacious negative space, and sharp subject and thumbnail details. The central look is a sleeveless, backless, high-neck qipao-inspired deep-plum dress with a sculptural fitted cut, small gold frog buttons at the neckline, ornate gold phoenix-like embroidery through the hip and high thigh slit, plus large gold geometric drop earrings. The woman stands upright with weight subtly shifted to one hip, one arm relaxed behind her, a graceful S-curve, direct lens gaze, relaxed closed slightly pouted lips, and a calm, sophisticated, quietly confident expression. Use soft glam editorial makeup, long straight black hair with face-framing strands and natural luster, and fair neutral-warm skin with natural studio texture. The alternate thumbnails may show a shirt with skirt, floral camisole layering, fitted black T-shirt with pleated skirt, and beige knit top with patterned skirt, while preserving the same person and coherent styling. Use soft, diffused, high-key even studio light with low-contrast shadows and gentle highlights on hair and skin; keep the background uncluttered. Contemporary Chinese-inspired fashion editorial, catalog-like and slightly playful, realistic materials and fabric edges. Avoid short or curly hair, missing gold embroidery, clutter, harsh flash, dark moody lighting, oversaturation, cartoon or plastic skin, over-sexualized posing, extra limbs, distorted hands, text artifacts, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张写实9:16竖幅时尚型录拼贴海报，背景为朴素的浅灰至微白演播室墙面。主体是一位20多岁中段的成年东亚女性，正面站立于中央，以中等全长肖像呈现；周围排列四个同一女性的较小剪裁缩略图，保持一致的脸型、深黑中分长直发、金色几何坠耳环和优雅纤细轮廓。保留干净的拼贴剪裁结构、白色虚线轮廓、宽阔留白，以及清晰的主体和缩略图细节。中心造型为无袖露背高领旗袍灵感深李子色连衣裙，采用雕塑般贴身剪裁，领口有小金色盘扣，臀部至高大腿开衩处饰有华丽金色凤凰般刺绣，搭配大型金色几何坠耳环。人物挺拔站立，重心微移至一侧臀部，一臂放松置于身后，形成优雅S形；直视镜头，嘴唇放松闭合并略微嘟起，神情平静、精致、自信且克制。妆容为柔和魅力编辑妆，黑色长直发带面部框架发丝和自然光泽，白皙中性暖调皮肤保留自然演播室纹理。缩略图可展示衬衫配裙、花卉背心叠穿、合身黑T恤配褶裙、米色针织上衣配图案裙等备用造型，但要保持同一人物和协调造型。使用柔和漫射、高调均匀的演播室灯光，低对比阴影，头发和皮肤带温柔高光，背景不杂乱。现代中式灵感时尚编辑摄影，兼具型录感和轻微俏皮感，呈现真实材质与清晰面料边缘。避免短发或卷发、丢失金色刺绣、背景杂乱、刺眼闪光、黑暗情绪光、过度饱和、卡通或塑料皮肤、过度性感化姿势、额外肢体、扭曲手部、文字伪影和水印。

items.title: 极简主义日式咖啡馆产品海报
items.description: Minimal 4:5 café product poster with a centered product, exact configurable name and price, and restrained Swiss-Japanese editorial design.
items.prompt: Create a minimalist 4:5 café product poster on a pure white background with black typography. Use the uploaded product reference image as the main visual reference when provided; otherwise generate a realistic product image based only on the product name COFFEE. Place one product centered with soft natural shadows and generous margins. Display the product name as large uppercase English text, exactly COFFEE, and display the price exactly as entered: PRICE. Generate only short English promotional phrases, and do not invent ingredients, brands, or product features that are not visible in the reference or implied by COFFEE. Use a clean Swiss-style editorial grid with a modern Japanese café aesthetic, precise alignment, ample white space, restrained black-and-white contrast, and legible text. Single image, 4:5 vertical. No extra products, invented claims, illegible text, watermarks, or logos.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张极简主义4:5咖啡馆产品海报，使用纯白背景和黑色排版。提供上传的产品参考图时，将其作为主要视觉参考；未提供时，仅根据产品名称COFFEE生成逼真的产品图像。画面只放置一个居中的产品，并带有柔和自然阴影和宽阔边距。以大写英文准确显示产品名称COFFEE，并将价格按输入内容原样显示为PRICE。只生成简短的英文宣传短语，不得虚构参考图中不可见或产品名称COFFEE未暗示的成分、品牌或产品功能。采用干净的瑞士风格编辑网格、现代日式咖啡馆审美、精准对齐、充足留白、克制的黑白对比和清晰可读的文字。单图，4:5竖幅。不要额外产品、虚构宣传、难以辨认的文字、水印或Logo。

items.title: 极简黑色背心东亚女性棚拍
items.description: Low-key fine-art beauty editorial portrait of an adult East Asian woman in a minimal black-and-charcoal studio.
items.prompt: Photorealistic fine-art beauty editorial studio portrait, vertical medium crop from the top of the head to just above the hips. An adult East Asian woman in her 20s sits slightly right of center against a pure-black to deep-charcoal gradient, with no props. Her body turns slightly toward frame left, shoulders relaxed and lower back naturally straight. Her left arm hangs naturally; her right arm is bent with the hand resting gently between collarbone and chin, index and middle fingers naturally extended in a restrained elegant gesture. Her head turns slightly left, gaze toward the far lower left rather than the camera, lips slightly parted, expression calm, rational, and subtly detached. She has a delicate elongated oval face, clear soft jawline, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, natural thin brows, straight slender nose bridge, and low-saturation nude-pink lips. Use extremely light makeup, fair neutral-warm skin with real pores, fine vellus hair, slight tone variation, and soft sebum highlights; no plastic smoothing. Deep-black long straight hair is loose and side-parted, falling over shoulders and back, with slightly more volume on the left and a few natural flyaways. Clothing: solid black slim-fit cropped tank top with wide straps and low round neck in matte stretch cotton or fine ribbed fabric, revealing only a small natural waist area; light-gray high-waisted jeans with visible waistband, metal buttons, belt loops, and denim texture, no logos. Light with a large softbox 45 degrees above front-left to shape forehead, nose bridge, cheekbones, collarbone, and fingers; use a very weak right reflector for subtle hair-background separation. Keep low saturation, low contrast, and rich shadow detail. Photograph with an 85mm or 105mm portrait lens, f/2.2, eye-level slightly high angle, medium-shallow depth of field, sharp eyes, lips, and hands, softened background, realistic skin, hair, cotton, and denim textures, slight ISO 200 film grain, and gentle Black Pro-Mist 1/8 diffusion. Avoid direct eye contact, exaggerated expression, heavy makeup, curly hair, exaggerated proportions, incorrect fingers, fused arms, deformed shoulders or neck, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, strong HDR, oversharpening, clutter, CG, anime, text, watermarks, and logos.
items.prompt_zh: 写实 fine-art beauty editorial 摄影棚人像，竖幅中景，从头顶拍至胯部上方。一位20多岁的成年东亚女性坐在深黑至炭灰色渐变背景前，位于画面中央略偏右，无道具。身体微微朝画面左侧转动，肩膀放松，腰背自然挺直；左臂沿身体自然垂落，右臂弯曲抬起，右手轻放在锁骨与下巴之间，食指和中指自然舒展，动作克制优雅。头部微转向左侧，视线看向左下方远处而非镜头，嘴唇微启，神情平静、理性且略带疏离。面部为精致偏长鹅蛋脸、柔和清晰下颌线、深棕杏仁眼、自然细眉、纤细直鼻梁和低饱和裸粉唇。妆容极淡；白皙中性暖调皮肤保留真实毛孔、细小绒毛、轻微肤色变化和柔和皮脂高光，禁止塑料磨皮。深黑长直发自然披散、偏分，垂落双肩和背后，左侧发量略多，耳侧和发尾有少量碎发。穿纯黑修身短款背心，宽肩带、低圆领，哑光弹力棉或细罗纹面料，仅露出少量自然腰部；搭配浅灰高腰牛仔裤，裤腰、金属纽扣、皮带袢和牛仔纹理清晰，无Logo。大型柔光箱从画面左前上方45度照射，塑造额头、鼻梁、颧骨、锁骨和手指；右侧极弱反光板仅提供轻微轮廓分离。整体低饱和、低对比、暗部层次丰富。使用85mm或105mm人像镜头，f/2.2，平视略高机位，中浅景深，双眼、嘴唇和手部清晰，背景柔化，呈现真实皮肤、发丝、棉质和牛仔纹理，轻微ISO200胶片颗粒与Black Pro-Mist 1/8柔化扩散。避免直视镜头、夸张表情、浓妆、卷发、夸张身材、错误手指、融合手臂、畸形肩颈、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、强HDR、过度锐化、杂乱背景、CG、动漫、文字、水印和Logo。

items.title: 海边露台香槟裙女性弹奏竖琴写实摄影
items.description: 海边酒店露台的4:5写实早晨人像：23岁成年东亚女性穿香槟色丝质长裙坐在高凳上，为金色古典踏板竖琴轻轻试音。
items.prompt:
Create a realistic 4:5 vertical high-end morning portrait on a seaside hotel terrace. Show a 23-year-old adult East Asian woman with balanced natural curves, relaxed shoulders and neck, and a gentle, confident, lightly mature presence. Give her a soft oval face, slender slightly arched brows, clear bright almond eyes, straight natural nose, defined full lips and cool fair skin with a healthy flush, visible realistic texture and subtle light variation. Use transparent champagne-beige makeup, meticulous lashes, softly highlighted under-eye volume and misty peach-rose lips; her expression is quiet and focused with a touch of morning ease. Style deep chestnut-brown hair in a low ponytail with a few loose strands by the ears moving in the sea breeze; add small pearl studs and a thin gold bracelet.

Dress her in a champagne silk satin long dress with thin straps, a soft square neckline, subtle dimensional chest pleats, natural waist, ankle-length fall, slight hem slit and natural folds. Keep the delicate fabric softly luminous with restrained premium reflections and stable, believable construction. Seat her on a thin-legged upholstered high stool near the terrace edge. Turn her body slightly toward the front-left, face naturally toward the camera and gaze just beside the lens. Rest her left hand on the middle of a classic golden-frame pedal harp column and use her right hand to gently pluck the strings while tuning. Keep both legs together, angled to one side with feet touching the floor and stable center of gravity. Place the harp slightly right in front of her without covering face or waist. Frame from head to near ankles, subject center-right occupying about 70%, with eye-level to slightly low 50mm perspective and shallow depth of field.

Add softly blurred white railing edges and a transparent glass water cup in the foreground. Show white terrace stone, linen cushions, distant deep-blue sea and bright morning sky behind. Use soft early-morning natural side light with sea-reflection fill and a subtle rim on hair and shoulder line. Grade champagne gold, off-white and sea blue with realistic skin, clear fingers, facial features, silk texture and hair strands. Avoid underage appearance, nudity, transparent clothing, exaggerated proportions, erotic framing, unstable stool or harp, obscured face/waist, malformed fingers, fused hands, distorted instrument, plastic skin, harsh flash, over-HDR, excessive blur, clutter, text, logo, watermark and low-quality rendering.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一幅4:5竖幅的高端清晨写实人像，场景位于海边酒店露台。一名23岁的成年东亚女性拥有匀称自然的曲线、舒展的肩颈和温柔、自信、轻熟的气质。面部为柔和鹅蛋脸、细长微挑眉、清亮杏眼、自然挺直鼻梁和丰润清晰的嘴唇；肤色冷白带健康血色，保留真实纹理和细微明暗变化。使用通透香槟米棕妆容、精致睫毛、自然提亮的卧蚕和柔雾蜜桃豆沙唇色，神情安静专注并带晨间松弛感。深栗棕色头发低位束起，耳侧留几缕被海风吹动的碎发；佩戴小珍珠耳钉和纤细金色手链。

穿香槟色丝缎长裙，细肩带、柔和方领、胸前轻微立体褶线、自然收束腰线，裙身垂落至脚踝，裙摆有轻微开衩和自然堆叠。面料细腻柔亮但反光克制高级，结构稳定可信。让她坐在露台靠海一侧的细腿软包高凳上，身体略向画面左前方，脸自然朝向镜头，视线落在镜头附近。左手扶住金色框架古典踏板竖琴的琴柱中段，右手轻轻拨弦试音；双腿并拢斜向一侧，双脚落地，重心稳定。竖琴位于人物身前偏右，不遮挡面部或腰线。构图从头顶至脚踝附近，人物居中偏右并约占画面70%，使用平视至略低的50mm视角和浅景深。

前景加入轻微虚化的白色栏杆边缘和透明玻璃水杯；背景表现白色石材露台、亚麻坐垫、远处深蓝海面和明亮晨空。使用清晨柔和自然侧光，海面反光辅助补光，发丝和肩线带细微轮廓光。整体为香槟金、米白和海蓝色，皮肤真实，手指、五官、丝绸纹理和发丝清晰可信。避免未成年感、裸体、透明服装、夸张比例、色情构图、不稳定的凳子或竖琴、遮住脸部或腰线、手指变形、手部粘连、乐器扭曲、塑料皮肤、硬闪光、过度HDR、过度虚化、杂乱、文字、标志、水印和低质量渲染。

items.title: 橙色背景下神秘女性的慢速快门摇摄人像
items.description: 垂直紧凑肖像：神秘成年女性以侧面轮廓站在满幅Pantone 137 C橙色背景前，慢速快门横向摇摄让发丝和下颌产生柔和拖影，同时保留面部结构。
items.prompt: Create a tight vertical studio portrait of a mysterious adult woman in side profile, with her head subtly turned forward. Use an intentional slow-shutter horizontal panning technique so soft motion-blur streaks pass through the hair and jawline while the facial structure remains recognizable. Dress her in a matte charcoal wool coat with gently softened edges. Fill the entire background with a solid Pantone 137 C orange field. Use soft diffused studio light, gentle highlights, low contrast and lifted blacks to create a faded analog-film character with fine grain and muted saturation. Photograph with a full-frame camera, 50mm lens, f/2.8, ISO 200 and 1/15s shutter-speed feel; keep the portrait vertical, close and shallow-focus. Aim for cinematic introspection and a modern independent fashion-editorial visual language, with believable wool texture, skin detail and controlled peripheral smearing. Avoid a frozen action-shot look, smeared or unrecognizable face, excessive blur, vertical blur, harsh flash, crushed blacks, oversaturation, plastic skin, distorted anatomy, cartoon, CGI, text, logo, watermark and clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一幅垂直紧凑的影棚肖像：一名神秘的成年女性以侧面轮廓出现，头部略微向前转动。使用有意的慢速快门横向摇摄，让柔和的运动模糊条纹掠过头发和下颌线，同时保持面部结构可辨。让她穿哑光炭灰色羊毛大衣，边缘柔和。背景完全填充纯色Pantone 137 C橙色。使用柔和漫射影棚光、柔和高光、低反差和提亮黑位，营造褪色模拟胶片质感，带细微颗粒和柔和饱和度。使用全画幅相机、50mm镜头、f/2.8、ISO200和约1/15秒快门观感；保持竖幅、近距离、浅景深肖像。整体具有电影感、内省气质和现代独立时尚编辑视觉语言，表现可信的羊毛纹理、皮肤细节和受控的周边拖影。避免凝固动作照、脸部被涂抹到无法辨认、过度模糊、垂直模糊、硬闪光、压碎黑色、过饱和、塑料皮肤、解剖扭曲、卡通、CGI、文字、标志、水印和杂乱。

items.title: 少数民族方言早安诗性视觉排版指南
items.description: 创建一套轻盈透光、适合投影与收藏的PPT信息图系统，共10张3:4页面，每张以一个少数民族方言的“早安”主题和3至5个知识点为内容核心。
items.prompt:
Design a coherent set of 10 vertical 3:4 presentation pages about “How to say Good Morning in ten minority ethnic-group dialects,” using the supplied bilingual dataset ten verified entries, each with group name, dialect Good Morning greeting, translation and 3–5 cultural knowledge points. Each page focuses on one group and its dialect greeting, with 3–5 verified knowledge points and a distinct information presentation, while all pages share one fixed editorial system. Do not invent language spellings, translations or cultural facts beyond the supplied dataset, and do not use serial-number logic.

Build each page around a large expressive title and a softly focused image: use an editorial reading rhythm of impact, pause and close reading; a top-left text center of gravity balanced by an offset focal visual and slender peripheral information bands; connect related content with thin continuity/proximity tracks and clear grouping. The first reading point is a giant column-crossing title, the second a boundary-crossing focal image, and the third the data/description modules. Keep broad edge whitespace, neat margins, controlled information density and thumbnail legibility. Use a high-key translucent background base, low-contrast environmental imagery, local out-of-focus foreground occlusion and a small amount of free-form halo; use diffused ambient light, soft color spill without hard edges and a subtle vertical fabric-like texture, with focal edges transitioning from soft to sharp rather than blurring the whole page.

Use a five-role color grammar that remains stable across all pages: background field 55–65%, highest value and low chroma with slow warm/cool drift; focal visuals 20–25%, medium-high value and medium chroma; information text 10–15%, deepest-value contrast anchor; translucent support layers 5–10%, low chroma adjacent to the background; high-chroma accents no more than 3% and only at key nodes. Keep this role mapping reusable for future themes or brand palettes without changing the layout or font system. Use multi-column and baseline grids. Pair oversized high-contrast display serif typography with a restrained, highly legible body system; allow display ligatures, shared strokes and directional terminals to interact with image contours, while keeping body rhythm, baseline order and Chinese/Latin/digit optical weight balanced. Use professional, collectible presentation typography and light, poetic, breathable motion. Keep imagery culturally respectful, structurally accurate and non-caricatured; avoid modern 3D cartoon effects, high-saturation clashes, unreadable microtext, excessive decoration, generic stock imagery, uniform full-page blur, hard shadows, logos, watermark and accidental serial numbering.
items.prompt_zh:
使用提供的双语数据十条已核验条目，每条包含群体名称、方言早安词、翻译和3至5个文化知识点，设计一套连贯的10张竖版3:4演示页面，主题为“十个少数民族方言如何说早安”。每页聚焦一个群体及其方言问候语，包含3至5个已提供的知识点，并采用不同的信息呈现方式；10页共享同一套固定编辑系统。除提供的数据外，不得自行编造方言拼写、翻译或文化事实，不使用序列号逻辑。

每页以巨型表现性标题和柔焦影像为核心，建立“冲击—停顿—细读”的编辑节奏；让左上文字重心与偏侧焦点视觉和细长边缘信息带隔空平衡；用细线的连续/接近轨迹连接相关内容并清晰分组。第一阅读点为跨栏巨型标题，第二为越界焦点影像，第三为数据和说明模块。页面四周保留宽阔留白、边距整齐、信息密度受控并确保缩略图可辨。背景先铺高调半透明底场，再叠加低对比环境影像、局部失焦前景遮挡和少量自由形光晕；使用漫射环境光、无硬边的柔和彩色溢出和轻微织物式纵向纹理，焦点层边缘由虚到实，避免全页均匀模糊。

使用稳定的五角色配色语法：背景场占55–65%，最高明度、低彩度并允许冷暖缓慢漂移；焦点视觉占20–25%，中高明度和中彩度；信息文字占10–15%，以最深值建立对比锚点；半透明支撑层占5–10%，低彩度并邻接底场；高彩度强调不超过3%，只落在关键节点。未来主题或品牌配色可按角色一一映射，无须改变版式或字体系统。采用多栏编辑网格和基线网格。将大字号高笔画反差展示衬线与克制、易读的正文体系配对；展示字允许连字、共享笔画和沿阅读方向延展的末笔与影像轮廓互动，同时保持正文节奏、基线秩序以及中英数字的视觉重量平衡。使用专业、收藏级的演示排版，氛围清透、诗性、轻盈有呼吸感。影像应尊重文化、结构准确、不漫画化；避免现代3D卡通、高饱和撞色、难以辨认的微型文字、过度装饰、泛化库存图、全页均匀虚化、生硬阴影、标志、水印和意外的序列编号。

items.title: 极致写实社论时尚肖像大片
items.description: 极简单色影棚中的高端时尚杂志封面人像：成年模特穿单色造型，柔光箱与轮廓光塑造清晰面部和干净留白，顶部加入手绘刷漆标题。
items.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic editorial fashion portrait of a confident adult model standing against a seamless monochromatic studio background. Use a centered composition, eye-level camera, clean negative space and a luxury fashion-campaign aesthetic. Dress the model in a stylish monochrome outfit with precise garment texture and restrained silhouette. Use dramatic softbox lighting with a subtle rim light, crisp facial detail, natural skin texture and cinematic but controlled color grading. At the top of the image, place the exact all-caps hand-painted brush typography “ICON, AURA, WILD”; match it to the background color scheme with slightly lighter contrast, keeping it integrated like a premium magazine cover title and free of extra copy. Use an 85mm lens look at approximately f/2 with shallow depth of field, realistic photographic detail and a polished minimalist cover design. Avoid low quality, blur, unwanted noise, overexposure, oversaturation, watermarks, logos, text artifacts, extra limbs, distorted face, bad anatomy, cropped head, cartoon, illustration, CGI and low resolution.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一幅超写实的社论时尚肖像：一名自信的成年模特站在无缝单色影棚背景前。采用居中构图、平视镜头、干净留白和奢侈时尚广告美学。让模特穿着时髦的单色造型，表现准确的衣物纹理和克制轮廓。使用戏剧性的柔光箱照明并加入微妙轮廓光，保持清晰面部细节、自然皮肤纹理以及电影感但受控的色彩分级。在图像顶部加入准确的大写手绘刷漆字体“ICON, AURA, WILD”；颜色与背景方案一致但略浅，像高级杂志封面标题一样融入画面，不加入其他文案。使用约85mm镜头、f/2浅景深观感、真实摄影细节和精致极简封面设计。避免低质量、模糊、不必要噪点、过曝、过饱和、水印、标志、文字伪影、多余肢体、脸部扭曲、解剖错误、裁切头部、卡通、插画、CGI和低分辨率。

items.title: 餐厅品尝食物的日本女性日常抓拍
items.description: 5:8竖幅2x2日常手机拼贴：同一名虚构成年日本女性在浴室、跑步、咖啡休息和户外早餐时被自然捕捉，最后一格以不锈钢碗反射出微妙文字。
items.prompt:
Create one realistic 5:8 vertical image arranged as a clean 2x2 grid of four candid smartphone photographs of the same fictional adult Japanese woman across one ordinary day. Use raw standard-phone/social-post realism, sharp natural details, slight JPEG compression and preserved imperfections; this is not a studio shoot, luxury restaurant advertisement or cinematic production. Keep her identity, natural adult proportions and everyday presence consistent in all panels, while changing the activity, setting and expression. Use real-world lighting appropriate to each scene and no portrait-mode blur.

Panel 1: “Morning wake-up bathroom mirror selfie”—in a small home bathroom, she stands casually before a mirror holding a partly visible phone; imperfect off-center mirror framing, sleepy slightly puffy eyes, unstyled short dark-brown hair, no or minimal makeup, loose random T-shirt and gentle overhead bathroom light. Panel 2: “Outdoor run – mid action selfie”—on a running path or sidewalk, she holds the phone with the front camera while running; one arm visible, focused lively face with open-mouth breathing, pink athletic outfit and white running cap, natural daylight and restrained motion energy. Panel 3: “Coffee break candid”—seated at a small café or home table, she casually drinks from a coffee cup in a handheld selfie, thoughtful relaxed expression looking away, cup mid-sip and unobtrusive background. Panel 4: “Outdoor breakfast – taken by someone else”—at an outdoor breakfast café, she eats naturally and is unaware of the camera, photographed from the side or across the table.

For the overall visual language, keep natural skin texture, realistic hands, believable posture, ordinary clothing and scene-specific light. In the breakfast panel, include a narrow stainless-steel spoon entering from the left and touching the center of the closed lower lip slightly toward frame-left; the other hand supports the cheek, causing a slight natural cheek press. Show a cut-off stainless-steel bowl at lower left and a shallow metal plate at lower center-right with reddish-brown food. In the bowl's curved polished reflection, integrate the exact string “@Live_life_style” as a subtle, distorted reflection formed by surrounding light/equipment—not a pasted watermark: it follows the bowl curvature, is interrupted by scratches, fog, food or highlights, lower contrast than the face, and is only recognizable on close inspection. It must not float on the image, glow, use a clean digital font, sit on skin or become a signature overlay. Keep a small eatery background with stainless equipment, cream tiles, a white louvered unit and blurred unrecognizable notices; no store names, brands or other readable text. Avoid underage appearance, sexual framing, exaggerated anatomy, doll-like face, plastic skin, huge pupils, forced smile, spoon inside the mouth, ornate accessories, strong background blur, studio light, over-clean commercial staging, app UI, borders, duplicated people, extra fingers/limbs, distorted hands, watermarks unrelated to the bowl reflection, logos, captions and low quality.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张5:8竖幅单图，整齐排列为2x2四格手机抓拍，表现同一名虚构成年日本女性在普通一天中的四个日常瞬间。使用原始标准手机和社交媒体直出质感，细节自然清晰，带轻微JPEG压缩和保留的生活瑕疵；不要影棚拍摄、高级餐厅广告或电影式制作。四格保持人物身份、成年自然比例和日常存在感一致，只改变活动、地点和表情。各格使用符合场景的真实光线，不使用人像模式式过度虚化。

第1格“Morning wake-up bathroom mirror selfie”：小型家用浴室，人物随意站在镜前拿部分可见的手机自拍；镜面构图不完美且略偏，眼睛略浮肿带睡意，短深棕发未打理，素颜或淡妆，宽松随意T恤，浴室顶光柔和。第2格“Outdoor run – mid action selfie”：在户外跑道或人行道上跑步，用前置镜头快速自拍；一只手臂可见，神情专注有活力，张嘴呼吸，穿粉色运动服和白色跑步帽，自然日光，动作感克制。第3格“Coffee break candid”：在小咖啡馆或家中餐桌旁随意坐着喝咖啡，用手持自拍记录；神情若有所思而放松，视线望向别处，咖啡杯正在入口，背景次要安静。第4格“Outdoor breakfast – taken by someone else”：在户外早餐咖啡馆自然进餐，没有察觉镜头，由他人从侧面或桌对面拍摄。

整体保持自然皮肤纹理、真实手部、可信姿态、普通服装和符合场景的光线。早餐格中，从画面左侧伸入一把细长不锈钢勺，接近水平并轻触略偏画面左侧的闭合下唇中央；另一只手支撑脸颊，使其自然轻微受压。画面左下方显示被切断的不锈钢大碗，下方中央偏右放浅金属盘，盘中有赤褐色料理。将准确字符串“@Live_life_style”作为大碗弯曲抛光表面中的微妙变形反射融入照片，而不是后期贴上的水印：文字沿碗面弯曲，被擦痕、雾气、食物或高光打断，明度和对比度低于脸部，只有仔细观察才可辨认。不得漂浮在画面上、独立发光、使用干净数字字体、置于皮肤上或变成签名覆盖层。小型餐饮店背景包含不锈钢设备、奶油色瓷砖、白色百叶设备和带不可辨认细线的模糊告示；不要店名、品牌或其他可读文字。避免未成年感、色情构图、夸张解剖、娃娃脸、塑料皮肤、巨大瞳孔、勉强微笑、勺子进入口腔、华丽配饰、强背景虚化、影棚光、过度整洁的商业布景、App界面、边框、重复人物、多余手指或肢体、手部扭曲、与碗反射无关的水印、标志、字幕和低质量。

items.title: 书籍主角文字云书法排版
items.description: 16:9的2x2书籍主角文字云书法作品：为四个非版权角色分别从微型文字密度、间距、换行、字号和负空间构成远近皆可辨的代表性轮廓。
items.prompt: Create a 16:9 artwork arranged as a precisely aligned 2x2 grid for four non-copyrighted book protagonists: a fictional public-domain detective, a fictional public-domain explorer, a fictional public-domain naturalist and a fictional public-domain wanderer. Generate one typographic calligram panel per subject. For each panel, infer the subject's visual DNA from the supplied name and choose only the most iconic silhouette, object, scene, creature, architecture, gesture or symbol associated with that subject; do not hard-code an unprovided film, quotation, character detail, object, scene, text or symbol. Build each image primarily from dense microtext rather than conventional drawing, using subject-specific thematic fragments and metadata as the texture source. If an exact text source is absent, invent only thematic fragments, metadata, chapter-like phrases, labels, dates, keywords and atmospheric wording appropriate to that subject. Make each subject emerge from typographic density, spacing, line breaks, text scale and negative space, with a strong readable silhouette from a distance. Close inspection should reveal thousands of tiny words, phrases, captions and fragments. Use monochrome ink, aged paper, archival grain and vintage printed texture; keep all four panels stylistically coherent while allowing each subject's silhouette and text rhythm to differ. Ensure the grid is balanced and the microtext remains text-like rather than random noise. Avoid normal painted illustration, hard-coded copyrighted media references, supplied-absent quotes, generic unrelated symbols, muddy silhouettes, illegible large text, colorful gradients, modern glossy design, clutter, watermark and logo.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一幅16:9作品，严格排列为2x2网格，服务于四个非版权书籍主角：一名虚构的公版侦探、一名虚构的公版探险家、一名虚构的公版博物学家和一名虚构的公版漫游者。每个主角对应一个排版书法面板。根据提供的名称推断每个主角的视觉DNA，只选择与其关联的最具代表性的轮廓、物体、场景、生物、建筑、姿态或符号；除非已提供，不得硬编码电影、引用、角色细节、物体、场景、文字或符号。每个画面主要由密集微型文字而非普通绘画构建，并使用与主体相关的主题片段和元数据作为纹理来源。若没有确切文本来源，只能为该主角创造主题片段、元数据、章节式短语、标签、日期、关键词和氛围词。让主体从排版密度、间距、换行、文字大小和负空间中显现，远看保持强烈且可读的轮廓，近看能发现成千上万个微小单词、短语、说明和文字碎片。使用单色墨水、陈旧纸张、档案颗粒和复古印刷纹理；四格风格统一，但每个主体的轮廓和文字节奏可以不同。保持网格平衡，让微型文字看起来像文字而非随机噪点。避免普通绘画插画、硬编码的受版权媒体引用、未提供的引文、无关泛化符号、浑浊轮廓、难读的大字、彩色渐变、现代光亮设计、杂乱、水印和标志。

items.title: 经典英语阅读教材排版设计
items.description: 竖版3:4中英双语英语阅读教材单页模板：固定经典出版物版式，按主题生成3至5段英文阅读、主题插画及底部学习辅助模块。
items.prompt:
Design a vertical 3:4 bilingual English-reading textbook infographic about The Water Cycle. Use a formal, durable editorial layout inspired by professional 20th-century English textbooks and supplementary readers; keep this layout logic fixed while allowing the illustration language and cultural details to follow the theme. At the top, add concise course, chapter or reading-level information. Center the prominent English title “THE WATER CYCLE” and place the smaller Chinese title “水循环” below it. Build the main reading area around a natural, concise English article suitable for primary and secondary learners, divided into 3–5 short paragraphs, with restrained accent color for key vocabulary or grammar. Place the English reading text on the left or upper area and a main theme illustration on the right. At the bottom, include clearly bounded learning modules such as Chinese Translation, Key Words, Did You Know? and Think and Answer. Keep reading order obvious, text legible and the page suitable for classroom printing.

Create the main illustration and 1–2 small supporting narrative illustrations according to The Water Cycle—for example a character story, natural science, historical event, city life, traditional culture, technology, animals or travel. Use an appropriate classic publication hand-drawn language such as watercolor, light color, pen line, vintage picture-book, natural-history or realistic textbook illustration. Render people, animals, objects and environments accurately and naturally, never childish, exaggerated or modern 3D-cartoon. Use a low-saturation printed palette: off-white, light gray or old paper base with deep blue, dark green, brown-red, terracotta or gray-black accents. Keep background texture and thematic decoration extremely light so text remains clear. Use rational professional typography: bold readable serif or classic textbook font for the English title, legible print type for body text, and concise standardized Chinese support text. Maintain neat margins, generous whitespace, balanced text-to-image ratio, rich but uncrowded information hierarchy and authentic publication texture. Avoid fancy display lettering, modern commercial-poster styling, excessive decoration, clashing high saturation, illegible text, distorted illustrations, clutter, watermark and logo.
items.prompt_zh:
设计一张关于水循环的竖版3:4中英双语英语阅读教材信息图。采用受20世纪专业英语教材与课外读物启发的正式、耐看的编辑版式；固定版式逻辑不变，同时允许插画语言和文化细节随主题调整。页面顶部加入简洁的课程、章节或阅读等级信息；中央放置醒目的英文标题“THE WATER CYCLE”，下方放置较小的中文标题“水循环”。正文区域围绕适合中小学生的自然简洁英文文章展开，分为3至5个短段落，可用克制的强调色突出重点词汇或语法。将英文阅读正文放在左侧或上方，右侧安排主题主插画；底部设置边界清晰的学习辅助模块，例如中文翻译、Key Words、Did You Know?和Think and Answer。阅读路径要清楚，文字易读，适合课堂打印。

根据水循环创作主插画，并可加入1至2幅辅助叙事小插画，例如人物故事、自然科学、历史事件、城市生活、传统文化、科技探索、动物世界或旅行场景。根据主题选择经典出版物手绘语言，如水彩、淡彩、钢笔线稿、复古绘本、自然历史插画或写实教材插画。人物、动物、物品和环境结构准确自然，不幼稚、不夸张、不采用现代3D卡通。使用低饱和印刷色板：米白、浅灰或旧纸色底色，搭配深蓝、墨绿、棕红、陶土色或灰黑色辅助色。背景纹理和主题装饰必须极淡，不能影响文字清晰度。字体和版式理性专业：英文标题使用粗重清晰的衬线或经典教材字体，正文使用易读印刷体，中文辅助文字简洁规范。保持边距整齐、留白合理、图文比例平衡、信息层级丰富但不拥挤，并具有真实出版物质感。避免花哨艺术字、现代商业海报风格、过度装饰、高饱和撞色、难以辨认的文字、插画变形、杂乱、水印和标志。

items.title: 西德尼斯威尼真实生活四宫格写真
items.description: 同一名成年女演员在同一天的四个自然日常瞬间：浴室镜子自拍、户外跑步自拍、咖啡休息和户外早餐，由2x2手机照片网格呈现。
items.prompt: Create one realistic 4:5 vertical image containing a clean 2x2 grid of four candid daily-life smartphone photographs of the same adult actress, Sydney Sweeney, using the uploaded reference identity consistently across every panel without beauty-face alteration or idealization. Each panel should feel spontaneous, unposed and captured naturally during the same day, with raw iPhone/social-media realism, sharp natural detail and preserved imperfections. Use real-world lighting appropriate to each scene, never studio or cinematic lighting. Panel 1, “Morning wake-up bathroom mirror selfie”: at home in a bathroom, she stands casually before the mirror holding a partly visible phone, with a natural arm angle, slightly puffy sleepy eyes, unstyled morning hair, no makeup or minimal makeup, a loose casual T-shirt, imperfect off-center mirror framing and gentle bathroom light. Panel 2, “Outdoor run – mid action selfie”: she runs on a path or sidewalk while holding the phone for a quick front-camera selfie, arm visible, focused but lively expression and open-mouth breathing, pink athletic outfit and white running cap, natural daylight, restrained motion energy and no exaggerated blur. Panel 3, “Coffee break candid”: she sits casually at a café or home table drinking coffee, captured with a handheld selfie, thoughtful relaxed expression looking away from the camera, cup mid-sip and quiet unobtrusive background. Panel 4, “Outdoor breakfast – taken by someone else”: at an outdoor breakfast café, she eats naturally, unaware of the camera, photographed from the side or across the table. Keep the same face, skin tone, proportions, realistic body language and natural texture across all four frames; vary only the time, setting, activity and expression. Use crisp but not overprocessed phone detail, slight compression and ordinary imperfections. Avoid duplicated or inconsistent identity, beauty retouching, plastic skin, staged poses, studio light, excessive motion blur, distorted anatomy, unreadable interface text, logos, watermark and clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张4:5竖幅单图，其中包含2x2网格的四幅真实日常手机照片。四格都必须是同一名成年女演员 Sydney Sweeney，使用上传的参考身份保持面部、肤色和比例一致，不进行美颜式改变或理想化。每一格都应像同一天中自然捕捉的无摆拍瞬间，具有原始iPhone和社交媒体真实感，保留自然瑕疵与清晰细节。根据各场景使用真实环境光，不要影棚光或电影式布光。第1格“Morning wake-up bathroom mirror selfie”：家中浴室，主角随意站在镜子前拿手机自拍，手机部分可见，手臂角度自然；眼睛略浮肿带睡意，头发未打理，素颜或淡妆，宽松随意T恤，镜面构图不完美且未居中，浴室光线柔和。第2格“Outdoor run – mid action selfie”：在户外跑道或人行道上边跑边用手机快速前置自拍，手臂可见，神情专注而有活力，张嘴呼吸，穿粉色运动服和白色跑步帽；自然日光，动作感真实但不夸张运动模糊。第3格“Coffee break candid”：在咖啡馆或家中餐桌旁随意坐着喝咖啡，以手持自拍记录；神情若有所思而放松，视线不直对镜头，咖啡杯正在入口，背景安静且不抢镜。第4格“Outdoor breakfast – taken by someone else”：在户外早餐咖啡馆自然进餐，没有察觉镜头，由他人从侧面或桌对面拍摄。四格保持相同脸部、肤色、比例、可信身体语言和自然纹理，只改变时间、地点、活动和表情。使用清晰但不过度加工的手机细节、轻微压缩和日常瑕疵。避免身份重复或不一致、美颜修图、塑料皮肤、摆拍姿势、影棚光、过度运动模糊、解剖扭曲、难读的界面文字、标志、水印和杂乱。

items.title: 星尘沐浴的梦幻少女电影感肖像
items.description: 根据上传参考图保持成年女性身份，创作一幅被生物发光与星尘照亮的梦幻电影感肖像，重点表现王冠式编发、发光雀斑和水晶耳坠。
items.prompt: Create a magical cinematic close-up portrait of an adult woman using the uploaded reference image to preserve her recognizable identity. Bathe the scene in deep bioluminescent light and softly illuminate her face with shimmering stardust particles. Style her hair in intricate braids woven into a regal crown; individual strands should sparkle with cosmic dust and tiny glowing embers. Give her expressive eyes filled with wonder and innocence, with detailed realistic skin texture and luminous natural freckles. Add crystal drop earrings that catch and refract subtle rainbow light. Keep the composition intimate, elegant and filmic, with controlled atmospheric particles, believable skin and hair detail, clear eye reflections and a refined fantasy-cinema finish. Avoid juvenile framing, plastic skin, featureless overexposure, muddy darkness, chaotic particles, indistinct eyes, malformed braids, floating jewelry, excessive rainbow effects, cartoon, anime, flat illustration, text, logos and watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传参考图保持成年女性可辨认的身份，创建一幅魔幻电影感的近距离肖像。让场景沐浴在深邃的生物发光中，闪烁的星尘颗粒柔和照亮她的脸庞。将头发精细编织成华丽的王冠式发辫，每根发丝都闪耀着宇宙尘埃和微小发光余烬。她的富有表现力的眼睛充满惊奇与纯真，皮肤保留细腻真实纹理，天然雀斑带有发光感。加入捕捉并折射细微彩虹光的水晶垂坠耳环。构图保持亲密、优雅和电影化，控制大气粒子，表现可信的皮肤与发丝细节、清晰眼睛反光和精致奇幻电影质感。避免幼态构图、塑料皮肤、无细节过曝、浑浊黑暗、混乱粒子、眼睛模糊、发辫变形、悬浮珠宝、过度彩虹效果、卡通、动漫、扁平插画、文字、标志和水印。

items.title: 复古极简风格旅游海报设计
items.description: 方形复古旅游海报模板，以扁平矢量和中世纪现代风格，用几何网格平衡呈现地点的地标、建筑、野生动物、食物、文化、景观、国旗、植物和活动。
items.prompt: Create a square vintage travel poster for Japan in a flat-vector mid-century-modern style. Use a clean geometric grid and balanced symmetrical minimalist panels to depict the destination's iconic landmarks, notable architecture, native wildlife, traditional foods, cultural symbols, characteristic landscapes, national flag, local flora and popular activities. Keep each panel legible and thoughtfully simplified, with crisp geometric shapes, a warm earthy palette, restrained visual hierarchy and a timeless travel-poster silhouette. Add the exact destination name Japan centered at the bottom in a thin elegant sans-serif font. Apply subtle retro print texture while keeping edges clean and colors controlled; avoid photorealism, clutter, random generic landmarks, inaccurate symbols, distorted geometry, excessive text, illegible lettering, logos and watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 为日本创建一张方形复古旅游海报，采用扁平矢量和中世纪现代风格。使用干净的几何网格与平衡对称的极简面板，分别呈现该地点的标志性地标、著名建筑、原生野生动物、传统食物、文化符号、代表性风景、国旗、当地植物和热门活动。每个面板都要清晰易读并经过有意识的简化，使用利落几何形状、温暖土地色调、克制的视觉层级和永恒的旅游海报轮廓。底部中央用细长优雅的无衬线字体准确加入地点名称日本。加入细微复古印刷纹理，同时保持边缘干净、色彩受控；避免写实摄影、杂乱、随机泛化地标、不准确的符号、几何变形、过多文字、难以辨认的字样、标志和水印。

items.title: 胶片质感下的姜发雀斑女孩与都市咖啡时光
items.description: 以Taylor为中心的电影感生活方式人像：一名姜发、浓密自然雀斑的成年女性在都市咖啡馆木桌旁双手捧杯，随意望向镜头外。
items.prompt: Create a high-quality cinematic lifestyle photograph of Taylor, an adult influencer with vibrant ginger hair, heavy natural freckles, high cheekbones and a soft nose. Preserve Taylor's recognizable identity from the uploaded reference image while allowing a natural candid variation. Show her sitting relaxed at a wooden table in a cozy urban coffee shop, holding a coffee cup with both hands and looking away from the camera in an effortless, unposed moment. Keep the background softly blurred with a small neon sign glow. Use warm golden-hour sunlight entering from the side, gentle soft illumination and an eye-level camera with shallow depth of field at an f/1.8 look. Render the tactile character of Kodak Portra 400 film, subtle grain, cinematic high-fashion editorial polish and an expensive yet cozy urban morning-routine mood. Keep freckles natural and prominent, hands believable and cup clearly held; avoid plastic skin, smoothed freckles, harsh flash, over-sharpening, stiff posing, distorted hands, distracting background detail, logos, captions and watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张高质量的电影感生活方式照片：主角是拥有鲜艳姜黄色头发、浓密自然雀斑、高颧骨和柔和鼻子特征的成年网红 Taylor。使用上传参考图保持 Taylor 可辨认的身份，同时允许自然的抓拍变化。让她放松地坐在舒适都市咖啡馆的木桌旁，双手捧着咖啡杯，随意望向镜头之外，呈现不摆拍的轻松瞬间。背景柔焦，并带有一块小型霓虹招牌的微光。使用从侧面进入的黄金时段温暖阳光和柔和光线，平视机位，浅景深并呈现f/1.8观感。表现 Kodak Portra 400 胶片的触感、细微颗粒、电影感高级时尚编辑质感，以及昂贵却舒适的都市晨间日常氛围。保持雀斑自然且明显，手部可信、咖啡杯被清楚握住；避免塑料皮肤、磨平雀斑、刺眼闪光、过度锐化、僵硬摆姿、手部扭曲、分散注意力的背景细节、标志、字幕和水印。

items.title: 鲜艳明黄背景前的全黑潮酷匿名者
items.description: 极简现代时尚影棚人像：一名全黑着装、脸部大幅遮蔽的成年男子正面站在鲜艳纯黄背景前，形成神秘匿名的高对比视觉。
items.prompt: Create a minimalist professional studio portrait of an adult man standing front-facing and symmetrically against a solid, vibrant yellow background. Dress him entirely in black: a black beanie, matte black sunglasses, a black face mask covering the nose and mouth, and a fully zipped black padded winter jacket. The concealed face and monochrome outfit should create a mysterious anonymous fashion-editorial presence while preserving clean facial contours around the covered areas and visible jacket texture. Use dramatic directional cinematic lighting with strong contrast and soft controlled shadows; emphasize the jacket's padded material, crisp edges and restrained silhouette. Keep the subject centered, ultra-sharp and professionally photographed, with modern fashion-magazine styling, high-contrast color separation and realistic 4K-level detail. Avoid a patterned or uneven background, visible uncovered nose or mouth, logos, extra accessories, distorted anatomy, soft focus, harsh clipped shadows, excessive props, text, watermark and low-quality rendering.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一幅极简的专业影棚肖像：一名成年男子正面站立，在纯色鲜艳明黄色背景前保持对称构图。让他全身使用黑色造型：黑色无边帽、哑光黑色太阳镜、遮住鼻子和嘴巴的黑色口罩，以及完全拉上的黑色加厚冬装夹克。被遮蔽的脸部和全黑服装营造神秘、匿名的时尚杂志气质，同时保留遮挡区域周围干净的面部轮廓和清晰的夹克纹理。使用戏剧性的方向性电影布光，强烈对比配合柔和可控的阴影，突出夹克的蓬松材质、利落边缘和克制轮廓。保持主体居中、超锐利对焦和专业摄影质感，采用现代时尚编辑风格、高对比色彩分离和4K级真实细节。避免有图案或不均匀的背景、露出的鼻子或嘴巴、标志、多余配饰、解剖扭曲、失焦、生硬死黑阴影、过多道具、文字、水印和低质量渲染。

items.title: 奇幻材质重构的巴黎微缩城市天际线
items.description: 以巴黎为默认地点，将整座城市天际线重构为由指定材料组件组成的超精细微缩建筑立体模型，并让材质物理性主导结构、纹理和光照。
items.prompt: Create a hyper-detailed miniature architectural cityscape of Paris, France, with the entire skyline assembled from components of amber glass and translucent crystal. Let skyscrapers, landmarks and structural systems visibly emerge from the constituent parts of that material, using thematic structural engineering rather than ordinary concrete-and-glass construction. Apply the physical properties, innate material logic and characteristic texture of amber glass and translucent crystal throughout the architecture, replacing conventional concrete and glass while preserving high-fidelity surface detail. Light the diorama so illumination reveals the material's surface behavior, with ambient occlusion and a volumetric atmosphere that match its theme. Present it as tilt-shift macro photography with an f/2.8 look, detailed texture mapping, miniature scale-model aesthetics and a refined Unreal Engine 5 architectural-render finish. Keep the city clearly miniature, geometrically coherent and richly textured; no human presence, full-size scale, blur, low resolution, bad geometry, distortion, flat 2D rendering, text or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一座Paris, France的超精细微缩建筑城市景观，整条城市天际线都由琥珀玻璃与半透明水晶的组件组装而成。让摩天大楼、地标和结构系统明显从该材料的构成部分中生长出来，采用主题化结构工程，而不是普通的混凝土和玻璃建造。将琥珀玻璃与半透明水晶的物理特性、固有材料逻辑和典型纹理贯穿应用于建筑，以其纹理取代传统混凝土与玻璃，同时保留高保真表面细节。灯光必须展示该材料的表面特性，并加入与材料主题匹配的环境光遮蔽和体积大气。以移轴微距摄影呈现，具有f/2.8景深观感、细致纹理映射、比例模型美学和精致的虚幻引擎5建筑渲染质感。保持城市明确为微缩模型，几何结构连贯、纹理丰富；不要人物、全尺寸城市感、模糊、低分辨率、糟糕几何、扭曲、扁平二维效果、文字或水印。

items.title: 雨夜街头冷酷黑帮新黑色电影写实人像
items.description: 使用上传面部参考进行中等强度身份影响的1920年代雨夜黑帮电影感半身人像，保留整体面貌并允许轻微变化。
items.prompt: Create a vertical 3:4, ultra-cinematic photorealistic half-body portrait of a young adult man using the uploaded face reference with medium identity strength and high influence: preserve the overall look, allow minor natural variation and only subtle stylization; do not lock the face rigidly. Show him walking forward in a slow, confident stride on a 1920s city street at night. He holds a lit cigarette in one hand and keeps the other inside his overcoat pocket; shoulders square but relaxed, head slightly tilted, eyes looking directly at the camera with a cold, fearless, authoritative expression. Dress him accurately as a 1920s street gangster: long dark heavy-wool overcoat with slightly wet fabric, dark buttoned three-piece suit and waistcoat, loosened tie, and a flat cap worn low. Set the scene among wet cobblestones, vintage street lamps, brick buildings and old shopfronts, with distant figures blurred into rainy light bokeh and cigarette smoke mixing with the rain. Use warm street lamps as the key light and cool moonlight as fill, with high-contrast neo-noir grading, deep shadows, glowing amber highlights, cool blue-gray surroundings, and emphasis on the face, eyes, raindrops and coat texture. Photograph at eye level with an 85mm lens, f/1.4 ultra-shallow depth of field, eyes in focus, cinematic freeze and subtle film grain. Render detailed realistic skin, wool and wet reflections; exclude cartoon, anime, illustration, painterly style, plastic skin, warped face, bad anatomy, extra limbs, low resolution, overexposure, modern objects or cars, logos and text.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一幅3:4竖幅、超电影感的照片级写实半身人像：使用上传的面部参考，以中等身份强度和较高影响力保持整体面貌，同时允许自然的轻微变化，只进行细微风格化，不要僵硬锁定脸部。表现一名年轻成年男子在1920年代城市夜街上缓慢而自信地向前走。他一只手拿着点燃的香烟，另一只手放在大衣口袋里；肩膀平直但放松，头部略微倾斜，直视镜头，表情冷峻、无畏且具有权威感。准确穿着1920年代街头黑帮服装：深色厚重羊毛长大衣，布料略微湿润，内搭深色扣好的三件套西装和马甲，领带松开，低压平顶帽。场景包含湿润鹅卵石路、复古街灯、砖砌建筑和老式店面；远处人物虚化为雨夜灯光散景，香烟烟雾与雨丝交融。以暖色街灯为主光、冷色月光为辅光，采用高反差新黑色电影调色：深沉阴影、发光琥珀高光、冷蓝灰环境，并突出面部、眼睛、雨滴和大衣纹理。使用平视机位、85mm镜头、f/1.4超浅景深，眼睛清晰对焦，具有电影定格感和细微胶片颗粒。表现真实皮肤、羊毛和湿润反射的细节；排除卡通、动漫、插画、绘画感、塑料皮肤、脸部扭曲、错误解剖、多余肢体、低分辨率、过曝、现代物件或汽车、标志和文字。

items.title: 金色芝麻与翡翠杏仁的奇幻双生世界
items.description: 垂直镜像双联画中，一只中央玻璃瓶连接金色芝麻油丰收世界与翡翠杏仁奶热带世界，形成超现实饮料广告般的童话景观。
items.prompt: Create a vertical mirrored diptych surrealist storybook illustration with a contrasting fantasy world on each panel and an oversized elegant glass bottle as the shared focal point near the upper center. Left panel title: SESAME SILK. Theme warmth, harvest and golden sesame; use amber, golden brown, bronze, deep ochre and sunset orange. A crown of golden sesame seeds pours thick amber oil into the bottle, while rolling toasted-grain hills and autumn foliage surround a winding viscous golden-oil river flowing from the bottle base. Include sliced avocados, whole coconuts, scattered sesame seeds and small blue wildflowers. Add tiny stylized adult folk-art figures in traditional garments harvesting, boating on the oil river and interacting with giant seeds. Right panel title: ALMOND AMBROSIA. Theme freshness, vitality and almond ambrosia; use emerald green, sky blue, pale gold, deep purple and teal. A crown of purple grapes and almonds pours creamy white almond milk into the bottle, above a lush tropical forest with dense canopy and flowering vines. A winding sparkling blue-water river flows from the bottle base; include grape clusters, sliced avocados, coconuts, lush leaves and blue forget-me-not flowers. Add tiny stylized adult figures rowing wooden boats, swimming and gathering fruit along the banks. Use high-angle whimsical landscape perspective, strong miniature-people versus giant-fruit scale distortion, intricate seed and leaf textures, soft atmospheric lighting, glowing highlights and volumetric halos behind the bottles. Blend detailed digital painting, Maxfield Parrish-inspired luminous light, folk-art character design and polished commercial beverage-advertising art. Keep the diptych symmetry legible, both titles exact and typography restrained; avoid photorealism, muddy colors, broken bottle symmetry, illegible text, excessive clutter and harsh lighting.
