items.prompt_zh: 创建一幅垂直镜像双联画式的超现实童话幻想插画，让两个色彩对比鲜明的奇幻世界共享一个位于上方中央附近的超大优雅玻璃瓶作为焦点。左侧标题：SESAME SILK。主题是温暖、丰收与金色芝麻，使用琥珀色、金棕色、青铜色、深赭色和落日橙。一顶金色芝麻冠将浓稠琥珀油倒入瓶中；烤谷物山丘和秋色树叶环绕着一条从瓶底流出的蜿蜒粘稠金色油河。加入切片牛油果、整个椰子、散落芝麻和小蓝色野花，并安排身着传统服饰的微型风格化成年民间艺术人物收割、在油河上划船、与巨大种子互动。右侧标题：ALMOND AMBROSIA。主题是清新、活力与杏仁琼浆，使用翠绿色、天蓝色、淡金色、深紫色和青色。一顶紫色葡萄与杏仁冠将奶油状白色杏仁奶倒入瓶中，下方是拥有茂密树冠和开花藤蔓的葱郁热带森林。一条蜿蜒闪光的蓝色水河从瓶底流出；加入葡萄串、切片牛油果、椰子、茂盛绿叶和蓝色勿忘我花，并安排微型风格化成年人物在河上划木船、游泳和沿岸采摘水果。采用高角度异想风景视角，突出微型人物与巨大水果的比例失真，表现种子和叶片的复杂纹理、柔和氛围光、发光亮点及瓶后体积光晕。融合精细数字绘画、受 Maxfield Parrish 启发的辉光光线、民间艺术人物设计和精致商业饮料广告艺术。保持双联画对称关系清楚、两个标题准确且排版克制；避免写实摄影、浑浊色彩、瓶子对称破坏、难以辨认的文字、过度杂乱和生硬光线。

items.title: 巧夺天工的泰式西瓜雕刻二次元少女
items.description: 特写展示完整西瓜上的泰式水果雕刻：以棕发短双马尾、红眼和微尖锯齿牙为抽象脸部图案，重点表现瓜皮、白瓤与红肉的层次和刀工。
items.prompt: Create a masterpiece-quality, photorealistic close-up photograph of a whole watermelon carved in the center with a stylized anime-girl face motif: brown hair, short twin tails, red eyes and slightly pointed giza teeth, all represented only through Thai fruit-carving lines, reliefs, remaining skin, negative space and stepped layers—not as a real person. Use an oblique front three-quarter view; do not show the stem. The carving must have exceptionally intricate Thai fruit-carving craftsmanship, sculpted eyes made from watermelon skin, monochrome eyes with no iris or pupil color, and deep cuts that expose a graded red-flesh background. Emphasize the three-material contrast of green skin, white mesocarp and red flesh. Surround the motif with elegant rose and geometric reliefs, arabesque and floral carvings, and dimensional spiral patterns built from the green-and-white layer contrast. Show artisan knife texture and precise handwork. Place the watermelon on a silver tray over a tablecloth, lavishly surrounded by fresh strawberries, grapes, oranges and berries. Use bright natural light, vivid but believable color, shallow depth of field, high-resolution editorial food photography and an oblique close composition. Exclude the stem, iris, colored pupils, makeup, painted surfaces, skin tone, colored hair, illustration, drawing, flat 2D rendering, smooth uncarved skin, plain background, text, watermark and low quality.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张杰作级、超逼真的特写照片：一整个西瓜中央雕刻出抽象的二次元少女脸部图案，包括棕色头发、短双马尾、红色眼睛和略尖的锯齿牙；这些特征只能通过泰式水果雕刻线条、浮雕、保留的瓜皮、负空间和分层高度来表现，不是真人。采用斜前方的四分之三视角，不显示瓜蒂。雕刻必须体现极其精细的泰式水果雕刻工艺：用西瓜皮雕出眼睛，眼睛为无虹膜、无瞳孔着色的单色表达，并以深雕露出背景红色果肉的渐变。突出绿色瓜皮、白色瓜瓤和红色果肉三种材料的对比。角色图案周围环绕优雅的玫瑰与几何浮雕、蔓藤和花卉雕刻，并用绿皮与白瓤的层次对比形成三维螺旋纹样。表现雕刻刀痕和精确手工。将西瓜放在铺有桌布的银盘上，周围丰富摆放草莓、葡萄、橙子和浆果。使用明亮自然光、鲜艳但可信的色彩、浅景深、高分辨率编辑式美食摄影和斜角近距离构图。排除瓜蒂、虹膜、彩色瞳孔、化妆、彩绘表面、肤色、彩色头发、插画、绘画、平面二维效果、光滑未雕刻瓜皮、单调背景、文字、水印和低质量。

items.title: 高级感商业产品摄影光影质感呈现
items.description: 面向商业用途的单主体产品摄影模板，先明确用途与比例，再控制材质、具体背景色、统一自然柔光、极简文字和主体聚焦。
items.prompt: Create a premium commercial product photograph of a premium consumer product for a commercial campaign. Use a 4:5 vertical composition with one clearly dominant hero subject, a specific warm light gray background, and only the key visible materials: the product's essential surface materials. Illuminate the product with uniform, natural, soft light that reveals surface texture without harsh glare or distracting shadows. Keep the main subject sharply focused and the surrounding scene restrained. If text is included, use only minimal, quiet typography that supports rather than competes with the image. Prioritize commercial clarity, polished material rendering, clean composition, and a refined high-end finish; avoid vague backgrounds, clutter, uneven lighting, excessive props, decorative copy, and visual elements that obscure the product.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张用于商业宣传的高端商业产品摄影图，主体为一件高端消费品。采用4:5 竖幅构图，让单一英雄主体清晰占据主导；背景使用具体的暖浅灰色，只呈现关键可见材质：产品的核心表面材质。使用统一、自然、柔和的光线，表现表面纹理，同时避免刺眼反光和分散注意力的阴影。主体必须清晰对焦，周围环境保持克制。若加入文字，只使用支持画面的极简、安静排版，不得抢夺视觉焦点。优先保证商业表达清晰、材质渲染精致、构图干净和高端完成度；避免模糊背景、杂乱道具、光线不均、过度装饰文案以及遮挡产品的视觉元素。

items.title: 豪车后座黑裙东亚女性侧身看向镜头
items.description: 现代豪华轿车后排的成年东亚女性电影感生活方式肖像，人物侧身坐在棕色皮革座椅上越肩回望，午后窗光勾勒黑色长发与纯黑连衣裙。
items.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic lifestyle portrait of a single young adult East Asian woman in her twenties sitting sideways in the rear seat of a modern luxury car. Frame from above the head to near the waist and hips, placing her slightly right of center with her body facing the side window, back and left shoulder closer to the lens, then turning her head over her shoulder toward the camera. Keep the upper body naturally twisted, shoulders relaxed, and the right hand raised to the ear with fingertips gently tidying hair beside the face; the left arm rests naturally in front or falls out of frame. Give her direct eye contact, a very slight soft smile, and a gentle, confident, approachable expression like a candid moment during a journey. Use a slightly round oval face, soft jawline, bright dark-brown almond eyes, natural straight brows, slender nose bridge, hydrated nude-pink lips, clear light makeup, fine lashes, subtle liner, warm-brown shadow, soft pink blush, and fair warm skin with pores, fine fuzz, tonal variation, and soft natural highlights. Style deep-black ultra-long hair with thin straight bangs, length below the waist, soft large waves spread over her back and brown seat, realistic volume, weight, layers, flyaways, and restrained sheen. Dress her in a solid black sleeveless slim-fit dress with narrow or medium straps, shallow V or low-back structure, matte satin or fine elastic fabric following the natural waist, fully opaque, with no pattern or brand logo. Set the car interior with caramel or light-brown leather seats, black roof, dark door trim, broad side windows, softly blurred trees and road outside, and slight dust/reflections on the glass. Use soft afternoon sunlight entering diagonally from the right window to illuminate face, eyes, shoulders, and arms and create a delicate rim on the crown of the black hair; keep deep interior shadows detailed. Use low-saturation, low-contrast black, caramel brown, warm skin, and gray-green scenery. Apply a 50mm or 85mm lens look at f/2, close eye-level to slightly high camera position, shallow depth, creamy bokeh, crisp eyes, lips, fingers, hair strands, and believable fabric, leather, and glass textures, subtle film-like grain and gentle diffusion. Exclude frontal sitting, short hair, missing bangs, exaggerated smile, heavy makeup, incorrect car structure, deformed fingers, fused or repeated limbs, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, strong HDR, over-sharpening, CG, anime, text, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张电影感写实生活方式肖像，主体为单一一位二十多岁的年轻成年东亚女性，侧身坐在现代豪华轿车后排。画面从头顶取景至腰胯附近，人物位于中央略偏右，身体面向侧窗，背部和左肩更靠近镜头，再转头越过肩膀看向镜头。上半身自然扭转，肩膀放松；右手抬至耳边，指尖轻轻整理脸侧发丝，左臂自然放在身体前方或落出画面。她直视镜头，嘴角带极轻微的柔和笑意，神情温柔、自信、亲近，像旅途中被偶然记录的一刻。她拥有精致偏圆鹅蛋脸、柔和下颌线、明亮深棕杏仁眼、自然平直眉、纤细鼻梁和水润裸粉色嘴唇，妆容清透，带细长睫毛、轻微眼线、暖棕眼影和柔和粉色腮红；肤色白皙偏暖，保留毛孔、细小绒毛、自然色调变化和柔和高光。深黑色超长头发自然披散，整齐轻薄直刘海覆盖额头，发长延伸至腰部以下，带柔和大波浪，大部分铺展在背部和棕色座椅上，保留真实发量、重量、层次、碎发和低调光泽。穿纯黑无袖修身连衣裙，窄或中等宽度肩带，浅 V 或低背结构，哑光缎面或细腻弹力面料贴合自然腰线，完全不透明，无图案或品牌标志。车内为现代豪华轿车后排，包含焦糖棕或浅棕色真皮座椅、黑色车顶、深色车门饰板和宽大侧窗；窗外树木与道路柔和虚化，玻璃带轻微灰尘和反光。柔和午后阳光从右侧车窗斜射，照亮面部、眼睛、肩膀和手臂，并在黑发顶部形成细腻轮廓光；车内阴影深但保留细节。整体低饱和、低对比，以黑色、焦糖棕、暖肤色和灰绿色窗外景为主。采用 50mm 或 85mm 镜头感、f/2、近距离平视略高机位、浅景深和奶油色散景，确保眼睛、嘴唇、手指、发丝以及布料、皮革和玻璃纹理可信清晰；加入细微胶片颗粒和柔和扩散。排除正面坐姿、短发、无刘海、夸张笑容、浓妆、错误车内结构、手指畸形、手臂融合或重复肢体、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、强 HDR、过度锐化、CG、动漫、文字、水印或标志。

items.title: 室内写实银色细高跟鞋腿部特写
items.description: 约 3:4 竖幅室内手机时尚摄影，仅呈现坐姿成年女性的交叠腿部、脚部和白色百褶裙边缘，银色透明细高跟鞋与木地板纹理为视觉重点。
items.prompt: Create a realistic indoor mobile-phone fashion photograph in an approximately 3:4 vertical frame. Show only the legs, feet, and hem of the skirt of a seated adult woman; keep her face and upper body completely out of frame and do not reveal the full person. Her legs are naturally crossed and bent, with cool fair skin and clear ankle and instep lines. Place the hem of a white pleated mini skirt in the upper-right corner. Dress the feet in silver transparent strappy high-heeled sandals with square-toe soles, slender crystal-like transparent heels, and diamond-sparkle chain decoration across the uppers. Set the scene over a warm brown wooden floor with clearly visible grain; add a metal threshold or mirror frame as a horizontal line in the lower-left. Use soft indoor window light and warm reflections from the wood floor. Make the metal and crystal highlights on the sandals the sharpest details, while the leg skin is only gently softened. Preserve realistic shoe construction, natural leg anatomy, and visible floor texture. Keep the crop intentional and editorial, with no text, watermark, logo, full person, ordinary opaque heels, distorted feet, extra toes, or lost wood grain.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张真实的室内手机时尚摄影，画幅约为 3:4 竖幅。仅呈现坐姿成年女性的腿部、脚部和裙摆边缘，脸部与上半身必须完全不入画，不展示完整人物。双腿自然交叠并弯曲，皮肤为偏冷白色，脚踝和脚背线条清晰。将白色百褶短裙的裙摆放在画面右上角。双脚穿银色透明细高跟凉鞋，具有方头鞋底、透明水晶感细跟和鞋面闪钻链条装饰。背景为暖棕色木地板，清晰表现木纹；左下方加入金属门槛或镜面边框，形成横向线条。使用室内柔和窗光，并保留木地板的暖色反射。让鞋面金属与水晶高光成为最锐利的细节，腿部皮肤只做轻微柔化。保持真实鞋子结构、自然腿部解剖和可见地板纹理。保持裁切有意且具有编辑感，不出现文字、水印、标志、完整人物、普通不透明高跟鞋、脚部变形、多余脚趾或消失的木纹。

items.title: 动态模糊极简人像海报
items.description: 9:16 动态模糊人像海报模板，以一个清晰面部细节为锚点，结合有方向的光线、反射、运动拖影或半透明滤镜，并使用 LIGHT RESIDUE 系列与 2026 年份信息。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 editorial portrait poster built around light, directional motion blur, and selective focus. Subject: adult Asian fashion portrait. Custom title: AFTERIMAGE. Blur method: horizontal motion trail. Color palette: charcoal, electric cyan, and soft mint. Series label: LIGHT RESIDUE. Year: 2026. Keep one facial detail clearly recognizable, such as one eye, glasses, or the nose bridge, while the rest of the portrait gradually shifts through blur, reflection, colored light, or motion. The blur must have a clear direction and visible cause, never random defocus. Develop the selected visual direction as one coherent composition: SIGNAL CUT uses a sharp eye crossed by a vivid beam while hair and face stretch into horizontal trails; FILTER STATE shows the portrait through translucent colored acrylic panels with glasses and eyes crisp; PASSING FRAME keeps the subject still while blurred figures move through the foreground and a soft reflection appears behind; MINT STATIC dissolves a quiet portrait into mint haze while one eye remains visible inside the soft blur. Use realistic skin, natural hair, believable fabric, cinematic light, subtle grain, strong negative space, and restrained editorial layout. Keep typography minimal and readable: the supplied custom title, LIGHT RESIDUE, one short supporting line, and 2026. Let the title interact slightly with light or blur without losing legibility. Do not add unrelated text, logo, watermark, or extra faces.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张以光效、具有方向的动态模糊和选择性对焦为核心的 9:16 编辑风格人像海报。主体：adult Asian fashion portrait。自定义标题：AFTERIMAGE。模糊方式：horizontal motion trail。配色方案：charcoal, electric cyan, and soft mint。系列标识：LIGHT RESIDUE。年份：2026。保持一个面部细节清晰可辨，例如一只眼睛、眼镜或鼻梁，而人像其他部分通过模糊、反射、彩色光影或运动逐渐变化。模糊必须具有明确方向和可见成因，不能像随机失焦。将所选视觉方向发展为一个统一构图：SIGNAL CUT 以锐利的一只眼睛为锚点，让生动光束穿过，同时头发和脸部延伸成水平拖影；FILTER STATE 通过半透明彩色亚克力板观看时尚人像，同时保持眼镜和双眼清晰；PASSING FRAME 让主体静止清晰，模糊人物穿过前景，背后出现柔和倒影；MINT STATIC 让安静人像消散在薄荷色雾气中，同时在柔和动态模糊内保留一只可见眼睛。使用真实皮肤、自然头发、可信织物、电影感光效、细微颗粒、强烈留白和克制编辑排版。排版保持极简且可读：所提供的自定义标题、LIGHT RESIDUE、一行简短辅助说明和 2026。让标题与光影或模糊轻微互动，但不能失去可读性。不添加无关文字、徽标、水印或额外面孔。

items.title: 甜品店甜蜜互动生活抓拍
items.description: 3:4 单张手机生活抓拍：保留参考女性的外貌特征，一对成年亚洲男女在温馨甜品店靠窗座位互动，男生用勺子喂女生浅绿色冰淇淋，女生为主要焦点。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image only to preserve the referenced adult woman’s facial features, face shape, long straight black hair, natural skin texture, and overall temperament; do not copy the reference’s single-person pose. Reconstruct a single realistic 3:4 vertical mobile-phone lifestyle snapshot of two adult Asian people in a quiet, warm dessert shop window seat, with both people clearly visible. The referenced woman sits on a light-brown sofa chair by the window, wearing a light gray-brown sleeveless knitted long dress, hair naturally over her shoulders, body slightly turned toward the man, happy and slightly shy. A generic adult Asian man sits beside or diagonally opposite her, wearing a clean light-colored short-sleeve shirt or white T-shirt, short black hair, natural refreshing appearance, not a celebrity likeness, and visually secondary to the woman. He holds a dessert cup in one hand and a small spoon in the other, naturally offering a small bite of pale-green ice cream toward her mouth. She leans forward slightly with a gentle open mouth, smiling toward him or briefly toward the camera; he turns toward her with a relaxed gentle smile. Make the interaction, distance, hands, spoon, dessert cup, and mouth relationship physically clear and natural, as if a friend captured an unposed couple’s date moment. Add optional tissues, another dessert cup, and a phone on a wooden table. Use light walls, frosted glass windows, warm-brown seats, soft window daylight mixed with warm indoor light, close mobile-phone framing at near eye level. Keep the woman the main visual focus while the man’s full face and upper body remain visible. Preserve realistic skin texture, slight pores, stray hairs, clothing wrinkles, and casual snapshot imperfections. Keep the mood relaxed, sweet, and lifestyle-oriented, not a wedding photo, studio pose, or commercial advertisement. Exclude a cropped male face, third person, female holding the spoon herself, floating or intersecting spoon, malformed hands or extra arms, shared hands, facial distortion, excessive mouth opening, exaggerated intimacy, kissing, fake smiles, plastic skin, heavy smoothing, anime style, clutter, collage, four-grid layout, text, watermark, or garbled dessert-cup lettering.
items.prompt_zh: 仅使用上传的参考图来保持参考成年女性的五官、脸型、黑色长直发、自然肤质和整体气质一致，不照搬参考图的单人姿势。重新构建一张真实的 3:4 竖版手机生活抓拍照片，画面中是一对成年亚洲男女，坐在安静温馨的甜品店靠窗座位上，两个人都必须清晰入镜。参考女性坐在靠窗的浅棕色沙发椅上，穿浅灰棕色无袖针织长裙，黑色长直发自然披在肩上，身体微微面向男生，表情开心又略带害羞。男生为通用成年亚洲男性，坐在她旁边或斜对面，穿简洁的浅色短袖衬衫或白色 T 恤，黑色短发，外形自然清爽，不使用明星脸，视觉上不抢夺女性主体位置。他一只手拿甜品杯，另一只手拿小勺，自然地将一小口浅绿色冰淇淋递到她嘴边。女性微微前倾，轻轻张嘴准备吃下勺中冰淇淋，带笑看向男生，或短暂看向镜头；男生转头看她，表情温柔放松，嘴角带自然笑意。两人的互动、距离、手部、勺子、甜品杯和嘴部关系必须清晰且符合物理逻辑，像朋友无意间拍下情侣约会的自然瞬间。木桌上可放纸巾、另一杯甜品和一部手机。背景为浅色墙面、磨砂玻璃窗和暖棕色座椅，使用窗边柔和日光与室内暖光混合的照明，手机近距离拍摄，镜头高度接近人物视线。女性是主要视觉焦点，但男生的脸部和上半身必须完整可见。保留真实皮肤纹理、轻微毛孔、自然碎发、衣服褶皱和随手抓拍的不完美感。整体轻松、甜蜜、生活化，不呈现婚纱照、影楼摆拍或商业广告。排除男生脸部被裁切、第三个人、女性自己拿勺子、勺子悬空或穿过嘴巴、手部畸形、多余手臂、共用一只手、五官变形、过度张嘴、夸张亲密动作、接吻、假笑、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、动漫感、杂乱、拼贴、四宫格、文字、水印或甜品杯文字乱码。

items.title: 现代东方女性梦境立体剪纸艺术
items.description: 9:16 现代东方纸雕梦境海报：一位成年女性从层层绽放的巨大纸花中醒来，象征内在春天、柔软与生命力，整体采用杏粉奶油白纸艺和克制梦境意象。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical modern Oriental female dreamscape as layered paper-cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, and contemporary art-poster display. The theme is ‘Dreams grow from within the flower’: an adult Oriental woman wakes from a giant blooming paper flower that unfolds layer by layer, symbolizing spring regrowing within her heart and her acceptance of softness and vitality. Give her a soft oval face, bright almond eyes, gentle gaze, faint smile, clear natural features shaped in refined Oriental paper-art style, neither photorealistic nor overly cartoonish. Let long black hair fall naturally and connect to the cut-paper petals, constructed from flowing paper ribbons, dense cut strands, and light paper curves; add pearl-white paper flowers and small pale-gold branch-and-leaf ornaments. Dress her in an apricot-pink and cream-white layered paper-art formal gown with a petal-shaped spreading hem, dense cut floral-branch motifs at chest and cuffs, visible layered skirt, paper creases, hand-cut edges, and delicate fibers. Build the dreamscape from a giant blooming paper flower with flowers, vines, butterflies, clouds, glowing seeds, and distant mountains, all using one unified paper-cut and 3D paper-sculpture language. Center the woman as she rises from the opening flower core, gently holding outer petals; let skirt and petals unfold downward together while butterflies fly upward beside her. Establish clear front-to-back paper layers, distributing restrained dream imagery across foreground, middle ground, and background without obscuring her face or body outline. Use apricot pink, cream white, and champagne gold as main colors with a small misty-purple accent; keep layers clear and pure, coordinated but not covered by a single filter, never gray, dirty yellow, or globally color-cast. Use soft warm-white overhead light, slight glow through petal edges, transparent layered shadows, visible paper fibers, subtle creases, hand-cut edges, hollow motifs, and delicate light transmission. Make the result feel like a modern Oriental art poster, paper-sculpture display cabinet, and 3D paper installation: fresh, luminous, complete, spatially clear, and character-centered. Exclude minors, juvenile features, real-life photography, ordinary anime, plastic 3D, resin, clay, felt, child-craft appearance, Spring Festival window grilles, zodiac cutouts, monochrome red paper-cutting, disconnected materials, missing or messy layers, dead-black shadows, gray cast, excessive stacking, blocked face, deformed hands, extra characters, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张 9:16 竖版现代东方女性梦境画面，采用层叠剪纸插画、立体纸雕、精细纸雕刻、纸艺微缩景观和当代艺术海报展示语言。主题为“梦从花朵内部生长”：一位东方成年女性从一朵层层绽放的巨大纸花中醒来，花朵象征她内心重新生长的春天，以及她终于接纳自己的柔软与生命力。她拥有柔和鹅蛋脸、明亮杏眼、温和眼神和浅浅微笑，五官清晰自然，以精致东方纸艺方式塑形，既不使用真人摄影质感，也不过度卡通化。黑色长发自然披落并与剪纸花瓣连接，由流动纸带、细密镂空发丝和轻盈纸张弧线构成；佩戴珍珠白纸花和小型浅金枝叶发饰。为她穿杏粉与奶油白的多层纸艺礼裙，裙摆由花瓣形纸片向外舒展，胸口和袖口带细密花枝镂空纹样，清晰表现层叠裙摆、纸张折痕、手工裁切边缘和细腻纤维。梦境由巨型盛放纸花展开，加入花朵、花藤、蝴蝶、云层、发光种子和远山，所有元素统一使用剪纸与立体纸雕语言。让人物位于中央，从正在打开的巨大花芯中站起，双手轻轻扶住外层花瓣；裙摆与花瓣共同向下展开，蝴蝶从身侧向上飞起。建立清晰的前后纸层关系，将克制的梦境意象分布在前景、中景和背景，不遮挡人物面部和身体轮廓。主色为杏粉、奶油白和香槟金，加入少量雾紫点缀；不同纸层保持清晰纯净、协调但不被单一滤镜覆盖，画面不灰、不脏黄、不整体偏色。使用从上方落下的柔和暖白光，让花瓣边缘轻微发光，形成通透的纸层阴影，并表现纸张纤维、细微折痕、手工裁切边缘、镂空纹样和轻微透光。整体具有现代东方艺术海报、纸雕展柜和立体纸艺装置展示感，清新明亮、构图完整、空间层次清晰，人物始终是第一视觉中心。排除未成年人、幼态特征、真人摄影、普通动漫、塑料 3D、树脂、黏土、毛毡、儿童手工感、春节窗花、生肖剪纸、单色大红剪纸、人物与背景材质割裂、缺少或混乱纸层、暗部死黑、灰蒙偏色、元素过度堆积、遮挡面部、手部畸形、多余人物、文字、标志或水印。

items.title: 顶级国际豪宅建筑销售海报设计
items.description: 超高级国际豪宅销售海报：上方大气天空与漂浮建筑分解图，下方锚定超写实旗舰销售展馆，结合克制英文品牌排版、浅石材、香槟金属和雨后城市前场。
items.prompt: Create an ultra-premium vertical architectural sales poster for a fictional international luxury real-estate developer. The architecture is the absolute visual hero. Use a disciplined top-heavy hierarchy with vast atmospheric negative space: the upper two-thirds are a luminous pale silver-blue, misty pearl, and cool warm-gray sky field; the lower third anchors a hyper-real flagship sales pavilion and branded residence showcase in a pristine urban frontage. At upper center, float a precise exploded architectural line diagram corresponding exactly to the building below, with several separated layers in vertical alignment, ultra-thin white drafting lines, generous spacing, subtle construction guides, and museum-grade weightlessness. At top center integrate only this elegant English typography, with refined spacing and no Chinese headline: “LUMERA LAND”, “LUMERA HORIZON PAVILION”, “DESIGNED FOR THE FUTURE OF LIVING”, “Flagship Sales Gallery and Residence Vision”. Add only a few tiny English specification notes if necessary. Use a sculptural contemporary building with softened corners, disciplined massing, elegant vertical facade fins, pale mineral stone, satin champagne metal, ultra-clear glazing, warm timber undertones, and gentle warm interior glow. Make it residential-luxury and hospitality-grade, internationally high-end, buildable, iconic, simple, and memorable rather than a generic commercial building. Show a broad open street and lightly reflective wet ground, very controlled reflections, minimal edge landscaping, only a few understated pedestrians and refined vehicles for scale, and little distant urban context. Use very soft post-rain morning or bright overcast daylight, luminous airy diffusion, even natural illumination, subtle highlights on stone, metal, and glass, and a gentle interior glow. Render dense smooth stone, premium satin metal, architecturally accurate clear glass, razor-clean fin rhythm, believable wet pavement, road markings, curb lines, and physical material detail. Maintain a three-layer reading order: refined title typography, floating exploded diagram, and hyper-real architecture below. Use an internationalist asymmetric grid, modular columns, baseline rhythm, restrained geometric sans-serif typography, optical alignment, and generous whitespace; let the cover feel calm, spacious, collectible, intelligent, aspirational, and softly cinematic. Treat any high-resolution reference as style guidance rather than a promise of a specific output resolution. Exclude cheap brochure design, crude bold fonts, generic mall advertising, cluttered infographics, fantasy architecture, dirty city, excessive people, low-detail facade, inaccurate diagram, weak linework, oversaturated sky, HDR glare, cartoon or plastic materials, chaotic composition, noisy reflections, extra text, watermark, or unrelated logos.
items.prompt_zh: 为虚构的国际奢侈房地产开发商创建一张超高级纵向建筑销售海报，建筑必须是绝对视觉主角。采用自律的头重脚轻层级：上方三分之二为明亮的浅银蓝、雾珍珠和冷暖灰色大气天空，保留广阔留白；下方三分之一在纯净城市临街面上锚定超写实旗舰销售展馆与品牌住宅展示建筑。上方中心漂浮一张与下方建筑精确对应的建筑分解线框图，多个分离层垂直对齐，以超细白色绘图线、宽松层间距、微妙辅助线和近似博物馆展品的轻盈感呈现。顶部中心只整合以下优雅英文排版，间距精致，不使用中文标题：“LUMERA LAND”、“LUMERA HORIZON PAVILION”、“DESIGNED FOR THE FUTURE OF LIVING”、“Flagship Sales Gallery and Residence Vision”。如有需要，仅添加少量微小英文规格说明。建筑采用带柔化边角的雕塑感现代形式、克制体量、优雅垂直立面格栅、浅色矿物石材、缎面香槟金属、超清玻璃、温暖木纹底色和轻柔室内暖光。建筑应具有住宅奢侈感和酒店级品质，国际化、高端、可建造、标志性、简洁难忘，而不是普通商业建筑。环境为宽阔开放街道与轻微反射的湿润地面，反射高度受控，边缘景观极少，只加入少数低调行人和精致车辆表现尺度，以及少量远处城市背景。使用极柔和的雨后清晨光或明亮阴天日光，天空通透明亮、漫射细腻，建筑获得均匀自然光，石材、金属和玻璃边缘带微妙高光，室内光线轻柔发亮。真实表现致密平滑石材、高级缎面金属、符合建筑精度的清澈玻璃、利落格栅节奏、可信湿路面、道路标线、路缘线和物理材质细节。维持三层阅读顺序：精致标题排版、漂浮分解图、下方超写实建筑。采用国际主义非对称网格、模块列、基线节奏、克制几何无衬线字体、光学对齐和充足留白，使海报平静、宽敞、收藏级、理性、向往且带柔和电影感。将高分辨率描述视为风格参考，不承诺特定输出分辨率。排除廉价宣传册、粗糙粗体字、普通商场广告、杂乱信息图、幻想建筑、肮脏城市、过多人物、低细节立面、不准确分解图、虚弱线稿、过饱和天空、HDR 强光、卡通或塑料材质、混乱构图、嘈杂反射、额外文字、水印或无关徽标。

items.title: 雨后青石巷古风仙侠叙事感女主写真
items.description: 9:16 古风仙侠叙事肖像：一位 20–28 岁成年东方女性撑油纸伞走过雨后青石巷，清雅玉绿白金造型与柔亮雨后天光营造角色海报感。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical, high-detail ancient-style Xianxia narrative portrait with an elegant, implicit, pensive, gentle story-driven mood. Show a single adult Eastern woman with an approximate visual age of 20–28, clearly Eastern in appearance, not juvenile, Westernized, or influencer-styled. Give her refined light features, a smooth elegant facial contour, clear long eyes with a gentle thoughtful gaze, delicate nose, soft natural lips, and naturally clear, moist skin. Use transparent fairy-like makeup: light thin luminous base, softly blended pale gray-pink, soft brown, and light-jade eye tones, thin natural liner, naturally long lashes, subtly highlighted tear troughs, restrained blush, and low-saturation bean-paste pink, light rose, or clear moist lips. Style black long hair half-down and half-pinned, with soft volume, natural smooth strands, a few rain-damp flyaways near the face, light-gold hairpins, small white-jade ornaments, fine bead tassels, small flowers, restrained jade accents, and slender jade or pearl earrings. Dress her in a cross-collar top, layered long skirt, and light gauze shawl in a medium-opulence ancient-style female-lead costume. Use jade green, blue-white jade, soft cyan-green, white, cream, moon white, light gold, white jade, and a small amount of turquoise as the palette. Render gauze, silk-like chiffon, embroidered tulle, layered fabric, cloud, vine, small-flower, jade-leaf, or simplified baoxiang embroidery, with the shawl falling softly. Have her walk through a rain-washed bluestone alley holding an oil-paper umbrella. Capture the instant she gently looks back from a diagonal rear angle, emphasizing side profile and upper body. One hand holds the umbrella naturally; the other lightly touches the shawl or sleeve or hangs relaxed. Use a softly blurred alley, umbrella shadows, distant ancient walls, wet stone reflections, distant blurred umbrellas, and clean post-rain air. Light with bright soft post-rain sky light; let subtle ground reflections edge the hair tips, clothing, and silhouette. Keep the rain feeling transparent and fresh, never dirty gray or gloomy. Make the woman the absolute visual center, with clear hair strands, makeup, garment layers, natural anatomy, refined cinematic poster finish, and no added text, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张 9:16 竖版高细节古风仙侠叙事感肖像，整体气质清雅、含蓄、若有所思、温婉且富有故事感。画面展示单一一位视觉年龄约 20–28 岁的成年东方女性，外观明确具有东方特征，不幼态化、不欧美化、不呈现网红脸。她拥有精致淡雅的五官、清秀流畅的面部轮廓、清亮长眼和温和若有所思的眼神，鼻型秀气，唇形柔软自然，肌肤清透且带自然清润感。使用清透仙气妆：轻薄柔润底妆，淡灰粉、柔棕和浅玉色眼影轻柔晕染，纤细自然眼线、自然纤长睫毛、轻微提亮卧蚕、克制腮红，以及低饱和粉豆沙、浅玫瑰或清淡水润唇色。黑色长发半披半挽，发顶柔和蓬松，发丝自然顺滑，几缕雨后碎发贴近脸侧；佩戴浅金发簪、白玉小饰件、细珠流苏、小花和克制玉石点缀，耳饰为细长玉坠或珍珠小坠。服装为对襟上襦、层叠长裙和轻纱披帛，属于中等华丽度古风女主造型。配色以玉绿、青白玉、柔和浅青绿为主，辅以白、乳白、月白，点缀浅金、白玉和少量松石色。表现轻纱、绢感雪纺、刺绣薄纱和层叠面料，并加入云纹、细藤蔓、小花、玉叶或简化宝相纹刺绣；披帛轻柔垂落。让她撑着油纸伞走过雨后青石巷，镜头从斜后方捕捉她轻轻回眸的一瞬，突出侧脸和上半身。一只手自然撑伞，另一只手轻扶披帛或衣袖，或自然下垂。背景为虚化青石巷、伞影、远处古墙、湿润石板反光、远处虚化行伞和清亮雨后空气。使用柔亮的雨后天光，让地面反光轻微勾勒人物轮廓、发梢和衣摆边缘。雨感保持干净通透，不脏灰、不阴沉。人物必须是绝对视觉中心，发丝、妆面和服装层次清晰，人体自然，整体具有精致电影感角色海报质感，不添加文字、水印或标志。

items.title: 国际主义纪实风格城市韧性防涝报告设计
items.description: 16:9、10 页报告型 PPT 设计，使用大尺度雨后城市纪实摄影、国际主义网格、暴雨蓝紫与荧光黄警示色，复盘海岚市 2026 汛期城市韧性防涝行动。
items.prompt: Design a 10-page, 16:9 report-style presentation titled ‘Review of Hailan City’s Urban Resilience and Flood Prevention Actions’ for the 2026 flood-season assessment. Build the visual system around large-scale documentary photography and clear information architecture: modular and baseline grids lock columns, margins, title rhythm, and body rhythm; Gestalt proximity and common-region grouping create scannable blocks; editorial pacing alternates main-visual pages, whitespace information pages, and multi-column data pages. Use an asymmetric mathematical grid for alignment, radical documentary cropping and image scale for narrative pauses, a restrained geometric sans-serif system and unified components for consistency, and adjacent-color relationships to calibrate chapter tabs and information cards without mechanically imitating any named historical design method. Establish replaceable color roles: main visual field 55–70% in medium-dark, medium-high-saturation values while retaining natural tonal range; paper background 20–35% in bright low-saturation cold gray-white; structural text 8–15% in near-black with strong projection contrast; chapter coding and key prompts 3–8% in equally weighted high-purity colors with visible temperature and saturation jumps. If themes or brand colors change, map them once across visual, background, text, coding, and prompt roles while preserving area ratios, brightness sequence, chroma difference, adjacency, and contrast intensity. Use asymmetric multi-column pages. The cover uses a large rounded-corner high-angle aerial view of the city after rain running through the left side, with oversized time information and short title stacked on the right. Theme pages combine small logos, theme titles, and oversized time into three reading stages. Content pages combine column text, equal-height cards, narrow edge-aligned chapter tabs, occasional cross-column titles or photographs, single-point folded card corners, and a reading order of title/focal image, summary, then details. Photography uses real ambient light, subtle grain, near-to-far brightness compression, natural tone correction before rounded-mask cropping, retained edge detail and local highlights. Information pages use matte textureless backgrounds, low-opacity outline numbers, single-line geometric icons, and thin color bars synthesized as background, image/card, structural lines, text, then coding. Pair geometric sans-serifs: oversized bold condensed display type can cross columns or become hollow outlines over photography; regular, more widely spaced body text; smaller, more widely tracked captions; align Chinese and English by optical blackness and correct optical margins around numbers, full-width punctuation, and rounded boundaries. Keep body copy away from busy images. Use storm blue-purple as the main visual, cold gray-white background, fluorescent yellow prompts, and near-black structural text. Inner pages use diagonal event trajectories, unequal narrow/wide double columns, partial cross-column risk maps, rotating full-page conclusions, right-aligned numbered titles, compact time review, generous risk-explanation whitespace, and denser action lists. Include these ten pages: 01 Cover—Keeping the city running during heavy rain, 2026 flood-season review and assessment date; 02 Heavy-rain stress test—hourly precipitation peaks, water spread, traffic disruption, and response chain; 03 Risk Map—low-lying areas, population density, critical facilities, drainage capacity, five high-risk unit types and prioritization basis; 04 Engineering Defense Line—pump-station expansion, pipeline repair, storage, sponge facilities, completed/under construction/gaps; 05 Digital Early Warning Chain—weather monitoring, model forecast, graded warning, grassroots reach, lead time and arrival rate; 06 Cross-departmental Emergency Coordination—real disposal handoffs, time, and bottlenecks among urban management, transport, fire, sub-districts, and utilities; 07 Community Micro-resilience—underground spaces, people living alone in old age, schools, merchants, plans, material points, and volunteer-network coverage; 08 Flood-season Result Comparison—same-level historical rainfall, waterlogging-point count, recession duration, suspension time, and loss change, not inputs alone; 09 Three Exposed Shortcomings—old pipeline blind spots, warning-terminal breaks, nighttime coordination gaps, each with evidence, impact scope, and priority; 10 Before the Next Heavy Rain—90-day repairs, annual expansion, three-year upgrades, responsible departments, completion standards, and public inquiry portals. Make the overall presentation credible, clear, pragmatic, open, organic, and action-oriented, with no invented statistics, logos, or unsupported data.
items.prompt_zh: 设计一套 10 页、16:9 的报告型 PPT，标题为《海岚市城市韧性防涝行动复盘》，用于 2026 汛期评估。以大尺度纪实摄影和清晰信息架构建立视觉系统：用模块网格与基线网格锁定列宽、边距、标题节奏和正文节奏；用格式塔接近律与共同区域将内容组织为可扫读板块；用编辑节奏交替安排主视觉页、留白信息页和分栏数据页。使用非对称数学网格统领对齐，以纪实摄影的激进裁切和影像尺度制造叙事停顿，以克制的几何无衬线字体和统一组件保持一致，并用相邻色域关系校准章节色签和信息卡，但不要机械临摹任何被提及的历史设计方法。建立可替换的色彩角色：主视觉场占 55%–70%，使用中暗值、中高饱和度并保留自然明暗层次；纸面背景占 20%–35%，使用高明度低饱和冷灰白；结构文字占 8%–15%，使用近黑色并保持强投影反差；章节编码与关键提示占 3%–8%，使用等权高纯度色，在相邻模块间形成明显冷暖和饱和度跳变。主题或品牌色变化时，只替换一次，并按主视觉、背景、文字、编码和提示逐项映射，同时保持面积比例、明度序列、色度差、邻接关系和对比强度。页面采用非对称多栏网格。封面左侧用贯穿上下的大圆角雨后城区高位俯视纪实影像，右侧堆叠超大时间信息和短标题；主题页以小型标识、主题标题和超大时间形成三段阅读。内容页组合分栏文本、等高卡片、贴边窄幅章节色签，允许标题或摄影局部跨列，以单一指向折角收束信息卡，并按标题或焦点影像、摘要、细节的顺序阅读。摄影使用真实环境光、细微颗粒和由近及远的明度压缩，先做自然影调校正，再以圆角遮罩裁切，保留边缘细节和局部高光。信息页使用无纹理哑光底，叠加低透明度轮廓数字、单线几何图标和细色条，按背景、影像或卡片、结构线、文字、编码的顺序合成。搭配同骨架几何无衬线字体：超大、粗窄的展示字可跨列或转为空心描边并压叠在摄影上；正文使用常规字重和较大行距；说明文字更小且字距更宽；中英文按光学黑度对齐，并校正数字、全角标点和圆角边界的光学边距，正文避开繁复影像。以暴雨蓝紫为主视觉、冷灰白为背景、荧光黄为提示色、近黑为结构文字。内页采用斜向事件轨迹、窄宽不等双栏、局部跨列风险地图和满页结论轮换；标题右对齐并以编号先行，时间复盘紧凑，风险解释留白，行动清单再次提高密度。包含以下 10 页：01 封面——让城市在暴雨中保持运行，锁定 2026 汛期复盘主题与评估日期；02 暴雨压力测试——按小时呈现降雨峰值、积水扩散、交通受阻和响应链；03 风险地图——叠加低洼片区、人口密度、关键设施和排水能力，识别五类高风险单元及优先级依据；04 工程防线——呈现泵站扩容、管网修复、调蓄空间和海绵设施，区分已完成、在建和待补缺口；05 数字预警链——说明气象监测、模型预报、分级预警和基层触达，使用提前量和到达率验证效能；06 跨部门应急协同——通过真实处置流程展示城管、交通、消防、街道和公共事业单位的任务交接、耗时和堵点；07 社区微韧性——聚焦地下空间、独居老人、学校和商户，说明社区预案、物资点和志愿网络覆盖；08 汛期结果对照——将本年度与历史同等级降雨对比，呈现积水点数量、退水时长、停运时间和损失变化，不只报告投入；09 暴露出的三处短板——明确老旧管网盲区、预警末端断点和夜间协同不足，分别给出证据、影响范围和整改优先级；10 下一场暴雨前——形成 90 天修补、年度扩容和三年系统升级路线，落实责任部门、完成标准和公众查询入口。整体呈现可信、清朗、务实、开放、有机且行动导向，不编造统计数据、徽标或无依据的信息。

items.title: 极简建筑背景Vogue奢华时尚大片
items.description: 极简奢华建筑前的成年女性高端时尚活动肖像，以低机位广角、黄金时刻光线、奶油色针织长裙和指定配饰呈现杂志封面质感。
items.prompt: Create an ultra-photorealistic luxury fashion campaign portrait of an adult woman standing confidently in front of a minimalist luxury building. Shift one hip naturally into a graceful S-curve; have one hand hold the specified black Hermès handbag while the other gently adjusts black sunglasses. Let her hair move softly in a light breeze. Style her in a cream ribbed sleeveless knit maxi dress, black sunglasses, Valentino pearl earrings, a brown Hermès watch, the black Hermès handbag, and nude Christian Louboutin pointed flats. Use a very low-angle wide composition with strong but controlled perspective, a 35mm lens look, and magazine-cover framing. Light the scene with golden-hour luxury cinematic sunlight and high-end fashion contrast. Aim for an editorial masterpiece with premium luxury-campaign polish, Vogue-style cover composition, refined Leica-like color rendering, realistic skin, fabric, leather, metal, and pearl materials, and extremely high photographic detail. Treat the camera and resolution references as visual style guidance rather than a promise of a specific device or 8K output. Do not add visible text, watermark, or unrelated logos beyond the specified product identity details.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张超写实的奢华时尚活动肖像，主角是一位自信站在极简奢华建筑前的成年女性。一侧胯部自然偏移，使身体形成优雅的 S 型曲线；一只手拎着指定的黑色爱马仕手提包，另一只手轻轻调整黑色墨镜。让头发在微风中轻柔飘动。为她搭配奶油色罗纹无袖针织长裙、黑色墨镜、华伦天奴珍珠耳环、棕色爱马仕手表、黑色爱马仕手提包和肉色克里斯提·鲁布托尖头平底鞋。采用极低角度的宽阔构图、强烈但受控的透视、35mm 镜头感和杂志封面式取景。使用黄金时刻的奢华电影感阳光和高端时尚对比度。整体呈现编辑级杰作、高级奢华活动质感、Vogue 风格封面构图、精致的徕卡式色彩表现，以及真实的皮肤、织物、皮革、金属和珍珠材质与极高摄影细节。将相机和分辨率描述视为视觉风格参考，不承诺特定设备或 8K 输出。除指定产品身份细节外，不添加可见文字、水印或无关徽标。

items.title: 东亚女性油菜花田超写实时尚摄影
items.description: 无边油菜花田中的成年东亚女性时尚旅行写真，以回眸、邀请式伸手、蓝天绿山、黄金时刻光线和高级写实摄影为核心。
items.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic editorial fashion photograph of a single adult East Asian woman standing in the middle of an endless blooming yellow rapeseed field beneath a crystal-clear deep-blue sky. Capture her from a slightly low-angle three-quarter side profile as she turns her head toward the camera with a calm, dreamy expression. Extend one arm naturally toward the viewer as if inviting them to follow, creating strong depth and perspective; keep her posture relaxed with a subtle body twist, open shoulders, and natural movement. Give her shoulder-length silky black hair with soft wispy bangs, natural makeup, glossy coral lips, dark almond-shaped eyes, realistic skin texture, and a tiny beauty mark near her cheek. Dress her in a delicate white floral corset camisole with thin straps, a white lace ribbon around her neck, a loose oversized blue plaid overshirt draped off one shoulder, and a flowing high-waisted white skirt; add a simple wooden bracelet. Show vibrant flowers stretching to the horizon, rolling green mountains, and an intense cloudless summer sky. Use bright golden-hour sunlight with soft natural highlights on face and hair, realistic shadows, cinematic depth, and rich color contrast. Use the look of an 85mm f/1.4 fashion lens, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, crisp facial focus, realistic fabric folds, individual hair strands, natural color grading, high dynamic range, premium travel-editorial photography, and vibrant colors. Keep anatomy and proportions natural and exclude text, watermark, logo, artifacts, distortion, extra fingers, and over-smoothed skin. Treat the camera and resolution references as visual style guidance, not a promise of a specific device or output resolution.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张超写实时尚编辑摄影作品，主体为单一一位成年东亚女性，站在无边无际盛开的黄色油菜花田中央，头顶是晶莹清澈的深蓝色天空。采用略微低角度的四分之三侧面视角拍摄，她转头看向镜头，神情平静而梦幻。一只手臂自然向观众伸出，仿佛邀请对方跟随，形成强烈的深度和透视；姿态保持放松，身体轻微扭转，双肩舒展，动作自然。她留着齐肩丝滑黑发和柔软稀疏的刘海，妆容自然，嘴唇为水润珊瑚色，眼睛深色呈杏仁形，皮肤保留真实纹理，脸颊旁有一颗微小美人痣。她穿精致白色花朵紧身胸衣吊带背心和细肩带，颈部系白色蕾丝丝带，一件宽松蓝色格子大衬衫随意搭在一侧肩膀上，下身为飘逸高腰白裙；手腕佩戴简单木质手镯。背景展示延伸至地平线的鲜艳黄花、起伏绿山和浓烈无云的夏日天空。使用明亮黄金时刻阳光，在脸部和头发上形成柔和自然高光，同时保留真实阴影、电影般深度和丰富色彩对比。采用 85mm f/1.4 时尚镜头感、浅景深、奶油色散景、清晰面部对焦、真实织物褶皱、单根发丝、自然色彩分级、高动态范围、高级旅行编辑摄影和鲜艳色彩。保持人体解剖和比例自然，排除文字、水印、标志、人工痕迹、扭曲、多余手指和过度磨皮。将相机与分辨率描述视为视觉风格参考，不承诺特定设备或输出分辨率。

items.title: 新中式极简东方意境海报
items.description: 新中式极简文化海报：雾中显现的中国古建筑与传统凉亭置于宁静东方园林，以翠绿象牙色、留白、水彩纸张质感和清晨漫射光营造诗意意境。
items.prompt: Create a minimal New Chinese aesthetic Oriental poster design. Show ancient Chinese architecture emerging from mist, centered on a traditional pavilion with an elegant curved roof, within a quiet Oriental garden. Use a jade-green and ivory palette, large negative space, soft watercolor texture, translucent architectural details, and a tiny generic human silhouette for scale. Convey a misty morning atmosphere with soft diffused light and high-key photographic brightness. Blend Japanese editorial design, luxury cultural branding, paper texture, matte finish, low saturation, cinematic composition, and a quiet poetic mood. Keep the architecture refined and legible, the silhouette unobtrusive, and the poster free of added text or logos.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张新中式美学的极简东方海报设计。画面表现从迷雾中显现的中国古建筑，以带有优雅曲线屋顶的传统凉亭为中心，置于宁静的东方园林中。使用翠绿色与象牙色调、大面积留白、柔和水彩纹理、半透明建筑细节，并加入一个用于表现尺度的微小通用人物剪影。营造雾蒙蒙的清晨氛围，使用柔和漫射光和高调摄影亮度。融合日式编辑设计、奢华文化品牌感、纸张纹理、磨砂质感、低饱和度、电影感构图与宁静诗意。保持建筑精致清晰，人物剪影不喧宾夺主，不添加额外文字或徽标。

items.title: 复古扁平矢量城市旅游海报插画
items.description: 复古扁平矢量旅游海报模板，融合城市传统遗产、现代地标、当地生活、自然元素，并在底部显示城市与国家名称。
items.prompt: Create a retro flat-vector travel poster for Kyoto, Japan, blending traditional heritage with modern landmarks. Include iconic architecture, local people in traditional clothing, lively street scenes, natural elements, and recognizable city landmarks. Use a clean vintage travel aesthetic with bold geometric shapes, vibrant colors, and a cohesive limited palette. Add a bold sans-serif title at the bottom showing Kyoto, with Japan underneath; render these supplied names clearly and accurately. Keep the illustration graphic, polished, and poster-ready, with no additional invented logos or text.
items.prompt_zh: 为 Kyoto、Japan 创作一张复古扁平矢量旅游海报，将传统遗产与现代地标融合在一起。画面包含标志性建筑、穿着传统服饰的当地人、活跃的街道场景、自然元素以及易于识别的城市地标。使用整洁的复古旅游美学、大胆的几何形状、鲜艳的色彩和统一的有限配色。在底部添加粗体无衬线标题，清晰准确地显示所提供的 Kyoto，并在下方显示 Japan；不要额外编造徽标或文字。保持插画具有图形感、精致且适合海报输出。

items.title: 纵向商业摄影活动海报设计模板
items.description: 3:4 纵向品牌活动海报模板，以动态角色将产品伸向镜头，结合可读的空间化核心词、强透视和完整商业信息布局。
items.prompt: Create a vertical 3:4 commercial campaign poster for a fictional beverage brand. Brand: NOVA. Product: NOVA Spark. Main word: BOOST. Tagline: Rise into motion. Color palette: cobalt blue, white, and electric lime. Model: adult lifestyle character. Key features: fresh taste, light carbonation, portable can, recyclable packaging. Use oversized bold typography with a strong one-point or diagonal perspective. Integrate BOOST into the scene as a giant wall, corridor, street, stage, or spatial structure with clear depth and readable letterforms. Place adult lifestyle character near the center. The character holds NOVA Spark and extends that hand toward the camera, creating an exaggerated foreground and a strong 3D wide-angle effect. Make the product the closest, largest, and sharpest element, followed by the character in the midground and giant typography in the background. Keep the product shape accurate, realistic, and clearly branded. Add controlled secondary details appropriate to the product, such as condensation, ice, bubbles, fruit, sauce, steam, or packaging elements. Include a complete campaign layout with NOVA, feature icons, vertical side text, campaign number, release date, product details, barcode, and micro typography using only supplied values; distribute information across lower corners and side margins, with no thick footer bar covering the character. Use high-resolution commercial-photography styling, realistic skin and materials, strong perspective, dynamic pose, polished brand design, and high visual impact.
items.prompt_zh: 为虚构的 beverage 品牌创建一张纵向 3:4 商业活动海报。品牌：NOVA。产品：NOVA Spark。核心词：BOOST。标语：Rise into motion。配色方案：cobalt blue, white, and electric lime。模特：adult lifestyle character。主要特征：fresh taste、light carbonation、portable can、recyclable packaging。使用超大的粗体排版，采用强烈的一点透视或对角线透视。将 BOOST 融入场景，使其成为巨型墙壁、走廊、街道、舞台或空间结构，并具有清晰深度和可读的字母形状。将 adult lifestyle character 放置在构图中心附近。角色手持 NOVA Spark，并将握住产品的手向摄像机伸出，营造夸张前景和强烈的 3D 广角效果。产品应是距离最近、尺寸最大且最清晰的元素，其次是中景角色，背景为巨型排版。保持产品形状准确、写实且品牌标志清晰。根据产品添加冷凝水、冰、气泡、水果、酱汁、蒸汽或包装元素等受控的次要细节。加入完整活动布局，使用所提供的值呈现 NOVA、特征图标、垂直侧边文字、活动编号、发布日期、产品详情、条形码和微型排版；将信息分布在下角和侧边，不能用厚重底部栏遮挡角色。采用高分辨率商业摄影风格、真实皮肤和材质、强烈透视、动态姿势、精致品牌设计和高视觉冲击力。

items.title: 被低估发明家收藏级艺术玩具发布视觉图
items.description: 4 格 16:9 收藏级设计师艺术玩具发布视觉图模板，以每位被低估发明家的身份、职业、故事和成就推导人偶、配件与包装设计。
items.prompt: Create a 2x2 grid in a 16:9 composition showing four underrated inventors who deserved more credit. For each the supplied underrated inventor, generate a collector-grade designer art-toy launch visual. Infer infer from supplied subject information only from the supplied subject information, including identity, profession, story, achievements, and symbolic world; do not invent unsupported biographical claims. Make a large pristine hero figure the dominant center-left object in each panel, designed as a premium collectible art toy rather than a normal portrait. Infer an iconic outfit, pose, facial expression, scale, materials, and one signature handheld object from the subject’s supplied identity. Arrange infer from identity, profession, story, achievements, and symbolic world around each figure in clean product-display clusters, with every accessory grounded in the subject’s profession, story, achievements, or symbolic world. Include an alternate figure or variant. Show premium packaging with a window box, restrained foil details, side illustration, collector markings, and edition branding. Include an authenticity card, rarity indicator, sticker sheet, scale reference, and material-feature callouts. Make each panel feel like a luxury drop reveal, product catalog, and museum gift-shop collectible at once. Keep the four panels coherent but distinct. Do not hard-code any person, outfit, object, color, text, logo, quote, accessory, box design, or edition number unless supplied in the subject data; render any packaging text only when  is supplied and keep otherwise unreadable or absent.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张 16:9 的 2x2 网格图，展示 4 位本应获得更多赞誉却被低估的发明家。针对每个 the supplied underrated inventor，生成一张收藏级设计师艺术玩具发布视觉图。根据所提供的主体信息推断 infer from supplied subject information only，包括身份、职业、故事、成就和象征性世界；不要编造没有依据的传记事实。在每个分格中，让一个巨大、崭新的英雄人偶成为占据主导地位的中左侧物体，将其设计为高端收藏级艺术玩具，而非普通肖像。根据主体已提供的身份信息推断标志性装束、姿势、面部表情、比例、材质以及一件招牌手持物品。在每个人偶周围以整洁的产品展示集群排列 infer from identity, profession, story, achievements, and symbolic world，所有配件都必须有依据地来自主体的职业、故事、成就或象征性世界。加入一个替代人偶或变体。展示带有开窗盒、克制的箔片细节、侧面插图、收藏家标记和版本品牌的优质包装。包含真实性卡、稀有度指示器、贴纸页、比例参考和材质特性标注。让每个分格同时具有奢侈品首发揭晓、产品目录和博物馆礼品店收藏品的感觉；四个分格保持整体统一，同时各自具有辨识度。除非主体数据明确提供，否则不得硬编码人物、服装、物品、颜色、文字、徽标、名言、配件、包装盒设计或版本号；只有在  提供时才渲染包装上的文字，否则保持文字不可读或不出现。

items.title: 雾灰绞缬丝衣与象牙雪纺裙造型
items.description: A precise fashion styling specification pairing a mist-gray indigo-to-pale-blue shibori silk blouse with a layered ivory chiffon skirt and coordinated accessories.
items.prompt: Create a refined fashion styling presentation centered on this exact outfit: a mist-gray sleeveless blouse in lightweight silk with a softly gathered neckline and subtle hand-dyed shibori dots fading from indigo to pale blue; a long ivory chiffon skirt with multiple translucent layers and an uneven floating hem; pale-gray loose socks gathered just above the ankles; ivory ballet flats with thin ribbon ties; a tiny silver shoulder bag; and delicate glass-bead earrings inspired by traditional Japanese tonbo-dama. Preserve the distinct garment materials, dye pattern, color transition, layered transparency, irregular hem, sock volume, ribbon ties, miniature bag scale, and glass-bead character. Use an elegant quiet fashion-editorial presentation with soft natural light, clean restrained surroundings, and enough detail to inspect the construction and coordination. Keep the styling delicate, airy, handmade, and refined. No additional garments, competing accessories, logos, text, or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅精致的时尚造型展示，严格围绕这套服装：雾灰色无袖轻盈丝绸上衣，带柔和褶皱领口和从靛蓝渐变到浅蓝的细微手工染色绞缬圆点；象牙色长款雪纺裙，具有多层半透明结构和不规则飘逸裙摆；收在脚踝上方的浅灰色宽松袜；带细丝带系带的象牙色芭蕾平底鞋；小巧银色单肩包；以及灵感源自传统日本蜻蜓珠的精致玻璃珠耳环。保留各服装的材质差异、染色图案、色彩渐变、层叠透明度、不规则裙摆、袜子蓬松感、丝带系带、包袋小巧比例和玻璃珠特色。采用安静优雅的时尚编辑展示，柔和自然光和整洁克制的环境，并保留足够细节以检查服装结构与整体协调。整体轻盈、手工感精致而含蓄。不要额外服装、抢戏配饰、标志、文字或水印。

items.title: 苔藓岩石与古堡修道院海岸旅行人像
items.description: A photorealistic 3:4 travel portrait of an adult East Asian woman on a quiet sandy shoreline with mossy rocks and a historic stone abbey on a rocky island behind her.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic candid travel portrait of an adult East Asian woman standing on a quiet sandy shoreline beside large moss-covered rocks. Behind her, a magnificent historic stone abbey and medieval castle-like architecture rise dramatically on a rocky island. She has long straight dark-brown hair falling naturally over one shoulder, soft youthful features, and a gentle warm smile while looking directly at the camera. She wears a long oversized black coat over a light-colored outfit, with both hands casually tucked into the pockets. A large soft cream-white scarf wraps warmly around her neck and hangs down the front; near its end, include a small black designer-style emblem with no legible brand name. Let a delicate chain shoulder bag be partially visible. Place her in the foreground while the abbey dominates the background, surrounded by ancient stone walls, rocky cliffs, sandy tidal flats, and calm coastal atmosphere. Add a few tiny distant vehicles and people for realistic scale. Use soft natural evening light, a clear pale-blue sky, natural proportions and skin texture, realistic fabric and architecture detail, subtle smartphone-camera character, soft cinematic light, slightly dreamy color grading, and peaceful European travel mood. Vertical 3:4 composition. No prominent logos, extra text, watermarks, or artificial anatomy.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅照片级写实的自然旅行人像，主体是一位成年东亚女性，站在安静的沙滩岸边，身旁是巨大的长满苔藓的岩石。她身后是一座宏伟的历史石制修道院和中世纪城堡般的建筑，在岩石岛屿上形成壮观背景。她留着深棕色长直发，自然垂在一侧肩膀上，面部特征柔和年轻，直视镜头并露出温暖柔和的微笑。她穿长款宽松黑色外套，内搭浅色服装，双手随意插在口袋里。宽大的柔软乳白色围巾温暖围在脖子上并垂在身前；靠近末端加入一个小型黑色设计师风格徽记，但不要出现可读品牌名。精致的链条单肩包部分可见。将她置于前景，让宏大的修道院占据背景，周围有古老石墙、岩壁、沙质潮滩和宁静海岸。远处加入少量微小车辆和行人以体现真实尺度。使用柔和自然的傍晚光线、晴朗淡蓝天空、自然比例和皮肤纹理、真实织物与建筑细节、轻微智能手机相机质感、柔和电影感光效和略带梦幻的调色，营造宁静的欧洲旅行氛围。竖幅3:4构图。不要醒目标志、额外文字、水印或不自然肢体。

items.title: 东方禅意白墙竹影团扇插画
items.description: A bright feminine 9:16 Oriental minimalist illustration of an ancient-style woman with a round fan, white wall, bamboo shadows, and grapefruit-pink floral accents.
items.prompt: Create a bright, feminine Oriental Zen minimalist illustration in a 9:16 vertical composition. Show an ancient-style woman holding a circular hand fan, positioned low and slightly to one side in front of a clean cream-white wall. Place the circular fan near the visual center. Cast green bamboo shadows and grapefruit-pink flower shadows across the wall, with only a small amount of green plant detail. Keep the top and the opposite side as clean white negative space. Dress the woman in light white or pale pink ancient-style clothing. Use a light, lively summer-breeze mood, bright soft light, clear edges, clean refreshing textures, and a modern Oriental illustration feel suitable for a high-aesthetic Xiaohongshu cover. Control the palette carefully: cream white base, bamboo green shadows and sparse plants, grapefruit pink flower shadows and fan highlights; avoid excessive red or green and avoid a full-image pink-green filter effect. No text, logos, watermarks, or unrelated figures.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅明快、女性审美鲜明的东方禅意极简插画，采用9:16竖幅构图。表现一位手持圆形团扇的古风女性，人物位于画面下方偏一侧，站在干净的奶油白墙前；圆形团扇靠近视觉中心。墙面投射青竹绿色竹影和西柚粉色花影，仅加入少量绿色植物细节。顶部与另一侧保留整洁的白色留白。人物穿浅白或浅粉色古风服装。整体营造轻盈、明媚、带夏日微风感的氛围，使用明亮柔光、清晰边缘、干净清爽质感和现代东方插画风格，适合小红书高颜值封面。严格控制配色：奶油白背景基底、竹绿竹影与少量植物、西柚粉花影与扇面高光；避免红绿过满，也不要出现全图粉绿滤镜感。不要文字、标志、水印或无关人物。

items.title: 白色荷叶边连衣裙的自然金饰人像
items.description: An ultra-realistic close-up editorial portrait of a young adult woman with hazel-green eyes, a loose updo, textured white dress, and delicate layered gold jewelry.
items.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic close-up portrait of a young adult woman with natural delicate features, soft fair skin, subtle freckles, authentic pores and texture, expressive hazel-green eyes looking slightly to the side, naturally defined eyebrows, soft pink lips, and a gentle confident expression. Her dark-brown hair is in a loose elegant messy updo with natural flyaway strands framing her face. She wears a romantic textured white dress with delicate ruffled short sleeves and a softly gathered neckline, layered fine gold necklaces with tiny pearl details and small pendants, and elegant dangling earrings. Use soft warm natural studio lighting, a neutral beige background, subtle shadows, realistic facial proportions, detailed hair strands, natural makeup and soft blush. Cinematic professional editorial photography, shallow depth of field, 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8, high dynamic range, photorealistic ultra-detailed 8K-quality rendering. No CGI, artificial appearance, plastic skin, or excessive retouching.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅超写实近景肖像：一位年轻成年女性拥有自然细腻的面部特征、柔和白皙的皮肤、细微雀斑、真实毛孔和皮肤纹理，富有表现力的淡褐绿色眼睛略微看向侧面，自然清晰的眉毛、淡粉色嘴唇和温柔自信的表情。她的深棕色头发打理成松散优雅的凌乱发髻，自然碎发修饰脸庞。她穿浪漫的纹理白色连衣裙，带精致荷叶边短袖和柔和收拢领口，佩戴叠戴的精细金色项链，点缀微小珍珠和小吊坠，以及优雅的垂坠耳饰。使用柔和温暖的自然影棚光、中性米色背景和微妙阴影，保持真实面部比例、细致发丝、自然妆容和淡腮红。电影感专业编辑摄影，浅景深，85mm人像镜头、f/1.8、高动态范围、照片级写实超细节8K质感。不要CGI、人造感、塑料皮肤或过度精修。

items.title: 冷暖双光花材环绕的古风琵琶人像
items.description: A realistic 2:3 environmental portrait of an adult East Asian woman holding a vertical wooden pipa amid dense flowers, warm gold backlight, cool blue rim light, and coordinated Soran watermark layers.
items.prompt:
Create a realistic 2:3 vertical ancient-style environmental portrait of an adult East Asian woman holding a wooden pipa. Keep the woman and pipa as a clear stable vertical axis in a dark set surrounded by dense floral materials. She stands slightly turned with a gentle body tilt; her right hand holds the upper end and her left hand supports the lower body, keeping the pipa vertical and physically contacting the body with believable weight. She lowers her head and looks toward the lower-left, not at the camera; eyelids slightly lowered, brows relaxed, lips naturally closed, expression quiet and restrained. Her long black hair is half-tied and half-loose, with windblown strands crossing the face. Dress her in moon-white and light-blue ancient-style gauze Hanfu with translucent wide sleeves, off-shoulder layers, blue embroidery, pearls, and long slender dangling ornaments; preserve light transparent fabric and flowing edges. Surround her with dense flowers: pink-white clusters upper left, cool blue-white clusters right, orange-red and pink-orange materials below and lower right. Use them as enclosing color blocks without overpowering the face. Keep a black negative-space field behind her, with a glowing warm-gold rectangular board centered behind the head and upper body. Light from the left with warm orange-gold key light on face, neck, gauze, and board; add cool blue fill from the right to outline the figure, flowers, and gauze, creating distinct warm/cool zones. Live-photography texture, natural skin variation, slight light spill on pale gauze and flowers, soft peripheral flowers, clear face/pipa/upper body, no airbrushed studio look, standard AI beauty face, excessive symmetry, or over-retouching.

Watermark layers: weave the clearly readable word “Soran” naturally into collar or shoulder-edge patterns near the face in silver-blue embroidery, following fabric folds, perspective, and light. Hide “Soran” in the pipa wood grain and granular texture of the warm-gold board. Form microscopic “Soran” details through pearl-string arrangements, embroidery stitches, tiny pipa scratches, and flower-stamen arrangements. No extra text, brands, external watermark, sticker logo, detached letters, captions, subtitles, floating text, oversized branding, or flat pasted logo.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一幅2:3竖幅真人写实古风环境人像：一位成年东亚女性怀抱木质琵琶。人物与琵琶形成清晰稳定的纵向主体轴，站在被高密度花材包围的暗色布景中。她微微侧身、身体轻度倾斜，右手扶琵琶上端，左手托琴身下部；琵琶竖直贴合身体，具有可信的真实承重和接触关系。她低头侧视画面左下方，不直视镜头；上眼睑微压、眉间放松、嘴唇自然闭合，神情安静克制。黑色长发半束半披，几缕碎发被风吹起并横穿面部。穿月白与浅蓝色古风纱质汉服，带半透明大袖、露肩层次、蓝色刺绣、珍珠和细长垂坠饰品；保留轻薄通透面料和柔软飘逸边缘。花材高密度环绕：左上粉白花团，右侧冷蓝白花团，下方及右下橙红和粉橘色花材。外围花材作为色块与空间包围，不抢夺脸部主体。背景保持黑场负空间，头部和上身后方中央有发光暖金色矩形背板。左侧暖橙金主光照亮面部、肩颈、白纱和背板；右侧冷蓝辅光勾勒人物、花材和薄纱边缘，形成明显冷暖双光区。保持现场摄影质感、自然皮肤纹理和轻微明暗不均，白纱与浅色花材有轻微溢光，外围花材略柔，面部、琵琶和上半身清晰；避免商业棚拍磨皮、标准AI美女脸、过度对称和过度精修。

水印层：在靠近脸侧的衣领或肩缘花纹中，以银蓝色刺绣自然织入清晰可读的“ Soran ”，随布料褶皱、透视和光线变化。将隐藏的“Soran”融入琵琶木纹与暖金背板颗粒纹理，并用珍珠串排列、刺绣针脚、琵琶细小划痕和花蕊排列形成微观“Soran”细节。不要额外文字、品牌名、外部水印、贴纸式标志、脱离的字母、说明文字、副标题、漂浮文字、过大品牌或平贴式标志。

items.title: 漆黑房间中的极简强光侧脸肖像
items.description: A fictional adult East Asian woman rendered in an intimate fine-art profile portrait, with one narrow late-afternoon beam cutting through near-total darkness.
items.prompt: Create an intimate, extremely photorealistic fine-art portrait of a completely fictional adult East Asian woman in her twenties who does not resemble any real person. Place her in a nearly pitch-black room in a vertical 9:16 composition, using an extremely close side-profile frame from slightly below face level. She reclines with her head strongly tilted backward and eyes gently closed. Show a delicate small oval face, soft cheek, slim refined nose, natural lips, smooth fair skin with realistic pores, and a tiny beauty mark near the lower cheek or jaw. Dark hair with a few loose strands fades into the darkness. A narrow, brutally intense beam of hard late-afternoon sunlight enters from the upper left and illuminates only a thin irregular strip of her face plus a rounded foreground shoulder or knee in the lower right. Let the brightest highlights on the nose bridge, nose tip, cheek, eyelashes, lips, and jaw edge approach clipping, with slight bloom and halation. Use no fill light, ambient light, or shadow recovery; keep approximately 80–90% of the frame near-black. Contrast warm reddish-golden skin highlights against deep black shadows. Full-frame 50–85mm look, very close distance, f/1.8–f/2.8, shallow depth of field, subtle grain, quiet melancholic cinematic mood. No text, logos, or resemblance to a real person.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅极其写实、亲密的纯艺术肖像：一位完全虚构、与任何真实人物都不相似的20多岁成年东亚女性。将她置于近乎漆黑的房间中，以9:16竖幅构图，从略低于面部水平的位置进行极近侧脸取景。她仰卧，头部明显向后倾斜，双眼轻轻闭合。表现精致的小椭圆脸、柔和脸颊、纤细挺拔的鼻子、自然嘴唇、带真实毛孔的平滑白皙皮肤，以及下脸颊或下颌附近的微小美人痣。深色头发带几缕散乱发丝并消失在黑暗中。一束狭窄而强烈的午后硬直射光从左上方进入，只照亮脸部一条不规则细窄区域，以及右下方前景中圆润的肩膀或膝盖。让鼻梁、鼻尖、脸颊、睫毛、嘴唇和下颌边缘的最亮高光接近过曝，带轻微泛光和光晕。不要补光、环境光或阴影恢复；约80–90%的画面保持近乎全黑。以暖红金色皮肤高光对比深黑阴影。使用全画幅50–85mm镜头效果、极近距离、f/1.8–f/2.8、浅景深和微细颗粒，营造宁静忧郁的电影氛围。不要文字、标志，也不要与真实人物相似。

items.title: 深色亚麻布上的刺绣人物肖像
items.description: A tactile handmade embroidered portrait rendered with visible needlework, layered thread textures, and earthy sacred character on deep linen fabric.
items.prompt: Create an embroidered portrait of Elon Musk on deep linen fabric, using rich steel gray and electric blue thread. Preserve the subject's recognizable facial identity when an identity reference is supplied. Make the needlework visibly tactile, with layered thread textures, handmade patterns, and an earthy, quietly sacred atmosphere. Show the embroidered likeness as the clear focal subject, with refined stitch direction, convincing thread relief, and natural linen weave. Keep the composition intimate and portrait-focused; do not turn it into a flat digital painting. No unrelated figures, logos, watermarks, or unintended text.
items.prompt_zh: 在深色亚麻布上创作一幅Elon Musk的刺绣肖像，使用rich steel gray and electric blue色丝线。提供身份参考图时，保留主体可辨认的面部身份。让针线工艺具有明显的触感，表现层叠丝线纹理、手工图案和朴实而安静神圣的氛围。将刺绣肖像作为清晰视觉焦点，呈现精致的针脚方向、可信的线材浮雕和自然亚麻织纹。保持亲密且以肖像为中心的构图，不要将其变成平面的数字绘画。不要无关人物、标志、水印或无意文字。

items.title: 爆发瞬间悬浮产品视觉
items.description: A reusable premium-campaign template for a hyperrealistic subject suspended mid-air amid energetic particles, splashes, or fragments.
items.prompt: Create a hyperrealistic, high-impact premium product-campaign image of a slim premium energy-drink can suspended mid-air at the peak of an explosive moment. Surround it with dynamic translucent liquid splashes, ice fragments, and micro-droplets that visibly enhance motion and energy without obscuring the main subject. Use macro-level detail, bold rim lighting, and a vibrant electric cobalt blue background to emphasize form, texture, material, and contrast. Keep the composition cinematic, modern, visually striking, and commercially polished, with crisp subject edges and physically coherent motion effects.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张超写实、高冲击力的高端产品广告图：a slim premium energy-drink can悬浮在空中，定格于爆发性瞬间的顶点。用动态的translucent liquid splashes, ice fragments, and micro-droplets环绕主体，明显增强运动感和能量，但不要遮挡主要主体。使用微距级细节、大胆的轮廓光和充满活力的electric cobalt blue背景，强调形状、质感、材质和对比度。保持电影感、现代感、视觉冲击力和商业级精致效果，主体边缘清晰，运动效果符合物理逻辑。

items.title: 秋日落叶拼成的小猫与咖啡
items.description: A sunny autumn afternoon film-textured ground-level composition where fallen leaves, branches, ginkgo leaves, and osmanthus flowers form a small cat beside a disposable coffee cup.
items.prompt: Create a medium-shot, ground-level composition in sunny afternoon light with a tactile analog-film texture. Arrange autumn fallen leaves, small branches, ginkgo leaves, and osmanthus flowers flat on the ground to form the recognizable shape of a small cat. Place one disposable takeaway coffee cup beside the leaf cat. Keep the arrangement charming, simple, and clearly readable as a cat, with natural seasonal variation in the leaves and blossoms. Use realistic ground texture, gentle sunlight, soft natural shadows, and warm autumn atmosphere. Film photography character, understated color grading, no people, no text, logos, watermarks, or unrelated objects.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅中景、贴近地面拍摄的画面，采用明媚午后阳光和富有触感的胶片质感。将秋天的落叶、小树枝、银杏叶和桂花平铺在地面上，拼组成一只容易辨认的小猫形状。小猫旁边放置一杯一次性外带咖啡。保持拼摆可爱、简洁，并清晰呈现猫的轮廓，同时保留叶片和花朵自然的季节变化。表现真实地面纹理、柔和阳光、自然阴影和温暖秋日氛围。保留胶片摄影特征和克制的色彩调校；不要人物、文字、标志、水印或无关物体。

items.title: 音乐平台界面旁的艺术家全身肖像
items.description: A realistic full-body editorial campaign portrait of a configurable artist beside an oversized vertical smartphone displaying a Spotify music-player interface.
items.prompt: Create a realistic full-body editorial portrait of a contemporary recording artist in their recognizable signature style, positioned next to a giant vertical smartphone. The phone displays a crisp, accurately rendered Spotify music-player interface featuring the song “Midnight Echoes”, with electric violet signature accent colors at approximately 80% opacity for a premium translucent effect. Dress the artist in their characteristic outfit and styling. Use a confident editorial pose and an expression that matches the artist's established persona, embodying the mood and energy of the song. Set the scene against a plain background with subtle electric violet lighting accents. Use soft studio lighting with colored gels in the same signature electric violet tones, 35mm or 50mm lens, f/2.2, ISO 100–160, 1/125-second shutter speed, and sharp focus on both the artist and phone interface. Premium music-platform campaign editorial style. Keep the song title and interface legible; do not add unrelated text, logos, or watermarks beyond the requested Spotify interface.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅a contemporary recording artist采用其可辨认标志性风格的逼真全身编辑级肖像，主体站在一部巨大的竖屏智能手机旁边。手机显示清晰准确的Spotify音乐播放器界面，突出歌曲“Midnight Echoes”，并使用约80%不透明度的electric violet标志性强调色，营造高级半透明效果。让艺人穿着其特征性服装并保持相应造型。采用自信而富有时尚感的姿势，表情符合艺人既有形象，体现歌曲的情绪和能量。背景保持纯色，并加入柔和的electric violet灯光点缀。使用柔和影棚灯光和同色调electric violet彩色滤光片，35mm或50mm镜头，f/2.2，ISO 100–160，1/125秒快门速度，同时清晰对焦于艺人与手机界面。整体采用高端音乐平台推广活动的编辑风格。保持歌曲标题和界面清晰可读；除要求的Spotify界面外，不要添加无关文字、标志或水印。

items.title: 角色设计表情风格指南
items.description: A 16:9 visual guide presenting a character design's expression style in a clear, consistent reference-sheet format.
items.prompt: Create a clean 16:9 character-design expression style guide for an original fictional character with a clear, readable face. Present a consistent reference-sheet image that focuses on the character's expression language, with clearly separated expression studies, coherent facial design, and consistent rendering across the guide. Use a legible organized layout, neutral unobtrusive background, even studio-like illumination, and polished concept-art presentation. Keep the character design consistent from study to study while varying only the expression as appropriate for the guide. No unrelated characters, logos, watermarks, or unintended text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张16:9的an original fictional character with a clear, readable face角色设计表情风格指南。以清晰一致的设定参考表形式呈现，重点展示角色的表情语言，包含区分明确的表情练习、统一的面部设计和一致的渲染效果。采用易读有序的版式、不中断主体的中性背景、均匀的棚拍式照明和精致的概念艺术呈现。保持各个表情练习中的角色设计一致，只根据指南需要改变表情。不要无关角色、标志、水印或无意文字。

items.title: 薯条盒变身小夜灯创意广告海报
items.description: A conceptual advertising poster turning a fries box into a glowing nightlight, with warm reflected light, the McDonald's logo, and precise small-print copy.
items.prompt: Create a conceptual advertising poster with a box of golden French fries transformed into a small nightlight at the center. The fries act as the light source; their warm glow reflects onto the wall behind a power outlet and casts a yellow illumination over the McDonald's logo. Directly beneath the logo, place tiny but clearly legible white text reading exactly “open 24 hours”. Place another McDonald's logo in the bottom-right corner. At the bottom center, add tiny but legible text reading exactly “Underwood Dessert”. Use a clean graphic-advertising composition, warm yellow light, realistic fry and packaging texture, controlled wall reflections, strong focal hierarchy, and high-quality poster rendering. Preserve the logos and copy exactly; do not add extra text, misspellings, watermarks, or unrelated branding.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张概念广告海报：画面中央将一盒金黄色薯条巧妙改造成一盏小夜灯。薯条充当光源，温暖的光线反射到插座后方的墙面上，并为麦当劳标志投射黄色光晕。标志正下方放置极小但清晰可读的白色文字，准确写为“24小时营业”。右下角放置另一个麦当劳标志。底部中央加入极小但清晰可读的文字，准确写为“Underwood Dessert”。采用干净的平面广告构图、温暖黄色光线、真实薯条与包装纹理、受控墙面反射、明确视觉层级和高质量海报渲染。准确保留标志和文字；不要添加额外文字、拼写错误、水印或无关品牌。

items.title: 极简诗意肖像
items.description: A reusable minimalist illustration template expressing a subject's inner state through gentle facial expression and one subtle surreal visual metaphor.
items.prompt: Create a minimal, poetic illustration of a solitary young adult with a thoughtful gaze, shown in half-body. The subject is experiencing quiet longing, with clear facial details and a soft natural expression. Introduce exactly one subtle surreal element, a tiny paper boat floating gently above the subject's shoulder, as a visual metaphor reflecting the subject's inner world. Use clean shapes, a limited color palette, gentle lighting, and a calm uncluttered background. The overall mood is introspective, cinematic, quietly emotional, and restrained; keep the surreal element subtle rather than overwhelming the subject.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一幅极简而诗意的插图，描绘a solitary young adult with a thoughtful gaze，采用half-body呈现。主体正处于quiet longing，面部细节清晰，表情柔和自然。加入恰好一个微妙的超现实元素a tiny paper boat floating gently above the subject's shoulder，作为反映主体内心世界的视觉隐喻。使用干净的形状、有限的配色、柔和的光线和宁静整洁的背景。整体氛围应内省、具有电影感、含蓄而安静地传达情绪；保持超现实元素微妙，不要压过主体。

items.title: 沐浴暖光在咖啡馆埋头苦读的治愈瞬间
items.description: An identity-preserving candid smartphone-style lifestyle photograph of the reference subject studying at a cozy modern urban café.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image and match the subject's face and identity exactly. Create a candid, unposed UGC lifestyle photograph in a cozy modern urban café with warm ambient light and a calm focused study atmosphere. The subject sits at a wooden café table, leaning slightly forward while writing in an open workbook; one hand holds a pen and the other rests on papers. Her posture is casual, slightly hunched in concentration, head tilted down toward the notebook and not looking at the camera. Keep her hair tied in a low messy ponytail with loose strands near the face, thin metal-frame glasses, and an oversized light beige or off-white cozy hoodie. Use a slightly above-table-level angle, medium framing, natural indoor lighting, warm tones, realistic smartphone-photo feel, shallow depth of field, and soft background blur. On the table, show open notebooks with handwritten notes, printed study sheets, scattered pens, two minimalist takeaway coffee cups, a wireless-earbuds case, and a face-up smartphone near the notebooks. Set the background in an aesthetic urban café with warm hanging lights, wooden furniture, coffee counter, hanging plants, and shelves of coffee bags and equipment; suggest soft café ambience without a visible crowd. Calm, warm, intimate, productive, real-life study motivation and cozy productivity. No staged pose, beauty retouching, or unintended legible text.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图，并完全匹配主体的面部和身份。创作一张自然抓拍、非摆拍的UGC生活方式照片：场景是舒适现代的都市咖啡馆，具有温暖环境光和宁静专注的学习氛围。主体坐在木质咖啡馆桌旁，身体略微前倾，在打开的练习册上书写；一只手握笔，另一只手放在纸上。姿势随意，为集中注意力略微弓背，头部向下倾斜看向笔记本，不看镜头。头发扎成低位凌乱马尾，几缕发丝自然垂在脸侧，佩戴细金属框眼镜，穿宽松浅米色或米白色舒适连帽衫。采用略高于桌面水平的角度和中景构图，自然室内光、暖色调、真实智能手机照片质感、浅景深及柔和背景虚化。桌面放置写有手写笔记的打开笔记本、打印学习资料、随意散落的多支笔、两个简约外带咖啡杯、无线耳机盒和一部屏幕朝上的手机。背景为有格调的都市咖啡馆，包含暖色吊灯、木质家具、咖啡吧台、悬挂盆栽，以及摆放咖啡豆袋和设备的置物架；表现柔和咖啡馆氛围，不出现明显人群。整体平静、温暖、亲密、真实，具有学习动力和舒适高效感。不要摆拍姿势、美颜修饰或无关的可辨认文字。

items.title: S形光影流转的雪夜河灯概念图
items.description: A monochrome or sepia lighting-study illustration for a zodiac lantern parade, guiding the eye from a crouching girl on a snowy bank through twelve lanterns along an S-shaped river path.
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 high-angle cinematic overview concept-art lighting study for “The Zodiac Parade — An Emotional Night”. Use a monochrome or sepia sketch rendering with strong glow, not distracting full-color painting. Make the S-shaped light path the highest visual priority: the eye begins at the girl in the lower left, follows the water lanterns, and exits toward the upper right background. The darkest area is the river surface with reflected light; the brightest area is the lanterns as light sources. Keep the dark upper-left sky empty as negative space for later text. Establish a clear diagonal land-water boundary: a snow-covered riverbank occupies the lower left, and the flowing river occupies the upper right. On the snowy bank, place a rough sketch silhouette of a girl crouching and facing the river, emphasizing the volume of her kimono rather than facial detail. Place seven water lanterns total: one held in her hand and six floating on the river, arranged in a graceful S curve flowing toward the upper right. Place five additional land lanterns grouped neatly together, representing the future and waiting to be released. Use strong light-dark contrast, balanced composition, and unmistakable visual flow.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张9:16竖幅、高角度电影式概览的概念艺术光照研究图，项目为《十二生肖游行：情感之夜》。采用带强烈光晕的单色或棕褐色草图渲染，避免全彩绘画造成干扰。将S形光路作为最高视觉优先级：视线从左下角的女孩开始，沿着水灯流动，向右上角背景延伸并离开画面。河面及其反光为最暗区域，作为光源的灯笼为最亮区域。左上角黑暗天空保持空白，作为后续文字的负空间。建立清晰的对角线陆地与水面分隔：左下角是积雪河岸，右上角是流淌的河流。雪地上放置一个女孩的粗略剪影，她蹲坐并面向河流，重点表现和服的体积感而非面部细节。共放置7盏水上灯笼：1盏在她手中，6盏漂浮在河面，组成向右上方流动的优美S形曲线。另放置5盏陆上灯笼，整齐聚集在一起，代表未来并等待释放。使用强烈明暗对比、平衡构图和清晰不可误认的视觉流动。

items.title: 清新绿色能量饮料高速飞溅商业大片
items.description: A premium photorealistic product shot of a slim energy-drink can floating amid a frozen green liquid spiral, kiwi, mint, ice, and droplets.
items.prompt: Create a high-end commercial product photograph of a slim premium energy-drink can labeled AFENON. The can has brushed aluminum with a deep-green accent and floats on a diagonal tilt. Use a soft mint-green-to-white gradient background with a subtle radial burst behind it, cool mist, faint vapor trails, and a fresh clean atmosphere. Wrap the can in a dynamic spiral of translucent green liquid, with fresh seeded kiwi slices, one whole kiwi with natural skin, veined mint leaves, sharp clear ice cubes with internal cracks, and micro-droplets frozen in motion. Use soft upper-left key light, clean rim light along the can edges, cool green backlight, and soft controlled shadows. 85mm product-lens look, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on AFENON and can surface, high-speed-flash motion freeze. Fresh greens, silver metal, and clean whites; medium contrast, natural non-neon saturation. Cinematic premium energy-drink advertising, commercial photorealism, natural liquid physics. No plastic look, over-sharpening, exaggerated glow, or illegible brand text. Single image, 4:5.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张高端商业产品摄影：纤细的高端能量饮料罐印有AFENON。罐身为拉丝铝材并带深绿色点缀，沿对角线倾斜悬浮。背景使用柔和的薄荷绿到白色渐变，罐后有微妙径向光爆，周围有凉爽薄雾、淡淡蒸汽轨迹和清新洁净的空气感。半透明绿色液体以动态螺旋环绕罐身，搭配带可见籽粒和湿润质感的新鲜奇异果切片、一颗保留自然果皮细节的完整奇异果、带真实叶脉的薄荷叶、边缘锐利且内部有裂纹的透明冰块，以及凝固在运动中的微小水滴。使用左上方柔和主光、勾勒罐身边缘的清晰轮廓光、增强清新感的冷绿色背光和柔和受控阴影。85mm产品镜头质感，浅景深，清晰对焦于AFENON和罐身表面，高速闪光冻结液体与水滴。色彩为清新绿、银色金属和洁净白，中等对比度，自然而非霓虹饱和度。电影感高端能量饮料广告，商业照片级写实，自然液体物理。不要塑料感、过度锐化、夸张光晕或难以辨认的品牌文字。单图，4:5。

items.title: 沐浴后从公寓门口收取晾晒衣物
items.description: A candid everyday scene of an adult Japanese woman leaning from an apartment doorway to retrieve a black garment from a clothesline on a narrow veranda after bathing.
items.prompt: Candid everyday photograph of an adult Japanese woman just after bathing, wrapped modestly in a simple bathrobe, leaning out through the doorway of an apartment room on a narrow veranda. She reaches toward the clothesline and removes a black thong among the hanging laundry. Keep the action matter-of-fact and non-erotic, with no nudity or exposed body beyond ordinary modest coverage. Show the apartment doorway, narrow veranda, clothesline, hanging laundry, and compact urban residential details. Natural candid framing, realistic household atmosphere, soft available light, documentary realism, and understated Japanese apartment-life mood. No text, logos, voyeuristic framing, nudity, or sexualized posing.
items.prompt_zh: 生活化的随手照片：一名刚沐浴完的成年日本女性，端庄地裹着简洁浴袍，从公寓房间的门口探身到狭窄阳台上。她伸手从晾衣绳上收下一条黑色丁字裤，周围还有其他晾晒衣物。动作保持平实日常而非情色，不出现裸体或超出正常遮蔽范围的身体暴露。展现公寓门口、狭窄阳台、晾衣绳、悬挂衣物和紧凑的城市住宅细节。采用自然随拍构图、真实的家庭生活氛围、柔和可用光、纪实写实质感和克制的日本公寓日常情绪。不要文字、标志、窥视式构图、裸体或性化姿势。

items.title: 极简影棚红夹克时尚人像
items.description: A clean modern fashion-editorial studio portrait of a stylish young woman in a bold red jacket against a neutral light-gray backdrop.
items.prompt: Create one portrait-oriented 2:3 image: a minimalist studio fashion portrait with a modern editorial aesthetic and ultra-realistic high detail. Depict a stylish young adult woman with short wavy hair showing natural movement and soft definition, round eyeglasses, calm confident expression, gaze slightly away from the camera, soft natural makeup, and realistic skin with subtle highlights and visible natural texture. She wears a bold red jacket over a white T-shirt in a modern clean editorial style. Set her in a refined uncluttered studio against a neutral light-gray backdrop. Use head-and-shoulders to mid-length framing, clean centered balance, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the subject, and smooth background falloff. Use soft diffused studio lighting, gentle natural shadows, and subtle highlights that enhance facial structure. 85mm professional fashion-editorial look, crisp natural 8K rendering. Mood: confident, composed, contemporary. No harsh lighting, busy background, oversaturated colors, heavy makeup, plastic skin, low detail, or blurred subject.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张竖幅2:3单图：极简主义影棚时尚肖像，具有现代编辑美学和超写实高细节。表现一位时尚的年轻成年女性，留短波浪发，具有自然动感和柔和层次感，佩戴圆形眼镜，神情平静自信，目光略微偏离镜头，妆容柔和自然，皮肤保留真实纹理和微妙高光。她穿醒目的红色夹克，内搭白色T恤，整体现代、简洁且具有编辑风格。场景为精致整洁的影棚，背景是中性浅灰色。采用头肩至中长构图，简洁居中且平衡，浅景深，主体锐利对焦，背景平滑虚化。使用柔和漫射的影棚灯光、自然柔和阴影，以及增强面部结构的微妙高光。85mm专业时尚编辑摄影质感，清晰自然的8K渲染。整体情绪自信、沉着、现代。不要刺眼光线、杂乱背景、过饱和色彩、浓妆、塑料感皮肤、低细节或模糊主体。

items.title: 凝视你的超现实红粉罂粟花田
items.description: A surreal dreamlike field of viewer-facing pink, red, and cream poppies, each with an eye at its center, fading into softly blurred flowers and greenery.
items.prompt: A surreal, dreamlike field of poppies stretching across the image. Every flower faces the viewer and contains one clearly formed eye at its center. Use a varied field of pink, red, and cream poppies, with natural petals and stems. The background recedes into a soft blur of additional flowers and green foliage, creating depth while keeping the front flowers and their eyes readable. Ethereal atmosphere, gentle organic detail, poetic uncanny beauty, balanced natural composition, no people, no text, no logos, no extra eyes detached from flowers.
items.prompt_zh: 一片延伸至画面深处的超现实梦幻罂粟花田。每朵花都朝向观者，并在花心中央形成一只清晰完整的眼睛。花田由粉色、红色和奶油色罂粟组成，花瓣与茎秆保持自然质感。背景逐渐虚化为更多花朵和绿色植物，在营造空间深度的同时，让前景花朵及其眼睛保持清晰可辨。整体具有空灵氛围、细腻自然的有机细节、诗意而诡奇的美感，构图平衡自然；不要人物、文字、标志，也不要出现脱离花朵的多余眼睛。

items.title: 暮色红巴士划过的静谧恋人
items.description: A cinematic dusk street-romance photograph of an adult couple held tack sharp while a red double-decker bus and pedestrians streak around them in slow-shutter motion.
items.prompt: Create four high-resolution 1:1 images in a photorealistic cinematic street-photography style. Show an adult woman and adult man standing still at the center of an urban street at dusk, holding hands, calm expressions, looking toward the camera. The woman wears a simple long-sleeved ivory bridal dress with minimal jewelry and natural makeup, holding a small bouquet of orange-red flowers and greenery. The man wears a dark suit jacket and trousers with a white crew-neck shirt or white shirt. A red double-decker bus passes behind them, creating strong horizontal motion blur, while foreground pedestrians become soft streaks. Keep the couple's faces and hands tack sharp; only the bus and passersby may blur. Use a curbside perspective, wet asphalt with subtle reflections, visible street lines, balanced negative space, 35mm lens at f/2.8, locked focus on faces and hands, clean subject edges, realistic skin texture, and subtle film grain. Cinematic dusk lighting from warm streetlights and ambient city glow; preserve warm highlights and deep shadows without overexposing the white dress. Grade with a rich red bus, warm amber lights, cool shadows, natural skin tones, filmic contrast, slightly soft highlights, and no crushed blacks. No text, logos, watermarks, blurry faces, double faces, deformed hands, extra fingers, messy bouquet, warped bus, unreadable signs, oversharp halos, CGI, cartoon treatment, low resolution, or noise artifacts.
items.prompt_zh: 生成4张高分辨率1:1图片，采用照片级写实的电影感街头摄影风格。表现一位成年女性和一位成年男性在黄昏城市街道中央静止站立、手牵手、表情平静并看向镜头。女性穿简约长袖象牙色新娘礼服，佩戴极简首饰、自然妆容，手持一束橙红色花朵和绿叶组成的小捧花。男性穿深色西装外套和长裤，搭配白色圆领衫或白衬衫。一辆红色双层巴士从他们身后驶过，形成强烈水平运动模糊，前景行人化为柔和条纹。情侣的面部和手部必须极其清晰；只有巴士和行人可以出现运动模糊。采用路边视角，湿润柏油路有细微反光，街道线条可见，负空间平衡，35mm镜头、f/2.8，锁定对焦于面部和手部，主体边缘清晰，皮肤纹理逼真并带微妙胶片颗粒。使用暖色街灯与环境城市光晕形成电影感黄昏照明，保留暖色高光和深色阴影，避免白色礼服过曝。色彩包含浓郁红色巴士、温暖琥珀灯光、冷色阴影和自然肤色，电影感对比度，高光略柔和，不出现死黑。不要文字、标志、水印、模糊面部、双重面部、变形的手、多余手指、凌乱捧花、扭曲巴士、无法辨认的标志、过锐光晕、CGI、卡通、低分辨率或噪点伪影。

items.title: 落日天台上的奢华街头风
items.description: A raw editorial fashion photograph of a stylish woman in luxury streetwear standing confidently against a broad urban skyline at golden hour.
items.prompt: Raw high-quality editorial fashion photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio. A stylish adult woman wearing high-end modern luxury streetwear stands confidently on a rooftop, facing the camera with a relaxed but confident natural posture. Show a wide city skyline and urban landscape behind her. Use sunset golden-hour warm natural light with a cinematic glow. Balanced framing keeps the subject sharply in focus while the skyline remains visible; use shallow to moderate depth of field. Mood: confident, stylish, modern urban luxury. Avoid a glossy commercial-advertising look; retain raw editorial fashion photography character.
items.prompt_zh: 原始感、高质量的时尚编辑摄影，4:5比例。一位穿着高端现代奢华街头服饰的成年时尚女性自信地站在屋顶上，自然面对镜头，姿态放松而自信。身后呈现广阔城市天际线和都市景观。使用日落黄金时段的温暖自然光与电影般辉光。采用平衡构图，主体清晰对焦，同时保留可见天际线；使用浅至中等景深。整体情绪自信、时尚、现代而具有都市奢华感。避免光鲜的商业广告感，保留原始时尚编辑摄影的质感。

items.title: 稍纵即逝的烂漫情绪摄影艺术海报
items.description: A vertical low-saturation emotional photography poster combining a recognizable adult East Asian woman, a bouquet, and controlled dynamic ghosting that suggests two near-simultaneous moments.
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical high-end emotional photography art poster, not an ordinary portrait or commercial advertisement. Depict an adult young East Asian woman in a simple lightweight summer outfit at a glass greenhouse at dusk, holding a soft pink and white roses with loose leaves. Use muted blue-green with warm pink accents as the dominant palette and express quiet residual warmth. Preserve realistic natural facial features, skin texture, and body proportions. Use partial clarity with dynamic ghosting: keep the body, shoulders, neck, hands, and central flowers relatively clear, while selected hair strands, facial edges, hemline, and movement directions show natural slow-shutter directional blur, slight double exposure, and time-dislocation traces. Do not blur the whole person evenly; keep the main face recognizable. Make the bouquet the emotional anchor, with clear center flowers and slight trailing motion on peripheral petals and leaves; contrast its color with the scene using warm/cool or light/dark separation. Give the background scene-specific flow, such as horizontal traffic-light streaks, brushed plant foreground, wind-blown wheat and hemline, or corridor-light time ghosts, while keeping the character dominant. Use incomplete symmetry and natural negative space, place the character on one side, and reserve the other side for restrained vertical Chinese title text “稍纵即逝的烂漫” and small English subtitle “BEFORE IT FADES”. Use modern Song-style or fine serif typography, allowing a few strands, light traces, or environmental ghosts to pass subtly through the text area. Overall low saturation, cinematic, realistic, poetic, emotionally tense, with a palpable sense of time passing.
items.prompt_zh: 生成一张9:16竖版高级情绪摄影艺术海报，不要做成普通人物写真或商业广告。表现一位成年年轻东亚女性，在a glass greenhouse at dusk中穿着a simple lightweight summer outfit，手持soft pink and white roses with loose leaves。以muted blue-green with warm pink accents为主色调，传达quiet residual warmth的情绪。保持真实自然的五官、皮肤纹理和身体比例。采用“局部清晰+动态残影”的摄影方式：人物身体、肩颈、手部和花束中央花朵保持相对清晰；选定的发丝、脸部边缘、衣摆和动作方向产生自然的慢速快门方向性模糊、轻微双重曝光和时间错位痕迹。不要将整个人均匀模糊，脸部主体仍需可辨认。让花束成为情绪视觉锚点，中心花朵清晰，外围花瓣和叶片带少量拖影；花束颜色与场景形成明确的冷暖或明暗对比。让背景根据场景产生流动效果，例如交通灯横向拉丝、植物前景掠过、麦田和衣摆随风流动，或走廊灯光形成时间残影，但不要压过人物。采用不完全对称和自然留白，将人物放在画面一侧，另一侧留给克制的中文竖排标题“稍纵即逝的烂漫”和小号英文副标题“BEFORE IT FADES”。使用现代宋体或细衬线字体，让少量发丝、光影或环境残影轻微穿过文字区域，使文字自然融入摄影。整体低饱和、电影感、真实、诗意且有情绪张力，明显传达时间流逝感。

items.title: 邻家女孩咖啡馆随拍
items.description: An identity-preserving low-end smartphone snapshot of a young Indonesian woman casually using her phone at a Jakarta rooftop café at night.
items.prompt: Edit the uploaded photo without changing the woman's face or identity in any way; keep her facial features 100% authentic and identical to the original. Depict a young Indonesian woman in her early twenties with a relaxed face, gently closed lips, calm warm eyes, no smile, and an everyday girl-next-door presence rather than a model, influencer, or glamorous subject. She sits casually in an unplanned, unposed moment, holding a drink in one hand and using her phone with the other, focused on the phone and unaware of the camera. She wears a plain fitted black long-sleeved top with no pattern. Her waist-length brown hair is smooth, straight, naturally voluminous, and worn loose; preserve subtle pores and natural variation with no beauty filter, retouching, AI-polished skin, or plastic appearance. Make it a realistic, unpolished 3:4 candid snapshot taken at night on a low-end Android phone: handheld, rushed, slightly imperfect, with the camera slightly from the side and behind, medium-wide framing, upper body and part of the table visible, subject slightly small in frame, and a minor imbalance. Use harsh imperfect rooftop café and city-street lights with uneven exposure, blown highlights, deep shadows, and imperfect white balance. Keep the subject slightly more in focus while the background has soft low-light blur, not portrait-mode blur or artificial bokeh; include digital noise, grain, slight motion blur, limited dynamic range, and imperfect focus accuracy. Set the scene at a Jakarta rooftop café with tables, railing, casually visible other people, distant buildings, and city lights. Include an iPhone 17 Pro Max and part of a woman's handbag on the table, plus a latest-model Apple Watch naturally visible on her wrist. The overall feeling is normal, intimate, quiet, slightly messy, authentic, non-cinematic, non-staged, and not AI-looking, as if photographed by her boyfriend. Do not add unintended text or logos.
