items.prompt_zh: 编辑上传的照片，任何情况下都不要改变女性的脸部或身份；保持她的面部特征100%真实，并与原图完全一致。表现一位二十出头的年轻印度尼西亚女性：面部放松，嘴唇轻闭，眼神平静温暖，不带微笑，呈现邻家女孩般的日常气质，而不是模特、网红或华丽造型。她随意坐着，处于未经安排和摆拍的瞬间，一只手拿着饮料，另一只手使用手机，专注于手机而没有注意镜头。她穿纯色黑色修身长袖上衣，不带图案。她有及腰的棕色长发，顺滑、直且自然蓬松，随意披散；保留细微毛孔和自然肤色变化，不使用美颜滤镜、修图、AI磨皮或塑料感。将画面处理成夜晚用低端安卓手机拍摄的真实未修饰3:4随手照：手持、匆忙、略有瑕疵，镜头稍从侧面并稍偏后，中宽幅构图，可见上半身和部分桌面，主体在画面中略小且构图轻微失衡。使用屋顶咖啡馆灯光和城市街灯形成刺眼而不完美的照明，保留曝光不均、过曝高光、深阴影和不准确的白平衡。主体略为清晰对焦，背景因弱光产生柔和模糊，但不是人像模式虚化或人工景深；加入可见数字噪点、颗粒、轻微动态模糊、有限动态范围和不完全准确的对焦。场景位于雅加达屋顶咖啡馆，有桌子、栏杆、随意可见的其他人、远处建筑和城市灯光。桌面放置一部iPhone 17 Pro Max和女士手提包的一部分，手腕自然露出最新款Apple Watch。整体感觉普通、亲密、安静、真实、略带凌乱、非电影感、未摆拍且没有AI感，仿佛由她的男友拍摄。不要添加无关文字或标志。

items.title: 复古等距时代立体模型
items.description: A nostalgic isometric 3D miniature time capsule packed with era-specific objects, fashion, technology, cultural symbols, and tiny faceless figures.
items.prompt: Create a clear 45-degree top-down isometric miniature 3D diorama representing THE 1980s as a nostalgic time capsule. Use soft refined textures, realistic PBR materials, and gentle nostalgic lighting. Build a raised base filled with iconic objects, fashion, technology, and cultural symbols from THE 1980s. Include tiny stylized people interacting with the environment, with no facial details. Use a clean solid dusty teal background. At the top center, display THE 1980s in large bold text; beneath it, show the short nostalgic subtitle A decade of bold beginnings; below that, place a minimal retro-style icon. Ensure all text is clearly legible and automatically uses white or black according to the background contrast.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一个清晰的45°俯视等距迷你3D立体模型，将THE 1980s表现为一枚怀旧的时代时间胶囊。使用柔和精致的纹理、逼真的PBR材质和温柔怀旧的灯光。制作一个凸起的底座，填满THE 1980s的标志性物品、时尚、科技和文化符号。加入与环境互动的小巧风格化人物，但不呈现任何面部细节。使用纯色dusty teal背景。在顶部中央用大号粗体显示THE 1980s；下方显示简短怀旧副标题A decade of bold beginnings；再下方放置一个极简复古风格图标。确保所有文字清晰可读，并根据背景对比度自动使用白色或黑色文字。

items.title: 少女窗边花语浪漫
items.description: An identity-preserving, dreamy portrait of the referenced woman seated on a flower-framed wooden window sill in an opulent pale ballgown.
items.prompt: Edit the uploaded photo while preserving the woman's face and identity exactly; do not alter facial features. Create a highly romantic, dreamy, ethereal Princesscore/Cottagecore mood, soft and feminine like a fairy-tale scene. The woman has extremely long, thick, wavy, voluminous ash-brown hair with near-white platinum-blonde highlights. She wears a luxurious strapless off-white ballgown with a pearl-like sheen and a voluminous layered ruffle skirt forming cloud-like, blooming-petal texture; the satin or silk taffeta softly reflects light. Keep accessories minimal, focus attention on the bouquet, and leave her barefoot. She sits sideways on a wide warm orange-brown wooden window sill, back resting casually against the right frame, both legs extended forward with toes touching the opposite side. Her left hand holds a bouquet of soft pink and white roses on her lap; her right hand lifts toward her face or hair in a candid shy gesture. She looks directly at the camera with a calm expression. Surround the window with climbing plants, dark green leaves, and small blooming pink roses that naturally frame her. Use soft diffused natural light suggestive of golden hour or shade, with no harsh shadows. Vertical 9:16 composition, photographic realism, no facial alteration.
items.prompt_zh: 编辑上传的照片，完全保留女性的脸部和身份，不改变任何面部特征。营造高度浪漫、梦幻、空灵的公主风/田园风氛围，柔美而女性化，如童话场景。女性拥有极长、浓密、飘逸的长卷发，发色为灰棕色，并带有近乎白金色的高光。她穿奢华的无肩带米白色舞会礼服，面料带珍珠般光泽，裙摆蓬松并由层层荷叶边组成云朵般、花瓣绽放般的质感；缎面或丝绸塔夫绸柔和反光。配饰保持极简，将视觉焦点放在花束上，并让她赤脚。她侧身坐在宽阔的暖橙棕色木质窗台上，背部随意倚靠右侧窗框，双腿向前伸展，脚趾触碰另一侧。左手将一束柔和的粉白玫瑰放在腿上；右手抬向脸部或发丝，呈现自然羞涩的动作。她神情平静，直视镜头。窗户周围有攀爬植物、深绿色叶片和盛开的小粉玫瑰，自然勾勒人物轮廓。使用柔和漫射的自然光，像黄金时刻或阴凉处拍摄，没有生硬阴影。竖幅9:16构图，照片级写实，不改变面部。

items.title: 晨光中抱着大白猫的成年女性温馨对镜自拍
items.description: A photorealistic mirror-selfie lifestyle portrait of a generic adult woman hugging a fluffy white cat in a sunlit lived-in bedroom with natural morning warmth.
items.prompt: Create a high-resolution photorealistic mirror-selfie lifestyle photograph of a generic adult woman with long messy wavy dark-brunette hair and a playful happy expression with a gently scrunched nose. She hugs a large fluffy white cat close to her chest; the cat has soft fur and calm blue-green eyes. Dress her in an oversized heather grey crewneck sweatshirt and white lounge pajama pants with a small whimsical all-over print of cats and figures. Let fluffy beige slippers appear on the wooden floor in the background. Set the scene in a cozy lived-in bedroom with an unmade bed, messy white sheets, scattered denim jeans and grey tees, a clothing rack of neutral garments, a wooden bedside table with a small modern lamp, a large bright window, and lush Monstera plants in white and woven pots. Capture the mirror's slight surface smudges and natural reflections. Use sun-drenched natural daylight, soft shadows, warm inviting morning atmosphere, realistic fabric and individual cat-fur detail, natural skin texture, and sharp focus on the woman and cat with only gentle depth-of-field softening in the background. Keep the mirror-selfie perspective candid and authentic; no logos, watermarks, extra text, distorted hands, duplicated cat features, plastic skin, or clutter that obscures the subjects.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张高分辨率照片级写实的对镜自拍生活方式照片：一名普通成年女性留着凌乱的深棕色波浪长发，带着俏皮愉悦的表情，鼻子轻轻皱起。她将一只体型较大、毛茸茸的白猫紧紧抱在胸前；猫咪毛发柔软，眼睛平静且呈蓝绿色。为她穿宽松的heather grey圆领运动衫和白色休闲睡裤，睡裤带有小巧异想天开的猫咪和人物满版图案。背景木地板上可见毛茸茸的米色拖鞋。场景是一间舒适、有生活气息的卧室，包含未铺整的床、凌乱白床单、散落的牛仔裤和灰色T恤、挂着中性色衣物的衣架、带小型现代台灯的木质床头柜、采光充足的大窗户，以及窗边白色和编织花盆中的茂盛龟背竹。保留大镜子表面的轻微污迹和自然反光。使用阳光充足的自然日光、柔和阴影和温暖亲切的清晨氛围，呈现真实面料、猫咪单根毛发和自然皮肤纹理；女性与猫咪清晰对焦，背景只做轻微景深柔化。保持对镜自拍的抓拍感和真实感；不要出现标志、水印、额外文字、变形手部、重复猫咪特征、塑料感皮肤或遮挡主体的杂乱。

items.title: 专业UI/UX用户旅程图绘制风格
items.description: A clean flowchart or user-journey diagram rendered in a strict monochrome style with orthogonal connectors, precise node geometry, centered sans-serif labels, and minimal visual noise.
items.prompt: Generate a clean professional UI/UX user-journey or process-flow diagram for Open app → sign in → choose project → review results → export report. Use a pure white #FFFFFF background, dark-gray or pure-black #333333/#000000 lines and borders, regular-weight dark-gray text with no bold, and no fill or pure-white node fill to mask lines behind. Use only extremely thin 1px orthogonal/elbow connectors made of horizontal and vertical segments with right-angle corners, ending in small solid black triangular arrowheads. Render normal nodes as small rounded rectangles with an approximately 4–8px radius, decision nodes as diamonds, and start/end nodes as capsules or rectangles with larger rounded corners. Center-align all labels in a small 12–14px sans-serif font such as Arial, Roboto, or Source Han Sans. Maintain strict spacing, clear hierarchy, balanced whitespace, accurate arrow direction, and legible process order. Use only the supplied process content, do not invent unrelated steps, and avoid gradients, shadows, decorative graphics, 3D styling, colored fills, logos, watermarks, or illegible extra text.
items.prompt_zh: 为Open app → sign in → choose project → review results → export report生成一张干净专业的UI/UX用户旅程图或流程图。使用纯白#FFFFFF背景，深灰或纯黑#333333/#000000线条与边框，深灰色常规字重文字，不加粗；节点不填充，或使用纯白填充遮挡其后的线条。只使用极细1px正交/肘形连接线，即由水平和垂直线段组成并带直角拐点，末端使用小型实心黑色三角箭头。普通节点绘制为圆角半径约4–8px的小型圆角矩形，判断节点绘制为菱形，开始/结束节点绘制为胶囊形或更大圆角的矩形。所有标签居中对齐，使用12–14px的小字号无衬线字体，例如Arial、Roboto或思源黑体。保持严格间距、清晰层级、平衡留白、准确箭头方向和可读的流程顺序。只使用提供的流程内容，不要编造无关步骤；避免渐变、阴影、装饰图形、3D风格、彩色填充、标志、水印或难以阅读的额外文字。

items.title: 夜色加油站的成年女性自然回眸肖像
items.description: A photorealistic 9:16 medium-full street portrait of a generic adult woman fueling a compact pink hatchback at a brightly lit gas station at night.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 9:16 vertical medium-full portrait from the knees up of a generic adult woman fueling a compact pink hatchback at a brightly lit gas station at night. She stands beside the pump holding the nozzle securely in the car, twists slightly, and looks back over her right shoulder directly toward the viewer with a confident natural expression. Give her dark hair in a casual messy bun with a small gold star-shaped hair clip, realistic skin texture and natural pores, genuine facial features, and bare arms with no tattoos. Dress her in a fitted light yellow cropped T-shirt and fitted grey athletic leggings, keeping natural adult proportions and believable fabric tension without exaggerating or reshaping the body. Show gas pumps, concrete ground, an overhead canopy with industrial lights, and distant convenience-store signage kept softly blurred and unreadable against the dark sky. Use mixed nighttime lighting: bright overhead canopy light with distinct but controlled shadows, colored station glow, realistic highlights on skin and fabric, and glossy reflections on the car paint. Keep the subject sharply focused, candid, and naturally integrated with the scene; use high-resolution night photography, realistic perspective, subtle film grain, balanced exposure, and no logos, watermarks, readable text, brand-specific vehicle markings, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, plastic skin, or overexposure.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张9:16竖幅照片级写实的中景全身肖像，画面从膝盖以上捕捉一名普通成年女性在灯火通明的夜间加油站为一辆pink紧凑型两厢车加油。她站在加油泵旁，将油枪稳稳插入汽车，身体略微扭转，越过右肩直接回头看向观者，表情自信自然。她的深色头发随意扎成凌乱发髻，戴一枚小型金色星形发夹；皮肤纹理真实、毛孔自然、五官真切，裸露手臂上没有纹身。为她穿合身的light yellow短款T恤和合身的grey运动打底裤，保持自然的成年人体比例和可信的面料张力，不夸张或重塑身体。背景显示加油泵、混凝土地面、带工业灯光的顶棚结构以及远处便利店招牌；招牌保持柔和虚化且不可读，映衬漆黑夜空。使用夜间混合照明：明亮顶棚灯形成清晰但受控的阴影，叠加加油站彩色辉光，在皮肤和面料上形成真实高光，并在车漆上产生光泽反射。主体清晰对焦，整体为自然抓拍；使用高分辨率夜间摄影、真实透视、微妙胶片颗粒和平衡曝光。不要出现标志、水印、可读文字、品牌车辆标记、人体变形、多余肢体、塑料感皮肤或过曝。

items.title: 悬浮在空中的高端动态美食摄影
items.description: A selectable high-speed commercial food photograph featuring either suspended medium-rare steak with potatoes and herbs or golden grilled shrimp with lemon and parsley.
items.prompt: Create one high-speed macro commercial food photograph using the selected module steak in a 4:5 vertical composition. For the "steak" module, suspend medium-rare sliced steak in mid-air against a dramatic black background, showing a juicy pink center and crispy seared crust, with coarse sea-salt crystals, roasted baby potatoes, garlic cloves, fresh rosemary, visible steam, and seasoning particles frozen in motion. Use dynamic splash energy, studio strobe lighting, sharp macro focus, shallow depth of field, glossy realistic textures, and a dark moody gourmet atmosphere. For the "shrimp" module, suspend golden grilled shrimp against a dramatic dark-blue gradient background, freezing water droplets, seasoning particles, parsley leaves, and lemon zest in motion, with a glossy surface reflection below, vibrant warm tones, crispy edges, juicy texture, studio flash, cinematic food styling, and dynamic splash composition. In either module, keep ingredients appetizing, physically plausible, sharply detailed, and professionally arranged. Avoid plastic food, fake motion, distorted ingredients, clutter, logos, watermarks, extra text, or low-end menu styling.
items.prompt_zh: 使用所选模块steak创作一张4:5竖幅高速微距商业美食摄影。对于“steak”模块，将半熟牛排切片悬浮在空中，背景为戏剧性黑色；展现多汁的粉红色中心和酥脆焦香外皮，周围有粗海盐晶体、烤小土豆、蒜瓣、新鲜迷迭香、可见蒸汽和凝固在运动中的调味料颗粒。使用动态飞溅感、影棚频闪照明、锐利微距对焦、浅景深、光泽真实纹理和黑暗高级的美食氛围。对于“shrimp”模块，将金黄色烤虾悬浮在戏剧性深蓝渐变背景中，凝固水滴、调味料颗粒、欧芹叶和柠檬皮屑的运动；下方加入光泽表面反射，并呈现鲜艳暖色、酥脆边缘、多汁质感、影棚闪光、电影感美食造型和动态飞溅构图。无论哪个模块，都要保持配料诱人、物理可信、细节锐利和专业摆盘。避免塑料感食物、虚假运动、变形配料、杂乱、标志、水印、额外文字或低端菜单风格。

items.title: 高端立体突破商业海报设计
items.description: A clean high-end graphic advertisement on white, built around a solid rounded gradient square with a subject and product breaking through its edges.
items.prompt: Create a professional high-end graphic advertising composition on a pure solid white 4:5 canvas. Center a perfectly symmetrical large solid rounded square, never a hollow frame. Fill the entire square with a smooth vibrant gradient from deep cobalt blue at the top-left to vivid coral red at the bottom-right. Place an adult woman in a tailored ivory jumpsuit with natural dark hair so the bottom of the torso is exactly flush with the square's bottom edge, leaving no thick colored border beneath. Keep the adult subject's clothing, skin, and hair in natural realistic colors and textures, lit by professional studio lighting independent of the background gradient so no color cast affects the person or product. Have the subject firmly and naturally grip a matte cobalt skincare bottle with a minimal unbranded label; the head and hair break through the square's top boundary into the white canvas, while the hands and AURORA BALM break through the side boundaries for a powerful but physically believable breakout effect. Above the square, leave a clear white gap and place the brand text "AURORA" in bold condensed uppercase sans-serif and deep cobalt blue. In the bottom-right of the gradient square, overlay a small thin clean block of warm white text reading exactly "FORM FOLLOWS LIGHT". Use crisp softbox commercial lighting with crisp controlled detail on the subject, clothing, and product. Keep the layout minimal, symmetrical in the square, sharply aligned, and free of logos beyond the declared brand text, watermarks, extra text, distorted anatomy, warped product, impossible intersections, or accidental color spill.
items.prompt_zh: 在纯白色4:5画布上创作一张专业高端的平面设计广告构图。中央放置一个完美对称的大型实心圆角正方形，绝不要做成空心边框。正方形内部全部填充平滑鲜艳的渐变，从左上角的deep cobalt blue过渡到右下角的vivid coral red。将an adult woman in a tailored ivory jumpsuit with natural dark hair放置在画面中，使其躯干底部与正方形的最底边完全齐平，下方不留下厚重彩色边框。人物的服装、皮肤和头发保持自然真实的颜色与纹理，并由独立于背景渐变的专业影棚灯光照明，避免人物或产品产生偏色。让人物牢固且自然地握持a matte cobalt skincare bottle with a minimal unbranded label；头部和头发突破正方形顶部边界，延伸到白色画布中，同时双手和AURORA BALM突破侧面边界，形成强烈但物理可信的立体突破效果。在正方形上方留出清晰的白色间隙，使用bold condensed uppercase sans-serif字体和deep cobalt blue颜色放置品牌文字“AURORA”。在渐变正方形右下角直接叠加一小块纤细简洁的warm white文字，准确显示“FORM FOLLOWS LIGHT”。使用crisp softbox商业灯光，以清晰受控的细节强调人物、服装和产品纹理。保持版面极简，正方形内部对称，边缘精准对齐；除声明的品牌文字外，不要出现其他标志、水印或额外文字，也不要出现人体变形、产品变形、不可能的相交或意外色彩溢出。

items.title: 画韵红妆：东方高定美学人像
items.description: A single 4:5 fashion-editorial image containing a 2x2 grid of the same generic adult woman, consistently styled in a deep-red embroidered kimono with graphic crimson eyeliner and four distinct poised expressions.
items.prompt: Create one 4:5 vertical high-fashion editorial portrait image containing a clean 2x2 grid of four panels, separated by thin black borders with no outer border. Show the same generic adult woman in every panel; keep her face, bone structure, proportions, hairstyle, wardrobe, makeup, lighting, and color grade fully consistent across the grid. Style her with a modern sculptural updo, loose textured strands, asymmetrical organic volume, and subtle natural shine, explicitly not a traditional geisha style. Use natural matte porcelain skin with realistic texture, full natural brows brushed upward, subtle warm peach blush, and deep matte crimson lips. Her signature makeup is a dramatic red graphic eyeliner that flows from the inner corner across the lid and extends toward the temple in a smooth calligraphy-inspired curve. Dress her in a deep-red embroidered kimono with floral detailing, a white inner collar, rich fabric texture, and elegant drape over the shoulders; add minimal gold drop earrings and no heavy hair ornaments. Use a soft muted dark-green smooth gradient background. The four panel poses and expressions are: 1 serious calm gaze slightly right; 2 direct confident eye contact; 3 side profile emphasizing the eyeliner curve; 4 soft downward gaze with subtle emotion. Use soft diffused key light from front-left, gentle cheekbone shadow shaping, no harsh flash, an 85mm portrait-lens look, fine skin and fabric detail, subtle analog grain, cinematic soft-warm grading, and elegant, powerful, artistic mood. Keep all panels sharp, coherent, and free of logos, watermarks, extra text, different faces, different hairstyles, different outfits, inconsistent lighting, warped anatomy, plastic skin, or obvious CGI.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张4:5竖幅高端时尚编辑肖像图，内部包含干净的2×2四格网格；各格之间使用细黑边分隔，不要外边框。四格中都显示同一名普通成年女性；保持她的面部、骨骼结构、比例、发型、服装、妆容、光线和色彩分级完全一致。为她设计现代雕塑感盘发，带松散纹理发丝、不对称有机蓬松感和微妙自然光泽，明确不要传统艺伎风格。皮肤为自然哑光瓷肌并保留真实纹理，眉毛自然浓密并向上轻梳，脸颊带微妙暖桃色腮红，嘴唇为深哑光绯红色。标志性妆容是戏剧性的红色图形眼线，从内眼角沿眼睑延伸，以受书法笔触启发的流畅曲线伸向太阳穴。穿深红色刺绣和服，带花卉细节、白色内领和丰富织物纹理，优雅披在肩上；搭配简约金色垂坠耳环，不要厚重发饰。背景使用柔和、平滑的暗绿色渐变。四格姿势与表情依次为：1严肃平静地略看向右侧；2自信地直视镜头；3侧面轮廓突出眼线曲线；4柔和向下凝视并带有微妙情绪。使用左前方柔和漫射主光，在颧骨处形成轻柔阴影塑形，不要刺眼闪光；采用85mm人像镜头效果、细腻皮肤与织物细节、微妙模拟颗粒、电影感柔和暖色分级，整体优雅、强大且艺术化。保持四格清晰连贯，不要出现标志、水印、额外文字、不同面孔、不同发型、不同服装、不一致光线、人体变形、塑料感皮肤或明显CGI。

items.title: 黄金时刻乡间小路的温柔成年女性肖像
items.description: A natural full-body lifestyle portrait of an adult woman walking toward the camera on a quiet summer country road, with soft golden-hour light and green fields.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic full-body natural lifestyle portrait of a generic adult woman walking naturally toward the camera on a quiet countryside road. She has light brown long straight hair flowing naturally, realistic skin texture with a soft warm tone, a soft gentle smile, relaxed confident expression, and direct gaze toward the camera. Dress her in a simple black T-shirt, blue denim jeans, and black canvas sneakers with white laces, with minimal casual accessories. Surround the road with green trees and open summer fields beneath a soft blue sky with light clouds. Set the scene in late-afternoon golden hour: warm sunlight comes from the side, creating soft shadows, a golden glow, and gentle highlights with believable outdoor illumination. Use an eye-level full-body camera angle, sharp focus on the subject, slight natural depth in the background, warm greens and natural tones, realistic textures, and natural shadows. Keep the mood peaceful, fresh, and unposed. No logos, watermarks, extra text, distorted anatomy, duplicated limbs, plastic skin, or contemporary visual clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张照片级写实的自然生活方式全身肖像：一名普通成年女性在宁静的乡村小路上自然地走向镜头。她有一头自然飘逸的light brown长直发，皮肤纹理真实、色调柔和温暖，面带温柔微笑，表情放松自信，并直视镜头。为她穿简约blackT恤、蓝色牛仔裤和黑色帆布运动鞋，鞋带为白色，搭配极简日常配饰。小路周围是绿树和开阔的夏日田野，天空柔和湛蓝并带有轻薄云朵。场景设定在傍晚黄金时段，温暖阳光从侧面射入，形成柔和阴影、金色光晕和温柔高光，呈现可信的户外光线。使用与视线齐平的全身拍摄角度，主体清晰对焦，背景带轻微自然景深；采用暖绿色和自然色调、真实纹理与自然阴影。保持宁静、清新、不刻意摆拍的氛围。不要出现标志、水印、额外文字、人体变形、重复肢体、塑料感皮肤或当代视觉杂物。

items.title: 原创角色四角度光影侧颜特写
items.description: A clean four-panel character study showing the same original adult character from rear, profile, diagonal-rear upper-body, and close profile views with consistent design and lighting.
items.prompt: Create a clean four-panel character study of an original adult character with short silver hair, a charcoal high-collar coat, and a calm expression. Keep the same adult character's face, hair, costume, proportions, and lighting consistent across all four panels. Arrange the panels as a balanced 2x2 contact sheet with clear separation and no extra objects. Panel 1: diagonal rear view showing the back of the character. Panel 2: right-side profile showing the character's full facial profile. Panel 3: diagonal rear upper-body view emphasizing shoulder, neck, hair, and costume structure. Panel 4: close-up right-side profile of the face with crisp eyes, nose, lips, skin texture, and hair detail. Use refined portrait lighting with controlled highlights and soft shadows, a clean neutral background, realistic anatomy and materials, consistent color grading, and sharp focus on each view. Make the study suitable as a visual character-reference sheet; no logos, watermarks, extra text beyond the panel numbers 1, 2, 3, and 4, duplicated features, mismatched designs, distorted anatomy, or blurry faces.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张an original adult character with short silver hair, a charcoal high-collar coat, and a calm expression的干净四格角色研究图。确保同一名成年角色在四格中的面部、发型、服装、比例和光线保持一致。将四个画面排成平衡的2×2接触表，各格清晰分隔，不要出现额外物体。第1格：斜后方背部视图，展示角色背面。第2格：右侧面视图，展示角色完整的面部侧面轮廓。第3格：斜后方上半身视图，强调肩部、颈部、头发和服装结构。第4格：面部右侧面特写，清晰呈现眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、皮肤纹理和头发细节。使用精致的人像光线、受控高光和柔和阴影，干净的中性背景，真实人体结构与材质，统一色彩分级，并让每个视图清晰对焦。使其适合作为角色视觉参考表；除面板编号1、2、3、4外，不要出现标志、水印或额外文字，也不要出现重复特征、设计不一致、人体变形或模糊面部。

items.title: 逼真原创角色特效参考图
items.description: A configurable still-image prompt for generating a realistic original character with a coherent visual effect, suitable for use as a later video-reference asset.
items.prompt: Generate a single high-resolution still image of an original adult fantasy traveler in a weathered charcoal coat featuring soft bioluminescent blue energy ribbons interacting with the coat and surrounding air. The image should be a clean, believable character-reference asset with realistic anatomy, expressive but natural pose, coherent costume and materials, and an effect that interacts physically with the character through light, shadows, particles, and atmospheric depth. Use cinematic photorealistic rendering, clear subject separation, natural skin and hair texture when applicable, detailed fabric or surface materials, balanced exposure, and a simple environment that supports the effect without distraction. Keep the character and effect fully visible, compositionally readable, and consistent enough to serve as a visual reference for a later motion or video treatment. Use a 4:5 vertical portrait composition, restrained color harmony, no logos, watermarks, brand names, or extra text, and no distorted anatomy, duplicated limbs, plastic skin, or uncontrolled particle clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 生成一张高分辨率静态图像，主体为an original adult fantasy traveler in a weathered charcoal coat，并呈现soft bioluminescent blue energy ribbons interacting with the coat and surrounding air。画面应成为干净可信的角色参考素材，具有真实人体结构、自然而富有表现力的姿态、统一的服装与材质，以及通过光线、阴影、粒子和空间氛围与人物发生物理互动的特效。使用电影感照片级写实渲染；在适用时保留自然的皮肤和头发纹理、细致的织物或表面材质、平衡曝光和不会分散注意力的简洁环境。确保人物和特效完整可见、构图清晰，并保持足够一致，以便后续制作动态或视频处理。采用4:5竖幅肖像构图、克制的色彩和谐；不要出现标志、水印、品牌名称或额外文字，也不要出现人体变形、重复肢体、塑料感皮肤或失控的粒子杂乱。

items.title: 萌娃躺在缤纷巧克力海洋中的快乐里程碑平铺照
items.description: A bright professional flat-lay milestone photograph of a laughing baby on a pink quilted blanket, surrounded by colorful unbranded confectionery and holding one wrapped chocolate bar across the face.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the baby; preserve the baby's identity naturally without altering facial structure. Create a bright, professional high-resolution flat-lay milestone photograph. A laughing baby lies safely on her back on a vivid pink quilted blanket, holding one generic wrapped chocolate bar across the lower part of her face without obstructing breathing. Dress her in denim overalls over a floral-patterned top, a yellow bow headband, and colorful socks. Surround her with a dense but safely arranged playful sea of colorful unbranded chocolate bars, candies, and wrappers, varying in shape and color but showing no logos, brand names, or readable text. Keep the baby as the central focus, with cheerful celebratory energy, clear baby-safe spacing, natural infant anatomy, realistic fabric and confectionery textures, soft even studio light, crisp overhead composition, balanced color, and no hazardous loose objects near the mouth or nose. Avoid branded packaging, extra text, watermarks, distorted hands or limbs, duplicate objects, harsh shadows, plastic skin, or clutter that obscures the baby.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为婴儿的面部身份依据，自然保持婴儿的身份，不改变面部结构。创作一张明亮、专业的高分辨率里程碑平铺照片。一个正在大笑的婴儿安全地仰卧在鲜艳的粉色绗缝毯子上，手里拿着一根通用包装的巧克力棒横在脸部下方，但不要遮挡呼吸。她穿牛仔背带裤、碎花上衣、黄色蝴蝶结发带和彩色袜子。周围布置一片密集但安全的彩色无品牌巧克力棒、糖果和包装纸，形状和色彩各异，但不要出现标志、品牌名称或可读文字。保持婴儿为画面中心，营造快乐庆祝的里程碑氛围；确保婴儿安全间距、自然婴儿解剖结构、真实的面料和糖果纹理、柔和均匀的影棚光线、清晰的俯拍构图和平衡色彩，并避免嘴巴或鼻子附近出现危险松散物体。不要出现品牌包装、额外文字、水印、变形手脚、重复物体、刺眼阴影、塑料感皮肤或遮挡婴儿的杂乱元素。

items.title: 铜红发成年女性录音棚幕后肖像
items.description: A candid waist-up recording-studio portrait of a generic adult woman with long copper-red waves, pastel loungewear, headphones, and a contemplative upward gaze.
items.prompt: Create a detailed photorealistic waist-up portrait of a generic adult woman in a professional recording studio or vocal booth. She has fair natural skin with subtle freckles, long silky copper-red waves parted at the center, and blue eyes looking upward and slightly right with a contemplative expression. She stands angled slightly to the side, with her right hand resting naturally on her hip and relaxed fingers. Dress her in a tight-fitting sleeveless scoop-neck ribbed-cotton top in pastel pink and oversized pastel-pink sweatpants with an elastic waistband. Add large black over-ear studio headphones, a black-and-red multi-motif clover bracelet on the left wrist, and multiple thin silver rings on the left hand. Place a silver condenser microphone with a shock mount in the foreground and a black cable draping down; keep it generic without brand markings. The background contains dark grey and black acoustic panels, a vertical wooden beam or wall accent, and a visible electrical outlet on the lower wall. Use soft diffused studio lighting that illuminates the face evenly, sharp focus on the subject with slight depth-of-field blur on the microphone stand, natural skin and fabric texture, clean contemporary behind-the-scenes pop-music atmosphere, balanced exposure, and no logos, watermarks, extra text, plastic skin, distorted anatomy, or excessive retouching.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张详细的照片级写实腰部以上肖像，主体是一名普通成年女性，场景位于专业录音室或人声录音棚。她拥有白皙自然且带细微雀斑的皮肤、长而丝滑的铜红色中分波浪发，以及向上微向右看的蓝色眼睛，表情沉思。她站立时身体略微侧向一边，右手自然放在髋部，手指放松。为她穿pastel pink紧身无袖圆领罗纹棉上衣，以及带松紧腰的宽松柔和粉色运动裤。搭配大型黑色包耳式录音室耳机、左手腕黑红多图案三叶草手链和左手多枚细银戒指。前景放置银色电容麦克风与防震架，黑色麦克风线自然垂下；麦克风保持通用外观，不出现品牌标记。背景包含深灰色和黑色吸音板、垂直木梁或墙面装饰，以及下墙可见的电源插座。使用柔和漫射的录音室灯光均匀照亮面部，主体清晰对焦，麦克风支架略有景深虚化；保留自然皮肤与面料纹理、整洁现代的幕后流行音乐氛围、平衡曝光。不要出现标志、水印、额外文字、塑料感皮肤、人体变形或过度修图。

items.title: 浆果悬浮冰沙碗高端食物广告摄影
items.description: A 3:4 premium hyper-realistic food image with a selectable energetic splash or calm floating-topping smoothie-bowl composition.
items.prompt: Create one premium hyper-realistic commercial food photograph in a 3:4 vertical portrait format using the selected module splash. For the "splash" module, show a deep navy glossy ceramic bowl centered and floating against a seamless vibrant coral-pink studio background, filled with a thick intense violet-magenta mixed-berry smoothie. Capture the bowl at the peak of an energetic upward splash, with banana slices, whole bloom-covered blueberries, richly textured raspberries, bright fresh mint leaves, sculpted smoothie arcs, and fine droplets frozen sharply in midair. Use controlled studio lighting with crisp highlights, defined splash edges, and high-speed capture with shallow-to-medium depth of field. For the "minimal" module, show a softly speckled blush ceramic bowl with a velvet-matte finish, centrally aligned and visually floating against a muted lavender pastel gradient. Fill it with a thick uniform pale-rose creamy fruit smoothie with muted berry undertones, and suspend golden toasted oat clusters, fine dark seeds, strawberry halves with visible seed texture, whole raspberries, and plump blackberries gently and evenly above the surface. Use diffused studio light, soft shadows, clean separation, and shallow depth of field. In either module, keep the bowl geometry centered, materials physically believable, colors controlled, food appetizing, and no people, logos, watermarks, or extra text. Avoid distorted bowls, fake plastic liquid, messy clutter, or inconsistent ingredient scale.
items.prompt_zh: 以所选模块splash创作一张3:4竖幅、高端超写实的商业食物摄影。对于“splash”模块，展示一个深海军蓝光泽陶瓷碗，置于无缝鲜艳珊瑚粉色工作室背景中并居中悬浮；碗中装有浓稠、浓郁紫红色的混合浆果冰沙。捕捉充满活力的向上飞溅瞬间：加入柔和弯曲的香蕉片、带天然果霜的完整蓝莓、质地分明的鲜红覆盆子、翠绿新鲜薄荷叶、雕塑般的冰沙飞溅弧线和清晰凝固在空中的细小水滴。使用受控工作室照明，形成清晰高光和明确飞溅边缘，并以高速捕捉和浅至中等景深呈现。对于“minimal”模块，展示一个带微妙斑点细节、天鹅绒哑光表面的柔和腮红色陶瓷碗，居中且视觉上轻盈地悬浮在柔和薰衣草色粉彩渐变背景中。碗中装有浓稠、顺滑、均匀的淡玫瑰色奶油水果冰沙，带柔和浆果底色；让金黄色烤燕麦簇、细小深色种子、可见种子纹理的半片草莓、完整覆盆子和饱满黑莓轻柔且均匀地悬浮在表面上方。使用漫射工作室照明、柔和阴影、清晰分离和较浅景深。无论哪个模块，都要保持碗的几何形态居中、材质物理可信、色彩受控、食物诱人；不要出现人物、标志、水印或额外文字。避免变形碗、塑料感液体、杂乱堆叠或配料比例不一致。

items.title: 迷离霓虹下的荧光蘑菇丛
items.description: A low-angle close-up of bioluminescent mushrooms in a grassy field, glowing pink and blue against surreal pink-purple grass and a soft teal background.
items.prompt: Create a low-angle close-up photograph of a cluster of bioluminescent mushrooms growing in a grassy field. Illuminate the mushrooms with vibrant pink and blue neon light so they emit a soft believable glow onto the surrounding grass. Tint the grass with subtle pink and purple hues, creating a surreal dreamlike atmosphere while retaining recognizable organic mushroom and grass textures. Use a soft out-of-focus teal background to isolate and emphasize the glowing cluster. Keep the composition intimate and low to the ground, with shallow depth of field, natural glow falloff, gentle atmospheric contrast, crisp mushroom detail, and no people, logos, watermark, or extra text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张低角度特写照片，展示一簇生长在草地上的生物发光蘑菇。使用鲜艳的粉色和蓝色霓虹光照亮蘑菇，让它们向周围草地投射出柔和且可信的光芒。让草地带有微妙的粉色和紫色色调，营造超现实、梦幻的氛围，同时保留蘑菇和草本植物可辨认的有机纹理。背景使用柔和失焦的青绿色，以分离并突出发光蘑菇簇。保持贴近地面的亲密低机位构图、浅景深、自然的光晕衰减、柔和氛围对比和清晰的蘑菇细节；不要出现人物、标志、水印或额外文字。

items.title: 实验性文字液体交互海报
items.description: A premium 9:16 experimental poster where physical letterforms fall from a tilted product and interact with a liquid boundary through believable refraction, bubbles, drag, and diffusion.
items.prompt: Create a refined experimental typography poster in a 9:16 vertical format where letters behave like real physical objects interacting with realistic refraction, bubbles, drag, partial occlusion, distortion, and fluid diffusion. Feature premium dried noodles branded NANA NOODLE BAR, named LIQUID UMAMI, in a tilted matte paper noodle cup with a controlled dark plum, vermilion orange, coral pink, and a small cold-cyan accent. Place the container near the top edge, partially cropped and tilted downward. Let the letters from the brand and product name pour out, fall through generous negative space, and enter the liquid. Give the falling letters controlled randomness through varied scale, rotation, spacing, overlap, and depth while preserving a clear downward motion and increasing density near the surface. Make the liquid boundary the main visual event: apply realistic refraction, bubbles, drag, partial occlusion, distortion, and fluid diffusion through believable refraction, bubbles, drag, partial occlusion, distortion, and fluid diffusion as letters cross into the medium; underwater portions must visibly respond to the liquid. Follow the rhythm release → fall → gather → impact → transform. Keep splashes elegant and restrained, with transparent and concentrated liquid layers, subtle depth, and generous negative space. Use dark plum, vermilion orange, coral pink, and a small cold-cyan accent to create slight contrast between the upper air space and lower liquid space. Add only a small editorial information area containing CITY SOUND / 04:12 / FIELD NOTES. Make the result minimal, premium, editorial, experimental, physically believable, detailed up close, and clear at thumbnail size. Avoid heavy 3D type, random scattered letters, excessive copy, oversized splashes, clutter, generic commercial-ad styling, logos not specified by the brand variable, watermarks, or extra text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张9:16竖幅的精致实验性排版海报，其中字母像与realistic refraction, bubbles, drag, partial occlusion, distortion, and fluid diffusion互动的真实物理对象。以a tilted matte paper noodle cup呈现名为LIQUID UMAMI、品牌为NANA NOODLE BAR的premium dried noodles，使用受控的dark plum, vermilion orange, coral pink, and a small cold-cyan accent。将容器放在顶部边缘附近，部分裁剪并向下倾斜。让品牌名和产品名中的字母倾泻而出，穿过大量负空间并进入液体。通过变化的比例、旋转、间距、重叠和深度赋予下落字母受控的随机性，同时保持清晰的向下运动，并让字体在接近液面时逐渐变密。使液体边界成为主要视觉事件：当字母进入液体时，通过可信的折射、气泡、阻力、部分遮挡、扭曲和流体扩散呈现realistic refraction, bubbles, drag, partial occlusion, distortion, and fluid diffusion；跨越液面的字母，其水下部分必须明显受到液体介质影响。遵循释放→下落→聚集→冲击→转化的视觉节奏。保持飞溅优雅而克制，使用透明且浓缩的液体层、微妙深度和充足留白。用dark plum, vermilion orange, coral pink, and a small cold-cyan accent在上部空气空间和下部液体空间之间形成轻微对比。仅添加一小块包含CITY SOUND / 04:12 / FIELD NOTES的编辑信息区域。整体应极简、高端、社论风格、实验性且物理可信，特写细节丰富，同时在缩略图大小下保持清晰。避免沉重的3D字体、随机散落字母、过多文案、过大的飞溅、杂乱、通用商业广告风格、变量未指定的标志、水印或额外文字。

items.title: 实验性排版与实体印刷痕迹文化刊物封面
items.description: A narrow 3:4 culture-magazine cover about city sound collection, built from oversized black glyph structures, warm flat-color illustration, dense information columns, and tactile misregistered ink traces.
items.prompt: Create a vertical 3:4 culture-magazine cover about city sound collection. Begin with a magnified core symbol of urban listening and oversized black glyphs or abstract text structures cutting in from the frame edges, then overlap them with a high-saturation flat illustration so text and image create deliberate cut-in and misregistration relationships. Use a narrow vertical arrangement and strong whitespace, guiding the eye through the large title forms, compact theme illustration, dense information columns, and bottom information bar. Use dark purple-black as the dominant field, with vermilion orange, coral pink, and one small block of cold cyan as high-saturation jump points; let light beige paper provide breathing room. Set the title as right-aligned oversized original glyphs with partial inversion, exaggerated proportions, heavy strokes, tight spacing, sharp or asymmetric terminals, occasional connected turns, and open counters; keep the glyph skeleton legible and coherent across writing systems. Arrange small directory-like annotations vertically along the left edge and keep them secondary. In the lower-left, place a compact illustration cluster of concentric sound ripples, microphone outlines, and intermittent lines; use a few pure color blocks, silhouettes, repeating patterns, and local thin lines rather than realism. Preserve rough printed edges, local spot-color shifts, uneven paper base color, slight registration misalignment, edge ink overflow, and localized fading, as if produced by physical platemaking. Keep the central reading path clear, with whitespace unfolding diagonally toward the bottom information bar. Use no smooth gradients, glass gloss, excessive symmetry, digital sharpening, commercial beautification, logos, watermarks, or unrelated readable text. The result should feel like a sophisticated experimental cultural publication cover with tactile handmade print evidence.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张关于城市声音采集的竖版3:4文化刊物封面。先以城市聆听的放大核心符号和从画面边缘切入的大型黑色字形或抽象文字结构形成冲击，再让高饱和扁平插图与文字产生有意的遮挡、切入和套印错位关系。采用偏窄的竖向编排与强烈留白，引导视线经过大型标题字形、紧凑主题插图、细密信息栏和底部信息条。以暗紫黑为主色，使用朱橙、珊瑚粉和一小块冷青作为高饱和视觉跳点，让浅米色纸面负责呼吸。标题使用右对齐的超大原创字形和局部反白，强调夸张比例、厚重笔画、紧凑字距、锐利或不对称端点、偶尔相连的转折与开放反白空间；保持字形骨架在不同文字系统中仍清晰连贯。细小的目录式注释沿左边缘纵向排列，并保持次要。左下放置由同心声波、麦克风轮廓和断续线条组成的紧凑插图簇；使用少量纯色块、剪影、重复纹样和局部细线，不追求写实。保留粗粝印刷边缘、局部套色偏移、纸张底色不均、轻微套印错位、边缘溢墨和局部褪色，仿佛经过实体制版印刷。保持清晰的阅读路径，让留白沿对角线展开并把视线引向底部信息条。不要使用平滑渐变、玻璃光泽、过度对称、数字化锐化、商业海报式美化、标志、水印或无关的可读文字。整体应像一张精致、实验性、具有触觉印刷证据的文化刊物封面。

items.title: 史诗级原创动画战斗分镜图
items.description: A 3:4 vertical 12-panel storyboard sheet showing a continuous high-energy animated battle between two consistently designed original characters, from environment setup through aftermath.
items.prompt: Generate a high-energy animated battle storyboard image in cinematic high-energy anime-inspired storyboard, featuring Aster, a silver-haired lightning lancer in white and cobalt armor versus Veyra, a dark-haired gravity mage in charcoal and crimson robes. Use a strict 3:4 vertical composition with a 3-column by 4-row grid containing exactly 12 storyboard panels. This must read as one continuously progressing battle sequence, not an ordinary collage or unrelated illustrations. Maintain unified appearance, clothing, abilities, and temperament for both characters across all panels. Use cinematic camera tension, intense action design, epic atmosphere, clear character and ability contrast, strong color and aura contrast, speed, impact, energy fission, smoke, debris, and spectacular but coherent special effects. Sequence the panels exactly as follows: 1 environment establishment; 2 Character A close-up; 3 Character B close-up; 4 confrontation; 5 Character A attacks first; 6 Character B counterattacks; 7 close-quarters clash; 8 power escalation; 9 both ultimate moves manifest; 10 final sprint; 11 decisive blow; 12 aftermath. Put a clear large white panel number 1 through 12 in the top-left corner of every panel. Put a white timecode and a concise Chinese description in the bottom-left corner of every panel. Keep panel borders and reading order clear, action continuity legible, anatomy coherent, and effects consistent with each character's abilities. Use an original non-franchise design for the default characters; do not copy existing character costumes, logos, names, or recognizable protected imagery. The finished sheet should make the complete battle process immediately understandable, with crisp linework, dynamic framing, controlled high-energy color, and no extra text beyond the required numbers, timecodes, and concise Chinese captions.
items.prompt_zh: 请以cinematic high-energy anime-inspired storyboard生成一张高燃动画战斗分镜图，内容为Aster, a silver-haired lightning lancer in white and cobalt armor对战Veyra, a dark-haired gravity mage in charcoal and crimson robes。采用严格的3:4竖版构图，排成3列×4行、共12格分镜。画面必须呈现一整组连续推进的战斗过程，而不是普通拼图或互不相关的单张插画合集。两名角色在全部12格中保持外观、服装、能力和气质统一。使用电影级镜头张力、强烈动作设计和史诗级氛围，突出角色、能力、色彩和气场的对比，并加入速度感、冲击感、能量裂变、烟尘、碎石以及壮观但连贯的特效。分镜节奏必须严格为：第1格环境建立；第2格角色A特写；第3格角色B特写；第4格双方对峙；第5格角色A先攻；第6格角色B反击；第7格近身交锋；第8格力量升级；第9格双方大招显现；第10格最终冲刺；第11格决胜一击；第12格战后余波。每格左上角放置清晰的大号白色编号1至12；每格左下角放置白色时间码和一句简洁中文说明。保持格线与阅读顺序清晰、动作连续易读、人体结构连贯，特效与角色能力一致。默认角色使用原创且非系列作品的设计；不要复制现有角色服装、标志、名称或具有辨识度的受保护形象。最终分镜应让人一眼看懂完整战斗过程，具有清晰线稿、动态镜头、受控的高燃色彩；除规定的编号、时间码和简洁中文说明外，不要出现额外文字。

items.title: 极简现代风黄金菠萝奶油特饮商业摄影海报
items.description: A premium 4:5 tropical beverage poster for fictional brand SOLARA SIP, centered on a chilled pineapple-latte fusion in a clear rocks glass against a saturated mango-yellow monochrome field.
items.prompt: Create a premium 4:5 vertical beverage advertising poster for the fictional tropical cafe brand SOLARA SIP and its signature drink "Golden Pine Cream". Use ultra-realistic product photography, not illustration or 3D render. Build a fully saturated mango-yellow monochrome background and matching surface. Place one short clear thick-bottomed rocks glass slightly below center as the absolute visual hero; it contains a chilled pineapple-latte fusion with a luminous golden-yellow body, subtle density variation, faint condensation, smooth silky micro-bubbled cream foam, and one fresh triangular pineapple wedge floating on the foam and angled slightly toward camera. The glass casts a clean sharply defined warm shadow diagonally toward the lower right. Integrate large bold white uppercase sans-serif typography behind and above the glass reading exactly "GOLDEN / TROPIC"; add a slim vertical left label reading exactly "PINEAPPLE LATTE"; add one small uppercase bottom descriptor reading exactly "VELVETY PINEAPPLE, SILK FOAM, BRIGHT ISLAND ENERGY." Add only a tiny restrained SOLARA SIP brand mark. Keep the layout centered, iconic, and spacious. Use strong clean directional sunlight from upper left, bright highlights on the rim, foam, fruit, and liquid surface, crisp elegant shadow, and no clipped highlights or dead black areas. Render realistic glass thickness, refraction, polished edges, internal reflections, liquid meniscus, sauce-like fruit-creamy opacity, pineapple fibers, natural rind detail, and condensation haze. Use saturated tropical yellow, mango gold, pineapple yellow, creamy ivory foam, transparent glass neutrals, and crisp white type. Aim for luxury pop-minimal modernist beverage advertising with controlled color harmony and no extra props, fruit clutter, splash explosion, fake CGI glass, warped geometry, unreadable type, watermark, copied branding, or extra text.
items.prompt_zh: 为虚构的热带咖啡品牌SOLARA SIP及其招牌饮品“Golden Pine Cream”创作一张高级4:5竖幅饮料广告海报。使用超写实产品摄影，而非插画或3D渲染。构建完全饱和的芒果黄色单色背景和配套台面。将一个矮身、厚底、晶莹透明的古典杯放在画面中心略下方，作为绝对视觉主角；杯中装有冷藏的菠萝拿铁融合饮品，液体呈发光的金黄色，具有微妙密度变化、淡淡冷凝水、顺滑丝滑且带微小气泡的奶油泡沫；泡沫表面漂浮一片新鲜三角形菠萝块，略微朝向相机倾斜。玻璃杯向右下方投射干净、边缘锐利的温暖斜向阴影。在玻璃杯后方和上方融入大号粗体白色大写无衬线排版，显示字面内容“GOLDEN / TROPIC”；左侧添加纤细垂直标签“PINEAPPLE LATTE”；底部添加一行白色大写小字描述“VELVETY PINEAPPLE, SILK FOAM, BRIGHT ISLAND ENERGY.”；只添加一个极小且克制的SOLARA SIP品牌标记。保持构图居中、标志性并留有充足空间。使用来自左上方的强烈清晰定向阳光，在杯缘、泡沫、果肉和液面形成明亮高光；阴影清晰优雅，高光不过曝，不出现死黑区域。呈现真实玻璃厚度、折射、抛光边缘、内部反射、液体弯月面、果油奶油般的不透明度、菠萝纤维、自然果皮细节和冷凝水雾。使用饱和热带黄、芒果金、菠萝黄、奶油象牙泡沫、透明玻璃中性色和利落白色字体。整体为奢华波普极简现代主义饮料广告，色彩和谐且受控；不要额外道具、水果杂乱、爆炸式溅射、假CGI玻璃、变形几何、无法阅读的排版、水印、复制品牌或额外文字。

items.title: 1979年县集市上的复古成年情侣
items.description: A 16:9 period photograph of an adult couple at a 1979 county fair, both styled with feathered hair and an authentic late-1970s documentary snapshot feel.
items.prompt: Create a 16:9 period-style photograph set at a county fair in 1979. Show a generic adult couple, both clearly over 21, standing together among fairground rides, string lights, and a softly busy crowd. Give both adults authentic late-1970s feathered hairstyles and period-appropriate casual clothing. Capture a warm candid relationship moment with relaxed natural body language and an easy affectionate expression, as if taken by a family photographer. Use slightly faded analog color, gentle film grain, realistic flash or late-afternoon fairground light, natural skin texture, and documentary snapshot composition. Keep the era cues coherent in the clothing, hair, rides, signage shapes, and color palette, but do not add readable brand names, modern devices, logos, or extra text. Avoid exaggerated nostalgia, plastic skin, duplicated people, distorted anatomy, or contemporary elements.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张16:9的时代感照片，场景设定在1979年的县集市。画面中是一对普通成年情侣，两人都明确为21岁以上，站在游乐设施、串灯和略显繁忙的人群之间。两人都留着符合时代的20世纪70年代末羽毛状发型，穿着符合年代的休闲服装。捕捉一个温暖、自然的关系瞬间，身体语言放松，表情轻松亲昵，仿佛由家庭摄影师随手拍摄。使用略微褪色的模拟彩色、柔和胶片颗粒、真实的闪光灯或傍晚集市光线、自然皮肤纹理和纪实快照构图。服装、发型、游乐设施、标牌形状和色彩应保持时代线索一致，但不要添加可读的品牌名称、现代设备、标志或额外文字。避免夸张怀旧、塑料感皮肤、人物重复、人体变形或当代元素。

items.title: 高级复古丝网印刷旅行海报插图
items.description: An adaptable 4:5 vintage screen-print travel or cultural poster built from layered graphic planes, stippled tonal modeling, a bold geometric anchor, and exactly four inks.
items.prompt: Create a premium 4:5 vertical vintage screen-print poster illustration centered on Kyoto temple district in autumn. Make it adaptable to a location, historical period, landmark, or subject while retaining a refined travel and cultural print character. Place the exact primary title text "KYOTO" in a bold condensed uppercase sans-serif within balanced negative space, with the smaller exact supporting line "AUTUMN ARCHIVE" beneath it. Feature a layered pagoda and mountain silhouette as the dominant visual element in the lower or side third, using a distinctive silhouette or profile and carefully rendered defining details without photorealism. Add one bold simple geometric shape behind or around the subject as a graphic anchor. Build the background from flat layered graphic planes using recognizable elements associated with Kyoto temple roofs, lanterns, mountains, and autumn foliage; create depth through overlap, scale, linework, and tonal density without a strong vanishing point. Render atmospheric details as controlled stippled clusters where appropriate. Use an authentic physical silkscreen aesthetic: all tonal modeling comes only from stippling, halftone patterns, and varying dot density, with crisp consistent contour lines, subtle riso-style registration shifts, imperfect ink edges, natural paper grain, and faint woven-print texture. Use exactly four inks: vermilion, deep indigo, warm ochre, and paper cream. Generate intermediate values only through stipple density, halftone overlap, and ink coverage; do not add hues. Keep strong editorial balance, generous negative space, layered depth, bold silhouettes, collectible premium proportions, edge-to-edge composition, crisp print-ready detail, and no modern photographic elements or extra text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张以Kyoto temple district in autumn为中心的高级4:5竖幅复古丝网印刷海报插图。作品应适用于地点、历史时期、地标或主题，同时保持精致的复古旅行与文化印刷品特征。将字面主标题“KYOTO”置于粗体紧凑的大写无衬线字体中，放在平衡的负空间区域；下方添加较小的字面辅助行“AUTUMN ARCHIVE”。将a layered pagoda and mountain silhouette作为主要视觉元素，放在构图下方或侧面的三分之一处，使用独特剪影或轮廓，并绘制清晰的定义细节，但不要呈现照片级写实。用一个大胆、简单的几何形状置于主体后方或周围，作为图形锚点。将背景构建为扁平、分层的图形平面，加入与Kyoto temple roofs, lanterns, mountains, and autumn foliage相关的可识别元素；通过重叠、比例、线条和色调密度建立深度，避免强烈的透视灭点。在适当情况下，将大气细节表现为受控的点画集群。采用真实的实体丝网印刷美学：所有色调建模只能通过点画、半色调图案和变化的网点密度完成，使用清晰且视觉重量一致的轮廓线、微妙的Riso风格套印偏移、不完美的墨边、天然纸纹和隐约的编织印刷纹理。只使用四种油墨：vermilion、deep indigo、warm ochre和paper cream。中间色调只能通过点画密度、半色调重叠和油墨覆盖产生，不要添加其他色相。保持强大的编辑平衡、丰富负空间、分层深度、大胆剪影、具收藏价值的高级比例、边到边构图、清晰的印刷就绪细节；不要出现现代摄影元素或额外文字。

items.title: VOLCANO BITE高端辣酱超写实商业海报
items.description: A premium product-first poster for an original tropical chili sauce, centered on a translucent red-orange squeeze bottle with controlled heat-driven accents and a clean three-dish lower panel.
items.prompt: Create a flagship commercial advertising poster for an original hot-sauce brand named "VOLCANO BITE". Use ultra-realistic product photography, not illustration or 3D render, in a bold tropical heat campaign layout. Set a 3:4 vertical canvas with a blazing orange-red background and subtle heat-wave patterning. Make one giant front-facing squeeze bottle the absolute visual hero, centered vertically from the upper-middle into the lower-middle and overlapping the lower band slightly. The original bottle has a sharp green nozzle cap, a translucent body filled with vivid red-orange sauce and suspended chili flecks, crisp cap ridges, believable thickness and liquid meniscus, glossy reflections, and a premium printed label reading the exact text "VOLCANO BITE" with the descriptor "tropical fire chili sauce" and an original compact heat mark. Balance condensed bold headline blocks reading the exact texts "TROPIC HEAT" at upper-left and "SHARP FINISH" at upper-right. Use a few controlled chili slices, fruit pieces, petals, and tiny sauce droplets in elegant upward arcs around the bottle, preserving generous negative space. Divide the lower area into three equal-width aligned compartments showing realistic secondary pairings: sliced chicken, a fried savory snack, and crispy spring rolls with dipping sauce. Add only the minimal lower micro-copy "dip", "drizzle", and "crave". Use bright studio key light from front-upper center with warm side shaping, gentle rim highlights, and soft grounded shadows under the dishes. Keep the palette hot orange and chili red with green cap accents, off-white typography, pale fruit highlights, and natural food colors. Use original label and poster copy only, sharp bottle focus, readable text, correct symmetry, realistic food and materials, no copied branding, no distorted bottle or food, no clutter, no perspective distortion, and no extra text.
items.prompt_zh: 为一个名为“VOLCANO BITE”的原创辣酱品牌创作一张旗舰商业广告海报。使用超写实产品摄影，而非插画或3D渲染，呈现大胆的热带酷热广告布局。使用3:4竖幅画布，炽热的橙红色背景带有微妙的热浪纹理。让一个巨大的正面挤压瓶成为绝对视觉核心，垂直位于上中部至下中部，并略微压入底部条带。原创瓶身带有醒目的绿色喷嘴盖、装满鲜艳红橙色酱汁和悬浮辣椒碎的半透明瓶体、清晰的瓶盖棱线、可信的厚度与液体弯月面、光泽反射，以及印有字面内容“VOLCANO BITE”的高级标签；标签还显示描述语“tropical fire chili sauce”和原创的紧凑热度标记。在左上角和右上角平衡放置醒目的标题块，分别显示字面内容“TROPIC HEAT”和“SHARP FINISH”。在瓶子周围使用少量受控的辣椒片、水果碎块、花瓣和微小酱汁液滴，形成优雅向上的弧线，并保留充足负空间。将底部区域分成三个等宽且整齐对齐的隔间，展示次要但写实的搭配：切片鸡肉、炸咸味小吃、以及带蘸酱的酥脆春卷。下方只添加极简微型文案“dip”“drizzle”和“crave”。使用来自前上方中心的明亮影棚主光和温暖侧面塑形光，瓶缘有柔和轮廓高光，菜肴下方有柔和落地阴影。保持火热橙色与辣椒红为主，辅以绿色瓶盖、米白色字体、淡色水果高光和自然食物色。仅使用原创标签和海报文案；瓶子对焦极其清晰，文字可读，瓶身对称，食物与材质真实。不要复制品牌，不要变形瓶子或食物，不要杂乱，不要透视变形，也不要出现额外文字。

items.title: 复古独立流行感蓝色LP成年女性写真
items.description: A horizontal eye-level studio portrait of an adult woman holding a blue LP cover overhead, styled in a cool blue Y2K-inspired indie-pop editorial mood with direct flash and a crisp wall shadow.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible adult woman. Create a high-definition horizontal front-facing medium portrait at eye level. She holds a bright cyan-blue paper LP cover above her head with both hands, arms forming a triangle, the cover slightly inverted, and leans cheerfully toward camera-left. She looks playfully and curiously toward the upper right rather than directly at the camera, with slightly parted lips and a witty, sentimental indie-pop mood. Dress her in a deep-blue sleeveless cropped top with pronounced vertical ribbing and a minimalist light sky-blue linen or denim-textured long skirt with natural waist folds. Give her neat pure-white manicure, voluminous jet-black long straight hair falling over shoulders, chest, and back, soft brown eyeshadow, and moist pink-coral lip gloss over natural skin texture. The LP cover visibly reads the exact text "CHASE - Love Wins All" in its printed design. items.title: 深蓝缎面裙地面闪光双联时尚组图

items.prompt: Generate four separate ultra-realistic 3:4 vertical editorial fashion images. Frame one is tack sharp: eyes closed, relaxed warm smile, long dark hair naturally fanned around her head, small earrings, delicate necklace, rings, and neat manicure. Frame two shows a tiny head turn with intentional controlled motion blur in the face and hand while the silhouette remains readable. Keep the dress, carpet, top-down camera position, and lighting continuous across both frames, with only micro-movement between them. Use a 24–28mm wide lens look, f/1.8, faster shutter in frame one and slightly slower shutter in frame two. Add controlled satin specular highlights, natural skin sheen, fine digital grain, minimal halation, warm skin against deep satin blue and beige floor. Preserve believable anatomy, hair strands, fabric texture, realistic shadows, and imperfect candid editorial composition. Avoid minors, sexualized emphasis, plunging or revealing clothing, face distortion, deformed hands, extra fingers, duplicated figures, blown highlights, plastic skin, logos, watermarks, text, CGI, and clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 生成四张彼此独立的3:4竖版超写实社论时尚照片。每张图都是从正上方拍摄的双联画，两帧上下堆叠：一位泛化的成年女性舒适地躺在中性米色地毯上，场景为极简房间，穿deep blue色缎面挂脖风格连衣裙，领口得体，面料带光泽褶皱并保持完整覆盖。一条细白色家具边缘或墙线出现在画面顶部。使用卡片相机或智能手机直闪的写实感、随性深夜氛围和中高对比度。第一帧清晰锐利：她闭着眼，带温暖放松的微笑，深色长发自然铺散在头部周围，佩戴小耳环、精致项链和戒指，指甲整洁。第二帧表现头部轻微转动，脸部和手部出现受控的有意运动模糊，但轮廓仍清晰可辨。保持两帧的服装、地毯、俯视机位和光线一致，只发生细微动作变化。采用24–28mm广角镜头观感，f/1.8，第一帧较快快门、第二帧稍慢快门。控制缎面高光不过曝，保留自然皮肤光泽、细微数字颗粒和极少晕光，以深蓝缎面、暖肤色和米色地面形成色彩关系。保持可信解剖结构、发丝、面料纹理、自然阴影和不完美的抓拍社论构图。避免未成年人、性化强调、深V或暴露服装、面部扭曲、手部变形、多余手指、重复人物、高光溢出、塑料肌肤、标志、水印、文字、CGI和杂乱画面。

items.title: 奢华生态木屋建筑百科参考图
items.description: A 1:1 architecture reference-book infographic centered on a detailed tropical eco-hut, with plans, sections, material studies, and sustainability callouts.
items.prompt: Create a premium 1:1 square architectural reference-book infographic centered on a beautiful eco-architecture nature hut, designed as a curated handbook page rather than a tourism advertisement. Combine a modern visual encyclopedia, luxury eco-retreat design manual, and high-end editorial information system. Use a soft earthy background with subtle blueprint marks, hand-drawn architectural sketches, and natural paper texture. Use a muted palette of warm beige, natural wood brown, olive green, soft cream, bamboo tan, and charcoal accents. Organize the page with refined typography hierarchy, rounded modular information cards, clean spacing, gentle realistic shadows, premium dividers, and minimal eco-architecture icons. Make the central hut an extremely detailed realistic three-quarter render in warm golden-hour light: natural wood, bamboo framework, thatched roof, elevated foundation, warm interior glow, lush landscaping, handcrafted construction, and cozy tropical eco-luxury. Surround it with thin precision callout lines for the thatched roof, natural ventilation, elevated foundation, bamboo/wood frame, passive cooling, open verandah, sustainable materials, rainwater handling, daylight optimization, and eco-living integration. Include compact modules for overview, architectural specifications, floor plan, material palette, sustainability features, passive-design benefits, interior concepts, sectional view, construction/material breakdown, daylight and ventilation analysis, site plan, indicative cost, advantages and considerations, timeline, key facts, and ideal use cases. Add small floor-plan, cutaway, airflow, sunlight, material, landscape, circulation, blueprint-elevation, and sustainability diagrams. Keep the information dense but breathable and legible, with no invented brand or tourist-brochure styling. Avoid fantasy huts, excessive futurism, clutter, dramatic effects, dark mood, 3D toy appearance, and illegible microtext.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张高级1:1正方形建筑参考书信息图，核心是一座精美的生态自然木屋，定位为策展式建筑手册页面，而非旅游广告。融合现代视觉百科全书、豪华生态度假设计手册和高端编辑信息系统。背景使用柔和大地色，并加入细微蓝图标记、手绘建筑草图和自然纸张纹理。调色采用暖米色、天然木褐、橄榄绿、柔和奶油色、竹编色和炭黑点缀。通过精致排版层级、圆角模块化信息卡、整洁间距、柔和写实阴影、高级分割线和极简生态建筑图标组织页面。中心木屋使用温暖黄金时段光线呈现极其细致的写实三分之四透视渲染：天然木材、竹木框架、草编屋顶、抬高地基、温暖室内光、繁茂景观、手工建造感和温馨热带生态奢华感。用精密细线标注草屋顶、自然通风、抬高地基、竹木框架、被动冷却、开放式走廊、可持续材料、雨水处理、日照优化和生态生活整合。加入紧凑模块，涵盖木屋概况、建筑规格、平面图、材料色板、可持续性特征、被动式设计效益、室内概念、剖面图、施工与材料拆解、日照和通风分析、场地平面、指示性成本、优势与考量、施工时间线、关键事实和理想使用案例。添加小型平面图、剖面切面、气流、阳光方向、材料、景观、动线、蓝图立面和可持续性图示。保持信息密度高但留白通透、文字清晰，不加入虚构品牌或旅游宣传册风格。避免奇幻木屋、过度科幻、杂乱、戏剧化特效、阴暗氛围、玩具般3D质感和不可读微型文字。

items.prompt_zh: 创作一张高质量9:16竖版二次元时尚海报，采用日系轻奢极简视觉系统。以白色和红色为主色，使用纯白背景、大面积负空间和都市疗愈氛围。将一位明确成年的二次元风格女性置于画面中间偏右：银白色长发、冷白皮肤、红色眼眸、闭眼、头部微微倾斜，表情放松安静。她自然地将双臂向上伸展，呈优雅的晨起拉伸姿势。头发为浅银灰色高马尾配长刘海，带细腻光泽和小红色发带。她穿宽松白色棉质T恤，带柔和褶皱并保持舒适覆盖。将干净二次元插画、半写实渲染和高端时尚社论平面设计融合：细腻皮肤细节、柔和阴影、低饱和银白色调、边缘高光、半透明发丝光泽、轻微bloom和通透环境光。使用从侧后方进入的柔和晨光、克制体积雾和电影感轮廓光。保持画面干净，左侧留作排版区域，加入极简几何线条、圆形、十字和点阵装饰。加入以下精确文字：黑色粗体URBAN、饱和红色粗体CALM、英文手写体Breathe in Peace，并可加入少量次要日文与英文副标题，但不要其他可读文字。使用高端生活方式海报质感和8K级细节。避免未成年人、性化造型、杂乱、厚重阴影、赛博朋克过载、解剖扭曲、多余手指、重复肢体、畸形手部、丑陋或变形面部、嘈杂背景、过度饱和、水印、标志、品牌标记和文字伪影。

items.title: 中国成年女性古风宴会舞蹈时尚组图
items.description: A set of four separate 9:16 fashion-performance images featuring an adult Chinese woman in tasteful dance attire within varied ancient-inspired banquet settings.
items.prompt: Generate four separate photorealistic 9:16 vertical fashion-performance images of a generic Chinese adult woman, clearly over 21, in an evening banquet hall with a varied ancient-inspired Chinese setting. Dress her in tasteful, stage-ready dance attire with full coverage, elegant fabric, and varied coordinated colors across the four images; avoid lingerie-like styling or sexualized emphasis. Vary the front-facing and side-facing movement poses naturally across the set while keeping the adult subject, facial features, hair, anatomy, and visual quality coherent. Use refined ancient-inspired banquet decor, warm evening illumination, believable movement, graceful dance gestures, and polished editorial photography. Keep the scene culturally respectful and the subject expressive but non-sexualized. Preserve realistic skin and fabric detail, natural proportions, and 9:16 framing. Avoid minors, influencer or glamour branding, revealing clothing, erotic poses, distorted anatomy, duplicated limbs, logos, watermarks, text, and clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 生成四张彼此独立的9:16竖版写实时尚表演照片，主体是一位明确超过21岁的泛化中国成年女性，场景为带有多样古风中式布置的夜间宴会厅。为她设计得体、适合舞台表演且覆盖完整的舞蹈服装，使用优雅面料，并在四张图中变化协调色彩；避免类似内衣的造型和性化强调。让四张图自然变化正面与侧面的舞蹈动作和姿势，同时保持成年主体、面部特征、发型、解剖结构与画质连贯一致。使用精致的古风宴会装饰、温暖夜间光线、可信的运动感、优雅舞姿和高级社论摄影。保持文化表达尊重，人物富有表现力但不性化。保留真实皮肤与面料细节、自然比例和9:16构图。避免未成年人、网红或商业品牌包装、暴露服装、情色姿势、解剖扭曲、重复肢体、标志、水印、文字和杂乱画面。

items.title: 极简奢华芒果汁饮品商业摄影海报
items.description: A 4:5 premium beverage advertisement centered on a condensation-covered mango-juice bottle, ripe fruit, controlled reflections, and exact label typography.
items.prompt: Create a 4:5 vertical premium commercial beverage poster for a fresh mango juice product. Center a tall transparent glossy glass bottle filled with rich golden-yellow mango juice, positioned slightly right of center in a front-facing eye-level product shot. Show realistic condensation droplets, tiny water beads, controlled glossy reflections, believable refraction, and a black glossy cap. Use a minimal cream, orange, and black label with the exact text FRESH, MANGO JUICE, COLD PRESSED, NO ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS, and 100% NATURAL, plus a small realistic mango illustration; do not add a logo or other text. Split the background vertically: warm off-white cream on the left and saturated mango orange on the right. Place the exact vertical word MANGO in oversized white letters on the orange side. On the left, add the exact bold textured headline MANGO FRESH and the exact smaller tagline Sweet. Cool. Delicious. Use a clean bold condensed sans-serif for the headline, modern sans-serif secondary type, minimal information icons for natural and freshness cues, and restrained premium spacing. Place a whole ripe mango with diced cubes and a dynamic juice splash in the lower left, and a juicy mango slice with fresh green leaves in the lower right. Use deep focus, soft diffused studio-commercial light, premium bottle reflections, crisp product and fruit texture, wet glossy surfaces, energetic refreshing mood, and high-contrast clean advertising design. Render photorealistically at 8K detail. Avoid invented text, illegible lettering, placeholder logos, third-party branding, watermarks, clutter, cartoon styling, 3D/CGI appearance, harsh flash, washed-out color, or distorted product geometry.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张4:5竖版高端商业饮料广告海报，主题为鲜榨芒果汁产品。采用正面平视产品摄影，将一瓶装满浓郁金黄色芒果汁的高大透明光泽玻璃瓶置于画面中心偏右。表现真实冷凝水珠、微小水滴、受控光泽反射和可信折射，并配黑色光泽瓶盖。使用米色、橙色和黑色的极简标签，必须加入以下精确文字：FRESH、MANGO JUICE、COLD PRESSED、NO ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS、100% NATURAL；再配一幅小型写实芒果插图，不要其他标志或文字。背景垂直分割：左侧温暖米白，右侧饱和芒果橙。橙色一侧加入大号白色竖排精确文字MANGO。左侧加入粗体纹理精确标题MANGO FRESH和较小的精确口号Sweet. Cool. Delicious. 标题使用粗体紧凑无衬线字体，副文案使用现代无衬线字体，辅以极简天然与新鲜提示图标，并保持克制高级的间距。左下方放置带方块切口的成熟整颗芒果和动态果汁溅射，右下方放置多汁芒果切片与新鲜绿叶。使用深焦、柔和漫射影棚商业光、优质瓶身反射、清晰产品与水果纹理、潮湿光泽表面、清新有活力的氛围和高对比度简洁广告设计。以8K级细节进行照片级写实渲染。避免凭空生成文字、不可读字样、占位标志、第三方品牌、水印、杂乱画面、卡通风格、3D/CGI质感、刺眼闪光、褪色或产品几何变形。

items.title: 红发绿眼成年女性九宫格FACS表情肖像
items.description: A 1:1 3x3 smartphone-style portrait collage of one adult red-haired woman, with consistent lighting and nine FACS-informed expressions.
items.prompt: Create a 1:1 3x3 portrait collage of one consistent generic adult woman with natural red hair, slightly wet or textured, expressive green eyes, refined features, and naturally textured skin. Use candid full-color smartphone photography with visible grain, slight noise, neutral-to-slightly-warm tones, direct flash or simple frontal lighting, mild hard shadows, and handheld imperfect framing. Keep all nine tight head-and-shoulders panels similarly framed with the same subject and lighting, allowing only small pose and angle changes. Dress her in a minimal cream sleeveless top with comfortable coverage. Panel 1: slight snarl, FACS AU4/AU9/AU10. Panel 2: playful tongue-out expression, AU25/AU26/AU19. Panel 3: soft serious look with hands together, AU1/AU2/AU24. Panel 4: relaxed upward gaze with hands in hair, AU5/AU25. Panel 5: subtle natural smile, AU12/AU6. Panel 6: intense lip-compressed expression, AU4/AU10/AU25. Panel 7: playful fish face, AU18/AU22. Panel 8: surprised open-mouth expression, AU25/AU26/AU5. Panel 9: soft melancholic or tired expression with one hand on the face, AU1/AU15. Prioritize FACS-informed facial clarity, consistent identity within the collage, natural anatomy, authentic smartphone texture, and expressive portrait realism. Avoid minors, heavy makeup, sexualized posing, black-and-white output, studio perfection, over-retouched skin, inconsistent faces, cinematic lighting, distorted features, logos, watermarks, and text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张1:1的3×3肖像拼贴，画面中始终是同一位泛化的成年女性，拥有自然红发，略微湿润或带纹理感，富有表现力的绿眼睛、精致五官和自然皮肤纹理。采用彩色手机抓拍摄影，保留可见颗粒、轻微噪点、中性至微暖色调、直闪或简单正面光、轻微硬阴影和手持拍摄的不完美构图。九个紧凑头肩面板使用相近取景，保持人物和光线一致，只允许细微姿势与角度变化。为她穿极简米色无袖上衣，保持舒适覆盖。第1格：略微咆哮表情，FACS AU4/AU9/AU10；第2格：俏皮吐舌表情，AU25/AU26/AU19；第3格：双手合十的温柔严肃表情，AU1/AU2/AU24；第4格：双手抚发的放松向上凝视，AU5/AU25；第5格：微妙自然的微笑，AU12/AU6；第6格：强烈的抿唇表情，AU4/AU10/AU25；第7格：俏皮鱼脸，AU18/AU22；第8格：惊讶张嘴表情，AU25/AU26/AU5；第9格：一只手托脸的柔和忧郁或疲惫表情，AU1/AU15。优先保证基于FACS的表情清晰度、拼贴内部身份一致、自然解剖结构、真实手机纹理和富有表现力的人像真实感。避免未成年人、浓妆、性化姿势、黑白输出、影棚完美感、过度修图、面部不一致、电影化灯光、五官扭曲、标志、水印和文字。

items.title: 复古电子美学高端时尚杂志封面
items.description: A 3:4 photorealistic high-fashion cover mockup with a referenced adult woman, retro CRT televisions, Y2K-inspired styling, and lavender-gray studio light.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference photo as the identity reference for the same adult woman. Preserve her exact facial structure, recognizable identity, and natural appearance without altering the face. Create a photorealistic 3:4 full-body luxury fashion-magazine cover mockup. The woman has an extremely fair pink-toned complexion, green-hazel eyes, and a slim adult figure. Pose her sideways on a stack of two vintage black CRT televisions, body facing right while she looks back over her shoulder toward the camera with a poised, confident expression. One hand in a black mesh glove rests elegantly near her face. Use an understated high-fashion outfit: fitted black knee-length dress with refined metallic buckle details, long black mesh gloves, and deep chocolate-brown structured leather boots with chunky block heels; keep the styling tasteful and non-revealing. Give her ultra-long sleek dark espresso hair with a clean center part. Use polished Korean and Y2K-inspired beauty makeup: natural luminous skin, soft rosy blush, shaped brows, delicate lashes, subtle under-eye highlight, and softly blurred gradient lips. Set the scene in a minimal seamless studio with muted lavender-gray tones and soft vignette lighting, brighter in the center and darker at the edges. The two CRT screens emit a pale blue static glow contrasting with the warm brown boots. Use a premium 50mm or 85mm full-frame camera look at f/2.8–f/4 for crisp detail and smooth depth. Add a generic elegant magazine masthead behind and partially framing the head, with no recognizable third-party logo or copied layout. Preserve realistic textures, natural anatomy, magazine polish, and cinematic studio lighting. Avoid minors, changed identity, face distortion, extra limbs, bad anatomy, cartoon style, low quality, blurry face, oversaturated skin, logos, watermarks, and random readable text.
items.prompt_zh: 使用用户上传的参考照片作为同一位成年女性的身份依据。准确保持她的面部结构、可识别身份和自然外观，不改变面容。创作一张写实的3:4高端时尚杂志封面模型图，采用全身纵向影棚构图。女性拥有极白粉调肤色、绿棕色眼睛和苗条的成年体态。让她侧身坐在两台叠放的复古黑色CRT电视机上，身体朝右，同时回头看向相机，表情沉着自信。一只戴黑色网纱手套的手优雅地靠近脸部。造型采用低调高级时装：修身至膝的黑色连衣裙，带精致金属扣细节，配长款黑色网纱手套和深巧克力棕色结构感皮革粗方跟靴；整体得体且不暴露。她留极长顺滑的深咖啡色直发，整齐中分。妆容采用精致的韩系与Y2K启发美学：自然透亮肌肤、柔和玫瑰腮红、修饰眉形、细致睫毛、轻微下眼睑高光和边缘柔化的渐变唇妆。场景为极简无缝影棚，使用柔和淡紫灰色调和暗角光线，中心较亮、边缘较暗。两台CRT屏幕发出淡蓝色静态光，与暖褐色靴子形成对比。使用50mm或85mm全画幅镜头观感，光圈约f/2.8–f/4，获得锐利细节和柔和影棚景深。加入通用而优雅的杂志刊头，使其位于头部后方并部分环绕头部，但不要使用可识别的第三方标志或照搬版式。保持真实材质、自然解剖结构、杂志质感和电影感影棚灯光。避免未成年人、身份改变、面部扭曲、多余肢体、错误解剖结构、卡通风格、低画质、面部模糊、皮肤过饱和、标志、水印和随机可读文字。

items.title: 韩国成年男性八造型时尚九宫格海报
items.description: A 1:1 entertainment-style collage poster with eight consistent identity fashion portraits surrounding a central vintage microphone.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the identity reference for the same adult Korean man in every portrait panel. Preserve consistent face identity, bone structure, eyes, base hairstyle, skin tone, and apparent age while allowing different fashion looks, hairstyles, expressions, poses, and colorful outfits. Create a highly cohesive ultra-realistic 1:1 square collage poster in a clean 3x3 grid: eight outer square panels each show the same man in a distinct stylish look, while the center panel contains only a realistic vintage microphone on a stand and no person. Use bright orange, red, pink, yellow, and blue backgrounds with controlled gradients, premium entertainment-show promotional energy, cinematic studio lighting, sharp focus, realistic skin and fabric texture, expressive but natural emotion, and magazine-quality editorial fashion photography. Keep spacing balanced and the identity consistent across all eight portraits. Use a polished Korean entertainment-poster direction without copying a specific show or brand. No text, typography, logos, watermarks, distorted anatomy, duplicated facial features, inconsistent identity, plastic skin, or clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 使用用户上传的参考图作为同一位成年韩国男性在所有人物面板中的身份依据。保持一致的面部身份、骨骼结构、眼睛、基础发型、肤色和年龄观感，同时允许每格拥有不同的时尚造型、发型、表情、姿势和彩色服装。创作一张高度统一的超写实1:1方形拼贴海报，采用整洁的3×3九宫格：外围八个方格分别展示同一位男性的八种不同风格，中心方格只放置一支写实的复古立式麦克风，不出现人物。使用明亮的橙、红、粉、黄、蓝色背景并进行受控渐变，营造高端娱乐节目宣传活力；采用电影级演播室灯光、锐利焦点、真实皮肤和面料纹理、自然而富有表现力的情绪，以及杂志级时尚摄影品质。保持八个肖像之间间距均衡、身份一致。采用精致的韩国娱乐海报方向，但不要照搬具体节目或品牌。不要文字、排版、标志、水印、解剖扭曲、重复五官、身份不一致、塑料肌肤或杂乱画面。

items.title: 笔记本圆珠笔手绘四个历史成就涂鸦
items.description: A 2x2 notebook-scan grid depicting four human achievements as charming blue or black ballpoint doodles with lined paper and classroom-light nostalgia.
items.prompt: Create a 2x2 grid showing four historic human achievements that inspire pride, using the selected scene set: the first Moon landing, the first powered flight, the invention of the printing press, and the eradication of smallpox. Render each panel as a cute ballpoint-pen sketch in a lined notebook, with simplified expressive figures or objects, messy hair or small accessories where relevant, and tiny charm marks. Use blue or black ink on paper, visible ruled lines, slight ink bleed, hand-drawn imperfections, and a scanned-notebook feel. Light the page with soft overhead classroom illumination and a subtle hand shadow, creating nostalgic student-doodle atmosphere. Keep the four panels distinct but visually consistent, with clear panel separation and no invented captions. Render at 8K detail with authentic paper and ink texture. Negative direction: no digital-clean finish, no colored rendering, no photorealism, no dark moody treatment, no vector graphics, no heavy decorative background, no logos, watermarks, or readable text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张2×2网格，展示四个令人类自豪的历史成就，使用所选场景集合：the first Moon landing, the first powered flight, the invention of the printing press, and the eradication of smallpox。每个面板都以有线笔记本中的可爱圆珠笔素描呈现，人物或物体采用简化而富有表现力的形态，在适用处加入凌乱发型、小配饰和细小趣味符号。使用纸张上的蓝色或黑色墨水，保留横线、轻微渗墨、手绘不完美感和笔记本扫描质感。用柔和的教室顶灯照亮纸面，并加入手部投下的微妙阴影，营造怀旧学生涂鸦氛围。四个面板应彼此区分但视觉统一，保持清晰分格，不凭空添加说明文字。以8K级细节表现真实纸张和墨水纹理。负面方向：不要数字化的过度整洁效果、彩色渲染、照相写实、阴暗忧郁处理、矢量图形、厚重装饰背景、标志、水印或可读文字。

items.title: 极简产品摄影与手绘涂鸦叠加
items.description: A configurable 1:1 mixed-media product photograph combining a warm studio setup with a white-line doodle character interacting with the product.
items.prompt: Create a 1:1 minimalist product photograph featuring a single sculptural ceramic perfume bottle in a clean, warm studio. Use a textured beige wall, simple tabletop, and soft directional sunlight casting long natural shadows. Arrange the product in a playful but refined concept composition. Overlay a hand-drawn white line-art doodle of a tiny doodled shopkeeper interacting with the product; keep the doodle clearly illustrative and integrated with the photographed scene rather than a realistic person. Combine real product photography with sketch illustration for a polished mixed-media look and high-end branding feel. Use shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic materials, natural warm light, believable tabletop contact shadows, and crisp product detail. Include no extra text, logos, watermarks, or brand marks; preserve a clean 1:1 composition and 8K-level detail.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张1:1极简产品摄影，主体为a single sculptural ceramic perfume bottle，置于干净温暖的工作室中。使用带纹理的米色墙壁、简洁桌面和柔和的定向阳光，让自然光投下长长的阴影。将产品安排在俏皮但精致的概念构图中。叠加一幅手绘白色线稿涂鸦，让a tiny doodled shopkeeper与产品互动；涂鸦应明确保持插画性质，并融入摄影场景，不要表现为写实人物。将真实产品摄影与素描插画结合，形成精致的混合媒介效果和高端品牌感。使用浅景深、超写实材质、自然温暖光线、可信的桌面接触阴影和清晰产品细节。不要额外文字、标志、水印或品牌标记；保持干净的1:1构图和8K级细节。

items.title: 首尔街头北欧风成年女性日落自拍
items.description: A 9:16 photorealistic handheld street selfie near a generic coffee shop in Seoul at sunset, with soft Scandinavian-inspired styling and candid city bokeh.
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic amateur smartphone selfie of a generic adult Scandinavian woman on a busy Seoul downtown street near a modern coffee shop during sunset golden hour. Use a warm orange-pink sky, city lights beginning to glow, contemporary Korean street atmosphere, softly blurred pedestrians, and a cinematic urban evening mood. She has messy blonde hair loosely tied with soft strands around her face, fair glowing skin with natural texture and subtle freckles, light-blue eyes, minimal clean makeup, soft blush, glossy lips, and a relaxed candid expression. She holds a modern smartphone in one hand and takes a close-up upper-body selfie at a slight angle. Dress her in a cream ribbed knit top with comfortable coverage, a light pastel-blue oversized cardigan, high-waisted white shorts, and a minimal gold necklace. Let her hold a large iced coffee cup with a simple unbranded design and green straw. Use a 9:16 vertical frame, sharp focus on the face, softly blurred city background, slight amateur motion softness, natural light, realistic skin, natural shadows, and subtle cinematic bokeh. Keep the Scandinavian-inspired beauty styling understated and non-sexualized. Avoid minors, logos, watermarks, readable brand text, copied storefront branding, distorted anatomy, plastic skin, excessive retouching, and clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 一张超写实的业余智能手机自拍：一位泛化的成年北欧女性在日落黄金时段的首尔繁忙市中心街道上，靠近一家现代咖啡店。使用温暖橙粉色天空、初现的城市灯光、现代韩国街道氛围、柔和虚化的行人和电影感城市夜晚情绪。她有凌乱的金发并松散扎起，柔和发丝落在脸部周围；皮肤白皙透亮，带自然纹理和淡淡雀斑；浅蓝色眼睛，极简干净妆容、柔和腮红、光泽唇妆，以及放松自然的抓拍表情。她单手持现代智能手机自拍，采用略微倾斜的近距离上半身视角。她穿有足够覆盖度的米色罗纹针织上衣、浅粉蓝色宽松开衫、高腰白色短裤和极简金项链，手持一大杯简洁无品牌设计的冰咖啡并配绿色吸管。使用9:16竖构图，面部清晰对焦，城市背景柔和虚化，加入轻微业余动态柔化、自然光线、真实皮肤、自然阴影和细微电影级散景。北欧风美学保持低调且不性化。避免未成年人、标志、水印、可读品牌文字、照搬店铺品牌视觉、解剖扭曲、塑料肌肤、过度修图和杂乱画面。

items.title: 立体几何纸艺卷发成年男性肖像
items.description: A detailed low-poly paper-craft portrait using an uploaded identity reference, folded geometric planes, and soft studio shadows on white.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference photo as the facial identity reference for the same adult man, preserving his face, curly brown hair, glasses, gentle smile, and light facial-hair stubble. Create a highly detailed 3D paper-craft portrait made entirely from folded and layered paper. Use sharp geometric creases, faceted planes, clean cut edges, and a refined low-poly aesthetic. Build the face and hair from tan and brown paper tones, and make the shirt from crisp white textured paper. Keep the likeness recognizable while translating all forms into crafted paper rather than skin or hair. Use soft studio lighting to create believable inter-layer shadows and dimensional depth against a plain white background. Preserve natural facial proportions, glasses geometry, paper texture, and a polished sculptural presentation. Avoid photorealistic skin, plastic or wax materials, messy folds, deformed facial features, distorted glasses, extra facial parts, logos, watermarks, and text.
items.prompt_zh: 使用用户上传的参考照片作为同一位成年男性的面部身份依据，保持他的面部、棕色卷发、眼镜、温和微笑和淡淡胡茬的可识别特征。创作一幅高度精细的3D纸艺肖像，所有部分都由折叠与分层纸张制成。使用锐利几何折痕、切面结构、整齐切割边缘和精致低多边形美学。面部与头发使用米色和棕色纸张色调，衬衫使用清爽的白色纹理纸。保持身份相似度，同时将所有形体转译成纸艺，不要出现真实皮肤或真实发丝质感。使用柔和摄影棚光线，在纯白背景前形成可信的层间阴影和立体深度。保持自然面部比例、眼镜结构、纸张纹理和精致雕塑呈现。避免照相写实皮肤、塑料或蜡质材质、杂乱折痕、面部变形、眼镜扭曲、多余面部器官、标志、水印和文字。

items.title: 梦幻彩虹棱镜光漏电影感夜晚人像
items.description: A 9:16 hyper-realistic night portrait using an uploaded identity reference, experimental flash, rainbow prism streaks, windblown hair, and a dark seaside atmosphere.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait only as the identity and hairstyle reference for the same adult person. Preserve facial identity, face shape, features, skin tone, hairstyle, hair volume, and natural appearance, but do not copy the source clothing, background, lighting, pose, or image quality. Create a hyper-realistic cinematic night portrait near a dark seaside or open outdoor environment. Use a close half-body composition as the subject turns slightly back toward the camera over one shoulder, with a calm, soft, mysterious expression, clear natural skin texture, realistic eyes, soft lips, and subtle makeup. Apply experimental flash photography with horizontal rainbow prism light leaks, a bright white lens flare across the forehead and upper face, and blue, cyan, orange, red, and green light streaks crossing the frame. Add believable long-exposure motion blur, film grain, soft glow, subtle vintage digital-camera texture, and gently windblown hair with illuminated strands. Keep the background very dark and slightly blurred. Dress the subject in a light-colored sleeveless dress with soft fabric texture, subtle ruffles, and a natural shoulder line, keeping it tasteful and non-revealing. Mood: dreamy, cinematic, mysterious, high-fashion, photorealistic. Vertical 9:16, realistic camera perspective, natural anatomy, premium editorial quality. No text, logos, watermarks, signatures, AI labels, anime, illustration, doll face, plastic or over-smoothed skin, changed identity, different hairstyle, deformed anatomy, extra fingers, distorted face, blurry face, low resolution, chaotic composition, blown facial highlights, cheap filters, random objects, duplicated person, unnatural neck or shoulders, or noisy artifacts.
items.prompt_zh: 仅使用用户上传的肖像作为同一位成年人物的身份和发型参考。保持面部身份、脸型、五官、肤色、发型、发量和自然外观，但不要复制参考图中的服装、背景、光线、姿势或图像质量。在黑暗海边或开放户外夜景附近创作一张超写实电影感夜晚肖像。采用特写半身构图，主体越过一侧肩膀微微回头看向相机，表情冷静、柔和而神秘，面部清晰，保留自然皮肤纹理、真实眼睛、柔和唇形和细致妆容。使用实验性闪光摄影：水平彩虹棱镜光漏、横跨额头和上半脸的明亮白色镜头光晕，以及穿过画面的蓝、青、橙、红、绿光条纹。加入可信的长曝光运动模糊、胶片颗粒、柔光、轻微复古数码相机质感和被风轻轻吹动、带有受光发丝的头发。背景保持非常暗并略微虚化。主体穿浅色无袖连衣裙，具有柔软面料质感、细微荷叶边和自然肩线，造型得体且不暴露。氛围梦幻、电影化、神秘、高级时装而写实。垂直9:16，真实相机视角，自然解剖结构，高级社论肖像品质。不要文字、标志、水印、签名、AI标签、动漫、插画、娃娃脸、塑料或过度平滑的皮肤、改变身份、不同发型、解剖变形、多余手指、面部扭曲、面部模糊、低分辨率、混乱构图、面部高光溢出、廉价滤镜、随机物体、重复人物、不自然脖子或肩膀以及噪点伪影。

items.title: 超现实图书馆漂浮书页四视角人像
items.description: An ultra-realistic four-view library portrait using a supplied identity reference, dark tailored styling, warm amber light, and drifting book pages.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference photo as the identity reference for the main subject, preserving the same adult face and likeness consistently across all views. Create an ultra-realistic surreal library portrait presented as a coherent four-view contact sheet or four-panel editorial composition, with no extra people. View 1 is a wide library scene with tall bookshelves, warm amber light, drifting dust, and floating book pages. View 2 is a seated portrait at a reading table in the same library. View 3 is a close-up of the subject with floating pages passing around the face while keeping facial features unobstructed. View 4 is a side profile among the shelves. Dress the subject in a dark tailored outfit with refined, fully covered styling. Keep the library architecture, pages, dust, and warm amber atmosphere consistent across views. Use cinematic but physically believable lighting, natural skin texture, realistic hair, authentic paper edges, subtle surreal motion, and detailed shelves. Maintain one consistent identity, natural anatomy, and no additional figures, readable text, logos, watermarks, or distorted pages.
items.prompt_zh: 使用用户上传的参考照片作为主要主体的身份依据，在所有视角中保持同一位成年人物的面部与相似度一致。创作一张超写实的超现实图书馆人像，以连贯的四视角接触表或四格社论构图呈现，不出现额外人物。视角1为图书馆全景：高大书架、温暖琥珀色光线、漂浮尘埃和空中飘动的书页。视角2为同一图书馆内坐在阅读桌旁的肖像。视角3为主体面部特写，漂浮书页环绕脸部但不遮挡五官。视角4为书架之间的侧面轮廓。主体穿深色精裁服装，造型精致且完整遮盖。保持四个视角中的图书馆建筑、书页、尘埃和温暖琥珀氛围一致。使用电影感但物理可信的光线、自然皮肤纹理、真实发丝、可信纸张边缘、细微超现实运动和精细书架细节。保持单一一致的身份、自然解剖结构，不出现其他人物、可读文字、标志、水印或变形书页。

items.title: 昏暗水族馆隧道饲养员与海獭意外自拍
items.description: A candid flash-lit zookeeper portrait in a dim aquarium tunnel, with a playful baby sea otter and chaotic marine-enclosure details.
items.prompt: Accidental selfie-like portrait of a generic adult female aquarium zookeeper inside a dim aquarium tunnel, captured at a tilted Dutch angle with direct flash reflecting from the glass tanks. She has long straight black hair in a loose low bun with stray strands, and looks directly at the camera with a gentle playful smile and slightly squinted eyes while a baby sea otter naturally clings to her forearm. Dress her in a navy waterproof zookeeper jacket, black practical leggings, rubber boots, and a blank or unreadable ID badge hanging from her neck; add tiny shell-shaped earrings and a waterproof watch with a subtle display. Keep the interaction gentle and animal-safe. Make the background cluttered and imperfect: aquarium equipment carts, hoses, water droplets on glass, floating bubbles, feeding tools, wet-floor reflections, and blurred fish and ray silhouettes behind the glass. Mix slight motion blur, uneven illumination, mild flash overexposure, deep blue aquarium glow, VHS grain, lens distortion, candid realism, and an unplanned composition. Preserve believable marine-enclosure atmosphere, natural anatomy, realistic wet surfaces, and natural sea-otter behavior. Avoid minors, animal distress, dangerous handling, distorted limbs, extra fingers, readable badge text, logos, watermarks, and staged glamour.
items.prompt_zh: 一张意外自拍感的人像照片：泛化的成年女性水族馆饲养员位于昏暗的水族馆隧道内，采用倾斜的荷兰角拍摄，直射闪光灯在玻璃水箱上产生反射。她留黑色长直发，扎成松散低发髻并带有游离发丝，直视镜头，带着温柔俏皮的微笑和微眯的双眼；一只小海獭自然地抱住她的前臂。她穿深蓝色防水饲养员夹克、黑色实用长裤和橡胶靴，胸前挂着空白或不可读的身份牌；佩戴小贝壳形耳环和显示微光的防水手表。动物互动应温和并确保海獭安全。背景杂乱而不完美，包括水族馆设备推车、软管、玻璃上的水滴、漂浮气泡、喂食工具、潮湿地面反光，以及玻璃后模糊的鱼类和鳐鱼剪影。混合轻微运动模糊、不均匀光线、闪光灯造成的轻度过曝、深蓝水族馆光、VHS颗粒、镜头畸变、坦率写实感和无意构图。保持可信的海洋围栏氛围、自然解剖结构、真实湿润表面和自然海獭行为。避免未成年人、动物痛苦、危险抓抱、肢体扭曲、多余手指、可读身份牌文字、标志、水印和摆拍式 glamour。

items.title: 暖阳公寓韩系风格穿搭五姿势时尚拼贴
items.description: A warm sunlit apartment fashion lookbook collage with five poses, diagonal white separators, and relaxed pink-striped shirt styling.
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic fashion lookbook collage of a generic adult woman shown in five different poses inside a warm, sunlit modern apartment. Use soft golden-hour light that casts natural window shadows across beige walls. Give her long wavy brown hair, natural luminous skin, minimal makeup, elegant gold earrings and necklace, an oversized pink-and-white striped button-up shirt, loose light-wash wide-leg jeans, white sneakers, and a dark-brown shoulder bag; keep the styling comfortable and non-revealing. Use a magazine-style collage layout with diagonal white borders separating the poses, mixing full-body views and close-up portraits. Include a cozy modern interior with hanging green vines and framed wall art in the background. Preserve relaxed confident expressions, natural skin texture, detailed fabric folds, realistic photography, soft depth of field, and a dreamy Korean-inspired fashion-editorial mood. Avoid minors, sexualized styling, distorted anatomy, duplicate limbs, plastic skin, excessive retouching, logos, watermarks, readable random text, and clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 一张超写实的时尚型录拼贴，展示一位泛化的成年女性在温暖阳光充足的现代公寓中的五种不同姿势。使用柔和的金色时刻光线，让自然窗影投射在米色墙壁上。她拥有棕色长波浪发、自然透亮的皮肤、极简妆容、精致金色耳环和项链，穿超大号粉白条纹纽扣衬衫、宽松浅色宽腿牛仔裤、白色运动鞋并背深棕色单肩包；造型舒适且不暴露。采用杂志风格拼贴布局，用对角线白色边框分隔五个姿势，混合全身照与近景肖像。背景是舒适的现代室内空间，带有悬挂绿藤和装裱墙面艺术。保持放松自信的表情、自然皮肤纹理、细致面料褶皱、真实摄影、柔和景深和梦幻韩风启发的时尚社论氛围。避免未成年人、性化造型、解剖扭曲、重复肢体、塑料肌肤、过度修图、标志、水印、随机可读文字和杂乱画面。

items.title: 疯狂星期四KFC压花玻璃档案感封面
items.description: A 9:10 portfolio-cover composition that partially hides a theme inside embossed glass atomization, releasing only a precise recognition window and restrained metadata typography.
items.prompt: Create a 9:10 visual portfolio cover centered on the theme Crazy Thursday KFC. Do not display the core object in full. Compress it into an off-axis main mass submerged between a translucent atomized surface layer and a low-saturation background field. Let embossed-glass particles, tiny refractions, milky haze, and low-contrast blur swallow most contours, secondary details, and ordinary description. Cut one restrained, precise clear window at the location that best communicates the theme; this window alone retains real texture, higher contrast, and necessary color, while the rest becomes dark mass, softened edges, broken transitions, and background-eaten forms. Derive a large low-noise color field from the theme's materials, spatial relationships, time direction, and emotional temperature: airy light space above or outside, a pale breathing zone on one side, and lower brightness around the main mass. Use stable proportions of low-saturation structural colors, low-brightness main colors, a small amount of concentrated real color, and white information color. Build three depth layers: clear window for recognition, semi-clear short thick white sans-serif title and numbers that remain readable, and atomized defocus for most of the subject, background, and tiny bottom information. Make the text look printed on glass and lightly bitten by the surface. Add restrained corner marks, edge dates, work numbers, archive records, and production-parameter micro-annotations as a metadata coordinate system, without covering the clear window.
