Preserve a visible granular embossed-glass touch: denser in dark areas, milkier in bright areas, with fine edge refraction and slight displacement unifying object, image, and text under one material. The result should feel calm, technical, restrained, and archival, with only critical information released. For KFC-related themes, use generic red-and-white fast-food visual cues and no official logo or copied brand lockup. Avoid clutter, photorealistic scene narrative, excessive legible copy, watermarks, and unrelated branding.
items.prompt_zh: 以主题Crazy Thursday KFC为核心，创作一张9:10比例、具有作品集封面秩序的视觉作品。不要完整展示核心对象，而是将其压缩成偏离中轴的主质量，沉入半透明雾化表层与低饱和背景场之间。让压花玻璃颗粒、细小折射位移、乳白雾化和低对比模糊吞没大部分轮廓、次要细节与普通说明。只在最能传达主题的位置切出一条尺寸克制而精准的清晰窄窗；仅该窄窗保留真实纹理、较高对比和必要色彩，其余部分化为暗部质量、柔化边缘、破碎过渡和被背景吞掉的形态。根据主题的材质、空间关系、时间方向和情绪温度推导大面积低噪声色场：上方或外侧保留轻盈空气感，一侧形成淡色呼吸区，主体周围压入更低明度。保持低饱和结构色、低明度主体色、少量集中真实色与白色信息色之间的稳定比例。构建三层深度：清晰窄窗负责识别，半清晰的短促粗白无衬线标题和编号保持可读，主体大部、背景和底部微型信息进入雾化失焦。让文字像印在玻璃上，并被表层轻微咬边。加入克制的角落标记、边缘日期、作品编号、档案记录和制作参数微型注释，组成元数据坐标系，但不要遮挡清晰窄窗。整体表面保留颗粒压花玻璃触感：暗部更密集，亮部更乳白，边缘带细碎折射和轻微位移，使对象、图像与文字像被同一块材料统一压住。最终画面应冷静、克制、带技术档案感，只释放最关键的信息。若主题涉及KFC，使用泛化的红白快餐视觉线索，不使用官方标志或照搬品牌组合。避免杂乱、普通写实场景叙事、过多可读文案、水印和无关品牌。

items.title: 纽约中央公园八月午后城市写生海报
items.description: A premium urban-sketch travel journal poster depicting Central Park summer life with ink lines, transparent watercolor, and the Manhattan skyline.
items.prompt: Premium vertical urban-sketch travel-journal poster of New York's Central Park on an August afternoon. Show expansive green lawns, mature elm and oak trees, leisurely pedestrians, cyclists, joggers, picnics on the grass, and the Manhattan skyline emerging softly beyond the treetops. Use refined expressive pen-and-ink drawing with thin black lines, broken contours, slightly imperfect hand-drawn perspective, and an authentic sketchbook feel. Layer transparent watercolor with soft pigment diffusion, subtle paper texture, a limited palette, and preserved white highlights. Build an airy composition with large negative space: foreground park life, middle-ground walkers and cyclists, background skyline fading into watercolor haze. Mood is warm, poetic, peaceful, observational, and timeless. Use soft August sunlight, gentle tree shadows across the lawn, warm reflected highlights, and delicate atmospheric depth. Add the exact typography NEW YORK and An August Afternoon in a restrained elegant travel-journal layout. Keep hand-drawn architecture and landscape details authentic; avoid photorealism, 3D, heavy shadows, saturated color, clutter, logos, watermarks, or unrelated text.
items.prompt_zh: 一张高级竖版城市写生旅行日记海报，描绘八月午后的纽约中央公园。展示广阔绿草坪、成熟榆树和橡树、悠闲行人、骑行者、慢跑者、草地野餐，以及在树梢外柔和浮现的曼哈顿天际线。采用精致而有表现力的钢笔淡彩画：纤细黑色墨线、断续轮廓、略带不完美的手绘透视和真实素描本质感。叠加透明水彩、柔和颜料扩散、细微纸张纹理、有限色调，并保留白色高光。构建轻盈且有呼吸感的构图，留出大面积负空间：前景表现公园生活，中景表现散步者和骑行者，背景中的天际线淡入水彩薄雾。氛围温暖、诗意、宁静、观察式且具有永恒的夏日城市生活感。使用柔和八月阳光、草坪上的轻柔树影、温暖反光高光和细腻大气深度。以克制典雅的旅行日记排版加入以下精确文字：NEW YORK 和 An August Afternoon。保持手绘建筑与景观细节真实；避免照相写实、3D、厚重阴影、过度饱和、杂乱、标志、水印或无关文字。

items.title: 窗边阳光下的东亚成年女性手机自拍
items.description: A quiet ultra-photorealistic smartphone selfie of an adult East Asian woman beside a bright window, with natural skin detail and imperfect handheld framing.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible adult East Asian woman. Preserve recognizable facial structure, true-to-life skin tone, subtle asymmetry, and authentic unretouched features without beautification filters or stylized rendering. Create an ultra-photorealistic casual smartphone selfie in a quiet room beside a sunlit window. Capture a relaxed three-quarter profile from close arm's length as she turns slightly toward the window and gazes outside with a thoughtful understated expression, calm eyes, relaxed facial muscles, and a naturally resting mouth. Give her long dark brown-black hair with natural volume, slight disarray, flyaways, and individual strands catching the backlight. She wears large circular black acetate eyeglasses with believable daylight reflections and a simple fitted heather-gray cotton T-shirt with natural creasing and drape. Use one-sided natural sunlight with convincing contrast and window-frame shadow bands across parts of the face and upper body; retain realistic highlights and color variation without HDR or artificial glow. Keep the setting minimal: light neutral wall, clean vertical window frame, no decorative distractions. Use a slightly low front-camera angle, partially visible arm, mild wide-angle distortion, realistic computational photography, subtle digital noise, slight lens softness, and natural exposure. Compose a tight upper-body vertical frame with the subject slightly off-center and the window at the edge, preserving genuine handheld imperfection. Prioritize accurate anatomy, skin pores, natural hair, believable optics, documentary smartphone quality, and no CGI, cinematic grading, influencer retouching, anime, illustration, logos, watermarks, or text.
items.prompt_zh: 使用用户上传的参考图作为画面中主要可见的东亚成年女性的面部身份依据。保持可识别的面部结构、真实肤色、细微不对称和未经修饰的自然特征，不使用美颜滤镜或风格化渲染。创作一张超写实的随性手机自拍：安静房间中，成年女性坐在阳光照射的窗边。以近距离手臂长度的放松三分之二侧面拍摄，她略微转向窗户并凝视窗外，表情深思而含蓄，眼神平静，面部肌肉放松，嘴部自然闭合。她拥有深棕黑色长发，自然蓬松、略显凌乱，逆光中可见碎发和单根发丝。她戴大型圆形黑色醋酸纤维眼镜，镜框可信地反射日光，穿合身麻灰色棉质T恤，表现自然褶皱和垂坠。使用从一侧进入的自然阳光，形成真实对比与横跨脸部和上半身局部的窗框阴影带；保留真实高光和色彩变化，不要HDR或人工光晕。背景保持简约：浅中性色墙壁、干净的垂直窗框，不加入装饰干扰。使用略低的手机前置摄像头角度，前景部分可见手臂，带轻微广角透视、真实计算摄影、细微数字噪点、轻微镜头柔和感和自然曝光。紧凑上半身竖幅构图，主体略偏离中心，窗户位于画面边缘，保留真实手持自拍的不完美感。优先保证准确解剖结构、皮肤毛孔、自然发丝、可信光学瑕疵和纪录片式手机画质；不要CGI感、电影调色、网红式修图、动漫、插画、标志、水印或文字。

items.title: 金黄焦糖香蕉挞超写实美食摄影
items.description: A 4:5 luxury dessert close-up with caramel custard, torched bananas, a spoon-cut cross-section, and warm bakery bokeh.
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic 4:5 close-up food photography of a freshly baked banana-caramel tart. Show a rustic golden-brown flaky pastry shell filled with creamy caramel custard, topped with neatly sliced ripe bananas lightly torched, golden caramel drizzle, crushed pistachios, and tiny chocolate curls. A spoon scoops a portion to reveal a luscious cross-section of distinct creamy caramel and banana layers. Set it on a rustic wooden board in a warm bakery environment; softly blur other desserts in the background, including a chocolate truffle, berry mini pavlova, and almond-flake croissant. Use golden-hour lighting, soft bokeh, a warm rich caramel-brown and banana-yellow palette with subtle green accents, and a refined luxury dessert aesthetic. Shoot with a Sony A1 and 85mm f/1.4 look, razor-sharp focus on the tart and spoon, highly detailed natural textures, cinematic food-photography realism, and believable food materials. Avoid blur, low resolution, compression artifacts, cartoon or painted styles, plastic or fake food, deformed utensils, bad proportions, text, watermark, signature, logo, oversaturation, washed-out color, harsh flash, cold light, 3D/CGI, toy food, or miniature diorama appearance.
items.prompt_zh: 4:5纵向超写实特写美食摄影：拍摄一个新鲜出炉的香蕉焦糖挞。质朴的金棕色酥皮外壳呈现层层酥脆质感，内馅为奶油焦糖蛋奶沙司，顶部铺放整齐切片的熟香蕉并略微炙烤，淋上金黄色焦糖酱，撒上碎开心果和细小巧克力卷。一把勺子舀出一部分，展示奶油焦糖与香蕉层次分明、诱人的横截面。将甜点置于质朴木质砧板上，环境为温暖烘焙店；背景柔和虚化，可见巧克力松露、浆果迷你蛋白酥和撒杏仁片的羊角面包。使用黄金时段光线与柔和散景，采用焦糖棕、香蕉黄和微妙绿色点缀的温暖浓郁调色，营造精致奢华甜点美学。使用Sony A1与85mm f/1.4镜头观感，对挞和勺子进行锐利对焦，表现高度细致的自然纹理、可信食材材质和电影级美食摄影真实感。避免模糊、低分辨率、压缩伪影、卡通或绘画风格、塑料感或假食物、变形餐具、比例失调、文字、水印、签名、标志、过饱和、褪色、刺眼闪光、冷光、3D/CGI、玩具食物或娃娃屋微缩模型感。

items.title: 极简高级城市建筑线稿海报
items.description: A restrained architectural travel print with deep cobalt linework, cream paper, small lower-third city scene, and bilingual city labeling.
items.prompt: Create a minimalist high-end city architecture line-art poster themed around Lisbon. Use deep cobalt-blue pen drawings and fine architectural sketches to represent the city's most recognizable streets, buildings, skyline, or natural landscape, naturally integrating representative urban elements without piling up landmarks. Keep the scene restrained, authentic, and alive. Concentrate the small main city illustration in the lower third, leaving generous cream-white negative space—especially above—so it feels like a premium architectural travel manuscript or collectible city print. Add only a few incidental life details such as pedestrians, bicycles, trams, cars, streetlights, trees, or small shops; they must remain subordinate to the architecture. Use deep cobalt monochrome linework, delicate hand-drawing, slight cross-hatching, cream-white aged or subtly textured paper, low contrast, low saturation, quiet editorial design, and large breathing room. Do not use heavy shadows, large watercolor areas, 3D, glossy modern commercial illustration, complex borders, or clutter. In the white space below the illustration, center two very small lines: 里斯本 and LISBON. Use a thin scholarly Chinese typeface and refined letter-spaced serif Latin type, keeping the labels as a finishing touch. Overall feel: architect's travel manuscript × classical city print × minimalist art poster × premium paper stationery. Ultra-HD with exquisite line detail.
items.prompt_zh: 以Lisbon为主题，创作一张极简高级的城市建筑线稿海报。使用深钴蓝色钢笔线稿和精细建筑速写表现该城市最有辨识度的街道、建筑、天际线或自然景观，自然融入具有代表性的城市元素，但不要堆砌地标，保持克制、真实并富有生活感。将较小的城市主体集中在画面下方约三分之一处，四周尤其上方保留大量米白色负空间，使画面像高级建筑旅行手稿或艺术收藏级城市版画。仅加入少量行人、自行车、电车、汽车、路灯、树木或小店等生活细节，并让它们服从建筑主体。使用深钴蓝单色线稿、精细手绘、轻微排线、米白色旧纸或细微纹理纸、低对比度、低饱和度、安静克制的编辑设计和充足呼吸空间。不要厚重阴影、大面积水彩、3D、光滑现代商业插画感、复杂边框或杂乱画面。在主体下方的留白处居中加入两行极小文字：里斯本和LISBON。中文使用纤细典雅的书卷体，拉丁字母使用精致且适度增加字距的衬线体，文字只作点睛，不要压过城市插画。整体感觉为建筑师旅行手稿 × 古典城市版画 × 极简艺术海报 × 高级纸本文创。超高清，线稿细节精致。

items.title: 白衬衫黑牛仔裤亚洲成年女性混凝土墙人像
items.description: A professional medium close-up portrait of an adult Asian woman seated by a concrete wall in natural daylight, with a configurable gaze direction.
items.prompt: Professional medium close-up portrait of a generic Asian adult woman wearing an opaque white silky blouse with a modest V neckline and black high-waisted jeans. Keep the styling polished and non-revealing; the blouse may be neatly tied or tucked at the waist without exposing the abdomen. She sits beside a concrete wall with one knee bent in front of her, posing in a calm, absorbed manner while a diagonal shadow falls across the wall. Natural daylight highlights her skin with realistic texture and a gentle luminous finish. One hand tucks a strand of hair behind her ear to reveal a long triangular earring, while the other supports her chin. She gazes at the camera with a cool, subtly playful expression. Preserve natural anatomy, believable hands and hair, authentic daylight, moderate skin detail, and a professional fashion-editorial mood. Avoid minors, sexualized styling, distorted anatomy, plastic skin, excessive retouching, logos, watermarks, and text.
items.prompt_zh: 专业中景特写肖像：一位泛化的亚洲成年女性穿着不透肤的白色丝质衬衫，采用得体的V领，搭配黑色高腰牛仔裤。整体造型精致且不暴露；衬衫可以在腰部整齐打结或塞入裤腰，但不要露出腹部。她坐在混凝土墙旁，一只膝盖在身前弯曲，神态平静而专注，墙面上投下斜向阴影。自然日光照亮皮肤，保留真实纹理并呈现柔和的明亮感。一只手将发丝别到耳后，露出长三角形耳环，另一只手托着下巴。她以冷静而略带俏皮的表情看向镜头。保持自然解剖结构、可信的手部与发丝、真实日光、适度皮肤细节和专业时尚社论气质。避免未成年人、性化造型、解剖扭曲、塑料肌肤、过度修图、标志、水印和文字。

items.title: 2026国际足球赛事电影感冠军海报
items.description: An epic vertical 4:5 sports poster centered on a giant golden championship trophy in a futuristic stadium at sunset.
items.prompt: Create a vertical 4:5 cinematic sports poster inspired by the global 2026 football championship atmosphere, without official logos or copied tournament branding. Place a giant golden championship trophy at the center of a futuristic stadium. Thousands of small distant fans form a sea of lights without any individual becoming a main character. Show a dramatic sunset sky transitioning into night, fireworks above, and national flags subtly blending into the atmosphere. Use epic volumetric lighting, ultra-realistic gold reflections, physically believable stadium materials, dynamic composition, global celebration energy, premium sports-advertising polish, and sports-magazine-cover quality. Render at hyper-detailed 8K quality with rich cinematic contrast and realistic depth. Avoid readable text, watermarks, logos, third-party branding, identifiable close-up people, distorted figures, plastic materials, and clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张竖版4:5电影感体育海报，灵感来自2026年全球足球冠军赛事氛围，但不要官方标志或照搬赛事品牌视觉。将巨大的金色冠军奖杯置于未来主义体育场中央。数千名远处的小比例球迷形成灯海，不让任何单个人物成为主角。展现戏剧性的日落天空向夜晚过渡，上方烟花绽放，各国国旗微妙地融入氛围。使用史诗般的体积光、超写实的金色反射、物理可信的体育场材质、动态构图、全球庆典活力、高端体育广告质感和体育杂志封面品质。以超高细节8K质量渲染，具备丰富电影级对比度和真实空间层次。避免可读文字、水印、标志、第三方品牌、可辨识的近景人物、变形人物、塑料材质和杂乱画面。

items.title: 青色涂鸦宇宙背景黑白音乐人像海报
items.description: A vertical 2:3 monochrome music portrait cutout on a vivid teal hand-drawn space-doodle background with exact chalk-style typography.
items.prompt: Vertical 2:3 poster, a high-contrast black-and-white photographic cutout of a generic adult Indian man on a vivid hand-drawn teal doodle-universe background. He has naturally curly messy black hair, short 3–5-day stubble, no glasses, and a left-facing side profile with chin lifted, head slightly back, eyes closed, and an absorbed expression as if surrendered to music. He wears white over-ear headphones and an oversized acid-washed denim jacket with a relaxed cool posture. Render the subject fully monochrome and desaturated with deep blacks, bright whites, heavy film grain, and a rough white hand-cut border around the silhouette. Use a pure flat teal-cyan background #00BCD4 with energetic Gen-Z music-culture energy. Scatter white chalk doodles: ringed Saturn upper left, shooting-star trail, constellation dots, satellite dish upper right, ringed planet center right, spiral galaxy, launching rocket with clouds at bottom, floating astronaut with heart speech bubble, music notes near the head, a radiant crown above the headphones, small stars and hearts, and an arrow pointing to the subject. Add the exact text DREAM BIG on the jacket back in teal graffiti lettering, LOST IN THE MUSIC at center-right in casual white chalk script, and GOOD VIBES ♡ in tiny white chalk lettering at bottom-left. Keep typography legible but hand-drawn, with no other text, logos, watermarks, or brand marks. Preserve natural anatomy, believable headphones and jacket, clear subject silhouette, high contrast, vintage poster texture, and authentic music-poster composition. Do not use photorealistic color, gradients, 3D, clutter, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, or childish caricature.
items.prompt_zh: 竖版2:3海报：一位泛化的成年印度男性黑白高对比照片剪影，置于充满活力的手绘青色涂鸦宇宙背景上。他拥有自然卷曲凌乱的黑发、3–5天的短胡茬、无眼镜，侧脸朝左，下巴抬起，头部略向后仰，双眼闭合，表情仿佛完全沉浸在音乐中。佩戴白色头戴式耳机，穿宽大的酸洗牛仔夹克，姿态放松而有酷感。主体完全以黑白去饱和表现，深黑与亮白形成强烈对比，加入厚重胶片颗粒，并在剪影周围保留粗糙的白色手剪边缘。背景使用纯平涂青蓝色#00BCD4，呈现充满活力的Z世代音乐文化感。散布白色粉笔涂鸦：左上方带环土星、流星轨迹、星座连线点阵、右上方卫星天线、右中方带环行星、螺旋星系、底部带云朵的发射火箭、带心形对话气泡的漂浮宇航员、头部附近的音符、耳机上方带光芒的皇冠、散落的小星星与爱心，以及指向主体的箭头。加入以下精确文字：夹克背面使用青色涂鸦字体写DREAM BIG；画面右中方使用随意白色粉笔手写体写LOST IN THE MUSIC；左下角用极小白色粉笔字写GOOD VIBES ♡。文字应清晰但保留手绘感，不要其他文字、标志、水印或品牌标记。保持自然解剖结构、可信的耳机与夹克、清晰剪影、高对比度、复古海报颗粒和真实音乐海报构图。不要彩色写实、渐变、3D、杂乱背景、解剖扭曲、多余肢体或低幼 caricature。

items.title: 卧室中的东亚成年女性温馨生活人像
items.description: A warm, photorealistic Korean-inspired bedroom lifestyle portrait with modest oatmeal knitwear and late-afternoon light.
items.prompt: Ultra-photorealistic portrait of a generic East Asian adult woman with long glossy black hair in a loose high ponytail, soft wispy bangs, luminous natural skin texture, understated makeup, and a calm gentle expression. She sits comfortably cross-legged on a cozy bed in a warm modern bedroom. The room has cream bedding, soft knit blankets, sheer curtains filtering afternoon light, framed photos, a wooden nightstand, small houseplants, and a softly glowing bedside lamp, creating a peaceful lived-in home atmosphere. Dress her in modest luxury loungewear in warm oatmeal-beige: a fully opaque long-sleeve textured knit Henley top covering the chest and shoulders, relaxed fit, matching high-waisted ribbed knit lounge pants, and soft cream socks. Her hands rest gently in her lap, shoulders relaxed, torso leaning slightly toward the camera, with soft eye contact, a subtle head tilt, and natural body language. Use warm late-afternoon window sunlight blended with soft bedside-lamp ambient glow, gentle hair and skin highlights, realistic shadows, cozy golden-hour falloff, and a neutral beige-cream palette with warm wood accents. Capture an eye-level vertical 9:16 portrait with an 85mm-equivalent lens, shallow depth of field, soft background separation, realistic skin and fabric detail, and natural photographic imperfections. Style: cozy lifestyle photography, minimalist Korean-inspired bedroom editorial, candid peaceful weekend mood, premium quality, natural proportions. Avoid minors, sexualized styling, revealing clothing, distorted anatomy, plastic skin, excessive retouching, logos, watermarks, and copied brand aesthetics.
items.prompt_zh: 一张超写实的人像照片，主体是一位泛化的东亚成年女性，拥有柔顺乌黑的长发，扎成自然蓬松的高马尾，搭配轻盈碎刘海，呈现真实透亮的皮肤纹理、低调妆容和平静温柔的表情。她舒适地盘腿坐在温馨现代卧室的床上。房间有奶油色床品、柔软针织毯、过滤午后光线的薄纱窗帘、墙上相框、木制床头柜、小盆栽和散发柔光的床头灯，营造宁静而有生活气息的家庭氛围。为她穿温暖燕麦米色的低调居家服：完全不透肤、遮盖胸部和肩膀的长袖纹理针织亨利领上衣，宽松剪裁，搭配同色高腰罗纹针织居家裤和柔软奶油色袜子。双手轻轻放在腿上，肩膀放松，身体略向镜头倾斜，带柔和眼神接触、轻微头部倾斜和自然肢体语言。使用温暖午后窗光与柔和床头灯氛围光混合，表现头发和皮肤的柔和高光、真实阴影、舒适金色时刻的自然光衰减，以及中性米色奶油色调和温暖木色点缀。平视拍摄，竖版9:16构图，85mm等效镜头，浅景深和柔和背景分离，清晰表现真实皮肤与面料细节，保留自然摄影瑕疵。风格为温馨生活方式摄影、极简韩风启发的卧室社论、宁静周末抓拍感和高级自然质感。避免未成年人、性化造型、暴露服装、解剖扭曲、塑料肌肤、过度修图、标志、水印和照搬品牌审美。

items.title: 阿尔达·居莱尔土耳其双重曝光足球海报
items.description: A 4:5 cinematic double-exposure football poster blending a referenced athlete's portrait with a Turkish urban and cultural panorama.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the identity reference for the adult football player Arda Güler. Preserve recognizable facial structure, eyes, nose, jawline, hairstyle, skin texture, and expression without generating a generic face. Aspect ratio 4:5 is mandatory. Create an ultra-premium cinematic double-exposure poster featuring Arda Güler in a powerful three-quarter pose with a calm, determined gaze. Let the portrait dominate the composition with photorealistic skin and expressive eyes. Within the silhouette, weave an immersive Turkey panorama of elegant boulevards, illuminated bridges, modern architecture, historic districts, lively waterfronts, cultural landmarks, and a world-class football arena. Integrate the cityscape organically into the athlete's silhouette to symbolize ambition, movement, and global influence. Use atmospheric dawn lighting with warm amber sunlight through soft clouds, cinematic haze, volumetric beams, subtle lens reflections, and realistic environmental depth. Layer architecture, urban textures, distant skylines, flowing motion elements, wind-swept hair, and restrained energy trails to suggest scale and momentum. Combine luxury fashion-campaign art direction with elite sports storytelling and premium tourism-poster quality. Use minimal refined typography placement without inventing readable copy, rich contrast, cinematic color grading, realistic reflections, magazine-cover sophistication, inspiring travel narrative, and high-resolution photorealistic detail. Avoid official logos, third-party branding, watermarks, generic faces, altered identity, anatomy errors, excessive effects, and cluttered typography.
items.prompt_zh: 使用用户上传的参考图作为成年足球运动员Arda Güler的身份依据。保持可识别的面部结构、眼睛、鼻子、下颌线、发型、皮肤纹理和表情，不生成通用脸。纵横比必须为4:5。创作一张超高端电影感双重曝光海报，展现Arda Güler充满力量感的三分之二侧身姿势与冷静坚定的眼神。让肖像主导构图，表现写实皮肤和富有表现力的眼睛。在人物剪影内部有机融入Turkey的沉浸式全景：优雅林荫大道、亮灯桥梁、现代建筑、历史街区、充满活力的滨水区、文化地标和世界级足球场。让城市景观自然编织进运动员剪影，象征雄心、运动与全球影响力。采用大气黎明光线，让温暖琥珀色阳光穿过柔云，加入电影薄雾、体积光束、微妙镜头反射和真实环境深度。叠加建筑、城市纹理、远方天际线、流动动势、随风发丝和克制的能量轨迹，营造尺度感与动量。将奢侈时尚广告艺术指导与精英体育叙事结合，达到高端旅游海报品质。使用极简精致的排版位置但不要凭空生成可读文案，加入丰富对比、电影级调色、真实反射、杂志封面质感、鼓舞人心的旅行叙事和高分辨率写实细节。避免官方标志、第三方品牌、水印、通用脸、身份改变、解剖错误、过度特效和拥挤排版。

items.title: 黄黑极简日系时装插画封面
items.description: A vertical 9:16 high-end Japanese fashion-cover illustration with minimalist anime styling, cel shading, and a controlled yellow-black palette.
items.prompt: High-end Japanese fashion magazine cover illustration featuring an elegant adult fashion model, vertical 9:16. Use a minimalist modern anime fashion-illustration style with refined cel shading, clean sharp large color blocks, almost no line art, and elegant clear edges. Build a unified yellow-and-black palette: bright yellow, golden yellow, and amber as the main background or environment colors; off-white, cream, and light skin tones as subject base colors; and pure black, charcoal, and deep gray-black hard-edged blocks for shadows. Add only small ocher, caramel, taupe, or tiny orange-red accents if needed. Keep the background clean with generous negative space. Strong light comes from upper left, highlights are transparent, shadows are crisp, the silhouette is slender, and the posture is quiet and cool. The result should feel like an eye-catching, minimalist, fashionable, slightly alienated premium magazine cover. No text, watermark, complex background, realistic photography, 3D rendering, thick paint, childish cartoon styling, or messy decoration.
items.prompt_zh: 高端日系时装杂志封面感插画，主体为an elegant adult fashion model，竖版9:16。采用极简现代二次元时装插画风，精致赛璐璐上色，干净锐利的大色块塑形，几乎无线稿，边缘优雅清晰。建立统一的黄黑配色：以明黄、金黄和琥珀黄作为主要背景或环境色，以米白、奶油白和浅肤色作为主体基础色，以纯黑、炭黑和深灰黑的硬边块面表现阴影。仅在需要时少量加入赭黄、焦糖色、灰褐色或极小面积橘红色点缀。保持背景干净并留出大面积负空间。强光从左上方照射，亮部通透，暗部利落，主体轮廓修长，姿态安静冷淡。最终效果应像一张醒目、极简、时尚且略带疏离感的高端杂志封面。不要文字、水印、复杂背景、写实摄影、3D渲染、厚涂、低幼卡通风格或杂乱装饰。

items.title: 实验性时尚社论肖像海报视觉干预
items.description: A configurable 9:16 experimental editorial portrait poster using one controlled photographic intervention and restrained typography.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Create a 9:16 experimental editorial portrait poster featuring adult fashion portrait subject and exactly one strong visual intervention: narrow light beam. Use the headline AFTERIMAGE, a controlled palette of black, white, cool gray, electric blue accent, and an overall mood of sharp, cinematic, restrained, experimental. Begin with a striking close or waist-up fashion portrait: keep the subject large in frame with clear facial emotion, natural skin texture, realistic hair, and a strong silhouette. The photograph must work as a fashion image before graphic treatment. Apply only the selected intervention. For color split, use uneven translucent bands passing through face and body to selectively reveal or shift color. For a narrow light beam, keep the scene cool and restrained while one beam cuts across the eyes, nose, or cheek and continues naturally into the surrounding space. For a horizontal cut, use bold bands and oversized typography to reorganize selected parts of the portrait. For a motion veil, keep the main portrait sharp while selected eyes, mouth, or shoulders stretch into soft horizontal photographic motion trails, never a digital glitch. Make AFTERIMAGE part of the composition: crop letters off canvas, overlap the subject, hide them behind the body, or let them change through the intervention. Add only minimal supporting text: STUDY 01 and FORM IN MOTION. Use mostly black, white, gray, or deep neutrals plus one accent, keep skin tones natural, and avoid yellow grading. Add only a few fine lines, circles, or open corner marks if needed. The result should feel like a contemporary fashion editorial or art-direction experiment, not a generic template. Avoid competing effects, dense micro-text, UI graphics, heavy glitch, random collage, numbering, Vol./Issue labels, four-point sparkles, logos, watermarks, and distorted anatomy.
items.prompt_zh: 使用用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。创作一张9:16实验性社论肖像海报，主体为adult fashion portrait subject，并且只使用一种强烈而受控的视觉干预：narrow light beam。使用标题AFTERIMAGE、black, white, cool gray, electric blue accent的受控调色板，以及sharp, cinematic, restrained, experimental的整体情绪。从引人注目的特写或半身时尚肖像开始：主体在画面中占据较大比例，具有清晰面部情绪、自然皮肤纹理、真实头发和强烈轮廓；在加入图形处理前，摄影本身就应具备时尚照片水准。只应用所选干预方式：若为色彩分割，使用穿过脸部和身体的不均匀半透明条带，有选择地揭示或偏移颜色；若为窄光束，保持场景清冷克制，让一道光束横穿眼睛、鼻子或脸颊并自然延伸至周围空间；若为水平切割，用大胆条带和超大排版重组肖像的选定部分；若为动态面纱，保持主肖像清晰，让眼睛、嘴巴或肩膀等局部拉伸成柔和的水平摄影运动轨迹，绝不做成数字故障。让AFTERIMAGE成为构图的一部分：字母可以裁切出画布、与主体重叠、隐藏在身体后方，或在经过干预区域时发生变化。辅助文字保持极简，只加入STUDY 01和FORM IN MOTION。调色以黑、白、灰或深中性色为主，辅以一种强调色；保持肤色自然，避免发黄调色。如有需要，仅加入少量细线、圆圈或开放式边角标记。最终应像当代时尚社论或艺术指导实验，而不是普通模板。避免相互竞争的多重效果、密集微型文字、UI图形、重度故障、随机拼贴、编号、Vol./Issue标签、四角星光符号、标志、水印和解剖结构扭曲。

items.title: 写实近景奶油色连帽衫成年女性自拍肖像
items.description: A casual intimate-feeling webcam selfie portrait with a cream hoodie, soft makeup, muted tones, and warm screen lighting.
items.prompt: Photorealistic close-up webcam-selfie portrait of a generic adult woman filling almost the entire frame. Tilt her head slightly, rest her cheek against her shoulder, and let the long cream-colored hoodie sleeve partly frame the cheek. Long straight hair with curtain bangs falls along the left side of her face and covers one eye. On the visible side, use soft makeup with laminated brows, elongated black winged eyeliner, matte dusty-pink lips, visible eyelashes, and a calm slightly pouty expression while looking directly into the camera. The long zip-up hoodie is comfortably worn with a relaxed neckline that shows only the collarbone, with no revealing or sexualized emphasis. Use a slight frame tilt and place the face very close to the lens. Keep sharp focus on the visible eye, lips, hair texture, and thick cream fabric while the simple warm gray-beige wall recedes into soft blur. Warm indoor and screen light from front-left creates gentle highlights on skin and hair; use moderate contrast and a muted black, beige-gray, and dusty-pink palette. Preserve authentic casual selfie realism, natural anatomy, believable hair, and natural skin texture; avoid minors, sexualized posing, distorted facial features, extra eyes, logos, watermarks, text, plastic skin, and heavy airbrushing.
items.prompt_zh: 一张写实的网络摄像头自拍特写肖像，画面几乎被一位泛化的成年女性填满。她的头微微向侧面倾斜，脸颊靠在肩膀上，奶油色连帽衫的长袖部分环绕在脸颊旁。长直发配窗帘刘海，沿脸部左侧垂落并遮住一只眼睛。可见的一侧脸使用柔和妆容：整理平整的眉毛、拉长眼型的黑色上扬眼线、哑光灰粉色唇妆和清晰睫毛；她直视镜头，表情冷静并略微嘟嘴。长款拉链连帽衫自然舒适地穿着，领口放松但只露出锁骨，不强调暴露或性化效果。画面略微倾斜，脸部非常靠近镜头。对可见的眼睛、嘴唇、头发质感和厚实的奶油色面料进行清晰对焦，简单的暖灰米色墙壁在背景中柔和虚化。左前方的温暖室内光与屏幕光在皮肤和头发上形成柔和高光；采用适中对比度和黑色、米灰色、灰粉色的低饱和调色。保留真实随意的自拍质感、自然解剖结构、可信发丝和自然皮肤纹理；避免未成年人、性化姿势、面部变形、多余眼睛、标志、水印、文字、塑料肌肤和过度磨皮。

items.title: 春日田园成年女性长焦摄影
items.description: A transparent, dreamy spring countryside portrait photographed with a telephoto lens and candid vitality.
items.prompt: Photorealistic 9:16 spring countryside portrait with a dreamy rural atmosphere, clear transparent air, candid snapshot energy, and a telephoto long-shot perspective. Show a Chinese adult woman with long black hair, airy bangs, light natural makeup, and realistic fine skin texture. She wears a modest floral pinafore dress layered over a cardigan, with opaque coverage and natural fabric detail. Set the scene in a bright rural environment and randomly select a few—not all—of these supporting elements: a vintage wooden house, a window-side sink with a copper faucet, a wooden fence, a haystack, a flower field, red gerbera daisies, yellow daisies, a duckling, a cat, or a lamb. Use clear direct spring sunlight, cool-white highlights, slight controlled overexposure, transparent atmospheric depth, and backlit hair strands. Keep the subject and background naturally separated while retaining an authentic countryside feel. Capture a candid expressive gesture or lively facial expression within the long telephoto composition, with clean, fresh, vital oxygen-rich color and subtle film realism. Preserve natural anatomy, realistic proportions, and believable animal forms; avoid minors, sexualized styling, artificial skin, distorted anatomy, duplicate animals, logos, watermarks, and garbled text.
items.prompt_zh: 写实9:16春日田园人像，营造梦幻乡村氛围、清透空气感、抓拍活力和长焦远景视角。画面中是一位中国成年女性，黑色长发配空气刘海，清透淡妆，带有真实细腻的皮肤纹理。她穿着得体的碎花背带裙，外搭开衫，保持不暴露并表现自然面料细节。场景位于明亮的乡村环境中，从以下陪衬元素中随机选择少量出现，不必全部加入：复古木屋、窗边带铜水龙头的水槽、木栅栏、稻草堆、花田、红色非洲菊、黄色小雏菊、小鸭子、猫咪或小羊。使用清澈的春日直射阳光、冷白高光、受控的轻微过曝、通透的空气层次和逆光透亮的发丝。保持主体与背景自然分离，同时保留真实乡村抓拍感。在长焦构图中捕捉自然而有表现力的动作或鲜活表情，呈现干净、清新、富有生命力的氧气感色彩和细微胶片真实感。保持自然解剖结构、真实比例和可信的动物形态；避免未成年人、性化造型、人工磨皮、解剖扭曲、重复动物、标志、水印和乱码。

items.title: 暗夜红玫瑰与哥特芭蕾成人三联画
items.description: A vertical three-panel high-fashion portrait triptych with dark romantic styling, red-rose motifs, and low-key editorial lighting.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the identity reference for the main visible adult woman. Create a photorealistic high-end fashion editorial in a vertical three-panel photo collage. The top and bottom panels are extreme close-ups; the middle panel is a full-body view. Dark Romantic / Gothic Ballerina aesthetic, with black, deep red, cream-beige, and pale-skin tones against a pitch-black background. The adult woman has platinum-blonde long straight-to-slightly-wavy hair in a half-up half-down style, smoky red-brown eyeshadow, defined mascara, deep burgundy lips, silver chain necklaces, and a dangling cross earring. Dress her in a black structured bodice with lace detailing, a beige tulle tutu skirt, opaque black tights with subtle sparkle, and black opera gloves; keep the styling elegant and non-revealing. Top panel: eyes-to-chin extreme close-up, holding a dark red rose beside her cheek and jawline, with an intense melancholic gaze and soft shadow on the left side of her face. Middle panel: full-body wide shot, seated upright on the floor with knees bent and comfortably angled apart, hands resting in her lap while holding the rose stem vertically, maintaining an elegant ballerina posture. Bottom panel: macro facial close-up, holding the rose stem gently between her teeth, with fierce direct eye contact and sharp focus on the eyes and rose petals. Use 85mm or 100mm macro perspective for the close-ups and 35mm for the middle panel, f/2.8 close-up background blur, 1/160s shutter, ISO 400 with subtle film grain. Low-key directional lighting should sculpt the face and red rose against the black background. Preserve natural anatomy, realistic fabric and hair detail, and a polished dark editorial finish.
items.prompt_zh: 使用用户上传的参考图作为画面中主要可见成年女性的身份依据。创作一张写实的高端时尚社论三联画，采用纵向三格照片拼贴：顶部和底部为极近距离特写，中间为全身照。整体为暗黑浪漫 / 哥特芭蕾舞者美学，以黑色、深红色、米色与浅肤色为主，并置于漆黑背景前。成年女性拥有铂金色长直至微卷发，半扎半披造型；妆容为红棕烟熏眼影、清晰睫毛和深酒红色唇妆；佩戴银色链条项链与垂坠十字架耳环。她穿黑色结构感上装并带蕾丝细节、米色薄纱芭蕾舞裙、不透肤的微闪黑色丝袜和黑色歌剧手套；造型保持优雅且不暴露。顶部面板：眼睛至下巴的极近特写，将深红玫瑰放在脸颊与下颌线旁，呈现强烈而忧郁的凝视，脸部左侧有柔和阴影。中间面板：全身广角镜头，她坐在地面上，膝盖弯曲并自然分开，双手放在腿上竖直握住玫瑰花茎，躯干挺直，保持优雅芭蕾姿态。底部面板：面部微距特写，她轻轻用牙齿含住玫瑰花茎，直视镜头，眼睛和玫瑰花瓣清晰对焦。顶部和底部使用85mm或100mm微距视角，中间使用35mm视角；特写使用f/2.8营造柔和背景虚化，快门1/160秒，ISO 400并加入轻微胶片颗粒。采用低调、定向光线，在纯黑背景前塑造脸部和红玫瑰。保持自然解剖结构、真实面料与发丝细节，以及精致的暗黑时尚社论质感。

items.title: C罗奢华足球社论海报设计
items.description: A premium 3:4 editorial sports poster template with a carved football arch, stadium celebration atmosphere, dimensional breakout effect, and exact wall typography.
items.prompt: Photorealistic luxury editorial sports poster, 3:4 portrait ratio. Cover the full frame with premium warm-ivory Italian linen wall texture, subtle grain, and tactile detail. Center a precision-carved football-shaped archway with deep architectural relief, visible carved edges, inner shadow depth, sculptural bevels, and premium craftsmanship. Inside the arch: an elegant stadium-gala atmosphere with deep-blue and white smoke trails, gold and silver championship confetti, white orchid and rose arrangements with dark-green foliage, royal-blue and pearl-white celebration balloons, and subtle trophy silhouettes in the haze. Subject: Cristiano Ronaldo, full figure, standing confidently inside the carved frame, wearing a Portugal crimson-and-green national football kit, fitted athletic shorts, and premium performance football boots; realistic jersey folds, athletic build, focused expression, short textured dark hair, and natural skin texture. Celebration pose: chest slightly forward, chin raised, one hand relaxed, football beside his right boot. Create a believable 3D breakout: face, right shoulder, right arm below the elbow, and right boot extend beyond the frame onto the wall, with soft natural shadows and dimensional depth. Use premium stadium tungsten light blended with warm golden-hour light from upper left, soft white rim light on shoulders and jaw, and subtle right-side wall fill. Avoid harsh overexposure and artificial neon. Place the exact wall typography: CRISTIANO RONALDO above the frame in bold Didot- or Bodoni-style embossed gold serif; CHAPTER 41 centered below in warm bronze; 365 MORE DAYS OF GREATNESS below that in widely tracked thin cream-gold uppercase sans serif. Ultra-photorealistic commercial sports photography, luxury magazine art direction, warm ivory, deep blue, and gold palette, authentic shadows, correct anatomy, no extra limbs, no distorted proportions, no tree shadows, no AI artifacts.
items.prompt_zh: 写实主义奢华体育社论海报，3:4 纵向比例。全画幅铺满温暖象牙色的优质意大利亚麻墙面纹理，带细腻颗粒和真实触感。墙面中央设置精密雕刻的足球形拱门，呈现深邃建筑浮雕、清晰雕刻边缘、内部阴影深度、雕塑般倒角与高级工艺感。拱门内部是优雅的体育场庆典氛围：深蓝与白色烟雾轨迹、金银冠军纸屑、白兰花和玫瑰花艺及深绿色叶片、皇家蓝与珍珠白庆典气球，以及隐约融入烟雾的奖杯剪影。主体为克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多（Cristiano Ronaldo）全身像，自信地站在雕刻框内，穿葡萄牙深红与绿色国家队足球服、修身运动短裤和高性能足球鞋；表现真实球衣褶皱、运动员体格、专注表情、短纹理黑发与自然皮肤纹理。庆典姿势：胸部微挺、下巴抬起、一只手放松，足球位于右脚靴旁。制作可信的3D突破效果：面部、右肩、肘部以下的右臂和右脚靴越出框架，延伸到墙面，并在纸张纹理上投下柔和自然的落影，形成有层次的空间感。使用高级体育场钨丝灯与左上方温暖金黄时段光线混合，肩膀和下颌有柔和白色轮廓光，墙面右侧有微妙补光；避免过曝和人工霓虹。墙面排版必须使用以下原文：CRISTIANO RONALDO 位于框架上方，采用粗体 Didot 或 Bodoni 风格压印金色衬线字体；CHAPTER 41 居中置于其下，使用温暖青铜色；365 MORE DAYS OF GREATNESS 位于下一行，使用宽字距、纤细奶油金色大写无衬线字体。超写实商业体育摄影质感，奢华杂志艺术指导，温暖象牙白、深蓝与金色调色，真实阴影，正确解剖结构，无多余肢体、无比例扭曲、无树影、无AI瑕疵。

items.title: 现代东方器物编辑风海报
items.description: A 2:3 modern East Asian editorial poster combining a photographed artifact, Chinese and small English typography, line drawings, and a restrained visual thread on warm ivory paper.
items.prompt: Create a 2:3 vertical modern East Asian artifact editorial poster for {theme}. Feature {artifact} as the core photographed object, with the main title “{main_title}”, subtitle “{subtitle}”, a {main_color} primary palette, a continuous {line_element} visual thread, and a small {accent_color} accent. Use warm ivory paper with subtle fiber and print grain as the base, combining realistic artifact photography, Chinese typography, small English text, line drawings, and restrained East Asian graphic motifs. Keep medium-to-high information density without clutter by organizing 2–3 main visual blocks. Let a visual thread connect title, artifact, and auxiliary graphics: typography may be partly obscured by the artifact, lines may wrap around it, patterns may extend from it, and pale large characters may hide in the background. Use four controlled text scales—giant visual characters, medium Chinese title, small English, and tiny information text—in horizontal, vertical, and staggered arrangements governed by an invisible grid. Present the artifact through complete view, partial crop, and faint line drawing layers. Fill blank areas with low-contrast characters, plant linework, artifact outlines, or texture without overpowering the subject. Keep colors low-saturation with one small high-recognition accent. Avoid PPT partitions, isolated scattered elements, empty contentless space, generic logos, numbering, starbursts, excessive decorative motifs, illegible text, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 为{theme}创建一张2:3竖版现代东方器物编辑海报。以{artifact}作为核心真实摄影器物，主标题为“{main_title}”，副标题为“{subtitle}”，使用{main_color}主色、贯穿性的{line_element}视觉脉络和少量{accent_color}点缀。以带细微纤维与印刷颗粒的暖象牙白纸为底，结合真实器物摄影、中文字体、小型英文、线稿和克制的东方图形。保持中高信息密度但不杂乱，用2至3个主要视觉团块组织版面。让视觉脉络连接标题、器物和辅助图形：文字可以被器物局部遮挡，线条绕过主体，纹样从器物延伸到版面，浅色大字隐藏在背景中。使用四级受控文字尺度——巨型视觉字、中型中文标题、小型英文和极小信息文字——以横排、竖排和错位组合，并由隐形网格控制。通过完整主体、局部裁切和淡线稿等层次呈现器物。留白区域加入低对比大字、植物线描、器物轮廓或纹理，但不要抢主体。主色保持低饱和，只加入一次小面积高识别点缀色。避免PPT式分区、元素孤立散落、没有内容的大面积留白、通用logo、编号、星芒、过度装饰、难以辨认的文字或水印。

items.title: 极简动态人像时尚杂志封面
items.description: A photorealistic minimalist fashion cover with one sharply focused identity-bound subject and softly blurred motion echoes at the sides.
items.prompt: Create an original photorealistic minimalist fashion magazine cover using the attached identity reference as the sole face and identity reference for the central clearly adult subject; do not copy unrelated reference clothing or background. Compose a dynamic motion effect with multiple softly blurred echoes of the same subject at the left and right foreground while keeping the central subject perfectly sharp and naturally proportioned. Use cinematic but restrained lighting, soft shadows, neutral luxury color, shallow depth of field, high-end fashion photography, clean editorial composition, professional 85mm portrait optics, realistic skin texture, and crisp fabric detail. Add large modern cover typography at the top reading exactly “HER19845”; keep all other text minimal and legible. Create an original premium editorial cover aesthetic without imitating a named magazine or artist. No sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, nudity, childlike presentation, distorted faces, duplicate central identities, extra limbs, blurry central subject, excessive retouching, unrelated logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张原创照片级真实的极简时尚杂志封面，将附加身份参考图作为中央明确成年主体唯一的面部与身份参考，不要复制无关的参考服装或背景。通过左右前景多个柔和虚化的同一人物动态残影营造运动效果，同时让中央主体保持极其清晰、比例自然。使用电影感但克制的灯光、柔和阴影、中性奢华色调、浅景深、高端时尚摄影、干净编辑构图、专业85mm人像镜头质感、真实皮肤纹理和清晰面料细节。顶部加入大型现代封面排版，准确写出“HER19845”；其余文字保持极少且清晰可读。采用原创高级编辑封面美学，不模仿具名杂志或艺术家的个人风格。不要性化构图、暴露私密部位、裸露、幼态呈现、扭曲面部、中央身份重复错误、多余肢体、中央主体模糊、过度修图、无关logo或水印。

items.title: 高级美妆杂志3×3网格广告
items.description: A premium 3×3 beauty-advertising grid with nine clearly adult models, distinct cosmetics, controlled studio styling, and a branded center panel.
items.prompt: Create a premium luxury beauty advertisement as a perfectly aligned 3×3 grid of nine equal square panels, using a new layout inspired by an uploaded reference only for broad composition if provided, never for identity. Each panel contains exactly one clearly adult woman with a distinct generic appearance, hairstyle, makeup style, outfit color, and pose. Use elegant high-end styling, realistic skin texture, soft makeup, glossy lips, refined features, and non-sexualized commercial beauty presentation. Give the nine outfits distinct premium colors such as emerald, sapphire, ruby, lavender, champagne, pearl, rose, teal, and silver. Place one unique oversized skincare or cosmetic product inside each panel; vary its shape, packaging, material, and color, and keep it fully inside its own panel without crossing borders. Vary camera angles across panels: close-up, profile, over-the-shoulder, editorial, commercial, and skincare-campaign views. Replace the center panel with clean luxury typography reading exactly “VELORIA BEAUTY”, “Radiance Beyond Limits”, and “Premium Skincare Collection” in elegant gold lettering. Use distinct sophisticated gradient backgrounds, gold accents, soft reflections, luxury studio lighting, subtle bokeh, strict geometric alignment, perfect spacing, no overlaps, no merged panels, no duplicate faces, and no collage errors. Use realistic commercial photography, premium magazine design, and ultra-detailed but tasteful rendering. No sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, nudity, childlike presentation, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable branding text, unrelated logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一则高端奢华美妆广告：采用完美对齐的3×3网格，由九个相等的方形面板组成。如提供上传参考图，仅借鉴其整体构图，不借用任何人物身份。每个面板恰好包含一位明确成年的女性，拥有不同的通用外貌、发型、妆容、服装色彩和姿势。使用优雅高级的造型、真实皮肤纹理、柔和妆容、光泽唇部和精致五官，呈现不性化的商业美容质感。九套服装采用翡翠绿、蓝宝石蓝、宝石红、薰衣草、香槟金、珍珠白、玫瑰粉、青色和银色等不同高级色调。每个面板放置一件独特的大型护肤品或化妆品，分别改变形状、包装、材质和颜色，且产品必须完整留在各自面板内，不越过网格边界。不同面板使用不同镜头角度，包括特写、侧脸、越肩、编辑时尚、商业广告和护肤宣传视图。将中心面板替换为优雅金色排版，准确写出“VELORIA BEAUTY”“Radiance Beyond Limits”和“Premium Skincare Collection”。使用每格不同的精致渐变背景、金色点缀、柔和反射、奢华影棚灯光和细微散景，保持严格几何对齐、完美间距、无主体重叠、无合并面板、无重复面孔和无拼贴错误。采用真实商业摄影、高级杂志设计和细节丰富但得体的渲染。不要性化构图、暴露私密部位、裸露、幼态呈现、解剖扭曲、多余肢体、难以辨认的品牌文字、无关logo或水印。

items.title: 复古卡通风格国家旅行海报
items.description: A collectible 4:5 illustrated travel poster that imagines a country as a joyful hand-painted animated world with a central landscape hero and tiny everyday details.
items.prompt: Create a beautiful 4:5 vertical illustrated travel poster for {country}, designed as a charming collectible vintage animation poster. Imagine {country} as a magical hand-painted world of rolling mountains, winding roads, colorful villages, iconic architecture, local food stalls, traditional homes, trees, flowers, rivers, trains, boats, and tiny generic people enjoying everyday life. Use one strong central landscape or landmark as the hero, with smaller playful details scattered naturally throughout the scene. Draw everything in a cohesive style with rounded shapes, expressive tiny characters, whimsical architecture, slightly exaggerated perspective, soft clouds, warm sunlight, beautiful skies, rich painted textures, textured paper, subtle grain, imperfect printed edges, painterly brushwork, and layered atmospheric depth. Use a playful sophisticated palette with warm vintage tones and a few vibrant accents, nostalgic but not dated. Add elegant poster typography with “{country}” and the exact phrase “Adventure Begins Here”. Make the result joyful, magical, cozy, adventurous, and recognizable, like a poster from a fictional animated travel film. No photorealism, flat vector graphics, generic clip-art, landmark collage, clutter, unrelated logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 为{country}创建一张精美的4:5竖版插画旅行海报，设计成迷人的可收藏复古动画海报。将{country}想象为一个神奇的手绘世界，包含起伏山脉、蜿蜒道路、彩色村庄、标志性建筑、当地小吃摊、传统民居、树木、花卉、河流、火车、船只和享受日常生活的微小通用人物。以一个强烈的中心景观或地标作为主角，在场景中自然散布较小的趣味细节。整体采用统一风格，使用圆润形状、富有表现力的微型角色、异想天开的建筑、略微夸张的透视、柔软云朵、温暖阳光、美丽天空、丰富手绘纹理、纹理纸张、细腻颗粒、不完美印刷边缘、绘画笔触和分层大气深度。使用俏皮而精致的调色板，以温暖复古色调配少量鲜艳强调色，营造怀旧但不落伍的感觉。加入优雅海报排版，包含“{country}”和固定短语“Adventure Begins Here”。最终作品应愉悦、神奇、舒适、充满冒险精神且易于辨认，如虚构动画旅行电影中的海报。不要照片写实、扁平矢量图、通用剪贴画、地标拼贴、杂乱、无关logo或水印。

items.title: 电影镜头类型参考板
items.description: A multi-panel cinematic reference board showing one consistent subject through varied camera angles, framing, lighting, motion, and lens treatments.
items.prompt: Create a cinematic shot-reference board using the same clearly adult man with glasses, a burgundy jacket, gray shirt, and neutral expression as the consistent subject across all panels. Show varied shot styles including close-up, mid shot, long shot, wide angle, overhead, low angle, high angle, worm's-eye, panoramic, and aerial views. Use varied compositions such as symmetrical, intentionally imperfect, foreground prominence, reflection, partial obstruction, abstract framing, and multi-angle layout. Explore cinematic lighting, strong contrast, backlight, artistic light and shadow, light rays, natural outdoor light, and shallow depth of field. Include fast and slow movement impressions, handheld feel, lens reflections, focus contrast, ultra-wide perspective, and detailed close-ups. Keep identity, clothing palette, and subject continuity consistent while making the camera and visual treatment change clearly from panel to panel. Arrange the panels as a clean, legible editorial reference board with restrained labels for shot types. No cartoon, anime, painting, low resolution, blurry face, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, duplicate faces, messy layout, unreadable labels, overexposure, underexposure, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张电影镜头类型参考板：所有画面都使用同一位明确成年的戴眼镜男性作为统一主体，穿酒红色夹克和灰色衬衫，保持中性表情。展示多种镜头类型，包括特写、中景、远景、广角、俯拍、低角度、高角度、虫眼视角、全景和航拍。使用对称构图、刻意不完美构图、前景突出、反射、局部遮挡、抽象构图和多角度布局等不同方式。探索电影照明、强对比、背光、艺术光影、穿透光束、自然户外光和浅景深。加入快速移动与慢动作的视觉印象、手持感、镜头反射、焦点对比、超广角透视和细节特写。保持主体身份、服装色调和连续性一致，同时让每个面板的相机与视觉处理明显变化。将所有面板组织成干净易读的编辑式参考板，并为镜头类型加入克制清晰的标签。不要卡通、动漫、绘画、低分辨率、模糊面部、解剖扭曲、多余手指、重复面部、杂乱布局、难以辨认的标签、过曝、欠曝或水印。

items.title: 复古街机风格像素头像
items.description: A square retro pixel-art profile picture based on one uploaded reference image, with a raised glove, crisp arcade shading, and a flat Pantone 354 C green background.
items.prompt: Create a square 1:1 profile picture using the uploaded reference image as the sole reference for the subject's identity, raised-glove pose, framing, facial features, and overall pixel-art direction. Recreate the subject as detailed retro pixel art with large visible pixels, defined stair-stepped edges, strong dark outlines, dramatic pixelated shading, vibrant but controlled colors, and a crisp 16-bit/32-bit arcade sprite look. Preserve the recognizable face and raised glove without copying unrelated background details. Use only a flat solid Pantone 354 C green background, color #00B140. No gradients, background texture, text, logos, extra objects, photorealism, smooth vector edges, distorted face, missing fingers, extra limbs, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一个1:1正方形头像，将上传的参考图作为主体身份、举起手套的姿势、构图范围、面部特征和整体像素艺术方向的唯一参考。将主体重新创作为细节丰富的复古像素艺术，具有清晰可见的大像素、明确的阶梯状边缘、强烈深色轮廓、戏剧性像素阴影、鲜艳但受控的色彩，以及清晰的16位/32位街机精灵图外观。保留可识别面部和举起的手套，但不要复制无关背景细节。背景仅使用纯色Pantone 354 C绿色，色值#00B140。不要渐变、背景纹理、文字、logo、额外物体、照片写实感、平滑矢量边缘、扭曲面部、缺失手指、多余肢体或水印。

items.title: 仙侠风银发成年女性室内幻想人像
items.description: A photorealistic full-body fantasy portrait of an identity-bound adult woman with silver-white hair and blue ribbons, reclining beside a chick plush in a Chinese-inspired interior.
items.prompt: Use the attached identity reference as the sole facial identity reference for the clearly adult East Asian woman; preserve recognizable face and natural proportions, but do not copy reference clothing or background. Create a photorealistic 9:16 vertical full-body fantasy portrait of her seated or reclining comfortably on a floor platform in a traditional Chinese-inspired interior. Give her long flowing silver-white hair, ornate gold hair ornaments, a small crown-like headpiece, translucent blue-white ribbon streamers, and a refined layered ivory and icy-blue fantasy gown with opaque lining, flowing sleeves, gold trim, and sculptural blue accents. Add opaque dark gloves and pale closed-toe shoes with restrained metallic details. She holds a small round pale-yellow chick plush with tiny wings, orange beak, black eyes, and pink cheeks. Include dark wooden architecture, large windows, calligraphy scrolls, monochrome landscape paintings, a large ink-wash artwork, a yellow orchid, a muted blue embroidered carpet, loose paper, and gentle white mist. Use soft diffused window daylight with cool ambient fill, delicate haze, soft shadows, cool blue-white tones and restrained warm gold. Compose from a low floor-level three-quarter angle with the subject centered, ribbons and mist creating diagonal movement, moderate depth of field, clear face and complete feet. Maintain realistic anatomy, accurate hands, believable materials, and high-end cinematic Chinese fantasy photography. No sexualized framing, body-part emphasis, exposed intimate areas, transparent clothing over the body, nudity, childlike presentation, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, cropped feet, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 将附加身份参考图作为这位明确成年的东亚女性的唯一面部身份参考；保留可识别面部和自然比例，但不要复制参考图的服装或背景。创建一张照片级真实的9:16竖版全身幻想人像：她舒适地坐着或斜倚在传统中国风室内的地面平台上。让她拥有飘逸的银白色长发、华丽金色发饰、小皇冠状头饰、半透明蓝白丝带，以及精致分层的象牙白与冰蓝色幻想长裙，采用不透明内衬、流动袖子、金边和雕塑感蓝色装饰。搭配不透明深色手套和带克制金属细节的浅色包头鞋。她抱着一只淡黄色圆形小鸡毛绒玩具，带小翅膀、橙色喙、黑眼睛和粉色脸颊。场景包含深色木质建筑、大窗户、书法卷轴、单色山水画、大型水墨作品、黄色兰花、铺有刺绣的低饱和蓝色地毯、散落纸张和柔和白雾。使用窗户透入的柔和漫射日光、冷色环境补光、细腻薄雾、柔和阴影、冷蓝白色调和克制暖金点缀。采用低机位地面四分之三视角，人物居中，丝带和雾气形成对角线动势，中等景深，面部清晰且双脚完整。保持真实解剖、准确手部、可信材质和高端电影感中国幻想摄影。不要性化构图、身体部位强调、暴露私密部位、贴身透明暴露、裸露、幼态呈现、解剖扭曲、多余肢体、裁切脚部、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 表现力炭笔线条主题插画
items.description: A monochrome fine-art charcoal drawing that translates a chosen subject into bold gestural strokes, smudged tonal movement, and raw paper texture.
items.prompt: Create an expressive charcoal drawing of {subject} using bold gestural strokes, soft smudging, dramatic line variation, unfinished edges, and raw paper texture. Capture strong artistic movement with selective detail, a monochrome fine-art aesthetic, emotional spontaneity, and natural expressive energy. Preserve the subject's recognizable silhouette while allowing the charcoal marks to remain loose and tactile. Use a balanced composition with clear focal hierarchy, believable tonal range, and no color accents. No text, logo, watermark, photorealistic rendering, 3D effects, clutter, or mechanical vector-clean finish.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一幅{subject}的表现力炭笔画：使用大胆的手势笔触、柔和涂抹、戏剧性的线条变化、未完成的边缘和粗粝纸张纹理。表现强烈的艺术运动感、选择性细节、单色美术审美、情感自发性和自然的表达能量。保留主体可辨识的轮廓，同时让炭笔痕迹保持松弛和有触感。采用平衡构图、清晰视觉层级和可信的明暗范围，不加入彩色强调。不要文字、logo、水印、照片写实渲染、3D效果、杂乱或机械矢量般过度干净的边缘。

items.title: 高端时尚编辑海报设计模板
items.description: A reusable 9:16 premium fashion-poster template combining one identity-bound adult subject, oversized interactive typography, and a selected editorial graphic direction.
items.prompt: Use the attached identity reference as the sole facial identity reference for the clearly adult main subject; preserve recognizable facial identity and natural proportions, but do not copy reference clothing or background. Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster featuring {human} in {clothing}, using a {palette} palette. The main title is “{title}”; add the short supporting phrase “{supporting_text}”. Apply this design direction: {direction}. Build the poster around one strong photographic subject and one dominant graphic idea. Make oversized typography part of the composition through cropping, overlap, foreground/background layering, or scale contrast. If the direction is perspective × typography, use a strong but natural gesture toward camera with dramatic near-far perspective. If blur × sharp detail, keep most of the portrait softly blurred while one narrow facial region is sharply focused. If profile × oversized type, use a sculptural side profile against a bold flat-color background with large serif type crossing the silhouette. If gesture × editorial layout, combine an expressive but non-sexualized fashion pose, subtle motion echo or secondary silhouette, and magazine typography. Keep the layout clean and bold, with one dominant color, one neutral base, limited accents, one large headline, one short supporting line, and only a few small labels. Maintain realistic skin texture, natural facial anatomy, refined fashion styling, crisp fabric detail, controlled studio lighting, strong negative space, and premium magazine-cover quality. No sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, nudity, childlike presentation, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, illegible text, unrelated logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 将附加身份参考图作为明确成年主要人物的唯一面部身份参考；保留可识别面部身份和自然比例，但不要复制参考图的服装或背景。创建一张9:16高端时尚编辑海报：人物为{human}，穿着{clothing}，采用{palette}色板。主标题为“{title}”，辅助短句为“{supporting_text}”。应用以下设计方向：{direction}。围绕一个强摄影主体和一个主导图形理念构建海报。让超大排版通过裁剪、重叠、前景/背景分层或比例对比成为构图的一部分。如果方向为透视×排版，使用朝向镜头的强烈但自然姿态和戏剧性远近透视；如果方向为模糊×锐利细节，让大部分肖像柔和虚化，同时保持狭窄面部区域极其锐利；如果方向为侧面肖像×超大字体，在大胆纯色背景下使用雕塑般侧脸，并让大号衬线字体跨越轮廓；如果方向为姿势×编辑布局，结合表现力强但不性化的时尚姿势、微妙动作回声或次要剪影以及杂志排版。保持布局简洁大胆，使用一种主导色、一种中性基色和有限强调色，包含一个大标题、一行短辅助语和少量小标签。保留真实皮肤纹理、自然面部解剖、精致时尚造型、清晰面料细节、受控影棚灯光、强烈留白和高级杂志封面质感。不要性化构图、暴露私密部位、裸露、幼态呈现、解剖扭曲、多余肢体、难以辨认的文字、无关logo或水印。

items.title: 明亮清透大字背景线描容器主题海报
items.description: A bright flat poster template pairing oversized cropped title glyphs with a central transparent line-drawn container of layered paper-cut symbolic forms and sparse infographic text.
items.prompt: Create a bright, clear flat poster for {theme}. Transform {theme_keywords} into extremely thick sans-serif title characters forming a huge structural background across the upper area; add subtle paper texture and translucent printed grain, with natural edge cropping. Place the main symbolic subject near the central axis inside a single-line transparent container with elliptical rim and base. Fill it with slender stems, rounded blunt leaves, and simplified block-shaped flower or symbolic forms built like layered paper cutouts, with clean geometric edges and slight handmade imperfections. Keep the information layer sparse: place small {info_nodes} on both sides in rounded bold lettering, using colors that echo the graphics, and add two short paragraph blocks plus a tiny footer at the bottom. Extract a bright palette from the theme's season, materials, and emotion: clean high-brightness ground, variable warm or cool title color, saturated support colors for stems/framework, and a few bright accent colors for flowers or symbolic blocks and small text. Emphasize scale contrast between oversized typography and the central line container, light negative space, clear color hierarchy, and a playful infographic rhythm. Use flat graphic design, paper-cut texture, crisp boundaries, airy layout, and no aged or dirty look. The footer may include a small non-branded mark but no readable logo. No photorealism, 3D rendering, rigid grid, clutter, muddy colors, illegible text, unrelated logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 为{theme}创建一张明亮清透的平面海报。将{theme_keywords}转化为极粗无衬线标题大字，让字形在上方形成巨大的结构背景；加入轻微纸纹和半透明印刷颗粒，并让边缘自然裁切。把主题象征主体放在画面中轴附近，用单线轮廓的透明容器承托，容器口沿和底部用椭圆线表现。内部加入细长枝干、圆钝叶片和简化块面花形或象征形，采用层叠剪纸质感，边缘干净几何并带轻微手作偏差。信息层保持稀疏：在主体两侧用圆润粗体放置小号{info_nodes}，颜色与图形呼应，底部加入两组短段落和极小页脚。色彩从主题的季节、材质和情绪提取：高明度洁净底场、可冷可暖的标题结构色、枝干/骨架的高饱和支撑色，以及花朵或象征块面和小文字的少量明亮强调色。突出超大文字与中心线描容器的尺度反差、轻盈留白、清晰色彩层级和童趣信息图节奏。使用平面图形设计、剪纸纸纹、清晰边界、通风构图，不要陈旧或脏污感。页脚可以有小型非品牌标记，但不要可读logo。不要照片写实、3D渲染、僵硬网格、杂乱、浑浊色彩、难以辨认的文字、无关logo或水印。

items.title: 纺织工艺灵感柔和编织插画
items.description: A refined textile-inspired illustration that translates a subject into soft woven and stitched forms with subtle thread texture on a pure white background.
items.prompt: Create a textile-inspired illustration of {subject}, simplified into soft woven and stitched shapes with subtle thread texture. Use restrained neutral colors, gentle dimensional layering, clean edges, and a handcrafted yet highly refined composition. Isolate the subject on a pure white background with generous negative space. Keep the object or motif legible while translating its key silhouette and details into tactile textile construction. Use a premium lifestyle-editorial aesthetic, soft even illumination, tasteful material realism, and no photorealistic rendering. No clutter, harsh shadows, plastic surfaces, random text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一幅以纺织工艺为灵感的{subject}插画：将主体简化为柔软的编织与缝制形状，并加入细微线头纹理。使用克制的中性色、柔和的立体分层、干净边缘，以及手工制作但高度精致的构图。将主体孤立在纯白背景上，保留充足留白。保持物体或图案清晰可辨，同时把其关键轮廓和细节转化为有触感的纺织结构。采用高级生活方式编辑美学、柔和均匀照明和得体的材质真实感，不要照片写实渲染。不要杂乱、硬阴影、塑料表面、随机文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 高端极简城市双层旅游海报
items.description: A refined 3:4 travel poster pairing one accurately photographed city landmark with a flat graphic interpretation of the same subject.
items.prompt: Create a refined 3:4 vertical premium travel poster for {city}, {country}. Select ONE iconic, highly recognizable real-world landmark as the hero and use one believable photographic viewpoint; do not make a collage of unrelated landmarks. Divide the poster into two equal 50% sections on a warm beige, ivory, or soft-white background with precise alignment and generous negative space. In the top half, show an ultra-realistic high-end editorial photograph of the chosen landmark with accurate architecture, proportions, materials, environment, natural light, shadows, atmosphere, and geographic character. In the bottom half, reinterpret the same landmark as sophisticated flat graphic design using its recognizable silhouette, contours, structure, and distinctive details simplified into geometric shapes, flat color blocks, thin lines, restrained divisions, and negative space; keep it instantly recognizable without becoming a realistic illustration, 3D render, cartoon, or game graphic. Derive a restrained 4–6 color palette from the city and photograph. Add minimal geometric accents only when useful. Include subtle elegant typography: “{city} {country}” and “ARCHITECTURAL STUDY 2026”, with generous letter spacing and clear hierarchy. Use Swiss/international graphic design, architectural exhibition poster, luxury editorial, and museum visual-identity aesthetics. The photographic upper half and graphic lower half must feel like two expressions of the same identity. No identity-bound person, landmark collage, inaccurate or invented architecture, excessive text, tourist-brochure styling, neon, flashy effects, heavy gradients, glossy 3D, cartoon styling, game UI, clutter, unrelated logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 为{city}、{country}创作一张精致的3:4竖版高端旅游海报。选择一个具有代表性且高度可辨识的现实世界地标作为核心主体，并使用一个可信的摄影视角；不要拼贴不相关的多个地标。将海报在暖米色、象牙色或柔和白色背景上精确分成上下两个各占50%的部分，保持大量留白和严谨对齐。上半部分展示选定地标的超写实高端编辑照片，保留准确建筑、比例、材质、环境、自然光、阴影、氛围和地理特征。下半部分将同一地标重新诠释为精致平面图形设计，提取其可辨识轮廓、线条、结构和独特细节，简化为几何形状、扁平色块、细线、克制分割和负空间；地标必须一眼可辨，但不要变成写实插画、3D渲染、卡通或游戏图形。从城市和照片中提取克制的4至6色调色板，仅在必要时加入极简几何点缀。加入含蓄优雅的排版：“{city} {country}”和“ARCHITECTURAL STUDY 2026”，字距宽松、层级清晰。采用瑞士/国际平面设计、建筑展览海报、奢侈品编辑设计和博物馆视觉识别美学。上方照片与下方图形应像同一视觉身份的两种表达。不要身份绑定人物、地标拼贴、不准确或虚构建筑、过多文字、旅游手册风格、霓虹、炫目效果、重度渐变、亮面3D、卡通风格、游戏UI、杂乱、无关logo或水印。

items.title: 复古极简中世纪风格旅行海报
items.description: A refined 4:5 vintage travel poster built around one poetic landscape and cultural detail, with faded lithographic print texture and elegant tourism typography.
items.prompt: Create a beautiful 4:5 vertical vintage travel poster for {country}, inspired by classic mid-century European tourism posters and aged lithographic printmaking. Build the entire poster around one poetic landscape associated with {country}—mountains, coastline, countryside, old streets, desert, forest, lake, or rolling hills—with one iconic cultural element subtly integrated. Use a refined vintage palette, slightly faded pigments, warm paper texture, subtle grain, imperfect ink edges, gentle shadows, and authentic screen-printed/lithographic detail. Keep the composition minimal, balanced, elegant, and centered with generous negative space. Add only a few tiny atmospheric details such as birds, a distant traveler, train, bicycle, boat, or village lights. Integrate genuine tourism-poster typography reading “{country}” and “Discover the Soul of {country}” in elegant vintage lettering. Make the artwork feel like a rare old poster rediscovered in a European railway station: nostalgic, sophisticated, dreamy, collectible, cinematic, and timeless. No modern graphics, photorealistic collage, excessive landmarks, neon colors, 3D text, clutter, unrelated logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 为{country}创作一张4:5竖版精美复古旅行海报，灵感源自经典20世纪中期欧洲旅游海报和陈旧石版印刷工艺。整张海报围绕一个与{country}相关的诗意景观构建，如山脉、海岸线、乡村、老街、沙漠、森林、湖泊或起伏丘陵，并将一个标志性文化元素微妙融入其中。使用精致复古色板、略微褪色的颜料、温暖纸张纹理、细腻颗粒、不完美油墨边缘、柔和阴影和真实丝网/石版印刷细节。构图保持极简、平衡、优雅、居中，并有充足留白。只添加少量氛围细节，如鸟类、远方旅人、火车、自行车、船只或村庄灯光。使用优雅复古字体融入真正旅游海报式文字：“{country}”和“发现{country}之魂”。整体应像在欧洲火车站重新发现的一张珍稀旧海报：怀旧、精致、梦幻、具有收藏价值、电影感且永恒。不要现代图形、照片级拼贴、过多地标、霓虹色、3D文字、杂乱、无关logo或水印。

items.title: 欧式石阶旁东亚成年女性建筑时尚人像
items.description: A photorealistic full-body architectural fashion portrait of an identity-bound adult woman standing on historic European stone steps in soft daylight.
items.prompt: Use the attached identity reference as the sole facial identity reference for the clearly adult East Asian woman; preserve recognizable face, skin tone, and natural facial proportions, but do not copy reference clothing or background. Create a photorealistic full-body three-quarter portrait of her standing slightly left of center on broad exterior stone steps beside a historic European limestone façade. She has dark brown hair center-parted in a low bun with a few loose strands, small pearl studs, and calm refined expression looking right in profile. Dress her in a fitted beige sleeveless blouse with structured collar and seam details, paired with a modest beige plaid pleated knee-length skirt, opaque dark-gray tights, and polished black pointed-toe shoes with restrained red sole detail. One leg extends down while the other rests on a higher step, creating a natural diagonal; arms rest comfortably at her sides. Show pale textured limestone, classical moldings, recessed panels, carved details, a dark arched doorway, and additional entrance steps. Use soft warm-neutral daylight, gentle directional illumination, realistic skin, fabric, plaid, stone grain, and architectural relief, with the doorway naturally darker for depth. Compose from head to feet at waist-to-chest camera height, natural perspective, moderate background depth, and no wide-angle distortion. Use high-end fashion and architectural photography with restrained color and no artificial beauty effects. No sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, nudity, childlike presentation, body-part emphasis, distorted anatomy, cropped shoes, extra limbs, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 将附加身份参考图作为这位明确成年的东亚女性的唯一面部身份参考；保留可识别面部、肤色和自然面部比例，但不要复制参考图的服装或背景。创建一张照片级真实的全身四分之三人像：她略偏画面中心左侧，站在历史欧式石灰岩立面旁的宽阔室外石阶上。她留深棕色中分低发髻，带几缕散发，佩戴小珍珠耳钉，表情冷静精致，侧面朝右。让她穿修身米色无袖衬衫，带结构感领口和缝线细节，搭配得体的米色格纹及膝百褶裙、不透明深灰色连裤袜和抛光黑色尖头鞋，鞋底保留克制的红色细节。一条腿向下伸展，另一条腿放在更高台阶上形成自然对角线，双臂舒适地放在身体两侧。展示浅色有质感石灰岩、古典建筑线脚、凹陷面板、雕刻细节、深色拱形门洞和更多入口台阶。使用柔和暖中性日光、温和定向照明、真实皮肤、织物、格纹、石材纹理和建筑浮雕，门洞自然偏暗以形成深度。相机位于腰部至胸部高度，从头到脚拍摄，透视自然、背景景深适中、无广角畸变。采用高端时尚与建筑摄影，色彩克制，不使用人工美颜。不要性化构图、暴露私密部位、裸露、幼态呈现、身体部位强调、解剖扭曲、裁切鞋子、多余肢体、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 复古未来主义航空成年女性海报肖像
items.description: A 4:5 vintage aviation poster portrait of an identity-bound adult subject in a winged flight helmet, rendered with aged paper, painted scenery, and nostalgic mechanical detail.
items.prompt: Use the attached identity reference as the sole facial identity reference for the clearly adult main subject; preserve recognizable face and natural proportions, but do not copy the reference clothing or background. Create a vintage retro-futurist aviation poster portrait of {human}, shown chest-up in a heroic three-quarter pose, wearing {clothing} and a stylized winged flight helmet with goggles, bold graphic insignia, and restrained retro-mechanical details. Give the subject {hair} and a poised {mood} expression. Render richly painted facial features, expressive eyes, soft blush, defined lips, glossy hair, and polished poster realism. Behind the figure, add {background} with painted environmental depth rather than a flat backdrop. Use distressed aged paper, faded ink, worn scratches, weathered border, vintage print texture, and bold poster typography reading “{title}” near the bottom. Use a controlled {palette} palette, dramatic nostalgic composition, realistic anatomy, and 4:5 aspect ratio. Keep insignia fictional and avoid military claims or real organizations. No sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, nudity, childlike presentation, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, illegible text, unrelated logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 将附加身份参考图作为明确成年主要人物的唯一面部身份参考；保留可识别面部和自然比例，但不要复制参考图的服装或背景。创建一张{human}的复古未来主义航空海报肖像，画面为胸部以上的英雄式四分之三姿态，人物穿着{clothing}和带护目镜的程式化羽翼飞行头盔，配有醒目的虚构图形徽章与克制的复古机械细节。让人物拥有{hair}和淡定的{mood}表情。细致绘制面部特征、富有表现力的眼睛、柔和腮红、轮廓清晰的嘴唇、光泽头发和精致海报写实感。背景加入{background}，使用绘画般的环境深度而非扁平背景。加入受损陈旧纸张、褪色墨水、磨损划痕、风化边框和复古印刷纹理，并在底部附近用醒目海报排版写出“{title}”。使用受控的{palette}色板、戏剧性怀旧构图、真实解剖比例和4:5画幅。徽章必须为虚构设计，不要暗示真实军队或机构。不要性化构图、暴露私密部位、裸露、幼态呈现、解剖扭曲、多余肢体、难以辨认的文字、无关logo或水印。

items.title: 治愈系手绘涂鸦旅行海报
items.description: A charming 4:5 illustrated travel poster that turns a country into a dense, connected sketchbook world of tiny ink doodles and discoveries.
items.prompt: Create a charming 4:5 vertical doodle-art travel poster featuring {country} as a whimsical hand-drawn world. Fill the page with hundreds of tiny playful black-ink doodles inspired by the country: landmarks, food, traditional clothing, animals, flowers, landscapes, transportation, famous buildings, cultural symbols, street scenes, tiny generic characters, souvenirs, and hidden visual jokes. Do not arrange them as a rigid collage; let them flow organically through winding hand-drawn lines, arrows, stars, clouds, hearts, speech bubbles, stamps, handwritten notes, and decorative patterns that connect the scenes. Place the name “{country}” prominently at the center in charming hand-lettered typography, surrounded by tiny illustrated details. Use a clean warm paper background, slightly imperfect ink lines, playful sketch texture, subtle vintage-postcard character, minimal muted accents, and a handmade illustrated feel. The artwork should feel like an entire country's personality inside one giant sketchbook page: cute, clever, nostalgic, detailed, and full of discoveries. Use premium editorial doodle illustration, hand-drawn ink, whimsical travel sketchbook, sophisticated composition, and playful detail. No photorealism, 3D rendering, flat generic icons, rigid grid, cluttered typography, unrelated logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张4:5竖版涂鸦艺术旅行海报，将{country}描绘成一个异想天开的手绘世界。整页填满数百个受该国启发的微小俏皮黑色墨水涂鸦：地标、美食、传统服装、动物、花卉、风景、交通工具、著名建筑、文化符号、街道场景、微小的通用人物、纪念品和隐藏的视觉笑话。不要以僵硬拼贴排列，而要让它们通过蜿蜒手绘线条、箭头、星星、云朵、爱心、对话框、印章、手写笔记和装饰图案有机流动并互相连接。在中心用迷人的手写字样显著放置“{country}”，周围环绕微小插图细节。使用干净暖色纸张背景、略显不完美的墨线、俏皮素描纹理、微妙复古明信片特征、极简柔和强调色和手工插画感。整体应像是在一张巨大速写本页面中创造了一个国家的完整个性：可爱、巧妙、怀旧、细致且充满发现。采用高级社论涂鸦插图、手绘墨水、异想天开旅行速写本、精致构图和俏皮细节。不要照片写实主义、3D渲染、扁平通用图标、僵硬网格、杂乱排版、无关logo或水印。

items.title: 未来主义概念人物侧脸社论海报
items.description: A premium 4:5 futuristic editorial poster using an identity-bound side-profile portrait, bold graphic shapes, circuit diagrams, interface accents, and experimental typography.
items.prompt: Use the attached identity reference as the sole facial identity reference for the clearly adult main subject; preserve recognizable face and natural proportions, but do not copy the reference clothing or background. Create a conceptual futuristic editorial poster featuring {human} in a large side-profile portrait, wearing {clothing}. Use sleek contemporary fashion styling, clean studio lighting, a white background with bold {color1} graphic shapes, fine {color2} circuit-like line diagrams, and subtle {color3} interface accents. Place the uppercase title “{title}” prominently at the top and a short small editorial text block reading “{text}” beneath or beside the portrait. Use modern experimental typography, an asymmetrical magazine layout, sharp high-contrast composition, premium graphic-design finish, and a 4:5 aspect ratio. Keep the identity clear and the design uncluttered. No sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, nudity, childlike presentation, distorted face, extra limbs, illegible typography, unrelated logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 将附加身份参考图作为明确成年主要人物的唯一面部身份参考；保留可识别面部和自然比例，但不要复制参考图的服装或背景。创建一张概念性未来主义社论海报，以{human}的大型侧脸肖像为主体，穿着{clothing}。采用流畅的现代时尚造型、干净影棚灯光、白色背景、大胆的{color1}图形形状、精细的{color2}电路状线条图和微妙的{color3}界面装饰。在顶部醒目放置全大写标题“{title}”，并在肖像下方或旁边加入写着“{text}”的简短小型社论文字块。使用现代实验性字体、不对称杂志布局、锐利高对比构图、高级平面设计质感和4:5比例。保持身份清晰、设计整洁。不要性化构图、暴露私密部位、裸露、幼态呈现、扭曲面部、多余肢体、难以辨认的排版、无关logo或水印。

items.title: 三维厚涂油画建筑艺术海报
items.description: A tactile 4:5 architectural art print showing a landmark as a thick impasto oil painting mounted on textured archival paper with refined italic lettering.
items.prompt: Create a sophisticated 4:5 vertical fine-art architectural poster featuring {structure_landmark} as the unmistakable central subject. Show it from a slightly low frontal perspective, preserving recognizable architecture, proportions, silhouette, windows, columns, arches, roofline, materials, and distinctive details while reinterpreting the scene as a handcrafted contemporary oil painting. Use extremely thick palette-knife impasto with raised strokes, layered paint, scraped edges, ridges, and expressive overlaps in cream, warm stone, soft gray, muted blue, dusty green, charcoal, and restrained antique-gold accents. Behind it, use a simplified atmospheric sky made from thick powder-blue, ivory, pale-gray, and warm-white strokes. Add only a few tiny secondary location details such as bicycles, vintage lamps, plants, steps, pavement, or distant figures. Mount the painted panel on warm off-white handmade archival paper with an irregular torn painted edge and subtle dimensional shadow. At the bottom, integrate refined high-contrast editorial italic serif lettering reading “{structure_landmark}” and a smaller italic subtitle “{city_country_region}”; make the lettering legible and physically printed or painted into the surface. Use soft natural light that reveals impasto relief and tiny layer shadows, an elegant European art-book and vintage travel-art atmosphere, painterly realism, tactile handmade texture, centered architecture, generous off-white negative space, and no photorealistic camera look. No identity-bound person, cartoon rendering, illegible text, extra branding, logo, watermark, distorted architecture, or clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张4:5竖版精致建筑艺术海报，将{structure_landmark}作为明确的中心主体。从略低的正面视角展示它，保留可识别的建筑特征、比例、轮廓、窗户、柱子、拱门、屋顶线、材质和独特细节，同时将整个场景重新诠释为手工制作的当代油画。使用极厚调色刀厚涂，表现凸起笔触、分层颜料、刮擦边缘、棱脊和富有表现力的重叠痕迹，配色为奶油色、暖石色、柔灰、低饱和蓝、尘绿、木炭色和克制的古金色。背景为由粉蓝、象牙、浅灰和暖白厚重笔触构成的简约大气天空。底部只加入少量次要地点细节，如自行车、复古路灯、植物、台阶、铺面或远处人物。将绘画板安装在暖米白手工存档纸上，带不规则自然撕裂的绘画边缘和细微立体阴影。底部融入精致高对比编辑衬线斜体文字“{structure_landmark}”，并在下方加入较小斜体副标题“{city_country_region}”；文字清晰，并像印刷或绘制在纸面上一样自然。使用柔和自然光强调厚涂起伏和颜料层间的细微阴影，营造优雅欧洲艺术书与复古旅行艺术氛围、绘画现实主义、触感手工质地、居中建筑和充足米白留白，不要照片级相机外观。不要身份绑定人物、卡通渲染、难以辨认的文字、额外品牌、logo、水印、扭曲建筑或杂乱构图。

items.title: 超写实冬季城市等距缩微模型海报
items.description: A premium 4:5 winter travel poster showing an accurate city miniature on a square architectural tile, with restrained editorial typography above it.
items.prompt: Create an ultra-detailed photorealistic isometric winter city diorama poster for {city}, {country_region}. Show a thin square architectural-model tile on a pure off-white seamless studio background, rotated like a diamond and viewed from a high 45–50° angle. The tile has straight edges and a thin dark wood or earth band on its sides. Fill its top surface edge to edge with an accurate miniature recreation of {city}: real street layout, local residential blocks, authentic architecture, 1–3 recognizable landmarks in correct relative positions, plazas, parks, boulevards, waterways where geographically appropriate, bridges, and urban details. Transform it with fresh natural snow on roofs, sidewalks, trees, vehicles, railings, and road edges while keeping roads partially cleared with tire tracks and exposed asphalt. Include individually modeled snow-covered trees, tiny winter pedestrians, cars, buses, lamps, signs, crosswalks, benches, and other coherent micro-details. Keep landmarks identifiable and geography believable. Use tilt-shift miniature photography with everything on the tile sharply focused, cool soft studio daylight, realistic snow, stone, glass, brick, asphalt, and vegetation, restrained shadows, and premium architectural-model realism. The diorama occupies the lower two-thirds. In the upper third, add small centered editorial typography: “WINTER CITY COLLECTION”, “{city}” in a restrained dark-charcoal condensed sans-serif, and “{country_region}”. Keep typography elegant and legible, with no extra branding or watermark. Use a 4:5 vertical poster composition. No people requiring identity matching, distorted structures, impossible geography, clutter, oversaturation, harsh HDR, blurry details, illegible text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 为{city}、{country_region}创建一张超精细照片级真实的等距冬季城市模型旅行海报。将薄的方形建筑模型底板放在纯米白无缝影棚背景上，旋转成透视菱形，并以45至50度高位视角俯视。底板边缘笔直，侧面露出一圈薄薄的深色木材或泥土材质。整个顶面边缘到边缘填满{city}的准确缩微再现：真实街道布局、当地住宅街区、真实建筑风格、处于正确相对位置的1至3个可识别地标、广场、公园、林荫大道、适用时的河流或海岸线、桥梁和城市细节。用自然新雪覆盖屋顶、人行道、树木、车辆、栏杆和路边，同时保持道路部分清理，带轮胎痕迹和露出的沥青。加入单独建模的积雪树木、穿冬装的微小行人、汽车、公共汽车、路灯、标志、人行横道、长椅和其他连贯的微观细节。保持地标可辨识、地理关系可信。采用移轴缩微摄影外观，底板上所有部分都清晰对焦，使用冷色柔和影棚冬日光、真实雪、石材、玻璃、砖、沥青和植被质感、克制阴影以及高级建筑模型写实感。立体模型占下方三分之二。上方三分之一加入居中的极简编辑排版：“WINTER CITY COLLECTION”、使用克制深炭灰紧凑无衬线字体的“{city}”，以及“{country_region}”。排版优雅清晰，不要额外品牌或水印。采用4:5竖版海报构图。不要需要身份匹配的人物、扭曲建筑、不可能的地理关系、杂乱、过度饱和、刺眼HDR、模糊细节、难以辨认的文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 兔耳蓝发国风奇幻成年女性肖像
items.description: A photorealistic full-body fantasy-cosplay portrait of an adult woman with cobalt-blue hair and rabbit-ear headpiece, seated with a chick plush in an ornate Chinese-inspired interior.
items.prompt: Use the attached identity reference as the sole face and identity reference for the clearly adult woman; preserve recognizable facial identity and natural facial proportions, but do not copy the reference clothing or background. Create a photorealistic 9:16 vertical full-body portrait of her seated gracefully sideways on a raised wooden platform in an ornate Chinese-inspired interior. Give her vivid cobalt-blue long hair with straight bangs and face-framing strands, a prominent blue rabbit-ear headpiece with gold ornaments, and long blue ribbon streamers. Dress her in a refined dark navy-and-black sleeveless high-collar fantasy dress with lace, floral embroidery, gold trim, and ornate details, plus opaque long black gloves and dark stockings with polished black platform shoes. She holds a small round pale-yellow chick plush with tiny wings, orange beak, simple black eyes, and pink cheeks. Include dark polished wood, carved panels, geometric lattice screens, white inset panels, gold accents, a woven mat, cushions, and ribbons across the platform. Use warm indoor directional light, soft shadows, realistic skin and fabric texture, a slightly low three-quarter view, face near the upper center, and legs creating an elegant diagonal while keeping the complete feet visible. Preserve natural adult anatomy, correct hands and fingers, coherent accessories, and high-end photorealistic cosplay photography. No childlike presentation, sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, transparent clothing, nudity, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, cropped feet, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 将附加身份参考图作为明确成年女性的唯一面部与身份参考，保留可识别面部身份和自然面部比例，但不要复制参考图的服装或背景。创建一张照片级真实的9:16竖版全身人像：她优雅地侧坐在华丽中国风室内的高起木台上。让她拥有鲜艳钴蓝色长发、齐刘海和修饰脸型的碎发，佩戴显眼的蓝色兔耳头饰与金色发饰，身边有飘动的蓝色长丝带。她穿精致的深藏青与黑色无袖高领幻想风连衣裙，带蕾丝、花卉刺绣、金边和华丽装饰，搭配不透明黑色过肘长手套、深色丝袜和抛光黑色厚底鞋。她双手抱着一只淡黄色圆形小鸡毛绒玩具，玩具有小翅膀、橙色喙、简单黑眼睛和粉色脸颊。场景包含深色抛光木材、雕花板、几何木格屏风、白色嵌板、金色细节、编织垫、靠垫和铺在台面上的丝带。使用温暖室内定向光、柔和阴影、真实皮肤与面料纹理、略低机位的四分之三视角，面部靠近上方中心，双腿形成优雅对角线并完整呈现双脚。保持自然成年解剖比例、准确手部和手指、连贯配饰，并采用高端照片级角色扮演摄影。不要幼态呈现、性化构图、暴露私密部位、透明衣物、裸露、解剖扭曲、多余肢体、裁切脚部、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 建筑式字形早安城市系列海报
items.description: A bright 16:9 information-graphic poster template embedding city imagery and materials inside oversized rounded glyphs for a ten-city Good Morning series.
items.prompt: Create one bright 16:9 Good Morning city poster for a ten-city series. Use {city_pinyin} as the city identifier, {representative_elements} as its representative image fragments, and {color_hue} as its distinct palette logic. Convert the core information into oversized, heavy rounded-corner near-white glyphs that are read before everything else, forming a central architectural skeleton. Do not fill the screen with a literal city scene; instead embed several clear fragments, action moments, or material bursts inside the glyph strokes, counters, and intersections, with a few fragments crossing character edges. The effect should feel like information symbols penetrated by the city's energy. Build the background from a large clean, bright, slightly translucent derivative color field with fine vertical lines and subtle speed blur, like an information screen and a competition countdown while retaining ventilation and clear boundaries. Extract supporting colors from the city's materials, mood, and scenes: bright base field, near-white main glyphs, small high-saturation accents, and clean shadows/textures for hierarchy. Place one narrow uppercase identifier line at the top with loose restrained spacing, and ensure all image fragments follow the glyph reading path. Avoid ordinary collage, dirty backgrounds, defocused typography, or isolated illustrations. Keep the result light, exciting, legible, and polished as a premium graphic-design poster. Include only readable text for the city identifier and a small GOOD MORNING series label; no extra logos or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张用于十城系列的明亮16:9早安城市海报。使用{city_pinyin}作为城市标识，使用{representative_elements}作为代表性影像碎片，并使用{color_hue}作为一眼可区分的配色色相逻辑。将核心信息转化为极大号、厚重圆角的近白字形，让字形优先于一切被读到，形成中央建筑式骨架。不要让完整城市场景铺满画面，而要把若干清晰片段、动作瞬间或材质爆发嵌入字形笔画、内孔和交界处，并让少量碎片越过字边，产生信息符号被城市能量穿透的效果。背景使用大面积明亮、干净、略带半透明光感的派生底色，加入细密竖线和轻微速度拖影，既像信息屏幕也像竞技倒计时，同时保持通风感和清晰边界。辅助色彩从城市材质、情绪和场景提取：高明度底色、近白主字形、少量高饱和强调点，以及只用于层次分离的干净阴影和纹理。顶部放一行窄体大写式城市标识，字距疏朗克制，所有影像碎片都要服从字形阅读路径。避免普通拼贴、脏乱背景、文字失焦或孤立插画。整体保持轻盈、兴奋、易读，并具有高级平面设计海报质感。只保留城市标识和小型GOOD MORNING系列标签等可读文字，不要额外logo或水印。

items.title: 夜间酒店走廊冷调直闪成年女性人像
items.description: A photorealistic 9:16 direct-flash portrait of a clearly adult woman in an upscale hotel corridor, with cool low-saturation tones and an understated, distant mood.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 9:16 medium portrait of a clearly adult woman in a night-time hotel corridor or elevator lobby, cropped around mid-thigh and occupying about 60% of the frame. Use a low-saturation cool palette, intimate everyday distance, direct on-camera flash, and realistic semi-matte skin with narrow highlights. Give her long straight black hair or a low ponytail, restrained gray eye makeup, and nude lips. Dress her in an elegant opaque black satin midi dress or fitted gray knit dress with a modest neckline and natural drape; keep the silhouette polished without emphasizing the chest or body. Add only composition-appropriate details such as a thin metal necklace, room card, elevator button, or leather bracelet. Use a doorframe-peeking perspective or low angle against the wall, with corridor depth and elevator doors behind her. She may lean against the wall looking upward toward the camera, turn back while pressing an elevator button, or rest fingers near her shoulder without pulling clothing. Keep her expression calm, detached, and thoughtful, with a sense of distance. Flash illuminates the front while the environment falls darker, creating hard but natural shadows along the pose and cool highlights on metal accessories. No formal posing, sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, transparent clothing, nudity, childlike presentation, greasy skin, deformed limbs, messy background, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张照片级真实的9:16中景人像：一位明确成年的女性位于夜间酒店走廊或电梯间，画面裁切至大腿中部，人物约占画面60%。使用低饱和冷色调、克制的日常距离感、机顶直闪和带窄高光的真实半哑光皮肤。她留黑色长直发或低马尾，妆容为克制的灰调眼妆和裸色唇。让她穿优雅的不透明黑色缎面中长裙或修身灰色针织连衣裙，领口得体、垂坠自然；保持利落轮廓，不强调胸部或身体。根据构图需要仅选择细金属项链、房卡、电梯按键或皮质手环等少量细节。采用门框窥视视角或靠墙低机位，背景有走廊纵深和电梯门。她可以靠墙抬眼看向镜头、按电梯按键时回头，或将手指自然放在肩侧但不要拉扯衣物。表情平静、疏离、若有所思，带有距离感。直闪照亮正面，同时压暗环境，在姿态边缘形成硬朗但自然的阴影，并让金属配饰出现冷色亮点。不要端正摆拍、性化构图、暴露私密部位、透明衣物、裸露、幼态呈现、油亮皮肤、畸形肢体、杂乱背景、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 极简奢华湖畔住宅建筑销售海报
items.description: A collector-grade vertical architecture sales poster combining a precise technical drawing with a photorealistic luxury waterfront residence in misty morning light.
items.prompt: Create an ultra-premium vertical real-estate architecture sales poster for the fictional international brand NORHAVEN ESTATE and project NORHAVEN LAKE PAVILION. Use a disciplined two-level hierarchy: the upper half is spacious pale mist-gray, mineral white, and warm silver-beige negative space containing a refined elevation or section drawing of the same residence, with ultra-thin graphite lines, restrained measurements, minimal English callouts, and generous breathing room; the lower half is a larger photorealistic built residence at a calm lakeside or coastal inlet. Integrate the layers seamlessly. The building is the visual hero: long elegant roofline, ultra-thin slabs, floor-to-ceiling glazing, pale travertine or mineral stone, warm timber soffits, champagne metal trim, slender dark columns, and a minimal chimney. Show a broad timber terrace, subtle warm interior glow, refined furniture silhouettes, rocky shore, soft grasses, still water, distant misty trees, and a pale atmospheric horizon. Use very soft misty morning light, pale gray/silver/ivory/mineral-beige palette, realistic material physics, cinematic color grading, and museum-grade architectural realism. Include only this elegant English typography: “NORHAVEN ESTATE”, “NORHAVEN LAKE PAVILION”, “LIVING IN PURE HORIZON”, and “Waterfront Residence Collection”, plus a few tiny technical notes. Typography must be integrated into the architectural board, never cluttered. No Chinese main title, crude fonts, cheap brochure layout, fantasy architecture, oversaturation, harsh HDR, plastic materials, messy landscape, excessive furniture, unreadable text, logo outside the fictional brand system, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 为虚构的国际高端地产品牌NORHAVEN ESTATE及项目NORHAVEN LAKE PAVILION创作一张超高端竖版房地产建筑销售海报。采用严格的上下两层层级：上半部分使用宽阔的浅雾灰、矿物白和暖银米色负空间，放置同一住宅的精致立面或剖面图，使用超细石墨线条、克制尺寸标记、少量英文引注和充足留白；下半部分以更大、更具主导性的照片级真实成品住宅呈现在平静湖畔或海岸湾口。两层应自然且有逻辑地融合。建筑是绝对主角：长而优雅的屋顶线、超薄板片、落地玻璃、浅色洞石或矿物石材、温暖木质檐口、香槟色金属装饰、纤细深色立柱和极简烟囱。展示宽阔木质露台、玻璃后的微暖室内光、精致家具剪影、岩石岸线、柔软草丛、静水、远处薄雾树影和浅色大气地平线。使用极柔和的薄雾晨光、浅灰/银白/象牙/矿物米色调、真实材料物理、电影级调色和博物馆级建筑写实质感。只加入以下优雅英文排版：“NORHAVEN ESTATE”“NORHAVEN LAKE PAVILION”“LIVING IN PURE HORIZON”和“Waterfront Residence Collection”，以及少量微小技术说明。排版必须融入建筑展示板系统，不得拥挤。不要中文主标题、粗俗字体、廉价画册布局、幻想建筑、过度饱和、刺眼HDR、塑料材质、杂乱景观、过多家具、难以辨认的文字、虚构品牌系统以外的logo或水印。

items.title: 首尔夏日街头身份绑定iPhone人像
