items.description: A photorealistic casual iPhone portrait of an adult woman pausing on a quiet Seoul street in warm afternoon light, with identity taken from one supplied reference image.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 9:16 vertical iPhone Portrait-mode lifestyle photograph of a clearly adult woman in a quiet upscale Seoul neighborhood on a warm summer afternoon. Use the attached identity reference as the only identity reference for her face, skin tone, and hairstyle; preserve recognizable identity and natural facial asymmetry, but do not copy the reference clothing or background. She has realistic skin texture, subtle natural makeup, and an approachable warm smile. She has just paused during a walk and turns naturally toward the camera after hearing her name. Her shoulders angle slightly toward the nearby friend holding the camera, her hips remain relaxed, one hand slips into the front pocket of her mid-rise dark-wash denim shorts, and the other brushes a loose strand of hair behind her ear. Dress her in a fitted taupe ribbed-knit top with a modest opaque neckline and a lightweight mocha linen overshirt worn open with naturally rolled sleeves; the shorts have a contemporary relaxed fit and realistic denim texture. Add a minimal silver pendant necklace, delicate bracelet, and simple stud earrings. Show small cafés, clean sidewalks, brick buildings, boutique storefronts, and trees in the naturally recognizable Korean street background. Use soft late-afternoon daylight, Apple Smart HDR rendering, balanced highlights and shadows, neutral white balance, realistic smartphone optics, subtle depth separation, candid everyday perspective, crisp face, and clean composition with restrained processing. No low-cut or transparent clothing, cleavage emphasis, exposed intimate areas, nudity, sexualized framing, childlike presentation, beauty filter, over-processing, distorted hands, extra limbs, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张照片级真实的9:16竖版iPhone人像模式生活方式照片：一位明确成年的女性在温暖夏日下午的首尔安静高级街区中短暂停步。将附加身份参考图作为唯一身份参考，用于她的面部、肤色和发型；保留可识别身份与自然面部不对称，但不要复制参考图的服装或背景。她拥有真实皮肤纹理、细微自然妆容和亲切温暖的微笑。她在散步时刚刚停下，听到名字后自然转向镜头。肩膀略微朝向近处手持相机的朋友，胯部保持放松，一只手插入中腰深色水洗牛仔短裤的前口袋，另一只手将散发轻轻别到耳后。让她穿贴身灰褐色罗纹针织上衣，领口得体且不透明，外搭敞开的轻便摩卡色亚麻衬衫，袖子自然卷起；短裤采用轻松现代的版型并保留真实牛仔纹理。添加极简银色吊坠项链、精致手链和简单耳钉。背景展示小咖啡馆、干净人行道、砖砌建筑、精品店门面和树木，形成自然可辨识的韩国街道氛围。使用柔和午后日光、Apple智能HDR渲染、平衡高光与阴影、中性白平衡、真实手机光学、细微景深分离、抓拍式日常视角、清晰面部和干净构图，后期处理克制。不要低胸或透明衣物、乳沟强调、暴露私密部位、裸露、性化构图、幼态呈现、美颜滤镜、过度处理、扭曲的手、多余肢体、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 斑马线上的成年情侣俯拍街头摄影
items.description: A cinematic overhead documentary photograph of a clearly adult couple sharing a playful, affectionate moment while crossing a city zebra crossing.
items.prompt: Create a cinematic overhead street photograph of a clearly adult couple walking across a zebra crossing with candid, natural interaction and a playful affectionate atmosphere. The man laughs happily with one arm comfortably over his partner's shoulder; he wears a black cap, oversized pale-blue shirt, dark sweater draped around his shoulders, loose black pants, sneakers, and carries a brown paper shopping bag. The woman wears an oversized dark sweatshirt with an orange sweater tied over her shoulders, knee-length green shorts, black socks, and white sneakers, holding a small orange fruit. Use soft daylight, muted color grading, realistic skin texture, documentary photography, subtle film grain, a Korean/Japanese lifestyle-editorial mood, emotional storytelling, high-angle top-down composition, and natural movement. Keep both subjects clearly adult, fully clothed, and naturally proportioned. No sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, nudity, childlike presentation, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张电影感的俯拍街头照片：一对明确成年的情侣自然走过斑马线，互动抓拍而自然，氛围俏皮亲密。男性开心大笑，一只手舒适地搭在伴侣肩上；他戴黑色帽子，穿超大号淡蓝色衬衫，肩上搭着深色毛衣，穿宽松黑色长裤和运动鞋，手提棕色纸质购物袋。女性穿超大号深色卫衣，肩上系着橙色毛衣，穿及膝绿色短裤、黑色袜子和白色运动鞋，手里拿着一个小橙子。使用柔和日光、低饱和色彩分级、真实皮肤纹理、纪实摄影、细腻胶片颗粒、韩系/日系生活方式编辑美学、情感叙事、高角度顶视构图和自然动感。两位人物都应明确成年、穿着完整且比例自然。不要性化构图、暴露私密部位、裸露、幼态呈现、解剖扭曲、多余肢体、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 满城巨型广告牌皆是我的特写
items.description: A surreal urban scene where every oversized advertising billboard displays close-up portraits of the same person, using a supplied identity reference for the face.
items.prompt: Create a surreal yet photorealistic urban city scene in which every large advertising billboard is filled with a close-up portrait of the same person. Use the attached identity reference only for the person's face and identity cues; do not copy the reference background or clothing. Show multiple billboards at different scales and angles across a dense city street, with the repeated portrait creating an uncanny personal-public contrast. Keep the portraits consistent but naturally varied through crop, expression, and billboard perspective. Use realistic urban lighting, reflections, atmospheric depth, believable advertising structures, and cinematic composition. The billboards should contain portrait imagery rather than readable advertising copy; no logos or brand marks. No sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, nudity, childlike presentation, distorted faces, malformed billboard repetition, extra limbs, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一幅超现实但照片级真实的都市场景：城市中每一块巨型广告牌都展示同一个人的面部特写。使用附加身份参考图仅提取人物的面部和身份特征，不要复制参考图的背景或服装。让不同大小和角度的广告牌遍布繁密城市街道，通过重复出现的肖像制造诡异而私密的公共空间反差。保持肖像身份一致，同时通过裁切、表情和广告牌透视产生自然变化。使用真实都市光线、反射、空气透视、可信的广告结构和电影感构图。广告牌应以人物肖像为主，不出现可读的广告文案、logo或品牌标记。不要性化构图、暴露私密部位、裸露、幼态呈现、扭曲面部、畸形的广告牌重复、多余肢体、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 烈焰农舍前的浴袍绅士茶歇
items.description: A documentary-style surreal photograph of a clearly adult man calmly drinking tea in a velvet armchair while a farmhouse burns behind him under an overcast sky.
items.prompt: Create a documentary-style photorealistic photograph of a clearly adult man with short brown hair and dark sunglasses, wearing a blue terry-cloth robe, calmly seated in a black velvet armchair on a dirt road. He holds a patterned teacup and looks directly at the camera. Behind him, a wooden farmhouse is fully engulfed in controlled, non-graphic flames with smoke billowing into a cloudy overcast sky. A silver teapot rests on a small side table to his right. The ground is covered with gravel and grass. Preserve the surreal contrast between the composed tea break and the dramatic fire, while keeping the scene safe and non-graphic: no people or animals in danger, no injuries, no gore, and no visible emergency distress. Use natural documentary framing, realistic firelight and smoke, coherent shadows, and detailed textures. No distorted anatomy, extra limbs, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张纪录片风格的照片级真实摄影作品：一位明确成年的男子留着棕色短发，戴深色太阳镜，身穿蓝色毛圈布浴袍，平静地坐在土路上的黑色天鹅绒扶手椅中。他手持带图案的茶杯并直视镜头。身后木制农舍被受控且非血腥的火焰完全吞没，浓烟升入阴沉多云的天空。他右侧的小边桌上放着银色茶壶，地面铺有碎石和草。保留从容茶歇与戏剧性火灾之间的超现实反差，同时确保场景安全且非血腥：不要有人或动物处于危险中，不要伤口、血腥或可见的紧急 distress。使用自然纪录片式构图、真实火光与烟雾、连贯阴影和细腻质感。不要解剖扭曲、多余肢体、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 极简撞色背景下的高级时尚人像
items.description: A refined editorial portrait of a clearly adult woman standing between contrasting graphic studio panels in a clean two-tone outfit.
items.prompt: Create a high-fashion minimal portrait of a clearly adult woman standing confidently between contrasting graphic panels, with a subtle smile and strong presence. Dress her in {wardrobe_colors}, tailored with clean lines and a refined editorial silhouette. Use a graphic studio setup with flat color walls, two bold contrasting panels, even soft lighting, controlled shadows, realistic anatomy, crisp subject detail, and a polished magazine-fashion finish. Keep the composition minimal, geometric, and balanced, with the color blocking as the main visual structure. No childlike presentation, sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, transparent clothing, nudity, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张高级时尚极简肖像：一位明确成年的女性自信地站在对比鲜明的图形面板之间，带着浅浅的微笑和强大气场。让她穿着{wardrobe_colors}，剪裁利落、线条干净，具有精致的编辑时尚轮廓。使用平面摄影棚布景、纯色墙壁、两块大胆对比的色彩面板、均匀柔和的照明和可控阴影，保持真实解剖比例、清晰主体细节和高级杂志时尚质感。构图应极简、几何且平衡，让撞色成为主要视觉结构。不要幼态呈现、性化构图、暴露私密部位、透明衣物、裸露、解剖扭曲、多余肢体、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 沐浴自然光影的花园摩登时尚人像
items.description: An editorial fashion portrait of a clearly adult woman standing confidently in a tailored botanical-inspired outfit inside a softly lit indoor garden.
items.prompt: Create an editorial fashion portrait of a clearly adult woman standing confidently with a gentle, confident smile. Dress her in {wardrobe_style}, with refined tailoring, wearable proportions, and subtle botanical details integrated into the garment. Place her in an indoor garden with natural daylight and soft shadows cast by greenery. Use a polished fashion-editorial composition, realistic anatomy, crisp subject detail, elegant styling, natural color, and premium photographic finish. Keep the botanical elements tasteful and functional rather than costume-like. No childlike presentation, sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, transparent clothing, nudity, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张时尚编辑肖像：一位明确成年的女性自信站立，带着温柔而自信的微笑。让她穿着{wardrobe_style}，剪裁精致、比例自然，并将细腻的植物元素融入服装。场景设在室内花园，使用自然日光和由绿植投射的柔和阴影。采用精致的时尚编辑构图、真实解剖比例、清晰主体细节、优雅造型、自然色彩和高级摄影质感。植物元素应美观克制且具有服装功能感，不要像戏服。不要幼态呈现、性化构图、暴露私密部位、透明衣物、裸露、解剖扭曲、多余肢体、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 目的地旅行明信片纸雕三维立体景观
items.description: A luxury travel-editorial square diorama where a destination postcard opens into a detailed layered papercraft world with a collectible traveler and softly blurred real background.
items.prompt: Create a highly detailed photorealistic square 1:1 travel postcard diorama for {destination}, {country}, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. In the foreground, place an authentic vintage postcard with rounded corners, tactile paper texture, a postal stamp, elegant postmark, and handwritten travel text. From the postcard, let an intricate 3D papercraft world emerge, using layered paper-cut terrain, architecture, vegetation, coastline, and 1–3 iconic destination features. Add a stylized collectible traveler character standing naturally within the miniature scene, with realistic proportions, a fashionable climate-appropriate travel outfit, subtle storytelling accessories, and seamless integration into the paper world; use a generic character with no fixed identity. Behind it, show a softly blurred real-world view of {destination} for depth and a reality-to-imagination connection. Keep the postcard tack-sharp and the background creamy bokeh. Write destination-specific handwritten text expressing discovery and wonder: header “{destination}, {country}”, paragraph “Some places don't ask for attention — they simply stay with you.”, closing line “Go where the maps get quiet.” Keep postal marks and ink illustrations elegant and uncluttered. Visual hierarchy: blurred real destination, authentic postcard, emerging papercraft landscape, traveler character. Use warm natural light, shallow depth of field, premium paper texture, cinematic color grading, realistic shadows, handcrafted detail, collectible figurine quality, and luxury travel-magazine cover polish. Adapt architecture, palette, outfit, and quote accents to the destination; avoid generic attractions and crowds, emphasizing a hidden-gem, dreamy storybook feeling. No distorted anatomy, extra limbs, illegible text, random logos, watermark, or oversaturated clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张适用于{destination}、{country}的高度详细写实方形1:1旅行明信片立体模型，从略高角度观看。前景放置一张真实复古明信片，带圆角、可触知的纸张纹理、邮票、精致邮戳和手写旅行文字。让复杂的3D纸雕世界从明信片中自然浮现，使用层叠剪纸地形、建筑、植被和海岸线，并加入1至3个目的地标志性特征。一个风格化的收藏级旅行者角色自然站在缩微场景中，拥有写实比例、适合当地气候的时尚旅行装束、微妙叙事配件，并无缝融入纸雕世界；使用无固定身份的通用角色。背景展示{destination}的现实场景并柔焦虚化，形成深度以及现实与想象的联系。明信片保持极致锐利，背景呈奶油般散景。将具有目的地特色、表达发现与惊奇的手写文字放在明信片上：标题“{destination}，{country}”，段落“有些地方不求关注——它们只是留在你心中。”，结束语“去往地图静止的地方。”邮戳和水墨插画应优雅且不杂乱。视觉层级为：模糊的真实目的地、真实明信片、浮现的纸雕景观、旅行者角色。使用温暖自然光、浅景深、优质纸张质感、电影级调色、写实阴影、手工细节、收藏级人偶品质和奢华旅行杂志封面质感。根据目的地调整建筑、色板、服装和文字细节，避免通用景点与拥挤人群，强调秘境、梦幻、童话般的旅行感。不要解剖扭曲、多余肢体、难以辨认的文字、随机logo、水印或过度饱和的杂乱元素。

items.title: 晨曦冰雪河谷中身着派克大衣的沉思旅人
items.description: A photorealistic cinematic winter portrait of a contemplative adult man leaning on a snowy bridge above a frozen river valley at golden hour.
items.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic photorealistic medium side-profile portrait of a clearly adult man in his late twenties with a contemplative expression looking into the distance. Give him short dark hair, fair complexion, and subtle stubble. Dress him in a heavy olive-green winter parka with a fur-lined hood, chunky brown wool scarf, black thermal gloves, and warm practical layers. He holds a steaming silver thermos and leans naturally against a snow-covered wrought-iron bridge railing, with one gloved hand near a pocket. Place him above a frozen river valley in a mountainous or high-altitude region during a quiet winter morning. Show frost-covered pine trees, mist rising from icy water, accumulated snow on the railing, and a distant modern city skyline with skyscrapers silhouetted in the background. Use golden-hour sunrise from behind him, soft orange and yellow glow, cinematic backlighting, natural skin texture, and hopeful serene atmosphere. Use an 85mm lens at f/1.8, rule-of-thirds composition, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the face, softly blurred background, realistic perspective, and cinematic color grading. No oversaturation, blurry face, distorted hands, cartoon style, low resolution, messy hair, extra limbs, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张超写实、照片级真实的中景侧面人像：一位明确成年的二十多岁末男性神情沉思，眺望远方。让他拥有短黑发、白皙肤色和略带胡茬。为他穿上厚重的橄榄绿色冬季派克大衣，带毛边兜帽，搭配粗针织棕色羊毛围巾、黑色保暖手套和实用保暖内层。他手持冒着热气的银色保温瓶，自然倚靠在积雪覆盖的铸铁桥栏杆上，一只戴手套的手靠近口袋。场景位于山区或高海拔地区的冰冻河谷上方，是宁静的隆冬清晨。画面包含挂满厚霜的松树、冰冷水面升起的薄雾、积雪的栏杆，以及背景中被金色时段日出映成剪影的现代摩天大楼城市。使用来自人物身后的金色时段日出光，柔和橙黄色光芒和电影感逆光，保留自然皮肤纹理，营造安详而充满希望的氛围。使用85mm镜头、f/1.8光圈、三分法构图和浅景深，面部清晰对焦、背景柔和虚化、透视真实并带电影级色彩分级。不要过度饱和、模糊面部、扭曲的手、卡通风格、低分辨率、凌乱头发、多余肢体、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 复古胶片感五格连拍人像
items.description: A vertical five-frame photo-booth-style portrait strip of a clearly adult woman in a modest black outfit, with hazy lo-fi film texture and an open riverside setting.
items.prompt: Create a vertical five-frame photo-booth-style portrait strip of a clearly adult woman, presented as five stacked 16:9 cinematic frames with thick black side bars. Across the frames, show a dynamic progression from an eye-level frontal gaze to a bold upward head tilt, with changing horizontal and tilted compositions. In the second frame she makes a playful V-sign; in later frames her body and head turn with a natural dance-like line. Keep her expression relaxed, confident, and friendly, with deep attentive eyes and softly parted lips, never seductive. Give her rich dark-brown long layered hair with fluffy curls, face-framing strands, and loose flyaways; use matte natural skin, brown gradient semi-smoky eye makeup, and calm nude-pink brick-rose matte lips. Dress her in a minimalist fitted black high-neck sleeveless top with opaque full coverage and clean athletic-trend styling; no tube top, bikini styling, sheer fabric, or side cutouts. Use soft diffused outdoor daylight under a cloudy sky or bright shade, with no hard shadows. Create a gentle contrast between the deep black outfit and a bright blurred off-white/gray background, with hazy soft film grain and a 1990s lo-fi indie-film atmosphere. Set the optional background at an open riverside, lakeside path, or outdoor terrace with a simple white railing, blurred turquoise water, and soft green silhouettes. Use shallow depth of field focused on face and pose, realistic anatomy and hands, and an original editorial snapshot aesthetic. No social-media logo, signature, text, watermark, sexualized framing, exposed intimate areas, nudity, childlike presentation, wrong fingers, extra limbs, or distorted anatomy.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张纵向五格照片亭风格人像条：由五个上下堆叠的16:9电影感画面组成，左右边缘带厚重黑色电影边栏。各格依次展示从平视正面凝视到大胆仰头的动态变化，采用水平和倾斜构图。第二格中人物俏皮地比出V字手势，后续画面中身体与头部自然转动，形成仿佛跳舞般的造型线条。人物是一位明确成年的女性，表情放松、自信、友好，眼神深邃专注，嘴唇微微张开但不带诱惑感。她留着深棕色长层次发和蓬松卷发，脸侧有修饰发丝与自然飞散的碎发；皮肤妆感自然哑光，搭配棕色渐层半烟熏眼妆和沉静的裸粉砖玫瑰色哑光唇妆。让她穿简约修身的黑色高领无袖上衣，不透明且完整遮盖，具有干净的运动潮流感；不要抹胸、比基尼式造型、透明面料或侧腹镂空。使用阴天或明亮阴影下柔和漫射的户外自然光，不要硬阴影。深黑服装与明亮虚化的米白/灰色背景形成柔和对比，整体带朦胧柔和胶片颗粒和90年代低保真独立电影氛围。可将背景设置为开阔的河边、湖畔步道或户外露台，包含简约白色栏杆、虚化青绿色水光和柔和绿色轮廓。使用浅景深聚焦面部与姿势，保持真实解剖、自然手部和原创编辑式抓拍质感。不要社交媒体logo、签名、文字、水印、性化构图、暴露私密部位、裸露、幼态呈现、错误手指、多余肢体或解剖扭曲。

items.title: 原创成年女性灵魂使者铅笔线稿海报
items.description: An original adult female supernatural hero poster rendered as a detailed pencil drawing with energetic shonen manga-inspired linework.
items.prompt: Create a character poster of an original clearly adult female supernatural guardian with a confident, composed expression and a distinctive fantasy outfit. Use a detailed pencil drawing with fine line art, dynamic shonen manga-inspired energy, expressive anatomy, clean contours, and carefully rendered fabric and hair. The character must be an original design, not a named or recognizable copyrighted character, and must not imitate any living artist's exact style. Show natural hands and feet with correct finger and toe counts, coherent anatomy, balanced poster composition, and strong readable silhouette. No physical defects, missing fingers or toes, extra limbs, distorted anatomy, nudity, sexualized framing, childlike presentation, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张原创角色海报：一位明确成年的女性超自然守护者，表情自信沉着，穿着独特的幻想风格服装。采用细致铅笔画与精细线稿，带有充满动感的少年漫画式能量、富有表现力且自然的解剖比例、干净轮廓，以及对布料和头发的精心刻画。角色必须是原创设计，不得使用或描绘可识别的受版权保护角色，也不得精确模仿任何在世艺术家的个人风格。手脚自然，手指和脚趾数量正确，解剖结构连贯，海报构图平衡，轮廓清晰易读。不要肢体缺陷、缺失手指或脚趾、多余肢体、解剖扭曲、裸露、性化构图、幼态呈现、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: iPhone 17 Pro抓拍宋代贵族女子午后庭院
items.description: A natural iPhone 17 Pro snapshot of a clearly adult Song-Dynasty noblewoman resting in a Jiangnan courtyard, rendered with soft afternoon light and historically inspired costume.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic natural-life snapshot captured with an iPhone 17 Pro using the Apple original camera look, with no commercial studio polish. Show a clearly adult Song-Dynasty noblewoman with a mature, natural proportioned figure, jet-black long hair half-tied with a jade hairpin, elegant restrained Song-Dynasty makeup, and a gentle quiet temperament. In an afternoon Jiangnan courtyard, she sits naturally beside a Song-style armchair to rest, body slightly turned to the side, one leg extended comfortably forward and the other lightly tucked in. Her right hand rests naturally beside her leg and her left hand tidies a sleeve or smooths the skirt; she looks away from the camera, like a candid moment recorded by a nearby attendant. Dress her in historically inspired Song-style beizi and high-waisted ruqun made from layered opaque moon-white and light-blue silk, with a softly draped outer layer and a modest hem that may reveal only the lower calves and ankles; barefoot is acceptable. Do not use transparent fabric or body-emphasizing styling. Set the scene in a real Song-Dynasty Jiangnan courtyard with bamboo shadows, a wooden corridor, bluestone ground, guqin, side table, and celadon vase. Soft sunlight filters through bamboo leaves. Use a close 3:4 vertical composition, slight handheld feel, natural clear rendering, realistic perspective, and authentic everyday atmosphere. No sexualized framing, cleavage emphasis, exposed intimate areas, nudity, childlike presentation, anachronistic objects, text overlays, logos, watermarks, distorted anatomy, or extra limbs.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张照片级真实的自然生活抓拍，使用iPhone 17 Pro与苹果原相机直出质感，不要商业棚拍的精修感。画面中是一位明确成年的宋代贵族女性，体态成熟而比例自然，乌黑长发半挽并佩戴玉簪，妆容淡雅克制，气质温婉宁静。午后江南庭院中，她自然坐在宋式圈椅旁休息，身体微微侧向一边，一条腿舒适地向前伸展，另一条腿轻轻收拢。右手自然放在腿侧，左手整理衣袖或抚平裙摆；她望向镜头之外，像身边侍从记录下的生活瞬间。让她穿具有历史感的宋制褙子与齐腰襦裙，采用月白和浅青色的多层不透明丝绸，外层自然垂坠，裙摆至多露出小腿下段和脚踝；可以赤脚。不要使用透明面料或强调身体的造型。场景为真实宋代风格的江南庭院，包含竹影、木廊、青石地面、古琴、案几和青瓷花瓶，柔和日光穿过竹叶洒落。使用近距离3:4竖构图、轻微手持感、自然通透的真实成像、写实透视和日常生活氛围。不要性化构图、乳沟强调、暴露私密部位、裸露、幼态呈现、时代错置物件、文字叠加、logo、水印、解剖扭曲或多余肢体。

items.title: 复古卧室午后柔雾暖调成熟女性人像
items.description: A photorealistic, clearly adult East Asian woman in a modest cream dress poses thoughtfully beside a vintage bedroom window in soft, warm afternoon light.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 3:4 vertical half-body portrait of a clearly adult young East Asian woman with a soft oval face, clear almond eyes, natural semi-matte makeup, peach-toned lips, realistic skin micro-texture, and dark-brown fluffy long curly hair with a few wisps framing her face. Add small pearl earrings. Dress her in a modest opaque cream-white dress with a softly pleated bodice, restrained satin-like sheen, and naturally covered shoulders and neckline; keep the styling elegant and non-sexualized. Place her beside a vintage bedroom window with a translucent lace curtain in the left foreground, off-white walls, light bedding, low-saturation wood, and an open old book softly blurred near the bed; no flower bouquet. Use an eye-level side-front composition with the subject on the left, body slightly turned toward the window, and a broad softly blurred background on the right. She looks out of frame with a quiet, thoughtful, gentle expression and relaxed closed or softly parted lips. One hand may rest naturally near the chest or book; do not touch or bite the lips. Use 85mm shallow depth of field, soft warm afternoon window light filtered through the curtain, creamy low-contrast tones, subtle highlight diffusion, realistic texture, and polished digital portrait photography. No private-portrait framing, flirtation, provocative gestures, exposed intimate areas, transparent clothing, nudity, childlike presentation, heavy makeup, plastic skin, oily sheen, harsh light, over-sharpening, wrong fingers, extra limbs, text, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张照片级真实的3:4竖版半身人像：一位明确成年的年轻东亚女性拥有柔和鹅蛋脸、清亮杏眼、自然半哑光妆容、蜜桃色嘴唇、真实皮肤微纹理，以及深棕色蓬松长卷发，脸侧留有几缕轻盈碎发。佩戴小巧珍珠耳钉。让她穿一条得体的不透明奶油白连衣裙，胸口带柔和收褶和克制的缎面质感，肩部与领口自然覆盖，整体优雅且不性化。她位于复古卧室窗边，左侧近景有半透明蕾丝纱帘，背景包含米白墙面、浅色床品和低饱和木质结构，床边一本翻开的旧书以柔和虚化呈现，不出现花束。采用侧前方平视构图，人物位于画面左侧，身体略微朝向窗户，右侧保留大面积柔和虚化背景。她望向画外，表情安静、若有所思且温和，嘴唇自然闭合或轻微张开。一只手可以自然放在胸前或旧书附近，不要触碰或咬嘴唇。使用85mm浅景深、穿过纱帘的柔和暖色午后窗光、奶油色低反差调子、细微高光扩散、真实质感和精致数字人像摄影。不要私密写真式构图、挑逗或夸张动作、暴露私密部位、透明衣物、裸露、幼态呈现、浓艳妆容、塑料皮肤、油膜感、强烈硬光、过度锐化、错误手指、多余肢体、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 灰白色毛绒玩具私密情绪特写人像
items.description: A 3:4 photorealistic low-key close-up portrait of an adult woman nestled among soft gray-white plush toys, with messy dark hair, sleepy expression, shallow depth of field, and a gently uncanny editorial mood.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 3:4 vertical extreme close-up portrait of an adult woman nestled among a group of soft gray-white plush toys. Use a crowded composition with almost no negative space. Give her messy long black hair with a few strands across the face, half-open slightly dazed eyes, lightly pursed lips, light makeup, faint pink blush beneath the eyes and on the cheeks, and natural moist lip texture. Keep the plush toys soft and fluffy in low-saturation gray-white tones, close around the cheeks and shoulders, creating a soft, sleepy, gently uncanny editorial atmosphere. Use soft low-key natural light, shallow depth of field, a slight airy feeling, realistic skin texture, and a clean Japanese-inspired quiet-room portrait aesthetic. Keep the mood intimate in a calm editorial sense but non-sexual. Do not add any logo, signature, brand label, readable text, watermark, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothing, erotic framing, plastic skin, or artificial smoothing.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张照片级真实的3:4竖版极近距离面部特写：一位成年女性安静地陷在一群柔软的灰白色毛绒玩具中。采用拥挤构图，几乎不留空白。她有凌乱的黑色长发，几缕发丝落在脸上，半睁且略带困倦的眼睛，轻轻抿起的嘴唇，淡妆，眼下和脸颊带淡淡粉晕，嘴唇保持自然湿润质感。周围毛绒玩具柔软蓬松，使用低饱和灰白色调，靠近脸颊与肩部，营造柔软、困倦、轻微怪诞的编辑人像氛围。使用柔和暗调自然光、浅景深、轻微空气感和真实皮肤纹理，呈现干净、受日系安静室内肖像启发的摄影美学。氛围可以亲密但必须是平静的编辑表达，不带性化意味。不要logo、签名、品牌织标、可读文字、水印、裸露、内衣、透明衣物、性化构图、塑料皮肤或人为磨皮。

items.title: 树叶上的微缩男子与蝴蝶金色梦幻微距摄影
items.description: An identity-bound photorealistic macro fantasy scene in which the referenced adult man appears as a tiny peaceful figure seated on a dew-covered leaf beside a giant patterned butterfly at golden hour.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference. Preserve the exact adult man's face, hairstyle, facial features, beard, skin tone, and peaceful expression without beautification, morphing, or identity drift. Create a whimsical photorealistic macro-fantasy scene at golden hour: depict the identity-bound man as a tiny approximately six-inch-tall miniature figure sitting cross-legged on a large dew-covered green leaf. Give him a slightly oversized head with believable proportions, a dark-blue patterned pajama set, and a small white ceramic coffee mug held gently in both hands. His eyes are closed with a calm, content smile. Beside him sits a giant butterfly with intricate blue, orange, black, and white wing patterns, facing him as if sharing a quiet moment. Show crystal-clear dew droplets sparkling in warm sunlight. Use a dreamy garden background with soft pink flowers, lush green foliage, creamy cinematic bokeh, golden sunrise backlight, warm rim light, and restrained volumetric rays. Use ultra-realistic macro photography, shallow depth of field, 85mm macro lens, f/2.8, HDR, hyper-detailed natural textures, natural colors, and soft cinematic lighting. No face alteration, extra people, disturbing anatomy, text, logo, watermark, or artificial plastic texture.
items.prompt_zh: 以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。以极高忠实度保留这位成年男性的面部、发型、面部特征、胡须、肤色和平静表情，不进行美颜、变脸或身份漂移。创建一个黄金时刻的奇幻照片级真实微距场景：将身份绑定的男性表现为约六英寸高的微缩人物，盘腿坐在覆盖露珠的大绿叶上。头部略大但比例可信，穿深蓝色图案睡衣，双手轻轻拿着小白色陶瓷咖啡杯；双眼闭合，带着平静满足的微笑。身旁坐着一只巨型蝴蝶，翅膀具有复杂的蓝、橙、黑、白图案，正面朝向他，仿佛共享安静时刻。表现晶莹露珠在温暖阳光下闪烁。背景为梦幻花园，包含柔和粉色花朵、茂盛绿叶、奶油色电影感散景、金色日出逆光、温暖轮廓光和克制体积光。使用超写实微距摄影、浅景深、85mm微距镜头、f/2.8、HDR、超细节自然纹理、自然色彩和柔和电影灯光。不要面部改造、额外人物、异常解剖、文字、logo、水印或塑料质感。

items.title: 户外花园持马鞭的条纹西装裙亚裔女性
items.description: A photorealistic full-body garden editorial portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman seated on a modern bench, with gold-rim glasses, long geometric earrings, soft dappled daylight, and a composed fashion pose.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic full-body vertical fashion editorial portrait of one clearly adult East Asian woman seated elegantly on a modern outdoor bench with a light cushion. Set the scene in a tranquil upscale garden with dense lush foliage, stone tile flooring, natural daylight filtering through leaves, soft dappled sunlight, realistic environmental light, shallow depth of field, and creamy bokeh. She faces the camera with direct eye contact and a calm, confident expression. Give her fair skin, an oval face, expressive eyes, refined natural makeup, long straight black hair center-parted and tucked behind the ears, thin gold oval glasses, long geometric gold earrings, and a small necklace. Dress her in a tailored black pinstripe blazer dress with a modest neckline, long sleeves, a decorative black belt with an antique-silver buckle, opaque dark tights, and polished black pointed low block-heel shoes with a subtle red sole accent. She holds a slim black fashion portfolio or folded umbrella horizontally between both hands, with legs crossed naturally, upright posture, relaxed shoulders, and a sophisticated non-sexual editorial pose. Keep the entire body and shoes visible at seated eye level. Use an 85mm lens at f/1.8, sharp facial focus, soft creamy background bokeh, HDR, natural skin tones, clean fabric texture, and high detail. No whip, fetish styling, sheer stockings, mini hemline, deep neckline, cleavage emphasis, erotic framing, exaggerated anatomy, text, logo, watermark, or distorted hands.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张照片级真实的竖向全身时尚编辑人像：一位明确成年的东亚女性优雅地坐在带浅色垫子的现代户外长椅上。场景为宁静的高端花园，拥有茂密绿叶、石砖地面、穿过叶片的自然日光、柔和斑驳光、真实环境照明、浅景深和奶油色背景虚化。她面向镜头并保持直接眼神交流，表情冷静自信。她有白皙皮肤、鹅蛋脸、富有表现力的眼睛、自然精致妆容、黑色长直发，中分并整齐塞在耳后；佩戴细金边椭圆眼镜、长款几何金耳环和小巧项链。让她穿剪裁利落、领口得体的黑色细条纹西装裙，长袖，配装饰性黑色腰带和复古银色扣饰、全不透明深色袜裤，以及带微妙红色鞋底点缀的黑色尖头低跟鞋。她双手水平握着一件细长黑色时尚文件夹或折叠伞，双腿自然交叉，姿态挺拔，肩膀放松，呈现成熟而非性化的编辑时尚姿态。相机约在坐姿眼睛高度，完整拍入全身和鞋子。使用85mm镜头、f/1.8、面部锐利对焦、柔和奶油色背景虚化、HDR、自然肤色、干净面料纹理和高细节。不要马鞭、恋物化造型、半透明丝袜、迷你裙摆、深V领口、强调乳沟、性化构图、夸张身体、文字、logo、水印或扭曲手部。

items.title: 极简水彩风格城市建筑旅行海报
items.description: A reusable bilingual watercolor travel-poster template for a chosen location or landmark, with elegant architectural sketching, airy white paper, restrained pastel color, and configurable city typography.
items.prompt: Create a 4:5 vertical minimalist watercolor travel poster illustration of a quiet Lisbon hillside street overlooking the Tagus. Render an elegant architectural sketch with expressive ink linework and loose watercolor washes on bright white paper with generous negative space. Use a soft pastel palette of sky blue, warm beige, muted sage green, and subtle terracotta accents. Include delicate urban details, tiny generic strolling pedestrians, lush trees, reflective water or a plaza, atmospheric perspective, light paint splatters, hand-drawn imperfections, and refined watercolor paper texture. Use a sophisticated editorial travel-magazine and contemporary architectural-illustration aesthetic with an airy composition, natural daylight, and a calm inviting mood. At the top, add clean modern typography reading “LISBON” with the small editorial subtitle “A STUDY IN LIGHT AND STONE” beneath. Keep it suitable as a premium coffee-table art print and understated European sketchbook poster. Maintain highly detailed but elegant minimal watercolor rendering, no heavy outlines, photorealism, frame, or border. No invented factual claims, logo, watermark, or clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张 4:5 竖版极简水彩旅行海报插画，主题为 a quiet Lisbon hillside street overlooking the Tagus。在带大量留白的亮白色纸张上绘制优雅建筑草图，使用富有表现力的墨线和松散水彩晕染。采用天蓝色、暖米色、柔和鼠尾草绿和微妙红陶色点缀的柔和粉彩配色。加入精致城市细节、微小普通漫步行人、茂盛树木、倒影水面或广场、大气透视、轻微颜料溅痕、手绘不完美感和细腻水彩纸纹理。整体融合精致编辑旅行杂志、当代建筑插画和低调欧洲写生簿美学，构图轻盈，使用自然日光，气质平静而亲切。顶部加入整洁现代排版“LISBON”，下方加入小型编辑副标题“A STUDY IN LIGHT AND STONE”。适合作为高级咖啡桌艺术印刷品和低调奢华旅行海报。保持高度细节但优雅极简，不使用粗重轮廓、写实摄影、画框或边框。不要编造事实、logo、水印或杂乱元素。

items.title: 极简手绘治愈可爱卡通表情包合集
items.description: A reusable bilingual square 3x3 sticker-pack template that converts a referenced or described character into a consistent minimalist chibi emoticon collection with exact Chinese phrases and distinct actions.
items.prompt: Create a square minimalist hand-drawn cartoon emoticon collection. If a character reference image is supplied, use it only to identify the character's appearance, clothing, and accessories, not its layout, text, background, or photographic style. Otherwise use this character setting: a cheerful adult fox-eared traveler with short brown hair, a yellow scarf, and a teal coat. Extract five to eight recognizable anchors and convert the character into a unified chibi design with a large head, small body, short limbs, simple symbolic eyes/brows/mouth, consistent hair, clothing, colors, accessories, proportions, and line thickness across all nine units. Use a pure white background and an invisible evenly spaced 3x3 grid with nine independent non-overlapping stickers; show no grid lines or cell borders. From left to right and top to bottom, use exactly one Chinese phrase and one clear action in each unit: 1 “早上好” with waving with a smile and a red accent; 2 “谢谢” with bowing politely and orange; 3 “加油” with raising a tiny fist and yellow; 4 “收到” with giving an OK gesture and green; 5 “等等” with holding up one finger and blue; 6 “太棒了” with jumping with both arms up and purple; 7 “抱歉” with making an apologetic bow and red; 8 “晚安” with sleeping on a small cloud and blue; 9 “出发” with pointing forward with a tiny backpack and orange. Keep each phrase legible and separate from the face, using a speech bubble, small sign, or gesture-adjacent placement. Use playful rounded black ink lines with slight hand irregularity, soft bright flat colors, and no gradients; omit realistic lighting and shadows or use only a faint sticker shadow. Render a cute, healing, minimalist 2D sticker-pack aesthetic with clean spacing, consistent style, no repeated actions or phrases, and accurate Chinese text. No realistic characters, adult realistic anatomy, complex background, 3D, CGI, visible grid, borders, standard print font, English, Pinyin, extra titles, watermark, signature, cropped characters, extra limbs, overlap, or pseudo-text.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张方形极简手绘卡通表情包合集。如果提供人物参考图，只用于识别人物外观、服装和配饰，不复制参考图的排版、文字、背景或摄影风格；如果没有参考图，则使用人物设定：a cheerful adult fox-eared traveler with short brown hair, a yellow scarf, and a teal coat。提取五至八个最具辨识度的视觉锚点，将人物转化为统一的Q版形象：大头、小身体、短四肢，眼睛、眉毛和嘴巴使用简洁符号。九个单元必须保持相同的发型、服装、配色、配饰、比例和线条粗细。使用纯白背景和整洁均匀的隐形3×3网格，生成九个独立、互不重叠的表情贴纸，不显示网格线或边框。从左到右、从上到下分别使用一句中文短语和一个明确动作：1“早上好”配waving with a smile和红色点缀；2“谢谢”配bowing politely和橙色；3“加油”配raising a tiny fist和黄色；4“收到”配giving an OK gesture和绿色；5“等等”配holding up one finger和蓝色；6“太棒了”配jumping with both arms up和紫色；7“抱歉”配making an apologetic bow和红色；8“晚安”配sleeping on a small cloud和蓝色；9“出发”配pointing forward with a tiny backpack和橙色。每格只出现一句短语和一个动作，文字可放在气泡、小牌子或手势旁，但不得遮挡面部。使用略带手工不规则感的圆润黑色墨线、柔和明快的纯色平涂，不使用渐变；不使用写实光影，阴影省略或仅保留极淡贴纸式影子。整体可爱、治愈、极简、扁平二维、像统一的表情包贴纸包；保持间距、风格和中文准确性，不重复动作或短语。不要写实人物、成人写实身体比例、复杂背景、3D、CGI、可见网格、边框、标准印刷字体、英文、拼音、多余标题、水印、签名、裁切人物、多余肢体、元素重叠或伪文字。

items.title: 东方留白当代装置艺术海报设计提示词
items.description: A reusable bilingual 9:16 art-poster template that transforms a cultivation maxim into a restrained material installation metaphor with handmade paper, bas-relief, a monumental object, and precise editorial typography.
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical Oriental negative-space art poster that transforms the cultivation maxim “守拙归真” into a contemporary installation metaphor. Derive the concise two-character theme 归真 and express the core meaning returning to what is essential through the visual metaphor peeling away ornament until the vessel's inner light returns. Use premium handmade art paper with visible fibers, indentations, and pulp particles as the background, preserving a large area of quiet white space. Add low-contrast bas-relief based on subtle vessel contour lines and concentric ring structure; it should participate in the meaning, remain restrained from a distance, and reveal detail only on close inspection. Feature a monumental a monumental blue-and-white porcelain vessel with a clear outline, real volume, and tactile material texture. Add one tiny generic person occupying about 1%–2% of the frame solely to establish scale. Use warm ivory, cobalt blue, muted cinnabar, and charcoal with clear primary and secondary roles; let color enter through glaze, cracks, reflections, flowing light, lacquer, or material interiors. Do not limit the palette to gray and do not use cheap neon effects. Set the main Chinese title to 归真 in a modern Songti, Mingti, or carved-style serif, with complete accurate legible characters; refined spacing, misalignment, curves, or short lines may add design. Also include 守拙归真, Nanjing · 2026, and a short English title in small restrained type. Combine Oriental cultivation, material art, contemporary installation, handmade paper, and high-end editorial poster design. No clutter, fake Chinese, illegible typography, logo, QR code, URL, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张9:16竖版东方留白艺术海报，将修养箴言“守拙归真”转化为具有当代装置感的视觉隐喻。提炼出两字主题 归真，通过 peeling away ornament until the vessel's inner light returns 表达核心含义 returning to what is essential。使用带真实纤维、压痕和纸浆颗粒的高级手工艺术纸作为背景，保留大面积安静留白。加入基于 subtle vessel contour lines and concentric ring structure 的低对比浅浮雕；压纹必须参与表达含义，远看克制，近看才显现细节。画面设置一个轮廓清晰、具有真实体积和材质触感的巨大 a monumental blue-and-white porcelain vessel，并加入一个只用于建立尺度关系、占画面约1%至2%的极小普通人物。使用 warm ivory, cobalt blue, muted cinnabar, and charcoal，明确主色与辅助色层级；让颜色通过釉光、裂隙、倒影、流光、漆面或材料内部进入空间，不要局限于黑白灰，也不要使用廉价霓虹效果。中文主标题使用 归真，采用现代宋体、明朝体或雕刻感衬线字体；可用字距、错位、弧线或短线增加设计感，但汉字必须完整、准确、清晰。同时以小字号加入 守拙归真、Nanjing · 2026 和简短英文标题。整体融合东方修养、材料艺术、当代装置、手工纸和高级编辑海报设计。不要杂乱、假中文、不可读排版、logo、二维码、网址或水印。

items.title: 富士胶片质感下的九宫格动态时尚人像
items.description: An identity-bound bilingual workflow for a square 3x3 editorial movement grid, keeping the same face across every frame while exploring natural gestures, warm studio light, and Fujifilm Classic Negative texture.
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference. Preserve the same person's facial identity, proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, and skin tone across every frame; do not beautify, morph, blend identities, or shift age. Create a square 1:1 ultra-high-resolution 3x3 editorial movement grid with the same clearly adult subject in every panel. Use an ultra-photorealistic editorial fashion style with soft-but-detailed sharpness, natural fine film grain, warm-natural skin, and a Fujifilm Classic Negative-inspired warm grade. Photograph the subject in a minimal warm studio with a beige or sand backdrop, large soft window light from one side, very subtle ambient fill, soft defined shadows, gentle cinematic contrast, and controlled highlights. Use a Fujifilm X-T5 look, Fujinon XF 35mm f/1.4 lens at f/2.0, 1/500s, ISO 500, warm daylight white balance, continuous autofocus, and eye focus. Keep the subject in a white ribbed full-length tank top and loose light-wash relaxed-fit jeans, with minimal accessories and natural unpolished nails. Across the grid, explore small natural changes in movement, gesture, posture, and hair motion while keeping the same face, wardrobe, setting, and editorial continuity. The mood is free, intimate in a non-sexual editorial sense, confident, and movement-focused. No logos, nudity, transparent clothing, erotic framing, identity drift, face-swap artifacts, extra people, distorted anatomy, text, watermark, or over-beautification.
items.prompt_zh: 以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。让同一人物在每个画格中都保持一致的面部身份、比例、眼型、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线和肤色；不要美颜、变脸、混合身份或改变年龄。创建一张1:1正方形超高分辨率九宫格动态编辑时尚人像，九个画格中均为同一位明确成年的主体。采用超写实编辑时尚风格，清晰但柔和，带自然细胶片颗粒、暖自然肤色和受富士Classic Negative启发的暖色调。场景为米色或沙色背景的极简暖调影棚，使用一侧大面积柔和窗光、极弱环境补光、柔和但明确的阴影、轻柔电影感对比度和受控高光。采用Fujifilm X-T5质感、Fujinon XF 35mm f/1.4镜头、f/2.0、1/500秒、ISO 500、暖日光白平衡、连续自动对焦和眼睛优先对焦。主体穿白色罗纹全长背心和宽松浅色水洗牛仔裤，配极简饰品和无指甲油的自然指甲。九宫格中探索细微自然的动作、手势、姿态和发丝运动变化，同时保持同一面孔、服装、场景和编辑连续性。整体气质自由、亲密但保持非性化编辑表达、自信且强调运动感。不要logo、裸露、透明衣物、性化构图、身份漂移、换脸伪影、额外人物、解剖扭曲、文字、水印或过度美颜。

items.title: 冷白清透CCD都市休闲少女摄影
items.description: A bright, playful 9:16 CCD-style lifestyle portrait of a clearly adult woman examining a small designer toy in a modern display store, with raspberry-red focal clothing, cool white light, and neat colorful surroundings.
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 urban leisure lifestyle photograph in a cool-white, clear CCD aesthetic. Show a clearly adult woman with a soft small oval face, bright round almond-shaped eyes, natural nose and lips, pale rose-nude lip color, and long black hair half-tied in a high ponytail with light ends and natural stray hairs. Place her in a modern designer-toy store with a white transparent display case, colorful model wall, silver display stand, and a rich but orderly collection of toys. Dress her in a raspberry-red relaxed-fit knit short-sleeve top with a modest U-neck and a light gray-white regular-rise denim skirt of practical length. Keep natural proportions and avoid emphasizing the chest, waist, or hips. She stands at the display case, carefully examining a small designer toy in one hand while the other hand lightly touches the case; give her a bright, playful expression with a hint of surprise. Frame from the thighs through the upper body. Use cold-white lightbox illumination, transparent acrylic reflections, extremely weak soft flash, cool-white highlights, red-and-white clear CCD color, light grain, and slight controlled overexposure. Raspberry red should remain the person's visual focal color without tinting the whole image red. Keep the background neat and the mood fashionable, relaxed, energetic, and candid. No sexualized framing, transparent clothing, nudity, logo, readable text, watermark, or clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张9:16都市休闲生活照，采用冷白清透的CCD美学。主体是一位明确成年的女性，拥有柔和小鹅蛋脸、明亮圆润的杏眼、自然鼻子和嘴唇、淡玫瑰裸粉唇色，以及黑色长发半扎高马尾，发尾轻盈，额前有自然碎发。场景为现代潮玩设计店，包含白色透明展示柜、彩色模型墙、银色展示台，以及丰富但整洁的潮玩陈列。让她穿覆盆子红的宽松合身针织短袖上衣，领口得体，并搭配浅灰白色正常腰位、长度实用的牛仔裙。保持自然比例，不强调胸部、腰部或臀部。她站在展示柜前，一只手仔细观察小型潮玩，另一只手轻扶展示柜，表情明亮俏皮并带一点惊喜。画面从大腿至上半身取景。使用店内冷白灯箱光、透明亚克力反射光和极弱柔闪，呈现冷白高光、红白清透CCD色彩、轻颗粒和轻微可控过曝。覆盆子红只作为人物视觉焦点，不要让整体画面偏红。背景保持整洁，气质时髦、轻松、有活力且自然抓拍。不要性化构图、透明衣物、裸露、logo、可读文字、水印或杂乱。

items.title: 暖色室内东亚女性手机写实人像
items.description: A realistic 9:16 handheld smartphone portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman seated at a wooden table at night, wearing gold glasses and a pale-gray hooded jacket in a warmly lit, richly textured room.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic 9:16 close-up smartphone portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman sitting at a wooden table in a warmly lit room at night. Give her an elegant soft-oval face, luminous fair skin with realistic texture, large dark almond-shaped eyes, softly arched brows, a straight delicate nose, natural rose-red lips, and a small beauty mark beneath the lower lip near the chin. Her short thick black hair is swept upward and backward with natural volume, slightly tousled texture, and loose strands around the hairline. She wears oversized round gold wire-frame glasses with clear lenses and subtle reflections that leave the eyes fully visible, plus small stud earrings. Dress her in an opaque white inner top with comfortable coverage beneath a lightweight pale-gray hooded zip-up jacket, zipped to a modest neckline with two white drawstrings hanging naturally. Keep her body naturally proportioned without body-part emphasis. She sits close to the table and leans gently toward the phone; one forearm rests on the tabletop while the other arm reaches casually toward the phone, with relaxed shoulders and a slight head tilt. She looks directly into the lens with a calm, confident, friendly expression. Use a close eye-level handheld smartphone angle, framing from the top of her hair to slightly below the waist; place her face left-center while retaining part of the tabletop and room. Set the background with a deep burgundy wall with narrow vertical textured panels, a black-framed window reflecting white ceiling lights, and a honey-colored wooden cabinet with woven rattan doors, topped by a small framed ballerina ornament, flowers, and understated household decor. Use warm overhead indoor lighting with natural shadows beneath the glasses and chin, authentic vertical smartphone-video still softness, subtle digital grain, mild compression texture, believable fabric folds, and no over-editing. No sexualized framing, cleavage emphasis, transparent clothing, lingerie, nudity, plastic skin, excessive beauty filter, doll-like face, distorted glasses, text, captions, interface icons, logo, or watermark.

Keep the mirror geometry physically credible and do not introduce extra faces or people in the reflection. No readable text, brand names, logos, watermark, signature, labels, makeup-mirror UI, identity drift, deformed hands, extra fingers, cartoon, anime, CGI appearance, low resolution, heavy noise, or harsh blown highlights.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张超写实的抓拍编辑照片：一位明确成年的女性正在涂口红，通过化妆镜中的倒影呈现。化妆镜占据画面大部分，具有真实玻璃反光、轻微污迹和自然镜面眩光；镜中女性是唯一的人，不要把倒影误作额外人物。表情精致、自信但不带性化意味，身穿具有得体覆盖度的丝质浴袍并佩戴简洁珠宝。环境为豪华酒店房间，使用暖色钨丝环境光和柔和补光，带有微妙焦外虚化高光；面部锐利清晰，背景柔和虚化。画面中应看见化妆镜和化妆刷。确保手部、手指、握刷动作、面部对齐和人体结构正确，皮肤保持照片级真实而不塑料化。保持镜面几何可信，不要在倒影中加入多余人物或面孔。不要可读文字、品牌名、logo、水印、签名、标签、化妆镜UI、身份漂移、变形的手、多余手指、卡通、动漫、CGI感、低分辨率、严重噪点或刺眼过曝高光。

items.title: 黑白光影下的祖母绿墨镜冷峻侧颜
items.description: A cinematic high-contrast profile portrait using the uploaded face reference for identity fidelity, with a deep-black background, dramatic rim lighting, and selective emerald color restricted to reflective sunglass lenses.
items.prompt: Create an 8K photorealistic cinematic portrait using the uploaded face reference as an exact identity reference. Do not change the person's facial structure, proportions, or defining features. Show a clearly adult man in a tight telephoto profile close-up, looking toward the right side of the frame, with the face and upper shoulder in sharp focus and a deep black background fading away without visible detail. Give him a serious, contemplative expression with a slightly furrowed brow, dark textured hair, a full well-groomed beard, and round silver sunglasses with vibrant reflective emerald-green lenses. Use a strong cinematic key light from the front right to illuminate the face and glasses, plus a distinct rim light tracing the left edge of the hair, ear, and beard. Use high contrast with dramatic highlights and deep shadows. Keep the overall image desaturated black and white; emerald green may appear only in the reflective sunglass lenses. Show ultra-detailed natural skin, hair, beard, and leather-jacket texture, with a subtle jacket sheen at the lower right. Preserve shallow depth of field, intense cinematic mood, and fine-art restraint. No text, watermark, logo, facial alteration, or extra background detail.
items.prompt_zh: 使用用户上传的面部参考作为精确身份参考，创建一张8K照片级真实的电影感肖像。不得改变人物的面部结构、比例或辨识性特征。主体是一位明确成年的男性，以长焦镜头拍摄紧凑的侧面特写，面向画面右侧；面部和上肩清晰对焦，深黑色背景逐渐淡出且不出现可见细节。人物表情严肃、沉思，眉毛微蹙；头发深色且纹理清晰，留着浓密整齐的胡须，佩戴圆形银色镜框和鲜艳祖母绿反光镜片的太阳镜。使用来自右前方的强烈电影主光照亮面部与眼镜，并用清晰轮廓光勾勒头发、耳朵和胡须左侧边缘。保持高对比度、戏剧性高光和深邃阴影。整体画面去饱和黑白，祖母绿只能出现在反光镜片中。呈现超精细而自然的皮肤、头发、胡须和皮夹克纹理，右下方可见微妙皮革光泽。保持浅景深、强烈电影感和艺术摄影克制感。不要文字、水印、logo、面部改造或额外背景细节。

items.title: 极简暗调光影下的沉思艺术人像
items.description: A vertical fine-art photographic portrait of a clearly adult woman in three-quarter view, with auburn hair, contemplative expression, opaque dark clothing, and dramatic rim light against a minimal studio gradient.
items.prompt: Create a vertical fine-art photographic portrait of a clearly adult woman, framed as a medium close-up from the face through the upper body in three-quarter view. Place her slightly left of center with minimal negative space concentrated on the right. Her body faces right while her head turns gently left and her gaze lowers, creating a softly contemplative, calm, introspective expression. Give her vibrant long auburn hair flowing loosely over the shoulders. Dress her in an opaque, elegant, long black dress with a natural flowing drape. Use dramatic rim lighting from the right so the hair and right body edge glow against deep shadows with smooth falloff. Set the portrait against a clean studio backdrop with a dark-gray-to-near-black vertical gradient and no distracting detail. Keep a low-saturation monochrome palette of black, charcoal, and deep gray with subtle warm auburn highlights. Keep the face and upper body sharp with shallow-to-moderate depth of field, soft unobtrusive background blur, moderate-to-high contrast, subtle facial clarity, and a soft natural vignette. The mood is quiet, introspective, moody, minimalist, cinematic, and fine-art. No text overlay, nudity, transparent fabric, erotic framing, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张竖向艺术摄影肖像，主体是一位明确成年的女性，以面部至上半身的中景特写呈现四分之三侧面。人物略微偏左，右侧保留少量负空间。身体朝向右侧，头部轻柔转向左方，目光向下，呈现柔和沉思、平静而内省的表情。让她拥有鲜艳的长款赤褐色头发，自然披散在肩上。穿一件不透明、优雅、具有自然垂坠感的黑色长裙。使用来自右侧的戏剧性轮廓光，照亮头发和身体右侧边缘，使其从深邃且平滑过渡的阴影中显现。背景为干净的影棚渐变，从深灰色垂直过渡至近黑色，无干扰细节。整体采用低饱和黑色、炭灰色和深灰色单色调，仅加入微妙温暖的赤褐色高光。面部和上半身清晰锐利，使用浅至中等景深、柔和不显眼的背景虚化、中高对比度、面部轻微清晰度和自然柔和暗角。气质安静、内省、忧郁、极简、电影感且具有艺术性。不要文字叠加、裸露、透明面料、性化构图、水印或logo。

items.title: 超写实电影感三联画前卫时尚大片
items.description: A reusable bilingual high-end fashion campaign template for a brand, using an autonomously generated clearly adult muse and three horizontally stacked close-up panels focused on portrait, gesture, and material texture.
items.prompt: Create a high-end, hyper-realistic editorial fashion photography triptych campaign for an independent atelier of tactile coastal fashion. Analyze the brand's archetype, aesthetic, philosophy, and target-audience lifestyle, then autonomously generate a clearly adult human muse who embodies that spirit; determine their gender presentation, age over 18, appearance, striking features, and charismatic attitude from the brand analysis. Do not imitate or name any living photographer; use an original blend of cinematic close-up, raw tactile fashion editorial, and art-house visual language. Create a cohesive three-panel layout stacked vertically as top, middle, and bottom panels, with intimate tight framing. Top panel: an intense cinematic head-and-shoulders portrait focused on expressive eyes and face, with visible natural skin texture and emotion. Middle panel: a tight crop of a specific body part in motion or repose, such as hands gripping a prop, a neck and shoulder gesture, or a poised mouth without smoking; convey attitude without showing the whole body. Bottom panel: an extreme macro of distinctive garment fabric, jewelry, a symbolic prop, or an abstract environmental texture relevant to an independent atelier of tactile coastal fashion. Push toward avant-garde high fashion with unexpected accessories, juxtaposed garments, or a restrained touch of deliberate absurdity that fits the brand. Make the image raw, expensive, tactile, and cohesive. Use strong film grain, detailed pores and fabric weave, realistic depth of field, bold cinematic dramatic lighting chosen from chiaroscuro, colored gels, harsh sunlight, or moody shadow according to the brand DNA, and a sophisticated editorial color grade harmonious with an independent atelier of tactile coastal fashion. No nudity, transparent clothing, erotic framing, smoking, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 为 an independent atelier of tactile coastal fashion 打造一套高端、超写实的编辑时尚摄影三联画宣传活动。分析品牌的原型、美学、理念和目标受众生活方式，再根据分析自主生成一位体现品牌精神的明确成年人物缪斯；由品牌语义决定其性别呈现、18岁以上年龄、外貌、醒目特征和富有魅力的姿态。不要模仿或点名任何在世摄影师，使用原创的电影感特写、原始触感时尚编辑和艺术电影式视觉语言。创作一个连贯的三幅版面，垂直堆叠为顶部、中部和底部面板，全部采用亲密紧凑构图。顶部面板：强烈的电影感头肩肖像，聚焦富有表现力的眼睛和面部，突出自然皮肤纹理与情感。中部面板：紧凑裁切一个处于运动或静止状态的身体局部，例如握住道具的手、颈部与肩部姿态，或不吸烟的端正嘴部姿势；在不展示全身的情况下传达人物态度。底部面板：极致微距特写，表现与 an independent atelier of tactile coastal fashion 相关的独特服装面料、珠宝、象征性道具或环境抽象纹理。造型应是前卫高级时装，可加入符合品牌气质的意外配饰、并置服装或克制的刻意荒诞感。画面必须原始、昂贵、有触感且统一。使用强烈胶片颗粒、高度细致的毛孔与织物编织、真实景深，以及根据品牌DNA从明暗对比、彩色滤光、刺眼阳光或阴郁阴影中选择的大胆电影化戏剧光线；色彩采用与 an independent atelier of tactile coastal fashion 和谐相关的精致编辑调色。禁止裸露、透明服装、性化构图、吸烟、水印和logo。

items.title: 高端生活方式杂志感社交媒体设计
items.description: A reusable bilingual social-media art-direction template for {{subject}}, combining modern-retro typography, an asymmetric modular grid, editorial photography, tactile paper surfaces, and a relaxed coastal lifestyle mood.
items.prompt: Design a social-media post for a relaxed coastal summer lifestyle campaign with bold editorial art direction and a premium lifestyle-magazine aesthetic. Use modern-retro typography with condensed display type and oversized headlines, an asymmetric modular grid, generous negative space, tactile paper-like surfaces, clean photographic cutouts, warm natural sunlight, and soft shadows. Keep a restrained pastel palette on muted cream backgrounds, with teal accents, occasional saturated color blocks, and smooth tonal transitions. Combine high-contrast editorial photography with playful image crops, thin rules, minimal icons, and a structured information hierarchy. Keep the overall atmosphere relaxed and coastal. No clutter, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 为 a relaxed coastal summer lifestyle campaign 设计一张社交媒体帖子，采用大胆的编辑艺术指导和高端生活方式杂志美学。使用现代复古排版、紧凑的展示字体、超大标题、非对称模块化网格、大量留白、触感纸张表面、干净的照片剪切、温暖自然阳光和柔和阴影。以柔和奶油色背景承载克制的低饱和色调，加入青蓝色点缀、少量饱和色块和平滑色调过渡。结合高对比度编辑摄影、俏皮图像裁剪、细线、极简图标和结构化信息层级。整体保持轻松的海滨氛围。不要杂乱、水印或logo。

items.title: 纪念仪式感几何建筑海报设计
items.description: A reusable bilingual geometric poster template that turns a theme's most recognizable short symbol into a monumental typographic-architectural anchor descending into a perspective memorial platform, with bright negative space and restrained paper-print texture.
items.prompt: Create a geometric poster with a solemn memorial-ceremony feeling around the preservation of quiet city memories. Organize the reading on a strong central axis. Keep about half of the frame as bright, relaxed, light-colored negative space with the title 静默纪念 suspended within it; let the subtitle A MONUMENT FOR ORDINARY LIGHT sit below in thinner, smaller, widely tracked centered lines. Enlarge the theme's most recognizable short symbol into an overwhelming bold geometric visual anchor, allowing it to descend from the white space into a perspective memorial platform built from horizontal color blocks. The platform expands step by step from a narrow top near the visual center downward and beyond the boundaries, creating an upward-looking scale, stable center of gravity, and top-to-bottom ritual reading path. The giant symbol and platform must share colors and a vertical axis, appearing inseparable as both text and architecture. Layer the platform with adjacent light and dark strip modules, clear edges, and soft dark bands pressing selected seams to create restrained step depth while retaining flat-vector simplicity. Use upright, low-contrast Chinese sans-serif title lettering with medium-to-thick weight and relaxed spacing; use a heavy geometric skeleton, square terminals, and compact counters for the giant symbol. Embed a minimalist light-colored silhouette emblem derived from the theme in the platform's middle section. Beneath it place ARCHIVE 026, then two lines of widely spaced short sentences: what remains becomes structure and light holds the center. Keep only low-contrast Edition 01 · Visual Research Unit at corners and bottom edges. Determine all hues from the theme semantics: the brightest, lowest-saturation theme light color fills the large background; a deeper, more saturated theme core color carries the symbol and platform, progressing through dark top, stable mid-tone, and brighter foreground levels. Use a dark core-color text or light reverse text, a few small bright related-color circles at the platform edge, and one larger pale circular light spot cropped from the negative-space edge. Use high-brightness diffused light, fine paper-fiber texture, uniform particles in light areas, and thin spray-dot mist at white-space edges and color-block boundaries. Preserve slight ink absorption and transparent overlap while keeping outlines flat and clear, never stained or damaged. A large low-transparency cropped emblem may sink into the foreground platform for depth without competing with the giant symbol. Maintain approximately half light negative space, nearly half symbol and platform, and very few accents. The result should be bright, gentle, solemn, monumental, and cohesive. No clutter, decorative excess, heavy peripheral information, broken symbol/platform separation, texture covering outlines, logo, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 围绕 the preservation of quiet city memories 创建一张具有庄重纪念仪式感的几何海报，以强中轴组织阅读。让画面约一半保持明亮、松弛的浅色留白，将标题 静默纪念 悬置其中；副标题 A MONUMENT FOR ORDINARY LIGHT 使用更细、更小、明显加宽字距的字体，分行居中置于标题下方。将主题最具识别度的简短符号放大为压倒性的粗重几何视觉锚点，使它从留白区向下跨入由水平色块搭成的透视纪念台。台体从靠近视觉中心的窄顶向下逐级扩展并延伸出画面边界，形成仰望式尺度、稳定重心和由上至下的仪式性阅读路径。巨大符号与台体必须共享色彩和垂直轴线，既像文字又像建筑，二者不可分离。台体使用明暗相邻的宽条模块分层，每层边缘清晰，局部以柔和暗带压住接缝，在保持平面矢量简练的同时产生克制的台阶深度。标题使用端正、低笔画反差的中文无衬线字，中等偏粗字重与舒展字距；巨大符号采用厚重几何骨架、方整端部与紧凑内部空间。台体中段嵌入由主题提炼的极简浅色剪影徽记；其下排列 ARCHIVE 026，再以两行疏朗短句 what remains becomes structure 和 light holds the center 形成节奏停顿。角落与底缘只保留低对比的 Edition 01 · Visual Research Unit。全部色相由主题语义决定：最亮、最低饱和的主题浅色承担大面积背景，较深且高饱和的主题核心色承担巨大符号与纪念台，并在暗顶、稳定中间调和更明亮前景之间作同色系递进。文字使用核心色深色版本或浅色反白；在台体边缘加入少量高明度近似色圆形点缀，并从留白边缘裁切一枚更大、更淡的圆形光斑。背景呈高明度漫射光与细密纸纤维触感，浅色区域有均匀微粒，留白边缘和色块交界叠加轻薄喷点云雾。印刷色块保留轻微吸墨与透明叠色，轮廓仍平整清楚，不形成污渍或强烈破损。前景可让主题派生的简化徽记以低透明度、大尺度、局部裁切的方式沉入台体，增强纵深但不争夺巨大符号。保持浅色留白约一半、巨大符号与透视台体近一半、点缀极少的面积秩序。整体明亮、温和、庄重、纪念碑式且凝聚。避免杂乱、装饰过多、外围信息过重、符号与台体分家、纹理遮盖轮廓、logo和水印。

items.title: 治愈系柔和水彩城市明信片海报
items.description: A reusable bilingual 3:4 city postcard template with a single city-specific watercolor scene, small everyday figures, airy paper space, configurable local details, and integrated bilingual typography.
items.prompt: Create a 3:4 vertical soft-watercolor city poster with a warm handmade postcard feeling for Lisbon. Place the city name “Lisbon” prominently in the upper area and the English emotional phrase “a little light by the sea” just below it in a small soft handwritten or lightly editorial style, with generous breathing space. Show one cohesive, simple, friendly city-specific scene rather than a crowded landmark collage: include one signature landmark, street, coastline, hill, village, canal, park, harbor, old-town lane, or neighborhood corner of Lisbon, one or two small human figures enjoying a peaceful everyday moment, and the supporting local details yellow tram rails, blue-tiled facades, and a quiet hillside lookout. Before drawing, identify one visual anchor, one everyday lifestyle moment, one local environmental or cultural detail, and one calm composition specific to Lisbon. Use delicate pencil sketch lines and soft brown hand-drawn outlines; keep any faces minimal and friendly. Use a refreshing summer palette: 75% cool blues and blue-grays, 15% clean white and warm off-white paper highlights, and 10% pale lemon, butter, cream, or light-gold accents. Blue must dominate; use yellow only as refined accents and never as an all-blue flat background. Use translucent washes, soft blue bleeding, pigment granulation, wet-on-dry texture, gentle brush blooms, pale layered shadows, visible cold-pressed paper grain, minimal splashes, and delicate watery reflections where appropriate. Reserve clean space above for the typography, place the main subject slightly below center, keep the background clean and airy, and add only a few tiny watercolor doodles such as hearts, dots, stars, flowers, clouds, leaves, or underline marks. The mood is comforting, cheerful, peaceful, refreshing, low-saturation, and handmade. No photorealism, clutter, dense landmark collage, heavy paint, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张3:4纵向柔和水彩城市海报，为 Lisbon 营造温暖的手工明信片感。将城市名称“Lisbon”显著放在上方区域，并在下方用小号、柔和的手写体或轻盈社论风格加入英文情感短语“a little light by the sea”，周围保留充足呼吸空间。展示一个连贯、简单、友好的城市特定水彩场景，而不是拥挤的地标拼贴：包含一个属于 Lisbon 的标志性地标、街道、海岸线、山丘、乡村、运河、公园、港口、老城区巷子或邻里街角；安排一两个享受平静日常时光的小人物，并加入 yellow tram rails、blue-tiled facades 和 a quiet hillside lookout 这些当地细节。绘制前确定一个城市视觉锚点、一个日常生活瞬间、一个当地环境或文化细节，以及一个专属于 Lisbon 的宁静构图。使用精致铅笔线条和柔和棕色手绘轮廓；人物面部保持简略友好。采用清新的夏日配色：75%冷蓝与蓝灰，15%干净白色和暖米白纸张高光，10%淡柠檬黄、柔和黄油色、阳光奶油色或浅金色点缀。蓝色必须占主导，黄色只能作为精致点缀，不要制作全蓝色平铺背景。使用半透明晕染、柔和蓝色渗色、颜料颗粒、干叠色纹理、轻柔水渍、浅淡分层阴影、可见冷压水彩纸纹理、少量溅渍和适当的水面反射。顶部为文字留出干净空间，主要主体略置于中心偏下，背景保持通透，仅添加少量爱心、圆点、星星、花朵、云朵、叶子或下划线等小水彩涂鸦。整体舒适、愉快、宁静、清新、低饱和且有手工感。不要写实、杂乱、密集地标拼贴、厚涂或水印。

items.title: 东方古风人物志剪纸拼贴海报
items.description: A reusable bilingual 3:4 editorial collage template for a clearly adult ancient-style character profile, combining realistic full-body photography, partial paper-cut edges, dynasty object catalogs, and an archival research layout.
items.prompt: Create a 3:4 Oriental ancient-style character profile editorial collage poster featuring a full-body clearly adult character. Use late Qing dynasty as the historical reference, an adult scholar-official as the character's role, a structured dark teal changshan with an embroidered outer robe as the clothing direction, a folding fan, inkstone, seal, bamboo manuscript case, and porcelain cup as three to five cataloged objects, a quiet courtyard archive with old timber architecture as the environmental setting, seal-script motifs, paper labels, textile swatches, and archival notes as cultural motifs and research materials, and ink black, warm ivory, dark teal, muted ochre, and vermilion as the main color palette. Make the character highly realistic, with natural body proportions, real skin and hair, natural eyes and movement, authentic clothing materials, and natural light and shadows in a real scene. Give the clothing both period representativeness and high-end design sense; avoid studio costumes and historical-drama stills. Use a partial paper-cut sticker effect: keep slightly irregular warm off-white paper edges and light shadows around the main body contour, while hair, sleeves, hands holding objects, and some clothing corners blend naturally into the collage without a thick complete white border. Use a warm off-white Xuan-paper or old-catalog-paper background. Arrange three auxiliary collage groups around the character: environmental photos for a quiet courtyard archive with old timber architecture, still-life catalog images for a folding fan, inkstone, seal, bamboo manuscript case, and porcelain cup, and seal-script motifs, paper labels, textile swatches, and archival notes, lettering, clothing textures, and research material. Keep the main character in full color and reduce saturation appropriately in auxiliary images. Use cut paper, torn edges, tape, slight rotation, and layering for an Oriental archive-collage feel. At the top, add the Chinese calligraphy title “东方人物志” and the English subtitle “ORIENTAL CHARACTER ARCHIVE”. Include small catalog information for the dynasty, identity, objects, color system, location, and archive number, plus restrained annotations and vermilion seals. Keep 25%–35% overall white space. Avoid CG feel, plastic skin, fantasy special effects, stiff poses, incorrect clothing, random objects, overcrowded collage, cheap costume styling, and thick white sticker edges.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张3:4东方古风人物志编辑拼贴海报，以一名全身完整出镜的明确成年人物为主视觉。以 late Qing dynasty 作为历史参考，以 an adult scholar-official 作为人物身份，以 a structured dark teal changshan with an embroidered outer robe 作为服饰方向，以 a folding fan, inkstone, seal, bamboo manuscript case, and porcelain cup 作为三至五件图录器物，以 a quiet courtyard archive with old timber architecture 作为环境场景，以 seal-script motifs, paper labels, textile swatches, and archival notes 作为文化纹样与研究资料，以 ink black, warm ivory, dark teal, muted ochre, and vermilion 作为主色调。人物应高度写实，具有自然身体比例、真实皮肤与发丝、自然眼神和动作、可信服装材质，以及实景自然光影。服装既要有时代代表性，也要有高级设计感；避免影楼戏服和历史剧照感。采用局部剪纸贴片效果：主要身体轮廓保留轻微不规则的暖米白纸边与浅阴影，发丝、衣袖、持物手部和部分衣角自然融入拼贴，不要完整粗白边。使用暖米白宣纸或旧图录纸张背景。围绕人物安排三组辅助拼贴：a quiet courtyard archive with old timber architecture 的环境照片、a folding fan, inkstone, seal, bamboo manuscript case, and porcelain cup 的静物图录，以及 seal-script motifs, paper labels, textile swatches, and archival notes、文字、服饰纹理和研究资料。主人物保持完整色彩，辅助图片适当降低饱和度，并使用裁纸、撕纸、胶带、轻微旋转和叠压形成东方档案拼贴感。顶部加入中文书法标题“东方人物志”和英文副标题“ORIENTAL CHARACTER ARCHIVE”。加入朝代、身份、器物、色系、地点和Archive编号等小型图录信息，以及克制的批注和朱文印章。整体保留25%至35%的留白。避免CG感、塑料皮肤、仙侠特效、僵硬姿势、错误服饰、随机器物、拼贴过满、廉价古装感和粗白色贴纸边。

items.title: 海风港口防波堤漫步女性写实
items.description: A photorealistic 3:4 harbor portrait of a clearly adult woman walking on a breakwater in strong sea wind, with a calm profile, deep perspective, fishing boats, and vivid maritime textures.
items.prompt: Create a high-precision photorealistic 3:4 vertical full-body portrait in a sunny fishing port. Show a clearly adult woman walking on a breakwater at the center of the frame, wearing an opaque dark-blue full-coverage athletic one-piece outfit under a front-opening white button-down shirt, with the dark-blue pleated skirt worn normally at the waist and held lightly at the front as she walks. Roll the shirt sleeves to the elbows and loosen a dark silk ribbon at the collar; add white ribbed socks and beige low-top sneakers. Her calm profile faces the lower left, with downcast eyes, slightly parted natural coral lips, a soft oval face, straight nose bridge, and short black bob blown to the right by strong sea breeze. Place a smaller seated man in the back right looking up, and small fishing boats on the lower-left sea. Include vivid blue water, moored boats, ropes in the right foreground, rusty bollards, yellow-and-black quay walls, green mountains, a harbor town, and a giant white cumulonimbus cloud in the upper right. Shoot from a low near-ground angle with the entire figure from head to shoes in frame; keep her head in the upper third, advancing shoes toward the bottom right, and use a wide-angle feel to lengthen the leg line while maintaining deep depth of field and a clear background. Use harsh direct sunlight from above, dense short shadows, and water reflections. Show believable opaque fabric folds, natural skin texture, seawater, rust, and hard sunlight in vivid blues and whites. No nudity, erotic posing, exposed intimate areas, transparent clothing, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张高精度照片级真实的3:4竖向全身人像，场景为晴朗的渔港。画面中央是一位明确成年的女性，正在防波堤上行走；她穿着不透明、全覆盖的深蓝色运动连体服，外搭前开扣白衬衫，深蓝褶裙正常穿在腰部并在行走时轻轻扶在身前。衬衫袖子卷至肘部，领口系着一条松开的深色丝带；搭配白色罗纹袜和米色低帮运动鞋。她面向画面左下方呈现平静侧脸，目光低垂，珊瑚色自然唇微微张开，面部轮廓柔和卵形，鼻梁直挺；黑色短博布发被强劲海风吹向画面右侧。画面右后方安排一名较小的坐着的男性抬头望向她，左下方海面上有小型渔船。加入鲜艳蓝色海面、停泊渔船、右前景绳索、生锈系船柱、黄黑色岸壁、远处绿色山峦与港口小镇，以及右上方巨大的白色积雨云。从接近地面的低机位拍摄，头到鞋完整入镜；头部位于上三分之一，前进的鞋子朝向右下方，以广角感拉长腿部线条，同时保持深景深和清晰背景。使用来自上方的强烈直射阳光，形成浓密短促的影子与水面反射。表现可信的不透明面料褶皱、自然皮肤纹理、海水、锈迹和硬质阳光，整体以鲜艳蓝白色为主。禁止裸露、性化姿势、暴露私密部位、透明服装、水印和logo。

items.title: 夏日超广角写实人像摄影提示词
items.description: A reusable bilingual template for an energetic, photorealistic summer lifestyle portrait of a clearly adult woman reclining on a lawn, photographed from a very low ultra-wide angle with a reaching-hand foreground gesture.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic ultra-wide summer portrait of a clearly adult woman with natural features and shoulder-length hair wearing a modest Y2K-inspired tennis outfit with an opaque top and full-coverage bottoms, using grass green, white, and sky blue as the main color palette, with a paperback book, canvas tote, and water bottle as lifestyle props and a distant modern skyline, trees, and a pedestrian bridge in the distance. Use a 9:16 aspect ratio. If a reference image is provided, use it only for composition, camera angle, and body pose; do not copy its exact clothing or props. Show the clearly adult woman lying naturally on a large green lawn. Shoot from a very low position with a 0.5x ultra-wide lens, around 14–16mm equivalent, and a strong 25–35 degree Dutch angle. Preserve the signature pose: one arm reaches directly toward the lens so the open hand becomes a large foreground element, while the face remains clear in the midground and both legs extend diagonally toward an upper corner to create strong near-big/far-small perspective. Offset the legs slightly instead of tightly overlapping them; keep the knees naturally extended and the line from thighs to ankles continuous. Make the foreground hand dramatic without covering too much of the body. Let loose hair rest naturally on the grass with soft volume, flyaway strands, and a light breeze. Render realistic skin texture, natural facial features, lively eyes, authentic fabric folds, and believable outdoor sunlight. Keep the environment bright, airy, spacious, and believable, with a summer lawn, blue sky, distant modern city architecture, trees, and subtle urban infrastructure. Style: realistic lifestyle fashion photography, spontaneous summer snapshot, strong depth, playful camera interaction, and subtle film texture. No sexualized framing, no nudity, no transparent clothing, and no text or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张写实的超广角夏日人像，主体为 a clearly adult woman with natural features and shoulder-length hair，穿着 a modest Y2K-inspired tennis outfit with an opaque top and full-coverage bottoms，以 grass green, white, and sky blue 为主色调，加入 a paperback book, canvas tote, and water bottle 作为生活方式道具，远处呈现 a distant modern skyline, trees, and a pedestrian bridge。画面比例为 9:16。如果提供参考图，只参考构图、相机角度和身体姿势，不复制参考图中的具体服装或道具。让这位明确成年的女性自然地躺在大片绿草坪上。使用极低机位和0.5倍超广角镜头，约14–16mm等效焦距，并采用25–35度强烈荷兰角。保留标志性姿势：一只手臂直接伸向镜头，让张开的手掌成为巨大的前景元素；面部在中景保持清晰；双腿向画面上方一角对角线延伸，形成强烈的近大远小透视。两条腿略微错开，不要紧密重叠；膝盖自然伸展，大腿到脚踝保持连贯线条。前景手部要有戏剧感，但不要遮挡过多身体。头发自然散落在草地上，带有柔和蓬松感、飞散发丝和微风效果。呈现真实皮肤纹理、自然面部特征、生动眼神、可信的织物褶皱和真实的户外阳光。环境应明亮、通透、开阔且可信，包括夏日草坪、蓝天、远处现代城市建筑、树木和不抢眼的城市基础设施。风格为写实生活时尚摄影、自发的夏日抓拍、强烈纵深、与相机的俏皮互动和微妙胶片质感。禁止性化构图、裸露、透明服装、文字和水印。

items.title: 极简光影创意产品广告提示词
items.description: A reusable bilingual template for a minimalist product advertisement in which a small product casts a large, benefit-shaped shadow. The visual claim should be immediately legible without explanatory copy.
items.prompt: Create a 2x2 contact sheet in a 16:9 canvas, with four variations of a minimalist product advertisement. Use a compact reusable water bottle as the small physical object and keeps water cold throughout a long day as the single benefit it communicates. In each variation, make the object and the benefit it suggests clearly different: the cast shadow is the benefit made visible. Design a plausible, instantly readable transition from object-shadow to idea-shadow. Use one hard light source whose position is physically supported by the shadow angle, and choose one receiving surface per variation: a wall, floor, inside corner, or draped fabric. Let the shadow soften naturally with distance from the object. Keep the product small and the shadow large so the idea outranks the object. Leave the frame nearly empty and let negative space carry the argument. Use clean single-source lighting, a true-black shadow core, one wall and one floor where appropriate, and no competing texture. Show a slightly imperfect honest surface with faint dust in the beam. No explanatory copy, no second visual idea, and no second light source. The claim must be understandable in under two seconds without assistance. Keep all four variations consistent in visual restraint and photographic realism.
items.prompt_zh: 在16:9画布中制作一个2x2四宫格联系页，呈现四个极简产品广告变体。将 a compact reusable water bottle 作为画面中较小的实体物件，将 keeps water cold throughout a long day 作为它要传达的单一益处。每个变体都要让物体本身与它所暗示的益处明显不同：投射的影子就是可见化的益处。设计从物体影子过渡为创意影子的可信、易读过程。每个变体使用一个硬光源，光源位置应能由影子的角度在物理上得到支持；接影表面分别可选墙面、地面、内角或垂坠织物。让影子随着远离物体而自然变软。产品保持较小，影子保持较大，让创意胜过物体。画面几乎留空，用负空间承载广告论点。使用干净的单光源照明、影子核心的纯黑效果，并在合适时只保留一面墙和一块地面，不让纹理与形状竞争。呈现略带瑕疵的真实表面，以及光束中隐约可见的灰尘。禁止解释性文案、第二个视觉创意和第二个光源。观者应能在不到两秒、无人辅助的情况下理解主张。四个变体保持统一的克制感与摄影写实质感。

items.prompt_zh:

items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的人物身份参考图保留明确成年主要女性的面部身份。创作一张3:4竖版生活方式人像：她坐在有生活感的独居居室沙发上，从斜前方视角拍摄，自然带出大腿、肩膀和手臂。她喝着热咖啡，并将咖啡碟放在大腿上，表情放松但不直视镜头。将来源中“用头发代替衣物”的想法改为完整遮盖的高领居家长袍，衣料从锁骨至肋骨并覆盖腿部，自然垂坠；长发只作为造型元素，不得替代衣物。使用真实手部、杯子、咖啡碟、衣料褶皱、自然皮肤纹理、柔和室内光和普通非性化生活氛围。负面：裁切取景、面部被遮挡、手部扭曲、裸体、透明衣物、乳房裸露、性化姿势、文字、水印。

items.title: 高级梦幻手作纸艺拼接风景人像
items.description: 将上传的人物身份参考融入高级手工纸艺乡村透视模型，保留完整端庄的时尚造型与写实人物质感。
items.prompt:

Build a dimensional countryside scene from textured paper: layered blue-green mountains, forested rolling hills, a muted-blue lake, grassy lakeside, warm-beige paper path, rustic white fence, and a pale blush-and-blue pastel sky. Frame the lower corners with oversized handmade flowers in dusty pink, blush, cream, peach, ivory, and soft lavender with sage leaves. Add floating paper hearts, golden-yellow and pale-blue stars, soft white and pale-blue clouds, and tiny pastel dots. Place a tiny cream vintage camper van and a muted sage-blue vintage car near the lake.

Keep the woman photorealistic and seamlessly integrated with the paper world. Show hand-torn edges, paper fibers, layered cardstock, realistic paper shadows, tactile texture, soft natural daylight, cinematic depth, gentle atmospheric perspective, natural skin, and a dreamy dusty-rose, taupe, sage, and cream palette. Use a vertical 4:5 portrait composition, sharp face, full-body framing, and the woman as the strongest focal point. Avoid immature styling, nudity, sexual content, distorted anatomy, CGI, anime, text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:

用有纹理的纸张构成立体乡村场景：远方蓝绿色层叠山脉、绿色森林与起伏丘陵、低饱和蓝色湖泊、湖畔草地、暖米色纸质小径、质朴白色木栅栏和浅粉蓝粉彩天空。用藕粉、浅粉、奶油、桃色、象牙白和淡紫色的大型手工纸花及鼠尾草绿叶框住下方角落。天空中加入漂浮的纸心、金黄色与淡蓝色星星、柔和的白色和淡蓝色云朵及微小彩色纸点；湖边放置一辆奶油色复古露营车和一辆鼠尾草蓝复古车。
