items.title: 大胆排版商业海报视觉设计
items.description: 可编辑的商业活动主视觉模板：让超大主词承担阴影、框架、光影或路径等明确视觉功能，并与人物或产品及摄影共同构成完整海报。
items.prompt:
Create a bold 9:16 vertical editorial campaign poster. Use these editable defaults: brand = NORTHLINE; product/campaign = MOTION STUDY; main word = TRACE; subject/product = product; typography function = route; main color = cobalt blue; accent color = warm orange; campaign details = MOTION STUDY / 2026. Use contemporary editorial design, realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, and a strong high-contrast color system. Make the main word occupy about 50–75% of the composition; it may extend beyond the canvas, crop, overlap the subject, or use negative space. Give the typography one clear meaningful visual function: cast shadows across the subject, frame the product, shape the lighting, create a movement path, or organize the scene. Make the subject or product interact naturally with the typography so text, photography, and graphics form one composition.

Use one dominant color with a contrasting secondary color, black, white, and only a small accent. Add a few organized, relevant campaign details such as brand, product, slogan, specifications, labels, route information, or short editorial text; avoid random filler. Keep people, products, materials, lighting, and shadows realistic and polished. The result should feel like a finished commercial key visual: bold, colorful, editorial, and complete. Avoid generic subject-plus-text layouts, typography with no function, implausible occlusion or shadows, clutter, excessive UI graphics, unreadable text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张大胆的9:16竖版编辑活动海报。使用以下可编辑默认值：品牌=NORTHLINE；产品/活动=MOTION STUDY；主词=TRACE；主体/产品=产品；排版功能=路径；主色=钴蓝；强调色=暖橙；活动细节=MOTION STUDY / 2026。使用现代编辑设计、真实商业摄影、超大排版和强烈高对比色彩系统。让主词占构图约50%–75%，可以超出画布、被裁切、与主体重叠或利用负空间。赋予排版一个明确而有意义的视觉功能：在主体上投射阴影、为产品构建框架、塑造光线、创建运动路径或组织场景。让主体或产品与排版自然互动，使文字、摄影和图形成为一个完整构图。

使用一种主色搭配对比辅助色、黑色、白色和少量强调色。加入少量组织清晰且与概念相关的活动细节，如品牌、产品、标语、规格、标签、路径信息或短编辑文字，避免随机填充词。人物、产品、材质、灯光和阴影要真实精致。最终像完成的商业主视觉：大胆、色彩丰富、编辑感强且完整。避免平庸的主体加文字布局、没有功能的字体、不可信的遮挡或阴影、杂乱、过多UI图形、不可读文字、Logo和水印。

items.title: 手绘风格创意旅行海报插画
items.description: 为指定国家制作4:5连续手绘旅行日记海报插画，将地标、建筑、景观、文化、美食、交通和街头细节融合于温暖纸面，使用2–3种柔和点缀色。
items.prompt:
Create a premium 4:5 vertical illustrated travel-journal poster for the editable country input, default Japan. Make one continuous flowing hand-drawn ink illustration in which architecture, landscape, culture, food, transport, nature, and everyday details merge into one playful scene. Use simplified shapes, expressive lines, slightly exaggerated proportions, whimsical perspective, imperfect hand-drawn contours, delicate cross-hatching, loose sketch marks, bold black ink outlines, and subtle screen-print texture. The artwork must be intentionally non-photorealistic and mostly flat, with minimal shading and no realistic lighting.

Include one dominant iconic landmark, a second architectural landmark woven subtly into the composition, a recognizable natural landscape, simplified local transportation, traditional clothing or cultural detail, a recognizable local food or drink, small fictionalized street-life moments, and integrated birds, clouds, plants, and decorative details. Add handwritten illustrated labels pointing to selected elements. Use a warm off-white paper background with generous clean negative space and only 2–3 muted accent colors inspired by the country, with slight traditional screen-print imperfection.

At the top, add a large playful hand-lettered country title. Below it, add the exact small subtitle “A little world to discover”. Keep the result whimsical, editorial, nostalgic, artistic, and handcrafted like an imaginary vintage travel sketchbook page. Avoid photorealism, realistic photography, cinematic realism, hyperrealistic people, realistic textures, 3D, glossy surfaces, gradients, dramatic light, realistic faces, overly precise architecture, excessive colors, digital-perfect geometry, generic tourist-poster layouts, unreadable labels, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
为可编辑的国家输入创作一张高级4:5竖版插图旅行日记海报，默认国家为Japan。制作一张连续流动的手绘墨水插画，将建筑、景观、文化、美食、交通、自然和日常生活细节自然融合为一个充满趣味的场景。使用简化形状、富有表现力的线条、略显夸张的比例、奇思妙想的透视、不完美手绘轮廓、精细交叉排线、松散草图痕迹、大胆黑色墨线和细微丝网印刷纹理。画面要刻意非写实并以扁平图形为主，阴影极少，不使用写实光影。

包含一个占主导地位的标志性地标、一个巧妙编织进构图的第二建筑地标、可辨识的自然景观、简化的当地交通工具、传统服饰或文化细节、一种可辨识的当地美食或饮品、小型虚构街头生活瞬间，以及融入其中的鸟、云、植物和装饰细节。加入指向选定元素的手写插图标签。使用温暖米白纸张背景和充足洁净留白，只使用2–3种从该国获得灵感的柔和点缀色，并保留传统丝网印刷般的轻微不完美。

顶部加入大型趣味手写国家标题，下方加入准确的小型副标题“A little world to discover”。整体应奇幻、具有编辑感、怀旧、艺术化且有手工气息，像想象中的复古旅行素描本一页。避免照相写实主义、写实摄影、电影感写实、超写实人物、写实纹理、3D、光滑表面、渐变、戏剧性光影、写实脸部、过于精确的建筑、过多颜色、数字完美几何、平庸旅游海报布局、不可读标签、Logo和水印。

items.title: 冰棍里的微缩城市景观摄影
items.description: 将城市目的地的地标与文化元素冻结在透明冰棍内部，制作4:5超写实旅行概念摄影；城市、地标和建筑为可编辑输入，手部仅作自然持棒动作。
items.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic 4:5 vertical conceptual travel photograph using these editable defaults: city/country = Kyoto, Japan; iconic landmark = Kiyomizu-dera; local architecture = traditional machiya. Freeze the essence of the destination inside a crystal-clear ice popsicle centered in the frame. Build a sharp miniature 3D world inside the ice with the landmark as hero, surrounded by recognizable local architecture, flowering trees, a small café, street furniture, and restrained cultural details. The miniature world must appear physically embedded and frozen in time.

Make the popsicle realistic with clear ice, frozen bubbles, tiny cracks, edge frost, melting droplets, internal condensation, imperfections, translucent depth, and physically accurate refraction and reflections. Place it against a softly blurred real street scene of the same city, contrasting ordinary reality with the magical frozen miniature. A natural human hand enters from below holding the wooden stick, with realistic skin texture, fingerprints, and creases; the hand is only a supporting product interaction and does not require a fixed identity. Use cinematic travel and macro photography, shallow depth of field, soft golden daylight, subtle lens compression, beautiful bokeh, natural colors, and clean foreground-to-background depth. Keep the popsicle and landmark sharp, centered, and text-free. Avoid invented local facts or landmarks, generic travel clichés, artificial ice, implausible scale, distorted hand or fingers, extra people, HDR excess, CGI plasticity, 3D-rendered look, logos, text, watermarks, and unsupported resolution claims.
items.prompt_zh:
使用以下可编辑默认值创作一张超写实的4:5竖版概念旅行摄影：城市/国家=日本京都；标志性地标=清水寺；当地建筑=传统町屋。将目的地精髓冻结在画面中央一根晶莹剔透的冰棍内部。冰层中构建清晰的微缩3D世界，以地标为主体，周围有可辨识的当地建筑、开花树木、小咖啡馆、街道家具和克制的文化细节。微缩世界必须像真实嵌入冰层并被冻结在时间中。

冰棍要呈现真实透明冰块、冻结气泡、细小裂纹、边缘霜、融化液滴、内部冷凝、微妙瑕疵、半透明深度以及物理准确的折射和反射。将冰棍置于同一城市真实且柔和虚化的街景前，在平凡现实与神奇冷冻微缩世界之间形成对比。一只自然的人手从底部握住木质冰棍棒，具有真实皮肤纹理、指纹和细小褶皱；手部只是产品互动，不需要固定身份。使用电影感旅行摄影与微距摄影、浅景深、柔和金色日光、轻微镜头压缩、美丽虚化、自然色彩和清楚的前后景纵深。冰棍与地标保持清晰居中，画面无文字。避免虚构地方事实或地标、通用旅游陈词滥调、不真实冰块、不可信尺度、畸形手部或手指、额外人物、过度HDR、CG塑料感、3D渲染感、Logo、文字、水印和无依据的分辨率承诺。

items.title: 雨中神社参道成年女性手机自拍
items.description: 将上传身份参考融入八重神子灵感的成年女性雨中神社自拍，保留粉色长发、改良水手服、透明伞、朱红鸟居、湿石阶、广角手机构图和雨风氛围。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference image for the facial identity of the clearly adult main subject, while retaining the source's Yae Miko-inspired pink hair and shrine-fantasy styling. Create a realistic 9:16 vertical mobile-phone selfie on a modern shrine path in the rain. She holds the phone forward and upward with her left arm, naturally enlarged in the upper-left foreground; her right hand holds a transparent umbrella with the pole at frame-right. She is center-right, fully visible from head to shoes, looking down into the lens with a composed playful smile, weight on one leg and the other lightly touching wet stone steps. Wind moves her long pink hair and skirt sideways.

Dress her in a white modified sailor-style top with deep purple-red collar edges, fine gold motifs, a loosened deep-red bow, and a fitted but fully covered neckline; pair it with a deep-purple plaid pleated short skirt, semi-transparent white thigh-high stockings with fine lace edges, black loafers, and small gold gohei-shaped ear pendants. Keep the adult presentation clothed and non-explicit, with natural proportions and realistic fabric and stocking texture.

Show a transparent umbrella with sharp raindrops, wet dark-gray stone steps with puddles, ripples, reflections, and cherry-colored petals, vermilion torii gates, stone lanterns, manicured greenery, blurred city lights, and a small white car outside. Use bright cool overcast scatter light with warm contrast from torii and pink hair; preserve fine highlights on umbrella, wet steps, and rain-clinging fabric, subtle phone grain, natural exposure, and mild 24mm wide-angle character without fisheye distortion. Avoid underage appearance, nudity, explicit sexual activity, plastic skin, anime rendering, CGI, distorted anatomy, extra people, incorrect mirror images, harsh commercial lighting, HDR, heavy retouching, watermarks, logos, or unrelated text.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物身份参考图确定明确成年主要人物的面部身份，同时保留来源中受八重神子启发的粉色长发与神社幻想造型。创作一张真实的9:16竖版手机自拍，场景为雨中的现代神社参道。人物左臂向前上方伸出握住手机，手臂在左上前景自然放大；右手握透明伞柄，伞杆位于画面右侧。人物位于中央偏右，从头顶到鞋尖完整入镜，低头看向镜头并带从容俏皮的微笑，单腿承重，另一条腿轻点湿石阶。雨风将粉色长发和裙摆吹向侧后方。

穿白色改良水手服上衣，深紫红领边、细金纹、松开的深红蝴蝶结和贴身但完整遮蔽的领口；搭配深紫格纹百褶短裙、带细蕾丝边的半透明白色长筒丝袜、黑色乐福鞋和耳侧小型金色御币形坠饰。保持成年、穿着完整、非露骨的呈现，自然身体比例以及真实服装和丝袜纹理。

展示有清晰雨滴的透明伞、布满积水和涟漪并带反光的深灰湿石阶、樱色花瓣、朱红鸟居、石灯笼、修剪绿植、远处虚化城市灯光和参道外的小白车。阴雨天空提供明亮冷灰散射光，鸟居与粉发形成暖色对比；保留伞面、湿阶和被雨水贴合面料上的细碎高光、轻微手机颗粒、自然曝光和轻微24mm广角感，但不要鱼眼畸变。避免未成年感、裸露、明确性行为、塑料皮肤、动漫化、CGI、扭曲解剖、多余人物、错误镜像、刺眼商业布光、HDR、重度修图、水印、Logo和无关文字。

items.title: 当代透视排版空间装置海报
items.description: 用可编辑的主词、环境与变形机制制作9:16当代透视排版海报，让超大字体成为空间装置的一部分并保持物理可信和清晰可读。
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical contemporary perspective-typography poster. Use these editable defaults: title word = REFRACT; project = SPATIAL STUDY; environment = water; type mechanism = refraction; subject = none; main color = electric blue. Make the main word occupy about 35–55% of the composition and become part of the scene. Let the letterforms stretch, bend, split, compress, or realign according to the chosen material or optical medium: follow tension and folds on fabric, slopes and valleys on terrain, readable reflected distortion in a mirror, or depth and refraction in water.

Keep perspective, occlusion, reflections, refraction, depth, and surface contact physically believable. Use one strong accent color against a restrained architectural or natural palette. Make the typography bold, clean, and highly legible from the intended viewpoint. If a small person is requested, use them only as a scale reference or observer within the typographic space. Add only a small amount of secondary editorial information such as project name, date, location, and one short thematic line; keep it accurate and readable. The overall result should feel like spatial graphic design and contemporary installation art with strong depth, clean hierarchy, and high visual impact. Avoid generic flat text, random distortion, implausible perspective, clutter, excessive UI graphics, unreadable text, logos, watermarks, or decorative effects unrelated to the chosen environment.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张9:16竖版当代透视排版海报。使用以下可编辑默认值：主词=REFRACT；项目=SPATIAL STUDY；环境=水；字体机制=折射；主体=无；主色调=电光蓝。让主词占构图约35%–55%，并成为场景本身的一部分。根据所选材质或光学介质，让字母进行拉伸、弯曲、分裂、压缩或重新排列：织物上遵循张力和褶皱，地形上包裹斜坡和山谷，镜面中产生仍可读的反射变形，水中利用深度和折射偏移并重新连接字形。

保持透视、遮挡、反射、折射、深度和表面接触在物理上可信。在克制的建筑或自然色调中使用一种强烈强调色。排版要大胆、整洁，并从预定视角保持高度可读。如果用户要求加入小人物，只将其作为排版空间内的比例参考或观察者。只加入少量次要编辑信息，如项目名、日期、地点和一行主题文字，并确保准确清晰。整体应像空间平面设计与当代装置艺术，具有强烈纵深、清晰层级和高视觉冲击力。避免普通平面大字、随机扭曲、不可信透视、杂乱、过多UI图形、不可读文字、Logo、水印或与所选环境无关的装饰效果。

items.title: 80年代复古印度时尚人像
items.description: 将上传的人物照片转换为真实的1980年代印度复古时尚肖像，保持面部身份和自然比例，替换服装、发型、配饰、背景与胶片时代氛围。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference image to preserve the exact facial identity, facial structure, features, skin tone, and natural proportions of the clearly adult woman. Transform the uploaded photo into an authentic 1980s Indian retro fashion portrait without changing or beautifying her face. Dress her in a full-sleeve pink shirt neatly tucked into a black high-waisted skirt with a stylish belt; remove the scarf completely. Add simple 1980s-inspired accessories and bouncy voluminous retro hair finished with a cute ribbon.

Create a believable 1980s background and atmosphere. Use an authentic Kodak film-camera look with warm faded colors, subtle film grain, soft analog texture, gentle period-appropriate lighting, and natural skin texture. It must feel like a genuine photograph taken in the 1980s, not a modern image with a vintage filter. Keep anatomy and clothing construction natural. No watermark, no text, no distortion, and no face alteration.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物身份参考图保持明确成年女性完全一致的面部身份、面部结构、五官、肤色和自然比例。将上传的照片转换为真实的1980年代印度复古时尚肖像，不要改变或美化她的脸。让她穿长袖粉色衬衫，整齐塞入黑色高腰裙，配一条时尚腰带；完全去掉围巾。加入简洁的1980年代风格配饰，并将头发做成蓬松丰盈的复古发型，用可爱丝带装饰。

营造可信的1980年代背景与氛围。使用真实柯达胶片相机质感、温暖褪色、细微胶片颗粒、柔和模拟纹理、符合年代的温和复古光线和自然皮肤纹理。画面应像一张真正拍摄于1980年代的照片，而不是现代照片套复古滤镜。保持人体和服装结构自然。不要水印、文字、畸变或面部身份改变。

items.title: 创意手工纸艺微缩景观与写实成年女性
items.description: 以上传人物参考图为唯一人物主体，制作4:5全身写实成年女性与手工纸艺乡村微缩景观融合的高级社论画面，保留端庄服装、花束、湖山、栅栏和纸材质。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the only human subject and strict facial-identity reference for the clearly adult woman. Preserve her recognizable face, eyes, brows, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle, hairline, and distinctive features without redesigning, beautifying, aging, de-aging, or replacing her. Create a premium 4:5 vertical full-body editorial image: she stands alone in the center, facing camera with a relaxed confident expression and subtle smile, body slightly angled, holding a small mixed bouquet naturally with both hands, one leg slightly crossed.

Dress her modestly and elegantly in an ivory or cream long-sleeve button-up blouse, high-waisted wide-leg beige trousers with full coverage, simple cream closed-toe shoes, and a small brown leather shoulder bag. Keep realistic fabric folds and no exposed midriff or revealing clothing. Surround her with a handcrafted textured-paper countryside diorama: layered blue mountains, green forest and rolling hills, a peaceful blue lake, grassy shore, beige paper path, rustic white fence behind her, and a dreamy pastel sky. Frame the lower corners with oversized handmade paper flowers in pink, peach, cream, white, and light blue plus layered green leaves. Add paper hearts, stars, clouds, and tiny colored dots in the sky, and two tiny vintage vehicles near the lake: a cream camper van and a blue-green car.

The environment is made from layered cardstock with hand-torn edges, visible fibers, tactile surfaces, dimensional cut-paper elements, realistic paper shadows, subtle handmade imperfections, soft natural daylight, gentle atmospheric perspective, and premium storybook craft. The woman remains photorealistic and seamlessly integrated, with natural skin texture, sharp facial detail, realistic anatomy, and professional editorial photography. Keep her the strongest focal point, with balanced near-symmetry and clear lake-and-mountain depth. Avoid childish features, changing identity, extra people, CGI or plastic skin, cartoon/anime rendering of the woman, clutter, distorted anatomy, harsh light, unreadable text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
将上传的参考图作为唯一人物主体和明确成年女性的严格面部身份依据。保持她可辨识的脸部、眼睛、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、发型、发际线和独特特征，不要重新设计、美化、变老、变年轻或更换面孔。创作一张高级4:5竖版全身社论画面：她独自站在构图中央，面对镜头，表情轻松自信并带自然微笑，身体略微倾斜，双手自然拿着一小束混合花束，一条腿稍微交叉。

让她端庄优雅地穿象牙色或奶油色长袖纽扣衬衫、高腰阔腿米色长裤、完全包头的奶油色鞋子和棕色皮革小挎包。保留真实织物褶皱，不露脐，不使用暴露服装。周围是手工纹理纸艺乡村微缩景观：远处层叠蓝山、绿色森林和起伏丘陵、宁静蓝色湖泊、草地湖岸、米色纸质小径、身后的朴素白色栅栏和梦幻粉彩天空。用粉红、桃色、奶油、白色和浅蓝色的巨大手工纸花及层叠绿叶框住下方两角。天空加入纸质爱心、星星、云朵和微小彩色纸点；湖边背景放置两辆微型复古车，一辆奶油色露营车和一辆蓝绿色小车。

环境全部由层叠卡纸制作，具有手撕边缘、可见纸纤维、触感表面、立体剪纸、真实纸张阴影、细微手工瑕疵、柔和自然日光、温和大气透视和高级故事书工艺。人物保持写实摄影质感并无缝融入纸艺世界，皮肤自然、面部细节清晰、解剖正确，具有专业社论摄影感。人物仍是最强焦点，构图平衡近似对称，湖泊与山脉形成清楚纵深。避免幼稚特征、改变身份、额外人物、CG或塑料皮肤、将人物动漫化、杂乱、扭曲解剖、刺眼光线、不可读文字、Logo和水印。

items.title: 古风极近景半面遮纱东亚女性人像
items.description: 成年东亚女性的9:16古风极近景三分之二侧脸肖像，使用低饱和灰青自然光、风吹碎发、半透明面纱、青灰玉饰与克制暗金细节，并保留指定的自然化Soran标记。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference image for the facial identity of the clearly adult main subject. Create a 9:16 vertical photorealistic ancient-style extreme close-up of an East Asian woman in a two-thirds side profile. She has long dark brown-black classical updo hair with windblown strands crossing forehead, eyes, and nose bridge; she looks toward the distant right side, not at camera, with a quiet, alert, aloof expression. A dark teal and ink-gray-green translucent veil is lifted beside her face and fully covers below the nose tip, lips, and jaw, leaving only eyes, brow bone, and part of the nose bridge clear. Show natural folds, fine mesh, and layered translucency.

Add a forehead ornament of gray-green jade beads, fine gold beads, and staggered long jade pendants. Reveal only part of a dark-gold classical scroll-pattern hair crown on the left, never a complete large crown. Show only a small amount of deep-teal clothing and dark-gold woven shoulder edging. Use soft overcast daylight, low-saturation gray-green and cool-gray tones, natural skin texture, clear eyes, restrained jade shimmer and metallic highlights, and a fully blurred integrated background with shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, soft highlight roll-off, and live-action photography texture.

Integrate the requested three-layer natural mark: clearly readable “Soran” micro-engraved on a small dark-gold connector near the hairline; hidden Soran woven into jade-bead arrangement, veil texture, windblown hair paths, and crown scrollwork; micro Soran formed naturally by bead nodes, chain links, hair intersections, veil fibers, and embroidery stitches. Keep the mark part of the materials, not an external overlay. Avoid direct eye contact, exposed lips, veil below the nose, opaque masks, rhinestone masks, saturated emerald green, a full phoenix crown, bright gold headwear, palace backgrounds, heavy makeup, enlarged eyes, anime, doll-like face, smoothed or oversharpened skin, tidy hair, smoke, magic effects, HDR, CGI, sticker logos, floating text, subtitles, or external watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物身份参考图确定明确成年主要人物的面部身份。创作一张9:16竖幅、真人写实古风极近景人像：一位东亚女性呈三分之二侧脸。她有深棕黑色长发古典盘发，部分发丝被风吹散，横穿额头、眼睛和鼻梁；视线看向画面右侧远处，不看镜头，神情安静、警觉而疏离。深青绿与墨青灰色半透明轻纱从脸侧抬起，完整遮住鼻尖以下、嘴唇和下颌，只让双眼、眉骨与部分鼻梁清晰可见；表现自然褶皱、细密纱纹和轻微透光层次。

额前佩戴青灰玉珠、细金珠和长度错落的长条玉坠垂链额饰。左侧只露出部分暗金古典卷草纹发冠，不要完整大型头冠。肩部仅露出少量深青古风衣料和暗金精细织边。使用柔和阴天自然光、低饱和灰青绿与冷灰色调、真实皮肤纹理、清晰眼睛、克制的玉饰微光和金属高光；背景完全虚化为融合的灰绿冷灰色块，带浅景深、细微胶片颗粒、柔和高光过渡和真人摄影质感。

整合指定的三层自然标记：在靠近发际线的小型暗金连接件上清晰可读地微雕“Soran”；将hidden Soran融入青玉珠串排列、面纱纱纹、风吹发丝路径和发冠卷草纹；让micro Soran自然形成于玉珠节点、链节、发丝交叉、面纱纤维和衣料刺绣针脚中。标记必须属于材质本身，不得像后贴的外部水印。避免正脸直视、嘴唇露出、面纱低于鼻尖、厚重不透明口罩、现代水钻面罩、高饱和翡翠绿、完整凤冠、亮金头饰、复杂宫殿背景、浓妆、放大双眼、动漫、AI娃娃脸、磨皮或过度锐化、整齐发丝、烟雾、法术特效、HDR、CG、贴纸Logo、悬浮文字、字幕和外部水印。

items.title: 南半球小众早餐文化对比海报提示词
items.description: 依据用户输入推理四种被低估的早餐文化，制作统一主题的16:9 2×2区域对比海报，不硬编码国家、食物、色板或未经证实的地方事实。
items.prompt:
Create one premium 16:9 regional comparison poster in a strict 2x2 grid, with four equal panels and one unified cultural theme. Use only inference from the user's inputs: topic category, region set, selection criteria, and mood. Do not hard-code a country, food, breakfast, palette, or the Southern Hemisphere; infer them from the inputs and state no unsupported local facts.

For each panel, infer the category DNA: what is being compared, how it is used, why it matters, and what makes it visually recognizable. Infer regional DNA including environment, visual culture, palette, typography attitude, texture, symbols, landscape, tools, rituals, and social context. Select one overlooked or representative breakfast item that fits the category, region, and criteria. Choose the most suitable hero treatment for each item: plated food, product close-up, ritual scene, tool layout, garment portrait, still life, landscape-backed artifact, map-backed diagram, or symbolic vignette.

Generate a coherent copy system for every panel: a large item title, short emotional tagline, origin/location label, 2–4 tiny descriptors, a stamp or badge phrase, and a brief contextual note. Render the graphic system with inferred torn paper, printed grid, muted or locally appropriate color blocks, topographic lines, stamps, borders, halftone, atlas marks, and editorial spacing. Each panel should feel locally specific yet belong to the same designed poster. Avoid fake local facts, random travel-poster clichés, fixed beige/red/green styling, generic stock imagery, illegible text, and clutter.
items.prompt_zh:
制作一张高级16:9区域文化对比海报，采用严格2×2网格，四个等大面板属于同一统一文化主题。只依据用户输入进行推理：主题类别、区域集合、选择标准和情绪。不要硬编码国家、食物、早餐、调色板或南半球；应从输入推理内容，不添加未经支持的地方事实。

为每个面板推理类别DNA：正在比较什么、如何使用、为什么重要，以及什么使它在视觉上具有辨识度。推理区域DNA，包括当地环境、视觉文化、调色板、排版态度、纹理、符号、景观、工具、仪式和社交背景。为每个区域选择一个符合主题类别、区域和选择标准的被忽视或具有代表性的早餐项目。根据项目选择最合适的主体视觉处理：摆盘食物、产品特写、仪式场景、工具布局、服装肖像、静物、景观背景文物、地图背景图表或象征性片段。

为每个面板生成统一文案系统：大号项目标题、简短情感标语、起源/地点标签、2–4个微型描述词、印章或徽章短语，以及简短上下文备注。图形系统使用推理得到的撕纸、印刷网格、克制或符合当地语境的色块、等高线、印章、边框、半色调、地图集标记和编辑间距。每个面板应具有地方特征，同时属于同一张设计海报。避免虚假地方事实、随机旅游海报陈词滥调、固定米色/红色/绿色风格、通用素材感、不可读文字和杂乱布局。

items.title: 复古拍立得拼贴写实成年女性人像
items.description: 同一成年女性的两张早期数码相机风格拍立得拼贴：保持严格身份一致、俏皮表情差异、浅粉服装、暖色闪光和白色织物背景。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference photo as the only strict identity reference for the clearly adult woman. Preserve her exact recognizable identity across both photos: eye shape, eyelids, brows, nose, lips, jawline, cheekbones, facial proportions, skin tone, and natural skin texture. Create an ultra-realistic early-2000s compact-camera collage on textured white fabric, 9:16 vertical, with two slightly overlapping and tilted vertical Polaroid photos in off-white frames with subtle vintage texture.

Top photo: close-up from head to chest, dark brown almost-black long slightly messy hair with loose strands around the face, soft rosy makeup with brushed-up brows, curled lashes, soft pink blush, and realistic glowing skin. She wears a light-pink tank top with black straps and a thin silver necklace. Against a plain beige-taupe wall, she touches the hair beside her face and makes a playful mischievous expression with exaggerated crossed eyes and a natural slight tongue-out gesture. Bottom photo: similar close-up with the same hair, makeup, outfit, and background; her head is slightly upright and faces camera, with a funny playful duck-face smile and one relaxed peace-sign hand near the cheek.

Use direct compact-camera flash, soft warm tone, subtle grain, sharp facial detail, and natural imperfections. Keep hands and anatomy correct. Add the explicitly requested small handwritten white signature “♡eL” in the collage's bottom-left corner, clean and subtle. Avoid altered identity, different faces, duplicate people or limbs, plastic/waxy skin, beauty filters, CGI, anime, excessive makeup, stiff poses, malformed hands, extra/fused fingers, blurry or low-resolution output, oversharpening, harsh or clipped exposure, clutter, unwanted text, and large watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
将上传的参考照片作为明确成年女性的唯一严格身份依据。两张照片中的她必须保持完全可辨识的相同身份：眼形、眼睑、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇、下颚线、颧骨、面部比例、肤色和自然皮肤纹理都要一致。创作一张超写实的2000年代早期紧凑型数码相机风格拼贴，画面为9:16竖版，铺在有纹理的白色织物上，由两张轻微重叠并倾斜的竖向拍立得照片组成，使用带细微复古纹理的米白色拍立得相框。

顶部照片为从头部到胸部的特写：深棕近黑色长发略显凌乱，散落发丝修饰脸部；妆容柔和玫瑰色，眉毛自然向上刷起，睫毛卷翘，腮红柔粉，皮肤带真实纹理和自然光泽。穿浅粉色背心、黑色肩带和细银项链，背景为纯色米灰褐墙面；她一只手触摸脸侧头发，做出夸张斗鸡眼、俏皮淘气且舌尖自然微吐的表情。底部照片为类似特写，保持相同发型、妆容、服装和背景；头部略微挺直面向镜头，做有趣俏皮的鸭子脸微笑，一只手在脸颊旁做自然放松的剪刀手。

使用直方紧凑型相机闪光灯、柔和暖色调、细微颗粒、清晰面部细节和自然瑕疵。保证手部和人体解剖正确。在拼贴左下角加入明确要求的小型白色手写签名“♡eL”，干净而含蓄。避免改变身份、不同面孔、重复人物或肢体、塑料或蜡质皮肤、美颜滤镜、CGI、动漫、浓重妆容、僵硬姿势、畸形手部、多余或融合手指、模糊低清、过度锐化、刺眼或溢出的曝光、杂乱背景、无关文字和大水印。

items.title: 超写实人物模型参考图设计
items.description: 使用上传的人物参考图制作同一成年人物的超写实角色模型表，系统展示正面、侧面、背面、转视、表情、手部、服装材质与细节特写。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded human reference photo as the only strict identity reference. The same clearly adult person must remain exactly recognizable across the entire photorealistic character model sheet: preserve facial structure, face shape, eyes, brows, nose, lips, jaw, cheekbones, skin tone and texture, hair color, hairstyle, hairline, body proportions, apparent age, and distinctive features. Do not redesign, beautify, change identity, or introduce another person.

Create a clean professional character-reference sheet on one canvas with a clear grid and consistent spacing. Include full-body front, side, and back views; a three-quarter or turn-around sequence; a row of natural facial expressions; hand and finger references; clothing construction and material swatches; and a few useful close-ups of face, hair, accessories, footwear, and garment details. Keep every view consistent in scale, anatomy, outfit, hairstyle, skin tone, and identity. Use neutral studio lighting, a simple uncluttered background, accurate garment fit and physical materials, realistic hair strands, pores, eyes, hands, and natural anatomy. Preserve panel hierarchy and readable separation so the sheet is practical for production reference.

The output should look like high-end photorealistic studio documentation, not a poster or stylized illustration. Avoid cartoons, anime, illustration, 3D characters, CGI, dolls, plastic skin, artificial faces, fantasy redesigns, inconsistent faces or outfits, altered body proportions, extra people, repeated bodies, malformed hands, extra or missing fingers, random accessories, cluttered layout, cropped full-body views, blurred faces, low resolution, excessive smoothing, beauty retouching, painterly texture, watercolors, sketch lines, and unreadable text.
items.prompt_zh:
将上传的人物参考照片作为唯一且严格的身份依据。整张超写实人物模型表中的同一位明确成年人物必须始终完全可辨识：保持面部结构、脸型、眼睛、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌、颧骨、肤色与皮肤纹理、发色、发型、发际线、身体比例、视觉年龄和所有独特特征。不要重新设计、美化、改变身份或加入其他人物。

在一张画布上制作整洁专业的人物参考表，使用清楚的网格和统一间距。包含全身正面、侧面和背面视图；四分之三视角或转视排列；一排自然面部表情；手部和手指参考；服装结构与材质色样；以及脸部、头发、配饰、鞋履和服装细节的实用特写。所有视图在比例、解剖、服装、发型、肤色和身份上保持一致。使用中性影棚光线、简洁不杂乱的背景、准确的服装合体度和物理材质、写实发丝、毛孔、眼睛、手部与自然人体结构。保留面板层级和清晰分隔，使模型表适合制作参考。

成品应像高端写实影棚人物资料，而不是海报或风格化插画。避免卡通、动漫、插画、3D角色、CGI、人偶、塑料皮肤、人造脸、幻想重设计、不一致的脸或服装、改变身体比例、额外人物、重复身体、畸形手部、多余或缺失手指、随机配件、杂乱布局、裁切的全身图、模糊面部、低分辨率、过度平滑、美颜修饰、绘画纹理、水彩、素描线和不可读文字。

items.title: 健身房女性运动后流汗直拍
items.description: 成年女性在现代健身房完成训练后自然流汗的智能手机直拍，保留弯臂秀肌、汗渍运动服、真实比例、健身房环境与非性化生活记录感。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference image for the facial identity of the clearly adult main subject. Create a realistic smartphone snapshot of a young adult woman between the entrance and workout area of a modern gym, just after an intense set. She has black straight hair with light bangs, a closed-mouth small smile, direct eye contact, and a trained but naturally feminine, healthy physique. Preserve the reference orientation: her left arm appears on viewer-right in a bent-arm biceps flex, her right hand rests at the waist, and one leg is bent to create an asymmetrical stance.

Dress her in a light-gray high-neck cropped athletic tank with a large irregular dark sweat patch across the front, gray-brown high-waisted fitted leggings, a black fitness smartwatch, and a delicate necklace with a small cross pendant. Keep natural post-workout perspiration and skin texture; do not remove the sweat or replace the worn-in clothing with pristine dry fabric. The image should feel like a spontaneous training-between-sets record, not a bodybuilding competition pose or sexualized portrait.

Show a believable gym background with glass doors, dark lettering, gray walls, mirrors, and a bench. Use a natural blend of overhead gym lights and entrance ambient light, with mild phone compression, imperfect exposure, realistic shadows, and no three-point studio lighting, cinematic backlight, extreme bokeh, HDR, oversharpening, plastic skin, heavy retouching, exaggerated muscles, extreme abs, artificially narrow waist, altered proportions, strong cleavage, extra fingers, malformed hands, or reversed arm/watch direction.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物身份参考图确定明确成年主要人物的面部身份。创作一张真实的智能手机生活抓拍：一位年轻成年女性站在现代健身房入口与训练区之间，刚完成一组高强度训练。她有黑色长直发和轻薄刘海，闭口小微笑，直视镜头，身形健美但仍保持自然、健康的女性比例。保留参考方向：她的左臂位于观众右侧并弯曲展示肱二头肌，右手放在腰部，一条腿弯曲抬起，形成不对称站姿。

穿浅灰色高领短款运动背心，正面有大片不规则深色汗斑；搭配灰褐色高腰紧身裤、黑色健身智能手表和带小十字吊坠的精致项链。保留运动后的真实汗水与皮肤纹理，不要去掉汗渍，也不要用崭新干燥的衣服替换。画面应像训练间隙自发记录的一瞬间，而不是比赛级健美姿势或性化肖像。

背景为可信的健身房，包含玻璃门、深色字母、灰色墙壁、镜子和长凳。使用头顶健身房灯光与入口环境光的自然混合，保留轻微手机压缩感、不完美曝光和真实阴影；不要三点式影棚灯光、电影感逆光、极端散景、HDR、过度锐化、塑料皮肤、重度修图、夸张肌肉、极端腹肌、人为细腰、改变身体比例、强烈乳沟、多余手指、畸形手部或反转手臂和手表方向。

items.title: 创意材质化超大字体时尚海报
items.description: 用于商业活动主视觉的可执行双语模板：让超大主词由选定真实材质构成，并以符合物理规律的方式与人物或产品互动。
items.prompt:
Create a bold editorial campaign key visual in a 9:16 vertical layout. Use these editable defaults: brand name = NORTHLINE; product or campaign = MATERIAL STUDY; main word = FORM; material = denim; material behavior = tear; subject/product = product; main color = cobalt blue; accent color = cream; campaign details = MATERIAL STUDY / 2026. Make the main word extremely large, occupying about 50–75% of the frame, but keep it readable. Build every letter from the chosen physical material with believable thickness, seams, fibers, surface detail, texture, and lighting. The material must behave physically: fabric compresses and wrinkles, denim tears and exposes fibers, mesh threads through eyelets, or cream softens and melts. Use realistic contact, pressure, tension, shadows, folds, tearing, or melting where the subject or product interacts directly with the typography. Distort only affected areas.

Use realistic commercial photography, bold high-contrast color, one dominant color system with a few accents, and contemporary editorial design. Include only a small amount of meaningful campaign information such as the brand, product, slogan, specifications, date, labels, or callouts; render all text accurately and legibly. Make the result tactile, colorful, concept-driven, and visually complete. Avoid generic subject-plus-big-text layouts, plastic materials, random distortion, meaningless filler text, excessive UI graphics, heavy CGI, clutter, and effects unrelated to the chosen material.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张大胆的社论风格商业活动主视觉，采用9:16竖版。使用以下可编辑默认值：品牌名称=NORTHLINE；产品或活动=MATERIAL STUDY；主词=FORM；材质=丹宁；材质行为=撕裂；主体/产品=产品；主色=钴蓝；点缀色=奶油色；活动详情=MATERIAL STUDY / 2026。让主词极大地占据画面约50%–75%，同时保持清晰可读。用选定的真实物理材质构建每个字母，呈现可信的厚度、接缝、纤维、表面细节、纹理和光影。材质必须符合物理规律：织物压缩起皱，丹宁撕裂并露出纤维，网眼穿过孔眼，奶油变软并融化。当主体或产品直接与材质化字体互动时，表现真实的接触、压力、拉力、阴影、褶皱、撕裂或融化；只扭曲受到行为影响的区域。

使用真实商业摄影、大胆高对比色彩、一种主导色系加少量点缀色，以及现代社论设计。只加入少量有意义的活动信息，如品牌、产品、口号、规格、日期、标签或标注；所有文字都要准确、清晰可读。最终应具有触感、色彩、概念性和完整的商业主视觉完成度。避免平庸的主体加大字布局、塑料感材质、随机扭曲、无意义占位文字、过多UI图形、沉重CGI、杂乱以及与所选材质无关的效果。

items.title: 夜色阳台收衣服的真实感东方女性
items.description: 成年东方女性在夜色阳台收衣服的真实iPhone生活抓拍，保留安静私密的居住氛围、自然曲线、动作和暖冷交织的环境光。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference image for the facial identity of the main visible person. Create a realistic 16:9 horizontal iPhone snapshot of an adult young East Asian woman, approximately 20–26 in apparent age, on a narrow apartment balcony at night beside a laundry pole. Keep natural East Asian features, realistic pores and slight skin variation, relaxed eyes, light makeup, and a quiet, gentle, slightly lonely expression as she looks back toward the room. Outside the railing are softly blurred residential lights; warm bedroom light leaks through the sliding door into the cool night air. Show lived-in details such as a laundry pole, a few freshly washed clothes, railing, sliding door, curtain, and a corner of the bed.

She has a naturally full, healthy figure with realistic waist-to-hip transitions and smooth shoulder, hip, and leg lines. Dress her in a dark blue-gray slim-fit camisole home dress with thin straps, soft close-fitting fabric, and slight natural wrinkles, without excessive exposure or glamour styling. She is collecting laundry: her body is slightly turned away in side-back view, one hand removes clothing from the pole, the other holds collected clothes, and she turns her head toward the room. Keep the pose relaxed and candid.

Use genuine low-light location lighting from the balcony night and warm indoor lamp, with natural gradients across face, shoulders, torso, waist, and legs, modest dark areas, slight exposure imperfection, subtle phone noise, and realistic auto white balance. Use a real phone main-camera perspective, imperfect framing, and mild low-resolution snapshot character; do not use portrait-mode blur, studio lighting, commercial retouching, HDR, dreamy filters, CGI, or 3D rendering. Keep anatomy complete and natural: stable stance, normal limb proportions, clear hands, correct finger count, natural joints, and no extra limbs or distortion. Avoid exaggerated S-poses, eroticized expression, influencer filters, or polished fashion-editorial styling.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物身份参考图确定主要可见人物的面部身份。创作一张16:9横版、真实iPhone随手拍摄的生活抓拍：一位视觉年龄约20–26岁的成年年轻东方女性，位于夜晚狭长的公寓阳台晾衣杆旁。保留自然的东方女性五官、真实毛孔与轻微肤色变化、舒展的眉眼、淡妆，以及她回头望向室内时安静、温柔、略带孤独的神情。栏杆外是虚化的城市住宅楼灯光，推拉门内的卧室暖光自然泄入夜色。背景出现晾衣杆、几件刚洗好的衣服、阳台栏杆、推拉门、窗帘和床铺一角等真实居住痕迹。

人物身形丰腴、健康且比例真实，腰胯转折自然，肩部、臀部和腿部线条流畅。穿深蓝灰色修身细肩带家居短裙，柔软贴身面料带少量自然褶皱，不要过度暴露或时装大片感。人物正在收衣服：身体轻微侧背向镜头，一只手从晾衣杆取下衣物，另一只手抱着已经收下的衣服，并回头看向室内。动作松弛、像生活中被偶然记录的一瞬间。

使用来自阳台夜色与室内暖灯的真实低照度环境光，在面部、肩颈、身体、腰侧和腿部形成自然过渡，保留适度暗部、轻微曝光不完美、细微手机噪点和真实自动白平衡。使用真实手机主摄视角、并不完美的构图和轻微低清感；不要人像模式虚化、棚拍布光、商业精修、HDR、梦幻滤镜、CG或3D渲染。保证肢体完整自然：站姿稳定、四肢比例正常、双手清晰、手指数量正确、关节自然，不出现额外肢体或身体扭曲。避免夸张S型姿势、情色化表情、网红滤镜和过度润饰的时尚写真感。

items.title: 四层进阶叙事高阶设计海报生成指令
items.description: A vertical 3:4 four-layer narrative poster from one uploaded photo: four seamless 25%-height 3:1 banners aligned as 1:1:1:1, progressing from unchanged photography through humanistic geometric abstraction, integrated logo reconstruction and a complete brand-packaging mockup system.
items.prompt:
Turn each uploaded photo into one independent high-end design poster, never a multi-photo collage. Use a vertical 3:4 composition divided into four seamless horizontal layers, each exactly 25% of the height, in a strict 1:1:1:1 ratio. Each layer is an approximately 3:1 flat banner; fill its area fully, align visual center/subject/contours vertically, and keep the same subject quantity, structure, pose/action, relationships, perspective, occlusion, colors and core narrative across all four layers. Extend or crop only background naturally without stretching the subject or cropping key parts. Add no layer numbers, dividers, borders, seams, watermark or logos; add text only where specified below, small and legible.

Layer 1 | Original Photography: preserve the uploaded photo's real subject, structure, pose, relationships, perspective, natural light/shadow and core colors as the baseline. No illustration, geometry or 3D reconstruction.

Layer 2 | Humanistic Geometric Abstraction: on a clean ivory background, translate the same subject into a few geometric forms using deconstruction, screening, refinement and reconstruction. Preserve recognizable proportions, axes, curves, overlap, negative space and narrative. Use a restrained palette extracted from the photo: one main color, one dark structural color and one light/medium neutral, plus at most a small accent. Add a 2–5-word poetic English title and 2–4 tiny editorial notes/serial markers, arranged with the geometry using refined typography, not icon-like clutter.

Layer 3 | Integrated Logo Reconstruction: turn the same recognizable subject into one concise professional custom wordmark/logo, embedding its key outline or feature into the letters or unified mark rather than placing icon beside title. Use a short English name derived from subject/theme/place/action; add at most minimal category or tagline text. Keep clean light background, geometric order, generous space, restrained black/white or one source-derived accent, mature brand identity quality; avoid a generic icon-plus-text layout.

Layer 4 | Brand Packaging System Mockup: translate the same subject into a coherent packaging and material system. Extract reusable graphic symbols, patterns and color blocks, and apply them to 5–8 suitable carriers such as bags, boxes, labels, tags, tickets, cards, stickers, sleeves or cups; choose 1–2 focal packages and organize the rest with a clear grid, scale contrast, spacing and negative space. Use a soft airy premium palette of pale pink-blue, mist/sky blue, ivory, cream, light beige, soft gray-green and architectural neutrals with one muted rose accent. Show refined matte paper, textured stock, thick card, translucent paper, embossing, die cuts, folds, stickers and restrained print layering; use natural light only to show material, not plastic gloss. Add one short English title plus minimal varied packaging labels, never repetitive clutter.

Overall style: modern, elegant, restrained, collectible and artistic, merging real photography, abstract memory, integrated typography, logo identity and packaging-system logic. Avoid excessive filters, cheap decoration, commercial-template feel, random abstraction, wrong perspective, illogical scaffolding, plastic textures, heavy CGI and clutter.
items.prompt_zh:
请将我上传的每张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不要多图拼贴。采用3:4竖版构图，从上到下严格分为四个无缝衔接的横向区域，每层精确占画面高度25%，四层比例严格为1:1:1:1。每层约为3:1的扁横幅并完整填满自身区域；四层视觉重心、主体和轮廓尽量上下对齐，所有层保持同一主体数量、结构、姿态/动作、关系、视角、遮挡、色彩和核心叙事。只允许自然延展或轻微裁切背景，不得拉伸主体或裁掉关键部分。不要层号、分隔线、边框、拼贴缝隙、水印或Logo；仅在下述明确要求处添加少量清晰文字。

第一层｜原始摄影：保留上传照片的真实主体、结构、姿态、关系、视角、自然光影和核心色彩，作为视觉基准；不进行插画化、几何化或三维重建。

第二层｜人文几何抽象：使用干净象牙色背景，将同一主体通过“解构—筛选—提炼—重构”转译为少量几何形体。保留可识别比例、轴线、曲线、穿插、遮挡、负空间和叙事关系。配色从照片提取并限制为一个主色、一个深色结构色和一个浅/中性色，最多少量强调色。添加2—5词诗意英文主标题及2—4组极小编辑注释/序列标记，让文字与几何共同构图，避免图标化堆积。

第三层｜图形文字一体化Logo重构：将同一可识别主体重构为简洁专业的定制英文字标/Logo，把主体关键轮廓或特征融入字母或统一标志结构，不要把图标孤立放在标题旁。英文名称从主体、主题、地点或动作提炼；最多添加极少类别或标语文字。使用浅色纯色背景、几何秩序、大量留白、克制黑白或一种原图强调色，达到成熟品牌识别质量，避免普通图标加文字。

第四层｜品牌包装系统Mockup：将同一主体转译为统一的品牌包装与物料系统。提取可重复使用的图形符号、纹样和色块，应用于5—8种合适载体，如纸袋、包装盒、标签、吊牌、票券、卡片、贴纸、封套或杯具；以1—2个主包装为重心，其余按网格、尺度差、间距和留白组织。使用浅粉蓝、雾蓝/天空蓝、象牙白、奶油白、浅米色、柔和灰绿和建筑中性色组成柔和通透高级色系，少量低饱和玫瑰色作跳点。展示哑光纸、细纹纸、厚卡、半透明纸、压纹、模切、折叠、贴纸和克制印刷层叠；光线只表现材质，不要塑料高光。添加一个简短英文主标题和少量随载体变化的包装标注，避免重复杂乱。

整体风格现代、雅致、克制、具收藏感和艺术性，融合真实摄影、抽象记忆、文字一体化、Logo识别和包装系统逻辑。避免过度滤镜、廉价装饰、商业模板感、随机抽象、错误透视、无逻辑结构、塑料质感、厚重CG感和杂乱。

items.title: 莫兰迪风格垂直构图混合媒介记忆卡
items.description: A vertical mixed-media memory card with a strict 50/50 split: unchanged original photo above, textured handmade paper below with a muted color patch, dark wax-crayon subject sketch, short handwritten English phrase and subtle Risograph grain in a quiet Morandi-style layout.
items.prompt: Transform the uploaded photo into a vertical mixed-media memory card with a strict 50/50 split. Keep the original photo unchanged in the top half. In the bottom half, use textured off-white handmade paper and add one muted, irregular color patch matching the photo's tones. Redraw the main subject or related subjects as a simple dark wax-crayon sketch with loose imperfect lines and minimal details. Add one short handwritten English phrase and subtle Risograph grain. Create a quiet, nostalgic Morandi-style aesthetic with generous negative space. Do not add extra elements or copy the reference composition exactly.
items.prompt_zh: 将上传的照片转换为一张严格50/50分割的垂直混合媒介记忆卡。上半部分保持原始照片不变。下半部分使用有纹理的米白色手工纸，并添加一个匹配照片色调的柔和不规则色块。将主要主体或相关主体重新绘制为简单的深色蜡笔素描，使用松散不完美的线条和极少细节。添加一段简短的手写英语短语和微妙的Risograph颗粒感。营造安静怀旧的莫兰迪风格美学，保留大量负空间。不要添加额外元素，也不要完全复制参考构图。

items.title: 极简微缩建筑景观脚手架艺术海报
items.description: A single-photo vertical 3:4 poster with an upper preserved photograph and a lower minimalist 3D miniature architectural landscape interpretation using an isometric/cut-cube view, lighthouse semantics, rational scaffolding, bright refined color and restrained editorial text.
items.prompt:
Process each uploaded photo into one independent high-end design poster; output each photo separately with no multi-image stitching. Use a vertical 3:4 layout divided into equal 50% upper and lower regions.

Upper half: preserve the original photo's subject or related subjects, structure, pose, realistic texture, natural light and shadows, color atmosphere and details. Apply only slight high-end grading; extend environmental background naturally if needed, without stretching, distorting or changing the subject.

Lower half: extract the most recognizable outline, structure, pose and narrative relationships and reconstruct them as a minimalist 3D miniature architectural landscape in isometric view, cut-cube composition and underwater-continental-shelf-like perspective. Use a miniature lighthouse landscape as the core semantic when compatible with the source, while retaining recognizable identity and relationships. Treat it as a dissected miniature scene with correct spatial hierarchy, simple geometric forms, flat color blocks, fine lines and generous white space on textured paper; keep moderate structural detail and hand-drawn architectural quality, not photorealism.

Add rational scaffolding that wraps, supports, constructs, surveys or displays the subject, with dense horizontal/vertical members and local nodes around contours, transitions or cross-sections; keep perspective accurate, never a floating collage. Center the subject and use restrained lines, circles and sectional boundaries. Use bright clear high-end colors inspired by the photo, such as clear blue, lake green, tender green, bright yellow, coral orange, peach pink and light purple; purify colors but avoid gray/dirty dullness, Morandi styling, cheap candy colors, plastic, gradients and heavy shadows. Add minimal refined English titles, serial numbers or years as restrained editorial annotations. Overall: elegant modern miniature landscape, architectural cross-section, scaffolding system and minimalist poster; avoid excessive filters, cartoon feel, strong CGI feel, templated effects, incorrect views and illogical decoration.
items.prompt_zh:
请将我上传的每张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，每张照片单独输出，不进行多图拼接。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分：保留原始照片中的主体或相关主体、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影、色彩氛围和细节。仅进行轻微高级调色；需要适配画幅时可自然延伸环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分：提取照片主体最具识别度的轮廓、结构、姿态和叙事关系，将其重构为极简3D微缩建筑景观，采用等距视图、剖面立方体构图和类似水下大陆架的透视。与原图相容时，以微缩灯塔景观作为核心语义，同时保留主体的可识别性和原始关系。将其表现为具有正确空间层级的剖开微缩场景，使用简洁几何形状、扁平色块、细线条和纹理纸上的大量留白；保留适度结构细节和手绘建筑插画质感，不要写实渲染。

加入理性的脚手架系统，用于包裹、支撑、搭建、测绘或展示主体；由细密水平/垂直构件和局部节点组成，围绕轮廓、转折或剖面展开，透视准确，不要画成漂浮拼贴。主体居中，使用克制的线条、圆形元素和剖面边界增强空间感。色彩从照片获得灵感，重新处理为明艳清透的高级色系，可使用清澈蓝、湖水青、嫩绿、明黄、珊瑚橙、桃粉和淡紫；避免灰脏暗沉、莫兰迪化、廉价糖果色、塑料感、渐变和厚重阴影。少量加入精致克制的英文标题、编号或年份作为编辑标注。整体融合微缩立体景观、建筑剖面图、脚手架系统和极简海报版式；避免过度滤镜、卡通感、强电脑生成感、模板化效果、错误视图和无逻辑装饰。

items.title: 超大排版物理材质交互商业海报
items.description: A bilingual executable 9:16 editorial campaign key visual in which oversized typography behaves as physical material around a featured product, with realistic commercial photography, limited high-contrast color and restrained campaign details.
items.prompt:
Create a bold 9:16 editorial campaign poster for the brand STUDIO and Signature Campaign. Make the oversized main word “FORM” behave like a physical material around the featured product rather than flat static text. Use realistic commercial photography, contemporary editorial design, strong high-contrast color and one dominant cobalt blue with black, white and vermilion accent.

Make “FORM” extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the composition. Use a FOLD material behavior: create clean creases and folded planes that follow the featured product's structural direction. Build strong foreground–subject–background interaction so the product feels physically connected to the typography. Keep the product, material, lighting and reflections realistic and polished.

Add only these meaningful campaign details: “STUDIO”, “Signature Campaign”, and “NEW SEASON / 2026”, using a few small editorial labels. Keep the final image bold, colorful, layered and conceptually clear. Avoid a generic subject-plus-big-text layout, random deformation, heavy 3D lettering, meaningless filler text, excessive UI graphics, clutter and disconnected effects.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张大胆的9:16社论活动海报，品牌为“STUDIO”，活动为“Signature Campaign”。让超大主要文字“FORM”围绕主体像物理材质一样表现，而不是扁平静止的文字。使用真实商业摄影、当代社论设计、强烈高对比色彩，以钴蓝色为主导色，搭配黑色、白色和朱红色强调色。

让“FORM”非常大，占据构图约50–75%。采用“折叠”材质行为：创建遵循主体结构方向的整洁褶皱和折叠平面。建立强烈的前景—主体—背景互动，使产品在物理上与排版相连。保持产品、材质、灯光和反射真实精致。

仅添加这些有意义的活动细节：“STUDIO”“Signature Campaign”和“NEW SEASON / 2026”，使用少量小型社论标签。最终图像应大胆、多彩、分层且概念清晰。避免通用的主体加大字布局、随机变形、沉重3D字效、无意义填充文字、过多UI图形、杂乱和断开的视觉效果。

items.title: 摄影与韩式插画组合设计海报
items.description: An executable single-photo 3:4 poster with an upper photographic half and a lower relaxed Korean-style graphic editorial illustration of the same recognizable subject, using bright flat color blocks, negative space and integrated playful typography.
items.prompt:
Create one independent high-end design poster for the uploaded photo; output each photo separately and do not make a multi-image collage. Use a vertical 3:4 composition divided into equal 50% upper and lower halves.

Upper half: retain the original photo's main structure, recognizable subject, realistic texture, natural light and shadows, color atmosphere and details. Apply only subtle high-end photographic color grading; naturally extend environmental background when needed, but never stretch, distort or change the subject.

Lower half: extract the most recognizable subject, outline, pose and narrative relationships from the photo and reconstruct them as a relaxed, clumsy Korean-style graphic editorial illustration. Preserve the layout, object relationships and core actions while simplifying forms into rounded, concise, slightly exaggerated geometry with rough, jittery, partly broken hand-drawn black outlines and flat fills. Keep it recognizable rather than a cartoonized photo.

Use a clear visual center, playful rhythm through size differences, misalignment, occlusion, subtle cropping and incomplete symmetry. Use large bright solid color areas and negative space, with vivid colors sampled from the photo; use limited high-chroma flat blocks without a fixed palette. Contrast the subject and background sharply; use no gradients, shadows, muddy gray mixtures or plastic textures.

Integrate a short English title derived from the photo's theme, action, emotion or story, plus a few concise phrases, objects, place names, numbers or playful notes. Let the title and small text align with subject contours, color-block edges, negative space or frame axes, with slight rotation, misalignment, splitting or interleaving so the text belongs to the illustration. Overall: real photography × clumsy graphic illustration × bright, friendly, playful editorial design. No watermark, no logos.
items.prompt_zh:
请为我上传的每张照片制作一张独立的高端设计海报，每张照片单独输出，不要制作多图拼贴。整体采用3:4的垂直构图，上下部分高度严格为1:1，每个部分占据画面的50%。

上半部分：保留原始照片的主结构、可识别主体、逼真质感、自然光线与阴影、原有色彩氛围和细节。仅进行细微的高端摄影调色；为适应画面时可以自然延伸环境背景，但不拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分：从照片中提取最具辨识度的主体、轮廓、姿势和叙事关系，将其重构为轻松笨拙的韩式平面编辑插图。保留整体布局、物体关系和核心动作，将主体简化为圆润简洁、略带夸张的几何形状，搭配粗糙抖动、部分破损的手绘黑色轮廓和纯色填充；保持可立即识别，不要变成卡通化照片。

保持清晰的视觉中心，通过大小差异、错位、遮挡、细微裁剪和不完全对称营造俏皮节奏。使用大面积明亮纯色和负空间支撑主体，从照片提取鲜艳易识别的颜色，转化为有限数量的高色度平面色块，不机械套用固定配色。让背景与主体形成鲜明区域对比，避免渐变、阴影、浑浊灰色、复杂混合和塑料质感。

整合一个从照片主题、动作、情感或故事中提炼的简短英文标题，并搭配少量短语、物体、地名、数字或俏皮注释。让标题和小文字沿主体轮廓、色块边缘、负空间或画面轴线排列，可带轻微旋转、错位、分割或交织，使文字成为插图的一部分。总体呈现真实摄影×笨拙平面插画×明亮友好俏皮的编辑设计。无水印、无标志。

items.title: 怀旧当代旅行日记艺术画册页面
items.description: A nostalgic contemporary travel-journal artbook page: the configured reference identity appears in an ultra-realistic upper airport photograph and the exact same person, luggage, scene and composition continue into a lower black-and-white ink illustration on warm off-white paper, with restrained editorial travel annotations.
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the same visible person throughout the composition. Preserve the source person's facial features, hairstyle, pose, expression, clothing, luggage, proportions, camera angle, composition and emotional atmosphere.

Create a nostalgic contemporary travel-journal artbook page divided vertically into two seamlessly connected sections. The upper section is an ultra-realistic cinematic airport photograph: the same person stands quietly in a modern airport terminal with a carry-on suitcase beside them, soft natural window light, subtle polished-floor reflections, realistic skin texture, authentic colors, shallow depth of field, delicate film grain, natural candid body language and a quiet pre-departure atmosphere.

The lower section transforms the exact same scene, person, luggage and composition into a loose black-and-white hand-drawn ink illustration on warm off-white textured paper. Preserve the same pose and perspective, using expressive imperfect lines, rough cross-hatching, minimal shading, subtle architectural details, small directional arrows, luggage outlines, terminal-signage shapes and handmade sketchbook imperfections. Add tasteful editorial typography around the illustration: a small numbered diary entry, handwritten-style caption, tiny documentary notes, subtle timestamp, gate-style notation and minimal travel-journal annotations. Keep generous cream-colored negative space, slightly imperfect ink printing, an understated vintage layout, sophisticated minimalist Japanese-inspired graphic design, emotionally warm cinematic tone and premium contemporary photography-journal aesthetics. Keep the transition between photograph and drawing cohesive, with natural human anatomy and authentic proportions. No watermark, no logos.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为整个画面中同一可见人物的面部身份依据。保留来源人物的面部特征、发型、姿势、表情、服装、行李、比例、摄像机角度、构图和情感氛围。

创建一个怀旧的当代旅行日记艺术画册页面，将页面垂直分为两个无缝连接的部分。上部是超写实的电影感机场照片：同一个人静静地站在现代机场航站楼内，身边放着一个手提行李箱，使用柔和自然窗光，呈现抛光地板的细微反射、真实皮肤纹理、本真色彩、浅景深、细腻胶片颗粒、自然抓拍身体语言和安静的出发前氛围。

下部将完全相同的场景、人物、行李和构图转变为温暖米白色纹理纸上的松散黑白手绘墨水插画。保留相同姿势和透视，使用富有表现力的不完美线条、粗糙交叉阴影、极简阴影、细微建筑细节、小方向箭头、行李轮廓、航站楼标识形状和手工素描本的不完美感。在插画周围添加雅致的编辑排版：小型编号日记条目、手写风格标题、微小纪录片笔记、细微时间戳、登机口风格标注和极简旅行日记注释。保持大量奶油色留白、略显不完美的油墨印刷、低调复古布局、精致极简日式平面设计、温暖而有电影感的情绪和高品质当代摄影杂志美学。确保照片与绘画之间衔接连贯，人体解剖自然、比例真实。无水印、无标志。

items.title: 奢华旅行海报分屏图形设计
items.description: A bilingual executable luxury travel poster using the uploaded photo as the unchanged left panel and a restrained collectible travel graphic on the right.
items.prompt:
Create a luxury travel poster based on my uploaded photo. Use a horizontal 4:3 split-screen layout: 65% on the left for the original photo and 35% on the right for the graphic design. Keep the left image 100% unchanged.

Right section: use a minimalist matte background sampled from the photo. Center a small collectible magnet: a realistic handcrafted enamel pin badge with delicate gold outlines, depicting a simplified scene based on the photo. Add luxurious typography showing the location name "Destination" and country/region "Country / Region" in an elegant serif font. Keep a high-end travel-brand aesthetic with understated luxury.
items.prompt_zh:
根据我上传的照片制作一张豪华旅行海报。使用横向4:3分屏布局：左侧65%为原始照片，右侧35%为平面设计。保持左侧图像100%不变。

右侧部分：使用从照片中采样的极简磨砂背景。中央放置一个小型收藏磁贴，即带有精致金色轮廓、描绘照片简化场景的写实手工珐琅别针徽章。使用优雅的衬线字体，显示地点名称“Destination”和国家/地区“Country / Region”。整体保持高端旅行品牌审美与低调奢华感。

items.title: 视觉完形极简编辑海报设计提示词
items.description: A bilingual executable template for transforming one uploaded photo into a 3:4 Visual Gestalt minimalist editorial poster. The source photo remains the sole photographic material; the upper text uses the supplied representative scene-description defaults and the lower photo remains continuous except for the specified slice gaps.
items.prompt:
Please create a vertical 3:4 "Visual Gestalt" minimalist editorial poster based on the original photo I uploaded. Use the source photo as the sole photographic material.
Retain the main subject, lighting, colors, composition, and details of the original photo; do not redraw the scene, and do not add objects that do not exist in the original image.

Visual Structure: Divide the canvas into an upper section occupying approximately 48% of the height and a lower section occupying approximately 52%. Use a pure warm gray-white background #F1F1EF above, and place the continuous, complete, full-bleed source photo below. Add no border, divider, or shadow between them.

Upper Text: Typeset this short scene description: "A quiet moment with the subject in view". Keep it to 24–42 characters over 2–4 lines. Use a regular-weight black neutral sans-serif font, approximately 2.6%–3.2% of canvas width, with line spacing 1.65–1.9. Center the text-and-slice content block in the upper half, using 78%–86% of canvas width and ample surrounding whitespace; it is body text, not a large title.

Photo Slices: Select 5–7 distinct, clearly identifiable parts from the source photo. Crop them into inline images with varied aspect ratios and embed them at keyword positions in the short sentence, enclosed in parentheses or curly braces. Each slice should be 1.4–2 times the text height, 5%–12% of canvas width and never over 14%. Use narrow vertical strips, near-squares, or wide horizontal strips with only 2–4px rounded corners; add no strokes or shadows.

Lower Gaps: Every upper slice must come from a real, unique position in the lower photo. Cover each slice's original position with a solid #F1F1EF rectangle, creating the appearance that part of the photo has been removed.
items.prompt_zh:
请基于我上传的原照片，制作一张竖版 3:4 的“视觉完形”极简编辑海报。以源照片作为唯一摄影素材。
保留原照片的主体、光线、色彩、构图和细节，不重新绘制场景，不增加原图中不存在的物体。

画面结构：将画布分为上下两部分，上半区约占高度48%，下半区约占52%。上半区使用纯净暖灰白背景#F1F1EF，下半区放置连续、完整、全出血的源照片。上下区域之间不添加边框、分隔线或阴影。

上半区文字：排版以下画面描述：“柔和留白中，主体与细节被安静而完整地定格”。文字保持24—42字、2—4行。使用黑色中性无衬线字体、常规字重，字号约为画布宽度的2.6%—3.2%，行距为1.65—1.9。文字与照片切片组成的内容块宽度约占画布78%—86%，整体位于上半区视觉中心，四周保留充足留白；文字是正文，不是大标题。

照片切片：从源照片中选择5—7个彼此不同且清晰可辨的局部，将其裁切成不同宽高比的行内图片，嵌入短句中的关键词位置，并使用圆括号或花括号包围。每个切片高度约为正文字高的1.4—2倍，宽度约占画布5%—12%，最大不超过14%。切片可以是窄竖条、近方形或宽横条，只允许2—4px轻微圆角，不添加描边和阴影。

下半区缺口：每个上方切片必须来自下方照片中的一个真实、唯一位置。在每个切片的原始位置覆盖#F1F1EF实心矩形，形成照片被取走一部分的视觉缺口。

items.title: 俏皮现代的应用程序图标设计
items.description: A playful square app icon showing a cute coffee-cup character with a wink and smile, flame-like red-orange hair, flat vector shapes, glossy highlights, and a transparent background.
items.prompt: Playful modern app icon of a cute coffee cup character with one winking eye and a smiling mouth, red-orange flame-like hair on top, minimal flat vector style, glossy highlights, soft shadows, centered square composition, rounded corners, vibrant high-contrast colors, transparent background, no text and no elements outside the frame.
items.prompt_zh: 俏皮现代的方形应用图标：可爱的咖啡杯角色，带有一只眨眼和微笑的嘴巴，顶部是红橙色火焰状头发；极简扁平矢量风格，带高光和柔和阴影，居中构图，圆角，高对比鲜艳色彩，透明背景，不含文字，元素不越出画面。

items.title: 纸上的小卡通角色
items.description: A lively cartoon character bursts from a sheet of paper and runs from a giant erasing pencil, surrounded by colorful pencils on a desk and flying eraser crumbs.
items.prompt: Playful illustration of a tiny cartoon character bursting out of a sheet of paper and running away from a giant pencil trying to erase it. Surround the paper with colorful pencils on a desk and a few flying eraser crumbs; energetic perspective, vivid colors, expressive motion, no living people, logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 充满趣味的插画：一个微型卡通角色从纸张中冲出来，逃离一支试图擦除它的巨型铅笔。纸张周围摆放彩色铅笔和书桌，并加入少量飞舞的橡皮屑；动感透视，色彩鲜明，动作表情丰富，不出现真人、标志或水印。

items.title: 叠层纸雕 VOX 风格城市矢量插画
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的城市主题 4:5 叠层纸雕矢量插画提示词。保留城市和国家变量、主地标、4-6 个辅助地标、顶部唯一标题、纸张材质和高级社论解说美学。原文为非人物城市插画，不需要人物身份参考。
items.prompt:
ASPECT RATIO: 4:5  - VERTICAL PORTRAIT

Create a premium vertical 4:5 layered papercut collage × VOX-style flat-vector illustration of Kyoto, Japan.

Use a warm cream paper background, crisp layered cut-paper shapes, thick pure-white keylines, subtle short shadows, minimal matte paper grain, and a sophisticated low-saturation color palette. Premium editorial explainer aesthetic — playful, witty, elegant, and never childish.

TOP TITLE:
Place a clean centered title at the top:
Kyoto
Japan
Use thin uppercase geometric sans-serif typography with wide tracking and deep ink navy. Add a thin horizontal rule underneath. No other text anywhere.

COMPOSITION:
Make the most iconic and recognizable landmark of Kyoto the dominant central hero, with a strong, clean silhouette and layered papercut construction.

Surround it with 4–6 additional authentic landmarks, architectural elements, cultural objects, and natural features that immediately identify Kyoto. Arrange them at different heights and depths rather than symmetrically.

Include recognizable local elements such as:
• One major architectural landmark
• 2–3 supporting landmarks
• A distinctive local natural or geographic feature
• Characteristic vegetation
• A recognizable street, bridge, waterfront, or public space
• Small everyday details that communicate the city's culture

FOREGROUND STORY:
Keep the foreground entirely person-free, using only architectural details, vegetation, vehicles without occupants, and cultural objects.

Do not include people, faces, bodies, silhouettes, crowds, or human-shaped figures.

Add one or two subtle visual details or deadpan humorous elements that feel authentic to the destination without becoming cartoonish.

STYLE:
Every landmark, person, tree, vehicle, and object should appear as a physically separate layered paper cutout with a thick clean PURE-WHITE external keyline.

Use flat color fields, crisp edges, subtle short hard-edged shadows, and clear layered depth. No gradients.

Use a restrained palette inspired by the destination, keeping colors sophisticated, muted, and cohesive. Allow one small accent color for visual interest.

The image should feel like a premium modern editorial travel illustration — highly recognizable, visually rich, witty, sophisticated, and handcrafted.

IMPORTANT:
Prioritize recognizable silhouettes and strong composition over excessive detail. Keep enough negative space around major elements so the image does not feel crowded. Avoid excessive symmetry.

NO photorealism.
NO 3D render.
NO gradients.
NO realistic faces.
NO crowds.
NO excessive tiny details.
NO random landmarks.
NO fantasy architecture.
NO unnecessary text.
NO watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
宽高比：4:5 - 垂直纵向

为 京都, 日本 创作一张高端垂直 4:5 叠层纸雕剪贴画 × VOX 风格扁平矢量插画。

使用温暖的奶油色纸张背景、清晰的叠层剪纸形状、厚实的纯白色轮廓线、细微的短阴影、极简的哑光纸张纹理以及高级的低饱和度配色方案。高端社论解说美学——俏皮、风趣、优雅，绝不幼稚。

顶部标题：
在顶部放置一个干净的居中标题：
京都
日本
使用细体大写几何无衬线字体，字间距宽，深海军蓝墨水色。在下方添加一条细水平线。其他地方不要有任何文字。

构图：
将 京都 最具标志性和辨识度的地标作为占主导地位的核心主体，具有强有力、干净的轮廓和叠层纸雕结构。

在周围环绕 4–6 个额外的真实地标、建筑元素、文化物品和自然特征，以便立即识别出 京都。将它们排列在不同的高度和深度，而不是对称排列。

包括可识别的当地元素，例如：
• 一个主要建筑地标
• 2–3 个辅助地标
• 一个独特的当地自然或地理特征
• 特色植被
• 一条可辨识的街道、桥梁、海滨或公共空间
• 传达城市文化的小型日常细节

前景故事：
添加 2–3 个细小的无脸人物，自然地与环境互动——例如行走、坐着、进食、观光、骑行、购物或享受当地活动。

让人像保持微小并次于地标。使用简单的几何纸雕形状，无面部特征，无手指，无写实的衣服褶皱，且带有独立的白色轮廓线。

添加一两个细微的视觉细节或冷幽默元素，感觉符合目的地特征且不显卡通化。

风格：
每个地标、人物、树木、车辆和物体都应呈现为物理分离的叠层剪纸，并带有厚实的干净纯白色外部轮廓线。

使用扁平色域、清晰边缘、细微的短硬边阴影和清晰的叠层深度。无渐变。

使用受目的地启发的克制色调，保持色彩高端、柔和且协调。允许使用一种小的点缀色以增加视觉趣味。

图像应感觉像是高端现代社论旅行插画——高度可辨识、视觉丰富、风趣、精美且纯手工制作。

重要提示：
优先考虑可辨识的轮廓和强大的构图，而非过度的细节。在主要元素周围保留足够的负空间，使画面不显得拥挤。避免过度对称。

无照片写实。
无 3D 渲染。
无渐变。
无写实脸部。
无人群。
无过度微小细节。
无随机地标。
无幻想建筑。
无不必要的文字。
无水印。

items.title: 札幌北海道霓虹丝带旅行海报
items.description: Premium neon-ribbon travel poster for Sapporo and Hokkaido with explicit non-person cultural and natural motifs.
items.prompt: Create a premium 4:5 vertical artistic travel poster for Sapporo, Japan, based on the concept "City as a Neon Ribbon." Use a deep matte-black background with dramatic empty negative space. Build the composition from expressive hand-painted neon strokes, ink splashes, dry-brush textures, and energetic gestural lines. A single continuous luminous brushstroke should flow across the poster like a ribbon, twisting into the Sapporo TV Tower as the iconic landmark. Integrate the city name "SAPPORO" in huge custom hand-painted lettering interacting with the ribbon. Surround the main landmark with subtle neon silhouettes or expressive brush marks of the Sapporo Clock Tower, a modern streetcar, a Hokkaido festival lantern, a bowl of miso ramen, and snow-covered Mount Moiwa. Use electric pink, hot magenta, cobalt blue, cyan, violet, orange, and acid yellow against pure black, with fluorescent glow, rough dry-brush edges, paint texture, ink splatters, and handmade strokes. Add one small handwritten phrase: "CITY NIGHTS". Bold, sophisticated, youthful, collectible editorial limited-edition travel poster; no photorealism, no ordinary skyline collage, no generic clip-art, no people, no excessive details; graphic, dramatic, recognizable, highly stylized, vertical 4:5 premium poster design.
items.prompt_zh: 为札幌（日本）创作一张高级4:5竖版艺术旅行海报，主题为“城市如霓虹丝带”。使用深哑光黑背景和大面积戏剧性留白。整幅构图由富有表现力的手绘霓虹笔触、墨水飞溅、干刷纹理和充满能量的手势线条构成。一条连续发光的笔触像丝带一样贯穿海报，并扭转变形成札幌电视塔这一标志性地标。将城市名称“SAPPORO”以巨大的手绘字融入丝带，使文字与笔触互动。围绕主体加入札幌钟楼、现代有轨电车、北海道祭典灯笼、一碗味噌拉面和覆雪的藻岩山等城市符号，仅以简化的霓虹剪影或富有表现力的笔触呈现。使用电光粉、亮洋红、钴蓝、青色、紫罗兰、橙色和酸性黄色，衬托纯黑背景；加入强烈荧光、粗粝干刷边缘、可见颜料纹理、墨点飞溅和不完美的手工笔触。添加一行小型手写短语“CITY NIGHTS”。整体应大胆、精致、年轻、具有收藏价值和编辑感，像限量版当代旅行海报；不要写实、不要普通天际线拼贴、不要通用剪贴画、不要人物、不要过多细节；保持图形化、戏剧性、可识别且高度风格化的4:5高级海报设计。

Generate a 9:16 vertical high-quality character Editorial Poster.

【Theme】: Beyond the Circle
【Character】: Adult woman in her twenties, coral tailored suit, seated along the lower arc
【Circular Structure】: Large thick teal ring
【Interaction Mode】: Seated inside the ring, lower legs extending forward over the lower circular frame
【Main Color】: Ivory background, teal ring, coral suit, pale teal field inside ring
【Title】: 跨越边界 / BEYOND THE CIRCLE; small editorial line GEOMETRY IN MOTION

Take "large-scale circular frame scenery + character interaction" as the core composition. The circle occupies about 60%–85% of the frame and must become the main visual anchor, not just a decoration behind the character.

Let the character truly have a spatial relationship with the circle: the body can sit in, pass through, lean against, or break through the boundaries of the circle. At least the head, arms, legs, skirt hem, or props should cross over the circular frame, establishing clear foreground and background occlusion.

Create a difference between inside and outside the circle through color, material, light, or space, making the circle look like an independent visual field. The character's posture should be organized along the arc, center, and boundaries, making the geometric order and body movements echo each other.

Typography is arranged around the negative space left by the circle, using modern high-contrast Chinese fonts, elegant Serif English, and a small amount of Editorial fine print. All text centers around the theme of the current work, and no meaningless template placeholder information is used.

The overall style adopts the visual language of high-end fashion magazines, Magazine Cover, and Contemporary Editorial Design: realistic and natural character photography texture, clear large color blocks, moderate white space, simple but layered.

Focus on ensuring that even in the thumbnail state, the following can be seen at a glance:

Character + Large Circle + Clear frame-breaking / interleaving relationship.

Avoid ordinary characters standing in front of the circle, PPT feel, circular sticker feel, too many small decorations, tech HUD, Logo, QR codes, serial numbers, and copyright markings.

【圆形结构】：大型厚实青绿色圆环
【互动方式】：坐入圆环，下腿向前越过圆环下边框
【主色】：象牙白背景、青绿色圆环、珊瑚色西装，圆内浅青绿色空间
【标题】：跨越边界 / BEYOND THE CIRCLE；小字 GEOMETRY IN MOTION

以“大尺度圆形框景 + 人物互动”为核心构图。圆形占画面约 60%–85%，必须成为主要视觉锚点，不要只是人物背后的装饰。

让人物真正与圆形发生空间关系：身体可以坐进、穿过、倚靠或突破圆形边界，至少让头部、手臂、腿部、裙摆或道具有一处越过圆框，并建立清楚的前后遮挡。

圆内与圆外通过颜色、材质、光线或空间形成差异，让圆形像一个独立视觉场。人物姿态要顺着圆弧、圆心和边界组织，使几何秩序与人体动作互相呼应。

Typography 围绕圆形留下的负空间排布，使用现代高对比中文字体、优雅 Serif 英文和少量 Editorial 小字。所有文字围绕当前作品主题，不使用无意义模板占位信息。

整体采用高级时尚杂志、Magazine Cover、Contemporary Editorial Design 的视觉语言：真实自然的人物摄影质感，清楚的大色块，适量留白，简洁但有层次。

重点保证缩略图状态下仍能一眼看到：

人物 + 大圆 + 明确的破框 / 穿插关系。

避免普通人物站在圆前、PPT 感、圆形贴纸感、过多小装饰、科技 HUD、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。

背景特点是茂盛的成熟绿树、安静的人行道、优雅的石材与金属围栏，以及透过叶丛隐约可见的柔和建筑细节。明亮的自然光线穿过树木，在整个场景中营造出美丽的斑驳阳光和柔和阴影。
韩系简约时尚摄影，随性街拍审美，柔和的夏季氛围，自然日光，真实的皮肤纹理，细致的发丝，真实的织物和手提包纹理，微妙的暖色调调色，浅景深，温柔的背景虚化，真实的智能手机摄影，照片级真实感，高分辨率，自然的人体比例，垂直 4:5 构图。
负面提示：卡通，动漫，CGI，塑料感皮肤，过重的妆容，扭曲的面部，不对称的眼睛，畸形的手，多余的手指，扭曲的饮料杯，变形的手提包，不真实的头发，不自然的人体比例，过饱和的颜色，刺眼的阴影，模糊的主体，过度修饰，文本伪影，水印。

items.title: 琥珀花厅中的成年女性华服侧影
items.description: 用途：古典华服侧面肖像。保留琥珀花厅、金丝花饰、青金象牙层叠长袍与宽广柔和环境光。
items.prompt:
Use the supplied ref-10a-v1 image as the facial identity reference for the adult woman. Preserve that identity, with source facial descriptors subordinate to the reference. Preserve the source age, styling, wardrobe, pose and scene.

Close up side profile of an adult East Asian Chinese woman in an ancient luxurious amber flower hall, head, shoulders and upper body visible. Ivory peonies and antique gold filigree branches softly blurred in foreground; deep black lacquer columns, celadon vases and champagne silk curtains in background. Dark blue black hair in elegant high bun supporting a Chinese antique gold floral filigree headpiece with ivory petals, teal gemstones and short pearl chains; face unobstructed. Deep teal silk inner robe, ivory middle layer, translucent champagne gold outer robe, refined gold embroidery on collar and shoulders. Soft broad ambient light diffused through amber lanterns, flowers, lacquer, porcelain and silk; near side gently brighter, far side softly darker with subtle blue teal tone; broad natural tonal gradients, realistic matte satin skin texture. No hard light, no specular hotspots, no overexposure, no sunlight, no spotlight, no text, no watermark. --c 5 --s 250
items.prompt_zh:
以提供的 ref-10a-v1 图像作为成年女性的面部身份参考；保持该身份，来源五官描述如有冲突以参考为准。保留来源年龄、造型、服装、姿势与场景。

一名成年东亚中国女性在古代华贵的琥珀花厅中的特写侧面轮廓，头部、肩膀和上半身可见。前景中是柔和模糊的象牙色牡丹和古董金丝花枝；背景中是深黑漆柱、青瓷花瓶和香槟色丝绸窗帘。深蓝黑色的头发束成优雅的高发髻，支撑着一个带有象牙色花瓣、青色宝石和短珍珠链的中国古代金花丝头饰；面部无遮挡。深青色丝绸内袍，象牙色中间层，半透明香槟金外袍，衣领和肩膀上有精致的金绣。柔和宽广的环境光通过琥珀灯笼、花朵、漆器、瓷器和丝绸扩散；近侧略亮，远侧略暗并带有细微的蓝青色调；宽广的自然色调渐变，真实的哑光缎面皮肤纹理。无硬光，无镜面热点，无过度曝光，无阳光，无聚光灯，无文字，无水印。--c 5 --s 250

items.title: 日本国旗红熊猫超级英雄肖像
items.description: Hyper-realistic red panda superhero portrait with Japan flag elements.
items.prompt: A hyper-realistic square 1:1 portrait of a red panda standing in a heroic pose, facing slightly left. The animal wears a textured dark gray superhero suit with fabric grain and subtle seams. On its chest, inside a golden metallic diamond emblem, is a fabric-embroidered Japan flag. A flowing Japan flag cape rests over its shoulder. Behind it is a realistic fabric Japan flag backdrop, slightly out of focus. Warm directional studio light emphasizes fur texture and suit material. Dramatic cinematic warm grading, full head visible, no cropping, no text, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 一只红熊猫以英雄姿态站立，身体略向左侧，创建写实方形 1:1 肖像。它穿着有织物纹理和细微缝线的深灰色超级英雄紧身服，胸前金色金属菱形徽章内嵌日本国旗刺绣。肩上披着具有真实褶皱和重量感的日本国旗披风，身后是略微虚化的真实布质日本国旗背景。使用温暖、有方向性的摄影棚灯光，突出毛发与服装材质；采用戏剧化电影质感和暖色调，完整呈现头部，不裁切，不含文字、标志或水印。

items.title: 近距强闪光哥特风成年女性肖像
items.description: 用途：哥特风人像摄影概念与时尚视觉。保留黑色蕾丝、双手靠近唇颏的姿态、近距正面强闪光与冷淡紫红暗调；按图库规则将原虚构身份改为10A参考面部身份，当前仅完成文本整理。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image ref-10a-v1 as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Portray her as an adult woman in her 20s. Preserve the reference facial identity; the source facial-feature descriptions below are secondary styling guidance and must not replace that identity. Create an extremely photorealistic dark gothic close portrait with a vertical composition, framed from upper torso to head. She is turned slightly sideways and leans inward toward the camera, shoulders softly hunched, with both hands raised near her mouth and chin in a shy, guarded pose. She looks toward the camera with a quiet, melancholic, slightly distant expression. She has a short rounded black bob with dense blunt bangs, glossy hair with subtle violet-magenta reflections, a small soft oval face, delicate jaw, narrow nose, softly defined lips, and slightly sleepy dark brown eyes. She wears an elegant black gothic lace top with floral lace and square-grid mesh sections on the shoulder and sleeves.

Lighting is the highest priority: use a very strong close frontal flash in an almost completely dark environment, with little to no ambient fill. The face should appear pale, luminous, and slightly overexposed, with near-clipped highlights on the forehead, nose, cheeks, and lips, while the rest of the image falls quickly into deep shadow. Preserve a cold desaturated lavender-magenta cast, deep crushed blacks, low saturation, and a moody nocturnal gothic atmosphere. Skin should look pale and realistic with subtle pores, faint texture, slight imperfections, and minimal retouching. Add subtle high-ISO noise, fine grain, faint compression artifacts, slight bloom on highlights, and a raw late-night flash-photo feeling. Background should remain nearly black and indistinct. 50–85mm look, close distance, f/2.0–f/2.8, shallow depth of field.
items.prompt_zh: 以用户上传的参考图ref-10a-v1作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据，将她表现为20多岁的成年女性。保留参考图的面部身份；下文来自来源的五官描述仅作次要造型指引，不得替换参考身份。创建一张极度写实的暗黑哥特风格近景人像，垂直构图，取景范围从上半身到头部。她身体微侧，向相机方向倾斜，肩膀微微耸起，双手举在嘴巴和下巴附近，呈现出一种害羞、防备的姿态。她带着安静、忧郁且略显疏离的表情注视着相机。她留着一头圆润的黑色短发波波头，带有浓密的齐刘海，光泽的头发带有微妙的紫红色反光，小巧柔和的鹅蛋脸，精致的下颚，窄鼻子，轮廓柔和的嘴唇，以及略显倦意的深褐色眼睛。她穿着一件优雅的黑色哥特式蕾丝上衣，肩膀和袖子部分有花卉蕾丝和方格网状装饰。光影是重中之重：在几乎完全黑暗的环境中使用极强的近距离正面闪光灯，几乎没有环境补光。面部应显得苍白、透亮且略微曝光过度，额头、鼻子、脸颊和嘴唇上有接近溢出的高光，而图像的其余部分迅速陷入深邃的阴影中。保持冷色调的低饱和淡紫色/洋红色调，暗部压至深黑，低饱和度，以及一种忧郁的深夜哥特氛围。皮肤应显得苍白且真实，带有细微的毛孔、隐约的纹理、轻微的瑕疵和极少的修饰。添加微妙的高ISO噪点、细微颗粒、隐约的压缩痕迹、高光处轻微的晕染，以及一种原始的深夜闪光灯照片质感。背景应保持近乎黑色且模糊不清。50–85mm视角，近距离，f/2.0–f/2.8，浅景深。

items.title: 海洋分开形成自定义陆地图案
items.description: 用途：超现实海洋概念图、创意背景与视觉海报素材。通过形状、海浪状态和陆地颜色控制俯视图案；中英文参数需成对保持同义。圆形与白色仅为可执行示例默认值，并非来源指定。
items.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic top-down image of a vibrant blue ocean with wavy water being magically pushed aside by an unseen force. The parted ocean reveals an empty expanse of land in the shape of a circle, with a stark white interior. Make the shape distinctly recognizable and preserve an ultra-thin, sharply defined boundary line between the empty land and the surrounding water. The intense contrast between the white land and vivid blue ocean emphasizes the supernatural parting effect. Keep the revealed land empty and the composition focused on the shape and surrounding water.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅超写实俯视图：一片鲜亮的蓝色海洋，水面状态为波浪起伏，海水被一股看不见的力量神奇地推向两侧。分开的海洋露出一块空旷陆地，其形状为圆形，内部呈鲜明的白色。让图案轮廓清晰可辨，空旷陆地与周围海水之间保留极细且锐利的边界线。白色陆地与鲜亮蓝色海洋形成强烈对比，突出海水被超自然力量分开的效果。保持露出的陆地空旷，构图聚焦陆地图案与周围海水。

items.title: 同一模特的九格猫与网球时装拼贴
items.description: 同一成年模特在白底3x3高级时装拼贴中与猫、网球、气球和手袋互动。需上传人物身份参考图；九格保持统一身份与服装。
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic high-fashion studio collage as a strict 3x3 editorial grid. Use the uploaded image as the facial identity reference for the same adult model in every panel. Keep a seamless white background, soft diffused studio lighting, crisp focus, clean shadows and a polished magazine-quality commercial finish. The model wears one consistent navy sweater, relaxed denim, glasses and polished shoes, with a luxury structured handbag. Each square is separate and fully aligned: panel 1, cat beside the handbag; panel 2, model tossing playing cards; panel 3, holding white balloons; panel 4, pushing a shopping cart full of tennis balls; panel 5, magnifying-glass portrait; panel 6, vintage suitcases with a tennis ball; panel 7, cat perched on the model’s shoulders; panel 8, backward chair pose with a tennis ball; panel 9, cat inside the handbag. Keep the same identity and wardrobe across all nine panels, with playful surreal storytelling, no merged panels, no duplicate faces beyond the one model, no collage seams, random text, logos or watermark. Retain natural proportions and clean shadows. Source lens settings are provenance only; do not claim unsupported camera controls.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅写实高端时装摄影拼贴，严格采用3x3编辑网格。使用上传图像作为九个面板中同一位成年模特的面部身份参考。保持无缝白色背景、柔和漫射影棚光、清晰对焦、干净阴影和杂志级商业质感。模特全程穿统一的藏蓝色毛衣、宽松牛仔裤、眼镜和抛光鞋，并搭配结构化高级手袋。九个方格彼此独立且严格对齐：第1格猫在手袋旁；第2格模特抛接扑克牌；第3格手持白色气球；第4格推着装满网球的购物车；第5格放大镜肖像；第6格复古行李箱与网球；第7格猫站在模特肩上；第8格倒坐椅子姿势与网球；第9格猫在手袋里。九格保持同一身份和服装，呈现俏皮超现实叙事，不合并面板，不出现同一模特之外的重复人脸，不要拼贴接缝、随机文字、标志或水印。保持自然比例和干净阴影。来源镜头参数仅作出处信息，不声称工具提供不支持的相机控制。

items.title: 逆光亚麻衬衫侧身时装人像
items.description: 3:4侧身时装人像，以逆光展现宽松亚麻衬衫的透光纹理与优雅轮廓，保持身体遮盖。需上传人物身份参考图；示例使用统一参考人物。
items.prompt: Create a 3:4 fashion portrait of one adult female model wearing a loose linen shirt and standing sideways in a graceful pose. Use the uploaded image as the facial identity reference for this single model; keep the source styling, clothing, pose and lighting. Backlight the linen so that the fabric transmits light but remains nontransparent: emphasize the graceful front and back contours of the clothed figure through the shirt silhouette, without revealing intimate body parts. Preserve the loose linen texture and delicate interplay of transmitted light and clothing folds. No sensitive parts are exposed.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张3:4时装人像：一位成年女性模特穿着宽松亚麻衬衫，优雅地侧身站立。使用上传图像作为这位唯一模特的面部身份参考，并保留来源造型、服装、姿势和光线。以逆光照亮亚麻面料，使布料透光但不透明：通过衬衫剪影突出着衣身形前后优雅的轮廓，不透出私密身体部位。保留宽松亚麻纹理与透射光、衣褶之间的细腻关系。不露出敏感部位。

items.title: 悬海：极简超现实中文概念海报
items.description: 以头顶悬海与下方渺小人物形成尺度反差，采用浅灰白留白和克制中文排版，表达对现实的观察与疑问。标题文案可替换。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Generate a finished vertical 3:4 Chinese surrealist concept poster with complete, clear and accurate Chinese typography. Use minimalist pale gray-white negative space, a restrained cool or neutral palette, cinematic realism and a quiet, ethereal modern art-museum atmosphere. The source example chosen is an ocean suspended overhead: place an immense realistic sea above a clean, empty misty ground with a slight reflection, creating an unmistakable displaced reality. Keep one very small, solitary person at the center or lower part of the open ground, looking upward at the suspended ocean. Preserve the tiny figure's quiet, lonely and restrained posture to create strong scale contrast; do not enlarge the figure. The upper subject should feel immense and slightly oppressive, while the bottom remains mostly empty. Let typography respond freely to the image through asymmetry, vertical or bottom horizontal title placement, edge copy and multiple zones of negative space rather than a rigid template. Set the main title exactly to '悬海' and subtitle exactly to '当海洋悬于头顶，现实还在原位吗？'. Optional tiny text may add one brief conceptual question; limited English may be secondary, never dominant. Keep typography refined and restrained. No cartoons, cheap science-fiction styling, e-commerce advertising, complex collage, gaudy saturation, watermarks or real brand logos.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

生成一张竖版3:4、已完成中文排版的超现实概念海报，中文文字必须清晰准确。采用极简浅灰白留白、克制的冷色或中性色调、电影写实感，以及安静空灵的现代美术馆氛围。本示例选择来源中的头顶悬海：将巨大而真实的海洋悬置于上方，下方是干净空旷、略有反射的雾面地面，形成明确的现实错位。在空地中央或偏下方保留一个非常渺小的独立人物，仰望悬海；人物安静、孤独、克制，以形成强烈尺度反差，不要放大人物。上方主体巨大且略有压迫感，下方保持大量留白。排版可通过左右不对称、竖排或底部横排标题、边缘辅助文案和多区块留白自由响应画面，不必套用固定模板。主标题准确写为“悬海”，副标题准确写为“当海洋悬于头顶，现实还在原位吗？”。可选极小字可加入一句简短概念提问，少量英文只能作为辅助，不能主导。字体精致克制。不要卡通、廉价科幻、电商广告感、复杂拼贴、艳俗高饱和、水印或真实品牌标志。

items.title: 书山中的困惑女孩漫画插画
items.description: 复古漫画与动漫风格的书山场景，需上传人物身份参考图；示例使用统一参考人物。保留九个英文书名、问号气泡及2:3构图。
items.prompt: Create a whimsical 2:3 vertical comic illustration of one young adult woman buried under a chaotic mountain of colorful books. Use the uploaded identity reference for her facial identity, translated into the illustration style; keep the following hairstyle and expression. Only her head and one reaching hand emerge, along with the tail of a cat hidden among the books. She has messy dark hair in a loose bun with stray strands, oversized round glasses, wide shocked eyes and a surprised open mouth. Her hand reaches outward as if trying to escape. A thought bubble with one large question mark floats above her head. Use a slightly top-down centered medium close-up, sharp facial and foreground-book detail, and books filling nearly the entire frame. Behind them is a minimal soft pastel-purple backdrop. Dozens of red, blue, yellow and green books are stacked and scattered. Render the following fictional English book titles clearly, without translating them: Amy’s Guide to Survival; Advanced Overthinking; The Art of Procrastination; How to Talk to Your Cat; World Domination for Beginners; Cooking 101; Philosophy for Confused People; Dangerously Good Ideas; The History of Naps. Combine retro comics with anime-inspired character design, detailed digital painting, clean bold ink outlines, slight print grain and vintage paper texture. Use saturated primary colors against the pastel backdrop, soft diffused studio light, medium contrast and clean shadows. Keep books, lettering, face and textures detailed. Avoid blur, low resolution, extra limbs, deformed hands, cropped face, distorted text, messy anatomy, poor proportions, watermarks and noise.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅2:3竖版奇趣漫画插画：一位年轻成年女性被五颜六色、杂乱堆积的书山掩埋。使用上传的身份参考图，将她的面部身份转译为插画风格；发型和表情遵循下述设定。书堆中只露出她的头和一只向外伸出的手，以及藏在书中的猫的一条尾巴。她留着凌乱的深色松散丸子头，有零散发丝，戴超大圆框眼镜，双眼惊讶地睁大，嘴巴张开。她向外伸手，像要从书堆中脱身。头顶漂浮一个含大问号的思考气泡。采用轻微俯视、居中的中近景，面部和前景书籍细节清晰，书籍几乎铺满画面。背景是简洁柔和的淡紫色。数十本红、蓝、黄、绿的书堆叠散落。以下虚构英文书名须清楚呈现并保持英文，不翻译：Amy’s Guide to Survival；Advanced Overthinking；The Art of Procrastination；How to Talk to Your Cat；World Domination for Beginners；Cooking 101；Philosophy for Confused People；Dangerously Good Ideas；The History of Naps。融合复古漫画与动漫角色设计，采用细腻数字绘画、干净粗黑墨线、轻微印刷颗粒和复古纸张纹理。饱和原色搭配柔和背景，使用柔和漫射摄影棚光、中等对比度和干净阴影。细致刻画书籍、文字、面部与纹理。避免模糊、低分辨率、多余肢体、手部畸形、裁切面部、文字扭曲、混乱解剖、不当比例、水印和噪点。

items.title: 浅蓝背景白衬衫领带时尚写真
items.description: 浅蓝影棚中的白衬衫、松领带与米色高腰长裤时尚写真。需上传人物参考图；示例使用统一参考人物。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the single adult woman. Preserve her visible facial identity; clothing, hairstyle and pose follow the scene below. Create a photorealistic fashion portrait of an elegant, confident adult woman against a seamless light baby-blue studio background with soft even lighting. Long voluminous side-parted wavy dark-brown hair falls over her shoulders, with strands framing her face. Use subtle natural makeup and a gentle direct gaze. She wears a crisp oversized white button-up shirt, sleeves rolled to the forearms and top buttons undone, with a loosely knotted black silk necktie draped across her chest. Pair it with high-waisted light-beige trousers, a black leather belt and a distinctive hanging pale-pink leather strap detail. Place a silver watch on her left wrist, a thin gold bracelet on her right wrist, and delicate gold and silver rings on both hands. Frame a three-quarter-length portrait: her right hand gracefully touches her hair near her cheek and chin; her left hand rests at her hip with fingers lightly holding the belt area. Use a slight contrapposto stance and a natural stylish fashion-model presence. items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Create a 2x2 grid at 1:1 for four famous books, preserving each subject's recognizable structure while combining grainy line illustration with soft pastel miniatures and still-life object worlds.
