items.title: 空间透视建筑体量排版海报
items.description: 空间透视建筑体量排版海报，使用上传人物参考图绑定主可见人物身份。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Create a high-impact 9:16 perspective typography poster where oversized type is physically integrated into architecture and becomes complete from one intentional camera viewpoint. Build the structure first, then make typography follow real depth, surfaces, angles, gaps, folds and occlusion. Use vertical slicing, spanning, offsets or folded planes so fragments align into one readable word from the intended view. Keep the main word at roughly 35-55% of the composition, use bold geometric sans-serif type, one solid accent color and restrained concrete, black, white or neutral stone materials. If a person is included, keep them small as scale reference and let architecture naturally overlap them. Add only minimal editorial information. Avoid floating text, random distortion, weak alignment, decorative extrusion, neon sci-fi effects, excess copy, clutter, watermarks and numbering.
items.prompt_zh: 以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。创建一张9:16高冲击力透视排版海报，让超大号字体在物理上融入建筑，并仅在一个预定相机视角下变得完整。先构建建筑结构，再让排版严格遵循真实深度、表面、角度、缝隙、折叠和遮挡。使用切片、跨度、偏移或折叠平面，让碎片从预定视角对齐成一个清晰可读的词。主要词汇约占构图35-55%，使用粗体几何无衬线字体、一种纯色强调色和克制的混凝土、黑、白或中性石材。若包含人物，保持其微小并作为比例参考，让建筑自然遮挡或重叠人物。仅添加少量编辑信息。避免悬浮文字、随机扭曲、对齐不佳、装饰性挤压、霓虹科幻效果、过多文案、杂乱背景、水印和编号。

items.title: 高级时尚社论纵向狭缝扫描人像
items.description: 高级时尚社论纵向狭缝扫描人像，使用上传的人物参考图绑定主可见人物身份。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Create a premium fashion editorial portrait using controlled vertical slit-scan distortion. Keep one clear identity anchor such as the eyes, profile or facial outline; break selected areas into varied vertical slices with gradual optical fragmentation while preserving realistic skin, hair and fabric texture. Keep some areas sharp, use a restrained palette, strong silhouette and generous negative space, with clean editorial typography limited to one title, one short phrase and minimal supporting copy. Make it feel like an optical photography experiment and high-fashion magazine poster, not a digital glitch effect. Avoid RGB splitting, VHS noise, horizontal scanlines, uniform slices, neon cyberpunk graphics, excessive text, plastic skin, logos, numbering and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。使用受控的纵向狭缝扫描畸变创作高级时尚社论人像。保留眼睛、侧脸或面部轮廓等至少一个清晰身份锚点；将选定区域分解为宽度、压缩度和水平位移各异的垂直切片，从清晰摄影渐进到光学碎片化，同时保留真实皮肤、头发和织物纹理。保留部分完全清晰区域，使用克制色调、强烈轮廓和大量负空间，排版限制为一个标题、一个短句和极少辅助文案。整体应像光学摄影实验和高级时尚杂志海报，而不是数字故障效果。避免RGB分离、VHS噪点、水平扫描线、均匀切片、霓虹赛博朋克图形、过多文字、塑料皮肤、标志、编号和水印。

items.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic magazine portrait of the same clearly adult East Asian woman from the 10A identity reference standing on a cold winter beach. Preserve her recognizable facial identity, mature adult appearance, natural proportions and real skin texture. She faces the camera in a calm confident pose, centered in a vertical portrait frame, with clear expressive eyes in crisp focus. A soft sea breeze moves her long loose dark hair and a few fine strands across the air, creating subtle natural motion.

Dress her in a lightweight tailored camel wool coat worn open over an ivory fine-knit turtleneck sweater, with one narrow taupe scarf tucked loosely inside the lapels. The layers are elegant and suitable for a chilly shore without appearing bulky. Keep the fabrics opaque, naturally fitted and visibly textured, with realistic folds and wind movement.

Behind her, show winter beach waves and a low horizon under a lightly overcast sky, fully softened into creamy bokeh by very shallow depth of field. Use gentle golden winter light filtered through cloud, a soft diffused frontal key and a delicate warm rim light along her hair and coat. Keep skin tones natural, shadows soft and highlights restrained. Simulate an 85mm professional portrait lens at f/1.8 and ISO 200: sharp face and eyes, smooth background separation, subtle lens compression, realistic high-detail skin and natural color grading. The result should feel cold, serene, refined and cinematic, like a premium seasonal fashion magazine portrait. No second person, childlike appearance, distorted face, malformed hand, bulky parka, missing coat, extra scarf, busy background, hard shadow, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, over-sharpening, strong HDR, oversaturated teal-orange grade, readable text, logo, watermark, collage or interface graphic.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一幅超写实电影感高级杂志人像，画面中为 10A 身份参考里的同一位明确成年的东亚女性，她站在寒冷的冬日海滩上。保持她可辨识的面部身份、成熟成年外观、自然比例与真实皮肤纹理。她在竖版人像构图中央平静自信地面向镜头，清澈而富有表现力的双眼精准对焦。柔和海风吹动她松散垂落的深色长发，少量细发丝在空气中飘起，形成克制自然的动态。

她穿一件轻薄剪裁的驼色羊毛外套，敞开叠穿象牙色细针织高领毛衣，一条窄灰褐色围巾松弛收在翻领内。层次优雅，适合寒冷海岸但不显臃肿。所有衣料不透明、自然合身且纹理清楚，带可信褶皱和微风动态。

背景呈现冬日海浪与低矮地平线，天空略微阴沉；非常浅的景深将整个背景柔化为奶油般散景。使用穿透云层的柔和金色冬光、正面柔和漫射主光，以及沿发丝和外套边缘的一道细腻暖色轮廓光。保持肤色自然、阴影柔和、高光克制。模拟 85mm 专业人像镜头、f/1.8 光圈与 ISO 200：脸部和双眼锐利、背景分离顺滑、透视压缩自然、皮肤细节真实、色彩分级自然。整体氛围寒冷、宁静、精致且富有电影感，像高级冬季时尚杂志人像。不得出现第二个人物、幼态儿童外观、脸部畸变、畸形手部、厚重羽绒服、外套缺失、额外围巾、杂乱背景、生硬阴影、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、过度锐化、强烈 HDR、过饱和青橙调、可读文字、标志、水印、拼贴或界面图形。

1. Bench sitting: Person sitting on a light blue bench or window seat, one leg hanging naturally, the other leg bent on the seat, hands pulling both sides of the twin tails outward, body slightly close to the camera, looking straight at the camera, slight smile.
2. Standing interaction: Person standing in the dessert shop, one hand near the cheek doing a slight cat claw or face-pinching motion, the other hand holding a transparent drink cup with a light-colored drink and lemon slices, one eye winking, the other eye looking at the camera, one leg naturally bent backward.

穿白色高级水手风短裙套装，蓝灰色大水手领，白色双线滚边，胸前长领巾垂落，收腰剪裁，短款蓬松裙摆或分层荷叶裙摆，真实布料纹理和缝线细节，搭配白色短袜和厚底白色运动鞋；整体为甜品店轻复古制服风，高级感角色穿搭，避免普通校服感。

动作可自由组合：
1. 长椅坐姿：人物坐在浅蓝色长椅或窗边座位，一腿自然下垂，另一腿弯曲放在椅面，双手分别拉住两侧双马尾向外展开，身体微微靠近镜头，正面看向镜头，轻微微笑。

2. 站姿互动：人物站在甜品店内，一只手靠近脸颊做轻微猫爪或捏脸动作，另一只手拿透明饮料杯，杯中有浅色饮品和柠檬片，一只眼睛眨眼，另一只眼睛看向镜头，一条腿自然向后弯曲。

整体摄影风格：韩系甜品店日常写真，朋友手机随手拍，真实人物存在感，柔和曝光，轻微HDR，干净明亮，低饱和色彩，背景自然，避免商业棚拍感。左下艺术签名“DeepBlue”

避免：动漫脸，二次元风格，未成年感，娃娃脸比例，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，AI生成感，影楼硬光，欧美成熟妆容，普通校服化，夸张身体比例，手部错误，双马尾缺失，服装结构错误。

items.prompt:
Use ref-10a-v1 only for the facial identity of the main visible adult East Asian woman. Create a photorealistic 9:16 nighttime portrait at a rain-darkened covered tram shelter, with distant amber streetlights and wet pavement reflections. She has shoulder-length, softly tousled dark-brown hair and natural makeup. Dress her in a modest charcoal long-sleeved midi dress, opaque black tights, black ankle boots, and a small silver pendant.

Place the camera close to the ground for an intimate low-angle view. She sits on the dry shelter bench in a compact curled pose: one fully covered knee is raised nearer the lens, the other leg folds inward, and both arms rest loosely across the raised knee. Turn her shoulders slightly inward, tilt her head gently, lower her chin, and direct her eyes upward into the camera. Keep her expression restrained, quiet, wistful, guarded, and cinematic, without a smile. Frame the pose clearly without emphasizing the body.

Use direct on-camera flash to render the subject crisp while the surrounding shelter remains darker and atmospheric. Preserve realistic adult skin texture, individual hair strands, accurate hands and legs, believable knit fabric and tights, and a candid late-night photography feel. Keep the wet ground reflections subdued, the background uncluttered, and the subject cleanly separated from the darkness. Do not add extra people, revealing clothing, unrelated text, logos, signatures, watermarks, or malformed anatomy.

She has a small oval face, clean and soft facial lines, soft almond eyes, a gentle, quiet, subtle, and composed gaze, a delicate and natural nose shape, and soft, clear lip lines, overall presenting the temperament of a noble boudoir female lead. The base makeup is light, thin, delicate, fair, and translucent, presenting a soft creamy water-light feel; the eye makeup is delicately blended with peach pink, soft pink-brown, and light warm brown to enhance the warm moisture of the soft almond eyes; eyelashes are naturally slender, and the aegyosal is softly highlighted; the blush is peach pink, honey peach pink, or light rouge pink, mainly distributed under the eyes and in the middle of the face, distinct but sophisticated; the lip makeup is soft and moist light peach pink, petal pink, or low-saturation rose pink, with a moist and full texture but not excessively influencer-like; facial highlights slightly brighten the tip of the nose, the center of the face, under the eyes, and the cupid's bow. The overall makeup is delicately raised and exquisite, but not 'sweet girl'-like and not modern influencer-like.

The hairstyle is long straight black hair, half-draped and half-pinned, with moderately fluffy hair on top, smooth and delicate hair strands, and a small amount of natural broken hair framing the face. The accessory level is ornate, wearing light gold hair ornaments, pearl tassels, white jade flower ornaments, a small amount of green jade embellishments, and delicate buyao (step-shakes), paired with pearl, white jade, and light gold thin chain long pendant earrings, overall ornate and light, without overwhelming the face. The clothing consists of a light gauze outer robe + an embroidered inner layer + a pearl waist chain, belonging to a medium-to-high ornateness ancient style boudoir female lead outfit, using an aqua, white, and gold color scheme, dominated by aqua, light green jade, and soft light cyan-green, with white, milk white, and moon white as auxiliary colors, and light gold, pearls, white jade, and a small amount of light green jade-like ornaments as accents. The inner long dress features detailed embroidery of floral patterns, vine patterns, jade leaf patterns, or flowing cloud patterns, while the outer light gauze robe is semi-transparent, soft, and draping, with a detailed pearl waist chain worn at the waist, composed of thin light gold chains, pearls, small white jade pendants, and a small amount of jade ornaments. The upper body contour is soft, elegant, and dignified, with a full and natural chest, overall dignified and restrained.

The character is leaning and sitting by the side of an ancient-style soft couch, body slightly turned, one hand gently lifting a white gauze curtain, looking out the window, the camera shot is a half-body close-up. The scene is in front of a magnolia window, with white gauze curtains and an ancient-style soft couch environment, the background features blurred magnolia flower shadows, window lattices, white gauze curtains, and soft couch details, with hazy magnolia shadows, soft light from the window, and layers of the indoor boudoir visible. The lighting is soft daylight by the window, with the gauze curtains providing diffuse reflection making the face delicate and bright, and soft luster on the side of the face, hair tips, earrings, and edges of the light gauze. The character is the absolute visual center, the overall image is high-precision and high-completion, the makeup is distinct, hair strands are delicate, clothing layers are clear, and the background does not overpower the subject, possessing the completion level of an ancient style xianxia noble boudoir female lead character poster.

场景：日出时分的一个巨大的现代马士基物流枢纽。在前景中，一辆崭新的马士基蓝色电动集装箱卡车从高级物流终端自信地驶向镜头。卡车装载着一个官方马士基海运集装箱，上面印有真实的马士基星星标志和企业蓝色涂装。车辆处于极具张力的前侧三四分透视位置，成为构图中的视觉主角。

在它身后，一个最先进的集装箱码头正繁忙运作。巨大的岸桥起重机精准地吊起集装箱，自动导引车在场站内无缝移动，整齐堆放的马士基集装箱营造出强烈的几何律动感。远处的码头停泊着一艘巨大的马士基集装箱船，船上装载着数百个集装箱。在地平线上方，一架现代货机冲向云霄，完成了从海洋到航空的端到端物流叙事。

人的存在为活动增添了生命力：戴着安全帽的物流经理在数字平板电脑上审查运营情况，起重机操作员协调集装箱移动，叉车驾驶员运输货物，码头工人检查集装箱，所有这些都是自然捕捉的，没有直视镜头。每个动作都显得真实，创造出一个生动的工业生态系统，而非摆拍的企业照片。

环境干净、工程化且高端，灵感来自斯堪的纳维亚工业建筑，拥有抛光混凝土、玻璃控制塔、有序的集装箱堆栈、平静的海水、清爽的蓝天和细微的大气雾霾。整个物流枢纽给人以高效、可持续和技术先进的感觉。

构图大胆且极具图形感。巨大的白色留白平衡了工业场景。印有“MOVE THE WORLD.”的大型编辑排版字体融入建筑之中，部分重叠在集装箱上，但没有遮挡重要主体。细致的技术网格线、微妙的路线图形、坐标标记和受物流启发的极简设计元素强化了马士基的工程精度。巨大的马士基蓝色几何面板固定了构图，创造出一种现代的企业视觉系统，且毫不杂乱。

调色板：真实的马士基蓝 (#42B0D5)、纯白、柔和的混凝土灰、钢灰、深海蓝以及克制的安全黄点缀。斯堪的纳维亚极简主义，清晰的对比，高端企业审美。

光照：明亮的自然晨光，柔和的漫射阳光，油漆金属、海运集装箱、卡车车身和玻璃建筑上的真实反射，清晰的大气深度，高端商业汽车和工业摄影。

由 Phase One XF IQ4 150MP 中画幅相机拍摄，搭配 Schneider Kreuznach 55mm 镜头，超高动态范围，锐利的细节，真实的集装箱纹理、钢铁表面、轮胎橡胶、玻璃反射、油漆金属、细微磨损、真实的工业材料、自然的皮肤纹理以及高端的色彩科学。

最终图像感觉应该像马士基全球综合物流活动在 Behance 上的案例研究主封面——现代、大胆、干净、设计精良、绝对高端，并且一眼就能认出是马士基官方社交媒体广告。

items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible adult East Asian woman. Keep the source pose, clothing, composition, lighting and editorial print feel unless they conflict with the identity reference. Create an original fictional 3:4 vertical retro fashion magazine cover, not a reproduction of any existing publication. Use a large warm beige-gray blank background, an oversized deep burgundy publication name “SORAN” at the top, a full-width deep red serif title “IN BLOOM” at the bottom, and only minimal restrained column text at the sides. Show one adult woman seated sideways and looking back over her shoulder, with her face in the upper-middle right. Her long dark hair falls into a large detailed silhouette around the face. She wears a matte deep-red editorial bodysuit with modest opaque coverage and light beige ribbed stockings; her folded legs form a triangular base, and one hand supports her from behind. Keep the posture calm, restrained and distant, with the red publication system connecting the title and clothing without cutting through body structure. Use soft diffused light from upper front left, medium-low contrast, natural skin and hair texture, clothing texture, stocking ribbing and fine vintage print grain. Integrate the exact word “Soran” naturally into a woven label near the shoulder or neckline, with subtle hidden echoes in fabric texture, stocking ribs, hair highlights, stitching and paper grain; all marks must follow material perspective and remain tasteful, never detached or over the face. items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中主要可见成年东亚女性的面部身份参考。除非与身份参考冲突，否则保留原有姿势、服装、构图、光线和复古印刷社论质感。创作一张原创虚构刊物的3:4竖版复古时尚杂志封面，不要复刻任何现有出版物。使用大面积暖米灰留白背景，顶部放置超大深酒红色刊名“SORAN”，底部放置跨幅深红衬线标题“IN BLOOM”，左右只保留少量克制的栏文。画面只出现一位成年女性，她侧坐并回头越过肩膀看向镜头，脸部位于上中偏右；深色长发垂落成围绕面部的大面积暗色轮廓，同时保留发丝细节。她穿哑光深红色、适度遮盖且不透明的社论风连体服，搭配浅米色罗纹长袜；双腿折叠形成底部三角基座，一只手在身后支撑。姿态冷静、克制并带距离感，红色刊名系统与服装和底部标题相互呼应，但文字不要切断身体结构。使用左前上方柔和漫射光和中低对比度，保留自然肌肤、发丝、服装、袜面罗纹和细腻的复古杂志印刷颗粒。将准确单词“Soran”自然嵌入肩部或领口附近的织标，并在织物纹理、袜面罗纹、发丝高光、缝线和纸张颗粒中形成低调隐藏呼应；所有字样都必须顺应材质透视且有品味，不能脱离材质或覆盖脸部。避免现实杂志商标、明星相似、直接复刻现有封面、多人物、密集小字、乱码、文字遮挡眼睛、手腿变形、塑料皮肤、霓虹、硬闪、HDR、极端高对比、模糊、外置水印、贴纸式标志、漂浮文字或重复的Soran字样。

items.title: 黑色网眼猫咪 Y2K 另类街头时装
items.description: 黑银配色的 Y2K 另类街头服装设计说明；聚焦无肩带网眼上衣、左右独立猫脸轮廓、透明短外套、不对称裹裙、超高筒袜与厚底靴，不绑定真人身份。
items.prompt:
Black-based Y2K alternative street fashion merging cute and cool. Primarily black, with low-key silver hardware. Not heavy punk clothing or cosplay, but endowed with a sense of lightness and transparency that works on the street. Not lingerie style or underwear style.

【Top】
Using delicate and thin black fashion mesh fabric to make a compact bandeau-style top. No shoulder straps, backless strings, or straps. Covering the chest with a nearly horizontal line, not a simple tube, but a three-dimensional structure that naturally fits the body. Do not use thick leather, latex, PVC, or vinyl materials. A small silver ring is placed in the center, with a thin and light material, slightly larger black decorative ribbon attached below it. No fabric added below the ribbon. No longitudinal fabric, triangular cloth, front piece, hanging cloth, or additional panels covering the abdomen. No corsets, bustiers, bodysuits, or long tops. Instead of layering garters as separate pieces, thin black faux-leather-style details are used as the top edge, bottom edge, and left and right outer piping of the bandeau top, integrated together. No straps extending to the upper chest or shoulders. Small silver rings, buckles, rivets, etc., are kept to a minimum.

【Cat Theme】
On the inside of the chest part of the top, place one black cat-face shaped silhouette independently on the left and right. Not connected in the center, do not place one large cat. Only a textureless black outline of a rounded cat face with two short triangular ears. No cat body, neck, limbs, tail, eyes, nose, mouth, or whiskers. Size is small to medium, leaving mesh space around it. Not patches on the surface of the mesh, but thin and non-transparent panels sewn tightly to the inside. No thick appliques or 3D decorations.

【Outerwear】
Black or dark charcoal gray, transparent organza or chiffon ultra-short top. An open-front short bolero or short shrug that only lightly covers the shoulders and upper chest. Does not block the cat silhouettes, central ring, and decorative ribbon of the top. The sleeves are transparent long puff sleeves that swell moderately from the shoulder to the upper arm. Naturally tapering from below the elbow to the wrist, with thin cuffs. No giant balloon sleeves, excessive ruffles, or princess style.

【Bottoms】
Black low-waist asymmetrical wrap mini skirt. No culottes, skorts, or integrated shorts. A clear one-piece wrap skirt with fabric overlapping diagonally from one side to the opposite side. The embedding of the inner fabric is kept short, creating a slit-like opening on one side, allowing the structure to naturally reveal the thigh slightly when walking. No crotch piece, pant-type seams, or short hems. The hem is asymmetrical, slightly shorter on one side. Material is matte soft black fabric. A thin black belt, small silver rings, short chains, thin hanging straps, and small cat-shaped charms are discreetly added to the waist.

【Legs/Shoes】
Thin and naturally transparent black ultra-high-thigh tight stockings. Covering continuously from the toes to the mid-thigh on the left and right respectively. The upper end is not a loose garter, but a thin and flat black belt-style piping. No lace, embroidery, ruffles, or large ribbons. Feet are black slim-fit platform mid-calf boots. Square-ish toe, low-key silver hardware. Neck is paired with a thin black rivet-style choker.

【Overall Effect】
Combining the black mesh strapless bandeau top, left and right cat face silhouettes, central ring and decorative ribbon, integrated piping garters, transparent puff sleeve top, one-side slit low-waist wrap mini skirt, and ultra-high-thigh stockings. Dominated by black and silver, blending cute, cool, and Y2K-style lightness and transparency.
items.prompt_zh:
以黑色为主调，融合可爱与酷感的Y2K另类街头时尚。
以黑色为主，金具使用低调的银色。不做沉重的朋克服装或cosplay，而是赋予能在街头成立的轻盈感和透明感。不做内衣风或内衣风格。

【上衣】
使用细腻轻薄的黑色时尚网眼面料，制作紧凑的班杜式上衣。
不加肩带、露背绳或肩带。
以接近水平的线条覆盖胸部，不是简单的筒状，而是自然贴合身体的立体结构。
不使用厚实的皮革、乳胶、PVC或乙烯基材质。

中央放置一个小型银环，其下方附上薄而轻的材质、稍大一些的黑色装饰缎带。
缎带下方不添加面料。不做纵长布料、三角布、前片、垂布或覆盖腹部的附加面板。
不做紧身胸衣、紧身背心、紧身连体衣或长上衣。

不将束带作为独立件叠加，而是将细黑色的仿皮革风细节作为班杜上衣的上缘、下缘及左右外侧的镶边，一体化处理。
不做延伸到胸上或肩部的肩带。
小型银环、扣环、铆钉等保持最小化。

【猫咪主题】
在上衣胸部内侧，左右独立放置一个黑色猫脸形状的轮廓各一个。
不连接中央，不放置一个大猫。
仅为圆润猫脸加上两个短三角耳的无纹理黑色轮廓。
不加猫的身体、脖子、四肢、尾巴、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、胡须。
大小从小到中等，周围绕留网眼空白。
不是网眼表面的贴片，而是密着内侧缝制的薄而非透明面板。不做厚实的贴花或立体装饰。

【外套】
黑色或深烟灰色的、透明的欧根纱或雪纺制超短上衣。
仅轻覆肩部和胸上部的开襟短款波莱罗，或短款耸肩。
不遮挡上衣的猫轮廓、中央环和装饰缎带。

袖子是从肩部到上臂适度鼓起的透明感长袖泡泡袖。
从肘下到手腕自然收细，袖口做成细袖口。
不做巨大的气球袖、过度褶边或公主风。

【下装】
黑色的低腰不对称裹式迷你裙。
不做裙裤、裤裙或一体式短裤。
从一侧斜向对侧叠布的、明确的一片裹裙。
内侧面料的嵌入保持较短，在一侧制造类似开衩的开口，让走动时大腿自然稍露结构。
不做裆布、裤型接缝或短裤下摆。
下摆为一侧稍短的不对称。材质为哑光柔软的黑色布料。
腰部低调添加细黑腰带、小型银环、短链条、细垂带和小猫形吊饰。

【腿部·鞋子】
薄而自然透感的黑色超高筒紧身袜。
从脚尖到大腿中段，左右分别连续覆盖。
上端不是宽松的袜带，而是细而平坦的黑色腰带式镶边。
不加蕾丝、刺绣、褶边或大缎带。

脚部是黑色细身厚底中筒靴。鞋头偏方形，银色金具低调。
颈部配细黑铆钉式颈圈。

【整体效果】
组合黑色网眼无肩带班杜上衣、左右猫脸轮廓、中央环与装饰缎带、镶边一体式束带、透明泡泡袖上衣、一侧开衩低腰裹式迷你裙、超高筒紧身袜。
以黑银色为主，融合可爱、酷感，以及Y2K式的轻盈与透明感。

items.title: 奶油蕾丝床幔复古学院风成年女性人像
items.description: 奶油色蕾丝床幔中的复古学院生活方式成年女性人像；保留盘腿姿势、白蓝运动服、Soran 三层材质水印与柔和室内光线，人物使用统一身份参考。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the single visible adult woman. Preserve the source hairstyle, clothing, pose, lace-curtain bedroom setting, watermark placement and retro portrait style; the reference takes priority over conflicting facial features.

3:4 vertical, a realistic retro campus lifestyle portrait set within cream-colored lace bed curtains. An adult young woman sits centered on a soft bed surface in a cross-legged posture, body leaning slightly forward, facing the camera directly with a quiet, restrained, and slightly detached expression. Warm brown medium-long natural wavy hair, fair skin, and light red lips. She wears a white retro sporty short-sleeved T-shirt with a blue crew neck and cuffs, featuring a blue and red old-print style sports graphic on the chest with the main text "SORAN RUNNING CLUB 1984", paired with light blue high-waist jeans with rolled cuffs, cream-white sneakers, and white socks.

The scene is surrounded by cream-colored semi-transparent lace curtains from the left and right, forming a soft and private arched frame, with light-colored bedding and a warm white indoor space in the background. The subject is in the center of the frame, her legs filling the lower half, one hand placed naturally near her leg or ankle, and the other supporting her on the bed to one side. The sneakers in the foreground show a slight foreshortening effect, but without exaggerated wide-angle distortion. The overall atmosphere is quiet, intimate, light retro, with the feel of an old photo album campus lifestyle portrait.

The lighting uses a soft front fill light or a weak direct flash effect from the front-left of the lens; the face, chest print, arms, and footwear are clearly visible, with shallow and natural shadows. items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity basis for the single adult woman, translating her recognizable features into delicate Oriental paper-art modeling. Keep all source hair, costume, pose and paper materials; do not render her face as a photograph.

Create a 9:16 vertical modern Oriental female dreamscape in intricate layered paper-cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, paper diorama and shadow-box theater form. Theme: "She re-embraces her childhood self." In a dream paper garden, a woman opens her arms to receive a tiny glowing paper silhouette symbolizing a forgotten childhood memory, expressing self-comfort and healing. The glow is translucent light and paper, not a physical child or second person.

The only figure is an Oriental adult woman of about 25, quiet, gentle yet firm and mature. Soft round-oval face, clear almond eyes with a tiny glimmer of tears, relieved tender expression and faint reassuring smile; refined paper-sculpted features, neither photorealistic skin, excessive cartooning nor plastic 3D. Her long black hair is tied low, made of soft paper ribbons, fine hollow-cut strands and flowing paper arcs. Pearl-white tiny flowers and star fragments sit lightly in the hair; no heavy palace crown.

She wears a cream-white and pale peach-pink paper-art long dress. Layered petal-shaped and curved paper pieces form the hem; fine flowering-branch cutouts decorate the cuffs. Show thin layered dress panels, folds, cut edges, paper thickness, fibers and intricate openwork like a meticulously handmade paper-sculpture gown.

A folded-open paper screen unfolds into a garden of vines, flowers, stars, clouds, glowing seeds and paper boats. Every plant, cloud, boat and ornament uses the same dimensional cut-paper material, not real vegetation or flat decorative illustration. Center the woman slightly low: she bends gently before the open screen, arms softly opened forward, gaze lowered toward the warm glowing memory silhouette. Vines and boats curl around her protectively. Clearly separate foreground paper, main figure, middle-ground screen and background dream layers, creating a complete multi-layer stage with readable depth.

Palette: warm white/cream base, peach pink for skirt, flowers and atmosphere, champagne gold for glow, selected patterns and accents, with only small turquoise touches in leaves, water or plant details. Each paper layer keeps its own pure color. Warm, luminous, bright and dreamy; no gray haze, dirty yellow, overall orange cast or uniform color filter.

Soft warm light falls from upper center. Paper edges glow gently and hollow edges transmit a little light; delicate natural shadows separate layers. Retain visible fibers, slight creases, hand-cut edges, thickness and extremely fine openwork. Emphasize layered structures and the enveloping paper garden without clutter. The effect is a contemporary Oriental art poster, paper display case and refined handcrafted installation, with the woman as the primary focal point and rich but restrained imagery. Mood is warm and healing, never sad or oppressive.

No minors, juvenile faces, actual children or second physical person; no photography, ordinary anime, plastic 3D, resin, clay, felt or childish craft effect. No Chinese New Year window decorations, zodiac cutouts or monochrome bright-red paper art. No material mismatch between figure and scene, missing/confused paper layers, dead-black shadows, gray image, overall color cast, excessive piled elements, obscured face, malformed hands, text, logo or watermark.

创作9:16竖版现代东方女性梦境，以精细层叠剪纸、立体纸雕、纸艺微缩景观和影盒剧场呈现。主题为“她重新抱住小时候的自己”：梦境纸艺花园中，女性张开双臂接住象征被遗忘童年记忆的一小团发光纸影，表达自我安慰与治愈。纸影由半透明光与纸构成，不是实体儿童，也不是第二个人物。

唯一人物是约25岁的东方成年女性，安静、温柔坚定而成熟。柔美圆鹅蛋脸、清亮杏眼与细微泪光，释然温柔的表情和淡淡安慰微笑；五官为精致纸雕，不是真人皮肤、过度卡通或塑料3D。黑色长发低挽，以柔软纸带、细密镂空发丝和流动纸弧构成，轻盈点缀珍珠白小花与细小星片，不要厚重宫廷冠饰。

奶油白与浅桃粉纸艺长裙，层叠花瓣形及圆弧纸片组成裙摆，袖口有细密花枝镂空。展示轻薄多层衣片、折痕、裁切边缘、纸张厚度、纤维与复杂镂空，像精工手制纸雕礼裙。

展开的纸屏风延伸为花园、花藤、花朵、星星、云、发光种子和纸船。所有植物、云、船及装饰统一采用立体剪纸材质，不是真实植物或平面装饰插画。人物居中偏下，在屏风前轻轻弯身，双臂向前柔和张开，低头望向温暖记忆纸影；花藤与纸船环绕形成保护感。清楚区分前景纸层、主体人物层、中景屏风层与背景梦境层，形成完整、景深清晰的多层舞台。

配色为暖白与奶油白基底，桃粉用于裙摆、花与氛围，香槟金用于发光、局部纹样和点缀；青绿只少量出现在叶、水面与植物细节。各纸层保有独立纯净颜色，温暖、明亮、清透、梦幻，不灰蒙、不脏黄、不整体偏橙、不统一套色滤镜。

柔和暖光从中央偏上落下，纸边微亮，镂空边缘略透光，细腻自然柔影区分纸层。保留可见纤维、微折痕、手切边、厚度与极精细镂空，强化层叠和纸艺花园的包裹感而不杂乱。整体兼具现代东方艺术海报、纸雕展柜与精致手工装置感，女性为首要视觉中心，意象丰富而克制，情绪温暖治愈，不悲伤压抑。

不要未成年人、幼态脸、真实儿童或第二实体人物；不要真人摄影、普通动漫、塑料3D、树脂、黏土、毛毡或儿童手工感。不要春节窗花、生肖剪纸、单色大红纸艺。不要人物与环境材质割裂、纸层缺失或混乱、死黑阴影、灰蒙画面、整体偏色、元素过堆、挡脸、畸形手、文字、标志或水印。

items.title: 东亚成年女性室内自拍写实人像
items.description: 以统一人物参考身份呈现的超写实室内生活方式自拍：齐颔深棕法式波波头、托腮与前景弯膝姿势、炭黑酸洗卫衣、暖米色卧室和柔和暖色环境光，具有高端手机摄影与韩系编辑质感。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible adult woman. Keep the source scene, hairstyle, clothing, pose, composition, lighting, camera language, and editorial style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create an ultra-photorealistic candid indoor selfie portrait of one young adult East Asian woman with fair porcelain-toned skin and delicate facial features. Give her a short chin-length textured French bob in deep dark brown, with soft layers, slightly messy volume, wispy bangs, and loose strands naturally crossing the face and partly covering one eye. Preserve thick natural eyebrows, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes looking directly into the camera with a calm dreamy expression, a small straight nose, soft gradient-pink lips, minimal Korean-inspired makeup, subtle blush, natural lashes, visible skin pores, realistic translucency, and fine hair strands.

She gently rests her face on her supported left hand, tilts her head slightly, and has one bent knee in light-wash blue denim visible in the foreground. She wears an oversized charcoal-black acid-wash long-sleeve sweatshirt whose cuff covers part of her hand, plus a delicate thin silver necklace with a tiny pendant. Place her in a cozy minimalist bedroom or modern hotel room with warm beige walls, an upholstered headboard, and built-in open shelves holding neatly arranged skincare bottles and a few small personal items; keep the space clean and uncluttered.

Use soft warm diffused ambient indoor light, gentle shadows, and cinematic warm color grading. Frame at eye level as if captured with a premium smartphone front camera and a 28mm-equivalent lens, with shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the eyes, and subtle background bokeh. The result should feel intimate, relaxed, effortless, and editorial, with true-to-life color, broad dynamic range, premium fashion-magazine polish, and high-resolution photographic detail. Avoid low quality, blur, soft focus on the eyes, noise, grain, overexposure, underexposure, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, CGI, 3D render, anime, cartoon, doll-like facial treatment, bad anatomy, deformed face, asymmetrical eyes, extra or missing fingers, distorted hands, duplicate body parts, unrealistic proportions, oversaturation, harsh flash, motion blur, text, logo, signature, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为画面中主要可见成年女性的面部身份依据。除与身份参考冲突之处外，保留来源的场景、发型、服装、姿势、构图、光线、镜头语言和编辑风格。

创作一张极度写实的室内生活抓拍自拍人像，主体是一位年轻成年东亚女性，拥有白皙瓷感肤色与精致五官。她留着深棕色齐颔纹理法式波波头，层次柔软、体积略显凌乱蓬松，轻薄刘海与散落发丝自然掠过面部并部分遮住一只眼睛。保留浓密自然眉毛、直视镜头的杏仁形深棕眼睛和平静梦幻的表情、小巧挺直的鼻子、柔和渐变粉唇、极简韩系妆容、轻微腮红、自然睫毛、可见皮肤毛孔、真实通透感与细致发丝。

她用有支撑的左手轻轻托住脸，头部微微倾斜，前景可见一条穿浅色水洗蓝牛仔裤的弯曲膝盖。她穿宽松的炭黑色酸洗长袖卫衣，袖口遮住部分手掌，并佩戴一条带微小吊坠的精致细银项链。环境为舒适的极简卧室或现代酒店房间，采用暖米色墙面、软包床头板和嵌入式开放搁架，架上整齐摆放护肤瓶与少量个人小物，空间保持干净、不杂乱。

使用柔和温暖的室内漫射环境光、轻柔阴影和电影感暖色调。以高端智能手机前置摄像头和28毫米等效镜头的感觉，在视平线机位构图；采用浅景深，让眼睛清晰对焦，背景产生细腻虚化。成品应亲密、放松、自然不费力并具有编辑感，色彩真实、动态范围宽，达到高端时尚杂志质感与高分辨率摄影细节。避免低质量、模糊、眼睛软焦、噪点、颗粒、过曝、欠曝、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、CGI、3D渲染、动漫、卡通、娃娃脸处理、错误解剖、面部畸形、双眼不对称、多余或缺失手指、手部扭曲、重复肢体、不真实比例、过饱和、强烈闪光、运动模糊、文字、标志、签名或水印。

items.title: 雨夜街头的复古黑帮与霓虹光影
items.description: 雨夜街头的复古黑帮与霓虹光影：明确成年的男性穿深色三件套与长款风衣，压低软呢帽，在湿润石板路与昏黄灯光中呈现神秘克制的电影感肖像。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.\n\nCreate a hyper-realistic 3:4 vertical 8K cinematic portrait of a clearly adult man in a 1920s noir gangster-inspired style. Half-body framing, standing slightly angled, one hand holding the lapel of a long dark trench coat and the other relaxed by his side. He wears a dark fedora lowered over the eyes, a dark three-piece suit and a loosely knotted classic tie. His head tilts slightly down while his eyes look up from the hat shadow; the expression is mysterious, calm and intense. Set him at a dim alley or bar entrance at night with wet cobblestones, a faint glowing lamp, blurred city shadows and thin smoke. Use low-key side light with soft back fill, strong contrast, subtle amber glow, visible wool and felt texture, an 85mm lens at f/1.4, shallow depth of field, sharp eyes and jawline, restrained film grain. Avoid cartoon, anime, illustration, painterly or plastic skin, face distortion, bad anatomy, extra limbs, low resolution, soft focus, modern elements, logos and text.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中主要可见人物的面部身份参考。除非与身份参考冲突，保留原场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线与视觉风格。\n\n创作一张超写实、3:4竖版、8K电影感肖像：明确成年的男性，采用1920年代黑色电影黑帮风格。半身构图，身体略微侧向站立，一只手捏住长款深色风衣衣领，另一只手自然垂放。身穿深色三件套西装和略微松开的经典领带，戴一顶压低遮住部分眼睛的深色软呢帽。头部略向下，眼睛从帽檐阴影中向上看，表情神秘、平静而有张力。场景位于夜晚昏暗的巷口或酒吧入口，有湿润石板路、微亮街灯、虚化城市阴影和薄烟。采用低调侧光与柔和轮廓补光，强对比和克制琥珀色光晕，呈现羊毛与毡帽材质；85mm镜头、f/1.4、大光圈浅景深，眼睛和下颌线清晰，保留克制胶片颗粒。避免卡通、动漫、插画、绘画感、塑料皮肤、脸部变形、错误人体结构、多余肢体、低清晰度、过度虚焦、现代元素、标志和文字。

items.title: 欧洲鹅卵石街道上的秋日镜面时尚自拍
items.description: 绑定10A身份的成年女性在欧洲鹅卵石街道旁用落地镜自拍，穿棕色粗花呢西装与复古男装风配饰，呈现秋日35毫米胶片时尚街拍。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded ref-10a-v1 image as the facial identity reference for the only visible person, one clearly adult stylish woman. Preserve her recognizable facial features while keeping the source outfit, mirror-selfie action, European cobblestone setting and autumn editorial style.

Create a photorealistic vertical high-fashion street portrait with an explicitly visible freestanding full-length mirror placed safely beside a quiet European cobblestone street. The woman photographs her reflection with a black smartphone held in front of part of her face. Keep the mirror edge visible, the reflection direction coherent, the phone and hands anatomically correct, and the pose relaxed and confident. She has long dark wavy hair.

Her vintage menswear-inspired outfit consists of a brown tweed blazer over a crisp white shirt with a cream tie, wide-leg dark trousers and polished brown leather shoes. Add a brown newsboy cap and amber-tinted aviator sunglasses. Show convincing tweed weave, tailored structure, trouser drape, leather texture and an understated autumn palette of brown, cream, charcoal and muted amber.

In the background, show old European stone buildings, shopfront shapes and street details softly blurred by shallow depth of field. Keep the street quiet with no other visible people. Use soft natural daylight, muted tones, cinematic but believable street photography, a premium fashion-editorial composition and subtle 35 mm film character with fine grain and gentle highlight rolloff. Maintain realistic perspective, high detail and natural proportions. Avoid duplicated phones, warped reflections, malformed hands, extra people, text, logos, watermark, plastic skin, overprocessed HDR, oversaturated color, illustration or CGI.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的 ref-10a-v1 图像作为唯一可见人物——一名明确成年的时尚女性——的面部身份参考。保留她可辨认的面部特征，同时保持来源中的服装、镜面自拍动作、欧洲鹅卵石街道环境和秋日时尚编辑风格。

创作照片级写实的竖幅高级街头时尚人像。在安静的欧洲鹅卵石街道旁安全放置一面明确可见的落地全身镜。女性用黑色智能手机拍摄自己的镜中影像，手机遮挡部分脸部。镜框边缘必须可见，镜像方向保持连贯，手机与双手结构正确，姿势轻松自信。她留深色波浪长发。

她身穿复古男装风造型：棕色粗花呢西装外套内搭挺括白衬衫和米色领带，下穿深色阔腿长裤与擦亮的棕色皮鞋；配棕色报童帽和琥珀色飞行员墨镜。清楚呈现粗花呢织纹、剪裁结构、裤装垂坠、皮革质感，以及由棕色、米白、炭灰和低饱和琥珀色组成的克制秋季色盘。

背景呈现欧洲老石建筑、店面轮廓与街道细节，并通过浅景深柔和虚化。街道保持安静，不出现其他可见人物。使用柔和自然日光、低饱和色调、电影感但可信的街头摄影、高级时装编辑构图，以及带细微颗粒和柔和高光过渡的35毫米胶片质感。透视真实、细节清楚、人体比例自然。避免重复手机、扭曲镜像、畸形手部、额外人物、文字、标志、水印、塑料皮肤、过度HDR、过饱和色彩、插画或CGI。

items.title: 奢华新中式红色旗袍剪纸光影人像
items.description: 以 10A 成年女性身份为主体的 3:4 新中式商业人像：红色旗袍、珍珠项链与花卉耳环，鹤、蝴蝶和牡丹剪纸前景及真实 Gobo 投影光影。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity basis for the only visible person. Preserve the recognizable 10A adult East Asian woman's face while applying the clothing, profile, lighting and New Chinese festive editorial styling below.

Create a high-end commercial portrait in a 3:4 vertical framed composition. Show an extreme close-up side profile or soft three-quarter profile at eye level, photographed from very close range with an 85–100mm macro portrait perspective and shallow depth of field. She wears an elegant red qipao, a warm pearl necklace and red floral earrings. Keep her expression calm and refined.

Place matte red paper-cut art in the near foreground as a framing layer, clearly incorporating crane, butterfly and peony motifs. Let selected paper-cut shapes fall into soft foreground bokeh while enough crisp edges remain to identify the handmade cardstock material and motifs. Do not cover the eyes, nose or lips.

Use real optical Gobo projection: intricate cutout patterns cast coherent light and shadow across the contours of her face, following the cheek, nose bridge, eyelids and jaw rather than appearing as flat decals. Add warm golden-hour side backlight, a narrow luminous rim on hair and facial peach fuzz, believable subsurface scattering in the skin and gentle warm reflections in the pearls. Maintain high-saturation festive reds while keeping skin tones natural. The mood is dreamy, festive and clear.

Render authentic fine skin texture, visible backlit vellus hair, individual hair strands, tactile matte cardstock and softly lustrous pearls. The result should feel like a luxury New Chinese fashion editorial with realistic optics and materials. No text, logo, watermark, extra person, plastic skin, flat printed shadows, malformed anatomy or blocked facial features.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为画面中唯一人物的面部身份依据。在应用以下服装、侧颜、光线和新中式节庆编辑造型时，保持 10A 成年东亚女性可辨识的面部身份。

创作一张 3:4 竖版框式构图的高端商业人像。使用人眼平视角度和极近拍摄距离，以 85–100mm 微距人像镜头语言和浅景深表现极近侧颜或柔和三分之二侧脸。她穿优雅红色旗袍，佩戴温润珍珠项链和红色花卉耳环，神态平静精致。

在近景前方布置哑光红色剪纸作为框景层，清楚包含仙鹤、蝴蝶和牡丹纹样。部分剪纸形成柔和前景虚化，同时保留足够清晰边缘，让手工卡纸材质和纹样可辨识；不得遮挡眼睛、鼻子或嘴唇。

使用真实光学 Gobo 投影：复杂镂空纹样在面部形成连贯光影，并沿颧骨、鼻梁、眼睑和下颌起伏变化，不能像平面贴花。加入金色暖阳侧逆光，在发丝和面部绒毛边缘形成窄亮轮廓，皮肤具有可信的次表面散射，珍珠带柔和暖反光。保持高饱和喜庆红调，同时让肤色自然。整体梦幻、节庆而清晰。

表现真实细腻皮肤、逆光可见的绒毛、单根发丝、可触的哑光卡纸和柔润珍珠。成片呈现具有真实光学与材质的新中式奢华时尚大片。不得出现文字、标志、水印、额外人物、塑料皮肤、平面印刷式阴影、畸形解剖或五官遮挡。

items.title: 乡村小屋门口的白裙夏日人像
items.description: 绑定10A身份的成年韩国女性穿白色不透明田园风棉质短连衣裙，倚在乡村小屋门口，暖晨光下由好友用手机抓拍。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded ref-10a-v1 image as the facial identity reference for the only visible person, one clearly adult Korean woman in her twenties. Preserve her recognizable facial features while retaining the source wardrobe, pose, cottage setting and candid smartphone style.

Create an ultra-photorealistic vertical 4:5 summer lifestyle portrait, framed from the upper calves to slightly above the head. She is about 163 cm tall with a naturally slim adult build, elegant shoulders, a defined waist and long legs. Her short black bob has soft wispy curtain bangs and slight breeze-driven movement. Use warm fair skin with peach undertones, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, subtle aegyo-sal, a naturally straight nose, thin eyeliner, peach blush, glossy rose-pink lips and realistic skin pores.

She wears a romantic vintage cottagecore white cotton babydoll mini dress. Its lightweight but fully opaque cotton bodice has thin adjustable straps, a softly gathered square neckline, delicate lace trim and a small front tie; the relaxed fit drapes naturally without emphasizing anatomy. The short flared skirt ends high on the upper thighs and has gathered embroidered-cotton panels, scalloped lace edging, soft wrinkles and airy motion. Add a small gold bracelet, delicate necklace and tiny pearl earrings. Clothing must remain fully opaque and secure, with no visible underwear or wardrobe malfunction.

At the open white wooden doorway of a charming countryside cottage, she leans casually against the frame with one leg softly bent. One hand gently brushes her hair while the other rests naturally beside her thigh; she turns slightly toward the lush flower garden with a calm, thoughtful expression. Show climbing vines, warm morning sunlight and subdued vintage curtains inside the cottage.

Photograph as if a close friend used a modern smartphone rear camera with an approximately 26 mm equivalent lens from a few feet away. Use warm natural garden light, gentle interior bounce fill, balanced exposure, believable handheld framing, natural phone color, mild HDR and JPEG texture. Keep realistic anatomy, hands, cotton embroidery and candid atmosphere. Avoid extra people, minor appearance, transparent fabric, sexualized posing, distorted hands, duplicate limbs, plastic skin, excessive beauty filters, studio glamour light, cinematic grading, CGI, text, logo or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的 ref-10a-v1 图像作为唯一可见人物——一名明确成年的二十多岁韩国女性——的面部身份参考。保留她可辨认的面部特征，同时保持来源中的服装、姿势、乡村小屋环境和随手手机摄影风格。

创作超写实的 4:5 竖幅夏日生活方式人像，从小腿上部取景至头顶略上方。她身高约163厘米，成年身材自然纤细，肩部优雅、腰线清晰、双腿修长。黑色短波波头配轻盈的法式刘海，在微风中略有摆动。肤色温暖白皙并带桃色底调，杏仁形深棕眼睛带微妙卧蚕，鼻梁自然挺直，配细眼线、桃色腮红、亮泽玫瑰粉嘴唇和真实皮肤毛孔。

她穿浪漫复古田园风的白色棉质娃娃装短连衣裙。轻盈但完全不透明的棉质上身带可调细肩带、轻柔收褶方领、精致蕾丝边和前侧小系带；宽松剪裁自然垂坠，不强调身体结构。短款伞裙止于大腿上部，采用收褶刺绣棉布拼片、扇形蕾丝边、自然皱褶和轻盈飘动感。搭配小金手镯、精致项链和微小珍珠耳环。服装必须完整不透明、穿着稳妥，不得露出内衣或走光。

在迷人的乡村小屋敞开的白色木门旁，她随意倚靠门框，一条腿轻轻弯曲；一只手轻拨头发，另一只手自然垂在大腿旁，头部略转向繁茂花园，表情平静而沉思。画面包含攀援藤蔓、温暖晨光，以及小屋内低调的复古窗帘。

摄影感觉像好友在几英尺外用现代智能手机后置摄像头和约26毫米等效镜头随手拍摄。使用来自花园的温暖自然光与室内柔和反射补光，保持平衡曝光、可信手持取景、自然手机色彩、轻度HDR与JPEG质感。人体、双手、棉布刺绣和抓拍氛围真实。避免额外人物、未成年外貌、透明面料、性感化姿势、手部扭曲、重复肢体、塑料皮肤、过度美颜、影棚华丽灯光、电影调色、CGI、文字、标志或水印。

items.title: 高端医美品牌 VELORA 旗舰宣传海报
items.description: 以 10A 成年女性身份为主视觉的虚构高端医美品牌竖版旗舰海报，保留右侧大肖像、左侧四个圆形治疗模块、完整英文品牌文案与暖中性奢华编辑设计。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity basis for the only woman shown. Preserve the recognizable 10A adult East Asian woman's face in the hero portrait and all treatment-detail crops.

Create a premium tall vertical editorial campaign poster for the fictional clinic brand VELORA AESTHETIC LAB. Use a soft warm-neutral background and elegant negative space. A serene ultra-realistic beauty portrait from upper chest upward dominates the right two-thirds: soft three-quarter profile, eyes closed or gaze lowered, hair gently gathered with realistic flyaways, and one anatomically natural hand resting near the collarbone or neck. She conveys calm trust, balance and restorative beauty.

Keep a spacious headline block in the upper-left. Down the left side, arrange four numbered circular treatment-story insets connected by one thin flowing line. Each module must consistently show its number, title, Treatment Focus, Target Area, Signature Result and supporting line:
01 LIFT — Treatment Focus: Contour Support — Target Area: Jawline + Cheek — Signature Result: Softer definition — Balanced elevation with natural facial flow.
02 GLOW — Treatment Focus: Skin Recovery — Target Area: Full Face — Signature Result: Radiant clarity — Barrier-first care for luminous skin quality.
03 DEFINE — Treatment Focus: Precision Mapping — Target Area: Lower Face — Signature Result: Harmonized structure — Expert facial planning with subtle contour logic.
04 RENEW — Treatment Focus: Dermal Recovery — Target Area: Face + Neck — Signature Result: Quiet vitality — Restorative care for lasting elegance.

In the DEFINE inset, show an anatomically correct hand holding a white or nude cosmetic pencil with a graceful grip. Add only delicate, professionally plausible cheek-to-jaw contour guide lines; keep the scene elegant and non-surgical.

Use airy luxury serif typography with thin modern sans-serif microcopy. Set the exact three-line headline "FACIAL / HARMONY / RESET" at upper-left. Beneath it place exactly "Precision-led rejuvenation for calm, balanced, radiant skin." Put exactly "True beauty returns when balance meets precision." in the lower-right. Center the exact wordmark "VELORA AESTHETIC LAB" near the bottom. items.title: 逆光中绽放的笑容

items.prompt:
Use the configured reference image as the identity reference for the single adult woman. Preserve the source scene, styling, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Theme:
A smile blooming in backlighting

Subject:
A close-up portrait of a young woman in a white spaghetti strap dress turning her head and smiling in intense sunlight through tree shadows. The character's face and upper body are largely positioned in the center-right of the frame, overlaid with white backlighting on the left, golden translucent hair, and green circular bokeh.

Character · Expression:
A slightly oval melon-seed face with a small rounded chin, face facing directly forward. Large brown almond-shaped eyes, thin and soft arched eyebrows, a thin straight nose bridge and a small nose tip, pale coral glossy lips, a gentle smile showing teeth. Bright skin tone, light pink blush, and understated eye makeup. Chest-length chestnut hair with thin bangs and strands around the face, blown to the right side of the frame by the wind.

Clothing · Pose:
White spaghetti strap dress. The chest has a deep curved neckline, with visible thin patterned weave and a high waistline seam below the chest. The upper body leans forward while twisting towards the left of the frame, with the right shoulder raised forward, only turning the face back to the camera.

Background · Lighting:
The background consists of overall yellow-green leaves and large circular bokeh, with bright sunlight blown out to white on the left side of the frame, and deep green remaining in the upper right. Warm and soft backlighting from the back-left of the frame outlines the hair and shoulders with golden edges, creating lens flare and a light haze.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 3:4. Level perspective at shoulder height, capturing a close-up from the top of the head to below the chest. The face is largely placed in the upper center, the back of the head and hair are placed at the right end, the chest is cropped at the bottom, and the left half is left as empty space with bright light. Focus on both eyes, with the background heavily blurred.

Texture · Style:
A high-definition realistic photo dominated by white, gold, and yellow-green tones. Realistically depicting natural skin texture, glossy lips, translucent hair strands, thin white fabric, soft backlighting, and circular bokeh.

Negative Prompt:
Significantly changing facial features; do not weaken the intense backlighting on the left

服装·姿势：
白色细肩带连衣裙。胸口是深曲线领口，可见薄花纹织图案和胸下细腰线收接。上半身前倾的同时向画面左侧扭转，右肩向前抬起，仅将脸部转回镜头。

背景·光线：
背景整体为黄绿色的树叶和圆形的大虚化，画面左侧白到过曝的明亮日光，右上方残留浓绿。来自画面左后方的温暖柔和逆光将头发和肩膀勾勒成金色边缘，营造镜头光晕和淡淡的薄雾。

构图·镜头：
纵向 3:4。镜头与肩部同高水平视角，收录从头顶到胸下的近景。将脸部大幅置于上半部分中央，后脑勺和头发置于右端，胸口裁切于下端，左侧半边留出明亮光线的空白空间。对焦双眼，背景大幅虚化。

质感·风格：
以白色、金色、黄绿色为主调的高精细写实照片。真实描绘自然的皮肤纹理、光泽嘴唇、透光的发束、薄薄的白布料、柔和的逆光以及圆形虚化。

负面提示：
大幅改变面部特征；不减弱左侧的强烈逆光

items.prompt:
Use the configured reference image as the identity reference for the adult person. Preserve the source poster composition, graphic style and requested text hierarchy unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Editorial poster featuring an adult woman in strict left-facing profile, cropped from mid-torso, with short black geometric hair forming a dominant graphic silhouette and a white collared jacket. Place one large flat circular disk directly behind the head. Render crisp flat vector shapes, angular facial features, controlled black contour lines, screen-print grain, halftone dots, and woven grid texture. Construct the background from layered layered geometric blocks and a solid field while keeping the composition clean and the subject dominant. Limit the entire artwork to exactly four high-contrast colors: black, white, vermilion red, and cobalt blue. Add the minimalist title “PROFILE” at the upper left in bold condensed uppercase sans serif, with the smaller headline “FORM IN FOUR COLORS” directly beneath it; clear hierarchy, generous negative space, Vertical 4:5 AR.
items.prompt_zh:

items.title: 现代东方史诗立体纸艺梦境
items.description: 现代东方史诗纸艺梦境模板，以悬空高台、沿外壁垂落的天梯、无边云海和远山构成高空巨构，成年女性仅作为极小情绪锚点。
items.prompt:
Use the configured reference image as the identity reference for the single adult woman. Preserve the source paper-art scene, scale, pose, composition, lighting and material language unless they conflict with the identity reference.

9:16 vertical modern oriental 3D papercut dreamscape, layered paper illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, paper diorama and epic contemporary oriental fantasy poster. A quiet, clear and firm adult oriental woman of about 25 stands alone at the edge of a towering paper-art viewing platform suspended above an endless sea of clouds. She is a tiny emotional anchor, much smaller than the architecture, facing the distant clouds and mountains with her head slightly raised; her body is away or three-quarter to camera. By her feet, an extremely long paper-art heavenly ladder descends continuously along the outer wall of the platform toward the bottom of the frame. Her half-up long black hair, thin paper ribbons and a light moon-white/misty-blue paper shawl stream in high-altitude wind; light gold leaf and small flower hair ornaments remain delicate. Her layered paper dress has cloud and water-wave patterns, clear thickness, fibers, cut edges, folds and translucent layered construction.

The platform is enormous, with an open top, refined railings, restrained oriental details, curved cut-paper outer walls, cloud motifs, wave-like layers and vertical structures. The ladder creates powerful vertical depth. Beyond it, an endless layered cloud sea reaches the horizon, with distant paper mountains, a few gliding paper birds, sparse star-like glints and broad white-space sky. Establish at least four clear spatial layers and an epic human-to-world scale contrast; the true subjects are the platform, ladder, cloud sea, mountains and sky, never a gentle small scene.

Palette: moon white, misty blue, restrained light gold and small silver-white accents. Keep it bright, clear, high-end and transparent, neither gray, dirty, uniformly blue nor overly yellow. Use blended cool/warm morning side light from the left or distance; illuminate the platform top, ladder edges, railings and figure outline, with soft translucency on paper curves, cloud layers and mountain edges. Every element uses one coherent high-precision paper-carving language with real fibers, thickness, hand-cut patterns, inter-layer shadows and light transmission. No real person against a paper background, plastic 3D, ordinary CG architecture, crowded composition, oversized character, vague depth, blurred paper edges, dead-black shadows, haze, malformed hands, extra characters, text, logo or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
以配置的参考图作为画面中唯一成年女性的身份参考。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的纸艺场景、人物尺度、姿势、构图、光线和材质语言。

9:16竖版，现代东方立体剪纸梦境，层叠纸艺插画、立体纸雕、纸艺场景与史诗级当代东方幻想海报风格。一位约25岁的东方成年女性安静、清醒而坚定，独自站在悬于无边云海之上的巨大纸艺观景高台边缘。人物只是情绪锚点，比例必须远小于建筑；她面向远方云海与群山，头部略抬，可以背对或三分之二侧对镜头。脚边一道极长的纸艺天梯沿高台外壁连续向画面底部垂落。黑色长发半披半挽，细长纸带与月白雾蓝轻薄纸艺披帛被高空风向后吹起；浅金叶片和小花发饰轻盈精致。多层纸艺长裙带云纹与水波纹，具有清晰纸张厚度、纤维、裁切边缘、折痕、层叠结构和透光感。

高台体量极大，顶部为开阔观景平台，带精致栏杆和克制东方装饰；外壁由纸雕曲面、云纹、波浪纸层与纵向结构组成。天梯制造强烈垂直纵深。高台之外是延伸至天际的层叠云海，加入远处纸艺山脉、少量滑翔纸鸟、稀疏星点和大面积留白天空。必须形成至少四层清晰空间，突出人与天地的史诗尺度差异；真正主角是高台、天梯、云海、远山和天空，不能做成温柔小景。

色彩以月白、雾蓝为主，少量浅金和银白点缀；整体明亮、清澈、高级、通透，不灰、不脏、不整体偏蓝、不偏黄过重。使用来自左侧或远方的冷暖交融清晨侧光，照亮高台顶部、天梯边缘、栏杆与人物轮廓，并在纸艺曲面、云层和山体边缘形成柔和透光。所有元素统一采用高精度纸雕语言，呈现真实纸纤维、厚度、手工裁切纹样、层间阴影和透光效果。不要真人站在纸艺背景中、塑料3D、普通CG建筑、拥挤构图、人物过大、纵深模糊、纸边模糊、暗部死黑、灰蒙、手部畸形、多余人物、文字、Logo或水印。

items.title: 东方神界三级巨构电影剧照
items.description: 东方神界电影场景模板，以前景巨型白玉殿构、无边镜面水台、深色主神宫和更远超级神壁构成连续尺度递进，远景人物仅作比例节点。
items.prompt: 16:9 landscape cinematic aspect ratio, hyper-realistic, bright, divine, oppressive Eastern divine realm film still, 1980s Hong Kong fantasy wuxia frontal dramatic composition combined with modern high-spec photorealistic VFX. The camera stands at the edge of a giant mirrored water platform, located in the liminal space between a partial structure of a giant hall and the water platform, adult eye level, 35mm cinematic environment lens. In the foreground on the right or top, a portion of an ultra-giant white jade palace wall, deep eaves, tall side columns, and partial beam structures are pressed in; the foreground structure must be giant enough to be cropped out of the frame, clearly expressing that a divine giant structure is right beside you. The middle ground is an extremely wide borderless mirrored water platform, the water surface is like a mirror, clearly reflecting the sky, buildings, and characters, forming a second divine space; 2 adult Eastern female immortals sit by the steps at the far end of the mirror pool looking into the distance, the figures are small, serving only as static scale nodes. Beyond the mirror pool is a large area of high-altitude sea of clouds, the cloud layer is below the platform, with a few giant vertical cumulus clouds remaining in the distance. The first layer of the background is an already very giant main divine palace, which must be composed of a deep blue-gray main body, dark cyan double eaves, dark vermilion beams and columns, and a heavy warm white base, the whole being a stable medium-dark color mass; in the second layer further back, behind the main palace, a more exaggerated and taller ancient divine wall or vertical divine gate must appear, it cannot be pure bright white, but should be a cool deep gray-white large vertical giant structure, with a huge shadow side and an incomprehensible sense of scale, forming a continuous scale progression of 'the main palace is already large, but the divine wall behind it is even larger.' The overall image should present a three-level giant structure civilization of foreground giant structure -> mirror pool giant space -> background dark main palace -> further back super divine wall. The light is strong morning sunlight, the sky and water surface are high-bright, the main palace outline is clear, the distant divine wall is slightly grayish-blue but still retains weight, overall high-key exposure, clear air, strong divinity, and a clear sense of oppression.
items.prompt_zh:
16:9 横向电影画幅，超写实、明亮、神圣、富有压迫感的东方神界电影剧照，1980s Hong Kong fantasy wuxia 的正面戏剧构图结合现代高规格 photorealistic VFX。

摄影机站在一座巨型镜面水台边缘，位于巨殿局部结构与水台之间的阈限空间，成年人眼高度，35mm 电影环境镜头。近景右侧或上方压入一部分超巨大白玉殿墙、深远檐角、高大侧柱与局部梁架，近景结构必须巨大到被裁切出画，明确表现身边就有神界巨构。

中景是一片极宽阔的无边界镜面水台，水面如镜，清晰反射天空、建筑和人物，形成第二片神界空间；2 位成年东方女仙坐在镜池尽头的台阶边远望，人物较小，只作为静态比例节点。

镜池之外是大面积高空云海，云层位于平台下方，远处保留少量巨大立体积云。远景第一层是一座已经非常巨大的主神宫，必须以深青灰主体、黛青重檐、暗朱梁柱和厚重暖白基座构成，整体是稳定的中深色质量块；更远的第二层，在主宫之后必须进一步出现一个更加夸张、更加高大的远古神壁或垂直神阙，它不能是纯亮白，而应为偏冷深灰白的大型垂直巨构，具有巨大阴影面和难以理解的尺度感，形成“主宫已经很大，但后方神壁更大”的连续尺度递进。

画面整体应呈现近景巨构 → 镜池巨空间 → 远景深色主宫 → 更后方超级神壁的三级巨构文明。光线为上午强烈日光，天空和水面高亮，主宫轮廓清晰，神壁远处略偏灰蓝但仍保留重量，整体高调曝光、空气清澈、神性强、压迫感明确。

items.prompt:
Use the configured reference image as the identity reference for the single adult woman. Preserve the source scene, styling, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

The same person appears with their overall appearance, temperament, and recognizability unchanged, with hair length and clothing style naturally adapted to their own gender temperament rather than copying the specific clothing style of the reference person, shooting a studio portrait in the style of a red-background ID photo: the emotional tone is dignified, confident, restrained, and introverted, using an equivalent 85mm short telephoto portrait lens, shot frontally at eye level with the character, medium-distance framing to avoid perspective distortion, head and shoulders half-body centered symmetrical composition, shoulder line parallel to the lens, aperture approximately f/5.6 to ensure all facial features are in focus, white balance neutral and slightly warm; a large area softbox is placed directly in front slightly higher than eye level as the main light, with a low-level reflector added below the chest for clamshell fill light, eliminating shadows under the chin and nose, light ratio close to 1:1 flat light, leaving a soft circular highlight in the center of the pupil; the background is a pure bright red studio background cloth, evenly exposed without shadows or reflections, forming a high-saturation color contrast separation with the character's skin tone and collar; the character looks at the lens in a posture with chest out and head up, chin slightly tucked, shoulders naturally open showing stable support, the corners of the mouth restrainedly turned up showing a frozen moment of confidence and composure; apply the same rich and exaggerated stage-like makeup without reducing intensity, adjusting position and strength to the woman's bone structure and skin tone: upper and lower eyeliners are thickened and joined into one, significantly upturned at the corners of the eyes extending into broad cat-eye strokes, the length of the corners of the eyes significantly exceeding the real eye shape, eye sockets lightly brushed with black-brown eyeshadow to deepen the contour, upper eyelashes wearing rows of thick, dense, fan-shaped exaggeratedly enlarged false eyelashes almost covering the entire upper eyelid, eyebrow shape sharp and straight; coral pink blush is smudged on the apple muscles and softly transitions towards the temples; lips are fully coated with high-saturation brick orange-red lipstick, the lip surface has a glass-like luster, the lip line is precisely outlined with the same color to create a full and clear lip contour, with the center of the lips highlighted; skin is given high-intensity smoothing, presenting an even, delicate, matte-to-velvet luster porcelain texture, pores and fine lines are significantly softened and weakened, retaining only very slight facial light and shadow transitions and natural asymmetry to avoid a completely flattened plastic feel; the hairstyle retains the person's original hair length and habitual cutting direction, only enhancing smooth luster and fluffy three-dimensionality, long hair is combed into large wavy curls with eyebrow-level bangs, short hair maintains a neat silhouette with three-dimensional blow-styling; the woman wears a white wide-lapel suit jacket with crisp fabric and a neckline naturally open to reveal the collarbone, plus small stud earrings; avoid identity drift, stiff or dull expressions, 'yin-yang face' lighting conflicts, and also avoid changing the character's own gender temperament due to makeup or clothing.

items.title: 东亚女性户外骑行运动肖像
items.description: 高架城市骑行道上的东亚女性运动肖像模板，强调黑色碳纤维公路车、白色头盔、勃艮第骑行短裤、V 手势、湿润路面与阴天手机摄影质感。
items.prompt:
Use the configured reference image as the identity reference for the single adult woman. Preserve the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a photorealistic 3:4 outdoor cycling portrait of an exceptionally beautiful adult East Asian woman standing beside a sleek black carbon road bicycle on an elevated cycling path. She has a sweet softly rounded face, fair natural skin, large dark almond-shaped eyes, straight eyebrows, a small refined nose and soft coral-pink lips. She looks directly into the camera with wide expressive eyes while gently pursing her lips into a cute playful pout.

Her straight black hair is tied back beneath a streamlined white road-cycling helmet, with neat wispy bangs visible across her forehead and a few loose strands beside her cheeks. Large mirrored wraparound cycling sunglasses rest across the front of the helmet, reflecting the pale sky and surrounding greenery.

She has a fit, naturally curvy athletic figure with a full bust, narrow waist, rounded hips and strong shapely thighs. She wears a tightly fitted short-sleeve cycling jersey with a front zipper, dark-gray raglan panels and a muted photographic city-street print across the torso. A small square black action camera or wireless microphone is clipped at the center of her chest. Pair it with high-waisted burgundy cycling shorts featuring thin white curved piping that follows the contours of her hips and thighs. A bright pink sports watch is worn on one wrist.

Reproduce the pose precisely: she stands upright facing the camera with her weight distributed naturally between both legs. One arm hangs downward while her hand rests casually on the bicycle’s handlebar. Her opposite elbow is bent outward, with her hand raised beside her shoulder in a large relaxed V-sign. Keep both fingers straight and clearly separated, with the palm angled slightly toward the camera. Her shoulders remain relaxed and her head tilts only slightly.

Place the black aerodynamic road bicycle diagonally behind and beside her, with the curved drop handlebar visible in the lower-left foreground and the deep-section rear wheel visible behind her right hip and legs. Preserve realistic bicycle geometry, spokes, brake discs, tires and frame connections without malformed mechanical parts or unnecessary branding.

The setting is an elevated urban cycling path with gray metal railings, concrete ramps, wet pavement and blue roadside barriers. Green trees, low modern buildings and misty forested hills appear in the distance beneath a pale overcast sky. The damp environment suggests that it has recently rained.

Use an eye-level frontal smartphone-camera angle, framing her from the top of the helmet to slightly below the knees. Keep her face, outfit, hand gesture and bicycle clearly visible. Soft diffused daylight, subdued overcast colors, natural skin texture, slight smartphone sharpening, mild digital grain and realistic depth of field. Authentic casual cycling photograph, accurate anatomy and hands, believable stretch-fabric tension and natural body proportions. No studio lighting, no exaggerated muscles, no plastic skin, no doll-like face, no malformed bicycle, no extra fingers, no incorrect text, no captions, no logo, no watermark.

采用低机位仰拍，但不要夸张贴地视角、脚部过大、大脚透视或广角畸变。人物全身完整入镜，脸部清晰自然，成年人体态真实，比例自然舒展。保留充足天空与海面，让环境参与构图。

表现海平面日落、水面的金色反光、远处淡淡山影和一艘极小的船。整体氛围安静、干净、治愈，结合真实生活感与日系清透的编辑摄影气质。使用夕阳逆光，让发丝边缘出现柔和金色轮廓光；肤色自然，保留真实皮肤纹理。避免过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、人工网红假脸、漫画感、3D渲染、其他人物、文字和水印。

items.title: 东方留白艺术海报装置提示词
items.description: 参数化9:16竖版东方留白装置艺术海报模板，默认以“明月松间照，清泉石上流”为诗意输入，生成手工艺术纸、浅浮雕、材料装置、光路与极小人物构成的高级编辑海报；提供诗句、两字主题、光线动作、核心装置、主色、背景压纹和地点日期变量。
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical Oriental blank-space art poster using 明月松间照，清泉石上流, 清流, 流动并折射, 黑色玄武岩与浅水镜, 月白、墨黑、青绿、朱砂, 松针、山形与水波浅浮雕 and 杭州西湖 / 2026.09; use the representative defaults when no replacement is supplied. Transform the poem's imagery, light and movement into a contemporary installation-art metaphor with a high-end editorial finish.

Use handmade art paper with visible fibers, pulp particles and natural indentations as the ground. Preserve large areas of clean blank space. Add low-contrast bas-relief 松针、山形与水波浅浮雕 that is restrained from a distance but reveals narrative detail on close inspection.

Place 黑色玄武岩与浅水镜 in the composition with a clear silhouette, real volume and tactile material texture. Organize the installation, space and the sole tiny adult figure through 流动并折射. Use the uploaded reference image ref-10a-v1 for the figure's facial identity cues only; do not copy its clothing, background or photographic medium. Keep this figure at approximately 1%–2% of the frame so it establishes vast scale without becoming the subject.

Use 月白、墨黑、青绿、朱砂 with clear primary and secondary roles. Let light travel through smoke, water, transparent material, projection, starlight or reflection to form one legible visual path. Keep the effect refined and physical; avoid cheap neon and exaggerated fantasy effects.

Set the main Chinese title to the exact two-character value 清流 in a modern Songti, Mingti or carved serif style. The characters must be complete, accurate and clearly legible. Also include the small original poem line 明月松间照，清泉石上流, 杭州西湖 / 2026.09 and a short English title. Typography should feel designed through restrained spacing, alignment or fine lines, never through distorted or unreadable glyphs.

Use contemporary installation art, poetic atmosphere, premium material detail and restrained editorial poster design. No extra readable text, logos, watermarks, decorative clutter or multiple figures.
items.prompt_zh:
使用 明月松间照，清泉石上流、清流、流动并折射、黑色玄武岩与浅水镜、月白、墨黑、青绿、朱砂、松针、山形与水波浅浮雕 和 杭州西湖 / 2026.09 创作一张9:16竖版东方留白艺术海报；没有替换值时使用代表性默认值。将诗句中的画面、光线与动作转化为具有当代装置感的视觉隐喻，并呈现高级编辑海报质感。

使用带有真实纤维、纸浆颗粒和自然压痕的手工艺术纸作为底材，保留大面积干净留白。加入低对比浅浮雕 松针、山形与水波浅浮雕，远看克制，近看才显出参与叙事的细节。

在画面中设置 黑色玄武岩与浅水镜，使其轮廓清晰、具有真实体积和材料触感。通过 流动并折射 组织装置、空间与唯一的极小成年人物。使用上传的参考图 ref-10a-v1 仅作为该人物的面部身份依据，不复制参考图的服装、背景或摄影媒介。人物约占画面1%–2%，只用于建立巨大尺度，不得成为主体。

使用 月白、墨黑、青绿、朱砂，明确主色与辅色关系。让光通过烟雾、水面、透明材质、投影、星光或反射进入画面，形成一条清晰的视觉路径。效果应精致并具有真实物理感，避免廉价霓虹和夸张奇幻特效。

中文主标题使用准确的两字变量 清流，采用现代宋体、明朝体或具有雕刻感的衬线字体。汉字必须完整、准确、清晰可读。同时加入小字号原诗句 明月松间照，清泉石上流、杭州西湖 / 2026.09 和简短英文标题。可通过克制的字距、对齐或细线增加设计感，但不得扭曲或制造不可读文字。

整体结合当代装置艺术、古诗意境、高级材料细节与克制的编辑海报设计。不要额外可读文字、标志、水印、装饰堆叠或其他人物。

items.title: 春日公园长椅上的东亚美女
items.description: 以配置人物参考图绑定明确成年东亚女性，制作明媚春日下午公园长椅休闲时装写真：粉色宽松衬衫短裤、半扎深棕发、花朵丝带、托腮微笑和清新绿色公园。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the sole main visible clearly adult East Asian woman. Extract identity cues only; do not copy the reference clothing, background or photographic medium. Preserve the source fresh spring lifestyle-fashion direction, outfit, pose, park environment and candid mood.

Create an ultra-photorealistic lifestyle fashion photograph on a bright spring afternoon. Show the adult woman seated on a wooden park bench in a lush green park. She has long dark-brown hair with wispy bangs styled half-up, natural dewy makeup, rosy cheeks and glossy pink lips. Give her a relaxed, gentle smile while she rests her face lightly in one hand.

Dress her in a pastel-pink oversized button-up shirt with matching loose shorts. Add a small cream crossbody bag with a gold chain strap and a pink flower-ribbon accessory attached to the shirt. Keep the pose relaxed, natural and confident, with realistic adult anatomy and fabric texture.

Include vibrant green grass, a winding park path, leafy trees and additional benches in the background. Use soft natural daylight and a fresh outdoor atmosphere, with shallow depth of field and creamy bokeh that keeps the face, hair and outfit details sharp while the park recedes gently. Use a candid composition, DSLR-quality realism, an 85mm lens and f/1.8 feel, cinematic but natural color grading and soft pastel tones. Render detailed hair strands, natural skin texture and realistic textile folds. Do not add other foreground people, text, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
使用用户上传的参考图作为唯一主要可见、明确成年的东亚女性的面部身份依据。仅提取身份特征，不复制参考图的服装、背景或摄影媒介。保留来源清新的春日生活方式时装方向、服装、姿势、公园环境和抓拍氛围。

创作一张明媚春日下午的超照片级真实生活时装摄影。让成年女性坐在郁郁葱葱的绿色公园木质长椅上。她有深棕色长发，带稀疏刘海并半扎起来；妆容自然水润，脸颊红润，双唇粉嫩有光泽。她一只手轻轻托着脸，露出放松温柔的微笑。

她穿淡粉色宽松纽扣衬衫和配套的宽松短裤。添加一个带金色链条肩带的小型米色斜挎包，以及固定在衬衫上的粉色花朵丝带配件。姿势应放松、自然而自信，成年人体态真实，面料具有自然纹理与褶皱。

背景包含充满活力的绿草、蜿蜒公园小径、枝叶繁茂的树木和其他长椅。使用柔和自然日光与清新户外氛围，浅景深和奶油色散景让面部、发丝与服装细节清晰，同时让公园背景自然退后。采用抓拍构图、单反级真实感、85毫米镜头与 f/1.8 观感，电影感但自然的色彩分级和柔和粉彩色调。细致呈现发丝、自然皮肤纹理和真实布料褶皱。不要前景其他人物、文字、标志或水印。

items.title: 简约室内白衫黑裙东亚美女全身写真
items.description: 以配置人物参考图绑定明确成年东亚女性，制作明亮现代极简客厅中的全身时装肖像：白色短袖衬衫、黑色高腰短裙、薄黑连裤袜、黑色漆皮高跟鞋、交叉手臂姿势与自然室内光。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the sole main visible clearly adult East Asian woman. Extract identity cues only; do not copy the reference clothing, background or medium. Preserve the source bright minimalist interior, exact outfit combination, crossed-arm pose, eye-level full-body framing and natural fashion-photography direction.

Create a photorealistic high-end full-body fashion portrait in a modern minimalist living room with a bright, clean aesthetic. Use white walls, recessed ceiling lights, soft natural daylight, a light-colored carpet, gray tiled flooring, a modern lounge chair, decorative cushions, a few plush toys and a small flower pot. Keep the spacious room calm, uncluttered and secondary to the subject. Center the woman and show both feet completely.

Show her with natural adult proportions, a tall slender build, soft natural curves, a defined waist, fair-to-light skin with realistic texture, long slightly wavy black hair parted near the center, an oval face, large almond-shaped eyes, a small straight nose and soft coral lips. She looks directly at the camera with a calm, gentle and confident expression. Use natural makeup and avoid plastic smoothing.

Dress her in the exact combination of a fitted short-sleeve white blouse with a pointed collar, front button placket and subtle ruching, a high-waisted black mini skirt, sheer black pantyhose with a restrained subtle sheen and pointed black patent-leather high heels. Add only a delicate necklace, a translucent jade-like bangle and a black elastic hair tie on one wrist. Cross one arm gently across the body while lightly holding the opposite forearm; let the other hand relax and extend slightly downward. Keep the legs naturally close together and the posture elegant.

Use an eye-level perspective, centered clean composition, DSLR-quality realism, an 85mm portrait-lens and f/2.8 feel, sharp face and fabric detail, realistic pantyhose transparency, soft indoor ambient light and gentle natural shadows. Use neutral white and black tones with natural color grading, high dynamic range and detailed skin, fabric, tile and carpet texture. No extra people, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, dramatic hard shadows, exaggerated watermarks, logos, text overlays, added text or other readable text.
items.prompt_zh:
使用用户上传的参考图作为唯一主要可见、明确成年的东亚女性的面部身份依据。仅提取身份特征，不复制参考图的服装、背景或媒介。保留来源明亮极简室内、准确服装组合、交叉手臂姿势、平视全身取景和自然时装摄影方向。

创作一张照片级真实的高端全身时装肖像，场景为明亮洁净的现代极简客厅。使用白色墙壁、嵌入式天花板灯、柔和自然日光、浅色地毯、灰色瓷砖地面、背景中的现代休闲椅、装饰垫、少量毛绒玩具和小花盆。保持空间宽敞、平静、整洁，让环境服务于主体。女性居中，双脚完整入镜。

呈现自然成年人体态、高挑纤细身材、柔和自然曲线、清晰腰线、带真实纹理的白皙至浅色肌肤、近中分的黑色长微卷发、鹅蛋脸、大杏眼、小巧挺直鼻子和柔和珊瑚色双唇。她直视镜头，神情平静、温柔而自信。使用自然妆容，不要塑料磨皮。

严格采用以下服装组合：合身白色短袖衬衫，尖领、前排扣门襟与细微褶皱；高腰黑色短裙；带克制细微光泽的黑色薄款连裤袜；黑色漆皮尖头高跟鞋。仅添加精致项链、半透明玉石感手镯和一只手腕上的黑色弹性发圈。一只手臂轻轻横跨身体并握住另一侧前臂，另一只手放松地略向下伸展；双腿自然靠拢，站姿优雅。

使用平视视角、居中简洁构图、单反画质真实感、85毫米人像镜头与 f/2.8 观感，面部和面料细节清晰，连裤袜透明度真实，室内环境光柔和，阴影自然。以中性黑白色为主并进行自然色彩分级，呈现高动态范围和皮肤、面料、瓷砖、地毯的细致纹理。不要其他人物、扭曲解剖、多余肢体、剧烈硬阴影、夸张水印、标志、文字叠加、额外文字或其他可读文字。

items.title: 豪华旅行目的地弹出式立体书设计
items.description: 参数化豪华旅行弹出式立体书模板，默认示例为日本京都；提供目的地、国家、人物模式和人物描述变量，保留恰好3个真实地标、恰好1个绑定身份的纸质人物、3–5项辅助细节、可折叠纸张工程与4:5白色摄影棚产品构图。
items.prompt:
Create a premium travel pop-up-book artwork for Kyoto, Japan, using the defaults when no replacement is supplied. Treat the destination as a functional luxury sculptural paper storybook, not a miniature city, diorama, dollhouse or architectural model.

Use the uploaded reference image ref-10a-v1 as the facial identity reference for exactly one clearly adult, destination-inspired full-body paper character. Extract identity cues only; do not copy the reference clothing, background or photographic medium. Use auto to guide the character concept; use a single adult traveler in destination-inspired clothing as the character description when supplied. Keep the paper character 25–40% smaller than the main landmark, naturally placed in the scene and visibly attached to the page by a subtle fold or tab.

Show an open clothbound or embossed hardcover book resting on a bright white studio surface, captured as flat illustrated paper structures spring upward. Every element must remain attached to the pages and visibly fold completely flat when the book closes. Design the unfolding mechanism around Kyoto’s distinctive geography, architecture, culture and iconic features so the transformation is location-specific.

Select exactly 3 real, instantly recognizable landmarks or place-defining elements from Kyoto. Make one the focal point and integrate the other two into one continuous asymmetrical composition with overlap, layered depth, natural visual flow and diagonal movement. Add only 3–5 authentic supporting details specific to Kyoto. Use thin illustrated cardstock and real pop-up engineering: V-folds, accordion folds, box folds, hinged façades, interlocking slots, curved strips and collapsing platforms. Supports must be elegant, minimal and integrated.

Use a three-quarter front view from slightly above with the entire open book visible. Separate foreground, midground and background paper layers while preserving generous negative space. Build everything from premium museum-white cardstock with refined watercolor, gouache or editorial print textures, crisp die-cut edges, precise folds, subtle fibers and soft paper shadows.

Use bright professional studio lighting on a pure white background. Create a cohesive 6–9-color palette inspired by Kyoto, mostly refined muted tones with one or two accents; avoid beige, sepia, muddy colors, glossy finishes and excessive saturation. Show minimal decorative page graphics on the clothbound or embossed cover. Display only the exact destination name “Kyoto”; no other readable text, logos or watermarks. The final image is vertical 4:5 premium product photography with sharp paper edges, strong dimensional depth and elegant negative space.
items.prompt_zh:
为 Kyoto、Japan 创作一件高级旅行弹出式立体书艺术品；没有替换值时使用默认示例。将目的地呈现为功能性的豪华雕塑感纸质故事书，不要做成微缩城市、立体模型、娃娃屋或建筑模型。

使用上传的参考图 ref-10a-v1 作为恰好一个明确成年、受目的地启发的全身纸质人物的面部身份依据。仅提取身份特征，不复制参考图的服装、背景或摄影媒介。使用 auto 指导人物概念；如果提供 a single adult traveler in destination-inspired clothing，将其作为人物描述。人物比例保持比主地标小25–40%，自然放置在场景中，并通过细微折痕或纸卡标签清晰附着在页面上。

展示一本打开的布面或压纹精装书，放在明亮的白色摄影棚表面上，捕捉平面插画纸质结构向上弹起的瞬间。所有元素必须附着在页面上，并明显能够在书本关闭时完全折叠平整。围绕 Kyoto 独特的地理、建筑、文化和标志性特征设计展开机制，使转化针对该地点而非通用布局。

从 Kyoto 中选择恰好3个真实且一眼可认出的地标或定义性元素。一个作为焦点，另外两个通过重叠、层叠深度、自然视觉流和对角线运动整合为一个连续的不对称构图。仅添加3–5个 Kyoto 特有的真实辅助细节。使用薄型插画卡纸和真实立体书工程技术：V型折叠、手风琴折叠、盒式折叠、铰链立面、联锁插槽、弯曲条带和折叠平台；支撑物必须优雅、简约并融入结构。

使用略微俯视的斜侧前视图，让整本打开的书完整可见。区分纸张的前景、中景和后景层次，同时保留优雅留白。全部使用高级博物馆白卡纸，加入精致水彩、不透明水彩或编辑级印刷纹理、锐利切纸边缘、精准折痕、细微纤维和柔和纸张阴影。

在纯白背景上使用明亮专业的摄影棚照明。创建受 Kyoto 启发的协调6–9色调色板，以精致低饱和色为主并加入一两个点缀色；避免米色、乌贼墨色、泥土色、光泽效果和过度饱和。布面或压纹封面只保留极简装饰性页面图形。仅显示准确的目的地名称“Kyoto”，不要其他可读文字、标志或水印。最终图像为垂直4:5高级产品摄影，具有锐利纸张边缘、强烈立体深度和优雅负空间。

items.title: iPhone17Pro拍摄落日背景写实女性肖像
items.description: 以配置人物参考图绑定明确成年女性，保留 iPhone 17 Pro 高分辨率写实质感、头至腰平视正面构图、米白长袖上衣、落日天空和树木剪影。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the sole main visible clearly adult woman. Extract identity cues only; do not copy the reference background or clothing. Preserve the source iPhone 17 Pro smartphone-portrait feel, outfit, pose, framing, sunset environment and lighting.

Create a high-resolution, ultra-realistic medium portrait framed from head to waist, photographed with an iPhone 17 Pro aesthetic. Use a straight-on eye-level perspective. The woman has long, wavy dark hair falling over her right shoulder; keep her head upright with only a very slight tilt to the right. Direct her gaze softly off-camera toward the viewer’s left. Give her a calm, gentle expression, natural-looking makeup and softly defined lips.

Extend her right arm slightly outward and downward toward the lower-left of the frame. Let her left arm rest naturally at her side; both arms are relaxed and only partly visible. Dress her in a form-fitting long-sleeve cream or off-white top with a simple round neckline, smooth fabric and subtle natural folds.

Set the background outdoors after sunset: a warm gradient of soft orange and peach near the horizon fading into muted gray-blue above, with scattered wispy clouds. Frame the upper-right corner with dark silhouetted tree foliage, add a distinct tall tree silhouette on the left, and place distant dark-green trees and vegetation across the horizon. Create a soft, dim twilight atmosphere.

Use warm golden-hour backlight with a gentle rim light outlining the hair and shoulders, subtle cool tones on the skin, natural soft shadows and no harsh brightness. Keep crisp facial detail, lifelike texture, true-to-life color and realistic smartphone-camera character. Do not add other people, text, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
使用用户上传的参考图作为唯一主要可见、明确成年女性的面部身份依据。仅提取身份特征，不复制参考图的背景或服装。保留来源的 iPhone 17 Pro 智能手机人像质感、服装、姿势、取景、落日环境和光线。

创作一张高分辨率、超照片级真实的头至腰中景人像，呈现 iPhone 17 Pro 拍摄观感。采用平视、正面视角。女性拥有长而波浪形的深色头发，垂落在右肩；头部保持挺直，仅向右略微倾斜。目光柔和地移向画面左侧、避开镜头。表情平静柔和，妆容自然，唇部轮廓柔和。

让右臂向画面左下方稍微向外、向下伸展；左臂自然垂在身侧，双臂放松且仅部分可见。她穿米白色或乳白色修身长袖上衣，简洁圆领，面料平滑并带细微自然褶皱。

背景为日落后的户外天空：地平线附近是柔和橙色与桃色，上方渐变为低饱和灰蓝色，散布缕缕薄云。右上角由深色树叶剪影框住，左侧有清晰挺拔的高树剪影，地平线上横贯远处深绿色树木与植被，营造柔和昏暗的黄昏氛围。

使用柔和温暖的黄金时刻逆光，以轻柔轮廓光勾勒头发和肩膀，皮肤带细微冷色调，阴影自然柔和，不产生刺眼高光。保持面部细节清晰、纹理逼真、色彩还原自然和真实手机相机特征。不要其他人物、文字、标志或水印。

items.title: 这个杀手不太冷片场三人自拍花絮
