items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image ref-10a-v1 as the identity and wardrobe-continuity reference for the woman from the reference image. Preserve her facial features, natural skin texture and outfit exactly; do not copy the reference background. Keep the other two people as distinct source-led film characters, not as versions of the reference woman.

Create a photorealistic 9:16 vertical behind-the-scenes selfie composite set at the real filming location of “Léon: The Professional”. In the foreground, the reference woman, Léon and young Mathilda pose together for one casual group selfie. Keep all three clearly separate, naturally proportioned and fully visible enough to read as a candid set moment. The scene is nonsexual and documentary in tone.

Replace the original background with a believable real film set behind-the-scenes environment: visible crew members working, period filming props, set pieces and multiple camera setups around the shooting area. The location should feel like an active production rather than a polished fictional scene, with authentic equipment, practical clutter and natural candid interactions. Keep the reference woman’s face and clothing stable while matching the light and perspective of the new set.

Use realistic handheld smartphone framing, natural perspective and subtle cinematic film grain. Preserve believable contact shadows, consistent color and lighting across all three people and the set. Do not add unrelated characters in the foreground, extra limbs, distorted faces, logos, watermarks, title text or other readable text.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的参考图 ref-10a-v1 作为参考图女性的身份与服装连续性依据，完整保留她的面部特征、自然皮肤纹理和服装，不复制参考图背景。其余两人必须是独立的来源电影角色，不要把参考女性的身份套用到莱昂或年幼玛蒂尔达身上。

创作一张照片级真实的9:16竖幅幕后自拍合成图，场景设定在电影《这个杀手不太冷》的真实拍摄片场。前景中，参考图女性、莱昂和年幼的玛蒂尔达一起进行一次自然的三人自拍。三人要彼此清晰区分、身体比例自然，并充分入镜，呈现随手记录的片场瞬间。整体为非性化、纪录片式氛围。

将原背景替换为可信的真实电影幕后环境：拍摄现场可以看到正在工作的剧组成员、时代感拍摄道具、布景组件和多套摄影机设备。场景应像真实制作中的工作现场，而非打磨过度的虚构电影画面，保留真实设备、实用杂物和自然互动。保持参考女性的脸部与服装稳定，并让新片场的光线和透视与人物匹配。

使用真实手持智能手机自拍构图、自然透视和微妙电影胶片颗粒。确保三个人物与片场之间具有可信的接触阴影，并保持统一色彩与光线。不要前景无关人物、多余肢体、扭曲面部、标志、水印、片名文字或其他可读文字。

items.title: 莫兰迪蓝调极简都市街头时尚大片
items.description: 以配置人物参考图绑定成年女性，提供可替换的统一服装色变量；默认制作9:16柔和蓝色极简都市街头时装人像，人物自信向前行走于深色石板路上。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the sole main visible clearly adult woman. Preserve her facial structure, proportions, expression, skin texture and identity exactly; do not copy the reference background or clothing. Use pastel blue for the coat, turtleneck and trousers, using the default pastel blue when no replacement is supplied.

Create a vertical 9:16, 1080x1920 ultra-photorealistic full-body fashion portrait with a cinematic, minimal, modern and classy street-style aesthetic. Show the adult woman walking confidently forward on dark stone pavement. Her right leg steps ahead while the left leg trails naturally; the left hand swings loosely by her side and the right arm bends so the hand lightly touches the edge of the pants pocket. Tilt her head slightly left and direct her eyes softly downward. Keep her calm, confident and self-assured.

Dress her in a structured, elegant long pastel blue coat, a fitted pastel blue turtleneck, slim-cut slightly cropped pastel blue trousers and clean white sneakers. Use natural proportions and realistic fabric texture. Set the environment as a refined, modern, minimal urban street with dark stone pavement and no distracting elements.

Use soft warm lighting to enhance the depth and texture of the clothing and pavement, with realistic shadows, natural highlights and cinematic depth. Shoot from directly in front at eye level with an 85mm portrait-lens perspective, realistic subtle foreground blur and gentle bokeh. Keep the result crisp, modern and photorealistic with no beautification, facial retouching, distortion or stylization; no extra people, text, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
使用用户上传的参考图作为唯一主要可见、明确成年女性的面部身份依据。必须完整保持她的面部结构、比例、表情、皮肤纹理和身份，不复制参考图的背景或服装。使用 pastel blue 作为大衣、高领毛衣和长裤的统一颜色；没有替换值时使用默认的“柔和蓝色”。

创作一张9:16竖幅、1080x1920分辨率的超照片级真实全身时装人像，整体为电影感、极简、现代而优雅的街头风格。成年女性在深色石板路上自信地向前行走，右腿向前迈步，左腿自然落后；左手在身侧松弛摆动，右臂弯曲，手指轻轻触碰裤袋边缘。头部略向左倾斜，目光柔和地向下看，神情平静、自信、泰然自若。

她穿结构感强且优雅合身的 pastel blue 长大衣、修身 pastel blue 高领毛衣、略微九分的修身 pastel blue 长裤和干净的白色运动鞋。保持自然身体比例与真实面料纹理。环境为精致、现代、极简的都市街道，以深色石板路为主，不加入分散注意力的元素。

使用柔和温暖的灯光增强服装与石板路的深度和纹理，形成真实阴影、自然高光与电影感空间。相机正对主体、与视线平齐，采用85毫米人像镜头观感，前景有轻微真实虚化和柔和散景。保持清晰、现代、照片级真实；不要美化、面部修饰、扭曲或风格化，不要其他人物、文字、标志或水印。

items.title: 都市街头少女手持手机画中画摄影
items.description: 以配置人物参考图绑定主可见成年女性，制作都市街头画中画手机摄影：银色细框眼镜、米色罗纹吊带上衣、灰色水洗破洞牛仔裤、路缘坐姿、高机位俯视和阴天漫射光。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the sole main visible clearly adult woman. Extract identity cues only; do not copy the reference clothing, background or photographic medium. Preserve the source casual off-duty-model styling, streetwear, pose, phone meta-photography concept and candid smartphone aesthetic.

Create an ultra-photorealistic portrait-oriented full-body street photograph. Show the adult woman seated casually on a concrete curb in an urban city sidewalk, leaning slightly forward with elbows on her knees. Her left hand supports her chin heavily in a bored, indifferent, nonchalant “over it” attitude; her right hand extends a smartphone directly toward the photographer’s point of view.

Give her long dark-brown hair worn loose in a messy, textured center-parted wave, natural skin texture with soft cheek blush, defined brows and full lips, plus silver rectangular wire-rimmed glasses with a Y2K office-siren feel. Dress her in a tight beige ribbed thin-strap tank top and baggy gray washed denim jeans with a large distressed rip over the right knee. Keep the styling as lazy-day chic, casual streetwear and modern urban fashion, with natural anatomy.

Make the phone screen visible and sharply focused. It displays a camera-app viewfinder showing a live image of the woman’s face, creating a clear picture-in-picture effect and a fourth-wall-breaking meta-photography concept. Use a high-angle point of view looking down at the curb sitter, or an eye-level view relative to a standing photographer, while keeping the composition coherent and the face and phone screen equally important.

Set the background as a textured gray stone building façade, concrete pavement and a distant metal grate or doorway; show asphalt meeting the curb. Use soft overcast natural daylight with diffuse illumination and no harsh shadows. Keep muted neutrals, gray, beige and soft skin tones, with an iPhone-like candid snapshot feel, sharp facial and phone detail, slight background depth-of-field blur and realistic textures. Do not add other people or human figures, stickers, emoji, stars, overlays, readable interface text, logos, watermarks, blurred subject, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, unnatural lighting or over-processed skin.
items.prompt_zh:
使用用户上传的参考图作为唯一主要可见、明确成年的女性的面部身份依据。仅提取身份特征，不复制参考图的服装、背景或摄影媒介。保留来源下班模特般的休闲造型、街头服装、姿势、手机元摄影概念和自然抓拍的智能手机质感。

创作一张超照片级真实、竖向取景的全身街拍照片。让成年女性随意坐在城市人行道的混凝土路缘上，身体略微前倾，手肘放在膝盖上。左手重重托住下巴，呈现无聊、冷漠、漫不经心、仿佛“受够了”的态度；右手向前伸出，将智能手机直接对着摄影者视角。

她有深棕色长发，散开并以凌乱、有质感的中分波浪垂落；保留自然肤质和柔和腮红，眉形清晰、双唇丰满；佩戴银色长方形细框眼镜，带有Y2K办公室女郎气质。她穿米色紧身罗纹细肩带背心，下身为宽松的灰色水洗牛仔裤，右膝有明显的大破洞。整体造型是慵懒日时尚、休闲街头服饰和现代都市风，身体比例自然。

让手机屏幕可见并清晰对焦，屏幕显示相机应用取景器，其中有这位女性面部的实时影像，形成明确的画中画效果和打破第四面墙的元摄影概念。采用高机位俯视坐在路缘上的人物，或相对于站立摄影者的平视角度，同时保持构图连贯，让脸部与手机屏幕同等重要。

背景为有纹理的灰色石质建筑立面、混凝土地面，远处可见金属格栅或门廊；地面表现沥青路面与混凝土路缘的交界。使用柔和阴天自然日光，漫射照明，不产生强烈阴影。整体采用灰色、米色、柔和肤色等克制中性色，带类似iPhone的自然抓拍感；脸部和手机细节清晰，石墙背景略有景深虚化，纹理真实。不要其他人物或人形、贴纸、表情符号、星星、叠加层、可读界面文字、标志、水印、模糊主体、扭曲解剖、多余肢体、不自然光线或过度磨皮。

items.title: 欧洲古镇街头倚墙而立的优雅绅士
items.description: 以成年女性参考图绑定主体，采用中性绅士风剪裁造型呈现欧洲老城冬秋街头时尚人像；保留炭灰大衣、祖母绿马甲、白衬衫领带、浅灰长裤、咖啡色牛津鞋、石墙倚靠姿势与咖啡馆暖光。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image ref-10a-v1 as the facial identity reference for the sole main visible clearly adult woman. Extract identity cues only; do not copy the reference clothing, background or photographic medium. Adapt the source’s gentleman styling into gender-neutral tailored fashion for this adult woman, while preserving the source outfit, pose, old-town setting, lighting and editorial mood.

Create a high-fidelity 4:5 vertical full-body fashion portrait on a European old-town cobblestone street. The adult woman has the configured facial identity, groomed brown hair styled neatly, and a calm confident expression while looking to the side. She leans casually against an old textured stone wall, with relaxed effortless posture.

Add black leather gloves and a black leather tote bag. Keep the styling elegant, modern and gender-neutral rather than costume-like.

Place a wooden-framed café window behind her, with warm interior light glowing through it and softly blurred silhouettes of people working inside. The atmosphere is cozy, sophisticated and urban, suggesting winter or late autumn. Use natural daylight on the subject with warm café highlights, shallow depth of field around f/1.8–f/2.8, sharp focus on the face and clothing, and soft background bokeh. Render cinematic street photography with fashion-editorial polish, realistic skin tones and detailed wool, silk, leather, stone and cobblestone textures. items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的参考图 ref-10a-v1 作为唯一主要可见、明确成年女性的面部身份依据。仅提取身份特征，不复制参考图的服装、背景或摄影媒介。将来源的绅士造型转化为适合这位成年女性的中性剪裁时装，同时保留来源的服装方向、姿势、老城场景、光线和编辑氛围。

创作一张高保真4:5竖幅全身时尚人像，场景为欧洲老城鹅卵石街道。成年女性使用配置的面部身份，棕色头发整洁修饰，神情平静自信，目光看向侧面。她随意倚靠在一堵带纹理的古老石墙上，姿态放松、不费力。

她穿深炭色羊毛大衣，内搭深祖母绿定制马甲、挺括白色正装衬衫和有图案的丝绸领带；下身为米色定制修身长裤，脚穿擦亮的棕色皮革牛津正装鞋。搭配黑色皮手套和黑色皮革托特包。整体造型优雅、现代且中性，不要有戏服感。

背景加入木框咖啡馆窗户，窗内透出温暖灯光，并有正在工作的人物柔和虚化的剪影。氛围舒适、精致、都市化，带有冬季或深秋气息。主体使用自然日光，并叠加咖啡馆暖色高光；采用约 f/1.8–f/2.8 的浅景深，脸部与服装清晰对焦，背景形成柔和散景。呈现电影感街头摄影与时尚杂志质感，保留真实肤色以及羊毛、丝绸、皮革、石墙和鹅卵石的细致纹理。不要额外前景人物、可读文字、标志或水印。

items.title: 都市灰墙前长出天使翅膀的超写实人像
items.description: 以配置人物参考图绑定都市街景中的明确成年主体，制作4:5超写实全身人像：浅灰混凝土墙、黑白翅膀壁画与深灰牛仔造型形成平静超现实的电影感。

Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the sole main visible clearly adult person. Extract identity cues only; do not copy the reference clothing, background or photographic medium. Preserve the source urban portrait composition, wardrobe, pose, mural, lighting and cinematic surreal mood.

Create an ultra-photorealistic 4:5 vertical full-body portrait of the adult subject leaning casually against a light-gray textured concrete wall in a minimalist urban street setting. The subject has dark, voluminous hair styled upward and a lean athletic build, with realistic skin and highly detailed clothing texture. Frame the image from a slightly low angle using a natural 50mm perspective and moderate depth of field, keeping the subject sharply focused.

Rest the subject’s left shoulder and head against the wall. Tuck the right hand casually into the front pocket of the jeans and let the left arm hang relaxed at the side. Keep the attitude effortless, calm and confident. Dress the subject in an open dark-gray short-sleeved denim shirt over a white crew-neck T-shirt, light-gray ripped skinny jeans with prominent tears at the knees and thighs revealing darker denim patches, and white athletic sneakers with light-blue accents.

Paint large, intricately detailed black-and-white wings on the wall directly behind the subject, aligned precisely so they appear to grow from the subject’s back. The wings are a wall mural, not physical wings. Use soft natural daylight with even illumination and subtle shadows defining the subject and wall. Include gray and brown cobblestone or large tiled pavement and keep other urban elements minimal. Render an urban cinematic-surreal aesthetic with gender-neutral modern fashion, crisp photorealistic textures in skin, denim, concrete and mural paint, and no extra people, text, logo or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
使用用户上传的参考图作为唯一主要可见、明确成年主体的面部身份依据。仅提取身份特征，不复制参考图的服装、背景或摄影媒介。保留来源的都市人像构图、服装、姿势、壁画、光线和电影感超现实氛围。

创作一张超照片级真实的4:5竖幅成年主体全身人像。人物随意倚靠在浅灰色纹理混凝土墙上，场景为极简都市街景。主体拥有深色、蓬松并向上塑形的头发和精瘦健美的体格，皮肤与服装纹理真实细致。使用略低机位和自然的50毫米镜头透视，适中景深，保持主体清晰对焦。

让主体的左肩和头部靠在墙上，右手随意插入牛仔裤前袋，左臂放松地垂在身侧；姿态自然、不费力、平静而自信。穿敞开的深灰色短袖牛仔衬衫，内搭白色圆领T恤；下身为浅灰色破洞修身牛仔裤，膝盖和大腿有明显破洞并露出深色牛仔布补丁；脚穿带浅蓝色点缀的白色运动鞋。

items.title: 漫天飞雪中的Bagel Labs奢华美妆大片

items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image ref-10a-v1 as the single locked edit reference and facial identity anchor for the sole main visible clearly adult woman. Preserve its composition, identity, pose, framing, expression, eye direction, lighting mood, color tone, skin detail, snowy background, falling snow, hand position and wardrobe. Do not change the scene or layout; modify only the cosmetic product in her hand.

Create a luxury winter beauty advertising image in a bright snowy alpine environment beneath a clear blue sky, with delicate snow falling. The woman wears a white fluffy fur hat and a white knitted sweater. She laughs joyfully with her head slightly tilted back and eyes looking upward. Keep her long wavy brunette hair framing the face, natural freckles, radiant winter skin with visible texture, glossy lips and bold white graphic eyeliner accents exactly consistent with the reference.

Replace only the item in her hand with a premium Bagel Labs lipstick. The lipstick has a translucent pink tube containing fine shimmering micro-glitter and a sleek brushed-silver metallic cap with clean reflections. Print the exact brand text “Bagel Labs” sharply and clearly on the tube in a high-contrast modern sans-serif font; preserve correct scale relative to the fingers, realistic contact shadows between product and hand and specular highlights consistent with snowy daylight.

Use ultra-photorealistic high-end beauty-advertising rendering, crisp but natural focus, clean cool winter color grading, minimal editorial retouching and none or minimal film grain. Keep natural skin texture visible. Exactly one female subject only. No layout drift, pose drift, wardrobe change, extra products, unreadable or misspelled brand text, other logos, unrelated text or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的参考图 ref-10a-v1 作为唯一锁定的编辑参考图，并作为画面中唯一主要可见、明确成年的女性的面部身份依据。保留参考图的构图、身份、姿势、取景、表情、视线方向、光线氛围、色调、皮肤细节、雪山背景、飘落的雪花、手部位置和服装。不要改变场景或版式，只修改她手中的化妆品。

创作一张奢华冬季美妆广告图：明亮的雪山环境、晴朗蓝天和细小飘雪。女性戴白色蓬松毛绒帽，穿白色针织毛衣，头部微微后仰并喜悦地笑着，眼睛向上看。保持与参考图一致的深色长波浪发、自然雀斑、保留纹理的明亮冬季肌肤、水润双唇和醒目的白色图形眼线。

items.title: 静奢书香：手工皮革日记网页设计
items.description: 以配置人物参考图绑定左侧主视觉中的成年女性，制作16:9桌面端静奢皮革日记本产品落地页：左侧图书馆书写场景，右侧五项工艺细节 Bento 网格，保留指定英文文案与 Willy 签名。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the sole main visible adult woman. Extract identity cues only; do not copy the reference clothing, background or medium. Preserve the source product-showcase concept, library setting, layout, copy, lighting and quiet-luxury art direction.

Create a polished 16:9 desktop landing-page visual for a new line of handcrafted leather journals. Use a split-screen composition: a large hero image occupies the left side and a five-card Bento detail grid occupies the right side. The page should feel warm, inviting and premium, with clear typographic hierarchy and every requested label legible.

Hero image, left: show the same clearly adult woman with the configured identity, Eurasian-featured fashion-model presence, wearing a cream cashmere sweater and seated in a leather armchair in a softly lit library. She writes in an open journal with an elegant fountain pen. Keep the warm wood bookshelves filled with books, an antique desk lamp and the leather chair visible but subordinate. Place the exact headline text “Handcrafted Leather Journals - Capture Your Thoughts in Style” in the hero area and the exact CTA “Discover the Collection” beneath it.

Bento detail grid, right: include five distinct, neatly aligned detail cards with these exact labels and visuals: “Leather Texture Detail” showing a close-up of the journal cover and leather grain; “Fountain Pen” showing an elegant fountain pen resting on an open journal page; “Hand Stitching” showing meticulous stitching along the spine; “Paper Quality” showing high-quality paper texture with tasteful handwritten script; and “Custom Embossing” showing personalized embossing on the cover. Keep the card text crisp and readable without adding unrelated copy.

Use a single Rembrandt-style key light with dramatic but controlled shadows and a gentle golden-hour effect. Use warm earth tones: brown, cream, gold accents and rich mahogany. Aim for quiet luxury, understated elegance and a focus on craftsmanship. Suggest a Hasselblad H6D with an 85mm f/1.2 shallow-depth-of-field look, while keeping the design a coherent landing-page composition rather than a literal camera specification. Add a small elegant handwritten signature “Willy” at the bottom-right corner. No extra logos, watermarks or unrelated text.
items.prompt_zh:

左侧主视觉：呈现使用配置身份的同一位明确成年女性，她带有欧亚裔特征的时装模特气质，身穿米色羊绒毛衣，坐在光线柔和的图书馆皮革扶手椅中，用优雅的钢笔书写打开的日记本。保留摆满书籍的暖色木质书架、古董台灯和皮革扶手椅，但让它们服务于主体。主视觉中放置准确标题“Handcrafted Leather Journals - Capture Your Thoughts in Style”，下方放置准确 CTA“Discover the Collection”。

右侧 Bento 信息卡片网格：整齐排列五张独立细节卡片，并使用以下准确标签和画面： “Leather Texture Detail”，展示日记本封面与皮革纹理特写；“Fountain Pen”，展示置于打开日记本页面上的优雅钢笔；“Hand Stitching”，展示书脊上的精细手工缝线；“Paper Quality”，展示高品质纸张纹理与雅致手写字迹；“Custom Embossing”，展示封面上的个性化压花。保持卡片文字清晰易读，不添加无关文案。

使用单一伦勃朗式主光，形成戏剧性但受控的阴影与柔和的黄金时刻效果。采用棕色、米色、金色点缀和浓郁桃花心木色组成的暖色大地色系。整体追求静奢、低调优雅，并聚焦手工工艺。可呈现类似哈苏 H6D 搭配85mm f/1.2浅景深的观感，但让它成为统一的落地页视觉，而不是机械展示相机参数。右下角添加小巧优雅的手写签名“Willy”。不要额外标志、水印或无关文字。

items.title: 沙漠中的数学符号纪念性地景
items.description: 四格构图的纪念性数学符号地景艺术：将四个可替换的数学符号转化为荒漠中的巨大地形与建筑遗迹，使用俯瞰斜角、金色时刻光线和写实侵蚀材质。
items.prompt: Create a square 2:2 artwork in a clear 2x2 grid, showing four monumental mathematical symbols as colossal terrain typography carved into an arid desert. In the top-left quadrant, use an arch-like mathematical symbol as a sandstone arch cut through a canyon, with a thin aqueduct stream following its curve and tiny caravans casting long shadows in the distance. In the top-right quadrant, use a stepped geometric symbol as a stepped fortress carved into a mesa, with sharp terraces, windblown sand pooling in corners, and tiny equations chiseled into the stone. In the bottom-left quadrant, use a block-like mathematical symbol as massive stone pylons connected by a lintel bridge, with ruined blocks scattered like fragments of a proof. In the bottom-right quadrant, use the Penrose Triangle as impossible ruins half-buried in sand, using forced perspective to create a visual paradox while harsh sunlight slices the edges. Use an aerial oblique view, golden-hour desert light, crisp dramatic shadows, photoreal erosion detail, and minimal haze. Keep the four quadrants distinct but visually unified, with a Swiss 2x2 grid composition. No close-up people, brands, logos, watermarks, random text, or extra panels.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张 2:2 方形画面，以清晰的 2x2 四格构图展示四个巨大的数学符号，它们像由砂岩雕刻出的纪念性地形文字，矗立在干旱荒漠中。左上象限使用 an arch-like mathematical symbol，表现为砂岩峡谷切出的拱形结构，细窄的引水渠沿曲线流过，远处有投下长影的小型商队。右上象限使用 a stepped geometric symbol，表现为从台地中凿出的阶梯式堡垒，层层锐利的露台、风吹沙堆和细小的方程刻痕清晰可见。左下象限使用 a block-like mathematical symbol，表现为巨大的石柱与横梁桥，破碎石块像证明过程的残片散落在地。右下象限使用 Penrose Triangle，表现为半埋在沙中的不可能几何遗迹，以强制透视制造视觉悖论，猛烈日光切出清晰边缘。使用空中斜俯视角、金色时刻的沙漠光线、清晰而戏剧性的投影、写实的风化侵蚀细节和极少雾气。四个象限边界明确但视觉语言统一，保持 Swiss 2x2 网格构图。不要人物特写、品牌、标志、水印、随机文字或额外分格。

items.title: 日本杂货店购物高角度成年女性生活照
items.description: 绑定成年身份参考的日本杂货店购物写实生活照：年轻成年东亚女性穿淡黄色开衫与复古格纹短裙，从高位俯拍角度抬头微笑，身处充满亚洲零食和木质货架的温馨店内。
items.prompt:

Create an ultra-realistic vertical 4:5 candid lifestyle photograph of one clearly adult East Asian woman shopping in a cozy Japanese grocery store. Capture her from a high overhead angle with a modern smartphone camera. She has long silky dark-brown hair with soft bangs and a small hair clip, natural glowing skin and a gentle playful smile. Dress her in a pastel-yellow cardigan over a white top, a vintage plaid mini skirt, white ankle socks and casual sneakers. Keep the outfit tasteful and everyday.

Have her look upward toward the camera while posing naturally. One hand rests lightly against her cheek. Her other hand holds a black shopping basket, with her smartphone naturally visible near the basket handle or resting close to that hand without creating extra fingers or impossible overlaps.

Surround her with tightly packed shelves of colorful Asian snacks, dried foods and neatly arranged grocery packages. Use warm wooden flooring and shelving to create a cozy Japanese grocery-store atmosphere. Keep a slight wide-angle perspective, spontaneous candid composition, realistic smartphone exposure, subtle lens distortion, soft indoor lighting, natural skin texture and an authentic everyday moment.

Render highly photorealistic detail without a heavy filter. Avoid extra people, child subjects, duplicate limbs, impossible hand positions, distorted basket handles, plastic skin, commercial posing, excessive beauty retouching, text, copied packaging logos, watermarks and artificial 3D rendering.

items.prompt: Use the uploaded identity reference for the adult East Asian woman. Create a high-definition realistic 3:4 vertical night-park sports portrait. Show her standing on white high-top roller skates with pink laces, four pink wheels and light-brown soles on a paved road. Use a dramatic but sport-focused low-angle wide view with the camera almost touching the ground: make the nearer white skate with pink wheels extremely large in the lower-right foreground, place the other skate near bottom center, and keep her calm face toward the upper left. Preserve natural adult proportions and realistic skin, shoulder-length light-brown hair with thin bangs and loose waves, and a composed downward gaze. The foreground is gray slate pavement; behind her are black night sky, deep green trees, a metal fence and multiple white streetlights. Hard white lights from the left and back right illuminate the face, clothing and skates and cast long shadows. Keep the focus on the skates and person, with distant park lights slightly blurred, accurate leather, laces, resin wheels, ribbed socks, pavement and night-light texture. Do not weaken the giant foreground skate or low-angle perspective. No extra people, sexualized framing, text, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的人物身份参考图作为成年东亚女性的身份依据。生成一张高精细写实3:4竖版夜间公园运动人像。让她站在铺装路面的白色高帮滚轴溜冰鞋上，鞋带为粉色，四个车轮为粉色，鞋底为浅棕色。她穿白色短款圆领T恤，短袖边缘有两条粉色线条，暗粉色短裤带白色镶边和左腰白色系带，白色及膝长袜顶部有两条粉色线条。保持运动服实用且完整穿着。右手置于腰间，左臂向后下垂，一只脚大幅向前踏向镜头。使用戏剧性但以运动为中心的低机位广角：镜头几乎贴近地面，让近处的白色粉轮溜冰鞋在右下前景极度放大，另一只鞋位于底部中央，人物平静的脸部位于左上方。保持成年自然比例和真实皮肤，亮棕色及肩发配薄刘海和松散波浪，目光平静地向下。前景为灰色石板路，背景有黑色夜空、深绿色树木、金属栅栏和多盏白色街灯。左侧和右后方街灯投射硬质白光，照亮脸部、衣服和鞋子，并在路面形成长影。焦点放在鞋子和人物，远处公园灯略微虚化，准确表现皮革、鞋带、树脂车轮、罗纹袜、路面和夜光质感。不要削弱巨大前景鞋和低机位透视。不要多余人物、性化构图、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 樱花树下纪实闪光灯成年女性人像

items.prompt:

Create a vertical 9:16 spontaneous documentary photograph caught by chance. Place one clearly adult woman directly beneath a blooming cherry tree, with blossom-covered branches hanging down from above and entering the frame. Her head tilts slightly back and turns gently to one side; her gaze drifts sideways, her eyes are partially closed and her expression is relaxed and dreamy.

Keep subtle natural motion blur on her face and hair while the configured identity remains recognizable. Cherry-blossom petals fall around her, with some petals sharp and others softly blurred by motion. Dress her in a creamy chocolate off-the-shoulder long-sleeved dress with buttons running down the front. Give her short square nails with a milky base.

Make the blossom-covered branches sharp and highly detailed as the visual anchor. Use a direct harsh flash cutting through evening darkness, creating bright high-contrast light across the face, shoulders and petals, slight overexposure on some blossoms and deep shadow in the background. Preserve glowing skin with visible pores and natural texture, long thick eyelashes, soft eyeliner and nude glossy lips.

Use film grain, imperfect framing and the feeling of a genuine spontaneous moment. Keep one adult woman only and avoid plastic skin, artificial or AI-looking features, distorted anatomy, duplicate limbs, extra faces, copied logos, text, watermarks and polished studio posing.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物参考图作为画面中唯一主要可见成年女性的面部身份参考。除身份适配外，保留原场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线与视觉方向。

The strong summer midday sun is imperfect and not optimized for her face. She raises her free hand horizontally above her forehead to shield the light. items.title: 现代东方梦境立体纸雕：成年女性站在天门前
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见成年女性的面部身份，生成一张9:16东方纸雕梦境：极小人物在超巨型天门与超长天阶前回眸，冷白天光从门后照亮层叠纸艺世界。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible adult woman, extracting identity cues only and not copying the reference clothing or photographic medium. Keep the source papercut illustration medium, wardrobe, action, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a 9:16 vertical modern Oriental dreamscape made from layered papercut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, paper diorama, shadow-box layers, intricate paper carving and epic Oriental papercraft fantasy. The theme is “She stands before the opening of the Heavenly Gate.” A roughly 24-year-old adult Oriental woman stands alone before a gigantic hollowed paper-art gate leading to the sky. Multiple doors open into a sea of clouds and starlight, revealing an unknown world lit by cold white celestial light. She has come a long way; her body still faces forward while her head turns gently back to bid farewell to the old world. The look-back is neither hesitation nor sadness: she takes one final look and continues forward.

Keep the woman obviously tiny, serving as emotional anchor and scale reference only. The Heavenly Gate must be far larger and occupy most of the upper and middle frame, with its sides rising to or beyond the frame boundary. Build doors within doors, layered paper arches, celestial steps and distant temple silhouettes to create at least four to six depth layers. Place the woman small in the lower-center area with one foot stepping onto a higher stair. Keep shoulders and waist mainly forward, upper body and head naturally turned into a restrained two-thirds rear-side look-back; one hand gathers part of the skirt and the other hangs or opens slightly. High-altitude wind blows hair, skirt and streamers backward to preserve forward momentum.

Let black hair fall naturally while much of it streams to the rear-left and becomes slender hollowed paper ribbons like star trails. Add light pale-gold star-and-moon tassels, small stars and crescent papercut ornaments, without a tall complex crown. Dress her in a layered ultramarine-blue and silver-white paper-art gown: deep ultramarine inner skirt, silver-white outer pieces, streamers and cut patterns, with galaxies, moons, stars, clouds and Oriental geometry engraved inside and small pale-gold foil lines. Show paper thickness, layered construction, cut edges, fibers, creases and precise perforation.

Build the gate from towering papercut doors, continuous inner frames, giant hollow panels, cloud motifs, star trails and Oriental temple-carving structures. A very long silver-white paper staircase runs from the foreground bottom into the gate and onward to a glowing distant temple; use strong near-large/far-small perspective, never a short ordinary stair. Surround both sides with curled multi-layer blue and silver paper clouds. Keep the night sky bright deep ultramarine with pale-gold trails, silver starlight, a few crescents and a few white paper birds. Do not let clouds hide the gate or overcrowd the stars.

Use ultramarine blue, silver-white and cold white with small pale-gold accents, including #587667, #A5BFBA, #344A43, #C8D5D0, #718888 and #E3E7E1. Keep blue deep but bright, never black, and keep regional colors distinct rather than applying one blue filter. Cold white celestial light from deep inside the gate must be the brightest core, extending down the stairs as rim light on the figure's face, shoulders, hair, skirt and streamers. Give cut edges soft transmission and clear natural shadows between paper layers; retain ultramarine and light-purple darks, never dead black.

Layer the scene as stairs, clouds and figure in front; first gate in midground; second and third gates and cloud sea farther back; and cold-lit palace or temple silhouettes in the distance. Make it a museum-grade giant Oriental paper-carving installation with pressure, sanctity, ritual and epic depth. No minors, juvenile face, live-action photography, ordinary anime, plastic 3D, resin, clay, felt, children's crafts, Spring Festival window grilles, modern gates, ordinary building entrances, short stairs, oversized figure, full frontal turn, exaggerated twist, crying sadness, hesitation, a simple empty gate, blurred paper edges, grey wash, blue mush, disconnected materials, malformed hands, extra people, text, logo or watermark.

创作一张9:16竖幅现代东方梦境立体纸雕艺术图，融合分层剪纸插画、纸艺雕塑、纸艺立体盒景、精细镂空雕刻和史诗东方纸艺幻想。主题是“她站在天门开启之前”：一位约24岁的成年东方女性独自站在通往天际的巨大镂空纸艺神门前。多重门扉在云海与星光中向两侧打开，门后是被冷白天光照亮的未知世界；她已走过很长道路，身体仍朝向前方，却轻轻回头告别旧世界。回眸不是犹豫或悲伤，而是最后看一眼后继续前进。

人物必须明显渺小，仅作情绪锚点与尺度参照；巨门远大于人物并占据画面中上部，门扉从两侧延伸接近或超出画面边界。门中还有门，门后继续出现多层纸艺拱门、天阶、神殿轮廓，形成至少四至六层深度。人物位于下半部中央偏小位置，一只脚踏上更高阶梯，肩腰主要朝前，上半身与头部约三分之二侧后方自然回转，目光越过肩膀，双手一只收住裙摆、另一只自然下垂或侧展；高空风把长发、裙摆和披帛向后吹，保持明确向前动势。

天门由高耸纸艺门扉、连续内框、巨型镂空门板、云纹、星轨和东方神殿式纸雕构成。门前是一道从画面底部延伸入门内、继续通向远处发光神殿的超长银白纸艺阶梯，近大远小，不能是普通短楼梯。两侧是群青与银白多层卷曲纸云，天空为明亮深群青，带浅金星轨、银白星点、少量月牙和少量白色纸鸟；云层不可遮住天门，星星不要堆满画面。

前景为阶梯、云和人物，中景为第一重天门，中远景为第二、第三重门与云海，远景为冷白光照亮的天宫或神殿。画面像博物馆级巨型东方纸雕装置，具备压迫感、神圣感、仪式感和史诗纵深。不要未成年人、幼态脸、真人摄影、普通动漫、塑料3D、树脂、黏土、毛毡、儿童手工、春节窗花、现代大门、普通建筑入口、短阶梯、人物过大、完全正面、夸张扭身、悲伤哭泣、犹豫感、简单空门、模糊纸边、灰蒙、蓝色糊成一团、材质割裂、手部畸形、额外人物、文字、标志或水印。

全局加入轻量旧彩印扫描柔化、细微纸张颗粒和低强度压缩噪点，同时保持五官、发丝、耳环和服装线稿清晰。不要真人摄影、照片写实、3D渲染、现代手游立绘、萌系大眼、大面积平滑渐变、全身站立构图、文字、标志或水印。

items.title: 东亚女性海上游轮旅行街拍
items.description: 成年女性海上游轮旅行街拍：使用统一人物参考图保持面部身份，人物站在船舶甲板上迎风看海，穿蓝色牛仔夹克与棕灰宽檐软帽，船尾航迹和开放海面构成自由的手机抓拍场景；仅保留指定文字 Soran。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the visible adult woman. Preserve her recognizable facial identity and natural proportions while keeping the travel styling candid and ordinary.

Create an authentic vertical 3:4 mobile travel snapshot of her on the open deck of a moving passenger ship. Keep a medium-wide composition with clear negative space toward the sea: she leans slightly forward, one hand holds a deck fixture and the other lifts high toward the upper right, creating a relaxed tilted shoulder line. Her deep brown-black long hair blows in the sea breeze. She wears a loose medium-blue denim jacket over a simple inner layer and a wide soft brown-gray floppy hat. Give her a natural happy smile, with only occasional partial eye contact; she should mostly look toward the sea or the wake rather than pose for the camera.

Show a clear blue sky, gray-blue sea, white wake at the stern, believable ship structure and only a few flags or ribbons. Use bright natural daylight with a light hat-brim shadow, warm skin tones, denim blue, sky blue, sea blue-gray and restrained brown accents. Keep the body anatomy natural, hands and fingers correct, and the scene open, free and unmistakably underway. Preserve a realistic smartphone look with slight lens distortion and natural imperfection, not HDR, heavy sharpening or commercial retouching.

Integrate the exact word "Soran" as the only allowed readable text at three material scales: clearly readable embroidery near the face on the denim collar, chest pocket or hat strap; subtle hidden instances in denim twill, hat weave, hair flow, hull scratches or rope fibers; and tiny instances suggested by denim stitching, metal rivets, ship bolts, rope knots and wake foam. These repetitions must feel physically embedded, not pasted logos. Do not add any other readable text, logo, watermark, sticker, floating text or subtitle.

Avoid repeated direct gaze, stiff posing, electric-blue sky, denim merging completely with sky, hat covering the eyes, dislocated shoulders, overlong arms, malformed fingers, missing wake, severely tilted horizon, excessive flags, plastic skin and over-edited advertising polish.
items.prompt_zh:

创作一张竖幅 3:4 的真实手机旅行快照：她站在正在航行的客船开放甲板上。使用中广角构图，在海面方向保留充足留白；人物身体略微前倾，一只手扶住甲板设施，另一只手向右上方高举，形成自然倾斜的肩线。深棕黑色长发被海风吹动，穿宽松中蓝色牛仔夹克和简洁内搭，戴棕灰色宽檐软帽。她自然微笑，只偶尔短暂接触镜头，主要看向海面或船尾航迹，不要摆拍感。

展现晴朗蓝天、灰蓝海面、船尾清晰白色航迹、可信的船体结构，以及少量旗帜或彩带。使用明亮自然日光和帽檐轻微阴影，保持暖肤色、牛仔蓝、天空蓝、海水蓝灰与克制棕色点缀。人体比例、肩部、手部和手指自然正确，画面明确处于航行状态，传达开放和自由感。保留真实手机旅行照片的轻微镜头畸变与自然瑕疵，不要 HDR 过度处理、强锐化或商业磨皮。

将精确单词“Soran”作为唯一允许出现的可读文字，以三种材质尺度融入画面：在脸旁的牛仔衣领、胸前口袋或帽带处清晰可读的刺绣；隐藏在牛仔斜纹、帽子织纹、头发走势、船体细划痕或缆绳纤维中的细节；以及由牛仔车线、金属铆钉、船体螺栓、绳结和航迹泡沫排列暗示的微观文字。所有重复都必须像物理材质自然形成，不能像贴上的 logo。不要加入其他可读文字、标志、水印、贴纸 logo、漂浮文字或字幕。

避免反复直视镜头、僵硬摆姿、过度电光蓝天空、牛仔与天空完全融为一色、帽檐遮住眼睛、肩关节错位、手臂过长、手指变形、缺失航迹、海平面严重倾斜、过多旗帜彩带、塑料皮肤和过度广告化修图。
