items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as an identity reference for the small supporting figures in the poster. Keep exactly 3-6 figures, all small and subordinate to the city scene; do not turn the referenced person into one dominant hero character.

Create a fresh, airy and elegant city travel poster for Melbourne that feels uniquely designed for that city rather than reused from another city. Before drawing, identify the unique city DNA of Melbourne: one primary landmark or skyline feature, one local movement or transport cue, one everyday lifestyle moment, one native plant or environmental detail and one spatial composition that specifically fits the city. Choose a structure grounded in its real atmosphere, such as a harbour lookout, laneway street, riverside park, beach walk, hilltop viewpoint, market corner, tram street, ferry quay, botanical garden, old town street, coastal boardwalk, cultural square or skyline overlook. Each city must use a different scene structure; do not always put a shop on the right, a signboard on the left, people at a cafe table, the same foreground flower bed, the same lamppost or the same waterfront promenade.

Place “Melbourne” in the upper-left with generous typography-safe negative space, and add one short refined English caption matching the city mood. Use one iconic primary landmark as the main visual anchor and only 2-4 supporting local details that genuinely belong to the city. Do not make a landmark collage or overfill the background. Use only small supporting figures performing city-specific everyday actions such as walking, sketching, cycling, waiting for a tram, boarding a ferry, carrying a surfboard, taking a quiet photo, reading in a park, jogging by the water or browsing a small market. Avoid crowds and any dominant hero figure; place people naturally within the city.

Use local transport, signage, street furniture, plants, food, architecture and leisure details only when they fit Melbourne. Transport cues may appear subtly as a tram-stop marker, ferry route board, station clock, bike-lane symbol, beach patrol flag, small metro icon or painted pavement mark rather than always as a large vertical signboard.

Use a Japanese stationery aesthetic, luxury sticker illustration and premium commercial flat-vector travel-poster language: clean thin outlines, consistent line weight, flat colors only, soft minimal shapes and a calm editorial composition. Base the atmosphere on pale powder blue, soft sky blue and mist blue; use warm cream, soft beige, sage green and muted grey-green for architecture and nature. Use dusty rose or blush pink only as tiny accents on flowers, signs, awnings, clothing or small decorative details. Keep the palette refined, toned-down and high-end, with open space, breathing room and a relaxed local rhythm like a premium travel postcard and quiet lifestyle brand.

Negative constraints: no realism, watercolor, painterly effects, photorealism, heavy shading, gradients, paper texture, dense background, repeated cafe-on-right layout, repeated signboard-on-left layout, generic tourist-poster collage, crowded street, oversized supporting people or dramatic lighting.
items.prompt_zh:
使用用户上传的参考图作为海报中小型支撑人物的身份参考；人物必须保持3至6个、尺寸较小且不形成主角，不要让参考人物成为主导英雄角色。

为 Melbourne 创建一个清新、通透、优雅且真正为该城市量身定制的城市旅行海报，不要套用其他城市的模板。绘制之前先识别 Melbourne 独特的城市 DNA：一个主要地标或天际线特征、一个当地交通或移动线索、一个日常生活瞬间、一种原生植物或当地环境细节，以及一个专门适合这座城市的空间构图。根据城市真实氛围选择港口观景台、小巷街道、河滨公园、海滩步道、山顶视角、市场角落、电车街道、渡轮码头、植物园、旧城区街道、海岸木栈道、文化广场或天际线俯瞰等结构。不同城市必须使用不同场景结构，不要固定商店在右、招牌在左、咖啡桌、花坛、路灯或滨水长廊位置。

将“Melbourne”放置在左上角，预留充足的排版安全负空间；添加一条匹配城市气质的简短精炼英文说明。使用一个标志性主要地标作为视觉锚点，仅加入2至4个真正属于该城市的辅助细节，不要做地标拼贴或塞满背景。小人物执行该城市特有的日常动作，例如行走、写生、骑行、等电车、登渡轮、携带冲浪板、安静拍照、在公园阅读、沿水慢跑或逛小市场；避免拥挤和单一主角，人物要自然融入城市。

当地交通、标牌、街道设施、植物、食物、建筑和休闲细节只有在适合 Melbourne 时才使用。交通信息可低调表现为电车站标记、渡轮航线牌、车站时钟、自行车道符号、海滩巡逻旗、小型地铁图标或路面标记，不要总是使用大型垂直招牌。

风格为日系文具美学、奢华贴纸插画、高端商业平铺矢量旅行海报、干净细轮廓、一致线条粗细、仅限平涂色彩、柔和极简形状和冷静社论构图。以淡粉蓝、柔和天蓝和薄雾蓝为氛围基调，用暖奶油、柔和米色、鼠尾草绿和灰绿色表现建筑与自然；灰粉或淡粉只作花卉、标志、雨篷、服装或小型装饰的微小点缀。保持精致、柔和、高端、开放并有呼吸感，像高端旅行明信片和安静的生活方式品牌。

负向约束：无写实、无水彩、无绘画笔触、无照片写实、无重阴影、无渐变、无纸张纹理、无密集背景、无重复右侧咖啡馆布局、无重复左侧招牌布局、无通用旅游拼贴、无拥挤街道、无放大的支撑人物、无戏剧性光效。

items.title: 幽蓝复古时尚人像对镜补妆编辑摄影
items.description: 9:16 layered mirror fashion portrait of a clearly adult woman finishing makeup in a blue-and-wine-red backstage dressing room, with exact VOXCAT branding integrated into clothing and layout.
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 high-end photorealistic fashion portrait of a clearly adult woman finishing makeup in a dim private backstage dressing room. Shoot from behind and slightly to the side so the real person on the right is a large softly focused foreground of black-to-dark-brown classical updo hair, shoulders and translucent ice-blue fabric, while her sharp front face appears in the central vertical mirror. Build a clear three-layer composition: foreground body, mirrored subject and cool-blue background.

The adult woman has a narrow soft oval face, relaxed jaw, slightly lowered lids, parted lips and a lazy self-immersed expression. She looks at her own lips in the mirror rather than directly at the physical camera. One hand gently touches the lower lip with a small gloss wand; the other loosely holds the collar. Keep hands natural and relaxed. Style the hair in a full modern classical updo with a few soft stray strands and pale white/light-green flower branches at the back. Use creamy skin, rose-brown eyeshadow, fine slightly lifted black liner, restrained peach blush and high-gloss coral-to-rose-red lips. Add slender drop earrings and small bead ornaments.

Dress her in a light ice-blue or gray-blue translucent tulle/light-silk robe with white, pale-pink and orange-pink floral embroidery, a loose open neckline and a light fitted inner layer. Preserve a small clear white garment tag reading exactly “VOXCAT” in the right foreground. Set the designed night dressing room with multiple mirrors, deep red-to-black glossy lacquer furniture, geometric patterns, dark-red wall left, ice-blue rear space and a partial pink bouquet at lower left. Use soft cold-blue key light, dark red/magenta/slight purple ambient light, complete face exposure, medium-low ratio, soft haze and controlled mirror reflections. Add a restrained white stylized V-and-cat logo upper left, fine white English/Japanese editorial type on the left, and an exact slender handwritten “voxcat” signature lower right. Keep text small and secondary. No extra logos, unreadable required literals, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, CGI or noisy layout.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张 9:16 竖版高端写实时尚人像：一位明确成年的女性在幽暗的私人后台梳妆室对镜完成补妆。摄影机位于她背后略偏侧方，使右侧真实人物的黑色至深棕色古典盘发、肩部和半透明冰蓝衣料成为大面积柔焦前景，而清晰正脸出现在中央竖直镜面中。构成前景人物、镜中主体和冰蓝背景三层纵深。

成年女性拥有柔和偏窄椭圆脸、放松下颌、微垂眼睑、微张嘴唇和慵懒自我沉浸的表情。她通过镜子观察自己的嘴唇，不直接看现实摄影机。一只手用小唇彩棒轻触下唇，另一只手松弛地扶住衣领，手部自然放松。黑色盘发丰盈并带现代时尚感，保留少量碎发，后侧插浅白与浅绿色花枝。底妆柔润，玫瑰棕眼影、细黑上眼线、克制桃粉腮红和高光泽珊瑚红至玫瑰红唇釉。佩戴细长垂坠耳环和小珠饰。

穿浅冰蓝或灰蓝色半透明薄纱或轻丝外袍，带白色、浅粉和橙粉花卉刺绣，宽松开放领口内搭浅色贴身层。右侧前景衣物保留清晰白色吊牌，精确写着 “VOXCAT”。场景为设计感夜间梳妆室：多块镜面、深红至黑色高光漆木家具、几何纹样、左侧暗红墙、后方冰蓝空间和左下粉色花束。使用柔和冷蓝主光、暗红洋红微紫环境光、完整面部曝光、中低光比、柔和雾气和受控镜面反射。左上加入克制白色 V 与猫元素图形 logo，左侧加入细小白色英文/日文编辑字体，右下加入精确手写体 “voxcat” 签名，文字保持小而次要。不要额外 logo、不可读硬文字、变形手部、多余手指、塑料皮肤、CGI 或嘈杂布局。

items.title: 超现实浪漫幻想樱花仙子时尚摄影
items.description: 成年女性超现实樱花时尚肖像：统一人物参考图保持面部身份，人物坐在盛开白色樱花枝上，穿半透明白色水晶欧根纱与流动丝绸，结合低角度、蓝天旧建筑和融化现实的魔幻时尚叙事。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible adult woman. Preserve her recognizable identity, facial structure and natural proportions.

Create a surreal romantic fashion editorial in a vertical 9:16 composition. An adult woman with delicate features and pale light skin sits gracefully on a blooming white cherry-blossom branch. She wears an elegant translucent white crystal-organza dress layered with flowing transparent silk fabric that moves in the wind like liquid glass. Her short platinum-blonde hair lifts softly in the breeze and blends visually with the fabric. Keep the wardrobe editorial and non-explicit.

Use a low-angle view from the ground looking upward to create dreamlike scale. Surround her with abundant white blossoms, drifting petals and transparent ribbons of fabric. Give her a peaceful melancholic expression with gently closed eyes, like a fragile spring dream. Behind the blossoms, show bright blue sky, soft white clouds and old residential buildings partially hidden by flowering trees, creating a contrast between ordinary urban life and a fantasy world.

Render natural skin texture, realistic translucent fabric, delicate petals, narrow hair strands, soft sunlight through silk, subtle shadows and cinematic depth of field. Use a dreamy Japanese spring atmosphere, poetic visual storytelling, magical realism and contemporary high-fashion editorial photography. Preserve a refined color-film character, volumetric sunlight, realistic materials and a controlled surreal melting-reality effect in which the boundaries between human, glass, silk and nature softly dissolve.

Avoid altered facial identity, childish appearance, sexualized posing, opaque or muddy fabric, broken anatomy, extra limbs, fused fingers, duplicated blossoms, chaotic distortion, flat lighting, low detail and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的参考图作为画面中主要可见成年女性的面部身份依据，保留她可辨认的身份、面部结构与自然比例。

创作一幅竖幅 9:16 的超现实浪漫时尚编辑肖像。一位具有精致面部特征和浅色皮肤的成年女性优雅地坐在盛开的白色樱花树枝上。她穿着优雅的半透明白色水晶欧根纱连衣裙，外层叠加随风飘动、如液体玻璃般流动的透明丝绸。白金色短发在微风中轻轻扬起，并在视觉上与周围织物呼应。服装保持高级时装编辑感，不做露骨表达。

使用从地面向上看的低角度，营造梦幻的尺度感。人物被大量白色樱花、飘落花瓣和天空中旋转的透明织物缎带包围。她带着平静、忧郁的表情，双眼轻轻闭合，如同脆弱的春日梦境。樱花后方呈现明亮蓝天、柔软白云和被花树部分遮挡的旧住宅楼，在普通城市生活与幻想世界之间形成对比。

表现自然皮肤纹理、真实半透明织物、精致花瓣、细致发丝、穿过丝绸的柔和阳光、细微阴影和电影级景深。采用梦幻日本春日氛围、诗意视觉叙事、魔幻现实主义和当代高级时装编辑摄影。保留精致彩色胶片质感、体积光、真实材质，以及受控的融化现实效果，让人物、玻璃、丝绸与自然之间的边界柔和溶解。

避免面部身份改变、幼态化外观、性化姿势、不透明或浑浊的织物、解剖结构错误、多余肢体、融合手指、重复花朵、失控变形、平淡光线、低细节和水印。

items.title: 复古花卉人像金色逆光胶片梦境
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见成年女性的面部身份，生成一张奶油玫瑰贴脸、金色逆光勾勒发丝与花瓣的复古柔焦胶片近景肖像，并将 Soran 微缩字样融入蕾丝、花瓣、发丝与花蕊纹理。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, composition, lighting, floral arrangement and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a 1:1 photorealistic vintage floral close-up portrait of an adult woman. She has large light golden-brown curls and wears creamy white lace fabric. Cream-colored roses sit close to her lips and jawline, with the flowers slightly blocking the foreground. Tilt her head slightly, tuck the chin a little, and direct her gaze away from the camera or downward rather than making direct eye contact, creating a quiet trance.

Use a dark brown to near-black background and an extremely strong warm golden backlight from the upper-left rear. Keep the face in shadow while the top of the head, curl edges and flower petals glow through with gold, creating a dark face with golden edges and golden air atomization. Use a 50-85mm close-up portrait feel, low contrast, overall soft focus, fine grain, low resolution, warm halation, hazy highlights and an old-film dreamlike quality.

Make Soran clearly readable in the creamy white collar lace embroidery beside the face, or in a small rose-floral nameplate. Also hide Soran naturally within hair strands, rose-petal veins, fabric fibers and flower-stem textures. Let microscopic Soran emerge from stamen arrangements, lace stitches, petal folds and intersections of hair strands. The Latin letters Soran must remain recognizable while genuinely integrated with the materials, never floating like a sticker.

Negative constraints: frequent direct eye contact with the camera, a front-lit bright face, a golden-yellow filter over the whole image, orange skin, hair highlights burned white, pure white razor-sharp roses, roses too far from the face, a brightened background, sharp focus, ultra-detailed 8K crispness, HDR, high contrast, studio lighting, flash photography, modern smartphone look, commercial beauty retouching, plastic skin, external watermark, sticker logo, floating text, subtitles or unreadable Soran.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、构图、光线、花卉安排和视觉风格。

创作一张1:1方幅、照片级真实的复古花卉近景肖像，主体为一位成年女性。她有浅金棕色的大卷发，穿奶油白蕾丝衣料；奶油色玫瑰贴近嘴唇和下颌，花朵在前景形成轻微遮挡。头部轻侧，下颌微收，视线看向画外或低垂，避免直视镜头，呈现安静恍惚的状态。

背景为深棕至近黑色。使用左后上方极强的暖金色逆光，脸部保持暗面，仅让发顶、卷发边缘和花瓣被金光照透，形成暗脸金边与金色空气雾化。采用50至85mm近景人像感、低反差、全图柔焦、细颗粒、低解析、暖色 halation、高光泛朦和旧胶片梦境质感。

将清晰可读的 Soran 融入脸旁奶油白衣领的蕾丝刺绣，或融入玫瑰旁的小型花艺铭牌；同时把隐藏的 Soran 自然嵌入卷发发丝、玫瑰花瓣脉络、衣料纤维和花茎纹理。再让微观 Soran 由花蕊排列、蕾丝针脚、花瓣褶皱和发丝交叉组成。文字必须是可辨认的拉丁字母 Soran，并与材质真实融合，不要漂浮或像贴纸。

负向约束：不要频繁直视镜头、正面补光亮脸、金黄滤镜覆盖全图、肤色橙化、头发高光烧白、纯白锐利玫瑰、玫瑰离脸过远、提亮背景、锐利对焦、超高细节、8K、清脆干净画面、HDR、高反差、影棚灯、闪光摄影、现代手机质感、商业美容修图、塑料皮肤、外部水印、贴纸 logo、漂浮文字、字幕或不可读的 Soran。

items.title: 雨夜古风油纸伞成年女性近距离写真
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见成年女性的面部身份，生成一张雨夜庭院中撑米白色油纸伞、贴近镜头的浪漫真实抓拍肖像。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a near-4:5 vertical photorealistic close-up portrait with the feeling of an ancient-style rainy-night private snapshot. The subject is clearly an adult young woman with a Korean-mixed-style oval face, upturned eye corners, New Chinese Magnolia makeup, light peach blush under the eyes, moist red-bean lips and naturally satin skin that retains real texture. Her long black hair is half-tied, with a few damp fragmented strands beside her face, and she wears jade pendant earrings.

She wears a moon-white modern New Chinese long dress with delicate light-colored floral embroidery on the chest, covered by a large translucent white gauze cloak. Her body is close to the lens. One hand holds the handle of a cream-white traditional oil-paper umbrella tilted toward the camera, as if sheltering the photographer under it; her other hand reaches naturally toward the photographer. She looks directly at the camera with an open, happy smile. Keep a natural adult body, realistic proportions and believable weight.

Set the scene in a rainy-night courtyard. The umbrella is covered with tiny water droplets and warm light spots; the wet stone road reflects the lights, while distant wooden buildings and warm lamps fall into soft blur. Use softened flash on the face and a warm orange rim light behind the hair, with tiny raindrops and scattered light spots in the air. Contrast warm lamps with cool night-rain colors, keep the image low contrast with moist air, and preserve a romantic but genuinely photographic texture. Retain soft-flash bloom and candid imperfections. No illustration, anime, CGI, plastic skin, malformed hands, extra limbs, modern advertising over-retouching or extra text. Keep the low-key artistic signature ChenLin in the lower-right corner.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创作一张接近4:5的竖幅照片级真实近距离肖像，呈现雨夜古风与私人抓拍感：明确是一位成年年轻女性，拥有韩系混血感的鹅蛋脸、上扬眼尾、新中式玉兰妆、眼下浅桃粉腮红、水润豆沙唇，以及保留真实纹理的自然缎光肌肤。她留长黑发并半束，少量潮湿碎发垂在脸侧，佩戴玉石垂坠耳环。

她穿月白色改良新中式长裙，胸前有细腻浅色花卉刺绣，外搭大面积半透明白色薄纱披衣。人物身体贴近镜头，一只手握住米白色传统油纸伞的伞柄，伞向镜头方向倾斜，仿佛把摄影者一起罩进伞下；另一只手自然向摄影者方向伸出。她张嘴开心笑并直视镜头，姿态自然，保持成年人的真实身体比例与重心。

场景是夜雨庭院：伞面布满细小水珠和暖色光斑，背景湿石板路反射灯火，远处木建筑与暖灯虚化。使用柔化闪光照亮脸部，人物背后有暖橙色发丝轮廓光，空气中散布细小雨滴与光点。采用暖灯与冷夜雨色的对撞、低对比和湿润空气感，浪漫但保持真实照片质感。画面保留柔和闪光的 bloom 与自然抓拍的不完美，不要插画、动漫、CGI、塑料皮肤、畸形手部、额外肢体、现代广告式过度修图或多余文字。右下角保留低调艺术签名 ChenLin。

items.title: 敷面膜吐舌头年轻女性低角度自拍
items.description: 3:4 realistic smartphone selfie of a clearly adult woman in a brown T-shirt and white skincare mask during a relaxed evening at home.
items.prompt:
Create a realistic 3:4 portrait smartphone selfie of a clearly adult woman in a cozy modern home interior during a relaxed self-care evening. Preserve the approved identity on the visible subject. Use a low-angle selfie perspective and playful expression: she sticks out her tongue while looking toward the lens. Style her hair in a messy bun, with square dark-brown nails and natural realistic skin texture. She wears a loose brown T-shirt with a subtle printed graphic and a white fabric skincare mask covering the central face while leaving the eyes and surrounding features natural. Include a transparent glass filled with ice cubes in the scene.

Use a white wall and modern lamp in the background, warm soft home lighting, relaxed natural exposure, realistic smartphone lens behavior, subtle film grain and high-resolution detail. Keep the mood casual, chill and non-sexual, with believable anatomy and hands. No text overlays, logos, watermarks, CGI, plastic skin, distorted face or extra limbs.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张写实的 3:4 竖版智能手机自拍：一位明确成年的女性在舒适的现代家居室内度过轻松的自我护理夜晚。将 approved identity 保留在可见主体上。使用低角度自拍视角和俏皮表情：她看向镜头吐出舌头。头发梳成凌乱丸子头，指甲为方形深褐色，皮肤保持自然真实纹理。她穿宽松棕色 T 恤，带低调印花图案，脸部中央覆盖白色织物护肤面膜，眼睛和周围特征保持自然。画面中加入装满冰块的透明玻璃杯。

背景为白墙和现代灯具，使用温暖柔和的家居灯光、自然曝光、真实手机镜头特性、细微胶片颗粒和高清细节。氛围保持休闲、放松且非性化，人体结构和手部可信。不要文字叠加、标志、水印、CGI、塑料皮肤、变形脸部或多余肢体。

items.title: 业余质感长发女子户外自拍人像
items.description: Natural iPhone-style blue-hour selfie portrait of a clearly adult woman beside a calm river, framed by trees, a bridge and a distant flag-decorated temple spire.
items.prompt:
Create an amateur-quality but photorealistic blue-hour outdoor selfie portrait of a clearly adult woman, using the approved identity reference to preserve her face and overall identity. She has long flowing dark-brown hair and extends her right arm toward the camera for a gentle selfie. Tilt her face slightly upward with a soft direct gaze. Place a delicate purple five-petal flower near the right temple in her hair. Add simple silver hoop earrings and a thin cross necklace.

Dress her in a light heather-gray casual off-shoulder T-shirt with a subtle faded dark-green graphic, relaxed natural fit and no readable logo. Set the scene in early evening beside a calm blue-gray river under a clear pale-blue sky transitioning into dusk. Large leafy tree branches frame the top and left. Across the water show a concrete bridge, distant green trees and a distinct golden-brown temple or spire-like building with colorful flags.

Use soft natural twilight: cool blue sky tones balanced by a gentle warm glow on skin, no harsh shadows. Keep the flower lavender-purple with a pale center, water muted blue-gray and foliage deep natural green. iPhone-style sharp but candid high-resolution texture, authentic amateur quality, believable anatomy and natural skin. No text overlays, watermark, distorted hands, CGI or over-polished studio finish.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张业余感但写实的蓝调时刻户外自拍人像，使用 approved identity reference 保留明确成年的女性面部与整体身份。她留飘逸深棕色长发，右臂向相机伸出拍摄柔和自拍，脸部微微向上，带温柔直视。右侧太阳穴附近的头发上放一朵精致紫色五瓣花，佩戴简约银色圆环耳环和细十字架项链。

穿浅麻灰色休闲露肩 T 恤，版型自然宽松，正面带低调褪色深绿色图案，不要可读标志。场景为傍晚蓝调时刻的河畔：清澈柔和的浅蓝天空渐变入黄昏，繁茂树枝框住顶部和左侧，下方是平静蓝灰河水。对岸有混凝土桥、远处绿树，以及明显的金褐色寺庙或塔尖式建筑和缤纷旗帜。

使用柔和自然暮光，天空冷蓝与皮肤温暖柔光平衡，不要刺眼阴影。花朵呈浅紫色并带浅色花心，水面为克制蓝灰色，树叶为深自然绿。保持 iPhone 风格的清晰但抓拍质感、真实业余感、可信人体结构和自然皮肤。不要文字叠加、水印、变形手部、CGI 或过度精致的影棚效果。

items.title: 抱着黑白猫咪的日系少女酒店随性自拍
items.description: Close smartphone portrait of a clearly adult Japanese woman gently holding a fluffy black-and-white cat in a warmly lit luxury hotel room.
items.prompt:
Create a photorealistic close smartphone selfie of a clearly adult fictional Japanese woman, age 20, in a warmly dim luxury hotel room. A fluffy black-and-white bicolor cat is held very close to the camera in the foreground, its face large and sharp with a pink nose, long white whiskers, dark mask-like fur around the eyes and thick soft fur. The woman is behind the cat, gently wrapping one arm around its chest and shoulders; the cat partly hides her face, creating a casual affectionate snapshot.

She has mature adult features, long slightly messy light-brown hair with soft natural bangs and loose cheek-framing strands, relaxed dark-brown eyes, a sleepy gentle smile, natural asymmetry, pores and realistic skin texture. Dress her in tasteful adult casual hotelwear: a dark thin-strap camisole or soft black sleeveless top under a loose beige knit cardigan resting naturally around the shoulders. Keep the outfit cozy and non-explicit, with natural drape and no exaggerated cleavage.

Use a 28mm-feel slightly low front angle, close-distance smartphone depth of field and realistic indoor shadows. Set a warm beige hotel wall, framed European architecture artwork, soft bedside lamp glow and elegant muted furnishings behind them. Add gentle highlights to eyes, cheeks, hair and cat fur, high-resolution photorealism, natural candid quality and cozy intimate atmosphere. No text, logos, watermarks, distorted anatomy, plastic skin or CGI.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张写实的近距离智能手机自拍：一位明确成年的虚构日本女性，20 岁，位于暖色昏暗的豪华酒店客房内。前景中一只蓬松的黑白双色猫离镜头很近，脸部大而清晰，有粉色鼻子、长白胡须、眼睛周围的深色面罩状毛发和厚实柔软的皮毛。女性在猫身后，用一只手臂轻轻环抱猫的胸部和肩膀；猫部分遮住她的脸，形成随性亲密的快照。

她有成熟的成年面部特征，长而略乱的浅棕色头发、柔软自然的刘海和修饰脸颊的碎发，放松的深棕色眼睛和困倦温柔的微笑，面部不对称、毛孔和真实皮肤纹理自然可见。穿得体的成年休闲酒店服装：深色细肩带吊带背心或柔软黑色无袖上衣，外搭宽松米色针织开衫，自然落在肩部。保持舒适、非露骨，面料自然垂坠，不夸张表现胸部。

使用约 28mm 镜头感、略低的近距离手机前置视角、浅景深和真实室内阴影。背景为暖米色酒店墙、装框欧洲建筑艺术品、柔和床头灯和雅致低调的室内陈设。让眼睛、脸颊、头发和猫毛有柔和高光，呈现高清写实、自然抓拍和舒适亲密氛围。不要文字、标志、水印、解剖变形、塑料皮肤或 CGI。

items.title: 东亚女性校园墨绿学院风人像摄影
items.description: 9:16 natural outdoor portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman in dark-green academy-inspired fashion holding a small silver vintage camera, with the exact word Soran embedded as fine decorative lettering.
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical natural-fashion portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman in an outdoor campus-like green field. Give her long deep-brown hair in soft loose double braids, thin wispy bangs and a calm clear expression. She wears an adult academy-inspired outfit, not a school uniform: white pointed-collar shirt, dark-green tailored suit, matching oversized butterfly bow, gray-green plaid long skirt and gold buttons. Her hands naturally hold a small silver vintage camera; her body turns slightly, with a brief glance near the camera or down toward the camera rather than a strong direct gaze.

Use a highly blurred green field background with no clear buildings or people. Warm golden side backlight from the upper right creates a soft rim on the crown of her head, flyaway hair and braid edges. Use an 85mm medium-long focal length, shallow depth, low saturation, low contrast, gentle focus and light halation. Keep a dark green, gray-green, warm white, soft skin-tone and restrained gold palette. Real natural photography, believable adult anatomy, natural skin and hair texture, quiet youth-film mood without childlike styling.

Hard visible text: make the exact word “Soran” clearly readable and integrated into the silver camera's front engraving, the ribbon edge near her face or the suit's gold-thread embroidery. Also repeat tiny, subtle “Soran” details in plaid lines, braid strands, ribbon weave, suit fibers, camera brushing, button engravings, braid intersection nodes, clothing stitches and plaid intersections. The repeated micro-details must remain physically integrated, not pasted logos. Negative prompt: frequent strong eye contact, ID-style pose, overly thin tight braids, modern large DSLR, oversized camera, fluorescent green, tiny bow, stiff collar, clear school building, clear background people, front hard flash, isolated face sharpening, 8K or HDR look, commercial skin retouching, plastic skin, pasted watermark, sticker logo, floating text, subtitles or unreadable “Soran”.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张 9:16 竖版自然时尚人像：一位明确成年的东亚女性置身户外校园感绿色场地。她留深棕色长发，编成松软双辫，配轻薄碎刘海，表情安静清澈。她穿成人学院风造型而非校服：白色尖领衬衫、墨绿色合身西装、同色大蝴蝶领结、灰绿色格纹长裙和金色纽扣。双手自然托住小型银色复古相机；身体略微侧转，短暂看向镜头附近或低头看相机，不要强烈直视。

背景是高度虚化的绿色场地，不要清晰教学楼或背景人物。右上方暖金侧逆光为发顶、碎发和双辫边缘勾勒柔和金色轮廓。使用 85mm 中长焦、浅景深、低饱和、低反差、轻柔焦和轻微光晕。色彩以墨绿、灰绿、暖白、柔肤色和少量金色为主。真实自然摄影，成年人体结构可信，皮肤与头发质感自然，具有安静青春电影感但不能幼态化。

硬性可见文字：将精确单词 “Soran” 清晰融入银色相机正面刻字、脸旁缎带边缘或西装金线刺绣中；并在格纹线条、双辫发丝、缎带织纹、西装纤维、相机拉丝、按钮刻纹、辫发交叉节点、衣料针脚和格纹交点中重复细小而隐约的 “Soran”。这些微观细节必须与材质物理融合，不能像贴上的 logo。负面提示词：频繁强直视、证件式站姿、过细过紧的双辫、现代大单反、相机过大、荧光绿、蝴蝶结过小、领口过硬、清晰教学楼、清晰背景人物、正面硬闪、单独锐化脸部、8K 或 HDR 过度效果、商业磨皮、塑料皮肤、外贴水印、贴纸 logo、漂浮文字、字幕或不可读的 “Soran”。

items.title: 简约黑白条纹无袖束腰中长裙
items.description: Garment-focused fashion prompt for a clearly adult woman wearing a crisp white cotton-poplin midi dress with narrow black stripes, flutter ruffles and a corset-inspired waist panel.
items.prompt: Create a clean, photorealistic fashion-focused image of a clearly adult woman wearing a crisp summer dress. The dress is sleeveless white cotton poplin with narrow black vertical stripes, a clean round neckline framed by small flutter ruffles at the shoulders, fitted princess seams through the bodice, a wide corset-inspired waist panel with neat black ribbon lacing at the front, and a softly flared calf-length skirt with deep controlled pleats. Preserve the cool graphic silhouette, light movement, tactile poplin weave, clean construction and refined adult styling. Keep the framing focused on the garment and natural adult proportions; do not invent a specific environment, brand, text or logo. High-detail realistic textile rendering, natural daylight, clean editorial fashion finish. Negative prompt: childlike subject, school-uniform implication, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed hands, plastic fabric, CGI, text, logo, watermark, cropped garment or muddy low-resolution detail.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张干净写实、以服装为重点的时尚图像：一位明确成年的女性穿着清爽夏季连衣裙。裙子为无袖白色棉质府绸，带细窄黑色竖条纹，圆领由肩部小飞飞边包围，紧身公主缝线勾勒上身，宽大的束腰灵感腰部裁片正面带整齐黑色丝带系带，裙摆柔和外扩并落至小腿，带深而规整的褶皱。保留清爽图形轮廓、轻盈动感、府绸织物触感、干净结构和成熟时尚造型。构图聚焦服装与自然成年比例，不凭空指定环境、品牌、文字或标志。高细节真实纺织物渲染、自然日光、干净的编辑时尚完成度。负面提示词：幼态主体、校服暗示、解剖变形、多余肢体、畸形手部、塑料面料、CGI、文字、标志、水印、裁切服装或浑浊低分辨率细节。

items.title: 纯欲CCD风金红凤凰神装成年女性肖像
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见成年女性的面部身份，生成一张结合 CCD 摄影感、金红神装与古代艺术装置背景的9:16华丽时装肖像。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source styling, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a high-detail 9:16 vertical ancient-inspired fashion portrait combining clear CCD photography texture with a glamorous, sacred art direction. The subject is an adult woman with a naturally refined oval face, softly pointed chin, slender brows and subtly phoenix-like eyes. Give her a captivating, confident expression without vulgarity. Use transparent natural makeup, bright healthy skin and realistic skin texture with dimensional light.

Decorate her black hair with abundant gold ornaments and metal tassels. Build an original ceremonial outfit from layered silk, satin, brocade gauze and gold-and-silver jewelry, dominated by gold and red with phoenix-feather elements. Keep the styling original, majestic and fashion-editorial. Her posture and movements are graceful and elegant, with a naturally relaxed presence.

Use backlighting to create refined rim light and glass-like transmission through the hair, metal tassels, phoenix feathers and fabric edges. Set the background as an abstract ancient art installation with an exquisite, gorgeous and solemn atmosphere. Render ultra-high detail in silk, satin, brocade, metal, feathers and skin, combining realistic live-action photography with an elevated ceremonial fashion mood.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的造型、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创作一张9:16竖幅的高细节古风时装肖像，结合清透 CCD 摄影质感与华丽神圣的艺术造型。人物是一位成年女性，拥有自然精致的椭圆脸、柔和尖下巴、细长眉和略带凤眼感的眼型，表情迷人而自信但不低俗；底妆清透，肤色明亮自然，保留真实皮肤质感和光照层次。

黑色头发上装饰繁复的金色饰物和金属流苏，服装由层叠的丝绸、缎面、锦缎纱和金银珠宝构成，主色为金色与红色，融入凤凰羽毛元素，呈现原创的神圣礼服造型。姿势和动作优美典雅，身体自然放松。

使用背光，让发丝、金属流苏、凤凰羽饰和衣料边缘产生精致轮廓光与玻璃般透光感；背景为抽象古代艺术装置，氛围华丽、精致而庄严。整体细节超高，真实表现丝缎、锦纱、金属、羽毛和皮肤的材质，兼具真人摄影质感与艺术化神装氛围。

items.title: 城市社论风大号排版叠加海报
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图替换海报主体，并按指定城市重建天际线和城市信息，保留大号城市字跨越人物前景的高级社论版式。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the subject and facial identity reference. Preserve its identity, facial features, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone and natural appearance. Recreate the reference as a premium editorial city poster for TOKYO. Rebuild the skyline, landmarks, architecture, bridge and urban photography specifically for TOKYO, and adapt all city-specific labels, coordinates, location information and captions accordingly.

Critical typography composition: the oversized “TOKYO” typography must be physically layered over the standing subject while preserving the reference subject's pose, body orientation, framing, scale and approximate position. Do not place all city text behind the subject. The huge letters must pass across the body, overlap the clothing and lower torso, and visibly obscure portions of the subject, while some portions remain behind the head and shoulders. Create a true three-layer collage: background city imagery → subject → foreground oversized city letters. Keep the subject recognizable through the gaps and around the typography; the letters should intersect the figure naturally rather than float beside it.

Let the oversized city typography extend almost across the full poster width and integrate grayscale city photography inside selected letterforms. Keep the type bold, geometric, heavy and editorial. Preserve the reference visual language and color code: warm cream or off-white background, deep-black oversized typography, grayscale city photography, red accent blocks, blue accent elements and yellow or gold accent elements. Do not invent a new palette for the city; keep similar saturation, contrast and proportions.

Preserve the structured editorial grid, thin lines, geometric circles, dots, rectangles, technical markings, small uppercase labels, coordinates and minimalist information blocks, adapting only the city content to TOKYO. Maintain the vertical poster composition, subject placement, typography scale, graphic layering, spacing, photographic treatment and premium magazine aesthetic. Add no unrelated text, logos, watermarks or brand marks beyond the city name and information labels.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为人物主体和面部身份依据，保留其身份、面部特征、发型、发色、肤色和自然外观。将参考图重新创作为一张高级社论城市海报，并将城市替换为 TOKYO。根据 TOKYO 重建周围的天际线、地标、建筑、桥梁和城市摄影，同时替换所有城市相关标签、坐标、位置信息和说明。

关键排版构图：超大号“TOKYO”文字必须物理层叠在站立人物之上，保持与参考图相同的姿势、身体方向、构图、比例和大致位置。不要把所有城市文字都放在人物后面。巨大的字母要穿过人物身体，与服装和下躯干重叠并明显遮挡部分区域；同时让部分字母保持在头部和肩膀后方。建立真实的三层拼贴关系：背景城市图像 → 人物主体 → 前景超大城市字母。人物必须通过字母间隙和周围区域保持可辨认，字母应自然交叉而不是漂浮在人物旁边。

超大城市字排版几乎横跨整张海报宽度，并在选定字母内部融入灰阶城市摄影。字形大胆、几何、厚重且具有社论感。保持参考图的视觉语言与配色：暖奶油白或灰白背景、深黑超大排版、灰阶城市摄影、红色装饰块、蓝色装饰元素和黄色或金色装饰元素；不要因城市名称改变调色，保持相近的饱和度、对比度和比例。

保留结构化社论网格、细线、几何圆圈、点、矩形、技术标记、小型大写标签、坐标和极简信息块，仅将城市内容适配为 TOKYO。保持垂直海报构图、人物位置、字级、图形分层、间距、摄影处理和高级杂志美感。除城市名与信息标签外，不添加无关文字、logo、水印或品牌标志。

items.title: 明星应援双竖框实验排版海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已整理为绑定统一人物参考的参数化明星应援海报模板。通过人物信息、主题口号、视觉概念和配色控制双竖框等尺寸构图与实验性排版。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the visible adult subject in both panels. Create a 9:16 vertical celebrity-support editorial poster for 参考人物. The English name is “FEATURED PERSON”, the birthday numbers are “01.01”, the identity line is “PERFORMER”, the English theme is “A QUIET CONSTELLATION”, and the Chinese slogan is “在光影之间持续发光”. The representative visual concept is silver sound waves crossing a midnight rehearsal room.

In the center, place two narrow vertical boxes side by side. They must be exactly the same width, height and proportion, sit on the same plane, and share equal visual importance; do not use front-back perspective or scale one panel larger. Together they occupy the main area of the poster.

The left box identifies the person: use a realistic close-up or upper-body portrait of the adult reference subject with real skin texture and clear eye contact. Integrate large cropped English and Chinese names, the birthday numbers, the identity line and a small amount of micro-information with the portrait silhouette in a high-end fashion-magazine layout.

The right box tells the emotional story: keep its outer frame exactly equal to the left box, rotate the internal horizontal portrait, scene and typography as one coherent 90-degree composition, and express silver sound waves crossing a midnight rehearsal room. Display “A QUIET CONSTELLATION” and “在光影之间持续发光” clearly; the Chinese slogan must be prominent and readable, not decorative microtype. Keep the same adult identity across both panels.

Let one narrative visual element, such as a silver sound wave, light path or film frame, pass through both boxes and extend into the background. Use deep navy as the primary color and silver white and electric cyan as restrained accents. Add a low-contrast oversized profile, eye or silhouette behind the panels without creating a second visual center. Keep information rich but hierarchically clear, with legible supplied text, controlled negative space and restrained editorial polish. No minors, identity drift, extra people, mismatched panel sizes, ordinary card collage, meaningless pseudo-text, repeated faces, excessive skin smoothing, cheap celebration decoration, unrelated symbols, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为两个竖框中可见成年人物的面部身份依据。创建一张用于 参考人物 的 9:16 竖版明星应援 Editorial 海报。英文名为“FEATURED PERSON”，生日数字为“01.01”，人物身份为“PERFORMER”，英文主题为“A QUIET CONSTELLATION”，中文口号为“在光影之间持续发光”。代表性视觉概念为 silver sound waves crossing a midnight rehearsal room。

画面中央并排放置两个狭长竖框。两个竖框必须拥有完全相同的宽度、高度和比例，处于同一平面并具有相同视觉重要性；不要使用前后透视，也不要把其中一个框放大。两个竖框共同占据海报主要区域。

左侧竖框负责人物识别：使用参考成年人物的写实近景或大半身肖像，保留真实皮肤纹理和清晰眼神。将大号裁切英文名、中文姓名、生日数字、人物身份和少量微型信息，与人物轮廓融合为高级时尚杂志排版。

右侧竖框负责叙事与情绪：外框尺寸与左框完全相同，将内部横向人物摄影、场景和字体排版作为一个整体旋转 90 度装入竖框，并通过 silver sound waves crossing a midnight rehearsal room 表达情绪。清晰展示“A QUIET CONSTELLATION”和“在光影之间持续发光”；中文口号必须醒目可读，不能缩成装饰小字。两个竖框中的成年人物保持同一身份。

使用一条具有叙事作用的视觉元素，例如银色声波、光线轨迹或胶片帧，贯穿两个竖框并延伸到背景。以 deep navy 为主色，以 silver white and electric cyan 作克制点缀。背景加入低对比度的放大侧脸、眼部或人物轮廓，但不要形成第二视觉中心。保持信息丰富而层级清晰，输入文字清晰可读，留白受控，整体具有克制的实验性编辑质感。不要未成年人、身份漂移、多余人物、竖框尺寸不一致、普通卡片拼贴、无意义伪文字、重复堆脸、过度磨皮、廉价庆典装饰、无关符号、logo 或水印。

items.title: 东亚女性现代大学走廊毕业人像
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见成年女性的面部身份，生成一张明亮现代大学走廊里的优雅毕业全身人像。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

An adult East Asian woman with fair skin and soft makeup, her light-brown hair styled in a neat low bun with a few loose strands framing the face. She stands in a bright modern university hallway wearing a black academic graduation gown with a vibrant red collar and hood, a white collared shirt underneath, black fitted shorts and white pointed-toe high-heel pumps.

She leans naturally against a white wall on her left, with the left arm resting on the wall and a silver ring visible on one finger. Her head tilts slightly downward as she looks toward the camera with a gentle, confident smile. Her right leg is raised and bent at the knee while her right hand holds the heel of the white shoe; her left foot remains planted on the polished gray marble floor. Keep natural human proportions, believable balance and an elegant but unforced graduation-portrait posture.

Soft natural sunlight streams through large glass windows behind her and casts gentle shadows. A tall gray concrete pillar stands to the left, with modern glass-and-metal architecture around her; blurred green trees and a white van are visible outside. Use a sharp full-body composition, professional high-detail photography, natural lighting and realistic skin texture at high resolution.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

一名成年东亚女性，皮肤白皙，妆容柔和，浅棕色头发扎成整洁的低发髻，几缕碎发修饰脸型。她站在明亮的现代大学走廊里，穿黑色学位服，配鲜红色领子和兜帽，内搭白色领衬衫、黑色修身短裤和白色尖头高跟鞋。

她自然地靠在左侧白墙上，左臂搁在墙上，手指可见银戒指；头部微微低垂，带温柔自信的微笑看向镜头。右腿抬起并在膝盖处弯曲，右手握住右脚白鞋的后跟，左脚稳稳踩在抛光灰色大理石地面上。保持真实人体比例、自然重心和不夸张的毕业肖像姿态。

柔和自然阳光从身后的大玻璃窗照入并投下柔和影子。左侧立有高大的灰色混凝土柱，周围为现代玻璃与金属建筑，窗外隐约可见绿树和一辆白色货车。全身构图，清晰对焦，优雅时尚的毕业人像，专业高细节摄影，自然光线，真实皮肤纹理和高分辨率。

items.title: 少女晨间刚睡醒手机自拍特写
items.description: 9:16 candid smartphone close-up of a clearly adult woman just after waking, with messy black hair, pale-pink pajamas and curtain-gap morning light across her face.
items.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 9:16 smartphone front-camera close-up of a clearly adult woman just after waking in the morning. She has cool fair skin and long black hair, wears light-pink pajamas, and lies on her side with her back toward the window while facing the camera lens. Most of the left side of her face is gently buried in a pillow. Her hair is extremely messy, her eyes relaxed, and her expression slightly confused and sleepy; keep the depiction clearly adult and non-sexual.

Let soft morning light enter only through gaps between pale-yellow curtains beside her, creating a strong but natural light-shadow pattern across her face. Preserve realistic skin texture, high-definition detail, candid smartphone sharpness and the feeling of a spontaneous real-life moment. No makeup-heavy studio look, text, logos, watermarks, distorted anatomy or CGI.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张 9:16 的写实智能手机前置镜头近景：一位明确成年的女性刚在早晨醒来。她肤色冷白，留黑色长发，穿浅粉色睡衣，侧卧时背对窗户、面向镜头；左脸大部分轻轻埋在枕头里。头发非常凌乱，双眼放松，表情带一点困惑和睡意；保持明确成年且非性化的呈现。

柔和晨光只从身旁淡黄色窗帘的缝隙透入，在脸上形成强烈但自然的明暗光影。保留真实皮肤纹理、高清细节、自然手机清晰度和现实生活中自发快照的感觉。不要浓重影棚妆容、文字、标志、水印、解剖变形或 CGI。

items.title: 都市周末清亮高光CCD夏日市集人像
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见成年女性的面部身份，生成一张现代明亮的户外手作市集周末生活人像。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

9:16 vertical bright daytime high-highlight CCD lifestyle photography with a sweet, relaxed, bright, natural and healing urban-weekend mood. An adult woman stands beside a wooden stall at an outdoor handmade market with a white tent, colorful pottery and bouquets. She holds a small paper bag in one hand and rests the other naturally at the side of her waist, smiling toward the camera. Frame from the thighs upward and keep the posture natural rather than like an advertising pose.

Give her a gentle delicate face, natural fine features and a light, slender but realistic figure. Dress her in a primrose-yellow fitted knitted vest with a low-waist plaid pleated skirt. Keep the yellow clothing fresh and bright, never dirty-looking.

Use sunny soft side light, bright diffuse reflection from the white tent and an extremely weak soft flash. Apply clear warm-white CCD color, bright midtones, distinct natural skin-tone layers and light grain. This is a modern, bright, clear summer lifestyle photo rather than retro market color grading; preserve believable materials and spatial relationships for the pottery, flowers, wood stall and tent.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

9:16竖幅，日间清亮高光CCD生活照风格，主题是甜美、松弛、明亮、自然而治愈的都市周末生活。一位成年女性站在户外手作市集的木质摊位旁，摊位有白色帐篷、彩色陶器和花束。她一只手拿着小纸袋，另一只手自然放在腰侧，微笑看向镜头。取景覆盖大腿和上半身，姿态自然，不像摆拍广告。

人物拥有温柔清秀的脸、自然细腻的面部特征和轻盈纤细但真实的身形。穿樱草黄色修身针织背心，搭配低腰格纹百褶裙；黄色服装要清爽明亮，不发脏。

使用晴天柔和侧光、白色帐篷形成的明亮漫反射，以及极弱的柔和闪光。画面采用高亮清晰的暖白CCD色彩、明亮中间调、清楚的肤色层次和轻微颗粒。整体不是复古市集调色，而是现代、明亮、清晰的夏日生活照；保留陶器、花束、木摊位和帐篷的真实材质与空间关系。

items.title: 冷灰针织衫黑色阔腿裤低机位人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已整理为绑定统一人物参考的成年时尚人像模板。保留浅冷灰罗纹针织上衣、黑色高腰阔腿裤、极低机位、蓝天积云、左上方逆光与真实手持摄影质感。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the single visible adult woman. Preserve her identity while following this low-angle fashion portrait's clothing, pose, composition, lighting and natural photographic texture.

Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photograph of a clearly adult woman standing above the low camera and looking down toward it. Frame from the upper thighs to just above the head; the torso and hips fill the lower frame while the face remains readable at a natural scale. Crop the hands and lower legs at the edges. Place her slightly right of center with broad blue-sky and cloud negative space around her.

Use a very low close viewpoint aimed steeply upward with a mild wide-angle perspective and natural handheld framing. Her torso leans subtly toward camera, shoulders relaxed and slightly uneven, arms hanging straight beside the body with hands outside the crop, hips angled slightly to one side, head tipped marginally forward and turned toward the lens. She wears a fitted light cool-gray ribbed long-sleeve cropped knit top with a plain round neckline and wrist-length sleeves, plus high-waisted black tailored wide-leg trousers with front pleats, side pockets and a visible waistband button. Keep the knit's slight horizontal tension and natural elbow and waist wrinkles.

The setting is open blue sky filled with pale white cumulus clouds; show no buildings, ground, props or horizon. Strong daylight backlight from upper-left behind the subject creates a locally bright cloud edge, soft upper-body rim light, slight flare and uneven exposure. Keep the face gently shadowed but readable and the lower outfit in deep shadow. Finish as a natural modern digital photograph with cool clean blues, restrained saturation, moderate contrast, softly rolled highlights except for the backlit cloud, faint lens flare, subtle fine grain, visible pores and restrained sharpening. No children, nudity, wardrobe malfunction, exaggerated anatomy, distorted hands, extra limbs, text, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为单一可见成年女性的面部身份依据。保留人物身份，同时遵循本次低机位时尚人像的服装、姿势、构图、光线与自然摄影质感。

创作一张写实的 9:16 竖版照片：一位明确成年的女性站在低位摄影机上方，自然低头看向镜头。取景从大腿上部到头顶上方，躯干和臀部占据画面下方，面部以自然比例保持清晰可辨，手部和小腿在画框边缘裁切。人物略偏画面右侧，周围保留广阔蓝天与云朵留白。

使用极低位近距离陡峭仰拍，轻微广角透视和自然手持构图。躯干微妙向镜头倾斜，肩膀放松且略微不平，双臂自然垂在身体两侧、手部位于画框外，臀部略向一侧倾斜，头部轻微向前并转向镜头。服装为合身浅冷灰色罗纹长袖短款针织上衣，平圆领，袖子延伸至手腕；下身为高腰黑色定制阔腿裤，带前褶、侧口袋和可见腰带纽扣。保留针织面料在肘部和腰部的轻微水平拉力与自然褶皱。

环境只有开阔的蓝天和浅白色积云，不出现建筑、地面、道具或地平线。主体左后上方的强日光逆光形成局部明亮云边、上半身柔和轮廓光、轻微光晕和不均匀曝光；面部处于柔和阴影中但保持清晰，下半身服装落入深影。整体为自然现代数码摄影，冷净蓝色、克制饱和度、中等对比度，除逆光云朵外高光柔和，带微弱镜头光晕、细颗粒、可见毛孔和克制锐化。不要儿童、裸露、衣物穿模或滑落、夸张解剖结构、手部变形、多余肢体、文字、logo 或水印。

items.title: 群门之后升起的纸雕王城海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已压缩为绑定统一人物参考的 9:16 东方立体剪纸艺术海报模板。保留巨大群门、云海王城、极小人物、纸层厚度、镂空纹样与象牙白/深雾蓝/浅金配色。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the small but visible adult woman. Preserve her identity while rendering her as a layered paper-cut illustration, not a photo. Create a 9:16 vertical contemporary oriental paper-cut art poster with a mythic scene: she passes through enormous nested paper arches and sees a sleeping royal sky-city rising from a sea of clouds beyond the gates.

The adult woman is calm, independent and elegant, seen from behind or three-quarter back at the lower center near the start of a long stairway. She must remain very small and never become a close-up. Give her long black half-up hair that extends into flowing hollow paper ribbons, small pale-gold flower and crescent ornaments, and an ivory-white and deep mist-blue layered paper dress with light-gold foil details. Show paper thickness, cut edges, fibers, hollow patterns and slight creases.

Build a strong doors-within-doors perspective. Giant foreground arches can exceed the frame; each successive arch decreases in scale and carries precise cloud, spiral, star, bird, wave and oriental geometric cutouts. The central stair and longitudinal passage lead to the distant final focus: a huge sacred royal city floating in the cloud sea, made of layered palaces, towers, pavilions and a main hall. Its edge is slightly translucent, bright sky light enters through the arches, and clouds surge beneath it. Include distant mountains and flying birds in the same paper-carved language.

Use multi-layer shadow-box staging, ivory white, deep mist blue, light gold and a small amount of cool gray. Keep the colors slightly saturated but clear, airy and high-end. Ivory frames the arches, stairs, cloud highlights and city; blue forms inner walls, distant mountains, shadows and dress layers; gold is limited to outlines and small cut details. Use bright high-altitude light, clear layered shadows, luminous mist and refined handmade paper texture. The epic scale comes from tiny character, huge rhythmic arches, deep perspective and the royal city rising dramatically. No minors, childish face, photorealism, ordinary anime, plastic 3D, resin, clay, felt, modern architecture, small city, oversized character, crowded scene, weak depth, missing cloud sea, gray muddy palette, chaotic paper layers, malformed hands, extra people, text, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为画面中虽小但可见的成年女性人物身份依据。保留人物身份，同时将她呈现为多层立体剪纸插画，而不是真人摄影。创建一张 9:16 竖版现代东方立体剪纸艺术海报：她穿过层层相套的巨大纸艺拱门，在群门尽头看见沉睡的皇家天空王城从云海中升起。

成年女性保持冷静、独立、优雅，从背面或半侧背面出现在画面下方中央、长阶起点附近。人物必须明显偏小，不得成为特写。黑色长发半披半挽，发丝延展为流动镂空纸带，佩戴浅金花枝与月牙发饰；穿象牙白与深雾蓝多层纸艺长裙，带少量浅金纸箔细节。清晰表现纸张厚度、裁切边缘、纤维、镂空纹样与轻微折痕。

构建强烈的“门中有门”透视。巨大前景拱门可以超出画框，每一重拱门尺度递减并带有云纹、旋纹、星点、飞鸟、波浪和东方几何镂空纹样。中央长阶与纵向通道通向远方最终视觉焦点：一座漂浮在云海深处的巨大神圣王城，由多层宫阙、塔楼、殿阁和主殿组成。王城边缘轻微透光，明亮天光穿过拱门，云海在下方翻涌；远山与飞鸟统一采用纸雕语言。

采用多层影盒式结构，主色为象牙白、深雾蓝和浅金，少量冷灰平衡。颜色比基础版略饱和但保持清透、明亮和高级：象牙白用于拱门、长阶、云层高光与王城主体；深雾蓝用于门内壁、远山、阴影层和服装内层；浅金只用于描边和细小镂空高光。使用明亮高空光、清晰层叠投影、发光雾气与精致手工纸张质感。通过极小人物、巨大有节奏的拱门、深远透视和震撼升起的王城呈现史诗尺度。不要未成年人、幼态脸、真人摄影、普通动漫、塑料 3D、树脂、黏土、毛毡、现代建筑、小王城、人物过大、场景拥挤、纵深不足、缺失云海、灰闷配色、混乱纸层、手部畸形、多余人物、文字、logo 或水印。

items.title: 咒术神秘电影感极致微距肖像
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见人物的面部身份，制作一张包含脸部墨字、粗35mm颗粒和神秘电影排版的极致微距肖像海报。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source pose, composition, lighting, body art, typography and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create an extreme macro geometric portrait poster with an occult dark cinematic mood. Fill the frame diagonally with the right side of the adult subject's face on the left side of the image, close enough to reveal pore and pupil texture. Between irregular messy black bangs covering the forehead, show one pupil in sharp focus. The adult subject stares firmly into the camera with a mysterious, cold gaze; slightly parted lips and stiff facial features create deep mystery-thriller tension. Exclude clothing from the frame so attention stays on skin, eye, hair and facial body art; a tiny silver stud earring may glint at the earlobe.

Paint handwritten deep-black Chinese body-art characters across the cheeks, bridge of the nose and above the jawline, with the cheek characters “司” and “我” clearly recognizable. The ink has a matte, smooth absorption quality that follows the unevenness and pores of the skin. Use irregular long dark bangs over the brows and part of the eye area, with a few messy strands across the forehead. Apply a cold pale base, clear eyeliner, shaded eye makeup and deep eye contours. Finish the lips with subdued nude rose-pink glossy color, moist highlights and vertical lip-line detail.

Use low-key directional light seeping from the front left: highlight the touched skin and ink while the hair on the right and the surroundings sink into deep black shadow. Build an occult dark-cinematic palette of cool gray-beige skin, jet-black hair and characters, and subtle burgundy-pink lips. Cover the image with dense coarse 35mm high-ISO analog film grain; let the moist lips provide the only soft organic glimmer among the grain.

Shoot a macro portrait at eye level with ultra-shallow depth of field, razor-sharp on the single pupil and the cheek characters “司” and “我”. Let the foreground bangs, dark background and grain fall softly out of focus. In the lower right, place a small Meta-operated Threads logo with “CHAse” above it in small white handwritten script like a signature. Overlay “*THE BLACK FILM” in slender white serif type at the top; arrange “CHASE”, the subtitle “Interstellar Traveler” and the widely spaced white main title “H U S H” over the center of the facial features; place “ONLY IN THREADS” in white sans-serif type at the bottom center. Keep the typography orderly without destroying the pupil or ink focus.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的姿势、构图、光线、身体艺术、文字排版和视觉风格。

创作一张暗黑神秘电影感的极致微距几何肖像海报。人物脸部右侧从画面左侧斜向充满整个画面，镜头近到可见毛孔和瞳孔纹理；凌乱遮额黑色碎发之间只清晰露出一侧瞳孔。成年人物以神秘阴冷的眼神牢牢凝视镜头，嘴唇微微分开，五官僵硬，形成神秘惊悚电影般的深层叙事。服装不入镜，视觉集中在皮肤、眼睛、头发与脸部艺术细节；耳垂可见一枚微小银色耳钉。

在脸颊、鼻梁和下颌线上方绘制深黑色手写汉字身体艺术，重点让脸颊上的“司”和“我”可辨识，墨水应以哑光平滑质感吸附于皮肤凹凸和毛孔。深黑色不规则长碎发覆盖眉毛与部分眼周，带少量凌乱发丝。妆容为冷峻苍白底妆、清晰眼线、阴影眼影和深邃眼部轮廓；嘴唇使用低调裸玫瑰粉光泽唇，带湿润感和纵向唇纹。

使用从人物左前方渗入的低照度定向光：光线突出触及的皮肤和墨字，右侧发丝与周围沉入深黑阴影，形成克制的明暗对照。整体色彩为冷灰米肤色、墨黑头发与汉字、细微勃艮第粉唇色的暗黑电影氛围。全画面覆盖非常密集粗糙的35mm高ISO模拟胶片颗粒；唇部湿润感在颗粒中形成唯一柔和闪光。

从人物眼高进行微距拍摄，极浅景深如刀刃般对焦在单侧瞳孔及脸颊“司”“我”上，眼前碎发和漆黑背景与颗粒一同柔和失焦。右下角放置小巧的 Meta 运营 Threads 标志，其上方以小号白色手写体写“CHAse”。上方叠加细长白色衬线字“*THE BLACK FILM”；人物五官中央整齐叠加“CHASE”和副标题“Interstellar Traveler”，以及拉宽字距的白色主标题“H U S H”；底部中央放置白色无衬线字“ONLY IN THREADS”。文字清晰有秩序，但不破坏瞳孔和墨字焦点。

items.title: 蓝调傍晚街头奶茶生活人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已整理为绑定统一人物参考的成年街头生活感人像模板。保留蓝调傍晚、石阶坐姿、浅蓝牛仔外套、近景放大奶茶杯、黑色吸管和店铺暖光。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the only visible adult woman. Preserve her identity while following this blue-hour Korean-street lifestyle styling, pose, composition, lighting and mobile-snapshot texture.

Create a 9:16 vertical close handheld-phone snapshot on street stone steps at blue hour. A clearly adult East Asian woman has wind-mussed black medium-length hair with airy bangs, rose dewy makeup, a little fine glitter under the eyes, peach-pink blush, hydrated nude-pink lips and visible natural pores. She wears a light-blue denim jacket over a white inner top, a dark-gray pleated short skirt and a cream-white canvas shoulder bag.

She sits on the steps and leans slightly forward, holding a cup of pearl milk tea toward the camera. The cup is significantly enlarged because it is close to the lens; she gently bites a black straw and looks up toward camera with a playful but quiet friendly expression. Keep the cup, straw, face and denim edges readable, with natural hands and one coherent adult subject.

Use a slight wide-angle perspective. The background is an evening city street with warm shop lights, railings and blurred car lights. Shop light illuminates the milk-tea cup, cheeks and jacket edges while the background falls rapidly out of focus. Keep authentic phone-camera grain and candid snapshot texture. No children, extra people, distorted hands, warped cup, unreadable text, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为唯一可见成年女性的面部身份依据。保留人物身份，同时遵循本次蓝调傍晚韩系街头生活造型、姿势、构图、光线与手机抓拍质感。

创作一张 9:16 竖版手机近距离抓拍，场景为蓝调傍晚的街边石阶。一位明确成年的东亚女性拥有被风吹乱的黑色中长发和空气刘海，妆容为玫瑰水光妆、眼下少量细闪、桃粉腮红和水润裸粉唇，皮肤保留毛孔与自然细节。她穿浅蓝色牛仔外套、白色内搭、深灰色百褶短裙，肩背米白色帆布袋。

人物坐在石阶上，身体微微前倾，将一杯珍珠奶茶举到镜头前方。杯子因贴近镜头而明显放大；她轻轻咬住黑色吸管并抬眼看向镜头，表情调皮但安静亲切。保持奶茶杯、吸管、脸颊和牛仔外套边缘清晰，手部自然，画面只有一个连贯的成年主人物。

使用轻微广角透视。背景为傍晚城市街道、店铺暖光、栏杆和虚化车灯；店铺灯光照亮奶茶杯、脸颊与牛仔外套边缘，背景快速散焦。保留真实手机颗粒和随手拍质感。不要儿童、多余人物、手部变形、奶茶杯变形、乱码文字、logo 或水印。

items.title: 古风仙侠夜景女主写真精修海报
items.description: 9:16 refined fantasy character poster of a clearly adult Oriental woman holding a small glass lantern before layered ancient towers and illuminated stairs.
items.prompt:
Create a bright, refined 9:16 vertical ancient-style Xianxia fantasy character poster featuring one clearly adult Oriental woman, visual age about 20–28. Give her a soft small oval face, clear round almond eyes with slender outer tails, gentle shallow smile, luminous fair skin and elegant peach-pink dewy makeup with natural highlights on nose, under-eyes, cheekbones and lips. The mood is dreamy, agile, noble and luminous, not dark or dirty.

Style her abundant smooth black hair half-down and half-tied, with a fluffy polished crown. Add an elaborate ancient silver-white hair crown with pearl tassels, lavender gemstones, crystal flowers and fine chain pendants, plus long pearl-and-lavender crystal drop earrings. Dress her in a high-waisted chest-level fantasy skirt with a dense pearl-chain overlay, misty lavender, pearl white and silver-white palette, cold-silver details, lavender crystals, multi-layer light gauze, translucent outer gauze, fine silver embroidery and crystal drops. Keep the fabrics light, elegant and physically believable, with soft highlights and micro-shimmer.

Place her before ascending layered glass-lantern stairs in a slight front three-quarter view, body gently turned and head turned toward camera with a soft smile. One hand holds a small transparent glass lantern with metal handle and bright soft warm-white candlelight; the other hand drops naturally or lightly supports the skirt. Use an upper-body close composition focused on face, makeup, crown, upper clothing and lantern interaction; avoid exaggerated posing and motion blur.

Background: ancient towers, long illuminated stairs, golden-roofed pavilions, eaves, high platforms and layered seas of lights at night. Warm-white lanterns and fine light points line the stairs, with a few lavender flowering trees and soft purple-gold bokeh. Keep depth readable rather than excessively blurred. Use deep-blue sky, warm lamp light plus soft face fill, fine highlights on jewelry, pearl chains, lantern and embroidery, and a slight rim light on hair and shoulders. Bright, clean, dreamy high-precision realism, refined character-poster finish. No text, logos, watermarks, CGI look, dirty gray grading, plastic skin, deformed hands, extra fingers or obvious motion blur.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张明亮精致的 9:16 竖版古风仙侠幻想角色海报，主体是一位明确成年的东方女性，视觉年龄约 20–28 岁。她有柔和小鹅蛋脸、清亮圆润杏眼和细长眼尾、温柔浅笑、白皙有光泽的皮肤，以及桃粉水光妆；鼻尖、眼下、颧骨和唇峰有自然高光。整体气质梦幻、灵动、贵气、明媚，不暗沉或脏灰。

黑色顺滑长发半披半挽，发量丰盈，发顶蓬松精致。佩戴重工古风银白发冠，包含珍珠流苏、淡紫宝石、水晶花饰和细链垂饰，搭配长坠式珍珠与淡紫晶石耳环。穿齐胸高腰幻想裙和细密珠链罩层，采用柔雾淡紫、珍珠白和银白色，辅以冷银、淡紫晶石、多层轻纱、半透明外纱、细银线刺绣和水晶垂坠。面料轻盈优雅、物理可信，具有柔和高光和微闪质感。

人物站在层层向上的琉璃灯阶前，略微正面侧身，头部转向镜头，带浅浅微笑。一只手提透明灯罩配金属提柄的小琉璃灯，内部暖白烛光明亮柔和；另一只手自然垂落或轻扶裙侧。采用大半身近景，重点表现脸部、妆容、发冠、上身服装和灯笼互动；动作不要夸张，无明显动态拖影。

背景为古风楼台、长阶、金顶楼阁、飞檐、高台和层叠灯海。灯阶两侧布满暖白灯笼和细碎光点，夹杂少量淡紫花树与柔和紫金散景。保留纵深，不要过度虚化。使用深蓝夜空、暖灯光和柔和面部补光，头饰、珠宝、珠链、琉璃灯和刺绣产生细碎高光，轻微侧逆光勾勒发丝和肩部轮廓。整体明亮、通透、梦幻、高精度写实，达到精修角色海报质感。不要文字、标志、水印、CGI 感、脏灰调色、塑料皮肤、畸形手、多余手指或明显动态模糊。

items.title: 极简时尚竖纹玻璃人像广告
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见人物，透过竖向瓦楞玻璃呈现一张4:5极简时尚广告海报。人物、服装、背景、配色和中心标题均可替换。
items.prompt:
Create a 4:5 vertical minimalist fashion advertisement poster. Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the subject's composition, pose, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference. Show an adult woman with a refined editorial presence wearing a sculptural black tailored dress, viewed through a vertical corrugated-glass panel, with a pale concrete studio with soft shadows visible behind the figure. Let the glass create semi-obscured facial features and elongated distortion lines while keeping the silhouette, clothing structure and pose recognizable.

Use charcoal, pearl gray and muted silver, soft directional lighting, an elegant editorial mood, centered composition, subtle depth, smooth gradients and polished commercial styling. Place the title “FORM” in refined serif typography across the center, keeping it clear without covering key facial or clothing details. Keep the overall treatment sophisticated, restrained and clean. Do not add extra logos, watermarks, brand names or unintended text.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张4:5纵向极简主义时尚广告海报。以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留人物的构图、姿势、光线和视觉风格。人物：an adult woman with a refined editorial presence，穿着 a sculptural black tailored dress；透过一块垂直瓦楞玻璃板观看，玻璃产生半遮掩的面部特征和拉长的畸变线条，人物身后可见 a pale concrete studio with soft shadows。

使用 charcoal, pearl gray and muted silver，配合柔和定向照明、优雅社论氛围、居中构图、微妙景深、平滑渐变和精致商业造型。玻璃纹理应成为构图的一部分，但仍让人物轮廓、服装结构和姿态可辨。画面中心以精致的衬线字体显示标题“FORM”，文字清晰但不要遮盖人物的关键面部或服装细节。整体高级、克制、干净，不要额外logo、水印、品牌名或多余文字。

items.title: 街头韩系露肩黑裙女性
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见成年女性的面部身份，生成一张自然日光下的城市街头韩系穿搭全身写真。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

An adult East Asian Korean woman in her twenties with shoulder-length black hair and straight bangs, a soft neutral expression, and a natural posture leaning against a gray concrete ledge or low step on a city sidewalk. She wears a black off-the-shoulder mini dress with thin spaghetti straps, a structured bodice with two gold buttons on the front, and a flared A-line skirt. Pair it with white crew socks, clean white sneakers and a delicate gold necklace with a small pendant.

Use natural daylight and a sharp full-body composition at eye level, with the subject visible from head to toe and in clear focus. Set the urban street background around a cafe storefront, with large glass windows reflecting the city and pink flowers in planters beside her. Keep natural human proportions, realistic clothing texture and a relaxed street-lifestyle atmosphere without excessive posing or commercial advertising polish.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

一位二十多岁的成年东亚韩国女性，齐肩黑发配齐刘海，表情柔和中性，身体自然地靠在城市人行道的灰色混凝土台阶或矮墙上。她穿黑色露肩迷你连衣裙，带细吊带、结构化胸衣、正面两个金色纽扣和蓬松的A字裙摆；搭配白色圆袜、干净白色运动鞋和带小吊坠的精致金项链。

使用自然日光和清晰的全身构图，平视相机角度，人物从头到脚完整入镜并保持清晰聚焦。背景是城市街道与咖啡馆店面，大玻璃窗反射周围城市景象，人物旁边的花盆里有粉红色花朵。保持自然人体比例、真实服装纹理和轻松的街头生活氛围，不要过度摆拍或商业广告感。

items.title: 冬日公园雪地护耳帽生活人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已整理为绑定统一人物参考的成年女性冬日手机人像模板。保留浅灰蓬松羽绒服、毛绒护耳帽、发丝雪点、公园滑梯和雪地漫反射光。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the only visible adult woman. Preserve her identity while following this winter mobile-photography styling, expression, environment and lighting.

Create a realistic mobile photograph of a clearly adult East Asian woman with a rounded oval face, black medium-long straight hair, warm ivory skin, faint pink on the nose tip and cheeks, large round-almond eyes and fine natural skin texture. She wears a light-gray loose fluffy down jacket and a plush earflap hat covering the crown and ears. A light breeze lifts loose hair strands, and tiny snow dots rest on the hair and jacket.

Set the scene outdoors in a snowy winter park with a playground slide. Use soft diffused light and bright snow bounce to illuminate the face evenly; keep the shadowed environment from darkening the skin. Give her a cute, playful social-photo expression and natural pose without making her childlike. Keep one woman only, with believable anatomy, real fabric, snow and hair texture. Let the background be about 10 percent out of focus while the face remains clear. No children, extra people, sexualized styling, plastic skin, cartoon treatment, distorted hands, text, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为唯一可见成年女性的面部身份依据。保留人物身份，同时遵循本次冬日手机摄影造型、表情、环境与光线。

创作一张真实手机摄影照片：一位明确成年的东亚女性拥有圆润鹅蛋脸、黑色中长直发、明亮暖象牙肤色、鼻尖和脸颊淡淡粉色、圆润杏仁形大眼睛与细腻自然的皮肤纹理。她穿浅灰色宽松蓬松羽绒服，戴覆盖头顶和双耳的毛绒护耳帽。微风吹起碎发，发丝和羽绒服上落有细小雪点。

场景为冬日户外公园雪地，背景可见滑梯。使用柔和散光和雪地漫反射均匀照亮面部，暗部环境不要压暗肤色。人物呈现可爱、俏皮的社交媒体拍照表情与自然姿势，但不要幼态化。保持单一女性、可信解剖结构以及真实布料、雪和发丝质感。背景约 10% 程度虚焦，面部保持清晰。不要儿童、多余人物、性化造型、塑料皮肤、卡通处理、手部变形、文字、logo 或水印。

items.title: 盛夏屋顶日光下的成年日本女性人像快照
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见成年女性的面部身份，生成一张在学校、大学或公共设施屋顶通道休息时由朋友随手拍摄的3:4夏日人像快照。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

A photorealistic 3:4 vertical image on a sunny midsummer day: an adult Japanese woman over 20 sits on the floor against a light cream wall on a school, university or public-facility rooftop walkway or outdoor terrace, as if casually photographed by a friend while resting. Shoot from directly in front at a slightly low close-to-medium distance. Center the subject and include nearly the full body from the top of the head to the shoes. Her knees are bent, legs naturally open to either side and feet loosely crossed in front; hands rest near the ankles and shins with fingertips lightly overlapping. Keep the posture natural rather than groomed, with a quiet closed-mouth smile and a calm, slightly shy feeling.

She has a small oval face, light Korean-style makeup, naturally hydrated skin, black-to-dark-brown long straight hair and slightly heavy straight bangs. Add small pastel hair clips in light blue, light pink and white on both sides. She wears a slightly oversized thin white long-sleeved shirt with sleeves casually rolled near the elbows; tie the front hem lightly near the abdomen over a simple white inner layer. Add layered thin silver necklaces with small pendants and a small bead bracelet. Wear a black-to-deep-navy above-knee finely pleated skirt, expressed as adult campus-inspired fashion. Keep nails short and natural in transparent pink, cream-pink or nude-beige with only slight gloss. Add dark-gray ribbed socks and lightly used white-and-red volleyball-style indoor shoes: white canvas upper, red toe and sole, broad rubber band over the instep, no laces, brand marks, platform or excessive decoration.

Lighting: bright hard natural midsummer light pouring from above, illuminating the face, white shirt, legs and floor with clear contrast. Cast the person's head-and-shoulder shadow on the cream wall, plus distinct diagonal vertical and horizontal railing shadows across the wall and floor. This is sharp daytime-to-afternoon light, not orange sunset light. Let the white shirt glow without complete overexposure, preserving wrinkles and fabric texture.

Keep the background simple with a pale cream wall and a thin gray or metallic baseboard at the floor-wall junction. On the floor to the subject's right, place one 500 ml tea-drink plastic bottle with transparent body, amber liquid, yellow-green cap and a fictional green-toned label; use no real brand or product name. Strong sun hits the bottle and casts a short clear floor shadow.

The image should feel like an everyday smartphone or high-performance compact-camera snapshot by a friend. Preserve realistic skin, individual hair, shirt wrinkles, pleats, sock knit, and canvas-and-rubber wear, with extremely slight digital noise and grain. Do not make it a studio, advertisement or overly perfect magazine image. Avoid excessive HDR, CGI, illustration, oversharpening or AI-perfect facial tidiness.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

照片级真实的3:4竖幅图像：盛夏晴朗白天，学校、大学或公共设施的屋顶通道或室外露台上，一位20岁以上的成年日本女性背靠浅奶油色墙壁坐在地板上，像休息时被朋友自然拍下。相机从正前方略低位置近中距离拍摄，人物居中，几乎从头顶到鞋子全身入镜。双膝弯曲，双腿自然向左右分开，脚在身前松弛交叉；双手放在脚踝至小腿附近，指尖轻轻叠合。姿势自然、不像刻意摆拍，面带闭口浅笑，略带羞涩而平静。

人物有小巧椭圆脸、轻薄韩系淡妆、自然水润肌肤、黑色至深棕色长直发和略厚直刘海。两侧佩戴浅蓝、浅粉、白色等小巧粉彩发夹。穿略宽松的白色薄款长袖衬衫，袖口随意卷到肘部，前摆在腹部轻轻打结，露出简约白色内搭；佩戴细银色叠戴项链、小吊坠和小珠手链。下装是黑色至深海军蓝的膝上细褶短裙，体现成年女性的制服风/校园风时尚。指甲短而自然，透明粉、奶油粉或裸米色，只有轻微光泽。穿深灰罗纹袜和略带日常使用痕迹的白红排球鞋型室内鞋：白色帆布鞋面、红色鞋尖与鞋底、脚背宽橡胶带，无鞋带、无品牌标志、无厚底或夸张装饰。

光线：盛夏高处倾泻的明亮硬质自然光，照亮脸部、白衬衫、腿部和地板，光影对比鲜明。奶油墙面上出现头部至肩部的影子，墙壁和地板上还有扶手或栏杆形成的清晰斜向纵横投影。不是夕阳橙色，而是白天至午后的刺眼光线；白衬衫明亮但保留褶皱与布料纹理，避免完全过曝。

背景保持简洁：浅奶油素墙、地面交界的细灰色或金属色踢脚线。人物右侧地面放一瓶约500毫升茶饮塑料瓶，透明瓶身内为琥珀色液体，黄绿色瓶盖和绿色虚构标签，不使用真实品牌名；瓶子被阳光照亮并在地面投下短而清晰的影子。

整体像朋友用智能手机或高性能小型数码相机随手拍摄的日常快照，保留皮肤、发丝、衬衫褶皱、裙褶、袜子编织、帆布和橡胶磨损的真实细节，加入极轻微数字噪点和颗粒。不要棚拍、广告或杂志式完美效果，不要过度HDR、CG感、插画感、过度锐化或AI般整齐的脸。

items.title: 写实成年女性运动人像剪贴簿海报模板
items.description: 9:16全身运动人像海报模板：成年女性运动者在真实训练环境中完成明确动作，以白色贴纸边缘、撕纸照片、手写笔记和单一强调色构成编辑风格拼贴。
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 full-body editorial sports portrait poster for track running, using the following variables: subject a clearly adult woman in her late twenties with a focused, energetic presence, outfit a cobalt-blue performance running top, black running shorts, and white running shoes, main action accelerating through a track curve with one arm driving forward, environment an outdoor stadium track at early morning, gear a simple stopwatch and lane markers, large headline “RUN / BREATHE”, clean subtitle “CONTROL THE NEXT STEP”, and graphic accent color cobalt blue.

Make a clearly adult woman in her late twenties with a focused, energetic presence the dominant visual, occupying about 75-85% of the poster height with the full body and shoes visible. Show accelerating through a track curve with one arm driving forward as a real sport-specific movement with natural body proportions, believable muscle tone, realistic skin and hair, accurate balance, and physically credible hands, equipment, and body mechanics. Use a cobalt-blue performance running top, black running shorts, and white running shoes without invented logos or readable brand marks.

Place the athlete in an outdoor stadium track at early morning with natural or realistic training light. Include a simple stopwatch and lane markers and a few sport-specific visual notes about movement, alignment, route, rhythm, breathing, strength, or control. Cut the full person out with a clearly visible irregular white sticker or paper border. Keep the portrait primary and the scrapbook collage secondary.

Use a clean off-white textured-paper background with visible fibers, a few torn-paper photo fragments, tape, handwritten-style note marks, arrows, and small track running details. Use cobalt blue only for selected typography, arrows, underlines, tape, and small graphic accents. Add one large handwritten headline “RUN / BREATHE” and one clean subtitle “CONTROL THE NEXT STEP”; render these accurately and legibly, with no extra readable text, logos, watermarks, or random characters. The final style is realistic sports photography plus workout identity plus editorial scrapbook poster. Avoid a stiff model pose, studio plastic skin, distorted anatomy, deformed hands or shoes, clutter, or generic non-sport scenery.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张关于 track running 的9:16全身编辑风格运动人像海报，使用以下变量：主体 a clearly adult woman in her late twenties with a focused, energetic presence、服装 a cobalt-blue performance running top, black running shorts, and white running shoes、主要动作 accelerating through a track curve with one arm driving forward、环境 an outdoor stadium track at early morning、装备 a simple stopwatch and lane markers、大型手写标题“RUN / BREATHE”、简洁副标题“CONTROL THE NEXT STEP”和图形强调色 cobalt blue。

让 a clearly adult woman in her late twenties with a focused, energetic presence 成为视觉核心，占海报高度约75-85%，完整呈现全身和鞋子。将 accelerating through a track curve with one arm driving forward 表现为真实的特定运动动作，使用自然身体比例、可信肌肉线条、真实皮肤与头发、准确重心和平衡，以及符合物理规律的手部、装备和身体力学。使用 a cobalt-blue performance running top, black running shorts, and white running shoes，不添加虚构 Logo 或可读品牌标记。

让运动者处于 an outdoor stadium track at early morning 中，使用自然或写实的训练光线。加入 a simple stopwatch and lane markers，以及少量关于动作、对齐、路线、节奏、呼吸、力量或控制的运动笔记。将完整人物抠出，并带清晰可见的不规则白色贴纸或纸张边缘。保持人像为主，剪贴簿拼贴为辅。

使用带可见纸张纤维的干净米白色纹理纸背景，加入少量撕纸照片碎片、胶带、手写风格笔记标记、箭头和 track running 相关细节。仅在指定排版、箭头、下划线、胶带和小型图形点缀上使用 cobalt blue。添加一个大型手写标题“RUN / BREATHE”和一个简洁副标题“CONTROL THE NEXT STEP”；准确清晰地渲染这两行文字，不添加其他可读文字、Logo、水印或随机字符。最终风格是写实运动摄影、训练身份和编辑风格剪贴簿海报的结合。避免僵硬模特姿势、棚拍塑料皮肤、解剖结构变形、手部或鞋子变形、杂乱和无关的通用场景。

items.title: 古风写实韩系淡颜美女雨窗摄影
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见成年女性的面部身份，生成一张古风汉服、冷雨窗景与温暖肤色对比的写实人像摄影。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

3:4 vertical ancient-style realistic portrait photography of a clearly adult Korean woman in her 20s. She has refined Korean-inspired natural makeup, an oval face, a classical black updo, light-purple floral ornaments, silver dangling hairpins and dewy natural makeup. She sits in a classical pavilion or a window-side corridor, gently gathering one wide sleeve close to her face with both hands. Her body is slightly turned and she looks directly at the camera with a quiet, thoughtful expression that feels intimate but subtle.

Dress her in mist-purple and light-lavender Hanfu with lightweight layered long sleeves and extensive delicate floral embroidery. The window on the left is covered with clear raindrops; outside is a softly blurred courtyard with greenery and stone scenery. Cold gray-blue rainy-day daylight enters from the window while the subject's skin remains warm, creating a delicate cool-warm contrast. Use shallow depth of field while preserving clear details in the face, eyes, hair ornaments, sleeve edges and embroidery, with the background still recognizable as a rainy courtyard. Keep the image delicate, realistic and restrained. No text, collage or split panels.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

3:4竖幅，古风写实人像摄影。一位明确成年的20多岁韩国女性，拥有精致韩系淡颜、鹅蛋脸、黑色古典盘发、淡紫色花饰和银色垂坠发簪，妆容水润自然。人物坐在古典亭台或临窗回廊，双手轻轻拢住一侧宽袖并靠近脸部，身体微侧，直视镜头，表情安静而略带若有所思，亲密但含蓄。

服装为雾紫色与浅薰衣草色汉服，带轻薄层叠长袖和大面积细腻花卉刺绣。左侧窗面布满清晰雨滴，窗外是柔和虚化的庭院、绿植和石景。冷灰蓝色雨天自然光从窗边照入，同时让人物肤色保持温暖，形成细腻的冷暖对比。使用浅景深，保留面部、眼神、发饰、袖口与刺绣细节，背景仍可辨识为雨中庭院。整体细腻、真实、克制，不要文字，不要拼图或拼贴。

items.title: 复古上海旗袍美女剧院自拍
items.description: Photorealistic 3:4 smartphone-video still of an adult East Asian woman in a flowered gray-green qipao greeting the camera inside a nostalgic Chinese theater lobby.
items.prompt:
Create a highly photorealistic 3:4 vertical smartphone-video still of a clearly adult East Asian woman standing close to the camera at an elegant retro Chinese theater entrance. Frame from the top of her hair to slightly below the waist, with her face in the upper-left center. She has a softly oval face, luminous fair skin with warm undertones, dark-brown almond eyes, softly arched brows, a delicate straight nose and rose-pink lips. Use elegant feminine makeup: thin winged liner, separated lashes, champagne eyeshadow, peach blush and glossy coral-pink lipstick. She looks directly into camera with a warm poised expression and relaxed small smile.

Style her glossy dark-brown hair in a polished 1930s–1940s Shanghai-inspired coiffure: center part, two sculpted victory rolls above the temples, symmetrical low rolled buns around ears and nape, small pearl clips and compact pale-lilac, powder-blue and ivory flowers. Keep visible individual strands and realistic texture.

Dress her in a sleeveless gray-green silk qipao with high mandarin collar, fitted bodice, asymmetrical front closure, dark piping and small frog closures. Print large painterly peonies and hydrangeas in dusty pink, cream, muted blue, lavender and sage. Add pearl drop earrings, two layered strands of small white pearls and a pale-jade bangle. Keep the figure refined, believable and naturally proportioned.

Pose precisely: one arm extends forward and slightly down outside the lower-left frame as if holding the phone. The other elbow is raised before the upper chest; the open relaxed hand sits between chin and collarbone, palm diagonal to camera, all five fingers visible and naturally separated, fingertips toward the left side of her face. Capture a gentle side-to-side greeting wave with soft directional blur on hand and fingertips while face, hair and qipao remain sharp; never cover eyes, nose or mouth. Relaxed shoulders, slight three-quarter torso turn.

Use an eye-level close front-facing smartphone camera about an arm's length away, with mild wide-angle perspective that does not distort the face. Behind her: nostalgic Chinese cabaret or vintage theater lobby, crimson velvet curtains, warm cream walls, oversized star-shaped marquee forms with round glowing tungsten bulbs, small gold starbursts and hints of lacquered dark wood. Keep any signage abstract and unreadable. Warm amber marquee light rims her hair and curtains; gentle phone fill brightens her face and gives pearly highlights to skin, eyes, jewelry and silk. Shallow depth, slightly soft phone sharpness, restrained smoothing, subtle digital noise and compression texture. No captions, readable text, interface icons, watermark, plastic skin, doll face, exaggerated eyes, deformed hands or extra fingers.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张高度写实的 3:4 竖版智能手机视频定格画面：一位明确成年的东亚女性靠近镜头，站在优雅的复古中式剧院入口。构图从发顶拍到腰部稍下方，脸位于画面左上中心。她有柔和鹅蛋脸、带暖色调的透亮白皙皮肤、深褐色杏眼、柔和拱眉、精致直鼻和玫瑰粉唇。妆容优雅：细眼线、根根分明的睫毛、香槟眼影、桃色腮红和亮泽珊瑚粉口红。她直视镜头，表情温暖从容，带放松微笑。

将深棕色亮泽长发设计成 1930–40 年代老上海风格：中分，太阳穴上方两个立体大卷，耳朵和颈后对称低卷发髻，搭配小珍珠发夹及淡紫、粉蓝、象牙色小花。保留根根发丝和真实质感。

穿无袖灰绿色丝绸旗袍，高立领、合身衣身、不对称前襟、深色滚边和小盘扣。印大朵绘画感牡丹与绣球花，色彩为灰粉、奶油、柔和蓝、薰衣草和鼠尾草绿。佩戴珍珠坠耳环、两串层叠白珍珠和淡绿色玉镯。身材比例自然可信，整体保持优雅。

精确还原动作：一只手臂向前并略向下伸出画面左下方之外，仿佛手持手机；另一侧手肘抬到上胸前，张开而放松的手位于下巴与锁骨之间，掌心斜向镜头，五指清晰、自然分开，指尖朝向脸部左侧。捕捉轻柔左右招手，手和指尖有柔和方向性运动模糊，脸部、头发和旗袍保持清晰；手不能遮住眼睛、鼻子或嘴巴。肩膀放松，躯干略转四分之三。

使用眼平高度、约一臂距离的正面手机前置镜头，轻微广角但不变形。背景为怀旧中式歌舞厅或老剧院大堂：深红天鹅绒幕布、暖奶油墙面、由圆形钨丝灯泡勾勒的巨大星形跑马灯造型、金色星芒装饰和少量深色漆木地板。标牌保持抽象且不可辨认。暖琥珀灯勾亮卷发和幕布边缘，柔和手机正面光照亮脸部，并在皮肤、眼睛、珠宝和丝绸上形成珍珠般高光。浅景深、略柔和的手机清晰度、克制磨皮、细微数字噪点和压缩纹理。不要字幕、可读文字、界面图标、水印、塑料皮肤、洋娃娃脸、夸张眼睛、畸形手或多余手指。

items.title: 薄荷绿与淡紫灰档案记录封面风格
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定档案人像主体，制作4:5全出血现场记录封面。固定淡紫灰底与薄荷绿文字系统，并提供学科、字标、记录堆栈、符号和手持物件变量。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source composition, clothing, pose, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a 4:5 vertical, full-bleed field-record cover poster. Use one desaturated gray-mauve value #6E6672 across the background, appearing as a plain studio wall or dusk sky with no texture and no gradient banding. The only saturated color anywhere is spring mint #7FE68D; all other colors come only from natural skin and cloth. Wardrobe may use muted navy, olive, rust, charcoal or silver, but nothing that competes with the mint.

Frame the adult subject chest-up, slightly off-center, in three-quarter or near-profile view with the eyes lifted away from the lens. The subject holds a ribbon microphone near the face and studies it by reading, listening or inspecting; never present it to camera. Use cool ambient fill with a hard warm side key, retaining natural skin gloss, sweat and pores with specular highlights; never flatten the skin with retouching. Allow at most one soft out-of-focus background clue.

Place the wordmark “RESONANCE” at the top: ultra-condensed heavy sans-serif capitals in mint, spanning the full width and cropped by both frame edges. The head must always eclipse 2–3 letters, so the wordmark is never fully legible while remaining orthographically recognizable. Stack 3–4 lines of mint condensed capitals “TAPE 031 ROOM TONE 18 20 ARCHIVE B” at mid-height on the left, one record item per line with generous leading, no slogans and no punctuation. Place one small mint glyph “four-point star” beneath the stack. Add 4–6 lines of tiny mint capitals at the bottom containing location, recordist, format, date and notes. Every text string must read like an index, time, coordinate or format record, never marketing copy.

Use field recording as the discipline context; the held object should name the discipline without a caption. Treat occlusion of the wordmark as the signature. Keep one background value and one accent color, with no second saturated color. Add slight collage feel, screen-print grain and authentic archive-cover tactility. Do not add high-end polish, complex scenes, extra decoration, logos, watermarks or other brands.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的构图、服装、姿势、光线和视觉风格。

制作一张4:5纵向、全出血的“现场记录封面”海报。背景是单一去饱和灰紫色 #6E6672，可表现为纯色摄影棚墙面或黄昏天空；无纹理、无渐变条纹。全图唯一饱和色为春意薄荷绿 #7FE68D，其他颜色仅来自自然皮肤和布料。服装使用不会与薄荷绿竞争的静谧蓝、橄榄绿、铁锈红、木炭黑或银色。

人物采用胸部以上取景，略微偏离中心，三分之四侧脸或近侧面，眼睛向上并远离镜头。人物在脸部附近拿起 a ribbon microphone 并认真研究它，可以是阅读、倾听或检查，但绝不向相机展示。使用凉爽环境填充光与侧面硬暖主光，保留皮肤自然光泽、汗水和毛孔，皮肤上有镜面高光，绝不磨皮调平；背景最多出现一个柔和失焦的线索。

顶部放置字标“RESONANCE”：极细长的超粗无衬线全大写薄荷绿字，横跨全宽并被两侧边缘裁切；人物头部必须遮挡其中2–3个字母，使字标从不完全清晰，但仍可辨认。左侧中部堆叠3–4行薄荷绿窄体大写记录文字“TAPE 031 ROOM TONE 18 20 ARCHIVE B”，每行一项，行距宽松，无标语和标点。堆栈下方放置一个小薄荷绿符号“four-point star”。底部添加4–6行极小薄荷绿大写记录信息，包含地点、记录者、格式、日期和备注。所有文本都应像索引、时间、坐标或格式记录，不要写营销口号。

整体以 field recording 为学科语境，手持物件在不加说明的情况下暗示该学科。文字标识被遮挡是签名式特征；坚持一个背景数值和一种强调色，不添加第二种饱和色。采用轻微剪贴感、网印颗粒和真实档案封面触感，不要高端抛光、复杂场景、额外装饰、logo、水印或其他品牌。

items.title: 三名成年日本女性地板视角自然快照
items.description: 纵向自然 iPhone 快照：手机放在地板上朝向天花板，三名约20岁的成年日本女性保持站立并从超低机位俯视镜头，只呈现上半身和真实生活感。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person on the left. Preserve the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with that identity reference.

Create a natural realistic vertical iPhone snapshot of three clearly adult Japanese women around 20 years old. Place the smartphone on the floor with its lens facing the ceiling, creating an ultra-low-angle view looking up at the women from approximately waist height. Capture only their upper bodies and faces. All three women remain standing with straight waists and look down directly at the floor camera by bending only their necks; do not have them lean forward.

The left woman is the main visible person with medium-length hair, a fox-like facial impression, a simple tank top, faint freckles, and a naturally asymmetrical face. The center woman has a bob haircut and a fitted crew-neck T-shirt. The right woman has a single ponytail and simple training wear. Keep all three faces natural and slightly asymmetrical, with believable skin texture and faint freckles. Remove body-size emphasis and keep the clothing ordinary and non-explicit.

Use soft indoor natural light, slight camera shake, everyday snapshot realism, and a lived-in home-room atmosphere. Keep the smartphone geometry correct and placed in the foreground, with all three women behind it and no lower body entering the frame. Avoid cleavage, waist bending, over-beautified skin, completely symmetrical faces, studio polish, deformed hands or fingers, warped phone geometry, visible text, watermarks, or logos.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的参考图作为画面左侧主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创作一张自然写实的竖幅 iPhone 快照：三名约20岁的明确成年日本女性。把智能手机放在地板上，镜头朝向天花板，从大约腰部高度形成仰视三人的超低机位。只拍摄她们的上半身和面部。三人保持腰部挺直的站姿，只弯曲脖子俯视地板上的相机并直视镜头，不要让她们弯腰前倾。

左侧女性是主要可见人物，留中长发，具有略带狐狸感的面部印象，穿简洁背心，肌肤有淡淡雀斑，面部自然不对称。中间女性留波波头，穿合体圆领 T 恤。右侧女性留单马尾，穿简洁训练服。三人的面部都应自然且略有不对称，保留可信的肌肤纹理和淡淡雀斑。去除身体尺寸强调，服装保持普通、非露骨。

使用柔和的室内自然光、轻微手持晃动、日常快照写实感和有人生活过的家居房间氛围。保持手机形状正确并位于前景，三名女性都在手机后方，画面不出现下半身。避免胸部沟壑、弯腰、过度美化皮肤、完全对称的脸、棚拍式精修、变形手部或手指、变形手机、可见文字、水印和 Logo。

items.title: 超写实韩国巫堂萨满仪式全身像
items.description: 9:16 full-body fantasy character portrait of a clearly adult Korean Mudang in monumental hanbok-inspired ritual robes, framed by a bold black ink circle.
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 full-body portrait of a clearly adult Korean female shaman, a Korean Mudang (무당), in an elegant mysterious hyperrealistic anime-influenced character-design style. Keep realistic East Asian facial features, luminous natural skin, visible pores, individual hair strands, a calm commanding gaze and subtle cinematic beauty. This is a refined fantasy portrait, not ordinary anime or real documentary photography.

Dress her in monumental Korean shamanic ceremonial clothing inspired by traditional hanbok and Muism: flowing dark-navy outer robes, voluminous white inner layers, deep-crimson lining, antique-gold embroidery, layered ceremonial belts, Korean pendants, ritual jewelry and traditional hair ornaments. Arrange long black hair in an elaborate but elegant high ceremonial style with delicate dangling accessories. Use believable silk weight, natural folds, precise embroidery and layered sleeves.

One hand rests naturally on an ornate traditional Korean sword in its decorated black scabbard. The other hand is raised with elegant extended fingers, holding multiple aged Korean shamanic talismans, ritual paper charms, beads and red-blue tassels. Keep both hands anatomically correct.

Behind her, place a huge expressive black ink-brush circle across a clean warm-white background, with scattered ink splashes and dry-brush texture. Use minimalist editorial composition, sacred ritual atmosphere, mysterious elegance and ancient spirituality fused with contemporary fantasy character design. Soft cinematic lighting, subtle shadows, physically believable silk and metal, clean background and premium Korean fantasy film character quality.
