items.title: 两位日系偶像风成熟女性街头自然随拍
items.description: Photorealistic vertical daytime street-fashion snapshot of two clearly adult Japanese women sharing a playful outing moment, with natural styling and a softly blurred shopping-street background.
items.prompt:
Create a photorealistic natural 4:5 vertical street-fashion snapshot of two clearly adult fictional Japanese women, both 20 years old, attractive but believable, with natural skin texture, pores, slight imperfections and facial asymmetry. Use a clean magazine-style candid mood, tasteful adult fashion and an airy outing atmosphere.

Frame both faces clearly from head to mid-thigh as they stand close together like a casual theme-park or shopping-street snapshot. The left woman has a soft oval face, large brown eyes, delicate straight brows and a small natural nose; she leans slightly toward camera, tilts her head and raises an open palm beside her cheek in a playful framing gesture, with softly pursed lips. The right woman has a gentle idol-inspired face, long lashes and a closed-eye smile; she leans shoulder-to-shoulder with the left woman, extends one arm upward and forward as if taking a selfie or reaching toward the camera, and lets the other arm rest naturally.

Both have long dark-brown hair, see-through bangs and smooth face-framing strands. Keep the left hair sleek and straight, the right hair softly curled at the ends. No headbands, character ears or branded accessories. Dress both in coordinated adult fashion inspired by uniform styling, never actual school uniforms: oversized white button-up shirts with open collars, rumpled fabric, rolled sleeves and partly untucked uneven hems. The left wears a charcoal-gray pleated mini skirt with subtle pinstripes and a loose deep-navy ribbon tie. The right wears a soft-gray asymmetrical layered mini skirt with fine plaid texture and fitted waist, with the white shirt tucked on one side only. Add simple black shoulder bags with original pastel plush animal keychains, one pink bunny-like charm and one beige teddy-like charm; no recognizable licensed characters.

Set the scene on a stylish outdoor shopping street with stone pavement, warm neutral walls, potted greenery and a softly blurred café terrace. Use bright natural daytime light, crisp focus on both faces and outfits, healthy natural adult proportions, realistic legs, natural gravity and no exaggerated cleavage. Premium street-fashion photography, high detail, clean color and crisp 8k finish. No logos, text, watermarks, extra limbs, distorted hands, plastic skin, school-uniform implication or sexualized framing.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张写实自然的 4:5 竖版街头时尚抓拍：两位明确成年的虚构日本女性，均为 20 岁，外貌吸引人但可信自然，具有真实皮肤纹理、毛孔、轻微瑕疵和自然面部不对称。整体是干净的杂志式抓拍氛围、得体的成人时尚和轻盈的外出休闲感。

两人靠近站立，像主题公园或购物街随手合影，竖构图从头部拍到大腿中部，两张脸都清晰可见。左侧女性有柔和卵圆脸、大棕眼、精致平直眉毛和小巧自然鼻子；她向镜头轻微前倾、头部微偏，在脸颊旁举起张开的手掌做俏皮取景手势，嘴唇轻轻抿起。右侧女性有柔和的偶像感面孔、长睫毛和闭眼微笑；她与左侧肩并肩，一只手臂向上向前伸出，仿佛自拍或向镜头伸手，另一只手臂自然放松。

两人都有深棕色长发、空气刘海和修饰脸型的顺滑发丝。左侧留柔顺直长发，右侧发尾柔软微卷。不要发带、角色耳朵或品牌配饰。两人穿协调的成人时尚制服灵感套装，但绝不是真正校服：宽松白色纽扣衬衫，敞开领口，面料略皱，袖口随意卷起，下摆部分未扎入且不对称。左侧穿炭灰色细条纹百褶迷你裙，搭配松散垂下的深蓝窄带；右侧穿浅灰色不对称层搭迷你裙，带细格纹和贴合腰部，白衬衫仅一侧松散扎入。两人背简洁黑色单肩包，挂原创粉彩毛绒动物钥匙扣：一个粉色兔子样挂坠和一个米色泰迪样挂坠；不要可识别的授权角色。

背景是时尚户外购物街，包含石板路、暖中性色墙面、盆栽绿植和远处柔焦咖啡馆露台。使用明亮自然日光，面部与服装清晰对焦，保持健康自然的成年身材比例、写实腿部、自然重力和不夸张的胸部轮廓。高级街头时尚摄影，高细节、干净色彩和清晰 8k 完成度。不要标志、文字、水印、多余肢体、变形手部、塑料皮肤、校服暗示或性化构图。

items.title: 现代东方梦境立体剪纸世界之树
items.description: 9:16 modern Oriental paper-sculpture art poster: a small adult woman looks up beneath an immense World Tree whose layered canopy becomes a celestial palace.
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical contemporary Oriental 3D papercut art poster titled “She Looks Up Beneath the Crown of the World Tree.” Use layered paper-cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate carving, diorama depth and a surrounding poetic dreamscape; this is not real photography, ordinary anime, plastic 3D or a childlike craft.

Narrative and scale: a clearly adult Oriental woman of about 25 stands between the roots and a high platform of a gigantic paper-art World Tree, looking up in quiet relief and wonder as its canopy unfolds upward like a celestial palace. The woman is a small emotional anchor near the lower center or platform edge; the divine tree is the true protagonist and must be overwhelmingly larger than her and the platform. Use a strong low-angle upward view.

Character: soft oval face, bright almond eyes turned upward, serene expression with a trace of awe, long flowing black hair joined at the ends to paper-cut flower vines, light-gold leaf and small paper-flower hair ornaments. Dress her in a cyan-green and milky-white layered paper-art gown with a leaf, petal and branch-like hem, restrained light-gold hollow patterns, draped paper ribbons, visible paper fibers, hand-cut edges, fine creases, real thickness and interlayer shadows. Keep her clearly adult, small in frame and never the visual focus.

World Tree: rise from the bottom with an extremely thick towering trunk, woven from paper vines, branch veins, arches, corridors, lattice windows, small pavilions and palace-like hollow levels rather than a realistic tree. Make the canopy enormous, spreading layer by layer across the upper frame like a sky palace that props up the heavens. Show dense paper branches and leaves, hollow motifs, sculpted flowers, hanging vines, glowing flower hearts and circular canopy layers. Surround the tree with flower clusters, looping vines, long stairs, small platforms, a few paper birds and soft clouds that create high-altitude sacred negative space; no ordinary garden or decorative-tree feeling.

Color and light: bright holy cyan-green, milky white and warm gold with small light-pink floral accents. Cyan-green supports leaves, cloud shadows and inner dress layers; milky white shapes trunk, flowers, platforms, cloud highlights and outer dress; warm gold marks canopy center, flower hearts, outlines and foil details. Warm-white skylight pours through the canopy in soft sacred beams, with luminous canopy depth, translucent leaf edges and clear paper-fiber transmission. Finish as a museum-grade large-scale paper sculpture installation with crisp layered edges, fine cut marks, restrained premium art-poster color and 8k detail.

Negative prompt: minors, youthful face, real photography, ordinary anime, plastic 3D, resin, clay, felt, children's craft, ordinary garden, ordinary forest, bonsai, small tree, oversized character, close-up, small canopy, thin trunk, flat depth, missing paper layers, missing hollow structure, messy layers, blurred edges, heavy shadows, dead black areas, gray or dirty-yellow grading, extra characters, text, logo or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张 9:16 竖版现代东方立体剪纸艺术海报，主题为“她在世界之树的冠冕下抬头”。采用层叠剪纸插画、立体纸雕、精细镂空、纸艺场景盒和环绕式诗意梦境结构；不是真人摄影、普通动漫、塑料 3D 或幼稚手工。

叙事与尺度：一位约 25 岁、明确成年的东方女性站在巨型纸艺世界之树的树根与高台之间，向上仰望，神情安静、释然又带着惊叹；树冠像天空宫殿一样向上层层展开。女性位于下方中央或高台边缘，只是很小的情绪锚点；神树才是真正主角，视觉上必须压倒性地大于人物与高台。采用强烈低角度仰视。

人物：柔和鹅蛋脸，明亮杏眼微微向上，宁静神情带一点敬畏；黑色长发自然飘散，发尾与花藤剪纸连接，佩戴浅金叶片和小纸花发饰。穿青绿色与奶白色多层纸艺长裙，裙摆像叶片、花瓣和长枝生长，局部有克制浅金镂空纹样、披帛和真实纸张厚度。清晰表现纸纤维、手工裁切边缘、细微折痕和层间投影。保持女性明确成年、画面偏小，不能抢走视觉焦点。

世界之树：从画面底部拔地而起，树干极其粗壮高耸，不采用写实树木质感，而由纸艺藤蔓、枝脉、拱门、回廊、花窗、小亭和宫殿般镂空层级编织而成。树冠必须极其巨大，向画面上方层层展开，像撑起天空的天穹宫殿。表现密集纸艺枝叶、镂空纹样、纸雕花朵、悬垂花藤、发光花心和环形冠层。周围加入花丛、盘旋藤蔓、长阶、小平台、少量纸艺飞鸟与柔软云层，形成高空神域般的神圣留白；不要普通花园或装饰树感。

色彩与光线：以明亮圣洁的青绿、奶白和暖金为主，少量浅粉点缀花朵。青绿用于叶片、云影和裙装内层；奶白用于树干、花朵、高台、云层亮部和裙装外层；暖金用于树冠中心、花心、描边和纸箔。暖白天光穿过树冠形成柔和神圣光束，树冠内部发光，叶缘轻微透光，纸层与纤维清晰可见。完成为博物馆级大型纸雕装置，边缘锐利、裁切细密、色彩高级克制、8k 细节。

负面提示词：未成年人、幼态脸、真人摄影、普通动漫、塑料 3D、树脂、黏土、毛毡、儿童手工、普通花园、普通森林、盆景、小树、人物过大、人物特写、树冠过小、树干过细、缺乏纵深、没有纸张层次、没有镂空结构、纸层混乱、边缘模糊、阴影过重、暗部死黑、灰蒙或脏黄调色、多余人物、文字、logo 或水印。

items.title: 日系运动场伸展女性SNS日常快照
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见人物的面部身份，生成一张3:4竖构图、由朋友随手拍摄的户外运动场伸展日常快照。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

A realistic 3:4 vertical smartphone SNS snapshot on a clear or lightly clouded daytime sports field. A fictional adult Japanese woman in her 20s is stretching before or after exercise, or during a break, naturally photographed by a friend. This is an accidental everyday exercise moment, not a cosplay, advertisement or studio fashion shoot. Keep the mood bright, refreshing and healthy; she has just been called and briefly looks back toward the camera with a quiet friendly smile rather than a posed expression.

Character: a healthy, curvy adult woman who looks flexible and accustomed to exercise, with a natural Japanese face and bone structure, a small soft oval face, dark-brown almond eyes, subtle makeup and a calm approachable expression. Her long hair is light beige-gold to milk-tea gold with softly curled ends, and a few strands move in the outdoor breeze. Her skin is a sunlit healthy golden-beige with natural color variation, pores, fine hairs and subtle texture; avoid plastic smoothing. Keep the full figure naturally proportioned, with a full bust that has realistic weight and remains coordinated with the shoulders, ribcage, waist, pelvis and legs; do not exaggerate a single body part.

Clothing and Accessories: a regular-length white short-sleeved sports T-shirt with light-pink ribbing only at the crew neck and cuffs, no logo, text, school name, brand or number. Use soft sports-jersey fabric with moderate fit and natural pull wrinkles when the arms rise; the hem may lift slightly but must not be designed as a crop top. Wear light cherry-blossom-pink sports shorts with an elastic waist and two thin white side lines, naturally modest length, plus a bright pink slightly wrinkled fabric scrunchie near one wrist. No large jewelry.

Pose is the priority: the arm on the right side of the image stretches almost vertically upward with a slightly relaxed elbow; the opposite arm bends behind the head and the hand lightly touches the other arm between elbow and upper arm, creating a natural crossed-overhead stretch. Tilt the ribcage slightly left and let the pelvis slide naturally right. Bias the weight toward one leg, keep shoulder and waist heights imperfectly uneven, and form a soft inverted S-curve. It must read as an ordinary stretch, not a model pose. Include the range from the raised hand to the upper thighs; the subject occupies about 75–85% of the frame, with the head near center, ribcage slightly left, pelvis flowing right and the right margin a little tighter.

Scene: horizontal layers of yellow-green grass, red to dark-pink track, blue low fences or sports equipment and dark-green trees. Add only sparse distant field lines, benches, sports bags or small equipment. Retain small signs of use and avoid a crowded stadium.

Lighting and Camera: soft natural light from the upper-left front, with natural highlights on the forehead, nose, cheeks, shoulders, upper arms, T-shirt and thighs, soft shadows under the chin, arms and clothing folds, and weak blue sky and ground bounce light. A friend photographs from about 1.8–2.3 meters using a standard to 2x smartphone lens, around 50–60mm full-frame equivalent, from slightly below the sternum with a mild upward angle. Keep the person clear and preserve recognizable sports-field detail in the background. Allow subtle JPEG compression, luminance noise, smartphone edge processing, faint motion traces at hair tips or fingertips and about one degree of compositional tilt. Avoid excessive HDR, portrait-mode blur, orange-teal grading or studio polish.

Negative Prompt: faces resembling real people or celebrities, underage appearance, school uniforms, juvenile anime faces, unrealistic body proportions, enlarging one body part alone, gravity-defying anatomy, extreme low angle, excessive arching, vulgar posing, bikinis, underwear, a crop top designed short from the start, extreme high cuts, plastic skin, excessive beauty correction, strong background blur, ultra-wide distortion, advertisement photography, huge logos, text, UI or icons.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

一张3:4竖构图的真实SNS投稿风智能手机照片：晴朗或薄云的白天户外运动场上，一位虚构的20多岁成年日本女性在运动前后或休息时伸展身体，被朋友自然拍下。不是cosplay、广告或写真棚拍，而是实际运动中的偶然日常快照。整体明亮、清爽、健康，人物自然地被叫到后短暂回望镜头，不做强行摆拍笑容。

人物：健康有曲线且看起来有运动习惯的成年女性，自然日本人脸型和骨架，小巧柔和的椭圆脸、深棕杏仁眼、自然淡妆、安静亲切的微笑。长发为偏亮的米金至奶茶金色，发尾柔和微卷，户外微风使少量发丝飘动。肌肤为被阳光照亮的健康金米色，保留自然色差、毛孔、细小汗毛和轻微纹理，不使用塑料感磨皮。身材丰满但整体比例自然，胸部具有真实重量并与肩宽、胸廓、腰、骨盆和腿部协调，不把任何单一部位夸张化。

服装与配饰：白色常规长度短袖运动T恤，圆领和袖口仅有淡粉色罗纹，无logo、文字、校名、品牌或号码；柔软运动针织面料适度贴合，抬臂时出现自然拉伸褶皱，下摆可轻微上提但不要从设计上做成露脐装。淡樱花粉运动短裤，松紧腰、左右细白线，长度自然不过短；一侧手腕戴略带褶皱的鲜艳粉色布发圈，不加夸张首饰。

姿势是最重要的元素：画面右侧手臂几乎竖直向上伸展但肘部略放松，对侧手臂弯曲，前臂横过头后，手轻触伸展手臂的肘部至上臂位置，形成双臂交叉过顶的自然伸展。胸廓向画面左侧微倾，骨盆向右侧自然滑动，重心略偏一条腿，肩膀和腰线不完全水平，全身形成柔和的反S形；这是普通伸展产生的身体线条，不是模特摆拍。头顶伸展手臂至大腿上部都应纳入画面，人物约占75–85%，头部接近中央，右侧余白略紧。

场景：黄绿色草坪、红至暗粉色跑道、蓝色低围栏或运动设备、浓绿树木依次形成背景色层。远处仅少量白线、长椅、运动包或小型设备，保留实际使用痕迹，不要拥挤体育场。

光线与摄影：画面左上前方的柔和自然日光，额头、鼻梁、脸颊、肩、上臂、T恤和大腿有自然高光，衣物褶皱、腋下和下巴有柔和阴影，并有天空蓝光和地面反射光补足。朋友在约1.8–2.3米处用标准至2倍等效手机镜头拍摄，约50–60mm自然透视，机位略低于胸骨并轻微仰拍，人物清晰且背景保留运动场信息。允许轻微JPEG压缩、亮度噪点、边缘处理、发梢或指尖极弱运动痕迹和约1度构图倾斜；不要过度HDR、强人像虚化、橙青调色或棚拍质感。

负面提示：类似真实人物或名人的脸、未成年外观、学生服、幼态动漫脸、非现实身体比例、只放大单一部位、无视重力、极端低角度、过度反弓、低俗摆拍、比基尼、内衣、原生露脐装、过度高叉、塑料皮肤、过度美肌、强背景虚化、超广角畸变、广告照片、巨大logo、文字、UI、图标。

items.title: 暖阳下与橘猫亲密互动的毛衣女性人像
items.description: Warm 4:5 indoor lifestyle portrait of an adult woman sharing a tender golden-hour moment with a fluffy orange tabby cat.
items.prompt:
Create a warm, intimate 4:5 vertical lifestyle portrait of a clearly adult woman seated indoors beside a fluffy orange tabby cat. She has long softly wavy dark-brown hair and wears a cozy cream chunky-knit sweater. She gently cradles the cat's face with one hand as they face each other closely in a tender, affectionate moment; her eyes are softly closed, with a serene expression and subtle smile.

Golden sunlight enters through a nearby window and casts elegant striped shadows across her hair, face, sweater and the cat's fur. Fill the simple room with soft amber warmth. Use neutral beige walls and understated wood-toned interior details as a clean background. Preserve realistic adult skin, hair and fur texture, believable hands, natural fabric folds and a shallow depth of field.

Candid natural photography, cozy winter atmosphere, warm golden-hour light, soft shadows, subtle film grain, dreamy but photorealistic finish, intimate composition, high detail and crisp 8k texture. Keep the interaction gentle and non-dramatic; no text, logos, extra limbs, distorted hands, plastic skin or CGI look.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张温暖亲密的 4:5 竖版生活方式肖像：一位明确成年的女性坐在室内，身旁是一只蓬松的橘色虎斑猫。她留着柔软微卷的深棕色长发，穿着舒适的米色粗针织毛衣。她用一只手轻轻托住猫的脸，两者近距离面对面，形成温柔亲密的互动；她双眼柔和地闭着，表情宁静，带着淡淡微笑。

金色阳光从附近窗户照入，在她的头发、脸庞、毛衣和猫的皮毛上投下优雅的条纹阴影，让简约房间充满柔和琥珀色暖光。背景使用中性米色墙面和低调的木色室内细节。保持真实成年皮肤、头发和皮毛质感，手部可信，衣物褶皱自然，景深浅而柔和。

自然抓拍摄影，舒适冬日氛围，温暖金色时刻光线，柔和阴影，细微胶片颗粒，梦幻但写实的完成度，亲密构图，高细节和清晰 8k 质感。互动保持温柔自然，不要文字、标志、多余肢体、变形手部、塑料皮肤或 CGI 效果。

items.title: 复古氛围深海军蓝发色果冻少女画报

items.prompt:

Accessories: A thin silver necklace, opal blue finger nail art, and thorn line tattoo details on the left thigh, adding trendy highlights. 

3. Character Hairstyle and Makeup Details 
Hairstyle: Voluminous deep navy blue long wavy hair with bangs hanging down. 

Makeup: Emphasizing eye contours with brown gradient eye makeup, paired with moist peach-brown lip makeup, completing subtle and mysterious facial features. 

4. Lighting and Light Direction 
Light Source and Effects: Strong indoor spotlight lighting shining obliquely from the side above. 

Highlights/Shadows: Creating bright highlights on the character's face and shoulder line, and creating smooth and deep shadows on the back wall, maximizing the contrast between light and dark. 

5. Texture and Tone Atmosphere 
Colors: A high-contrast warm-cold mixed analog palette blending deep navy blue hair, vintage red bricks, a pure white high-neck top, and gorgeously colored jelly. 

Texture: The unevenness of rough exposed brick walls, the texture of knit fabric, and the fine graininess unique to analog film are vivid. 

6. Film and Camera Lens Depth of Field, Angle 
Angle and Depth of Field: A calm frontal horizontal angle at the subject's eye level. 

Features: Applying a shallow depth of field, focusing clearly on the character and the jelly cup, while the wooden shelf and wall in the background are softly blurred. 

7. Background and Layout Elements 
Background Space: A retro interior studio background with a wooden structure holding photo frames and props on the right, and a rough vintage exposed brick wall arranged on the left. 

Layout: A centrally concentrated snapshot pictorial layout that highlights the contrast between the subject and the background textures.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见成年人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。`n`n右下角有 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志小幅放置在其上方，以白色手写体小字写着“CHAse”，像签名一样。  

1. 人物的姿势及表情  
构图及姿势：坐在椅子上，一手拿着装有色彩斑斓果冻的玻璃杯，另一手举起果冻，上身略微扭转，慵懒地坐着的中小景构图。  

表情及氛围：头部微微倾斜，以梦幻而迷离的正面凝视眼神，营造出时髦的复古复古氛围。  

2. 人物服装  
上、下装及细节：穿着解开一颗纽扣的白色高领长袖亨利领上衣，搭配饰钉腰带的复古裁剪黑色牛仔短裤。  

配饰：细银项链、欧泊蓝手指美甲艺术，以及左大腿的荆棘线条纹身细节，增添了时髦的亮点。  

3. 人物发型及化妆细节  
发型：刘海式前发垂下的丰盈感深海军蓝色的长波浪发。  

化妆：以棕色渐层眼妆强调眼部轮廓，搭配湿润的桃棕色唇妆，完成微妙而神秘的五官。  

4. 照明及光线方向  
光源及效果：从上方侧面斜射的强烈室内聚光灯照明。  

高光/阴影：在人物的脸部和肩线形成明亮的高光，并在后方墙面创造平滑而深邃的阴影，最大化明暗对比。  

5. 质感与色调氛围  
色彩：深海军蓝头发、复古红砖、纯白高领上衣、华丽色彩果冻融合的高对比暖-冷混合模拟调色板。  

纹理：粗糙裸露砖墙的凹凸、针织面料质感，以及模拟胶片特有的细密颗粒感活灵活现。  

6. 胶片及相机镜头景深、角度  
角度及景深：主体眼平高度的平静正面水平角度。  

特点：应用浅景深，将人物和果冻杯清晰对焦，后景的原木架子和墙面柔和地虚化处理。  

7. 背景及布局元素  
背景空间：右侧放置相框和小道具的原木结构，以及左侧粗糙复古裸露砖墙布置的复古室内工作室背景。  

布局：突出主体与背景材质对比的中央集中式抓拍画报布局。

items.title: 伦敦3D纸雕粘土微缩景观插图
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已整理为伦敦主题的高级 3D 纸雕与粘土微缩明信片模板。
items.prompt:
Create a charming miniature 3D papercraft and clay-diorama illustration of London, England, presented like a premium handcrafted souvenir postcard. Set the scene on a rounded cobblestone island over a warm off-white textured paper background.

Feature miniature Big Ben and the Palace of Westminster, the London Eye, Tower Bridge, and classic red double-decker buses, surrounded by elegant Victorian architecture, narrow streets, tiny black cabs, and the River Thames flowing through the composition. Add miniature Londoners in stylish everyday British clothing, tiny Union Jack details, street lamps, flower planters, café tables, newspaper stands, red telephone booths, and subtle London street signs.

Build everything from layered paper, molded clay, folded cardstock, and finely textured handmade materials. Include soft papercraft clouds above the skyline with a tiny airplane and a few birds drifting through the sky. Use warm cinematic lighting, gentle shadows, subtle depth of field, whimsical miniature proportions, intricate handcrafted details, and a sophisticated premium souvenir aesthetic.

Compose the diorama from a slightly elevated three-quarter perspective, with a polished yet handmade feel and beautifully balanced visual density. Place elegant cursive lettering beneath the miniature diorama, integrated naturally into the postcard design.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一个迷人的英国伦敦 3D 纸雕和粘土微缩景观插图，呈现得像一张高级手工制作的纪念明信片。场景设置在温暖的米白色纹理纸背景上的一个圆形鹅卵石岛屿上。

重点展示微型大本钟和威斯敏斯特宫、伦敦眼、塔桥和经典的红色双层巴士，周围环绕着优雅的维多利亚式建筑、狭窄的街道、微小的黑色出租车，以及流经构图的泰晤士河。添加穿着时尚日常英式服装的微型伦敦人、微小的英国国旗细节、路灯、花坛、咖啡桌、报刊亭、红色电话亭和细微的伦敦街道标志。

所有物品均由层叠纸张、模制粘土、折叠卡纸和精细纹理的手工材料构建。在天际线上方包含柔和的纸雕云朵，以及一架微型飞机和几只在空中飘荡的鸟。使用温暖的电影照明、柔和的阴影、微妙的景深、异想天开的微缩比例、复杂的手工细节和精致的高级纪念品美学。

从略微抬高的四分之三透视角构图，具有精致且手工制作的感觉，以及美妙平衡的视觉密度。在微缩景观下方放置优雅的草书字体，自然地融入明信片设计中。

items.title: 梦幻旅行女孩玩偶手工纸雕立体模型
items.description: 高端手工3D纸雕旅行立体模型：复古旅行装女孩玩偶与配套小玩偶坐在立体框架上方，俯瞰一个可替换目的地的微型纸雕世界。
items.prompt:
Create a premium handcrafted 3D paper-craft travel diorama centered on a collectible girl doll and her beloved small doll companion on a magical journey. The figures are stylized dolls and paper-craft characters, not real people.

Place the charming girl doll on the upper edge of the dimensional frame, with the small companion doll beside her. Dress the girl doll in a vintage travel outfit: soft knitted cardigan, pleated skirt, little boots, cute hat, and tiny backpack. Give her a miniature travel journal or map. Dress the companion in a matching outfit and give it a tiny suitcase. Add a tiny teddy bear peeking from the backpack and a miniature camera around the doll's neck.

Inside the dimensional frame, build Kyoto as a magical miniature world in Japan. Include recognizable local architecture and landscape, reinterpreted entirely as handcrafted toys and paper sculptures: tiny buildings, colorful streets, flowers, trees, bridges, cafes, lanterns, local decorations, and a small pathway leading into the scene. Add a sticker-covered suitcase, postcards and stamps, a miniature paper airplane, a tiny map with a dotted travel route, and handmade flowers and plants around the foreground.

Use a soft pastel vintage palette of dusty pink, warm cream, terracotta, muted teal, sage green, peach, and warm brown. Make the entire artwork feel like a luxury handcrafted children's storybook mixed with a vintage travel scrapbook, using layered cardstock, paper quilling, embossed paper, miniature clay, fabric textures, stitched leather accents, and delicate hand-painted surfaces. Give the dolls oversized curious eyes, expressive handcrafted faces, and a warm adventurous personality.

At the bottom, add one large raised plaque with exactly two lines: Kyoto and Japan. Keep all other travel marks decorative and non-readable; do not add random text, invented brands, or author information. Surround the frame with a compass, postage stamps, luggage tags, leaves, postcards, and the dotted route. Use soft warm studio lighting, realistic miniature shadows, tactile paper fibers, shallow depth of field, premium product photography, highly detailed handcrafted textures, whimsical cinematic atmosphere, elegant composition, cozy nostalgia, and museum-quality diorama finish. Avoid photorealistic humans, plastic-looking 3D characters, clutter, harsh colors, modern objects, and generic fantasy scenery.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一个高端手工3D纸雕旅行立体模型，中心是一个收藏级女孩玩偶和她心爱的小玩偶同伴，正在进行奇幻旅程。画面中的角色是风格化玩偶和纸雕角色，不是真实人物。

让可爱的女孩玩偶坐在立体框架的上缘，小玩偶同伴坐在她身边。女孩玩偶穿复古旅行装：柔软针织开衫、百褶裙、小靴子、可爱帽子和小背包；手持微型旅行日记或地图。小玩偶穿配套服装并携带小提箱。背包里探出一只微型泰迪熊，玩偶脖子上挂着微型相机。

在立体框架内部，把 Japan 的 Kyoto 构建成神奇的微型世界。加入当地具有辨识度的建筑与景观，但全部重新诠释为手工玩具和纸雕：微型建筑、彩色街道、花卉、树木、桥梁、咖啡馆、灯笼、地方装饰，以及一条通往场景内部的小径。加入贴满旅行贴纸的小提箱、明信片与邮票、飞过场景的微型纸飞机、带虚线路线的微型地图，以及前景周围的手工花卉和植物。

使用灰粉、暖奶油、陶土、柔和青色、鼠尾草绿、桃色和暖褐色组成柔和的粉彩复古色调。整体感觉应像奢华手工儿童故事书与复古旅行剪贴簿的结合，使用分层卡纸、卷纸艺术、浮雕纸、微型黏土、织物纹理、缝线皮革装饰和细腻手绘表面。让玩偶拥有好奇的大眼睛、富有表现力的手工面部细节和温暖的冒险气质。

在底部添加一个大型凸起铭牌，严格显示两行文字：Kyoto 和 Japan。其他旅行标记只作为装饰且不可读，不添加随机乱码、虚构品牌或作者信息。用指南针、邮票、行李牌、叶子、明信片和虚线旅行路线环绕框架。使用柔和温暖的影棚灯、真实微型阴影、可触感纸张纤维、浅景深、优质产品摄影、高细节手工纹理、奇幻电影氛围、优雅构图、舒适怀旧感和博物馆级立体模型质感。避免写实人类、塑料感3D角色、杂乱、刺眼颜色、现代物品和无关的通用幻想风景。

items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a 9:16 high-precision ancient Xianxia character poster with realistic Oriental fantasy portrait texture. The setting combines an early-morning cold pool, a misty bridge and a distant mountain gate. Keep the mood elegant, aloof, quiet, firm and ethereal: cold but luminous, with a sense of destiny and landscape narrative.

The single main subject is a clearly adult East Asian woman, visually mid-20s, with natural refined features, a small oval face, clear bone structure, long almond-shaped eyes with a thoughtful lowered gaze, delicate nose and soft defined lips. Keep fair translucent skin with natural texture and moisture from the mist. Use transparent immortal makeup: light moist base, subtle grey-pink and cool-brown eye color, thin eyeliner, natural lashes, barely-there blush and low-saturation rose or cold bean-paste lips.

Style her with smooth black long hair, half down and half pinned up, abundant volume and a few natural strands. Dress her in elegant jade-green ancient attire with refined layered fabric, restrained embroidery and believable drape, avoiding armor or modern fashion. Keep the character the absolute visual focus; use a tasteful portrait composition with atmospheric depth from the pool, bridge, mist and mountain gate. Use soft cool morning light, delicate rim light and controlled highlights; preserve realistic skin, fabric and hair texture.

Avoid sickly or spiritless mood, sweet-girl or modern influencer styling, heavy makeup, plastic skin, excessive sharpening, HDR, cartoon/anime/chibi treatment, armor, modern logos, watermarks, captions, garbled text and fictional extra characters.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创建一张 9:16 高精度古风仙侠角色海报，具有真实东方幻想人像质感。场景结合清晨冷池、雾桥和远处山门，整体气质优雅、清冷、安静、坚定而空灵，明亮但不灰暗，并带有命运感与山水叙事。

唯一主体是一位明确成年的东亚女性，视觉年龄约二十多岁，拥有自然精致的五官、小巧椭圆脸、清晰骨相、微微下垂的杏长眼和克制沉思的视线，鼻梁秀气，嘴唇柔和清晰。皮肤白皙通透，保留自然纹理与晨雾带来的湿润感。使用透明仙系妆容：轻薄水润底妆，灰粉与冷棕眼影，细自然眼线，真实睫毛，极淡腮红和低饱和玫瑰或冷豆沙唇色。

黑色顺滑长发半披半挽，发量充足，保留少量自然碎发。穿着优雅的玉绿色古风服饰，具有细腻层次、克制刺绣和真实垂坠感，避免铠甲或现代时装。人物始终是绝对视觉主体，以冷池、雾桥、薄雾和山门提供含蓄空间深度。使用柔和清冷的清晨光线、细腻轮廓光和受控高光，保留真实皮肤、面料与头发质感。

避免病弱或无神气质、甜妹或现代网红风、厚重妆容、塑料皮肤、过度锐化、HDR、卡通/动漫/Q版、铠甲、现代标志、水印、字幕、乱码和虚构的额外人物。

items.title: 唐风美女持碗面食高端视觉海报
items.description: Premium vertical restaurant social key visual: an adult Chinese woman presents an oversized steaming noodle bowl with original sticker graphics in a warm Asian restaurant.
items.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium vertical restaurant social key visual built around one clear three-part symbol: a confident, stylish adult Chinese woman in a refined modern Tang-style outfit, one oversized steaming bowl of premium noodles thrust very close to the camera, and two or three original sticker-like callouts orbiting the presentation. Keep the food as the absolute visual hero and make the result feel like a polished global commercial poster disguised as a shareable social post; use no real brand names, copied captions, interface wording, or existing slogans.

Composition: strict vertical frontal hero shot with a slightly wide-angle lens. Center the woman in the upper middle, facing the viewer with bright eye contact and an open joyful smile. She extends both arms forward, holding the bowl so its enlarged rim and rising noodles dominate the lower center foreground. Her arms form a direct forward-thrust path. Place a dynamic but orderly graphic halo around the bowl and upper torso: curved arrows and short fictional decorative labels point toward the noodles and toppings, plus a simplified original social strip along the bottom edge.

Subject: original clearly adult Chinese woman, cool, confident, approachable and fashionable; fitted Tang-inspired top or dress with elegant frog-button details, subtle Chinese tailoring, premium fabric, natural luminous makeup and softly shaped hair. Preserve realistic adult anatomy, natural shoulder and arm proportions, correct neck posture and accurate five-finger hands gripping the bowl from both sides. Keep natural pores, lip texture and subtle under-eye detail; no mannequin stiffness, fused fingers, extra fingers or twisted wrists.

Food: large glazed ceramic bowl filled with glossy springy noodles, visible steam, rich seasoning and premium toppings such as caramelized grilled chicken or braised meat, scallion, sesame, oil sheen and restrained garnish. Show moist elastic strands with slight natural disorder, appetizing texture and physically believable translucent steam. The bowl receives the strongest highlight emphasis.

Setting and light: warm stylish Asian restaurant with wood furniture, partition grids, cream walls and softly blurred diners or seating. Use warm practical restaurant light, soft frontal fill and gentle overhead warmth; keep the face inviting, the bowl brightest, steam delicately backlit, shadows controlled and materials polished. Use noodle gold, amber-brown, dark ceramic, ivory, warm wood, restrained lacquer red or wine accents, natural skin tones and charcoal details. Render tailored fabric, glazed ceramic, juicy meat fibers and crisp flat-color stickers with premium commercial retouching, clean depth and 8k detail.

Mood and finish: viral, iconic, warm, craveable, stylish, energetic, premium, youthful, confident and globally polished; hyper-real food photography and agency-level flagship campaign finish. Negative prompt: real brands, copied text, readable existing slogans, male subject, childlike appearance, vulgar clothing, broken hands, extra or fused fingers, twisted wrists, plastic noodles, fake steam, blurry bowl, cluttered layout, messy stickers, muddy lighting, cheap social design, low resolution.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张超高端竖版餐厅社交媒体核心视觉海报，围绕一个清晰的三部分超级符号：一位穿着精致现代唐装、气质自信时髦的成年中国女性；一个极近距离推向镜头、冒着热气的超大高端面碗；以及环绕展示的两到三个原创贴纸式标注。食物必须是绝对视觉主角，整体像经过国际商业广告打磨的社交分享海报；不要使用真实品牌名称、复制的标题、界面措辞或现有口号。

构图：严格竖版、正面、略广角的英雄镜头。女性位于画面上中部中央，直视观众，目光明亮并带着开放愉快的笑容。她双臂向前伸出，从两侧托住面碗，使放大的碗缘和升起的面条占据下方中央前景，形成直接的向前推送轨迹。在碗和上半身周围安排动态但有秩序的图形光环：弧形箭头和简短虚构装饰文字指向面条与配料，底部边缘加入简化且原创的社交信息条。

主体：原创、明确成年的中国女性，酷飒、自信、亲切且时尚；穿修身唐风上衣或裙装，带优雅盘扣、微妙中式剪裁和高级面料。保持真实成年人体比例、自然肩臂关系、正确颈部姿势，以及从两侧抓碗的准确五指手部。保留自然毛孔、唇部纹理和细微眼下结构，避免人体模型般僵硬；不要融合手指、多余手指或扭曲手腕。

食物：大型釉面陶瓷碗，装满油亮有弹性的面条、清晰蒸汽、浓郁调味和高端配料，例如焦糖烤鸡或炖肉、葱花、芝麻、油光和克制装饰。表现湿润、有韧性的面条、轻微自然散乱、真实食物质感和物理可信的半透明蒸汽。面碗获得最强高光。

环境与灯光：温暖时尚的亚洲餐厅，包含木质家具、隔断格栅、米白墙面和柔焦的背景食客或座位。使用餐厅暖色实用灯、柔和正面补光和温和顶光；脸部明亮亲切，面碗最亮，蒸汽轻微受光，阴影受控，材质精致。采用面条金、琥珀棕、深色陶瓷、象牙白、暖木色、克制漆红或酒红、自然肤色和炭黑细节。表现高级织物、釉面陶瓷、多汁肉类纤维和清晰平色贴纸，具有商业修图、干净景深和8k细节。

氛围与完成度：病毒式、标志性、温暖、诱人、时髦、充满活力、高端、年轻、自信、全球化精美感；超真实美食摄影，旗舰商业广告质感。负面提示词：真实品牌、复制文字、可读现有口号、男性主体、幼态外貌、庸俗服装、残缺手部、多余或融合手指、扭曲手腕、塑料面条、虚假蒸汽、模糊面碗、杂乱构图、凌乱贴纸、混浊灯光、廉价社交媒体设计、低分辨率。

items.title: 涂抹面膜的居家风高冷特写自拍
items.description: 以用户上传的人物参考图绑定主要可见人物的面部身份，生成一张带面膜质感、环形灯高光和浴室背景的居家护肤近距离自拍人像。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Character and Signature Text:
An intimate extreme close-up selfie of an adult East Asian woman, framed close to the face, neckline and collarbone. In the lower-right corner, place a small Meta-operated Threads logo discreetly, with “CHAse” written above it in small white handwritten script like a signature.

Pose and Expression:
Her head is tilted slightly to the left, captured from a natural diagonal smartphone front-camera selfie angle. She does not look directly into the lens, instead giving a lazy, confident side-eye toward the upper right. Her closed lips are slightly pouted, creating a vivid everyday skincare moment.

Clothing and Props:
She wears a comfortable heather-gray blended-cotton V-neck home T-shirt that naturally reveals the neckline and collarbone. Apply a moist white moisturizing or makeup-remover cream mask thickly and unevenly over the face as the core visual object. Comb the hair back and secure it, with a mini hair clip decorated with shiny stones slightly visible on the upper-right side.

Hairstyle and Makeup:
A fluffy, natural deep-black updo, casually tied as if for washing the face or doing skincare. Fine stray hairs fall around the neckline and ears, adding realistic lived-in detail. Under the mask, show a clear, clean bare-skin base with neatly groomed dark-brown eyebrows. Keep the lips clear of the mask and add natural pink-coral glossy lip color with a moist finish.

Lighting:
Use high-intensity urban indoor LED light and a ring light shining from above the front of the subject. Make the circular ring-light catchlight crystal clear and concentrated in the pupils, while the moist sheen on the white cream mask reflects brightly for vivid three-dimensional texture.

Color and Texture:
Build a smartphone homecare-selfie palette from calm heather gray for the blended T-shirt, pure white for the mask, jet black for the hair, and gentle pink-beige for the lips and skin. The mask should have a thick, high-viscosity yet subtly moist structure with uneven translucent and opaque white layers, as if swept by fingers or a brush. Clearly show tiny pilling and fiber details in the soft blended cotton, along with natural fine skin texture and moisture on the uncovered collarbone and neckline.

Composition and Depth of Field:
Use the slightly high-angle perspective of a smartphone front camera. Keep the face, mask texture, ring-light reflection in the pupils and T-shirt fibers in sharp close focus, while the indoor background falls into a soft natural blur.

Background:
A clean, modern indoor bathroom with understated off-white tiles or walls and simple horizontal storage-cabinet lines behind the subject, keeping attention on the face and cream-mask texture.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

人物与签名文字：
一位成年东亚女性的亲密极致特写自拍，取景靠近脸部、颈线和锁骨。右下角小巧放置 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志，其上方以小号白色手写体写着“CHAse”，像签名一样。

姿势与表情：
头部微微向左倾斜，使用智能手机前置摄像头自然的斜角自拍视角。人物不直视镜头，而是慵懒地向右上方侧目；闭合的嘴唇微微嘟起，呈现自然鲜活的日常护肤瞬间。

服装与道具：
穿舒适的混纺浅灰色V领棉质家居T恤，自然露出颈线和锁骨。脸上厚薄不均地涂抹湿润的白色保湿霜或卸妆面膜，使其成为核心视觉对象。头发向后梳理并固定，右上侧微微露出一枚镶闪亮装饰的迷你发夹。

发型与妆容：
深黑色调的蓬松自然盘发，像是为洗脸或护肤而随意扎起；细碎发丝落在颈线和耳周，增加真实生活感。面膜覆盖处呈现清透干净的素颜肌理，眉毛为整齐的深棕色；唇部避开面膜，涂自然粉珊瑚色水润唇彩。

光线：
人物正面上方有高强度都市室内LED灯和环形灯。瞳孔内清晰凝聚圆形环形灯高光，白色面膜表面的湿润水光被明亮反射，形成鲜活的立体效果。

色彩与质感：
以混纺T恤的沉稳浅灰、面膜的纯白、黑发的墨黑，以及嘴唇和皮肤的温和粉米色构成智能手机家居护理自拍氛围。面膜应呈厚实、高黏度但含蓄水润的半透明与不透明白色纹理，像被手指或刷子不均匀扫过；清晰呈现柔软混纺棉的细小起球和纤维纹理，以及未敷面膜的锁骨和颈线处自然细腻的皮肤纹理。

构图与景深：
采用智能手机前置摄像头特有的微高角度自拍构图。近距离锐利对焦面部、面膜质感、瞳孔环形灯反射和T恤纤维细节，背景自然柔和虚化。

背景：
干净现代的室内浴室，人物后方为低调简约的米白色瓷砖或墙面，以及收纳柜框架的水平线条，使视线集中在人物脸部和面膜纹理上。

items.title: 旅行照片分屏涂鸦物件海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报。每张照片单独输出，禁止多图拼接。 整体采用3:4竖版构图，由清楚可见的真实照片与同场景“照片涂鸦旅行物件”转绘组成。上下区域高度接近1:1，使用清楚、平直、克制的水平分界，不要在分界处进行模糊、羽化、渐融或图像重叠。 ## 上半部分：真实原始照片 忠实保留原始照片中的主体身份、数量、姿态、动作方向、核心物件、人物关系、街道或空间结构、观察角度、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩氛围。 只进行轻微的旅行杂志、独立出版物或摄影展级调色，并加入极薄的胶片颗粒。上半部分必须仍然是一张清楚、真实、具有实质面积的摄影作品。 不得重新绘制照片，不得移动人物，不得改变车辆、食物、店铺、桌椅、船只或纪念品的身份和结构，不得增添照片中不存在的文化符号与旅行物件。 为适应画幅，可以自然延展少量天空、地面、墙面或周边环境，但不得拉伸、挤压、镜像、复制或扭曲主体。 ## 下半部分：照片涂鸦旅行物件 从同一张照片中提取一个最值得被记住的核心旅行物件，例如： - 车辆、单车、摩托车、船只或推车； - 咖啡杯、餐盘、食物、餐具或桌面组合； - 椅子、行李箱、路牌、雨伞或纪念品； - 店铺门面、售货窗口、报刊亭或街头摊位； - 其他轮廓清楚、具有地点气息的日常物件。 人物可以保留，但只作为物件动作、使用方式和旅行故事的辅助关系，不得抢走主要视觉中心。 首先理解照片中最重要的物件身份、轮廓、方向、颜色和使用关系，然后主动删除复杂背景、无关路人、重复建筑、广告、密集招牌、细小装饰和摄影噪声。 不要把原照片完整缩小后放进下半部分，也不要将整张照片简单描边或卡通化。 ## 二次构图 采用“缩小提炼”的编辑构图。 核心物件占下半部分宽度约40%–65%、高度约30%–58%，放置在中央、偏下或一侧。根据照片内容改变主体尺度、裁切方式和空间位置，使下半部分明显区别于上方照片。 只保留一个核心物件，并搭配一至三条必要的场景线索，例如： - 一小段道路、轨道或桌面； - 一扇门、一个窗口或一角墙面； - 一只使用物件的手或一位缩小人物； - 一道影子、蒸汽、运动轨迹或方向线。 转绘区域必须保留约35%–55%的连续暖白纸面或浅色空场，让主体周围能够呼吸。不要使用模板式白色边栏，也不要把空白切碎成许多小缝隙。 ## 照片切片与哑光色块 核心物件不能完全变成普通插画。 保留少量来自原照片的真实质感，可以使用： - 一至三块经过裁切的照片质感区域； - 物件最有识别度的真实表面； - 车窗、食物、织物、金属或木材的局部摄影纹理； - 与原物轮廓相适应的不规则照片切片。 照片切片应自然嵌入哑光色块和手绘线条中，不要出现规则照片框，不要拼成密集相册。 其余结构使用从照片中提取的4–6种哑光平涂色块重新概括。保留一处最有辨识度的鲜明颜色作为视觉焦点，其余颜色适度降低饱和度。 色块边缘允许轻微手工偏差、颜料缺口和纸张透底，避免光滑矢量形状和商业数字插画质感。 ## 叙事涂鸦 在核心物件周围加入极少量与真实场景有关的手绘涂鸦。 可以根据照片内容选择： - 指示动作或行进方向的箭头； - 车辆、船只或人物的运动轨迹； - 食物与饮品上方的蒸汽线； - 轻微声音符号、震动线或等待标记； - 连接人物与物件的弧线； - 圈点、下划线或简短观察标记； - 一两个非常简单的小型符号。 涂鸦必须解释物件的动作、使用方式或旅行情绪，而不是纯粹装饰。 使用黑色、深褐色或照片中的一种深色，以松动马克笔、蜡笔、油性笔或铅笔线表现。线条可以有断裂、重画、轻微越线和不均匀墨迹。 涂鸦数量保持克制，通常只使用3–7组小型线条或符号。不要让整个画面变成儿童涂鸦本、漫画分镜或密集贴纸页。 ## 文字 在生成前，根据照片中真实可见的物件、地点、动作或气氛，确定并准确渲染以下文字： 1. 一个1–3个英文单词的主标题； 2. 字段：“OBJECT NOTE 01”； 3. 一行5–12个英文单词的观察句。 标题可以是物件名称或简短旅行感受，例如： - “YELLOW TRAM” - “LATE LUNCH” - “CORNER TABLE” - “SMALL FERRY” - “STREET CART” - “RAINY RIDE” 观察句只描述照片中真实存在的颜色、动作、位置和物件关系，不得虚构品牌、地点、日期或故事。 文字集中放置在连续留白区域，与核心物件和涂鸦形成一组明确的编辑题签。主标题在聊天预览尺寸下必须清楚可读，辅助文字不能缩成无法辨认的装饰灰线。 字体使用松动手写体、旧印刷小字或带有马克笔质感的窄体字。文字边缘可以有轻微缺墨、重复描写和纸张摩擦感，像画者与涂鸦一起写在纸面上，不要使用光滑悬浮的数字排版。 禁止复制原照片中的广告、招牌和品牌文字。禁止作者名、签名、社交账号、Logo、网址、二维码、假中文、乱码和无意义编号。 ## 整体气质 像从一张旅行照片里挑出最舍不得忘记的小东西，再用照片残片、哑光颜色和几笔随手画下的注释，把它重新保存一次。 轻松、聪明、有观察感、略带幽默和生活气息，同时保持独立旅行杂志与艺术出版物的克制版式。 强制避免：full-photo cartoon filter, same-crop same-scale redraw, complete realistic lower background, dense doodles, childish cartoon page, comic panel, generic travel stickers, copied signage, invented brand, excessive arrows, excessive symbols, multiple competing objects, glossy 3D, smooth vector shapes, digital gradients, oversaturated colors, tiny decorative source photo, missing source-photo comparison, fake text, author signature, watermark.

items.title: 秋日咖啡馆成年女性 Y2K 闪光坐姿时尚肖像
items.description: 3:4 秋日咖啡馆成人时尚肖像：成年女性坐在蜂蜜色木平台上手持冰抹茶杯，穿黄油黄开衫与宽腿牛仔裤，使用 Y2K CCD 闪光风格，背景唯一招牌为 `chryzleen`。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Preserve the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with that identity reference.

Create an 8K-detail 3:4 vertical adult fashion portrait in a cafe. The main visible subject is clearly an adult woman. Preserve recognizable identity, exact facial structure, natural proportions, authentic facial asymmetry and realistic skin texture. Tilt the crown about 9° toward frame-left, rotate the face about 18° toward frame-right and lift the chin slightly. Her eyes glance toward the upper-right with relaxed lids; her expression is playful, lighthearted and emotionally natural, with a small restrained pout.

She sits diagonally on a raised honey-toned wooden cafe platform with her pelvis fully supported. One leg folds sideways beneath her and the other knee opens naturally outward; one white retro sneaker is prominent in the center foreground while the other leg extends naturally toward the lower-left. Her torso curves gently toward frame-left with softly uneven shoulders. Her frame-left elbow bends as she holds a clear iced-matcha cup beside her cheek, fingers naturally wrapped around it. Her frame-right arm descends between the legs, the hand resting loosely near a rolled denim cuff with the long sleeve partly covering the fingers. Show exactly two normally connected arms and two realistic hands.

HAIR: shoulder-length beige-blonde hair with dimensional darker roots, soft center part, airy cheek-framing layers and rounded ends. Preserve a smooth blowout with believable volume, separated strands, warm highlight ribbons and a few flyaways. OUTFIT AND ACCESSORIES: fuzzy pale butter-yellow button-front cardigan with round neck, dropped shoulders, long relaxed sleeves, ribbed cuffs and tonal buttons; relaxed medium-wash wide-leg blue jeans with natural seated-knee folds and loosely rolled cuffs; white retro low-top sneakers with black side stripes, cream laces, gum soles and realistic creasing; small gold hoops, delicate rings, short pendant necklace and glossy pink manicure; compact cream quilted leather shoulder bag with a fine gold chain behind the frame-right shoulder; folded round sunglasses on the nearby wooden table. Preserve the exact clothing, colors, pose, matcha cup and accessories.

Use polished but refined full makeup: sculpted brows, champagne shimmer, warm-brown outer-corner definition, elongated brown liner, separated lashes, peach-rose blush, cheekbone highlight and glossy rosy-nude lips. Use warm medium-beige skin with healthy red undertones, visible pores, clean facial shadows and controlled reflections, never oily, waxy or plastic.

Set the scene in a contemporary department-store cafe at peak autumn: pale cream square tiles, honey wood platforms and tables, slim brushed brass supports, open shelving with neatly arranged bottles and boxes, and warm amber architectural light. Through a distant street-facing window show golden and copper trees, cool autumn daylight and leaves only on the outdoor pavement. Keep the entire indoor cafe and the area around the woman spotless, with no fallen leaves, branches, pumpkins or outdoor debris. On the upper shelving, include exactly one compact backlit cafe sign reading lowercase `chryzleen`, small and refined, the only occurrence of that word in the scene.

Mix cool directional autumn daylight with warm ceiling and shelf lights. Use controlled compact-camera fill flash to lift the face, hair, hands, cardigan, denim, sneakers and matcha cup without flattening texture. Render as an early-2000s Y2K flash compact digital camera with crisp CCD color, strong true color, local contrast, slight localized highlight clipping, controlled fixture bloom and subtle JPEG compression. Do not use modern smartphone HDR, DSLR bokeh or cinematic grading. Keep the camera level at seated chest height with a slight downward view and no Dutch tilt. The woman fills about 92% of the frame height, hair near the top edge, sneaker and extended denim leg near the bottom; keep the cafe sign small and secondary.

Negative constraints: no changed identity, outfit, colors, pose or props, standing pose, knees pressed together, complex crossed legs, arm or finger errors, duplicated cup, sunglasses or bag, flat hair, excessive smoothing, plastic skin, severe noise, low resolution, excessive headroom, Dutch tilt, slanted horizon, indoor leaves or debris, floating typography, logo, watermark, extra text on the cardigan or cup, or a second `chryzleen`.

创作一张 3:4 竖幅、8K 细节的成年女性咖啡馆时尚肖像。主可见人物明确为成年女性，保留可辨识身份、精确面部结构、自然比例、面部不对称和真实皮肤质感。她的头顶向画面左侧约倾斜 9°，面部向右侧旋转约 18°，下巴轻抬；眼睛向右上方斜视，表情轻快、俏皮、情感自然，嘴唇形成小而克制的嘟嘴。

她斜坐在抬高的蜂蜜色木质咖啡馆平台上，骨盆完整由平台支撑。一条腿侧折在身下，另一条腿的膝盖自然向外打开；一只白色复古运动鞋位于中心前景，另一条腿向左下方自然延伸。躯干向画面左侧轻弯，肩膀略不对称。画面左侧手臂弯曲，在脸颊旁握着透明冰抹茶杯，手指自然环绕杯身；右侧手臂在双腿之间下垂，手松散地靠近卷起的牛仔裤脚，长袖部分覆盖手指。只出现两条连接正常的手臂和两只自然的手。

头发为肩长米金色，带有层次感深色发根、柔软中分、空气感脸侧层次和圆润修饰脸型的发尾；保留平滑吹风造型、自然蓬松、分明发丝、暖色高光带和少量碎发。服装与配饰：毛茸茸浅黄油色扣式开衫，圆领、落肩、长袖、罗纹袖口和同色纽扣；中度水洗蓝宽腿牛仔裤，自然膝部褶皱与松散卷脚；白色复古低帮运动鞋，黑色侧边条纹、奶油鞋带和生胶鞋底；小金耳环、戒指、短吊坠项链、亮粉色美甲；奶油色绗缝皮革链条包靠在右肩后方，小圆形太阳镜放在旁边木桌上。保持服装、颜色、姿势、抹茶杯和配饰一致。

妆容为清晰但精致的全妆：雕刻眉、香槟金眼影、暖棕外眼角、拉长棕色眼线、根根分明的睫毛、桃玫瑰腮红、高光颧骨和高光玫瑰裸唇。肤色为暖中米色，带健康红润底色、可见毛孔、干净阴影和受控光泽，不油腻、不蜡质、不塑料。

场景是秋季当代百货咖啡馆，浅奶油方砖、蜂蜜色木质平台和桌子、拉丝黄铜支架、开放式货架、整齐瓶盒和暖琥珀建筑光。远处临街窗外有金黄与铜色树木、凉爽秋日光和只落在室外路面的叶子；室内地板、桌面、座位、货架、平台和人物附近保持洁净，不出现落叶、枝条、南瓜或室外碎屑。上方货架只有一个紧凑的背光咖啡馆招牌，准确写小写 `chryzleen`，文字小巧精致且为场景中唯一一次出现。

使用凉爽定向秋日光与暖色吸顶灯、货架灯的混合光，受控紧凑相机补光提升脸部、头发、手、开衫、牛仔布、鞋和抹茶杯的质感。使用早期 2000 年代 Y2K 闪光紧凑数码相机的清晰 CCD 渲染、强真实色彩、局部对比、轻微高光溢出、灯具周围受控光晕和细微 JPEG 压缩，不使用现代手机 HDR、单反虚化或电影级调色。相机在坐姿胸口高度水平手持，略向下取景，无荷兰式倾斜；人物占画面高度约 92%，头发接近上缘，运动鞋和牛仔裤腿接近下缘，背景招牌保持小而次要。

负面约束：不要改变身份、服装、颜色、姿势或道具，不要站立姿势、双膝并拢、复杂交叉腿、手臂或手指错误、重复杯子/太阳镜/包、扁平头发、过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、严重噪点、低分辨率、过多留白、荷兰式倾斜、水平线歪斜、室内落叶或碎屑、浮动文字、Logo、水印、开衫或杯子上的额外文字，也不要出现第二个 `chryzleen`。

items.title: 韩系都市街头时尚咖啡馆少女街拍
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Ultra-realistic candid street-style fashion photo of an adult woman in her mid-20s sitting casually on a narrow cream-colored wooden bench outside a small café or boutique in a quiet urban neighborhood. The image feels spontaneous, feminine, and slightly nostalgic, like an effortless Seoul or Tokyo street-fashion snapshot.

She has very long, softly wavy dark brown hair with airy curtain bangs, worn loose over her shoulders and down her back. Natural Korean-inspired makeup with smooth luminous skin, softly defined eyes, subtle rosy blush, and glossy pink lips. Her expression is calm and slightly distracted, looking off to the side while sipping her drink through a straw.

Outfit: a cream knitted sleeveless vest with softly structured shoulders, paired with a beige-and-brown plaid knee-length skirt with a relaxed, slightly ruffled silhouette. Cream ribbed mid-calf socks and beige retro sneakers with oversized ivory satin ribbon laces tied into large bows. Delicate, understated accessories.

Pose: sitting sideways on the bench with both knees bent and raised casually in front of her, legs relaxed and slightly overlapping. One hand holds a transparent plastic cup filled with a pale green iced citrus or matcha-style drink containing lime slices, while the other lightly holds the straw near her lips. Natural, unposed posture.

Next to her is a small structured caramel-brown leather handbag with rounded handles. Several cute colorful plush keychains hang from the bag, creating a playful girlish detail.

On the bench nearby: a small silver dessert dish with a spoon, a partially eaten dessert, and a rectangular pastry dusted generously with powdered sugar on a silver tray. The arrangement should feel casually left there rather than styled.

Background: minimalist storefront exterior with large white-framed glass windows. Her reflection is clearly visible in the glass beside her, creating an interesting layered composition. Warm gray and white walls, subtle stone and reddish-brown polished granite details, a partially visible metal shop shutter, simple city pavement. No crowded street scene.

Photography: natural bright overcast daylight, realistic soft shadows, slightly muted creamy color palette, crisp but not overly processed detail, authentic skin texture, subtle digital-camera sharpness, editorial Korean street photography, casual café-date aesthetic, soft neutral tones, understated Y2K influence, realistic fabric textures, photorealistic, high resolution.

Composition: full-body vertical portrait, subject positioned slightly right of center, storefront window and reflection occupying the left half of the frame, bench extending horizontally across the foreground, candid asymmetrical framing, approximately 3:4 aspect ratio.

Negative prompt: studio backdrop, luxury restaurant, nighttime scene, heavy makeup, high heels, overly glamorous pose, exaggerated curves, plastic skin, overly blurred background, extreme bokeh, distorted hands, extra fingers, malformed legs, duplicated accessories, incorrect reflection, floating objects, cartoon, anime, illustration, CGI, oversaturated colors.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

超写实的自然街头风格时尚照片，一位年轻成年女性随意坐在安静城市社区中一家小咖啡馆或精品店外的窄乳白色木质长凳上。画面感觉自然自发、充满女性气质并略带怀旧感，就像一张随意的首尔或东京街头时尚快照。

她留着极长的、柔和波浪状的深棕色头发，配有轻盈的法式刘海，头发随意散落在肩膀和背部。自然的韩系妆容，拥有平滑发亮的皮肤、柔和定义的眼睛、淡淡的玫瑰色腮红和有光泽的粉色嘴唇。她的表情平静且略显分心，在用吸管吸吮饮料时看向一侧。

穿搭：一件奶油色针织无袖无袖上衣，肩部线条柔和，搭配一条米褐色格纹迷你裙，剪裁宽松且带有轻微褶边。奶油色罗纹中筒袜和带有大尺寸象牙色缎面丝带鞋带（系成大蝴蝶结）的米色复古运动鞋。精致且低调的配饰。

姿势：侧坐在长凳上，双膝弯曲并自然地在身前抬起，双腿放松且略微重叠。一只手拿着一个叠层塑料杯，杯里装满淡绿色的冰镇柑橘或抹茶风味饮料，里面有青柠片，另一只手轻轻握住靠近嘴唇的吸管。自然、不经意摆拍的姿态。

她身边是一个小巧的有结构的焦糖棕色皮革手提包，带有圆形手柄。包上挂着几个可爱彩色毛绒钥匙扣，营造出俏皮的少女细节。

长凳旁边：一个带勺子的小银色甜点盘，一份吃了一半的甜点，以及一个放在银色托盘上、撒满糖粉的长方形糕点。布置应感觉是随手放置的，而非刻意摆放。

背景：带有大白框玻璃窗的极简主义店面外观。她的倒影在身侧的玻璃中清晰可见，创造出有趣的层次构图。暖灰色和白色的墙壁，微妙的石头和红褐色抛光花岗岩细节，部分可见的金属店铺卷帘门，简单的城市人行道。没有拥挤的街道场景。

摄影：自然的明亮阴天日光，真实的柔和阴影，略显柔和的奶油色调，清晰但不过度处理的细节，真实的皮肤纹理，微妙的数码相机锐度，社论风韩系街拍，休闲咖啡馆约会美学，柔和的中性色调，低调的Y2K影响，真实的织物纹理，照片写实，高分辨率。

构图：全身垂直肖像，主体位于中心略偏右，店面橱窗和倒影占据画面左半部分，长凳横向延伸穿过前景，自然的不对称构图，约3:4的长宽比。

负面提示：影棚背景，豪华餐厅，夜间场景，浓妆，高跟鞋，过于妖艳的姿势，夸张的曲线，塑料皮肤，过度模糊的背景，极端的虚化，扭曲的手，多余的手指，畸形的腿，重复的配件，错误的倒影，漂浮物体，卡通，动漫，插画，CGI，过饱和的色彩。

items.prompt:

The dressing table includes a bronze round mirror, open pearl jewelry box, gold hairpins, pearl chains and a few jade ornaments. Use soft warm-white natural light with gentle side-front fill, shallow background blur and sharp eyes, makeup, jewelry and embroidery. Realistic 85mm portrait photography, delicate skin texture, refined ancient-style beauty portrait and high-end transparent softness. items.title: 奢华名流感黑女巫万圣节镜前自拍
items.description: 豪华黑女巫万圣节镜前自拍时装肖像：成年女性在奶油色大理石浴室中佩戴夸张黑色女巫帽、黑色裙装与歌剧手套，以低光手机摄影呈现早期数码名流派对快照质感。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Ultra-realistic glamorous Halloween mirror selfie of an adult woman in her mid-20s posing in an elegant cream marble bathroom at night, styled as a sophisticated black witch. The image should feel dark, feminine, slightly mysterious, and very early-2000s celebrity Halloween—more luxurious party snapshot than theatrical costume photography.

She has very long straight jet-black hair falling past her waist, worn loose with a sleek center part. Makeup is dramatic but polished: sculpted brows, smoky brown-black eyeshadow, sharp eyeliner, long lashes, softly contoured cheeks, luminous warm skin, and muted nude lips. Her expression is calm and slightly aloof as she looks at her phone screen rather than directly toward the mirror.

Outfit: a fitted black floor-length midi dress with very thin spaghetti straps and a sleek body-skimming silhouette. Add sheer black opera gloves extending above the elbows, made from layered mesh or fine tulle.

The main statement piece is an extravagant oversized black witch hat: extremely tall pointed crown with intentionally irregular, feathery, shredded, or sculptural texture at the top, combined with an enormous asymmetrical floppy brim. Layers of sheer black tulle and gauze trail softly around the brim, giving the hat a dramatic couture Halloween feel rather than a cheap costume look.

Pose: photographed in side profile through the bathroom mirror, torso angled away from the mirror while the face turns back slightly toward it. One hand holds a red smartphone close to the face to take the selfie, while the other gloved hand is lifted palm-up in a playful witch-like gesture. Hips shifted subtly backward, shoulders relaxed, creating a sleek S-shaped silhouette.

Environment: luxurious warm-toned bathroom with cream marble walls, large wall mirror, framed botanical or minimalist artwork arranged vertically, a deep white bathtub in the background, soft Roman blinds over a window, polished stone counters, and warm recessed ceiling lighting. Reflections in the marble and mirror should add depth while keeping the space intimate and residential.

Photography: authentic low-light smartphone mirror selfie, warm tungsten bathroom lighting, slight digital softness, mild grain, subtle noise in the shadows, imperfect white balance, gentle highlight bloom, natural skin texture, understated flash-free exposure, candid celebrity-at-home Halloween aesthetic, photorealistic, high resolution.

Composition: vertical 9:16 frame, woman positioned slightly right of center, dramatic witch hat occupying much of the upper frame, bathroom and bathtub visible behind her, phone partially covering one side of her face, slightly imperfect handheld crop.

Negative prompt: cartoon witch costume, bright orange pumpkins, green face paint, broomstick, fantasy forest, gothic castle, theatrical stage lighting, cheap costume fabric, corset armor, excessive jewelry, neon colors, exaggerated body proportions, plastic skin, distorted hands, extra fingers, malformed hat, duplicated limbs, anime, illustration, CGI.

她留着长过腰际的乌黑直发，自然垂下并带有平滑的中分。妆容夸张但精致：有型的眉毛、烟熏棕黑色眼影、锋利的眼线、长睫毛、柔和的修容、发光的暖色皮肤和暗淡的裸色嘴唇。她的表情平静且略显冷淡，看着手机屏幕而不是直接看镜子。

服装：一件合身的黑色及地吊带裙，带有极细的细肩带和平滑的修身轮廓。加上延伸至肘部以上的叠层黑色歌剧手套，由半叠层网眼或精细薄纱制成。

主要的亮点单品是一顶夸张的特大号黑色女巫帽：极高的尖顶，顶部具有刻意的不规则、羽毛状、破碎感或雕塑感纹理，并结合了巨大的不对称软边帽檐。层层叠层的黑色薄纱和细纱在帽檐周围轻柔地垂下，使这顶帽子具有戏剧性的万圣节高级定制感，而非廉价的服装感。

姿势：通过浴室镜子拍摄侧面轮廓，躯干背离镜子，同时脸部微微转回镜子。一只手拿着一部红色智能手机贴近脸部自拍，另一只戴着手套的手掌心向上抬起，做出俏皮的女巫式手势。臀部微微向后偏移，肩膀放松，营造出流畅的 S 形轮廓。

环境：豪华的暖色调浴室，配有奶油色大理石墙壁、大面镜子、垂直排列的有框植物或极简主义艺术品、背景深处的白色浴缸、窗户上柔和的罗马帘、抛光石材柜台和温暖的嵌入式天花板照明。大理石和镜子中的反射应增加深度，同时保持空间的私密感和居住感。

A clearly adult East Asian woman in her mid-20s stands at a Milan street corner in Via Brera. She has naturally fair skin, refined facial features, silver-grey short wavy hair with precise layered shaping, soft neutral makeup and a small natural beauty mark. Keep natural mature body proportions and a graceful, healthy silhouette without numeric measurements or exaggerated anatomy.

She wears an elegant pale-beige fine cashmere cardigan layered over an opaque light camisole, with the cardigan relaxed and modestly buttoned. Pair it with high-waisted slim tailored light-grey trousers, simple black shoes and minimal jewelry. Add one tiny hollow-ribbon X decorative mark centered just below the collarbone; do not add any other tattoos, symbols or logos. The outfit remains fully wearable, opaque and secure.

She stands with her body slightly turned and looks back toward the camera with an elegant, calm, direct gaze. Frame a medium-full to three-quarter portrait from a slightly low angle, with stone buildings, a visible street sign reading VIA BRERA, luxury boutique windows and cobblestone pavement. Keep distant pedestrians softly out of focus.

Use late-afternoon Milan sunlight mixed with open shade. Warm light shapes the face and cashmere while a faint back-right golden rim traces the hair and shoulders. Use shallow depth of field, crisp skin and knit texture, and a cool-silver and warm-stone color grade. The feeling is refined, restrained luxury street fashion photography, never erotic or vulgar. {
“方向”：这是一张从正上方拍摄的自然光人像，捕捉了日式老式旅馆或民宿房间里一个转瞬即逝的午后瞬间。照片中，五位虚构的二十岁出头到二十岁末的成年女性正躺在榻榻米上休息。重点并非人物的面部，而是人物呈放射状排列，一人居中，四人环绕。她们身着以红白为主的浴衣（夏季和服），榻榻米和米白色被褥，自然光从左侧斜射而入，如同阳光透过树梢洒下。这并非一张女性们排成一排摆拍的集体照，而是一张写实的照片，仿佛是同伴在夏季旅行期间，从高处随意拍摄的，记录了五位女性在房间里聊天或休息的场景。照片中的人物并非任何特定的名人、网红或真实人物。
“氛围”：“夏日午后，一家静谧的旅馆。午餐和沐浴后，两位好友回到房间，穿着浴衣，躺在榻榻米上放松。她们看起来有些困倦，略显慵懒，仿佛刚才的谈话暂时中断了。这不是一张光鲜亮丽的广告照，而是只有朋友才能看到的旅途日常瞬间。温柔而略带怀旧，慵懒惬意，却不带一丝情色或挑逗意味。”
“模特”：“五位成年女性。她们显然都是二十岁出头到三十岁末的成年人。她们是虚构的东亚女性，但并非特指特定人物。这五位女性在面部特征、轮廓、发型、身高、肩宽和体型上都存在自然的个体差异；她们并非被设计成完全相同的复制品。中心人物是视觉主角，但她周围的四位也同样具有很强的存在感。”
“面部”：“自然的成年女性特征。淡雅的日常妆容，自然的眉毛，精致的眼妆，以及不太浓烈的唇色。面部略微不对称，双颊泛起淡淡的红晕，眼神略显疲惫，嘴角也略显放松。并非每个人都露出完美的笑容，画面中心人物的目光略微偏向一侧。周围的人物并没有直视镜头，而是看向中心人物或彼此的表情。”
“头发”：五位模特的头发颜色以黑色到深棕色为主，长度自然各异，从长发到中长发再到齐肩发不等。由于重力作用，斜倚者的头发在榻榻米或蒲团上呈扇形散开，一些发丝垂落在脸颊、额头和耳边。其中不乏因汗水或潮湿而粘连的发丝、凌乱的刘海以及因与枕头摩擦而略显凌乱的头发。这样的发型并非追求广告中那种完美无瑕的效果。
“身体”：展现成年女性的真实体态比例。五位人物在身高、体型、腿长和肩宽上略有不同。中央人物仰卧，其身体的垂直线条贯穿画面中心。周围四位人物姿势各异，有的侧卧，有的微屈，有的蜷缩，构成直线与曲线交错的画面。肩部、锁骨、手臂、部分腹部以及透过衣物可见的腿部，都因人物的姿态和浴衣（和服）的摆放而自然展现，构图并未着重强调任何特定的身体部位。
“皮肤”： “逼真的皮肤纹理。保留了淡淡的毛孔、细微的肤色不均、轻微的泛红和自然的阴影。直接受光区域略亮，而障子门或格栅阴影区域则略暗。五位人物的肤色和光照并非完全一致。在织物接触处，会留下非常细微的压痕和类似温差的自然色差。避免过度美白、瓷器般光滑以及对全身进行统一修饰。”
“服装”：“五人均身着夏季浴衣，主要颜色为红色、白色、藏青色和米白色，但图案和穿着方式各不相同。由于躺卧或蜷缩，他们的领口、肩膀、袖子和下摆自然地略有变化。这些浴衣看起来并没有经过精心整理，反而像是在日式旅馆（传统日式旅馆）待了几个小时后随意散落的。”
“outfit_center”：画面中心人物身着白色至米白色浴衣，内衬白色内衣。人物仰卧，衣领宽松，肩部、锁骨和腹部周围的皮肤在画面中心形成一片相对较大的明亮区域。身形自然地被白色布料和手臂遮盖，腰部周围还残留着一些浴衣布料。肤色和白色布料向上延伸，在画面中心形成一条视觉支柱。
“outfit_upper_left”：左上角的人物身着一件以红白为主色调的浴衣。她侧卧，身体向中间人物的头部倾斜，衣领和一侧肩膀明显敞开，自然地露出肩膀、锁骨和部分手臂。身形被重叠的白色衬里和浴衣遮盖。红白相间的布料从左上角向中心形成一条醒目的斜线。
"outfit_upper_right": "右上角的人穿着一件以红色为主色调的浴衣，上面有白色、藏青色和浅蓝色的日式图案。在五张照片中，这件浴衣的布料最多，露出的皮肤相对较少。大片的红色布料裸露在外，使其成为整张照片的主要色彩点缀。"
“outfit_lower_left”：左下角的人物身穿以白色为主色调，饰以藏青色和紫色图案的浴衣，并系有腰带。她侧卧着，肩部和袖子宽松，下摆也随着她的姿势而移动。画面前景中，她的大腿占据了屏幕左下角的大部分空间，白色的浴衣、肌肤和紫色点缀交相辉映。这条腿本身并非画面主体，而是用来构成前景的。
“outfit_lower_right”：右下角的人物身穿白色底红色日式图案的浴衣。由于她蜷缩着身子，双膝弯曲，一侧肩膀下垂，使她的肩膀、手臂和部分弯曲的腿看起来自然流畅。浴衣的下摆、膝盖和肩膀构成了一个圆润的轮廓，与中间人物笔直的身体形成对比。
“配饰”：“配饰非常简约。只有小耳环、细发圈和简单的发夹。不使用奢华的珠宝、拍照用的大型发饰或过多的日式配饰。”
场景物品：榻榻米、白色或米白色日式床垫、略微起皱的床单、薄被、木制障子门或格子门。床垫因五人之重而自然凹陷，布满褶皱，床单边缘也并非完全对齐。榻榻米边缘、布料褶皱以及小布条或毛巾碎片可置于障子门边缘。小物件不宜过于杂乱，以保持典型客栈的氛围。
“姿势”：中心人物C仰卧，头部向上，身体几乎与屏幕垂直轴线平行，双腿放松并略微分开，面部略微转向左侧。双臂自然地将白色布料置于胸前。左上角人物A从靠近中心人物头部的位置进入，身体从左上角斜向中心延伸。她将头部靠近中心人物，并略微抬起上半身。右上​​角人物B坐着，侧坐或双膝微屈，上半身向中心倾斜。左下角人物D侧卧，头部略微偏向屏幕左侧，腰部和腿部向下延伸，靠近观众的那条腿构成前景。右下角人物E身体略微蜷缩，双膝弯曲，肩膀和背部朝向中心，面部转向中心。五个头部构成一个松散的五边形，但并非完全对称。
“目光”：并非所有人都看向镜头。画面中央的人物略微将目光转向左侧。左上、右上、左下和右下四个人的目光自然而然地被中央人物的脸部、手部或画面中心附近所吸引。这样就形成了一种视线从照片四个角落最终回到中心的结构。避免在合影中常见的众人同时看向镜头的情况。
“重力”：浴衣、头发、袖子、腰带和被褥都会随着人物的姿势和重力而摆动。侧卧时，上衣的领口和袖子会略微远离身体，下摆的布料会被挤压在身体和被褥之间，产生褶皱。仰卧时，头发会向两侧散开，浴衣的布料会垂落到身体中央，环绕腰部。屈膝时，浴衣的下摆会沿着膝盖的形状向上卷起。这不仅仅是对“凌乱的衣物”的描绘，而是对每块布料如何随着姿势而运动的描述，使人能够直观地理解其运动规律。
“照明”：主要光源是午后透过左侧障子门或窗户照射进来的自然光。色温为中性日光，约为4500-5200K，并非像日落时分那样强烈的橙色。光线被障子门的格栅、窗框以及窗外的枝叶遮挡，形成如同阳光穿过树梢般的细条和不规则图案，斜射在人物、浴衣、被褥和榻榻米上。尤其在屏风下半部分，有几条明亮的斜向光带，左下角的人物以及中间人物腿部周围的区域光线较为强烈。右上角则略显昏暗。
“光照行为”：五个人的面部光照并不均匀。有些人的脸颊一侧只有一束光线照射，有些人的整张脸都笼罩在柔和的阴影中，还有些人只有肩膀被照亮。白色浴衣和床单的部分区域略微过曝，阴影部分没有完全提亮，导致一些细节模糊。这种曝光差异仿佛是自然光和室内微弱环境光混合而成。
“色彩”：“整体配色方案中，肤色约占40-45%，白色/米白色约占25-30%，红色约占10-15%，榻榻米和木材则使用米色/棕色约占15%。少量紫色、藏青色和浅蓝色用作辅助点缀。红色在五人身上的分布并不均匀，右上角的红色浴衣是其中色彩最浓郁的部分。”
“效果”：“饱和度略低于中等。对比度柔和，锐度细腻，胶片颗粒感极弱。暗部有少量数码噪点，亮部有轻微光晕。整幅图像并非完全复古处理，而是对现代数码照片进行轻微调整，使其具有胶片质感。保留了皮肤纹理，避免了过度人工智能式的超高清处理。”
“摄像机”：摄像机几乎正位于五人站位的中心正上方。据推测，摄像机与人群中心垂直距离约为1.5至2米。焦距相当于28至35毫米，并非超广角镜头。摄像机倾斜角度约为0至5度。画面中包含了五人以及部分榻榻米/被褥，其中人物占据了画面的大部分。景深适中，光圈估计在f/4至f/5.6之间，可以同时清晰地呈现五人和榻榻米/被褥的细节。在ISO 400至800左右，暗部区域略有噪点。快门速度约为1/125秒时，没有明显的运动模糊，但头发和指尖略微有些柔和。
“相机感”：与其说是专业时尚摄影，不如说是旅行中随手拍摄的自然数码快照。俯视构图是经过精心设计的，但地平线并非完全水平；1-2度的轻微倾斜是可以接受的。人物的位置也略微偏离了几厘米。没有使用过度的背景虚化和电影式的变形效果。
“瑕疵”：被褥有细微的褶皱、人体重量造成的压痕以及下垂。浴衣袖口不对称，腰带略微松弛，以及布料重叠造成的复杂褶皱。有几缕散落的头发。榻榻米颜色不均，并有磨损痕迹。面部略微不对称，表情不够完美。画面边缘不如中心清晰，镜头造成的轻微畸变和色差属于正常范围。暗部有轻微的颗粒感。白色布料部分区域有少量过曝。与其将所有瑕疵都刻意强调，不如让它们保持在真实照片中自然存在的范围内。
“背景”：“一间典型的日式客房，位于一家略显老旧的旅馆或民宿中。榻榻米并非全新，略有褪色和磨损痕迹。障子门和木框都很简洁，没有豪华旅馆那种繁复的装饰。墙壁是米白色或浅米色。室内装潢并不奢华，房间给人一种温馨舒适的感觉，午后自然光线柔和宜人。这里没有大理石、LED间接照明、名牌家具或奢华的金色屏风。”
“氛围”：“窗外是明媚的夏日，但日式房间内光线略显昏暗。榻榻米干燥的质感、柔软褶皱的浴衣、棉质的被褥、透过障子门洒下的阳光，都营造出一种静谧放松的氛围。我们更注重打造真实酒店客房的质感，而非摄影棚的风格。”
“构图”：竖幅比例为4:5或2:3。中心人物C位于画面中央，头部→肩部→躯干→腰部→和腿部的线条构成照片的主轴。A位于左上角，B位于右上角，D位于左下角，E位于右下角，围绕中心人物C呈放射状排列。五张脸的位置大致构成一个不规则的五边形。A的身体从左上角向下延伸至中心，形成一条对角线；B的红色浴衣在右上角起到点缀作用；D的侧脸和腿部在左下角构成较大的前景；E蜷缩的姿势则为右下角的曲线增添了一抹色彩。四个角落的人物并非完全对称，它们的大小、角度和距离略有不同。色彩构图以中心人物的白色和肤色垂直平面为中心，周围环绕着红色和白色。浴衣。”
“构图”：“请勿人为地截去人物的头部或主要肢体。但浴衣下摆、被褥或脚尖等部位自然地超出画面是可以接受的。请勿将人物过于紧凑地置于照片中央，应在榻榻米或被褥周围留出足够的空间。如果想要还原原图顶部和底部的深白色区域，请将照片置于竖幅画布的中央，并在顶部和底部添加宽阔的黑色或深炭白色区域。”
“真实感优先”：重要性顺序为：1. 恰好五位成年女性；2. 俯视视角；3. 中心一人，周围四人呈放射状排列；4. 中心人物的垂直身形线条；5. 每个人穿着不同的红白浴衣，且穿着方式各异；6. 日式房间、榻榻米和米白色被褥；7. 从左侧斜射入的自然光；8. 周围四人目光汇聚于中心；9. 不对称的姿态和织物的自然垂坠感；10. 柔和的胶片色调和留下阴影的曝光效果。
“负面”：四人、六人、人数变化、所有人长着同一张脸、双胞胎般的脸、所有人都看着镜头、所有人摆着同样的姿势、完全对称、以中心人物为坐姿的构图、侧身拍摄、强烈的低角度、鱼眼镜头、极端的超广角畸变、人物间手臂和腿部融合、额外的肢体、扭曲的手指、浴衣图案延伸到其他人身上、衣服不自然地贴在身上、面料违反物理定律、五个人曝光量相同、衣着完美、露骨的肢体语言、挑逗性的姿势、暴露重要部位、疑似未成年人、娃娃般的脸、塑料般的皮肤、过度修图、过度HDR、均匀照亮所有人的影棚灯光、过度背景虚化、豪华旅馆、豪华酒店、大理石、过于整齐的床铺、过度的电影特效、酷似真人或名人的面孔
}

items.title: 阳光明媚公园路径漫步的侧编发少女
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

A photorealistic outdoor lifestyle portrait of an adult woman in her mid-20s walking along a peaceful tree-lined park pathway on a bright sunny day. She has long dark hair styled in a neat side braid, secured with a soft cream-colored bow, with a few delicate strands framing her face. She wears small elegant earrings and a simple bracelet.
She is dressed in a casual white graphic T-shirt featuring a delicate red illustration and text, paired with a flowing white tiered skirt. A brown leather shoulder bag hangs naturally from her shoulder. She gently rests one hand against her cheek while tilting her head slightly toward the camera, smiling softly with a sweet, relaxed expression.
The background features a beautiful green park with tall leafy trees, palm-like foliage, neatly trimmed bushes, and a paved pathway extending into the distance. Bright blue sky visible through the tree canopy, warm natural sunlight, soft highlights and dappled shadows, subtle lens flare.
Natural smartphone photography, candid travel aesthetic, realistic skin texture, detailed hair strands, authentic fabric and leather textures, shallow depth of field, soft background bokeh, vibrant yet natural colors, peaceful summer atmosphere, highly photorealistic.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

一张写实的户外生活方式肖像，一位年轻女性在阳光明媚的日子里沿着宁静的树木繁茂的公园小径行走。她留着长长的黑发，梳成整齐的侧边辫子，用柔软的奶油色蝴蝶结固定，几缕精致的发丝修饰着她的脸庞。她戴着精美的小耳环和一只简单的手镯。
她穿着一件休闲的白色印花T恤，上面有精致的红色插图和文字，搭配一条飘逸的白色蛋糕裙。一个棕色皮革单肩包自然地挂在她的肩膀上。她轻轻地将一只手靠在脸颊上，同时头微微向镜头倾斜，带着甜美、放松的表情温柔地微笑着。
背景是一个美丽的绿色公园，有高大的茂密树木、棕榈状植物、修剪整齐的灌木丛，以及延伸到远处的铺砌小径。透过树冠可以看到湛蓝的天空，温暖的自然阳光，柔和的高光和斑驳的阴影，微妙的镜头光晕。
自然智能手机摄影，随性旅行美学，真实的皮肤纹理，细腻的发丝，真实的织物和皮革纹理，浅景深，柔和的背景虚化，鲜艳而自然的色彩，宁静的夏天氛围，高度写实。

items.title: 超写实Y2K粉色卧室少女时尚写真
items.description: Y2K 粉色卧室成年女性时装抓拍：铂金短刘海、酒红星纹毛衣、复古杂志、迪斯科球和毛绒床面共同营造怀旧的早期数码相机编辑氛围。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Ultra-realistic playful Y2K bedroom fashion photo of an adult woman in her mid-20s lounging on a fluffy bubblegum-pink faux-fur bedspread in a highly stylized pink room, surrounded by magazines, plush toys, disco balls, and retro accessories. The overall mood is dreamy, girly, nostalgic, and slightly kitschy—like an early-2000s teen magazine editorial.

She has long straight platinum-blonde hair with soft blunt bangs, styled with two black star-shaped hair clips placed near the top of her head. Fresh doll-like makeup with softly defined eyes, rosy cheeks, pale pink lips, and a calm, slightly serious expression as she looks downward at a fuzzy pink notebook or diary.

Outfit: an oversized deep burgundy-red fuzzy sweater with large turquoise-blue star motifs, worn loosely over the body. Pair it with sheer black tights and simple dark shoes or ankle boots, mostly hidden by the pose and bed. The styling should feel cozy, playful, and very Y2K.

Pose: lying on her stomach across the pink furry bed, upper body propped up on her elbows while reading or flipping through a fluffy pale-pink diary. One leg is bent upward at the knee while the other extends more casually behind her. Relaxed, absorbed body language, as if she is quietly reading in her room.

Environment: maximalist pastel-pink bedroom with pink walls, shiny silver disco balls, glittery tinsel curtains, a large soft pink teddy bear sitting nearby, retro electronics, small decorative boxes, and playful clutter. Scatter pastel magazines, notebooks, photo books, pens, and paper items across the furry bed in the foreground. Add a few glossy metallic and transparent decorative objects for texture.

Include a full-length or large wall mirror that creates a subtle reflection of the scene, adding layered depth. The room should feel intentionally styled but still lived-in and slightly messy.

Lighting: warm pink ambient light mixed with soft flash or compact-camera illumination, gentle reflective highlights from disco balls and metallic surfaces, slightly blown pink tones, mild grain, low-fi early-digital-camera texture, soft shadows, nostalgic 2000s teen-bedroom atmosphere.

Photography: candid editorial snapshot, vertical framing, slightly elevated camera angle from the foot or side of the bed, subject placed toward the upper-left/center, magazines filling the foreground, realistic skin and fabric texture, mild digital noise, imperfect composition, photorealistic, high resolution.

Negative prompt: minimalist bedroom, neutral beige décor, luxury hotel, modern clean influencer room, mature formal styling, dramatic cinematic lighting, heavy glamour makeup, sleek corporate fashion, empty bed, monochrome palette, plastic skin, exaggerated anatomy, distorted legs, extra fingers, duplicated magazines, cartoon, anime, illustration, CGI.

超写实且俏皮的Y2K卧室时尚照片，一位成年女性躺在高度风格化的粉色房间里蓬松的泡泡糖粉色人造毛皮床罩上，周围环绕着杂志、毛绒玩具、迪斯科球和复古配件。整体氛围梦幻、少女、怀旧且略带俗艳——就像2000年代早期的青少年杂志社论。

她留着长直的铂金色头发和柔软的齐刘海，头顶上方别着两个黑色星形发夹。清新如人偶般的妆容，眼部轮廓柔和，脸颊红润，嘴唇呈淡粉色，神情冷静而略显严肃，正低头看着一本毛茸茸的粉色笔记本或日记。

服饰：一件大号深酒红色毛绒毛衣，上面带有大颗绿松石蓝色的五角星图案，松松地穿在身上。搭配黑色叠层连裤袜和简单的深色鞋子或短靴，这些大部分被姿势和床遮挡。造型应当感觉舒适、俏皮且非常Y2K。

姿势：趴在粉色毛茸茸的床上，上身用肘部撑起，正在阅读或翻阅一本浅粉色毛绒日记。一条腿在膝盖处向上弯曲，另一条腿则自然地伸展在身后。放松、专注的肢体语言，仿佛她正安静地在房间里阅读。

包含一面全身镜或大墙镜，营造出场景的微妙反射，增加层次感。房间应感觉是精心设计的，但仍有生活气息且略显凌乱。

items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已整理为绑定统一人物参考的成人街拍时尚人像模板。保留首尔圣水洞工业咖啡馆、白衬衫领带、黑色亮面皮裤、蓝天硬光、倾斜构图与 VHS 模拟磁带质感。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Preserve the adult identity, streetwear styling, pose, composition, lighting and VHS texture unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Single 9:16 vertical knee-up street-fashion portrait in Seoul Seongsu-dong. A clearly adult East Asian woman leans naturally toward a nearby handheld camera from a friend-like companion viewpoint. Use a slightly tilted frame and a 35mm lens with a human-scale natural perspective. Her head faces the camera; her hands stay relaxed, her legs cross naturally, and one hip rests against an existing waist-height edge with partial body-weight support.

She wears medium smooth hoop earrings, a short gold curb-link necklace at collarbone level, a white collared shirt with a short soft necktie, low-rise black gloss leather trousers, and a wide leather hip belt with an off-center buckle. Keep the outfit structured and fully wearable. Her hair is natural black, long and softly wavy with a deep side part, face-framing layers, restrained volume and a few aligned loose strands. Give her a playful mock-angry expression with lightly furrowed brows, a small pout and a restrained smile.

Set the scene at an industrial cafe frontage and concrete urban corner in Seoul Seongsu-dong. Use clear blue-sky daylight, saturated azure sky, hard direct sunlight and crisp shadow edges. Compose with spacious documentary street-photography language. Add a shallow f/2-style separation, subtle 1/15-second motion drag on both subject and surroundings, blurred foreground occlusion near a frame edge, a thick near-field bokeh veil and a clear opening toward the subject.

Apply VHS camcorder degradation: analog tape noise, scanlines, color bleeding and restrained chromatic aberration. Keep the face, clothing structure and hands legible. Generate one coherent image, not a contact sheet or multiple options. No children, nudity, wardrobe failure, exact body measurements, extra limbs, distorted hands, unreadable text, logos, watermarks, or excessive blur.

她佩戴中号平滑圆环耳环、位于锁骨水平的短款金色古巴链项链，穿白色翻领衬衫和短款柔软领带、低腰黑色亮面皮革长裤，以及带偏心扣的宽皮革臀部腰带。服装保持结构清晰且正常穿着。头发为自然黑色，长发柔和卷曲并深侧分，带修饰脸型的层次、克制发量和少量整齐松散发丝。表情俏皮又像假装生气，眉头轻皱，小幅撅嘴并带克制微笑。

场景是首尔圣水洞的工业咖啡馆门面与混凝土城市街角。使用晴朗蓝天日光、饱和蔚蓝天空、主体上的硬直射光和清晰阴影边缘。采用宽阔的纪实街拍构图语言，加入 f/2 风格的浅景深分离、约 1/15 秒造成的主体与环境轻微拖影、靠近镜头边缘的模糊前景遮挡、厚重近场焦外虚化面纱，以及朝向人物的清晰开口。

加入 VHS 摄像机退化质感：模拟磁带噪点、扫描线、色彩溢出和克制的色差。保持脸部、服装结构和手部清晰可辨。生成一张连贯的单图，不要拼图或多个选项。不要儿童、裸露、衣物穿模或滑落、精确身材数字、多余肢体、手部变形、乱码文字、logo、水印或过度模糊。

items.title: 午后开放式厨房成年女性 iPhone 生活肖像
items.description: 16:9 午后居家生活肖像：成年女性穿浅杏方领上衣与奶白家居裙侧坐餐椅，安静看向咖啡杯，开放式厨房和自然午后光保留真实居住感。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Preserve the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with that identity reference.

Create a 16:9 landscape realistic home-lifestyle photograph of a clearly adult woman captured with an ordinary iPhone main camera. The main visible subject is an adult Eastern woman visually aged about 20–26, with natural clear features, a soft oval or subtly tapered face, clear almond eyes, balanced nose and lips, slight facial asymmetry and realistic skin texture. Her mood is gentle, relaxed, quiet and pensive, like a brief moment of zoning out alone at home on an ordinary afternoon. Use only light makeup and fair natural skin without porcelain filters, smoothing or plastic texture. Her black or dark-brown long hair is casually tied up with a few loose strands around the face and ears.

She wears a light-apricot square-neck fitted short-sleeve top in soft ribbed knit with believable small wrinkles, paired with a cream or pale-beige soft low-waist home skirt that is light, natural and lived-in. Keep the palette light and soft against natural skin; this is a home snapshot, not a fashion campaign.

Seat her sideways on a wooden dining chair with clear stable weight support, leaning back slightly. One hand rests naturally on the dining table edge and the other rests by the leg or chair side. Both legs angle to one side and extend comfortably, with natural knees and feet rather than a complex crossed pose. Her gaze falls near the coffee cup on the table, not directly at the camera, capturing a quiet daydreaming moment. Ensure the weight relationship through feet, knees, pelvis, spine and shoulders is natural, with no floating or distortion.

Set the scene where a small-apartment dining table connects to an open kitchen. Show a wooden table, ordinary chairs, cabinets, stove, refrigerator, window-side plants, storage rack, tissue box, cups, vase and a few everyday items. Keep the room clean but lived-in, not a show house or studio. Place one everyday coffee cup on the table with optional tissue box, frame and scattered small objects, without arranging a commercial still life.

Use soft afternoon daylight from the kitchen or dining-room window. Give natural highlights to the face, neck, arms and legs while retaining local shadows, real contrast and slight exposure imperfections. No strong photography lights, softboxes, commercial rim light, cinematic lighting or excessive HDR. Use a 24–28mm equivalent phone view with ordinary auto exposure and white balance, slight phone sharpening and noise, allowing a little local softness and imperfect horizon. Keep the subject, table and kitchen background relatively readable; do not use portrait mode, large-aperture background blur or commercial retouching.

Negative constraints: no minors, pornography or explicit sexualized presentation, commercial fashion shoot, studio retouching, influencer filters, exaggerated body, exaggerated S-shape, twisted-waist posing, incorrect seated anatomy, deformed soles or toes, wrong fingers, mirrored misalignment, strong depth-of-field blur, fake lighting, anime, CG, text, logo, watermark or extra people.

以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创作一张 16:9 横幅、真实 iPhone 普通主摄拍摄的成年女性生活感照片。主可见人物是视觉年龄约 20–26 岁、明确成年的东方女性，五官自然清晰，柔和椭圆或轻微瓜子脸，清亮杏眼，鼻唇比例自然，保留轻微面部不对称和真实皮肤纹理。她气质温柔、松弛、安静、若有所思，像普通午后独自在家时短暂放空；妆容轻淡，皮肤白皙自然，不使用瓷白滤镜、磨皮或塑料质感。黑色或深棕色长发随意挽起，脸侧和耳边留少量碎发，保持居家状态。

服装为浅杏色方领修身短袖上衣，柔软罗纹针织面料，贴合身体但有真实轻微褶皱；下身为奶白或浅米白柔软低腰家居短裙，轻薄、自然、有少量生活痕迹。服装颜色清淡柔和，与自然肤色形成低对比，不做时装大片造型。

人物侧坐在木质餐椅上，坐姿受力清晰，身体略微向后靠；一只手自然放在餐桌边缘，另一只手放在腿边或椅侧，双腿朝一侧放松伸展，膝盖和脚部方向自然，不交叉成复杂姿势。她看向桌边咖啡杯附近而不是镜头，呈现安静发呆的瞬间。重点保证脚底、膝盖、骨盆、脊柱和肩膀的受力自然，不悬空、不扭曲。

场景为小户型餐桌与开放式厨房连接的真实居家空间：木质餐桌、普通餐椅、橱柜、灶台、冰箱、窗边绿植、收纳架、纸巾盒、杯子、花瓶和少量生活物品自然出现。空间干净但有居住痕迹，不像样板间或摄影棚。桌面有一只日常咖啡杯，可搭配纸巾盒、相框和零散小物件，但不要摆成商业静物布景。

使用厨房或餐厅窗户透入的柔和午后自然光，人物面部、肩颈、手臂和腿部出现自然高光，同时保留局部阴影、真实明暗差和轻微曝光不完美。室内不开强摄影灯，不使用柔光箱、商业轮廓光、电影布光或过度 HDR。采用 24–28mm 等效手机广角、普通自动曝光和自动白平衡，轻微手机锐化与噪点，允许少量轻微失焦和非完美水平线；人物、餐桌与厨房背景都保持较清晰，不使用人像模式、大光圈背景虚化或商业精修。

负面约束：不要未成年人、色情或露骨性化呈现、商业写真、影棚精修、网红滤镜、夸张身材、夸张 S 型、扭腰摆拍、错误坐姿、脚掌或脚趾畸形、错误手指、镜像错位、强景深虚化、假光影、动漫、CG、文字、Logo、水印或额外人物。

items.title: 照片极简墨线小插画
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Create ONE refined PHOTO + MINIMAL INK VIGNETTE artwork based ONLY on the uploaded photograph.

FORMAT: Vertical 3:4.

### TOP — ORIGINAL PHOTO
Use approximately the upper 48–50% for the original photograph.

Preserve the photo faithfully and photorealistically. Do not redraw, beautify, replace, remove, duplicate, or invent important elements.

Preserve:
- people, animals, faces, clothing, poses and gestures
- food and objects
- buildings and environment
- perspective, lighting, colors and atmosphere

Only crop or scale proportionally when necessary.

### BOTTOM — MINIMAL INK VIGNETTE
Use a warm ivory / natural off-white paper background.

Study THIS photograph independently and identify the ONE main visual subject or small group that best represents the moment.

Illustrate only what matters. Remove roughly 70–90% of unnecessary background detail.

Recognition should come mainly from:
silhouette + shape + color + pose + 1–3 distinctive details.

Keep the illustration relatively small with generous negative space.

### STYLE
Vintage editorial / classic printed vignette.

Use:
- thin controlled dark-ink outlines
- slightly imperfect hand-drawn contours
- simple geometric forms
- restrained flat colors
- subtle tonal variation
- minimal texture
- soft grounding shadow
- clean shape separation

Keep it charming, graphic, tidy, nostalgic and understated.

Use fewer strokes than a detailed sketch.

Avoid:
photorealistic illustration, watercolor, painterly brushwork, dense sketching, cross-hatching, excessive outlines, comic-book style, anime/chibi, 3D rendering, vector-perfect geometry, or unnecessary tiny details.

### TITLE + CAPTION
Above the illustration, create:

ONE short editorial title: approximately 2–4 words, inspired specifically by the photograph.

ONE micro-caption: approximately 3–8 words, natural and understated.

Never use generic titles such as “Beautiful Moment,” “Sweet Memories,” or “Wonderful Day.”

If a recognizable place, landmark, food, brand, event, or subject is clearly visible, its real name may be used. Never guess.

### INDEX
Add a tiny bottom-right label based on the main subject:

- Food/drink → PLATE NO. 01
- Animal → PORTRAIT NO. 01
- Person/group → MOMENT NO. 01
- Place/architecture/landscape → VIEW NO. 01
- Object/miscellaneous → STUDY NO. 01

For a person + pet, normally use MOMENT NO. 01.

### FINAL FEEL
A beautifully curated personal visual archive:

REAL PHOTOGRAPH ABOVE 
+ SIMPLIFIED MEMORY BELOW 
+ SHORT EDITORIAL TITLE 
+ TINY HUMAN CAPTION 
+ ADAPTIVE INDEX

Quiet, minimal, collectible, elegant, and consistent.

IMPORTANT: Analyze every uploaded photograph independently. Never carry over subjects, objects, locations, colors, captions, or details from previous images.

格式：纵向 3:4。

### 顶部 —— 原始照片
使用大约上方 48–50% 的区域放置原始照片。

忠实且写实地保留照片。不要重绘、美化、替换、删除、复制或捏造重要元素。

仅在必要时进行裁剪或等比例缩放。

### 底部 —— 简约水墨装饰画
使用温暖的象牙色/自然的米白色纸张背景。

独立研究这张照片，并确定最能代表那一刻的一个主要视觉主体或一小群主体。

仅描绘重要的部分。移除大约 70–90% 不必要的背景细节。

识别度应主要源于：
轮廓 + 形状 + 颜色 + 姿势 + 1–3 个独特细节。

保持插图相对较小，留有大量的留白。

### 风格
复古编辑风格 / 经典的印刷装饰画。

使用：
- 纤细受控的深色墨水轮廓
- 略显不完美的轻微手绘轮廓
- 简单的几何形状
- 克制的平面色彩
- 微妙的色调变化
- 极简的纹理
- 柔和的落地阴影
- 清晰的形状分离

保持其迷人、图形化、整洁、怀旧且内敛。

使用比详细素描更少的笔触。

避免：
写实插画、水彩、绘画般的笔触、密集的素描、交叉排线、过多的轮廓、漫画风格、动漫/Q版、3D 渲染、完美的矢量几何或不必要的微小细节。

### 标题 + 说明
在插图上方，创建：

一个简短的编辑标题：大约 2–4 个单词，灵感特别源自照片。

一个微型说明：大约 3–8 个单词，自然且内敛。

绝不使用通用标题，如 “Beautiful Moment”、“Sweet Memories” 或 “Wonderful Day”。

如果清晰可见可辨认的地点、地标、食物、品牌、事件或主体，可以使用其真实名称。绝不猜测。

### 索引
根据主要主体在右下角添加一个微小的标签：

- 食物/饮料 → PLATE NO. 01
- 动物 → PORTRAIT NO. 01
- 人物/群体 → MOMENT NO. 01
- 地点/建筑/景观 → VIEW NO. 01
- 物品/杂项 → STUDY NO. 01

对于人物 + 宠物，通常使用 MOMENT NO. 01。

### 最终感觉
一个精美策展的个人视觉档案：

上方是真实照片 
+ 下方是简化记忆 
+ 简短的编辑标题 
+ 微型的人文说明 
+ 自适应索引

安静、极简、具收藏价值、优雅且一致。

重要提示：独立分析每一张上传的照片。绝不沿用之前图像中的主体、物体、地点、颜色、说明或细节。

items.title: 清晨洗手间刷牙日常快照
items.description: 9:16 成年女性清晨刷牙镜中快照：镜面反射中的人物清晰，左下保留相机侧实像虚化，蓝色宽松衬衫、住宅浴室晨光和细微镜面水痕构成自然生活感。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a realistic 9:16 vertical morning snapshot of a clearly adult woman brushing her teeth in an ordinary home bathroom. It should feel like one frame casually captured from a short social-video clip through a mirror, not an advertisement, posed portrait, or typical selfie. The reflected woman is the clear subject; part of the camera-side shoulder or upper arm enters the lower-left foreground as soft blur. Do not show her holding the phone.

She has a slightly elongated oval face, dark-brown eyes, natural brows, small natural lips partly opened by the toothbrush, and a calm sleepy expression while looking near her own reflection. Her dark-brown hair is loosely tied high at the back, with wispy front pieces and stray strands around the cheeks and ears. Preserve natural adult proportions, skin texture, slight tone variation, and minimal makeup.

She wears a low-saturation sax-blue oversized button-down shirt in thin soft cotton. The lower buttons stay fastened while a few upper buttons are open, making a relaxed everyday collar; one shoulder sits lower and the shirt falls with natural wrinkles. The opening is incidental to morning preparation, not a body-display pose. She holds a slender white-to-pale-blue toothbrush at her mouth; place only 2-4 simple dental-care items on the vanity.

Use an ordinary residential bathroom with white-to-light-gray walls, a simple towel rack, a gray-white towel, a muted light-brown wooden door at the far right, and a clean but lived-in vanity. Soft daylight enters from the left and mixes with weak bathroom light. Keep a low-saturation, slightly cool morning atmosphere and gentle face and shirt shadows; no cinematic rim light or stage lighting.

Use a phone-video framing near 9:16, a 0.8-1.3m subject-to-mirror distance, and a natural 35-50mm field of view. Focus near the reflected face and toothbrush, framing from head to near waist so the shirt, toothbrush, and bathroom context remain together. Preserve tiny handheld tilt, uneven collar and shirt wrinkles, stray hair, faint wiping marks or fog on the mirror, and an unfinished daily-life feeling.

Integrate the exact text '@Live_life_style' as a subtle natural mark on the mirror, never as a floating digital overlay. Let faint irregular wiping lines near the lower-right mirror edge form the readable layer, with hidden echoes in droplets, mist, and wiping traces. Keep it much lower contrast than the person and away from the face, collar opening, toothbrush, and lower-left blur.

Negative: underage appearance, celebrity resemblance, nudity, private exposure, provocative pose, chest-focused framing, extreme clothing opening, exaggerated proportions, deliberate smile, direct lens gaze, standard phone-in-mirror selfie, luxury-hotel bathroom, clutter, strong flash, neon, HDR, plastic skin, heavy retouching, distorted hands, extra limbs, captions, subtitles, floating text, bright digital logo, or detached watermark. --ar 9:16
