创作一张写实的 9:16 纵向清晨生活快照：一位明确成年的女性在普通住宅洗手间刷牙。画面像通过镜子从社交短视频中随意截取的一帧，而不是广告、摆拍肖像或典型镜子自拍。镜中女性是清晰主体，左下前景进入一部分相机侧肩部或上臂并柔焦；不要让她手持手机。

女性保持自然成年比例，脸部略呈纵长卵形，深棕色眼睛、自然眉毛和小巧自然的嘴唇，牙刷在嘴边使嘴唇微微张开；她看向镜中自己脸部附近而不是镜头，表情安静困倦。深棕色头发在后脑稍高位置松散扎起，额前有轻薄碎发，脸颊和耳侧保留几缕散发。保留自然肤质、细微肤色差异和极简妆容。

她穿低饱和萨克斯蓝宽松纽扣衬衫，面料为柔软薄棉。下方纽扣保持扣好，上方少量纽扣解开，形成日常放松的领口；一侧肩膀略低，衬衫随着重力自然下垂并产生褶皱。领口敞开只是早晨准备时的偶然状态，不构成展示身体的姿势。她将细身白色至浅蓝色牙刷放在嘴边，洗面台上只放 2–4 件简单牙具。

场景是普通住宅洗手间：白色至浅灰墙面、简易毛巾架、略带灰色的白毛巾、右侧远处低饱和浅棕木门和整洁但有生活痕迹的洗面台。柔和日光从左侧进入，与微弱室内灯混合。保持低饱和、略偏清冷的清晨空气感和温和阴影，不加入电影边缘光或舞台灯。

相机使用约 9:16 的手机纵视频画面，人物与镜面距离 0.8–1.3 米，画角接近 35–50mm；焦点落在镜中脸部和牙刷附近，从头部拍到腰部附近，让衬衫、牙刷和浴室环境处于同一生活场景。保留轻微手持倾斜、不均匀领口和衬衫褶皱、散发、镜面淡淡擦痕或雾气，以及前后几秒视频般的未完成感。

将精确文本“@Live_life_style”作为镜面上的自然细痕融入，绝不做悬浮数字叠加。用镜面右下附近淡淡、不规则的擦拭线条形成可读层，并让水滴、薄雾和擦痕中隐约呼应字母结构。水印对比度必须远低于人物，且避开脸部、领口、牙刷和左下虚化。

避免：未成年外观、类似名人的脸、裸体、私密部位暴露、挑逗姿势、聚焦胸部、极端衣领开口、夸张身体比例、刻意微笑、直视镜头、标准手机镜自拍、豪华酒店浴室、杂乱、强闪光、霓虹、HDR、塑料肌肤、过度美颜、手部变形、多余肢体、字幕、悬浮文字、明亮数字 logo 或脱离材质的水印。--ar 9:16

items.title: 秋季窗台复古数码相机风格人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the clearly adult main visible person. Preserve the source identity, exact facial structure, proportions, pose, outfit, accessories, composition, lighting, camera character, and the single physical wine-label text unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a high-detail photorealistic adult portrait in an authentic early-2000s Y2K compact-camera style, 3:4 vertical. The woman sits sideways inside a wide-open cottage window during late-autumn blue hour, close and visually dominant. Both knees are loosely drawn toward her torso at different heights; lower legs descend diagonally to the exterior ledge, with both bare feet resting naturally on the surface. Her torso curves gently toward camera-left and one shoulder sits slightly lower. Her camera-left arm reaches toward the open window panel, fingertips resting near a stemmed wineglass on the sill; her other forearm rests loosely across the raised knee with naturally curled fingers. Exactly two connected arms and two realistic hands.

Turn her face into a clean three-quarter profile toward camera-left, crown tilted about 7 degrees toward camera-right and chin lifted about 3 degrees. Her relaxed eyes look through the open window and her lips make a playful kiss toward the cool autumn air. Keep a softly raised cheek, relaxed jaw, and spontaneous affectionate expression.

Give her warm beige-blonde hair with dimensional darker roots, loose center part, wispy face-framing strands, and a relaxed low segmented braid-ponytail over the camera-right shoulder. Keep believable density, loosened sections, tapered ends, fine flyaways, and narrow warm highlights. She wears an oversized fuzzy navy-and-cream striped sweater with a wide round neckline, broad zigzag-edged horizontal stripes, dropped shoulders, voluminous sleeves, thick ribbed cuffs partly covering the hands, and visible mohair-like fibers. Pair it with relaxed light-wash straight-leg jeans, natural knee folds, softly stacked hems, authentic denim texture, bare feet with glossy deep-blue toenails, small gold hoops, delicate rings, and deep-burgundy manicure.

Show polished profile makeup: sculpted feathered brows, champagne shimmer, brown outer-corner definition, elongated brown eyeliner, separated lashes, peach-rose blush, localized cheekbone highlight, and high-shine rosy-nude lips. Use warm medium-beige skin with healthy reddish undertones, realistic pores, warm midtones, clean profile shadows, and controlled reflections without oily or waxy skin.

Set the cozy cottage window among weathered sage-green siding and warm terracotta roof tiles. Copper, amber, and rust maple branches enter the upper and side edges; fallen leaves rest on the roof and exterior ledge. Inside are warm table lamps, woven pendant light, bookshelves, cream curtains, wood flooring, and a pale sofa. A clear stemmed wineglass sits on the camera-left sill. A dark glass wine bottle stands on camera-right with exactly one small refined cream label reading lowercase "chryzleen"; no other instance of that word appears anywhere.

Mix cool blue-hour daylight from outside with warm tungsten interior light. Use controlled direct compact-camera fill flash to lift face, sweater fibers, hands, jeans, and feet without overpowering the room. Keep narrow reflections on glassware, bottle, jewelry, painted wood, glossy lips, and hair. Preserve punchy navy, cream, denim blue, amber, terracotta, and copper foliage with clean shadows.

Use a straight level handheld chest-height frame with no Dutch tilt, minimal sky, feet near the lower edge, and the open window as a strong frame around the woman. Let her occupy about 88% of the frame height while enough interior and autumn foliage establishes the setting. Use crisp CCD rendering, true color, local contrast, slight localized highlight clipping, controlled bloom, subtle JPEG compression, and no facial softness. Avoid changed outfit or pose, wrong legs or balance, extra or malformed limbs, duplicated glass or bottle, spilled wine, altered identity, flat or helmet hair, weak makeup, oily or plastic skin, muddy colors, cinematic grading, DSLR bokeh, modern smartphone HDR, film grain, heavy noise, distant or tiny subject, excess headroom, floating typography, watermarks, oversized logos, sweater text, or more than one physical "chryzleen" label. 3:4 vertical.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的参考图作为明确成年主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源身份、精确面部结构、比例、姿势、服装、配饰、构图、光线、相机质感以及唯一实体酒标文字。

创作一张高细节照片级写实的成年女性人像，采用真实的 2000 年代早期 Y2K 紧凑型数码相机质感，3:4 竖版。女子在深秋蓝调时刻侧坐于乡村小屋的宽敞开窗内，人物靠近镜头并占据视觉主导。双膝以不同高度松散抬向躯干，下腿向外部窗台对角延伸，双脚自然放在窗台表面。躯干向相机左侧轻弯，一个肩膀略低。相机左臂伸向打开的窗板，指尖靠近窗台上的带梗酒杯；另一侧前臂松散搭在抬起的膝盖上，手指自然弯曲。必须只有两条连接正常的手臂和两只真实的手。

脸转向相机左侧，形成干净的三分之二侧脸；头顶向相机右侧倾斜约 7°，下巴抬起约 3°。放松的眼睛望向窗外，嘴唇朝凉爽秋空气做出俏皮飞吻动作。保持脸颊柔和抬起、下颌放松和自发亲切的表情。

暖米金色头发带层次深色发根、松散中分和修饰脸庞的碎发，长发汇集成放松的低段式编织马尾，垂在相机右肩。保留可信发量、略松散部分、锥形发梢、细碎发丝和窄窄的暖色高光。她穿超大号蓬松海军蓝与奶油色条纹毛衣，宽圆领、宽大锯齿边横纹、落肩、蓬松袖子、部分遮手的厚罗纹袖口，清晰可见柔软马海毛纤维；搭配浅色直筒牛仔裤、自然膝部折痕、柔软堆叠裤脚和真实丹宁纹理。赤脚涂亮面深蓝趾甲，佩戴小金耳环、精致戒指和深酒红色美甲。

侧脸可见精致全妆：羽毛感雕刻眉、香槟金闪粉、棕色外眼角轮廓、拉长棕色眼线、分明睫毛、桃红玫瑰腮红、局部颧骨高光和高光泽玫瑰裸唇。皮肤为暖中性米色，带健康微红底色、真实毛孔、暖色中间调、清晰侧脸阴影和受控反光，不要油腻或蜡质感。

环境是舒适的乡村小屋窗户，周围为风化鼠尾草绿木护墙板和温暖赤陶屋瓦。铜色、琥珀色、铁锈色枫树枝进入上方和侧边，落叶停在屋顶与外窗台。室内有暖台灯、编织吊灯、书架、奶油色窗帘、木地板和浅色沙发。相机左侧窗台放一只透明带梗酒杯，相机右侧放一只深色玻璃酒瓶，只有一张小巧精致的奶油色标签写着小写“chryzleen”；全图不能出现第二处该文字。

混合室外冷蓝调日光与室内暖钨丝灯。使用受控的紧凑型相机直闪补光提亮脸部、毛衣纤维、手部、牛仔裤和脚部，但不压过房间暖色。玻璃制品、酒瓶、珠宝、木材、亮唇和发丝保留窄高光。保持海军蓝、奶油色、丹宁蓝、琥珀色、赤陶色与铜色叶片的鲜明分离和干净阴影。

items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Preserve the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with that identity reference.

Create a photorealistic 9:16 vertical adult ethnic-fashion portrait in a contemporary Miao-inspired style. The main visible subject is a clearly adult 23-year-old East Asian woman with a stylish, confident and gentle presence and natural mature balanced proportions. Do not use body measurements or exaggerated curves. Preserve a refined natural oval face, clear eyes, soft brows, a delicate nose bridge and luminous berry lip makeup. Style her jet-black long hair in a neat high bun with a silver horn-shaped hair crown, a few hanging chains, silver bells by the ears and layered silver jewelry with clear separation.

OUTFIT: an indigo low square-neck cropped top with a small waist opening, made from crisp cotton and linen and decorated with fine multicolor embroidery along the neckline and broad lower band; a low-waist black-blue pleated short skirt with lightweight side-draping embroidered panels; layered silver collars, bell tassels and silver waist pieces. Show the textile weave, embroidery, metal reflections, ties and garment layers accurately while keeping the adult fashion styling complete and natural.

Place her on a wooden drying platform outside a Miao stilted house in the Miao mountains. She has just finished adjusting a gently moving silver bell at her chest; her right hand rests at the edge of the jewelry, her weight shifts to the back leg and she looks directly toward the camera as the mountain wind quiets. Deep wooden rails, layered terraced fields and indigo cloth hanging beneath the eaves create depth and a restrained sense of lived-in local life. Do not add extra people.

Use an 85mm portrait-lens look with a vertical 9:16 front three-quarter framing from head to thigh, clearly showing the face, garment silhouette, embroidery and silver jewelry. Use wide-aperture shallow depth of field while keeping the background recognizable. Early-morning side skylight illuminates the eyes, collarbones, silver pieces and textile texture, with warm bounce from the wooden floor. The finish is high-end ethnic lifestyle photography with cinematic color, realistic skin texture, natural color and controlled metal and fabric detail.

Negative constraints: no minors or childlike presentation, pornography or explicit sexualized action, exaggerated body proportions, extra people, confused cultural symbols, incorrect embroidery, clipped jewelry, malformed hands, duplicated limbs, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, text, logo, watermark or severe out-of-focus rendering.

创作一张 9:16 竖幅、照片级真实的苗族风格成人民族时尚写真。主可见人物是 23 岁、明确成年的东亚女性，气质时尚、自信而温柔，具有自然成熟、协调的身体比例，不使用身体尺寸参数或夸张曲线。她有精致自然的椭圆脸、清澈眼睛、柔顺眉形、细致鼻梁和柔亮莓果色唇妆；乌黑长发盘成利落高髻，搭配银角形发冠、少量垂链、耳畔银铃与层次清晰的银饰。

服装为当代苗族风造型：靛青色低领方领露腰刺绣短上衣，以挺括棉麻制作，领缘和胸下宽边有细密彩线纹样；搭配低腰黑蓝百褶短裙、轻薄侧垂绣片、层叠银项圈、银铃流苏和腰间银片。准确呈现织物纹理、刺绣图案、金属反光、系带与服装层次，保持成人时尚造型完整自然。

人物站在苗岭吊脚楼外的木质晒台上，刚整理好胸前一枚轻晃的银铃，右手停在银饰边缘，身体重心落在后侧腿上，在山风安静下来的瞬间正面抬眸看向镜头。深色木栏、远处层叠梯田和屋檐下晾晒的靛蓝布匹构成纵深，环境有克制的民族生活气息，不添加额外人物。

使用 85mm 人像镜头，9:16 竖幅正面半身至大腿构图，清晰呈现面部、服装轮廓、刺绣和银饰结构；大光圈浅景深，背景柔和但仍可辨识。清晨侧向天光照亮眼睛、锁骨、银片和衣料纹理，木地板提供柔暖补光。整体为高级民族风生活方式摄影、电影感、真实皮肤纹理、自然血色、低调清晰的金属和织物细节。

负面约束：不要未成年人或幼态化呈现、色情或露骨性化动作、身体比例夸张、额外人物、文化符号混乱、错误刺绣、银饰穿模、错误手部、重复肢体、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、文字、Logo、水印或严重失焦。

items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the clearly adult main visible person. Preserve the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting, and cover direction unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a bright, clean 9:16 Oriental Zen minimalist cover poster with a contemporary New Chinese morning aesthetic. A clearly adult Oriental woman in an elegant ancient-style look stands beside a huge circular lattice window in the lower-right area, slightly turned with a relaxed, quiet, reserved posture, as if just waking on a clear morning. Give her refined Oriental features, a simple elegant bun, a few small white flower ornaments, and light drooping ribbons. Her long dress transitions through pale white, pale apricot pink, and extremely light mint green; keep the fabric lightweight and layered, the styling simple rather than ornate, with no complex embroidery or heavy headpiece.

Her left hand rests lightly on the circular window edge and her right hand hangs naturally holding a small branch of white flowers. Hands must be anatomically natural, correctly proportioned, and not reversed. Use a minimalist cream-white interior with a large clean blank area on the left for title layout. Place the circular lattice window from the upper-right to the middle as the main visual memory point. Beyond it, show layered mint and light cyan-green plants, a soft morning-mist atmosphere, barely visible distant courtyard or mountain outlines, and an apricot-orange circular morning sun located outside in the distance, never stuck to the wall. Add only a few white or very pale pink flowers on the branches and slight tree shadows on the wall and floor.

Keep the composition airy and stable: window as the upper visual anchor, woman in the lower right, complete title space on the left. Use cream white as the base, mint and light cyan-green outside the window, apricot orange only for morning light and tiny warm reflections, and pale white/apricot clothing. Avoid a full teal-orange filter, gray dirtiness, old-paper aging, or darkening. Use bright soft natural morning light, crisp clean edges, subtle paper feel, no heavy ink wash, gray fog, or dense grain.

The overall feeling is gentle, light, clear, bright, clean, feminine, and rooted in Oriental lifestyle Zen. If text is needed for the cover layout, add only the restrained vertical Chinese inscription "晨光正好 / 一窗花影 / 许自己一段缓慢的时光" in the left blank area with a small red seal; keep all typography sparse and legible. Avoid extra text, clutter, distorted hands, reversed hands, cartoon or 3D icon style, watermark, and heavy decoration.

创作一张明亮、清透的 9:16 东方禅意极简封面海报，具有现代新中式清晨审美。一位明确成年的东方女性以优雅古风造型站在巨大圆形花窗旁，位于画面右下区域，微微侧身，姿态松弛、安静、含蓄，像在清晨刚刚醒来。她有精致东方五官，梳简洁雅致的发髻，点缀少量白色小花与轻垂发带。长裙由浅白、浅杏粉和极淡薄荷绿过渡，面料轻盈有层次，造型简洁而非繁复，不要复杂刺绣或沉重头饰。

左手自然轻扶圆窗边缘，右手自然下垂握着一小枝白花。手部结构必须自然、比例准确，不畸形、不反手。场景是极简奶油白室内空间，左侧保留大面积干净留白用于标题排版。圆形花窗从右上延伸至画面中部，作为第一视觉记忆点。窗外呈现薄荷绿与浅青绿植物层次、柔和晨雾空气、极淡的远景庭院或远山轮廓，以及位于远处窗外的杏子橙圆形晨光，绝不能贴在墙上。枝叶只带少量白色或极淡粉白小花，墙面和地面有轻微树影。

构图保持轻盈、稳定和大留白：圆窗是上方视觉锚点，人物在右下方，左侧是完整标题区。奶油白作为基底，窗外使用薄荷绿和浅青绿，杏子橙只用于晨光和少量暖反光，服装保持浅白与浅杏色。避免全图青橙滤镜、灰脏感、旧纸做旧或压暗。使用明亮柔和的清晨自然光、清晰边缘、轻微纸感，不要厚重水墨、灰雾或密集颗粒。

整体气质温柔、轻盈、清透、明亮、干净，具有女性向封面感与东方生活禅意。如需增加版式，只在左侧留白加入克制的竖排中文题字“晨光正好 / 一窗花影 / 许自己一段缓慢的时光”，并配一枚小红印章；文字必须稀疏清晰。避免额外文字、杂乱、手部畸形、反手、卡通或 3D 图标风、水印和厚重装饰。

Photorealistic vertical 4:5 smartphone snapshot of a fictional 21-year-old adult Japanese woman beside the touchline of a regional soccer field just before an amateur match. A friend lifted the phone at very close range while she was temporarily helping as a fourth-official assistant and moving an electronic substitution board. She has a friendly slightly rounded adult face, a barely forming smile, one subtly raised eyebrow, and a gaze toward the friend's shoulder rather than the lens. 人物背后展开一对巨大洁白天使羽翼，羽毛柔软、蓬松、层次丰富。翅膀从肩背向两侧展开，部分羽翼自然环绕身体，形成柔软帷幕般的包围感，但不要遮挡人物脸部和主要身体轮廓。

人物站在夜晚建筑天台的石质台阶高处。摄影机位于较低一级台阶，从人物斜后方采用低机位仰拍。人物背部主要朝向镜头，一只脚自然踏向下一层台阶，另一条腿稳定支撑身体。

人物上半身轻微回转，越过肩膀回头向下看镜头，露出漂亮侧脸。眼神清冷、神秘、疏离，形成明显的“高处天使回眸”视觉关系。

一只手自然握着一朵深红色玫瑰，另一只手自然垂落或轻触裙摆。深红玫瑰作为冷蓝画面中唯一明显的暖色视觉焦点。

背景为深蓝黑色的超现实都市夜景，可见远处城市灯光、建筑轮廓、深蓝夜空与沿台阶缓慢扩散的薄雾。背景保持简洁，不增加杂乱元素。

冷蓝色主光从侧后方照亮人物，在巨大白色羽翼、长发、肩背、腰线与修长双腿边缘形成清晰的蓝白色轮廓光；柔和冷白补光照亮回眸侧脸，使真人五官保持清晰。

采用 9:16 完整全身构图，从羽翼顶部、完整头顶、回眸面容、白色天使裙、修长双腿一直到台阶上的双脚全部入镜。使用约 35–50mm 自然焦段，强化高低空间关系，同时避免超广角造成腿脚异常放大。

人物主体保持高清清晰，眼睛、真人面容、皮肤、发丝、羽毛、蕾丝、珠饰和玫瑰细节清晰可见。仅加入轻微柔和 Bloom、低饱和冷蓝调、细腻胶片颗粒、空气薄雾与少量边缘柔化，不使用严重失焦或运动模糊。

整体呈现暗黑天使、巨大白色羽翼、冷蓝夜景、高处石阶、斜后方仰拍、回眸、深红玫瑰、超现实梦核的高级电影 Editorial 氛围，神圣、清冷、孤独、神秘而具有视觉冲击力。

负面提示词： 动漫脸，CG脸，未成年外观，多对翅膀，羽翼畸形，翅膀遮脸，身形过度夸张，V领过浅，高领，衣物滑落，身体比例失衡，短腿，腿部反折，台阶结构错误，多余肢体，多手多脚，玫瑰变形，头发遮脸，严重广角畸变，人物主体模糊，面部失焦，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，严重过曝，廉价Cosplay感，背景杂乱，文字，Logo，水印。

items.title: 山海经神兽东方史诗电影感提示词
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

【Mythical Beast】

Examples: Nine-tailed Fox, Yinglong, Baize, Xiangliu, Bifang, Qiongqi, Luwu, Zhulong, Taotie, Dijiang, Tiangou, Zheng, Zhu Yan, Kui, etc.

Core Optimization Direction

This version focuses not on blindly stacking "weirdness," "ferocity," or "special effects," but on locking down the most touching elements from reference images:

① The mythical beast must be beautiful
② The mythical beast must be massive and shocking
③ The scene must have an Oriental mythical cinematic feel like the reference images
④ Cloud seas, sky light, backlighting, and human scale difference must be strong
⑤ No cheap MMO style, no Western monster style, no horror/ugly style

General Main Prompt
Strictly refer to the overall visual style of the uploaded image to generate a "Classic of Mountains and Seas" Oriental mythical giant creature cinematic scene.
The main subject of the picture is a 【Mythical Beast】 from the "Classic of Mountains and Seas."
It must simultaneously possess:
High aesthetic value, divinity, beauty, sense of gigantism, sense of oppression, ancient feel, and Oriental feel.
【Mythical Beast】 is not an ordinary monster, not a Western magic creature, and not a horror creature intentionally made ugly or fierce;
it should possess, like in the reference images:

A stunning, solemn, mysterious, gorgeous, and blindingly ancient divinity.

The overall visual effect must be as if:

The mythical beasts in the "Classic of Mountains and Seas" have truly descended between heaven and earth in a cinematic way.

I. The mythical beast must be "beautiful"
This is the most important reinforcement point of this version.

【Mythical Beast】 needs a clear aesthetic upgrade:

The silhouette should be graceful, stretched, and magnificent
The face should have divinity and beauty
The eyes should be deep, ancient, and restrained
Hair / feathers / scales should be exquisite, gorgeous, and realistic
The posture should be elegant and oppressive, but not grotesque or low-grade
The overall "mythical beast feel" should be strong, rather than a "monster feel"

The aesthetic direction of the mythical beast should be:

"Sacred exotic beast" in Oriental mythology
Instead of:

Cheap horror monsters, demons, or ugly magic beasts.

Even for fierce-type beasts, they must be:
Majestic, dangerous, shocking, and gorgeous, rather than messy, ugly, or low-grade horror.

II. The sense of gigantism must be extremely strong
【Mythical Beast】 must reach a true heaven-and-earth-level giant scale.
It's not just a bit bigger, but big enough to:
Press down like a mountain
As if the sky itself has life
As part of storms, cloud seas, and mountains/rivers
So big that the lens cannot fully contain it

The mythical beast occupies about 75%–95% of the frame.

Allowed:

Head approaching the lens
Wings extending out of the frame
Giant tail filling the sky
Dragon body piercing through the cloud sea
Body parts hidden deep in the clouds
Multi-headed beasts peeking out from different spatial layers
Do not shrink the beast just to show the whole body.
People must feel at first glance:
"It's too big."

III. Reference-style composition lock

Use the core composition language of the reference images:

16:9 cinematic widescreen
12–20mm ultra-wide angle
Extremely low camera position
Looking up
Ultra-wide panorama / epic grand panorama
Beast-pressing-down composition

Tiny characters as scale references

Keep one or a very small number of ancient characters, boats, ancient cities, mountain gates, altars, pavilions, army formations, etc., at the bottom of the frame as scale references.

Human height controlled at around 0.5%–2% of the frame.

Ideally, a tiny ancient person with their back to the camera, standing between heaven and earth looking up at the mythical beast.

Forming a strong relationship:

Mortals like dust, beasts like the sky.

IV. Reference-style cloud sea must be locked
In the reference images, the key is not a common background, but:
Giant, thick, churning, dreamlike volumetric cloud seas that engulf heaven and earth.
Cloud layers must have a real sense of volume like mountains and oceans, becoming the second protagonist of the frame.

The cloud sea needs:
Large areas of rolling layers
Localized storm eyes, cloud walls, cloud waves, sky light cracks
Real occlusion relationship with the mythical beast's body
Parts of the mythical beast's body hidden in clouds
Cloud layers clearly disturbed by giant wings, giant tails, dragon bodies, or force fields

Ideal state:

30%–50% of the mythical beast's body hidden in the cloud sea.

Because:

Partially hidden and partially visible has a stronger sense of gigantism and a more high-end temperament than seeing everything clearly.

V. The mythical beast must integrate with the environment
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

【神兽】

例如：九尾狐、应龙、白泽、相柳、毕方、穷奇、陆吾、烛龙、饕餮、帝江、天狗、狰、朱厌、夔等。

核心优化方向

这一版重点不是一味堆“怪”“猛”“特效”，而是把参考图里最打动人的东西锁定下来：

① 神兽要好看
② 神兽要巨大震撼
③ 画面要像参考图一样有东方神话电影感
④ 云海、天光、逆光、人物尺度差必须强
⑤ 不做廉价网游风，不做西方怪兽风，不做恐怖丑陋风

通用主提示词
严格参考上传图片的整体视觉风格，生成一幅 《山海经》东方神话巨物电影画面。
画面主体是一只来自《山海经》的 【神兽】。
它必须同时具备：
高颜值、神性、美感、巨物感、压迫感、远古感、东方感。
【神兽】不是普通怪兽，不是西方魔物，也不是故意做丑做凶的恐怖生物；
它应该像参考图中那样，拥有一种：

惊艳、庄严、神秘、华美、不可直视的远古神性。

整体视觉效果必须像：

《山海经》中的神兽真正以电影级方式降临天地之间。

一、神兽必须“好看”
这是这一版最重要的强化点。

【神兽】要有明确的审美升级：

轮廓要优美、舒展、恢弘
面部要有神性与美感

眼神要深邃、古老、克制

毛发 / 羽毛 / 鳞片要精致、华丽、真实

姿态要优雅、有压迫感，但不狰狞低级

整体要“神兽感”强，而不是“妖怪感”强

神兽的美感方向应是：

东方神话中的“神圣异兽”
而不是：

廉价恐怖怪物、恶魔、丑陋魔兽。

即使是凶兽类神兽，也要做到：
威严、危险、震撼、华美，而不是脏乱、丑陋、低级恐怖。
二、巨物感必须极强
【神兽】必须达到真正的 天地级巨物尺度。
它不是大一点，而是要大到：
像山一样压下来

像天空本身拥有生命

像风暴、云海、山河的一部分
大到镜头无法完整容纳

神兽占画面约 75%–95%。

允许：

头部逼近镜头

翅膀延伸出画框

巨尾铺满天空

龙身贯穿云海

身体部分隐藏在云层深处

多首异兽从不同空间层次探出
不要为了展示全身而把神兽缩小。
必须让人第一眼就感受到：
“太大了。”

三、参考图式构图强锁定

采用参考图中最核心的构图语言：

16:9 电影宽银幕
12–20mm 超广角
极低机位
仰视
超大全景 / 史诗大全景
神兽压顶式构图

极小人物作为尺度参照

画面底部保留一名或极少量古代人物、舟船、古城、山门、祭坛、楼阁、军阵等作为比例参照。

人物高度控制在画面 0.5%–2% 左右。

最好是一名极小的古人，背对镜头，站在天地之间仰望神兽。

形成强烈关系：

凡人如尘，神兽如天。

四、参考图式云海必须锁定
参考图里最关键的不是普通背景，而是：
巨大、厚重、翻涌、梦幻、吞没天地的体积云海。
云层必须像山脉和海洋一样具有真实体积感，成为画面的第二主角。
云海需要具备：
大面积翻滚层次
局部形成风暴眼、云墙、云浪、天光裂隙

与神兽身体发生真实遮挡关系

神兽身体部分隐没在云层中

云层被巨翼、巨尾、龙身、力量场明显扰动

理想状态是：

30%–50% 的神兽身体隐没在云海中。

因为：

半隐半现，比全部看清更有巨物感，也更像参考图的高级气质。

五、神兽要与环境融为一体

不要把神兽孤零零放在背景上。

它必须像参考图那样，真正改变天地环境。

例如：

巨翼扇动，云海向两侧翻卷
龙身穿云，形成巨大流动轨迹
九尾搅动天际云浪
巨兽低头，山河被阴影覆盖
身体掠过，海水翻起巨浪

火属性神兽让天幕染上赤金火光

雷属性神兽让风暴与闪电围绕云墙爆发

神圣属性神兽让云层裂开，天光倾泻

神兽要有一种感觉：

它不是在“画面里”，它就是天地的一部分。

六、光影严格参考图片风格

整体光影必须严格延续参考图中的高级电影感：

低饱和灰青 / 青黑环境 + 暖金 / 赤金逆光 + 少量冷白高光。

不要五颜六色。

不要花哨彩光。
不要游戏能量条感。
采用：
大面积厚重暗部
局部暖金轮廓光
云层中的穿透光
神兽边缘被逆光勾亮
神兽主体大部分仍沉在阴影和云雾中

最佳光影结构：

65% 阴影
25% 中间层次
10% 高光。

高光主要集中在：

神兽眼睛

头部轮廓

毛发边缘

羽翼边缘

鳞片高点

云层裂口

神兽身后的巨大天光 / 日轮 / 火环

七、色彩要像参考图一样高级
整体主色必须克制统一。
主色范围：
墨青、青灰、灰蓝、象牙白、雾白、黑褐、深灰。
属性色只作为点睛：

九尾狐 / 白泽：乳白、淡金、暖白

应龙：灰白、赤金、金白
烛龙：暗红、赤金、深褐火光
相柳：铁青、灰白、冷白

毕方：灰蓝、熔金、暗橙火光

穷奇：深灰、暗红、冷金
陆吾：金棕、灰金、暗青背景
核心原则：
整体低饱和，局部璀璨。
不要：
荧光蓝
紫粉霓虹

RGB彩光

五颜六色法术特效

整张画面满屏亮光

八、材质必须“华丽但真实”

神兽一定要美，材质是关键。

毛发类神兽

毛发应浓密、顺滑、层次分明、受风流引导，边缘被逆光照亮，呈现真实而高贵的质感。
比如九尾狐、白泽，不是毛茸茸卡通感，而是：
神性、丝绸般、云雾般、电影级的真实毛发。
羽翼类神兽
羽毛必须层层展开，主飞羽、覆羽结构清晰，具有光泽、厚度、空气动力感。
比如毕方、应龙之翼，必须：
华丽、磅礴、巨大、真实。
鳞甲类神兽
鳞片要有自然生长感、轻微磨损、真实粗糙度与反光变化。
不要机械排列。
比如应龙、烛龙、相柳，要做到：

古老、真实、威严、精致。

角 / 爪 / 面部骨骼

要有天然骨质感、岁月感、风化感。
不能塑料、不能廉价、不能机甲风。

九、神兽眼神必须有“神性”
眼睛不要过爆，不要像灯泡。
最佳状态是：
暗金、琥珀、赤金、冷白的微弱神光。
眼神要传达：

高贵、安静、古老、无情、神秘、俯视众生。

这种克制感，比瞪眼咆哮更高级。

十、不同神兽的“好看方向”

为了让【神兽】替换后仍然稳定出图，可以自动按以下方向理解：

【九尾狐】
巨大、圣洁、绝美、九尾铺天盖地，毛发如云海与流光，头部优雅高贵，整体偏暖金乳白。

【应龙】

修长东方龙体，龙首英武，双翼巨大华美，盘旋穿云，气势磅礴，偏金白与赤金风暴感。

【白泽】
圣洁、智慧、神圣、安静、绝美，毛发细腻柔和，偏冷白与淡金天光。

【相柳】

九首结构层层递进，虽然危险，但整体轮廓仍要美观有秩序，偏铁青与冷白风暴云感。

【毕方】
神鸟姿态华丽，羽翼盛大，火光映照云层，整体如神火与天风中的远古神禽。
【穷奇】

巨大虎兽轮廓 + 华丽羽翼，力量感与审美感并重，不能做脏乱邪兽。

【烛龙】

古老、尊贵、天象级存在，龙首威严，身体如山海盘踞，搭配暗红日轮极具史诗感。
十一、画面必须“好看且震撼”

这一版审美重点：

不是越乱越震撼，
不是越亮越震撼，
不是越多特效越震撼。

真正高级的震撼来自：

巨大的留白云海

清晰的主视觉中心

一眼就懂的尺度差

统一而高级的色彩

神兽轮廓极其漂亮

明暗关系很强

局部璀璨、整体克制

即：

大而不乱，华丽而不俗，神秘而不脏，震撼而不廉价。

电影质感关键词

Shan Hai Jing mythical creature, ancient Chinese mythology, colossal beautiful divine beast, cinematic epic scale, ultra wide low angle shot, giant volumetric clouds, majestic oriental fantasy, high-end creature design, photorealistic fur, realistic feathers, realistic scales, golden rim light, dramatic backlight, deep shadows, atmospheric perspective, large scale environment simulation, divine and elegant, mysterious and awe-inspiring, high-budget oriental mythological film, 8K cinematic detail

负面提示词

西方魔兽，西方恶魔，西方龙，欧美奇幻，机甲，机械生物，赛博朋克，科幻城市，网游风，游戏Boss，廉价玄幻风，卡通，动漫，Q版，普通怪兽，神兽太丑，恐怖血腥，脏乱邪典，塑料CG，蜡像质感，普通动物写真，神兽太小，神兽完整缩在远处，普通摆拍，平视镜头，完全居中，完全对称，背景空洞，普通蓝天白云，云层太薄，高饱和，紫粉霓虹，RGB光效，满屏粒子，过度闪电，过度火焰，过度HDR，过度锐化，错误解剖，多余肢体，多余头部，结构混乱，文字，字幕，Logo，水印，UI界面。

items.title: 超写实日系森林溪流石桥少女看书摄影
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Hyper-realistic Japanese forest stream portrait photography, vertical ratio approximately 4:5, a young adult East Asian female sitting on a dark gray stone bridge railing beside a forest stream quietly reading a book. The photographer is located approximately 3–4 meters directly in front of the subject, slightly to the left, using an approximately 50–70mm equivalent lens, with the camera position close to the subject's waist and abdomen height and basically at eye level. The subject is located in the center-right of the frame, occupying about 60–68% of the frame height, captured completely from the top of the head to the feet; a black student-style handbag is kept on the left side, and a large area of the background retains the stream, trees, branches, leaves, and dappled sunlight. The overall look is like a quiet lifestyle photo taken casually in a mountain forest park on a summer afternoon, without using a fisheye lens and without obvious background blur.

The subject is a young adult East Asian female, with a small to medium frame, narrow shoulders, naturally slender upper body, short and slightly tapered waist, natural and moderate pelvis and hips, well-proportioned and slightly full thighs, and slender, long calves. The overall proportion is a natural, light, and compact Japanese girl-like sense, but clearly an adult female; do not generate tall Western models, athletic muscular types, exaggerated wide hips, or extremely full figures.

The subject sits on top of a dark gray stone bridge railing, the body basically facing the camera but turned slightly towards the subject's left, with the back leaning slightly forward and shoulders relaxed. The shorts tailoring sit in the center of the railing, with both legs hanging down naturally from the front of the railing.

The two legs are very close together, knees basically touching, one leg slightly extended forward and the other slightly retracted backward, creating a natural misalignment of the legs. Toes are pointing down, with black shoes located near the bottom of the frame. Do not cross legs, sit cross-legged, or spread legs widely.

The subject's hands hold an open small-sized manga/illustration book in front of the chest and abdomen. The book has a white cover and white pages, with a gray-black character illustration or manga character drawing on each of the left and right pages. Text is minimal and kept blurry and unreadable. The left hand supports the edge of the left page, and the right hand holds the right page, with the gaze naturally falling on the book as if concentrating on reading.

The head is slightly lowered, the chin is tucked in, not looking at the camera. The expression is quiet, focused, with a slight sense of contemplation, lips naturally closed, no toothy smile.

The subject has jet-black ultra-long straight hair, reaching near the waist, with naturally thick volume. The top is nearly center-parted or slightly off-center, with thick straight fragmented bangs in front, length close to the eyebrows and the upper edge of the eyes. Long hair on both sides falls naturally along the shoulders, chest, and back, with slightly messy hair ends and a few fine flyaway hairs affected by the forest breeze. Do not have high pony-tails, large curls, short hair, or no bangs.

The face shape is small and slightly oval, with a soft jawline and a fair, warm skin tone. Deep brown almond eyes, natural double eyelids, very thin eyeliner, and naturally thin eyebrows. The bridge of the nose is small, and the lips are low-saturation nude pink. Makeup is very light, overall leaning towards a natural Japanese lifestyle photo feel, without heavy makeup or excessive skin smoothing.

The upper body wears a cream-white/pure white short-sleeved sailor collar uniform-style top, made of light cotton or uniform fabric. The neckline is a classic sailor collar structure with dark navy blue double-line piping on the edges; the short-sleeved cuffs also have two thin dark blue lines.

No exaggerated big bow is tied on the chest, only a simple sailor collar front and a light-colored tie/narrow neckerchief structure are kept, overall clean and restrained. The body is slightly waisted, and the length is near the natural waist.

The lower body wears a dark navy blue short pleated skirt, the color close to navy blue or ink blue, with clear but not exaggerated wide pleats. In the sitting position, the hem naturally spreads on the stone railing, forming soft folds above the thighs, and the skirt length is about the upper-middle part of the thighs.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

超写实日系森林溪流人像摄影，竖版约 4:5，一名年轻成年东亚女性坐在森林溪流旁的深灰色石桥栏杆上安静看书。摄影者位于人物正前方略偏左约 3–4 米，采用约 50–70mm 等效镜头，机位接近人物腰腹高度并基本平视。人物位于画面中央偏右，占画面高度约 60–68%，从头顶完整拍到双脚；左侧保留一只黑色学生风手提包，背景大面积保留溪流、树木、枝叶和斑驳阳光。整体像夏日下午在山林公园里随手拍到的安静生活照，不使用鱼眼，不做明显背景虚化。

人物为年轻成年东亚女性，小到中等骨架，肩部偏窄，上半身自然纤细，腰部短而轻微收束，骨盆和髋部自然适中，大腿匀称偏丰满，小腿纤细修长。整体是自然轻盈、紧凑的日系少女感比例，但明确为成年女性；不要生成高挑欧美模特、健美肌肉型、夸张宽胯或极端丰满身材。

人物坐在深灰色石质桥栏顶部，身体基本正对镜头但略微向人物左侧转，背部微微前倾，肩膀放松。臀部坐在栏杆中央，双腿从栏杆前方自然垂下。

两条腿靠得很近，膝盖基本并拢，一条腿略微向前伸，另一条腿稍微向后收，使双腿形成自然错位。脚尖朝下，黑色鞋子位于画面底部附近。不要翘二郎腿、盘腿或大幅张腿。

人物双手在胸腹前捧着一本打开的小尺寸漫画/插画书，书本为白色封面和白色纸页，左右页上各有一幅灰黑色人物插画或漫画角色图，文字极少且保持模糊不可读。左手托住左页边缘，右手扶着右页，视线自然落在书上，像正在专心阅读。

头部轻微低下，下巴收起，不看镜头。表情安静、专注、略带一点沉思感，嘴唇自然闭合，不露齿笑。

人物留乌黑色超长直发，长度到腰部附近，发量自然浓密。头顶接近中分或轻微偏中分，额前有较厚的平直碎齐刘海，长度接近眉毛和眼睛上缘。两侧长发沿肩膀、胸前和背部自然垂落，发尾略微凌乱，受到森林微风影响有少量细碎飞发。不要高马尾、大卷发、短发或无刘海。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌柔和，肤色白皙偏暖。深棕色杏仁眼，双眼皮自然，眼线很细，眉毛自然偏细。鼻梁小巧，嘴唇低饱和裸粉色。妆容非常轻薄，整体偏自然日系生活照感，不要浓妆和过度磨皮。

上身穿一件奶油白/纯白色短袖水手领制服风上衣，面料为轻薄棉质或制服布料。领口为经典水手领结构，领缘有深藏蓝色双线滚边；短袖袖口同样带两条深蓝细线。

胸前不系夸张大蝴蝶结，仅保留简洁的水手领前襟和浅色领结/窄领巾结构，整体干净克制。衣身略微收腰，长度到自然腰附近。

下身穿一条深海军蓝色短款百褶裙，颜色接近藏蓝、墨蓝，裙摆有清楚但不夸张的宽褶。坐姿后裙摆自然铺在石栏上，大腿上方形成柔和褶皱，裙长约到大腿中上部。

双腿穿黑色或深炭灰色过膝长袜/高筒袜，袜口位于大腿中上部，颜色整体偏深但在阳光照射处略微透出灰色层次。袜子材质平滑，贴合腿部，没有条纹、Logo 或复杂花纹。

脚穿黑色亮面圆头乐福鞋/Mary Jane 风低跟鞋，鞋型小巧，鞋面带轻微皮革反光，鞋底较薄。不要运动鞋、厚底鞋或高跟鞋。

人物左侧石栏上放着一只大型黑色学生风手提包/波士顿包，包体为黑色皮革或厚实尼龙，略带软塌感，带两只短提手、多个外部口袋和银色小金属扣。包体尺寸较大，约占人物上半身宽度的一半，位置紧贴人物左侧。不要改成小型链条包或背包。

场景为茂密亚热带/日式山林溪谷中的小石桥。人物身后是一条非常清澈、流速缓慢的浅绿色溪流，水面平静，颜色为浅翡翠绿、橄榄绿和灰绿色，能看到细小水波和树影反射。

溪流从画面左后方蜿蜒向中央，并被两侧浓密植被包围。河岸生长大量深绿色灌木、蕨类、竹叶状植物和杂乱藤蔓，植被层次非常丰富，不要变成整齐公园草坪。

背景上方和左右两侧被大量巨大树干、横向树枝和茂密树冠覆盖。画面左上有一根粗黑褐色大树枝横向延伸，树枝形状自然弯曲，表面有苔藓和粗糙树皮。树冠形成天然拱顶，使画面上半部几乎都被绿色叶片填满。

光线为强烈夏日下午自然阳光穿过树叶形成的斑驳光影。人物脸部、白色上衣、裙摆和部分大腿被从左上方穿透树叶的阳光照亮，形成局部高光；其他区域进入凉爽绿色阴影。

溪流水面左侧有一大片明显的亮绿色阳光反射，树叶间出现不规则白色亮斑。黑发顶部和肩膀边缘带少量金白色轮廓光，整体光比真实、略偏硬，不要柔光棚拍。

石桥栏杆为深灰黑色老旧石材/混凝土结构，栏杆顶部宽而平，人物和包都能坐放其上。下方有规则竖向石柱，柱间可以看到溪水。石材表面略粗糙，有灰尘、苔痕和长期风化纹理。

整体呈2000s 日系数码相机/早期智能手机旅行照质感：自然锐度、轻微 JPEG 压缩、有限动态范围、阴影略偏绿，高光局部轻微过曝，背景保持大量细节而不是奶油虚化。色彩以森林深绿＋溪水浅绿＋白色水手服＋深蓝裙＋黑色长袜＋黑色长发为主，安静、清凉、带明显夏日山林氛围。

重点锁定：年轻成年东亚女性＋森林溪流石桥＋坐在宽石栏顶部＋低头看打开的漫画书＋超长黑直发＋厚碎齐刘海＋白色深蓝滚边水手领短袖上衣＋深海军蓝百褶短裙＋双腿靠近自然垂下＋黑色过膝长袜＋黑色圆头皮鞋

items.title: 九宫格透明人物表情包贴纸页
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请严格参考我上传的人物原图，制作一张 **1:1 正方形透明贴纸页**。

【画面结构】
- 整张画面由 **9 个独立贴纸** 组成；
- 按 **3×3 网格** 排列；
- 九个贴纸之间保留 **较宽且完全透明的间隔**；
- 整张贴纸页背景必须透明；
- 不要生成额外背景，不要做成整张连续插画，不要让贴纸相互重叠。

【主体一致性】
- 九个贴纸都必须是 **同一个人物**；
- 严格保留原图人物的身份特征、脸型、五官、发型、发色、肤色、服装关键特征和整体气质；
- 可以做轻微优化，如提高清晰度、优化边缘、微调质感；
- 不要改变人物身份，不要换脸，不要让不同贴纸像不同的人。

【中心贴纸要求】
- **中间第5格** 固定为原图人物的抠像版；
- 中间贴纸保留真实感，仅做轻微精修；
- 不要对中间贴纸做风格化处理；
- 中间贴纸要与周围八张形成“真实 vs 风格化”的对比。

【周围八张要求】
- 周围八张都基于同一个人物延展；
- 统一转换为以下风格：
从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为观察式钢笔淡彩手稿。不要完整描摹照片，只保留最值得记录的视觉线索，以最少信息维持主体身份、比例、方向和场景含义，让人一眼认出原物，同时保留观察、删减与停笔的痕迹。

构图强调极简页面中的音乐性节奏：把主体最重要的轮廓或动作视为一个视觉动机，通过重复、变奏、停顿、重音和突然留白组织画面。主体不必完整，也不必居中，可偏置、裁切、悬置或向某一方向自然延伸；一两处较有力量的自由线条承担视觉重音，其余线条迅速减弱，让大片空白像音乐中的休止。避免平均分布和完整填充，使画面呈现一种克制秩序中的即兴、未完成中的完整感。

线条使用纤细、松动、不均匀的钢笔手绘线稿，允许断续轮廓、寻找线、重复修正、突然加重、轻微偏差和未完成边缘。局部可以出现更自由、更果断的长线或快速笔触，与安静细线形成节奏反差，但关键比例、方向和姿态必须准确。淡彩只用于少数必要位置，从原图提取2–4种最具辨识度的颜色进行轻薄、透明的局部点染，允许越线、水痕、颗粒和不均匀覆盖，环境颜色迅速消失。

背景纸色不固定，根据原图综合色温、光线与情绪智能匹配一个极度浅、干净、几乎接近白色的综合色底，可以微暖、微冷或带极轻色相，但始终服务于原图，不形成明显彩色背景。

文字自由根据照片本身生成，不预设固定标题、编号、地点、年份或固定语种。可从主体、动作、环境、情绪、声音、时间感、记忆或偶然细节中提炼少量真正有意义的字、词、短句或符号。文字也遵循画面的节奏，可像一个轻微重音、停顿或回声一样进入留白，沿轮廓、视线、运动方向或未完成边缘自然排列；宁可少、偏、轻、巧，也不要形成菜单式信息区。

整体像一本被精心编辑过的私人观察手册：页面极简、留白大胆、构图敏锐，线条自由却不散乱，局部即兴而整体高度克制。 让画面具有“一个视觉动机被观察、重复、变奏，然后在最恰当的位置停下”的艺术感。避免完整水彩风景、平均构图、填满背景、过度精描、装饰性笔触、粗黑轮廓、矢量线、卡通、三维渲染、菜单式排版和商业海报模板感。

【表情包适配要求｜优先级高于上述海报版式描述】
- 上述风格内容中的“当前层区域”，均指周围八张中的当前单枚贴纸区域；不得把八张风格贴纸连接成一幅连续画面。
- 原风格涉及的纸面、底色、色域、矩形、留白、环境或局部背景必须完整保留其色彩、材质、光影和质感逻辑，但只能作为当前层区域内围绕人物的局部衬底、材质片、色块、负形或构图元素；不得铺满单格，更不得铺满整张贴纸页。人物及局部衬底之外必须透明，九格之间的宽间隔必须完全透明。
- 人物在每个当前层区域内必须是唯一主角、完整可见、边缘清楚。风格化、概括、删减或夸张只能作用于非身份性细节、材质语言、笔触、色彩与辅助环境；不得删减或抽象掉脸型、五官、发型、发色、肤色、服装关键特征和整体气质。
- 人物数量固定，不新增第二人物，不复制人物，不把同一人物拆成多个局部。允许按照模板要求改变八张贴纸的表情、姿势、手势和反应；除此以外，人物视角、身体结构、左右方向、相对位置及与原图关键道具的空间关系必须连续、合理，不得因风格转换而擅自重构。
- 原风格涉及的标题、编号或注释只允许在确有必要时作为当前层区域内极少量、清晰可读的短语或微型标记；不得跨格、占用透明间隔或生成大段无意义文字。
- 周围八张必须分别呈现 **不同的表情、姿势、手势或反应**；
- 强调 meme 感、反应感、戏剧化、夸张感；
- 八张之间必须明显不同，避免只有轻微表情变化；
- 位置不固定，由模型自由分配，但必须视觉均衡。

【整体效果】
- 中间一张是真实原图抠像版；
- 周围八张是同一人物的风格化 meme 贴纸；
- 所有贴纸都应是独立 PNG 贴纸感，边缘清晰、主体完整；
- 整体像一张已经排好版的九宫格透明表情包贴纸页。

items.title: 古风夜色美妆写真东方古典贵女
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

9:16 vertical orientation, ancient style night makeup portrait, Oriental classical noblewoman portrait, bust close-up, front view, the character sits in front of a dressing table, body facing the camera, head naturally upright, eyes gentle and full of emotion, looking quietly at the camera, expression reserved, soft, and emotionally restrained, with a hint of 'hesitant to speak' night emotion. The overall temperament is that of a noble lady from a high-ranking family, gentle, luxurious, exquisite, restrained, and charming, like a noble lady who has just finished her makeup in the night.

The character is an adult woman in her mid-20s with a visual age of approximately 20–28 years old, clearly an adult, with bright eyes and full lips, a soft oval face, a naturally full forehead, a full and three-dimensional mid-face, and a soft and smooth jawline. The eyebrow shape is detailed and stretched, the eyes are clear and spirited, the eye shape is naturally long, the outer corners of the eyes are slightly upturned but not excessively exaggerated, and the gaze is soft and affectionate; the bridge of the nose is elegant and smooth, the tip of the nose is exquisite and rounded; the lip shape is soft and full, the lip pearl is naturally clear, the overall features are exquisite and symmetrical, the close-up is pleasing to the eye, not juvenile, and not internet-celebrity-like.

Makeup is 'Light Shadow Sea Pomegranate Soft Glamour Makeup'. The base makeup is transparent and delicate, the skin tone is fair and soft, preserving the natural and delicate skin texture. The eye makeup uses pomegranate red, red tea, warm brown, and a small amount of warm gold fine shimmer for gradient blending, the outer side of the upper eyelid and the outer corner of the eye are slightly deepened, the aegyo-sal has delicate warm gold pearlescence, the eyeliner is thin and clear, and the eyelashes are curled and distinct. The mid-face and apple muscles have a soft and natural warm rose blush, looking warm and healthy. Detailed and clear highlights are added to the bridge of the nose, the tip of the nose, the mid-face, and the cupid's bow, but without creating oily shine across the whole face. The lip makeup is pomegranate red water-gloss lips, the color is fresh, moist, and bright, with a slight glass-like texture on the lip surface. The overall post-makeup temperament is gentle, soft-glamorous, reserved, and luxurious, with the emotional sense of a noble lady under night candlelight.

The hairstyle is black hair loosely tied in a high bun, the high bun is full and rounded, the top of the head is naturally fluffy, and the hair strands are jet black and smooth. 人物为一位视觉年龄约 20–28 岁、明确成年的年轻东方女性，明眸丰唇脸，柔和鹅蛋脸，额头自然饱满，面中丰盈立体，下颌线柔和流畅。眉形细致舒展，眼睛清亮有神，眼型自然修长，眼尾轻微上扬但不过分夸张，眼神柔润含情；鼻梁秀气流畅，鼻尖精致圆润；唇形柔软饱满，唇珠自然清楚，整体五官精致对称，近景耐看，不幼态、不网红化。

妆容为 灯影海榴柔艳妆。底妆通透细腻，肤色白净柔润，保留自然细腻皮肤质感。眼妆使用榴红、赤茶、暖棕与少量暖金细闪渐层晕染，上眼睑外侧与眼尾轻微加深，卧蚕带细腻暖金珠光，眼线纤细清楚，睫毛卷翘分明。面中与苹果肌带柔和自然的暖玫瑰腮红，气色温润。鼻梁、鼻尖、面中与唇峰加入细致清透高光，但不形成全脸油光。唇妆为榴红水光唇，颜色鲜润柔亮，唇面带轻微玻璃感。整体妆后气质温柔、柔艳、含蓄、华贵，具有夜色烛光下的贵女情绪感。

发型为黑发松挽高髻，高髻饱满圆润，头顶自然蓬松，发丝乌黑顺滑。发间佩戴 海榴红珠钗、浅金发链、金色花枝结构、红色小宝石、珍珠点缀与多层流苏垂饰，整体发饰精致华丽，层次丰富但不压脸。耳饰为珍珠流苏耳坠，搭配红色玉珠与浅金细链，轻垂于耳侧，增强华贵感。

服装为 海榴红对襟上襦，衣料带有大量金线花卉刺绣与细密暗纹，搭配 乌金暗纹长裙 与 象牙白轻纱披帛。领口和胸前为精致古风抹胸式内层，身形饱满自然，上半身比例丰润协调，可以清楚看到柔和的胸线与大部分身形轮廓，但仍有完整服装覆盖，整体得体，不低俗、不现代礼服化。服装配色以海榴红、乌金、象牙白、暖金为主，华美鲜明，同时保持古典精致感。

场景为 宫灯暖阁 / 珠帘 / 铜镜妆台 / 烛影摇曳。人物坐于古风妆台前，左侧可见古铜雕花圆镜，前景和两侧垂落多层珍珠珠帘，妆台上摆放红金首饰盒、珍珠链、小件首饰与烛台。背景可见暖黄宫灯、深木阁室、远处夜色楼阁虚化灯影，整体空间华丽但背景柔和虚化，不喧宾夺主。

光线采用暖白偏金的烛光与宫灯柔光结合，人物面部有独立柔和补光，确保双眼、眼影、腮红、唇妆、发饰、刺绣和皮肤细节清晰可见。画面整体温暖通透，有夜色氛围，但不过暗、不发黄、不灰脏。背景浅景深虚化，人物脸部与妆容始终是第一视觉中心。

85mm 人像镜头，真实摄影质感，高完成度古风贵女美妆写真，人物双眼精准对焦，妆容清晰，珠饰与金线刺绣精致细腻，画面华美、柔艳、温润、富有古典夜色电影感。

items.title: 海边夏日少女感超写实人像摄影

Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Hyper-realistic seaside summer girlhood portrait photography, vertical version about 3:4, a young adult East Asian female sitting on a dark gray stone low wall at the edge of a seaside promenade/pier, background is light blue-green seawater, white sand beach, a light green sea-crossing bridge across the frame, distant port cranes and extremely clear blue sky. Using about 35–50mm equivalent lens, medium-close distance shot, photographer about 1.5–2 meters from the subject, camera position close to the subject's waist and abdomen height and basically at eye level. Subject located in the center-right of the frame, occupying about 75–82% of the frame height, composition from the top of the head to below the knees, keeping a light straw-yellow straw hat in the lower-left foreground. Realistic travel snapshot perspective, no fisheye, no obvious background blurring.

Subject is a young adult East Asian female, small-boned, shoulders moderate to narrow, upper body slender and natural, waist short and slightly tapered, pelvis and hip width moderate, thighs natural and symmetrical, overall belongs to a small-boned, light and slender, natural youthful proportion. Do not generate voluptuous hourglass, exaggerated wide hips, thick thighs, athletic muscularity or tall European and American model proportions.

Subject sitting on the edge of the low wall, body slightly turned to subject's left, upper body standing in a relaxed natural posture slightly, shoulders naturally relaxed. Double legs naturally overlapped at the bottom of the frame, one leg bent and raised closer to the lens, the other leg partially blocked by the front leg and dress hem, pose relaxed, not deliberately posed.

Subject's head slightly lowered and slightly tilted to subject's left, gaze falling toward the lower-left of the frame, not looking directly at the camera. Expression quiet, soft, lips naturally slightly parted, with a bit of a thoughtful feeling, no toothy smile.

Subject has jet-black extra-long straight hair, length near the waist, hair volume naturally thick. Top of head near middle part, front of forehead is thick but light straight fragmented bangs, length close to eyebrows and upper edge of eyes; long hair on both sides naturally falls along shoulders, chest and arms, a few strands of hair blown outward by the sea breeze, hair ends slightly messy. No high ponytails, large curls, short bobs or no-bangs styles.

Face shape small and oval-shaped, jaw soft, skin tone fair with neutral-warm tone. Dark brown almond eyes, natural double eyelids, black thin eyeliner slightly extended, eyelashes clear; eyebrows naturally thin. Nose bridge small and straight, lips naturally full, color low-saturation nude pink/light bean paste. Makeup light, clean, biased towards Japanese life photo feel, no heavy contouring and internet celebrity makeup.

Front of neckline is a shallow V-shaped opening, no tie or only minimalist details inside. Do not generate ordinary white T-shirts or formal shirts.

Shoulder straps are medium to wide, connecting vertically down from the shoulders to the front chest, front chest is a lower square/round-square neckline, white sailor shirt inside is clearly visible. Dress slightly tapers at the waist and abdomen, naturally spreads down from the hips, material is matte cotton or uniform fabric.

dress hem length about mid-to-lower thigh/above the knee, naturally spreading around the stone wall and legs after sitting. items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

超写实海边夏日少女感人像摄影，竖版约 3:4，一名年轻成年东亚女性坐在海滨步道/码头边缘的深灰石质矮墙上，背景是浅蓝绿色海水、白色沙滩、横跨画面的浅绿色跨海桥、远处港口吊机和极通透的蓝天。采用约 35–50mm 等效镜头，中近距离拍摄，摄影者距离人物约 1.5–2 米，机位接近人物腰腹高度并基本平视。人物位于画面中央偏右，占画面高度约 75–82%，构图从头顶拍到膝盖以下，左下前景保留一顶浅草黄色草帽。真实旅行抓拍透视，不使用鱼眼，不做明显背景虚化。

人物为年轻成年东亚女性，骨架偏小，肩部适中偏窄，上半身纤细自然，腰部短而轻微收束，骨盆和髋部宽度适中，大腿自然匀称，整体属于小骨架、轻盈纤细、自然少女感比例。不要生成丰满沙漏型、夸张宽胯、粗壮大腿、健美肌肉感或高挑欧美模特比例。

人物坐在矮墙边缘，身体略微向人物左侧转，上半身轻轻前倾，肩膀自然放松。右手向身体右后方伸出并撑在石质墙面上，手掌贴住墙顶作为支撑；左手自然垂落在身体左侧，手指靠近裙摆和石墙边缘。双腿在画面下方自然交叠，一条腿屈膝抬起更靠近镜头，另一条腿被前腿与裙摆部分遮挡，姿态松弛、不刻意摆拍。

人物头部微微低下并略向人物左侧倾斜，视线落向画面左下方，不直视镜头。表情安静、柔和，嘴唇自然微张，带一点若有所思的感觉，不露齿笑。

人物留乌黑色超长直发，长度到腰部附近，发量自然浓密。头顶接近中分，额前为较厚但轻盈的平直碎齐刘海，长度接近眉毛和眼睛上缘；两侧长发沿肩膀、胸前和手臂自然垂落，几缕发丝被海风吹向外侧，发尾略微凌乱。不要高马尾、大卷发、短 Bob 或无刘海造型。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌柔和，肤色白皙偏中性暖调。深棕色杏仁眼，双眼皮自然，黑色细眼线轻微延长，睫毛清楚；眉毛自然偏细。鼻梁小巧顺直，嘴唇自然丰满，颜色为低饱和裸粉/浅豆沙色。妆容轻薄、干净、偏日系生活照感，不要浓重修容和网红妆。

上身穿一件象牙白/奶油白色短袖水手领衬衫。面料为轻薄哑光棉布，整体宽松但不肥大。领口为经典水手领结构，领缘有深藏蓝/黑蓝色细双线滚边；短袖袖口同样带一圈深色细滚边。领口前方为浅 V 形开口，内部无领带或仅有极简细节。不要生成普通白 T 恤或正式衬衫。

外面套一件深海军蓝/近黑色无袖吊带连衣裙/无袖上衣裙。肩带中等偏宽，从肩部垂直向下连接胸前，前胸为较低方形/圆方形领口，内搭白色水手衫清楚可见。裙身在腰腹位置略微收束，从髋部开始自然向下展开，材质为哑光棉质或制服布料。

裙摆长度约到大腿中下部/膝盖上方，坐姿后自然铺在石墙与腿部周围。整体颜色接近深海军蓝、蓝黑或墨蓝，不加入格纹、百褶或复杂装饰。不要生成黑色妩媚紧身裙、短裙或洛丽塔裙。

人物下半身裸腿，肤色自然白皙。小腿位置穿白色中筒罗纹棉袜，袜筒到小腿中下段，材质柔软、略厚，表面有细密竖向罗纹。鞋子大部分在画面外或被裁切，不强调鞋款。

左下前景放一顶浅米黄色宽檐草帽，帽体为天然编织草材质，帽冠中等高度，帽檐较宽并带轻微毛边/不规则纤维，帽身绕一圈深棕或黑色细带。草帽距离镜头很近，因此尺寸偏大、细节清楚，是重要前景元素。

场景为晴朗白天的海滨步道。人物背后是一片非常浅的叠层蓝绿色海水，靠岸区域颜色从浅薄荷绿、青绿色过渡到稍深的蓝绿色，水面有少量细小波纹。

右后方和人物后方是大片明亮白色/浅米色沙滩，沙面平整，只有少量脚印或轻微阴影。靠近海岸可见一条蓝色浮筒/安全浮标线，横向延伸。

画面中上部横跨一座浅灰绿/青灰绿色混凝土跨海桥，桥面基本水平，从左侧一直延伸到右侧。桥下有粗大的桥墩落入海水中，桥面上方排列细长路灯杆和低矮护栏。不要生成现代玻璃桥、悬索桥或大型拱桥。

远处桥后方可见少量工业港口吊机/施工起重机，其中右上背景有一台较高的红白色塔吊/港机，旁边还有一支倾斜绿色吊臂。它们体积较小，只作为真实港区背景细节。

天空占画面上半部较大区域，为高饱和但真实的晴朗蔚蓝色，基本无云，仅右上方有一小团细薄白云。空气通透、能见度高，呈典型海岛/冲绳式盛夏晴天气质。

光线是非常强烈的正午至下午早段自然阳光，来自画面左上方。人物头发顶部、左侧肩膀、脸颊和裸露腿部出现明显白色高光；人物右侧身体进入较深阴影，形成真实硬朗日照对比。不要柔和阴天光。

人物面部虽然处于部分阴影中，但通过手机 HDR/自动曝光仍保留眼睛、鼻梁和嘴唇细节。黑发在日光下出现冷蓝色高光和细碎发丝反射。白色水手衫局部略亮，但不要完全过曝。

整体呈高质量手机/便携相机夏日旅行随手拍质感：自然手机 HDR、轻微数码锐化、少量细颗粒，人物与桥梁都保持基本清晰，远处海面和工业设施略柔但不做明显人像模式虚化。色彩以高饱和蓝天＋青绿海水＋浅色沙滩＋黑蓝裙装＋奶油白水手衫＋浅草黄色草帽为主，明亮、清爽、带轻微日系青春感。

items.title: 中秋月下改良唐风美女写实写真
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的中秋夜改良唐风时尚人像提示词，保留月白丝绸、桂金轻纱、水袖、桂花金簪、兔灯、临水庭院、冷暖月灯光和 85mm 浅景深，并绑定统一人物参考图。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Character:
A clearly adult East Asian woman with a stylish, confident and gentle presence. She has an oval face, clear elegant eyes and brows, natural balanced proportions, soft contours, luminous skin with a light flush and real pores, and softly lit collarbones and shoulders. Use champagne-gold and osmanthus-brown eyeshadow, thin eyeliner, natural blush and glossy bean-paste pink lips. Her long black hair is arranged in a loose soft high bun, with two slightly curled strands at the temples, secured by a small osmanthus-gold hairpin that reinforces the adult styling.

Clothing and accessory:
Improved Tang-style Mid-Autumn costume. Layer a moon-white light-silk and organza low-collar short ru with a wide soft cross-collar that overlaps naturally. Add a champagne satin bandeau under the gauze and keep the layered coverage complete. The short ru gathers below the ribs and pairs with a low-waist high-slit light osmanthus-gold gauze skirt, whose fine pleats follow the waist and hips before drifting downward. Use smoky-pink to moon-white gradient gauze water sleeves with subtle osmanthus embroidery at the cuffs. Keep only the osmanthus-gold hairpin as the visual accessory.

Scene and lighting:
A classical waterside courtyard on Mid-Autumn night, with a full moon in an indigo sky, osmanthus trees, carved wooden windows, stone railings and warm palace lanterns creating depth. Broken gold moonlight reflects on the water. A warm gold palace lantern at front-left is the soft key light; cool white moonlight from rear-right outlines the hair, shoulders and gauze. Light night mist blends the warm and cool sources for a quiet romantic atmosphere.

Pose and composition:
9:16 vertical composition framed from above the knees, with the woman occupying about 75% of the frame at natural eye level. She stands slightly sideways before the stone railing, weight on the back leg and waist and hips forming a soft curve. One hand lightly holds the outer garment edge, the other supports a small rabbit-shaped lamp, and the water sleeves drift to the side and back in the evening breeze. She faces the camera with a restrained smile and clear confident gaze. Place the full moon above and behind the shoulder, avoiding overlap with the head.

Texture and style:
Realistic ancient-style fashion editorial portrait, high-end Mid-Autumn night photography, 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field and slight film grain. Show silk, satin, organza, flowing sleeves and osmanthus embroidery clearly while retaining natural skin texture. Use a moon-white, osmanthus-gold, smoky-pink and indigo palette with elegant, non-vulgar styling.

Negative prompt:
Underage or child-like appearance, mature middle-aged appearance, overly heavy makeup, vulgar pose, accidental exposure, exposed private areas, slipping neckline, missing inner bandeau, completely transparent gauze, clothing clipping, incorrect costume layers, cheap studio costume, visible modern zipper, stacked jewelry, moon overlapping the head, unnatural face or gaze, extra or missing fingers, merged hands or feet, broken joints, extra limbs, deformed rabbit lamp, floating lantern, stuck sleeves, unnatural gravity, wrong perspective, contradictory shadows, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, excessive HDR, garbled text, logo or watermark.

人物：
一位明确成年的东亚女性，气质时尚、自信、温柔；鹅蛋脸，眉眼清丽，身材匀称自然，轮廓柔和，服装廓形清晰但不夸张。肌肤细腻通透，带轻微血色与真实毛孔，锁骨和肩线泛着柔光。使用香槟金与桂花棕眼影、纤细眼线、自然腮红和水光豆沙粉唇。乌黑长发挽成松柔高髻，鬓边垂落两缕微卷长发，以小巧桂花金簪固定，保持明确成年感。

服装与配饰：
改良唐风中秋古装。穿月白色轻薄真丝与欧根纱叠层低领短襦，宽阔柔和的交领自然交叠；内搭香槟色缎面抹胸，外层薄纱保持完整覆盖。短襦收束于肋骨下方，搭配低腰高开衩浅桂金轻纱长裙，细密褶裥贴合腰胯后向下飘散。水袖为烟粉至月白渐变薄纱，袖缘绣淡雅桂花纹；只保留桂花金簪作为视觉配饰。

场景与光线：
中秋夜临水古典庭院，圆月悬于黛蓝夜空，桂花树、雕花木窗、石栏和暖色宫灯形成景深，水面映出碎金月光。左前方暖金宫灯作为柔和主光，右后方冷白月光勾勒发丝、肩线和薄纱轮廓，轻微夜雾融合冷暖光线，气氛静谧、浪漫、含蓄。

姿势与构图：
9:16 竖构图，膝上取景，人物占画面约 75%，自然平视机位。人物微侧站在石栏前，重心落于后腿，腰胯形成柔和曲线；一手轻扶外层衣襟，另一手托着小巧兔灯，水袖随晚风向侧后方飘动。面向镜头含蓄微笑，目光清澈自信；圆月位于肩后上方，避免与头部重叠。

质感与风格：
写实古风时尚编辑人像，高级中秋夜景写真，85mm 人像镜头，浅景深和轻微胶片颗粒。清晰呈现真丝、缎面、欧根纱、水袖和桂花刺绣纹理，保留真实皮肤质感。使用月白、桂金、烟粉和黛蓝配色，整体优雅而不低俗。

负面提示：
看起来未成年或幼态、成熟中年感、过重浓妆、低俗姿势、走光、敏感部位暴露、领口滑落、内层抹胸缺失、薄纱完全透明、服装穿模、错误古装层次、廉价影楼服、现代拉链外露、首饰堆叠、月亮与头部重叠、不自然的脸和视线、多余或缺失手指、手脚融合、关节崩坏、多余肢体、兔灯变形、灯笼悬浮、水袖粘连、不自然重力、错误透视、矛盾阴影、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、过度 HDR、乱码文字、Logo 或水印。

items.title: 简约时尚人像与手绘插画视觉对比
items.description: 4:5 混合媒介时尚人像：一位成年女性与自己的孩子大小手绘插画副本并置，服装、色彩、姿态和情绪相互呼应，置于简洁的城市墙面与路面环境中。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a highly realistic 4:5 editorial fashion photograph featuring an adult woman in her mid-20s on the right beside a child-sized hand-drawn illustrated girl on the left, designed as her miniature visual counterpart.

The woman has long, naturally wavy dark black-brown hair, a gentle smile, and looks toward the illustrated girl. She wears a cobalt-blue utility jacket with realistic seams, buttons and pockets, both hands inside the pockets; a cream sweater with dark navy horizontal stripes; a long ivory pleated ankle-length skirt; mustard/caramel oval crossbody bag; white ankle socks; and dark burgundy leather loafers.

The illustrated girl matches the woman’s outfit, colors, hairstyle, pose and mood exactly. She remains clearly hand-drawn with delicate pencil/ink outlines, soft watercolor coloring, subtle blush, expressive eyes and a gentle smile.

Set them against a minimalist weathered light-gray concrete wall and rough gray pavement, with no background clutter. Both are fully visible from head to shoes, slightly facing each other, with generous negative space.

Use soft overcast natural daylight, subtle shadows, realistic skin and fabric texture, 50mm full-frame camera, eye-level perspective, f/4, natural proportions and high resolution. Premium minimalist Japanese/Korean street-fashion editorial aesthetic blended with whimsical children's illustration.

Negative: no mismatched outfits, altered identity, distorted faces/hands, extra limbs or people, photorealistic cartoon, anime woman, cropped feet/head, wide-angle distortion, clutter, text, watermark or logo.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创建一个高度写实的 4:5 社论时尚照片，右侧是一位年轻女性，左侧是一个孩子大小的手绘插图女孩，被设计成她的微缩视觉副本。

这位女性留着长长的、自然波浪状的深黑褐色头发，带着温柔的微笑，看向插图女孩。她穿着一件带有写实接缝、纽扣和口袋的宝蓝色多功能夹克，双手插在口袋里；一件带有深海军蓝水平条纹的米色毛衣；一条象牙色的及踝长褶裙；芥末色/焦糖色的椭圆形斜挎包；白色短袜；以及深酒红色的皮革乐福鞋。

插图女孩与这位女性的装扮、颜色、发型、姿势和心情完全匹配。她保持清晰的手绘风格，带有精致的铅笔/墨水轮廓、柔和的水彩着色、微妙的腮红、富有表现力的眼睛和温柔的微笑。

将她们置于极简的饱经风霜的浅灰色混凝土墙和粗糙的灰色人行道背景下，没有背景杂物。两人从头到脚完全可见，稍微面向彼此，并留有充裕的负空间。

使用柔和的阴天自然日光、微妙的阴影、写实的皮肤和织物纹理、50mm 全画幅相机、平视透视、f/4、自然比例和高分辨率。高品质极简主义日系/韩系街头时尚社论美学与奇幻的儿童插画相融合。

负面：不要不匹配的装扮、改变的身份、扭曲的面部/手部、额外的肢体或人物、写实主义卡通、动漫女性、裁剪掉的脚/头、广角畸变、杂乱、文字、水印或标志。

items.title: 刺绣旅行布贴海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Please turn each travel photo I upload into a separate "Embroidered Travel Patch" high-end editorial poster, not a multi-image collage, with each photo output individually.

The overall layout uses a 3:4 vertical original-photo-comparison composition. The upper half retains a clear original photo with substantial area, and the lower half presents a single embroidered travel subject extracted from the same photo. The top and bottom usually occupy about 50% each, which can be slightly adjusted according to the photo ratio, but the original photo comparison must not be cancelled.

The upper half preserves the subject identity, quantity, posture, structure, observation angle, environmental relationship, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original colors in the photo with high fidelity, only performing slight travel magazine and art publication color grading. The upper part must continue to be a real photographic work, and must not be illustrated, have scenes replaced, have subjects added or deleted, or have the structure of buildings and transportation vehicles changed.

When the original photo ratio is not suitable for the horizontal area, it should be centered to retain its own ratio, and supplemented with the solid color sidebars of the lower half's fabric background, without stretching, mirroring, or using blurred photo edge-filling.

The lower half should not embroider the entire photo completely. Only select one core subject with the most recognition and clearest outline from the photo, such as a tram, a boat, a bicycle, a hot air balloon, an animal, a person with clear movements, or a travel object.

Retain the outer contour, orientation, posture, key structure, and iconic color blocks that determine the subject's identity, and delete building complexes, streets, sky, water surfaces, mountains, trees, and other complex backgrounds.

The subject uses a reduced extraction or single-item display composition, occupying about 28%—52% of the width and about 30%—50% of the height of the lower area, usually placed in the center or lower middle. Retain about 45%—65% of continuous, complete fabric open space without fragmented decorations around it.

2—5 short stitches can be added to imply tracks, water waves, wind direction, ground, or movement direction, but they must not develop into a complete background, and a second visual subject must not appear.

The background of the lower half is a whole piece of clearly visible twill, old canvas, coarse cotton, or linen. The fabric base color must be extracted from the original photo and adaptively changed according to each photo, such as grayish blue, terracotta pink, turquoise, smoky blue-gray, warm beige, or other low-saturation colors; do not use the same off-white cloth fixedly for all photos.

Use real satin stitch, split stitch, chain stitch, backstitch, and a small amount of loose thread to constitute the subject. The stitch direction must change according to the subject's blocks, structure, and movements: metal, wood, clothes, animal fur, wheels, hulls, balloons, or plants need to be expressed using embroidery threads of different directions, lengths, and pile heights.

Localized thread piling, slightly uneven stitches, edge misalignment, exposed backing, loose threads, thread ends, and fabric wrinkling are allowed, making it look like real handmade embroidery sewn on a fabric surface, rather than a printed illustration or digital filter.

Each work extracts 4—8 embroidery thread colors from the original photo, retaining the subject's most recognizable color relationships, and then appropriately summarizes and softens them. Fixed rainbow threads, neon gradients, or high-saturation color clashing unrelated to the photo must not be used.

Text is concentrated below the embroidered subject, using lower pile height chain stitches, small woven labels, or fabric embroidered characters. By default, it includes a title of 1—3 English words, a field like "PATCH NO. 01", and a short observation sentence of 5—10 English words.

The text content is extracted based on the real visible subject, action, or state in the photo, and must be clearly readable, restrained in quantity, not block the subject, and not generate fake place names, author names, brands, logos, URLs, or gibberish.

Overall presentation is a quiet, warm travel patch visual with handmade temperature and a sense of collectability.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的“刺绣旅行布贴”高级编辑海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用3:4竖版原图对比构图。上半部分保留清楚、具有实质面积的原始照片，下半部分呈现从同一张照片中提取出的单个刺绣旅行主体。上下通常各占约50%，可以根据照片比例轻微调整，但不得取消原图对比。

上半部分高保真保留照片中的主体身份、数量、姿态、结构、观察角度、环境关系、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩，仅进行轻微的旅行杂志与艺术出版物调色。上半必须继续是一张真实摄影作品，不得插画化、替换场景、增删主体或改变建筑与交通工具结构。

原图比例不适合横向区域时，应居中保留自身比例，并使用下半织物底色的纯色侧栏补齐，不拉伸、不镜像、不使用模糊照片填边。

下半部分不要把整张照片完整刺绣出来。只选择照片中最有识别度、轮廓最清楚的一个核心主体，例如一辆电车、一只船、一辆自行车、一个热气球、一只动物、一名动作明确的人物或一个旅行物件。

保留决定主体身份的外轮廓、朝向、姿态、关键结构和标志性色块，删除建筑群、街道、天空、水面、山体、树木和其他复杂背景。

主体采用缩小提炼或单体陈列构图，占下半区域宽度约28%—52%、高度约30%—50%，通常放在中部或中下部。周围保留约45%—65%连续、完整、没有碎片装饰的织物空场。

可以加入2—5条短小针脚，暗示轨道、水波、风向、地面或动作方向，但不得发展成完整背景，也不得出现第二视觉主体。

下半背景是一整块真实可见的斜纹布、旧帆布、粗棉或亚麻。织物底色必须从原照片提取并根据每张照片自适应变化，例如灰蓝、赤陶粉、青绿、烟蓝灰、暖米色或其他低饱和颜色，不要为所有照片固定使用同一种米白布。

使用真实的缎面绣、劈针、锁链针、回针和少量松线构成主体。针脚方向必须跟随主体体块、结构和动作发生变化：金属、木材、衣服、动物毛色、车轮、船身、球囊或植物，需要使用不同方向、长度和绒高的绣线表现。

局部允许绣线堆高、针脚轻微不齐、边缘错位、露底、松线、线头和布面起皱，使它像真正缝在布面上的手工刺绣，而不是印刷插画或数字滤镜。

每张作品从原照片提取4—8种绣线颜色，保留主体最有辨识度的色彩关系，再适度归纳和柔化。不得使用与照片无关的固定彩虹线、霓虹渐变或高饱和撞色。

文字集中在刺绣主体下方，使用较低绒高的链式针脚、小型织标或布面刺绣字。默认包含一个1—3个英文单词的标题、一个“PATCH NO. 01”式字段和一句5—10个英文单词的简短观察句。

文字内容根据照片中真实可见的主体、动作或状态提炼，必须清楚可读、数量克制，不遮挡主体，不生成假地名、作者名、品牌、Logo、网址或乱码。

整体呈现安静、温暖、具有手工温度和收藏感的旅行布贴视觉。真实照片负责保存完整场景，刺绣区域只留下最值得记住的一个主体，像从旅途中取下一枚可以缝在衣服、布袋或行李上的记号。

避免整幅风景全部刺绣、完整背景刺绣、照片同构图换材质、印刷贴纸、平面矢量吉祥物、厚毛毡拼贴、照片粘贴在布上、针织玩具、刺绣圈Mockup、额外人物或动物、时尚品牌标志、作者签名、水印和廉价模板感。

items.title: 超写实日系卧室镜前自拍摄影
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Hyper-realistic Japanese bedroom mirror selfie photography, vertical version approximately 2:3, a young adult East Asian female, clearly adult, sitting on a low soft stool/cushion in a narrow bedroom, taking a selfie with a bright pink portable digital camera facing a full-length mirror. The photographer is actually the character herself, the composition is a front view formed through the mirror, using an approximately 35–50mm equivalent portable digital camera lens, the camera position is near the character's chest and abdomen height and basically at eye level. The character is located in the center of the frame, occupying about 82–88% of the frame height, captured completely from the top of the head to the tips of the shoes; the left and right sides retain the bed, bedding, throw pillows, and wall hangings, the overall look is like a life selfie in a Japanese girl's room from the 2000s–2010s, not a commercial studio shoot. The character is a young adult East Asian female, small to medium frame, narrow shoulders, naturally slender upper body, short waist, natural and moderate pelvis and hips, naturally soft and well-proportioned thighs, slender calves. The overall proportion is a small-framed, compact, naturally light adult female, do not generate tall Western models, athletic muscular types, exaggerated wide hips, or excessively plump figures. The character sits on a blue square soft cushion/low stool, the surface of the cushion is printed with cartoon moon, stars, and sleep-themed patterns, the bottom is placed on the floor covered with a patterned carpet. The pelvis is located in the lower center of the frame, and the upper body leans slightly forward. The legs are an important structure of the image: both legs are bent at the knees and raised close to the front of the camera, the knees are very close together, almost touching, forming a natural adducted sitting posture. The thighs are folded upward and forward from the hips, the calves then hang down, and the feet fall at the bottom of the frame, with the tips of the shoes slightly separated outward. Do not cross legs, do not cross one leg over the other, and do not have both legs completely straight. The character's right hand holds a bright rose red/magenta small portable digital camera, the camera size is small, the body is high-saturation pink, the front has an obvious large black circular lens, with a small amount of silver or black details around it. The camera is located in front of the chest slightly to the character's right side, fingers naturally gripping the body, as if pressing the shutter. The character's other hand is raised to the side of the face, the palm supporting the left cheek/chin, the elbow naturally close to the chest or near the knee. The head tilts slightly toward the hand-supporting side, the movement is quiet and soft. The character's gaze is slightly downward looking at the camera or the mirror surface, the expression is calm, with a bit of laziness and shyness, no-teeth smile. Lips are naturally closed, the color is low-saturation pink. The character has black short Bob/short wolf-cut hair, the length is near the chin and the back of the neck, overall fluffy but not exaggerated. There are thick long fragmented straight bangs in front of the forehead, the length is close to the upper edge of the eyes, a few strands of bangs in the center naturally hang down and cover part of the eyebrows. The hair near the right side of the face is longer, gently touching the cheek. The hair ends are a mix of slight inner buckle and outward flip, with a bit of natural messiness. Do not have long straight hair, high ponytails, or large curls. The face shape is small and somewhat oval, the jawline is soft, and the skin tone is fair and cool-toned. Dark brown almond eyes, natural double eyelids, eyelashes are long but not exaggerated, thin eyeliner; eyebrows are naturally thin. The bridge of the nose is small, and the lips are light pink. The makeup is light and leans toward a natural Japanese style, with a slight pink blush on both cheeks, maintaining real skin texture overall, do not over-smooth the skin. The upper body wears a solid white short-sleeved slim-fit T-shirt/short home top, the neckline is a wide round neck or a shallow U-neck, the fabric is soft and slightly elastic, fitting the body but not excessively tight. The cuffs are short and simple, without patterns, logos, or complex decorations.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

超写实日系卧室镜前自拍摄影，竖版约 2:3，一名年轻成年东亚女性，明确成年，坐在狭小卧室里的低矮软凳/坐垫上，用一台亮粉色便携数码相机对着落地镜自拍。摄影者实际为人物自己，画面通过镜面形成正面构图，采用约 35–50mm 等效便携数码相机镜头，机位接近人物胸腹高度并基本平视。人物位于画面中央，占画面高度约 82–88%，从头顶完整拍到鞋尖；左右两侧保留床铺、被褥、抱枕和墙面挂布，整体像 2000s–2010s 日本少女房间里的生活自拍，不是商业棚拍。

人物为年轻成年东亚女性，中小骨架，肩部偏窄，上半身自然纤细，腰部较短，骨盆与髋部自然适中，大腿自然柔软匀称，小腿修长。整体是小骨架、紧凑、自然轻盈的成年女性比例，不要生成高挑欧美模特、健美肌肉型、夸张宽胯或过度丰满身材。

人物坐在一只蓝色方形软垫/矮凳上，软垫表面印有卡通月亮、星星和睡眠主题图案，底部放在铺着花纹地毯的地面上。骨盆位于画面中央偏下，上半身略微向前倾。

双腿是画面的重要结构：两条腿都屈膝抬起并向镜头前方靠近，膝盖靠得很近，几乎并拢，形成自然的内收坐姿。大腿从髋部向前上方折起，小腿再向下垂，双脚落在画面最下方，鞋尖略微向外分开。不要盘腿，不要翘二郎腿，也不要双腿完全伸直。

人物右手举一台亮玫红/洋红色小型便携数码相机，相机尺寸较小，机身为高饱和粉色，正面有一个明显的大型黑色圆形镜头，周围带少量银色或黑色细节。相机位于胸前略偏人物右侧，手指自然握住机身，像正在按快门。

人物另一只手抬到脸侧，手掌托住左侧脸颊/下巴，手肘自然靠近胸前或膝盖附近。头部轻轻向托脸一侧倾斜，动作安静、柔软。

人物视线略微向下看向相机或镜面，表情平静、略带一点慵懒和害羞感，不露齿笑。嘴唇自然闭合，颜色为低饱和粉红色。

人物留乌黑色短 Bob/短狼尾感发型，长度到下巴和后颈附近，整体蓬松但不夸张。额前为较厚的长碎齐刘海，长度接近眼睛上缘，中央几束刘海自然垂下并遮住部分眉毛。右侧脸附近的头发更长，轻轻贴着脸颊。发尾略微内扣和外翘混合，带一点自然凌乱感。不要长直发、高马尾、大卷发。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌柔和，肤色白皙偏冷。深棕色杏仁眼，双眼皮自然，睫毛较长但不夸张，眼线细；眉毛自然偏细。鼻梁小巧，嘴唇浅粉。妆容轻薄、偏日系自然妆，双颊有轻微粉色腮红，整体保持真实皮肤纹理，不要过度磨皮。

上身穿一件纯白色短袖修身 T 恤/短款家居上衣，领口为宽圆领或浅 U 领，面料柔软、略有弹性，贴合身体但不过分紧身。袖口短而简单，没有图案、Logo 或复杂装饰。

下身穿白色短裤/白色超短家居裤，大部分被抬起的大腿和构图遮挡，只在髋部和腿根附近露出少量白色布料。整体是很简洁的全白家居搭配，不要生成裙子、牛仔裤或彩色下装。

双腿穿纯白色过膝袜/长筒棉袜，袜筒到膝盖上方附近，颜色干净偏奶白，材质为柔软细密针织，表面略有轻微纵向纹理。袜口平整，没有彩色条纹或大 Logo。袜子整体不叠层，不要生成半叠层丝袜或黑丝袜。

脚穿一双银灰色＋白色复古运动鞋/厚实低帮跑鞋，鞋型偏 2000s 复古运动鞋，鞋头圆润、鞋底较厚但不过分夸张。鞋面由银灰、浅灰、白色拼接，带明显白色鞋带和深灰色弧形装饰线条。两只鞋完整出现在画面底部，鞋尖微微朝外。

背景是一个非常拥挤、可爱、日系卡通感浓厚的小卧室。人物身后墙面不是纯白，而是被大量红白格纹和卡通布艺装饰覆盖。

画面左上墙面挂有一块红白色卡通挂布/海报，主体是一个大型蓝白猫型卡通角色的红白化图案，周围有棋盘格、圆形和小图标装饰。不要要求生成准确版权角色文字或 Logo，只保留“蓝白机器猫风格卡通挂布”的视觉感觉。

人物背后正中央有一块大型红白格纹窗帘/布帘，外圈为红白 gingham 小格纹，中央区域印有大量彩色街道、商店、小汽车、房屋、圣诞树或童话城市图案，视觉信息非常丰富。中央偏右有一棵深绿色圣诞树图案，上面点缀彩色小球和灯饰，是背景的重要视觉元素。

窗帘上方还有一条横向大型卡通布饰，颜色以奶油白、红、浅蓝和粉色为主，带食物、动物或童趣插画，但文字保持模糊不可读。

画面左侧是一张窄床，床头靠墙，铺着浅黄色/奶油黄色条纹或格纹被褥。床上放着一个大型蓝白色卡通圆脸抱枕/毛绒玩偶，只有部分进入画面。床架为深棕木色。

画面右侧同样有另一张床或软垫家具，铺着白色、橙色和浅蓝色卡通床品。右边缘可见一个浅蓝色毛绒毯/毛巾从床边自然垂下。后方枕头上有黄色卡通人物图案和橙色边缘。

人物身后下方还能看到一只深棕色小桌/矮柜，周围有少量电线、充电线或杂物，增强真实私人卧室感。

地面铺着一块颜色略旧的花纹地毯，以灰白、淡粉、酒红和浅蓝色为主，图案不规则，带一点长期使用后的轻微磨损。

光线采用室内顶灯/环境灯＋便携数码相机弱直闪。人物脸部、白色上衣、大腿、白袜和鞋面被明显提亮，背景仍保持清楚但稍暗。肤色呈偏冷白和淡粉色，银灰运动鞋产生柔和反光。

9:16 vertical version, hyper-realistic real-person photography, high-budget Oriental period fantasy film costume portrait, fusion of Chinese classical court aesthetics and Oriental mythological aesthetics, a clearly adult adult East Asian woman in her mid-20s sitting in a dark and gorgeous Oriental palace, facing the camera frontally, upper body to waist composition.

【Character】
23-27 years old adult East Asian woman,
exquisite natural oval face,
small face shape but consistent with real adult female bone proportions,
soft and smooth jawline,
fair ivory skin,
delicate and transparent skin but retaining real pores and micro-textures,
straight and exquisite bridge of the nose,
small nose tip,
deep brownish-black almond eyes,
natural double eyelids,
slight upturned outer corners of the eyes,
long and natural eyelashes,
cold, quiet, and slightly mysterious gaze.
Thin and natural eyebrows,
real eyebrow hair flow.
Warm brown and light reddish-brown eye makeup,
slightly darkened outer corners of the eyes,
very faint red smudge on the lower eyelid,
natural aegyo-sal.
Full and soft lips,
low-saturation cinnabar red, coral red gradient lip makeup,
has a slight moisturizing feel.
A very small, exquisite, symmetrical cinnabar red classical floral ornament (Huadian) painted in the very center of the forehead,
composed of several tiny red dots,
no large forehead accessories.

【Hairstyle】
Thick jet-black long hair,
large Oriental classical high bun,
rounded and fluffy volume on top of the head,
symmetrical bun structure on the left and right but not overly stiff.
Middle part with a natural parting line,
a small amount of natural black flyaway hair retained at the forehead and temples,
a few strands of long, thin hair falling naturally by the sides of the ears.
Every strand of hair is distinct,
has the luster of real black hair,
no plastic wigs.
Warm contour light passing through the edges of the bun,
producing delicate golden hair light.

【Headwear】
Wearing a large hollowed-out champagne gold classical flower crown in the center of the top of the head.
The core is an oval deep red gemstone,
the gemstone has a pomegranate red/red agate texture,
surrounded by symmetrical golden hollowed-out flower and leaf, scrolling grass patterns, and petal structures.
Several smaller golden flower hairpins inserted into the left and right buns,
flower cores inlaid with red gemstones.
Long classical step-shakers (Buyao) hanging down from both sides,
structure includes: fine gold chains, small rubies, white pearls, teardrop-shaped pearls, golden flowers.
The length of the step-shakers reaches below the ears,
basically symmetrical on the left and right,
draping naturally.

【Earrings】
Wearing large golden flower-shaped earrings on both sides,
inlaid with rubies in the center,
connected to white teardrop pearls below.
Earrings are fine and slender,
have real metal highlights.

【Necklace】
Wearing multiple layers of champagne gold bead chains and pearl chains on the neck.
A large Oriental hollowed-out golden pendant hanging in the center of the chest,
the pendant central part is inlaid with a large oval deep red ruby.
Several red teardrop gemstones of different sizes hanging below,
forming a gorgeous court jewelry effect.

【Clothing——Most Important】
Character wears a deep dark green, peacock green, black-green velvet-textured tube-top style Oriental fantasy gown.
Shoulders are completely exposed,
clavicles are complete and clear,
the upper edge of the garment is a soft heart-shaped tube-top structure.
The center of the chest is covered by an extremely exquisite large 3D gold-plated phoenix breastplate decoration.
The phoenix pattern spreads out to the left and right,
highly symmetrical structure.
The phoenix wings spread from the center to the upper left and right,
feathers are composed of a large number of dense champagne gold metal feathers.
Metal patterns include: phoenix feathers, flame patterns, scrolling grass patterns, flower and leaf patterns, cloud patterns, Oriental court hollowed-out patterns.
A large oval deep red ruby is inlaid in the center of the phoenix chest ornament,
several tiny rubies exist around it.
The metal is not a flat print,
must have obvious 3D relief thickness,
like high-end court jewelry truly forged from gold.
The surface of the chest ornament produces soft warm gold highlights,
real metal reflections exist on the edges.

【Shawl (Pibo)】
Large areas of semi-transparent dark green/cyan-green light gauze shawls (Pibo) draped on the outside of the character's arms.
A very light champagne gold transparent gauze layer is mixed in the shawl.
Thin gauze features: semi-transparent, silk luster, weak gold powder, fine gold thread texture.

【人物】

23-27岁成年东亚女性，

精致自然鹅蛋脸，

脸型小巧但符合真实成年女性骨骼比例，

柔和流畅下颌线，

白皙象牙色肌肤，

鼻尖小巧，

真实眉毛毛流。

暖棕色与浅红棕色眼妆，

眼尾轻微加深，

下眼睑带极淡红色晕染，

自然卧蚕。

嘴唇饱满柔软，

低饱和朱砂红、珊瑚红渐变唇妆，

由数个微小红点组成，

浓密乌黑长发，

大型东方古典高髻，

头顶具有圆润蓬松体积，

左右发髻结构对称但不过度僵硬。

中分偏自然分缝，

额前和太阳穴保留少量自然黑色碎发，

耳侧几缕细长发丝自然垂落。

发丝根根分明，

具有真实黑发光泽，

不要塑料假发。

暖色轮廓光穿过发髻边缘，

产生细腻金色发丝光。

【头饰】

头顶中央佩戴大型镂空香槟金古典花冠。

核心为一颗椭圆形深红色宝石，

细金链

小型红宝石

白色珍珠

水滴形珍珠

金色花朵。

步摇长度达到耳朵以下，

左右基本对称，

自然垂坠。

【耳饰】

左右佩戴大型金色花形耳坠，

中央镶嵌红宝石，

下方连接白色水滴珍珠。

耳饰精细、纤细，

颈部佩戴多层香槟金珠链与珍珠链。

吊坠中央镶嵌大型椭圆深红宝石。

下方垂落数枚大小不同的红色水滴宝石，

形成华丽宫廷珠宝效果。

【服装——最重要】

人物穿深墨绿色、孔雀绿、黑绿色丝绒质感抹胸式东方幻想礼服。

肩部完全露出，

锁骨完整清晰，

服装上缘为柔和心形抹胸结构。

上半身中央覆盖一件极其精致的大型立体鎏金凤凰胸甲装饰。

凤凰纹样左右展开，

呈高度对称结构。

凤凰双翼从中央向左右上方展开，

羽毛由大量细密的香槟金金属羽片组成。

金属纹样具有：

凤凰羽毛

火焰纹

卷草纹

花叶纹

云纹

东方宫廷镂空纹样。

凤凰胸饰中央镶嵌一颗大型椭圆形深红宝石，

周围存在数颗微小红宝石。

金属不是平面印花，

必须具有明显3D浮雕厚度，

像真正由黄金锻造而成的高级宫廷首饰。

胸饰表面产生柔和暖金色高光，

边缘存在真实金属反射。

【披帛】

人物双臂外侧披着大面积半叠层墨绿/青绿色轻纱披帛。

披帛中混合非常淡的香槟金叠层纱层。

薄纱具有：

半叠层

丝绸光泽

微弱金粉

细密金线纹理。

披帛自然从肩部滑落至手臂，

露出完整肩膀和锁骨。

不要现代袖子，

不要普通汉服大袖。

【动作——严格锁定】

人物正面坐在深色桌案后。

肩膀自然展开，

姿态端庄。

左前臂横放在桌面上，

手掌自然放松。

另一只手抬起。

食指竖直，

指尖非常轻地触碰下唇中央。

其他手指自然微微弯曲，

不要刻意张开。

动作具有一种安静、神秘、若有所思的感觉。

双眼直视摄影机。

表情平静，

不笑，

略带距离感和神秘东方贵族气质。

【背景——关键】

幽暗的中国古典宫廷室内。

整体背景为极深墨绿色、黑绿色。

人物左右两侧出现巨大的对称鎏金中国龙浮雕。

右上方另一条金色东方龙。

金色鳞片

中国传统龙头

龙角

胡须

锋利爪部。

两条龙沿画面左右边缘盘旋，

不要恐龙。

背景深处存在极轻微古典云纹、宫廷纹样，

保持暗调虚化。

【前景】

画面左下角存在一根燃烧中的象牙白蜡烛，

古铜色烛台。

蜡烛火焰呈温暖橙黄色，

轻微虚焦。

人物面前深色桌面上散落少量华丽金色古典首饰：

金簪

红宝石发饰

金属步摇

粉白色玉石小饰品。

右下角存在一个小型古铜色镂空香炉/首饰盒。

所有前景元素保持适度虚化，

【灯光】

电影级低调布光。

主光从人物右前上方约45度照射，

重点照亮：

面部

双眼

鼻梁

嘴唇

肩膀

锁骨

金属凤凰胸饰。

人物右侧头发存在明显但柔和的金色轮廓光。

金属凤凰胸饰受到光线照射后产生漂亮的香槟金反射，

红宝石出现深红色透光。

高光不过曝，

阴影保留丰富细节

items.title: 高级胶片质感旅行手账
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。
items.prompt_zh:
请将上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级 3:4 竖版旅行手账作品，不要把多张照片拼在同一张图中。

画面采用清晰的上下结构：

上半部分约占画面 50%，完整保留输入的真实照片。保持主体身份、人物数量与姿态、建筑结构、道路方向、空间关系、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩，不得更换地点、增删人物、重塑建筑、改变透视或把照片画成插画。只允许进行轻微的旅行杂志级调色与克制的胶片质感。

下半部分约占画面 50%，呈现一本真实摊开的旅行手账。手账放在低饱和深色桌面上，清楚表现左右页面、中央书脊、纸页厚度、轻微翻页弧度、自然投影和细腻纸张纹理。书本两侧可以使用黑色长尾夹固定。

左页使用一块从照片色彩中提取的低饱和纸张作为底页，在上面粘贴一张同一旅行照片的撕边印刷照片。照片必须保持原场景可辨认，但可以重新裁切以突出最重要的主体。撕边应具有真实纸纤维、轻微翘边和自然厚度，并使用两到三小段半叠层米色胶带固定。

右页保留大面积连续的暖白色纸张，不要塞满内容。根据输入照片中真实可见或能够可靠确认的信息，选择二到四件值得纪念的小元素，例如：

- 建筑局部、窗户、拱门、屋顶、路灯或瓷砖纹样；
- 车辆号码牌、街道路牌、车票或交通线路片段；
- 水面、植物、船只、桥梁、雕塑或当地材料纹理；
- 一张很小的撕边照片、一块方格纸或一段简短铅笔速写。

纪念元素必须来自输入照片或已确认的地点信息，不得加入其他城市的地标、通用旅游贴纸或虚构纪念品。所有小元素都必须明显小于左页主照片，并围绕文字松散分布，保持右页安静、克制和有呼吸感。

右页只加入以下三层英文文字：

1. 一个根据照片主体或地点提炼的 1–3 个英文单词标题；
2. 一个简短字段，格式为“PLACE / FIELD NOTE”；如果无法可靠确定地点，使用“TRAVEL / FIELD NOTE”；
3. 一句 5–12 个英文单词的观察句，只描述照片中真实可见的颜色、光线、建筑、道路、自然景物或空间感受。

文字必须简短、准确、清楚可读，使用深棕色铅笔、钢笔或自然手写质感。不要生成长段落，不要添加作者名、日期、坐标、品牌、网址、二维码、Logo、乱码、假中文或其他文字。

整体风格像一本真实旅行结束后整理出来的私人纪念手账：安静、温暖、克制、具有真实纸张、胶带、撕边照片和收藏物的触感。上方是真实世界，下方是从同一地点留下来的纸面记忆。

必须保持：

- 一张输入照片对应一张独立成品；
- 3:4 竖版；
- 上下区域接近 1:1；
- 上方照片清楚、完整且高度保真；
- 下方必须是真实摊开的手账，不是平面双栏海报；
- 左页承担主要照片；
- 右页保留大面积留白；
- 纪念元素必须来自同一地点；
- 所有图片内容都能追溯到输入照片。

避免：multiple-photo collage, grid layout, altered architecture, invented landmark, replaced subject, distorted perspective, mirrored extension, blurred-photo background, dense scrapbook, excessive stickers, generic travel icons, unrelated souvenirs, full-page decoration, glossy digital template, flat vector layout, plastic 3D, illegible text, excessive typography, fake logo, watermark, signature.

items.title: 高级编辑感水粉拼贴旅行海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please turn the travel portrait photo I uploaded into a single high-end editorial poster, do not stitch multiple photos. Use a 3:4 vertical composition, with the top and bottom areas strictly 1:1.

The upper part retains the original photo, keeping the person's identity, face shape, expression, hairstyle, posture, main clothing colors, and identifiable small objects, without changing the relationship between the person and the original image. Only perform slight high-end photographic color grading, preserving the texture of a real photo.

The lower part extracts the person from the photo into a pastel gouache travel portrait. Use matte opaque gouache, pastel dry brushing, and thick outlines with a slight charcoal feel, preserving the person's movement, clothing structure, hairstyle direction, and emotion, but removing most environmental details. The person can be moderately enlarged or recropped to make the lower part look more like an independent travel portrait.

The background of the lower part must be a single solid color block extracted from the original image's colors, continuously filling from the edges of the frame, without windows, plants, streets, tables, chairs, buildings, gradients, decorative color blocks, or any scene information. Reserve about 18%–30% of continuous negative space for text; gouache brushstrokes only exist inside the person and near the outlines.

The colors are extracted from the original image into 5–7 soft colors, reducing noise and saturation while maintaining the warm-cool relationship of the original photo. The image features paper grain, dry brush gaps, slight color bleeding over lines, and a hand-edited feel.

Add only a small amount of clearly readable English editorial text:
【Fill in a short title based on the scene】
【GOUACHE NOTE 01/02/03/04】
Plus one tasteful knee-length travel observation. Use hand-drawn narrow font with slight dry brush gaps for the text, without covering the person's facial features.

No author names, logos, watermarks, fake Chinese, garbled characters, plastic 3D feel, cartoon template feel, or complete replication of the original scene.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请将我上传的旅行人物照片制作成一张独立的高级编辑海报，不拼接多张照片。采用 3:4 竖版构图，上下两个区域严格 1:1。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持人物身份、脸型、表情、发型、姿态、服装主色和可识别的小物件，不改变人物与原图的关系。仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，保留真实照片质感。

下半部分将照片中的人物提炼为粉彩水粉旅拍小像。使用哑光不叠层水粉、粉彩干刷和略带炭笔感的粗轮廓，保留人物的动作、服装结构、发型方向和情绪，但删去大部分环境细节。人物可以适度放大或重裁，让下半部分更像一张独立的旅途肖像。

下半部分背景必须是从原图颜色中提取的一整块纯色，从画面边缘连续铺满，不出现窗户、植物、街道、桌椅、建筑、渐变、装饰色块或任何场景信息。保留约 18%–30% 的连续留白用于文字，水粉笔触只存在于人物内部和轮廓附近。

颜色从原图提炼为 5–7 种柔和色，降低杂色和饱和度，保留原照片的冷暖关系。画面具有纸张颗粒、干刷缺口、轻微越线和手工编辑感。

只添加少量清晰可读的英文编辑文字：
【根据画面填写一个简短标题】
【GOUACHE NOTE 01/02/03/04】
再加一句很短的旅行观察。文字使用略带干刷缺口的手绘窄体字，不覆盖人物五官。

不要作者名、Logo、水印、假中文、乱码、塑料 3D 感、卡通模板感或完整复刻原场景。

items.title: 阁楼窗边披上白衬衫的日本女性全身抓拍
items.description: 3:4 全身手机抓拍风格的成人日本女性时装场景：她在旧阁楼窗边把白色宽松衬衫重新搭回肩上，展开的衣料、斜射夕光和生活化背景共同构成画面重点。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

3:4 vertical full-body smartphone snapshot in an old loft studio, a casual photo taken by a friend rather than a posed fashion shoot. The clearly adult Japanese woman, about 24-28 years old, is caught while putting a loose white shirt back over her shoulders. Her short black bob reaches the chin, with wispy bangs and a few strands displaced by motion. Use a natural adult physique and keep the body fully clothed; no private exposure and no composition that treats any body part as the subject.

She wears a white fitted crop top with thin straps and a practical V-neck, a lightweight loose white shirt worn through the sleeves with the front open, faded light-to-mid blue skinny jeans, black thin-strap open-toe heels without platforms, and small silver earrings. No brand names, logos, or added text.

The shirt is the visual counterpoint: both arms extend slightly backward as she settles it onto her shoulders, sleeves and hem spreading left and right like soft wings. One foot is half a step forward, weight shifted to the other leg, with a natural asymmetry and an unperformed in-between expression. She looks slightly beside the camera toward her next action.

Composition: the person stands slightly right of center and occupies about 83% of the frame from head to shoes. Approximate landmarks are head 12-14% from the top, waist 47%, knees 70%, and soles 93%. The expanded shirt reaches about 75% of the frame width. Keep blank plaster-wall space from the upper left to center; a tall industrial window fills about 35-40% of the right side.

Setting: lived-in old loft studio with uneven off-white plaster, small scratches, a warm brown worn wood floor, and a large window showing faint blue sky, greenery, distant buildings, or power lines. An empty old wooden frame leans at lower left; add at most one small canvas tote or folded cloth at the floor edge.

Lighting and camera: warm late-afternoon sunlight enters from the right, making long diagonal window-frame shadows across the floor; the left side remains in natural indoor shade. Preserve realistic fabric folds, slight backlight through the shirt, skin texture, modest highlight clipping, subtle sensor noise, and very slight motion softness at hair and shirt edges. Smartphone-like 35-45mm perspective from chest-to-waist height, 3-4m away, almost level, no portrait-mode blur or ultra-wide distortion.

Negative: underage-looking or student styling, celebrity resemblance, nudity or private exposure, provocative pose, body-part emphasis, unrealistic proportions, plastic skin, heavy beauty retouching, strong background blur, extreme lighting, platform shoes, loose pants, long curly hair, brand text, logos, app UI, icons, borders, or unnatural text.

--ar 3:4

3:4 纵向全身智能手机抓拍，场景是带有生活痕迹的旧阁楼工作室；像朋友随手拍下的瞬间，而不是摆拍的时装成片。一位明确成年的日本女性，约 24–28 岁，正在把宽松白衬衫重新搭回肩膀。黑色短鲍勃发至下巴，带轻薄刘海，几缕发丝因动作自然散开。保持自然成年体型并完全着衣，不暴露私密部位，也不让任何身体部位成为画面主角。

她穿白色修身细肩带短款上衣，V 领适合日常穿着；外搭一件轻薄宽松白衬衫，只穿入袖子、前襟敞开；下装为褪色浅至中蓝色细身牛仔裤；脚穿黑色细带露趾高跟鞋，不要厚底；仅佩戴小银耳环。不添加品牌名、logo 或额外文字。

衬衫是画面的视觉对照：她正将衬衫重新搭上肩膀，双臂从身体两侧略向后展开，袖子和下摆向左右铺开，像柔软的翅膀。一只脚向前半步，重心落在另一条腿上，身体保留自然不对称；表情是未完成动作中的中间状态，视线落在镜头旁侧并转向下一步动作。

构图：人物略偏画面右侧，从头到鞋约占画面高度 83%；头部距顶部约 12–14%，腰部约 47%，膝盖约 70%，鞋底约 93%。展开的衬衫约延伸至画面宽度 75%。左上至中央保留空白石膏墙，右侧约 35–40% 由延伸到地面的工业风高窗占据。

场景：米白色不均匀石膏墙，有小擦痕和年代感；暖棕色旧木地板带划痕和色差；窗外隐约可见淡蓝天空、绿意、远处建筑或电线。左下靠墙随意放一个空旧木框，地板边缘最多增加一个小帆布包或叠起的薄布。

光线与相机：午后偏晚的温暖阳光从右侧进入，在地板上投下窗棂的长条斜影，左侧保持室内自然阴影。保留真实布料褶皱、衬衫轻微逆光透光、自然肌肤纹理、略微溢出的高光、暗部细微噪点，以及发梢和衬衫边缘极轻的动感柔化。相机距人物约 3–4 米，位于胸部至腰部高度，接近水平，使用类似 35–45mm 的自然手机视角；不要人像模式强虚化或超广角畸变。

避免：看起来未成年或学生风、类似真实名人的脸、裸体或私密部位暴露、过度挑逗姿势、强调身体单一部位、非现实比例、塑料肌肤、过度美颜、强烈背景虚化、极端光效、厚底鞋、宽松裤、长卷发、品牌文字、logo、应用界面、图标、边框和不自然文字。
