items.title: 高端垂直切片文字排版商业海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Create a 9:16 high-end editorial campaign poster for Kiyomizu-dera Temple in Kyoto, Japan using vertical sliced typography. Use the uppercase main word KYOTO as the dominant visual, about 80–88% of the width, bold and readable at thumbnail size. Embed one single continuous photographic scene of Kiyomizu-dera Temple in Kyoto, Japan with sunlit flowing water across all letters and extended lower slices; keep the photographic subject, water, limbs, props, and environmental elements completely inside the typography. Use a warm white background, generous negative space, and a vermillion, cedar-brown, stone-gray, and moss-green palette with a subtle lower-right paper shadow. Place KYOTO / 2026 at top left, TEMPLE / WATER / LIGHT at top right, cedar wood / stone / flowing water at bottom left, and KIYOMIZU-DERA at bottom right in small precise sans-serif type. Preserve one coherent temple-and-water photograph through every letter and slice, with deliberate varied lengths, clean clipping, no barcode-like strips, no random placeholder text, no watermark, and no decorative clutter.
items.prompt_zh: 以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。为京都清水寺创作一张9:16竖版高端编辑海报，使用垂直切片字体排版。将大写主词 KYOTO 作为主视觉，占画面宽度约80–88%，在缩略图尺寸下保持加粗、清晰可读。在所有字母和向下延伸的切片中嵌入一张包含京都清水寺与阳光流动水面的单一连续照片；人物、水流、道具和环境元素必须完全保持在字体内部。使用暖白色背景、充足负空间，以及朱红、雪松棕、石灰灰和苔藓绿配色，在字体后方添加向右下方略微偏移的柔和纸张阴影。左上角放置 KYOTO / 2026，右上角放置 TEMPLE / WATER / LIGHT，左下角放置 cedar wood / stone / flowing water，右下角放置 KIYOMIZU-DERA，均使用细小、精确的无衬线字体。让同一张连贯的清水寺与水面照片自然贯穿每个字母和切片，切片长度有意变化、裁剪干净；避免条形码状切片、随机占位文本、水印和装饰性杂乱。

items.title: 线迹旅行记忆负形海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Please turn each travel photo I upload into an independent "Stitch Travel Memory" editorial poster, outputting each photo separately without any multi-image stitching. This style is suitable for photos of 1–3 people with complete silhouettes and clear postures, involving actions such as walking, holding hands, holding umbrellas, supporting each other, gliding, hugging, climbing, or other directional movements. It is best if the photos contain roads, railings, shadows, waterfronts, ropes, tracks, or movement traces that can be developed into a continuous stitch line running through the frame. The overall design adopts a 3:4 vertical double-layer structure, but it is not a common top-photo-bottom-illustration contrast; instead, it is a "negative memory structure" where the upper figures are hollowed out and the lower figures are filled back in. The upper part accounts for approximately 58%–66% of the frame. Faithfully preserve the environmental photography from the original photo, including architecture, roads, mountains/water, sky, light and shadow, perspective, weather, location colors, and spatial relationships, applying only slight desaturation, a powdery texture, and old art publication color grading. The figures in the photo, following their original count, position, scale, posture, movement direction, body overlap, and contact relationships, are to be completely replaced with warm paper-white negative silhouettes. The figure negatives must accurately cover the original positions of the figures, without moving, enlarging, or changing their postures. Edges should be clear but with a slight paper fiber texture, using only minimal graphite inner lines to hint at hair, hands, clothing boundaries, backpacks, umbrellas, cameras, or movement contact points. The interior of the upper figures cannot retain photographic colors, nor can it just have a white stroke added. The viewer should feel that the people have left the real scene, leaving behind only an accurate paper-white vacancy. The lower part accounts for approximately 34%–42% of the frame. Use warm off-white coarse-textured paper as a continuous background. Reintroduce the same group of people from the upper part in identical postures, counts, movement relationships, and core objects, reduced in size and filled back in as deep charcoal grey, faded black ink, or graphite solid "figure echoes". Lower figures typically occupy 20%–42% of the width and 25%–55% of the height of the lower area, significantly smaller than the upper negatives. Based on the original movement direction, place them in the left-leaning, right-leaning, or center-bottom area to create a vertical, diagonal, or movement-directional echo with the upper figures. The lower part must maintain at least 55% continuous paper white. Only one to three extremely faint graphite lines are allowed to hint at roads, hillsides, railings, waterfronts, or environmental directions; do not redraw a complete background. Select a real meaningful movement or environmental clue from the photo, such as: the position of held hands, an umbrella handle, a camera strap, walking footsteps, a mountain road curve, bridge deck perspective lines, railing directions, a gliding trajectory, waterfronts or figure shadows. Develop it into a continuous hand-drawn line in ochre red, dark red, grey-blue, or rust red. The main line must have the authentic texture of a pencil, wax line, or stitching, showing slight jitters, thickness variations, pauses, loops, and intermittent pressure. It should start from a real action contact point of the upper figures, extend along the photo's environmental direction, cross the horizontal boundary, and then connect to or surround the corresponding hand, foot, or core object of the lower figures. The stitch line cannot suddenly stop at the upper-lower boundary, nor can it become a smooth digital path or meaningless decoration. Keep colors restrained. The upper part retains the primary location colors of the photo but with reduced noise and saturation; figure negatives use warm paper white. The lower part is dominated by warm white, charcoal grey, and faded black ink, with one or two low-saturation environmental colors extracted from the photo as extremely faint auxiliary traces, using one dark red or grey-blue main line to connect the top and bottom. Based on the real location, action, and emotion in the photo, include: a main title of 1–3 English words; a short field, such as "FIELD NOTE 01"; one observation sentence of 5–12 English words. The observation sentence must be determined word-for-word in the prom
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的「线迹旅行记忆」编辑海报，每张照片单独输出，不进行多图拼接。

这套风格适合包含1～3名轮廓完整、姿态明确、具有行走、牵手、撑伞、搀扶、滑行、拥抱、攀登或其他方向性动作的人物照片。照片中最好存在道路、栏杆、影子、水岸、绳索、轨道或运动痕迹，可以发展为贯穿画面的连续线迹。

整体采用3:4竖版双层结构，但不是普通的照片与插画上下对比，而是“上部人物被挖空、下部人物被补回”的负形记忆结构。

上部约占画面58%～66%。

忠实保留原始照片中的环境摄影，包括建筑、道路、山水、天空、光影、透视、天气、地点色彩和空间关系，仅进行轻微灰化、粉质化与旧艺术出版物调色。

将照片中的人物按照原始数量、位置、尺度、姿态、动作方向、身体重叠和接触关系，完整替换为温暖纸白色的负形剪影。

人物负形必须准确覆盖原人物原本的位置，不得移动、放大或改变姿态。边缘清晰但略带纸张纤维，只使用极少量石墨内线暗示头发、手部、衣服分界、背包、雨伞、相机或动作接触点。

上部人物内部不能继续保留摄影颜色，也不能只添加一圈白色描边。观者应该感觉人物已经从真实场景中离开，只留下一个准确的纸白空位。

下部约占画面34%～42%。

使用温暖米白色粗纹纸张作为连续背景，将上部同一组人物以完全相同的姿态、数量、动作关系和核心物件，缩小后重新补回为深炭灰、褪黑墨或石墨实心人物回声。

下部人物通常占下半区域宽度20%～42%、高度25%～55%，明显小于上部负形。根据原照片的动作方向，将其放置在偏左、偏右或中下区域，与上部人物形成垂直、斜向或运动方向上的呼应。

下部至少保留55%的连续纸白。只允许使用一至三条极淡石墨线暗示道路、山坡、栏杆、水岸或环境方向，不得重新绘制完整背景。

从照片中选择一条具有真实意义的动作或环境线索，例如：

- 人物牵手的位置
- 雨伞伞柄
- 相机背带
- 行走脚步
- 山路曲线
- 桥面透视线
- 栏杆方向
- 滑行轨迹
- 水岸或人物影子

将它发展为一根赭红、暗红、灰蓝或铁锈红色的连续手绘线。

主线必须具有铅笔、蜡线或缝线般的真实材质，出现轻微抖动、粗细变化、停顿、回旋和断续压力。它应从上部人物的真实动作接触点出发，顺着照片环境方向延伸，跨过水平分界，再连接或环绕下部人物的对应手部、脚步或核心物件。

线迹不能在上下分界处突然停止，也不能变成光滑的数字路径或无意义装饰。

色彩保持克制。上部保留照片的主要地点色彩，但降低杂色与饱和度；人物负形使用暖纸白。下部以暖白、炭灰、褪黑墨为主，从照片中提取一至两种低饱和环境色作为极淡辅助轨迹，并使用一根暗红或灰蓝主线连接上下。

根据照片中的真实地点、动作和情绪加入：

- 一个1～3个英文单词的主标题；
- 一个简短字段，如“FIELD NOTE 01”；
- 一句5～12个英文单词的观察句。

观察句必须在提示词中提前逐字确定，并拆成2～4段，沿道路、人物动作方向或主线弧度分布在上下两层。至少一段文字应与跨区主线发生贴近、缠绕或延续关系。

字体使用纤细、略显迟疑的手写体、铅笔小写或蜡线般书写。文字可以沿曲线轻微旋转，但必须清楚可读。主标题应位于下部连续留白中，在聊天预览尺寸下仍然能够辨认。

避免：普通上方照片下方插画、上部人物仍保留摄影填充、仅添加白色轮廓、人物负形偏离原位、上下人物姿态不同、人物数量变化、下部人物过大、下部完整重画环境、线迹在分界处停止、光滑矢量路径、时尚人物剪影、彩色卡通、密集装饰、规整数字文本框、作者名、签名、Logo、网址、二维码、水印和假字。

最重要的规则：上部看见的是人物离开后留下的准确纸白空位；下部看见的是同一个动作被缩小后重新落回纸面。一根具有手工材质的线和沿线文字，必须把两个相同姿态连接成同一段旅行记忆。

使用超大标题、清晰的品牌信息、有意义的产品文案、克制的色彩、真实的皮肤和材料，以及精致的时尚/编辑布局。避免重复的面部特征、随机扭曲、塑料感皮肤、虚假 UI、条形码、无意义的文字、徽章和装饰性杂乱。

最终图像应该感觉像是一场真正的高端活动，具有强烈的缩略图冲击力和清晰的光学概念。

items.title: 互动式古代美人捏人游戏提示词 - Makeup
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

You are an interactive ancient-beauty character creation game. Determine the character through 8 steps, let AI complete other details, and save state after every selection.

PROCESS: 1 Dynasty -> 2 Body -> 3 Temperament -> 4 Hairstyle -> 5 Clothing -> 6 Makeup -> 7 Scene -> 8 Expression -> Completion. Show one item at a time, advance immediately without asking for confirmation, and start by displaying only Dynasty.

INTERFACE: Give 6-10 options per item as compact cards with example, number, name, and <=10-word analysis; use 2-3 columns. Prioritize clicks, then accept a number or name.

ITEMS: Dynasty = Pre-Qin, Qin/Han, Wei-Jin-Southern/Northern, Sui/Tang, Five Dynasties/Ten Kingdoms, Song, Liao/Jin/Yuan, Ming, Qing. Body = petite, slender, natural, tall, soft/plump, or graceful. Temperament = elegant, gentle, bright, exquisite, dignified, charming, cold, or naive. For the selected dynasty provide 6-8 historically grounded hairstyles, clothing styles, makeup styles, and female life scenes. Ground clothing in artifacts, paintings, archaeology, or literature; prohibit modern new-Chinese, pan-Chinese, and fictional film/TV clothing. After items 1-7, generate 8 distinct context-appropriate expressions; Expression has no fixed pool.

LINKAGE: Hairstyle, Clothing, Makeup, and Scene must match Dynasty; keep Liao, Jin, and Yuan separate. If Dynasty changes, re-process 4-7 and preserve 1-3. After any change to 4-7, check later conflicts and regenerate affected items plus Expression.

OPERATIONS: Save every selection. Random changes the current unlocked item; Change one re-provides options; Lock blocks Random, Change one, and Random All; Modify Setting changes a locked item only on explicit request. Back returns to the prior item and preserves other state; re-check later conflicts. Random All changes unlocked items from Dynasty onward, retains locks, and regenerates Expression after item 8. Restart Creation clears state and starts at Dynasty. Support semantic commands such as change to Ming Dynasty, hairstyle, or slight smile.

AI COMPLETION: Complete movement, gestures, hair accessories, jewelry, colors, patterns, materials, footwear, props, environment, relationships, composition, lens, lighting, season, and weather. Season = Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter; weather = Sunny/Cloudy/Misty/Drizzle/Snow. All must fit the selected character and historical settings.

FIXED: Adult female, natural body shape, coordinated proportions, realistic skin texture. Photography is fixed: mobile life snapshot, CCD direct flash, native digital photo, 9:16 vertical. It is not a selection item and does not change historical context.

COMPLETION: After Expression output, in order:
Complete Character Settings
Dynasty: [current selection]
Body: [current selection]
Temperament: [current selection]
Hairstyle: [current selection]
Clothing: [current selection]
Makeup: [current selection]
Scene: [current selection]
Expression: [current selection]

Final Image Prompt: Integrate all 8 settings and complete movements, gestures, accessories, jewelry, clothing details, colors, materials, props, environment, relationships, season, weather, composition, lens, and lighting. Maintain historical consistency and include mobile life snapshot, CCD direct flash, native digital photo, and 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. Make it complete, coherent, and copyable, never keywords only. End with bottom-left signature "● DeepBlue": ● is a solid #0B3D91 dark-blue circle and DeepBlue is white natural handwriting.

Then display: 1 Generate Image, 2 Modify Settings, 3 Restart Creation. Input 1, Generate, or Produce Image generates immediately. Input 2 plus an item redoes it, then re-output settings, prompt, and the three actions. Input 3 or Restart Creation clears state and starts at Dynasty.

ONE MORE: Keep the 8 core settings and fixed photography; reinterpret only movement, environment, season, weather, composition, lens, and lighting. Do not change the core settings or photography. Generate a new complete prompt and generate immediately.

FINAL RULES: This is a continuous creation game, not standard Q&A. Advance one item at a time, save state, apply linkage, check later consistency after changes to 4-7, regenerate Expression, keep photography fixed, never ask for the next step, and never repeat confirmation. After Expression output settings, prompt, and actions. If clicks are unavailable, use number or name. Start now by displaying only Dynasty.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

你是一款互动式古代美人捏人游戏。通过8步决定人物核心特征，其余细节由AI补全。少解释，多互动，始终保存当前角色状态。

【流程】

①朝代 → ②身材 → ③气质 → ④发式 → ⑤服饰 → ⑥妆容 → ⑦场景 → ⑧神态 → 完成

严格按顺序，一次只展示一个项目。用户选择后立即保存并进入下一项，不询问“下一步”，不重复确认。开始时只展示①。

【选择界面】

每项6～10个选项。

使用紧凑视觉卡：视觉示例＋编号＋名称＋一句短解析。解析突出选项特点或视觉效果，尽量控制在10字以内。2～3列，一屏显示。

支持点击时优先点击；无法点击时使用编号或名称。

【捏人项目】

①朝代
先秦｜秦汉｜魏晋南北朝｜隋唐｜五代十国｜宋｜辽金元｜明｜清

②身材
娇小纤秀｜纤细柔婉｜自然匀称｜高挑修长｜柔婉丰润｜丰姿婀娜

③气质
清雅｜温婉｜明艳｜灵秀｜端庄｜妩媚｜清冷｜娇憨

④发式
根据朝代提供6～8种有历史依据的女性传统发式。

⑤服饰
根据朝代提供6～8种有文物、绘画、考古或文献依据的女性传统服饰形制。禁止现代新中式、泛中国风、影视架空服饰。

⑥妆容
根据朝代提供6～8种有历史依据的女性妆容。

⑦场景
根据朝代提供6～8种符合时代建筑、生活方式和社会环境的女性生活场景。

⑧神态
根据①～⑦已确定的全部设定，动态生成8种最符合当前人物、场景和情境的神态。

8种神态须有明显区别，避免重复、冲突和泛化。⑧不使用固定选项池。

【朝代联动】

④发式、⑤服饰、⑥妆容、⑦场景必须与①朝代一致。

辽金元需分别处理，不得混合三个时期。

修改①朝代，只重新处理④⑤⑥⑦；②③保持不变。

修改④～⑦任一项目后，检查后续项目是否与最新设定冲突，有冲突则重新处理；⑧始终根据最新①～⑦重新生成。

【状态与操作】

始终保存已选项目。

“随机”：随机当前项目，已锁定则无效。

“换一个”：重新提供当前项目选项，已锁定则无效。

“锁定”：锁定当前项目，限制随机、换一个和全部随机改变该项目。

“修改设定”：用户明确指定修改时，可以修改已锁定项目。

“返回”：回到上一项目并立即显示该项目，重新选择后继续向后推进，其他状态保留；若后续项目与最新设定冲突，则重新处理受影响项目，并重新生成⑧神态。

“全部随机”：随机所有未锁定项目，已锁定项目保持不变，从①开始；遇到已锁定项目直接保留并进入下一项。完成①～⑦后，根据最新设定重新生成⑧神态。

“重新捏人”：清空全部设定，从①开始。

支持直接说“换成明代”“发式换一个”“改成浅笑”等，根据语义执行。

【AI自动补全】

除8个捏人项目外，其余全部由AI自动完成，包括动作、手势、具体发饰、首饰、颜色、纹样、材质、鞋履、道具、环境、人物关系、构图、镜头、光影、时令、天气等。

时令：春｜夏｜秋｜冬
天气：晴｜阴｜薄雾｜细雨｜雪

所有自动补全必须符合人物、朝代、服饰、发式、妆容和场景。

【固定人物】

成年女性；身材自然；比例协调；真实肤质。

【固定摄影】

手机生活抓拍 × CCD直闪；9:16竖幅；原生数码照片。

摄影风格固定，不作为选择项目，不改变历史语境。

【完成】

完成⑧神态后，必须依次输出：

【完整角色设定】

Selected single scene: 妆容: 当前选择

【最终图片提示词】

完整整合8项设定，并自动补全动作、手势、发饰、首饰、服装细节、颜色、纹样、材质、鞋履、道具、环境、人物关系、时令、天气、构图、镜头和光影。

保持历史一致性，并加入：

手机生活抓拍 × CCD直闪；9:16竖幅；原生数码照片。

最终提示词必须完整、连贯、可直接复制用于图片生成，不得只输出关键词或省略已选设定。

提示词最后加入：

左下签名“● DeepBlue”；“●”为纯 #0B3D91 深蓝色实心圆点，“DeepBlue”为白色自然手写字体

然后显示：

① 生成图片
② 修改设定
③ 重新捏人

【生成】

输入“1”“生成”或“出图”，立即根据最终图片提示词生成图片。

【修改】

输入“2”后指定项目并重新选择。

修改后重新输出完整角色设定和最终图片提示词，再显示①②③。

【重新捏人】

输入“3”或“重新捏人”，清空角色，从①开始。

【再来一个】

保留8项核心设定和固定摄影。

只重新演绎动作、环境、时令、天气、构图、镜头和光影。

不得改变8项核心设定或固定摄影。

生成新的最终图片提示词并立即生成。

【最终规则】

这是连续捏人游戏，不是普通问答。

一次一个项目；选择后立即推进；始终保存状态；朝代变化自动联动；修改④～⑦后检查后续一致性；⑧神态始终根据最新①～⑦动态生成；摄影固定；不得要求下一步；不得重复确认。

完成⑧后必须：

输出完整角色设定
→ 输出完整图片提示词
→ 显示①②③

不得跳过完整图片提示词。

点击不可用时，立即降级为编号或名称选择，不得中断流程。

现在开始，只展示①朝代。

items.title: 简约客厅日系轻熟女沙发时尚写真
items.description: 明确成年日本女性在明亮极简日式客厅沙发上的超写实生活时尚快照，突出参考图锁定、秋季米棕配色、自然日光和真实手机摄影质感。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the strict highest-priority visual reference for the only clearly adult Japanese woman, preserving her facial identity, hairstyle, hair color and length, body proportions, outfit, pose, camera angle, framing, sofa, living-room setting and lighting; whenever anything conflicts, follow the reference. Create an ultra-photorealistic live-action iPhone 17 Pro vertical 2:3 indoor fashion/lifestyle snapshot of the same adult woman in her twenties sitting casually on a large cream sofa in a bright cozy minimalist Japanese living room. Preserve her long silky dark chocolate-brown hair with loose waves, airy wispy bangs and face-framing strands; fair realistic skin, brown eyes, minimal pink-beige makeup, rosy cheeks, muted glossy pink lips, relaxed expression, subtle closed-mouth smile, direct eye contact and slight head tilt. Dress her in an ivory sleeveless fitted cable-knit top with vertical knit texture, round neckline and a small keyhole with a decorative brown button, a high-waisted warm dark-brown wrap mini skirt with asymmetric overlap and small buckle, dark chocolate leather mid-calf boots with subtle gold hardware, and a small structured dark-brown shoulder bag; bare natural legs, no stockings or tights. Sit diagonally with one leg bent upward and loosely crossed, one elbow on the raised knee and that hand supporting the cheek/temple, the other hand on the sofa cushion; torso slightly toward camera, relaxed shoulders and correct hands, fingers, knees and legs. This is not a selfie: photograph from directly in front near seated eye level with a very slight downward angle, 28–35mm equivalent, three-quarter seated portrait from head to below boots, woman occupying 85–90% of frame, face near upper center, realistic perspective without exaggerated distortion. Use a cream sofa with cream and dusty-pink cushions, warm off-white walls, wooden shelving with books, trailing plant, diffuser and simple decor, white curtains and a round wooden table entering lower-left with a light mug and small plant. Soft bright daylight from camera-right, gentle shadows, airy cream-and-brown autumn palette, balanced highlights and natural skin tones. 她穿深钴蓝色麻花针织高领镂空紧身连体毛衣，带厚实罗纹高领、垂直麻花纹理、修长长袖和侧腰镂空开口；搭配中等洗水色蓝色紧身牛仔裤，底部保留自然丹宁褪色。佩戴细框眼镜、小泪滴状宝石耳环和叠戴黄金项链，配金色金属框架与细腻含蓄的闪光。她微微抬起下巴，双手插在裤子的两个前口袋里，手肘放松并略向外张开，呈现放松挺拔的姿势。服装保持正常成人时尚覆盖和真实针织、牛仔纹理。

场景是涩谷站侧交叉口入口，位于超大商业广告牌下方，路口边缘有醒目的斑马线条纹和等待的行人群。寒冷冬季阴天，浅灰天空，冷色调干净日光和清脆浅白高光。采用轻盈高调的日系写真集影像语言，使用 35mm 镜头、略宽的自然透视、人体比例视野、f/1.4 风格极浅景深和极其锐利的焦点平面。加入克制的色差、微妙 RGB 边缘重影和高对比边缘的横向色彩分离，使用 Fuji Superia 胶片渲染、冷绿色阴影、明亮红绿、中高对比曲线和可见消费级胶片颗粒。不要出现可读文字、水印或额外人物作为主体。

items.title: 超现实高级时尚丝绸艺术人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

A surreal high-fashion fine-art portrait of an elegant adult woman standing gracefully amid enormous flowing layers of layered ivory-white silk fabric. She is centered in the composition, facing directly toward the camera with a calm, confident, slightly mysterious expression. She has delicate symmetrical facial features, porcelain-like warm skin, subtle natural blush, soft pink lips, refined nose, expressive hazel-brown eyes, and long elegant eyelashes. Her light brown hair is loosely tied back in a sophisticated low updo, with a few fine wispy strands naturally framing her face and neck.
She wears an ethereal short-sleeved white couture gown, sculpted elegantly around the upper body, while countless extremely long, lightweight layers of layered chiffon and silk wrap around her torso and flow outward dramatically. The fabric creates sweeping organic curves around her body, partially revealing and partially concealing the silhouette in an artistic, tasteful manner. The enormous fabric ribbons extend across the foreground and background like waves, creating a dreamlike sense of movement.
The scene feels like a living sculpture made from silk and light. Huge sheets of sheer white fabric are suspended and billowing around her, forming elegant arches, folds, loops, and flowing ribbons. Some layers pass softly across the foreground, creating depth and framing the subject. The layered material catches the light beautifully, showing delicate folds, subtle shadows, fine textile texture, and soft overlapping layers.
Lighting: warm diffused natural sunlight passing through the layered fabric, creating a soft ivory, cream, champagne, and pale beige color palette. Gentle glowing highlights on the woman's face and shoulders, subtle rim lighting around her hair, soft atmospheric shadows, luminous backlighting, dreamy editorial illumination.
Composition: vertical fashion editorial composition, full-to-three-quarter body portrait, woman positioned near the center, slightly elevated eye-level camera angle, flowing fabric occupying much of the frame, strong foreground depth, elegant negative space around the head, balanced symmetrical composition.
Photography / rendering: ultra-realistic cinematic fashion photography blended with surreal fine-art aesthetics, luxury couture editorial, extremely detailed facial features, realistic skin texture, physically accurate layered fabric, delicate silk fibers, natural shadows, volumetric light, soft depth of field, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, sophisticated color grading, atmospheric realism, 85mm portrait lens, f/2.0, crisp subject focus, dreamy background softness, 8K, masterpiece quality, photorealistic, highly detailed.
Mood: ethereal, elegant, serene, mysterious, luxurious, dreamlike, timeless, heavenly, minimalist fine-art aesthetic.
Negative prompt: cartoon, anime, exaggerated anatomy, distorted face, extra fingers, extra limbs, malformed hands, plastic skin, excessive makeup, harsh shadows, oversaturated colors, low resolution, blurry face, bad fabric physics, duplicated body parts, text, watermark, logo, unnatural pose, vulgarity, overly revealing appearance.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

一张超现实的高级时尚美术肖像，画面中一位优雅的成年女性优雅地站在巨大且流动的半叠层象牙白色丝绸织物层中。她位于构图中心，正对镜头，神情冷静、自信且略带神秘感。她拥有精致对称的面部特征、瓷器般温暖的皮肤、含蓄的自然腮红、柔粉色的双唇、精巧的鼻子、富有表现力的淡褐色眼睛和修长优雅的睫毛。她的浅棕色头发松松地扎成一个精致的低发髻，几缕细碎的发丝自然地勾勒出她的脸庞和脖颈。
她穿着一件空灵的抹胸白色高级定制礼服，上半身剪裁优雅，无数极长且轻盈的半叠层雪纺和丝绸层环绕着她的躯干并剧烈地向外流动。织物在她的身体周围形成横扫的有机曲线，以一种艺术且高雅的方式若隐若现地展现轮廓。巨大的织物带像波浪一样延伸到前景和背景，营造出一种梦幻般的运动感。
场景感觉就像是一个由丝绸和光线构成的活雕塑。巨大的半叠层白色织物悬挂并环绕在她周围翻滚，形成优雅的拱形、褶皱、环状和流动的丝带。一些层次轻轻掠过前景，创造出深度并为主题构图。半叠层材料完美地捕捉光线，呈现出精致的褶皱、细微的阴影、精细的纺织纹理和柔软的重叠层。
光照：温暖漫射的自然阳光穿过半叠层织物，营造出象牙白、奶油色、香槟色和淡米色的色调。女性的脸部和肩膀上有柔和的光晕亮点，头发周围有细微的轮廓光，柔和的气氛阴影，明亮的逆光，梦幻的社论式照明。
构图：垂直时尚社论构图，全身至四分之三身体肖像，女性位于中心附近，略微抬高的视线高度相机角度，流动的织物占据了大部分画幅，强烈的视觉深度，头部周围优雅的负空间，平衡对称的构图。
摄影/渲染：超写实电影时尚摄影与超现实美术美学融合，奢侈定制社论，极其详细的面部特征，真实的皮肤纹理，物理精确的半叠层织物，精致的丝绸纤维，自然阴影，体积光，柔和的景深，微妙的胶片颗粒，高动态范围，精致的调色，大气写实，85mm人像镜头，f/2.0，主体焦距清晰，梦幻的背景柔和度，8K，大师级品质，照片级真实感，高度详细。
情绪：空灵、优雅、宁静、神秘、奢华、梦幻、永恒、神圣、极简美术美学。
反面提示词：卡通，动漫，夸张的解剖结构，扭曲的面部，多余的手指，多余的肢体，畸形的手，塑料皮肤，过重的妆容，刺眼的阴影，过度饱和的颜色，低分辨率，模糊的脸部，糟糕的织物物理效果，重复的身体部位，文字，水印，标志，不自然的姿势，庸俗，过度暴露的外观。

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Subject:
A close-up fictional adult Japanese female sitting beside a neatly made bed in a dim bedroom with one arm reaching towards the outside of the lens, reproduced in a 9:16 vertical flash-style selfie format—in this subject image, fix the same woman, face, hair, clothing, body orientation, background arrangement, and light direction; produce only one vertical photo, do not include multiple people, different scenes, collages, or split screens; the woman is a fictional adult over 20 years old, maintaining a natural skeleton and proportions; do not make the face or body look young, do not do extreme beautification, exaggerated eyes, overly thin necks, or unrealistic body types. items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

被摄体：
在昏暗的卧室中坐在床上，一只手臂伸向镜头外那样的近距离虚构的成年日本女性一人，以纵9:16的闪光灯风格自拍照形式再现——在这个被摄体形象中，固定相同的女性、面容、头发、服装、身体朝向、背景布置、光线方向；只制作纵向的一张照片，不加入多人、不同场景、拼贴、分屏；女性作为20岁以上的虚构成人，保持自然的骨架和比例；不让脸或身体看起来幼小，不做极端美化、夸张的眼睛、过细的脖子、非现实的体型。从头顶到白色T恤、弯曲的双膝为止纳入画面。

地点・时间・背景：
昏暗卧室的墙壁、白色床上用品、左后方的架子或细长瓶状轮廓、右后方的小照片或矩形以低对比度可见——在这个场景的深度中，保持能辨识人物轮廓的深度，不将背景形状替换为均匀的单色或人工的虚化圆；不改变时间段和天气，不做日落、夜景、雨、雪、霓虹、摄影棚背景。

服装・小物：
宽松的无图案白色短袖T恤——在这个装束再现中，布料的颜色、形状、暴露、重叠、缝合、褶皱方向保持相同；皮肤与服装接触的边界保留缝合或薄薄的落影，防止融合。圆领、袖子的缝合、肩部和上半身的大的褶皱、下摆的柔和折痕固定。下装因画面无法辨识而不生成。

姿势・手指・接触：
坐在床上大大弯曲双膝，一侧上臂向画面左上方伸出——在这个动作的连贯性中，肩、颈、锁骨、上半身、上臂、腰、膝等可见关节的连接以成人的自然骨架保持；保留因靠近镜头而略微显得大的远近感，但不做超广角般的非自然膨胀。另一侧手臂隐藏在T恤和膝盖之间，因此不生成手指。

表情・视线：
直视镜头，嘴唇闭合的安静无表情接近的表情——在这个距离感和情感中，双目的焦点对准同一镜头位置，自然加入小小的捕捉光；不让眼睛过度睁大，不在眉间制造强烈的皱纹。只在眼角保留亲密感，不改为笑容或惊讶。

脸・化妆：
柔和的卵形、自然的深棕色眉毛、浓茶色的杏仁形瞳孔、整齐的鼻梁、有光泽的丰满玫瑰粉色嘴唇——在这个面容的精确度中，左右瞳孔的大小和高度不完全对齐，保留写实般的细小左右差异；睫毛是自然的密度，眼线细致，眼影是淡棕色到米色，脸颊是薄薄的血色，嘴唇保持原色和光泽；鼻尖、小鼻、嘴唇轮廓、下巴自然留下阴影；避免厚重的粉底、强烈的轮廓修正、过度的美白、闪粉、巨大的黑瞳、瓷器般的无毛孔皮肤。脸颊和鼻子上带有闪光灯的小光泽。

头发：
延伸到身形下方的接近黑色的深棕色长发——在这个发丝流动再现中，发根较暗，只在光线照射的面发出细茶色到金茶色的反射；刘海不与眼球或眉毛融合，保持与耳朵、脸颊、脖子、肩膀、服装的边界；发束不做成一张板或均匀的线条，混杂粗壮的束、细碎的后发、暗色的间隙。偏中央的分线和薄长刘海垂向额头和眼角，左右头发重重落在胸前和肩膀上。

光源：
接近相机附近小型闪光灯的正面光——在这个照明设计中，瞳孔放置对应光源的小捕捉光，鼻下、下巴、头发内侧、服装褶皱处保留薄薄的阴影；反射光弱而自然，保持脸颊、脖子、肩膀、服装的立体感；不让皮肤的亮部、白色或浅色的服装、背景的亮面白飞，不让暗色的头发和背景黑崩。脸、嘴唇、膝盖、白色T恤变亮，背景调暗。皮肤的立体感保留薄薄的阴影置于下巴和头发内侧。

颜色・色调：
白色、接近黑色的深棕色、炭灰色、自然肤色、玫瑰粉色——在这个配色和色调中，亮的布料和背景通过缝合、阴影、材质差异分离；不让皮肤过度橙色、洋红色、青白，保留脸颊和嘴唇的自然色差。低饱和度的暗室内和白色T恤的强烈明暗差保持。

材质・细微质感：
闪光灯下可见的皮肤毛孔和光泽、瞳孔的小捕捉光、嘴唇的湿度、长发的粗壮束和细反射、白色T恤的棉质褶皱、膝盖的自然皮肤作为写实再现——在这个质感设计中，皮肤保留不均匀的毛孔、细微的汗毛、细小的色差、关节或脸颊的自然光泽；头发发出束与束的粗细、反射的强弱、重叠造成的暗部；布料赋予编织、厚度、缝合、顺应拉伸和重力的褶皱；背景材质保持比人物弱的分辨率，不用去噪填充。

构图・相机：
人物整体的视觉中心置于横45〜55%的范围内——在这个画面配置中，相机位置靠近脸部，以接近智能手机标准画角的自然透视；对瞳孔、嘴唇、脸周的头发、服装的主要质感对焦，背景做自然的镜头虚化；不做别的构图拉远或全身化，固定纵向位置；避免强烈的鱼眼、极端的广角、长焦压缩、水平翻转、强烈的翻滚角、俯视或仰视的放大。以纵9:16的闪光灯风格自拍照形式再现。脸中心横约50%、上端起约29%、双眼线条上端起约25%。头顶余白约1%、脸宽为画面宽的约60%、近处的膝盖占画面高的约73%到下端，人物的视觉中心横约49%。

图像处理・完成：
像在暗房间用智能手机近距离闪光灯拍的自然自拍照——在这个照片感完成中，曝光以脸为基准，同时保留亮部和暗部的细节；白平衡配合光源，不移动皮肤色和服装色从原图；锐度温和地作用于瞳孔、眉毛、睫毛、嘴唇、脸周的头发、主要服装；背景虚化的边界、头发、肩膀、服装边缘不做抠图光晕、双重轮廓、过度的虚化。脸、嘴唇、头发、膝盖、T恤精细化，背景暗而不粗糙。

崩溃回避・禁止：
固定相同的成年女性、长暗色头发、闭合有光泽的嘴唇、白色T恤、弯曲的双膝、昏暗卧室、正面闪光灯——为了守护这个完成形象，不加入别人、多人、儿童、额外小物、文字、标志、水印；避免看起来未成年的造型、身体的夸张、原图以上的暴露、插图、动画、3D CG、人偶皮肤，做成自然成年女性一人的写实照片；不将面容、眼鼻口的比例、发型、表情、服装、姿势、背景布置、光线、颜色、质感、图像处理做成别的东西；禁止眼球偏移、左右不同的瞳孔、牙齿融合、融化的耳朵、脖子肩膀连接不良、多余的手臂或手指、布料或头发的穿透、双重轮廓。画面外的手、智能手机、下装、脚尖、背景物品的细节不创作。

items.title: 互动式古代美人捏人游戏提示词
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的交互式角色创建工作流。使用时上传人物参考图，按朝代、身材、气质、发式、服饰、妆容、场景和神态 8 步逐项创建成年女性角色，并在完成后输出完整图片提示词。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible adult woman. Run an interactive ancient-beauty character creation game. Keep explanations minimal, save state after every choice and show only one item at a time.

Process in order: 1 Dynasty -> 2 Body -> 3 Temperament -> 4 Hairstyle -> 5 Clothing -> 6 Makeup -> 7 Scene -> 8 Expression -> Completion. At the start show only 1 Dynasty. After each choice save immediately and advance without asking whether to continue or repeating confirmation.

For items 1-3 provide 6-10 compact visual-card options with number, name and a description of no more than 10 words, in a 2-3 column layout. Dynasty options: Pre-Qin, Qin and Han, Wei-Jin/Southern and Northern Dynasties, Sui and Tang, Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms, Song, Liao/Jin/Yuan, Ming, Qing. Body: petite/graceful, slender/soft, natural/proportioned, tall/slender, soft/plump, graceful/elegant. Temperament: elegant, gentle, bright, exquisite, dignified, charming, cold, naive.

For 4 provide 6-8 historically grounded female hairstyles consistent with the dynasty. For 5 provide 6-8 female clothing forms grounded in artifacts, paintings, archaeology or literature; prohibit modern new-Chinese, pan-Chinese and fictional film/TV costumes. For 6 provide 6-8 historically grounded makeup styles. For 7 provide 6-8 female life scenes consistent with the dynasty's architecture, lifestyle and social environment. For 8 dynamically generate eight clearly distinct expressions based on all current settings; do not use a fixed expression pool.

Linkage rules: 4-7 must match 1. Treat Liao, Jin and Yuan separately. If 1 changes, reprocess only 4-7 while preserving 2-3. If 4-7 changes, check later settings for conflicts and reprocess affected items; always regenerate 8.

Operations: Random changes the current unlocked item; Change one replaces its options; Lock prevents Random, Change one and Random All; Modify Setting can explicitly change a locked item; Back returns to the previous item and preserves unaffected state; Random All randomizes only unlocked items from 1 onward; Restart Creation clears all state. Understand direct commands such as changing dynasty, hairstyle or expression. If clicks are unavailable, immediately accept numbers or names.

AI may complete movement, gestures, accessories, jewelry, colors, patterns, materials, footwear, props, relationships, composition, lens, lighting, season and weather, but every completion must fit the chosen dynasty and character. Seasons: spring, summer, autumn, winter. Weather: sunny, cloudy, misty, drizzle, snow.

Fixed character: adult female, natural body shape, coordinated proportions and realistic skin texture. Fixed photography: mobile lifestyle snapshot with CCD direct flash, native digital-photo rendering and 9:16 vertical format; photography is not a selection item and does not change the historical context.

After 8 Expression, output in order: Complete Character Settings; Selected single scene; Final Image Prompt with all eight choices and all AI-completed details; then append the signature ● DeepBlue, where ● is a solid #0B3D91 circle and DeepBlue is white natural handwriting. Then show 1 Generate Image, 2 Modify Settings, 3 Restart Creation. Command 1 or Generate immediately generates from the final prompt; command 2 reopens a selected item and then reprints the complete settings and prompt; command 3 clears state. “Again” keeps the eight core settings and fixed photography but reinterprets only action, environment, season, weather, composition, lens and lighting, then generates a new prompt and image. This is a continuous stateful game, not ordinary Q&A.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见成年女性的面部身份依据。运行一个交互式古代美人捏人游戏。少解释，每次选择后立即保存状态，一次只展示一个项目。

流程严格按顺序进行：①朝代 → ②身材 → ③气质 → ④发式 → ⑤服饰 → ⑥妆容 → ⑦场景 → ⑧神态 → 完成。开始时只展示①朝代。每次选择后立即保存并推进，不询问是否继续，也不重复确认。

①至③各提供 6-10 个紧凑视觉卡选项，包含编号、名称和不超过 10 字的短解析，以 2-3 列显示。朝代：先秦、秦汉、魏晋南北朝、隋唐、五代十国、宋、辽金元、明、清。身材：娇小纤秀、纤细柔婉、自然匀称、高挑修长、柔婉丰润、丰姿婀娜。气质：清雅、温婉、明艳、灵秀、端庄、妩媚、清冷、娇憨。

④根据朝代提供 6-8 种有历史依据的女性传统发式。⑤根据朝代提供 6-8 种有文物、绘画、考古或文献依据的女性传统服饰形制；禁止现代新中式、泛中国风和影视架空服饰。⑥提供 6-8 种有历史依据的女性妆容。⑦提供 6-8 种符合该朝代建筑、生活方式和社会环境的女性生活场景。⑧根据当前全部设定动态生成 8 种明显不同的神态，不使用固定神态选项池。

联动规则：④至⑦必须与①朝代一致；辽、金、元分开处理，不得混合。修改①时只重新处理④⑤⑥⑦，②③保持不变。修改④至⑦任一项后检查后续设定，若冲突则重做受影响项目，并始终根据最新①至⑦重新生成⑧。

操作规则：随机只改变当前未锁定项目；换一个重新提供当前项目选项；锁定后限制随机、换一个和全部随机；明确使用“修改设定”时可修改已锁定项目；返回回到上一项目并保留不受影响的状态；全部随机只随机未锁定项目并从①开始；重新捏人清空全部设定。支持“换成明代”“发式换一个”“改成浅笑”等直接语义命令。无法点击时立即降级为编号或名称选择。

除 8 个捏人项目外，AI 可自动补全动作、手势、发饰、首饰、颜色、纹样、材质、鞋履、道具、人物关系、构图、镜头、光影、时令和天气，但必须符合选定朝代与人物设定。时令：春、夏、秋、冬；天气：晴、阴、薄雾、细雨、雪。

固定人物：成年女性、自然身形、比例协调、真实肤质。固定摄影：手机生活抓拍 × CCD 直闪、原生数码照片、9:16 竖幅；摄影风格不是选择项目，也不改变历史语境。

完成⑧神态后，必须依次输出：完整角色设定；当前单一场景；最终图片提示词，完整整合 8 项设定与所有自动补全细节；最后加入签名 ● DeepBlue，其中 ● 必须是纯 #0B3D91 深蓝色实心圆点，DeepBlue 使用白色自然手写字体。然后显示 ①生成图片、②修改设定、③重新捏人。输入“1”“生成”或“出图”立即根据最终提示词生成；输入“2”后指定项目并重新输出完整设定与提示词；输入“3”清空状态并从①开始。“再来一个”保留 8 项核心设定和固定摄影，只重新演绎动作、环境、时令、天气、构图、镜头和光影，然后生成新的提示词与图片。这是连续状态游戏，不是普通问答。

items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年东亚女性的面部身份参考，仅匹配面部身份。创建一张照片级真实的模拟胶片人像，主体是一位肤色较浅、身形纤细的成年东亚女性。她留着略显凌乱、蓬松的齐肩黑发，长刘海垂过右眼。她直视镜头，表情平静而略带强烈感，妆容自然柔和，嘴唇低调、眼部轮廓清晰。让她穿一件宽松方形的米白或奶油白短袖露脐T恤，衣摆位于躯干较高处，露出腹部和肚脐。胸前居中印有准确文字“SONAGAIONER”，使用粗体蓝字并带橙红色点缀，下方是准确的小号日文“ひとりを着てる”。姿势为左臂抬过头顶并弯曲手肘，右臂自然垂在身侧。使用来自左前方的柔和室内光，在素净的浅灰墙面上形成轻柔阴影。从略低至中等机位拍摄，画面从胸口中部裁切至肚脐下方。保留细腻胶片颗粒、低饱和复古调色、35mm摄影美学、丰富的织物细节和真实皮肤纹理。负面提示：改变面部、塑料皮肤、过度修图、手部畸形、额外人物、衣服文字难以辨认、衣服之外的文字、水印、动漫、CGI。

items.title: 欧洲建筑转单色蚀刻版画对比海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Please turn each European architectural travel photo I upload into an independent high-end monochrome architectural etching comparison poster, not a multi-image collage, with each photo output separately.

The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, forming a clear but natural contrast between the original image and the converted drawing above and below. The two areas usually account for about 50% each, which can be slightly adjusted according to the proportions of the original subject, but the contrast relationship of the original image must not be canceled.

The upper part preserves the original photo with high fidelity. Maintain the architectural identity, main structure, real materials, perspective relationship, natural lighting, environmental scale, and original color atmosphere, only performing slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of architectural magazines, independent publications, and exhibition photography. To adapt to the frame, the sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally extended, but the main architectural body must not be stretched, distorted, replaced, or changed at will.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable outlines, structures, and spatial relationships of the building from the original photo, reconfiguring them into a monochrome copperplate etching or classical architectural print. Do not directly replace the entire photo with a line drawing, nor mechanically copy the composition of the upper part; the scale, cropping, and position should be reselected according to the architectural features. Arches, spires, domes, colonnades, or gables can be enlarged, or a continuous facade can be compressed into a horizontal rhythm, making the lower part an edited and refined independent plate, while still being able to recognize the original building at a glance.

Use extremely fine etching lines, parallel hatching, cross-hatching, stippling, broken lines, and a small amount of drypoint scratches to shape stone, brick walls, carvings, window panes, metal roofs, and spatial shadows. Foreground structures are clear, and dark areas are established through line density rather than large blocks of pure black; background, air, sky, and screen edges gradually reduce lines and stippling, naturally dissipating into the paper, avoiding hard rectangular borders and complete photo outlines.

The lower part uses warm ivory white, natural cream, or slightly aged paper backgrounds, retaining about 35%—55% continuous paper white. The subject is prioritized in the middle and lower parts, leaving breathable empty space around it. The paper has restrained and realistic fibers, tiny indentations, and plate pressure, but do not make it look like dirty old kraft paper or use excessive retro filters.

Only one ink color and its lightness variations are allowed for each work. The ink color is adaptively selected according to the temperament of the original image from deep indigo, Prussian blue, blue-gray, charcoal ink, or warm dark sepia, but multiple color inks must not be mixed in the same work. Establish volume, distance, and light through variations in the thickness, density, overlap, and ink starvation of lines of the same color.

Refine a 1—3 word English title based on the location, architectural type, morphology, or travel feelings in the photo, and add a plate number in the form of "PLATE NO. 01" and a 5—10 word English observation sentence.

The text uses narrow uppercase serif fonts or old topographical movable type in the same color as the print, clearly readable with slight ink starvation and paper tooth; placed in the continuous white space, forming a sparse and restrained publication layout with the main building. Do not have garbled characters, meaningless long text, or large areas of text that grab the subject.

Overall reference classical copperplate etching, European urban topography, museum architectural plates, old architectural survey books, and contemporary high-end editorial design, presenting a precise, quiet, rational visual temperament with a sense of collectability and real printing touch.

Avoid simple black and white filters, pencil sketches, watercolors, gouache, comic ink lines, CAD blueprints, pure vector line art, screen-tone dots, multi-color printing, hard photo outlines, full-page coverage without white space, hard rectangular illustration frames, 3D rendering, plastic feel, e-commerce feel, and template feel.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

请将我上传的每一张欧洲建筑旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级单色建筑蚀刻版画对比海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下形成清晰但自然的原图与转绘对照。两个区域通常各占约50%，可根据原图主体比例进行少量调整，但不得取消原图对比关系。

上半部分高保真保留原始照片。保持建筑身份、主体结构、真实材质、透视关系、自然光影、环境尺度和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微的高级摄影调色，使其具有建筑杂志、独立出版物和展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可以自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲、替换或随意改变建筑主体。

下半部分从原图中提取建筑最具识别性的轮廓、结构和空间关系，重新构成为单色铜版蚀刻或古典建筑版画。不要把整张照片直接换成线稿，也不要机械复制上半部分构图；应根据建筑特征重新选择尺度、裁切与位置。可以放大拱券、尖塔、穹顶、柱廊或山墙，也可以将连续立面压缩成横向节奏，使下方成为经过编辑和提炼的独立图版，同时仍能一眼认出原建筑。

使用极细蚀刻线、平行排线、交叉排线、点描、断续线和少量干刻划痕，塑造石材、砖墙、雕刻、窗格、金属屋面和空间阴影。近景结构清楚，暗部通过线条密度而不是大块纯黑建立；远景、空气、天空与画面边缘逐渐减少线条和点描，自然消散进纸张，避免硬矩形边框和完整照片轮廓。

下半部分使用温暖象牙白、自然米白或轻微旧化的纸张背景，保留约35%—55%的连续纸白。主体优先集中于中下部，四周留出可以呼吸的空场。纸张具有克制真实的纤维、细小压痕和印版压力，但不要做成脏旧牛皮纸或过度复古滤镜。

每张作品只允许使用一种墨色及其明度变化。墨色根据原图气质自适应选择深靛蓝、普鲁士蓝、蓝灰、炭墨或暖深褐，但同一张作品中不得混用多种彩色油墨。通过同色线条的粗细、疏密、交叠和缺墨变化建立体积、距离与光线。

根据照片中的地点、建筑类型、形态或旅行感受，提炼一个1—3个英文单词的标题，并加入“PLATE NO. 01”形式的图版编号和一句5—10个英文单词的观察短句。

文字使用与版画同色的窄体大写衬线字或旧地志铅字，清晰可读，带轻微缺墨与纸齿；放置在连续留白中，与建筑主体形成疏朗、克制的出版物版式。不要出现乱码、无意义长文或抢夺主体的大面积文字。

整体参考古典铜版蚀刻、欧洲城市地志、博物馆建筑图版、旧建筑测绘册和当代高级编辑设计，呈现精确、安静、理性、具有收藏感和真实印刷触感的视觉气质。

避免简单黑白滤镜、铅笔素描、水彩、水粉、漫画墨线、CAD蓝图、纯矢量线稿、丝网网点、多色印刷、照片硬描边、满版无留白、硬矩形插画框、3D渲染、塑料感、电商感和模板感。

items.title: 留白蜡笔旅行姿态原图对比海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Please make each photo I upload into an independent "SPARSE CRAYON TRAVEL GESTURE | Sparse Crayon Travel Gesture" original image comparison poster, no multi-image stitching.

This style is suitable both for individual animals with clear outlines and poses, and for objects with clear individual outlines encountered during travel, such as suitcases, cameras, hats, shoes, coffee cups, pottery, bicycles, roadside seats, or small souvenirs.

The overall structure uses a vertical upper-and-lower diptych layout, with the top and bottom areas each occupying about 50%, and a clear, straight boundary in the middle.

The upper part faithfully preserves the original photo. Accurately maintain the identity, quantity, pose, direction, outer contour, key structure, light and shadow, and real environment of the animal or travel object, with only slight photographic color grading. Do not change the subject or stylize the photo area into an illustration.

The lower part uses extreme reduction and extraction.

If the subject is an animal, only retain the most important ear shape, head-to-body ratio, tail direction, standing/sitting pose, and expression.

If the subject is a travel object, only retain the outer contour, handle, wheels, lens, cup rim, folds, straps, or wear characteristics that define its identity.

Delete almost all of the background, keeping only a small section of a ground line, corner, stone, or one to two slight clues that explain the scene of use.

Use hesitant, broken, slightly paused black crayon outlines, and one to two light crayon smears extracted from the original photo. Allow line crossing, paper grain, unfilled areas, repetitive lines, and partial pauses.

Do not fill the subject completely. Let the paper white directly constitute the animal's body, the object's surface, and the surrounding space. Travel objects cannot be drawn as fine product illustrations or accurate industrial drawings.

The subject occupies approximately 38%—58% of the width and 30%—52% of the height of the re-rendered area, usually placed in the lower-middle or slightly to one side. The continuous warm white paper negative space is no less than 55%.

In a quiet white paper area, add a short English title, a "CRAYON STUDY 01" type field, and a sentence of observation text derived from the facts of the photo. The text uses slightly shaky crayon handwriting similar to the drawing and must be clearly legible.

Avoid fine fur, cute vector mascots, complete coloring, dense graffiti, complete backgrounds, smooth digital pencils, fine product illustrations, overly small text, author signatures, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的
「SPARSE CRAYON TRAVEL GESTURE｜留白蜡笔旅行姿态」
原图对比海报，不多图拼接。

这套风格既适用于轮廓与姿态清楚的单只动物，也适用于旅行途中具有明确单体轮廓的物件，例如行李箱、相机、帽子、鞋、咖啡杯、陶器、自行车、路边座椅或小型纪念物。

整体采用竖版上下双联结构，上下区域各占约50%，中间边界清楚平直。

上半部分忠实保留原始照片。准确保持动物或旅行物件的身份、数量、姿态、方向、外轮廓、关键结构、光影与真实环境，仅进行轻微编辑摄影调色。不得改变主体或将照片区域插画化。

下半部分采用极端缩小提炼。

如果主体是动物，只保留最重要的耳形、头身比例、尾巴方向、站坐姿态和表情。

如果主体是旅行物件，只保留决定其身份的外轮廓、把手、轮子、镜头、杯口、折面、绑带或磨损特征。

删除几乎全部背景，只保留一小段地面线、墙角、石块或一至两条能够说明使用现场的轻微线索。

使用迟疑、断裂、略带停顿的黑色蜡笔轮廓，以及一至两块从原照片提取的浅色蜡笔擦画。允许越线、纸齿、未填满、反复描线和局部停笔。

不要把主体完整涂满。让纸白直接构成动物的身体、物件的表面以及周围空间。旅行物件不能画成精细产品插画或准确工业制图。

主体约占转绘区域宽度的38%—58%、高度的30%—52%，通常放在中下部或略微偏向一侧。连续暖白纸张留白不少于55%。

在一块安静的纸白区域加入一个简短英文标题、`CRAYON STUDY 01`式字段和一句来自照片事实的观察文字。文字使用与画面相同的略微晃动的蜡笔手写字，必须清楚可读。

避免精细毛发、可爱矢量吉祥物、完整填色、密集涂鸦、完整背景、光滑数字铅笔、精细产品插画、过小文字、作者签名、Logo和水印。

items.title: 浓色马克笔人物画
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Dense Color Marker Portrait Painting | Turning a real person into an interesting piece of work

Creation Task

Using the photo uploaded by the user as the sole reference for the character, create a marker portrait painting with a sense of contemporary art.

Retain the identity, expression, posture, and recognizability of the person in the photo, but completely reorganize the colors, brushstrokes, and pictorial space. It is not applying a painting filter to the photo, but rather like an observant painter with a sense of humor who, after seeing this person, uses a few broad-tip markers with rich colors to redraw this moment.

The picture should be bold, thick, relaxed, and have distinct handmade traces. At first glance, one is attracted by the large color blocks; at second glance, one recognizes the person in the photo; at third glance, one discovers that slightly funny handwritten text next to them.

I. Artistic Direction

Color and shape organization references the distinct pure color relationships, simplified character silhouettes, and the rhythm between color blocks and negative space in Henri Matisse's paper cut-out works. Translate these inspirations into marker drawings rather than making paper cut-out collages. (Tate Gallery)

Text and humor reference the concise drawings, handwritten short sentences, and observations of the absurdity of daily life in David Shrigley's works. Only borrow this humorous relationship between text and image; this creation should be warmer, not adopting a dark, cynical tone, nor copying his specific works or sentences. (NGV)

Unify into a clear visual language: dense colors, broad strokes, simplified shapes, true expressions, a small number of handwritten side notes.

Do not mechanically mix multiple painting styles. The character is not a fixed role of a certain artist and must still be the person in the photo.

II. Recognize the person first, then simplify the person

Before drawing, first identify the most recognizable features in the photo: facial contour, hairstyle and hairline, the relationship between the eyes, the position of the nose and mouth, head angle, shoulder direction, posture, and memorable clothing or accessories.

Organize the picture around these features instead of depicting all details equally.

Retain the character's original sense of age, skin tone depth relationships, gender presentation, and bodily features. Retain obvious moles, freckles, glasses, beards, and a small number of facial lines that help identify identity.

Strictly retain the original expression and movement logic: closed eyes cannot be changed to open eyes, closed mouth cannot be changed to a toothy smile, profile face cannot be changed to a full face, and a rear three-quarter view cannot have a face added without authorization. Which direction the hair spreads and where the body tilts should continue from the original image.

Can simplify anatomical details, but the character cannot be reshaped into another face through beautifying, face thinning, enlarging eyes, or shrinking the nose.

Humor mainly comes from text and observation, not from drawing characters ugly.

III. Medium: Thick Opaque Pigment Markers

Set the drawing medium to opaque pigment markers, leaning towards an acrylic marker texture, using a wide, flat tip to lay down colors, a medium tip to establish shapes, and finally a small number of fine pens to complete necessary details and text.

Large color blocks should be full, solid, and have a sense of coverage, but there should be no three-dimensional piling up like oil paints.

Let people see how the pen passes across the paper surface: strips left by broad brush sweeps, slightly stiff corners when turning, seams of repeated overlapping, incompletely neat edges where strokes end, and small gaps formed by a few pen tips skipping over the paper texture.

Most color surfaces remain intact, showing these traces only locally. Do not replace real brushstrokes with granular noise spread across the entire picture.

Draw color blocks first, then add a small number of lines. Do not use uniform black lines to outline all contours first and then fill them in like a coloring book.

Allow local coverage, slight misalignment, and incompletely closed boundaries. Retain the drawing process, rather than polishing every stroke to perfection.

IV. Establish Characters with Large Color Blocks

Summarize the hair, face, neck, top, arms, and necessary accessories into a few heavy shapes. The relationship between shapes is more important than fine textures.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

浓色马克笔人物画｜把一个真实的人，画成一件有趣的作品

创作任务

以用户上传的照片为唯一人物参考，创作一幅具有当代艺术感的马克笔人物画。

保留照片中人物的身份、神态、姿势和辨识度，但彻底重新组织颜色、笔触和画面空间。不是给照片套上绘画滤镜，而是像一位有观察力、有幽默感的画家，看过这个人之后，用几支颜色浓郁的宽头马克笔，把这个瞬间重新画出来。

画面应当大胆、浓厚、松弛，有鲜明的手工痕迹。第一眼被大色块吸引，第二眼认出照片中的人，第三眼发现旁边那句有点好笑的手写文字。

一、艺术方向

色彩与形状组织参考 Henri Matisse（亨利·马蒂斯）剪纸作品中鲜明的纯色关系、简化的人物轮廓，以及色块与留白之间的节奏。把这些启发转译为马克笔绘画，而不是制作剪纸拼贴。(泰特艺术馆)

文字与幽默参考 David Shrigley（大卫·史瑞格里）作品中简练的绘画、手写短句，以及对日常生活荒诞之处的观察。只借鉴这种图文之间的幽默关系；本次创作应更温暖，不沿用黑暗、尖刻的语气，也不复制他的具体作品或句子。(NGV)

统一成一种明确的视觉语言：浓色、宽笔、简化造型、真实神态、少量手写旁注。

不要机械混合多种画风。人物不是某位艺术家的固定角色，必须仍然是照片里的那个人。

二、先认出这个人，再简化这个人

绘画前，先识别照片中最有辨识度的几个特征：脸部轮廓、发型与发际线、眼睛之间的关系、鼻子与嘴的位置、头部角度、肩膀方向、姿势，以及有记忆点的服装或配饰。

围绕这些特征组织画面，而不是平均描绘所有细节。

保留人物原本的年龄感、肤色深浅关系、性别呈现与身体特征。保留明显的痣、雀斑、眼镜、胡须，以及帮助辨认身份的少量面部线条。

严格保留原始表情与动作逻辑：闭眼不能改成睁眼，闭嘴不能改成露齿微笑，侧脸不能改成正脸，背影不能擅自补出面孔。头发朝哪个方向散开，身体朝哪里倾斜，都应延续原图。

可以简化解剖细节，但不能通过美化、瘦脸、放大双眼、缩小鼻子，把人物重塑成另一张脸。

幽默主要来自文字和观察，不靠把人物画丑。

三、媒介：浓厚的不叠层颜料马克笔

将绘画媒介设定为不叠层颜料马克笔，偏丙烯马克笔质感，以宽扁笔头铺色，以中等笔头建立形状，最后用少量细笔完成必要细节和文字。

大色块应饱满、扎实、具有覆盖感，但不要出现油画颜料般的立体堆积。

让人能看见笔是怎样经过纸面的：宽笔横扫留下的条带，转弯时略生硬的折角，重复覆盖的接缝，收笔处不完全齐整的边缘，以及少量笔尖跳过纸纹形成的细小缺口。

大部分色面保持完整，只在局部露出这些痕迹。不要用遍布全图的颗粒噪点代替真实笔触。

先画色块，再补少量线条。不要先用均匀黑线勾出全部轮廓，再像填色本一样填满。

允许局部覆盖、轻微错位和不完全闭合的边界。保留画过的过程，不把每一笔修得完美。

四、用大色块建立人物

把头发、脸、颈部、上衣、手臂和必要配饰，概括成少数几块有重量的形状。形状之间的关系比细碎纹理更重要。

脸部主要由一个基础肤色色面、两三处结构性色块和少量五官笔画构成。取消毛孔、照片微纹理、细碎反光和复杂明暗渐变，但保留支撑身份辨识的面部结构。

眼睛用少量短笔和深色色点完成，眼神方向必须准确。不要统一画成大圆眼，不添加夸张的高光和睫毛。

眉毛用有粗细变化的短笔画出，保留原本的走向和距离。

鼻子可以主要由一块暖色与一两笔暗色提示，不进行精密的立体塑形。

嘴部保留原始开合状态、嘴角方向与情绪。只有原图确实露出牙齿时才画牙齿，并将其概括为简单形状。

头发先画整体轮廓，再添加少量能说明方向的笔画。深色头发可使用深褐、墨蓝或近黑的色块；浅色、灰白色头发保留其辨识度，不一律改成棕发。重要的碎发可以像突然划出的细线，松动人物边缘。

衣服保留款式、领口、层次和关键色彩关系。褶皱只留下解释姿势所必需的几笔。

手势是照片重点时，必须保留动作；手不是重点时，可以减少细节，但不能随意改变位置。

五、色彩：浓重，不沉闷；鲜明，不嘈杂

放弃原提示词中统一的浅粉彩、奶油肤色和淡蓝背景设定。

根据照片里的服装、肤色和情绪，选择一组有限而有力度的配色。通常使用四至六种主要颜色，以一种主导色建立整体气氛，一种对照色制造张力，再用少量强调色点亮画面。

候选色包括钴蓝、群青、朱红、番茄红、赭黄、深草绿、孔雀绿、茄紫、酒红和暖象牙白。每张画只选择适合它的几种，不要把所有颜色同时放进去。

让大面积颜色真正参与构图，而不是只把背景涂得鲜艳、人物仍然保留照片式写实。

肤色允许艺术化转译，可使用赭石、陶土、杏桃或暖棕等色面，并在局部引入与背景呼应的冷色。保留原人物肤色的深浅特征，不统一漂白，也不要把脸切成杂乱的彩虹碎片。

用相邻色块的冷暖与明度差建立体积，不依赖柔焦渐变、喷枪阴影或电影光效。

六、构图与背景

根据原图提取主要人物，删除无关路人、杂物和复杂环境。若是没有明显主次的合影，保留核心人物之间的关系，不任意删掉其中一人。

默认延续原图的横竖方向与关键动作。可以适度裁切、放大和调整主体位置，但不要把有意义的全身动作一律裁成头像。

采用松弛而准确的构图。人物可以略微偏向一侧，为文字留出自然的位置；不要为了对称而机械居中。

背景以一整块主色或两块大的颜色区域构成，可以保留少量暖白纸面。用色块边缘、人物轮廓与空白之间的关系创造空间，不还原完整的摄影环境。

只有当某个物件直接构成照片的趣味或人物特征时，才保留它，例如手中的杯子、被风吹起的帽子、怀里的宠物。把它同样画成简洁色块。

不要无意义地添加植物、星星、爱心、贴纸或几何装饰。画面需要的是取舍，不是堆满设计元素。

七、手写文字：像画家看着这个人，忍不住写了一句

先理解照片中真实可见的动作、表情、衣物或物件，再创作与之对应的幽默短句。

文字应当让人觉得：“这句话是看过这张照片才想到的。”

采用轻微反差、一本正经的玩笑、拟人化的小抱怨，或日常生活中的微小荒诞。不要直接说明照片里有什么，也不要使用励志鸡汤和与画面无关的流行口号。

英文为主，可酌情加入一句更短的中文；不必逐句双语翻译。主句控制在三至八个英文单词，另可添加一个一至三个单词的小旁注。除日期外，文字最多形成两组。

以下仅示范幽默机制，不是固定文案，不要全部写入画面：

头发明显凌乱时，可以写：
“MY HAIR HAS OTHER PLANS.”
人物认真拿着一小杯饮料时，可以写：
“SMALL CUP. BIG RESPONSIBILITIES.”

人物明显望向远处、呈放空姿态时，可以写：
“CURRENTLY BETWEEN THOUGHTS.”
必须根据实际照片重新判断和创作。没有对应的画面线索就不要使用这些句子，也不要为配合句子给人物添加道具。

幽默针对情境，不贬损人物外貌或身份。照片气氛庄重时，让文字更轻、更含蓄，不强行制造笑点。
文字必须像手写：笔画有压力变化，字母略有大小差异，基线轻微起伏，间距自然不均匀，但拼写正确、清晰可读。

使用深色笔写在浅色区域，或用暖白色颜料笔写在深色区域。文字与人物共享同一种手工质感，不像后期叠加的电脑字体。

可以有一条短短的手绘下划线，或一根确有指向作用的小箭头。不要变成满页涂鸦。

八、时间戳落款

完成绘画与旁注后，在画面右下角或下方留白处，以更小、更轻的手写字落下实际创作日期。

日期采用 
http://
YYYY.MM.DD 格式；能够确认具体时间时，可采用 
http://
YYYY.MM.DD · HH:mm 格式。

使用生成作品时可核实的日期与时间，优先遵循用户指定的时区。无法确认时分时，只写日期，不编造精确时间。不要把生成日期冒充照片拍摄日期，也不要把格式占位符直接画进作品。

落款像画家画完后随手留下的一笔，与主文案拉开层级。不添加虚构的艺术家签名、品牌标志或水印。

九、最终控制

避免写实照片质感、半写实 AI 油画、柔软喷枪渐变、叠层水彩晕染、粉彩糖果色、塑料皮肤、动漫大眼、三维卡通、矢量轮廓、满画面黑色描边，以及过度精细的头发和织物纹理。

也避免另一种极端：不要把“艺术感”理解成随意破坏五官，把“手工感”理解成脏乱，把“幽默”理解成堆砌段子。

最终画面应当像一幅可以挂在小型画廊里的马克笔人物作品：远看，色块鲜明而有秩序；近看，笔触有停顿、有覆盖、有人的手感；再看，人物仍然是照片里的那个人，而旁边的一句小字，让整个瞬间突然有了性格。

少画一些无关细节，把颜色画得更有分量，把人画得更像他自己。

items.title: 街道时尚东亚女性全身实拍照片
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Scene / Background

Photorealistic full-body street-fashion photograph of a young adult East Asian woman walking along a quiet, tree-lined urban street in bright natural daylight. The street is shaded by mature roadside trees, creating irregular dappled sunlight and strong leaf shadows across the asphalt. A pale tiled sidewalk runs along the left side. On the right are a dark commercial building frontage, several parked scooters, a visible TAi-Beauty gas-station sign, and a partially visible white car. Urban residential/commercial surroundings, realistic street textures, natural depth, candid vacation/street-photography atmosphere.

Main Description

A young adult East Asian woman with long, straight dark-brown hair walks toward the camera with a relaxed, confident expression. She has a curvaceous figure and natural facial features. She wears a fitted white sleeveless cropped tank top with a low rounded neckline, dark blue denim knee-length athletic shorts, and black flat strappy sandals. She carries a large dark leather handbag in her left hand. Her body is captured mid-stride, with one leg crossing naturally in front of the other and her arms relaxed at her sides. She looks directly toward the camera.

She possesses the best head-to-body ratio, a perfect, curvaceous, S-shaped female figure, long legs with perfect leg lines, and a slender waist, perfect foots,perfect foot lines

Key Details
Full-body composition, head-to-toe visible
Natural walking pose, one foot stepping forward
Long straight dark-brown hair falling past the shoulders
Fitted white sleeveless fitted top
High-waisted dark denim knee-length athletic shorts
Black minimal strappy sandals
Large dark structured leather handbag held in the left hand
Relaxed, subtle smile / calm confident expression
Direct gaze toward camera
Bright tropical/Asian urban daylight
Strong dappled sunlight from overhead trees
Distinct soft-to-hard leaf shadows across the road and subject
Realistic skin texture, hair strands, fabric and denim details
Parked scooters and partially visible white car in background
Natural perspective and realistic photographic proportions
Candid smartphone/street-photography aesthetic

Constraints
Photorealistic real-world photography, not illustration or CGI
Preserve realistic human anatomy and natural body proportions
Keep the subject fully visible from head to feet
Keep the walking posture and crossed-step motion natural
Do not exaggerate body proportions, curves, facial features, or makeup
Do not add jewelry, accessories, clothing layers, or props not visible in the reference
Preserve the simple urban street environment and parked scooters
Maintain authentic daylight, dappled tree shadows, and natural contrast
Avoid excessive skin smoothing, beauty retouching, artificial lighting, cinematic color grading, or glamour-editorial styling
No text overlays, captions, borders, watermarks, or duplicated people
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

场景 / 背景

逼真的全身街头时尚摄影，一位年轻的东亚成年女性走在明亮自然日光下的宁静树荫城市街道上。街道被成熟的路边树木遮蔽，在沥青路面上形成不规则的斑驳阳光和强烈的树叶阴影。左侧有一条淡色瓷砖人行道。右侧是一个深色商业建筑正面，几辆停放的轻便摩托车，一个可见的 TAi-Beauty 加油站标志，以及一辆部分可见的白色汽车。城市居住/商业环境，写实的街道纹理，自然的深度，随意的度假/街头摄影氛围。

主要描述

一位留着深棕色直长发的年轻东亚成年女性神情放松、自信地走向镜头。她拥有曲线美身材和自然的面部特征。她穿着一件合身的白色无袖露脐无袖上衣，带有低圆领，深蓝色牛仔短裤，以及黑色平底系带凉鞋。她左手拎着一个大的深色皮质手提包。她的身体被捕捉到跨步中的状态，一条腿自然地交叉在另一条腿前面，双臂放松地垂在身体两侧。她直视镜头。

她拥有最佳的头身比，完美的曲线，S型女性身材，修长的双腿和完美的腿部线条，纤细的腰部，完美的双脚，完美的足部线条

关键细节
全身构图，从头到脚可见
自然的走路姿势，一只脚向前跨步
长直深棕色头发垂过肩膀
合身白色无袖露脐上衣
高腰深色牛仔短裤
黑色简约系带凉鞋
左手提着大型深色结构化皮质手提包
放松、细微的微笑 / 冷静自信的表情
直视镜头
明亮的热带/亚洲城市日光
来自头顶树木的强烈斑驳阳光
横跨道路和主体的明显的软到硬的树叶阴影
逼真的皮肤纹理、发丝、面料和牛仔细节
背景中有停放的轻便摩托车和部分可见的白色汽车
自然的透视和真实的摄影比例
随意的智能手机/街头摄影美学

约束条件
逼真的现实世界摄影，而非插图或 CGI
保持逼真的人体解剖结构和自然的人体比例
让主体从头到脚完全可见
保持行走姿势和交叉步动作自然
不要夸大身体比例、曲线、面部特征或妆容
不要添加参考图中不可见的珠宝、配饰、服装层或道具
保留简单的城市街道环境和停放的轻便摩托车
保持真实的日光、斑驳的树影和自然对比度
避免过度的磨皮、美颜修图、人造光、电影级调色或时尚杂志风格
无文字叠加、标题、边框、水印或重复的人物

9:16竖幅，韩系素人感，皮肤白皙，夸张身材；真实生活空间。人物注意力集中在眼前的事情上，不看镜头；动作由突发状况自然引发，允许笨拙、失衡、来不及反应或短暂愣住，不要刻意摆拍。

【场景池】

Selected single scene: 床单把人卷进去: 整理床单时身体被床单缠住，只露出脑袋和手脚，正在努力挣脱。

【影像】
iPhone 手机随手拍的成像；自然曝光、白平衡和环境光；允许自然的轻微动态模糊或对焦偏差；保留真实生活痕迹与适量留白。

items.title: 互动式古代美人捏人游戏提示词 - Expression
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

You are an interactive ancient beauty character creation game. Determine core character features through 8 steps, with the remaining details completed by AI. Minimal explanation, high interaction, and always save the current character state.

【Process】

① Dynasty → ② Body → ③ Temperament → ④ Hairstyle → ⑤ Clothing → ⑥ Makeup → ⑦ Scene → ⑧ Expression → Completion

Strictly follow the order, showing only one item at a time. After the user selects, save immediately and move to the next item without asking "next step" or repeating confirmation. At the start, only display ①.

【Selection Interface】

6–10 options per item.

Use compact visual cards: visual example + number + name + a short analysis sentence. The analysis highlights option characteristics or visual effects, kept within 10 words. 2–3 columns, displayed on one screen.

Support clicking as priority; use numbers or names when clicking is unavailable.

【Creation Items】

① Dynasty
Pre-Qin | Qin and Han | Wei, Jin, Southern and Northern Dynasties | Sui and Tang | Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms | Song | Liao, Jin, Yuan | Ming | Qing

② Body
Petite and graceful | Slender and soft | Natural and well-proportioned | Tall and slender | Soft and plump | Graceful and elegant

③ Temperament
Elegant | Gentle | Bright | Exquisite | Dignified | Charming | Cold | Naive

④ Hairstyle
Provide 6–8 historically based traditional female hairstyles according to the dynasty.

⑤ Clothing
Provide 6–8 traditional female clothing styles based on artifacts, paintings, archaeology, or literature according to the dynasty. Modern new Chinese style, pan-Chinese style, and fictional film/TV clothing are prohibited.

⑥ Makeup
Provide 6–8 historically based female makeup styles according to the dynasty.

⑦ Scene
Provide 6–8 female life scenes consistent with the architecture, lifestyle, and social environment of the era according to the dynasty.

⑧ Expression
Based on all determined settings from ① to ⑦, dynamically generate 8 expressions that best fit the current character, scene, and context.

The 8 expressions must be clearly distinct, avoiding repetition, conflict, and generalization. ⑧ does not use a fixed option pool.

【Dynasty Linkage】

④ Hairstyle, ⑤ Clothing, ⑥ Makeup, and ⑦ Scene must be consistent with ① Dynasty.

Liao, Jin, and Yuan must be handled separately and not mixed.

If ① Dynasty is modified, only re-process ④⑤⑥⑦; ②③ remain unchanged.

After modifying any item from ④ to ⑦, check if subsequent items conflict with the latest settings; if there is a conflict, re-process; ⑧ is always regenerated based on the latest ① to ⑦.

【State and Operations】

Always save selected items.

“Random”: Randomize the current item; invalid if locked.

“Change one”: Re-provide options for the current item; invalid if locked.

“Lock”: Lock the current item, restricting Random, Change one, and Random All from changing it.

“Modify Setting”: Locked items can be modified when the user explicitly specifies a modification.

“Back”: Return to the previous item and display it immediately; continue forward after re-selecting, with other states preserved. If subsequent items conflict with the latest settings, re-process affected items and regenerate ⑧ Expression.

“Random All”: Randomize all unlocked items, locked items remain unchanged, starting from ①; if an item is locked, retain it and move to the next. After completing ①–⑦, regenerate ⑧ Expression based on the latest settings.

“Restart Creation”: Clear all settings and start from ①.

Support direct commands like “Change to Ming Dynasty,” “Change hairstyle,” “Change to a slight smile,” etc., executed based on semantics.

【AI Auto-completion】

In addition to the 8 creation items, all other details are automatically completed by AI, including movements, gestures, specific hair accessories, jewelry, colors, patterns, materials, footwear, props, environment, character relationships, composition, lens, lighting, season, weather, etc.

Season: Spring | Summer | Autumn | Winter
Weather: Sunny | Cloudy | Misty | Drizzle | Snow

All auto-completions must fit the character, dynasty, clothing, hairstyle, makeup, and scene.

【Fixed Character】

Adult female; natural body shape; coordinated proportions; realistic skin texture.

【Fixed Photography】

Mobile life snapshot × CCD direct flash; 9:16 vertical aspect ratio; native digital photo.

Photography style is fixed and not a selection item; it does not change the historical context.

【Completion】

After completing ⑧ Expression, you must output in order:

【Complete Character Settings】
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

你是一款互动式古代美人捏人游戏。通过8步决定人物核心特征，其余细节由AI补全。少解释，多互动，始终保存当前角色状态。

【流程】

①朝代 → ②身材 → ③气质 → ④发式 → ⑤服饰 → ⑥妆容 → ⑦场景 → ⑧神态 → 完成

严格按顺序，一次只展示一个项目。用户选择后立即保存并进入下一项，不询问“下一步”，不重复确认。开始时只展示①。

【选择界面】

每项6～10个选项。

使用紧凑视觉卡：视觉示例＋编号＋名称＋一句短解析。解析突出选项特点或视觉效果，尽量控制在10字以内。2～3列，一屏显示。

支持点击时优先点击；无法点击时使用编号或名称。

【捏人项目】

①朝代
先秦｜秦汉｜魏晋南北朝｜隋唐｜五代十国｜宋｜辽金元｜明｜清

②身材
娇小纤秀｜纤细柔婉｜自然匀称｜高挑修长｜柔婉丰润｜丰姿婀娜

③气质
清雅｜温婉｜明艳｜灵秀｜端庄｜妩媚｜清冷｜娇憨

④发式
根据朝代提供6～8种有历史依据的女性传统发式。

⑤服饰
根据朝代提供6～8种有文物、绘画、考古或文献依据的女性传统服饰形制。禁止现代新中式、泛中国风、影视架空服饰。

⑥妆容
根据朝代提供6～8种有历史依据的女性妆容。

⑦场景
根据朝代提供6～8种符合时代建筑、生活方式和社会环境的女性生活场景。

⑧神态
根据①～⑦已确定的全部设定，动态生成8种最符合当前人物、场景和情境的神态。

8种神态须有明显区别，避免重复、冲突和泛化。⑧不使用固定选项池。

【朝代联动】

④发式、⑤服饰、⑥妆容、⑦场景必须与①朝代一致。

辽金元需分别处理，不得混合三个时期。

修改①朝代，只重新处理④⑤⑥⑦；②③保持不变。

修改④～⑦任一项目后，检查后续项目是否与最新设定冲突，有冲突则重新处理；⑧始终根据最新①～⑦重新生成。

【状态与操作】

始终保存已选项目。

“随机”：随机当前项目，已锁定则无效。

“换一个”：重新提供当前项目选项，已锁定则无效。

“锁定”：锁定当前项目，限制随机、换一个和全部随机改变该项目。

“修改设定”：用户明确指定修改时，可以修改已锁定项目。

“返回”：回到上一项目并立即显示该项目，重新选择后继续向后推进，其他状态保留；若后续项目与最新设定冲突，则重新处理受影响项目，并重新生成⑧神态。

“全部随机”：随机所有未锁定项目，已锁定项目保持不变，从①开始；遇到已锁定项目直接保留并进入下一项。完成①～⑦后，根据最新设定重新生成⑧神态。

“重新捏人”：清空全部设定，从①开始。

支持直接说“换成明代”“发式换一个”“改成浅笑”等，根据语义执行。

【AI自动补全】

除8个捏人项目外，其余全部由AI自动完成，包括动作、手势、具体发饰、首饰、颜色、纹样、材质、鞋履、道具、环境、人物关系、构图、镜头、光影、时令、天气等。

时令：春｜夏｜秋｜冬
天气：晴｜阴｜薄雾｜细雨｜雪

所有自动补全必须符合人物、朝代、服饰、发式、妆容和场景。

【固定人物】

成年女性；身材自然；比例协调；真实肤质。

【固定摄影】

手机生活抓拍 × CCD直闪；9:16竖幅；原生数码照片。

摄影风格固定，不作为选择项目，不改变历史语境。

【完成】

完成⑧神态后，必须依次输出：

【完整角色设定】

Selected single scene: 神态: 当前选择

【最终图片提示词】

完整整合8项设定，并自动补全动作、手势、发饰、首饰、服装细节、颜色、纹样、材质、鞋履、道具、环境、人物关系、时令、天气、构图、镜头和光影。

保持历史一致性，并加入：

手机生活抓拍 × CCD直闪；9:16竖幅；原生数码照片。

最终提示词必须完整、连贯、可直接复制用于图片生成，不得只输出关键词或省略已选设定。

提示词最后加入：

左下签名“● DeepBlue”；“●”为纯 #0B3D91 深蓝色实心圆点，“DeepBlue”为白色自然手写字体

然后显示：

① 生成图片
② 修改设定
③ 重新捏人

【生成】

输入“1”“生成”或“出图”，立即根据最终图片提示词生成图片。

【修改】

输入“2”后指定项目并重新选择。

修改后重新输出完整角色设定和最终图片提示词，再显示①②③。

【重新捏人】

输入“3”或“重新捏人”，清空角色，从①开始。

【再来一个】

保留8项核心设定和固定摄影。

只重新演绎动作、环境、时令、天气、构图、镜头和光影。

不得改变8项核心设定或固定摄影。

生成新的最终图片提示词并立即生成。

【最终规则】

这是连续捏人游戏，不是普通问答。

一次一个项目；选择后立即推进；始终保存状态；朝代变化自动联动；修改④～⑦后检查后续一致性；⑧神态始终根据最新①～⑦动态生成；摄影固定；不得要求下一步；不得重复确认。

完成⑧后必须：

输出完整角色设定
→ 输出完整图片提示词
→ 显示①②③

不得跳过完整图片提示词。

点击不可用时，立即降级为编号或名称选择，不得中断流程。

现在开始，只展示①朝代。

6–10 options per item.

Support clicking as priority; use numbers or names when clicking is unavailable.

① Dynasty
Pre-Qin | Qin and Han | Wei, Jin, Southern and Northern Dynasties | Sui and Tang | Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms | Song | Liao, Jin, Yuan | Ming | Qing

③ Temperament
Elegant | Gentle | Bright | Exquisite | Dignified | Charming | Cold | Naive

⑤ Clothing
Provide 6–8 traditional female clothing styles based on artifacts, paintings, archaeology, or literature according to the dynasty. Modern new Chinese style, pan-Chinese style, and fictional film/TV clothing are prohibited.

⑥ Makeup
Provide 6–8 historically based female makeup styles according to the dynasty.

⑦ Scene
Provide 6–8 female life scenes consistent with the architecture, lifestyle, and social environment of the era according to the dynasty.

④ Hairstyle, ⑤ Clothing, ⑥ Makeup, and ⑦ Scene must be consistent with ① Dynasty.

Adult female; natural body shape; coordinated proportions; realistic skin texture.

Mobile life snapshot × CCD direct flash; 9:16 vertical aspect ratio; native digital photo.

After completing ⑧ Expression, you must output in order:

【Complete Character Settings】

根据①～⑦已确定的全部设定，动态生成8种最符合当前人物、场景和情境的神态。

Selected single scene: 发式: 当前选择

然后显示：

③ 重新捏人

【生成】

输入“1”“生成”或“出图”，立即根据最终图片提示词生成图片。

输入“2”后指定项目并重新选择。

修改后重新输出完整角色设定和最终图片提示词，再显示①②③。

【重新捏人】

输入“3”或“重新捏人”，清空角色，从①开始。

【再来一个】

保留8项核心设定和固定摄影。

只重新演绎动作、环境、时令、天气、构图、镜头和光影。

不得改变8项核心设定或固定摄影。

生成新的最终图片提示词并立即生成。

一次一个项目；选择后立即推进；始终保存状态；朝代变化自动联动；修改④～⑦后检查后续一致性；⑧神态始终根据最新①～⑦动态生成；摄影固定；不得要求下一步；不得重复确认。

现在开始，只展示①朝代。

6–10 options per item.

Provide 6–8 historically based traditional female hairstyles according to the dynasty.

Provide 6–8 traditional female clothing styles based on artifacts, paintings, archaeology, or literature according to the dynasty. Modern new Chinese style, pan-Chinese style, and fictional film/TV clothing are prohibited.

Provide 6–8 historically based female makeup styles according to the dynasty.

Provide 6–8 female life scenes consistent with the architecture, lifestyle, and social environment of the era according to the dynasty.

All auto-completions must fit the character, dynasty, clothing, hairstyle, makeup, and scene.

Adult female; natural body shape; coordinated proportions; realistic skin texture.

Mobile life snapshot × CCD direct flash; 9:16 vertical aspect ratio; native digital photo.

Photography style is fixed and not a selection item; it does not change the historical context.

【Completion】

After completing ⑧ Expression, you must output in order:

【Complete Character Settings】

【Complete Character Settings】
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

你是一款互动式古代美人捏人游戏。通过8步决定人物核心特征，其余细节由AI补全。少解释，多互动，始终保存当前角色状态。

【流程】

①朝代 → ②身材 → ③气质 → ④发式 → ⑤服饰 → ⑥妆容 → ⑦场景 → ⑧神态 → 完成

严格按顺序，一次只展示一个项目。用户选择后立即保存并进入下一项，不询问“下一步”，不重复确认。开始时只展示①。

【选择界面】

每项6～10个选项。

使用紧凑视觉卡：视觉示例＋编号＋名称＋一句短解析。解析突出选项特点或视觉效果，尽量控制在10字以内。2～3列，一屏显示。

支持点击时优先点击；无法点击时使用编号或名称。

【捏人项目】

①朝代
先秦｜秦汉｜魏晋南北朝｜隋唐｜五代十国｜宋｜辽金元｜明｜清

②身材
娇小纤秀｜纤细柔婉｜自然匀称｜高挑修长｜柔婉丰润｜丰姿婀娜

③气质
清雅｜温婉｜明艳｜灵秀｜端庄｜妩媚｜清冷｜娇憨

④发式
根据朝代提供6～8种有历史依据的女性传统发式。

⑤服饰
根据朝代提供6～8种有文物、绘画、考古或文献依据的女性传统服饰形制。禁止现代新中式、泛中国风、影视架空服饰。

⑥妆容
根据朝代提供6～8种有历史依据的女性妆容。

⑦场景
根据朝代提供6～8种符合时代建筑、生活方式和社会环境的女性生活场景。

⑧神态
根据①～⑦已确定的全部设定，动态生成8种最符合当前人物、场景和情境的神态。

8种神态须有明显区别，避免重复、冲突和泛化。⑧不使用固定选项池。

【朝代联动】

④发式、⑤服饰、⑥妆容、⑦场景必须与①朝代一致。

辽金元需分别处理，不得混合三个时期。

修改①朝代，只重新处理④⑤⑥⑦；②③保持不变。

修改④～⑦任一项目后，检查后续项目是否与最新设定冲突，有冲突则重新处理；⑧始终根据最新①～⑦重新生成。

【状态与操作】

始终保存已选项目。

“随机”：随机当前项目，已锁定则无效。

“换一个”：重新提供当前项目选项，已锁定则无效。

“锁定”：锁定当前项目，限制随机、换一个和全部随机改变该项目。

“修改设定”：用户明确指定修改时，可以修改已锁定项目。

“返回”：回到上一项目并立即显示该项目，重新选择后继续向后推进，其他状态保留；若后续项目与最新设定冲突，则重新处理受影响项目，并重新生成⑧神态。

“全部随机”：随机所有未锁定项目，已锁定项目保持不变，从①开始；遇到已锁定项目直接保留并进入下一项。完成①～⑦后，根据最新设定重新生成⑧神态。

“重新捏人”：清空全部设定，从①开始。

支持直接说“换成明代”“发式换一个”“改成浅笑”等，根据语义执行。

【AI自动补全】

除8个捏人项目外，其余全部由AI自动完成，包括动作、手势、具体发饰、首饰、颜色、纹样、材质、鞋履、道具、环境、人物关系、构图、镜头、光影、时令、天气等。

时令：春｜夏｜秋｜冬
天气：晴｜阴｜薄雾｜细雨｜雪

所有自动补全必须符合人物、朝代、服饰、发式、妆容和场景。

【固定人物】

成年女性；身材自然；比例协调；真实肤质。

【固定摄影】

手机生活抓拍 × CCD直闪；9:16竖幅；原生数码照片。

摄影风格固定，不作为选择项目，不改变历史语境。

【完成】

完成⑧神态后，必须依次输出：

【完整角色设定】

Selected single scene: 朝代: 当前选择

【最终图片提示词】

完整整合8项设定，并自动补全动作、手势、发饰、首饰、服装细节、颜色、纹样、材质、鞋履、道具、环境、人物关系、时令、天气、构图、镜头和光影。

保持历史一致性，并加入：

手机生活抓拍 × CCD直闪；9:16竖幅；原生数码照片。

最终提示词必须完整、连贯、可直接复制用于图片生成，不得只输出关键词或省略已选设定。

提示词最后加入：

左下签名“● DeepBlue”；“●”为纯 #0B3D91 深蓝色实心圆点，“DeepBlue”为白色自然手写字体

然后显示：

① 生成图片
② 修改设定
③ 重新捏人

【生成】

输入“1”“生成”或“出图”，立即根据最终图片提示词生成图片。

【修改】

输入“2”后指定项目并重新选择。

修改后重新输出完整角色设定和最终图片提示词，再显示①②③。

【重新捏人】

输入“3”或“重新捏人”，清空角色，从①开始。

【再来一个】

保留8项核心设定和固定摄影。

只重新演绎动作、环境、时令、天气、构图、镜头和光影。

不得改变8项核心设定或固定摄影。

生成新的最终图片提示词并立即生成。

【最终规则】

这是连续捏人游戏，不是普通问答。

一次一个项目；选择后立即推进；始终保存状态；朝代变化自动联动；修改④～⑦后检查后续一致性；⑧神态始终根据最新①～⑦动态生成；摄影固定；不得要求下一步；不得重复确认。

完成⑧后必须：

输出完整角色设定
→ 输出完整图片提示词
→ 显示①②③

不得跳过完整图片提示词。

点击不可用时，立即降级为编号或名称选择，不得中断流程。

现在开始，只展示①朝代。

items.title: 东方神明工笔重彩圣像插画
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

【Deity Identity】: Manjushri Bodhisattva / Virupaksha (Wide-eyed Heavenly King) / Vajrapani / Samantabhadra Bodhisattva / Other deities
【Divine Beast / Dharma Tool】: Blue Lion / Crimson Dragon / Vajra Scepter / Six-tusked White Elephant / Others
【Core Action】: Sitting upright on a beast / Standing in suppression / Stepping on clouds / Surrounding / Holding a dharma tool
【Main Color Palette】: Azurite, pale green, cinnabar, old gold, ink blue, ivory white
【Composition Method】: Top and bottom dual subjects / S-shaped surrounding / Frontal suppression / Diagonal momentum
【Overall Temperament】: Solemn, sacred, powerful, eerie, majestic
【Aspect Ratio】: 9:16

Generate an illustration of an Eastern deity's Gongbi heavy-color sacred icon, with [Deity Identity] as the core subject, combined with [Divine Beast / Dharma Tool] to establish a complete, clear, and powerful compositional relationship. The figures, divine beasts, dharma tools, silk ribbons, and clouds together form a clear visual "momentum," but the subject hierarchy must be distinct, avoiding all elements competing for the screen at the same time.

The overall style merges the temperament of traditional Chinese deity paintings, Gongbi heavy color, fine-line ink engraving, and ancient sacred icon scrolls. The figure's appearance is solemn, possessing divinity and a sense of pressure. The attire adopts a complete system of traditional divine robes, armor, crowns, and jade ornaments, with patterns mainly consisting of cloud patterns, scale patterns, hui-style patterns, grass scrolls, lotus patterns, and beast-face patterns.

Focus on maintaining "high-continuity Gongbi line drawing": Figure hair, beards, divine beast fur, dragon manes, feathers, etc., must follow the direction of natural growth and volume, shaped with long, smooth, continuous, and stable lines; silk ribbons, sleeves, dragon bodies, elephant trunks, and clouds use complete S-shaped and C-shaped large curves, clearly coherent from start to finish. Reduce fine, fragmented textures; do not use random short lines, dense broken dots, jagged hair, noise-like engraved lines, or meaningless small patterns.

Armor, crowns, attire, and divine beast decorative patterns should be "few but complete," prioritizing the use of complete, closed large patterns and continuous border decorations. Complexity comes from clear structural layers, not a large number of miniature fragmented patterns.

Color uses low-saturation but full, uniform, and continuous traditional mineral heavy colors, with [Main Color Palette] as the core. Azurite, stone green, ink blue, old gold, bronze gold, cinnabar, ochre red, ivory white, and other colors form clear large color blocks. Colors in the same area are stable and complete, with depth changes naturally transitioning according to the structure. Avoid random mottling, fading, stains, particles, artificial aging, and uneven color blocks.

The background uses clean, warm ivory-colored Xuan paper, retaining only extremely light natural paper fibers, with large areas of white space and a small amount of continuous line-drawn clouds. The ancient charm comes from Gongbi lines, mineral coloring, Xuan paper, calligraphic inscriptions, and red seals, without relying on artificial aging.

The image must include a traditional ancient painting inscription system: one column of medium-sized deity names, one column of smaller sub-titles, a small amount of fine inscriptions, and 3–5 red seals of staggered sizes. The text is part of the visual structure but must not overpower the figures and divine beasts, nor should it be made into modern poster-style large titles.

The overall principle follows "high density for the subject, low density for the background": Figure faces, divine beast heads, dharma tools, and core armor areas have the richest detail; large robes and divine beast bodies maintain medium density; clouds and the Xuan paper background are the sparsest.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

【神明身份】：文殊菩萨 / 广目天王 / 金刚力士 / 普贤菩萨 / 其他神祇
【神兽 / 法器】：青狮 / 赤龙 / 金刚杵 / 六牙白象 / 其他
【核心动作】：端坐御兽 / 镇立 / 踏云 / 环绕 / 持法器
【主色调】：石青、苍绿、朱砂、旧金、墨青、象牙白
【构图方式】：上下双主体 / S 型环绕 / 正面镇压 / 斜向动势
【整体气质】：庄严、神圣、威猛、怪异、肃穆
【画幅比例】：9:16

生成一张东方神明工笔重彩圣像插画，以【神明身份】为核心主体，并结合【神兽 / 法器】建立完整、清晰、有力量的构图关系。人物、神兽、法器、披帛和云气共同形成明确的视觉“势”，但主体层级必须清楚，避免所有元素同时抢画面。

整体融合中国传统神像画、工笔重彩、白描线刻与古籍圣像图卷气质。人物法相庄严、有神性和压迫感，服饰采用完整传统神袍、甲胄、冠饰与璎珞体系，纹样以云纹、鳞纹、回纹、卷草纹、莲纹、兽面纹等为主。

重点保持“高连续性工笔线描”：人物头发、胡须、神兽毛发、龙鬃、羽毛等必须顺着自然生长和体积方向，以长而柔顺、连续稳定的线条塑形；披帛、衣袂、龙身、象鼻和云气采用完整的 S 型、C 型大曲线，从起点到收尾清楚连贯。减少微碎纹理，不使用随机短线、密集断点、锯齿毛发、噪声式刻线或无意义的小纹样。

甲胄、头冠、服饰和神兽装饰纹样要“少而完整”，优先使用完整闭合的大型纹样与连续边饰。复杂感来自清晰的结构层级，而不是大量微型碎纹。

色彩采用低饱和但饱满、均匀、连续的传统矿物重彩，以【主色调】为核心。石青、石绿、墨青、旧金、铜金、朱砂、赭红、象牙白等颜色形成明确大色块，同一区域色彩稳定完整，深浅变化跟随结构自然过渡。避免随机斑驳、褪色、污渍、颗粒、做旧和色块不均。

The composition emphasizes a single deity dominating the scene, without adding multi-person groups or complex large scenes, allowing the characters, mounts, and artifacts to form clear large shapes and visual momentum.

The overall pursuit is a true sense of handmade Gongbi coloring, rather than modern digital national-style illustrations. The character's face has the temperament of an ancient painted deity statue, with clear whites of the eyes, concentrated pupils, and a majestic and restrained expression, avoiding anime faces, influencer faces, or game character faces. Hair, beards, and divine beast fur are shaped with bundled, continuous long brush lines growing along the volume, with lines showing natural pressure changes, thickness variations, and tapered ends, clear but not stiff.

Do not use pure black, extremely thin, or extremely sharp manga outlines for the line work. Use ink-brown, blue-ink-brown, or warm-gray-ink for the main outlines of the characters; use light ochre-ink for the face and hands; and gradually reduce the line weight for clothing folds, hair, and clouds. Lines are used to hold the color, rather than pressing down on the color surface, allowing the screen to present complete coloring first, followed by delicate brush lines.

The colors adopt low-saturation but full and uniform traditional mineral heavy colors, with 【Main Color Tone】 as the core, which can be paired with stone azure, stone green, cinnabar, ochre red, old gold, ivory white, ink gray, and other colors. The coloring presents a sense of layering with light color base, separate dyeing, top dyeing, and accumulated color. The main color in the same area is stable and complete, without using digital flat painting, high-contrast hard color blocks, or random mottled textures.

Details of clothing, armor, crowns, and artifacts are rich but restrained: first establish a complete structure, then add a small amount of traditional patterns such as cloud patterns, fret patterns, lotus patterns, and scale patterns. Do not fill the inside of all armor plates, robes, and decorative pieces with micro-patterns. The sense of complexity comes from structural hierarchy, not the number of fragmented patterns.

Flexible elements such as ribbons, sleeves, beards, tails, and clouds retain only a few main trends, forming complete S-shaped and C-shaped long curves; artifacts maintain a complete, clear, and continuous structure from beginning to end, becoming a stable hard axis in the picture.

The background uses clean, warm, and neutral warm ivory-colored ripe Xuan paper, retaining only extremely light natural paper fibers, a small amount of light blue-gray cloud gas, and sufficient white space. Do not paint yellower and yellower, do not use creamy yellow, earthy yellow, or brownish-yellow old photo filters, and do not use a deathly white background. Ancient charm comes from brushes, colors, paper, and characters, not from dirt, cracks, fading, and graininess.

The image includes a complete ancient painting colophon system: use 【Inscription】 as the main title, paired with smaller subtitles, a small number of vertical colophons, and 3–5 staggered cinnabar seals of various sizes. The calligraphy has natural brush pressure changes and is not modern poster-style huge Typography.

整体追求真正的手工工笔设色感，而不是现代数位国风立绘。人物面容具有古画神像气质，眼白清楚、瞳仁集中、神态威严克制，不做动漫脸、网红脸或游戏角色脸。头发、胡须、神兽毛发以成束、连续、顺着体积生长的毛笔长线塑形，线条有自然提按、粗细变化和收锋，清楚但不生硬。

勾线不要使用纯黑、极细、极锐的漫画描边。人物主轮廓使用墨褐、青墨褐、暖灰墨；面部与手部使用淡赭墨；衣纹、毛发与云气逐级减轻线权。线条用于托住颜色，而不是压住色面，让画面先呈现完整设色，再看到细腻笔线。

服饰、甲胄、冠饰和法器细节丰富但克制：先建立完整结构，再加入少量云纹、回纹、莲纹、鳞纹等传统纹样。不要在所有甲片、衣袍和饰件内部堆满微型花纹。复杂感来自结构层级，而不是碎纹数量。

飘带、衣袂、胡须、尾巴、云气等柔性元素只保留少量主要走势，形成完整的 S 型、C 型长曲线；法器保持从头到尾结构完整、清楚、连续，成为画面中的稳定硬轴。

整体效果像真正由画师在熟宣纸上以毛笔勾线、矿物颜料层层敷染完成的工笔重彩神明画：大形稳定、人物突出、毛发柔顺、线条温润、颜色饱满、纸面干净，古雅但不褪色，精细但不数字化。

Characters are not a fixed element. When scale is needed, extremely small characters can be added; when stronger lingering charm is needed, "human traces" can be left only through swords, lamps, wine cups, railings, letters, etc.

The main title uses the 【Two-character Theme】, paired with streamlined poetry, 【Location】, 【Date】, and the 【English Subtitle】, using modern Songti, Mincho, or high-end Chinese serif fonts, maintaining accuracy, clarity, and an editorial sense.

Overall presentation:
Oriental Poetry × Large Negative Space × Handmade Paper × White Bas-relief × Small Subject × Emotional Flowing Light × Editorial Design.

Avoid: ordinary ancient-style illustrations, complete landscape replications, huge subjects, deep black backgrounds, full-screen golden light, neon gradients, xianxia special effects, meaningless reliefs, broken flow lines, yellowed/aged backgrounds, dense text.

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

【诗词原句】：填写
【两字主题】：填写
【核心情绪】：填写
【视觉动作】：穿 / 折 / 震 / 散 / 燃 / 聚 / 升 / 落
【主体】：剑 / 灯 / 人物 / 栏杆 / 河流 / 舟 / 花 / 鸟 / 器物等
【流光色彩】：填写 2–4 种
【浅浮雕】：山脊 / 水路 / 脚印 / 声波 / 旧路 / 建筑残影等
【地点】：填写
【日期】：填写
【英文副标题】：填写

生成一张 9:16 竖版东方诗意流光留白海报。

不要直接复刻【诗词原句】中的完整古风场景，而是提炼【核心情绪】和【视觉动作】，通过一个明确的小主体【主体】，把诗意转化成有方向、有变化的视觉运动。

背景使用接近纯白的高级手工艺术纸，保留细腻纸纤维和自然压痕，保持约 65%–75% 的有效留白。主体尽量控制在画面约 8%–20%，避免巨大人物或器物填满画面。

让“光”真正参与构图。根据【视觉动作】设计光的状态，例如穿越、折返、扩散、聚合或由一点逐渐消失。使用【流光色彩】形成局部珍珠、玉石、金属、水面般的高级偏光，可加入冰蓝、翡翠青、淡紫、香槟金、琥珀金等，彩色区域保持克制，避免霓虹和满屏彩虹渐变。

背景加入有叙事意义的白色浅浮雕【浅浮雕】，表现旧路径、山河、脚印、声音残响或已经消失的场景。远看保持干净，近看才发现隐藏细节。

所有水线、光线、风线和波纹必须连续、柔顺、完整，避免断线、碎点和杂乱 AI 纹理。

人物不是固定元素。需要尺度时可加入极小人物；需要更强余韵时，可以只通过剑、灯、酒杯、栏杆、信笺等留下“人的痕迹”。

主标题使用【两字主题】，搭配精简诗句、【地点】、【日期】和【英文副标题】，采用现代宋体、明朝体或高级中文衬线字体，保持准确、清晰、有编辑感。

整体呈现：
东方诗词 × 大留白 × 手工纸 × 白色浅浮雕 × 小主体 × 情绪流光 × Editorial Design。

items.prompt:
