Dynamic action portrait of a young Chinese warrior woman （use the uploaded image as reference) with long jet-black hair flowing wildly in the wind, captured mid-motion in an elegant dual-sword battle stance, wielding one straight sword in each hand, body twisting dynamically with powerful yet graceful martial-arts movement. Her flowing sleeves, layered robes, ribbons, and hair sweep dramatically in the same direction, creating strong circular motion and cinematic energy.

She wears extraordinarily ornate layered Chinese fantasy armor built around a luxurious cloisonné aesthetic: brilliant mirror-polished bright silver armor plates, highly reflective platinum-silver metallic surfaces, intricate embossed filigree and engraved relief ornamentation, combined with deep cloisonné enamel blue panels — rich lacquered cobalt-blue, extremely deep yet luminous, glossy vitreous enamel with subtle inner glow and reflected highlights, NOT matte navy fabric, NOT dark steel.

Fine oxidized antique-gold filigree wire traces the borders of the blue enamel panels, armor seams, decorative motifs and ornamental medallions — aged brass-gold, slightly tarnished and restrained, never bright yellow gold.

Her outer robes are flowing soft ivory-white silk, lightweight and layered at the edges, billowing violently through the air, layered over deep luminous enamel-blue decorative textile and armor sections. Very subtle cinnabar-red lining appears only inside selected folds as a restrained warm accent.

Behind and above her coils a colossal spectral Chinese dragon forming an enormous circular arc around the warrior, preserving a powerful serpentine silhouette. The dragon is rendered primarily in brilliant polished silver-white, with intricate sculptural scales, horns, whiskers and flowing mane, combined with deep glossy cloisonné enamel-blue scale accents matching the woman's armor. Fine antique-gold filigree wirework subtly traces selected dragon ornaments and scale boundaries.

The dragon's body partially dissolves into enormous swirling pale silver-white energy tendrils, liquid-metal mist, layered smoke and flowing cloud-like currents, forming a circular vortex around the woman. No orange fire, no conventional flames — all supernatural energy is silver-white, pearl-white and layered metallic mist.

Plain warm-grey studio backdrop, minimal environment, allowing the warrior and dragon silhouette to dominate the composition. Dramatic directional rim lighting catches every polished silver edge and produces sharp specular reflections across the armor, sword blades and dragon scales, while the deep enamel-blue surfaces remain dark, saturated, glossy and internally luminous.

Extremely intricate craftsmanship, Chinese cloisonné-inspired decorative language, luxury sculptural armor, realistic metal reflections, realistic silk texture, cinematic fantasy photography, dynamic freeze-frame movement, controlled high contrast, hyper-detailed, photorealistic skin, natural facial texture, 8K hyperrealistic.

Color hierarchy:
mirror-polished bright silver + luminous deep cobalt cloisonné enamel blue + soft ivory-white silk + restrained oxidized antique-gold filigree + tiny cinnabar-red accents.

No gunmetal, no matte navy blue, no black armor, no bright yellow gold, no orange flames, no excessive red, no plastic CGI surfaces.

items.title: 半写实半手绘高级杂志排版海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output individually. Overall use a 3:4 vertical composition, the top and bottom areas are strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper half retains the original photo, maintaining the subject's identity, structure, posture, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the texture of art magazines and exhibition images. To adapt to the frame size, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower half performs new artistic judgment, only extracting the most recognizable subject, outline, structure, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructed as Hand-drawn Doodle Lifestyle Illustration / Naïve Illustration / Marker Drawing. Do not retain all objects, do not copy the original scene; actively delete the vast majority of backgrounds and irrelevant information, re-direct the scene through deletion, reorganization, cropping, and scale changes, so that even if the original image has an ordinary composition, it can be transformed into a valid piece of work.

Modeling is simplified, symbolic, relaxed, and personalized, using slightly jittery, intermittent, and not completely regular hand-drawn lines, as well as natural coloring like markers, crayons, and oil pastels. Allow slight line crossing, white space, and manual errors, without pursuing realistic proportions, complete perspective, or fine depiction.

The lower half must take a huge amount of conscious whitespace as its core, with solid graphics occupying only a small proportion, and the rest of the space actively left blank. Subjects can be eccentric, edge-aligned, suspended, or partially cropped, with positions determined by posture direction and visual center of gravity. Whitespace and the subject together form positive and negative shapes, distance, pauses, and a sense of breathing; rather paint less than fill the screen.

Graphics and text must be re-typeset as a whole, rather than "a sentence on top, a character below." Establish an invisible grid, visual axis, and reading path first, then decide on text placement; text can be close to the subject's outline, follow the direction of movement, align with the head or shoulder line, fall in large negative spaces, or form staggered, interspersed, and asymmetrical echoes with the graphics. Avoid mechanical centering, top-to-bottom stacking, and fixed templates; let graphics handle emotion and text handle rhythm, with both completing the composition together.

Text has no language restriction, retaining only a very small amount of truly meaningful words or short phrases. Use light, natural handwritten fonts with slight variations in character width and pen pressure, keeping a bit of a casual writing feel, but letter spacing, line spacing, and overall placement must be controlled through editorial design. One slightly obvious short phrase can be used with tiny auxiliary text to form a hierarchy, but no menu-style titles, long copy, or full-page text.

Color adopts a soft, bright, and healing limited palette, re-modulating the most vital colors extracted from the original image to form refreshing colors such as cream yellow, peach pink, coral red, sky blue, lake cyan, tender green, and lavender purple; vivid but not glaring, soft but not dirty-grey, with warm white or extremely light composite colors as large areas of breathing space.

Overall pursuit of naive drawing, mature composition, smart text-graphic relationships, and a massive amount of whitespace, like high-end independent magazines, lifestyle editorial illustrations, or art publications, rather than children's scrapbooks. Avoid fixed structures of centered subject + centered copy, random small icons scattered around, complex backgrounds, information accumulation, filling the screen, cheap cartoonishness, and templated layout.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用 3:4 竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格 1:1，各占画面 50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分重新做美术判断，**只提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、结构、姿态与叙事关系**，重构为 Hand-drawn Doodle Lifestyle Illustration / Naïve Illustration / Marker Drawing。不要保留所有对象，不要复制原场景；主动删除绝大多数背景和无关信息，通过删减、重组、裁切、尺度变化重新导演画面，使原图即使构图普通，也能转化成一张成立的作品。

造型简化、符号化、松弛而有个性，使用轻微抖动、断续、不完全规整的手绘线条，以及马克笔、蜡笔、油画棒般的自然涂色。允许轻微越线、露白和手工误差，不追求写实比例、完整透视和精细描绘。

下半部分必须以**超大量有意识的留白**为核心，实体图形只占较小比例，其余空间主动留空。主体可偏心、贴边、悬置或局部裁切，根据姿态方向和视觉重心决定位置。留白与主体共同形成正负形、距离、停顿和呼吸感，宁可少画，也绝不填满画面。

**图形与文字必须作为一个整体重新排版，而不是“上面一句话、下面一个人物”。** 先建立隐形网格、视觉轴线和阅读路径，再决定文字位置；文字可贴近主体轮廓、顺着动作方向、与头部或肩线对齐、落在大块负空间中，或与图形形成错位、穿插和不对称呼应。避免机械居中、上下堆叠和固定模板，让图形负责情绪，文字负责节奏，两者共同完成构图。

文字不限制语种，只保留极少量真正有意义的字词或短句。使用**轻巧、自然、略带字宽差异与笔压变化的手写字体**，保留一点随手书写感，但字距、行距和整体落点必须经过编辑设计控制。可用一个稍明显的短句配合极小辅助文字形成层级，但不要菜单式标题、长段文案或满版文字。

配色采用柔和、明快、治愈的限定色系，从原图中提取最有生命力的颜色重新调制，可形成奶油黄、蜜桃粉、珊瑚红、天空蓝、湖水青、嫩绿、薰衣草紫等清爽色彩；鲜活但不刺眼，柔和但不灰脏，以暖白或极浅综合色作为大面积呼吸空间。

整体追求**稚拙的画、成熟的构图、聪明的图文关系、超大量留白**，像高级独立杂志、生活方式 editorial illustration 或艺术出版物，而不是儿童手帐。避免主体居中 + 文案居中的固定结构、随机小图标撒满四周、复杂背景、信息堆积、画面填满、廉价卡通感和模板化排版

items.title: 霓虹故障动漫旅行双联编辑海报

Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Please turn each character photo I upload into an individual high-end travel portrait editorial poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo separately. Overall use a 3:4 vertical diptych composition, with the top retaining the clearly visible real original image and the bottom performing a "neon glitch anime portrait" redraw; the upper and lower borders are horizontal, clear, and restrained, with no atomization or mutual penetration.

The upper part accounts for about 45%–50% of the frame, faithfully retaining the original photo. Accurately maintain character identity, quantity, face shape, facial feature relationships, hairstyle, glasses, gaze, expression, posture, gestures, clothing, personal items, and the spatial relationship between characters and the environment. Only perform slight art magazine-style color grading and extremely thin film grain processing, it must still clearly be real photography. To adapt to the frame, the sky, walls, or surrounding environment can be naturally extended, but the character must not be redrawn, faces changed, stretched, mirrored, copied, or the subject moved.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable face, hairstyle, clothing, gestures, and key items of the character from the same photo, reconstructing them into a contemporary anime editorial portrait with strong visual impact. Do not copy the full framing and background density of the original photo; significantly enlarge the character's half-body to occupy about 65%–95% of the lower area's width, which can be moderately cropped out of the frame, letting the line of sight, action direction, and silhouette become dominant. The background retains only one to three architectural lines, lights, railings, furniture, or spatial structures from the original image, compressed into low-information light-color fields and structural fragments.

The redraw uses angular color blocks, clear anime line-plane relationships, deep indigo shadows, steel blue and cyan highlights, and selects one existing warm color from the original image to translate into a restrained coral pink or magenta accent color. Add limited halftones, partial RGB color offset, edge signal breaks, and a small amount of pixel chunks. Glitch effects can only occur at hair edges, shoulder silhouettes, clothing outer edges, and background structures, and must not cover or destroy faces, eyes, hands, and key items; must not change character identity, nor generate irrelevant cyber cities.

The lower area retains about 18%–28% of continuous deep blue or low-information color surface as a breathing area. The text is concentrated into a group, the main title uses bold narrow game title fonts that are clearly readable in normal chat previews, with slight pixel cuts or RGB misalignments; auxiliary fields are smaller, but cannot be shrunk into gray lines.

Extract a 1–3 English word title based on the actually visible location, character state, action, or light in the photo, and add the field "SIGNAL NOTE 01" and a 5–12 English word observation sentence. If the location cannot be confirmed, do not fabricate place names, the title "AFTERLIGHT" can be used, and the observation sentence "A quiet face held inside moving light." Only render confirmed text, do not add author names, brands, accounts, logos, QR codes, or garbled characters.

The overall color is extracted from the original photo and compressed into a limited palette, maintaining the original warm and cold character of the character's clothing and environment. The image should have a sense of real travel atmosphere, anime character tension, video game cover feel, and editorial publication restraint; glitch is rhythm, not obstruction.

Avoid generic cyberpunk, full-screen neon rainbows, dense HUD, UI text too small to read, vaporwave templates, facial glitches, extra limbs, cheap filters, and full-frame illustrationization.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

请将我上传的每一张人物照片分别制作成一张独立的高级旅行肖像编辑海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版双联构图，上方保留清楚可见的真实原图，下方进行“霓虹故障动漫肖像”转绘；上下边界水平、明确、克制，不雾化、不互相渗透。

上半部分约占画面45%–50%，忠实保留原始照片。准确保持人物身份、数量、脸型、五官关系、发型、眼镜、目光、表情、姿态、手势、衣着、随身物件以及人物与环境的空间关系。只进行轻微的艺术杂志式调色与极薄胶片颗粒处理，仍必须明显是真实摄影。为适配画幅，可自然扩展天空、墙面或周边环境，但不得重画人物、改变面孔、拉伸、镜像、复制或移动主体。

下半部分从同一张照片中提取人物最具识别度的面部、发型、服装、手势和关键物件，重构为具有强烈画面冲击的当代动漫编辑肖像。不要照搬原照片的完整取景和背景密度；将人物半身明显放大，占下区宽度约65%–95%，可适度裁切出画，让视线、动作方向和轮廓成为主导。背景只保留一至三条来自原图的建筑线、灯光、栏杆、家具或空间结构，并压缩成低信息光色场与结构碎片。

转绘使用角面化色块、清楚的动漫线面关系、深靛蓝阴影、钢蓝与青色高光，并从原图中选择一处真实存在的暖色，转译为克制的珊瑚粉或品红跳色。加入有限网点、局部RGB套色偏移、边缘信号断裂和少量像素切块。故障效果只能发生在头发边缘、肩部轮廓、衣物外缘及背景结构，不得覆盖或破坏脸、眼睛、手和关键物件；不得改变人物身份，也不得生成无关的赛博城市。

下区保留约18%–28%连续的深蓝或低信息色面作为呼吸区。文字集中成一组，主标题使用在正常聊天预览中清楚可读的粗窄游戏标题字，带轻微像素切口或RGB错位；辅助字段较小，但不能缩成灰线。

根据照片中真实可见的地点、人物状态、动作或光线提炼1–3个英文单词标题，并加入字段“SIGNAL NOTE 01”与一行5–12个英文单词的观察句。若地点无法确认，不得编造地名，可使用标题“AFTERLIGHT”，观察句使用“A quiet face held inside moving light.”。只渲染已确定的文字，不添加作者名、品牌、账号、Logo、二维码或乱码。

整体色彩从原照片提炼并压缩为有限色盘，保持人物衣物和环境原有的冷暖性格。画面应兼具真实旅途气息、动漫人物张力、电子游戏封面感和编辑出版物的克制感；故障是节奏，不是遮挡。

避免通用赛博朋克、满屏霓虹彩虹、密集HUD、小到不可读的界面字、蒸汽波模板、面部故障、额外肢体、廉价滤镜和全画面插画化。

items.title: 1比3超纵向工笔重彩汉服仕女图
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

SUBJECT: [classical Chinese woman / character]
FLOWER: [plum blossom / magnolia / wisteria / osmanthus]
MAIN COLORS: [deep indigo + crimson / jade teal + ivory / dusky violet + lavender]
OUTFIT: [hanfu colors and fabric]
MOOD: [serene / elegant / dreamy / restrained]
ASPECT RATIO: 1:3 ultra-vertical

Create a highly detailed Chinese-inspired portrait in an elegant 1:3 ultra-vertical format, with the visual feeling of a long illustrated bookmark rather than a standard poster.

Keep the character as the clear focal point, occupying around 75–80% of the image height. The hairstyle, hands, flowing sleeves and main skirt should remain fully visible inside the frame. The figure should feel prominent but still leave enough breathing room for flowers and background.

Build the composition vertically: floral branches or hanging blossoms frame the upper and side areas, the face becomes the main focal point in the upper-middle section, and the long sleeves, draped fabric and skirt continue the visual flow downward.

Use flowers as part of the composition rather than simple decoration. Create clear foreground, middle-ground and background layers, with a few branches or petals crossing naturally in front of the figure without covering the face.

Dress the character in layered flowing hanfu with elegant long sleeves and refined fabric textures. Use fine, continuous gold linework to trace key garment edges, major folds, sleeve curves and the downward flow of the skirt. The gold lines should follow the natural structure of the fabric, never becoming thick borders or dense all-over decoration.

Combine refined gongbi-inspired figure rendering with rich mineral-pigment color fields, rock-painting texture, subtle palette-knife impasto and restrained scattered gold dust. Keep the face, hands, hair and clothing cleaner and more delicate, while allowing the background to carry stronger texture.

Use deep, saturated background colors to make the lighter figure stand out. Add only small amounts of muted gold leaf, luminous particles and fine gold accents to connect the flowers, accessories and clothing.

The final image should feel elegant, painterly, luxurious and handcrafted, with strong vertical rhythm and enough detail to work as a standalone artwork, illustrated bookmark, editorial visual or cultural-brand image.

No text, no title, no logo, no numbering, no border, no product mockup, no visible bookmark hole or tassel, no modern poster layout, no CGI look, no dirty distressed texture.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

花卉：[梅花 / 玉兰 / 紫藤 / 桂花]
主色调：[深靛蓝 + 绯红 / 翡翠绿 + 象牙白 / 暗紫 + 薰衣草紫]
服装：[汉服颜色与面料]
氛围：[宁静 / 优雅 / 梦幻 / 克制]
纵横比：1:3 超纵向

创作一张高度精细的中国风肖像，采用优雅的 1:3 超纵向格式，视觉感受更像是一张长形插画书签，而非标准海报。

保持角色为明确的视觉焦点，占据图像高度的约 75–80%。发型、手部、飘逸的袖子和主裙摆应完整保留在画面内。人物应显得突出，但仍为花卉和背景留出足够的呼吸空间。

垂直构建构图：花枝或垂下的花朵构筑上方和侧边区域，脸部成为中上部分的视觉焦点，长袖、垂坠的面料和裙摆将视觉流动感向下延伸。

将花卉作为构图的一部分，而不仅仅是装饰。创造清晰的前景、中景和背景层，一些枝条或花瓣自然地交错在人物前方，但不遮挡脸部。

为角色穿着层次感丰富的飘逸汉服，带有优雅的长袖和精致的面料纹理。使用精细、连续的金线勾勒服装的关键边缘、主要褶皱、袖子曲线和裙摆的下垂感。金线应遵循织物的自然结构，绝不能变成厚重的边框或密集的全身装饰。

结合精致的工笔风人物表现与浓郁的矿物颜料色块、岩彩质感、细微的调色刀厚涂效果和克制的零星金粉。保持面部、手部、头发和服装更整洁细腻，同时允许背景带有更强的纹理。

使用深邃、饱和的背景颜色使浅色的人物脱颖而出。仅添加少量暗哑的金箔、发光微粒和精细的金色点缀，以连接花卉、配饰和衣物。

最终图像应具有优雅、绘画感、奢华和手工感，带有强烈的垂直节奏，其细节程度足以作为独立艺术品、插画书签、社论视觉图或文化品牌形象。

items.title: 艺术杂志感照片转铅笔素描双联海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Please make each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo individually. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, with the upper and lower regions strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen. 

The upper part keeps the original photo, maintaining the subject's identity, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition image. To adapt to the aspect ratio, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed. 

The lower part involves a new independent artistic judgment and visual direction. Do not copy the original photo's composition, nor translate every object; first understand the themes, structural trends, subject relationships, and visual memory points truly worth preserving from the original image, then recompose through deletion, reorganization, cropping, scale changes, position adjustments, and white space. Even if the original subject is small, the background is cluttered, or the composition is ordinary, actively correct it so the lower part itself becomes a complete, valid work with aesthetic judgment. 

Reconstruct the preserved key subjects, local structures, or related objects into a theme-combined illustration in a hand-drawn pencil sketch style. Use graphite pencil outlines, natural hatching, small amounts of cross-hatching, and light gray tones, with shapes slightly loose, naive, and having an illustrative sketch feel, not pursuing academic realism or complex perspective. Only draw the most meaningful parts, allowing people to immediately feel its correspondence with the photo above, but not as a pencil copy of the photo. 

The composition emphasizes a large amount of conscious white space. White space is not a background, but a constituent element as important as the subject; arrange freely according to the subject's direction, proportion, and visual center of gravity, which can be eccentric, edge-aligned, suspended, enlarged, shrunk, or partially cropped, establishing a sense of breath, space, and editorial order through positive and negative shapes, density, dispersion, and asymmetrical balance. Better to delete information than to fill the screen. 

The overall tone is mainly black and white or natural graphite grayscale, with a very small amount of 1–2 identifying colors extracted from the original image for local emphasis. Text is only for a small amount of editorial intervention, with no restrictions on language or fixed format, freely generating a few words or short phrases based on the subject, location, mood, or metaphor, quietly blending into the white space to form the layout with the illustration. 

The overall presentation is a re-directed image, hand-drawn pencil, theme combination, active deletion, large amount of artistic white space, and high-end editorial layout. Avoid photo replication, traditional academic sketches, complex backgrounds, filled screens, overly dense details, mechanical typesetting, and a template feel.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分重新做一次独立的美术判断与画面导演。不要照搬原照片构图，也不要逐物转绘；先理解原图真正值得保留的主题、结构走势、主体关系和视觉记忆点，再通过删减、重组、裁切、尺度变化、位置调整和留白重新构图。即使原图主体很小、背景杂乱或构图普通，也应主动修正，使下半部分本身成为一张完整、成立、有审美判断的作品。

将保留下来的关键主体、局部结构或相关物件重构为手绘铅笔素描风格的主题组合插画。使用石墨铅笔轮廓、自然排线、少量交叉排线和轻微灰调，造型略带松动、稚拙和插画式速写感，不追求学院派写实与复杂透视。只画最有意义的部分，让人一眼感受到它与上方照片的对应关系，但不是照片的素描复制。

构图强调大量有意识的留白。留白不是背景，而是和主体同等重要的构成元素；根据主体方向、比例和视觉重心自由安排，可偏心、贴边、悬置、放大、缩小或局部裁切，通过正负形、疏密、聚散和不对称平衡建立呼吸感、空间感和编辑秩序。宁可删掉信息，也不要填满画面。

Please turn each travel photo I upload into an independent "Scenery Memo Postcard" high-end editorial poster, no multi-photo collage, each photo output separately.

The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout. The original photo serves as a clear, realistic, and recognizable full-frame background covering the entire canvas, faithfully preserving the location, subject, architecture, people, terrain, perspective, natural light and shadow, and authentic photography texture from the original photo. Apply only a slight high-end travel photography color grading and moderately reduce the contrast in the area behind the postcards to allow the physical cards to emerge naturally. Do not blur, redraw, replace, or randomly change the background photo.

Place two independent physical horizontal postcards in the center of the image, arranged vertically along the same central axis:

- Top: Postcard front;
- Bottom: Postcard back;
- Both cards must have the same width, same height, and use the same standard horizontal postcard ratio;
- Left and right edges strictly aligned, kept horizontal, no rotation, no tilting;
- Card width accounts for approximately 72%—82% of the overall image;
- Maintain a breathing space of about 5%—10% of the card height between the two cards;
- No overlapping, misalignment, side-by-side, or scattered arrangements.

The front of the top postcard uses a representative horizontal crop of the same original photo, highlighting the most recognizable subject, landmark, human action, or natural landscape in the photo. It must maintain an authentic photography texture and not be converted into an illustration. A short English main title and a real, accurate location name can be added.

The back of the bottom postcard uses warm white or off-white thick paper, preserving slight paper grain, edge wear, creases, and traces of collection. The back features a thin-line divider, four restrained address lines, a stamp in the top right corner, and a slight postmark.

The stamp design must be extracted from the same original photo, using silhouettes of landmarks, buildings, plants, vehicles, mountains, or figures from the photo; no second location or irrelevant patterns. The postmark is only an abstract mark, with no fabricated dates, zip codes, addresses, or fake postal information.

In the blank area of the back, add an original travel observation of no more than two sentences. The text should describe based on the location, light, weather, movement, and environmental imagery truly visible in the photo, being quiet, natural, and restrained, like a private note jotted down during a journey. Do not use famous quotes; do not fabricate stories that do not exist in the photo.

Before generation, please clearly write out and accurately present the following text:

Main Title:
"[Short English title extracted based on the photo]"

Location:
"[Real location, country]"

Back Subtitle:
"[Short travel observation title]"

Back Body:
"[A short English text of no more than two sentences created based on the actual scene]"

The font uses elegant and restrained editorial serif and simple postal sans-serif. Text colors are extracted from the original photo, such as dark gray, dark green, grayish blue, brown, etc., with low saturation, using one representative color from the photo as a minor accent. The text must be clearly legible, with no garbled characters or extra text.

The two cards use warm white thick paper material, with clear paper edges, slight wear, and natural short drop shadows, making them look like real collection postcards quietly placed on top of the original scenery.

The overall presentation merges the temperament of authentic photography, old postcards, travel publications, private correspondence, and collection archives: quiet, poetic, restrained, warm, with traces of time, while maintaining a high-end editorial design sense.

Avoid ordinary "original image on top, redrawn on bottom" diptych poster structures; avoid side-by-side arrangements, tilted cards, scattered collages, a third card, complex decorations, fictional place names, fake postal info, handwritten gibberish, excessive vintage filters, cartoonish feel, plastic 3D feel, e-commerce template feel, brand logos, and watermarks.

- 下方为明信片背面；
- 两张卡片必须同宽、同高、采用相同的标准横向明信片比例；
- 左右边缘严格对齐，保持水平，不旋转、不倾斜；
- 卡片宽度约占整体画面的72%—82%；

上方明信片正面使用同一张原始照片的代表性横向裁切，突出照片中最具识别度的主体、地标、人物动作或自然景观。必须保持真实摄影质感，不转绘成插画。可加入一个简短英文主标题，以及真实、准确的地点名称。

在背面的留白区域加入一段不超过两句的原创旅行观察。文字应根据照片中真实可见的地点、光线、天气、动作与环境意象进行描写，安静、自然、克制，像旅途中随手写下的一则私人注记。不得使用名人名言，不虚构照片中不存在的故事。

生成前请明确写定并准确呈现以下文字：

主标题：
“[根据照片提炼的简短英文标题]”

地点：
“[真实地点，国家]”

背面小标题：
“[简短的旅行观察标题]”

背面正文：
“[根据真实画面创作的不超过两句英文短文]”

整体呈现真实摄影、旧明信片、旅行出版物、私人通信与收藏档案相融合的气质：安静、诗意、克制、温暖、有时间痕迹，同时保持高级编辑设计感。

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Create ONE independent high-end editorial poster for EACH uploaded photo. Never combine photos. Each photo must become a separate poster.

FORMAT
Strict 3:4 vertical. Divide the canvas into two exactly equal 50% horizontal sections.

TOP 50% — ORIGINAL PHOTO
Preserve the photo faithfully: identity, face, body proportions, pose, clothing, objects, composition, lighting, shadows, atmosphere, and colors. Keep it photorealistic with subtle premium editorial color grading. Seamlessly extend the background if needed; never distort or alter the subject.

BOTTOM 50% — MINIMAL ILLUSTRATION
Reinterpret the most recognizable elements as a small, centered, hand-drawn paper illustration occupying only 10–20% of the bottom half. Preserve the key subject, silhouette, pose, objects, and narrative.

Use delicate imperfect lines, bold flat acrylic-style shapes, rough paper grain, handmade brush marks, and organic edges. Keep the background warm white/off-white with generous negative space.

COLOR
Extract dominant colors from the original photo and reduce them to a maximum of 4 restrained, harmonious colors.

TYPOGRAPHY
Optional minimal editorial text such as a short title, location, year, or keyword. Do not force text if unnecessary.

STYLE
Quiet, poetic, refined, minimal, innocent, artistic, thoughtful, premium, and highly recognizable — like a contemporary art book or independent editorial cover.

格式
严格的3:4纵向。将画布分成两个完全相等的50%水平区域。

顶部50% — 原始照片
忠实地保留照片：身份、面部、身体比例、姿势、服装、物体、构图、光影、氛围和颜色。保持其写实风格，并辅以微妙的高级编辑调色。如果需要，无缝延伸背景；绝不要扭曲或改变主体。

底部50% — 极简插画
将最易辨识的元素重新诠释为一个小型的、居中的手绘纸质插画，仅占据下半部分的10–20%。保留关键主体、轮廓、姿势、物体和叙事。

使用细腻的不完美线条、大胆的平涂丙烯风格形状、粗糙的纸张纹理、手工笔触和有机边缘。保持背景为暖白色/米白色，并留有大量的负空间。

颜色
从原始照片中提取主色调，并将其缩减为最多4种克制且和谐的颜色。

排版
可选的极简编辑文本，如短标题、地点、年份或关键词。如果没有必要，不要强行添加文字。

风格
安静、诗意、精致、极简、纯真、艺术感、深思熟虑、高级且具有高度辨识度——就像当代艺术书籍或独立编辑封面。

FORMAT: Vertical 3:4 editorial composition.

TOP SECTION — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH:
Place the original photograph in the upper 55–60% of the canvas. Keep it photorealistic and naturally detailed. Do not alter the identity, pose, proportions, objects, architecture, scenery, or important visual details. Give it a subtle premium editorial photography finish with natural cinematic light and gentle tonal balance.

BOTTOM SECTION — HAND-PAINTED INTERPRETATION:
Transform the same exact scene into a delicate minimal watercolor and fine-ink illustration. Recreate the main subject, pose, perspective, key objects, and recognizable background elements from the photograph. Use loose watercolor washes, subtle pencil/ink outlines, imperfect hand-painted edges, soft paper texture, and restrained pastel tones. Keep the illustration airy, elegant, and slightly imperfect rather than digitally polished.

The illustration should feel like a fashion/lifestyle magazine sketchbook page, with plenty of clean negative space and a warm off-white textured paper background. Do not introduce new subjects or details.

TYPOGRAPHY:
Add a short elegant handwritten brush-script phrase underneath or integrated naturally into the illustrated section, similar to a premium lifestyle editorial poster. Underneath it, add a tiny minimalist lowercase serif/sans-serif subtitle. Typography should be subtle, sophisticated, thin, and balanced with the artwork.

AESTHETIC:
Scandinavian editorial design, quiet luxury, nostalgic travel journal, soft watercolor, delicate ink drawing, handmade paper texture, muted natural palette, sophisticated minimalism, emotional storytelling, premium art-book layout.

IMPORTANT: The photograph and illustration must clearly represent the same exact moment and scene. No collage of unrelated images, no dramatic redesign, no excessive watercolor, no cartoon appearance, no heavy outlines, no saturated colors, no clutter.

Output: photorealistic upper section + matching delicate watercolor illustration below, seamless premium editorial composition, vertical 3:4, high detail.

For different photos, just change the text phrase

Examples:
•Good Days — a kinder me

items.title: 照片转绘滑稽鬼脸蜡笔涂鸦对比海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Render the person as a stylized illustration that preserves the reference facial identity cues; do not turn the result into a photorealistic camera portrait.

Please turn every photo I upload into an individual 3:4 vertical transformation comparison poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo separately. The screen adopts a clear top-and-bottom dual-link structure: the upper half retains the complete original photo, and the lower half transforms the same subject into a rough, funny, slightly grimace-like crayon scribble.

The upper part maintains the identity, quantity, posture, movement, clothing, animal fur color, architectural structure, environmental relationship, observation angle, and real lighting of the subject in the photo, with only slight photographic color grading. Do not add or delete people or animals, do not change the location, and do not turn the photographic part into an illustration.

The lower part retains the most recognizable outline, posture, and relationship of the subject in the original photo, but do not perform realistic copying. Refine and appropriately enlarge the faces of people or animals, deliberately exaggerating eyes, eyebrows, nose, teeth, tongue, corners of the mouth, and facial proportions to form a skewed, asymmetrical, and slightly clumsy funny grimace. Expressions can be more absurd and dramatic than the original photo, but must still be recognizable as the original subject; do not turn into horror images, and do not apply fixed cartoon characters.

Use thick black crayons, oil pastels, and oil pencils to repeatedly search for outlines. Lines should be shaky, broken, overlapping, uneven in thickness, and retain traces of erasing, back-strokes, coloring outside the boundaries, and untrimmed marks. Extract colors from the original photo and compress them into a limited color palette, representing bodies, clothes, or hair with rough friction, local white space, and uneven overlapping colors. Do not use smooth outlines, clean color blocks, or exquisite digital coloring.

The background only retains a few clues sufficient to identify the location or action relationship, such as building outlines, seats, railings, roads, trees, or travel landmarks, and summarizes them with more scribbly, low-density strokes. The subject should be more concentrated and impactful than the original photo, with a part of warm paper white reserved around it; do not redraw all the photographic details fully.

Add a set of short English handwritten text in the blank space of the lower half:

- Refine a 1–3 word main title based on the image;
- Add the field "SCRIBBLE STUDY 01";
- Add a short observation describing the real action or expression in the image.

The text uses skewed, dry, slightly broken pencil or crayon handwriting, like a painter's casual notes on the edge of the paper, clearly legible but not overly regular. No author names, brands, URLs, logos, watermarks, fake quotes, garbled code, or redundant text should appear.

Overall presentation is a deliberate non-pretty manual graffiti feel: rough, funny, absurd, with a bit of a grimace quality, while retaining the real character relationships, animal characteristics, and travel memories in the original photos.

Avoid: exquisite cartoons, cute style, Japanese anime style, smooth vectors, realistic sketches, horror and gore, uniform template faces, complete background copying, excessive decoration, changing the number of subjects, changing character postures, fictional landmarks, and turning the photographic part into an illustration.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

将人物渲染为风格化插画，只保留参考图的面部身份特征；不要生成写实摄影人像。

请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的 3:4 竖版转绘对比海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。画面采用清晰的上下双联结构：上半部分保留完整真实原图，下半部分将同一主体转绘为粗糙、滑稽、略带鬼脸感的蜡笔涂鸦。

上半部分保持照片中主体的身份、数量、姿态、动作、服装、动物毛色、建筑结构、环境关系、观察角度和真实光影，仅进行轻微摄影调色。不得增删人物或动物，不得改变地点，不得将摄影部分插画化。

下半部分保留原图主体最具辨识度的轮廓、姿态和关系，但不要进行写实临摹。将人物或动物的脸部提炼并适度放大，故意夸张眼睛、眉毛、鼻子、牙齿、舌头、嘴角和面部比例，形成歪斜、不对称、稍显笨拙的滑稽鬼脸。表情可以比原图更荒诞、更有戏剧性，但仍须能够辨认出原来的主体；不要变成恐怖形象，也不要套用固定卡通角色。

使用粗黑蜡笔、油画棒和油性铅笔反复寻找轮廓。线条应抖动、断裂、重叠、粗细不均，保留擦除、回笔、涂出边界和未经修整的痕迹。色彩从原图提取并压缩为有限色盘，以粗糙摩擦、局部留白和不均匀叠色表现身体、衣服或毛发。不要使用平滑描边、干净色块和精致数字上色。

背景只保留足以辨认地点或动作关系的少量线索，例如建筑轮廓、座椅、栏杆、道路、树木或旅行地标，并用更加潦草、低密度的笔触概括。主体应比原图更集中、更有冲击力，周围保留一部分温暖纸白，不要把所有摄影细节重新画满。

在下半部分留白处加入一组简短英文手写文字：

- 根据画面提炼一个 1–3 词主标题；
- 加入字段“SCRIBBLE STUDY 01”；
- 加入一句描述画面真实动作或表情的简短观察。

文字使用歪斜、干涩、略有断裂的铅笔或蜡笔手写体，像画画的人随手记在纸边，清楚可读但不要过分规整。不得出现作者名、品牌、网址、Logo、水印、假引用、乱码或多余文字。

整体呈现一种故意不画漂亮的手工涂鸦感：粗糙、滑稽、荒诞、有一点鬼脸气质，同时保留原照片中真实的人物关系、动物特征和旅行记忆。

避免：精致卡通、可爱萌系、日漫风、光滑矢量、写实素描、恐怖血腥、统一模板脸、完整背景临摹、过多装饰、改变主体数量、改变人物姿态、虚构地标和摄影部分插画化。

items.title: 实验性角色海报半色调扫描效果
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a 9:16 experimental character poster using a close or waist-up portrait with expressive body language.

Keep most of the portrait in high-contrast black and white, then add a clear halftone screen-print effect. Use finer dots on the face and denser dots in the hair, clothing and shadows, so it feels like a printed zine rather than simple photo grain.

Add one color scan window through an important part of the portrait. It can run vertically across the eye, face and hand, horizontally through the eyes and gesture, or extend from the face down into the collar and body.

Inside this window, return to clean high-resolution photography with realistic cool-neutral skin, blue-grey shadows and natural lip tones. Keep it crisp and free of halftone texture so the contrast between “printed portrait” and “real detail” feels obvious.

Use oversized condensed typography as part of the composition rather than placing a title in empty space. Let the letters crop off the canvas, overlap the body, pass behind the subject or cut across the scan window.

Keep the palette restrained: black, white and cool grey as the base, then one cool blue and one muted red / burgundy as accents.

Only add a few small identity-style labels such as “IDENTITY TRACE”, “SUBJECT ACTIVE”, “GESTURE READ” or “FEATURE ACTIVE”. A few thin lines, circles and open corner marks are enough.

The final image should feel like a mix of youth-culture poster, printed zine, character dossier and experimental magazine editorial.

Avoid warm yellow grading, multiple random scan windows, floating facial features, heavy glitch effects, dense UI graphics, long paragraphs, numbering, Vol./Issue labels, sparkle symbols, logos or watermarks.

创建一个 9:16 的实验性角色海报，使用具有表现力肢体语言的特写或半身肖像。

保持肖像的大部分为高对比度黑白，然后添加明显的半色调丝网印刷效果。在面部使用更精细的点，在头发、衣物和阴影中使用更密集的点，使其感觉像印刷的杂志而不是简单的照片颗粒。

通过肖像的重要部分添加一个彩色扫描窗口。它可以垂直穿过眼睛、脸部和手部，水平穿过眼睛和手势，或从脸部向下延伸到衣领和身体。

在这个窗口内部，恢复为清晰的高分辨率摄影，具有逼真的冷中性皮肤、蓝灰色阴影和自然的唇色。保持其清晰且没有半色调纹理，使“印刷肖像”与“真实细节”之间的对比感觉显而易见。

使用超大压缩排版作为构图的一部分，而不是在空白处放置标题。让字母裁剪出画布、重叠身体、从主体后方经过或穿过扫描窗口。

保持色调克制：以黑色、白色和冷灰色为基调，然后以一种冷蓝色和一种柔和的红色/酒红色作为点缀。

仅添加少量身份风格的标签，如“IDENTITY TRACE”、“SUBJECT ACTIVE”、“GESTURE READ”或“FEATURE ACTIVE”。少量细线、圆圈和开放式边角标记就足够了。

最终图像应感觉像是青少年文化海报、印刷杂志、角色档案和实验性杂志社论的混合体。

避免暖黄色调、多个随机扫描窗口、漂浮的面部特征、沉重的故障效果、密集的 UI 图形、长段落、编号、卷/辑标签、闪烁符号、徽标或水印。

items.title: 日式餐厅吃烤肉盖饭的黑衣女性人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible adult woman. Keep the source subject, identity, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create one fixed 9:16 vertical photograph of a single clearly adult woman (20+) in a calm Japanese-style restaurant, about to eat a yakiniku rice bowl. Use normalized anchors: face center at about x51%, y30%; closed eyes around y25%; the meat at the chopstick tips around x32%, y49%; rice-bowl center around x51%, y78%. The subject bounding area is x11–92%, y2–81%, with about 2% headroom. The rice bowl is intentionally cut by the bottom edge. Do not recenter, expand the canvas, flip, change camera distance or angle, zoom only the face, or resize only the person; keep anchor positions within roughly ±2%.

SUBJECT AND EXPRESSION
Show only one fictional adult Japanese woman, from above the head to the upper edge of the rice bowl, wearing a black long-sleeve ribbed top. She has a small oval face, thin bangs, dark brown half-length hair tied behind with longer side bangs, closed eyes and a natural open laugh with a little tooth visible. Her chin tilts slightly down; expression is joyful anticipation before eating, never exaggerated chewing, tongue, seduction, fear or sleepiness. Preserve natural pores, facial asymmetry, skin variation and realistic anatomy.

POSE AND FOOD ACTION
The upper body leans slightly toward the table. One hand enters from the left holding wooden chopsticks; the tips grip one small piece of grilled meat near the fixed coordinates, with believable finger, chopstick, food contact and gravity. The other hand remains outside the frame. Keep the chopsticks, fingers, meat and face readable; do not add a second person or extra hands. The bowl is a rice bowl/gyudon-like dish placed at the lower center and remains partially cropped by the frame.

RESTAURANT AND CAMERA
Use a quiet Japanese-style dining seat/table with only confirmed elements: warm wood, a dark neutral wall or partition, simple table surface and restrained background. Keep all other guests and unrelated store areas outside the frame. Use an eye-level to slightly elevated close smartphone perspective, natural 9:16 crop, medium depth of field and realistic handheld photography. Maintain the exact overlap order of person, tableware, chopsticks and background; do not equalize margins or invent missing areas.

LIGHTING AND MATERIAL
Use warm indoor restaurant light with soft highlights on face, black ribbed fabric, wooden chopsticks, grilled meat and bowl. Preserve realistic food texture, ceramic, wood grain, hair strands, skin pores and subtle shadow transitions. Keep color natural and lightly warm, without beauty filters, excessive sharpening or artificial HDR.

FIXED EXCLUSIONS
No cropped-off face, blocked face, missing eye/hand anchors, extra fingers, distorted anatomy, duplicated people, unknown dishes, invented restaurant names, menus, logos, steam, extra tableware, unrelated guests, new backgrounds, other seasons, other clothing, extra light sources, beauty filters, extreme face slimming, enlarged eyes, extreme chest/waist emphasis, explicit sexual hints, low angles that fetishize body parts, text, brands or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见成年女性的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源主体、身份、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创作一张固定的 9:16 竖向照片：一名明确成年（20+）的虚构日本女性在安静和风餐厅内，即将食用烤肉盖饭。使用归一化锚点：脸部中心约在 x51%、y30%，闭合双眼约在 y25%，筷子尖端的肉约在 x32%、y49%，盖饭中心约在 x51%、y78%。人物外接范围约为 x11–92%、y2–81%，头顶留约 2% 空白，盖饭故意被底边截断。不得重新居中、扩展画布、翻转、改变相机距离或角度、只放大脸部或只缩小人物；锚点误差控制在约 ±2%。

主体与表情
只出现一名虚构成年日本女性，画面从头顶拍到盖饭上缘，穿黑色长袖罗纹上衣。她有小巧椭圆脸、薄刘海、深棕色半长发，后方扎起并保留较长侧刘海；双眼闭合，自然张口大笑并略露牙齿。下巴微微向下，表现进食前的愉悦期待，不要夸张咀嚼、吐舌、挑逗、恐惧或困倦。保留自然毛孔、左右不完全对称、肤色变化和真实人体结构。

姿势与食物动作
上身略向餐桌前倾。画面左侧进入一只手，手持木筷，筷尖在固定坐标附近夹住一小片烤肉，手指、筷子、肉片接触关系和重力必须可信。另一只手留在画外。保持筷子、手指、肉片和面部清晰，不添加第二个人或多余手部。盖饭置于下方中央，并保持被画面底边部分截断。

餐厅与镜头
使用安静的日式餐饮座位和桌面，只保留已确认元素：暖色木材、深色中性墙面或隔断、简洁桌面和克制背景。其他客人及无关店内区域全部留在画外。使用平视到略微俯视的近距离手机视角、自然 9:16 裁切、中等景深和真实手持摄影。固定人物、餐具、筷子与背景的前后遮挡顺序，不均等化边缘留白，也不凭空补齐画外区域。

光线与材质
使用温暖室内餐厅光，在面部、黑色罗纹面料、木筷、烤肉和饭碗上形成柔和高光。保留食物、陶瓷、木纹、发丝、毛孔和细微阴影过渡的真实质感。色彩自然略暖，不使用美颜滤镜、过度锐化或人工 HDR。

固定排除
不得裁掉脸部、遮挡面部、丢失眼睛或手部锚点、增加手指、人体变形、重复人物、未知菜名、虚构店名、菜单、logo、蒸汽、额外餐具、无关客人、新背景、其他季节、其他服装、额外光源、美颜滤镜、过度瘦脸、放大眼睛、极端胸腰强调、露骨性暗示、以身体部位为诱导的低机位、文字、品牌或水印。

items.title: 黏土风横向咖啡节海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Horizontal coffee festival event poster, main visual medium is 3D/CG handmade clay style character, warm white coarse paper texture background, bright candy color commercial magazine layout. Place an exaggerated proportion clay character slightly to the right of the center, occupying about half of the frame: pink skin and limbs with small pit indentations, green knit hat, acid green loose jacket, blue large backpack, green and blue vertical striped shorts, green striped long socks, orange-red and white high-top shoes; one large pink arm extends horizontally holding a paper cup of coffee, an orange square watch on the wrist, the other giant hand reaches up to grab a bread-shaped handle, nails are yellow-green. The character's small face is clear, black dot eyes looking forward and slightly left, eyebrows pressed inward, red nose, corners of the mouth sinking, with a bit of stubbornness and dissatisfaction from being on the way. Layout structure: Top left about 25% features three lines of super large thin weight lowercase sans-serif title text like "morning coffee festival", dark gray, left-aligned, loose letter spacing; top right features location and number information; bottom right features huge date numbers, serving as the bottom visual anchor but not obscuring the character. Four brown-orange thin line product display boxes are distributed in the middle-left, bottom-left, and bottom-right, displaying the green hat, green jacket, orange watch, and striped shorts respectively, with small letter labels and thin leader lines connecting to the corresponding parts of the character, acting as local visual windows and information annotation layers, do not let them become random decorations. Layer order is paper texture background color at the back, clay character in the middle layer with soft shadows, thin line boxes and leader lines pressed around the character, title, location, date, and bottom small body text are foreground information layers, light paper grain covers the whole image but keeps the character, title, and product boxes clear. Avoid generating ordinary character illustrations, real-life photography, smooth plastic textures, single subject without layout, text filling the whole image, wireframes losing annotation function, or title or date overwhelming the main visual.

items.title: 甜美俏皮青春杂志封面设计
items.description: 可复用的9:16青春杂志封面模板，以成年女性角色、气泡标题、有机图形、少量主题道具和受控编辑信息组成甜美俏皮的平面视觉。
items.prompt: Theme: Sweet Cherry Picnic. Main title: CHERRY POP. Subject: an adult woman with bright eyes, a relaxed candid smile and softly wavy shoulder-length hair. Outfit: a cherry-red cardigan over a white tee, a pleated skirt and simple sneakers with small hair clips. Pose and props: sitting sideways with a sticker album, a cherry soda and a small paper fan. Main color: cherry red. Accent color: mint green. Cover lines: Fresh picks / Weekend mood / Little joys. Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main adult female photographic subject when provided; match facial identity only. Create a 9:16 cute youth magazine cover with a clean white or soft-cream graphic background. Use one adult woman as the main photographic subject, framed in a three-quarter-body composition with natural skin texture, expressive eyes, relaxed body language and a lively candid feel. Place an oversized glossy bubble title across the upper 30–38% of the poster using CHERRY POP. Make the letters soft, inflated and playful, with bold outlines, subtle offset shadows, curved white highlights and slight hand-drawn irregularity; let the character naturally overlap part of the title. Behind her, add one large organic graphic shape in mint green to build depth without a realistic environment. Include the editorial information Fresh picks / Weekend mood / Little joys in only 3–4 small text areas, maintaining strong contrast between the huge display title and tiny supporting type. Add 6–10 lightweight graphic accents such as dots, curves, open frames, checker patterns, brush marks, brackets or simple hand-drawn icons, playful but controlled. Use only the 2–3 real props specified in sitting sideways with a sticker album, a cherry soda and a small paper fan so the props communicate the story without building a full realistic scene. Apply cherry red as the dominant color and mint green as the supporting color. Overall look: sweet, youthful, playful, polished, graphic editorial, visually rich but never cluttered. Negative prompt: extra people, realistic environment, cluttered typography, unreadable title, plastic skin, malformed hands, watermark, copied brand or copyrighted character.
items.prompt_zh: 主题：Sweet Cherry Picnic；主标题：CHERRY POP；主体：an adult woman with bright eyes, a relaxed candid smile and softly wavy shoulder-length hair；服装：a cherry-red cardigan over a white tee, a pleated skirt and simple sneakers with small hair clips；姿势与道具：sitting sideways with a sticker album, a cherry soda and a small paper fan；主色调：cherry red；强调色：mint green；封面文案：Fresh picks / Weekend mood / Little joys。如提供上传的参考图，将其作为主要成年女性摄影主体的面部身份参考，仅匹配面部身份。创建一张9:16可爱青春杂志封面，背景为简洁的白色或柔和奶油色平面图形。使用一名成年女性作为主要摄影主体，采用四分之三身构图，保留真实皮肤纹理、传神眼神、放松肢体语言和活泼随性的感觉。将CHERRY POP作为超大的光泽气泡标题放在海报上方30–38%的区域。字体应柔软、膨胀且俏皮，具有粗轮廓、细微偏移阴影、弯曲白色高光和轻微手绘不规则感；让角色自然遮挡部分标题。在她身后添加一个mint green的大型有机图形形状来增加深度，但不要创建写实环境。仅用3–4个小文本区域排布编辑信息Fresh picks / Weekend mood / Little joys，让巨大的显示标题与微小辅助文字形成强烈对比。添加6–10个轻量级图形装饰，例如点、曲线、开口框架、棋盘格图案、笔触、括号或简单手绘图标，保持俏皮但受控。只使用sitting sideways with a sticker album, a cherry soda and a small paper fan中指定的2–3个真实道具，让道具传达故事而不是搭建完整写实场景。以cherry red为主色、mint green为辅助色。整体外观甜美、青春、俏皮、精致，具有平面编辑感，视觉丰富但绝不杂乱。负面提示：额外人物、写实环境、杂乱排版、无法辨认的标题、塑料皮肤、手部畸形、水印、抄袭品牌或受版权保护的角色。

A breathtaking ultra-realistic cinematic fashion editorial portrait of a beautiful adult East Asian woman in her mid-20s standing gracefully beside a tranquil deep-blue sea under soft overcast daylight.

She has porcelain-pale skin with flawless natural texture, delicate rosy undertones, subtle matte complexion, softly sculpted cheeks, almond-shaped dark eyes with refined eyeliner, naturally straight brows, muted rose lips, and elegant minimalist Korean editorial makeup.

Her long jet-black hair falls perfectly straight to her waist with blunt-cut full bangs framing her face. The silky hair moves gently in the ocean breeze, creating subtle flowing strands while maintaining a sleek, polished silhouette.

She wears a luxurious all-black Victorian-inspired long dress crafted from lightweight matte silk chiffon and structured crepe fabric. The dress features a high standing collar, delicate concealed buttons, softly gathered shoulders, fitted waist, elegant princess seams, long flowing sleeves with narrow cuffs, layered asymmetric draping, and a full-length softly pleated skirt that moves naturally with the sea breeze. The silhouette is refined, dramatic, and timeless without excessive ornamentation.

She wears fitted black opera gloves made of smooth stretch satin, extending elegantly past the wrists, adding an air of quiet sophistication.

Her posture is poised and graceful. She stands sideways toward the ocean while gently turning her face back toward the camera. One gloved hand rests softly in front of her body while the other hovers delicately as if caught mid-gesture. Her expression is calm, mysterious, distant, and emotionally restrained, creating an unforgettable cinematic presence.

The setting is a rugged Mediterranean coastline with textured natural limestone rocks beneath her feet and an endless calm sapphire-blue sea stretching into the horizon. The water is smooth with gentle ripples reflecting the soft sky, creating an atmosphere of serenity and solitude.

Natural diffused daylight softly illuminates her face without harsh shadows, producing smooth skin highlights while preserving rich blacks in the dress. The muted cool lighting enhances the contrast between her pale complexion and the monochromatic styling.

Color palette:
deep matte black,
porcelain ivory,
cool ocean blue,
soft gray sky,
natural stone beige,
subtle silver reflections.

Photographed from a medium full-body perspective using an 85mm prime lens with shallow depth of field. The composition emphasizes elegant negative space, balancing the solitary figure against the vast ocean backdrop.

The overall atmosphere is melancholic, mysterious, poetic, luxurious, cinematic, and timeless—blending Gothic romance with contemporary Korean fashion editorial aesthetics.

Inspired by Ann Demeulemeester, Yohji Yamamoto, Rick Owens, Vogue Korea, Harper's Bazaar Korea, luxury couture campaigns, dark romanticism, minimalist Gothic fashion, cinematic European coastal photography, and quiet luxury editorials.

Captured on a Canon EOS R5 with an RF 85mm f/1.2 lens, Kodak Portra 400 inspired color grading, subtle analog film grain, realistic skin texture, soft cinematic contrast, luxury editorial magazine quality, ultra photorealistic, 8K.

items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Theme:
A Look Back in Colorful Ruffles

Subject:
On a large stage shining with purple and pink lights, a female performer in her 20s stands with her back to the audience, looking back over her shoulder. Her slender full body is placed largely in the center of the frame, with her left hand holding a pink microphone and her thin, colorful, shining ruffled costume as the protagonists.

Character · Expression:
Slender oval face, slender deep brown eyes, thin and neat eyebrows, a small nose, and lustrous coral pink lips. Turning her face over her left shoulder towards the camera, looking straight ahead, she shows a confident expression with only a soft smile at the corners of her mouth. Deep dark brown long hair reaching below the chest, thin bundle-like bangs on the forehead, and loose wavy hair strands. Stage wind gently blows the ends of her hair towards the right side of the frame.

Costume · Pose:
An idol-style two-piece outfit layering light aqua blue, pink, lavender, and yellow. A fitted top with spaghetti straps decorated with jewel-like ornaments, gold trim, and light blue ruffles attached under the chest. On the waist are glossy light blue shorts and asymmetrical multi-layered transparent organza ruffles, with long tail-like fabric hanging down towards the right side of the frame. The body faces the back-side at an angle, with the waist twisted towards the left side of the frame and weight placed on the left leg. The left arm extends diagonally back and down holding a pink microphone, and the right arm extends towards the right side of the frame with a lightly clenched fist.

Background · Lighting:
A large LED screen on the left side of the frame reflects abstract patterns of pink, light blue, and yellow. White, purple, and pink circular stage lights are scattered on the right side and top/bottom of the frame, with the background graduating from deep indigo to black. Strong direct purple and pink light is projected from the back right and top of the frame, forming sharp magenta rim lighting on the hair, shoulders, and costume silhouette. The front is illuminated with soft white fill light on the face and skin.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 6:11. Using a slightly low-angle telephoto lens, looking up from the audience's perspective, capturing vertically from the top of the head to near below the knees, with the portion above the knees visible. The figure is placed largely in the center of the frame, with the face positioned towards the top and the multi-layered ruffles at the waist in the center, and hands extending left and right positioned near the edges of the frame. The left microphone is completely included, and the legs are cropped at the bottom. Sharp focus on the face and costume, with the LED and lighting forming large circular bokeh, using a shallow depth of field.

Texture · Style:
A photorealistic live-action photo of a live performance taken with a telephoto lens. High-definition depiction of natural skin texture, subtle reflections on long hair, transparency and layering of organza, sequins, beads, jewel-like decorations, and a metal mesh microphone. Keep the purple, pink, and light blue vibrant; even under strong stage light, do not let the details of the face and costume become overexposed.

Negative:
Omission of the back-facing look back and microphone, change to monochromatic costume.

七彩褶边的回眸

在紫色与粉色灯光闪耀的大型舞台上，一位20多岁的女性表演者背对观众，肩后回首。画面中央大幅放置她纤细的全身，将左手粉色麦克风和薄彩色闪耀褶边服装作为主角。  

人物·表情：  
细长的卵形脸，细长的深棕色眼睛，薄而整齐的眉毛，小巧的鼻子，富有光泽的珊瑚粉色嘴唇。将脸转向左肩后方，对准镜头，目光直视，仅以嘴角柔和微笑，展现自信的表情。身形以下的深暗棕色长发，前额薄薄的束状刘海，松散波浪状的发束。舞台的风将发梢轻轻向画面右侧飘扬。

创建一张写实的竖向 9:16 摄影肖像。主体与动作：一名女性独自坐在台座上，保持宽腿正面几何造型和直视目光；面部在中距离清晰可见；保持略微不平的肩膀、松弛的双手和未经磨饰的休息姿势可见。发型与造型：将成年女性的头发渲染为齐肩长的长波波头，直发且脸部露出来，深浓缩咖啡棕色，仅在下巴至锁骨的波波头、长波波头或紧凑绑扎的几何形状内。构图：居中的竖向全身影棚肖像，从略低于视平线的位置拍摄，坐姿人物几乎填满整个画面；适度的头部空间，双膝和鞋子完全可见，混凝土台座延伸至底边；自然的 45–50mm 镜头感，带有轻微的鞋部透视。姿势：高坐在面对摄像机的混凝土台座上，躯干直立略微前倾；双腿张开非常宽且对称弯曲，膝盖朝向下方角落抬起，小腿沿台座垂下；双前臂垂在双腿之间；手腕几乎在中心汇合，双手在低处放松，手指松散卷曲且略微不齐；肩膀不对称，一边略低；下巴抬起，头部微妙后仰，眼睛注视。服装：一件宽松且从一个肩膀滑落的超大号起皱炭黑色长袖纽扣衬衫，露出细窄的黑色无袖上衣带；衬衫下摆在腰部略微拉起；非常宽松的浅石米色降落伞工装裤，带有抽绳腰带、沉重的皱褶和深刻的重力折痕。场景：极简影棚，带有纯色深橄榄灰色无缝背景，以及由堆叠几何块构成的原始混凝土台座；单盏硬质顶前聚光灯在面部、肩膀、膝盖和鞋子上产生明亮的光池，下巴、手臂和腿部下方有深刻的定向阴影。修饰：低调的社论影棚照片，带有柔和的橄榄绿色调，温暖的皮肤高光，浓密的炭黑色阴影，中等偏高的对比度，略微压缩的黑色，克制的饱和度以及坚实的数字锐化；硬聚光灯产生突兀的阴影边缘和额头、锁骨上的轻微过曝高光。皮肤与材质纹理：未经修饰的摄影皮肤，具有可见的毛孔、汗毛、眼底/唇部纹理、色调变化以及面部、颈部、耳朵和手上的微弱颗粒感，包括闪光灯、单色和弱光效果；仅靠全局颗粒或噪点无法满足此约束。渲染约束：保持确切的裁剪、身体与相机的关系、手部任务、视线方向、光照方向、前景遮挡和背景放置；保留可信的解剖结构和自然的手部；避免美颜滤镜皮肤、影棚干净的重新布景、通用的时尚摆拍、文字、标志、边框和水印。

items.title: 操作系统式作品集编辑海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Design a 3:4 vertical "OS-style portfolio" editorial poster for [Personal Portfolio / Design Agency / Brand Project / Creative Team]. Use a deep graphite black background overall to establish a professional workstation-like interface order, but do not copy any specific brand's OS interface. Set a very narrow status bar at the top, sequentially placing: Brand Name / Current City / Date / Time / Online Status. Set a project directory area on the left, occupying about 30%—35% of the frame, with 6—8 project names listed consecutively. Each project includes: a short title and a one-sentence achievement description of no more than 12 words. Present the only activated core project on the right, occupying about 50%—55% of the frame. Use a single high-impact full visual image as the main visual, which can be a person, product, space, brand result, or key project visual. Do not split it into a thumbnail grid. The currently activated project should be highlighted in the left directory using reverse color, underline, or a single accent color, and establish a clear correspondence with the right main visual through a thin path, fine line, or positioning relationship. Add third-level auxiliary information at the bottom: Project Year, Service Type, File Status. Typography system: Use compact geometric sans-serif for main titles; neutral sans-serif for directory descriptions; monospaced fonts for time, numbers, and status. Color palette limited to: Charcoal Black, Warm White, Cold Gray, and one project accent color [Signal Orange / Cobalt Blue / Acid Green / Cold Purple]. The accent color area should not exceed 6%. Overall vibe like: Creative studio backend, digital archive, cultural magazine cover, mature proposal system. Avoid: Mimicking computer screenshots, stacked windows, complex icons, neon code rain, uniform card arrays, multiple images of equal size, cheap tech aesthetics.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

为【个人作品集 / 设计机构 / 品牌项目 / 创意团队】设计一张3:4竖版“操作系统式作品集”编辑海报。

整体采用深石墨黑背景，建立类似专业工作站的界面秩序，但不要复制任何具体品牌操作系统界面。

顶部设置一条极窄状态栏，依次放置：
品牌名称 / 当前城市 / 日期 / 时间 / 在线状态。

左侧设置占画面约30%—35%的项目目录区，连续排列6—8个项目名称。
每个项目包含：
短标题
一句不超过12字的成果说明

右侧呈现唯一被激活的核心项目，占画面约50%—55%。
使用一张高冲击力的完整视觉图像作为主视觉，可以是人物、产品、空间、品牌成果或关键项目画面。
不要拆成缩略图网格。

当前被激活的项目，在左侧目录中使用反白、下划线或单一强调色高亮，并通过一条纤细路径、细线或定位关系，与右侧主视觉建立清晰对应。

底部加入三级辅助信息：
项目年份
服务类型
文件状态

字体系统：
主标题使用紧凑几何无衬线字体
目录说明使用中性无衬线字体
时间、编号、状态使用等宽字体

配色限定为：
炭黑
暖白
冷灰
一种项目强调色【信号橙 / 钴蓝 / 酸性绿 / 冷紫】
强调色面积不超过6%。

整体气质像：
创意工作室后台
数字档案馆
文化杂志封面
成熟提案系统

避免：
仿制电脑截图
堆叠窗口
复杂图标
霓虹代码雨
均匀卡片阵列
多张同等大小的图片
廉价科技感

items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

9:16 vertical aspect ratio, photorealistic extreme close-up portrait, adult East Asian woman in her mid-20s, long dark brown-black hair naturally flowing down, slight waves, a large amount of fine messy hair strands realistically crossing the forehead, eyebrows, eyes, bridge of the nose, cheeks, and lips, some hair strands in the camera foreground slightly out of focus, forming a natural occlusion layer; the face almost fills the entire frame, hair and chin allowed to be cropped by the frame, slight two-thirds profile, looking directly or nearly directly at the camera, expression calm, cold, and restrained, lips naturally closed, warm brick red moist lip color.

Nighttime close-up on-camera direct flash photography, compact camera direct flash, on-camera flash, realistic hard highlights appear on the forehead, bridge of the nose, cheeks, and lips, dark long hair producing fine flash reflections, the background rapidly falls into nearly pure black, retaining only very few environmental highlights; natural skin texture, slight pores, lip lines, and under-eye details, reject excessive skin smoothing, black, warm skin tone, brick red lips, minimal deep blue comprehensive color, extreme close-up portrait, hard specular highlights, deep black background, subtle grain, slight digital compact-camera feel, minimal color grading, high local contrast, nighttime snapshot feel, realistic photography.

**Soran Three-Layer Natural Watermark:** Clearly readable "Soran" made into a small deep silver-gray embroidered woven label on the edge of a small amount of deep blue clothing material in the lower left; hidden Soran integrated into the trend of hair strands crossing the face, long hair highlights, and clothing texture; micro Soran naturally formed by hair intersection points, iris highlights, lip lines, clothing fibers, and black hair reflection nodes.

**Negative:** Neat hair without messy strands, only one or two strands covering the face, face too far from the camera, soft light studio shot, creamy skin smoothing, plastic skin, heavy eye makeup, bright red lipstick, sweet smile, big laugh, exaggerated expression, neon background, bar scene, complex street scene, background too bright, heavy cinematic mist, HDR, ultra-sharp commercial makeup feel, hair strands piercing into eyeballs or skin, redundant facial features, wrong eye proportions, external watermarks, sticker logos, floating text, subtitles.

9:16竖幅，真人写实极近景人像，二十多岁的成年东亚女性，深棕黑色长发自然披散，轻微波浪，大量细碎发丝真实横穿额头、眉眼、鼻梁、脸颊与嘴唇，部分发丝位于镜头前景轻微失焦，形成自然遮挡层；脸部几乎填满整个画面，头发和下颌允许被画框裁切，轻微三分之二侧脸，直接或接近直接看向镜头，神情平静、冷淡、克制，嘴唇自然闭合，暖砖红湿润唇色。

夜间近距离机顶直闪摄影，compact camera direct flash，on-camera flash，额头、鼻梁、脸颊与嘴唇出现真实硬质高光，深色长发产生细碎闪光反射，背景迅速坠入近乎纯黑，只保留极少环境亮点；自然皮肤纹理，轻微毛孔、唇纹和眼下细节，拒绝过度磨皮，黑、暖肤色、砖红唇、极少深蓝综合色，extreme close-up portrait，hard specular highlights，deep black background，subtle grain，slight digital compact-camera feel，minimal color grading，高局部反差，夜间抓拍感，真实摄影。

**Soran三层自然水印：**清晰可读“Soran”做成左下少量深蓝衣料边缘的小型深银灰刺绣织标；hidden Soran融入横穿脸部的发丝走势、长发高光与衣料织纹；micro Soran由发丝交叉点、虹膜高光、唇纹、衣料纤维和黑发反光节点自然形成。

**负向：**整齐无碎发，只有一两根遮脸发丝，脸离镜头太远，柔光棚拍，奶油磨皮，塑料皮肤，浓重眼妆，鲜红口红，甜笑，大笑，夸张表情，霓虹背景，酒吧场景，复杂街景，背景过亮，电影柔雾过重，HDR，超锐商业美妆感，发丝穿进眼球或皮肤，多余五官，眼睛比例错误，外贴水印，贴纸logo，漂浮文字，字幕。

items.title: 2x2 Instagram 韩国博主时尚穿搭网格
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

2×2 Instagram fashion grid, single square image, 1:1 aspect ratio. Korean female fashion influencer, adult 21+, tall slim elegant hourglass figure, extremely beautiful with symmetrical features, radiant smooth skin, long silky dark brown hair softly styled, K-beauty soft glam makeup with dewy glass skin, subtle blush, gradient pink lips.

{a concrete visual subject} styled as {a concrete visual subject}, same outfit across all four frames, emphasizing waistline and flattering silhouette, cute chic youthful Instagram-viral aesthetic.

Four equal square frames arranged 2×2:
• Top left: full-body standing pose against aesthetic café wall, soft cute smile
• Top right: mirror selfie pose indoors, playful wink or subtle pout
• Bottom left: close-up portrait with soft portrait mode blur, chic confident gaze, emphasizing dewy makeup
• Bottom right: seated pose on stairs, candid laugh looking away

Premium smartphone camera aesthetic (iPhone-style, ~26mm wide lens), natural daylight or soft café lighting, soft warm pastel color grading, slightly brightened exposure, cohesive tone across all frames. High-quality authentic influencer photo with ultra-realistic skin texture and fabric details. Subtle white borders between frames, clean trendy feed appearance.

Avoid: blurry image, over-smoothed skin, distorted anatomy, inconsistent outfit between frames, harsh flash lighting, low resolution.

{a concrete visual subject} 风格为 {a concrete visual subject}，所有四个画框中穿着相同服装，强调腰线和迷人轮廓，可爱时髦且充满活力的 Instagram 爆红审美。

四个相等的正方形画框，呈 2×2 排列：
• 左上：背景为唯美咖啡馆墙壁的全身站姿，柔和可爱的微笑
• 右上：室内镜面自拍姿势，俏皮的眨眼或微微嘟嘴
• 左下：带柔和人像模式虚化的特写肖像，时髦自信的目光，强调水光妆容
• 右下：楼梯上的坐姿，看向别处的自然大笑

高端智能手机摄像头美学（iPhone 风格，约 26mm 广角镜头），自然日光或柔和的咖啡馆照明，柔和温暖的马卡龙色调，曝光略微调亮，所有画框色调统一。高质量、真实的博主照片，具有超写实的皮肤纹理和织物细节。画框之间有细微的白色边界，干净时尚的动态外观。

items.title: 古风仙侠春日女主写实精修人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

9:16 vertical version, ancient style Xianxia spring female lead portrait, realistic retouched character poster style, high-precision Oriental fantasy female portrait, spring mountain flower slope scene, the overall image is soft, sweet, light, gentle, and agile, with a transparent sense of air, the flower sea is dreamy but not overly sweet. The main subject of the image is a young adult Oriental female, visual age about 20–28 years old, with natural and clear Oriental female characteristics, a soft oval face, clear almond eyes, a clear and gentle expression, looking gently at the camera with a very shallow smile, and a graceful and agile temperament. The skin is fair and delicate, transparent and natural, retaining real skin texture.

Makeup is peach-pink watery glow makeup, with an exquisite makeup concentration. The base makeup is light and delicate, with a soft watery glow; eye makeup is delicately blended with peach pink, light rose brown, and soft warm brown to enhance the clear almond eyes; blush is peach pink and honey peach pink, focusing on under the eyes and the center of the face, delicate but high-end; lip makeup is soft and moist light peach pink, petal pink, or low-saturation rose pink, with a moist and delicate texture; there is slight highlighting on the aegyo-sal, tip of the nose, center of the face, and Cupid's bow. The overall makeup is delicate and enhances the complexion, but is not "sweet girl" style or "Internet celebrity" style.

Hairstyle is long straight black hair half-down and half-up, hair strands are smooth and thick, with a slight sense of wind, the ends and side strands are gently lifted by the spring breeze. Exquisite flower branch hair accessories, thin light gold chains, pink and white flower decorations, pearl tassels, and small gemstone embellishments are worn in the hair, the headgear level is exquisite, light and agile but not overly complex. Earrings are slender pendants combining light gold with pink crystal and pearls, exquisite and graceful.

Clothing is a light gauze Xianxia layered dress, lotus pink, pearl, and gold color scheme, mainly light lotus pink, soft cherry pink, pearl white, and milky white, supplemented by light gold embroidery and delicate gold edges. The clothing fabric is lightweight layered gauze, soft silk-like inner layers, and multi-layered tulle, with detailed floral patterns, vine patterns, and gold thread embroidery on the shoulders, sleeve edges, and chest. The overall gorgeousness is medium to exquisite, sweet and graceful but not too heavy. The person gently pulls or lifts a small amount of the skirt hem and outer gauze with one hand, the movement is natural and gentle, not exaggerated.

The camera adopts a closer diagonal front close-up composition, from bust to half-body, highlighting the face, makeup, headgear, upper body clothing, and the flower sea atmosphere. The person's body is slightly turned towards the camera, the head looking back at the camera, the posture is light and natural, with a feeling of "looking back while walking among the flower slopes," but it is not a running snapshot, nor is there any exaggerated movement.

The scene is mountain flower slope / spring mist slope / breeze flower branches. In the background, a large flower slope composed of light pink and pale white small flowers is visible, in the distance are mountain mists in the faint fog and a soft spring sky, with local flower branches extending from the edge of the frame to form a natural foreground. The background uses a shallow depth of field for blurring, but still retains the layers of the flower sea, mountain terrain, and spring mist, the image is bright and transparent, with slight flower cluster bokeh.

Lighting is soft spring morning light, natural light coming in from the side back or diagonal back, highlighting the hair strands, flower decorations, earrings, and the edges of the thin gauze, the face is delicately and brightly lit, and the skin is transparent and soft. The overall light is clean, soft and bright, not grey, not dirty yellow, and has the atmosphere of a spring flower slope portrait.

Overall requirements: high precision, realistic retouched style, ancient style Xianxia spring female lead, flower sea close-up, light and immortal air, peach-pink makeup, gentle look back, character as the absolute main subject, no snapshot blur, no excessive CG feel.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

9:16 竖版，古风仙侠春日女主写真，偏写实精修角色海报风格，高精度东方幻想女性人像，春日山野花坡场景，整体画面柔婉、清甜、轻盈、温柔、灵动，空气感通透，花海梦幻但不过分甜腻。画面主体是一位年轻成年东方女性，视觉年龄约 20–28 岁，具有自然明确的东方女性特征，柔和鹅蛋脸，杏眼清亮，神情明净温柔，眼神柔和地看向镜头，带很浅的微笑，气质柔美灵动。肌肤白皙细腻，通透自然，保留真实皮肤质感。

妆容为 桃粉水光妆，妆容浓度精致。底妆轻薄细腻，带柔和水光感；眼妆以桃粉、浅玫瑰棕、柔和暖棕细腻晕染，强化清亮杏眼；腮红为桃粉、蜜桃粉，重点落在眼下与面中，娇柔但高级；唇妆为柔润浅桃粉、花瓣粉或低饱和玫瑰粉，质感水润细腻；卧蚕与鼻尖、面中、唇峰有轻微提亮。整体妆容娇柔显气色，但不甜妹化、不网红化。

发型为黑长直半披半挽，发丝顺滑浓密，带轻微风感，发尾与侧边发丝被春风轻轻带起。发间佩戴精致花枝发饰、浅金细链、粉白花饰、珍珠流苏与细小宝石点缀，头饰等级精致，轻盈灵动不过分复杂。耳饰为浅金与粉晶、珍珠结合的细长坠饰，精巧柔美。

服装为 轻纱仙侠层叠裙，藕粉珍珠金系配色，以浅藕粉、柔和樱粉、珍珠白、奶白为主，辅以浅金刺绣与细腻金边。服装面料为轻盈半叠层薄纱、柔软绢感内层与多层叠纱，肩部、袖缘与胸前带有细致花卉纹、藤蔓纹与金线刺绣。整体华丽度中等偏精致，清甜柔美但不过于厚重。人物一只手轻轻收拢或提起少量裙摆与外纱，动作自然温柔，不夸张。

items.title: 海边木质长椅上的夏日和风女性
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Subject:
A fictional adult Japanese woman sitting on a wooden bench by the sea, short hair lightly touching her face, smiling quietly. Depicted as a natural resting scene during a summer journey enjoying intense sunlight and sea breeze.

Location, Time, Background:
A wooden platform along a rocky coast on a clear afternoon. Rope railings, gray rocks, a walking path extending into the distance on the left, overlapping blue ocean and distant shoreline, and a large expanse of shimmering light spreading over the sea surface on the right.

Clothing, Accessories:
A white collared sleeveless top tucked into a light sage green long skirt. Paired with a thin-strap beige crossbody bag and nude lace-up sandals.

Pose, Fingers, Contact:
Sitting shallowly on the edge of the bench, legs covered by the long skirt crossed diagonally. One palm is placed on the seat surface, and the other hand lightly touches the hair near the temple, with the elbow slightly open towards the sea side.

Expression, Gaze:
The face is slightly turned toward the sea, the gaze is cast diagonally downward, showing a slight smile with teeth visible. Not intentionally conscious of the shooting, expressing a light joy blown by the sea breeze.

Face, Makeup:
Small oval outline, natural eyebrow shape, slender drooping dark brown eyes, well-formed bridge of the nose, pale rose lips. Applying a thin flush and understated eye makeup on bright skin, preserving the transparency of sunlight.

Hair:
Chin-length near-black dark brown bob, tucked behind the ear, with short strands of hair blown by the sea breeze remaining at the hairline. Clearly depicting the contact of the fingertips and the slight outward movement of the hair ends.

Light Source:
The main light source is strong sunlight from the back right, receiving a large expanse of white light reflected from the sea surface. The white top and the highlights on the cheeks are softly connected, and warm light reflected from the platform is cast back to the shadow side.

Colors, Tones:
High-key summer colors centered on white, light green, beige, sky blue, and bright wood grain. The blue of the ocean and the green of the vegetation remain pale, unified in a refreshing tone as if washed by sunlight.

Materials, Subtle Textures:
The thin woven texture and buttons of the top, the soft folds of the skirt, the smooth leather of the bag, the wood grain of the dry bench, the twist of the rope, the roughness of the rocks, and the fine reflections on the sea surface are each depicted.

Composition, Lens:
A slightly high angle perspective in portrait 9:16 approaching the sitting figure. The chest is placed as the visual center near 51% of the image width, and the midpoint between the eyes is placed near 46% horizontally, with the hair-touching arm and the diagonal line of the skirt guiding the gaze toward the sea.

Image Processing, Finishing:
Utilizing the white of the backlight, finished as a clean commercial photograph, meticulously preserving the boundary between the skin and the white clothing. The shimmering of the sea is treated with soft out-of-focus, while natural resolution is placed on the person's eyes, fingertips, and fabric outlines.

Corruption Avoidance, Prohibitions:
Fixed to one adult female, sitting on a bench, hair-touching action, white top, green long skirt, rocky coast. Avoid processing that loses the face due to white clipping, extra fingers, distorted benches, broken bags, text, logos, or watermarks.

被摄主体：
坐在海边木制长椅上，一位虚构的成年日本女性，短发轻触脸庞，静静微笑。描绘成享受强烈阳光和海风的夏日旅程中自然的休憩场景。

地点・时间・背景：
晴朗午后的岩礁海岸沿线的木制平台。绳索栏杆、灰色岩石、左侧远处延伸的步道、叠加的蓝色海洋与远方岸线，右侧海面展开大片光辉闪烁。

服装・小物：
白色领口无袖上衣塞入浅鼠尾草绿色的长裙。搭配细肩带米色斜挎包，以及裸色系带凉鞋。

姿势・手指・接触：
浅浅坐在长椅边缘，长裙覆盖的双腿斜向交叠。一只手掌置于座面，另一只手轻触太阳穴附近的发丝，肘部向海侧微微张开。

表情・视线：
脸庞微微转向海的方向，视线斜向下投落，微微露出牙齿微笑。不刻意在意拍摄，表现出被海风吹散的轻盈喜悦。

脸部・妆容：
小巧的卵形轮廓、自然眉形、细长低垂的深棕色眼睛、端正鼻梁、淡玫瑰色嘴唇。在明亮肌肤上施以薄薄血色和低调眼妆，保留阳光的叠层感。

头发：
及下巴的近黑色深棕色波波头，撩至耳后，海风吹起的短发束保留在发际线处。清晰描绘指尖接触和发梢轻微向外的动作。

光源：
以右侧后方的强烈日光为主光源，接收海面反射的大片白色光芒。白色上衣和脸颊亮部柔和连接，从平台反射的温暖光线回投至阴影侧。

颜色・色调：
以白、淡绿、米色、空蓝、明亮木纹为中心的高调夏日色彩。海洋的蓝和植被的绿保持浅淡，以阳光洗涤般的清爽色调统合。

材质・细微质感：
上衣的薄织纹理和纽扣、裙子的柔软褶皱、包的滑润皮革、干燥长椅的木纹、绳索的绞合、岩石的粗糙、海面的细碎反射，分别描绘。

构图・镜头：
纵向9:16的稍高视角接近坐姿人物。上半身作为视觉中心置于画面宽度的51%附近，双目中点置于横向46%附近，以撩发的手臂和裙子的斜线引导视线向海延伸。

图像处理・完成：
活用逆光的白色，完成干净的商业照片，细致保留肌肤与白色服装的边界。海的闪烁以柔和虚焦处理，在人物眼部、指尖、布料轮廓处置入自然的解析度。

崩坏回避・禁止：
固定成年女性一人、长椅坐姿、触碰头发的动作、白色上衣、绿色长裙、岩礁海岸。避免因白飞而丢失脸部的处理、多余手指、扭曲的长椅、断裂的包、文字、标志、水印。
