items.title: 手绘复古旅行拼贴画
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已整理为可复用的目的地旅行拼贴插画模板。通过目的地变量生成地标、自然、饮食、交通与文化物件的手工剪贴簿构图。
items.prompt: Create a charming handmade travel collage representing Kyoto, Japan. Build it from torn paper, faded watercolor washes, vintage photographs, ink sketches, and layered cut-paper textures on warm ivory paper. Include 5-7 instantly recognizable elements of the destination: an iconic landmark, native plant or tree, national animal or bird, famous local food, traditional transportation, a cultural clothing item or object, and a recognizable landscape or skyline. Arrange them as one organic scrapbook composition with slight overlaps and uneven hand-cut edges. Use a soft destination-inspired palette, visible paper fibers, brush strokes, torn-paper borders, gentle shadows, and vintage print imperfections. Add small handwritten or typewriter annotations using the destination name and short labels such as local life or heritage, plus small arrows pointing to objects. Keep the background mostly clean warm cream paper with generous negative space. The mood is artistic, nostalgic, sophisticated, handcrafted, and editorial, like a vintage travel scrapbook page. Avoid photorealistic collage, glossy 3D effects, excessive detail, and modern corporate graphic design.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一幅代表 Kyoto, Japan 的迷人手工旅行拼贴画。使用撕纸、褪色水彩、复古照片、墨水草图和层叠剪纸纹理，在温暖的象牙色纸张背景上构建画面。包含 5-7 个该目的地一眼可识别的元素：标志性地标、原生植物或树木、国家动物或鸟类、当地著名美食、传统交通工具、文化服饰或物品，以及可识别的景观或天际线。将它们排列成一个有机的剪贴簿构图，元素轻微重叠，边缘像手工裁剪一样不规则。使用受目的地启发的柔和配色、可见纸张纤维、笔触、撕纸边框、柔和阴影和复古印刷瑕疵。加入使用目的地名称和“当地生活”“遗产”等简短标签的手写或打字机注释，并用小箭头指向物件。背景大部分保持干净的暖奶油色纸张并留出充足负空间。整体感觉艺术、怀旧、精致、手工且具有社论风格，像复古旅行剪贴簿中的一页。避免写实拼贴、光滑 3D 效果、过度细节和现代企业平面设计感。

items.title: 海滨旅行日志原图与复古插画双面板编辑
items.description: 4:5 双面板照片编辑：顶部保留上传海滨源照片，底部将同一视角转译为暖象牙纸上的极简复古旅行日志版画，并保留两行指定文字。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Use the uploaded source photograph as the exact visual source. Create one single vertical 4:5 image with two clearly separated panels stacked vertically.

TOP PANEL — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH: keep the uploaded source photograph completely unchanged and recognizable. Do not repaint, crop, stylize, recolor or modify any buildings, sea, umbrellas, stairs, plants, pedestrians or composition. The top must remain the untouched reference photograph.

BOTTOM PANEL — ARTISTIC REINTERPRETATION: translate the exact same scene from the top into an original minimalist editorial travel-journal art print. Strictly preserve the same viewpoint, waterfront architecture, curved promenade, sea, stairs, umbrellas, pedestrians, plants, proportions and overall composition so the two panels correspond immediately. Do not invent a new location, add architecture or rearrange the scene.

Change only the visual medium: use delicate but slightly imperfect ink contours, simplified elegant shapes, soft watercolor washes, subtle screen-print texture, faded pigments, dry-brush marks, slight registration shifts, natural paper grain and lightly weathered vintage-print texture. Place the bottom artwork on warm ivory handmade paper with generous negative space and visible tactile fibers. Use dusty ocean blue, muted sea-green, warm sand, creamy ivory, soft stone gray and small faded terracotta accents. Preserve the important colors from the source while keeping the palette restrained and unsaturated.

Near the lower part of the bottom panel, typeset these exact two lines in understated typewriter-inspired typography:
“harbour light”
“afternoon lingers in the curve, where sea and steps remember.”
Add one very thin divider between the panels. Make the whole image feel like a carefully photographed before-and-after page from a premium independent travel-art journal.

Hard requirements: the top is only the untouched source photograph; the bottom is only an artistic reinterpretation of that same photograph. No photorealistic recreation in the bottom, major composition changes, excessive detail, glossy digital effects or oversaturated colors. Do not add other text, logos, watermarks or identity replacement.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

使用上传的源照片作为确切的视觉来源。创建一张单幅 4:5 竖幅图像，包含上下两个清晰分离、垂直堆叠的面板。

顶部面板——原始照片：完整保留上传的源照片，不重新绘制、不裁剪、不风格化、不改变颜色，也不修改其中的建筑、海面、阳伞、楼梯、植物、行人或构图。顶部必须保持为可辨认的未经处理原图。

底部面板——艺术重绘：将顶部的完全相同场景转译为原创的极简社论旅行日志艺术版画。严格保持同一视角、海滨建筑、弧形步道、海面、楼梯、阳伞、行人、植物、比例和整体构图，让上下两部分一眼可对应；不要发明新地点、增加新建筑或重新排列场景。

仅改变视觉媒介：使用细腻但略不完美的墨线轮廓、简化而优雅的形状、柔和水彩晕染、轻微丝网印刷纹理、褪色颜料、干笔刷痕迹、少量套印偏移、自然纸张纹理和轻微风化的复古印刷质感。底部放在暖象牙色手工纸上，保留充足留白和可见纤维。色彩使用灰尘蓝、柔和海绿、暖沙色、奶油象牙色、石灰灰和少量褪色赤陶色；保留原照片重要颜色，但整体克制、不饱和。

在底部面板下方附近准确加入两行文字：
“harbour light”
“afternoon lingers in the curve, where sea and steps remember.”
使用低调的打字机风格排版，并在上下面板之间加入一条极细分割线。整张图像应像一本高级独立旅行艺术杂志中被精心拍摄的前后对比页。

硬性要求：顶部只能是未经触碰的源照片；底部只能是对同一源照片的艺术重绘。底部不要写实重建，不要重大构图变化，不要过度细节、光泽数字效果或过度饱和。不要添加其他文字、Logo、水印或身份替换。

items.title: 橡皮印章风格旅行手记海报
items.description: 每张上传照片单独生成一张4:3旅行实录海报：左侧保留原照片，右侧以旧纸、少量专色和小型手工橡皮章提炼地点记忆，并显示用户输入日期。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Create one separate “Rubber Stamp Travel Field Notes Poster” for each uploaded photo; output each photo individually without collage or multi-image combinations. Use a 4:3 landscape composition with an implied left/right division but no obvious dividing line. Let the left side occupy about 58% and faithfully preserve the original photo's main subject, identity when present, terrain, architecture, plants, people, spatial relationships, natural lighting, shadows, textures and color atmosphere. Apply only restrained art-publication photo grading and extremely subtle fine film noise; natural cropping is allowed for layout, but never stretch, distort, shift, replace or redraw the original main subject. Let the right side occupy about 42%, using warm off-white aged paper with subtle fibers, grain, usage marks and matte texture, leaving large areas unprinted. Analyze the photo and compress only the most location-distinctive outlines and relationships into one small multicolor rubber stamp: architecture contours, roofs, domes, arches, towers, terraced settlements, mountain forms, shorelines, roads, skyline, plants or important foreground occlusions as appropriate. Remove crowds, vehicles, dense windows, repetitive buildings, fragmented vegetation and irrelevant decoration. Place the stamp in the lower-middle of the right paper area at about 30–38% of that region's height, with ample whitespace; it must remain a small stamp, not a full illustration, landscape painting or logo. Extract 2–4 spot inks from the photo, favoring desaturated carbon black, deep green, brick red, ochre, slate blue or taupe while preserving the source's distinctive color character and using only a small accent area. Render each color as a separately hand-stamped layer with carved rubber texture, hand-engraved marks, uneven line widths, contour notches, fractured edges, dry-ink shortages, paper show-through, granular ink, uneven pressure, partial ghosting and subtle 1–2 mm misregistration; never digitally smooth the edges. In the surrounding whitespace, generate from the photo an accurate English location name, a “No.” number, three short English keywords and the Gregorian year, plus the entered date 2026-09-12. Use a small restrained slightly imperfect typewriter font, with fully readable, accurately spelled text and no irrelevant slogans or brands. The mood is quiet, tactile, regionally specific field notes by an architect, travel writer or natural observer. Negative prompt: obvious central divider, circular seal, Chinese red stamp, postage perforations, wax seal, sticker collage, tourist-souvenir template, smooth vector logo, generic city icon, full architecture replication, dense detail, childlike craft, cartoon, 3D, plastic texture, glossy digital gradients, oversaturation, excessive text, clutter, or altering the left source photo.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

请为每一张上传的照片分别创建一张“橡皮印章旅行实录海报”，每张照片单独输出，不进行拼贴或多图组合。整体采用4:3横向构图，形成含蓄的左右分区，但不要绘制明显分割线。左侧约占58%，忠实保留原始照片中的主体、存在人物时的身份、地形、建筑、植物、人物、空间关系、自然光影、真实纹理和原始色彩氛围；仅应用克制的艺术出版级照片调色和极细胶片噪点。为了适配版式允许自然裁剪，但不得拉伸、扭曲、偏移、替换或重绘原照片主体。右侧约占42%，使用温暖米白色陈旧纸张，带细微纤维、自然纹理、轻微使用痕迹和哑光质感，并保留大面积未打印留白。分析照片，将最具地点辨识度的轮廓和关系压缩成一枚小型多色橡皮印章：根据照片选择建筑轮廓、屋顶、穹顶、拱门、塔楼、阶梯状聚落、山形、海岸线、道路、天际线、植物或重要前景遮挡。去除人群、车辆、密集窗户、重复建筑、碎片化植被和无关装饰。印章位于右侧纸张区域的中下方，仅占该区域高度约30%–38%，周围保留充足留白；不得放大成完整插图、风景画或品牌标志。根据照片提取2–4种专色墨水，优先低饱和碳黑、深绿、砖红、赭黄、石板蓝或灰褐色，同时保留原图最具特色的色彩，仅用小面积作为强调。每种颜色都要表现为独立手盖印层，具有真实橡皮雕刻纹理、手刻痕迹、不均匀线宽、轮廓缺口、断裂边缘、干墨缺墨、透纸感、颗粒墨迹、压力不均、部分重影和约1–2毫米的细微套印偏差；边缘不得数字平滑。在周围留白中，根据照片生成准确的英文地点名称、“No.”编号、三个简短英文关键词和公历年份，并显示输入日期2026-09-12。使用细小、克制、略带机械缺陷的打字机字体，所有文字拼写准确且完全可读，不添加无关口号或品牌。整体像建筑师、旅行作家或自然观察者记录的安静、克制、触感真实且具有地域特色的实地笔记。负面提示：明显中央分割线、圆形印章、中式红章、邮票齿孔、火漆印章、贴纸拼贴、旅游纪念品模板、平滑矢量标志、通用城市图标、完整复制所有建筑、密集细节、幼稚手作感、卡通、3D、塑料质感、光滑数字渐变、过度饱和、过多文字、装饰杂乱，或改动左侧原始照片。

items.title: 照片转复古蜡笔涂鸦留白海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的参数化海报工作流。每次上传一张 source_photo，分别输出一张独立的 3:4 高级设计海报；上半部保留原始照片，下半部重构为带复古纸张肌理的粉彩蜡笔涂鸦插画。不绑定固定人物参考图。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Use the uploaded source_photo to create one independent premium design poster. Do not make a multi-image collage; each uploaded photo receives its own output. Use a 3:4 vertical canvas divided into two regions with exactly equal height, 50% top and 50% bottom.

In the upper half, preserve the source photo's subject identity, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural lighting and original color atmosphere. Apply only subtle high-end grading with an art-magazine, independent-publication or exhibition-image feel. Extend environmental background naturally when needed, but never stretch, distort or change the source subject. If the source contains a person, preserve that person's identity from source_photo; do not apply a different identity reference.

In the lower half, first understand the source's memorable theme, subject relationships, structural direction, emotion and visual metaphor. Reconstruct only the strongest contours, postures, directions and memory points as a relaxed naive graffiti illustration on vintage paper texture. Do not copy every object or redraw the entire photo. Use thick-grained chalk/crayon outlines that are loose, dry, slightly shaky, intermittently faded and partly open, with blunt rounded ends. Add only a very small amount of pastel fills, simple grids, stripes, dots or casual smears; avoid realistic volume and complete detail.

Compress surrounding stars, flowers, plants, objects, environmental clues or abstract symbols into simple one- or few-stroke graffiti marks in the same line language. Keep a small subject community surrounded by generous active white space. The layout may be eccentric, edge-aligned, suspended or partially cropped; use scale contrast, asymmetry and empty-versus-solid relationships to create breathing room. Prefer drawing less over filling the page.

Use an extremely light clean near-white paper base: cream, ivory, pale beige, pale apricot or very light gray-white, matched to the source temperature. Keep only subtle fibers and particles; never use dark, yellowed or aged paper. The background must be much brighter than the lines and color blocks. Extract 2-4 vivid friendly source colors and reformulate them as soft pastel crayon colors such as peach, apricot, cream yellow, mint, sky blue, light purple, coral, soft blue or cyan-green. Avoid dirty brown, dull low-contrast Morandi palettes, fluorescents and cheap candy color.

Add only a small amount of freely extracted short text or fragments from the source subject, action, emotion, memory or metaphor. Use thin sparse typewriter-like lettering with slight irregular spacing, placed naturally in the white space and mixed with the graffiti. No fixed title template, unrelated copy or watermark. The final design should feel healing, relaxed, naive yet mature and editorial, with a pale paper field, coarse crayon lines, minimal pastel fills, tiny graffiti symbols and abundant artistic white space. Avoid realistic redrawing, fine polished strokes, complex icons, filled backgrounds, smooth vectors, 3D rendering and commercial template styling.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

使用上传的 source_photo 创建一张独立的高级设计海报。不要制作多图拼贴；每上传一张照片，就单独输出一张海报。画布采用 3:4 竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格相等，各占画面 50%。

上半部分保留源照片的主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光线和原有色彩氛围。只进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物或展览图像质感。需要适配画幅时可以自然延展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变源主体。如果源照片包含人物，应从 source_photo 保留该人物身份，不要套用其他固定人物参考图。

下半部分先理解源照片最值得记住的核心主题、主体关系、结构走势、情绪和视觉隐喻，再只保留最具代表性的轮廓、姿态、方向和视觉记忆点，重构为带复古纸张肌理的轻松稚拙涂鸦插画。不要逐物复制，也不要完整重绘整张照片。使用粗颗粒粉笔或蜡笔式轮廓：线条松弛、干涩、略微抖动、断续掉色、局部不闭合，笔端自然钝圆。内部只加入极少量粉彩色块、简单网格、条纹、圆点或随手涂抹，不做写实体积和完整细节。

将周围的星星、花朵、植物、器物、环境线索或抽象符号压缩成同一线条语言下的一笔或几笔涂鸦标记。让主体与极少量符号形成松散群落，周围保留大量主动留白。构图可以偏心、贴边、悬置或局部裁切，通过大小反差、不对称以及空与实的关系创造呼吸感；宁可少画，也不要填满。

使用极浅、明亮、干净的近白纸面，例如奶油白、象牙白、浅米白、淡杏白或极浅灰白，并根据源照片色温匹配。只保留很轻微的纸张纤维和颗粒，不要深色、发黄或陈旧纸面。背景明度必须明显高于线条与色块。从源照片提取 2-4 种鲜活且亲和的颜色，重新调制为柔和粉彩蜡笔色，如蜜桃、杏橙、奶油黄、薄荷、天空蓝、淡紫、珊瑚、柔蓝或青绿色。避免脏褐色、沉闷低对比莫兰迪色、荧光色和廉价糖果色。

只加入少量从源主体、动作、情绪、记忆或隐喻中提炼的短句或文字片段。使用轻薄、疏朗、带轻微字距不齐的打字机感字体，自然散落在留白处并与涂鸦混排。不要固定标题模板、无关文案或水印。最终应呈现浅色纸面、粗颗粒蜡笔线条、少量粉彩填色、极简涂鸦符号和大量艺术留白，松弛、治愈、天真但成熟且具有编辑设计感。避免写实转绘、精细光滑描边、复杂图标、填满背景、平滑矢量、3D 渲染和商业模板感。

items.title: 极简低多边形社论风格插画转换
items.description: 将用户上传的原始照片转换为极简低多边形社论插画；保留主体、姿势、场景关系、色彩和光线方向，以居中小场景和大面积留白呈现。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Transform the uploaded real photo into a minimalist low-poly editorial illustration.

Use the original photo as the visual source.

Faithfully preserve:
- the main subject
- pose and gesture
- body direction
- clothing
- important accessories
- key objects
- perspective
- recognizable scene relationships

Do not redesign the scene.
Do not invent a new composition.
Do not add unrelated elements.

STYLE

Convert the photo into a clean 2D low-poly illustration.

Use:
- medium-to-large geometric polygonal planes
- broad angular shapes
- simplified faceted light and shadow
- clean edges
- restrained details
- muted natural colors

Avoid excessive tiny triangles.

The result should feel:
minimal,
quiet,
refined,
editorial,
graphic,
elegant.

Less is more.

COMPOSITION

Create a compact illustrated scene floating in the exact center of a large empty canvas.

Place the entire scene precisely in the center, both horizontally and vertically.

The illustrated scene should occupy only about 35–50% of the total canvas height.

Leave a very large amount of empty space evenly around all four sides.

Do not fill the frame.
Do not crop tightly around the subject.
Do not shift the scene upward, downward, left, or right.

The scene should feel like a small visual specimen displayed in the center of a large editorial page.

BACKGROUND

Use one completely solid background color:

#F4EBDD

The background must remain clean, flat, uniform, and empty.

No texture.
No paper grain.
No gradient.
No vignette.
No decorative elements.
No background shadows.

ASPECT RATIO

Match the canvas aspect ratio to the uploaded photo as closely as possible.

Preserve the original image orientation and overall width-to-height relationship.

Horizontal photo → horizontal output.
Vertical photo → vertical output.
Square or near-square photo → square or near-square output.

Do not force the source photo into a predefined aspect ratio.

SCENE SIMPLIFICATION

Keep only the visual information necessary to recognize the original photo.

Simplify secondary details.

Group:
- buildings
- trees
- plants
- water
- furniture
- architecture
- landscape
- clothing folds
- reflections

into larger geometric masses.

Do not reproduce every small detail.

The outer edge of the illustrated scene should end naturally with an irregular silhouette.

Do not preserve the original rectangular photo boundary inside the canvas.

COLOR

Preserve the original photo’s overall color identity.

Reduce it into a controlled, slightly desaturated palette.

Keep colors natural, muted, warm, and sophisticated.

LIGHT

Preserve the original light direction and overall mood.

Translate realistic lighting into simplified geometric color planes.

FINAL LOOK

Minimalist low-poly editorial illustration.
Large negative space.
Small centered scene.
Solid #F4EBDD background.
Controlled geometric facets.
Natural irregular scene boundary.
Clear subject recognition.
Elegant visual simplification.
Less is more.

AVOID

full-frame illustration,
busy background,
photorealism,
3D rendering,
CGI,
cartoon style,
anime,
children’s illustration,
thick outlines,
tiny triangle overload,
overly fragmented polygons,
complex textures,
paper texture,
grain,
background gradients,
dramatic lighting,
neon colors,
oversaturated colors,
decorative graphics,
text,
typography,
borders,
frames.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

将上传的真实照片转换为极简低多边形社论插画。

使用原始照片作为视觉来源。

忠实保留：
- 主体
- 姿势与动作
- 身体方向
- 服装
- 重要配饰
- 关键物体
- 透视
- 可识别的场景关系

不要重新设计场景。
不要发明新的构图。
不要添加无关元素。

风格

将照片转换为干净的二维低多边形插画。

使用：
- 中到大型的几何多边形平面
- 宽阔的有棱角的形状
- 简化的切面光影
- 干净的边缘
- 克制的细节
- 柔和的自然色彩

避免过多微小的三角形。

结果应呈现：
极简、
安静、
精致、
社论感、
图形化、
优雅。

少即是多。

构图

在一个巨大的空白画布正中心创建一个悬浮的紧凑插画场景。

将整个场景精准地放置在水平和垂直中心。

插画场景应仅占画布总高度的约 35–50%。

在四周均匀留出极大量的空白。

不要填满画面。
不要紧贴主体裁剪。
不要向上、向下、向左或向右偏移场景。

场景应感觉像展示在大篇幅社论页面中心的一个小型视觉标本。

背景

使用一种完全纯色的背景色：

#F4EBDD

背景必须保持干净、平坦、统一且空白。

无纹理。
无纸张颗粒。
无渐变。
无暗角。
无装饰元素。
无背景阴影。

纵横比

尽可能贴合上传照片的画布纵横比。

保留原始图像的方向和整体宽高关系。

横向照片 → 横向输出。
纵向照片 → 纵向输出。
正方形或接近正方形的照片 → 正方形或接近正方形的输出。

不要强制将源照片放入预定义的纵横比中。

场景简化

仅保留识别原始照片所必需的视觉信息。

简化次要细节。

将以下内容组合：
- 建筑物
- 树木
- 植物
- 水
- 家具
- 建筑
- 景观
- 衣服褶皱
- 反射
为更大的几何块。

不要再现每一个微小细节。

插画场景的外边缘应以不规则的轮廓自然结束。

不要在画布内保留原始的长方形照片边界。

颜色

保留原始照片的整体色彩特征。

将其缩减为受控的、略微去饱和的调色板。

保持颜色自然、柔和、温暖且高级。

光线

保留原始光线方向和整体氛围。

将写实的光影转化为简化的几何色块。

最终效果

极简低多边形社论插画。
大面积负空间。
小型居中场景。
纯色 #F4EBDD 背景。
受控的几何切面。
自然的场景不规则边界。
清晰的主体识别。
优雅的视觉简化。
少即是多。

避免

全画幅插画、
杂乱背景、
写实主义、
3D 渲染、
CGI、
卡通风格、
动漫、
儿童插画、
粗轮廓、
过多的微小三角形、
过度破碎的多边形、
复杂纹理、
纸张纹理、
颗粒、
背景渐变、
戏剧性光影、
霓虹色、
过饱和颜色、
装饰图形、
文字、
排版、
边框、
框架。

items.title: 高级杂志感手写观察图谱海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Please turn every photo I upload into an individual high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo separately. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, with the top and bottom two areas strictly at a 1:1 height, each occupying 50% of the frame.

The upper part preserves the original photo, maintaining the main structure, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, only performing slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of magazine photography and art publications. To adapt to the frame, the sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructing it into a relaxed, intimate, and refreshing handwritten observation map. With a large area of clean white paper as the main space, the theme is broken down into several small block-like physical graphics, partial close-ups, cross-section small images, repeated small items, or detail fragments, loosely distributed in the upper-middle and middle sections of the frame, without a rigid table, but using staggered white space, a rhythm akin to horizontal reading, and handwritten phrases to naturally connect them, forming a casual observation record like taste, touch, sound, action, or memory. Small graphics should retain the material feel, color, and identification characteristics of the subject itself, presenting small scales, rounded outlines, slight perspective, and hand-painted coloring marks, with local parts carrying particles, charred edges, debris, textures, or cross-section details; do not unify them into standard icons, but rather a physical note feeling between picture book illustrations and journal stickers.

Text is the important skeleton of the lower part. Use thin black, slightly childlike or handwritten short words, short sentences, onomatopoeia, and annotations, interspersed around the graphics, some close to the edges of the graphics, some floating in the blank space, with relaxed character spacing and slightly jumping baselines, forming an intimate reading rhythm of 'reading while looking'; a smaller signature-style explanation, number, date, title, or thematic short sentence can be added at the bottom, making the text naturally integrate into the picture rather than a post-pasted layout label.

The overall color scheme is extracted from the upper photo, with white paper white space occupying the largest area, thin black characters carrying information, and the main color being warm, clean, and slightly high in brightness; a small amount of high-saturation warm colors, dark colors, or thematic auxiliary colors are only used for focus, shadows, textures, and rhythmic embellishments. Retain the slight softening, natural compression, uneven edges, and pigment absorption effects of scanned paper, without adding heavy shadows, decorative borders, or a strong sense of modern layout. The overall style references handwritten observation pages, picture book information pages, art publications, and relaxed editorial design, presenting a refreshing, gentle, naive, agile, readable, and life-like visual temperament, avoiding a template feel, cartoonization, cheapness, and over-design.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体结构、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有杂志摄影与艺术出版物质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为轻松、亲切、清爽的手写观察图谱。以大面积洁白纸面作为主要空间，将主题拆解为若干小块实物状图形、局部特写、剖面小图、重复小件或细节片段，松散分布于画面中上部与中段，不做严整表格，而以错位留白、近似横向阅读的节奏和手写短语自然串联，形成像对味觉、触感、声音、动作或记忆的随手观察记录。小图形应保留主题自身的材料感、颜色与识别特征，呈现小尺幅、圆钝轮廓、轻微透视和手绘上色痕迹，局部带有颗粒、焦边、碎屑、纹理或剖面细节，不要统一成标准图标，而要像绘本插图与手账贴纸之间的实物笔记感。

文字是下半部分的重要骨架。使用细黑色、略带童稚感或手写感的短词、短句、拟声词和注释，围绕图形左右穿插，部分贴近图形边缘，部分漂浮在空白中，字距松弛，基线轻微跳动，形成“边看边读”的亲密阅读节奏；底部可加入一行较小的署名式说明、编号、日期、标题或主题短句，使文字自然融入画面，而不是后期贴上的排版标签。

整体配色从上方照片中提取，白纸留白占最大面积，黑色细字承担信息，主体色温暖、清洁、略高明度；少量高饱和暖色、深色或主题辅色仅用于焦点、阴影、纹理和节奏点缀。保留扫描纸张的轻微柔化、自然压缩感、边缘不齐和颜料吸收效果，不加厚重阴影、装饰边框或强烈现代排版感。整体参考手写观察页、绘本信息页、艺术出版物与轻松编辑设计，呈现清爽、温柔、稚拙、灵动、可读、富有生活感的视觉气质，避免模板感、卡通化、廉价感和过度设计感。

items.title: 早安城市金句天气平面海报
items.description: 以早安问候、城市、金句、天气和日期为明确主题的平面海报，保留主题变量并使用2026-08-10作为默认日期。
items.prompt: Generate a restrained graphic poster around the THEME variable, defaulting to a Good Morning greeting about a city, a golden quote and weather on 2026-08-10. Preserve a large high-brightness color field in the upper area and an almost equal low-saturation light paper area below, separated by a clean horizontal color boundary. Translate the theme into two oversized, low-detail, rounded light-colored character-like graphics that cross the boundary and are cropped by the side edges; keep internal cavities and thickness contrast so they act as scale rulers and visual skeletons rather than decoration. Compress the theme into a small-to-medium realistic focal object near the boundary, partially overlapping the giant graphics, with natural surface texture, soft side-top light and short grounded shadows. Near the left boundary place two compact uppercase title lines: GOOD MORNING and CITY WEATHER; add tiny spaced metadata and the date 2026-08-10 on the upper edges. Keep the theme's colors in large clean blocks with limited accents, matte paper fibers, slight density variation and crisp but not harsh printed edges. Avoid heavy aging, yellowing, dirt, extra decoration and modern gradients. The reading path must move from color field to title to focal object.
items.prompt_zh: 围绕 THEME 变量生成克制的平面海报，默认主题为2026-08-10的早安问候、城市、金句和天气。保留上部大面积高明度色场与下部近乎等量的低饱和浅色纸面，用干净的水平色域边界分隔。把主题转译成两组超大、低细节、圆润的浅色字符化图形，横跨边界并被左右边缘裁切；保留内部空腔与粗细对比，使其成为尺度标尺和视觉骨架，而非装饰。将主题压缩为边界附近的中小型真实焦点对象，局部遮挡巨型图形，保留自然表面纹理、柔和侧上方光线与接地短阴影。在左侧边界附近放置两行紧凑大写标题：GOOD MORNING 和 CITY WEATHER；在巨型图形上缘添加小号宽字距元信息与日期 2026-08-10。保持主题色在大色块中的清洁对比和有限强调色，呈现哑光纸纤维、轻微密度变化以及清楚但不刺眼的印刷边缘。避免厚重做旧、泛黄、脏污、额外装饰和现代渐变。阅读路径应从色场经过标题到达焦点对象。

items.title: 极简主义红色手套射丝商业产品摄影
items.description: 极简商业产品广告模板：上传产品作为唯一精确主体参考，左侧红色蛛网图案手套发射一条横向白色蛛网，蛛网仅在接近产品处自然交互。适合高级产品摄影与广告视觉。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded product as the exact reference. Preserve its original shape, branding, packaging, label, logo, colors, proportions and details without redesigning, replacing or modifying it. Create a premium minimalist product advertisement on a panoramic {aspect_ratio} canvas, defaulting to 21:9. Use a seamless studio background matching {background_color}, defaulting to the dominant color of the uploaded product, with a soft radial gradient and subtle vignette. Keep the composition clean and spacious with generous negative space. On the far left, place a generic red glove with a web pattern, performing a web-shooting hand gesture. A realistic white spider web travels horizontally across the frame. Keep the web at a uniform thickness for approximately 80% of its length; only near the product may it naturally wrap around, attach to, interact with, or visually blend into the product. The product itself must remain unchanged and clearly legible. Luxury commercial product photography, ultra-realistic materials, soft studio lighting, realistic shadows, ultra-sharp focus, glossy details, photorealistic premium advertising finish. Avoid warped product geometry, altered logos, inconsistent web thickness, clutter, dead black areas, fake reflections, extra people, and unreadable product text.
items.prompt_zh: 以上传的产品作为精确参考。保留产品原始形状、品牌、包装、标签、徽标、颜色、比例和细节，不得重新设计、更换或修改产品。在全景 {aspect_ratio} 画布上创建高级极简产品广告，默认画幅为 21:9。使用与 {background_color} 匹配的无缝影棚背景；若未指定，则使用上传产品的主色调，并加入柔和径向渐变与微妙暗角。构图保持整洁开阔，留出充足负空间。在最左侧放置一只带蛛网图案的通用红色手套，做出射丝手势。一条真实的白色蜘蛛网横向穿过画面，约 80% 的长度保持统一厚度；仅在靠近产品的位置，蛛网才可以自然缠绕、附着、与产品互动或在视觉上融入产品。产品本身必须保持不变，并且标签与徽标清晰可辨。采用奢华商业产品摄影：超写实材质、柔和影棚光效、真实阴影、超锐聚焦、光泽细节和照片级高级广告质感。避免产品几何变形、徽标被改写、蛛网粗细不一致、画面杂乱、死黑区域、虚假反射、额外人物以及无法辨认的产品文字。

items.title: 怀旧彩色铅笔水彩旅行日记速写
items.description: 将参考照片转化为带有彩色铅笔笔触和水彩晕染的怀旧旅行日记插画，保留原始场景的构图与可辨识元素，并加入留白页面和手写标题排版。
items.prompt: Transform the reference photograph into a delicate hand-drawn travel journal illustration while preserving the original composition, architecture, people, trees, grass, road, and overall perspective. Use a traditional colored-pencil and watercolor sketch aesthetic on warm, slightly aged cream paper. Keep the buildings recognizable but simplify them into expressive hand-drawn shapes, with visible pencil strokes, loose watercolor washes, subtle paper grain, imperfect outlines, and gentle cross-hatching. Preserve the sunny summer atmosphere, soft blue sky, warm beige buildings, green lawn, scattered people relaxing on the grass, benches, trees, and distant cars. Use a muted vintage travel-sketch palette with natural imperfections and understated colors. Place the illustration in the lower portion of the page with generous cream-colored negative space around it. Add elegant handwritten typography above: “Sunny Days”, and below: “— Good time —”. Keep the overall mood minimal, nostalgic, and editorial, like an analog photograph transformed into a personal sketchbook memory; make it refined and authentic without photorealism.
items.prompt_zh: 将参考照片转化为精美的手绘旅行日记插画，同时保留原始构图、建筑、人物、树木、草地、道路和整体透视。采用传统的彩色铅笔和水彩速写美学，使用温暖、略微做旧的米白色纸张。保持建筑的可辨识度，但将其简化为富有表现力的手绘形状，带有可见的铅笔笔触、松散的水彩晕染、细微的纸张纹理、不完美的轮廓和柔和的排线。保留晴朗的夏季氛围、柔和的蓝天、温暖的米色建筑、绿色的草坪、散落在草地上休息的人群、长椅、树木和远处的汽车。使用柔和的复古旅行速写配色方案，带有自然的瑕疵和低调的色彩。将插画置于页面的下方，周围留出大量的米色负空间。在上方添加优雅的手写文字：“Sunny Days”，在下方添加：“— Good time —”。整体呈极简、怀旧、艺术旅行杂志美学，像将模拟照片转化为个人写生簿记忆；精致而真实，但不要使用写实摄影效果。

items.title: 东方武侠白衣剑客肖像特写 - [Texture and Color Atmosphere]
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

[Texture and Color Atmosphere]
Colors: A subtle and harmonious Eastern aesthetic cinematic palette of the clean pure white of the clothing, the deep black of the hair, the smooth cold silver of the sword, and the sage green and olive tones created by the background leaves.
Textures: The inherent light and smooth texture of silk fabric, the metallic luster of the cold steel sword body, the smoothness of porcelain skin, and the coarse yet delicate film grain noise unique to 35mm motion picture film cameras are interwoven and fused.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

[质感与色调氛围]
色彩：服装的整洁纯白（Pure White）、发丝的深黑、剑的光滑冷银（Silver），以及背景树叶营造出的鼠尾草绿（Sage Green）和橄榄色调，微妙和谐的东方美学电影调色板。

纹理：丝绸面料固有的轻盈光滑质感、冰冷钢质剑身的金属光泽、瓷器肌肤的平滑，以及 35mm 电影胶片相机特有的粗糙而细腻的胶片颗粒（Film Grain）噪点交织融合。

items.title: 照片重构复古纸张拼贴手绘插画海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。
items.prompt:
Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output separately. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, the top and bottom areas are strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper part retains the original photo, keeping the subject identity, structure, posture, real texture, natural light and shadow, and the original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition image. To adapt to the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower part first understands the core theme, subject relationship, structural trend, emotional atmosphere, and visual metaphor worth remembering from the original photo, and then reconstructs it into a vintage paper texture pastel hand-drawn graffiti illustration. The overall logic still maintains material collage, but do not copy the photo completely, nor redraw it object by object; instead, delete irrelevant details, retaining only the structures, trends, and visual memory points that best represent the original object. Through hand-drawn graffiti, paper collage, pastel crayon texture, naive shapes, and scrapbook-style reorganization, re-summarize so that after understanding and re-creation, the image can still be recognized at a glance in its correspondence with the photo above.

The styling uses a mixed media logic of hand-drawn graffiti + paper collage + pastel crayon texture. Lines are intentionally irregular, retaining the feeling of sketching, hand-drawing, slight clumsiness, and relaxation; color blocks have dry grainy edges, like traces lightly painted with crayons, pastels, or colored pencils. The main subject and a few auxiliary elements can be recombined like stickers, paper scraps, or hand-drawn symbols, but always revolve around the main narrative, without meaningless stacking.

The composition maintains the relationship between small-scale stamps and large areas of whitespace, freely arranging positions based on the subject's own direction, proportion, and visual center of gravity, which can be eccentric, edge-aligned, suspended, or partially cropped. The main subject and a few auxiliary elements form clear visual focal points, while the rest of the space is actively left blank. Whitespace must be an intentional compositional language, not just an empty background: it works with the subject, collage elements, text, and local symbols to form positive and negative shapes, density, clustering and scattering, and asymmetric balance, constituting a clear sense of breathing, space, and pause. Better to delete than to fill up.

The material is based on paper textures like kraft paper, recycled paper, or handmade paper, retaining the sense of real materials and slight grain to reduce the digital feel. The overall look is like an independently published scrapbook, visual diary, or scrapbook editorial illustration, rather than ordinary children's illustrations or simple redrawing.

The color scheme extracts 2–4 colors from the photo above that are the most vital, most friendly, and most representative of the picture's spirit, then reformulates them into a softer, brighter, and more healing pastel color palette. This can naturally form light color relationships such as peach pink, light blue, cream yellow, orange apricot, and tender green, appropriately brightening, purifying, and removing gray, while maintaining a warm, intimate, vintage, and lived-in feel. Avoid dim, dirty gray, dull vintage, fluorescent colors, and cheap candy feelings.

The text only involves a minimal amount of editorial intervention, with no language restriction. A few words or short phrases can be freely extracted from the subject, location, action, emotion, life details, or metaphors, using a small, restrained, slightly mechanical, and slightly misaligned vintage typewriter font, which forms a scrapbook-style graphic-text collage relationship with the illustration, quietly falling on the white space or the edge of the subject, without commercial title stacking.

Overall presentation is a high-end visual effect composed of hand-drawn graffiti, material collage, pastel crayons, paper texture, small-scale stamps, large areas of intentional whitespace, and vintage graphic-text layout. Avoid object-by-object redrawing, filling the screen, complex backgrounds, realistic depiction, smooth vectors, 3D feel, cheap cartoon style, and templated collage.
items.prompt_zh:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分先理解原照片最值得被记住的**核心主题、主体关系、结构走势、情绪气氛与视觉隐喻**，再重构为**复古纸张肌理粉彩手绘涂鸦插画**。整体仍保持**材料拼贴**的逻辑，但不要完整复制照片，也不要逐物转绘，而是删去无关细节，只保留最能代表原物的结构、走势和视觉记忆点，通过手绘涂鸦、纸张拼贴、粉彩蜡笔质感、稚拙造型与手账式重组重新概括，使画面经过理解与再创作后，仍能一眼识别与上方照片之间的对应关系。

造型采用**手绘涂鸦 + 纸张拼贴 + 粉彩蜡笔质感**的混合媒介逻辑。线条故意不规整，保留随笔、手画、轻微笨拙与松弛感；色块带有干涩颗粒边缘，像蜡笔、粉笔或色铅笔轻轻涂出的痕迹。主体及少量辅助元素可像贴纸、纸片或随手画的符号一样被重新组合，但始终围绕主体叙事，不做无意义堆砌。

构图保持**小尺度章印与大面积留白**的关系，根据主体自身的方向、比例和视觉重心自由安排位置，可偏心、贴边、悬置或局部裁切。主体与少量辅助元素形成清晰视觉落点，其余空间主动留空。**留白必须是有意识的构成语言，而不是空出来的背景**：它与主体、拼贴元素、文字和局部符号共同形成正负形、疏密、聚散与不对称平衡，构成明显的呼吸感、空间感与停顿感。宁可删减，也不要填满。

材质以**牛皮纸、再生纸或手工纸般的纸张肌理**为基础，保留真实材料感与轻微颗粒，降低数字感。整体像一本独立出版的手账、视觉日记或 scrapbook editorial illustration，而不是普通儿童插画或简单转绘。

配色从上方照片中提取**最有生命力、最有亲和力、最能代表画面精神的2–4种颜色**重新调制，转化为更柔和、明快、治愈的粉彩色组。可自然形成蜜桃粉、浅蓝、奶油黄、橙杏色、嫩绿等轻盈色彩关系，适度提亮、提纯、去灰，保持温暖、亲切、复古而有生活感。避免暗淡、灰脏、沉闷复古、荧光色和廉价糖果感。

文字只作极少量编辑性介入，不限制语种。可从主体、地点、动作、情绪、生活细节或隐喻中自由提炼少量字词或短句，采用**小型、克制、略带机械感与轻微错位的复古打字机式字体**，与插画共同形成手账式图文拼贴关系，安静地落在留白区域或主体边缘，不做商业标题堆砌。

整体呈现**手绘涂鸦、材料拼贴、粉彩蜡笔、纸张肌理、小尺度章印、大面积有意识留白与复古图文混排**共同构成的高级视觉效果。避免逐物转绘、画面填满、复杂背景、写实描摹、光滑矢量、3D感、廉价卡通感和模板化拼贴。

items.title: 奥利莫斯风格极简格式塔海报提示词
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
create temp view franchise_dna as
select
infer_iconic_character_profile(:franchise) as profile_mask,
infer_flat_environment(:franchise) as foreground,
infer_light_color(:franchise) as light_ink,
infer_dark_color(:franchise) as dark_ink;

create temp view poster_layers as
select
layer1 = render_background(light_ink, texture='archival_paper'),
layer2 = render_foreground(foreground, dark_ink, mask=profile_mask)
from franchise_dna;

-- gestalt logic: the foreground is printed with the profile_mask as negative space.
-- the environment's skyline edge aligns exactly with the profile silhouette.

create temp view final_poster as
select
composite(layer1, layer2, mode='screen_print_overprint') as artwork
from poster_layers;

render artwork
with style='olly_moss_minimalism, gestalt_figure_ground',
constraints='no_gradients, no_3d, no_floating_faces_in_sky';

items.title: 高级像素游戏旅行海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please turn every travel photo I upload into an independent high-end pixel game travel poster. No multi-photo stitching, one photo corresponds to one complete finished product.

The overall composition adopts a strict 3:4 vertical layout. The screen is divided into two nearly 1:1 areas at the top and bottom, using a straight, clear, and clean horizontal boundary in the middle. Only output the front of the poster, do not generate photo frames, walls, handheld displays, or Mockups.

### Top Half: High-Fidelity Original Photography

The upper half must faithfully preserve the original photo.

Accurately maintain the subject identity and quantity in the photo, person or animal poses, vehicle and boat directions, architectural structures, topographic relationships, observation angles, spatial perspective, front-and-back occlusion, real materials, natural light and shadow, and the original color atmosphere.

Only perform slight, restrained travel magazine, art publication, or photography exhibition level color grading, and add very thin film grain. The upper half must still clearly be a real photo.

不得将照片插画化，不得移动、替换、增删或放大主体，不得重塑建筑、镜像场景、改变人物动作或使用模糊照片填充画幅。

### Bottom Half: Subject Extraction-Style Pixel Game Redrawing

Do not fully pixelate the entire photo.

First, understand the single visual subject in the photo most worth the viewer getting closer to, operating, entering, or continuing to explore, for example:

- A landmark building with a clear outline
- A ship, vehicle, or other travel transportation tool
- A character or a group of characters with clear movement relationships
- A door, a stall, a bridge, or an independent travel object
- A section of road, steps, or navigation path that can represent the photo's story

Choose only one main visual anchor.

Retain the subject's most recognizable outline, posture, orientation, key structure, and iconic colors, and reconstruct it into an aesthetically mature independent travel game character, location, or interactive object.

The subject usually occupies about 35%–60% of the width and about 25%–45% of the height of the bottom area, placed in the lower center or naturally offset according to the direction of the original scene.

Do not redraw according to the original photo's full framing, original proportions, and original background density.

### Environmental Reduction

Keep only one to three environmental clues that can explain the location, direction, and action relationships, such as:

- A short section of road, track, steps, or track
- Two or three building facades or mountain fragments
- A small amount of trees, street lamps, guardrails, or shorelines
- Several sets of water ripples, reflections, or ground color blocks
- A very small distant figure, vehicle, or ship as a scale prompt

Delete other tourists, repeated window panes, dense vegetation, billboards, cluttered traffic, complex skies, irrelevant buildings, and photography noise.

The bottom half retains at least about 50%–65% of continuous warm off-white paper surface. Allow blank space to directly represent sky, air, water surface, distance, streets, or game areas that have not yet been explored.

### Pixel Medium

Rebuild the subject using square or near-square pixel blocks with clear edges.

- Use smaller, denser pixel blocks at key points of subject recognition.
- Use medium-sized pixel blocks for the main volume of the subject.
- Gradually reduce pixel density for roads, water ripples, vegetation, reflections, and distant views.
- The interior of the subject is relatively complete, and the exterior breaks apart, misaligns, scatters, and disappears into the paper white frame by frame along the real outline, road direction, water flow, mountain trend, or movement direction.
- Outlines must have clear stepped hard edges.
- There can be a small amount of paper gaps between pixel blocks.

This is not a photo mosaic filter, not an overall reduction in photo resolution, nor a blurred pixelated, cyber glitch, or data corruption effect.

The overall should be like an independent travel game with mature art design: a real location compressed into a small level that can be approached, entered, and continued to be explored.

### Game Text Information

Text is not tiny editorial notes, but part of the game scene information.

Based on the location, subject, and action that can be confirmed in the photo, extract and keep only three layers of English information:

1. Main Title: Location, landmark or scene name, 1–3 English words.
2. Area Subtitle: Route, area or scene type, 1–3 English words.
3. Status Information: Real action or state happening in the photo, 2–4 English words.

If the specific location cannot be confirmed, do not invent place names, coordinates, or dates; use
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级像素游戏旅行海报。不要多图拼接，一张照片对应一张完整成品。

整体采用严格的 3:4 竖版构图。画面上下分为两个接近 1:1 的区域，中间使用笔直、清楚、干净的水平边界。只输出海报正面，不生成相框、墙面、手持展示或 Mockup。

### 上半部分：高保真原始摄影

上半部分必须忠实保留原始照片。

准确保持照片中的主体身份与数量、人物或动物姿态、车辆和船只方向、建筑结构、地形关系、观察角度、空间透视、前后遮挡、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩氛围。

只进行轻微、克制的旅行杂志、艺术出版物或摄影展级调色，并加入极薄胶片颗粒。上半部分仍然必须明确是一张真实照片。

不得将照片插画化，不得移动、替换、增删或放大主体，不得重塑建筑、镜像场景、改变人物动作或使用模糊照片填充画幅。

### 下半部分：主体提炼式像素游戏转绘

不要将整张照片完整像素化。

首先理解照片中最值得观者靠近、操作、进入或继续探索的单一视觉主体，例如：

- 一座具有明确轮廓的地标建筑
- 一艘船、车辆或其他旅行交通工具
- 一个人物或一组动作关系清楚的人物
- 一扇门、一个摊位、一座桥或一个独立旅行物件
- 一段能够代表照片故事的道路、台阶或航行路径

只选择一个主要视觉锚点。

保留主体最具识别度的轮廓、姿态、朝向、关键结构和标志性色彩，将它重新构建成审美成熟的独立旅行游戏角色、地点或可交互物件。

主体通常占下半区域宽度约 35%–60%、高度约 25%–45%，放置在中央偏下或依据原场景方向自然偏移。

不要按照原照片的完整取景、原比例和原背景密度重新绘制。

### 环境删减

只保留一至三条能够解释地点、方向和行动关系的环境线索，例如：

- 一小段道路、铁轨、台阶或航迹
- 两三块建筑立面或山体碎片
- 少量树木、街灯、护栏或岸线
- 几组水纹、倒影或地面色块
- 一个很小的远处人物、车辆或船只作为尺度提示

删除其他游客、重复窗格、密集植被、广告牌、杂乱交通、复杂天空、无关建筑和摄影噪声。

下半部分至少保留约 50%–65% 连续的温暖米白纸面。允许空白直接代表天空、空气、水面、距离、街道或尚未探索的游戏区域。

### 像素媒介

使用边缘清楚的正方形或近似正方形像素块重新搭建主体。

- 主体识别关键处使用较小、较密的像素块。
- 主体主要体量使用中等尺寸像素块。
- 道路、水纹、植被、倒影和远景逐渐降低像素密度。
- 主体内部相对完整，外围沿真实轮廓、道路方向、水流、山势或运动方向逐格断开、错位、散落并消失到纸白。
- 轮廓必须具有明确的台阶状硬边。
- 像素块之间可以有少量纸面缺口。

这不是照片马赛克滤镜，不是将照片整体降低分辨率，也不是模糊像素化、赛博故障或数据损坏效果。

整体应像一款具有成熟美术设计的独立旅行游戏：真实地点被压缩成一个可以靠近、进入和继续探索的小型关卡。

### 游戏文字信息

文字不是微小的编辑注释，而是游戏场景信息的一部分。

根据照片中能够确认的地点、主体和动作，提炼且只保留三层英文信息：

1. 主标题：地点、地标或场景名称，1–3 个英文单词。
2. 区域副标题：路线、区域或场景类型，1–3 个英文单词。
3. 状态信息：照片中正在发生的真实动作或状态，2–4 个英文单词。

如果无法确认具体地点，不得虚构地名、坐标或日期，应使用主体和场景名称。

主标题是下半部分的第二视觉中心：

- 使用真正建立在方格网格上的 8-bit 或 16-bit 像素显示字体。
- 全部大写，字形厚实、端点方正、无抗锯齿。
- 宽度通常占下半区域约 35%–55%。
- 正常查看时必须清楚可读，不能缩成技术边注。
- 可使用从照片提取的深色字面，并加入一格浅色或特征色硬边像素投影。
- 长标题允许紧凑地分成两行。

区域副标题约为主标题字号的 35%–45%，像地图区域分类。

状态信息可以更小，但正常查看仍须可读，并沿主体基线、道路、航迹或水纹自然排列。

文字必须与画面使用相同的像素网格、限色色盘和硬边机制，像从游戏场景中自然长出来，而不是后期贴上的普通等宽字体。

不得生成其他文字、数字、作者名、签名、账号、品牌、Logo、二维码或网址。

### 色彩

配色完全从当前照片提取并压缩为约 6–12 个主色阶。

保留主体最具识别度的颜色，并使用相邻深浅色建立体积。可保留一处照片中真实存在的高饱和颜色作为视觉跳点。

米白纸面必须是下半部分的最大色块。

不要固定使用霓虹蓝紫、赛博配色、游戏机高饱和色或与原照片无关的夕阳橙。

### 整体气质

真实、安静、有生活感，同时带有游戏探索欲。

像旅行途中一个普通瞬间，突然被保存成独立游戏中的区域解锁画面、地点地图或行动存档。

游戏化来自主体提炼、像素结构、关卡式空间与文字信息层级，而不是堆叠 HUD 和游戏图标。

### 强制避免

Avoid: full-scene pixel redraw, same-crop same-scale redraw, complete pixel background, photo mosaic filter, overall low resolution, blurry pixelation, smooth vector illustration, generic pixel landscape, generic landmark icon, giant HUD, health bars, buttons, dialogue boxes, inventory panels, commercial game logo, voxel 3D, Minecraft blocks, cyber glitch, data corruption, neon palette, invented landmark, invented people, altered architecture, excessive text, tiny unreadable title, ordinary typewriter font, author name, signature, watermark, pixels crossing the horizontal divider.

作品主题为：她在月神回廊尽头看见世界翻面。

画面核心叙事为：
一位年轻东方女性走到巨型纸雕月神回廊的尽头，在一轮巨大圆形月窗之前停下。月窗之后，另一个世界正在缓缓展开，像山河、星河与天光在她眼前翻开了世界的背面。她站在高处，安静仰望，第一次看见月色之外仍有更辽阔的天地。
主体人物为：
 视觉年龄约24岁的东方成年女性，清冷空灵、安静清醒，带一点重新苏醒的力量感。
人物拥有清秀窄鹅蛋脸，细长杏眼微微抬起，神情安静中带有轻微惊醒后的释然。面部采用精致的东方纸艺插画式塑形，五官清晰，不是真人摄影质感，不过度卡通化。

人物发型与头饰为：
 黑色长发半披半挽，发丝向后延展成流动纸带，佩戴浅金月牙与星片发饰。
头饰轻盈、精致，不复杂、不高耸。长发与披帛在高处微风中轻轻向后飘动。
人物服装为：
 群青蓝与月白层叠纸艺长裙，裙摆镂刻月亮、云层、星点纹样，外层披帛轻薄飘动。
服装由多层纸片结构、细密镂空纹样、清晰裁切边缘、轻微折痕、真实纸张厚度和纤维纹理组成，局部带有少量浅金纸箔细节，整体精致华丽但仍保持清冷神性。
梦境载体为：
 巨型圆形纸雕月窗与月神回廊。

梦境意象包括：
 月亮、月窗、回廊、星河、飞鸟、远山。
所有月窗、回廊、山脉、云气、飞鸟和天空元素都必须统一采用高完成度的立体纸雕语言。
整体剪纸结构采用：
 圆窗窥梦式。
画面主体是一条极长的月神回廊。
回廊由大量连续排列的高耸纸柱、拱框、镂空梁架、月纹装饰和云纹纸雕结构组成，从近景一直向远方月窗延伸，形成非常强烈的纵深透视和“圣廊”般的仪式感。
回廊顶部、拱框、门楣和立柱之间带有大量高精度镂空纹样，包括月牙、云纹、星点和东方装饰性几何图案。

回廊尽头是一轮巨大、完整、极具压迫感的圆形纸雕月窗。
月窗远大于人物，几乎占据画面上部核心区域。
月窗不是普通装饰，而像是另一个世界的入口。
透过月窗，可以看见一片被月光与星河照亮的梦境世界：
层叠远山、蜿蜒河流、云海、远处的纸艺宫阁、飞鸟与星河轨迹共同构成另一个展开中的天地，仿佛世界在月窗背后翻开了另一面。
人物位于回廊尽头下方的高台或阶梯上，比例必须明显偏小，只作为空间中的情绪锚点。
人物站在高处，背对或半侧对镜头，身体朝向巨型月窗，头部微微仰起，目光望向月窗之后展开的世界。
人物只占整体画面很小比例，重点突出“巨大月窗 + 超长回廊”的神性尺度感。
构图必须强调：

回廊从近景向远方月窗延伸的强烈透视
巨型圆形月窗的压迫感与神圣感

人物极小、天地极大
上方与远方的大量高空留白
纸艺世界翻面般的史诗展开感

整体色彩方案为：
 群青蓝、月白、淡紫为主，少量浅金点缀。
其中：
群青蓝用于地面纹样、天空、远山与回廊局部结构

月白用于回廊主体、月窗、纸柱、云层与主要亮部
淡紫用于部分远景过渡与冷月光层次
浅金仅用于边缘描饰、星点和少量精致装饰高光

整体色调必须清冷、圣洁、通透、梦幻，不压黑，不灰蒙，不脏浊，不做成普通深夜小景。
光线与纸张质感为：
 冷白月光从高处斜照而下，月窗边缘透出通透高光，回廊纸柱与拱框形成清晰层叠阴影，纸张纤维和裁切边缘清楚可见。
必须强化：
月窗边缘的透光感
回廊立柱与拱门的层层投影
纸张厚度与手工裁切纹样

远山与云气的纸雕分层
地面与装饰边框上的精细镂空结构
整体画面要具有：
 东方神话感、月神圣廊感、巨型纸雕艺术装置感、史诗级梦境空间感、高完成度艺术海报感。
人物只是情绪锚点，真正的视觉主角是 超长回廊、巨型月窗以及月窗后缓缓展开的另一重世界。

补充要求：
 人物必须明显偏小，强化“巨大月窗 + 超长回廊”的神性尺度感，不要做成普通月夜小景；月窗必须完整巨大，回廊必须长且深，画面整体明亮通透，具有史诗感与高空留白感。

items.title: 首尔3D分层剪纸风格旅游海报
items.description: 以首尔为主题的高级4:5分层纸雕旅游海报，融合南山首尔塔、景福宫、汉江、传统屋顶与城市街景，呈现柔和马卡龙色和细腻纸纤维。
items.prompt: Create a premium vertical 4:5 travel poster of Seoul, South Korea, designed as a handcrafted layered 3D paper-cut miniature world. Use a soft pastel paper background with subtle grain, sculpted clouds, textured cardstock layers, realistic cut-paper edges, tactile fibers, gentle shadows and elegant 3D depth. Make N Seoul Tower the dominant central landmark, surrounded by Gyeongbokgung Palace, traditional hanok rooftops, the Han River and bridges, Seoul streets, cafés, trees, local buses and small paper-cut people for scale and storytelling. Use harmonious city-inspired pastels: cream, warm beige, muted green, dusty pink, soft blue and terracotta. At the top add minimal elegant typography with exactly three lines: "SEOUL", "SOUTH KOREA", and "A CITY IN LAYERS". Use a premium editorial travel-poster aesthetic, whimsical handcrafted paper sculpture, realistic architecture, layered depth, delicate paper fibers, soft studio lighting, subtle ambient shadows, refined composition, clean negative space and highly detailed collectible design. Avoid photorealism, plastic, glossy CGI, metallic surfaces, clutter, distorted landmarks, extra text and oversaturated colors.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张以韩国首尔为主题的高级竖版4:5旅游海报，设计为手工分层3D剪纸微缩世界。使用带细微纹理的柔和马卡龙色纸张背景、雕塑般的云朵、纹理卡纸层、真实剪纸边缘、纸张纤维、柔和阴影和优雅的3D深度。将南山首尔塔作为核心主体，周围环绕景福宫、传统韩屋屋顶、汉江与桥梁、首尔街道、咖啡馆、树木、当地公交车和用于体现比例与叙事的微小剪纸人物。使用奶油色、暖米色、柔和绿色、灰粉色、柔和蓝色和陶土色等城市灵感色调。顶部只添加三行精致排版："SEOUL"、"SOUTH KOREA"和"A CITY IN LAYERS"。采用高级编辑旅游海报美学、奇幻手工纸雕塑、写实建筑、分层深度、细腻纸张纤维、柔和影棚光效、微妙环境阴影、精致构图、干净留白和高细节收藏级设计。避免照片写实主义、塑料感、光泽CGI、金属表面、杂乱、扭曲地标、额外文字和过度饱和。

items.title: 1930年代橡胶软管风家电吉祥物海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的复古橡胶软管风吉祥物海报模板。将洗衣机、仙人掌、吸尘器或打字机等日常物品转译为单一运动中的钩针/定格动画式角色，并提供双关标题、爆炸框文字、碎片和配件变量。
items.prompt:
Subject object: washing machine
Pun title: SPIN OUT
Boast: SO FRESH
Shout: FULL SPEED
Debris: laundry and suds
Costume accessory: sweatband set

Create a premium 9:16 tall poster on aged cream paper #F4E9CF with soft print grain and light ink misregistration. Turn washing machine into one recognizable everyday-object mascot in a 1930s rubber-hose stop-motion style: skinny black limbs, white or yellow gloves, oversized sneakers or boots, and a face drawn on the object’s own surface. Keep the object recognizable at thumbnail size and let it perform its own function as a sport or show. Add sweatband set as exactly one performer accessory, with laundry and suds orbiting as the job’s output.

Use a five-ink retro palette: cream #F4E9CF, red-orange #E05A2B, mustard #E8B33A, mid blue #3E6FB0, and ink black #1C1814. Allow one extra hue only when the object itself requires it, such as cactus green. Use halftone dots in shadows and no gradients; depth comes from bevel shadows and halftone.

Set SPIN OUT in two fat rounded words with cream fill, red-orange outline, hard bevel shadow, and a lively arc at the top or bottom. The title must read as both the object’s function and an attitude. Place exactly two opposite-corner bursts: a yellow starburst containing SO FRESH and a blue or red burst containing FULL SPEED. Add red-orange checkered strips along two edges, with small sparkles, crescent moons, and dust puffs in the gaps. Show one character mid-motion with feet barely touching the ground. Negative: no glowing magic, real human skin, messy unspooled yarn, cheap synthetic texture, or distorted object silhouette.
items.prompt_zh:
主题物体：washing machine
双关标题：SPIN OUT
自夸语：SO FRESH
呐喊语：FULL SPEED
环绕碎片：laundry and suds
表演者配件：sweatband set

创作一张 9:16 竖向海报，使用做旧奶油色纸张 #F4E9CF、柔软印刷纹理和轻微油墨套印不准。将 washing machine 变成一个可辨识的日常物品吉祥物，采用 1930 年代橡胶软管定格动画风格：细长黑色肢体、白色或黄色手套、超大号运动鞋或靴子，面部画在物体自身表面。物体在缩略图大小下必须保持可辨识，并把自身功能表现成运动或表演。恰好添加一件 sweatband set 表演者配件，让 laundry and suds 作为工作产物环绕角色。

使用五色复古调色：奶油色 #F4E9CF、红橙色 #E05A2B、芥末黄 #E8B33A、中蓝色 #3E6FB0 和墨黑色 #1C1814。只有当物体本身需要时才允许一种额外色调，例如仙人掌绿。阴影使用半色调网点，不使用渐变；深度仅来自斜边阴影和半色调。

将 SPIN OUT 排成两个肥厚圆润的单词，奶油色填充、红橙色轮廓、硬斜边阴影，在顶部或底部沿活泼弧线排列。标题必须同时表达物体的功能和一种态度。在相对的两个角落各放一个爆炸框：黄色星形框写入 SO FRESH，蓝色或红色尖锐爆炸框写入 FULL SPEED。沿两条边添加红橙色格子带，间隙中加入小四角星、新月和尘埃云。只展示一个运动中的角色，双脚几乎离地。负面：无发光魔法、真实人类皮肤、凌乱的未缠绕纱线、廉价合成纹理或变形的物体轮廓。

items.title: 极近景中国清纯女性美容肖像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

A high-completion, realistic photography texture beauty portrait of a young adult Chinese female in an extreme close-up. The character's visual age is approximately 20–26 years old, with natural and clear Chinese female characteristics. The overall temperament is pure, fragile, quiet, moist, with light emotion and a cinematic feel; a clear sense of adulthood, not childish, not Westernized, not internet-celebrity style, and not copying the specific bone structure of any reference person, only drawing inspiration from ideal skin clarity, eye brightness, moist makeup, close-up lens language, and soft-light beauty photography atmosphere.

The character adopts the 'B | Bright-Eyed Cinematic Face.' The face shape and bone structure are a slightly long oval face, with low-key cheekbones, a soft and full mid-face, and a delicate but not overly sharp jawline. The overall appearance maintains a realistic and reasonable Oriental soft bone structure: a naturally full forehead, smooth temples, cheekbones with slight support but not expanding outward, a soft and plump mid-face, delicate and soft cheeks, a clear and delicate jawline but not sharp, a small and exquisite chin but not overly pointed, and smooth, natural facial lines, presenting a Chinese young female facial structure with a cinematic lead actress feel.

The eye design features large apricot eyes with a slight drooping sensation, tea amber irises, more distinct tear lines on the lower eyelids, an enhanced sense of a water film on the cornea, and long-strip window-shaped highlights in both eyes. The character has large, bright Oriental apricot eyes, stretching horizontally, with a larger vertical opening but maintaining real-life proportions, and the outer corners of the eyes slightly droop naturally, presenting a gentle, fragile, and quiet gaze temperament; natural and soft double eyelids, with clear but not overly exaggerated tear troughs (aegyo-sal). The iris is a transparent tea amber color, with fine and realistic radial textures, clear pupil boundaries, and a natural deep brown outer ring; under front soft light, it has slight layers of honey brown and amber brown. The whites of the eyes are bright and clear but not dead white, the tear lines on the lower eyelids are more distinct than in conventional close-ups, the cornea has a stronger sense of a moist and transparent water film, and the inner corners of the eyes are slightly moist. Both eyes have large-area, horizontally extended long-strip window-shaped highlights that truly enter the interior of the iris, making the eyes as a whole appear moist, bright, transparent, emotional, and full of vitality, becoming the first visual focus of the entire portrait.

The nose and lip design features a slender and natural bridge, a small round nose tip, soft and slightly parted lips, and a moist and full lower lip. The root of the nose is natural, the bridge is fine and straight but not overly sharp, the tip is small and rounded, and the wings of the nose are constricted while retaining a realistic structure; the lips are naturally soft, slightly parted, with a gentle cupid's bow, and the lower lip has a more moist and full feel, retaining slight realistic lip lines, presenting a delicate, moist, slightly glossy but not overly vitrified realistic lip texture.

The skin adopts a cold white water-porcelain low-frequency skin, moist but not oily. The skin tone is a high-brightness, low-saturation, neutral-to-cold white water-porcelain base, overall white, pure, soft, and transparent, significantly reducing yellow tones, gray tones, earthy tones, and fleshy pink tones. Large areas of the cheeks, forehead, and chin maintain a low-frequency, flat, quiet, and delicate skin surface, with almost no visible pores, coarse particles, or high-frequency skin noise. Skin realism does not rely on large areas of pores but is reflected through natural facial structures, continuous transitions of light and shadow, subcutaneous light transmission, and extremely slight real micro-structures around the wings of the nose, eyes, and lips. The overall appearance has a soft moist feel, but is never oily, never has heavy reflections, and is never plastic. Large areas of the face remain cold and pure porcelain white, with only a very low concentration of light pink blood color retained under the eyes, around the eyes, in a small area at the center of the apple muscles, the tip of the nose, and the lips, forming a color relationship of "white is the main body, pink is the embellishment." The forehead, bridge of the nose, apple muscles, and cupid's bow have wide and soft micro-highlights, making the skin appear white, delicate, moist, and transparent, but never wax-like and never CG-like.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

一张高完成度、真实摄影质感的中国年轻成年女性极近景美容肖像。人物视觉年龄约 20–26 岁，具有自然明确的中国女性特征，整体气质清纯、柔弱感、安静、湿润、带轻情绪与电影感，成年感明确，不幼态，不欧美化，不网红化，不复制任何参考人物的具体骨相，仅借鉴理想中的皮肤净度、眼睛明亮度、湿润妆感、近景镜头语言与柔光美容摄影氛围。

人物采用 B｜明眸电影脸。脸型与骨相为偏长鹅蛋脸，颧骨低调，面中柔和饱满，下颌纤秀但不过尖。整体保持真实合理的东方柔和骨相：额头自然饱满，太阳穴平滑，颧骨存在轻微支撑但不外扩，面中柔和丰润，脸颊细腻柔软，下颌线清晰纤秀但不锋利，下巴小巧精致但不过尖，脸部线条流畅自然，呈现具有电影女主感的中国年轻女性面部结构。

眼部设计为大杏眼略带下垂感，茶琥珀虹膜，下眼睑泪线更明确，角膜水膜感加强，双眼长条窗型高光。人物拥有偏大的明亮东方杏眼，横向舒展，纵向开合偏大但保持真人比例，眼尾略带自然下垂感，呈现温柔、脆弱、安静的眼神气质；双眼皮自然柔和，卧蚕清晰但不过分夸张。虹膜为通透的茶琥珀色，具有细密真实的放射状纹理、清晰的瞳孔边界与自然深棕外缘环，在正面柔光照射下带有轻微蜂蜜棕与琥珀棕层次。眼白明亮清澈但不死白，下眼睑泪线比常规近景更明确，角膜具有更强的湿润透明水膜感，内眼角轻微湿润。双眼均带有较大面积、横向延展的长条窗型高光，真正进入虹膜内部，使眼睛整体显得湿润、明亮、通透、有情绪、有生命力，成为整张肖像的第一视觉中心。

鼻唇设计为纤细自然鼻梁，小圆鼻尖，柔软微启唇，下唇水润饱满。鼻根自然，鼻梁细秀顺直但不过分刀削，鼻尖小巧圆润，鼻翼收敛且保留真实结构；嘴唇自然柔软，微微张开，唇峰温和，下唇更具水润饱满感，保留轻微真实唇纹，呈现细腻柔润、轻微水光但不过分玻璃化的真实唇部质感。

皮肤采用冷白水瓷低频肌，皮肤水润但不油亮。肤色为高明度、低饱和、中性偏冷的冷白水瓷基底，整体白净、纯净、柔和、通透，明显降低黄调、灰调、土色感与肉粉感。大面积面颊、额头与下巴保持低频、平整、安静、细腻的皮肤表面，几乎看不到明显毛孔、粗糙颗粒和高频皮肤噪声。皮肤真实感不依赖大面积毛孔，而通过自然面部结构、连续明暗过渡、皮下透光，以及鼻翼、眼周与唇周极轻微真实微结构来体现。整体带有轻柔水润感，但绝不油亮、绝不厚重反光、绝不塑料。脸部大面积保持冷净瓷白，仅在眼下、眼周、苹果肌中心小范围、鼻尖和嘴唇保留极低浓度的淡粉血色，形成“白是主体、粉是点缀”的色彩关系。额头、鼻梁、苹果肌与唇峰带有宽而柔和的微水光，皮肤显得白净、细腻、湿润、通透，但绝不蜡像、绝不 CG 化。

妆容采用极淡玫粉湿润妆，眼下粉色稍明显，唇部淡玫瑰裸粉。眼周使用极淡玫粉、灰粉玫瑰色与轻柔裸粉进行低浓度晕染，上下眼睑之间有柔和的粉润呼应，眼下粉色气息比普通清透妆稍明显，但仍保持克制和自然；眼尾仅以极细自然眼线轻微修饰。睫毛为黑褐色或深棕黑，纤长、根根分明、自然卷翘，密度适中，不夸张不厚重。腮红轻柔集中在眼下与苹果肌中心小范围，呈现若有若无的湿润气色。嘴唇采用淡玫瑰裸粉色，低饱和、柔润、轻反光、保留真实细唇纹，传达含蓄、安静、轻情绪的电影感。

发型为黑色柔顺长发，发根自然，中分，几缕略带湿润感的细碎发贴近脸侧。头发整体柔顺自然，发丝保留真人摄影质感与适量高频细节，单根发丝自然可辨，不出现塑料发丝、假发感和 CG 边缘；几缕靠近脸侧的细碎发带有若有若无的湿润贴肤感，增强雨后般的脆弱、柔软与情绪氛围，但整体造型仍然干净克制，不凌乱，不脏。

摄影采用 105mm 极近景，正面面向镜头，低饱和蓝灰背景。使用 105mm 长焦美容人像镜头语言，避免广角透视畸变。人物脸部占据画面约 70%–90%，正面直视镜头，双眼位于视觉中心偏上区域。焦点优先锁定双眼、虹膜与睫毛，嘴唇次清晰，耳部和后侧头发可轻微虚化。画面整体遵循“低频皮肤 + 高频五官”的摄影原则：皮肤大面积区域局部反差较低，睫毛、虹膜、瞳孔、泪线、唇纹与发丝保持较高真实度与清晰度。

光线采用高调正面美容柔光系统：一个超大面积柔光源位于摄影机正前方、略高于人物眼睛并靠近人物，柔和向下照射，同时存在低强度柔和补光，使人物面部整体明亮均匀，眼窝、鼻翼、眼下与下颌阴影非常浅且干净。皮肤高光宽而柔和，白净通透但不死白过曝，阴影保持中性或轻微冷调，不发黄、不发灰绿、不发脏。背景采用低饱和蓝灰色，亮度低于人物脸部约半档到一档，保持高度简洁和弱化，以衬托人物肤色更显白净、清冷、湿润、纯净。

画幅比例为 9:16。整体效果应呈现：一位具有真人摄影真实性的中国清纯美人，皮肤安静、白净、细腻、低频，眼睛湿润、明亮、通透，带有更强的角膜水膜感与轻情绪表达，妆面轻盈柔润，整体既真实又带有高完成度美容近景的高级感，传达出雨后般清冷、脆弱、安静、带电影故事感的美人气质。

items.title: 孔版印刷剪纸拼贴旅行海报
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的三印版、纸张纤维和人物地标拼贴旅行海报模板。
items.prompt: Create a 3:4 vertical travel poster as a handmade risograph or screenprint and cut-paper collage scanned from physical paper. Use KYOTO GATE as the city landmark/title text. Put wind finds the old street on the first handwritten travel-note line and a short walk to the sea on the second line of the coral band. Use warm cream fiber paper #F1E7D6 with visible tooth and one subtle fold crease; paper is the lightest value and no white ink is used. Use only three plates: black, pale sea teal and coral; plate overlaps create the only additional hues, and black coverage stays below 35%. Set KYOTO GATE in ultra-condensed heavy grotesque uppercase lettering over two stacked lines, bleeding slightly past both side edges and filling about 65% of the frame height, with the second line wider than the first. Use black letters with a 3mm coral misregistration ghost. Include one adult woman in her early twenties with wind-lifted hair standing in the destination's defining pedestrian or public area. Show her in three-quarter view turned back over her shoulder, with one hand holding her hair away from her face. Use the uploaded reference as the facial identity reference for this only adult woman; match facial identity only. Place her in front of the typography so she partly covers it: letters cut off at the figure while the top third of every letter remains clear. Render skin as dense black halftone photo-transfer with varying dot density and paper showing through highlights. Make her silhouette hand-cut paper with a 4mm bare-paper margin and thin teal offset outline. Use glued-paper textures with torn edges for clothing and accessories, a coral cross-hatch weave for a jacket or windbreaker, and pale teal cloud-print trousers. Add one distinctive local visual fragment behind her shoulder and a torn kraft-paper scrap attached to or near the bag. Place a flat semi-opaque coral rectangle across her eyes, slightly wider than the face; eyes remain visible underneath as dark halftone, with imperfect physically printed edges. Put one instantly recognizable architectural or structural landmark left of center. Fan signature lines, cables, streets, coastlines or structural elements toward both edges as thin black lines; show the recognizable destination environment far behind in flat teal halftone, with foreground paths, streets, steps or architecture converging naturally across the bottom. Add a coral drybrush band low on the horizon, a teal diagonal band upper-left, and small destination-specific environmental silhouettes in the upper-right and lower-left. On the coral band at mid-right, set two lines of small lowercase marker handwriting as “wind finds the old street / a short walk to the sea”. Show ink sinking into paper fiber, authentic plate misregistration, cut edges, faint scan noise, matte print and handmade imperfections. Maintain an even 8% margin on all sides. Avoid photorealistic skin, glossy or vector-smooth finish, 3D shading, painterly rendering, neon glow, gradients, signature, watermark, edition number, extra people, signage, logos, doodle lines or any other text; the main title and handwritten note are the only text elements.
items.prompt_zh: 创作3:4竖幅旅行海报，采用从实物纸张扫描的手工孔版/丝网印刷与剪纸拼贴。城市地标/标题文字为：KYOTO GATE；珊瑚色带上的手写旅行笔记第一行：wind finds the old street；第二行：a short walk to the sea。使用暖奶油色纤维纸 #F1E7D6，可见纸纹和一道细微折痕，纸张为最浅色调且不使用白墨。只用三个印版：黑色、淡海青和珊瑚色，印版重叠才产生额外色调，黑色覆盖率低于35%。KYOTO GATE用超压缩厚重怪诞体大写，堆叠两行，略超出左右边缘，占画面高度约65%，第二行更宽，黑字带3毫米珊瑚色套印偏移虚影。画面中有一位二十出头的成年女性，头发被风吹起，站在目的地标志性行人或公共区域；四分之三视角回望肩膀，一只手将头发拨离脸部。她位于字体前并部分遮挡文字，字母在人物处被切断但每个字母上三分之一清晰。使用上传参考图作为唯一成年女性的面部身份参考，仅匹配面部身份。皮肤用不同网点密度的密集黑色半色调照片转印，高光透出纸张；人物剪影是手工切纸，带4毫米裸纸边和细海青偏移轮廓。衣服和配饰使用撕边胶贴纸纹理，夹克/风衣为珊瑚色交叉排线，裤子为淡海青云纹；肩后加入一个当地视觉碎片，包上或附近贴一块撕裂牛皮纸。双眼横跨扁平半透明珊瑚矩形，略宽于脸，眼睛在下方以深色半调仍可见，边缘略不规则有物理印刷感。背景中心偏左放一个立即可辨认的建筑或结构地标，标志线、电缆、街道、海岸线或结构线以细黑线向两侧展开，远处目的地环境为平面海青半调，底部路径、街道、台阶或建筑线自然汇聚。近地平线加珊瑚干刷带，左上加海青斜带，右上与左下加入目的地环境剪影。珊瑚带中右放两行小写马克笔手写笔记，使用上述变量，以“wind finds the old street / a short walk to the sea”排版。表现墨入纸纤维、套印偏移、物理切纸边、扫描噪点、哑光、手工瑕疵，四周均匀8%边距。避免写实皮肤、光泽或矢量平滑、3D阴影、绘画渲染、霓虹、渐变、签名、水印、版次编号、额外人物、标牌、标志、涂鸦线和其他文字；主标题与手写笔记是唯一文字。

items.title: 超写实人像与手绘素描创意组合
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create an ultra-realistic editorial portrait using the uploaded photo as the exact reference for the person. Preserve the person’s facial identity, facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, clothing, accessories, and pose accurately.

Create a creative split-style composition where the real person is naturally positioned beside a highly detailed hand-drawn pencil sketch of the exact same person. The sketch must precisely replicate the person’s pose, hairstyle, sunglasses, outfit, shoes, bag, coffee cup, magazine, and body proportions.

The real person should look completely photorealistic with natural skin texture, realistic hair strands, authentic fabric details, soft natural lighting, subtle shadows, and cinematic depth. The sketch should be monochrome graphite/ink with fine pencil strokes, cross-hatching, realistic line variation, hand-drawn imperfections, and artistic shading.

Place the real person against a clean warm beige/cream wall in a minimalist fashion-editorial setting. Make the sketch appear as if it has been hand-drawn directly onto the wall beside the real person, perfectly aligned with the real pose.

Add small hand-drawn doodles around the sketch, including hearts, stars, motion lines, and subtle artistic marks. Include a small tilted Polaroid-style inset photo of the original person near the bottom-left corner with rounded white borders.

Maintain a sophisticated fashion magazine aesthetic, warm neutral tones, soft daylight, realistic textures, balanced composition, premium editorial photography, ultra-detailed, cinematic, high-end creative campaign, 4K quality.

Important: Keep the person’s identity, face, pose, hands, body proportions, clothing, accessories, and hairstyle consistent with the uploaded reference. Do not distort the face or body. Do not add extra people. No unwanted text, logos, captions, or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

使用上传的照片作为人物的精确参考，创建一个超写实的编辑型肖像。准确地保留人物的面部身份、面部特征、发型、肤色、身体比例、服装、配饰和姿势。创建一个创意的分割式构图，将真人自然地放置在完全相同人物的高细节手绘铅笔素描旁边。素描必须精确地复制人物的姿势、发型、太阳镜、服装、鞋子、包、咖啡杯、杂志和身体比例。真人应该看起来完全写实，具有自然的皮肤纹理、逼真的发丝、真实的织物细节、柔和的自然光照、细微的阴影和电影深度。素描应该是单色的石墨/墨水，具有精细的铅笔线条、交叉阴影、真实的线条变化、手绘的不完美感和艺术阴影。将真人放置在极简时尚编辑场景中干净的暖米色/乳白色墙壁前。让素描看起来像是直接手绘在真人旁边的墙上，并与真实的姿势完美对齐。在素描周围添加小型手绘涂鸦，包括心形、星星、运动线条和细微的艺术标记。在左下角附近包含一张原图人物的小倾斜宝丽来风格插图照片，带有圆角白色边框。保持精致的时尚杂志美感、暖色调中性色、柔和日光、真实纹理、平衡的构图、高级编辑摄影、超细节、电影感、高端创意活动、4K画质。重要：保持人物的身份、面部、姿势、手、身体比例、服装、配饰和发型与上传的参考图一致。不要扭曲面部或身体。不要添加额外的人。不要出现多余的文本、标志、标题或水印。

items.title: 象牙白开衫东亚女性室内暗调人像

items.prompt: A young adult East Asian woman in her 20s stands in front of a pure black studio background, the shot framed from the top of the head to near the waist. The subject is positioned slightly to the right of center, body slightly turned toward the left of the frame, shoulders relaxed, head tilted up and slightly back, looking calmly directly into the camera. Lips are naturally slightly parted, expression is quiet, restrained, with a slight sense of detachment. She has a refined, slightly elongated oval face, a soft and clear jawline, almond-shaped deep brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender bridge of the nose, and moist rose nude pink lips. Makeup is light, with sheer foundation, natural lashes, thin eyeliner, light warm brown eyeshadow, and soft pink blush. Fair skin tone with a neutral-cool undertone, preserving real pores, fine vellus hair, natural skin tone variations, and slight sebum highlights, no plastic skin smoothing. Deep brown-black hair styled in a loose low bun or mid-low bun, with light wispy bangs on the forehead, a few long thin strands falling beside the face, and natural stray hairs and slight volume maintained at the top. She wears an ivory white loose chunky knit cardigan, with a deep V-neck, large white buttons, oversized long sleeves, and clear ribbed knit textures. The cardigan naturally slides off one shoulder, revealing the collarbone and shoulder line, but the chest is fully covered by the garment. Both hands gently grasp the edges of the cardigan and near the buttons in front of the chest, fingers naturally relaxed. The background is a gradient from pure black to deep charcoal gray, without any props. Strong and concentrated side-top lighting shines from the upper left front of the frame, creating bright highlights on the forehead, bridge of the nose, lips, collarbone, shoulder, and white knit surface; the right side of the face and clothing enter deep, soft shadows. Preserve clear light and dark partitions, rich shadow layers, and slight highlight bloom. Photography style: 85mm or 105mm portrait lens, f/2, eye-level slightly low angle, medium-shallow depth of field, focus on eyes, lips, and hands, realistic skin, hair strands, wool fibers, buttons, and knit folds, ISO400 fine film grain, Black Pro-Mist 1/8 soft diffusion, low-key beauty editorial, cinematic studio portrait, photorealistic. Avoid: underage features, nudity, nipple exposure, transparent knits, exaggerated body proportions, heavy makeup, incorrect off-shoulder structure, deformed fingers, extra arms, incorrect buttons, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, strong HDR, over-sharpening, gray cluttered background, CG, anime, text, watermark, Logo.
items.prompt_zh:
一位20多岁的年轻成年东亚女性站在纯黑色摄影棚背景前，画面从头顶拍至腰部附近。人物位于中央略偏右，身体微微朝画面左侧转动，肩膀放松，头部轻抬并略向后仰，平静直视镜头。嘴唇自然微启，神情安静、克制、略带疏离感。

她拥有精致偏长的鹅蛋脸、柔和清晰的下颌线、杏仁形深棕眼睛、自然细眉、纤细鼻梁和水润玫瑰裸粉色嘴唇。妆容清淡，轻薄底妆、自然睫毛、细眼线、浅暖棕眼影和柔和粉色腮红。肤色白皙偏中性冷调，保留真实毛孔、细小绒毛、自然肤色变化和轻微皮脂高光，不要塑料磨皮。

深棕黑色头发盘成松散低发髻或中低位发髻，额前有轻薄碎刘海，脸侧垂落几缕细长发丝，头顶保留自然碎发与轻微蓬松感。

她穿一件象牙白色宽松粗针织开衫，深V领、大号白色纽扣、宽大长袖与明显罗纹针织纹理。开衫自然滑落一侧肩膀，露出锁骨和肩线，但胸前由衣物完整遮挡。双手在胸前轻轻抓住开衫边缘与纽扣附近，手指自然放松。

背景为纯黑至深炭灰渐变，无任何道具。强烈而集中的侧上方光线从画面左前上方照射，在额头、鼻梁、嘴唇、锁骨、肩膀与白色针织表面形成明亮高光；右侧面部和衣物进入深而柔和的阴影。保留明显明暗分区、丰富暗部层次与轻微高光溢出。

摄影风格：85mm或105mm人像镜头，f/2，平视略低机位，中浅景深，焦点落在双眼、嘴唇和手部，真实皮肤、发丝、羊毛纤维、纽扣和针织褶皱，ISO400细腻胶片颗粒，Black Pro-Mist 1/8轻柔扩散，low-key beauty editorial，cinematic studio portrait，photorealistic。

items.title: 东方古风红衣女侠水墨武侠海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Oriental ancient style female warrior, young adult female, delicate and natural facial features with a slight mixed-race feel, long black hair in a high bun + partially loose hair, red hairpins/hairbands/ribbons, silver tassel earrings.

Temperament: Cold and elegant, sharp, heroic, murderous but not stiff, eyes sharp with a sense of oppression (different gazes in different scenes).

Clothing: Bright red ancient style female warrior long dress + tube top overlapping top + translucent red gauze wide sleeves + black dark-patterned waist seal (waist-cinching) + multi-layered red gauze long skirt (high slit) + red, black, blue, and purple ribbons.

Accessories: Black and red scabbard + red sword tassel, high-heeled lace-up shoes.

Weapon: Oriental ancient sword (silver-white blade + dark patterns + metal carved handguard + exquisite hilt), no Western swords.

Style: Oriental martial arts movie poster + ink-wash rice paper background + high-end fashion magazine layout + realistic photography fused with ink-wash illustration + large white space + black wild cursive calligraphy + red and black contrast + ink dots/petals/dust particles.

2. Four Storyboard Scenes

1 | Desert Lonely Sword (Static Long Shot)
Ultra-wide shot, small full-body proportion (bottom 1/3 of the frame), desert + large area of sky white space.
Standing holding a sword, sword tip touching the ground or pointing diagonally at the ground, another sword stabbed into the sandy ground behind.
Expression calm and indifferent, eyes looking into the distance, not looking directly at the camera.
White space at the top of the frame + vertical poems + red stamps.

2 | Drawing Sword and Slashing Diagonally (Dynamic Mid-Close Shot)
Character occupies 70%, side-view drawing the sword.
Action: Draw sword → Turn waist → Drop shoulders → Slash diagonally (top right → bottom left).
The sword forms a strong diagonal composition.
Expression: Pressed eyebrows, murderous intent, locking onto the target.
Ribbons + sleeves + hair are strongly driven by movement.
Wild cursive large characters on the left: Red Robe Slashes the Heart.
Vertical short sentences on the right (optional).

3 | Horizontal Sword Swing (Close-up Perspective)
Half-body to thighs, character on the right, white space + ink writing on the left.
Horizontal-diagonal sword swing (top right → bottom left), the sword is very close to the lens forming perspective.
Not looking at the camera, side-glance at the target, calm and dangerous.
Red gauze rolling like smoke, ribbons surrounding.
Wild cursive title on top left: Red Sleeve Slashes the Swan Shadow.

4 | Close-range Thrust (Oppressive)
Low-angle close-up, character pressing towards the camera.
Action: Hidden sword → Step forward → Turn waist → Flip wrist → Straight thrust at the camera (diagonal line).
Sword tip is extremely close to the lens, strong perspective.
Expression focused and cold, murderous but not exaggerated.
Red gauze exploding + skirt hem like waves.
Wild cursive on the left: Red Sleeve Startles the Swan.

3. Universal Visual Keywords
Ink-wash rice paper background | Large white space | Black wild cursive calligraphy | Vermilion seal | Ink splashes | Red petals | Dust particles | Cinematic realistic photography | Oriental martial arts poster | Modern graphic design | calligraphy typography | cinematic wuxia style

4. Sword Qi (Simplified)
Thin white air-cutting tracks + a small amount of dark red flowing light + particle ink dots.
Extends along the direction of the sword, does not block the character and weapon.

5. Negative Prompt
Actions not conforming to human mechanics | Wrong sword grip | Finger deformity | Extra hands and arms | Floating weapons | Deformed sword | Stiff expression | Uncanny valley face | Looking directly at the camera (unless specified) | Plastic skin | Cyber neon | Laser special effects | Western armor | Japanese katana | Modern clothing | Watermark logo gibberish
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

东方古风女侠，年轻成年女性，五官精致自然略带混血感，黑长发高盘发+部分散发，红色发簪/发带/飘带，银色流苏耳坠。

气质：冷艳、凌厉、英气、有杀气但不僵硬，眼神锐利有压迫感（不同画面不同视线）。

服装：正红古风女侠长裙 + 抹胸交叠上衣 + 半透明红纱广袖 + 黑色暗纹腰封（收腰）+ 多层红纱长裙（高开衩）+ 红黑蓝紫飘带。

配饰：黑红剑鞘+红色剑穗流苏，高跟绑带鞋。

武器：东方古剑（银白剑身+暗纹+金属雕花护手+精致剑柄），不要西方剑。

风格：东方武侠电影海报 + 水墨宣纸背景 + 高级时尚杂志排版 + 写实摄影融合水墨插画 + 大留白 + 黑色狂草书法 + 红黑对比 + 墨点/花瓣/尘粒。

二、四张分镜

1｜荒漠孤剑（静态远景）

超远景，全身小比例（画面下方1/3），沙漠+大面积天空留白。

站立持剑，剑尖垂地或斜指地面，另一把剑插在身后沙地。

表情冷静淡漠，眼神看远方，不直视镜头。

画面上方留白+竖排诗词+红印章。

2｜拔剑斜斩（动态中近景）

人物占70%，侧身拔剑。

动作：拔剑→转腰→沉肩→斜向斩出（右上→左下）。

剑形成强烈斜线构图。

表情：压眉、杀气、锁定目标。

飘带+袖子+头发强烈被带动。

左侧狂草大字：红衣斩心

右侧竖排短句（可选）。

3｜横向挥剑（近景透视）

半身到大腿，人物在右侧，左侧留白+墨书。

横斜挥剑（右上→左下），剑非常靠近镜头形成透视。

不看镜头，侧视目标，冷静危险。

红纱像烟雾翻卷，飘带环绕。

左上狂草标题：红袖斩鸿影

4｜近距离刺击（压迫感）

低机位近景，人物压向镜头。

动作：藏剑→跨步→转腰→翻腕→直刺镜头（斜线）。

剑尖极近镜头，强透视。

表情专注冷酷，有杀气但不夸张。

红纱炸开+裙摆如浪。

左侧狂草：红袖惊鸿

三、通用视觉关键词

水墨宣纸背景｜大留白｜黑色狂草书法｜朱红印章｜墨点飞溅｜红色花瓣｜尘粒｜电影级写实摄影｜东方武侠海报｜现代平面设计｜calligraphy typography｜cinematic wuxia style

四、剑气（简化）

细白色空气切割轨迹 + 少量暗红流光 + 粒子墨点
沿剑方向延伸，不遮挡人物与武器。

五、负面提示词

动作不符合人体力学｜错误握剑｜手指畸形｜多手多臂｜武器漂浮｜剑变形｜僵硬表情｜恐怖谷脸｜直视镜头（除非指定）｜塑料皮肤｜赛博霓虹｜激光特效｜西方铠甲｜日式武士刀｜现代服装｜水印logo乱码

items.title: 东方文化竖三栏展览海报模板
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的高信息密度东方文化展览海报工作流模板。
items.prompt: Theme: Ceramic, cloud and mountain material study. Chinese title: 器物与山水. English title: Objects and Mountains. Core subject: A ceremonial vessel crossing a misty mountain scene. Three-column relationship: Artifact Crossing. Left column content: material samples and pattern research. Middle column content: the main vessel and mountain image. Right column content: structure, date and venue archive. Main color palette: bone white, vermilion, cobalt blue and ochre. Date / venue: 2026 / East Asia Cultural Hall. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Generate a high-aesthetic, high-information-density Oriental culture exhibition poster in a vertical left-middle-right three-column composition. Do not divide the columns equally or turn them into three independent information boxes. Adjust widths according to the theme so each column has a different visual responsibility, then actively cross column lines with subjects, text, lines or materials to reconnect the areas into one complete image. Choose a suitable structure: character crossing, same-subject three-column variation, middle-column main scene or artifact crossing. A character may occupy the middle while sleeves, skirt hems or ornaments enter the side columns; a continuous subject may pass through all columns with different materials, stages or states but one uninterrupted outline; the strongest mountain, building or image may anchor the middle while titles, dates, materials and research occupy the sides, with subject or mist crossing columns; a large artifact may enter other columns diagonally or horizontally to break the vertical grid. Redesign typography to suit the image using an oversized single character, full horizontal title, cross-column title, medium title or small information spine. Never force a fixed four-character vertical layout or a two-horizontal-plus-two-vertical title template. Keep information density close to a mature museum poster, art catalog and editorial design: include an English subtitle, materials, structures, date, venue, a short curatorial sentence and a small amount of structural, material, process, sectional or pattern research drawing, concentrated in 2–3 areas rather than spread evenly. Use 3–5 main colors with large clean fields; black, bone white, vermilion, cobalt blue, deep cyan and ochre are suitable, while dirty gray, heavy aging and complex gradients are not. Deliver high definition, clean order, accurate subject proportions, sharp lettering and fine lines at the completion level of a mature cultural exhibition poster. Avoid mechanical three-way splitting, three independent cards, PPT information boxes, fixed title templates, undersized subjects, fragmented columns, random small text, meaningless decorative lines, excessive aging, mottled noise and a low-completion AI-poster feel.
items.prompt_zh: 主题：Ceramic, cloud and mountain material study；中文标题：器物与山水；英文标题：Objects and Mountains；核心主体：A ceremonial vessel crossing a misty mountain scene；三栏关系：Artifact Crossing；左栏内容：material samples and pattern research；中栏内容：the main vessel and mountain image；右栏内容：structure, date and venue archive；主色调：bone white, vermilion, cobalt blue and ochre；日期/场馆：2026 / East Asia Cultural Hall；画面比例：9:16。生成一张高审美、高信息密度的东方文化展览海报，采用竖三栏左中右构图。三栏不可平均切分，也不可做成三个独立信息框；根据主题灵活调整宽度，让各栏承担不同视觉职责，再通过主体、文字、线条或材质跨越栏线，把区域重新连接成完整画面。可采用人物跨栏、同一主体三栏变化、中栏主景或器物跨栏：人物可主要位于中栏并让衣袖、裙摆或饰物进入左右栏；连续主体须同时穿过三栏，在各栏呈现不同材质、阶段或状态但轮廓连续；最强主景置于中栏，左右栏承载标题、日期、材质和研究信息，并允许主体或云雾越栏；大型器物可斜向或横向打破竖向网格。根据结构重新设计字体，可用超大单字、完整横排、跨栏标题、中等标题或小型信息脊柱；不要固定四字纵排或“两字横排+两字竖排”模板。信息密度接近成熟博物馆海报、艺术图录和Editorial Design：加入英文副标题、材质、结构、日期、场馆、策展短句和少量结构线稿、材质研究、制作流程、剖面或纹样研究，但集中在2—3个区域，不平均铺满。使用3—5种主要颜色和大面积纯色域，允许黑、骨白、朱红、钴蓝、深青、赭色组合，避免脏灰、严重做旧和复杂渐变。要求高清、清晰、干净、信息丰富而有秩序，主体比例准确，文字和细线锐利，达到成熟文化展览海报完成度。避免机械三等分、三个独立卡片、PPT信息框、固定标题、主体过小、栏位割裂、随机小字、无意义装饰线、过度做旧、斑驳噪点和低完成度AI海报感。

items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a surreal, ultra-realistic low-angle fisheye photograph of a young man walking directly over the camera in the center of a grand European city square. The camera is placed almost flat against the cobblestone pavement, creating an extreme forced-perspective effect. One leg is lifted high toward the lens, with the sneaker sole dominating the foreground and appearing dramatically oversized, showing detailed rubber tread and realistic texture. His other foot remains planted on the ground. He reaches one hand directly toward the camera with an open palm and naturally spread fingers, creating strong depth and interaction with the viewer. He wears a blue denim jacket over a clean white T-shirt, relaxed blue jeans, and classic black-and-white canvas sneakers. He has short slightly tousled dark hair and subtle round glasses, with a calm, confident expression as he looks down toward the camera. Surround him with elegant historic European architecture curving dramatically around the frame because of the extreme 8mm fisheye lens. Bright blue summer sky with soft white clouds, strong sunlight and subtle lens flare, realistic shadows across the cobblestones, distant pedestrians and city details around the square. Extreme barrel distortion, circular architectural framing, dynamic perspective, crisp facial detail, realistic skin, denim and shoe textures, cinematic street photography, natural colors, high dynamic range, immersive depth, photorealistic, 8K detail.
