Ultra-realistic material detail, cinematic lighting, a fantasy atmosphere and hyper-detailed concept-art rendering. No people or human-shaped figures; the creature is entirely non-human. No readable text, logos, signatures or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 细致描绘一只站在魔法迷雾森林中的超现实神话鸟类生物。它拥有优雅多彩的蝴蝶身体，带有鲜艳且对称的蝴蝶翅纹。头部为雄伟的象头，具有大耳朵、长长的卷曲象鼻和象牙，散发强大而古老的气息。带斑点的长颈鹿式长颈从蝴蝶身体优雅地向上伸展，与象头相连。巨大的鹰翼从身体两侧完全展开，每根羽毛细节分明，画面定格在羽毛富有张力的运动瞬间。虹彩孔雀尾羽如华贵羽饰般充分扇形展开。将这些特征呈现为同一只完整生物相互连接的部位，并让蝴蝶身体、斑点长颈、象头、羽毛鹰翼和孔雀尾在画幅中清晰可辨。空灵光线笼罩生物，发光粒子飘浮在周围的森林薄雾中。呈现超逼真材质细节、电影式光照、奇幻氛围和高度精细的概念艺术渲染。不要出现人物或人形身影；该生物完全为非人类。不要出现可读文字、标志、签名或水印。

items.title: 透明容器里的无人物微型景观
items.description: A transparent capsule containing a small scenic diorama with no people, signage or logos, presented as a quiet studio still life.
items.prompt: Create a single high-end studio still life: a giant transparent glass capsule containing a miniature 3D diorama of a quiet mossy mountain valley with a small stream, stones, miniature trees and a simple footbridge. Use soft directional studio light, gentle shadows, realistic glass refraction, subtle condensation and a neutral matte surface. Keep the scene entirely person-free: no visitors, figures, faces, animals, signs, letters, logos, labels or watermarks. Emphasize the scale contrast between the capsule and the tiny landscape, tactile materials, calm surreal mood, clean composition and restrained natural colors. No text anywhere in the image.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅高端棚拍静物：一枚巨大的透明玻璃容器中放置一座无人物的微型山谷立体模型，包含苔藓山坡、细小溪流、石块、微型树木和简洁木桥。使用柔和的定向棚拍光、轻微阴影、真实玻璃折射、细微凝结水汽和中性哑光台面。画面必须完全无人：不得出现游客、人物、脸、动物、标牌、字母、标志、标签或水印。突出容器与微型景观的尺度反差、触感材质、安静超现实氛围、干净构图和克制自然色彩。画面任何位置都不要文字。

items.title: 东京站丸之内站舍建筑旅行手稿
items.description: Fine-art architectural sketchbook study of Tokyo Station Marunouchi Building transitioning from construction lines to a detailed graphite, ink, and watercolor architectural drawing.
items.prompt: Create a stunning 4:5 vertical fine-art sketch illustration of Tokyo Station Marunouchi Building, Tokyo, Japan, as if drawn by a master architectural artist inside a luxury travel sketchbook. Show the structure transitioning from loose preliminary pencil lines into a fully detailed finished architectural drawing. Include delicate construction lines, perspective guides, measurement marks, small handwritten architectural notes, compass marks, arrows, erased pencil strokes, and unfinished portions in the foreground. Toward the main structure, refine the drawing with graphite pencil, fine black ink, subtle watercolor washes, cross-hatching, and delicate hand-drawn textures. Include small artistic studies around the main drawing: a side elevation, an architectural detail, a window or ornament study, a simplified map outline, and a small scale silhouette without depicting identifiable people. Use an elegant warm ivory sketchbook-paper background with natural paper fibers and subtle imperfections. Keep the composition sophisticated and spacious, with the building as the unmistakable hero. Add only minimal handwritten labels: Tokyo Station Marunouchi Building; Tokyo, Japan; ARCHITECTURAL STUDY. No photorealistic rendering, 3D CGI, modern infographic boxes, excessive text, logos, or watermarks. No people or faces.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张令人惊叹的4:5纵向美术草图插画，描绘日本东京的东京站丸之内站舍，仿佛由建筑艺术大师在豪华旅行写生本中绘制。展示建筑从松散的初步铅笔线条过渡到细节完备的最终建筑图。前景包含细腻结构线、透视导向线、测量标记、小型手写建筑笔记、指南针标记、箭头、擦除的铅笔笔触和未完成部分。视线靠近主体建筑时，逐渐使用石墨铅笔、精细黑色墨水、微妙水彩晕染、排线阴影和细腻手绘纹理完成。主图周围包含侧立面图、建筑细节、窗户或装饰研究、简化地图轮廓，以及不描绘可识别人物的小型比例剪影。使用带天然纸张纤维和细微瑕疵的暖象牙色写生本纸张背景。构图精致宽敞，让建筑成为绝对主体。仅添加极简手写标签：东京站丸之内站舍；东京，日本；ARCHITECTURAL STUDY。不得出现照片级渲染、3D CGI、现代信息图框、冗余文字、标志或水印。不得出现人物或面孔。

items.title: 黑色挂脖连衣裙配深红色芭蕾鞋
items.description: A static fashion outfit reference featuring a black halter dress and coordinated accessories.
items.prompt: Outfit: A black halter dress with a fitted bodice, a sheer dotted yoke, and a softly flared knee-length skirt; dark-red ballet flats; a miniature black handbag; delicate black crystal earrings.
items.prompt_zh: 穿搭：一件黑色挂脖连衣裙，带有贴身的上身设计、半透明的波点拼接领口和柔软微喇的及膝裙摆；深红色芭蕾平底鞋；一个小巧的黑色手提包；精致的黑色水晶耳环。

items.title: 担担面食材悬浮分层海报
items.description: 纯黑背景中的担担面食材分解海报，以七个垂直层次呈现配料、红油汤底与成品，保留双语标注和明显留白过渡。
items.prompt:
Premium Chinese noodle restaurant food poster featuring deconstructed layers of Dan Dan Noodles / Spicy Sichuan Noodles floating in vertical stack on pure black background (#000000). Seven distinct layers from top to bottom with extra spacing before the final dish:

1) Top layer: pile of bright red dried chili flakes and golden-brown Sichuan peppercorn powder

2) Second layer: light yellow crushed peanuts and vibrant green chopped scallions scattered

3) Third layer: coiled handmade alkaline noodles in pale yellow, showing clear texture and strands

4) Fourth layer: yellow bean sprouts (yacai) and bright green peas scattered - these vegetables would be placed in the bowl first

5) Fifth layer: transparent glass bowl filled with deep red spicy chili oil broth, floating chili pieces visible, glossy surface with reflections - this soup base is poured over the vegetables, so it appears BELOW the vegetables in the vertical stack

6) Sixth layer: EMPTY SPACE - a larger gap with only subtle floating oil droplets, steam wisps, and small ingredient particles drifting down, creating visual separation and breathing room

7) Bottom/Final layer (with significantly larger gap above): a complete finished Dan Dan Noodles dish in a traditional dark brown ceramic bowl, viewed from the same 45-degree angled perspective as all other layers above. The bowl contains all ingredients combined - pale yellow noodles coated in glossy red chili oil, topped with crushed peanuts, bright green chopped scallions, bean sprouts, peas, and red chili flakes sprinkled on top. The noodles look freshly mixed and glistening with oil, subtle steam rising. This finished bowl is at the same scale and viewing angle as the deconstructed ingredients above. The extra spacing above emphasizes this as the final result, creating a dramatic reveal of the transformation from separated components to complete dish.

Each layer separated with gaps revealing textures and details. Layers 1-5 have normal spacing between them. Layer 6 is an intentional empty transition space with double or triple the normal gap distance. Layer 7 (finished dish) sits at the bottom with clear visual separation. Chinese and English bilingual labels with elegant arrows pointing to each component: "辣椒油&花椒粉 Chili Oil & Sichuan Pepper Powder", "麻辣风味 Numbing & Spicy Flavor", "花生碎&葱花 Crushed Peanuts & Scallions", "手工碱面 Handmade Noodles", "芽菜&豌豆 Yacai & Peas", "丰富配料 Rich Toppings", "红油汤底 Spicy Red Broth", "成品 Finished Dish".

NO white pedestal, NO platform base. All layers float freely in space against pure black background. Dramatic studio lighting from 45-degree angle, rim lighting highlighting textures and glass bowl transparency. All layers including the finished bowl share identical lighting, perspective angle, and photorealistic quality. Subtle steam effects, oil droplets floating around layers, with more particles in the empty transition space. Star sparkle effect in bottom right corner near the finished dish. Dark moody aesthetic, luxurious commercial food photography style, ultra-realistic, highly detailed, professional restaurant advertising quality, 9:16 vertical format.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张高端中式面馆食品海报，将担担面／川味辣面拆解成食材层，在纯黑背景（#000000）中垂直悬浮排列。从上到下共七个明确层次，成品上方留出更大的间距：

1）顶层：一堆鲜红干辣椒碎与金棕色花椒粉。
2）第二层：散落的浅黄色花生碎与鲜绿色葱花。
3）第三层：盘绕的浅黄色手工碱面，清楚呈现面条纹理和条缕。
4）第四层：散落的黄色豆芽（原文称 yacai）与鲜绿色豌豆；这些蔬菜会先放入碗中。
5）第五层：装有深红色麻辣红油汤底的透明玻璃碗，可见漂浮辣椒片、光泽表面与反射。汤底会倒在蔬菜上，因此分解图中位于蔬菜下方。
6）第六层：留空过渡区，间距更大，仅有细微悬浮油滴、蒸汽丝缕和少量下落食材颗粒，形成视觉分隔与呼吸空间。
7）最下方成品层：一碗完整担担面，盛在传统深棕色陶瓷碗中，与上方各层采用相同的45度斜视角度。浅黄色面条裹满有光泽的红油，混合花生碎、鲜绿葱花、豆芽、豌豆，并撒上红辣椒碎。面条呈现刚拌好的油润质感，微微冒热气。成品碗与上方拆解食材保持一致比例和视角。明显加大的上方间距强调从分离配料到完整菜肴的转变。

各层之间的间隙清楚展示纹理细节；第1至5层保持常规间距，第6层是常规间距两至三倍的空白过渡，第7层在底部清楚分离。用优雅箭头将以下中英文标签指向对应部分，保留来源指定字样：
“辣椒油&花椒粉 Chili Oil & Sichuan Pepper Powder”
“麻辣风味 Numbing & Spicy Flavor”
“花生碎&葱花 Crushed Peanuts & Scallions”
“手工碱面 Handmade Noodles”
“芽菜&豌豆 Yacai & Peas”
“丰富配料 Rich Toppings”
“红油汤底 Spicy Red Broth”
“成品 Finished Dish”。

不要白色底座或平台。所有层次都自由悬浮在纯黑背景中。使用45度方向的戏剧性摄影棚照明，以轮廓光突出食材纹理和玻璃碗的透明质感。包括成品碗在内的各层保持完全一致的照明、视角和照片写实质量。添加细微蒸汽和层间悬浮油滴，在空白过渡区安排更多微小颗粒。成品旁的右下角有星形闪光效果。整体为暗调、高端商业食品摄影，写实、细节丰富、专业面馆广告品质，9:16竖版。

items.title: 透明灯泡中的火箭升空
items.description: 用途：超现实创意概念图、创新主题视觉与装饰插画。透明灯泡封存火箭升空、浓烟与烈焰；来源含8K要求，实际输出规格需单独核验。
items.prompt: A surreal dreamlike scene inside one large transparent glass lightbulb, shown close up: a powerful rocket launches vertically upward entirely within the bulb. Massive billowing clouds of thick white-orange rocket exhaust fill the glass dome like a contained explosion. Bright orange-yellow launch flames glow at the base as the rocket pierces dense turbulent smoke. Keep launch-pad structures and support towers visible at the bottom inside the bulb. Soft warm golden light from the rocket flames illuminates the smoke from within. Show subtle reflections and refractions on the curved glass, intricate filament details near the bottom, and a metallic bronze screw base. Use a lighter background and a realistic shadow cast by the bulb onto the floor. Hyper-detailed surreal concept art, magical realism, cinematic lighting, high contrast, dramatic atmosphere, ultra-realistic textures and an Octane-render aesthetic; source-requested 8K image. Keep the bulb, rocket and shadow clearly readable as forms. No people or human figures.
items.prompt_zh: 一个超现实梦境般的场景，近距离展示一枚巨大透明玻璃灯泡的内部：一枚强劲火箭完全在灯泡内部垂直向上发射。厚重的白橙色火箭尾气浓烟滚滚翻腾，充满玻璃穹顶，仿佛被封存的爆炸。底部明亮的橙黄色发射火焰发光，火箭穿透浓密湍动的烟云。让灯泡内部底部的发射台结构与支撑塔保持可见。火箭火焰发出的柔和温暖金光由内照亮烟雾。表现弧形玻璃表面的微妙反射与折射、靠近底部的精细灯丝，以及青铜色金属螺口底座。使用较明亮的背景，并让灯泡在地面投下真实阴影。高度精细的超现实概念艺术、魔幻现实主义、电影式光照、高对比度、戏剧氛围、超真实纹理与Octane渲染风格；保留来源要求的8K图像。让灯泡、火箭和投影的形体清晰可辨。不要出现人物或人形。

items.title: 双层芝士汉堡3D广告
items.description: 用途：餐饮广告、菜单主视觉与食品海报。以双层芝士牛肉汉堡为示例，结合光泽质感、逆光蒸汽、滴落酱汁、三词英文标语和原创火焰餐厅标志。
items.prompt: A smooth 3D hyperrealistic food advertisement featuring one double beef cheeseburger on a plate. Show mouthwatering glossy textures with polished advertising lighting. Place it on a dark, moody surface, with a soft glow and cinematic background blur. Preserve the source lighting direction: high-Kelvin illumination, golden highlights and sharp shadows, with rich appetite-inducing color grading. Backlight the food to clearly reveal rising steam and dripping sauce. Behind the burger, place the bold slogan "Savor Every Bite" in an elegant font: exactly these three words, clearly readable. Subtly place an original restaurant emblem consisting of a simple flame inside a circle on the plate. Ultra-sharp visual detail, professional food styling and a stylized render finish. Food still life with no people or hands.
items.prompt_zh: 一张流畅、超写实的3D食品广告，主体是一份放在餐盘上的双层芝士牛肉汉堡。表现令人垂涎的光泽质感与精致广告布光。将汉堡置于深色、富有氛围的台面上，背景带柔和光晕与电影感虚化。保留来源的布光方向：高开尔文色温照明、金色高光和清晰阴影，并采用浓郁、激发食欲的色彩分级。用逆光清楚展示升起的蒸汽和滴落的酱汁。汉堡后方以优雅字体放置醒目标语“Savor Every Bite”，严格只用这三个英文单词，保持清晰可读。餐盘上低调放置一个原创餐厅标志，图案为圆圈内的简洁火焰。画面细节清晰锐利，食物造型专业，呈现风格化渲染效果。食品静物，不出现人物或手。

items.title: 竖版双拼小狗木刻版画
items.description: 无人物、无文字与标志的竖版小狗摄影与限色木刻双拼图。
items.prompt: Create a vertical 2:1 split composition with two equal panels and no words, letters, logos, labels, watermarks, signage, or border. Top panel: a single quiet puppy sitting or standing naturally in a bright, soft, healing setting such as grass or a simple sunlit indoor corner; the puppy is the only subject and the background is clean and gentle. Bottom panel: reinterpret the same puppy, pose, silhouette, and key colors as a limited-color handmade woodcut or linocut print floating on warm off-white paper. Preserve recognizable proportions and the main gesture while simplifying the background. Use imperfect carved lines, uneven ink edges, small gaps, dry-brush texture, coarse paper grain, and softly overprinted cream, pale blue, mist green, soft coral, and light ochre. Leave generous paper space and incomplete fading edges. Keep it warm, quiet, bright, and handcrafted. No humans, other animals, objects, architecture as subject, text, logo, emblem, watermark, or border.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张竖版上下双拼图，上下两个等高画面，严格不出现文字、字母、标签、标志、徽记、水印、招牌或边框。上半部分：一只安静的小狗自然地坐着或站着，置于明亮、柔和、治愈的环境中，例如草地或简洁的室内采光角落；小狗是唯一主体，背景干净克制。下半部分：将同一只小狗、同一姿态、轮廓和关键色彩重新概括为漂浮在暖白纸张上的限色手工木刻或油毡版画。保留可辨识比例和动作，删减背景；使用不规则刻线、粗细不均墨边、细小断裂、干刷痕迹、粗颗粒纸纹，以及奶油白、浅蓝、雾绿、柔和珊瑚色、浅赭色的柔和套印。保留大面积留白和逐渐消失的不完整边缘。整体温暖、安静、明亮、手工感强。不得出现任何人、其他动物、物品、作为主体的建筑、文字、标志、徽记、水印或边框。

items.title: NOVA citrus typography campaign
items.description: Product-only editorial typography campaign poster.
items.prompt: Create a bold editorial campaign poster for NOVA premium citrus sparkling water. Make NOVA extremely large and transform its letters into clean physical space. A bright yellow can weaves between the letters with a small water splash tracing its path. Realistic commercial product photography, strong perspective, clear foreground/midground/background, yellow black white and cyan, readable matte typography, smooth lines, no distressed texture, 9:16. Add only NOVA, Citrus Sparkling Water, Brightness in Motion, Zero Sugar, Natural Citrus.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张大胆的编辑风格商业海报，推广 NOVA 高端柑橘气泡水。将 NOVA 极度放大并把字母变成干净的实体空间。一罐明亮黄色的气泡水罐穿行于字母之间，少量水花沿轨迹延展。真实商业产品摄影、强透视、清晰前中后景，使用黄色黑色白色和青色；文字清晰、哑光、线条平滑，不要磨损纹理，9:16。仅添加 NOVA、Citrus Sparkling Water、Brightness in Motion、Zero Sugar、Natural Citrus。

items.title: 夸张互联网表情包贴纸包
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。
items.prompt: Create a Meme sticker pack based on the images attached, remixing with . Use exaggerated internet-reaction expressions, including crying, confusion, shock, smugness, side-eye, and deadpan disbelief, with awkward poses, low-fi cutout textures, and absurd humor.  Create a single square(1:1) transparent sticker sheet with nine distinct stickers arranged in a 3×3 grid, each showing a different expression, pose, or reaction. Separate the stickers with wide, fully transparent gaps. No background, shadows, or overlapping elements.
items.prompt_zh: 根据附带的图片创建一个表情包贴纸包，并与之进行混编。使用夸张的互联网反应表情，包括哭泣、困惑、震惊、自满、斜眼和面无表情的不信任，配合尴尬的姿势、低保真剪切纹理和荒诞的幽默。创建一个单一的正方形（1:1）透明贴纸页，包含排列成 3×3 网格的九个不同贴纸，每个贴纸展示不同的表情、姿势或反应。用宽阔的完全透明间隙分隔贴纸。没有背景、阴影或重叠元素。

items.title: 黄山风格高山云海仙境写实摄影
items.description: 16:9 realistic mountain landscape from a cliffside wooden viewing platform, with ancient pine framing layered peaks above a luminous sea of clouds.
items.prompt:
Create a 16:9 wide-angle realistic landscape photograph of a Chinese Huangshan-style high-mountain cloud-sea wonderland. Place the camera on a tall cliff's wooden viewing platform. In the foreground show a rustic wooden walkway, stone table, stone benches and wooden railings. On the close left cliff, feature a vigorous twisted ancient pine with a thick trunk rising diagonally and a horizontal crown forming a natural frame; let the right cliff and pine act as a secondary foreground anchor.

Layer the middle and far distance with strange peaks and sculptural rocks emerging from a thick, churning white sea of clouds. Keep strong depth through natural aerial perspective as distant mountains gradually fade. Let the clear light cyan-blue sky occupy the upper half, with a few soft white clouds. Place a bright low morning sun in the upper right, producing gentle rays and slight lens flare. Warm golden light falls across peaks, cloud sea, wood platform and pine, creating clear warm-cool contrast.

Real natural mountain photography, delicate rock, wood and bark texture, cinematic natural light, high dynamic range without excessive HDR, transparent sharp atmosphere, clear foreground and background, restrained premium color, epic layered mountain scenery, crisp 8k detail. No people, buildings beyond the described viewing platform, signage, text, logos or fantasy CGI.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张 16:9 宽幅写实风景摄影，表现中国黄山风格的高山云海仙境。镜头位于高耸悬崖上的木质观景平台，前景包含古朴木栈台、石桌、石凳和木栏杆。左侧近景悬崖生长一棵苍劲扭曲的古松，粗壮树干斜向上延伸，枝冠横向展开形成天然框景；右侧悬崖和松树作为辅助前景锚点。

中景与远景铺陈层层奇峰和雕塑般的怪石，山峰从翻涌厚重的白色云海中穿出。通过自然空气透视建立强烈纵深，远山逐渐淡出。晴朗通透的青蓝色天空占据上半部，点缀少量柔软白云。右上方明亮的清晨太阳低角度照射，产生柔和光束和轻微镜头光晕。暖金色阳光洒在山峰、云海、木平台和古松上，形成清晰冷暖对比。

真实自然山岳摄影，细腻岩石、木材和树皮纹理，电影级自然光，高动态范围但不过度 HDR，空气通透锐利，远近景清晰，色彩高级克制，史诗级层叠山岳风光，清晰 8k 细节。不要人物、描述之外的建筑、标牌、文字、标志或幻想 CGI 效果。

items.title: 极简几何彩色构图
items.description: Minimalist abstract composition of three overlapping geometric shapes in distinct colors, with clean edges and balanced negative space.
items.prompt: Create a minimalist abstract composition of three overlapping geometric shapes with clean edges, balanced negative space, and a different solid color for each shape. No people, faces, characters, text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅极简抽象构图：三个相互叠放的几何形状，边缘干净、留白均衡，每个形状使用不同的纯色。画面不得出现人物、面孔、角色、文字、字母、数字、标志、符号或水印。

items.title: 可爱等距茶壶黏土表情图标
items.description: A tiny cute isometric teapot emoji rendered as a soft pastel 3D clay icon.
items.prompt: Tiny cute isometric teapot emoji, soft lighting, soft pastel colors, sage green, 3D icon clay render, blender 3D, pastel background, no people, no text, no logos or flags.
items.prompt_zh: 可爱的小型等距茶壶表情图标，柔和光线，柔和粉彩配色，鼠尾草绿色，3D 黏土图标渲染，Blender 3D，粉彩背景；无人物、无文字、无标志或旗帜。

items.title: 霓虹花卉和谐蜂鸟插画
items.description: 以蜂鸟、开花植物和叶片构成无人物霓虹植物插画。
items.prompt: Create a vertical illustration with no visible text, logos, signs or watermarks: a graceful hummingbird hovering beside flowering plants and broad leaves. Outline the hummingbird, flowers and foliage with luminous neon turquoise and magenta lines against a deep indigo botanical background. Keep the hummingbird as the sole focal subject, with elegant simplified shapes, crisp contours, restrained glow, calm negative space and a serene yet electrifying mood. Use layered botanical silhouettes, subtle luminous accents and balanced asymmetry. No people, faces, hands, characters, figurines, toys, user input, reference images, photorealism, gradients, 3D rendering, clutter, extra animals or decorative typography.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅竖幅插画，不出现任何可见文字、标志、招牌或水印：一只优雅的蜂鸟在开花植物与宽阔叶片旁悬停。以深靛蓝植物背景衬托蜂鸟、花朵和叶片的明亮霓虹青绿色与洋红色线稿。让蜂鸟成为唯一视觉焦点，使用简洁优雅的形体、清晰轮廓、克制光晕、平静留白与宁静但充满电感的氛围。加入分层植物剪影、细微发光点缀和均衡的不对称构图。禁止人物、脸、手、角色、摆件、公仔、用户输入、参考图片、写实摄影、渐变、三维渲染、杂乱背景、其他动物和装饰性排版。

items.title: 甜点构成的迷你蛋糕床景
items.description: 用途：甜点创意摄影、食品艺术插画与烘焙宣传。沿用来源中的蛋糕床意象，以可追溯甜点材料重现极简卧室床景，呈现食品纹理与柔和摄影棚光线。
items.prompt: Photorealistic conceptual food art: a minimalist bedroom vignette centered on a bed sculpture made entirely from desserts. Build the bed base and mattress from layers of vanilla sponge cake and whipped cream. Make the headboard from white chocolate, the pillows from marshmallows, and the blanket from strawberry fruit leather. Include one small bedside table made from stacked macarons. Every depicted furniture component must remain visibly edible. Set the surreal food sculpture against a pastel-pink background. Use bright, soft, evenly diffused studio lighting with subtle natural shadows to reveal airy cake crumb, soft cream, smooth chocolate, pillowy marshmallow, fruit-leather texture and crisp macaron shells. Fine atmospheric detail enhances realism. Evoke the photographic look of a Canon EOS 5D with an 85mm f/1.8 lens: shallow depth of field focused on the cake-bed sculpture, crisp subject detail and soft background falloff. Tabletop eye-level view, medium close-up, perfectly centered composition. Clean high-resolution food-photography appearance, vibrant natural colors and an editorial dessert-photography aesthetic.
items.prompt_zh: 照片级真实的概念食品艺术：以一座完全由甜点制成的床雕塑为中心，呈现极简卧室床景。用香草海绵蛋糕与打发奶油的层次搭建床基和床垫；白巧克力制成床头板，棉花糖制成枕头，草莓果皮制成毯子。加入一张由叠放马卡龙制成的小床头桌。每个家具部件都必须明显呈现可食用材料质感。以淡粉色背景衬托这座超现实食品雕塑。采用明亮柔和、均匀漫射的摄影棚布光，以轻微自然阴影突出蓬松蛋糕屑、柔软奶油、光滑巧克力、松软棉花糖、果皮质地和酥脆马卡龙外壳。精细的氛围细节增强真实感。营造佳能EOS 5D搭配85mm f/1.8镜头的摄影观感：浅景深聚焦蛋糕床雕塑，主体细节清晰，背景柔和虚化。采用桌面视线高度的中近景，构图准确居中。呈现清晰的高分辨率食品摄影观感、鲜艳自然的色彩与编辑类甜点摄影美学。

items.title: 冰蓝内发光玻璃香水瓶
items.description: 用途：产品概念海报与香氛广告视觉。以透明玻璃香水瓶和冰蓝霓虹为可追溯示例，突出贴合瓶身细节的内部发光、黑色反射台面与轻薄雾气。
items.prompt: A single clear glass perfume bottle glowing vividly from within with ice-blue neon light that matches a fresh, cool fragrance essence. The internal glow must follow the bottle shape and fine details precisely without overexposure. Cinematic studio lighting, rich reflective glass texture, subtle ambient mist around the bottle, sharp shadows and clean contrast. The bottle stands on a softly reflective black surface. Ultra-sharp detail, 2:3 vertical layout, pure black background, and high-Kelvin lighting to avoid a yellow tint. Ultra-HD photorealistic appearance. The glow should feel premium, dramatic and emotionally powerful.
items.prompt_zh: 一只透明玻璃香水瓶，由内部发出鲜明的冰蓝色霓虹光，呼应清新、冷冽的香氛气质。内部光芒必须精确贴合瓶身形状与细节，避免过曝。采用电影感摄影棚布光，表现丰富的玻璃反射质感，瓶身周围带有轻微薄雾，阴影清晰、对比干净。香水瓶立于带柔和反射的黑色台面上。细节清晰锐利，采用2:3竖向构图、纯黑背景和避免偏黄的高开尔文色温照明，呈现超高清照片级真实观感。发光效果应显得高级、富有戏剧性和情感冲击力。

items.title: 青色霓虹背光的发光小狐狸
items.description: 用途：可爱动物插画、头像与创意视觉。以小狐狸和青色霓虹作为来源动物、颜色变量的代表性示例，呈现生物发光与大眼睛的Q版3D卡通形象。
items.prompt: A bioluminescent cute fox, kawaii and chibi, with cyan neon backlighting, in a 3D cartoon style. Give the fox big, cute, bright eyes and high-definition visual detail.
items.prompt_zh: 一只具有生物发光效果的可爱小狐狸，采用卡哇伊、Q版比例，以青色霓虹背光照明，呈现3D卡通风格。狐狸有大而可爱、明亮的眼睛，画面细节清晰。

items.title: 印尼黄米盛宴俯拍
items.description: 用途：印尼美食专题、餐饮菜单与饮食文化视觉。俯拍圆锥形黄米饭及传统配菜，以香蕉叶、竹编托盘和爪哇装饰呈现丰盛静物。
items.prompt: Authentic Indonesian food photography of Nasi Tumpeng: cone-shaped yellow rice surrounded by ayam goreng (fried chicken), tempe orek (spicy stir-fried tempeh), sambal and vegetables. Include detailed chili-flower and carved-cucumber garnishes. Serve the feast on banana leaves in a woven bamboo tray, with Javanese cultural decorations in the background. Use an overhead flat-lay composition, a 50mm-lens photographic look, cinematic warm lighting, a 3:2 landscape aspect ratio and film grain. Food still life with no people or hands.
items.prompt_zh: 真实的印尼美食摄影：Nasi Tumpeng圆锥形黄米饭，周围搭配ayam goreng炸鸡、tempe orek辣炒天贝、参巴辣酱和蔬菜。加入精细的辣椒花与雕花黄瓜装饰。盛宴以香蕉叶承托，装在竹编托盘中，背景带有爪哇文化装饰。采用俯视平铺构图、50mm镜头摄影观感、电影感暖光、3:2横向画幅和胶片颗粒。食品静物，不出现人物或手。

items.title: 蓝色渐变中的抽象水彩海马
items.description: 用途：抽象海洋主题插画、装饰画与创意背景。以简洁海马轮廓、旋转水彩纹理和流动线条，在蓝色渐变中表现色彩与形状之美。
items.prompt: A single colorful seahorse depicted in an abstract style with minimal detail, against a clean blue gradient background. Create it as a digital painting, with swirling watercolor textures across its shell-like body surface and fluid lines that emphasize movement. Keep the seahorse silhouette recognizable, with a curved neck and curling tail, while expressing its form through simple shapes and flowing washes of color. Let the colors and shapes convey beauty and creativity. Maintain the minimal level of detail and open blue background; the sense of movement comes from the painted lines and textures in this single still image. No people, human figures, readable text, logos, signatures or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 一只色彩丰富的海马，以细节极少的抽象风格呈现，置于干净的蓝色渐变背景中。采用数字绘画方式，在海马的壳状身体表面铺展旋转的水彩纹理，并以流动线条强调动感。保留可辨识的海马轮廓、弯曲颈部与卷曲尾巴，同时用简洁形状和流动色彩晕染表现其形态。通过色彩与形状传达美感和创意。保持极简细节与开阔的蓝色背景，动感由这一幅静态画面中的笔绘线条和纹理表达。不要出现人物、人形、可读文字、标志、签名或水印。

items.title: 漂浮太空岩石上的邮政小屋
items.description: 用途：幽默魔幻现实主义概念插画与创意背景。老式邮政小屋坐落于漂浮太空岩石，信封如翅膀飘动，行星排队等候邮政服务。
items.prompt: An old-fashioned postal shack rests on a floating space rock, suspended against the vastness of space. Envelopes flutter around the shack like wings, captured in a single still moment. Several planets line up in an orderly queue approaching the postal shack, as if waiting their turn for postal service. Keep the planets recognizably spherical celestial bodies, with their humorous role expressed by their queue arrangement. Clearly show the shack, the floating rock beneath it, the wing-like envelopes and the line of planets together. Use humorous magical realism, with believable material texture and lighting that make the impossible scene feel tangible. The shack is unoccupied. No people, human silhouettes, human faces or humanoid bodies. The planets have no faces or limbs. Envelopes have plain surfaces without readable addresses, and the scene contains no readable text, lettering, logos or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 一间老式邮政小屋坐落在一块漂浮的太空岩石上，悬于浩瀚太空之中。信封在小屋周围像翅膀一样飘动，画面定格为一个静态瞬间。几颗行星朝向邮政小屋井然排成一列，仿佛正在依次等候邮政服务。保持行星可辨识的球形天体外观，通过排队的排列关系表达幽默意味。将小屋、下方漂浮岩石、如翅膀般飘动的信封与行星队列一同清晰呈现。采用幽默的魔幻现实主义风格，以可信的材质纹理和光照赋予这幅不可能的场景真实触感。小屋内无人。不要出现人物、人物剪影、人脸或人形身体。行星不带面孔或四肢。信封表面素净，不含可读地址，场景中不要出现可读文字、字母、标志或水印。

items.title: 沙漠夜空下的新艺术野牛油画
items.description: 单头野牛居于彩色几何纹样中心，沙漠夜空与新艺术曲线交织，呈现温暖厚重的油画肌理。
items.prompt: An ornate Art Nouveau oil painting featuring exactly one bison as the central subject, its complete body clearly recognizable within an array of colorful geometric abstract motifs. Give the bison a powerful shoulder hump, shaggy dark fur, curved horns and a grounded stance. Surround it with flowing botanical curves, interlocking circles, arcs, diamonds and layered color fields, arranged as decorative abstract patterns. Use nested and interwoven shapes to suggest warmth, belonging and shelter without literal emblems or writing. Integrate a deep starry night sky above and rolling desert dunes with distant rocky mesas below and behind the bison. Warm ochre, burnt orange, terracotta and golden tones dominate, balanced by deep indigo and turquoise accents. Rich oil-paint texture, visible brushwork and raised impasto highlights create a tactile three-dimensional effect, with intricate ornamental details throughout. Keep the animal distinct from the patterned background. No additional animals. No people, human silhouettes or human faces. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, glyphs, runes or symbols used as writing; all ornament is purely abstract geometry and botanical curves.
items.prompt_zh: 一幅华丽的新艺术风格油画，以恰好一头野牛为中心主体，野牛完整的身体在一系列彩色几何抽象纹样中清晰可辨。野牛具有强壮隆起的肩背、浓密深色毛发、弯曲牛角和稳健站姿。周围环绕流动的植物曲线、相互交错的圆形、弧线、菱形及层叠色块，构成装饰性抽象图案。通过嵌套与交织的形状暗示温暖、归属和庇护，不使用具象徽记或文字。画面上方融入深邃星空，野牛下方及后方呈现起伏沙丘和远处岩石台地。以温暖赭石、焦橙、陶土红和金色为主，搭配深靛蓝与绿松石色点缀。丰富油彩纹理、可见笔触和凸起的厚涂高光营造富有触感的立体效果，整体布满精细装饰细节。保持野牛与图案背景清晰区分。不要出现其他动物。不要出现人物、人物剪影或人脸。不要出现可读文字、字母、数字、标志、签名、水印、字符、符文或用作文字的符号；全部装饰仅由抽象几何形状与植物曲线构成。

items.title: 琥珀蜂巢昆虫科学城
items.description: 透明六边形蜂蜡实验舱组成迷你科学城，天然昆虫在花粉、蜂蜜与花卉设施间研究和活动。
items.prompt: Create one detailed miniature 3D fantasy diorama of a honeycomb insect science city, with cute rounded forms and a warm amber glow. Use an elevated three-quarter view to show the stacked hexagonal transparent beeswax laboratory pods and the surrounding garden clearly. Through the transparent honeycomb windows, reveal small test-tube workbenches, honey chandeliers and bee researchers. Above the roof, a hovering sunflower-shaped honey sprinkler releases visible golden honey droplets; luminous pollen-covered vines climb the outer walls. A smooth curved beeswax slide extends down one side. Beside it, a small insect descends under a clearly recognizable white dandelion-seed parachute. The entrance has a sunflower revolving door, shown in a single still moment. In the garden, a beetle courier rides a tiny pollen motorcycle and a butterfly researcher examines a flower with a magnifying lens. Include a clearly recognizable amber honey bench with a seat and backrest in the foreground, and a daisy-shaped fountain spraying water into a small basin nearby. Tiny glowing fireflies form drifting points of light around the garden. All inhabitants are non-human insects with recognizable segmented bodies, antennae, insect legs and appropriate wings; the research roles are conveyed by their tools and activities. Keep the insects in natural insect body proportions, without clothing or upright human-shaped bodies. Separate the key facilities so their silhouettes remain legible. Glossy translucent wax and honey, delicate petals and pollen, soft amber lighting, playful surreal miniature 3D rendering. No people, human silhouettes, human faces, human hands or humanoid figures. No readable text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signatures or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅细节丰富的迷你3D奇幻蜂巢昆虫科学城立体场景，造型圆润可爱，笼罩温暖琥珀色光晕。采用略微俯视的四分之三视角，清晰展示堆叠的六边形透明蜂蜡实验舱及周围花园。透过透明蜂巢窗，可见小型试管操作台、蜜糖吊灯与蜜蜂研究员。屋顶上方悬浮着向日葵形蜂蜜洒水器，滴落清晰可见的金色蜂蜜液滴；覆盖发光花粉的藤蔓攀爬外墙。一条光滑弯曲的蜂蜡滑梯沿建筑侧面向下延伸。滑梯旁，一只小昆虫悬在清晰可辨的白色蒲公英种子降落伞下缓缓下降。入口设有向日葵转门，以单幅静态画面定格。花园中，一只甲虫快递员骑着微型花粉摩托，一只蝴蝶研究员通过放大镜观察花朵。前景摆放一张清晰可辨、带座面与靠背的琥珀色蜂蜜长椅，附近有一座雏菊形喷泉，将水洒入小水盆。微小发光萤火虫在花园周围形成飘散光点。所有居民均为非人类昆虫，保留可辨识的分节身体、触角、昆虫足及相应翅膀，以工具和活动表现科研身份。昆虫保持天然身体比例，不穿衣物，不采用直立的人形身体。关键设施彼此分开，保持轮廓清晰。呈现亮泽半透明蜂蜡与蜂蜜、细腻花瓣与花粉、柔和琥珀光照，以及俏皮超现实的迷你3D渲染质感。不要出现人物、人物剪影、人脸、人手或人形角色。不要出现可读文字、字母、数字、标签、标志、签名或水印。

items.title: 亚麻布上的植物民俗刺绣面板
items.description: 亚麻织纹衬托彩色线绣花朵、树木、太阳与云朵，针脚与凸起轮廓清晰可见。
items.prompt: A handcrafted botanical embroidery panel on natural woven linen, viewed straight on so the fabric weave and individual colorful stitches are clearly visible. Arrange flowers and leafy stems across the lower portion, stylized trees on either side, and a simple sun with clouds above in a balanced, friendly composition with magical storybook charm. Every decorative element is embroidered from thread: satin-stitch fills in petals and leaves, backstitch outlines along stems and branches, and French-knot flower centers. Show raised stitched contours, distinct thread strands, directional thread flow and tiny soft shadows cast by the stitches onto the linen. Leave areas of plain woven linen visible between the motifs. Use gentle pastel and folk-inspired colors for a tactile, cozy handmade appearance, with soft natural light revealing the textile texture. The sun and clouds have simple nonfigurative shapes. No people, human silhouettes, faces or figurines. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, signatures or watermarks. No painted or printed substitutes for the stitched motifs.
items.prompt_zh: 一幅制作精细的植物主题刺绣面板，以天然织造亚麻布为底，从正面观看，使布料织纹和每一处彩色针脚清晰可见。画面下部排列花朵与带叶茎秆，两侧布置风格化树木，上方为简洁的太阳与云朵，构图均衡亲切，带有奇妙的童话书韵味。每个装饰元素都由绣线绣成：花瓣与叶片使用缎面绣填充，茎秆和枝条用回针绣勾勒，花心采用法国结粒绣。表现凸起的刺绣轮廓、分明的线股、具有方向的走线，以及针脚在亚麻布上投下的细微柔和阴影。图案之间保留可见的素色亚麻织纹。采用柔和粉彩与民俗风格配色，呈现富有触感、温暖舒适的手作质感，以柔和自然光凸显织物纹理。太阳和云朵采用简洁的非拟人形状。不要出现人物、人物剪影、人脸或人偶。不要出现可读文字、字母、数字、标志、标签、签名或水印。不要用绘画或印刷图案代替刺绣针脚。

items.title: 彩叶树下的花朵小屋
items.description: 墙体、屋顶、门窗洞均由花簇、叶片和藤蔓交织构成的奇幻小屋，屋顶彩叶树与远山相映。
items.prompt: A small fantasy house whose entire architectural body is formed exclusively from densely interwoven flower clusters, petals, leaves and living vines. Thick masses of blossoms and foliage themselves form the full thickness of the walls and the curved roof. Show one open arched doorway and two small open window holes: their edges, arches, reveals and sills are made entirely of flowers, leaves and intertwined vines, with visible botanical thickness around the empty openings. The interior surfaces visible through the openings are also woven flowers and foliage. The blossoms are the actual structure throughout. No stone, masonry, bricks, timber beams, wooden boards, wooden doors, plaster, concrete, tiles or conventional building shell anywhere in the house. No chimney, glass panes or manufactured window frames. One living tree with colorful leaves grows on top, its branches and foliage reaching around the doorway; retain the natural tree trunk. Keep the whole botanical house clearly legible against distant mountains. Natural light, soft colors, rich floral detail, a dreamlike fantasy atmosphere and subtle painterly texture. Empty house and empty landscape. No people, human silhouettes, faces or figurines. No readable text, letters, numbers, signs, logos, signatures or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 一座奇幻小屋，其整个建筑主体完全由密集交织的花簇、花瓣、叶片和活藤蔓构成。厚厚的花朵与枝叶本身构成墙体的全部厚度以及弧形屋顶。设置一个敞开的拱形门洞和两个敞开的小窗洞：洞口的边缘、拱顶、内侧壁与窗台全部由花朵、叶片和缠绕的藤蔓组成，空洞周围清晰展示植物结构的厚度。透过洞口可见的室内表面也由花朵与枝叶编织而成。花朵在整座房屋中就是实际结构。房屋任何部位都不要出现石材、砌体、砖块、木梁、木板、木门、抹灰、混凝土、瓦片或常规建筑外壳。不要烟囱、玻璃窗或人造窗框。一棵长着缤纷彩叶的活树生长在屋顶，树枝与叶片延伸至门口周围，保留树木天然的树干。以远山为背景，清晰呈现整座植物小屋。自然光、柔和色彩、丰富花卉细节、梦幻奇幻氛围和含蓄的绘画质感。小屋与周围风景均为空。不要出现人物、人物剪影、人脸或人偶。不要出现可读文字、字母、数字、标牌、标志、签名或水印。

items.title: 极光雪山下的三艘奇幻帆船
items.description: 三联画呈现三艘造型各异的奇幻帆船，航行于极光、彩色月亮与雪山相映的梦幻海洋。
items.prompt: Create a dreamy fantasy landscape in the style of digital art, arranged as a triptych of three ocean scenes. Show exactly three different fantasy sailboats in total, one clearly visible sailboat in each panel, with distinct hull and sail designs. Each scene combines the ocean, snowy mountains, beautiful flowing aurora borealis and colorful moons. Let the aurora and moonlight illuminate the snow, sails and water with luminous, dreamlike color. Keep the boats separate and the three scenes visually harmonious. Empty boats and empty shores: no people, human silhouettes, faces, humanoid figures or figurines anywhere. No readable text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signatures or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一幅数字艺术风格的梦幻奇幻风景三联画，由三个海洋场景组成。画面总共恰好出现三艘造型不同的奇幻帆船，每个分画面中有一艘清晰可见的帆船，三艘船的船体与船帆设计各具特色。每个场景都包含海洋、白雪覆盖的山峰、优美流动的极光和彩色月亮。极光与月光以明亮梦幻的色彩照亮积雪、船帆和水面。各船彼此分离，三个场景在视觉上协调统一。船上和岸边均为空：任何位置都不要出现人物、人物剪影、人脸、人形角色或人偶。不要出现可读文字、字母、数字、标签、标志、签名或水印。

items.title: 浮世绘风格插画主题模板
items.description: 可替换主题的日本浮世绘风格插画模板，默认使用非人物的月夜锦鲤池主题；保留优雅简化造型、黑色轮廓、传统配色、木版画纹理、平面构图与充足留白。
items.prompt: Create an illustration of a quiet koi pond with reeds, a crescent moon, and drifting maple leaves inspired by Japanese ukiyo-e. Use elegant simplified forms, expressive black outlines with consistent line weight, a restrained traditional color palette, subtle authentic woodblock texture, a flat composition and graceful negative space. Preserve the character of a handcrafted print with clear visual hierarchy, making the subject the sole focus. Keep the colors calm and the forms decorative without clutter, like a carefully carved collectible print. No text, title, sign, logo, watermark, photorealism, gradients, heavy shading, 3D rendering, cluttered background or modern commercial decoration.
items.prompt_zh: 以 a quiet koi pond with reeds, a crescent moon, and drifting maple leaves 为主题创作一幅受日本浮世绘启发的插画。使用优雅的简化形式、富有表现力且线条粗细一致的黑色轮廓、克制的传统调色板、细微真实的木版画纹理、平面构图和优美的负空间。保持手工印刷品的质感与清晰视觉层次，让主题成为画面唯一核心。色彩平静、造型有装饰性但不繁复，画面像经过精心制版的收藏级版画。不要文字、标题、标志、徽标、水印、照片写实、渐变、重阴影、三维渲染、杂乱背景或现代商业装饰。

items.title: 透明水晶橙子三棱柱蛋糕静物
items.description: 透明橙色水晶质感的三棱柱蛋糕切片，搭配完整玻璃橙子、白瓷盘、香槟金叉与白色丝绸，呈现高端静物摄影。
items.prompt: Create a luxury fashion-editorial still life of a sharp triangular prism cake slice made of hard crystal-clear glass-like material, with the featured fruit being orange, using a single unified candy-glass color tone while preserving the fruit’s original natural hue and form logic, explicitly excluding stems and leaves from recoloring so they retain natural green, the transparent glass cake has polished edges, elegant refraction, crisp highlights and internal reflections identical to solid crystal, inside the cake thick full-bodied seedless fruit cross-sections appear as pure clear glass with perfectly smooth seamless surfaces, one whole fruit in mirror-polished translucent crystal-glass candy style sits on top and another rests beside it, all fruit instances sharing identical color tone and material finish except leaves, arranged on a glossy white ceramic plate with clear crystal shards, a champagne-gold metallic fork and minimal baby’s-breath accents against softly draped white silk fabric, composed with balanced proportions and refined negative space, lit with soft diffused high-end editorial lighting that preserves candy-like color richness and material clarity, hyper-realistic, ultra-detailed, premium aesthetic, no text, no typography, no logo, no watermark, no graphic elements, exclude rough texture, matte surface, cube, square or round cake, ice cube, acrylic or resin block, cloudy transparency, people, hands, faces
items.prompt_zh:
创作高端时尚杂志风格的静物摄影：一块具有锐利边角的三棱柱蛋糕切片，以坚硬、晶莹剔透的玻璃质感材料制成，主题水果明确为橙子。使用统一的糖果玻璃色调，同时保留橙子天然的橙色与形态规律；果梗和叶片不随水果改色，保持自然绿色。透明玻璃蛋糕具有抛光边缘、优雅折射、清晰高光和如实心水晶般的内部反射。蛋糕内部嵌有厚实饱满、无籽的橙子横切片，同样呈现纯净透明玻璃质感，表面完全平滑、无接缝。

一颗完整橙子放在蛋糕顶部，另一颗完整橙子放在旁边，两者均为镜面抛光、半透明的水晶玻璃糖果质感。除绿色叶片外，所有橙子与切片保持相同的色调和材质光泽。将它们布置在有光泽的白色陶瓷盘上，搭配透明水晶碎片、一把香槟金色金属叉和少量满天星花枝，背景是柔软垂落的白色丝绸。

构图比例平衡、留白精致，采用柔和漫射的高端杂志摄影灯光，保持糖果般丰富的色彩和清澈透明的材质。照片写实、细节丰富、品质精致。不要文字、字体排版、标志、水印或图形元素；排除粗糙或哑光质感、立方体蛋糕、方形或圆形蛋糕、冰块、亚克力或树脂块、浑浊透明效果、人物、手和脸。

items.title: 极简3D折纸手工纸艺工作室渲染
items.description: 以蓝珊瑚双色纸艺机器人茶壶为明确默认主体的3D折纸纸艺工作室渲染；保留全部可替换变量。
items.prompt: Create a minimalist 3D origami papercraft studio render of the variable SUBJECT, defaulting to a small robotic teapot, built in a PRIMARY COLOR cobalt-blue and SECONDARY COLOR coral-orange paper design. Include TOPPING/DETAILS as two folded paper leaves on the lid, ACCESSORY 1 as a tiny paper cup, and ACCESSORY 2 as a folded paper spoon, all matching the papercraft style. Place the scene against a seamless BACKGROUND COLOR pale warm-gray studio backdrop. Preserve all six variable definitions and use these defaults when no replacement is supplied. Use clean geometric low-poly folds, layered paper construction, soft directional lighting, subtle shadows, crisp edges, realistic paper fibers, centered composition, and a premium handcrafted paper aesthetic in a studio-quality render.
items.prompt_zh: 生成极简3D折纸手工纸艺工作室渲染图，使用变量 SUBJECT 作为主体；默认主体为一只小型机器人茶壶，采用 PRIMARY COLOR 钴蓝色与 SECONDARY COLOR 珊瑚橙色纸张设计。TOPPING/DETAILS 默认是在壶盖上添加两片折叠纸叶，ACCESSORY 1 默认是一只微型纸杯，ACCESSORY 2 默认是一把折叠纸勺，所有元素保持一致的纸艺风格。将场景置于无缝 BACKGROUND COLOR 浅暖灰色工作室背景中。保留这六个变量定义，未提供替换值时使用上述默认值。采用干净的几何低多边形折痕、分层纸张结构、柔和方向光、细微阴影、清晰边缘、真实纸纤维、居中构图和高级手工纸艺质感，呈现工作室级渲染效果。

items.title: 手绘冷幽默荒诞单幅插画
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的成人 Q 版角色冷幽默单幅插画提示词。保留方形构图、右侧正式跪坐的两个成人角色、淡蓝粘性除尘滚轮、空白表情、手工杂志笔触和无文字背景约束。原文为非特定角色插画，不需要人物身份参考。
items.prompt:
Hand-drawn deadpan absurd single-panel illustration, square composition, two adult chibi characters sitting together in formal seiza on the right side.
One character calmly uses a pale-blue sticky lint roller to roll the other character’s cheek, as casually as cleaning a countertop. The roller surface is parallel to the face. Both characters have completely blank, vacant expressions, tiny dot eyes and flat mouths, no reaction.

Slightly wobbly ink outlines, uneven marker and colored-pencil fill, faint paper grain, muted pastel palette, handmade zine aesthetic.

No background objects, no text, no speech bubbles, no manga symbols, no exaggerated expressions, no 3D/CGI, no glossy mascot style.
items.prompt_zh: 手绘冷面荒诞单幅插画，正方形构图，右侧坐着两个正式跪坐的成年 Q 版角色。一个角色冷静地使用淡蓝色粘性除尘滚轮滚动另一个角色的脸颊，动作像清理台面一样随意。滚轮表面与脸部平行。两个角色都表情完全空白、空洞，小圆点眼睛和平坦的嘴巴，没有任何反应。略微摇晃的墨水轮廓，不均匀的马克笔和彩色铅笔填充，隐约的纸张纹理，柔和的调色板，手工杂志美学。无背景物体，无文字，无对话气泡，无漫画符号，无夸张表情，无 3D/CGI，无光泽吉祥物风格。

items.title: 日本涂鸦旅行地图插画
items.description: 以日本轮廓为主构图的黑墨手绘旅行地图，融入富士山、京都寺院、寿司、丹顶鹤、茶道、樱花与折扇等文化元素。
items.prompt: Create a 4:5 vertical hand-drawn doodle travel map illustration of Japan. Use the recognizable outline of Japan as the main composition, naturally filled with dozens of tiny black-ink doodles: Mount Fuji, Kyoto temples, sushi, a red-crowned crane, tea ceremony, cherry blossoms, a folding fan, plus architectural, street, transport, and everyday-life details. Keep the lines playful yet refined, with travel-journal character, subtle paper texture, and a warm off-white background; visually rich but clean, with no photorealism, flags, or cluttered text. Integrate only the hand-lettered word “Japan” naturally at the center of the map, preserving generous negative space and a premium museum-poster feel.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张4:5纵向日本手绘涂鸦旅行地图插画。使用日本可识别的轮廓作为主构图，在其中自然填充数十个微小黑色墨线涂鸦：富士山、京都寺院、寿司、丹顶鹤、茶道、樱花、折扇，以及建筑、街景、交通和日常生活细节。线条俏皮但精致，带旅行日志美学、轻微纸张纹理和米白背景；构图丰富但整洁，不使用照相写实、旗帜或杂乱文字。仅将“Japan”以美观手写字体自然融入地图中心，保持留白和高级博物馆海报感。

items.title: 笔触里的粉色轮滑鞋
items.description: 以低角度特写描绘一双粉色轮滑鞋，桃粉色轮子、松散鞋带与黑色青绿背景结合可见笔触和颜料滴落，形成略带抽象的绘画质感。
items.prompt: A pair of pink roller skates is depicted in a close-up, low-angle shot against a dark, textured background. The skates are the central focus, with their laces loosely tied and trailing. The wheels of the skates are a peachy-pink color, and the overall impression is one of a painted, somewhat abstract artwork with visible brushstrokes and drips of paint. The background is a mix of black, with hints of teal and pink, creating a moody and artistic atmosphere.
items.prompt_zh: 特写、低角度拍摄的一双粉色轮滑鞋，背景为深色且带有纹理。轮滑鞋是画面的核心焦点，鞋带松散地系着并自然垂落。轮滑鞋的轮子为桃粉色，整体呈现出一幅绘画作品的质感，略带抽象风格，可见明显的笔触与颜料滴落的痕迹。背景以黑色为主，点缀着青绿色与粉色，营造出富有情绪与艺术感的氛围。

items.title: 柔软毛线猫咪钩针玩偶特写
items.description: 可爱圆润的猫咪钩针玩偶特写，清楚呈现柔软毛线与钩针针脚，配合温暖柔光、马卡龙色彩和浅景深，营造细腻手作质感。
items.prompt: Create a cute, round, fluffy amigurumi cat, clearly recognizable as a crocheted stuffed toy. In a detailed close-up, make the soft yarn fibers, loops, and individual crochet stitches visibly crisp and tactile while keeping the toy charming and cuddly. Use a gentle pastel palette and soft warm lighting, with shallow depth of field that keeps the cat's face and front stitching sharp while the background falls into a smooth blur. Deliver a polished, high-quality handcrafted look with rich material detail. No people, human features, text, logo, signature, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一只可爱、圆润、毛茸茸的猫咪钩针玩偶，让它明确呈现为手工钩织的填充玩具。采用细节丰富的特写镜头，清楚表现柔软毛线纤维、线圈和一针一线的钩针纹理，同时保持玩偶迷人、柔软、可亲的气质。使用柔和的马卡龙色板和温暖柔光，并以浅景深让猫咪面部与前侧针脚保持清晰，背景自然化为顺滑虚化。成品应精致、高质量，具有丰富可信的手作材质细节。不要人物、人类特征、文字、标志、签名或水印。

items.title: 现代东方女性外滩梦境立体纸雕
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的现代东方城市梦境纸雕艺术海报模板。以约 25 岁成年女性为情绪核心，围绕外滩、浦江和陆家嘴天际线构建立体纸雕长廊，保留 9:16 构图、群青银白香槟金配色、夜晨交汇光线和博物馆级纸层质感。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the identity reference for the main visible adult woman; preserve the paper-art scene and styling unless they conflict with the reference.

Create a contemporary Oriental paper-cut dreamscape art poster in a 9:16 vertical composition. The theme is “She walked through the Bund to see the light on the other side of the Huangpu River.” Show one calm, independent adult woman of about 25 standing on a paper-sculpted riverside promenade, seen from behind or in half profile as she looks toward the opposite skyline. Give her long black hair that streams into paper ribbons with light-gold leaf and star hair ornaments, and a deep ultramarine and silver-white layered paper-art dress with a long openwork sash flowing in the river wind. Make the character the emotional core but keep the city space large.

Build every element as a coherent museum-grade layered paper sculpture: paper-page road, hand-cut edges, visible paper fibers, layer thickness, hollow cutouts, translucent edges, and soft layered shadows. The foreground has riverside railings, flowers, lamps, and pavement patterns; the middle ground has the curved promenade and woman; the background has the Huangpu River, a few paper cruise ships, the Bund’s historic facades, and the Lujiazui skyline. Make the Oriental Pearl, Shanghai Tower, and Shanghai World Financial Center recognizable without turning the scene into a generic tourism poster. Use the riverbank–river–opposite skyline depth as the main perspective.

Use deep ultramarine, silver-white, and champagne gold as the main palette, with only small coral-red lights. Blend clear night light with soft dawn light so cool and warm layers meet near the distant skyline. Keep the image bright, clear, dreamy, and refined rather than gray, dirty, or uniformly yellow. Preserve the paper-cut language across the woman, buildings, water, clouds, railings, and ornaments; avoid photographic realism, plastic 3D, resin, clay, felt, ordinary anime, messy layers, weak landmark recognition, excessive close-up, clutter, text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
将上传的参考图用于主要可见成年女性的身份依据；在不与参考图冲突的情况下，保留纸艺场景与整体风格。

创作一张现代东方立体剪纸梦境艺术海报，采用 9:16 竖向构图。主题是“她走过外滩，去看浦江另一边的光”。一位约 25 岁、平静而独立的成年女性站在纸雕滨江长廊上，背对或半侧背对镜头，凝望对岸天际线。她留着向后飘动并延展成纸带的黑色长发，佩戴浅金几何叶片与星点发饰；穿深群青与银白层叠纸艺长裙，轻薄镂空披帛在江风中向后流动。人物是情绪核心，但城市空间要足够辽阔。

所有元素统一为博物馆级层叠纸雕：纸页道路式结构、手工裁切边缘、真实纸张纤维、纸层厚度、镂空结构、边缘透光和柔和层叠投影。近景为滨江栏杆、花枝、灯柱与路面纹样；中景为弯曲长廊与人物；远景为浦江、少量纸雕游船、外滩历史建筑和陆家嘴天际线。清晰表现东方明珠、上海中心和上海环球金融中心的轮廓，但不要做成普通旅游宣传画。以“江岸—江面—对岸天际线”的纵深关系作为主要透视。

以深群青、银白和香槟金为主色，仅用少量珊瑚红表现局部灯火。将清透夜光与柔和晨光结合，让冷暖光层在远方天际线交汇。画面要明亮、清晰、梦幻而高级，不灰、不脏、不整体偏黄。人物、建筑、江面、云层、栏杆和装饰都保持纸雕语言。避免真人摄影、塑料 3D、树脂、黏土、毛毡、普通动漫、纸层混乱、地标辨识度不足、人物特写过大、元素堆积、文字、标志和水印。

items.title: 现代蒂罗尔风苔绿裙女性人像
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的现代蒂罗尔风吊带裙、柔光棚拍与织物装饰文字人像模板。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the only adult Japanese woman; match facial identity only. Create a realistic modern Tyrolean or Bavarian-inspired fashion portrait of a fictional adult Japanese woman aged 23–26 with a healthy natural physique. Stand her nearly frontally with a slight turn to the right and weight on one leg; retain subtle asymmetry in shoulder height, arm position and posture, never a deliberate chest-out pose or exaggerated emphasis on the figure. Dress her in a modernly reconstructed moss-green Tyrolean pinafore mini-dress made of thick matte suede-like fabric. Two straps fall forward from the shoulders into an embroidered horizontal band near the underbust. Under it, use a matching completely opaque bandeau top with sufficient support, naturally accommodating an adult figure while preserving gravity, left-right differences, slight stretch and fabric wrinkles. Add two large front flap pockets, gold-thread plant or swirl embroidery, black decorative side buttons and antique-gold metal parts. Keep body proportions balanced with shoulder width, ribcage, waist and stance, including subtle abdominal muscle shadows, real load tension in the straps and natural fabric pulls; no spherical shapes, unnatural lifting or plastic skin. Use uniform soft studio light from a large softbox, expressing dimensionality only through natural shadows around collarbones, shoulders, stretched fabric, bandeau and straps, never a spotlight that emphasizes the figure. Incorporate `@Live_life_style` as a tiny decoration that existed in the photograph: preferably weave its letterform as fine threads into the ethnic woven pattern at the bottom of the clutch held in the right hand, or integrate it as a very small signature within the gold-thread embroidery near the skirt hem. It should be readable only with slight attention and never more prominent than the subject; place it on the clutch or hem, never skin, chest or body center. Make it follow fabric bumps, fiber direction, bending and embroidery wrinkles, accepting the same light, shadows, thread reflections and material texture rather than appearing as a digital overlay, giant watermark, glow or perfectly horizontal CG text. Keep the result as realistic high-end fashion photography with clear clothing and material detail. No nudity, see-through clothing, overly provocative pose, composition focused only on the figure, unrealistic gigantism, unnatural skeleton, excessive skin retouching, celebrity-like face, fluorescent color, extra people, other text or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年日本女性的面部身份参考，仅匹配面部身份。创作一张写实的现代蒂罗尔/巴伐利亚风时装人像：一位虚构的23—26岁成年日本女性，体格健康自然，皮肤真实，几乎正面站立并略向右转，重心落在一条腿上；保持肩高、手臂位置和姿势的细微左右差异，不故意挺胸或夸张强调身形。她穿现代重构的深苔绿色吊带迷你裙，厚实哑光麂皮质感；左右吊带从肩部向前垂落，连接胸下刺绣横带。内搭同色、完全不透明且有足够支撑的班迪上装，服装自然适应成年身形，保留重力造成的圆润度、左右差异、轻微拉伸和褶皱；裙子正面有两个大翻盖口袋、金线植物/漩涡刺绣、侧面黑色装饰纽扣和古董金色金属件。身体比例需与肩宽、胸廓、腰部和站姿协调，保留自然的腹部肌肉阴影、肩带实际承重张力和面料拉扯，不做球体形状、不自然抬高或塑料皮肤。由大型柔光箱产生均匀柔和的工作室光，立体感只来自锁骨、肩部、布料拉伸、班迪上装和吊带周围的自然阴影，不使用强调身形的聚光灯。将 `@Live_life_style` 作为拍摄时就存在的细小装饰：首选把文字形状以细线织入右手所持手拿包下部的民族风织纹，备选是在裙摆金线刺绣流线中做成极小签名；它只在稍加注意时可读，不比主体突出，不放在皮肤、胸部或身体中央。文字必须遵循包面纤维/凹凸/弯曲或刺绣褶皱，并接受相同的光影和材质反射，不能像后期数字叠加、巨大水印、发光或完美水平CG文字。整体为真实高端时装摄影，背景和服装清晰，避免裸体、透视服装、过度挑逗姿势、仅强调胸部的构图、巨大化、不自然骨骼、过度美肌、真实名人脸、荧光、额外人物、其他文字或水印。

items.title: 极简灰墙东亚女性蓝花时装人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

3:4 vertical aspect ratio, East Asian female, minimalist gray wall fashion portrait, extra-long dark brown-black straight hair, thin long bangs, single large deep blue lily ornament on the side of the face, creamy white off-the-shoulder lace corset top, foggy blue high-waisted long skirt, silver necklace and earrings, two-thirds profile, head turned to look away, not looking directly at the camera, one hand lightly raised to the side of the face, shoulders and neck relaxed, restrained and aloof, warm gray minimalist background, soft key light from top left, main colors: dark hair, creamy white, foggy blue, deep cobalt blue, 50 to 85mm fashion portrait feel, clean digital photography, soft highlights, long hair forms a massive vertical silhouette, blue flower close to the side of the face becomes the core visual anchor.

Clearly readable Soran integrated into silver thread embroidery on lace collar near face, small metal nameplate at base of deep blue flower ornament; hidden Soran integrated into blue flower petal veins, lace fibers, foggy blue skirt jacquard patterns, long hair strands, jewelry engravings; microscopic Soran composed of lace pinholes, stamen arrangement, necklace links, skirt stitches, hair strand intersections.

Negative: frequent direct gaze at camera, blue flower too small, multiple blue flowers piled up, ordinary short hair, wig feel, repeating hair bundles, creamy top overexposed, vivid blue skirt, complex background, deformed fingers, extra fingers, strong sharpening, HDR, plastic skin, commercial skin smoothing, external watermark, sticker logo, floating text, subtitles, unreadable Soran.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

3:4竖幅，东亚女性，极简灰墙时装人像，超长深棕黑直发，轻薄长刘海，脸侧单枚大型深蓝百合花饰，奶油白露肩蕾丝束身上衣，雾蓝高腰长裙，银色项链耳饰，三分之二侧身，头部侧转看向画外，不直视镜头，一手轻抬至脸侧，肩颈放松，克制疏离，暖灰极简背景，左上柔和主光，深发、奶油白、雾蓝、深钴蓝主色，50至85mm时装人像感，干净数字摄影，轻柔高光，长发形成巨大纵向轮廓，蓝花贴近脸侧成为核心视觉锚点。

清晰可读Soran融入脸旁蕾丝领缘银线刺绣、深蓝花饰基部小型金属铭牌；隐藏Soran融入蓝花花瓣脉络、蕾丝纤维、雾蓝裙提花纹、长发发丝、首饰刻纹；微观Soran由蕾丝针孔、花蕊排列、项链链节、裙装针脚、发丝交叉组成。

负向：频繁直视镜头，蓝花过小，多个蓝花堆砌，普通短发，假发感，重复发束，奶油上衣过曝，艳蓝裙装，背景复杂，手指畸形，多余手指，强锐化，HDR，塑料皮肤，商业磨皮，外贴水印，贴纸logo，漂浮文字，字幕，不可读Soran。

items.title: 章节式影像档案编辑海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Design a 3:4 vertical "Chapter-style Image Archive" editorial poster for [Character Story / Travel Record / Brand Project / Film Archive / Architectural Project].

The overall design uses a warm off-white background and restrained vertical grids. The image is quiet, clear, and has the texture of a photography book and archival publication.

[Main Image]

Place a core photographic work in the center of the frame, occupying about 50%—65% of the total area.

The main image must carry the primary emotion of this chapter and can use a full horizontal or vertical photography composition.

Retain the real environment, natural light, real character states, and slight film grain. Do not use complex cutouts or add decorative special effects.

The main image highlights only one core scene, such as:
Character working state
A certain moment during travel
The final outcome of a brand project
Behind-the-scenes film set
Actual usage state in an architectural space

[Chapter Index]

Set a narrow vertical "Chapter Index" on the left side of the frame.

Use unified numbering rules, for example:

1.1 First Encounter
1.2 Departure
1.3 Turning Point
1.4 Accumulation

Current chapter uses darker text or a low-saturation accent color to stand out, while other chapters have reduced contrast.

Chapter numbers must maintain consistent font, position, and spacing so that the audience can clearly feel the reading order.

[Auxiliary Image]

Allow the addition of 1 partial detail image, slightly overlapping the edge of the main image.

The auxiliary image can only supplement details not seen in the main image, such as:
Hand movements
Object close-ups
Tickets
Manuscripts
Building materials
Product packaging
Behind-the-scenes records

The auxiliary image must not be the same size as the main image; do not create an ordinary collage.

[Next Chapter Hint]

Reveal approximately 5%—10% of the next chapter's image edge at the bottom right of the frame.

Display only a very small part, such as:
The color of the next photo
The edge of a building
Character outlines
Natural landscapes
A small segment of a night scene

Create a visual hint that "the page is continuing."

[Information System]

Retain only four core pieces of information below the main image:

Project Name
Location
Year
Medium

Keep the text brief; do not write long explanations.

[Typography]

Titles use a restrained neutral sans-serif font.

Project name is slightly larger.

Location, year, number, and medium use small monospaced fonts or narrow sans-serif fonts.

The overall layout has a combined sense of museum gallery labels, photography books, and film slate archives.

[Color Palette]

Mainly warm off-white, charcoal black, warm gray, and the natural colors of the photo itself.

Allow the addition of only one low-saturation accent color, such as:
Dark red
Moss green
Gray-blue

The accent color is only used for the current chapter number or a minimal amount of positioning information.

[Overall Requirements]

The image has:
A sense of continuity
A sense of time
A sense of archive
A sense of publication
A sense of photographic narrative
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

为【人物故事 / 旅行记录 / 品牌项目 / 电影档案 / 建筑项目】设计一张3:4竖版“章节式影像档案”编辑海报。

整体采用暖米白背景与克制的纵向网格，画面安静、清晰、具有摄影画册和档案出版物的质感。

【主影像】

画面中央放置一张占整体约50%—65%的核心摄影作品。

主影像必须承担这一章节的主要情绪，可以采用完整横向或竖向摄影构图。

保留真实环境、自然光线、真实人物状态和轻微胶片颗粒，不做复杂抠图，不添加装饰性特效。

主影像只突出一个核心场景，例如：
人物工作状态
旅行途中某个瞬间
品牌项目最终成果
电影幕后现场
建筑空间中的真实使用状态

【章节索引】

在画面左侧设置一条窄幅纵向“章节索引”。

使用统一编号规则，例如：

1.1 初识
1.2 启程
1.3 转折
1.4 沉淀

当前章节使用较深文字或一种低饱和强调色突出，其余章节降低对比度。

章节编号必须保持统一字体、位置和间距，让观众能够清楚感受到阅读顺序。

【辅助影像】

允许加入1张局部细节图片，轻微叠压主影像边缘。

辅助图片只能补充主影像中没有被看见的细节，例如：
手部动作
物件特写
车票
手稿
建筑材料
产品包装
幕后记录

辅助图片不得与主影像同等大小，不要形成普通拼贴画。

【下一章节提示】

在画面右下方露出下一章节约5%—10%的图像边缘。

只展示极小的一部分，例如：
下一张照片的颜色
建筑边缘
人物轮廓
自然景观
一小段夜景

形成“页面正在继续”的视觉暗示。

【信息系统】

主影像下方只保留四项核心信息：

项目名称
地点
年份
媒介

文字保持简短，不写长段说明。

【字体】

标题使用克制的中性无衬线字体。

项目名称稍大。

地点、年份、编号和媒介使用小号等宽字体或窄体无衬线字体。

整体排版具有美术馆展签、摄影画册和电影场记档案的结合感。

【配色】

以暖米白、炭黑、暖灰和照片自身自然色彩为主。

只允许加入一种低饱和强调色，例如：
暗红
苔藓绿
灰蓝

强调色只用于当前章节编号或极少量定位信息。

【整体要求】

画面具有：
连续感
时间感
档案感
出版物感
摄影叙事感

items.title: 梦境东方立体纸雕女性洪崖洞夜游
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

9:16 vertical version, modern Oriental female dreamland 3D papercut art, modern oriental papercut art, layered paper cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, layered shadow box, epic oriental papercraft fantasy, contemporary oriental art poster.

The theme of the work is "She walks towards the river surface from the lights of Hongyadong."

The core narrative of the scene is: a young Oriental female slowly walks from layers of paper-carved mountain city and corridors of lights towards the steps by the river, with the river water, night wind, distant bridge, and moonlight in front of her. She walks out from the depths of prosperous and noisy lights to the wider and more open edge of the river, as if finally seeing the distance she truly wants to go after the bustle.

The main character is an adult Oriental female with a visual age of about 25, clear-headed and independent, mysterious and elegant, with a sense of calmness after passing through prosperity. The character has a delicate oval face, slender almond eyes slightly raised, and a restrained and focused expression. The character does not look at the camera, using a back view or side-back narrative posture as the emotional core.

Character's hairstyle and headwear: Black long hair tied low, with slender flowing paper art ribbons extending from the ends, wearing pale gold light patterns and small flower branch hair accessories. The headwear is light and exquisite, not complex or high-lofted.

Character's clothing: Layered paper art long dress in deep vermilion, warm gold, and ivory white, with extremely fine hollow structures of pavilions, lights, railings, waves, and city patterns on the hem and silk scarf. The outer silk scarf is long and light, spreading extensively towards the back and side-rear. The clothing must have a clear paper thickness, fine cut edges, fiber texture, slight creases, and a high-completion museum-grade paper carving craftsmanship feel. The silk scarf and hem are like a whole piece of complex hollow paper carving long scroll.

The dream carrier is: mountain city paper art pavilion clusters and riverside corridors.

Dream imagery includes: stilt houses (Diaojiaolou), lights, long steps, river surface, distant bridge, flying birds, full moon, and distant city sea of lights. All buildings, characters, river water, sky, bridges, lanterns, railings, and plants must be unified into a high-completion 3D paper carving language, not realistic photography, not ordinary CG night scenes.

The overall papercut structure adopts: a multi-layered stage style.

Composition and character actions: The main body on the left and upper part of the image is a whole surface of huge paper-carved mountain city growing vertically along the cliff. Layers of stilt houses, pavilions, corridors, terraces, railings, lanterns, and small bridges overlap each other, extending from the foreground to the background, forming an extremely complex and orderly vertical space. On the right is the open river surface, distant bridge, city skyline, and full moon night sky, forming a clear opening and closing relationship. The character is located on the riverside steps below and slightly to the middle-left of the frame, body facing the river and the distance, walking down slowly or stopping quietly, becoming the narrative focus connecting the "prosperous mountain city" and the "vast river surface."

The mountain city architecture must clearly refer to Hongyadong-style mountain stilt house clusters, but entirely processed with paper carving: multi-layered wooden pavilions, dense window lattices, layers of corridors, cantilevered platforms, bending stairs, overhanging eaves, red lanterns, and warm-light window scenes intersect with each other, forming an overwhelming sense of vertical growth and strong depth. The building density is very high, but the order is clear. Foreground buildings can be cropped by the frame to enhance the sense of spatial pressure and presence.

The foreground and midground can feature continuous paper art railings, paper lamps, stone steps, platforms, and a few paper-carved plant silhouettes, serving as a frame for the viewer to enter the interior of the mountain city. The river surface on the right is open, with detailed paper-carved ripples and moonlight reflections on the water. A bridge spans the river in the distance with its lights lit, and the distant city sea of lights forms dense points of light. A full moon and scattered flying birds are visible in the night sky. The moonlight is cool, forming a cold-warm contrast with the warm lights of the mountain city.

Overall color scheme: Mainly vermilion, warm gold, deep cyan-blue, and ivory white, with a small amount of ink bl
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

9:16竖版，现代东方女性梦境立体剪纸艺术，modern oriental papercut art，layered paper cut illustration，dimensional paper sculpture，intricate paper carving，paper diorama，layered shadow box，epic oriental papercraft fantasy，contemporary oriental art poster。

作品主题为“她从洪崖洞的灯火里走向江面”。

画面核心叙事为：一位年轻东方女性从层层叠叠的纸雕山城与灯火回廊中缓缓走向临江阶梯，面前是江水、夜风、远桥与月色。她从繁盛喧闹的灯火深处走出，来到更辽阔开阔的江面边缘，像终于在热闹之后看见自己真正要去的远方。

主体人物为视觉年龄约25岁的东方成年女性，清醒独立、神秘优雅，带一点穿越繁华后的冷静感。人物拥有清秀鹅蛋脸，细长杏眼微微抬起，神情克制而专注。人物不看镜头，采用背影或侧背影叙事姿态，作为情绪核心。

人物发型与头饰为：黑色长发低挽，发尾延展出细长流动的纸艺丝带，佩戴浅金灯饰纹样与小型花枝发饰。头饰轻盈精致，不复杂不高耸。

人物服装为：深朱红、暖金与象牙白层叠纸艺长裙，裙摆与披帛带有极为精细的楼阁、灯火、栏杆、波浪与城市纹样镂空结构，外层披帛修长轻盈，大面积向身后与侧后方展开。服装必须具有清晰纸张厚度、细密裁切边缘、纤维纹理、轻微折痕和高完成度的博物馆级纸雕工艺感，披帛与裙摆像一整片繁复的镂空纸雕长卷。

梦境载体为：山城纸艺楼阁群与临江回廊。

梦境意象包括：吊脚楼、灯火、长阶、江面、远桥、飞鸟、满月、远处城市灯海。所有建筑、人物、江水、天空、桥梁、灯笼、栏杆和植物都必须统一为高完成度的立体纸雕语言，不要写实摄影，不要普通CG夜景。

整体剪纸结构采用：多层舞台式。

构图与人物动作为：画面左侧与上方主体是一整面沿崖壁垂直生长的巨大纸雕山城，层层吊脚楼、楼阁、回廊、露台、栏杆、灯笼与小桥彼此交叠，从前景一直延伸到远景，形成极其复杂而有秩序的垂直空间。右侧是开阔江面、远桥、城市天际线与满月夜空，形成明晰的开合关系。人物位于画面下方偏中左的临江台阶之上，身体朝向江面与远方，缓步向下或安静停驻，成为连接“繁华山城”与“辽阔江面”的叙事焦点。

山城建筑必须明显参考洪崖洞式山地吊脚楼群，但全部纸雕化处理：多层木构楼阁、密集窗格、层层回廊、悬挑平台、弯折楼梯、挑檐、红灯笼、暖光窗景彼此交错，形成压倒性的垂直生长感和强烈纵深。建筑密度很高，但秩序清晰，近景建筑可以被画框裁切，增强空间压迫感与现场感。

前景与中景可以出现连续的纸艺栏杆、纸灯、石阶、平台与少量纸雕植物剪影，作为观者进入山城内部的框景。右侧江面开阔，水面有细致的纸雕波纹与月光倒影，远处一座桥梁横跨江面，桥身灯光点亮，远方城市灯海形成细密光点。夜空中可见一轮明月与零散飞鸟，月色清冷，和山城暖灯形成冷暖对比。

整体色彩方案为：朱红、暖金、深青蓝、象牙白为主，少量墨黑平衡。朱红用于楼阁主体、人物主裙、栏杆与灯笼结构；暖金用于灯火、窗格、描边与局部高光；深青蓝用于夜空、江水与远景阴影；象牙白用于镂空披帛、建筑高光、月光与部分装饰性纸层。整体色彩华丽而通透，冷暖对比明显，但不能脏浊，不要整体压黑。

光线与纸张质感为：暖金灯火从楼阁内部透出，与冷蓝夜色和月光交织，建筑纸层局部发光，江面反射灯火与月光。纸张厚度、裁切纹样、镂空栏杆、窗格、灯笼边缘和人物服装细节都必须极其丰富清晰。强化真实纸张纤维、轻微折痕、层间投影、边缘透光感和多层纸雕结构，使整张画面像一件高完成度的大型东方纸雕艺术装置。

画面整体具有东方梦境山城、纸雕夜游、江边月色、女性成长叙事和高级艺术海报感。重点不只是“洪崖洞夜景”，而是“从繁华灯火里走向辽阔江面”的情绪转折。山城必须繁盛、复杂、层层向上生长；江面必须开阔、清冷、留出呼吸空间；人物必须成为由繁入静的情绪锚点。

补充要求：强化山城垂直空间与灯火繁盛感，人物位于前景或中前景，但不能破坏整体建筑压迫感与纵深感；整个场景必须统一纸雕化，不能只是人物纸艺、背景写实。

items.title: 20岁大学生夏日校园写实人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a photorealistic 9:16 summer campus portrait of a 20-year-old adult university student.

Character: [appearance]
Outfit: [summer preppy outfit]
Location: [campus scene]
Colors: [palette]

If a reference image is provided, use it only for composition, body pose, leg position and the face-framing hand gesture. Create a completely new face, hairstyle, outfit and environment.

Keep the signature pose: one foot lightly on tiptoe, the other leg bent backward, body slightly tilted, one arm curved above the head and the other hand framing the face.

She looks directly into the camera with a bright, playful, innocent expression.

Use a subtle low-angle perspective from upper-thigh height with a 75–90mm portrait-lens look to make the figure appear naturally taller.

Add strong summer wind:
long hair sweeps dramatically to one side in large natural arcs, while the lightweight pleated skirt opens asymmetrically with medium movement.

Use light summer clothing, bare legs or short socks, bright blue sky and clean campus surroundings.

Bright side-front afternoon sunlight, clear face and eyes, no sunset, no backlight, no visible sun, no overexposure.

Realistic skin, natural anatomy, authentic photography.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创建一个写实主义的 9:16 夏日校园人像，主角是一位 20 岁的成年大学生。

角色：[外观]
服装：[夏日学院风服饰]
地点：[校园场景]
颜色：[色调]

如果提供了参考图，仅将其用于构图、身体姿势、腿部位置以及修饰脸部的手势。请创建一个全新的面部、发型、服装和环境。

保留标志性姿势：一只脚轻轻踮起，另一条腿向后弯曲，身体轻微倾斜，一只手臂弯曲在头顶上方，另一只手托在脸部周围。

她直视镜头，表情明亮、俏皮、纯真。

采用从大腿上方高度拍摄的微妙低视角，搭配 75–90mm 肖像镜头效果，使人物显得自然修长。

添加强劲的夏日风：
长发以自然的弧度戏剧性地扫向一侧，轻质百褶裙呈中等幅度的不对称摆动。

穿着轻便的夏装，光腿或穿短袜，背景是明亮的蓝天和整洁的校园环境。

明亮的午后侧前方阳光，清晰的面部和眼睛，没有日落，没有背光，看不见太阳，没有过度曝光。

真实的皮肤，自然的解剖结构，真实的摄影效果。

items.title: 光影流转的动漫手部极致特写
items.description: 动漫电影感手部特写：两个角色以克制而细腻的动作伸手回应，电影布光与浅景深突出手指和情绪交流。
items.prompt: Create a clean 16:9 anime-style cinematic close-up focused on two characters hands and fingers. On the right, a cool young man in a suit extends one hand calmly toward the other character; on the left, the second character responds with a visible hand. Keep the gesture controlled and emotionally subtle, with the hands as the clear focal point and the faces secondary or outside the frame. Use cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, soft shadows, a quiet atmosphere, a clean composition and restrained colors. The scene is only a visual description: do not include any text, speech bubbles, captions, logos or watermarks. Avoid messy text, misspelled characters, blur, photorealism, 3D rendering, dark muddy colors, complex backgrounds, small text and crowded layouts.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张16:9动漫风格的电影感手部特写，聚焦两个角色的手和手指。右侧是一位穿西装的酷帅年轻男性，平静地向另一角色伸出一只手；左侧第二个角色用可见的手作出回应。动作沉着克制，情绪细腻，让手部成为明确视觉焦点，面部可作为次要元素或不出现在画面中。使用电影布光、浅景深、柔和阴影、宁静氛围、简洁构图和克制色彩。场景只作为视觉描述，不要加入任何文字、对话气泡、字幕、标志或水印。避免杂乱文字、错别字、模糊、写实、3D渲染、暗沉脏色、复杂背景、小字和拥挤布局。

items.title: CITRUS GLOW香橙玻璃蜡烛静物
items.description: 暖琥珀色圆形玻璃蜡烛内含香橙果片与橙色蜡，标注CITRUS GLOW，放在白色丝绸上，以柔和自然光和俯视构图呈现极简产品静物。
items.prompt: A minimal still life of a round glass candle filled with orange slices, labeled "CITRUS GLOW", placed on elegant white silk fabric. The candle glass is translucent warm amber, and the wax matches the orange color of the fruit. The scene is softly lit by natural daylight with subtle shadows and smooth highlights. Hyperrealistic texture, clean aesthetic, top-down view, styled like high-end product photography.
items.prompt_zh: 一组极简静物：圆形玻璃蜡烛内填有香橙果片，标签准确写着“CITRUS GLOW”，置于优雅的白色丝绸织物上。烛杯为半透明暖琥珀色玻璃，蜡体呈与香橙果肉相配的橙色。柔和自然日光照亮场景，形成轻微阴影和平滑高光。质感超写实，美学干净，采用自上而下的俯视视角，呈现高端产品摄影风格。

items.title: COFFEE BREAK虚构药房风格概念包装

The box is on the left, clean and minimalist, featuring the exact bold product name "COFFEE BREAK" and the witty line "Take one break daily." Next to the box is a silver blister pack containing exactly 8 decorative themed capsules shaped like small coffee cups. Neutral background, soft lighting, sharp focus, modern packaging aesthetic.
