items.prompt_zh: 一张方形数字摄影作品，展示虚构品牌MELLOW Pharmacy的药房风格概念产品。纸盒位于左侧，干净极简，醒目且准确地印着产品名“COFFEE BREAK”，并配上俏皮文案“Take one break daily.”。纸盒旁是一板银色泡罩包装，内含恰好8个小咖啡杯造型的主题装饰胶囊。中性背景、柔和灯光、清晰对焦和现代包装美学。这是虚构概念包装，不是真实药品。

items.title: 2026端午节像素庆典海报
items.description: 以像素化视觉呈现2026年端午节庆典，使用绿色基调、莫兰迪色和少量撞色。
items.prompt: Create a finished vertical 3:4 pixel-art celebration poster for the 2026 Dragon Boat Festival on June 19, 2026. Use a green base with restrained Morandi tones and a small amount of contrasting accent color. Build a clear festive composition with crisp visible pixels, charming Dragon Boat Festival motifs, balanced negative space and coherent retro-game rendering. Keep it polished, readable and culturally respectful. No unresolved variables, unrelated logos, watermarks or gibberish text.
items.prompt_zh: 生成一张竖版3:4的2026年端午节像素庆典海报，日期为2026年6月19日。以绿色为基调，搭配克制的莫兰迪色调和少量撞色点缀。构建清晰的节日构图，使用利落可见像素、端午节庆典元素、平衡留白和统一复古游戏视觉。画面精致易读并尊重文化语境。不要遗留变量、无关标志、水印或乱码文字。

items.title: 橄榄树陶瓷玻璃马赛克墙面
items.description: 以橄榄树为具体示例的马赛克墙面装饰：缺角陶瓷和玻璃碎片呈现日晒褪色的海沫绿与风化赭黄，嵌入开裂灰泥墙，保留不规则拼片、灰缝和古朴岁月感。
items.prompt: A mosaic mural of a stylized olive tree, crafted from chipped ceramic and glass shards in sun-faded seafoam green and weathered ochre. Set into a cracked plaster wall, the irregular shapes and grout lines add a rustic, timeworn charm.
items.prompt_zh: 一幅风格化橄榄树马赛克壁画，由缺角的陶瓷碎片与玻璃碎片拼成，使用日晒褪色的海沫绿和历经风化的赭黄色。壁画嵌在开裂的灰泥墙中，不规则的拼片形状与灰缝增添古朴的岁月感。

items.title: PULSELAB霓虹耳机创意广告
items.description: 以虚构品牌PULSELAB的头戴耳机为中心，结合霓虹卷曲线与放射光芒插画，在深色背景上呈现高对比产品广告。
items.prompt: Create a high-impact modern advertisement against a clean dark background. Center one pair of over-ear wireless headphones, sharply lit and highly detailed. Around the headphones, surreal stylized illustrations of abstract curls and sunbursts explode outward in a vibrant neon color palette. Keep the product clearly dominant and the composition clean. At the top, place bold uppercase ad copy reading exactly "FEEL THE BEAT". At the bottom, place an original simple wordmark logo reading exactly "PULSELAB", a fictional audio brand. No people.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张具有强烈视觉冲击力的现代广告，以干净的深色背景衬托主体。将一副头戴式无线耳机放在画面中央，照明锐利，细节清晰。耳机周围是向外迸发的超现实风格抽象卷曲线和放射状光芒插画，采用鲜活的霓虹配色。保持产品主导地位和清爽构图。顶部放置粗体大写广告文案，准确写为“FEEL THE BEAT”；底部放置原创简洁文字标志，准确写为“PULSELAB”，这是一个虚构音频品牌。画面无人。

items.title: 鲜艳童趣涂鸦平面插画
items.description: 将输入图像转绘为色彩鲜艳、造型简洁的童趣涂鸦平面插画，保留略不完美的手绘线条和白纸上的手工感。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_image; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Use the uploaded source_image as the content reference. Reconstruct it as a single flat illustration infused with playful childlike doodle elements. Use a bold, vibrant, and whimsical color palette, simplifying all details into clean, flat shapes. The artwork should have a handcrafted feel with slightly imperfect hand-drawn lines, creating a charming, imaginative style that looks as if it were drawn on white paper.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_image生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

以上传的 source_image 作为内容参考，将其重构为一幅融入俏皮童趣涂鸦元素的平面插画。使用大胆、鲜艳、充满奇思妙想的配色，将所有细节简化为干净的平面形状。画面应带有手工感和略不完美的手绘线条，呈现迷人、富于想象力的风格，仿佛画在白纸上。

items.title: 猫咪陶瓷多肉花盆产品摄影
items.description: 带友善表情的亮釉猫形陶瓷花盆，搭配十二卷、莲座状拟石莲花与小白花，以柔和中性背景和自然漫射光呈现清爽极简产品摄影。
items.prompt: A high-quality photo of a cute ceramic cat-shaped planter with a glossy finish, filled with a variety of vibrant succulents and greenery including a spiky Haworthia, a rosette-shaped Echeveria, and delicate white flowers. The planter has a friendly face and sits on a soft, neutral background with diffused natural lighting, showcasing fine textures and color contrast in a clean, minimalistic composition.
items.prompt_zh: 一张高品质产品照片：可爱的猫形陶瓷花盆，表面具有亮釉光泽，盆中种有鲜活多肉植物与绿植，包括叶片尖挺的十二卷、莲座状的拟石莲花以及娇小白花。花盆带着友善表情，置于柔和的中性背景前，以自然漫射光照明。在干净极简的构图中展现细腻材质与色彩对比。

items.title: 90年代复古赛璐璐动画风格插画
items.description: 将上传附图转化为带模拟胶片颗粒和视觉噪声的90年代复古赛璐璐动画风格数字插画，使用深色调、扁平阴影和忧郁细节氛围。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_image; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Edit the uploaded source image into a retro 1990s anime-style digital illustration. Preserve the source image's subject, composition and recognizable content while translating its rendering into classic celluloid animation. Add a heavy analog-film grain texture and visible visual noise derived from the attached image, with a dark color palette, flat 1990s cel shading, restrained tonal steps and a melancholic, richly detailed atmosphere. Keep the result coherent and intentionally illustrated rather than photorealistic, with hand-drawn animation character, crisp shape separation and tactile film wear. Do not add unrelated subjects, modern glossy 3D rendering, photorealistic retouching, random text, logo or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_image生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

将上传的原始图像编辑为90年代复古动漫风格的数字插画。保留原图的主体、构图和可辨识内容，同时将画面表现转换为经典赛璐璐动画。加入厚重的模拟胶片颗粒和源自附图的可见视觉噪声，使用深色调、扁平的90年代赛璐璐阴影、克制的色调层级，以及忧郁而细节丰富的氛围。最终效果应连贯且明确为手绘动画式插画，而不是照片写实修图；保持清晰的形状分离、动画手绘感和带触感的胶片磨损。不要添加无关主体、现代光泽3D渲染、照片级修饰、随机文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 绿叶水珠中的ARAVIA面霜产品摄影
items.description: 白色面霜软管斜置于圆形图表和绿叶上，明亮影棚光突出水珠、冷凝与清新质感。示例采用来源中文版的CREAM与ARAVIA标题。
items.prompt: Commercial product photography of one white Aravia Correcting Azelaic Cream tube placed diagonally on a white circular chart diagram over a bed of fresh green leaves. Put the exact words "CREAM" and "ARAVIA" at the top; this example uses the English heading specified in the source Chinese version. Include floating fresh green leaves in the foreground, fresh water droplets and condensation on surfaces. Use bright white studio lighting and a clean photorealistic 3D composition with crisp, high-resolution, 8K-style detail. Preserve the diagonal tube, circular graphic, layered greenery and refreshing wet surface texture as the main visual structure.
items.prompt_zh: 商业产品摄影：一支白色Aravia Correcting Azelaic Cream面霜软管斜放在白色圆形图表上，图表下铺一层新鲜绿叶。画面顶部准确显示“CREAM”和“ARAVIA”；此示例采用来源中文版指定的英文标题。前景有漂浮的新鲜绿叶，表面带清晰水珠和冷凝质感。使用明亮白色影棚灯光，呈现干净逼真的3D构图与清晰、高分辨率、8K风格细节。以斜向软管、圆形图形、层叠绿叶和清新湿润表面作为主要视觉结构。

items.title: CCD韩系女友居家夜拍胶片感
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

9:16, CCD / point-and-shoot camera direct flash home night shoot, Korean girlfriend perspective, slight film grain and digital compression, underexposed shadows, close-up flash snapshot. Adult Korean girl, oval face, long straight black hair in a low ponytail with wisps of hair on the sides of the face, large area of tear-like pink blush under the eyes, glass lips only forming moist reflections on the lip surface, real skin texture, pores and tiny fuzz, natural semi-matte skin, restrained narrow highlights on the bridge of the nose and T-zone. Loose white sweatshirt, sitting on a black leather sofa, beside her is an off-white textured throw pillow, a transparent glass soda bottle appears in the foreground at the bottom right corner of the frame. Slightly high-angle close-up selfie, one hand raised to the mouth, index finger lightly touching the corner of the mouth, the other eye slightly squinted, looking directly at the camera, with a bit of a thoughtful and cute expression. The flash only illuminates the person, fingers, and the glass edge of the soda bottle, the background quickly darkens, retaining the feeling of a casual home night snapshot. No finger dislocations, extra people, plastic skin, over-sharpening, text or logos becoming the visual subject.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

9:16，CCD / 傻瓜机直闪居家夜拍，韩系女友视角，轻微胶片颗粒与数码压缩，暗部欠曝，近距离闪光快照。成年韩系女生，鹅蛋脸，黑长直低马尾配脸侧碎发，眼下大面积泪感粉红腮红，玻璃唇只在唇面形成湿润反光，真实皮肤纹理、毛孔与细小绒毛，自然半哑光皮肤，鼻梁与 T 区保留克制窄高光。宽松白色卫衣，坐在黑色皮质沙发上，身旁有米白纹理抱枕，一只叠层玻璃汽水瓶出现在画面右下角前景。略高机位近景自拍，一只手抬到嘴边，食指轻轻触碰嘴角，另一只眼略微眯起，直视镜头，带一点若有所思的可爱神情。闪光灯只打亮人物、手指与汽水瓶玻璃边缘，背景快速变暗，保留居家夜晚随手抓拍感。不要手指错位、额外人物、塑料皮肤、过度锐化、文字商标成为视觉主体。

items.title: 圣托里尼阿马尔菲巴黎奢华旅行融合海报
items.description: 3:4 奢华旅行海报：将圣托里尼、阿马尔菲海岸与巴黎融合为一段连续旅行叙事，固定英文标题、目的地行和标语，配合统一建筑尺度与夕阳到夜景的光线过渡。
items.prompt:
Create a premium 3:4 vertical luxury travel poster that blends Santorini, the Amalfi Coast and Paris into one unified, original editorial composition, not a three-image collage and not three separate panels. The fixed main title is “MEDITERRANEAN & PARIS ESCAPES”; the fixed destination line is “SANTORINI 🇬🇷 • AMALFI COAST 🇮🇹 • PARIS 🇫🇷”; the fixed tagline is “Three Icons. One Unforgettable Journey.”

Build one continuous luxury travel journey: whitewashed Cycladic buildings, blue-domed churches, cliff paths, bougainvillea, deep-blue Aegean water and golden sunset from Santorini flow into Amalfi cliffside villas, terraced gardens, infinity pools, stone stairs, yachts and warm windows, then transition naturally toward the Eiffel Tower, Parisian rooftops, Seine bridges, riverside cafes, vintage lamps, bicycles and flower-filled balconies. Connect all three through one elevated viewpoint, atmospheric depth, believable architectural scale and coherent light. Avoid hard destination boundaries, duplicated landmarks or random architecture.

Place the main architectural and coastal visual toward the center with generous upper negative space for premium typography. Add restrained vintage-European travel-poster details: thin ornamental borders, corner flourishes, delicate divider lines and a few small symbols without overpowering the scenery. Use refined high-fashion serif typography with a small amount of elegant script. Keep the main title large, clean and readable without covering the Eiffel Tower, blue-domed churches or key architecture; keep the destination line and tagline aligned and readable, with no other large blocks of text.

Art direction: European luxury travel campaign, boutique travel magazine and vintage-meets-modern editorial design. Keep the scenery highly realistic with a subtle premium architectural-diorama refinement, never a plastic model. Show believable stone, stucco, wood, glass, water, metal, rooftops and flowers. Maintain clear foreground, middle-ground and background separation, elegant whitespace and an uncrowded composition.

Blend warm Santorini sunset gold into the Amalfi Mediterranean twilight and then a refined golden Paris evening. Add soft clouds, slight atmospheric haze, controlled volumetric glow, natural shadows, water reflections and restrained cinematic bloom. Use warm ivory, creamy white, Mediterranean blue, Santorini cobalt, sea turquoise, soft sunset gold, muted terracotta, beige, warm charcoal, deep navy and small champagne-gold accents. The palette must feel expensive, warm, sophisticated and cohesive; avoid fluorescent or oversaturated color.

Negative constraints: no split screen, three separate posters, obvious collage, disconnected scenes, duplicated landmarks, distorted Eiffel Tower, incorrect architecture or flags, floating buildings, warped roads or stairs, excessive boats, overcrowded composition, misspelled destination names, excessive text, excessive lens flare, watercolor, cartoon style, cheap tourist-poster look, low-resolution detail, visual clutter, copied reference layout, logo or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张 3:4 竖幅的顶级奢华旅行海报，将圣托里尼、阿马尔菲海岸和巴黎融合为一个统一、全新的编辑构图，而不是三张图的拼接或三个独立分屏。主标题固定为“MEDITERRANEAN & PARIS ESCAPES”，目的地行固定为“SANTORINI 🇬🇷 • AMALFI COAST 🇮🇹 • PARIS 🇫🇷”，标语固定为“Three Icons. One Unforgettable Journey.”

场景是一段连续的奢华旅行旅程：从圣托里尼的白色基克拉迪建筑、蓝顶教堂、悬崖小径、九重葛、深蓝爱琴海与金色夕阳，流动到阿马尔菲海岸的悬崖别墅、梯田花园、无边泳池、石阶、游艇与温暖窗光，再自然过渡到巴黎的埃菲尔铁塔、巴黎屋顶、塞纳河桥梁、河畔咖啡馆、复古路灯、自行车和鲜花阳台。三地必须通过统一的高空视角、大气透视、建筑尺度和光线连接，不要出现硬切的目的地边界、重复地标或随机建筑。

中心安排主要建筑与海岸视觉，上方保留充足留白用于高级排版。使用精致的复古欧洲旅行海报装饰：细装饰边框、角落花纹、细分隔线和少量符号，但不可压过景观。排版使用高级时尚衬线体与少量细手写体，主标题大而清晰，不遮挡埃菲尔铁塔、蓝顶教堂或主要建筑；目的地行与标语排列整齐、可读，不添加其他大段文字。

艺术方向为欧洲奢华旅行活动、精品旅行杂志和复古遇上现代的编辑设计。场景高度写实，带轻微高级 3D 建筑模型般的精致感，但不能像塑料模型；表现石材、灰泥、木材、玻璃、水面、金属、屋顶和花卉的真实纹理。前景、中景、背景层次清楚，保持优雅留白和不过度拥挤。

光线从圣托里尼暖金夕阳，经阿马尔菲温暖地中海黄昏，过渡到巴黎精致的金色夜景；加入柔和云层、轻微大气薄雾、可控体积光、自然阴影、水面反射和克制电影光晕。配色使用暖象牙、乳白、地中海蓝、圣托里尼钴蓝、海洋青、夕阳金、柔和陶土、米色、暖炭灰、深海军蓝和少量香槟金，整体昂贵、温暖、精致且连贯，避免荧光色和过饱和。

负面约束：不要分屏、三张独立海报、明显拼贴、断裂场景、重复地标、变形埃菲尔铁塔、错误建筑或国旗、悬浮建筑、扭曲道路阶梯、过多船只、拥挤构图、拼写错误、过多文字、过度镜头光晕、水彩、卡通、廉价旅游海报感、低分辨率、视觉杂乱、复制参考图布局、Logo 或水印。

items.title: 宠物照片转高端生活方式品牌产品展板
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的参数化产品设计工作流。使用时必须上传一张宠物照片作为 source_photo；流程会保留宠物识别特征，并生成统一品牌系统与多种真实产品的高端视觉展板。不绑定人物参考图。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Upload one clear pet photo as the required source_photo input. Build a complete, original, premium lifestyle brand around this real pet rather than merely printing the photo onto products.

First preserve the pet's recognizable identity: species and breed cues, fur colors and patterns, face and ear shape, eyes, nose, fur texture, distinctive markings and characteristic expression. The pet may be represented as a realistic portrait, hand-drawn line art, minimalist illustration, partial outline, silhouette or brand graphic, but every use must remain recognizably based on the uploaded pet. Do not turn it into a generic cartoon cat or dog.

Create a simple high-end English brand name, an original logo, a pet-specific graphic symbol, a restrained brand font system, 2-4 primary colors, a short natural English slogan, packaging language and a unified visual identity. The result should feel like an independent designer, lifestyle, cultural-creative, premium pet or editorial brand with real commercial value, not an ordinary pet shop.

Extend the same brand system across a curated 6-grid, 8-grid or 9-grid product display board. Each grid shows one product type, with consistent brand name, logo, typography, color system and visual language, while the artwork changes appropriately for the product. Possible products include ceramic or coffee mugs, thermos or water cups, glassware, dinner plates, pet bowls, trays, coasters, stationery, notebooks, calendars, postcards, greeting cards, folders, labels, stickers, keychains, phone cases, card sleeves, wallets, badges, pendants, luggage tags, throw pillows, blankets, carpets, scented candles, storage boxes, tabletop ornaments, decorative paintings, posters, T-shirts, hoodies, canvas bags, aprons, caps, socks, pet scarves, gift boxes, paper bags, hang tags, brand cards, shipping packaging, brand stickers and limited-edition packaging.

Redesign for material and use instead of mechanically repeating the pet image. Some products may use the pet's head, others line art, the logo, partial ears, nose, tail or paw prints, and some may use only abstract brand symbols with no pet image. Keep ceramic, cotton, paper, metal, fabric, glass and packaging proportions physically believable, with realistic shadows, folds, reflections and print/emboss details.

Use a modern lifestyle-brand and premium commercial-product photography style: low-saturation colors, soft high-end studio lighting, generous white space, restrained typography, clean editorial layout and believable product mockups. Avoid cheap marketplace styling, children's cartoon aesthetics, clutter, overly bright colors and repeatedly pasting the same pet photo. Output a polished 3:4 or 4:5 launch-board image that feels like a real brand launch, design case study or premium product catalog.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

请上传一张清晰的宠物照片，作为必需的 source_photo 输入。围绕这只真实宠物创建一个完整、原创且高端的生活方式品牌，不要只是把宠物照片机械地印到每件产品上。

首先保留宠物的可识别特征：物种与品种线索、毛色和花纹、脸型与耳朵形状、眼睛、鼻子、毛发质感、独特标记以及标志性表情。宠物可以被表现为写实肖像、手绘线稿、极简插画、局部轮廓、剪影或品牌图形，但所有表现都必须能识别出源照片中的宠物。不要把它变成普通的通用卡通猫或狗。

根据宠物的外观、性格和气质，创建简洁高级的英文品牌名、原创 Logo、宠物专属图形符号、克制的品牌字体系统、2-4 个主色、自然简短的英文 Slogan、包装设计语言和统一的视觉识别系统。整体应像独立设计师品牌、生活方式品牌、文创品牌、高端宠物品牌或编辑设计品牌，具有真实商业价值，而不是普通宠物店风格。

将同一套品牌系统延展到一张 6 宫格、8 宫格或 9 宫格的产品展示板。每个格子只展示一种产品类型，但所有产品保持相同的品牌名、Logo、字体系统、色彩系统和视觉语言，同时根据产品用途改变具体设计。可选产品包括陶瓷杯、咖啡杯、保温杯、水杯、玻璃杯、餐盘、宠物碗、托盘、杯垫、文具、便签、手账本、笔记本、日历、明信片、贺卡、文件夹、标签、贴纸、钥匙扣、手机壳、卡套、钱包、徽章、吊坠、行李牌、抱枕、毯子、地毯、香薰蜡烛、收纳盒、桌面摆件、装饰画、海报、T 恤、连帽衫、帆布包、围裙、棒球帽、袜子、宠物围巾、礼盒、纸袋、吊牌、品牌卡片、快递包装、品牌贴纸和限量版系列包装。

要根据材质和用途重新设计，而不是重复粘贴宠物照片。有些产品可以使用宠物头像，有些使用线稿、Logo、局部耳朵/鼻子/尾巴/爪印，有些只保留抽象品牌符号而不出现宠物。陶瓷、棉布、纸张、金属、织物、玻璃和包装的比例必须真实可信，并表现自然阴影、折痕、反光、印刷与压纹细节。

采用现代生活方式品牌与高端商业产品摄影风格：低饱和色彩、柔和高级影棚光、大量留白、克制排版、干净的编辑式布局和可信的产品 Mockup。避免廉价电商风、儿童卡通感、元素堆叠、过亮颜色以及把同一张宠物照片反复贴到所有产品上。输出一张 3:4 或 4:5 的高端品牌发布展板，整体像真实品牌发布会、品牌设计案例或高级产品目录。

items.title: 真实照片与稚拙扁平插画上下分屏海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的参数化海报工作流。每次上传一张 source_photo，分别输出一张独立的 3:4 高级设计海报；上半部保留真实照片，下半部重构为稚拙扁平编辑插画。不绑定人物参考图。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Use the uploaded source_photo to create one independent premium design poster. Never make a multi-image collage; each uploaded photo receives its own output. Use a 3:4 vertical canvas divided into two regions with exactly equal height, 50% top and 50% bottom.

In the upper half, preserve the original photo's subject structure, realistic texture, natural light and shadow, and color atmosphere. Apply only subtle high-end photographic grading with an art-magazine, independent-publication or exhibition-photography feel. Extend environmental background naturally when needed for the aspect ratio, but never stretch, distort or change the subject.

In the lower half, extract the most recognizable subject, outline, posture and narrative relationship from the photo and reconstruct it as a relaxed, naive Korean-style flat editorial illustration. Preserve the broad layout, object relationships and core action, but remove realistic lighting, perspective and material detail. Generalize the subject into rounded, simple, slightly exaggerated geometric shapes with rough, shaky, partly broken black hand-drawn outlines and flat solid fills. Keep the lower illustration instantly recognizable without becoming realistic.

Maintain one clear visual center. Use scale changes, misalignment, occlusion, slight cropping and incomplete symmetry to create a light rhythm. Support the subject with large bright solid color areas and white space, using partial or complete color blocks as breathing room. Extract a limited set of high-brightness, high-purity colors from the original photo instead of applying a fixed palette. Bright blue, red, yellow, green and white may create playful tension. Avoid gradients, shadows, muddy gray colors, complex mixing and plastic effects.

Create a short English title from the uploaded photo's subject, action, mood or story, plus only a few tiny short sentences, object words, location words, numbers or playful annotations. The title may use uneven handwritten lettering or a slight tilt; small text stays clear and restrained. Arrange text along the subject outline, color-block edge, white space or central axis, with slight rotation, misalignment, splitting or interlacing so it belongs to the illustration. Do not add unrelated text.

The final visual language is real photography plus naive flat illustration plus relaxed editorial design: bright, childlike, intimate, playful and design-oriented. Whether the source subject is a person, animal, plant, building, object, vehicle, food or natural scene, preserve a clear visual echo between the original photo and the lower illustration. Avoid cheap cartoons, complex rendering, 3D textures, commercial sticker styling and generic children's illustration templates.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

使用上传的 source_photo 创建一张独立的高级设计海报。不要制作多图拼贴；每上传一张照片，就单独输出一张海报。画布采用 3:4 竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格相等，各占画面 50%。

上半部分保留原始照片的主体结构、真实质感、自然光影和色彩氛围。只进行轻微的高级摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物或展览摄影质感。为适配画幅时可以自然延展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态和叙事关系，重构为轻松、稚拙的韩式扁平编辑插画。保留原图的大致布局、物体关系和核心动作，但去除写实光影、透视和材质细节。将主体概括为圆润、简单、略带夸张的几何形状，以粗糙抖动、局部断开的黑色手绘轮廓搭配纯色平涂。插画要一眼可辨，但不要变成写实画面。

保持一个明确的视觉中心。通过大小变化、错位、遮挡、轻微裁切和不完全对称建立轻快节奏。使用大面积明亮纯色与留白承托主体，将局部或完整色块作为呼吸空间。应从原始照片中提取数量有限的高明度、高纯度颜色，不要机械套用固定色卡；亮蓝、红、黄、绿、白可以形成童趣张力。避免渐变、阴影、灰脏色、复杂混色和塑料感。

根据上传照片的主体、动作、情绪或故事提炼一个简短英文标题，并搭配少量极小短句、对象词、地点词、编号或俏皮注释。主标题可以使用粗细不均的手写感字体或轻微倾斜，小字保持清晰克制。文字可沿主体轮廓、色块边缘、留白区域或画面轴线排列，并加入轻微旋转、错位、拆分或穿插，让文字成为插画的一部分。不要添加无关文字。

最终呈现真实摄影 × 稚拙扁平插画 × 轻松编辑设计的视觉语言：明快、童趣、亲切、俏皮、松弛且有设计感。无论源照片主体是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、交通工具、食物还是自然场景，都要保持原图与下方插画之间清晰的视觉呼应。避免廉价卡通、复杂描绘、3D 质感、商业贴纸风和模板化儿童插画。

items.title: 别喝完了草莓牛奶趣味广告
items.description: 虚构Q版卡通儿童拉住超大草莓牛奶瓶的极简趣味产品广告，结合写实食品摄影与2D插画对比。
items.prompt: Create a playful minimalist 16:9 product advertisement on a clean pure-white background. A realistic human hand enters from the top-left, gently holding and lifting an oversized strawberry milk bottle diagonally. The bottle appears enormous beside a tiny fictional chibi cartoon child. The child hugs and pulls the bottle with both hands while sliding backward, creating a funny tug-of-war. Use wide eyes, flushed cheeks, sweat droplets, speed lines, motion marks and tiny dust clouds to show effort. Add a hand-drawn comic speech bubble above the character reading “Don’t finish it yet!!”. Use clean black outlines, soft pastel colors, expressive anime-inspired features, oversized head, tiny body and dynamic pose. Render the strawberry milk bottle with photorealistic condensation, creamy liquid, fresh strawberries and premium commercial food lighting, contrasting with the cute flat 2D illustration. Keep lots of negative space, bright high-key light, soft shadows and a modern social-media advertising aesthetic. No real child, no logos, no watermark and no extra readable text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张16:9横幅、俏皮极简的产品广告，背景为干净纯白。一只写实人手从左上角伸入，轻轻握住并以对角线提起一瓶超大草莓牛奶。瓶子相对于一个虚构的迷你Q版卡通儿童显得巨大。儿童用双手抱住并拉住牛奶瓶，双脚向后滑动，形成有趣的拔河效果。用睁大的眼睛、红润脸颊、汗滴、速度线、动作线和脚后的小尘土表现用力。角色上方加入手绘漫画气泡，文字为“Don’t finish it yet!!”。使用干净黑色轮廓、柔和粉彩、富有表现力的动漫风特征、夸张大头、小身体和动态姿势。草莓牛奶瓶采用写实冷凝水、奶油质感、鲜草莓和高级商业食品光效，与可爱的扁平2D插画形成对比。保留大量留白、明亮高调光线、柔和阴影和现代社交媒体广告感。不要真实儿童、logo、水印或其他可读文字。

items.title: READY TO SERVE网球训练广告海报
items.description: 网球拍与网球鞋跨越球场和电光蓝色块的高冲击力网球训练广告海报，主标语为READY TO SERVE。
items.prompt: Create a high-impact 16:9 landscape tennis training advertising poster. Divide the composition into two functional areas: the upper half is a clean hard-light tennis-court scene with concise structural lines, while the lower half is a bright saturated electric-blue color field. A realistic tennis racket and a pair of tennis shoes cross the boundary diagonally in a dynamic training motion, leaping from the court into the color field; keep both objects sharply detailed with clear cast shadows on the blue area. Use white court lines and cool structural gray in the upper scene, electric blue as the dominant lower color, and neon yellow-green accents on the racket strings and shoe details. Add bold sports-ad typography at the bottom reading “READY TO SERVE”, with tight tracking and stable placement. Add only a small vertical rhythm line reading “TENNIS TRAINING”. Use compressed bird's-eye space, hard shadows, slight print texture, distinct borders and crisp high-brightness color. No people, logos, watermark, collage clutter or extra readable text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张高冲击力的16:9横向网球训练广告海报。将画面分为两个功能区域：上半部是带硬光的干净网球场景，使用简洁结构线；下半部是一整片明亮高饱和的电光蓝色块。一支写实网球拍和一双网球鞋以对角线动态跨越分界，从球场跃入色块，物体细节要清晰，并在蓝色区域投下明确阴影。上方场景使用白色球场线和冷灰结构色，下方以电光蓝为主色，球拍线床和鞋部细节加入霓虹黄绿色强调。底部加入粗重运动广告字体“READY TO SERVE”，字距紧凑、位置稳定；只添加一条小型竖向节奏信息“TENNIS TRAINING”。采用压缩的鸟瞰空间、硬阴影、轻微印刷纹理、清晰边界和高亮度鲜明色彩。不要人物、logo、水印、杂乱拼贴或其他可读文字。

items.title: 三联漫画角色情绪色彩设定海报
items.description: 同一虚构日本漫画角色的竖幅三联角色设定海报，以钴蓝宁静、珊瑚红活力和金黄梦幻三种氛围展示受控变化。
items.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 triptych graphic poster divided into three equal horizontal panels, featuring the same fictional Japanese manga-style character in every panel. Keep the face, eyes, nose, mouth, face shape, apparent age and hair color identical across all panels; vary only hairstyle, bangs, expression, head angle, glasses and small accessories like a professional character design sheet. Each panel is a shoulder-up portrait with bold graphic poster aesthetics, thick clean line art, minimal detail and large flat color shapes. Use three concrete moods: calm in cobalt blue, energetic in coral red, and dreamy in golden yellow; each panel uses its single dominant color plus black and white. Do not use a traditional background: immerse the character in each mood's atmosphere so the ambient color reflects naturally on skin, hair and clothing, as if the character exists inside that light and air. No text, logos, UI elements or speech bubbles. Each panel should stand alone while forming a cohesive character-design series. The subject is fictional and illustrated, not a real person.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张9:16竖幅三联图形海报，画布被分成三个等高的横向面板，每个面板都展示同一个虚构的日本漫画风格角色。三个面板中脸部、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、脸型、观感年龄和发色必须完全一致，只改变发型、刘海、表情、头部角度、眼镜和少量配饰，像专业角色设定表。每个面板都是肩部以上肖像，采用大胆的平面海报美学、粗而干净的线稿、极少细节和大面积纯色块。固定三种情绪：钴蓝色的宁静、珊瑚红的活力、金黄色的梦幻；每个面板只使用对应主色，并加入黑白。不要传统背景，而要让角色沉浸在每种情绪的氛围中，使环境色自然映射到皮肤、头发和服装上，仿佛角色存在于那种光线和空气里。不要文字、logo、UI元素或对话气泡。每个面板都应能独立成画，同时组成统一的角色设计系列。主体是虚构插画角色，不是真实人物。

items.title: 秋日湖畔茶屋复古手绘海报
items.description: 秋日湖畔茶屋主题的中世纪旅行海报风复古手绘模板，采用陈旧纸张、黑色墨线、低饱和大地色和丝网印刷纹理。
items.prompt: Create a vintage hand-illustrated poster featuring an autumn tea house beside a quiet mountain lake. Use detailed black ink linework, simplified graphic shapes, subtle crosshatching, muted ochre, moss green, faded brick red and slate-blue colors, and a soft aged-paper background. Give it an authentic mid-century travel-poster and screen-print aesthetic with slightly imperfect ink texture, gentle grain, faded colors and a handmade printed feel. Keep the composition clean and elegant with the tea house and lake centered, balanced negative space, small atmospheric mountain and reed details, and minimal decoration. Add simple vintage typography reading “AUTUMN TEA HOUSE” at the top. Nostalgic, artistic, timeless, editorial and sophisticated, in a striking vertical 9:16 poster composition. No people, logos, watermark or extra readable text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张以安静山间湖畔的秋日茶屋为主题的复古手绘海报。使用细致的黑色墨线、简化的图形形状、轻微排线、低饱和赭黄、苔藓绿、褪色砖红和石板蓝，以及柔和的陈旧纸张背景。呈现真实的中世纪旅行海报与丝网印刷美学，带有略微不完美的油墨纹理、柔和颗粒、褪色效果和手工印刷感。构图保持干净优雅，让茶屋与湖面位于视觉中心，保留平衡留白，并加入少量山景和芦苇氛围细节，装饰从简。顶部加入简单复古字体“AUTUMN TEA HOUSE”。整体怀旧、艺术、 timeless、编辑感和精致，采用醒目的竖幅9:16海报构图。不要人物、logo、水印或其他可读文字。

items.title: 白色天鹅栅格线条实验海报
items.description: 以隐藏的白色天鹅侧影为核心形体、深海军蓝背景和象牙色平行栅格线构成的9:16欧普艺术实验海报。
items.prompt: Create a refined 9:16 experimental poster titled "SWAN IN MOTION" on a deep navy background with a continuous field of fine warm-ivory parallel raster lines. Make a hidden three-dimensional white swan in profile emerge through smooth line compression, expansion, bending and negative space, occupying roughly 70-80% of the composition without a separate outline or realistic rendering. Use only a few large controlled deformation zones; away from the swan, lines gradually return to straight parallel form. Prioritize extremely fine, sharp, smooth, evenly spaced and uninterrupted curves. Add exactly three small typography blocks in quieter negative spaces using minimal modern sans-serif type: "SWAN IN MOTION", "FORM / FLOW / SILENCE", and "OP ART STUDY 01". Use an Op Art, generative graphic design, experimental editorial poster and refined minimalism aesthetic with tactile paper grain and subtle studio shadow. Avoid broken or intersecting lines, jagged curves, chaotic ripples, excessive realism, wireframe outlines, sci-fi UI, extra text, logos, numbering beyond the specified title block, starbursts and sparkles.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张9:16精致实验海报，标题为"SWAN IN MOTION"，背景为深海军蓝，由连续且细密的暖象牙色平行栅格线组成。让一个隐藏的白色三维天鹅侧影通过线条的平滑压缩、扩张、弯曲和负空间显现，占据约70-80%的构图，不使用单独轮廓或写实渲染。只使用少量大型且受控的变形区域；远离天鹅的地方，线条逐渐恢复为笔直平行形态。将线条质量置于一切之上：极细、锋利、平滑、间距均匀且不间断。在安静的负空间内添加恰好三组极简现代无衬线排版："SWAN IN MOTION"、"FORM / FLOW / SILENCE"和"OP ART STUDY 01"。采用欧普艺术、生成式图形设计、实验性编辑海报和精致极简主义美学，带有纸张颗粒和微妙影棚阴影。避免线条断裂或交叉、锯齿曲线、混乱波纹、过度写实、线框轮廓、科幻UI、额外文字、Logo、超出指定标题块的编号、星爆和闪烁。

items.title: 习惯性说谎主题现代国际主义信息图PPT系统
items.description: 保留暗场高反差、国际主义版式、新字体排印非对称、模块网格、图文切片、冷暖强调色和10页知识型主题，整理为非人物信息图视觉系统示例。
items.prompt: Establish a modern PPT system collaborating dark field high contrast, bold titles, and rectangular photographic slices: take International Typographic Style theory as the main axis, using modular grids, unified margins, and baseline rhythm to stabilize information; use the functional asymmetry of New Typography to create spanning columns, misalignments, and scale transitions; use Gestalt laws of proximity and common region to cluster titles, descriptions, data, and images into clear modules; use Itten's light-dark and area contrast to let small-area high-purity symbols form instantaneous focus against large-area low-chroma backgrounds. Borrow Josef Müller-Brockmann's mathematical grids and objective hierarchy to coordinate the entire series, absorb Jan Tschichold's dynamic white space and unequal blocks to guide the line of sight, use Paul Rand's conceptualized geometric symbols to provide light recognition, and then use Alexey Brodovitch's bold cropping and text-image dialogue to change page density, with each dividing labor without replicating individual works. The color scheme adopts four types of replaceable roles: deep low-brightness low-chroma background accounts for 65%—80%, high-brightness information color accounts for 15%—25%, thematic photos retain medium-high brightness and medium chroma accounting for 15%—35%, and high-purity cool and warm localized accent colors total no more than 8%; emphasis is only placed adjacent to title endpoints, key numbers, and directional nodes, enhancing brightness through simultaneous contrast, any theme or brand colors must be mapped once according to roles, maintaining area, brightness order, chroma difference, cool-warm tension, and projection readability unchanged. The composition uses a 4—8 column elastic modular grid, with titles read first, focal images second, and descriptions and data last; covers allow oversized titles to span columns, content pages rotate between left-right splitting, up-down staggered levels, and large blocks of white space, rectangular images serve as unequal visual mass to dynamically balance with text areas, allowing only one symbol to cross column lines for controlled breaking of the grid. The background uses a uniform matte plane as the base, with extremely fine low-contrast squares overlaid on the cover, while content pages remain pure; photography adopts natural diffused light, realistic tones, close-up cropping, and hard-edged rectangular masks without decorative filters; radial petals, sharp-angled intersections, and folded-angle linear shapes are produced as stroke-less vector flat fills, with sharp edges, partial edge-pressing or semi-bleeding, undertaking the rhythm of chapters, directions, and pauses. Titles and body text use a rounded geometric sans-serif family with consistent skeletons: titles are extra bold, tight letter spacing, tight line spacing and broken into short lines, body text is regular weight, small font size, loose line spacing; Chinese and Western characters are corrected according to visual face, counter density, and baseline, not strictly aligned by nominal font size, title symbols only fit endpoints or negative spaces, not eroding readability. The overall feeling is bright, direct, young, agile, clear, and credible. Topic: Why do some people habitually lie? Rich in knowledge points. Each layout varies to avoid repetition. A total of 10 pages.
items.prompt_zh:
建立暗场高反差、粗体标题与矩形摄影切片协同的现代PPT系统：以国际主义版式理论为主轴，用模块网格、统一边距和基线节奏稳定信息；以新字体排印的功能性非对称制造跨栏、错位与尺度跃迁；以格式塔接近律和共同区域把标题、说明、数据与图像聚成清晰模块；以伊顿明暗及面积对比让小面积高纯度符号在大面积低彩背景中形成瞬时焦点。借鉴约瑟夫·米勒-布罗克曼的数学网格与客观层级统筹全系列，吸收扬·奇肖尔德的动态留白和不等量区块引导视线，运用保罗·兰德的概念化几何符号提供轻快识别，再以阿历克谢·布罗多维奇的大胆裁切与图文对话改变页面密度，彼此分工而不复刻个人作品。配色采用四类可替换角色：深低明度低彩背景占65%—80%，高明度信息色占15%—25%，主题照片保留中高明度与中等彩度占15%—35%，高纯度冷暖分置的强调色合计不超过8%；强调仅贴邻标题端点、关键数字和方向节点，以同时对比增强亮度，任何主题或品牌色均须按角色一次映射，并保持面积、明度次序、彩度差、冷暖张力与投影可读性不变。构图使用4—8列弹性模块网格，标题先读、焦点图像次读、说明与数据后读；封面允许超大标题跨列，内容页在左右分栏、上下错层与大块留白间轮换，矩形图像作为不等量视觉质量与文字区动态平衡，仅让一处符号越过栏线形成受控破格。背景以均匀哑光平面为底，封面叠加极细低对比方格，内容页保持纯净；摄影采用自然漫射光、真实色调、近距离裁切和硬边矩形蒙版，不加装饰滤镜；径向齿瓣、尖角交叉和折角线性形以无描边矢量平涂制作，边缘锐利，局部压边或半出血，承担章节、方向和停顿节拍。标题与正文采用骨架一致的圆润几何无衬线家族：标题超粗、紧字距、紧行距并拆成短行，正文常规字重、小字号、宽松行距；中西文按视觉字面、字腔密度与基线校正，不按名义字号硬齐，标题符号只贴合端点或负形，不侵蚀识读。整体感受明快、直接、年轻、机敏、清晰、可信。 

 主题：为什么有些人，习惯性说谎？ 
知识点丰富 
每张排版多变避免雷同

items.title: 四种零食益处微缩景观产品海报
items.description: 将四种零食、对应益处、2x2微缩景观、木制尺度摆件、叙事瞬间、实景灯光和产品摄影规格落实为可执行示例；不绑定人物身份。
items.prompt: Create a premium 2x2 grid product-photography poster in 16:9, featuring four popular snacks with concrete benefit worlds: potato chips + crisp crunch, dark chocolate + sustained energy, buttery popcorn + sharing, and vanilla ice cream + cooling freshness. For each quadrant, make the benefit physically literal as a small practical miniature landscape: the snack is the monument, sun, or hero at the center, with a handmade set built from paper, foam, fabric, sugar, and real water. Use forced perspective and hero-scale products, a small wooden toy figure for scale, and one narrative moment paused mid-action. Light each quadrant like a landscape with a sun, horizon, weather, practical mist or dust, and benefit-driven color temperature. Use macro depth near f/16 so the whole set is readable, internal practical lights, authentic miniature falloff, visible dust motes, and one honest construction seam. Use a warm premium food-magazine palette, realistic materials, clean spacing, high-detail product photography, and no fake tilt-shift or obvious compositing. Keep any quadrant labels short and legible: 'CRUNCH', 'ENERGY', 'SHARE', and 'COOL'. No visible people; the wooden toy figure is non-human.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张16:9的高端2x2网格产品摄影海报，展示四种流行零食及其具体益处世界：薯片+酥脆口感、黑巧克力+持久能量、黄油爆米花+分享乐趣、香草冰淇淋+清凉新鲜。为每个象限把益处物理化为一个微缩景观：零食作为中心的纪念碑、太阳或主角，使用纸张、泡沫、织物、糖和真实水面搭建手工布景。采用强制透视和英雄比例产品，以木制玩具摆件作为尺度参照，并暂停一个正在发生的叙事瞬间。每个象限都像景观一样布光，包含太阳、地平线、天气、实际薄雾或灰尘，并使用承载益处温度的色彩。使用接近f/16的宏观景深，使整个布景清晰可读；灯光安装在微缩模型内部，呈现真实微缩衰减、光束尘埃微粒和一处真实搭建接缝。采用温暖高端美食杂志配色、真实材质、整洁间距、高细节产品摄影，禁止虚假移轴和明显合成。每个象限只加入简短清晰标签：“CRUNCH”“ENERGY”“SHARE”“COOL”。不出现真人；木制玩具摆件为非人类。

items.title: Berry Breeze Creamery 海滨冰淇淋旗舰海报
items.description: 非人物冰淇淋品牌旗舰海报：右前景超大草莓奶油甜筒、中央原创吉祥物、左中景品牌餐车与海滨木栈道，使用统一莓果夏日品牌系统。
items.prompt:
Create a premium flagship hero poster for the self-created ice-cream brand Berry Breeze Creamery. This is a non-human product/mascot advertisement; no real people. Preserve a bright sunny seaside boardwalk, one large original mascot-like 3D character centered, one oversized strawberry-and-cream cone extremely close in the right foreground, a branded ice-cream truck in the left-mid background, and lively splash motion across the lower foreground. Keep this exaggerated wide-angle structure.

Use polished family-film 3D realism: rounded original mascot design, soft plush fur, expressive eyes, friendly smile, premium summer outfit, balanced skating/running pose and one arm presenting the cone. Do not copy any existing mascot or branding. Build one cohesive mature brand system in strawberry pink, creamy vanilla, coral red, ocean blue, waffle beige, sky blue and fresh green, with rounded premium typography.

The cone is the main sales hero: one large textured scoop, visible strawberry marbling, fresh berry garnish, glossy fruit highlights, creamy melting edge, crisp waffle texture and a clean sleeve. Sleeve text must be recreated clearly: Chinese "莓风冰淇淋", secondary "夏日莓果特调", and English "BERRY BREEZE". The left truck is a flagship dessert station with striped awning, menu board, rounded retro-modern body, matching signage and packaging display. Keep palm trees, parasols, clean deck boards, ocean hints, blue sky and warm sunlight.

Integrate cone sleeve, mascot outfit, truck, menu, packaging, parasols and motion effects into one polished summer brand world. Use warm sunlight, ocean bounce, refined berry gloss, splash droplets, clean shadows and high-end materials: creamy ice cream, glossy strawberry, painted truck metal, striped fabric and wood deck. The result should be cheerful, premium, collectible and commercially coherent, not childish or toy-like. Text should be legible but never cluttered. Negative: copied branding, unreadable glyphs, watercolor, ink wash, ancient style, anime, cyberpunk, gritty realism, dirty beach, crude fonts, malformed mascot, broken anatomy, muddy colors, harsh shadows, low-end render, clutter, inconsistent brand elements.
items.prompt_zh:
为自创高端冰淇淋品牌 Berry Breeze Creamery 制作旗舰主视觉海报。本模板主体是非人物产品与原创吉祥物，不出现真人。保留明亮海滨木栈道：中央一只大型原创 3D 吉祥物，右前景一支极近镜头的超大草莓奶油冰淇淋甜筒，左中景一辆品牌冰淇淋车，下方前景有活泼飞溅动势；保持夸张广角英雄构图。

采用精致的家庭电影级 3D 写实风格：圆润原创吉祥物、柔软绒毛、富有表现力的眼睛、友好笑容、优质夏日服装和动态滑行/奔跑姿势，一只手展示甜筒。不得复制现有吉祥物或品牌。品牌统一使用草莓粉、奶油白、珊瑚红、海洋蓝、华夫米色、天空蓝和清新绿，搭配圆润高级字体。

甜筒是绝对销售主体：一大勺有纹理的草莓奶油冰淇淋，清晰草莓旋纹、新鲜莓果点缀、果实高光、奶油融化边缘、细致华夫纹理和干净包装套。包装文字必须清晰重现：“莓风冰淇淋”“夏日莓果特调”“BERRY BREEZE”。左侧冰淇淋车是旗舰甜品站，带条纹遮阳棚、菜单板、圆润复古现代车身、统一招牌和包装展示。保留棕榈树、遮阳伞、干净木板、海面提示、蓝天和暖阳。

让甜筒包装、吉祥物服装、餐车、菜单、包装、遮阳伞和飞溅效果共同组成成熟的夏日品牌世界。使用暖阳、海面反光、莓果光泽、飞溅水滴、干净阴影和高级材质：奶油冰淇淋、亮泽草莓、喷漆车身、条纹布料和木质栈道。成片应明快、高级、可收藏且商业统一，不幼稚、不像玩具。文字清晰但不拥挤。避免抄袭品牌、乱码字形、水彩、水墨、古风、动漫、赛博朋克、粗粝写实、肮脏海滩、粗糙字体、吉祥物畸形、结构错误、浑浊颜色、硬阴影、低端 3D、杂乱构图和品牌元素不一致。

items.title: 高明度电子印刷感城市早安图文海报
items.description: 高明度电子印刷感城市图文海报模板：以城市经典元素、早安文案和今日宜忌为内容，融合超大英文书写体、高瘦中文、全幅扫描线与洁净冷白留白，支持十城异配色与异版式。
items.prompt: Create one high-brightness clean editorial city poster in a 4:5 vertical format, representing one distinct variant in a set of ten different cities. The subject is Shanghai and its classic elements: the Bund skyline, Art Deco towers and a narrow river reflection. Use a broad near-white or very pale cool-neutral upper field and push the recognizable city scene from the lower edge toward the center, creating compressed scale and asymmetrical balance. Let the image edges cross into the type area rather than separating image and text. Add a heavily blurred theme-derived foreground layer and a translucent vermilion red mist, while the distant environment becomes a low-detail cool charcoal band. Cover the full frame with dense uniform horizontal fine scanning lines, faint over bright areas and more visible over dark areas, clean and unstained. Use an oversized English script headline “GOOD MORNING” across the top and tall thin Chinese display type embedded through it, following a diagonal upward sweep movement rather than formal centering. Scatter short readable editorial information around the edges: “Good morning, make room for a clear beginning”, “Today: take the long view; avoid rushing the small things” and “2026-08-04”. Use vermilion red only as a restrained high-saturation title and marker accent, with quiet support colors derived from the city; this variant must use a clearly different palette, hue balance and layout from the other nine cities. Preserve natural photographic city texture, soft diffused illumination and transparent shadow layers. No people, faces, logos, watermarks, extra dates, garbled Chinese, fake unreadable text, grain, yellowing, neon, heavy shadows or ordinary split-layout poster design.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张高明度、洁净、带轻微电子印刷感的4:5竖版城市图文海报，作为十个不同城市系列中的一个独立变体。主题城市为Shanghai，经典城市元素为the Bund skyline, Art Deco towers and a narrow river reflection。上部使用大面积近白或极浅冷中性色留白，将可识别的城市场景从下缘推向中部，形成尺度压缩与不对称平衡；让影像边缘越入文字区域，不要将图像与文字机械上下分区。底部加入主题派生的强虚化前景，并以半透明vermilion red色雾掠过主体，远处环境压缩为低细节的cool charcoal色带。全画面覆盖间距极密、粗细一致的水平扫描细线，亮部若隐若现，暗部更清楚，保持洁净无污渍。顶部横跨一组超大英文书写体标题“GOOD MORNING”，其间嵌入高瘦纤细的中文展示字，沿diagonal upward sweep形成视觉动势，避免规整居中。沿边缘分散排布清晰可读的短信息：“Good morning, make room for a clear beginning”、“Today: take the long view; avoid rushing the small things”和“2026-08-04”。只将vermilion red作为克制的高饱和标题和标记强调色，并从城市环境提取安静的支撑色；本变体必须在配色、色相关系和版式上与其余九座城市明显不同。保留自然城市摄影纹理、柔和散射光和通透暗部层次。不要出现人物、面孔、标志、水印、额外日期、乱码、虚假不可读文字、颗粒、泛黄、霓虹、厚重阴影或普通上下分区海报排版。

items.title: 锦面宴奢华米线四宫格品牌宣传海报
items.description: 纯食物品牌海报模板：深漆红黑背景中的四宫格高端米线宣传，含四款可追溯菜品与统一中英文字体系统。
items.prompt:
Create a premium Chinese rice-noodle campaign poster for the self-created restaurant brand "锦面宴" / Jinmian Feast. Preserve a strict 2x2 grid of four equally weighted square food panels, with food as the absolute hero. Use one unified dark lacquer-red to deep-black atmosphere, consistent bowl styling, lighting, typography hierarchy, garnish restraint and mature flagship-restaurant branding. No people.

Brand typography: Chinese headline "锦面宴" and "四味招牌米线"; restrained English support "JINMIAN FEAST / Signature Rice Noodle Collection". Add consistent, elegant small metadata: "Series Name: Four Signature Rice Noodles", "House Selection: Chef's Signature Collection", "Flavor Collection: Heat / Broth / Sesame / Umami", and "Brand Seal: Jinmian Feast Culinary House". Each panel uses the same label order: Chinese dish name, English dish name, Signature Dish, Flavor Note, House Selection. Chinese is dominant; English is airy and secondary, never heavy or crude.

Top left: "赤香红油米线" / Chili Oil Rice Noodles, Signature Dish: Heritage Heat, Flavor Note: bright heat, silk texture, House Selection: Signature Dish I. Show glossy red chili-oil rice noodles, sesame, scallion, crushed spice and a dramatic lifted strand.
Top right: "金汤炖牛米线" / Braised Beef Golden Broth Rice Noodles, Signature Dish: Golden Broth, Flavor Note: rich broth, slow-cooked depth, House Selection: Signature Dish II. Show amber broth, tender beef cubes, white radish, scallion and elastic noodles lifted by chopsticks.
Bottom left: "麻酱花生米线" / Sesame Peanut Rice Noodles, Signature Dish: Sesame Silk, Flavor Note: nutty silk, layered aroma, House Selection: Signature Dish III. Show thick sesame-peanut sauce, crushed peanuts, cucumber threads and glossy coiled noodles.
Bottom right: "菌香浓卤米线" / Mushroom Soy-Braised Rice Noodles, Signature Dish: Deep Umami, Flavor Note: savory finish, dark glaze richness, House Selection: Signature Dish IV. Show shiitake slices, dark umami glaze, soft green garnish and a refined noodle lift.

Make every strand read as authentic Chinese rice noodles: smooth, elastic, slightly translucent, glossy with sauce or oil, with believable weight, steam, broth reflections, beef fibers, sesame granules, chili highlights, mushroom glaze and peanut coating. Use premium Chinese ceramic bowls with subtle dark patterning, precise minimal garnish, and at most sparse peppercorns, a tiny sauce dish, elegant chopsticks or spice dust. Use soft cinematic studio light, controlled contour and rim highlights, rich shadows, and a clean dark crimson-black lacquer background with only faint ornamental texture. Palette: lacquer red, deep black, chili crimson, broth gold, sesame beige, soy umber, muted scallion green and ink-black ceramic.

The result must feel like an official, award-level seasonal flagship campaign: cohesive, appetizing, culturally elegant and commercially polished, never a casual menu. Negative: cheap menu styling, clutter, low-detail or plastic food, thick wheat noodles, spaghetti, ramen, flat or greasy light, random tableware, oversaturated red, ugly or heavy typography, cartoon food, low-resolution steam, messy layout, inaccurate chopsticks, weak sauce texture, generic fast-food styling.
items.prompt_zh:
为自创高端中餐品牌“锦面宴”制作奢华米线品牌宣传海报。严格保留四宫格结构：2×2 等权方形画面，每格一道米线，食物是绝对主体，不出现人物。统一深漆红至深黑的高级氛围、碗具、灯光、字体层级、克制配菜和旗舰餐厅品牌语言。

文字系统：中文主标题“锦面宴”“四味招牌米线”；英文辅助文字“JINMIAN FEAST / Signature Rice Noodle Collection”。统一添加小号高级元数据：“Series Name: Four Signature Rice Noodles”“House Selection: Chef's Signature Collection”“Flavor Collection: Heat / Broth / Sesame / Umami”“Brand Seal: Jinmian Feast Culinary House”。四格标签顺序一致：中文菜名、英文菜名、Signature Dish、Flavor Note、House Selection；中文为主，英文轻盈克制，不使用粗俗厚重字体。

左上：赤香红油米线 / Chili Oil Rice Noodles，Heritage Heat，bright heat, silk texture，Signature Dish I；表现油亮红油、芝麻、葱花、碎香料和有动势的挑起米线。右上：金汤炖牛米线 / Braised Beef Golden Broth Rice Noodles，Golden Broth，rich broth, slow-cooked depth，Signature Dish II；表现琥珀金汤、嫩牛肉块、白萝卜、葱花和筷子挑起的弹韧米线。左下：麻酱花生米线 / Sesame Peanut Rice Noodles，Sesame Silk，nutty silk, layered aroma，Signature Dish III；表现浓郁麻酱花生酱、碎花生、黄瓜丝和盘绕发亮的米线。右下：菌香浓卤米线 / Mushroom Soy-Braised Rice Noodles，Deep Umami，savory finish, dark glaze richness，Signature Dish IV；表现香菇片、深色鲜味卤汁、少量绿色点缀和精致挑起米线。

每根米线都应是真实中式米线：顺滑、弹韧、略带半透明感，有酱汁或油光、真实重量、蒸汽和汤面反射；强化牛肉纤维、芝麻颗粒、红油高光、菌菇卤光和花生酱包裹。使用带低调深色纹样的高级中式陶瓷碗，配菜精准克制，最多加入少量胡椒、迷你酱碟、雅致筷子或香料粉。采用柔和电影感棚拍光，控制轮廓光和碗沿高光，保留浓郁阴影；背景为干净的深绛红黑漆面，仅有几乎不可见的中式纹样。色彩为漆红、深黑、辣椒红、汤金、芝麻米色、酱褐、低饱和葱绿和墨黑陶瓷。

成片应像高端餐饮集团正式发布的季节旗舰广告：统一、诱人、文化精致、商业完成度高，而不是普通菜单。避免廉价菜单、杂乱道具、低细节或塑料食物、粗圆小麦面、意面、拉面、平淡或油腻光线、随机餐具、过饱和红色、丑陋厚重字体、卡通食物、低清蒸汽、混乱排版、错误筷子、弱酱汁质感和快餐风。

items.title: 学校周年庆典庄重明亮纪念海报
items.description: 学校周年庆典横版纪念海报模板，以巨幅周年数字、极细嵌套线框、丝缎起伏前景和竖向中文标题构成庄重明亮的东方庆典主视觉。
items.prompt: Create a solemn and bright horizontal 16:9 school anniversary commemorative poster. Use a strong central axis and a wide, pure upper background. Enlarge 100 into the monumental focal symbol, with extremely thin equidistant single-line continuous nesting to create multiple outlines and depth. Keep the outline near the edges with generous white space; let a few small school-related dynamic symbols lightly cross it. Scatter only a small amount of fine radial pattern and flying celebratory marks near the top, balanced but not mirrored. Build the lower half from continuous soft silk-like fabric with broad rolling folds entering from both sides; let the fabric cover the lower edge of the line symbol for clear depth. Place the Chinese title “Northbridge University 校庆” vertically, one character at a time along the central axis on a calm fabric area, with dignified high-contrast serif typography. Below it, place 1926 - 2026 inside a thin rectangular frame, plus exactly three small information points: learning, community and future. Add A century of learning as a widely spaced small line at the bottom. Use vivid clean core colors with darker same-hue fold shadows, pale neutral or soft metallic accents, and no people, logos, watermarks, extra dates or illegible text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张庄重而明亮的横版16:9学校周年庆典纪念海报。以强中央轴组织画面，上部保留宽阔纯净背景，将100放大为纪念碑式核心符号，采用极细等距单线连续嵌套形成多重轮廓和纵深错觉；轮廓接近边缘但保持舒展留白，让少量与学校相关的动态符号轻微穿越。顶部只散置少量极细放射纹和庆祝飞行符号，左右平衡但不镜像。下半部以柔软丝缎般的连续织物构成起伏前景，宽阔褶面从两侧切入并横向翻卷，织物遮住线框符号下缘，形成清晰前后关系。将中文标题“Northbridge University 校庆”沿中央轴逐字竖排，置于较平静的织物区域，使用端庄的高对比衬线字形。标题下方用细线矩形框放置1926 - 2026，并加入恰好三个小型信息点：学习、社区、未来；底部以宽字距小字号放置A century of learning。使用鲜明洁净的核心色，同色相深色褶皱阴影，搭配浅亮中性色或柔和金属色点缀；不要出现人物、标志、水印、额外日期或难以辨认的文字。

items.title: 高端咖啡馆极简风新品饮品广告海报
items.description: 高端咖啡馆新品饮品广告海报模板，以中心饮品、温暖自然光和极简社论排版传达精致而亲切的品牌气质。
items.prompt: Create a premium cafe advertisement poster featuring Signature iced coffee as the main subject. Use a clean minimalist editorial composition with warm natural sunlight, soft plant shadows, elegant serif typography and a sophisticated luxury cafe aesthetic. Place a beautifully styled Signature iced coffee at the center in a transparent glass, with realistic texture, reflections, condensation and garnish details appropriate to the drink. Set it on a wooden table with subtle decor, softly blurred greenery and a warm beige background. Use this exact text hierarchy: top section: NEW MENU and A slower kind of morning; middle section: Signature iced coffee and Cold brew, citrus peel and a soft vanilla finish; bottom section: USD 6.50. Keep the layout spacious and restrained, with realistic shadows and highlights, cinematic food photography, high-detail product rendering and no people, logos, watermarks, extra copy or illegible text. Aspect ratio: 4:5.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张以Signature iced coffee为主角的高端咖啡馆新品广告海报。采用简洁、极简的社论式构图，结合温暖自然光、柔和植物阴影、优雅衬线字体和精致的咖啡馆奢华美学。将造型精美的Signature iced coffee置于画面中央的透明玻璃杯中，呈现符合饮品特征的真实纹理、反射、冷凝水和装饰细节。场景包含木桌、微妙装饰、虚化绿植和温暖米色背景。严格使用以下文字层级：顶部区域为“NEW MENU”和A slower kind of morning；中部区域为Signature iced coffee和Cold brew, citrus peel and a soft vanilla finish；底部区域为USD 6.50。保持留白充足、布局克制，呈现真实阴影与高光、电影感食品摄影和高细节产品质感；不要出现人物、标志、水印、额外文案或难以辨认的文字。宽高比：4:5。

items.title: 极致细节的红眼双马尾少女角色便当
items.description: 以真实便当食材构成角色脸部的日式角色便当食物摄影模板；默认示例为棕发、红眼、短双马尾、略尖牙齿的可爱角色。
items.prompt: Brown-haired, red-eyed cute character with short twin tails and slightly pointed teeth, represented entirely with rice, thin omelet, nori, cheese and ham. [Fixed Part] High-quality food photograph of Japanese "Kyaraben" (Character Bento Box). Vertical aspect ratio. Composition: A cute bento box is placed on a tablecloth, photographed from directly above in a flat lay composition. Main Character Representation: The face of the character described in the Brown-haired, red-eyed cute character with short twin tails and slightly pointed teeth, represented entirely with rice, thin omelet, nori, cheese and ham. above is placed to occupy the front half of the bento box. The character must be represented using real "bento ingredients," not food samples or illustrations. The skin texture should resemble rice or thin omelet, the lines should resemble nori (seaweed), and decorations should have the texture of ingredients like cheese or ham. Side Dish Arrangement: Typical and colorful bento side dishes are packed tightly around the character's head and in the back space. Glossy meatballs or hamburger patties Vibrant green broccoli or edamame Red octopus-shaped wieners Boiled eggs or tamagoyaki (rolled omelet) Decorative picks (leaf or flower shapes) Environment and Lighting: The background is a bright tablecloth in pastel colors like light blue or pink, with polka dots or checks. Natural light shines in, giving the food a delicious sheen and soft shadows. Overall, the saturation is high, creating an appetizing, cute, and pop atmosphere.
items.prompt_zh: Brown-haired, red-eyed cute character with short twin tails and slightly pointed teeth, represented entirely with rice, thin omelet, nori, cheese and ham. [固定部分] 高质量的日式“角色便当”（Kyaraben）食物照片。 纵向构图。 构图： 一个可爱的便当盒放在桌布上，采用平铺构图，从正上方拍摄。 主要角色呈现： 将上述Brown-haired, red-eyed cute character with short twin tails and slightly pointed teeth, represented entirely with rice, thin omelet, nori, cheese and ham.中描述的角色的脸部放置在便当盒的前半部分。 角色必须使用真实的“便当食材”来呈现，而不是食物模型或插画。 皮肤质地应类似于米饭或薄蛋饼，线条应类似于海苔，装饰应具有奶酪或火腿等食材的质感。 配菜安排： 典型且色彩丰富的便当配菜紧密地围绕在角色头部周围和后方空间。 有光泽的肉丸或汉堡肉饼 鲜绿色的西兰花或毛豆 红色章鱼形状的香肠 水煮蛋或玉子烧（日式煎蛋卷） 装饰性签子（叶子或花朵形状） 环境和光线： 背景是浅蓝色或粉色等柔和色调的明亮桌布，带有波点或格子图案。 自然光照射进来，使食物呈现出美味的光泽和柔和的阴影。 整体饱和度高，营造出开胃、可爱和流行（pop）的氛围。

items.title: AURELIS顶级豪宅室内设计展示海报
items.description: 虚构地产设计品牌的3×3九页室内方案总览，统一主视觉、平面图、选品与材质页；画面仅用英文。
items.prompt:
Create one tall vertical flagship interior-sales overview poster for the fictional premium property-design brand "AURELIS LIVING STUDIO". Show nine vertical brochure pages in one strict 3x3 grid, not nine separate outputs. Combine Orbit-level alignment precision, Transit-level developer-system standardization and Port-level proposal-book completeness into a coherent international luxury real-estate interior manual. Preserve the white-margin brochure structure and alternating mixed content; do not make a random collage.

All pages share identical proportions, outer margins, spacing, internal white borders, headline baselines, image-crop logic, typography hierarchy, caption treatment, metadata and palette. Page-number positions and naming must be publication-precise. Pages 2 and 8 are the stronger hero images without breaking alignment. Retain the following order as parts of one board:
1/9 CLIENT VISION: small subheads, structured briefing and a refined preview image.
2/9 SIGNATURE LOUNGE: hero render with premium armchair, fireplace or feature wall, vertical wood slats, marble and warm daylight.
3/9 CONCEPT PLAN: crisp thin-line architectural floor plan above elegant explanatory copy.
4/9 STYLING LANGUAGE: sculptural decor, console, vase, wood slats and one editorial quote.
5/9 INSPIRATION BOARD: orderly collage of multiple small interior images.
6/9 LIGHTING DETAILS: cabinetry close-up, integrated light glow, fixture references and supporting copy.
7/9 FURNITURE SELECTION: organized product silhouettes or miniature visuals, coded items, concise labels and a room-based selection list.
8/9 LIVING ATMOSPHERE: hero living-room scene with premium soft seating and a quote-based title treatment.
9/9 MATERIAL BOARD: aligned, neatly named wood, stone, textile and surface-finish swatches.

Use only English in the artwork. Include a minimal official-style AURELIS LIVING STUDIO logo, restrained collection naming and consistent page numbers 1/9 through 9/9. Standardize labels Project Name, Space Type, Design Package, Ref Code and Page No. where appropriate across concept, technical, furniture and material pages. Use these source-specified metadata lines:
Project Name: Aurelis Residence Collection
Space Type: Living Room / Bedroom / Main Bathroom
Design Package: Interior Signature Series
Ref Code: ALS-INT-09
Use modern clean sans-serif for information, and refined serif/display accents for quotes and hero emphasis. Metadata, headers and captions must be legible, mature and consistent; technical pages are believable developer sheets, not decorative inserts.

All room imagery is photoreal warm minimalism: ivory and greige walls, walnut or smoked-oak paneling, pale marble, refined tactile upholstery, sculptural lounge seating, elegant tables, restrained objects, concealed lighting and calm editorial framing. Render matte plaster, real wood grain, subtle stone veining, fabric texture, clean joinery, soft daylight dust, refined reflections and contact shadows without synthetic-looking surfaces. Brochure pages should feel printed; spaces must be calm, luxurious and show-unit ready.

Light every interior with extremely soft warm-neutral architectural daylight, subtle ambient/cove glow and gentle shadow falloff. Unified palette: warm white, ivory, soft greige, taupe, walnut brown, pale marble gray, muted sand and small soft-charcoal accents. Aim for a precise, complete, materially rich and commercially persuasive official interior proposal overview.

Avoid messy layout, inconsistent page sizes, random typography, cheap catalog styling, cluttered furniture, harsh contrast/shadows, dark muddy rooms, low resolution, generic stock interiors, visual noise, plastic materials, distorted perspective, overcrowded text, poor margins, chaotic inspiration boards and cheap rendering.
items.prompt_zh:
为虚构高级物业设计品牌“AURELIS LIVING STUDIO”创作一张高竖版旗舰室内销售方案总览海报。在同一画面以严格3×3网格排布九个竖向手册页面，不是分别输出九张图。融合Orbit级对齐精度、Transit级开发商系统标准化及Port级方案书完整性，组成国际豪宅室内设计手册总览。保留白边手册结构及交替内容层级，不做随机拼贴。

九页统一比例、外边距、间距、内部白边、标题基线、裁图逻辑、字体层级、图注、元数据及配色；页码位置与命名达到出版级精度。第2、8页主视觉更突出，但不破坏对齐。以下顺序均为同一展板的组成部分：
1/9 CLIENT VISION：小副标题、结构化需求简报和精致预览图。
2/9 SIGNATURE LOUNGE：高级扶手椅、壁炉或特色墙、竖木条、大理石与暖日光的主渲染图。
3/9 CONCEPT PLAN：上方清晰细线建筑平面图，下方优雅说明文案。
4/9 STYLING LANGUAGE：雕塑感摆件、玄关柜、花瓶、木条与一句编辑引语。
5/9 INSPIRATION BOARD：多张室内小图组成整洁灵感拼贴。
6/9 LIGHTING DETAILS：橱柜特写、集成灯光、灯具参考及辅助文字。
7/9 FURNITURE SELECTION：有序产品轮廓或小图、编号单品、简短标签与按房间整理的选品表。
8/9 LIVING ATMOSPHERE：高级软座起居室主视觉，配引语式标题。
9/9 MATERIAL BOARD：对齐且名称清晰的木材、石材、织物与表面饰面样板。

画面文字只能使用英文。加入极简官方风格AURELIS LIVING STUDIO标志、克制系列名称及1/9至9/9统一页码。在概念、技术、家具和材质页按需一致使用Project Name、Space Type、Design Package、Ref Code、Page No.字段，采用来源明确指定的元数据：
Project Name: Aurelis Residence Collection
Space Type: Living Room / Bedroom / Main Bathroom
Design Package: Interior Signature Series
Ref Code: ALS-INT-09
信息正文用清洁现代无衬线体，引语及主视觉可用精致衬线体或展示字体。元数据、页眉与图注须可读、成熟、一致；技术页应像可信的开发商图纸，而不是装饰插页。

全部室内图采用写实温暖极简风：象牙及灰米色墙、胡桃木或熏橡木墙板、浅大理石、精致可触感软包、雕塑感座椅、优雅桌具、克制摆件、隐藏照明与安静编辑构图。呈现哑光灰泥、真实木纹、细微石纹、织物纹理、整洁木作、柔日光中的尘埃、精细反射和接触阴影，避免人工塑料感。页面有印刷真实感，空间豪华宁静、达到样板间水准。

所有室内使用极柔和暖中性建筑日光、细微环境光与灯槽光、柔和阴影衰减。统一暖白、象牙、柔灰米、灰褐、胡桃棕、浅大理石灰、柔沙色及少量炭黑点缀。整体精准、完整、材质丰富、有商业说服力，呈现官方室内方案总览。

避免杂乱布局、页面尺寸不一、随机排版、廉价目录感、家具拥挤、生硬反差和阴影、暗脏室内、低清、通用素材库内景、噪点、塑料材质、透视扭曲、文字过挤、糟糕边距、混乱灵感板及廉价渲染。

items.title: AUREL TEA LAB 焙谷茶云三栏详情页
items.description: AUREL TEA LAB 焙谷茶云高端茶粉拿铁三栏长幅电商详情页，以45%焙茶、35%烘焙燕麦与20%黑芝麻为代表配方，展示罐装产品、冲调饮品、粉末微距、营养图标和原料比例，强调旗舰品牌系统与真实可触材质。
items.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium long-form e-commerce sales poster for the invented tea beverage brand AUREL TEA LAB and its flagship hojicha oat latte powder ROASTED GRAIN CLOUD, with the smaller Chinese subtitle 焙谷茶云. Preserve a strict layout of three tall narrow columns side by side, each read from top to bottom; keep the same infographic hierarchy and product-explanation sequence. Do not convert it into a homepage, free collage, or reordered module system. The result must feel hyper-real, calm, clean, materially rich, award-level, and expensive, with minimal English headings supported by smaller Chinese subtitles.

Left column: begin with the brand, badge, and concise introduction. In the hero module, place one upright luxury cylindrical canister beside one prepared creamy hojicha-oat drink in an elegant transparent glass. Show believable foam micro-bubbles, milk-tea density, suspended powder, a soft meniscus, glass reflections, and wall thickness. Add only restrained hojicha powder, roasted oat fragments, black sesame, and one premium spoon. Follow with a precise uncluttered key-value strip, then a refined icon-based feature module.

Center column: place a quote-like brand statement at the top. Below it, show a large macro bowl or circular arrangement of the fine tea blend with controlled scattered powder. Present the exact blend structure as 45% HOJICHA, 35% ROASTED OATS, and 20% BLACK SESAME. Continue with a spacious cluster of circular nutrient or function icons, then end with a canister slightly open or tipped so powder spills in a controlled tactile arc.

Right column: at the top, compare two premium metal or ceramic measuring spoons holding visibly different powder textures. In the middle, explain aroma, taste, and mouthfeel beside a finished creamy drink. At the bottom, arrange separate bowls or neat clusters of hojicha leaves or powder, roasted oats, and black sesame, repeating the exact three-part ratio with one elegant percentage badge.

Use one disciplined flagship brand system across titles, Chinese subtitles, percentages, icons, badges, statistics, circles, ratios, and labels. Refine negative space, thin typography, module padding, alignment, number spacing, and image-to-text proportions. Render matte paper grain, subtle embossing, sharp label printing, powder micro-grains, soft spill edges, foam, liquid surface tension, utensils, raw ingredients, and reflections with touchable realism. Use warm ivory, oat beige, milk-tea cream, toasted grain gold, hojicha brown, muted matcha green accents, and soft taupe. Differentiate the three columns gently while keeping one elegant family. Light with soft commercial daylight-like highlights, graceful shadow falloff, refined package and glass reflections, and delicate powder detail. Avoid changed structure, cheap health-product styling, plastic liquid, fake powder, clutter, messy typography, generic or low-end packaging, cartoon infographic treatment, oversaturation, harsh flash, noisy props, people, hands, unrelated text, copied real brands, signatures, or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
为自创茶饮品牌 AUREL TEA LAB 及其旗舰焙茶燕麦拿铁粉 ROASTED GRAIN CLOUD 创作超高端长幅电商销售海报，较小中文副标题固定为“焙谷茶云”。严格保留三个高窄栏并排、各栏自上而下阅读的结构，以及原有信息图层级和产品说明顺序；不得改成主页、自由拼贴或重排模块。成品应超写实、克制、干净、材质丰富，具有设计奖级旗舰质感；英文标题极简，中文副标题较小。

左栏：顶部依次放品牌、徽章和简短介绍。核心模块展示一个直立的奢华圆柱罐，旁边是一杯装在优雅透明玻璃杯中的焙茶燕麦奶饮；表现可信的泡沫微气泡、奶茶密度、粉末悬浮、柔和液面弧度、玻璃反射与杯壁厚度。周围只克制摆放焙茶粉、烘焙燕麦碎、黑芝麻和一把高级勺子。下方依次为精确不拥挤的关键价值条和精致的图标卖点模块。

中栏：顶部为引语式品牌宣言。其下用大型微距碗或圆形构图呈现细腻混合茶粉及受控散落粉末，并准确标出配比“45% HOJICHA”、“35% ROASTED OATS”和“20% BLACK SESAME”。继续放置间距通透的圆形营养或功能图标集群；底部展示微微打开或倾斜的罐体，让粉末以受控且有触感的弧线溢出。

右栏：顶部用两把高级金属或陶瓷量勺比较明显不同的粉末质地；中部在一杯成品奶茶旁说明香气、味道和口感；底部把焙茶叶或焙茶粉、烘焙燕麦和黑芝麻分别装入圆碗或整齐原料簇，并以一个优雅百分比徽章重复准确的三项配比。

所有标题、中文副标题、百分比、图标、徽章、统计、功能圆圈、比例和标签采用统一且受控的旗舰品牌系统。精修负空间、纤细字体层级、模块内边距、对齐、数字间距与图文比例。以可触摸的真实感表现罐体磨砂纸纹、微妙压花、锐利标签印刷、茶粉微粒、柔软粉末边缘、泡沫、液体表面张力、勺具、原料和反射。色板使用暖象牙色、燕麦米色、奶茶奶油色、烤谷金、焙茶棕、柔和抹茶绿点缀和软灰褐色；三栏轻微区分但属于同一优雅系列。采用柔和商业光、类日光洁净高光、优雅阴影衰减以及包装和玻璃上的精致反射。避免改变结构、廉价保健品感、塑料液体、假粉末、拥挤、排版凌乱、通用或低端包装、卡通信息图、过饱和、刺眼闪光、嘈杂道具、人物、手部、无关文字、复制真实品牌、签名或水印。

items.title: 托斯卡纳番茄罗勒意面美食信息图海报
items.description: 将菜谱名称、食材、品质徽章、编号步骤、益处徽章、次级主图和烹饪提示落实为一组可执行的托斯卡纳番茄罗勒意面信息图示例。
items.prompt: Create a premium vertical digital infographic poster for Tuscan Tomato Basil Pasta using a warm, rustic palette of earthy beige, soft brown, terracotta, and subtle botanical accents. Feature a bold elegant title combining script and modern sans-serif fonts, the tagline 'Simple ingredients, slow comfort', and a brief introduction describing ripe tomatoes, basil, garlic, olive oil, and handmade pasta. Include a high-quality photorealistic hero image with the pasta bowl surrounded by tomatoes, basil, garlic, and olive oil. Design a clean ingredients panel with icons, an authenticity badge reading 'FRESH & HANDMADE', and an engaging numbered step-by-step preparation guide with illustrated process scenes. At the bottom, add a benefits section with circular icon badges for 'RICH IN TOMATOES', 'FRESH HERBS', and 'WEEKDAY READY', a secondary hero image surrounded by fresh ingredients, and a stylish tip box: 'Finish with basil and olive oil just before serving.' Use a balanced editorial layout, premium food magazine aesthetics, soft shadows, subtle textures, clean spacing, ultra-detailed food photography, and high-resolution print-quality design.
items.prompt_zh: 为托斯卡纳番茄罗勒意面创建一张高端竖向数字信息图海报，使用温暖乡村风格的配色，包括大地米色、柔和棕色、赤陶色和微妙植物元素。采用结合手写体与现代无衬线字体的大胆优雅标题，加入标语“简单食材，慢享舒适”和介绍熟番茄、罗勒、大蒜、橄榄油及手工意面的简短说明。包含一张高质量写实主图，展示被番茄、罗勒、大蒜和橄榄油环绕的意面碗。设计带图标的整洁配料面板、写有“FRESH & HANDMADE”的品质徽章，以及使用插画过程场景呈现的编号分步制作指南。底部加入带圆形图标徽章的益处区域，突出“RICH IN TOMATOES”“FRESH HERBS”“WEEKDAY READY”，再放置一张被新鲜食材环绕的次级主图和时尚提示框：“上桌前最后加入罗勒和橄榄油。”使用均衡社论布局、高端美食杂志美学、柔和阴影、微妙质感、整洁间距、超详细食物摄影和高分辨率印刷品质。

items.title: 午夜旋涡万圣节限定饮品商业海报
items.description: 以黑橙旋涡冰沙、雕塑感奶油塔和南瓜焦糖瀑布为超级符号的高端万圣节限定饮品竖版海报，结合超写实产品摄影与简洁可爱扁平吉祥物插画。
items.prompt:
Create a tall premium Halloween limited-edition beverage poster for the original seasonal brand "MIDNIGHT SWIRL", combining ultra-realistic drink photography with clean cute flat illustration. Use a saturated pumpkin-orange background. Center one enormous transparent iced-blended drink as the absolute hero, with a large irregular black silhouette behind it, a pale glowing moon disk in the upper-right, small bats on both sides, subtle spider-web corner motifs, and two or three small Halloween mascots near the lower sides. Keep the composition bold, polished, product-led, uncluttered, and ready for a high-end retail social campaign.

The hero is "MIDNIGHT SWIRL FROST": a clear front-facing cup filled with dense black-cocoa and dark-espresso frozen slush, vivid orange pumpkin-caramel marbling, and fine ice crystals. Crown it with a tall sculptural whipped-cream spiral, thick glossy pumpkin-caramel ribbons, irregular dark cookie crumbs, and one small pumpkin topper near the upper-right of the peak. Show accurate clear plastic, lid reflections, condensation haze, moisture beads, crisp original packaging print, airy dairy folds, viscous syrup weight, and appetizing shine. The cup, black-orange frozen core, exaggerated cream tower, and caramel cascade must form an instantly recognizable super-symbol at thumbnail scale.

Build a circular reading path: cream peak to caramel drips, through the marbled drink, across the lower mascots, upward along bat arcs and the moon curve, then back to the cup. Support this loop with the cream spiral, syrup flow, marbling curves, moon edge, and mascot sightlines. Add a pumpkin-headed mascot in a knitted beanie holding a mini drink, a skeleton-like mascot in a matching beanie sipping it, and optionally a rounded ghost peeking from an edge. Use simple premium silhouettes and minimal shading; all mascots remain secondary to the product. Do not depict real people or hands.

Use bright premium studio light: soft frontal illumination, gentle top-left shaping, clean specular highlights, and a soft grounded shadow beneath the cup and mascots. Keep the background flat and graphic while the beverage stays dimensional and photoreal. Palette: vivid pumpkin orange, deep black, creamy white, caramel amber, dark cocoa brown, soft moon cream, with tiny green-straw and muted-gray accents.

Use original English text only. Place "SIP THE SHADOW" near the top center with a concise seasonal subline, and a compact bottom badge reading "BLACK COCOA + PUMPKIN CARAMEL + WHIPPED CREAM". Keep "MIDNIGHT SWIRL" and "MIDNIGHT SWIRL FROST" crisp and readable on the brand/product. Do not copy any existing brand, slogan, or promotional wording.

Finish with pristine commercial sharpness, realistic fluids and materials, clean mascot integration, strong hierarchy, and festive premium color. Avoid weak product dominance, warped cup perspective, blurry or unreadable branding, muddy blacks, fake cream, thin syrup, low-resolution packaging, messy mascot styles, overcrowding, dull orange, dirty shadows, black blotches, or a cheap party-flyer look. No watermark, unrelated logo, random text, real person, or human identity reference.
items.prompt_zh:
为原创季节品牌“MIDNIGHT SWIRL”制作一张高端万圣节限量饮品竖版海报，将超写实饮料摄影与简洁可爱的扁平插画结合。背景使用饱和南瓜橙；正中央放置一杯巨大的透明冰沙作为绝对主角，杯后配大型不规则黑色剪影，右上方放淡色发光月盘，两侧有小蝙蝠，角落有轻微蛛网纹，下方两侧布置两至三个小型万圣节吉祥物。画面要大胆、精致、以产品为核心、无杂乱，达到高端零售社交媒体广告质感。

主打饮品名为“MIDNIGHT SWIRL FROST”：正面透明杯中装有浓密黑可可与深色浓缩咖啡冰沙、鲜明的橙色南瓜焦糖大理石旋涡和细冰晶。杯顶是高耸雕塑感奶油螺旋，覆盖浓稠油亮的南瓜焦糖丝带、不规则深色饼干碎，并在奶油峰右上方加入一个小南瓜装饰。准确表现透明塑料、杯盖反射、冷凝雾、水珠、清晰原创包装印刷、轻盈奶油褶皱、糖浆黏度和诱人光泽。透明杯、黑橙冰沙核心、夸张奶油塔与焦糖瀑布应组成缩略图尺寸也能识别的超级符号。

建立环形阅读路径：视线从奶油峰沿焦糖滴落进入旋涡饮品，再穿过下方吉祥物，沿蝙蝠飞行弧和月亮曲线升起，最后回到杯身。用奶油螺旋、糖浆流向、大理石纹、月缘和吉祥物视线强化循环。加入一个戴针织帽、手持迷你饮料的南瓜头吉祥物，一个戴同款帽、正在饮用的小骷髅吉祥物，并可在边缘放一个探头的圆润幽灵。造型采用高级简洁剪影与少量阴影，始终次于产品；不要出现真人或人手。

采用明亮高端影棚光：柔和正面照明、轻微左上塑形、干净镜面高光，以及杯子和吉祥物下方的柔和落地阴影。背景保持扁平图形感，饮料保持立体写实。色板限定鲜明南瓜橙、深黑、奶白、焦糖琥珀、深可可棕和柔和月光奶油色，仅以少量绿色吸管与灰色服饰细节点缀。

只使用原创英文文字。顶部中央放“SIP THE SHADOW”及一行简短季节副标题，底部紧凑徽章写“BLACK COCOA + PUMPKIN CARAMEL + WHIPPED CREAM”。品牌与产品文字“MIDNIGHT SWIRL”和“MIDNIGHT SWIRL FROST”必须清晰可读。不要复制现有品牌、口号或促销文案。

最终呈现洁净商业锐度、真实流体和材质、整洁吉祥物整合、强产品层级与高级节日色彩。避免产品不突出、杯体透视扭曲、品牌模糊或难读、黑色浑浊、奶油虚假、糖浆稀薄、包装低清、吉祥物风格混乱、画面拥挤、橙色暗淡、阴影肮脏、黑色斑点或廉价派对传单感。不要水印、无关标志、随机文字、真人或人物身份参考。

items.title: 未来序章：二零二六年抽象几何的数学诗篇
items.description: 以午夜蓝、冷青和银灰几何构造呈现数学视觉诗的未来感竖幅海报，仅含日期与数学标题。
items.prompt:
Create a vertical futuristic abstract-geometry poster that treats mathematics as a precise visual poem. Build the composition from layered circles, arcs, grids, coordinate lines, fine technical diagrams, translucent planes and a few crisp luminous points. Use disciplined asymmetry and generous negative space so the image feels rational, elegant and speculative rather than busy.

Choose a dark midnight-blue to black background with cool cyan, electric blue and restrained white geometry, plus subtle silver-gray construction lines. Give selected shapes a faint glasslike depth and soft glow while keeping most edges thin, sharp and diagrammatic. Suggest orbital paths, proofs, vectors and higher-dimensional structures without displaying equations that cannot be rendered accurately. The finish should resemble a premium 2026 science and culture editorial cover: minimal, refined, high contrast and meticulously aligned.

Include exactly two readable text elements as part of the design: “2026.01.06” and “Mathematics”. Set them in a clean modern sans-serif typeface with correct spelling and punctuation, small but clearly legible, aligned to a quiet typographic grid. Do not add any other words, numbers, logos, signatures or watermarks. No people, faces, animals or figurative subjects. Avoid chaotic decoration, illegible glyphs, random equations, warped typography, excessive neon bloom, heavy texture, low contrast or CGI clutter.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张竖幅未来感抽象几何海报，将数学呈现为精确的视觉诗。画面由分层圆形、弧线、网格、坐标线、精细技术图、半透明平面和少量清晰发光点组成。采用克制的不对称布局并保留充足负空间，使整体理性、优雅且具有思辨未来感，避免拥挤。

背景选择午夜蓝至黑色渐变，几何主体使用冷青色、电光蓝和克制白色，辅以细微银灰构造线。部分形体带轻微玻璃般纵深与柔光，多数边缘保持纤细、锐利和图解感。通过轨道、证明、向量与高维结构的视觉暗示表现数学，但不展示无法准确呈现的方程。成品像高端的2026科学文化编辑封面：极简、精致、高对比并严谨对齐。

设计中只包含两处可读文字：“2026.01.06”和“数学”。使用干净的现代无衬线字体，字符与标点正确，尺寸较小但清楚可辨，并对齐安静的文字网格。不得添加其他文字、数字、标志、签名或水印。不得出现人物、面孔、动物或具象主体。避免混乱装饰、不可读字符、随机方程、扭曲文字、过度霓虹光晕、厚重纹理、低对比或杂乱CGI效果。

items.title: 高级果汁品牌非对称电商详情页
items.description: A compressed flagship juice detail-page template preserving the central packaging spine, ingredient studies, text zones and lower serving narrative.
items.prompt:
Create a 3:4 ultra-premium e-commerce detail-page sales poster for the self-invented juice brand VELORA JUICE LAB, featuring a premium cold-pressed juice series. Strictly preserve the original asymmetrical packaging-led layout: one central hero package as the vertical spine, surrounding ingredient and texture modules, alternating rounded-corner image cards, left-right text explanation zones, and a lower serving/ingredient storytelling flow. Do not turn it into a homepage, grid collage or different composition. The result should feel like a collectible flagship commercial print, hyper-real, luminous, quiet and materially rich.

Central hero: one dominant luxury carton, glass bottle or slim clear bottle with refined label, crisp print, matte or satin finish, embossed detail, premium cap or seal reflections and visible liquid when transparent. Surround it with sculptural still-life modules of sliced citrus, berries, peach, kiwi, mango, apple, grape, pomegranate, puree bowls, pressed fruit, seeds, peel pores and juice droplets on refined neutral surfaces.

Material realism is the focus: fruit fibers and juicy translucency, wet cut edges, natural peel sheen, liquid depth and meniscus, condensation beads, paper grain, film sheen, glass wall thickness, clean reflections and natural puree or cold-pressed viscosity. Everything must feel touchable and de-AI. Between image blocks, use minimal elegant English titles “Pure Fruit Structure”, “Cold-Pressed Clarity”, “Natural Ingredients”, and “Freshness in Layers”, with smaller refined Chinese subtitles and airy short copy.

Continue the lower modules with controlled serving scenes: juice poured into elegant glassware, sliced fruit, breakfast accents and a chilled tabletop ritual. Use soft premium daylight, refined shadow falloff, bright organic palette warm ivory, citrus yellow, grapefruit coral, mango gold, kiwi green and leaf green, calm typography, generous negative space and unified luxury brand language. Keep the page readable as one premium detail-page narrative and suitable for online sales or printed showcase. No people, hands, watermarks or unrelated logos. Avoid changed structure, random collage, cheap advertising, fake fruit or liquid, plastic textures, clutter, messy typography, low-end packaging, cartoon graphics, oversaturation, harsh flash and noisy props.
items.prompt_zh:
为自创果汁品牌 VELORA JUICE LAB 的 premium cold-pressed juice series 生成一张 3:4 竖版超高级电商详情页销售海报。严格保留原始非对称、包装主导的版式逻辑：中央一个作为页面主轴的英雄包装，周围成分与材质模块，交替的圆角图像卡片，图像之间左右交替的文字说明区，以及底部饮用与成分叙事流。不要改成首页、网格拼贴或其他构图。整体应像可收藏的旗舰商业印刷品，超写实、明亮、克制且材质丰富。

中央英雄产品使用一个占主导地位的高级纸盒、玻璃瓶或细长透明瓶，具有精致标签、清晰印刷、哑光或缎面质感、压印细节、高级瓶盖或封签反光，透明包装可见真实果汁。周围设置雕塑感静物模块：切开的柑橘、浆果、桃、猕猴桃、芒果、苹果、葡萄、石榴、果泥碗、压榨果肉、果籽、果皮孔隙和果汁水滴，置于精致中性表面。

重点表现材质真实感：果肉纤维与汁液通透度、切面湿润、天然果皮光泽、液体深度与弯月面、冷凝水珠、纸张纹理、薄膜光泽、玻璃厚度、干净反射，以及果泥或冷压汁的自然黏度。所有元素都应可触摸、去 AI 感。图像模块之间使用简洁优雅的英文标题“Pure Fruit Structure”“Cold-Pressed Clarity”“Natural Ingredients”“Freshness in Layers”，配精致中文副标题和疏朗短文案。

底部延续同一模块叙事，展示果汁倒入优雅玻璃杯、切片水果、早餐点缀与冰镇桌面饮用仪式。使用柔和高级日光、细腻阴影、明亮有机色板 warm ivory, citrus yellow, grapefruit coral, mango gold, kiwi green and leaf green、克制字体、充足留白和统一奢华品牌语言。页面应作为一条完整详情页叙事，适合线上销售与线下品牌展示。不得出现人物、手、水印或无关 logo。避免结构改变、随机拼贴、廉价广告、虚假果肉或液体、塑料质感、杂乱排版、低端包装、卡通图形、过饱和、硬闪光和多余道具。

items.title: HEYAN 东方奢华奶茶电商长页
items.description: A compressed but complete long-page e-commerce art-direction template for a collectible Chinese-style milk tea flagship homepage with hero, proof strips and product comparison.
items.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium 3:4 portrait Amazon bestseller homepage for HEYAN TEA ATELIER, a self-created Chinese-style milk tea brand. Preserve the exact vertical long-page structure, stacked module order, panel rhythm, text-image hierarchy and segmented e-commerce logic: top hero cover, oversized impact section, alternating dark/light editorial bands, process-proof strips, signature flavor banner, and bottom comparison/product-family section. Do not alter the macro composition.

Hero: dark premium background, pale stone or rice-paper platform, one large centered front-facing milk tea cup, realistic tea-to-milk layers, cloud cream, embossed branding, lid reflections, condensation and tactile fresh detail. Add restrained pale ink haze. The impact section shows monumental tea streams, milk ribbons, cream folds, brown sugar gloss, pearl highlights, jasmine petals, osmanthus blossoms, ice translucency and tea leaves, with a centered headline.

Use one unified mature brand system across every panel: consistent typography, spacing, subtitles, icons, color grading, product naming and oriental luxury direction. Maintain alternating dark/light information bands with English-led premium copy and concise Chinese subtitles describing fresh-brewed tea, silky milk, handcrafted toppings, balanced sweetness, floral finish, chilled freshness and premium ingredients. Process strips show tea pouring, milk folding into tea, pearls, osmanthus, jasmine infusion, brown sugar glaze, steeping leaves, glass condensation, accurate lids and sharp packaging.

Signature banner: full-width amber tea currents, creamy turbulence, pearl sparkle, brown sugar ribbons, osmanthus dust, jasmine petals and pale ink-cloud diffusion, with a centered family title. Bottom catalog: three horizontally aligned products, Jasmine Cloud Milk Tea in celadon-ivory, Osmanthus Oolong Milk Tea in amber-gold, and Brown Sugar Pearl Silk Milk Tea in caramel-bronze; include flavor, sweetness, tea base, texture, serving temperature and concise purchase-ready descriptions.

Style: realistic commercial beverage photography fused with pale watercolor-ink atmosphere and modern Chinese luxury branding. Use soft cinematic lighting, clean contrast, warm tea glow, silky cream reflections and readable premium typography. Avoid cheap cafe styling, cartoon or plastic textures, neon oversaturation, muddy shadows, clutter, weak product dominance, garbled text, excessive small type and decorative stacking. No people, hands, watermarks or unrelated logos.
items.prompt_zh:
生成一张 HEYAN TEA ATELIER 高级中式奶茶品牌的 3:4 竖版亚马逊爆款首页。严格保留参考长页的纵向结构、模块顺序、版面节奏、图文层级与分段电商逻辑：顶部英雄封面、超大冲击模块、深浅交替信息带、工艺证明组图、招牌风味横幅，以及底部对比与产品系列区，不改变宏观构图。

英雄区使用深色高级背景、浅色石材或宣纸质感平台，中央放置一只放大的正面奶茶杯；表现真实茶乳分层、云朵奶盖、压印品牌、杯盖反光、杯壁冷凝与新鲜触感，并加入克制的浅淡水墨雾气。冲击模块展示夸张的茶流、奶缎、奶油褶皱、黑糖光泽、珍珠高光、茉莉花瓣、桂花、冰块透光与茶叶碎片，中央整合醒目标题。

所有模块统一字体、间距、字幕、图标、色彩、产品命名与现代东方奢华风格。深浅交替的信息带以英文主文案配精致中文副标题，表达鲜煮茶底、丝滑奶感、手作配料、平衡甜度、花香余韵、冰饮清爽与高级原料。工艺组图展示倒茶、奶茶融合、珍珠高光、桂花浮在奶盖、茉莉浸泡、黑糖挂壁、茶叶冲泡、玻璃冷凝、杯盖反射与清晰包装。

招牌横幅表现琥珀茶流、奶油涡流、珍珠闪光、黑糖丝带、桂花粉尘、茉莉花瓣与浅水墨云雾，并置中系列标题。底部目录横向排列三款产品：青瓷象牙色的 Jasmine Cloud Milk Tea、琥珀金色的 Osmanthus Oolong Milk Tea、焦糖铜色的 Brown Sugar Pearl Silk Milk Tea；每款列出风味、甜度、茶底、口感、建议饮用温度与适合购买决策的简短说明。

整体为真实商业饮品摄影融合浅水彩水墨氛围与现代东方奢华品牌设计，使用柔和电影光、干净对比、茶色暖光与丝滑奶油反射。避免廉价奶茶店风、卡通或塑料质感、霓虹过饱和、浑浊阴影、杂乱、产品主体弱、乱码、过多小字与装饰堆叠。不得出现人物、手、水印或无关 logo。

items.title: 点评餐饮商家视觉物料总览板
items.description: A modular 3:4 restaurant brand board covering entrance, dish sequence, set meal, recommendations, menu and news materials with unified editorial food styling.
items.prompt: Create a high-completion 3:4 portrait Dianping Merchant Visual Material Overview Board for a catering brand. Brand configuration: brand name NANA NOODLE BAR; English name NANA NOODLE BAR; category noodle restaurant; positioning fresh, handmade and contemporary; main dish citrus salmon soba; five-image sequence five signature noodle dishes; set meal and price Riverside Set, $28; recommended dishes six best-selling dishes; latest news theme seasonal citrus menu launch; main color vermilion red; secondary and accent colors cream, charcoal and leaf green; material and visual style warm editorial food photography with clean paper textures. Include six clearly separated modules: Entrance Image, Five-Image Sequence, Set Meal Image, Recommended Dishes, Menu Image, and Latest News Image. Place a narrow vertical index column on the left with those labels in order. At the top, show the brand entrance hero and an independent case card containing “Dianping Merchant Material Visual Design Case” and “RESTAURANT VISUAL SYSTEM”, plus minimal brand, category and year information. Entrance Image highlights the brand name, core title and main dish. Five-Image Sequence shows five signature dishes or selling points. Set Meal Image highlights the set meal name, price and complete combination. Recommended Dishes uses a unified product-card system for six dishes. Menu Image is an independent horizontal “must-order” list. Latest News Image presents a new product, seasonal special or recent event. Give every module its own background, complete composition, clear boundary and generous spacing; nothing crosses adjacent modules. Unify brand colors, typography, appetizing commercial food photography, utensils, borders, labels and decorative language while varying composition by module. Keep dish textures, hierarchy, lighting and tableware realistic and consistent. Use only essential Chinese information readable at thumbnail size. Avoid clutter, garbled text, repetitive dishes, cheap template styling, excessive small type, decorative stacking and inconsistent lighting. The result should be splittable into platform-ready sections. No people, hands, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 生成一张 3:4 竖版、高完成度的点评餐饮商家视觉物料总览板。品牌配置：品牌名 NANA NOODLE BAR；英文名 NANA NOODLE BAR；餐饮品类 noodle restaurant；品牌定位 fresh, handmade and contemporary；主打菜 citrus salmon soba；五图组内容 five signature noodle dishes；套餐名与价格 Riverside Set, $28；推荐菜 six best-selling dishes；最新动态主题 seasonal citrus menu launch；主色 vermilion red；辅助色与强调色 cream, charcoal and leaf green；材质与视觉风格 warm editorial food photography with clean paper textures。画面包含六个边界清晰、可独立使用的模块：Entrance Image、Five-Image Sequence、Set Meal Image、Recommended Dishes、Menu Image、Latest News Image。左侧设置窄竖栏，按顺序列出六个标签。顶部包含品牌入口主视觉与独立案例信息卡，加入“Dianping Merchant Material Visual Design Case”和“RESTAURANT VISUAL SYSTEM”，并只保留少量品牌、品类与年份信息。Entrance Image突出品牌名、核心标题与主打菜；Five-Image Sequence展示五道招牌菜或核心卖点；Set Meal Image突出套餐名、价格与完整组合；Recommended Dishes以统一产品卡展示六道菜；Menu Image制作成独立横向“must-order”清单；Latest News Image表现新品、季节限定或近期活动。每个模块使用独立背景、完整构图、清晰边界与充足留白，元素不得越过相邻模块。通过统一品牌色、字体、真实诱人的商业餐饮摄影、餐具、边框、标签和装饰语言保持整体一致，同时让不同模块拥有不同构图。食材纹理、主次层级、光线与餐具真实且统一，信息在缩略图状态也清晰。避免模块粘连、元素越界、菜品重复、乱码、廉价模板感、过多小字与装饰堆叠。最终画面应可拆分为平台物料。画面不出现人物、手、logo或水印。

items.title: 复古城市拼贴艺术旅行海报
items.description: 高级复古旅行拼贴海报模板：以城市地标剪影为核心，将建筑、街道、交通和旅行档案元素叠入一张 4:5 收藏级海报，并通过城市、国家、地标与标语变量复用。
items.prompt:
Create a premium vertical 4:5 vintage editorial travel poster for Lisbon, Portugal, using an artistic travel collage and layered postcard composition rather than a conventional skyline poster.

Main creative concept: create a large, recognizable silhouette or profile of Belem Tower as the central visual frame. Inside and around this silhouette, seamlessly blend multiple scenes from the destination - iconic architecture, streets, bridges, landscapes, local transportation, generic everyday people, and atmospheric elements - so the entire city feels present within one artistic composition.

Let the central landmark partially dissolve into the surrounding city imagery using layered photographic-illustration textures, torn-paper edges, subtle double exposure, ink textures, and vintage print effects.

Include several smaller graphic elements around the main composition:
- a vintage postage stamp featuring Lisbon
- a distressed passport or travel stamp
- an old luggage tag
- a small destination map fragment
- a street sign
- a tiny local transportation detail
- subtle handwritten or typewriter-style travel markings

Add one strong foreground element representing Lisbon, such as a taxi, vintage bus, bicycle, boat, tram, tuk-tuk, or another local vehicle. Generic background figures may appear as small ordinary travel-life details, but no identifiable celebrity or portrait subject.

Typography: at the top, use large elegant uppercase lettering:
Lisbon

Underneath:
Portugal

Add the short classic travel slogan:
A CITY IN MOTION

Use bold vintage sans-serif typography with generous letter spacing. All displayed words must be original, intentional and legible; do not copy logos or add unrelated watermark text.
