Visual style: sophisticated 1940s-1960s travel advertising, vintage European poster design, editorial collage, screen-printed artwork, distressed paper, faded ink, subtle grain, imperfect registration, layered textures, elegant negative space, cinematic atmosphere, and artistic realism.

Color palette: warm ivory paper, deep navy, muted blue, burnt orange, terracotta, faded beige, charcoal, and small golden-yellow accents. Keep colors slightly desaturated and harmonious. Create a thin aged-paper border around the poster.

The composition should feel like a rare collectible vintage travel poster discovered in an old railway station: artistic and premium rather than generic. Avoid a modern 3D-rendered look. Keep the landmark, destination text and major foreground vehicle visually dominant and readable.
items.prompt_zh:
为 Lisbon、Portugal 创作一张高级的竖幅 4:5 复古社论风格旅行海报，使用艺术化旅行拼贴与分层明信片构图，而不是传统的城市天际线海报。

核心创意：创建一个巨大且易于辨认的 Belem Tower 剪影或轮廓，作为核心视觉框架。在此剪影内部及其周围，无缝融合来自该目的地的多种场景，包括标志性建筑、街道、桥梁、景观、当地交通、普通日常人物和氛围元素，让整座城市仿佛存在于一个艺术构图之中。

让中央地标使用分层摄影插图纹理、撕裂纸张边缘、细微双重曝光、水墨纹理和复古印刷效果，部分溶解在周围的城市意象中。

在主构图周围加入以下较小的图形元素：
- 一枚带有 Lisbon 元素的复古邮票
- 一枚做旧的护照或旅行印章
- 一张旧行李标签
- 一小块目的地地图
- 一个街道标志
- 一处微小的当地交通细节
- 微妙的手写或打字机风格旅行标记

添加一个代表 Lisbon 的强烈前景元素，例如出租车、复古巴士、自行车、船只、电车、突突车或其他当地车辆。背景人物只能作为微小的普通旅行生活细节出现，不要出现可辨认的名人或肖像主体。

排版：顶部使用大号优雅的大写字体写出：
Lisbon

下方写出：
Portugal

加入简短经典旅行标语：
A CITY IN MOTION

使用加粗的复古无衬线字体，并保持宽松字距。所有显示文字都必须原创、有明确用途且清晰可辨，不要复制徽标，也不要添加无关水印文字。

视觉风格：精致的 1940 至 1960 年代旅行广告、复古欧洲海报设计、社论拼贴、丝网印刷作品、做旧纸张、褪色墨水、细微颗粒、不完美套色、层叠纹理、优雅留白、电影氛围和艺术写实。

调色板：暖象牙白纸张、深海军蓝、柔和蓝色、焦橙色、赤陶色、褪色米色、炭灰色以及少量金黄色点缀。保持颜色略微去饱和且和谐。在海报周围创建一圈薄薄的老化纸张边框。

整体应像在旧火车站发现的一张珍稀收藏级复古旅行海报：具有艺术感和高级感，而不是普通模板感。避免现代 3D 渲染外观，并让地标、目的地文字和主要前景车辆保持视觉主导且清晰可读。

items.title: 高端极简主义目的地纪念邮票集设计
items.description: 参数化A4竖版高端目的地纪念邮票整版模板，默认示例为Santorini、Greece、欧元符号与€3.00面值；生成7–9枚不同物理尺寸的3:4收藏邮票，采用斯堪的纳维亚极简当代邮政设计。
items.prompt:
Create a premium commemorative postage-stamp collection inspired by Santorini, presented as a complete A4 vertical stamp sheet; use the representative defaults when no replacement is supplied. Use Greece, € and €3.00 for the postal naming and value conventions.

Create exactly 7–9 individual stamps featuring a thoughtful mix of iconic landmarks, architecture, local food, transportation, nature, cultural objects and small everyday symbols that uniquely evoke Santorini. Give every stamp the same elegant 3:4 portrait proportion, but vary their physical sizes noticeably. Arrange them freely across the sheet with gentle asymmetry, visual rhythm and comfortable, purposeful white space; never use a rigid grid.

Use premium Scandinavian minimalism and sophisticated contemporary postal design. Simplify each subject into elegant geometric forms, clean silhouettes, restrained details, subtle graphic abstraction and refined editorial composition. Use a fresh limited palette naturally inspired by Santorini on a clean warm-white or pure-white background. Avoid vintage sepia, excessive decoration, cartoon styling, photorealism and generic tourist-poster aesthetics.

Make every stamp feel physically collectible, with crisp perforated edges, printed paper texture, subtle elegant typography, one distinctive subject per stamp, the destination or country name and the supplied realistic local currency denomination € €3.00. Keep each stamp visually different but coherent.

Show the complete A4 vertical sheet straight-on like a premium limited-edition postal release photographed or scanned for a design archive. Make the sheet tactile, sophisticated and physically believable, with no mockup frame, hands, envelopes, extra readable text, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一套以 Santorini 为灵感的高端纪念邮票集，以完整的A4竖版邮票整版呈现；没有替换值时使用代表性默认值。使用 Greece、€ 和 €3.00 作为邮政名称与面值规范。

创作恰好7–9枚单独邮票，周全混合能独特唤起 Santorini 的标志性地标、建筑、当地美食、交通、自然、文化物品和小型日常符号。每枚邮票保持优雅的3:4竖向比例，但物理尺寸要有明显变化。在整版纸张上自由排列，形成柔和不对称、视觉节奏和舒适且有目的的留白，绝不使用僵硬网格。

采用高端斯堪的纳维亚极简主义与精致当代邮政设计。将每个主题简化为优雅几何形状、干净剪影、克制细节、微妙图形抽象和编辑级构图。使用自然受 Santorini 启发的新鲜有限色板，背景保持干净暖白或纯白。避免复古棕褐色、过度装饰、卡通风格、照片级写实和通俗旅游海报美学。

让每枚邮票都像真实可收藏的实体邮票，具有清晰齿孔边缘、印刷纸张纹理、微妙优雅排版、一个独特主体、目的地或国家名称，以及所提供的真实当地货币面值 € €3.00。每枚邮票视觉不同但保持统一艺术方向。

正面展示完整A4竖版邮票整版，如同为设计档案拍摄或扫描的高级限量邮政发行物。整体要有触感、精致且物理可信，不要样机框架、手、信封、额外可读文字、标志或水印。

items.title: 极简金白建筑地标展示
items.description: 高级极简建筑地标展示模板，支持地标、国家/城市与标题变量，强调中心金色地标、哑光白城市比例模型、博物馆展陈、负空间和金色衬线排版。
items.prompt:
Create a premium minimalist architectural presentation of the Temple of Heaven in Beijing, China.

The landmark should emerge as the only focal point, sculpted in elegant metallic gold while the surrounding city is rendered entirely in matte white as a clean architectural scale model.

Place the landmark precisely at the center, softly glowing with warm golden illumination that naturally draws attention. The surrounding streets, buildings, plazas, and urban layout should appear simplified, monochromatic, and highly minimal, emphasizing the monument’s importance.

Use a refined museum exhibition aesthetic with luxury branding, abundant negative space, soft global illumination, subtle ambient occlusion, delicate shadows, and ultra-clean geometry.

Add a sophisticated serif title centered near the top:

China | the Temple of Heaven

in elegant gold typography.

The overall composition should feel like an Apple-style product reveal, luxury architectural visualization, premium tourism branding, and high-end editorial design.

Style: minimalist architecture, monochrome white city model, golden centerpiece, museum display, luxury presentation, clean geometric forms, cinematic lighting, soft gradients, photorealistic 3D render, ultra-detailed, octane render, global illumination, elegant typography, premium branding, calm aesthetic, high-end architectural visualization, 8K.
items.prompt_zh:
在Beijing, China为the Temple of Heaven创建一个高级极简主义建筑展示。

地标应作为唯一的焦点出现，以优雅的金属金雕刻而成，而周围的城市则完全渲染成哑光白，如同干净的建筑比例模型。

将地标精确地放置在中心，发出柔和温暖的金色光芒，自然地吸引注意力。周围的街道、建筑物、广场和城市布局应显得简化、单色且高度极简，以此强调纪念碑的重要性。

采用精致的博物馆展览美学，结合奢侈品牌设计、丰富的负空间、柔和的全局照明、细微的环境光遮蔽、细腻的阴影和极度干净的几何图形。

在顶部中心位置添加一个精致的衬线体标题：

China | the Temple of Heaven

采用优雅的金色字体。

整体构图应具有苹果风格的产品发布感、奢华建筑可视化、高级旅游品牌推广和高端编辑设计的质感。

风格：极简建筑、单色白色城市模型、金色核心焦点、博物馆展示、奢华呈现、干净的几何形状、电影级照明、柔和渐变、写实 3D 渲染、超高清细节、Octane 渲染、全局照明、优雅排版、高级品牌、宁静美学、高端建筑可视化、8K。

items.title: 梦幻花园中的粉彩生发护发素产品场景
items.description: A fantastical product-ad scene for a pastel pink hair-growth conditioner bottle floating above a glowing magical garden, with a clean no-person product focus.
items.prompt: A whimsical and dreamy product scene in a magical garden. A pastel pink silky hair growth conditioner bottle with a bamboo cap is floating mid-air, surrounded by soft glows, swirls of water or essence, cherry blossom petals and glowing sparkles. The background is a lush green hill landscape under a sunny sky with cartoonish clouds and a picnic tent in the distance. The style is bright, fantastical and animated like a skincare ad from a fantasy film. Gentle lens blur and soft lighting add a dewy, magical glow. No people, hands, logos or extra text.
items.prompt_zh: 梦幻花园中的奇趣护发产品场景。一只粉彩粉色的柔顺生发护发素瓶，配竹制瓶盖，悬浮在空中，周围有柔和光晕、水流或精华液旋涡、樱花花瓣与发光小星星。背景是晴朗天空下的葱郁绿色山丘，云朵带有童话动画感，远处可见野餐帐篷。整体明亮、奇幻、动画化，像奇幻电影中的护肤广告；轻微镜头虚化与柔和光线营造水润梦幻的光泽。画面不出现人物、手、logo或额外文字。

items.title: 极简社论风高端网页首屏设计模板
items.description: 可替换主体的高端网页首屏视觉工作流模板，默认使用现代家具品牌案例；保留左侧大标题与信息层级、右侧大型产品图、浮动内容卡片、几何构造线、暖白底和克制柔和配色，并提供健身、餐厅和咖啡订阅案例方向。
items.prompt:
Optional: use the uploaded reference image as the product, person or visual-material basis for a modern furniture brand hero section with a sculptural lounge chair and soft geometric accents; when no reference is provided, generate a polished photographic cutout or product-render treatment from the subject description.

Design a minimal editorial, high-end web hero visual for a modern furniture brand hero section with a sculptural lounge chair and soft geometric accents. Use oversized elegant serif typography for the primary heading with clean geometric sans-serif supporting type. Align the hero content to the left and preserve generous negative space so the visual hierarchy is weighted left. Place large product or key-visual imagery on the right to create an asymmetric editorial composition. Surround the main visual with a small number of floating rounded content cards for meaningful product information, features, booking metrics or delivery information. Add subtle thin geometric construction lines and soft dimensional shadows without letting decoration overpower the subject.

Use a warm-white background and a restrained premium palette of butter yellow, mint green, powder blue, blush pink and warm beige, supported by crisp black typography. Use smooth clean photographic cutouts and a polished product-render feel, like a mature high-end website, brand hero section or digital editorial design.

Adapt the content to the real business and visual character of a modern furniture brand hero section with a sculptural lounge chair and soft geometric accents rather than applying an unrelated template. Reference four possible directions: a modern fitness platform with an adult woman in colorful activewear, playful sports equipment and bright accessories; a modern furniture brand with product imagery and soft geometric accents; a modern restaurant-booking platform with curated dining experiences and reservation metrics; or a premium coffee-subscription landing page with product photography and recurring-delivery metrics. If a modern furniture brand hero section with a sculptural lounge chair and soft geometric accents includes people, keep them subordinate to the product and typography rather than turning one person into an overpowering hero.

Maintain a clear reading order between the left title and supporting copy, the right key visual and the restrained cards. Keep card numbers and short copy crisp, sparse and purposeful. No empty placeholders, random filler text, excessive cards, complex UI, oversaturated colors, strong gradients, heavy shadows, cluttered decoration, cheap template feel or unreadable typography.
items.prompt_zh:
可选：使用上传的参考图作为 a modern furniture brand hero section with a sculptural lounge chair and soft geometric accents 的产品、人物或视觉素材依据；未提供时，根据主体描述生成高级平滑的摄影切图或产品渲染。

为 a modern furniture brand hero section with a sculptural lounge chair and soft geometric accents 设计一个极简社论艺术指导的高端网页首屏视觉。使用超大优雅衬线字体作为主要标题，搭配清晰的几何无衬线辅助字体；主体内容左对齐，保留充足负空间，让视觉层级向左侧倾斜；将大型产品或关键视觉图像放置在右侧，形成非对称社论构图。围绕主视觉布置少量浮动圆角内容卡片，用于显示有意义的产品信息、功能、预订指标或配送信息；加入微妙细长的几何构造线和柔和立体阴影，但不要让装饰压过主体。

背景使用暖白色，调色板克制而高级，以黄油黄、薄荷绿、粉蓝、腮红粉和暖米色为主，辅以清晰黑色排版。使用平滑、干净的摄影切图和抛光产品渲染质感，整体像成熟的高端网页、品牌首屏或数字编辑设计。

根据 a modern furniture brand hero section with a sculptural lounge chair and soft geometric accents 的真实业务和视觉气质组织内容，不要套用与主体无关的模板。可参考以下四种方向：现代健身平台，彩色运动装成年女性与趣味运动器材和明亮配件；现代家具品牌，产品图像配柔和几何点缀；现代餐厅预订平台，精选用餐体验与预订指标；高级咖啡订阅落地页，产品摄影与周期配送指标。若主体含人物，人物只服务于首屏场景，不成为压倒产品与排版的英雄主角。

保持左侧标题、辅助文字与右侧主视觉的清晰阅读顺序，卡片中的数字和短文案清晰、少量且有用途。不要空洞占位符、随机假文字、过多卡片、复杂 UI、过饱和配色、强烈渐变、粗重阴影、杂乱装饰、低级模板感或不可读排版。

items.title: 莫拉桌食手绘质感高端早餐广告海报
items.description: MORRA TABLE 高级早餐芭菲广告海报：中心为三层浆果奇亚籽燕麦芭菲，外围以统一红褐色单色线稿构成温暖早餐微观宇宙，强调发光红宝石浆果层与优雅英文品牌排版。
items.prompt:
Create a premium vertical breakfast advertising poster for the original lifestyle cafe brand MORRA TABLE. Use a warm oatmeal-beige background with subtle paper texture and generous negative space. Place elegant original English typography at the top, including the exact brand name MORRA TABLE, a refined headline such as "Morning Layers," and a short supporting line such as "Soft berries, cultured cream, toasted oats." Do not copy wording from any reference image.

Make one enlarged, hyper-real berry chia oat parfait in a rounded clear glass the strongest visual anchor in the lower center. Show three precise layers: pale ivory chia-yogurt with visible tiny seeds, a vivid ruby-crimson berry compote or fruit gel layer, and a generous golden toasted oat-granola crown. Make the berry layer translucent, internally luminous and jewel-like with soft ruby highlights while keeping it edible and natural; it is the first-glance appetite hook. Render realistic glass thickness, rim, refraction, reflections and grounded shadow, plus creamy yogurt and crisp varied granola texture.

Surround the product with a sparse, mature red-brown monochrome hand-drawn breakfast micro-universe: tabletop edge, spoon, lamp outline, restrained interior traces, oats and berry marks, and a few generic miniature figures interacting playfully with the breakfast landscape. Keep all line art, brand mark, typography and secondary details in the same red-brown tonal family with disciplined line weight and spacing. The scene should feel warm, calm, intimate, collectible and editorial, never like a cheap cafe flyer or childish doodle.

Use soft warm diffused morning light, gentle glass highlights, a glowing berry interior, tender yogurt shadows and a golden kiss on the granola. Keep the background quiet and lightly textured so the real food product remains dominant. Ultra-premium photorealistic food advertising, balanced realism and graphic storytelling, clean layout, refined materials and high campaign polish. Avoid copied brand names or slogans, clutter, flat layers, dull or muddy berries, plastic yogurt, messy granola, hard shadows, dark stains, oversized decoration, low-resolution glass, unreadable typography and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
为原创生活方式咖啡品牌 MORRA TABLE 创建一张高级竖幅早餐广告海报。使用温暖燕麦米色背景与微妙纸张纹理，保留充足负空间。顶部放置优雅的原创英文排版，包括精确品牌名 MORRA TABLE、类似“Morning Layers”的精致标题，以及类似“Soft berries, cultured cream, toasted oats”的简短辅助文案。不要复制任何参考图中的文字。

让下方居中的一杯放大超写实浆果奇亚籽燕麦芭菲成为最强视觉锚点。使用圆形透明玻璃杯，清晰呈现三层：带细小奇亚籽的淡象牙色奇亚籽酸奶底层、鲜艳红宝石色浆果蜜饯或水果凝胶中层，以及丰盈金色烘烤燕麦格兰诺拉顶层。浆果层要透明、具有内部光感并像宝石一样呈现柔和红宝石高光，同时保持可食用和自然；它是第一眼的食欲记忆点。真实表现玻璃厚度、杯缘、折射、反光与落地阴影，以及柔滑酸奶和酥脆多变的燕麦质感。

围绕产品构建稀疏、成熟的红褐色单色手绘早餐微观宇宙：桌面边缘、勺子、台灯轮廓、克制的室内线条、燕麦与浆果痕迹，以及少量与早餐景观俏皮互动的通用微型人物。线稿、品牌标志、排版和所有次要细节必须共享同一红褐色调、规范线宽与间距节奏。画面应温暖、平静、亲密、具有收藏感和编辑感，不能像廉价咖啡馆传单或幼稚涂鸦。

使用柔和温暖的清晨漫射光，在玻璃上形成细腻高光，让浆果内部发光、酸奶带有柔和阴影、燕麦顶部有金色光吻。背景保持安静并带轻微纹理，使真实食品产品始终占主导。采用超高级写实食品广告质感，在写实与图形叙事之间取得平衡，布局干净，材质精致，具有高级宣传片完成度。避免复制品牌名或标语、杂乱布局、扁平层次、暗淡或浑浊浆果、塑料感酸奶、凌乱燕麦、硬阴影、黑色污渍、过大装饰、低分辨率玻璃、难以辨认的排版和水印。

items.title: 保时捷911GT顶级设计技术提案展示板
items.description: 4:5 vertical OEM-style technical presentation board for a Porsche 911 GT, combining orthographic views, a large hero render, engineering studies, aero analysis and disciplined English labeling.
items.prompt:
Create a 4:5 vertical premium OEM-style technical presentation board for the Porsche 911 GT. Use a warm-white technical-paper background and five disciplined horizontal bands: top metadata with front and rear elevations; upper-middle large dimensioned side-profile engineering drawing; center-lower ultra-realistic front three-quarter hero render; lower engineering modules for wheel assembly, suspension and body-kit exploded view; bottom top-view blueprint, compact aero chart, detail studies, material system and notes.

The vehicle must be a believable factory-authentic high-performance Porsche 911 GT, preserving the classic 911 roofline and greenhouse, round headlamp signature, low front overhang, wide rear haunches, center-lock wheels, aggressive front aero, carbon-fiber channels, large motorsport or swan-neck rear wing and deep diffuser. Make the hero car Guards Red with black motorsport striping and exposed carbon fiber. Show realistic paint depth, clearcoat, windshield distortion, carbon weave, ceramic brakes, tire tread, lamp internals, shut lines, dust traces and grounded contact shadow. The hero render dominates while smaller panels remain document-like.

Blend precise blueprint geometry with premium hand-drawn design-office language: contour refinements, construction guides, correction lines, marker washes, engineering arrows, dimensional callouts, perspective traces and subtle paper grain. Include front/rear elevations, side view, top view, wheel/tire/disc/caliper/hub study, damper/linkage/spring study, exploded splitter/canard/side-skirt/fender/wing/diffuser study, and a compact drag/downforce/speed chart.

Use only English visible text with a thin modern technical hierarchy. Exact title: “PORSCHE 911 GT” and “Performance Design Study”. Include restrained headings: “PROJECT NAME”, “DESIGN STUDY”, “VEHICLE SPECS”, “KEY FEATURES”, “WHEEL ASSEMBLY”, “SUSPENSION”, “BODY KIT EXPLODED VIEW”, “TOP VIEW”, “AERO PERFORMANCE”, “DETAILING”, “MATERIAL SYSTEM”, “NOTES”, “VIEW INDEX”. Include consistent data: “Engine: 4.0L naturally aspirated flat-six”, “Power: 510 PS”, “Torque: 470 Nm”, “Transmission: 7-speed PDK”, “0–100 km/h: 3.4 s”, “Top Speed: 311 km/h”; project metadata may read “Project Name: 911 GT Performance Study”, “Design Study: Road-Legal Track Aerodynamics”, “Material System: Steel / Aluminum / Carbon Fiber / Alcantara”, “Aero Package: GT Downforce Configuration”, “View Index: V1 / V2 / V3 / V4”, “Notes: Dimension references in millimeters”. Add a minimal Porsche crest and wordmark in a restrained official position.

Use clean studio-technical lighting, controlled reflections, graphite linework, black typography, Guards Red, carbon black, brushed metal gray and subtle beige accents. The page must feel award-level, realistic, multi-view, OEM-disciplined and complete, never a cheap brochure or sterile CAD screenshot. Negative prompt: generic sports car, wrong Porsche proportions, fake 911 roofline, wrong wheels or wing, messy blueprint, cartoon, cyberpunk clutter, plastic materials, low-resolution linework, distorted perspective, fake exploded views, inaccurate components, unreadable required headings or noisy layout.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张 4:5 竖版高端 OEM 风格保时捷 911 GT 技术提案展示板。使用暖白技术纸背景和五个严谨的水平区域：顶部元数据、前视图和后视图；中上部带尺寸标注的大型侧视工程图；中下部超写实前四分之三主体渲染；下部轮毂组件、悬挂和车身套件爆炸图工程模块；底部顶视蓝图、紧凑气动图表、细节研究、材料系统和注释。

车辆必须是可信的原厂高性能 Porsche 911 GT，保留经典 911 车顶线和玻璃舱、圆形大灯、低前悬、宽后轮拱、中心锁止轮毂、激进前部气动、碳纤维通道、大型赛车或天鹅颈后翼和深后扩散器。主体车使用卫红、黑色赛车条纹和外露碳纤维。表现真实车漆深度、清漆反射、挡风玻璃畸变、碳纤维编织、陶瓷制动、胎面、大灯内部、分缝线、灰尘痕迹和接地阴影。主体渲染占主导，小面板保持文档感。

将精确蓝图几何与高级设计办公室手绘语言结合：轮廓优化、结构指南、修正线、马克笔渲染、工程箭头、尺寸标注、透视痕迹和细微纸张纹理。包含前后视图、侧视图、顶视图、轮胎/制动盘/卡钳/轮毂研究、减震器/连杆/弹簧研究、分流器/小翼/侧裙/翼子板/后翼/扩散器爆炸研究，以及阻力/下压力/速度图表。

所有可见文字仅使用英文，并采用纤细现代的技术层级。精确标题为 “PORSCHE 911 GT” 和 “Performance Design Study”。加入这些分区标题：“PROJECT NAME”“DESIGN STUDY”“VEHICLE SPECS”“KEY FEATURES”“WHEEL ASSEMBLY”“SUSPENSION”“BODY KIT EXPLODED VIEW”“TOP VIEW”“AERO PERFORMANCE”“DETAILING”“MATERIAL SYSTEM”“NOTES”“VIEW INDEX”。加入一致数据：“Engine: 4.0L naturally aspirated flat-six”“Power: 510 PS”“Torque: 470 Nm”“Transmission: 7-speed PDK”“0–100 km/h: 3.4 s”“Top Speed: 311 km/h”；元数据可写：“Project Name: 911 GT Performance Study”“Design Study: Road-Legal Track Aerodynamics”“Material System: Steel / Aluminum / Carbon Fiber / Alcantara”“Aero Package: GT Downforce Configuration”“View Index: V1 / V2 / V3 / V4”“Notes: Dimension references in millimeters”。在克制的官方位置加入极简 Porsche 盾徽和字标。

使用干净的技术影棚光、受控反射、石墨灰线条、黑色排版、卫红、碳黑、拉丝金属灰和细微米色点缀。整体应像获奖级、真实、多视图、遵循 OEM 纪律的完整展示板，不要廉价宣传册或冰冷 CAD 截图。负面提示词：通用跑车、错误 Porsche 比例、假 911 车顶线、错误轮毂或尾翼、混乱蓝图、卡通、赛博朋克杂乱、塑料材质、低分辨率线稿、透视变形、虚假爆炸图、不准确组件、必需标题不可读或嘈杂布局。

items.title: 现代波普艺术风格社交媒体产品海报模板
items.description: 可替换产品名称并可选上传产品参考图的1:1社交媒体营销网格模板，保留四宫格波普艺术背景、类别配色、商业灯光、超大促销排版与高端 Instagram 活动质感。默认产品为 NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER。
items.prompt:
Optional: use the uploaded product reference image as the visual basis for the appearance, colors, ingredients, textures and packaging of NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER. When no reference is provided, generate a premium ultra-realistic product version of NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER.

Create a bold, colorful 1:1 social-media campaign grid for “NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER”, sized 1080 x 1080 pixels for Instagram posts and trend-led social branding. Automatically adapt colors, ingredients, textures, props, decorative elements and the overall visual mood to the product type or uploaded reference. Design a modern pop-art promotional collage divided into four creative square sections, each with its own background treatment and dynamic visual rhythm.

Use vibrant pop-art backgrounds with energetic color blocking, abstract wave patterns, maze lines, retro squiggles, doodle outlines, neon accents, playful geometric shapes and modern Memphis elements. Use bright commercial studio lighting with glossy highlights, vivid color reflections, soft realistic shadows and premium texture enhancement for a playful modern advertising atmosphere.

Use a modern pop-art advertising aesthetic, Gen-Z branding energy, trendy Instagram campaign visuals, colorful street-style graphics, a minimal yet energetic layout, bold modern typography, premium commercial-poster design and ultra-realistic product rendering. Use oversized bold type with playful placement, mixing condensed modern fonts with handwritten accent text. Keep the typography youthful, energetic and visually dynamic. Add a restrained selection of clear promotional phrases such as “New Collection”, “Limited Edition”, “Now Available”, “Fresh Drop”, “Premium Quality” or “Trending Now”; make the text serve NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER and never use random filler words.

Adapt the high-contrast trend-led palette to the product category: ice cream uses pink, cyan, orange and yellow; sneakers use neon green, purple and black; cosmetics use pastel pink, lavender and cream; tech products use electric blue, black and lime. For other categories, choose an impactful palette that fits the real appearance and product character of NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER.

Use a centered hero-product composition, close-up commercial photography, slightly tilted dynamic framing, shallow depth of field, ultra-sharp focus, cinematic advertising quality and modern 4K campaign rendering. Keep the design divided into four creative square sections, with colors, graphics and decorative elements adapted to NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER while the four sections work as one playful pop-art brand system. Avoid dull empty treatments while preserving enough layout breathing room. The final design should feel like a complete, fashionable, premium Instagram product-campaign key visual.
items.prompt_zh:
可选：使用上传的产品参考图作为 NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER 的外观、颜色、成分、纹理和包装依据；未提供时，为 NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER 生成高级、超现实的产品版本。

为“NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER”创建一张大胆、色彩丰富的1:1社交媒体营销网格海报，画布为1080×1080像素，适合 Instagram 帖子和时尚社交媒体品牌。自动根据 NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER 的产品类型或上传参考图调整颜色、成分、纹理、道具、装饰元素和整体视觉氛围。设计现代波普艺术风格的促销拼贴画，分成四个创意方形区域，每个区域拥有独特背景风格和动态视觉节奏。

背景使用充满活力的色块、抽象波纹、迷宫线条、复古波浪线、涂鸦轮廓、霓虹装饰、俏皮几何形状和现代孟菲斯元素。采用明亮商业摄影棚灯光、光泽高光、鲜艳色彩反射、柔和真实阴影和高级纹理增强，营造俏皮而现代的广告氛围。

整体风格为现代波普艺术广告、Z世代品牌、流行 Instagram 活动视觉、色彩丰富的街头图形、简约但充满活力的布局、大胆现代排版、高级商业海报设计和超现实产品渲染。使用超大粗体字，配合俏皮的版式位置，将紧凑现代字体与手写装饰文本混合，保持字体年轻、充满活力且有视觉动态。可加入有组织的促销文字：“New Collection”、“Limited Edition”、“Now Available”、“Fresh Drop”、“Premium Quality”、“Trending Now”；文字必须清晰、少量且服务于 NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER，不要使用随机填充词。

按产品类别适配高对比度趋势色彩：冰淇淋使用粉色、青色、橙色和黄色；运动鞋使用霓虹绿、紫色和黑色；化妆品使用柔和粉色、薰衣草色和奶油色；科技产品使用电子蓝、黑色和酸橙色。其他类别选择与 NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER 的真实外观和产品气质相符的高冲击配色。

使用中心英雄产品构图、特写商业摄影、略微倾斜的动态取景、浅景深、超清晰对焦、电影级广告质量和4K现代活动渲染。保持设计分为四个创意方形区域，颜色、图形和装饰元素适应 NOVA CITRUS SPARKLING WATER，四个区域共同维持俏皮波普艺术品牌风格。避免空洞无趣的色调，但保留必要的版式呼吸空间。最终效果应像时尚、高端、完整的 Instagram 产品活动主视觉。

items.title: 导演回顾展粗粝拼贴肖像海报
items.description: 以一卷带手写注记的35毫米胶片为中心物件的导演回顾展拼贴海报，保留主题变量并提供可直接执行的默认值。
items.prompt: Create a memorable vertical 3:4 graphic portrait poster for a director retrospective. Preserve the THEME variable and, when no replacement is supplied, use the default theme: an annotated 35mm film reel pressed into the center of the lower half. Derive real tools, objects and symbols from the theme, placing the physical film reel at the central axis and first visual anchor. Build a rough physical collage and oil-paint surface: a large warm indigo-black background, a roughly brushed chalk-white main surface with visible brush marks and uneven underlayers, a heavy dark upper block pressing down like a solemn hat brim, and a small amount of rusty-orange accent color concentrated on the axis. Complete a face-like graphic structure with only a few black hand-drawn scribble lines for eyes, eyebrows and curves; it is a graphic collage, not a real person. Across the top, place the loose-spaced title text DIRECTOR RETROSPECTIVE; near the bottom right add a reduced handwritten signature-like mark. Keep the result warm, dramatic, humorous yet solemn, intuitive and human, never a neat cartoon avatar or polished commercial illustration. No extra people, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 生成一张用于导演回顾展的3:4竖版、令人印象深刻的粗粝拼贴肖像海报。保留 THEME 变量；未提供替换值时，默认主题为一卷带手写注记、压入画面下半部中央的35毫米胶片卷。根据主题提取真实工具、物件和符号，把实体胶片卷放在面部轴线与第一视觉锚点上。构建粗糙的实体拼贴与油画表面：大面积温暖的靛蓝黑背景，带明显笔刷痕迹和不均匀底层的粉笔白粗刷主表面，顶部用沉重深色块向下压出庄重帽檐般的重量，并只在轴线集中少量锈橙色点缀。面部般的图形结构只用少量黑色手绘涂鸦线完成眼睛、眉形和曲线；这是图形拼贴，不是真人。顶部放置字距疏松的文字 DIRECTOR RETROSPECTIVE，右下方加入缩小的手写签名感标记。整体温暖、戏剧化、带手工幽默又庄重，直觉化且有人味，不能变成整洁卡通头像或精致商业插画。不要多余人物、logo或水印。

items.title: 极简手工叠层剪纸城市旅游海报模板
items.description: 9:16无人物城市旅游海报模板：以单一主地标、简化城市轮廓、平滑次级结构和一处特色元素构成克制的手工叠层剪纸拼贴。
items.prompt:
Create a premium 9:16 vertical travel poster for KYOTO, designed as a minimal handcrafted layered paper-cut collage with no people.

Use a warm off-white background with subtle matte cardstock texture, visible fine paper fibers, crisp cut edges, soft dimensional relief, and delicate contact shadows. Reserve the upper 22-25% as open negative space. Center the only text, the destination title “KYOTO”, at the top in dark-navy uppercase geometric sans-serif lettering with wide tracking. Do not add any other text.

Below the title, include only two or three small minimal white paper clouds. Do not include a sun, circle, red dot, decorative disk, border, or similar graphic element. Feature Kiyomizu-dera Temple as the single dominant centerpiece. Keep it simplified, iconic, immediately recognizable, and faithful to its defining architectural forms and proportions, using clear layered paper shapes, elegant symmetry, and a strong silhouette rather than intricate sculptural detail.

Introduce a gently curving stone path as one smooth simple paper form across the lower-middle composition. Behind the main landmark, place only a few simplified wooden Kyoto machiya houses as flat supporting layers, with Yasaka Pagoda subtly hinted in the background. In the foreground, add a very minimal streetscape: a few soft sage paper tree shapes, one or two pale paving layers, and exactly one small a single small red torii gate as the sole characteristic detail.

Keep the composition sparse, calm, balanced, and highly legible with only a small number of clean paper layers. Use warm ivory, deep navy, muted blue-gray, sage green, and muted vermilion in a sophisticated subdued palette. Use soft studio light from the upper left, casting subtle shadows toward the lower right. Make it feel like a refined editorial paper collage: minimal, elegant, tactile, handcrafted, and premium. Avoid people, photorealism, painterly effects, neon colors, dense detail, complex windows, heavy gradients, thick outlines, clutter, logos, watermarks, extra text, duplicate landmarks, and unnecessary decoration.
items.prompt_zh:
为 KYOTO 创作一张9:16竖幅高级旅游海报，设计为无人物的极简手工叠层剪纸拼贴。

使用暖白色背景，带细微哑光卡纸纹理、可见纸张纤维、利落剪切边缘、柔和立体浮雕和细腻接触阴影。顶部保留22-25%的开放负空间。顶部中央只放置一行文字，即目的地标题“KYOTO”，使用深海军蓝大写几何无衬线字体和宽字距。不添加任何其他文字。

标题下方只加入两到三朵极简白色纸云。不要出现太阳、圆圈、红点、装饰圆盘、边框或类似图形元素。将 Kiyomizu-dera Temple 作为唯一主视觉中心，保持简化、标志性、易于辨认，忠实保留其最有定义性的建筑形态和比例，以清晰的叠层纸形、优雅对称性和强剪影呈现，避免复杂雕塑细节。

在中下部加入 a gently curving stone path 这一种平滑简洁的纸质结构。在主地标后方只放置少量简化的 wooden Kyoto machiya houses 作为扁平支撑层，并在背景中隐约暗示 Yasaka Pagoda。前景保持极简：几片柔和的鼠尾草绿纸树形、一两层浅色铺面，以及正好一个小型 a single small red torii gate 作为唯一特色细节。

保持构图稀疏、平静、平衡且高度易读，只使用少量整洁纸层。使用暖象牙色、深海军蓝、柔和蓝灰、鼠尾草绿和 muted vermilion 组成高雅克制的色板。使用左上方柔和影棚光，向右下方投射细微阴影。整体像精致的社论纸质拼贴：极简、优雅、有触感、手工制作且高端。避免人物、写实主义、绘画效果、霓虹色、密集细节、复杂窗户、重度渐变、粗轮廓、杂乱、Logo、水印、额外文字、重复地标和不必要装饰。

items.title: 倒悬东方天阙云海环境场景
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已整理为不绑定人物身份的东方仙界超尺度环境模板。保留倒悬皇家天阙、白玉露台、云海断层、灰蓝雾层、朱红漆柱、青玉屏与局部金色边缘光。
items.prompt:
Create a 16:9 horizontal cinematic environment scene in an oriental celestial realm. A divine architectural civilization hangs above an endless sea of clouds, with a single spatial proposition: one massive royal celestial palace is suspended upside down like an artificial mountain range descending from the sky. Use a refined cinematic matte-painting and photorealistic fantasy-environment approach with gray-blue mist.

The camera stands inside a high-altitude white-jade terrace at human eye height, using a 35mm environmental lens and looking straight ahead with a slight upward angle. Do not use an aerial or bird's-eye view. The left foreground is strongly obscured by a huge deep-vermilion lacquer pillar, oily dark-wood beams and dark-green double eaves cropped by the frame. The right foreground adds a translucent green-jade screen and carved white-jade balustrade.

The middle ground is a wide, empty royal white-jade terrace reflecting the cold gray sky. Three tiny indistinct guardian silhouettes stand quietly at its far end and occupy about 1 percent of the image height; they are background scale cues, not a second subject. Beyond the terrace is a groundless cloud-sea fault. In the distance, show only part of the inverted palace-continent: upside-down eaves, giant dougong brackets, suspended white-jade platforms, deep-wood pillar forests, dark-green glazed roofs and vertically descending foundations. At least half of the architecture is hidden or cropped by mist, cloud curtains, foreground eaves and the frame; the upper connection disappears beyond the sky and the lower ends dissolve into pale blue-gray cloud.

Let about 80 percent of the frame be gray-blue sky, blue-gray cloud sea, cool air and deep blue-gray structural shadows. Use deep-vermilion lacquer, dark wood, white jade, green jade, dark-green glazed tiles and very limited local gilded edges. Soft directional light from high right passes through cloud and creates only a small amber rim on the inverted eaves and beams. Keep foreground details clear, middle distance moderate and far volumes simplified into deep gray-blue outlines. Preserve solemn stillness, deep atmospheric layering, luminous ivory mist and a monumental artificial-terrain feeling. No ruined architecture, crowded palace city, second visual protagonist, sci-fi spacecraft, text, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一幅 16:9 横向电影感东方仙界环境场景。神界建筑文明悬浮在无尽云海之上，整幅画面只围绕一个空间命题：一整座巨大的皇家天阙倒悬在天空中，像人工山脉一样向下垂落。采用精致电影级哑光绘景与照片级幻想环境质感，整体为灰蓝暮霭风格。

摄影机站在高空白玉露台内部，位于接近人眼高度的位置，使用 35mm 环境镜头平视略微仰拍。不要航拍或鸟瞰。左侧近景由巨大深朱红漆柱、油润深木梁架和被画框裁切的墨青重檐强烈遮挡；右侧由半透明青玉屏与雕花白玉栏板形成第二层框景。

中景是宽阔空旷的皇家白玉露台，抛光玉面映出冷灰天空。露台尽头静静站着三位极小且无法辨认的守望者，只占画面高度约 1%，仅作为尺度参照，不建立第二视觉主体。露台外立即坠入没有地面的云海断层。远方只展示部分倒悬天阙大陆：倒悬重檐、巨型斗拱、白玉悬台、深木柱林、墨青琉璃屋顶和向下延伸的宫基。至少一半建筑被雾层、云幕、近景檐口和画框遮挡或裁切；上方连接结构消失在天空之外，下方末端逐渐融入淡蓝灰云汽。

约 80% 画面由灰蓝天空、蓝灰云海、冷色空气和深青灰结构阴影控制。使用深朱红漆、深木、白玉、青玉、墨青琉璃和极少量局部鎏金边缘。右上方柔和方向光穿过云层，只在倒悬飞檐和梁架边缘形成少量琥珀轮廓光。近景细节清晰，中景适中，远景体块简化为深灰蓝轮廓。保持庄严静止、深层大气透视、发光象牙色雾气和人工地貌般的宏伟感。不要残破建筑、拥挤宫城、第二视觉主角、科幻飞船、文字、logo 或水印。

items.title: 东亚木质长廊云海古松景观
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已整理为不绑定人物身份的东方幻想环境景观模板。保留宏伟木质长廊、中央古松、云海、远景长袍剪影、冷色主调与局部暖边光。
items.prompt:
Create a 16:9 horizontal cinematic fantasy environment painting of a grand ancient East Asian timber corridor spanning the scene. A giant wind-swept ancient pine is framed inside a massive central architectural opening. The building floats above an endless sea of clouds with no visible ground. Rigid man-made horizontal geometry contrasts with the tree's irregular organic form, leaving vast negative space and a serene, solemn Eastern-fantasy atmosphere.

Use an eye-level environmental viewpoint from within the corridor, not an aerial or bird's-eye view. Show long eave lines, repetitive slender pillars, minimal decoration, thin railings and a clean central opening. The foreground architecture can be cropped by the frame. The pine has a broad flattened wind-swept canopy and a rough weathered trunk; distant mountains dissolve into mist. Add a few tiny paired figures in pale robes on narrow terraces only as anonymous scale references, with no recognizable faces and no dominant human subject.

Use this palette: #3D6683 sky and atmosphere, #7594A6 cloud sea and distant mist, #273E48 canopy and corridor shadows, #774332 dark wood, #C2673A a narrow warm rim light and #D8D4C0 sparse highlights. Let 85-90 percent remain cool, with only 10-15 percent localized warmth on eaves, pillars and trunk. Use low-angle warm side light from the right, layered atmospheric perspective, soft saturation, gentle contrast and refined cinematic matte-painting texture.

Integrate the exact word “Soran” subtly into one tiny figure's clothing, a small pendant, wood grain, a weathered pillar carving or a mortise-and-tenon joint. It must be physically integrated, discoverable but never dominant. No large foreground figures, portrait framing, recognizable faces, heroic action, crowded architecture, lantern overload, weak tree, visible ground, bright green vegetation, vivid cyan sky, orange sunset wash, oversaturation, bloom, flash, studio lighting, shallow depth of field, HDR, detached letters, subtitles, unrelated branding, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一幅 16:9 横向电影感东方幻想环境画：宏伟古代东亚木质长廊横跨整个场景，巨型风吹古松被框置于中央巨大建筑开口内。建筑悬浮在无尽云海之上，不出现地面。僵硬的人造水平几何形态与古松不规则的有机形态形成对比，保留巨大负空间和宁静庄严的东方幻想氛围。

使用站在长廊内部的人眼高度环境视角，不要航拍或鸟瞰。表现绵延长屋檐线、重复纤细柱子、极少装饰、细薄栏杆和干净的中央开口，前景建筑可以被画框裁切。古松拥有扁平的风吹树冠和粗糙风化树干，远山轮廓融入薄雾。狭窄露台上加入少量穿浅色长袍的极小人物对，仅作为匿名尺度参照；不得出现可辨识面部，也不建立人物主体。

使用以下配色：#3D6683 天空与氛围，#7594A6 云海与远方薄雾，#273E48 树冠与长廊阴影，#774332 深色木材，#C2673A 狭窄暖色边缘光，#D8D4C0 稀疏高光。85-90% 保持冷色，仅在屋檐、柱子和树干上使用 10-15% 局部暖光。使用来自右侧低角度的暖色侧光、层层空中透视、柔和饱和度、轻柔对比和精致电影级哑光绘景质感。

将准确单词 “Soran” 微妙地融入一位极小人物的衣物、小吊坠、木纹、风化柱刻或榫卯接缝中。文字必须与材质物理融合，可被发现但绝不主导画面。不要大型前景人物、肖像构图、可辨识面部、英雄动作、拥挤建筑、灯笼过载、弱小树木、可见地面、明亮绿色植被、生动青色天空、橙色日落滤镜、暖色冲洗、过饱和、过度泛光、闪光摄影、棚拍光、浅景深、HDR、脱离材质的字母、字幕、无关品牌、logo 或水印。

items.title: 静谧暮色圆润焦点中秋海报
items.description: 16:9 restrained Mid-Autumn Festival poster with a solitary glowing circular focal point suspended in a blue twilight sky above a low supporting structure.
items.prompt:
Create a 16:9 quiet Mid-Autumn Festival poster with a restrained solar-term narrative. Let the theme determine the imagery, symbols, materials and hues, then distill it into one rounded glowing focal point with a complete outline and concentrated volume. At first glance, show the isolated circular bright form in a large calm twilight sky; let a stable central axis descend to a restrained theme-derived title system, low supporting platform and two or three tiny narrative silhouettes or symbols. Preserve a gentle contrast between monumental scale and intimate scale.

Use expansive white space in the sky. The luminous circle may sit high or low on the axis, suspended in air or resting on a low base, with scale controlled from small and bright to huge and quiet. Form a dark horizontal frame along the lower edge from theme-derived railings, tabletop or support. Keep distant mountains, buildings or thematic environmental silhouettes atomized, lowered and blue-gray so the foreground stays clear, middle ground sparse and background never competes with the circular focal point. Add one small low-saturation warm object or point of light as a rhythm marker against the cool twilight.

Use blue twilight, soft creamy self-luminescence in the circular focal point, slightly softened edges that remain legible, light touching only adjacent surfaces and restrained fragmented distant lights. Keep a clean digital composite and soft depth of field; no grain, paper texture or dramatic glare.

Build the title system on the same axis: a narrow upright high-contrast serif title in the target writing system, tight spacing and quiet dark letterforms in the main white space, optionally overlapping the luminous circle slightly; a compact heavier subtitle beneath it, with tiny fine characters and date details creating hierarchy. Use only theme-derived Mid-Autumn Festival wording and minimal date text; do not add unrelated copy. The result must remain an isolated focal-point poster, never an ordinary decorated night scene, detached typography layout or crowded composition. No logos, watermarks or interface elements.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张 16:9 的静谧中秋节海报，建立克制的节气叙事。让主题决定意象、象征物、材质和色相，再将其提炼为一个轮廓完整、体量集中的圆润发光焦点。第一眼呈现大面积宁静暮空中的孤立圆形亮部；沿稳定中轴落到克制的主题标题系统、低位承托平台以及两到三个微小叙事轮廓或符号，形成宏大尺度与亲密尺度的温柔反差。

天空保留大面积留白。发光圆体可位于中轴高处或低处，悬于空中或压在低位基座上，尺寸在小而明亮与巨大而沉静之间受控变化。下缘用主题派生的栏杆、台面或承托结构形成深色水平框。远处山体、建筑或主题环境轮廓被雾化压低并蓝灰化，使前景清晰、中景稀疏，背景绝不抢夺圆形焦点。加入一处低饱和暖色小物或点光，作为冷调暮色中的节奏标记。

采用蓝调暮光，圆形焦点发出柔和奶油色自发光，边缘略柔但轮廓清楚，光只轻触相邻表面，远景灯火细碎克制。保持干净数字合成和柔和景深，不添加颗粒、纸纹或戏剧性炫光。

标题系统与中轴共线：在主要留白区使用目标书写系统中窄而端正的高对比衬线主标题，字距紧凑、深色安静，可轻微压过圆形亮部；下方承接较紧凑且略重的副标题，再用极小号细字和日期拉开层级。只使用与中秋节主题相关的标题和少量日期文字，不添加无关文案。最终必须保持孤立焦点海报的秩序，不能变成装饰拥挤的普通夜景、脱离环境的排版或杂乱构图。不要标志、水印或界面元素。

items.title: 东方暗黑档案实验博物馆海报
items.description: 9:16实验博物馆海报模板：以旧纸、墨黑平面和古代文物档案切片构成低饱和的东方暗黑视觉系统，展览主题、标题与信息均可替换。
items.prompt:
Design a 9:16 experimental museum poster for the exhibition “东方暗黑档案”, using the following content variables: Chinese main title “夜行古录”, English title “ORIENTAL DARK ARCHIVES”, subtitle “Experimental Museum of Fragmented Ancient Images”, core image “a fragmented Nuo mask”, black composition method “a giant diagonal cut”, thematic phrase “Fragments remember what time erases.”, and time/location line “2026 / HALL 03 / EAST ARCHIVE”.

Build an Oriental Dark Archives visual system. Use yellowed old paper, rice-paper fibers, scanning grain, ink bleed, and natural print wear as the background. Let large ink-black flat structures create a strong positive-negative relationship, specifically using a giant diagonal cut as an active compositional device rather than a decorative border. The structure must feel designed for this theme, not like a generic template.

Process a fragmented Nuo mask into a fragmented ancient map or cultural-relic archive slice, showing only its most recognizable portions. Retain cracks, faded pigment, rust, wood grain, rubbings, and age-related wear so the image feels like a rediscovered ancient visual archive, not an ordinary Chinese-style illustration. Use a large coarse Chinese calligraphy, stele-inscription, or rubbing-style treatment for “夜行古录”; use oversized high-contrast serif typography for “ORIENTAL DARK ARCHIVES”, allowing controlled cropping, border crossing, or partial occlusion by the black structure. Place “Experimental Museum of Fragmented Ancient Images”, “Fragments remember what time erases.”, and “2026 / HALL 03 / EAST ARCHIVE” in quiet areas with clear hierarchy. Add one tiny cinnabar-red seal.

Keep the palette low saturation: ink black, old-paper beige, ochre, dark gold, and gray-green. Render only the requested exhibition text accurately and legibly, with no random characters, dense small type, invented logos, watermarks, image numbers, or extra branding. Maintain a mysterious, ancient, restrained experimental museum and cultural-archive atmosphere. Avoid ordinary Chinese-style templates, a complete character illustration, material piling, fantasy-game styling, tourism-promotion styling, high saturation, glowing effects, and garbled text.
items.prompt_zh:
设计一张9:16竖幅实验博物馆海报，展览主题为“东方暗黑档案”，使用以下内容变量：中文主标题“夜行古录”、英文标题“ORIENTAL DARK ARCHIVES”、副标题“Experimental Museum of Fragmented Ancient Images”、核心图像“a fragmented Nuo mask”、黑色构图方式“a giant diagonal cut”、主题短句“Fragments remember what time erases.”以及时间地点信息“2026 / HALL 03 / EAST ARCHIVE”。

建立“东方暗黑档案”的视觉系统。以泛黄旧纸、宣纸纤维、扫描颗粒、墨迹渗透和自然印刷磨损作为背景质感。让大面积墨黑平面结构形成强烈正负形关系，并把 a giant diagonal cut 作为主动的构图手段，而不是装饰边框。结构应服务于本次主题，不能像普通套版。

将 a fragmented Nuo mask 处理成残缺古图或文物档案切片，只展示最具辨识度的局部。保留裂纹、褪色颜料、锈蚀、木纹、拓印和年代磨损，使画面像重新发现的古代视觉档案，而不是普通国风插画。中文主标题“夜行古录”使用巨大粗粝的书法、碑刻或拓印感字体；英文标题“ORIENTAL DARK ARCHIVES”使用超大高对比衬线字体，可以被适度裁切、越过边界或被墨黑结构局部遮挡。将“Experimental Museum of Fragmented Ancient Images”、“Fragments remember what time erases.”和“2026 / HALL 03 / EAST ARCHIVE”集中在安静区域并保持层级清晰，加入一枚极小的朱砂红印章。

整体保持低饱和，以墨黑、旧纸米黄、赭石、暗金和灰绿为主。只准确且清晰地渲染所要求的展览文字，不生成随机字符、密集小字、虚构 Logo、水印、图片编号或额外品牌信息。保持神秘、古老、克制的实验博物馆与文化档案氛围。避免普通国风模板、完整人物立绘、素材堆砌、玄幻游戏感、旅游宣传感、高饱和色彩、发光特效和乱码。

items.title: 暖橙巨字公积金极简印刷风海报
items.description: 以公积金为主题制作暖橙巨字极简印刷风海报，通过抽象灰阶主体与文字的遮挡、穿插和牵引关系建立具身化版式。
items.prompt:
Let the theme “Housing Fund” first generate an extremely short core word and a restrained supporting prompt. The first sight of the image must be a huge solid wall formed by warm-orange ultra-bold glyphs. An abstract grayscale photographic silhouette-like subject enters from the foreground and has real occlusion, interleaving, lifting or pulling relationships with the glyphs, making the characters feel like touchable spatial components rather than flat titles.

Use an old cream-paper background with large areas of quiet white space, retaining only slight printing wear, scratches and low-contrast paper fibers. Prohibit clean gradients and excessive decoration. Build the core word with an extremely heavy bold or sans-serif structure: thick strokes, compressed counters, decisive terminals and tight kerning. Partially cover it with the subject while keeping it orthographically recognizable. Stack the upper supporting prompt in small, widely spaced characters across vertical lines, like type being nailed line by line into the white space, forming a reading path from small rational text to huge emotional text to embodied actions.

Keep the subject black-and-white or low-saturation grayscale, with a slight collage feel and screen-print grain along the edges. Use very few shadows and rely on brightness differences to unify the subject and glyph systems. Let warm orange carry the visual impact, black and gray carry the narrative, and paper white carry the breathing room. Do not use specific figures, original text, brands or symbols from the source image. Do not polish the roughness into a high-end poster finish, and do not add complex scenes. Reconstruct the theme through giant letters, body movement, occlusion levels and old-print tactile quality.
items.prompt_zh:
让主题“公积金”先生成一个极短的核心词和一段克制的提示语。画面第一眼必须是由暖橙色超粗字形形成的巨大实体墙。一个灰阶摄影剪影般的抽象主体从前景切入，与字形发生真实的遮挡、穿插、托举或牵引关系，使文字像可触摸的空间构件，而不是平面标题。

背景使用旧奶油色纸张，留出大片安静空白，只保留轻微印刷磨损、擦痕和低对比纸纤维；禁止干净渐变和过度装饰。核心词采用极重黑体或无衬线构造，笔画厚、字腔压紧、端部果断、字距紧密，局部被主体遮住但仍保持正字法可识别。上方提示语用小号、大间距字符分行垂直堆叠，像铅字逐行钉在空白中，形成从细小理性文字到巨大情绪文字再到具身动作的阅读路径。

主体保持黑白或低饱和灰阶，边缘带轻微剪贴感和网印颗粒，阴影极少，依靠明度差与字形实现跨系统统一。色彩只让暖橙承担冲击，黑灰承载叙事，纸白承载呼吸。不要使用源图中的具体人物、原文、品牌或符号，不要把粗糙感修饰成高级海报质感，不要增加复杂场景。主题语义必须通过巨字、身体动作、遮挡层级和旧印刷触感共同重建。

items.title: 复古丝网印刷风格城市旅游海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。
items.prompt:
Create a premium 4:5 vertical vintage travel poster for Kyoto, Japan, inspired by classic screen-printing, linocut illustration, retro editorial graphics, and handmade European travel posters.

Build a completely original composition that captures the personality of Kyoto rather than simply arranging famous landmarks.

Use a warm aged cream paper background with visible paper fibers, subtle stains, distressed ink, rough printing edges, and authentic handmade texture.

VISUAL CONCEPT

Create one strong central visual story representing Kyoto.

Integrate 2–4 recognizable landmarks or architectural elements naturally into the environment, along with everyday details that make the city feel alive:

local transportation
characteristic streets and buildings
cafés and shops
street signs
local food or objects
pedestrians and cyclists
trees and surrounding landscape
culturally distinctive details

Avoid making the landmarks look like floating stickers or a checklist. Everything should feel like it belongs to one continuous scene.

COLOR PALETTE

Use a sophisticated limited palette:

warm ivory + charcoal/black + one signature accent color associated with Kyoto.

Keep the accent color selective and powerful rather than covering the entire artwork.

TYPOGRAPHY

Integrate large, bold, hand-printed typography into the composition:

Kyoto

Add a small secondary phrase that reflects the city’s character:

Quiet paths, enduring stories

Typography should feel imperfect, screen-printed, slightly distressed, and organically integrated into the artwork.

ART STYLE

vintage linocut
handmade screen print
retro travel-poster illustration
rough ink texture
distressed halftone grain
imperfect registration
hand-cut edges
strong silhouettes
expressive perspective
subtle paper imperfections
sophisticated negative space
editorial art-book aesthetic

Make the artwork feel like a rare collectible travel print, combining nostalgia with contemporary graphic design.

IMPORTANT

Do not simply reproduce a traditional tourist poster.

Do not use a generic landmark collage, photorealism, glossy 3D rendering, excessive colors, gradients, or overly clean digital graphics.

The final composition should be bold, artistic, slightly unexpected, highly recognizable, culturally authentic, and visually sophisticated, with Kyoto’s unique identity immediately apparent.
items.prompt_zh:
为京都, 日本创作一张优质的 4:5 垂直比例复古旅行海报，灵感源自经典丝网印刷、麻胶版画插图、复古社论图形和手工制作的欧洲旅行海报。

构建一个完全原创的构图，捕捉京都的个性，而不是简单地排列著名地标。

使用带有可见纸张纤维、细微污渍、磨损墨迹、粗糙印刷边缘和真实手工质感的温暖老化奶油色纸张背景。

视觉概念

创作一个代表京都的强有力的核心视觉故事。

将 2–4 个可识别的地标或建筑元素自然地融入环境中，以及让城市充满活力的日常细节：

当地交通
特色街道和建筑
咖啡馆和商店
街道标志
当地食物或物品
行人和骑自行车的人
树木和周围景观
具有文化特色的细节

避免让地标看起来像漂浮的贴纸或清单。一切都应该感觉属于一个连续的场景。

调色板

使用精致的限量调色板：

暖象牙色 + 炭黑色/黑色 + 一种与京都相关的标志性点缀色。

保持点缀色的选择性和力量感，而不是覆盖整个作品。

排版

将大号、加粗、手工印刷的排版融入构图中：

京都

添加一个反映城市特色的简短次要短语：

静谧小径，故事长存

排版应具有不完美感、丝网印刷感、轻微磨损感，并有机地融入艺术作品中。

艺术风格

复古麻胶版画
手工丝网印刷
复古旅行海报插图
粗糙墨迹纹理
做旧半色调颗粒
套印不准
手工切割边缘
强烈的剪影
富有表现力的透视
细微的纸张缺陷
精致的负空间
社论艺术书美学

让艺术作品感觉像一件稀有的收藏级旅行印刷品，将怀旧感与当代图形设计相结合。

重要事项

不要简单地复制传统的旅游海报。

不要使用通用的地标拼贴、写实摄影、光泽的 3D 渲染、过多的颜色、渐变或过于干净的数字图形。

最终的构图应该是大胆的、艺术性的、略带出人意料的、高度可识别的、具有文化真实性的且视觉上精致的，京都的独特身份应一目了然。

items.title: 博物馆视觉聚核展览海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已整理为可参数化的博物馆展览海报模板。通过核心对象、聚核结构、主辅色、标题和机构信息控制视觉层级，默认示例为青铜莲花灯展览。
items.prompt:
Create a high-end museum exhibition poster in a 9:16 vertical format for Bronze Lotus Lamp Exhibition / 青铜莲花灯展览. The Chinese title is “莲灯映古 / 古代青铜莲花灯展”; the English title is “Lotus Light: Bronze Craft and Memory”; the date and institution line is “2026 · City Museum / 2026 · 城市博物馆”. The absolute visual core is a single bronze lotus lamp / 一件青铜莲花灯.

Use the selected convergence method, Array Surrounding Core, to make every surrounding force guide the eye toward the same core: circular arcs and information may embrace it; large top and bottom color planes may press toward it; left and right typography or color blocks may compress toward it; or one clearly largest object may be surrounded by smaller related elements. Do not create a second visual center or distribute every element evenly.

Give the poster a mature Museum Editorial / Exhibition Poster temperament. Let the core object carry the main visual weight, with supporting museum objects, material fragments, restrained diagrams and white space only surrounding, pointing to, supporting or balancing it. Use deep teal as the dominant field and aged gold, ivory and restrained vermilion as controlled accents. Limit the palette to 2-4 colors and preserve generous negative space.

Typography is part of the composition: make the Chinese title visually prominent, place the English title and the date/institution line in one or two concentrated areas, and keep all supplied text legible and correctly spelled. Use realistic museum-collection or high-quality object-photography texture for a single bronze lotus lamp / 一件青铜莲花灯 and related objects, with credible materials, natural shadows and refined lighting.

The reading order is visual core first, converging structure second, then title and auxiliary information. Avoid a simple centered subject, multiple visual centers, sticker-like scattering, excessive decoration, information overload, e-commerce layout, souvenir-shop styling, unrelated text, logos and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张用于 Bronze Lotus Lamp Exhibition / 青铜莲花灯展览 的高端博物馆展览海报，采用 9:16 竖版构图。中文标题为“莲灯映古 / 古代青铜莲花灯展”，英文标题为“Lotus Light: Bronze Craft and Memory”，日期与机构信息为“2026 · City Museum / 2026 · 城市博物馆”。绝对视觉核心是 a single bronze lotus lamp / 一件青铜莲花灯。

使用所选聚核方式“Array Surrounding Core”，让所有周围视觉力量都把视线引向同一个核心：可以用圆形弧线与信息同心环抱，用上下大色面向中部夹逼，用左右文字或色块向中间压缩，或设置一个明显最大的主器物并用较小相关元素阵列围合。不要建立第二视觉中心，也不要平均分布所有元素。

整体具有成熟的 Museum Editorial / Exhibition Poster 气质。让核心器物承担主要视觉重量，辅助器物、材质碎片、克制图表与留白只能围绕、指向、托住或平衡核心。以 deep teal 作为主色场，以 aged gold, ivory and restrained vermilion 作为受控点缀。颜色控制在 2-4 种，并保留充足负空间。

文字参与构图：中文标题承担主要视觉重量，英文标题与日期/机构信息集中在一到两个区域，所有输入文字保持清晰且拼写正确。a single bronze lotus lamp / 一件青铜莲花灯 与相关器物使用真实博物馆藏品或高质量对象摄影质感，材质、自然阴影与精致光线可信。

最终阅读顺序是先看到视觉核心，再感受到聚核结构，最后阅读标题与辅助信息。避免主体只是简单居中、多个视觉中心、贴纸式散落、装饰过量、信息拥挤、电商详情页感、旅游纪念品感、无关文字、logo 与水印。

items.title: 安静有仪式感的窄幅分栏视觉构图
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已整理为适用于主题对象的安静仪式感分栏图文视觉模板。
items.prompt: Generate a quiet and ceremonial graphic visual around any subject object: the image is formed by a large area of subject background and a centered narrow main visual strip, creating a strong columned order; the main visual strip carries the main forms, linear textures, or image narratives derived from the subject, running through the reading path like a precisely framed dense picture; the background on both sides remains wide, soft, and breathable, with a small number of subject-related objects or symbols placed as lightweight anchors, allowing the vision to first read the dense details in the center, then the large-font titles and grouped information. The subject object should not be displayed in isolation, but instead dismantled into four roles: main form, attached details, information layer, and small objects, forming an exhibition rhythm that is dense in the center, sparse on both sides, and has pauses in the text. If text appears, use tall, thin, elegant title characters with letter spacing, forming silent weight in few words per column; explanatory text uses small, neat, restrained blocks, maintaining precise margins with images, like exhibition labels and date information embedded in the color field. Colors are extracted from the subject's own materials, seasons, cultural semantics, and emotions, maintaining the role relationship of a large area of clear and bright base color, a lighter main visual supporting color, clear light and dark gradations, a small amount of high-saturation accent colors, and light-colored informational text; the overall look is bright and clean, gentle and quiet, with clear boundaries and soft print grain, texture only increases the tactile feel of paper and materials, without making the image dirty, dark, smoky, or old.
items.prompt_zh: 围绕任意主题对象生成一张安静而有仪式感的图文视觉：画面由大面积主题底场与一条居中的窄幅主视觉带形成强烈分栏秩序，主视觉带承载主题派生的主要形体、线性纹理或图像叙事，像被精确装裱的细密画面一样贯穿阅读路径；两侧底场保持宽阔、柔和、可呼吸，放置少量主题相关器物或符号作为轻量锚点，使视觉先读到中央的密集细节，再读到大字标题和分组信息。主题对象不要被孤立陈列，而要拆解成主形体、附着细节、信息层和小型物件四种角色，形成中心密、两侧疏、文字有停顿的展陈节奏。文字若出现，使用高瘦、清雅、留有字距的标题字，少字成列形成静默重量；说明文字用小号、整齐、克制的组块，与图像保持精确边距，像展签和日期信息嵌在色场里。色彩从主题自身的材质、季节、文化语义与情绪中提取，保留大面积清透明亮底色、较浅的主视觉承托色、清晰深浅色阶、少量高饱和强调色和浅色信息文字的角色关系；整体明亮干净、温润安静，有清晰边界和柔和印刷颗粒，纹理只增加纸面与材质触感，不让画面变脏、灰暗、烟雾化或陈旧。

items.title: 极简主义城市地标拼贴垂直海报
items.description: 以同一城市的标志性地标制作9:16垂直城市海报，通过虫眼视角、放射状汇聚和巨大城市名称字体建立城市视觉识别。模板包含可替换的城市、地标、强调色和前景细节变量。
items.prompt:
CITY: Tokyo
MAIN LANDMARK: Tokyo Tower
OTHER LANDMARKS: Senso-ji, Shibuya Crossing, Tokyo Station, Skytree and Ueno Park
TYPE COLOR: vermilion red
FOREGROUND DETAIL: cherry blossoms
COUNTRY: Japan

Create a 9:16 vertical city poster using iconic landmarks from Tokyo.

Treat each landmark as an independent architectural collage element rather than a realistic street scene. Place the landmarks around the edges of the frame using an extreme worm's-eye perspective, with their forms rising and converging toward the center of the sky.

Use Tokyo Tower as the central vertical anchor and keep it the most complete and recognizable structure in the composition. Arrange Senso-ji, Shibuya Crossing, Tokyo Station, Skytree and Ueno Park around the upper-left, upper-right, lower-left and lower-right edges. Make them large near the frame edges and gradually narrower toward the center, creating a strong radial, upward-moving composition. Do not follow real geographic positions; reconstruct the visual identity of Tokyo through its landmarks.

Behind the architecture, place the city name “Tokyo” in huge ultra-tall condensed sans-serif typography. Let the letters occupy around 45–60% of the image, partially hidden behind the landmarks while remaining clearly readable. Keep the city-name typography clean, solid and sharp, with no distressed texture, cracks or worn lettering.

Use a limited three-color system: warm off-white paper background, charcoal or grayscale architecture, and vermilion red as the strong accent color for the city name. Render the landmarks with realistic architectural photography, then add subtle vintage editorial print texture, fine grain, halftone and paper texture.

Add a small blurred cherry blossoms connected to Japan or Tokyo along the lower edge. Keep it to around 5–10% of the image to create depth and local atmosphere.

Core visual formula: iconic landmarks + extreme low-angle perspective + radial convergence + giant city typography + limited colors + subtle foreground depth.
items.prompt_zh:
城市：Tokyo
主要地标：Tokyo Tower
其他地标：Senso-ji, Shibuya Crossing, Tokyo Station, Skytree and Ueno Park
字体颜色：vermilion red
前景细节：cherry blossoms
国家：Japan

创作一张 9:16 的垂直城市海报，使用来自 Tokyo 的标志性地标。

将每个地标视为独立的建筑拼贴元素，而不是真实的街道场景。使用极端的虫眼视角将地标放置在框架边缘，它们的形态向天空中心升起并汇聚。

以 Tokyo Tower 作为中心垂直锚点，使其成为构图中最完整且最具辨识度的结构。将 Senso-ji, Shibuya Crossing, Tokyo Station, Skytree and Ueno Park 布置在左上、右上、左下和右下边缘。使它们在靠近框架边缘处变大，并向中心逐渐变窄，创造出强烈的放射状向上移动构图。不要遵循真实的地理位置，目标是通过地标重建 Tokyo 的视觉身份。

在建筑背后，以巨大的超高压缩无衬线字体放置城市名称“Tokyo”。字母应占据图像约45–60%，部分隐藏在地标背后，同时保持清晰可读。字体保持整洁、稳实和锋利，不要有磨损纹理、裂纹或破旧效果。

使用受限的三色系统：暖米白色纸张背景、木炭色或灰色调建筑、以及用于城市名称的 vermilion red 强调色。使用真实的建筑摄影效果渲染地标，然后添加微妙的复古社论印刷纹理、细颗粒、半色调和纸张纹理。

在底边添加与 Japan 或 Tokyo 相关的 cherry blossoms，保持轻微模糊且仅占5–10%，以营造深度和当地氛围。

核心视觉公式：标志性地标 + 极端低角度视角 + 放射状汇聚 + 巨大城市字体 + 有限颜色 + 微妙前景深度。

items.title: 创意美食海报排版设计提示词
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。
items.prompt:
NANA NOODLE BAR: brand name
buckwheat noodles with citrus broth: main product
NANA: main word or short title
weave through type: weave through type / refract type / create negative space / replace a letter
deep vermillion: main typography color
buckwheat noodles / citrus broth / 11:00-21:00 / Riverside Lane 18: ingredients / short copy / hours / address

Create a 9:16 vertical food editorial poster combining highly realistic food photography with bold, expressive typography.

Use a warm cream or ivory paper background with subtle natural texture. Keep the food or drink realistic, appetizing and materially believable, with natural highlights, shadows, texture and proportions. Avoid CGI, plastic surfaces, floating cutouts or overly polished commercial rendering.

The key concept is that the food must physically interact with the typography according to weave through type, rather than simply sitting beside the text.

For “weave through type,” let a few continuous food elements move naturally in front of and behind large letters with clear, believable depth.

For “refract type,” place transparent glass or liquid in front of the headline so only the letters seen through it are naturally shifted, enlarged or distorted by real optical refraction.

For “create negative space,” let the shape or missing portion of the food create a clean empty area where the headline naturally fits.

For “replace a letter,” use the food itself as one recognizable letter inside the headline while keeping the full word immediately readable.

Make NANA one of the strongest visual elements using bold editorial typography. Integrate type and food into the same composition with clear hierarchy, strong negative space and intentional cropping.

Add only a few useful brand details such as NANA NOODLE BAR, ingredients, flavor notes, opening hours or address. Keep all copy short and meaningful.

Use deep vermillion as the main typographic accent alongside cream, natural food colors and dark neutrals. Keep the palette controlled.

Avoid numbered labels, 01/02, Vol., sparkles, generic filler copy, unnecessary decoration, UI-style cards or template-like layouts.

The final poster should feel like a real café, bakery or restaurant campaign: visually striking at thumbnail size, detailed up close, and built around one clear idea where food and typography genuinely affect each other.
items.prompt_zh:
NANA NOODLE BAR：品牌名称
buckwheat noodles with citrus broth：主要产品
NANA：主要单词或短标题
weave through type：穿插排版 / 折射排版 / 创建负空间 / 替换字母
deep vermillion：主要排版颜色
buckwheat noodles / citrus broth / 11:00-21:00 / Riverside Lane 18：成分 / 短文案 / 营业时间 / 地址

创建一个 9:16 的垂直美食社论海报，将高度写实的美食摄影与大胆、富有表现力的排版相结合。

使用带有微妙自然纹理的温暖奶油色或象牙色纸张背景。保持食物或饮料写实、诱人且材质可信，具有自然的亮部、阴影、纹理和比例。避免 CGI、塑料表面、漂浮的剪切图或过于平滑的商业渲染。

核心概念是，食物必须根据 weave through type 与排版产生物理互动，而不仅仅是停留在文字旁边。

对于“穿插排版”，让一些连续的食物元素自然地在大字母前后穿行，具有清晰、可信的深度感。

对于“折射排版”，将透明玻璃或液体置于标题前，使仅通过它看到的字母因真实的光学折射而自然地产生移位、放大或扭曲。

对于“创造负空间”，让食物的形状或缺失部分创造出一个干净的空白区域，使标题自然地嵌入其中。

对于“替换字母”，使用食物本身作为标题中一个可识别的字母，同时保持整个单词立即可读。

使用大胆的社论排版使 NANA 成为最强的视觉元素之一。将文字和食物整合到同一个构图中，具有清晰的层级、强大的负空间和有意的裁剪。

仅添加少量有用的品牌细节，如 NANA NOODLE BAR、成分、风味说明、营业时间或地址。保持所有文案简短且有意义。

使用 deep vermillion 作为主要的排版点缀，并搭配奶油色、自然食物颜色和深色中性色。保持色调受控。

避免数字标签、01/02、Vol.、闪烁、通用的填充文案、不必要的装饰、UI 风格的卡片或模板化的布局。

最终的海报应该感觉像是一个真实的咖啡馆、面包店或餐厅的宣传活动：在缩略图大小下视觉冲击力强，近看细节丰富，并围绕一个食物与排版真正相互影响的清晰创意而构建。

items.title: 极简一笔画国家系列艺术海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference as the primary inspiration. Create a 4:5 vertical minimalist collectible art print representing Japan through one continuous elegant line.

Draw a single uninterrupted hand-drawn line that begins as the recognizable silhouette or coastline of the country, then naturally transforms into 2–4 subtle elements of its identity — such as a famous landmark, mountain, river, traditional object, cultural symbol, or iconic food — all connected within the same flowing line.

The line should feel intentional, poetic, architectural, and slightly imperfect, like a refined museum sketch.

COMPOSITION:
One large continuous-line artwork centered on a warm ivory paper background. Huge negative space. No collage. No separate illustrations. No map filling the entire page.

STYLE:
Contemporary museum poster × Swiss minimalism × fine architectural drawing × Japanese restraint.
Thin charcoal/black ink line, subtle paper grain, delicate imperfections, tiny soft shadow, and one muted accent color used sparingly.

Add very small elegant typography beneath:

Japan
ONE LINE / Tokyo / 35.6762 N, 139.6503 E

Optional tiny caption:
“A country, reduced to one line.”

IMPORTANT: The continuous line must remain the hero. Every symbolic element should emerge naturally from the same line rather than appearing as separate objects.

Avoid: photorealism, busy travel-poster aesthetics, multiple colors, excessive typography, obvious tourist clichés, detailed maps, borders, flags, collage, clutter.

Overall feeling: quiet, intelligent, artistic, luxurious, poetic, instantly recognizable, and suitable as a high-end collectible gallery print.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的参考图作为主要灵感。创建一张 4:5 纵向的极简主义收藏艺术印刷品，通过一根连续优雅的线条代表 日本。

画一根不间断的手绘线条，它以国家辨识度高的轮廓或海岸线开始，然后自然地转化为 2–4 个其身份的微妙元素——例如著名的地标、山脉、河流、传统物品、文化符号或标志性食物——所有这些都连接在同一根流动的线条中。

线条应该让人感到是有意为之的、富有诗意的、具有建筑感的且略有瑕疵，就像一幅精致的博物馆素描。

构图：
一件巨大的连续线条艺术作品居中于暖象牙色纸张背景上。巨大的留白。无拼贴。无独立的插图。没有填满整个页面的地图。

风格：
当代博物馆海报 × 瑞士极简主义 × 精细建筑图 × 日式克制。
纤细的木炭/黑墨水线条，微妙的纸张纹理，精致的瑕疵，微小的柔影，以及极少量使用的单一柔和强调色。

在下方添加非常小的优雅排版：

日本
ONE LINE / 东京 / 35.6762 N, 139.6503 E

可选的微小说明文字：
“一个国家，简化为一根线条。”

重要：连续的线条必须保持为主角。每个象征元素都应该自然地从同一根线条中浮现，而不是作为独立的物体出现。

避免：写实主义、繁杂的旅游海报美学、多种颜色、过多的排版、显眼的旅游俗套、详细的地图、边界、国旗、拼贴、杂乱。

整体感觉：安静、睿智、艺术感、奢华、富有诗意、辨识度高，适合作为高端收藏画廊印刷品。

items.title: 手绘复古欧洲绘本风格旅游场景
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。
items.prompt:
Create a charming hand-drawn illustrated travel scene featuring a recognizable iconic structure representing the chosen city as the unmistakable main focal point, inspired by a beautifully detailed vintage European storybook postcard. Keep the structure highly recognizable with accurate proportions, distinctive architectural details, and an elegant handcrafted appearance. Surround it with a picturesque local environment representing the city — charming traditional buildings, cobblestone streets, cafés, small shops, flowers, trees, street lamps, bicycles, pedestrians, and subtle location-specific details. Add a beautiful foreground element such as a river, canal, garden, plaza, or waterfront with soft reflections.

Use colored-pencil and watercolor illustration, visible hand-drawn strokes, textured paper, slightly imperfect sketch lines, rich yet harmonious colors, delicate shading, and a nostalgic travel-journal feeling. Add tiny playful doodles such as hearts, stars, sparkles, clouds, birds, and little handwritten-style accents naturally around the sky. Create a lively, cozy atmosphere with layered depth and miniature details throughout the scene.

Whimsical handcrafted illustration, vintage travel postcard, storybook aesthetic, highly detailed architecture, colorful European charm, artistic colored-pencil texture, watercolor wash, warm nostalgic mood, no photorealism, no collage, cohesive single scene. 4:5 vertical composition.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一个迷人的手绘插画旅行场景，以 一座代表所选城市且清晰可辨的标志性建筑 作为不容错过的核心焦点，灵感源自精美细致的复古欧洲故事书明信片。保持建筑的高度可识别性，具有准确的比例、独特的建筑细节和优雅的手工艺外观。周围环绕着代表该城市的风景优美的当地环境——迷人的传统建筑、鹅卵石街道、咖啡馆、小商店、花卉、树木、路灯、自行车、行人以及细微的特定地点细节。添加一个美丽的建筑前景元素，如河流、运河、花园、广场或带有柔和倒影的水滨。

使用彩色铅笔和水彩插图，可见的手绘笔触，纹理纸张，略显不完美的素描线条，丰富而和谐的色彩，细腻的阴影，以及一种怀旧的旅行日志感。在天空周围自然地添加一些俏皮的小涂鸦，如心形、星星、闪光、云朵、鸟儿和手写风格的小点缀。在整个场景中通过分层深度和缩影细节营造出活泼、舒适的氛围。

异想天开的手工插图，复古旅行明信片，故事书美学，高度详细的建筑，多彩的欧洲魅力，艺术彩色铅笔纹理，水彩晕染，温暖的怀旧情绪，非写实主义，非拼贴，连贯的单一场景。4:5 垂直构图。

items.title: 摄影照片转建筑草图设计海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。
items.prompt:
Please make each photo I upload into a separate high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output individually. The overall composition adopts a 3:4 vertical format, with the top and bottom two areas strictly at a 1:1 height ratio, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper part retains the original photo, maintaining the subject identity, structure, posture, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the quality of an art magazine or exhibition image. To adapt to the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower part only extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, structure, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructing it as an architectural concept perspective sketch / architectural design performance hand-drawing. Do not fully retain the scene, do not copy the photo object by object; actively delete most of the background, scenery, and irrelevant details, leaving only the core form, spatial relationship, and visual memory points that best represent the original theme.

Re-make artistic judgments for the lower part. Even if the original composition is poor, the background is messy, or the subject is small, it must be saved into a viable work through deletion, reorganization, cropping, scale changes, and white space, truly giving the model the power to re-direct the image.

The painting style adopts freehand perspective line drawings + a small amount of selective color blocks. The lines are relaxed, restrained, with a slight sense of repetition and pause, and a small amount of auxiliary lines, extension lines, construction lines, and geometric reference lines for architectural hand-drawing can be retained, forming a clear sense of design deliberation. Colors are only slightly laid out in a few key parts to emphasize the subject, structural layers, local shadows, or spatial focuses, and other areas are kept unpainted as much as possible.

The image must be centered on a large amount of conscious white space. The subject should be smaller and more refined, with other spaces left large and empty. White space is not an empty background but part of the composition, forming a sense of breath, space, and rhythm together with the subject, line drawings, reference lines, shadows, and small amounts of color blocks. The subject can be eccentric, edge-aligned, partially cropped, or reduced in scale; it is better to draw less than to fill it up.

A small amount of geometric shadow color blocks can be added to strengthen volume, depth, and spatial layers, but avoid heavy rendering, complex environments, and realistic rendering effects. Keep the background minimalist, retaining only a minimal amount of necessary site hints.

Extract 2–4 most recognizable and vibrant colors from the photo above, and reorganize them into a cleaner, more restrained, and durable sketch color palette. The overall tone can be moderately brightened, purified, and de-greyed, dominated by off-white, light gray, warm gray, soft green, light wood color, light blue-gray, etc., with a small amount of more distinct but not glaring accent colors retained locally. Avoid dirty gray, dullness, excessive vintage, and cheap high-saturation feelings.

Text is used only as a minimal amount of editorial intervention, with no restrictions on language. A small amount of words, short phrases, or notes can be generated based on the subject, location, action, or emotion, quietly falling on the white space areas, forming a restrained graphic-text relationship with the image.

Overall, it presents a high-end visual effect composed of architectural concept hand-drawings, freehand line drawings, geometric reference lines, a small amount of color blocks, geometric shadows, an ultra-large amount of white space, and editorial layout. Avoid full scene retention, object-by-object copying, complex backgrounds, full-page coloring, realistic renderings, thick strokes, cartoonishness, 3D feeling, and templated expression.
items.prompt_zh:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用 3:4 竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格 1:1，各占画面 50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分只提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、结构、姿态与叙事关系，重构为建筑概念透视草图 / 建筑方案表现手绘。不要完整保留场景，不要逐物复制照片；主动删去大部分背景、配景和无关细节，只留下最能代表原始主题的核心形体、空间关系与视觉记忆点。

下半部分重新做美术判断。哪怕原图构图差、背景乱、主体小，也要通过删减、重组、裁切、尺度变化和留白，把它救成一张成立的作品，真正赋予模型重新导演画面的权力。

画风采用自由徒手透视线稿 + 少量选择性色块。线条松弛、克制、略带重复与停顿感，可保留少量辅助线、延长线、构造线与建筑手绘的几何参考线，形成明确的设计推敲感。色彩只在少数关键部位轻微铺陈，用于强调主体、结构层次、局部阴影或空间重点，其余区域尽量不画。

画面必须以大量有意识的留白为核心。主体应更小、更精炼，其余空间大面积留空。留白不是空背景，而是构图的一部分，要与主体、线稿、参考线、阴影和少量色块共同形成呼吸感、空间感与节奏感。主体可偏心、贴边、局部裁切或缩小尺度；宁可少画，也不要填满。

可加入少量几何阴影色块强化体量、进深与空间层次，但避免厚重渲染、复杂环境和写实效果图感。背景保持极简，只保留极少量必要的场地暗示。

配色从上方照片中提取 2–4 种最具识别度和生命力的颜色，重新整理为更干净、克制、耐看的草图色系。整体可适度提亮、提纯、去灰，以米白、浅灰、暖灰、柔和绿色、淡木色、浅蓝灰等为主，局部保留少量更鲜明但不刺眼的点睛色。避免脏灰、暗沉、过度复古和廉价高饱和感。

文字只作极少量编辑性介入，不限制语种。可根据主体、地点、动作或情绪生成少量字词、短句或注记，安静地落在留白区域，与画面形成克制的图文关系。

整体呈现建筑概念手绘、自由线稿、几何参考线、少量色块、几何阴影、超大量留白与编辑式排版共同构成的高级视觉效果。避免完整场景保留、逐物复制、复杂背景、满幅上色、写实效果图、粗重描边、卡通感、3D感和模板化表现。

items.title: 中轴夹景高级文化展览海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的参数化文化展览海报模板。通过主题、双侧主体、中轴内容、夹景方式、色彩、材质、展讯和画幅变量生成具有强中轴结构的高级编辑海报；不需要人物参考图。
items.prompt:
Create a high-impact cultural exhibition poster for {theme} in {image_ratio} format, using a central-axis clamped composition. Resolve these variables before generation: Chinese Main Title={chinese_main_title}; English Title={english_title}; Left Main Subject={left_main_subject}; Right Main Subject={right_main_subject}; Central Axis Content={central_axis_content}; Clamping Method={clamping_method}; Background Main Color={background_main_color}; Subject Material and Style={subject_material_and_style}; Date/Venue={date_venue}.

Establish a clear stable vertical central axis. Let the left and right main subjects create visual weight from the edges and push the title, small character, plant, structural line or negative space toward the center. Both subjects must be large enough for natural cropping and must carry the main weight. They may differ in silhouette, scale, color, material and detail, but their total weight must balance without simple duplication or mechanical mirroring.

Use {clamping_method} according to the theme: curved forms may clamp a central negative shape; architectural or screen forms may create depth through perspective; fabric or plants may bend naturally around the center; objects or cultural artifacts may weight the central title from both sides. Make the central axis the most important reading area. Set {chinese_main_title} in a bold large Chinese type treatment, using vertical, mixed horizontal/vertical, scale change, partial occlusion or slight intersection with the subjects. Add {english_title} and restrained exhibition micro-information.

Allow one low-weight visual node such as a tiny figure, flower branch, rubbing pattern, structural line drawing or research diagram, but do not create a third subject at the same visual level. Concentrate information in 2-3 areas: central core, sidebars and bottom exhibition information. Use one dominant large-area color from {background_main_color}, keep the full palette to 3-5 colors and let material, typography and tiny accents create contrast.

Render the subjects using {subject_material_and_style}. The result should have a strong axis, strong subjects, clear color field, readable text, realistic material behavior, rich but controlled information and the finish of a mature cultural-exhibition poster and editorial design. Include {date_venue} as restrained exhibition information. Avoid generic bilateral symmetry, clutter, random text, logos, watermarks and unreadable typography.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张关于 {theme} 的高冲击力文化展览海报，画幅为 {image_ratio}，采用“中轴夹景”构图。生成前解析变量：中文主标题={chinese_main_title}；英文标题={english_title}；左侧主体={left_main_subject}；右侧主体={right_main_subject}；中轴内容={central_axis_content}；夹景方式={clamping_method}；背景主色={background_main_color}；主体材质与风格={subject_material_and_style}；日期/场馆={date_venue}。

先建立清晰稳定的垂直中轴，让左右主体从画面边缘共同形成视觉重量，把标题、小人物、植物、结构线或留白推向中央。左右主体必须足够大，允许自然裁切并承担主要视觉重量。两侧可以在轮廓、大小、颜色、材质和细节上不同，但整体重量必须平衡，避免简单复制和机械镜像。

根据 {clamping_method} 与主题匹配：圆弧主体可以共同夹出中央负形；建筑或屏风可以通过透视形成中轴纵深；织物或植物可以自然弯曲围合中心；器物或文物可以通过左右配重强化中央标题。让中轴成为画面最重要的阅读区域。将 {chinese_main_title} 以大胆大字号中文排版呈现，可使用纵排、横竖混排、尺度变化、局部遮挡或与主体轻微穿插。加入 {english_title} 和克制的展览微型信息。

允许中轴加入一个低权重视觉节点，例如极小人物、花枝、纹样拓片、结构线稿或研究图，但不要形成第三个同等级主体。将信息集中在 2-3 个区域：中轴核心、左右边栏和底部展讯。以 {background_main_color} 作为明确的大面积主色，整体控制在 3-5 个主要颜色，通过材质、字体和极少量点缀色形成对比。

使用 {subject_material_and_style} 呈现主体。最终作品应具有强中轴、强主体、清晰色域、可读文字、真实材质、丰富但不混乱的信息，以及成熟文化展览海报和编辑设计的完成度。将 {date_venue} 作为克制的展览信息加入。避免普通左右对称、杂乱、随机文字、Logo、水印和无法辨认的排版。

items.title: 手工微缩美食场景与陶瓷餐具
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。
items.prompt: Create a charming handcrafted miniature food scene featuring strawberry shortcake as the main focal point. Arrange the food beautifully on a simple ceramic plate with tiny complementary ingredients naturally placed around it. Add a small drink, miniature wooden spoon and fork, a linen napkin, scattered ingredients, tiny flowers or leaves, and a few playful handmade decorative details. Include a small handwritten paper note with a short phrase related to the food, creating a cozy visual story. Use soft natural daylight, a clean warm-white textured background, gentle shadows, delicate pastel and earthy tones, tactile clay and paper textures, tiny handmade imperfections, minimal Scandinavian-inspired composition, whimsical stop-motion aesthetic, cozy editorial food photography, highly detailed, elegant negative space, 4:5 vertical.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一个以 strawberry shortcake 为主要焦点且迷人的手工微缩美食场景。将食物精美地摆放在一个简约的陶瓷盘上，周围自然地放置一些微小的配料。添加一小杯饮料、微型木勺和叉子、一张亚麻餐巾、散落的配料、微小的花朵或叶子，以及一些俏皮的手工装饰细节。包括一张写有与食物相关的简短短语的小手写纸条，营造出一个温馨的视觉故事。使用柔和的自然日光、干净的暖白色纹理背景、柔和的阴影、精致的柔和色彩和大地色调、触手可及的粘土和纸张纹理、微小的手工瑕疵、极简的北欧风格构图、奇幻的定格动画美学、舒适的社论式美食摄影、高度详细、优雅的负空间、4:5 纵横比。

items.title: 极简创意美食编辑海报摄影提示词
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的参数化美食编辑海报模板，恢复品牌、产品、标题、交互方式、强调色和详情变量，保留真实食物、专业排版、物理折射/反射和 9:16 构图。
items.prompt:
Brand: NANA NOODLE BAR
Product: buckwheat noodles with citrus broth
Headline: SLURP
Interaction: ripple-distorted reflection
Accent Color: vermilion red
Details: Riverside Lane 18 · 11:00–21:00

Create a 9:16 vertical food editorial poster combining highly realistic food photography with bold, professionally designed typography. Use a warm cream or ivory background, subtle paper texture, realistic materials, natural light and a clean editorial composition. Keep SLURP completely intact, sharp and normally designed. The food must remain a separate real object and physically change only how the typography is seen according to ripple-distorted reflection.

For “fractured refraction,” place transparent edible material in front of the type and break it into several large facets so each piece refracts the same letters at slightly different angles. For “mirror reflection,” use a glossy food surface to reflect the headline with believable curvature, compression and perspective while the original type remains unchanged behind it. For “deformable refraction,” place a transparent soft food in front of the letters and apply pressure so its changing shape creates stronger local refraction where compressed. For “ripple-distorted reflection,” reflect the headline on a dark liquid surface, then let real concentric ripples distort only the reflected letters while the original typography stays perfectly sharp.

Make SLURP large, simple and readable at thumbnail size. The selected ripple-distorted reflection must be understandable within the first second. Use vermilion red with cream, natural food colors and dark neutrals. Add only a few meaningful details such as NANA NOODLE BAR, buckwheat noodles with citrus broth and Riverside Lane 18 · 11:00–21:00; never add random filler text. Keep props minimal. Avoid food-shaped letters, photographic type fills, CGI materials, digital warp effects, fake reflection overlays, random distortion, numbered labels, 01/02, Vol. or sparkles. The final poster should have one bold headline, one realistic food object and one surprising but physically believable optical interaction. Keep the typography professionally designed and untouched; let the real food change how it is seen.
items.prompt_zh:
品牌：NANA NOODLE BAR
产品：buckwheat noodles with citrus broth
标题：SLURP
交互：ripple-distorted reflection
强调色：vermilion red
详情：Riverside Lane 18 · 11:00–21:00

创建一张 9:16 的垂直美食编辑海报，将高度真实的食物摄影与大胆且专业设计的排版相结合。使用温暖奶油色或象牙色背景、微妙纸张纹理、真实材料、自然光线和干净编辑式构图。保持 SLURP 完整、清晰且正常设计；食物必须是独立的真实物体，并仅根据 ripple-distorted reflection 物理地改变排版的呈现方式。

当交互为“碎裂折射”时，在字体前放置叠层可食用透明材料并破碎成几个大刻面，使每块碎片以略微不同角度折射相同字母。当交互为“镜面反射”时，使用光滑食物表面反射标题，保持可信曲率、压缩和透视，同时后方原始字体不变。当交互为“变形折射”时，在字母前放置叠层柔软食物并施加压力，使受压处产生更强局部折射。当交互为“波纹扭曲反射”时，在深色液体表面反射标题，让真实同心波纹仅扭曲反射字母，而原始排版保持清晰。

使 SLURP 大而简单，在缩略图大小时清晰易读；ripple-distorted reflection 应在第一秒内被理解。将 vermilion red 与奶油色、自然食物颜色和深色中性色结合。仅添加少量有意义的细节，例如 NANA NOODLE BAR、buckwheat noodles with citrus broth、Riverside Lane 18 · 11:00–21:00；不要添加随机填充文本。保持道具极简，避免食物形状字母、摄影式文字填充、CGI 材料、数字扭曲、伪造反射叠加、随机失真、数字标签、01/02、Vol. 或闪光。最终海报应有一个大胆标题、一个真实食物物体和一种惊讶但物理可信的光学交互。保持排版专业且不被改写，让真实食物改变它的呈现方式。

items.title: 城市繁忙交叉口水彩速写提示词
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的参数化城市水彩海报模板，恢复城市、建筑、车辆和暖色材质变量及默认值，保留纯白冷压纸、3:4 构图、手写地名标题、分层密度和留白约束。
items.prompt:
Create a loose urban-sketch watercolour of a busy street crossing in Kyoto, vertical 3:4, on pure bright-white cold-press paper with visible texture. No cream, beige, sepia or vintage tint.

TITLE: Paint only “Kyoto” across the empty upper sky in large expressive hand-lettering. Use translucent warm-grey watercolour with varied brush weight, darker pooling, dry-brush gaps, an irregular baseline and slight tonal fade. It must look hand-painted with the same brush as the artwork, never printed or pasted. Add a subtle pale blue/apricot wash behind it, fading before the edges.

SCENE: Low-angle pavement view of a wide multi-lane crossing. Make Kiyomizu-dera Temple the dominant middle-distance landmark, with distinct a timber machiya townhouse, a modern glass station entrance and smaller a low tiled-roof shop buildings. Include a green city bus, a few sedans and one small a small vermilion delivery van vehicle. Keep buildings clearly different in height, material and colour.

LINEWORK: Rough black fineliner drawn first with loose, wobbly, broken freehand strokes, imperfect perspective, occasional overshoots and minimal single-direction hatching. No perfectly ruled lines.

DEPTH: Strong density gradient: foreground about 60% resolved and colourful, mid-ground about 30% with softened edges, distance about 10% mostly pale outlines and washes. Leave some distant buildings unpainted. The outer 20% of every edge and all four corners must remain untouched white paper. Never create an even wash or vignette.

ARCHITECTURE: Avoid complete window grids. Kiyomizu-dera Temple gets only a few broken mullion lines with large areas of wash-only glass. Its glass reflects broad sky-blue and white-paper sweeps, warm terracotta sunlight and only two soft warped building reflections.

PEOPLE AND GROUND: Scatter 10–12 figures across near, middle and far distances, varying size, spacing, overlap, poses and activities. Use tiny loose ink marks for distant figures, minimal facial detail and soft grey contact shadows; let some outlines dissolve into washes. Keep darker visual weight in the bottom fifth with a near kerb, sparse pavement joints, grit and a cast shadow toward the viewer. Paint only portions of the crosswalk, leaving large areas of white paper.

COLOUR AND LIGHT: Use loose off-register watercolour over ink with wet-in-wet blooms, backruns, hard edges and dry-brush skips. Use warm terracotta for sunlit architecture and pavement, muted sage for trees, and cerulean for sky and glass. Include at least four distinct hues with no dominant hue. a small vermilion delivery van is a tiny accent under 3% of the image. White paper is the brightest value; keep only 4–5 small deepest-value accents. The sky is mostly white with sparse broken blue strokes. Trees appear in separated clusters with wide white gaps, including one large cropped foreground tree.

SIGNAGE: All signs are abstract and illegible. No readable text besides Kyoto.

AVOID: photorealism, digital/vector style, glossy 3D, uniform detail, full background washes, solid-black lettering, complete window grids, straight ruled geometry, continuous tree rows, detailed distant buildings, fully painted crosswalk, cream/sepia paper, borders, frames, signatures, logos or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
在纯亮白、有可见纹理的冷压纸上，创作一张 Kyoto 繁忙十字路口的松散城市速写水彩画，纵横比 3:4。不要奶油色、米色、乌贼墨色或复古色调。

标题：仅在空旷的上部天空用大型且富有表现力的手写字体画出“Kyoto”。使用半透明的暖灰色水彩，笔触粗细多变，有较深的积水、干笔留白、不规则基准线和轻微色调退色。它必须看起来是用与作品相同的画笔手绘的，绝不是印刷或粘贴的。在其背后添加淡蓝色与杏色晕染，并在边缘前淡出。

场景：宽阔多车道交叉口的人行道低角度视图。让 Kiyomizu-dera Temple 成为中景主导地标，伴有明显的 a timber machiya townhouse、a modern glass station entrance 和较小的 a low tiled-roof shop 建筑。包含 a green city bus, 几辆轿车和一辆小型 a small vermilion delivery van 车辆。保持建筑在高度、材质和颜色上明显不同。

线条：先用粗糙的黑色针管笔勾勒，使用松散、摇晃、断裂的徒手笔触、不完美透视、偶尔留白和极少单向排线。不要完美的尺规线条。

深度：形成强烈密度梯度。前景约 60% 清晰且有色彩，中景约 30% 且边缘软化，远景约 10% 主要是浅色轮廓和晕染。让一些远处建筑不着色。每个边缘外部 20% 和四个角必须保持空白白纸，切勿创建均匀晕染或暗角。

建筑：避免完整窗格网格。Kiyomizu-dera Temple 只得到几条断裂窗棂线，大面积仅为晕染玻璃。玻璃反射宽阔天蓝色和白纸扫尾、warm terracotta 阳光，以及仅有两个柔软扭曲的建筑物反射。

人物与地面：10–12 个形象分散在近、中、远距离，改变大小、间距、重叠、姿势和活动。远处人物使用微小松散墨迹、极简面部细节和软灰接触阴影，让一些轮廓溶解在晕染中。底部五分之一保持较重视觉重量，加入近处路缘、稀疏铺路接缝、砂砾和朝向观察者的投射阴影；仅绘制部分斑马线，留出大面积白纸。

色彩与光影：墨线上方是松散错位的水彩，带湿接湿晕染、回流、硬边缘和干笔跳跃。对受光建筑与路面使用 warm terracotta，树木使用柔和鼠尾草绿，天空与玻璃使用天蓝色。至少四种截然不同的色调，没有主导色调；a small vermilion delivery van 仅作为低于 3% 的微小点缀。白纸是最亮明度，仅保留 4–5 个小的最深明度重点。天空主要为白色并带稀疏断裂蓝色笔触，树木以分开的集群出现，包含一棵大型裁剪前景树。

标识：所有指示牌都抽象且不可辨认。除了 Kyoto 外没有可读文字。

避免：写实主义、数字或矢量风格、光泽 3D、均匀细节、完整背景晕染、实色黑色字体、完整窗格网格、直线尺规几何、连续树排、详细远景建筑、完全绘制斑马线、奶油或乌贼墨色纸张、边框、框架、签名、徽标或水印。

items.title: 极简墨线风景小笺对比海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。
items.prompt:
Please create each of my uploaded travel photos into an independent 'Minimalist Ink Line Landscape Note' comparison poster, without stitching multiple images, outputting each photo separately.

Adopt a 3:4 vertical composition overall, clearly maintaining the visual contrast of 'original photo above, stylized re-drawing below'.
