Create a premium minimalist dessert campaign poster for a fictional haute patisserie brand called VELORÉ, combining Transit-style restraint with Orbit-style poetic motion in a further purified composition. The image must feel ultra-clean, gallery-like, elegant, and commercially luxurious, with the dessert as the absolute and solitary visual hero. No copied text, no watermark, no clutter, no unnecessary props.

Main composition:
A single round raspberry mousse cheesecake sits perfectly centered on a matte white ceramic plate in the lower-middle of the frame. The cake is the only substantial object in the composition. Preserve a strict three-layer structure: a dark cocoa crumb base, a thick ivory mousse body with fine natural aeration, and a flawless glossy raspberry-red mirror glaze on top. The garnish is reduced to the minimum iconic expression: two fresh raspberries, one blackberry, one small whipped cream accent, and one extremely delicate blossom sprig rising upward in a graceful curved arc. The blossom line should create a subtle orbital motion that guides the eye upward and back toward the cake, while remaining almost weightless.

Transit restraint:
Use a large field of warm off-white negative space. Typography must be reduced to a highly disciplined editorial minimum: one small brand line, one product name, one short descriptor. Remove all extra annotation blocks and nonessential copy. The image should read instantly as a flagship luxury dessert poster.

Orbit motion:
The only motion cue comes from the elegant upward arc of the blossom sprig and the gentle clustered rhythm of the berries on top, creating a refined sense of lift and circulation above the cake. The motion must feel quiet, premium, and intentional, never decorative or busy.

Typography and layout:
Place a very small refined brand line at the upper center: “VELORÉ PATISSERIE”. Beneath it, set the product name in elegant editorial type: “Raspberry Cloud”. Add one restrained subline: “Silken mousse with vivid fruit glaze.” All typography should be dark charcoal, airy, centered, and clearly secondary to the cake.

Lighting:
Soft diffused studio light from the upper left-front, with subtle fill from the right and a very gentle shadow beneath the plate. Keep the light bright, soft, and sculptural, with a controlled highlight across the red glaze and delicate volume on the mousse body. No hard shadows, no muddy contrast, no overexposed whites.

Material rendering:
The raspberry mirror glaze must look ultra-smooth, glassy, and slightly viscous. The mousse layer should feel chilled, creamy, and naturally aerated with microscopic pores. The cocoa base should be compact, crisp, and finely granular. The berries must show realistic drupelet texture, subtle bloom, natural moisture, and fresh color depth. The whipped cream accent should feel dense, soft, and freshly piped. The blossom sprig must be fine, botanical, and fragile with tiny pink florets.

Color system:
Warm off-white, ivory cream, deep raspberry red, dark cocoa brown, blackberry black-purple, and a tiny accent of soft botanical pink. Keep the palette highly restrained, with the red glaze and berries as the only strong chromatic focus.

Style:
Luxury editorial dessert photography, ultra-minimal patisserie branding, flagship commercial food poster, Cannes-level premium restraint, clean, tactile, refined, and memorable.

Image quality and physical constraints:
Ultra-detailed, high resolution, crisp edges, correct circular geometry, clean plate silhouette, realistic glaze reflections, believable garnish balance, immaculate background, no extra crumbs, no random props, no distortion, no cheap bakery styling.

Negative prompt:
cheap bakery flyer, copied original text, cluttered layout, too many berries, excessive garnish, random props, cartoon dessert, fake CGI food, plastic glaze, waxy cream, distorted cake shape, dirty plate, harsh shadows, flat lighting, muddy whites, oversaturated red, noisy background, unreadable typography, watermark
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

为虚构的高级甜品店品牌 VELORÉ 创建一张高级极简主义甜品竞选海报，在更加纯净的构图中结合 Transit 风格的克制与 Orbit 风格的诗意运动。图像必须感觉超净、画廊般、优雅且具有商业奢华感，甜品是绝对且唯一的视觉主角。无复制文本，无水印，无杂乱，无不必要的道具。

主要构图：
一个圆形的覆盆子慕斯芝士蛋糕完美地置于画框中下部的一个哑光白色陶瓷盘中央。蛋糕是构图中唯一的实质性物体。保持严格的三层结构：深色可可碎基底、带有细微自然气孔的厚象牙色慕斯主体，以及顶部完美的亮面覆盆子红镜面淋面。装饰被简化为最小的标志性表达：两个新鲜覆盆子、一个黑莓、一个小的鲜奶油点缀，以及一根极细致的花枝以优雅的弧形向上升起。花枝线条应创造一种微妙的轨道运动，引导视线向上并回到蛋糕，同时保持近乎无重力感。

Transit 克制：
使用大面积的暖白色负空间。排版必须减少到高度自律的社论式最小值：一行小品牌文字、一个产品名称、一个简短描述。移除所有额外的注释块和非必要的文案。图像应能瞬间被识别为旗舰级奢华甜品海报。

Orbit 运动：
唯一的运动提示来自于花枝优雅的向上弧线和顶部浆果柔和的簇状节奏，在蛋糕上方创造出一种精致的提升和循环感。运动必须感觉安静、高级且有目的性，绝非装饰性或忙乱。

排版与布局：
在上方中央放置一行极小的精致品牌文字：“VELORÉ PATISSERIE”。在其下方，以优雅的社论字体设置产品名称：“Raspberry Cloud”。添加一行克制的副标题：“Silken mousse with vivid fruit glaze.” 所有排版应为深炭灰色、通透、居中，且明显次于蛋糕。

灯光：
左前上方发出的柔和扩散摄影灯光，右侧有微妙的补光，盘子下方有非常柔和的阴影。保持光线明亮、柔和且具有雕塑感，红色淋面上带受控的高光，慕斯主体上有细腻的体积感。无硬影，无浑浊对比，无过曝的白色。

材质渲染：
覆盆子镜面淋面必须看起来超平滑、如玻璃般且略显粘稠。慕斯层应感觉冰凉、奶油般，并带有微孔自然透气。可可基底应紧凑、松脆且呈细颗粒状。浆果必须展示真实的核果纹理、微妙的白霜、自然的水分和新鲜的色彩深度。鲜奶油点缀应感觉浓郁、柔软且新鲜裱花。花枝必须精细、具有植物学美感且脆弱，带有微小的粉色小花。

色彩系统：
暖白色、象牙奶油色、深覆盆子红、深可可棕、黑莓黑紫色，以及一点点柔和的植物粉色作为点缀。保持色调高度克制，以红色淋面和浆果作为唯一的强色彩焦点。

风格：
奢华社论甜品摄影，极简主义甜品品牌设计，旗舰级商业食物海报，戛纳级别的奢华克制，洁净、触感、精致且令人难忘。

图像质量与物理约束：
超细节，高分辨率，边缘清晰，正确的圆形几何形状，洁净的盘子轮廓，真实的淋面反射，可信的装饰平衡，一尘不染的背景，无多余碎屑，无随机道具，无畸变，无廉价的面包店造型。

负向提示词：
廉价面包店传单，复制的原始文本，杂乱的布局，过多的浆果，过度的装饰，随机道具，卡通甜品，虚假 CGI 食物，塑料质感淋面，蜡质奶油，扭曲的蛋糕形状，脏盘子，硬影，平淡光线，浑浊的白色，过饱和的红色，嘈杂背景，不可读的排版，水印

items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创建一张超高端美食广告海报，保留在一个温馨休闲餐饮环境中拍摄的手持插画品鉴卡的核心视觉逻辑，同时将其提炼为更具凝聚力的、以一个精心策划的产品系列为中心的 Transit 版本商业视觉。设计一个名为 KITSUNE TABLE 的原创日式灵感街头美食品牌。展示一只真实的人手在前景中握着一张垂直的米白色品鉴卡，略微倾斜，居中构图，在柔焦的餐厅桌面场景上方拍摄。卡片必须是绝对的视觉主角。它应包含一组精心挑选的 10 款招牌拉面和配菜，以迷人的手绘高端美食插画形式呈现，具有优雅的编辑间距、时尚的英文优先标签、小额价格和微小的手写注释标记。不要复制源图像中的文字。所有文字必须是新发明的、美观的、稀疏的且符合品牌调性。

核心构图：
采用严格的垂直构图，品鉴卡占据画面大部分，由一只手从左下角自然握住。卡片漂浮在柔焦的桌面上方，背景有细微的筷子、餐巾褶皱、陶瓷反光和温馨的餐厅氛围，但背景保持次要。卡片应从左下向右上稍微倾斜，营造出一种随意的抓拍感。保持设计密集但有呼吸感：小插图菜肴平衡地分布在页面上，采用分散式布局，并留有足够的留白，使其感觉高端且具有收藏价值。整体图像必须能让人立即读出既是时尚的拉面探索卡，又是纪念品般的品鉴指南，同时也是竞选海报。

品牌和标题逻辑：
在卡片顶部，放置一个紧凑的品牌标识“KITSUNE TABLE”，下方是一个醒目优雅的手写标题，如富有表现力的英文刻字“RAMEN & BITES GUIDE”。如果需要，可以在整齐的排版块中添加一个小的二级位置标签，如“MIDNIGHT DISTRICT”或“ALLEY EDITION”。排版必须感觉是手工打造的、编辑风格的、俏皮且精确的，而不是通用的、幼稚的或企业化的。

统一的产品系统：
包含正好 10 个围绕连贯的拉面和配菜宇宙构建的招牌项目：
1. Yuzu Shoyu Ramen (柚子酱油拉面)
2. Black Garlic Tonkotsu (黑蒜豚骨拉面)
3. Spicy Miso Corn Ramen (辣味噌玉米拉面)
4. Sake Clam Udon (清酒蛤蜊乌冬面)
5. Crispy Gyoza (酥脆饺子)
6. Tamago Sando Bites (玉子烧三明治)
7. Wagyu Negi Skewer (和牛大葱串)
8. Ebi Tempura Roll (海老天妇罗卷)
9. Plum Soda (苏打梅酒)
10. Hojicha Milk Tea (焙茶奶茶)
这张卡片必须感觉像是一个精心策划的深夜日式治愈美食系统，而不是随机组合。每张插图都应支持同一个品牌世界：温暖的汤头、有光泽的面条、金黄的油炸质感、烤焦的痕迹、柔软的面包屑、半透明的饮料、精确的装饰和紧凑的编辑风格诱人细节。

美食插画现实主义：
将每个项目渲染为具有真实产品逻辑的超诱人微型主角插图：汤面闪烁、油脂滴、面条光泽、蛋黄质感、叉烧肉片大理石纹、海苔柔软度、饺子皮起泡、天妇罗碎屑结构、串烧釉面、饮料冷凝水、冰块折射、泡沫高光和配菜新鲜度。外观应感觉像是编辑美食素描和奢侈产品可视化的结合体。每件物品都必须美味、干净且物理上可信。

排版和注释：
使用优雅的手写英文标注项目名称，在选定菜肴下方使用微小精致的描述词，以及克制干净的价格数字。添加细线涂鸦箭头、小型成分注释和极简的推荐提示，以连接文本和菜肴插图。保持布局活泼但受控。没有密集的段落，没有复制的外文文本，没有混乱的笔记堆砌。

卡片材质和印刷工艺：
品鉴卡应感觉像厚实的高端哑光纸，具有柔和的暖象牙色调、锋利的边缘、微妙的自然纹理和精细的印刷保真度。印刷线条应使用温暖的深褐色或浓缩咖啡色墨水，而不是生硬的黑色，赋予作品更柔和的美食身份。插图必须感觉清晰、精品设计且印刷专业。

手部和真实感：
展示一只真实的手从左下角握住卡片，具有可信的解剖结构、正确的手指数量、自然的皮肤纹理、柔软的关节褶皱、干净的指甲和放松的握持压力。手的感觉应该是随意的、不强求的，支持真实用餐瞬间的真实性。没有畸形的手指，没有尴尬的握姿。

光照：
使用温馨的餐厅环境光，右前方上方有柔和的主光，在纸张上产生悦目的高光，在手指下方产生微妙的阴影，并在后面的桌面上产生柔和的光晕。背景添加舒适的金褐色焦外成像和低对比度深度。灯光必须感觉亲密、诱人且具有商业感，阴影过渡柔和，没有浑浊的黑色区域。

色彩系统：
基础调色板：暖象牙色、烤奶油色、胡桃褐、深浓缩咖啡墨水、焦糖米色、柔和炭色。来自食物的点缀色：拉面琥珀色、味噌橙色、柚子黄、玉米金、叉烧粉褐色、海苔绿、天妇罗金、梅子红、焙茶棕。保持卡片色彩克制，以便菜肴提供色彩亮点。整体基调必须感觉温暖、都市、富有风味、手工且高端。

背景和环境：
场景设定在一个温馨的日式风格小酒馆或拉面吧环境中，柔焦处理。暗示一个深色桌面、一个折叠的餐巾、一双筷子、一个模糊的玻璃杯反光和远处的昏暗座位，但保持一切模糊和干净。没有凌乱的剩菜，没有分散注意力的行人，没有杂物。卡片仍然是主导产品。

商业成品感：
最终图像必须感觉像是戛纳级别的精品餐厅活动视觉效果：手持的真实感、可收藏的品鉴卡设计、精美的排版层级、令人垂涎的真实产品插图、优雅的品牌标识和极其干净的编辑构图。核心聚焦在卡片、文字、印刷菜肴和手部；其他地方都是柔和的大气模糊。没有污垢，没有污渍，没有错误的透视，没有廉价的菜单设计。

负面提示词：
复制的源文本、通用的菜单排版、拥挤的布局、无法辨认的标签、混乱的箭头、过多的段落、低分辨率的美食图画、塑料感的食物、糟糕的解剖、多余的手指、缺失的手指、融合的手指、扭曲的手、浑浊的阴影、黑色斑块、过饱和的颜色、混乱的背景、分散注意力的行人、廉价的品牌、重复的菜肴、平淡的光线、模糊的卡片边缘、糟糕的印刷质感、水印、徽标堆砌

Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

The screen is strictly divided from top to bottom into four horizontal areas, the height of each area must precisely account for 25% of the overall screen, the ratio of the four layers is strictly 1:1:1:1, no ratio deviation allowed. The 'no white space gaps' here only means that the seams between layers cannot have gaps; the interior of each layer can still retain negative space, paper, or solid color backgrounds according to the corresponding style. All four layers are based solely on the same uploaded photo, presenting the same subject, the same moment, and the same spatial relationship. Strictly maintain consistency in subject identity, quantity, key structure, proportions, posture, movement direction, line of sight, observation perspective, perspective, occlusion, left-right position, front-back relationship, and core narrative. The four layers are not four unrelated new compositions, but a continuous style translation of the same image. Since each layer is an extremely flat banner of about 3:1, the subject should be organized horizontally, and appropriate breathing space should be reserved on the left and right; natural horizontal extension or slight cropping of the background is allowed, but the subject must not be stretched vertically, key parts must not be cropped, character relationships must not be changed, or scenes unrelated to the original image must not be created. The visual center of gravity, subject proportion, and contour landing points of the four layers should be aligned vertically as much as possible, forming a coherent evolution from real photography to the target style. Each layer must completely fill its own 25% area. Do not add layer numbers, dividers, borders, collage gaps, watermarks, or logos. Unless a layer style description explicitly requires small amounts of editorial text, bill marks, or handwritten notes, do not generate extra text; even if text is needed, it must be small, restrained, not block the subject, and avoid gibberish as much as possible. Layer 1 | Original Photography: Directly retain the real photography state of the uploaded photo as the visual benchmark for the style translation of the subsequent three layers. Maintain the original person or subject identity, quantity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, structure, proportions, posture, movements, line of sight, interactive relationships, observation perspective, perspective, occlusion, environmental direction, natural light and shadow, and core colors, without performing illustration, texture transformation, geometrization, or 3D reconstruction. To adapt to the extremely flat banner of about 3:1, only natural extension of the left and right sides of the background that conforms to the original scene logic is allowed, or slight cropping that does not damage the subject; the subject's proportions must not be changed, people or buildings must not be stretched, and the head, hands, feet, key objects, or important narrative relationships must not be cropped. The screen remains natural, real, and clear, avoiding excessive skin smoothing, exaggerated color grading, fictional scenery, and decorations unrelated to the original image. Layer 2 | Black and White Thick Crayon Silhouette: In the roughly 3:1 flat horizontal banner area of this layer, translate the real subject of the first layer into a 'black and white thick crayon silhouette' style. Maintain consistency with the first layer's subject identity, quantity, key structure, posture, left-right position, perspective, spatial relationship, and core narrative, and then fully implement the following visual requirements: Extract the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, and reconstruct it as a minimalist thick black dry medium silhouette illustration. items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用 3:4竖版构图。画面从上到下严格四等分为四个横向区域，每个区域高度必须精确占整体画面的25%，四层比例严格为1:1:1:1，不允许出现比例偏差。区域之间无缝衔接，无分隔线、无留白间隙。这里的“无留白间隙”仅指层与层的接缝不能出现空隙；每层内部仍可按照对应风格保留负空间、纸面或纯色背景。

四层全部以同一张上传照片为唯一依据，呈现同一主体、同一瞬间和同一空间关系。严格保持主体身份、数量、关键结构、比例、姿态、动作方向、视线、观察视角、透视、遮挡、左右位置、前后关系与核心叙事一致。四层不是四张互不相关的新构图，而是同一画面的连续风格转译。由于每层均为约3:1的极扁横幅，主体应横向组织，并保留适量左右呼吸空间；允许对背景进行自然横向延展或轻微裁切，但不得纵向拉伸主体、裁掉关键部位、改变人物关系，或另造与原图无关的场景。

四层的视觉重心、主体占比和轮廓落点尽量上下对齐，形成从真实摄影逐步过渡到目标风格的连贯演化。每层都必须完整填满自身25%的区域。不要添加层号、分隔线、边框、拼贴缝隙、水印或Logo。除非某层风格说明明确要求少量编辑文字、票据标记或手写注释，否则不要额外生成文字；即使需要文字，也必须少量、克制、不遮挡主体，并尽量避免乱码。

第一层｜原始摄影

直接保留上传照片的真实摄影状态，作为后三层风格转译的视觉基准。保持原始人物或主体的身份、数量、面部特征、发型、服装、结构、比例、姿态、动作、视线、互动关系、观察视角、透视、遮挡、环境方向、自然光影与核心色彩，不进行插画化、材质化、几何化或三维重建。

为了适配约3:1的极扁横幅，只允许对背景左右两侧进行符合原场景逻辑的自然延展，或进行不损伤主体的轻微裁切；不得改变主体比例，不得拉伸人物或建筑，不得裁掉头部、手脚、关键物件或重要叙事关系。画面保持自然、真实、清晰，避免过度磨皮、夸张调色、虚构景物和与原图无关的装饰。

第二层｜黑白粗蜡笔剪影

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“黑白粗蜡笔剪影”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为极简粗黑干媒介剪影插画。不要机械描摹照片细节，而是将主体压缩成圆润、敦厚、略带稚拙感的概括形体，可适度放大头部、主要轮廓或最有记忆点的局部，使其在极少信息下仍能一眼识别原物。若照片包含多个主体，则保留最重要的互动关系，将它们视为一个整体视觉单元，而不是平均分散焦点。

本层画面只使用近乎纯白的纸面底 + 浓黑蜡笔、炭笔或干擦痕迹，不使用彩色，不使用灰阶渐变。黑色形体不是光滑实心矢量块，而是由短促、有力度的蜡笔反复涂抹形成，保留纸张颗粒、断笔、压痕、边缘毛糙、浓淡不均和局部露白。轮廓略微摇晃、不完整、不精确，让画面保持真实手作感。

主体最关键的识别特征可通过“黑色剪影中突然切出的白色特征区”强化，例如脸部、眼睛周围、窗洞、器皿开口、动物面部、物件核心结构或最具有辨识度的局部；再以极少黑点、短线或符号完成表情与细节。不要追求写实五官和精密结构，而是让黑、白之间形成直接、有趣而强烈的辨识关系。

构图保持大面积纯净留白 + 一个主要视觉关系。主体可居中悬浮，也可轻微偏置、局部裁切或靠近画面下方，仅用一条粗糙地面摩擦线、几根短线或极少环境符号提示空间。草叶、雨丝、烟气、桌面、影子、道路、风或其他环境信息都应被压缩成极少的蜡笔记号，让背景保持安静空旷。整体不追求复杂场景，而让一个姿态、动作、距离或关系承担主要叙事。

文字保留少量高级编辑感与童书感并存的小字系统。不要只写地点或物体名称，而从照片中的情绪、动作、关系、时间或微小故事提炼一个简短英文标题，再搭配编号、适配的金句、章节号或一句极短的含蓄小文案。文字可以是克制的印刷小字，也可以加入极少量笨拙手写、蜡笔字或不完全规整的字形，使其像原本就属于这幅插画。

文字需要与图形发生巧妙关系：可以贴着地面线排列、沿主体动作方向延伸、躲在大片留白中、与轮廓产生轻微遮挡、卡在两个主体之间的负形里，或用一条细线把编号与主体连接起来。保持“一个短标题 + 1–2组极小辅助文字”即可，让文字成为构图节奏的一部分，而不是普通海报标题。

整体呈现黑要粗、白要净、形要简、质要糙的视觉特征，在童稚、温软、安静、幽默与孤独之间保持微妙平衡，像一本由高级设计工作室重新编辑的旧黑白童书。避免光滑数字描边、精密线稿、写实光影、厚涂、三维效果、彩色、大面积灰色渲染、卡通贴纸感和模板化商业插画。

第三层｜几何秩序线性实验

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“几何秩序线性实验”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为具有几何秩序的线性实验海报。主体由高密度重复线条、错位描线、短促回环和轻微抖动轨迹聚合显形，保留清晰识别边缘，内部保持不稳定与流动感；外围使用同源但更细、更疏、更轻的线条向外扩散，并以水平、垂直、斜线、圆弧、切线或隐性网格建立理性结构，形成中心高密度、外围低密度，几何秩序与自由线性并存的视觉张力。

配色从上传的原图中提取最有生命力、最有辨识度、最能代表主体精气神的颜色作为主线色，不按面积平均取色，也不刻意做旧降灰；可适度提纯、提亮和校正，使颜色更干净、鲜明、现代。整体采用清洁浅色背景、单一主线色和黑灰微排版，通过线条密度、粗细和叠压形成层次，避免脏色、灰蒙、固定蓝调、多色混杂和数字渐变。

文字作为构图的一部分巧妙介入，从照片的情绪、动作、时间、状态或隐喻中提炼极短英文标题，并搭配少量编号、适配的哲理金句、状态词、标尺或微型注释。文字可沿几何轴线、主体轮廓或线场边界排列，横排、竖排、旋转、穿插或错位，通过极小字号、细字重、宽字距和精确对齐形成高级编辑感，使理性排版压住自由线条的躁动。

整体保持大面积留白、唯一视觉焦点和清晰几何秩序，呈现干净、克制、锐利、实验、艺术化且富有生命力的视觉气质。避免随机涂鸦、无方向线团、脏旧复古、赛博科技感、商业宣传感、卡通感和模板感。

第四层｜动态磁场颗粒版画

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“动态磁场颗粒版画”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为超现实极简版画视觉。将主体压缩成一个清晰而克制的视觉锚点，通常以较小尺度置于大片留白中，仅保留最关键的轮廓与姿态；不要复刻复杂细节，而是让原图中的动作、方向、光影或空间关系转化为围绕主体展开的动态场域。

动态场根据主体自身特征自然选择一种主要运动逻辑：优先沿横向或斜向流动、由核心向两侧扩散，或形成不规则波纹与回响；仅当原图动作本身明确时，才保留短距离的上下坠落或上升。使用大量细线、断裂轨迹、粗粝网点和颗粒密度变化表现运动，核心附近更密、更强，向边缘逐渐稀疏、破碎并消失于留白。避免同时堆叠多种特效，让一个主体、一种运动、一个巨大空间关系成为画面的核心。

配色从上传的原图中提炼最有辨识度、最有精气神的一个主色，与暖白、象牙白或自然纸色及少量黑色组成严格的2–3色体系。主色可适度提纯和强化，使其鲜明、有力量但不过度数字化；通过网点密度、油墨叠压与纸面留白形成深浅，而不是普通渐变。保留丝网印刷、孔版印刷（Risograph）、粗颗粒、纸张纤维、油墨覆盖不均和轻微套印偏差，避免电脑渲染、三维、真实光效和光滑数字插画感。

文字建立克制的实验艺术书微排版系统。从照片的动作、距离、状态、情绪或隐喻中提炼一个极短英文标题，并搭配2–4组微型文字，可由短句、状态词、地点或对象信息、序列号、坐标式数字、方向词、档案标签或观察注释自由组合。文字可沿地平线、动态轨迹、主体轴线或留白边缘排列，也可纵排、旋转、拉开字距、嵌入颗粒场或被线条轻微穿过，使排版本身参与空间与运动，而不是独立贴在画面上。

整体追求极小主体、极大留白、强烈尺度反差、单一动态场与粗粝印刷质感，呈现安静、孤独、神秘、诗意又带有轻微超现实感的实验编辑视觉。无论主体是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、交通工具或自然景观，都应保持原始影像与抽象场域之间清晰的身份呼应，避免复杂场景、多重焦点、装饰堆积、普通渐变、商业海报感和模板感。

items.title: 高级艺术设计海报几何极简诗意视觉寓言
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Better logic for processing the following text:
Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output separately. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, continuing the top-bottom dual-layer logic: the upper part is real photography, and the lower part is an artistic reconstruction based on subtext and allegory;

The upper part retains the original photo, keeping the subject's identity, structure, posture, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine, independent publication, and exhibition photography. To adapt to the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable **subject, outline, posture, narrative relationship, and emotional metaphor** from the photo, not only reproducing "what is seen," but more importantly understanding "what the original image implies, symbolizes, and reminds people of," then reconstructing it into a **geometrically minimalist, poetically romantic, but structurally rigorous** graphic scene. Do not fully depict the original scene, nor copy realistic details, but only retain the core theme and visual logic that most validates the spirit of the original image, translating complex information into a few clear and meaningful forms, paths, landforms, architectural feelings, spatial layers, or symbolic objects, making people feel at a glance that it shares the same source as the original image, while feeling an elevated sense of allegory and poetry.

The composition should be built on **geometric order and rational structure**, with a Da Vinci-like sense of rigor: emphasizing proportion, axis, perspective, primary and secondary order, block-surface relationships, path guidance, and spatial balance. The subject can be transformed into simplified mountains, buildings, vessels, human figures, roads, platforms, domes, arches, discs, tree-like forms, or other symbolic geometric shapes, building a quiet and romantic "conceptual landscape" through a few key elements. The lower part should have a large amount of light-colored negative space and breathing room, with complex backgrounds actively deleted, leaving only the necessary field to support the theme and allegory, allowing the blank space, distance, and order itself to participate in the narrative.

Visual language adopts **geometric flat graphics + soft manual texture**: clear and generalized forms, restrained edges, simplified details, allowing a slight paper, powdery, or print-like feel, but avoiding a sticker, 3D, realistic, and over-decorated feel. The overall image has both the simplicity of modern graphic design and the poetic nature of romantic narrative illustration, like a dream map, memory landscape, or allegorical illustration constrained by rational structure.

Color palette continues the current logic: overall adoption of **soft, transparent, slightly desaturated high-end color systems**, with an extremely light, clean, near-white pale background as a large-area breathing field. Use **pale pink-blue, mist blue, sky blue, airy cold-toned blue** to create the main atmosphere, then use **ivory white, cream white, light beige, soft gray-green, architectural neutral colors** to maintain balance; a small amount of **blush pink, soft peach, dusty rose, or muted blush** can be added as local highlights to make the image more healing, poetic, and exquisitely layered. Avoid dirty gray, excessive contrast, high-saturation clashing colors, and cheap vintage feels.

The text does not preset fixed titles, numbers, locations, or languages, nor does it provide menu-style information. It should freely generate a very small number of truly meaningful characters, words, short sentences, or fragments based on the theme, emotion, allegory, memory, or cultural context of the photo, and naturally enter the blank area through high-end editorial layout. The text should be small, light, restrained, and exquisite, and can be arranged along axes, edges, paths, or around the subject, like notes, labels, or observational phrases in an independent publication, forming a quiet and clever relationship with the geometric composition.

Overall temperament should be like an independently published art travel journal or visual allegory manual: **minimalist, poetic, romantic, rational, restrained, with geometric order and conceptual beauty.** Avoid complete realistic landscapes, information stacking, complex decorations, overcrowded subjects, overly solid backgrounds, template-like poster feels, e-commerce illustration
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

更好的逻辑处理如下文本：
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，延续上下双层逻辑：上半部分为真实摄影，下半部分为基于潜台词与寓意的艺术化重构；

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、姿态、叙事关系与情绪隐喻**，不仅重现“看见了什么”，更要理解原图“在暗示什么、象征什么、让人联想到什么”，再将其重构为一种**几何极简、诗意浪漫、但结构严谨**的图形化场景。不要完整描摹原场景，也不要照搬现实细节，而是只保留最能成立原图精神的核心主题与视觉逻辑，把复杂信息转译成少量清晰而有意味的形体、路径、地貌、建筑感、空间层次或象征性对象，让人一眼感到与原图同源，同时感受到被提升后的寓言感与诗意。

构图应建立在**几何秩序与理性结构**之上，具有类似达·芬奇式的严谨感：重视比例、轴线、透视、主次秩序、块面关系、路径引导与空间平衡。主体可被转化为简化的山体、建筑体、器物体、人物体、道路、平台、穹顶、拱形、圆盘、树状体或其他象征性几何形体，通过少量关键元素搭建一个安静而浪漫的“观念景观”。下半部分应有大量淡色留白与呼吸空间，复杂背景主动删减，只留下支撑主题与寓意的必要场域，让空白、距离和秩序本身参与叙事。

视觉语言采用**几何化平面图形 + 柔和手工质感**：形体清晰概括，边缘克制，细节简化，允许轻微纸感、粉感或版画感，但避免贴纸感、3D感、写实感和过度装饰。画面整体既有现代图形设计的简洁，也有浪漫叙事插画的诗性，像一幅被理性结构约束过的梦境地图、记忆风景或寓意图解。

配色延续当前逻辑：整体采用**柔和、通透、略微去饱和的高级色系**，并以极浅、干净、接近白色的淡色背景作为大面积呼吸场。以**浅粉蓝、雾蓝、天空蓝、空气感冷调蓝**营造主氛围，再以**象牙白、奶油白、浅米色、柔和灰绿、建筑中性色**保持平衡；可加入少量 **blush pink、soft peach、dusty rose 或 muted blush** 作为局部点睛，使画面更具治愈感、诗意与精致层次。避免脏灰、过强反差、高饱和撞色和廉价复古感。

文字不预设固定标题、编号、地点或语种，也不做菜单式信息。应根据照片的主题、情绪、寓意、记忆或文化语境，自由生成极少量真正有意义的字、词、短句或片段，并通过高级编辑排版自然进入留白区域。文字应小、轻、克制、精致，可沿轴线、边缘、路径或主体周围排布，像独立出版物中的注记、题签或观察性短语，与几何构图形成安静而聪明的关系。

整体气质应像一本独立出版的艺术旅行刊物或视觉寓言手册：**极简、诗意、浪漫、理性、克制、带有几何秩序与观念美感。** 避免完整写实风景、信息堆积、复杂装饰、主体过满、背景过实、模板化海报感、电商插画感、卡通感和廉价拼贴感。

items.title: AURELLE奢华护肤广告海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible adult woman. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create an ultra-premium beauty advertising poster for the original luxury skincare brand AURELLE. Preserve the concept that a woman and her reaching hand physically emerge from a smartphone screen into reality. Use a warm monochrome beige studio, one oversized upright smartphone in the center-left mid-background, one sophisticated adult woman partly stepping through the display, and one hyper-real luxury hand-cream tube in the lower-right foreground as the absolute commercial hero. The image is modern, elegant, tactile, intimate and conceptually sharp: digital beauty care crosses into a real ritual.

COMPOSITION AND PORTAL
Use a tall vertical editorial frame. The smartphone is frontal with a crisp black frame and a softly lit interior beauty scene. The woman's torso, arm and hand must clearly pass beyond the screen boundary with convincing perspective and spatial separation. Her hand reaches toward the lower-right product, creating a near-touching moment. The phone is a portal, not a flat picture frame; part of one leg and her body may remain inside the screen world while the upper body enters the studio.

PRODUCT
Make the AURELLE hand-cream tube the sharpest and strongest focus. Use an elegant satin ivory tube, warm champagne-gold typography, subtle metallic cap detail and minimal French-luxury layout. Include only the following original, cleanly printed English product text: “AURELLE”, “VELVET HAND RITUAL”, and “ROSE SILK REPAIR”. The tube must look expensive, feminine, tactile and physically grounded on the studio floor with a soft realistic shadow. Do not copy real brands, logos or slogans.

MODEL AND SCREEN WORLD
Show a poised adult fashion-beauty woman with dark refined sunglasses, a cream silk shirt, tailored dark-brown trousers and elegant neutral heels. Her shoulder-length hair is smooth and softly styled; her expression is calm, modern and quietly powerful, never influencer-like. Inside the phone, show a softly blurred private beauty interior with neutral seating, cream textiles and warm beige-brown tones. Keep the smartphone, model, product, serif typography, guide lines, floor tone and shadow density within one disciplined luxury system.

LIGHTING, TYPE AND FINISH
Use warm beige, ivory, champagne gold, espresso brown, soft black and cream neutrals. Add refined studio key light, controlled reflections on the tube and phone, soft shadows and a subtle warm halo. Use minimal elegant serif typography, precise spacing and restrained editorial hierarchy. If a campaign headline is used, it must be original English-only and short, such as “Care Steps Closer.” or “Reach the Ritual.” Add at most one small support line; no clutter. The finish is world-class high-end fashion-beauty campaign photography, tactile product rendering, 8K-level detail and a seamless portal illusion.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
No copied skincare branding, copied slogans, cluttered set, cheap influencer aesthetic, generic phone ad, weak product visibility, plastic tube, harsh shadows, messy typography, exaggerated expression, low-resolution skin, overdecorated background, random props, watermark or logo.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见成年女性的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

为原创奢华护肤品牌 AURELLE 创作一张超高端美容广告海报。保留女性和她伸出的手从智能手机屏幕中实体穿出、进入现实空间的核心概念。使用暖色单色米色影棚，中左背景放置一部超大的竖立智能手机，一名精致的成年女性部分跨出屏幕，右下前景放置一支超写实奢华护手霜软管作为绝对商业主角。画面应现代、优雅、有触感、亲密且概念清晰：数字美容护理进入真实的护理仪式。

构图与穿屏
使用高挑竖向编辑构图。手机正面朝向镜头，拥有清晰黑色边框，屏幕内是柔和照明的室内美容场景。女性躯干、手臂和手必须明显越过屏幕边界，以可信透视和空间分离感进入现实。她的手伸向右下方产品，形成接近触碰的瞬间。手机是门户而不是平面画框；可让一条腿和部分身体仍留在屏幕世界，上半身则进入影棚。

产品
让 AURELLE 护手霜软管成为最清晰、最强的视觉焦点。使用有缎面质感的象牙色软管、暖香槟金排版、微妙金属盖和极简法式奢华布局。只加入以下原创且清晰印刷的英文产品文字：“AURELLE”、“VELVET HAND RITUAL”和“ROSE SILK REPAIR”。软管必须昂贵、女性化、有触感，并以柔和真实投影稳稳落在影棚地面。不得复制真实品牌、logo 或口号。

模特与屏幕世界
表现一位沉着的成年时装美容女性，戴精致深色墨镜，穿奶油色丝绸衬衫、合身深棕色长裤和优雅中性色高跟鞋。肩长头发顺滑、造型柔和；表情平静、现代而低调有力，绝不呈现网红感。手机屏幕内是柔焦的私人美容室内空间，有中性色座椅、奶油色纺织品以及暖米色与棕色调。手机、模特、产品、衬线排版、辅助线、地面色调和阴影密度必须属于统一克制的奢华系统。

光线、文字与完成度

items.title: 极简艺术风格四层竖版拼图海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please turn my uploaded photo into a vertical collage poster with an overall 3:4 vertical composition. The image is strictly divided into four horizontal areas from top to bottom, and the height of each area must be precisely controlled at 25% of the overall image height (the ratio of the four layers is strictly 1:1:1:1, no ratio deviation allowed). The areas are connected seamlessly without dividing lines or gaps. The order is: original image → Style 1 → Style 2 → Style 3. Since each layer has an extremely wide ratio of approximately 3:1, it is suggested that the main subject of each layer be arranged horizontally centered, emphasizing open white space and a sense of breathing on the left and right, avoiding vertical stretching deformation or crowded edges. The four layers maintain continuity and resonance in character positioning, scene structure, and line of sight, presenting an overall sense of the same scene through four translations. The style layers (layers 2 to 4) must follow the principle of minimalism: the number of visual elements in each layer is compressed to the minimum, retaining only 1 most core main symbol, and all other secondary decorations, background details, and foil elements are omitted. The white space ratio is no less than 60%.

The first layer retains the main structure, real character interaction relationships and poses, real texture, natural light and shadow, and the original color atmosphere of the original photo. Only slight high-end photographic color grading is performed to present a magazine photography texture, without changing the character relationships and composition logic. The sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally expanded without changing character relationships and composition logic to make the whole more spatial and narrative.

The second layer is in woodcut style: high-contrast black and white woodcut knife marks express scene textures and character silhouettes, supplemented by one or two limited color accents. The background is cream or light gray paper, and the knife mark lines are bold and powerful but not messy. Colors are mainly black and cream, paired with one accent color. Avoid overly dense knife marks and avoid too many grayscale levels that make the image look gray.

The third layer is in torn paper collage style: torn edge paper color blocks are used to represent characters and the environment, and the layered edges retain natural tear textures. The background is a cream kraft paper base color. The main elements are composed of several torn edge colored papers stacked together, with no more than three layers. Colors are controlled within 2 to 4 natural color systems. Avoid clutter caused by too many paper pieces and avoid overly fine cut edges.

The fourth layer is in cyanotype style: using cyanotype photography (blueprinting) style, with single Prussian blue and white representing character and environment silhouettes, creating an old craft texture. The background is cream or light bluish-white, and there may be a slight graininess from development. The color is a monochromatic system of Prussian blue and white. Avoid adding other miscellaneous colors and avoid overly heavy graininess that looks dirty.

Each layer needs to uniformly convert the subject and scene into the corresponding style. The overall expression is extremely restrained and simplified, retaining only the most core main symbol and its basic outline relationship, deleting all non-essential background elements, decorative details, and foil items; the key positional relationships, interaction directions, and pose characteristics between characters must be retained but should be abstracted into recognizable outline relationships, achieving "fewer elements, clearer relationships." Colors are all extracted and summarized from the original image, with each layer strictly controlled within 2-4 main colors. The height ratio of the four areas must be strictly maintained at 1:1:1:1 (25% each), and no splicing misalignment or ratio deviation should occur. Overall, avoid punk/cyberpunk styles, forced overlay of realistic photo textures, cartoon styles, 3D rendering feel, commercial poster feel, complex background stacking, too many elements or crowded images, similar styles in adjacent layers, and any text, logos, watermarks, or titles.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请将我上传的照片制作成一张竖版拼图海报，整体采用 3:4 竖版构图。画面从上到下严格四等分为四个横向区域，每个区域的高度必须精确控制为整体画面高度的25%（四层比例严格为1:1:1:1，不允许出现比例偏差），区域之间无缝衔接，不设分隔线、不留间隙，顺序为：原图→风格1→风格2→风格3。由于每层为约3:1的极扁宽幅比例，各层主体建议横向居中排布，强调左右开阔留白与呼吸感，避免元素纵向拉伸变形或贴边拥挤。四层在人物站位、场景结构、视线方向上保持连贯呼应，呈现同一画面、四种转译的整体感。风格层（第二至四层）须遵循极简原则：每层视觉元素数量压缩至最低限度，只保留1个最核心的主体符号，其余次要装饰、背景细节与陪衬元素一律省略，画面留白占比不低于60%。

第一层保留原始照片的主体结构、人物真实互动关系与姿态、真实质感、自然光影与原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，呈现杂志摄影质感，不改变人物关系与构图逻辑，并可在不改变人物关系与构图逻辑的前提下自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，使整体更具空间感与叙事感。

第二层为木刻版画风格：以高对比黑白木刻刀痕表现场景肌理与人物剪影，辅以一至两处限定色点缀。背景为米白或浅灰纸底，刀痕线条粗犷有力但不杂乱。色彩以黑、米白为主，搭配一处点缀色。避免刀痕过密，避免灰阶层次过多导致画面发灰。

第三层为撕纸拼贴风格：以撕边纸张色块拼贴表现人物与环境，层叠边缘保留自然撕痕肌理。背景为米白牛皮纸底色。主体元素由数张撕边色纸叠放构成，层次不超过三层。色彩控制在2至4种自然色系以内。避免纸片过多导致画面凌乱，避免裁剪边缘过于精细。

第四层为蓝晒氰版风格：采用氰版摄影（蓝晒）风格，以单一普鲁士蓝与白表现人物与环境剪影，营造老工艺质感。背景为米白或浅蓝白底，可有轻微显影颗粒感。色彩为普鲁士蓝与白的单色系。避免加入其他杂色，避免颗粒感过重显脏。

每一层需将主体与场景统一转换为对应风格，整体表达极度克制与简化，只保留最核心的一个主体符号及其基本轮廓关系，删除一切非必要的背景元素、装饰细节与陪衬物；人物之间的关键位置关系、互动方向与姿态特征需保留，但应抽象为可识别的轮廓关系，做到“元素越少、关系越清晰”。色彩均从原图中提取归纳，每层严格控制在2-4种主色以内。四个区域的高度比例须严格保持1:1:1:1（各占25%），不可出现拼接错位或比例偏差。整体避免朋克/赛博朋克风格、写实照片质感强行叠加、卡通风格、3D渲染感、商业海报感、复杂背景堆砌、元素过多或画面拥挤、相邻两层风格雷同，以及任何文字、Logo、水印或标题。

items.title: 炭笔消隐旅行习作高级对照海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please turn each travel photo I upload into an independent "CHARCOAL VANISHING TRAVEL STUDY" high-end comparison poster. Output each photo separately, no multi-image collages.

Overall 3:4 vertical composition, consisting of two areas: the real original photo and a charcoal re-drawing. Clear boundary, restrained composition, but no need to mechanically pursue perfectly equal proportions. By default, let the upper real photo occupy about 48%—52%, and the lower charcoal study occupy the remaining space.

【Top: Real Original Photo】
Faithfully preserve the original photo at the top. Accurately maintain the subject's identity, quantity, posture, action direction, terrain structure, architectural outline, spatial relationship, natural light and shadow, real materials, and original color atmosphere. The viewer must clearly see that this is an original photo, not a re-drawn realistic illustration. Perform only slight and delicate photographic color grading to give the photo the texture of an independent travel magazine, art publication, or photography exhibition, and add an extremely thin, almost imperceptible film grain. To adapt to the vertical format, you may naturally crop or extend the sky, ground, mountains, and surrounding environment, but do not stretch, distort, move, replace, or redesign the subject.

【Bottom: Charcoal Vanishing Study】
First, understand the visual anchor points in the photo most worth remembering. It could be a lonely house, a car, a boat, a small bridge, a person, an animal, a single tree, a flight of steps, or a recognizable architectural structure. Do not convert the entire photo completely into a black and white charcoal drawing. Actively delete a large amount of information in the sky, forests, mountains, roads, grass, tourists, and buildings, keeping only the minimum elements necessary to maintain the subject's identity, posture, spatial direction, and travel memories. Shrink the extracted subject to form a concentrated, isolated charcoal study on paper. The subject and its necessary environment usually occupy only about 18%—35% of the lower half, with large areas of complete, un-drawn warm white sketchbook paper remaining around it. Environment should keep at most 1—3 sets of suggestive marks, for example: a disconnected patch of ground or hillside, a small piece of rock wall, two or three strokes of a ridge, a cable, a few tree hints, a contact shadow, a set of short spatial scuffs. Do not draw a complete background.

【Charcoal Material】
Use real willow charcoal, compressed charcoal, and mix in a tiny amount of graphite marks: willow charcoal, compressed charcoal, charcoal pencil, graphite accents, broad directional charcoal marks, finger-smudged gray, kneaded eraser lifting, broken contours, charcoal dust, loose charcoal crumbs, visible paper tooth, uneven hand pressure, dry powdery residue. Use broad, short, directional charcoal marks to build the weight of the subject, rather than using a lot of fine pencil cross-hatching. The deepest charcoal black is only used for the most recognizable structures of the subject, such as door openings, under eaves, car windows, silhouettes, animal horns, dark parts of a boat hull, tires, landing points, or key structural joints. Use one to two finger-smudged gray areas to establish volume, and retain smudge marks, charcoal dust particles, eraser highlights, paper grain breakage, and uneven pressure.

【Vanishing Method】
The center and key structures of the subject are relatively clear, while the outer edges gradually lose integrity: clear charcoal marks → broken outlines → loose scuffs → scattered charcoal dust → un-drawn paper. Vanishing must come from the artist not finishing the drawing, charcoal dust being smudged away, outlines being lifted by an eraser, and brushstrokes stopping naturally. Do not use digital transparency, soft focus, smoke, lens blur, airbrush, feathered masks, or smooth gradients to create the vanishing effect. Let the unfinished parts truly stop in the paper, presenting a feeling of "memory appearing and also leaving".

【Color and Paper】
The lower half strictly adopts a restrained monochromatic system: warm white paper, warm gray, cold gray, charcoal black, a tiny amount of graphite silver-gray. Do not keep the colors of the photo below. Do not add fixed accent colors. Paper should have a delicate but clearly visible natural texture: warm, matte, slightly rough, able to see paper tooth, fibers, and charcoal friction marks. By default, do not add titles, explanatory text, numbers, or logos, allowing the charcoal subject and paper white space to complete the narrative independently.

【Overall Temperament】
Overall it is like a saved page from a travel observation manual: the real photo records

请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的
“CHARCOAL VANISHING TRAVEL STUDY｜炭笔消隐旅行习作”
高级对照海报。每张照片单独输出，不进行多图拼贴。

整体采用3:4竖版构图，由真实原片与炭笔转绘两个区域组成。
分界清楚、构图克制，但不必机械追求完全相等的区域比例。
默认让上方真实照片占约48%—52%，下方炭笔习作占其余空间。

【上方：真实原片】

上方忠实保留原始照片。

准确保持主体身份、数量、姿态、动作方向、地形结构、建筑轮廓、
空间关系、自然光影、真实材质和原有色彩氛围。

必须让观者清楚看出这是原始照片，而不是被重新绘制的写实插画。

仅进行轻微而细腻的摄影调色，使照片具有独立旅行杂志、
艺术出版物和摄影展览的质感，并加入极薄、几乎不可察觉的胶片颗粒。

为适配竖版画幅，可自然裁切或延展天空、地面、山体和周边环境，
但不得拉伸、扭曲、移动、替换或重新设计主体。

【下方：炭笔消隐习作】

首先理解照片中最值得被记住的视觉锚点。

它可以是一间孤屋、一辆车、一艘船、一座小桥、一个人物、
一只动物、一棵独树、一段台阶或某个具有辨识度的建筑结构。

不要把整张照片完整转换成黑白炭笔画。

主动删除天空、树林、山脉、道路、草地、游客和建筑中的大量信息，
只保留维持主体身份、姿态、空间方向与旅行记忆所必需的最少元素。

把提炼后的主体缩小，形成一幅集中、孤立的纸上炭笔习作。
主体及其必要环境通常只占下半部分约18%—35%，
四周保留大面积完整、未经绘制的暖白色素描纸。

环境最多保留1—3组提示性痕迹，例如：

- 一段断开的地面或山坡
- 一小块岩壁
- 两三笔山脊
- 一根缆线
- 几个树木暗示
- 一块接触阴影
- 一组短促的空间擦痕

不得绘制完整背景。

【炭笔材质】

使用真实的柳木炭条、压缩炭笔，并混合极少量石墨痕迹：

willow charcoal,
compressed charcoal,
charcoal pencil,
graphite accents,
broad directional charcoal marks,
finger-smudged gray,
kneaded eraser lifting,
broken contours,
charcoal dust,
loose charcoal crumbs,
visible paper tooth,
uneven hand pressure,
dry powdery residue.

使用宽短、具有方向性的炭痕建立主体重量，
而不是使用大量细密铅笔排线。

最深的炭黑只用于主体最具有识别度的结构，
例如门洞、屋檐下方、车窗、人物剪影、动物犄角、
船体暗部、轮胎、落脚点或关键结构连接处。

使用一至两块手指擦开的灰色区域建立体积，
并保留擦拭痕迹、炭粉颗粒、橡皮提亮、纸纹断裂与不均匀压力。

【消隐方式】

主体中心与关键结构相对清楚，
外缘则逐步失去完整性：

清楚炭痕
→ 断开的轮廓
→ 松散擦痕
→ 零星炭粉
→ 未经绘制的纸张。

消失必须来自画家没有继续画完、炭粉被擦开、
轮廓被橡皮提走以及笔触自然停止。

不要使用数字透明度、柔焦、烟雾、镜头模糊、
空气刷、羽化蒙版或平滑渐变制造消失效果。

让未完成的部分真正停在纸张中，
呈现“记忆正在出现，也正在离开”的感觉。

【色彩与纸张】

下半部分严格采用克制的单色体系：

- 暖白色纸张
- 暖灰
- 冷灰
- 炭黑
- 极少量石墨银灰

不要保留下方照片的彩色。
不要加入固定强调色。

纸张应具有细腻但清楚可见的天然纹理：
温暖、哑光、略带粗糙感，能够看到纸齿、纤维与炭粉摩擦痕迹。

默认不加入标题、说明文字、编号或标志，
让炭笔主体和纸张留白独立完成叙事。

【整体气质】

整体像一本旅行观察手册中被保存下来的一页：

真实照片记录当时看见的风景，
炭笔习作留下后来仍然记得的部分。

安静、克制、孤独、触觉化、略带时间流逝感，
具有高级艺术出版物、旅行档案和美术馆素描册的收藏气质。

避免：

完整炭笔风景画、整张照片黑白滤镜化、学院派精细素描、
照片级铅笔写实、密集排线、完整背景、过大的主体、
数字喷枪、平滑阴影、烟雾消散特效、水彩、墨水晕染、
油画、拼贴、装饰边框、模板化排版、无关文字、标志和水印。

items.title: 高级分屏极简纸感手绘艺术海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please turn each photo I upload into an individual high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output separately. Overall use a 3:4 vertical composition, the top and bottom two areas are strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the frame. The upper part preserves the original photo, maintaining the subject structure, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of magazine photography and art publications. To fit the frame, naturally extend the sky, ground, or environmental background, but do not stretch, distort, or change the subject. The lower part extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructing it as a minimalist paper-texture hand-drawn cover illustration. Highly refine and subtract complex details, keeping only the most critical visual features, re-expressing them with thin, slightly unstable hand-drawn lines and a small amount of clear acrylic flat color blocks, allowing the original theme to be recognized at a glance. The subject remains small and concentrated, accounting for about 10%–20% of the lower part, with large areas of white space around it. The background is mainly rough white paper or light-colored paper, using only a very small amount of lines or color surfaces to hint at the environment. The color palette is extracted from the photo above and compressed into no more than 4 primary colors, with distinct, complete, and restrained color blocks, preserving paper grain, hand-smearing, and slightly irregular edges. Lines are responsible for suggesting structure, and color blocks are responsible for establishing the subject. Avoid colored pencils, crayons, watercolor bleeding, pure line drawings, complex realism, heavy oil painting, smooth digital illustration, and 3D textures. A small amount of concise text can be added, flexibly using titles, theme words, object names, locations, years, numbers, or short phrases based on the photo content, not limited to urban themes. Text layout is sparse and restrained, naturally blending with the white space and illustration, with the design sense of an art book cover, independent publication, and children's picture book. The overall presentation features a small subject, large white space, strong refinement, high recognizability, a quiet, childlike, relaxed, poetic, and high-end visual temperament, avoiding commercial cartoon, e-commerce, and template styles.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体结构、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有杂志摄影和艺术出版物质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为极简纸感手绘封面插画。高度提炼并删减复杂细节，只保留最关键的视觉特征，以纤细、略带不稳定感的手绘线条和少量明确的丙烯平涂色块重新表达，让人一眼识别原始主题。主体保持小而集中，约占下半部分10%–20%，四周大面积留白，背景以粗糙白纸或浅色纸张为主，仅用极少量线条或色面暗示环境。

配色从上方照片提取并压缩为不超过4种主要颜色，色块鲜明、完整、克制，保留纸张颗粒、手工涂抹和轻微不规则边缘。线条负责提示结构，色块负责建立主体。避免彩铅、蜡笔、水彩晕染、纯线稿、复杂写实、厚重油画、光滑数字插画和3D质感。

可加入少量简洁文字，根据照片内容灵活使用标题、主题词、对象名称、地点、年份、编号或短句，不局限于城市题材。文字排版疏朗克制，与留白和插画自然融合，具有艺术书封、独立出版物和儿童绘本式设计感。整体呈现小主体、大留白、强提炼、高识别度、安静、童趣、轻松、诗意而高级的视觉气质，避免商业卡通感、电商感和模板感。

items.title: 极简主义首尔旅行杂志风海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的纯图形化旅行海报模板，不需要人物参考图或其他文件输入。保留明确要求的英文与韩文排版文字，并以韩国建筑与首尔地标为视觉主体。
items.prompt:
Create a premium minimalist Seoul travel poster in a 3:4 vertical format. Use a sophisticated editorial travel-magazine style with clean flat-vector illustration, subtle shading, soft pastel sunset colors and an elegant balanced composition.

In the foreground, show a historic Korean hanok street with warm lanterns and only a few small pedestrians. Through the middle ground, add a tree-lined stream. In the background, show Seoul's skyline with N Seoul Tower and Lotte World Tower. Use accurate Korean architecture, generous negative space and a polished cream, soft pink, peach, powder blue, ivory, sage and navy palette.

Set the exact visible text as follows: large SEOUL at the upper left; SOUTH KOREA; A CITY WHERE TRADITION MEETS TOMORROW; Korean text 전통과 미래가 만나는 도시, 서울; a small Seoul postal-style emblem; and a clean cream footer reading RICH HERITAGE · MODERN VIBES · VIBRANT CITY · ENDLESS DISCOVERIES. Keep typography restrained, clean and legible. Do not invent extra text or alter the required wording.

Use clean premium vector-poster finish, subtle shadows and accurate building proportions. No photorealism, watercolor, clutter, excessive people, distorted buildings, random text or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张高级极简主义首尔旅行海报，采用 3:4 纵向画幅。整体使用精致的编辑旅行杂志风格：干净的扁平矢量插图、细腻阴影、柔和的淡彩落日色彩和优雅平衡的构图。

前景展示一条历史悠久的韩国韩屋街道，配有温暖灯笼和少量小型行人。中景加入一条绿树成荫的小溪。背景展示首尔天际线，包含南山首尔塔和乐天世界塔。韩国建筑要准确，留白充足，使用柔和粉色、桃色、粉蓝色、象牙色、鼠尾草绿和海军蓝的高级配色。

画面中的可见文字必须准确如下：左上角大号 SEOUL；SOUTH KOREA；A CITY WHERE TRADITION MEETS TOMORROW；韩文 전통과 미래가 만나는 도시, 서울；一个小型首尔邮政风格徽标；以及干净的奶油色页脚文字 RICH HERITAGE · MODERN VIBES · VIBRANT CITY · ENDLESS DISCOVERIES。排版要克制、清晰且易读，不得擅自编造额外文字或改写这些固定文案。

采用干净高级的矢量海报质感、细腻阴影和准确建筑比例。不要写实摄影、水彩、杂乱、过多人物、扭曲建筑、随机文字或水印。

items.title: 东方神界超尺度皇家建筑摄影
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

16:9 horizontal cinematic frame, oriental divine realm super-scale royal architectural photography, 1980s Hong Kong fantasy wuxia cinematic language + modern photorealistic cinematic VFX. The camera stands in the liminal space between the interior of a super-giant main divine hall and a cloud-adjacent platform, human eye height about 1.4 meters, 32mm lens, level gaze into the distance, no aerial photography.

The foreground is the abnormally massive interior structure of the main hall, with a giant viewing opening, deep vermilion palace lacquer pillars, oily deep wood beams, black-blue multi-layered eaves, cyan-green dougong, and a few ancient gold door decorations; the tops of the pillars, eaves, and beam structures are cropped by the frame, clearly expressing the oppression of the foreground mega-structure. White jade platforms, railings, column bases, and partial wall surfaces are warm and highly polished, with exquisite dragon patterns, cloud patterns, and lotus pattern reliefs, overall royal luxury, clean and magnificent.

The midground is an extremely wide white jade platform adjacent to clouds, where 3 adult oriental female immortals wear pale cyan, moon white, and light apricot long dresses, standing by the edge of the platform talking in low voices and viewing the scenery; the figures are small, serving only as a scale reference.

Beyond the platform is a vast and pure white sea of clouds, the air is extremely clear, with giant stereoscopic cumulus clouds in the distance. At the very far end, a central main god palace must stand at the edge of the sea of clouds, kilometers away but still abnormally massive, horizontally extremely wide, with a heavy foundation and obvious extended wings; the main body is medium-deep blue-grey palace structure, dark blue and black-blue multi-layered eaves, dark vermilion column rows, deep wood beams, and a warm white jade base; slightly washed out by atmospheric perspective, but must maintain a medium-deep color quality, significantly darker than the sea of clouds, cannot be whitened, cannot be shrunk, and cannot become a light, ethereal background.

The overall luminosity structure is: dark foreground frame → bright white jade platform and sea of clouds → medium-deep distant main palace → clear blue sky. The lighting is high-altitude clear daytime strong side-backlight, cloud edges are glowing, shadows are cool and clear, highlights are bright but not overexposed. Overall requirements: clear, luxurious, sacred, solemn, strong royal sense, distant main palace is huge and heavy, the composition is concise with a sense of pressure.

**Forbidden:** Aerial photography, bird's-eye view, ordinary small palaces, shrinking distance, whitened distance, gray fog, full-screen volumetric fog, oversized characters, plants stealing the spotlight, rough textures, ordinary temple feeling, tourist-spot style, plastic white jade, excessive gold, cluttered palace clusters.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

16:9 横向电影画幅，东方神界超尺度皇家建筑摄影，1980s Hong Kong fantasy wuxia cinematic language + modern photorealistic cinematic VFX。摄影机站在一座超巨型神界主殿内部与临云平台交界的阈限空间，人眼高度约 1.4 米，32mm 镜头，平视远方，不航拍。

近景是异常巨大的主殿内部结构，巨型观景开口、深朱宫廷漆柱、油润深木梁架、墨青重檐、青绿斗拱、少量古金门饰，柱顶、檐口、梁架都被画面裁切，明确表现近景巨构压迫。白玉平台、栏杆、柱础与局部墙面温润高抛光，带精致龙纹、云纹、莲纹浮雕，整体皇家奢华、洁净华贵。

中景是一片极宽阔的白玉临云平台，3 位成年东方女仙穿淡青、月白、浅杏长裙，站在平台边低声交谈并观景，人物较小，仅作尺度参照。

平台之外是浩瀚洁白云海，空气极其清澈，远处有巨大立体积云。极远处必须矗立一座云海尽头的中央主神宫，距离数公里却依然异常巨大，横向极宽、台基厚重、双翼延展明显，主体为中深青灰宫体、黛青墨青重檐、暗朱柱列、深木梁架与暖白玉基座；受空气透视略微洗淡，但必须保持中深色质量，明显深于云海，不能白化、不能缩小、不能变轻飘背景。

整体明度结构为：深色近景暗框 → 明亮白玉平台与云海 → 中深色远景主宫 → 清亮蓝天。光线为高空晴朗日间强侧逆光，云边发亮，阴影冷而清透，高光明亮但不过曝。整体要求：清透、华贵、神圣、庄严、皇家感强、远景主宫巨大厚重、画面简洁有压迫感。

**禁止：**航拍、鸟瞰、普通小宫殿、远景缩小、远景白化、灰雾、满屏体积雾、人物过大、植物喧宾夺主、材质粗糙、普通寺庙感、景区风、塑料白玉、过度金色、杂乱宫殿群。

16:9 横幅，超写实东方神界建筑文明摄影，photorealistic cinematic VFX。摄影机站在另一侧平台或桥端，人眼高度约 1.4 米，70mm 中长焦，平视略仰。近景是一条横跨画面中部的建筑级巨型横空廊桥，白玉桥基、深朱桥体、墨青桥檐、古金节点装饰，桥体巨大如可居住的宫殿走廊，两端被裁切，看不到完整边界，占画面 40%–50%。桥下是辽阔高空深渊与翻涌云海断层。极远处高空彼端悬浮着唯一终极主宰——主城核心神宫，城市级 / 山脉级尺度，隔着数公里空间仍占画面高度 30%–36%，远得离谱但依然巨大厚重，体量明显强于前景巨桥。2–3 位极小成年东方仙人在桥上行走，仅作尺度参照。整体明亮清透、能见度高、材质高级、皇家华丽、结构可信，禁止远景缩小、禁止灰雾、禁止普通小桥感。

items.title: 独居客厅驾照持卡土下座创意场景
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的独居客厅、土下座动作和清晰证件道具创意摄影模板。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the only adult female subject; match facial identity only. Create a highly realistic 3:4 vertical conceptual photograph in an ordinary living room of a person living alone. The adult woman performs dogeza on the floor, with her forehead and head close against the floor; the posture and full action must read naturally. Place worn clothes, a carry-on bag and accessories beside her. One hand of the subject enters the frame holding a fictional driver's-license card; both the card and the subject must be clear and sharp, but the card's name, number, address, portrait and all other personal information must be unreadable fictional placeholder texture. Retain “Momoiro John” only as a non-visible source style marker and do not generate a logo or brand identification. Compose around the narrative relationship between the low bowing posture, the card in hand and the living-room objects, with natural indoor photography, believable materials and correct hand anatomy. No extra people, real personal data on the license, readable sensitive information, logos, text watermarks, malformed fingers or distorted limbs.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年女性主体的面部身份参考，仅匹配面部身份。创作3:4竖幅超写实创意摄影：在独居者的普通客厅里，成年女性以土下座姿势跪在地面，额头和头部贴近地板，身体动作清楚而自然。她的旧衣物、随身行李箱和配饰放在旁边，画面中主体的一只手拿着一张虚构的驾照卡进入镜头；驾照卡与主体都必须清楚锐利、不模糊，但卡片上的姓名、号码、地址、照片和其他个人信息必须是不可读的虚构占位纹理。保留“Momoiro John”作为源提示中的非可见风格标记，不生成logo或品牌标识。构图突出低姿态动作、手中证件和客厅物件之间的叙事关系，保持自然室内摄影、真实材质和可信人体手部。不要额外人物、证件真实个人数据、可读敏感信息、logo、文字水印、畸形手指或扭曲肢体。

items.title: 2000年代卡丁车场直闪人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

use the attached image as the main facial reference with high precision. Preserve recognizable identity, exact facial proportions, natural asymmetry, and authentic facial character. Adult woman.

SCENE / COMPOSITION:
Create a vivid late-2000s compact-digital-camera portrait inside an indoor karting venue overlooking the track. Frame vertically from head to upper thighs. She stands beside a silver metal railing with the colorful kart circuit, red barriers, ceiling beams, and bright venue signage filling the background. Keep the composition slightly off-center and candid, like a spontaneous friend-taken snapshot rather than a polished editorial.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Her pelvis shifts softly toward camera-left while the ribcage leans and twists back toward camera-right, creating a visible curve through the waist. One shoulder lifts as she hooks a black racing helmet over it, while the opposite shoulder drops and the free arm hangs naturally beside the railing. Her head is clearly tilted toward the lowered shoulder with the chin angled downward, never straight or upright. She looks down past the camera with softly lowered lids, relaxed brows, slightly parted lips, and a calm sultry expression. Keep the pose fluid and human, with subtle weight shift and relaxed joints rather than mannequin stiffness.

HAIR:
Long pale champagne-blonde hair with a soft side part, lifted crown volume, and smooth layered lengths falling heavily over camera-right shoulder and chest. Fine flyaways and loose face-framing strands catch the overhead light while the opposite side remains tucked back enough to reveal the hoop earring.

MAKEUP / SKIN:
Fair/light peach-beige skin with realistic pores, fine texture, and glossy dimensional highlights. Polished full-glam makeup: feathered brows, softly smoked taupe eyes, refined elongated liner, dense separated lashes, rosy sculpted cheeks, luminous cheekbones and nose, and glossy rose-nude lips. Keep skin bright and fair, never orange, tan, muddy, or flat.

OUTFIT:
Fitted heather-gray asymmetric cropped T-shirt slipping off one shoulder, with subtle rhinestone graphic lettering across the chest. Pair with vivid red racing pants tied loosely around the hips over a red-and-white striped waistband. Large gold hoop earrings, layered gold bracelets, and slim wrist accessories. She carries a glossy black racing helmet with small red detailing over the raised shoulder.

BRANDING:
Integrate lowercase “chryzleen” subtly into the existing rhinestone chest graphic, small but readable and physically part of the shirt design.

ENVIRONMENTAL PHYSICS:
Direct flash creates broad glossy highlights on fair skin, tighter reflections on lips, jewelry, helmet shell, and metal railing, while the gray cotton shirt scatters light softly. The glossy helmet produces stronger specular hotspots; the brushed metal railing reflects narrow bright streaks. Background track lights and colored barriers stay more ambient and slightly darker because of realistic flash falloff, keeping the subject clearly separated from the venue.

CAMERA / LIGHTING:
Premium late-2000s CCD compact digital camera with direct built-in warm-neutral flash, hyper-detailed UHQ. Crisp eyes, lashes, hair strands, skin texture, helmet surface, fabric weave, and jewelry. Realistic flash falloff, slight localized highlight clipping, gentle optical bloom on reflective points, strong local contrast, and slightly dense shadows.

COLOR RENDERING:
Punchy high-density late-2000s compact-digital color with strong separation: vivid racing reds, rich blacks, clean metallic grays, bright fair skin, vibrant venue lights, and saturated track colors. Moderate-high contrast, bright flash-lit highlights, limited dynamic range, and unmistakable consumer-digicam color without modern smartphone HDR.

--ar 4:5

Negative prompt:
upright head, stiff pose, squared shoulders, flat waist, extra limbs, malformed hands, duplicated helmet, weak makeup, orange skin, muddy skin, weak flash, flat smartphone HDR, plastic skin, artificial bokeh, watermark, floating text
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

使用附带的图像作为高精度的主要面部参考。保留可识别的身份、精确的面部比例、自然的非对称性以及真实的面部特征。成年女性。

场景 / 构图：
在室内卡丁车场内，俯瞰赛道，创作一张生动的 2000 年代后期紧凑型数码相机人像。从头部到大腿上部进行垂直构图。她站在银色金属栏杆旁，背景充满了五彩斑斓的卡丁车赛道、红色障碍物、天花板梁和明亮的场馆标牌。构图略微偏离中心且自然，像朋友自发的抓拍，而不是磨皮的社论照。

姿势 / 表情：
她的骨盆轻轻向相机左侧移动，而胸腔向相机右侧倾斜并扭转，在腰部形成明显的曲线。一个肩膀抬起，她将一个黑色赛车头盔挂在上面，而另一个肩膀下垂，空着的手臂自然地垂在栏杆旁。她的头明显向降低的肩膀倾斜，下巴向下倾斜，绝不是直立或竖直的。她低头看向相机下方，眼睑轻微下垂，眉毛放松，嘴唇微张，表情冷静而妩媚。姿势保持流畅和拟人化，带有微妙的重心转移和放松的关节，而不是模特般的僵硬。

发型：
长款淡香槟金色头发，带有柔和的侧分，发顶蓬松，平滑的层次长发沉沉地落在相机右侧的肩膀和胸前。细微的碎发和散乱的修饰脸型的发丝捕捉着头顶的光线，而另一侧则被塞在耳后，足以露出大圆环耳环。

化妆 / 皮肤：
白皙/淡粉米色皮肤，带有真实的毛孔、细腻的纹理和有光泽的立体高光。精致的全妆：羽毛般的眉毛，柔和的烟熏灰褐色眼影，精致的拉长眼线，浓密且根根分明的睫毛，红润的修容脸颊，发光的颧骨和鼻子，以及光泽的玫瑰裸色嘴唇。保持皮肤明亮白皙，绝不显橙色、棕褐色、泥泞或扁平。

服装：
贴身的麻灰色不对称短款 T 恤，从一侧肩膀滑落，胸前有微妙的水钻字母图案。搭配鲜艳的红色赛车裤，松散地系在臀部，露出红白条纹的腰带。大金圆环耳环，层叠的金手链，以及细长的手腕配饰。她抬起的肩膀上提着一个带有红色小细节的黑色亮面赛车头盔。

品牌：
将小写的 “chryzleen” 微妙地融入现有的水钻身形图案中，小巧但清晰可辨，且在物理上属于衬衫设计的一部分。

环境物理：
直接闪光在白皙的皮肤上产生宽阔的光泽高光，在嘴唇、珠宝、头盔外壳和金属栏杆上产生更紧凑的反光，而灰色棉质衬衫则柔和地散射光线。亮面头盔产生更强的镜面亮点；拉丝金属栏杆反射出狭窄的光带。背景赛道灯光和彩色障碍物由于真实的闪光衰减而保持环境感且略暗，使主体与场馆清晰分离。

相机 / 灯光：
带有直接内置暖中性闪光灯的高端 2000 年代后期 CCD 紧凑型数码相机，超高清。锐利的眼睛、睫毛、发丝、皮肤纹理、头盔表面、织物纹理和珠宝。真实的闪光衰减、局部的轻微高光溢出、反射点上的柔和光学晕染、强烈的局部对比和略微浓重的阴影。

色彩渲染：
具有强分离感的鲜艳高密度 2000 年代后期紧凑型数码相机色彩：鲜艳的赛车红、浓郁的黑色、洁净的金属灰、明亮的白皙皮肤、鲜艳的场馆灯光和饱和的赛道颜色。中高对比度，明亮的闪光高光，有限的动态范围，以及标志性的消费级数码相机色彩，没有现代智能手机的 HDR 感。

--ar 4:5

负向提示：
直立的头部，僵硬的姿势，耸肩，扁平的腰部，额外的肢体，畸形的手，重复的头盔，淡妆，橙色皮肤，泥泞的皮肤，微弱的闪光，平淡的智能手机 HDR，塑料皮肤，人造虚化，水印，浮动文字

items.title: 复古千禧风贝兹娃娃妆容双格摄影
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的 Y2K 双格美容人像提示词，保留冰白粉色贝兹娃娃妆容、珍珠装饰、侧向下格肖像和早期便携 CCD 闪光质感，并绑定统一人物参考图。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Use the attached image for facial reference with high precision. Preserve exact facial structure, natural facial width, youthful cheek volume, original proportions, recognizable identity and natural asymmetry. Adult woman with naturally feminine proportions. The same adult woman must appear consistently in both panels.

[BRATZ MAKEUP — HIGHEST PRIORITY] Create dramatic icy-white and pink Bratz eye makeup with opaque shimmering pearl-white pigment wrapping around the inner corners, sweeping across the inner eyelids and continuing beneath the inner lower lash lines. Blend dusty rose-pink shadow across the outer lids and crease, then extend intense jet-black eyeliner into long sharp horizontal feline wings. Add dense separated upper lashes, fine lower lashes and sharply defined dark waterlines. Place tiny individual pearl and crystal embellishments above the eyelids, beside the outer corners and beneath the eyes; each embellishment must appear physically attached to the skin. Brows are dark, straight-to-gently-arched and precisely defined. Apply cool pink blush across both cheeks, subtle reflective highlight along the nose bridge, and vivid nude pink lipstick with full opaque pigment and a satin-gloss finish. Preserve identical matching makeup across both eyes and both panels, realistic iris texture, visible skin pores and natural human facial proportions.

[POSE / EXPRESSION / COMPOSITION] Create a two-panel horizontal diptych. The upper panel occupies approximately 30% of the frame and shows an extreme close-up of both eyes, eyebrows, eyeliner wings, white inner-corner makeup and pearl embellishments; crop out the mouth and most of the forehead. The lower panel occupies approximately 70% of the frame and shows the same woman in a close beauty portrait rotated approximately 90 degrees sideways. Do not straighten the lower portrait. Her head tilts naturally, her half-lidded eyes look sideways with a sultry, dreamy expression, and her lips remain gently closed. Keep the panels separated by a clean thin dark horizontal division. Keep the framing slightly off-center and close, like a spontaneous Y2K compact-camera portrait rather than a polished studio beauty shot. Natural candid composition with slight handheld framing imperfections, layered environmental depth and realistic compact-camera perspective.

[HAIR / OUTFIT / ACCESSORIES] Sleek glossy jet-black shoulder-length bob with sharply cut straight blunt bangs across the forehead, smooth straight sides, realistic strand separation and naturally curved ends. Add a short layered pearl necklace with several small round white pearls visible near the lower portrait edge. A narrow glimpse of a pink garment appears near the shoulder; do not invent additional clothing, earrings, rings or accessories.

[CAMERA / LIGHTING / ENVIRONMENT] Authentic flash-lit early-2000s compact digital camera with clean glossy CCD rendering, direct built-in flash, vivid pink-and-white makeup separation, crisp eyeliner and pearl detail, visible facial pores, restrained nose and lip highlights, slight highlight clipping, gentle optical bloom, mild digital compression and realistic flash falloff. Use a subdued pink-toned indoor atmosphere with a dark understated background. Integrate the exact lowercase word “chryzleen” as tiny tonal embroidery directly into the visible pink garment edge.

--ar 4:5
Negative prompt: altered identity, different faces between panels, narrowed face, elongated face, hollow cheeks, exaggerated doll eyes, plastic skin, mismatched makeup, missing white inner-corner shadow, missing pearl embellishments, missing diptych, single-panel composition, straightened lower portrait, wide blank eyes, missing head tilt, different hairstyle, missing blunt bangs, missing pearl necklace, invented accessories, heavy grain, DSLR bokeh, floating text, watermark, screenshot counter, carousel indicator, added nameplate.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

使用附图作为高精度的面部参考。保持精确的面部结构、自然的面部宽度、青春的脸颊丰盈度、原始比例、可辨认的身份和自然的非对称性。具有自然女性比例的成年女性。同一名成年女性必须在两个面板中保持一致。

[贝兹娃娃妆容 — 最高优先级] 创建戏剧性的冰白色和粉色贝兹娃娃眼妆，不透明的闪烁珍珠白颜料包裹内眼角，横跨内眼睑，并延伸至内下睫毛线下方。在外部眼睑和折痕处晕染枯玫瑰粉色眼影，然后将浓烈的喷射黑眼线延伸成细长的锐利水平猫眼翼。添加浓密的根根分明的上睫毛、精细的下睫毛和轮廓清晰的深色内眼线。在眼睑上方、外眼角旁和眼睛下方放置微小的独立珍珠和水晶装饰；每个装饰必须看起来物理吸附在皮肤上。眉毛为深色、平直微拱且轮廓精准。在双颊扫上冷粉色腮红，鼻梁处有细微的反光高光，涂抹饱满不透明且具有缎面光泽效果的鲜艳裸粉色口红。保持双眼和两个面板中完全匹配的妆容、逼真的虹膜纹理、可见的皮肤毛孔和自然的人类面部比例。

[姿势 / 表情 / 构图] 创建一个双格水平二分图。上方格子占据约 30% 的画幅，显示双眼、眉毛、眼线翼、白色内眼角妆容和珍珠装饰的极端特写；裁剪掉嘴巴和大部分额头。下方格子占据约 70% 的画幅，显示同一名女性在特写美容肖像中侧向旋转约 90 度。不要扶正下方的肖像。她的头自然倾斜，半睁的眼睛带着妩媚梦幻的神情看向侧面，嘴唇保持轻轻闭合。用一条整洁的深色薄水平分割线分开面板。保持取景略微偏离中心且紧凑，像一张自发的 Y2K 便携相机肖像，而不是精致的影棚美容大片。自然随意的构图，带有轻微的手持构图缺陷、分层的环境深度、逼真的便携相机透视。

[发型 / 服装 / 配饰] 光滑亮泽的喷射黑及肩波波头，额头上有裁剪整齐的平直齐刘海，侧面平滑顺直，有真实的丝缕分明感和自然的弯曲发尾。添加一条短款分层珍珠项链，在下方肖像边缘可见几颗圆形白色小珍珠。肩膀附近出现一抹粉色服装；不要虚构额外的衣物、耳环、戒指或配饰。

[相机 / 灯光 / 环境] 真实的 2000 年代早期闪光灯便携数字相机，具有干净亮泽的 CCD 渲染、内置直射闪光灯、鲜艳的粉白妆容区分度、清晰的眼线和珍珠细节、可见的面部毛孔、克制的鼻部和唇部高光、轻微的高光溢出、柔和的光学晕染、轻微的数字压缩感和真实的闪光灯衰减。使用柔和的粉色调室内氛围和深色低调背景。将完全小写的单词 “chryzleen” 作为细小的色调刺绣直接融入可见的粉色衣服边缘。

--ar 4:5

负面提示：改变的身份、面板间不同的脸部、变窄的脸、拉长的脸、凹陷的脸颊、夸张的娃娃眼、塑料皮肤、不匹配的妆容、缺失的白色内眼角眼影、缺失的珍珠装饰、缺失的双格图、单面板构图、扶正的下方肖像、圆睁的呆滞眼睛、缺失的头部倾斜、不同的发型、缺失的齐刘海、缺失的珍珠项链、虚构的配饰、重颗粒感、单反虚化、漂浮文本、水印、屏幕截图计数器、轮播指示器、添加的标牌。

items.title: 暖色卧室读书生活方式肖像
items.description: 成年女性在暖色极简卧室中靠枕读书的非性化写实生活方式肖像。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible adult woman; match facial identity only. Create a 2:3 vertical photorealistic bedroom lifestyle portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman semi-reclined on soft bedding against off-white linen pillows, framed from head to upper thighs. She leans back naturally with legs softly blurred in the foreground; an open paper book lies horizontally in front of the lower abdomen, her right hand resting on the pages and left hand lightly touching her hair. She looks directly at camera with a soft confident smile and natural dimples. Give her a refined mature face, dark brown almond eyes, natural makeup, pale peach blush and nude-pink lips. Long thick dark brown-black hair spreads over shoulders and pillows in soft waves. Dress her in a modest opaque light-pink short-sleeve lounge top and a light neutral skirt mostly hidden by the book and foreground; keep clothing non-revealing and not the focus. Use a warm minimalist bedroom with off-white sheets, linen pillowcases, beige walls, bright window and light curtains at back right. Soft natural window light enters from the right, with delicate shadows and no flash. Use a 50mm or 85mm shallow-depth lens, precise eye focus, warm creamy low-saturation tones, real skin and linen texture, subtle 35mm grain and gentle highlight roll-off. Preserve a private but non-sexual lifestyle editorial mood. No lingerie, nudity, sexualized pose, text, logo, watermark or distorted anatomy.
items.prompt_zh: 请使用上传的参考图作为画面中主要成年女性的面部身份参考，仅匹配面部身份。创作一张2:3竖幅写实卧室生活方式肖像：一位明确成年的东亚女性半躺在柔软床品上，靠着米白亚麻枕头，画面从头部到大腿上方。她自然后靠，前景双腿柔和虚化；一本打开的纸书横放在下腹前方，右手自然放在书页上，左手轻触头发。她直视镜头，露出柔和自信的微笑和自然酒窝。面部成熟精致，深棕杏眼，自然妆容、浅桃粉腮红和裸粉色嘴唇。浓密深棕黑长发以柔和波浪散在肩头和枕头上。她穿端庄不透明的浅粉色短袖居家上衣和浅色下装，下装大部分被书本与前景遮挡；服装保持不暴露且不是画面焦点。环境为暖色极简卧室，米白床单、亚麻枕套、米色墙面，右后方有明亮窗户和浅色窗帘。柔和窗光从右侧进入，形成细腻阴影，不使用闪光灯。使用50mm或85mm浅景深镜头，精准对焦眼睛，暖奶油色低饱和色调，真实皮肤和亚麻纹理，细微35mm颗粒与柔和高光过渡。保持私密但非性化的生活方式编辑氛围。不要内衣、裸露、性化姿势、文字、logo、水印或畸形解剖。

items.title: 敦煌美学东方时尚半身人像

items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

9:16 vertical version, half-body close-up, high-definition real photography × Dunhuang mural aesthetics × High-end Oriental fashion Editorial. Frontal eye-level view, centered symmetrical composition, lens shot to above the waist, fully presenting the gorgeous crown, exquisite face, shoulders, neck, collarbones, low-cut bodice, arms, and overlapping hands. The character occupies about three-quarters of the frame, avoiding cropping of headwear, hands, and chest.

A 20-year-old, clearly adult beautiful Asian woman with a slender and elegant figure, stretched shoulders and neck, dignified posture, and a visual chest size of approximately a natural D cup, full but not overly exaggerated. Small and exquisite Oriental face shape, clear jawline, slightly pointed chin, eyes looking softly at the camera, a natural tear mole at the corner of the eye, and a restrained slight smile at the corners of the mouth. The skin is fair and transparent, appearing as real cold white porcelain skin, retaining pores, fine texture, and natural blood color.

Jet-black long hair combed into a full and symmetrical high-positioned ancient-style bun, wearing a centered gilded flower crown inlaid with vermilion gems, jadeite, pearls, and jade; matched with gold hairpins, hanging pearls, tassels, fine pearl chains, and light cyan-green long ribbons on both sides, with clear structure and realistic materials.

Wearing ivory white, beige, light cyan-green, and pale peach pink Dunhuang Flying Apsara ancient costume. The upper body is a low-positioned ancient-style tube top and low-cut neckline, revealing more of the upper chest, shoulders, neck, and collarbones, naturally presenting a coordinated D-cup curve; the bodice includes light gold embroidery, scrolling grass patterns, floral patterns, pearls, and fine gold chains. Light cyan-green silk ribbons drape diagonally from one shoulder, arms paired with thin translucent long sleeves and drooping gauze bands, wearing jadeite, pearl, and gilded necklaces.

The character's hands are gently overlapped over the upper abdomen, with one hand naturally resting on the other's wrist or back of the hand, fingers clearly separated and naturally structured, avoiding stiffness and perspective distortion.

The background is a Dunhuang grotto mural with the texture of cracks, peeling, and mineral pigments. A complete and symmetrical circular lotus caisson halo is set behind the character's head, using pale coral pink, light cyan-green, ochre red, dark blue, off-white, and soft gold scrolling grass, flowers, cloud patterns, and flying bird patterns, moderately blurred but the circular outline remains complete.

70–85mm portrait lens, cinematic soft side-backlighting, warm gold rim light outlining the flower crown, hair strands, shoulders, neck, jewelry, and edges of ribbons, natural fill light on the face, precise focus on both eyes. High-definition 8K details, realistic skin, silk, gauze, embroidery, gemstones, and metal textures, natural shallow depth of field, slight cinematic soft focus and fine film texture. Overall low-saturation light cyan-green, ivory white, pale pink, ochre red, and soft gold tones, elegant, solemn, gorgeous, ethereal, and possessing Oriental divine beauty.

Negative Prompts:
Western features, big head and big face, unbalanced proportions, exaggerated or asymmetrical chest, over-gathering, shoulder and neck deformity, arm errors, twisted wrists, stuck fingers, extra fingers, missing fingers, extra limbs, exaggerated hand perspective, wide-angle distortion, headwear cropping, hand cropping, character too small, full-body composition, tilted or floating flower crown, stuck accessories, cheap ancient costumes, clothing clipping, broken ribbons, floating necklaces, offset or incomplete circular halo, asymmetrical background, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, messy makeup, overexposure, dead black, low resolution, out of focus, cartoon, anime, CGI, AI artifacts, text, logo, border, black edges, watermark.

一位 20 岁、明确成年的漂亮亚洲女性，身材纤细修长，肩颈舒展，体态端庄，身形视觉约为自然 D 罩杯，丰满但不过度夸张。小巧精致的东方脸型，清晰下颌线、微尖下巴，眼神柔和地看向镜头，眼角有一颗自然泪痣，嘴角带克制浅笑。肌肤白皙通透，呈真实冷白瓷肌，保留毛孔、细微肌理与自然血色。

妆容为精致敦煌飞天妆，朱红、赤金、浅棕与少量青绿色眼妆，纤细眼线，额间绘对称朱红花钿，眼下点缀少量金箔，珊瑚朱红水润唇色，古典华丽但不显浓重舞台感。

乌黑长发梳成饱满对称的高位古风盘发，佩戴居中的鎏金花冠，镶嵌朱红宝石、翡翠、珍珠与玉石；两侧搭配金簪、垂珠、流苏、细珠链与浅青绿色长飘带，结构清晰、材质真实。

身穿象牙白、米杏色、浅青绿与淡蜜桃粉敦煌飞天古装。上身为低位古风抹胸与低胸领口，露出较多上胸、肩颈与锁骨，自然呈现协调的 D 罩杯曲线；胸衣加入浅金刺绣、卷草纹、花卉纹、珍珠与细金链。浅青绿色丝绸披帛从一侧肩部斜垂，双臂搭配轻薄半透明长袖与垂坠纱带，佩戴翡翠、珍珠与鎏金项链。

人物双手在上腹部轻柔交叠，一只手自然搭在另一只手腕或手背上，手指清晰分离、结构自然，避免僵硬与透视变形。

背景为具有裂纹、剥落与矿物颜料质感的敦煌石窟壁画。人物头部后方设置完整对称的圆形莲花藻井光环，采用淡珊瑚粉、浅青绿、赭红、暗蓝、米白与柔金色卷草、花卉、云纹和飞鸟纹样，适度虚化但圆形轮廓保持完整。

70–85mm 人像镜头，电影级柔和侧逆光，暖金轮廓光勾勒花冠、发丝、肩颈、珠宝与披帛边缘，面部自然补光，双眼精准对焦。高清 8K 细节，真实皮肤、丝绸、薄纱、刺绣、宝石与金属质感，自然浅景深，轻微电影柔光与细腻胶片质感。整体低饱和浅青绿、象牙白、淡粉、赭红与柔金色调，清雅、庄重、华丽、空灵而具有东方神性美感。

负面提示词：

欧美五官，大头大脸，比例失衡，身形夸张或不对称，过度聚拢，肩颈畸形，手臂错误，手腕扭曲，手指粘连、多指、缺指、多余肢体，手部透视夸张，广角畸变，头饰裁切，手部裁切，人物过小，全身构图，花冠歪斜或悬浮，饰品粘连，廉价古装，衣物穿模，披帛断裂，项链悬浮，圆形光环偏移或残缺，背景不对称，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，妆容脏乱，过曝，死黑，低清晰度，失焦，卡通，动漫，CGI，AI 伪影，文字，Logo，边框，黑边，水印。

items.title: ALIGN 空间视错觉透视排版海报
items.description: Concrete bilingual adaptation for an anamorphic ALIGN typography poster with resolved project, spatial system, reveal mechanism, subject, color, and 9:16 format.
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

TITLE: ALIGN
PROJECT: MOTION LAB / KINETIC FORM
SPATIAL SYSTEM: rotating panels
REVEAL MECHANISM: alignment
SUBJECT: small human figure
MAIN COLOR: electric red
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a contemporary perspective typography poster where the main word becomes readable only when the spatial elements, viewpoint or light are correctly aligned.

The title should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition, but it must not simply be printed as normal text. Break the letterforms across physical structures so they appear fragmented or abstract from other viewpoints, then visually resolve into one clear word from the intended camera position.

For negative space, build the letters from openings cut through multiple architectural layers.
For shadows, let physical structures cast separate shapes that align into the word.
For rotating panels, split the typography across panels at different angles so they reconnect only at one precise phase.
For angled fins, distribute narrow slices of the word across repeated surfaces so the full title appears only from one viewing direction.

Keep perspective, scale, occlusion, lighting and geometry physically believable. The reveal should feel like a real installation rather than a digital overlay.

Use one strong accent color with a restrained architectural palette. Keep the typography bold, geometric and visually powerful when correctly aligned.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them as a scale reference or observer interacting naturally with the installation.

Add only a small amount of secondary editorial information such as project name, location, date and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, anamorphic installation, spatial graphic design, contemporary architecture, editorial poster, clean hierarchy and strong visual impact.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

标题：[打开 / 对齐 / 相位 / 旋转 / 你的关键词]
项目：[品牌 / 展览 / 活动名称]
空间系统：[负空间 / 阴影 / 旋转面板 / 成角度的鳍片 / 其他]
揭晓机制：[视点 / 光线 / 对齐 / 旋转]
主体：[小型人物形象 / 无]
主色调：[强调色]
格式：9:16 垂直海报

创作一张当代透视排版海报，只有当空间元素、视点或光线正确对齐时，主词才会变得清晰可读。

标题应占据构图的约 35–55%，但绝不能简单地以常规文本形式印刷。将字母形状分解到物理结构中，使它们从其他视点看去呈现碎片化或抽象化，然后从预定的相机位置在视觉上解析为一个清晰的单词。

对于负空间，通过切割多个建筑层的开口来构建字母。
对于阴影，让物理结构投射出独立的形状，并对齐成单词。
对于旋转面板，将排版分散到不同角度的面板上，使它们仅在一个精确的相位重新连接。
对于成角度的鳍片，将单词的窄切片分布在重复的表面上，使完整标题仅从一个观看方向出现。

保持透视、比例、遮挡、照明和几何形状在物理上是可信的。揭晓的过程应该感觉像是一个真实的装置，而不是数字叠加。

使用一种强烈的强调色和克制的建筑色调。当正确对齐时，保持排版大胆、几何化且具有强大的视觉冲击力。

如果包含人物，请保持其体型微小，并将其用作比例参考或自然地与装置互动的观察者。

仅添加少量的次要编辑信息，如项目名称、地点、日期和一行简短的主题。

整体风格：透视排版、变形装置、空间平面设计、当代建筑、编辑海报、清晰的层级和强烈的视觉冲击力。

items.prompt:

items.title: 银灰猫咪唤醒熟睡女子
items.description: 固定机位卧室随拍：银灰猫走近熟睡女子，与画外手互动后在被子上转身趴稳，女子醒来并自然微笑。
items.prompt:
Use the provided first-frame image to create a 15-second, 9:16, photorealistic video with a casual smartphone-recording texture, filmed in one continuous take. Strictly preserve the first frame's woman's identity, face shape, facial features, long straight dark-brown center-parted hair, pink spaghetti-strap sleepwear, white pillow and bedding, dark-brown headboard, and warm lamp in the upper left. The woman remains lying on the right side of the frame; a silver-gray short-haired cat starts at the far left. Fixed camera, no cuts, dolly moves or zooms; retain only very slight handheld breathing drift.

0–2.5 seconds: The woman sleeps with her eyes closed, her body still. The cat walks rightward along the bed from the far left, approaching and stopping beside her face. The distance between the cat and the woman gradually decreases.

2.5–5.5 seconds: One index finger of the same off-camera hand enters from below and stops in front of the cat's nose and chin. The cat first sniffs the fingertip, then gently rubs its nose and chin against the finger. The woman's eyes remain closed.

5.5–7 seconds: The index finger moves slowly upward, and the cat raises its head to follow. Awakened by the movement, the woman slowly opens her eyes, first looks at the cat, then looks toward the camera.

7–9 seconds: The same off-camera hand supports the cat beneath its chest, naturally moves it forward toward the center of the frame, and briefly lifts it. The cat has believable weight; its body and all four limbs remain anatomically normal, without struggling or deformation.

9–11 seconds: The hand places the cat on the blanket over the woman's chest. The cat sits steadily facing the camera for about one second, then turns its head toward the woman and immediately begins turning its body.

11–12.5 seconds: The cat completes the turn in one continuous movement, with its hindquarters and back facing the camera, then shuffles forward into the nearby lower foreground. The hand naturally exits the frame.

12.5–15 seconds: The cat's silver-gray striped back fills the lower half of the frame as it settles into a stable lying position facing away from the camera. The woman looks over the cat's back toward the camera and gives a natural, restrained smile. Hold a stable ending, with only breathing and one natural blink.

Throughout, there is exactly one woman, one cat and one off-camera hand. Keep the cat's size, round face, silver-gray stripes and four limbs consistent, and preserve the woman's identity and hairstyle. No additional people, cats, hands or fingers; no face swaps, bangs, hair-color changes, cat deformation, extra limbs, hand clipping, skipped frames, teleportation, sudden pose changes, camera moves, shot-size changes, text, subtitles, logos, watermarks or black borders. Quiet bedroom ambience, with optional subtle bedding rustles, paw sounds and purring; no dialogue or music.
items.prompt_zh:
使用提供的首帧图生成15秒、9:16、写实手机随拍质感的一镜到底视频。严格保持首帧中的人物身份、脸型、五官、深棕色中分长直发、粉色细肩带睡衣、白色枕头与被子、深棕床头和左上角暖灯；人物始终躺在画面右侧，银灰色短毛猫从画面最左侧开始。固定机位，不切镜、不推拉、不变焦，只保留很轻的手机呼吸感。

0–2.5秒：女人闭眼熟睡，身体不动。猫从画面最左侧沿床面向右走近，来到女人脸旁并停下，猫与女人之间的距离逐渐缩短。

2.5–5.5秒：画面下方伸入同一只画外手的一根食指，停在猫鼻子和下巴前。猫先闻指尖，再用鼻尖和下巴轻轻蹭手指；女人仍闭眼。

5.5–7秒：食指缓慢向上移动，猫抬头追随手指。女人被动作惊醒，慢慢睁眼，先看猫，再看向镜头。

7–9秒：同一只画外手从下方托住猫的前胸，把猫自然地向前、向画面中央移动并短暂抬起；猫有真实重量，四肢和身体保持正常，不挣扎、不变形。

9–11秒：手把猫放在女人胸前的被子上，猫面向镜头坐稳约一秒；随后猫转头看向女人，并立即开始转身。

11–12.5秒：猫连续完成转身，臀部和背部朝向镜头，向前挪到画面下方近处；手自然退出画面。

12.5–15秒：猫的银灰条纹背部占据画面下半部，保持背对镜头趴稳；女人越过猫背看向镜头，露出自然、克制的微笑。结尾稳定停留，只有呼吸和一次自然眨眼。

全程只有一名女人、一只猫和一只画外手。保持猫的体型、圆脸、银灰条纹和四肢稳定；保持女人身份与发型稳定。禁止新增人物、猫、手或手指，禁止换脸、刘海、发色变化、猫变形、额外肢体、手穿模、跳帧、瞬移、突然换姿势、镜头运动、景别变化、文字、字幕、Logo、水印和黑边。安静卧室环境声，可有轻微被面摩擦、猫爪声和呼噜声，不要对白与配乐。

items.title: 新加坡滨海湾3D等距微缩地理景观
items.description: 新加坡滨海湾博物馆级3D等距微缩地理模型，七个真实地标围绕海湾按空间关系组织，配准确页眉与新加坡国旗。
items.prompt: Create a premium vertical 2:3 high-angle three-quarter isometric miniature diorama of Singapore, focused on the recognizable Marina Bay core. Use the smallest raised terrain footprint that clearly represents the bay and keep the entire footprint visible and uncropped. Preserve Marina Bay's curved waterfront, harbor water, bridges, gardens, and correct spatial relationships, simplified only for clarity. Maintain 75% iconic core and 25% supporting context, excluding generic suburbs. Include each of these seven authentic elements exactly once with clear hierarchy: Marina Bay Sands and the Merlion as hero landmarks; the ArtScience Museum, Gardens by the Bay Supertrees, Singapore Flyer, Esplanade, and Helix Bridge as supporting landmarks. Keep Marina Bay Sands on the south waterfront, ArtScience Museum beside it, Helix Bridge spanning toward the north waterfront, Merlion across the bay facing Marina Bay Sands, Esplanade along the northern shore, Singapore Flyer behind the north-east waterfront, and Supertrees beyond the south-east gardens. Connect them naturally through shoreline promenades, water, bridges, parks, plazas, streets, foliage, and sculpted terrain. Use the bay and Helix Bridge as a visual axis toward Marina Bay Sands. Compose foreground harbor water and promenade, mid-ground Merlion, Helix Bridge and Marina Bay Sands, and background Esplanade, Flyer and Supertrees. Render a museum-quality realistic architectural miniature with orthographic-like perspective, detailed glass, stone, metal, water and foliage, ambient occlusion, soft contact shadows, and coherent scale. The diorama fills 68-75% of the frame with generous upper negative space, a warm off-white studio background, and a subtle ground shadow. At top center render exactly: large bold condensed uppercase SINGAPORE; below it smaller tracked uppercase SINGAPORE · SOUTHEAST ASIA; beside the subtitle a small accurate Singapore flag with a red upper half, white lower half, white crescent, and five white stars. No other text. Keep the result elegant, photorealistic, architectural, and instantly recognizable. Avoid people, inaccurate geography, generic filler, duplicated or invented landmarks, overcrowding, unstable tiny structures, excessive distortion, cropped terrain, incorrect text or flag, cartoon, chibi, toy-like, flat or low-poly styling, logos, signatures, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张优质竖版2:3高角度四分之三等距微缩景观模型，目的地为新加坡，聚焦最具辨识度的滨海湾核心。使用能清楚代表海湾的最小抬高地形基底，保持完整足迹可见且不裁切。保留滨海湾弧形水岸、港湾水体、桥梁、花园与正确空间关系，仅为清晰度适当简化。构成保持75%标志性核心与25%辅助背景，排除普通郊区。以下七个真实元素各出现一次并形成明确层级：以滨海湾金沙与鱼尾狮为核心地标；以艺术科学博物馆、滨海湾花园超级树、新加坡摩天观景轮、滨海艺术中心和螺旋桥为次要地标。保持滨海湾金沙位于南侧水岸，艺术科学博物馆紧邻其旁，螺旋桥跨向北岸，鱼尾狮位于海湾对岸并朝向金沙，滨海艺术中心沿北岸，新加坡摩天观景轮位于东北水岸后方，超级树位于东南花园深处。通过滨水步道、水面、桥梁、公园、广场、道路、植被与雕塑地形自然连接；以海湾和螺旋桥作为通往金沙的视觉轴。前景为港湾水面与步道，中景为鱼尾狮、螺旋桥和滨海湾金沙，背景为滨海艺术中心、观景轮和超级树。使用类正交透视，呈现博物馆级写实建筑微缩模型，玻璃、石材、金属、水体和植被细节真实，包含环境光遮蔽、柔和接触阴影与统一比例。微缩景观占画面68-75%，上方保留大量负空间，背景为温暖米白色工作室，并有细腻地面投影。顶部正中仅准确呈现：大号粗体压缩英文 SINGAPORE；下方较小字距展开的 SINGAPORE · SOUTHEAST ASIA；副标题旁放置小型准确的新加坡国旗，上半红、下半白，含白色新月与五颗白星。不得出现其他文字。整体优雅、照片级真实、建筑感强，并能瞬间识别。避免人物、错误地理、通用填充物、重复或虚构地标、过度拥挤、微小不稳定结构、过度变形、裁切地形、错误文字或国旗、卡通、Q版、玩具化、扁平或低多边形风格、标志、签名和水印。
