Reproduce a normal-mode phone look with 24-28mm equivalent perspective, slight exposure variation, mild phone sharpening, small noise, real white balance, partial softness and imperfect candid framing. Focus on correct hands, fingers, limbs and joints. Avoid underage appearance, lingerie, exposed underwear, cleavage emphasis, nudity, deliberate sexy posing, body distortion, extra limbs, influencer retouching, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, studio or hotel styling, CG, text, logos and watermarks.

items.prompt:

Her hands appear dramatically larger due to an extreme wide-angle perspective, creating a fun, dynamic composition. The Brooklyn Bridge stone towers, suspension cables, metal framework, and Manhattan skyline are visible in the background. Warm sunlight shines from behind her, producing beautiful rim lighting, subtle lens flare, and long shadows across the brick walkway. Low-angle camera perspective, exaggerated foreground depth, ultra-wide 14mm lens effect, energetic Gen-Z street photography aesthetic, natural skin texture, realistic details, warm cinematic color grading, sharp focus, photorealistic, vertical 4:5 composition.
items.prompt_zh:

items.title: 韩系时尚人物设定三视图与九宫格表情参考图
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的人物设定参考图模板。上半部分生成同一人物同一穿搭的全身正面、侧面、背面三视图，下半部分生成 9 个半身表情动作；穿搭通过必填变量指定，并提供普通时尚默认示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Reference the same adult female portrait in the image, maintaining consistent facial features, face shape, skin tone, hairstyle, and overall temperament. Black hair tied in a low bun with natural loose strands on the sides, white flower hair accessory, pearl earrings, exquisite natural makeup, realistic human photography, high-end Korean fashion photography texture.

Generate a clean character setting reference sheet / Character Sheet, light beige solid color studio background, soft and even lighting, high-definition realistic photography quality.

The upper part is a complete full-body three-view, showing the character from head to toe:
FRONT
SIDE
BACK

The three views must be the same person, the same outfit, the same hairstyle, the same shoes, with unified character proportions, natural standing poses, and accurate front and back clothing structures.

Outfit:
a tailored charcoal blazer, ivory blouse, pleated midi skirt, and black loafers

The lower part generates 9 half-body expression and action references, same person, same outfit, each expression and action clearly different, diverse eye directions, cannot all look directly at the camera:

1. Scornful and Disdainful: Slightly tilted head, half-squinted eyes, corners of the mouth slightly raised, arms crossed over the chest, with a sense of disgust and looking down.
2. Helpless: Closed eyes or slightly rolling eyes, hands spread open with shrugged shoulders, a face saying "there's nothing I can do with you".
3. Secretly Pleased and Smug: An uncontrollable smirk at the corner of the mouth, one hand lightly touching the chin, the other arm crossed, eyes secretly proud.
4. Sweet Eye Contact: Looking tenderly at the camera, soft eyes, a slight sweet smile, hands naturally folded in front of the chest.
5. Sulking: Puffed cheeks, lips slightly pursed, arms crossed, body slightly turned away, eyes intentionally looking to the side.
6. Aggrieved Pouting: Downward-sloping eyebrows, eyes slightly moist, corners of the mouth pointing down, slightly pouting, one hand near the mouth, as if about to cry.
7. Spooked and Terrified: Eyes clearly wide open, body shrinking, arms hugging oneself, shoulders raised, looking nervously toward the side and back.
8. Guilty and Dodging: Eyes quickly moving to the side, not daring to look directly at the camera, one hand lightly touching the neck or chin, looking flustered and guilty.
9. Gritting Teeth: Brows tightly furrowed, teeth clenched, hands on hips or clenched into fists, shoulders tense, clearly angry but not overly exaggerated.

Requirements: All expressions must be natural and realistic, the face must not be distorted or weird, actions must match the corresponding emotions. Maintain high consistency of character identity, do not appear with different face shapes, do not change hair color, do not randomly add accessories.

Overall style: Realistic human, Korean magazine model reference sheet, fashion Lookbook, character setting collection, clean light-colored background, soft studio lighting, realistic skin texture, realistic hair details, realistic clothing materials, high-definition details, neat composition, complete character, no cropping of hands or feet, no repetitive actions, no extra figures.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

参考图中同一位成年女性人像，保持五官、脸型、肤色、发型与整体气质一致。黑色头发盘成低位发髻，两侧自然碎发，白色花朵发饰，珍珠耳坠，精致自然妆容，真人写实，高级韩系时尚写真质感。

生成一张干净的人物设定参考图 / Character Sheet，浅米白纯色摄影棚背景，柔和均匀布光，高清真实摄影质感。

上半部分为完整全身三视图，人物从头到脚完整展示：
正面 FRONT
侧面 SIDE
背面 BACK

三视图必须是同一人物、同一套衣服、同一发型、同一鞋子，人物比例统一，站姿自然，衣服前后结构准确。

穿搭：
a tailored charcoal blazer, ivory blouse, pleated midi skirt, and black loafers

下半部分生成9个半身表情动作参考，同一人物、同一穿搭，每个表情动作明显不同，眼神方向丰富，不能全部直视镜头：

1. 轻蔑不屑：微微侧头，半眯眼，嘴角轻挑，双臂抱胸，带嫌弃和看不起的感觉
2. 无奈：闭眼或轻轻翻白眼，双手摊开耸肩，一脸拿你没办法
3. 暗爽得意：嘴角压不住的偷笑，一只手轻碰下巴，另一只手抱胸，眼神偷偷得意
4. 甜蜜对视：温柔看向镜头，眼神柔软，轻微甜笑，双手自然交叠放在胸前
5. 生闷气：鼓着脸，嘴唇微抿，双手抱胸，身体稍微转开，眼神故意看向旁边
6. 委屈撇嘴：眉毛下压，眼眶微湿，嘴角向下，轻轻撇嘴，一只手靠近嘴边，像马上要哭
7. 毛骨悚然：眼睛明显睁大，身体缩紧，双臂抱住自己，肩膀抬起，紧张地看向侧后方
8. 心虚躲闪：眼神快速移向旁边，不敢直视镜头，一只手轻碰脖子或下巴，神态慌张心虚
9. 咬牙切齿：眉头紧皱，咬紧牙齿，双手叉腰或握拳，肩膀紧绷，明显愤怒但不过度夸张

要求所有表情自然真实，脸部不能崩坏，不能诡异，动作必须与对应情绪一致。保持人物身份高度统一，不要出现不同脸型，不要改变发色，不要随机增加饰品。

整体风格：真人写实，韩系杂志模特参考图，时尚Lookbook，人物设定集，干净浅色背景，柔和棚拍光线，真实皮肤纹理，真实头发细节，真实服装材质，高清细节，构图整齐，人物完整，不裁切手脚，不重复动作，不出现多余人物。

items.title: CITRUS POP 柑橘软糖商业摄影广告海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的原创 CITRUS POP 柑橘软糖商业广告海报模板。糖果卷是绝对产品主角，橙色果汁喷发、切片橙子、清晰包装、原创英文广告文案和人物整合共同构成高端 FMCG 实拍广告；英文提示词已从来源完整文本压缩至执行限制内。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference for the main woman; preserve other source details.

Create a commercial advertising poster for the original chewy fruit-candy brand "CITRUS POP". Use ultra-realistic product photography with premium FMCG compositing, not illustration, not 3D cartoon render. Keep the same core structural logic: a vivid orange full-frame poster, one joyful young woman in the left-center immersed in a burst of fruity freshness, one hero candy roll held forward in her hand as the absolute product focus, giant oversized background typography, explosive juice motion around the frame, sliced oranges and glossy candy pieces suspended in motion, and a clean minimal benefit strip along the bottom. Core composition: one realistic young woman positioned left-center in three-quarter view, head tilted slightly back, eyes gently closed, expression refreshed and euphoric. Her near hand extends the candy roll toward camera in the lower-left foreground, and the pack must be the sharpest, clearest, and most readable object in the entire image. Behind her, a giant oversized freshness word occupies the upper background as an architectural graphic layer. Around the woman and product, build one strong circular citrus eruption that wraps the scene and visually returns to the candy roll.

Port logic: turn the combination of the candy roll and the orange burst ring into the brand’s super-symbol. The product should feel like the core source of the citrus explosion, while the surrounding circular juice-and-fruit arc becomes its signature energy halo. The viewer should remember the image as "the candy roll inside the orange burst." The symbol must feel ownable, immediate, and iconic.

Orbit logic: shape the splash, fruit slices, floating dragees, droplets, and flowing hair into one coherent circular motion path. The eye should begin at the hero pack, rise through the woman’s face, sweep into the giant headline, circle through the orange burst ring, and resolve back at the product. The motion must feel juicy, explosive, and controlled, never chaotic.

Product concept: redesign the product as "CITRUS POP Orange Chews", a chewy fruity fresh candy roll with bright citrus energy. The pack should be premium, playful, and globally shelf-ready, with a white-and-cobalt master wordmark, glossy orange wrapper ends, fresh citrus cues, and compact claims such as "juicy chew" and "bursting orange". All text must be original.

Female character: one realistic young adult woman with natural anatomy, correct hand structure, five fingers only, realistic skin texture, soft pores, natural lips, believable eyelids, and dynamic flowing hair. She wears a fresh orange-toned jacket or hoodie. Her pose must feel natural and open, with one hand presenting the pack and the body visually connected to the citrus burst.

Lighting: bright warm commercial lighting with a soft frontal key light on the face and product pack, plus glowing citrus backlight through the splash ring. Use crisp highlights on the candy roll, glossy droplets, orange pulp, and wet surfaces. Keep shadows soft and controlled. No muddy oranges, no dead black zones.

Materials and realism: realistic candy roll wrapper print, crisp foil-and-paper texture, believable hand grip, natural skin rendering, semi-translucent juice splash, juicy orange flesh texture, glossy candy dragees, sparkling droplets, and energetic yet physically coherent fluid motion. Every element must obey premium advertising lighting logic.

Typography and layout: use original English text only, never copy any existing wording. Place one giant top background word such as "BURST" or "FRESH" in oversized bold lettering. Add a central slogan such as "CHEW THE SUN." or "UNWRAP THE BURST." Add one compact circular seal with short copy such as "bursting with orange". Along the bottom, place a minimal benefit strip with concise labels such as "fruity fresh", "juicy chew", "long-lasting", and "shareable joy". Typography must be bold, architectural, and secondary to the candy roll.

Color strategy: dominant electric orange, citrus gold, warm tangerine, white highlights, cobalt brand lettering, and tiny green leaf accents. Keep the palette saturated, joyful, premium, and tightly controlled.

Quality and physical rules: extremely sharp hero pack, readable label, correct hand anatomy, believable splash flow, clean edge separation, premium citrus detail, no clutter, no warped pack, no deformed face, no extra fingers, no muddy gradients, no low-resolution fluid effects. The candy roll and its orange burst ring must remain the strongest visual sales trigger at all times.

Negative prompt: copied branding, copied slogan, weak product hierarchy, blurry pack, unreadable label, distorted hand, extra fingers, fused fingers, plastic skin, deformed face, muddy orange background, chaotic splash effects, excessive fantasy clutter, cheap retail flyer aesthetic, cartoon rendering, CGI toy look, low-resolution pack detail, product losing dominance.
items.prompt_zh:
将上传的人物参考图用于主要可见女性的身份；保留来源中的其他场景细节。

为名为“CITRUS POP”的原创嚼劲水果糖品牌创作一张旗舰商业广告海报，结合 Orbit 能量与 Port 符号力量。使用超写实产品摄影与高端快消品（FMCG）合成技术，而非插图，也不是 3D 卡通渲染。保持相同的核心结构逻辑：一张生动的全画幅橙色海报，左中位置有一名沉浸在水果新鲜爆发中的愉悦年轻女性，手中向前握着一卷作为绝对产品核心的主视觉糖果卷，背景有巨大的超大号版式，画框周围有爆发性的果汁动态，悬浮着切开的橙子和光泽的糖果块，底部有一条简洁精干的效益条。糖果卷在任何时候都必须保持为绝对的产品主角。

风格锁定：高能量快消品糖果广告，超洁净商业现实主义，清晰的包装拍摄质量，高端水果新鲜概念，产品优先层级，饱和的柑橘橙色调，精致的摄影棚人像结合，全球发布的活动视觉。

核心构图：一名真实的年轻女性位于左中位置，呈现四分之三侧面观，头微后仰，双眼微闭，表情清新愉悦。她靠近的这只手向镜头伸出糖果卷，位于左下方前景，包装必须是整个图像中最锐利、最清晰、最易读的物体。在她身后，一个巨大的超大号新鲜单词作为建筑图形层占据上方背景。环绕着女性和产品，构建一个强大的圆形柑橘喷发，包裹整个场景并视觉上回归到糖果卷。

Port 逻辑：将糖果卷与橙色喷发环的组合转化为品牌的超级符号。产品应该感觉像是柑橘爆炸的核心源头，而周围的圆形果汁和水果弧线则成为其标志性的能量光环。观众应该将该图像记忆为“橙色喷发中的糖果卷”。该符号必须具有归属感、即时感且具象化。

Orbit 逻辑：将喷溅、水果片、漂浮的糖粒、水滴和飘动的头发塑造成一条连贯的圆周运动路径。视线应从主角包装开始，穿过女性的面部上升，扫入巨大的标题，绕过橙色喷发环，并重新回到产品上。动态必须感觉多汁、爆发且受控，绝不混乱。

产品概念：将产品重新设计为“CITRUS POP Orange Chews”，一种带有明亮柑橘能量的嚼劲水果新鲜糖果卷。包装应该是高端、俏皮且全球上架可用的，带有白蓝相间的主字标、光泽的橙色包装边缘、新鲜的柑橘暗示，以及如“juicy chew”和“bursting orange”等简短声明。所有文字必须是原创的。

女性角色：一名真实的年轻女性，具有自然的解剖结构，正确的手部结构，仅五根手指，真实的皮肤纹理，细腻的毛孔，自然的嘴唇，可信的眼睑，以及动态飘动的头发。她穿着一件新鲜橙色调的外套或连帽衫。她的姿势必须感觉自然大方，一只手展示包装，身体在视觉上与柑橘喷发相连。

灯光：明亮的暖色商业灯光，面部和产品包装上有柔和的前部主灯，加上穿过喷溅环的柔和柑橘背光。在糖果卷、光泽的水滴、橙子果肉和湿润表面上使用清晰的高光。保持阴影柔和受控。没有浑浊的橙色，没有死黑区域。

材质与写实感：真实的糖果卷包装印刷，清晰的箔纸与纸张纹理，可信的手部握持，自然的皮肤渲染，半透明的果汁喷溅，多汁的橙子果肉纹理，光泽的糖果颗粒，晶莹的水滴，以及充满能量但物理连贯的流体运动。每个元素都必须遵循高端广告灯光逻辑。

版式与布局：仅使用原创英文文本，绝不复制任何现有措辞。在上方背景放置一个巨大的单词，如“BURST”或“FRESH”，采用超大号粗体字。添加一个中央口号，如“CHEW THE SUN.”或“UNWRAP THE BURST.”。添加一个紧凑的圆形印章，带有如“bursting with orange”等简短文案。沿底部放置一个极简的效益条，带有如“fruity fresh”、“juicy chew”、“long-lasting”和“shareable joy”等简洁标签。版式必须大胆、具有建筑感，且次于糖果卷。

色彩策略：主导性的电光橙、柑橘金、暖橘红、白色高光、钴蓝色品牌字标和微小的绿叶装饰。保持色调饱和、愉悦、高端且受到严格控制。

质量与物理规则：极其锐利的主角包装，可读的标签，正确的手部解剖，可信的喷溅流向，清晰的边缘分离，高端的柑橘细节，不杂乱，包装不变形，面部不畸形，没有多余手指，没有浑浊渐变，没有低分辨率流体效果。糖果卷及其橙色喷发环在任何时候都必须保持最强的视觉销售触发力。

负面提示：复制的品牌，复制的口号，薄弱的产品层级，模糊的包装，不可读的标签，扭曲的手部，多余的手指，融合的手指，塑料皮肤，畸形的面部，浑浊的橙色背景，混乱的喷溅效果，过度的幻想杂物，廉价的零售传单美学，卡通渲染，CGI 玩具感，低分辨率包装细节，产品失去主导地位。

items.title: 宇宙边缘东方天宫莲花水庭夜景
items.description: 10A身份成年汉服女子置身宇宙边缘的东方天宫月洞门莲花水庭，巨型近地行星悬于古城上空的16:9电影夜景。
items.prompt: Use ref-10a-v1 only for the facial identity of the sole visible 25-year-old adult East Asian woman. Create a 16:9 cinematic Oriental-fantasy midnight scene: an ancient Heavenly Palace city suspended at the edge of the universe, unified, refined, cold, dreamlike, epic, and spatially deep. Set the scene in a moon-gate lotus water garden with a stone bridge. Present the woman as a quiet poetic figure in a two-thirds back view or elegant side profile, never looking at camera or posing. Give her extremely long black hair in an exquisite bun with classical hairpins, flowers, and tassels. Dress her in a high-quality moon-white, ice-blue, fog-blue, and pale violet-blue Hanfu: wide sleeves, trailing skirt, layered light gauze over a fully opaque silk underdress, realistic drape, fine embroidery, hidden patterns, and faint pearl luster. Surround her with dark blue tiled roofs, flying eaves, vermilion corridors and pillars, wooden pavilions, terraces, water pavilions, railings, courtyards, bridges, lotus leaves and flowers, ancient pines, stone lamps, bonsai, restrained gray-pink blossoms, still open water, and layered palaces receding into a grand city. Keep detail elegant and controlled. Across much of the sky place one enormous near-Earth planet, not a moon, with blue atmospheric glow, cloud vortices, ocean textures, continental shadows, and night-city lights, creating monumental cinematic scale. Fix lighting at midnight blue hour: 80% ice-blue, silver-blue, moon-white, ultramarine and blue-black ambient light from the planet and sky; 20% restrained champagne-gold, amber, and warm-yellow palace lamps. Add soft silver-blue rim light to hair, clothing, eaves, railings, and water. Preserve transparent shadow detail, soft highlights, restrained HDR exposure, cold green foliage, realistic stars, faint Milky Way dust, and two meteors. Use a 20-35mm wide-angle four-layer composition: foreground moon gate, eaves, red pillar and pine branch; mid-ground woman and water garden; background palaces, bridge and pavilions; extreme background star field and giant planet. Let stone steps, bridge, corridors, railings, and waterways lead the eye from her toward city and planet. Render real silk, gauze, wood, stone, tile, plants, still-water reflections and aerial perspective, like a high-budget live-action Oriental fantasy film blended with top-tier environmental CG, 8K detail. Avoid daylight, dusk, modern architecture or cities, spaceships, armor, cyberpunk, Western castles, churches, steampunk, neon, anime, childish illustration, cheap costume-drama poster styling, studio portraiture, plastic texture, fluorescent colors, excessive effects, clutter, deformed anatomy or hands, bad architecture, small moon-like bodies, text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 仅将 ref-10a-v1 用于唯一可见25岁成年东亚女性的面部身份。创作16:9电影级幅的东方幻想深夜夜景：一座悬于宇宙边缘的东方天宫古城，风格统一、高级、清冷、梦幻、史诗且空间纵深强烈。具体场景为月洞门旁的莲花水庭与石桥。女子以三分之二背影或优雅侧脸成为环境叙事中的安静诗意主体，不直视镜头、不摆拍。她拥有极长黑发与精致发髻，佩戴古典发簪、花饰和流苏；身穿月白、冰蓝、雾蓝、浅紫蓝汉服长裙，宽袍大袖、裙摆拖地，轻纱层叠于完整不透明的丝绸内裙之上，垂坠真实，带细腻刺绣、暗纹和微弱珠光。环境包含深青瓦、飞檐翘角、朱红廊柱、木楼阁、亭台、水榭、栏杆、庭院、桥梁、莲叶荷花、古松、石灯、盆景、克制的灰粉花朵、安静开阔水面，以及向远方层叠延伸的宏大宫城；细节精致但不过度堆砌。天空大面积横跨一颗巨型近地类地行星，绝非普通月亮；它具有蓝色大气辉光、云层旋涡、海洋纹理、大陆暗影和夜间城市灯光，形成压迫、梦幻且宏伟的电影奇观。光影固定为深夜蓝调：80%由行星与夜空提供的冰蓝、银蓝、月白、群青和蓝黑环境光，20%由宫灯提供的香槟金、琥珀金和柔和暖黄点缀。发丝、衣缘、屋檐、栏杆和水面带柔和银蓝轮廓光；暗部通透有细节，亮部柔和不过曝，采用克制高动态曝光。植物偏冷绿，天空有真实细密星点、淡银河星尘和两颗流星。使用20-35毫米广角四层构图：近景为月洞门、屋檐、红柱和松枝，中景为女子与水庭，远景为宫城、石桥和亭台，极远景为星空与巨型行星；石阶、桥梁、回廊、栏杆和水道将视线从女子引向古城和行星。呈现真实丝绸、薄纱、木材、石材、瓦片、植物、静水倒影与空气透视，效果如高预算东方幻想实拍电影融合顶级环境CG，8K细节。避免白天、黄昏、现代建筑或城市、飞船、机械装甲、赛博朋克、西方城堡、教堂、蒸汽朋克、霓虹灯、动漫、低幼插画、廉价古偶海报、影楼写真、塑料质感、荧光色、特效泛滥、杂乱、人物或手部畸形、错误建筑透视、小月亮式天体、文字、标志和水印。

items.title: 90年代香港皇家女警成年女性夜间持枪街头快照
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

**Photorealistic vertical 1990s Hong Kong nighttime snapshot.**

A clearly adult **20-year-old fictional Hong Kong woman character** wearing a historically inspired **1990s Royal Hong Kong Policewoman cosplay uniform**. Large expressive eyes, realistic doll-like facial features, subtle makeup, natural skin texture, feminine hourglass figure, believable anatomy.

She wears a fitted **muted olive/khaki-green short-sleeved police shirt** with pointed collar, two chest pockets, shoulder epaulettes, dark buttons, black whistle lanyard and simple black leather duty belt, paired with a **matching short above-knee tailored uniform skirt** inspired by late-1980s to mid-1990s Royal Hong Kong Police female uniforms.

She wears a **dark navy female bowler-style police hat** with compact rounded crown, short black visor and centered silver British-era police badge. A compact period-style radio is clipped near her chest. No modern tactical gear.

She stands tensely on a **Hong Kong street at night**, her body slightly angled sideways to the camera. She holds a **Smith & Wesson Model 10 short-barrel revolver with both hands**, both arms **fully extended forward in a ready-to-fire pose**.

Her shoulders and posture show controlled tension. She has a **serious, focused expression** and is **not looking at the camera**; her eyes are fixed intensely toward something outside the frame in the direction of the revolver, as if responding to an uncertain situation during nighttime patrol.

The scene should feel like a candid moment caught just before action rather than a glamour pose.

Behind her are a **period-appropriate 1990s Hong Kong police patrol car and a Hong Kong police motorcycle**, both partly visible. The patrol car headlights are on and **red-and-blue roof lights are flashing**, casting irregular colored reflections across her face, uniform, revolver and the wet-looking asphalt.

Dark Hong Kong roadway, roadside barriers, sodium-vapor streetlights, faint period road signs and distant apartment blocks.

**Vertical cowboy shot, mid-thigh to just above the hat, subject filling about 75–80% of frame. Slight low angle, close 28–35mm point-and-shoot perspective, imperfect handheld framing and slightly tilted horizon.**

**Authentic late-1990s to early-2000s lo-fi consumer 35mm snapshot photography.** Cheap compact point-and-shoot camera, soft imperfect focus, slightly missed autofocus, subtle handheld shake, mild motion softness and weak micro-detail.

**Heavy coarse irregular 35mm grain**, uneven exposure, washed or blown highlights, murky faded shadows and hazy midtones. Muted aged colors, imperfect white balance, green-cyan shadows, warm yellowish streetlight highlights, subdued saturation and slight analog color bleeding.

Red-and-blue police lights softly bloom and bleed across her hat, face, arms and uniform. Headlights become partially blown glowing patches. Soft faded contrast, faint halation, slight haze, minor chromatic aberration and cheap-lens softness.

Looks like an **old drugstore-developed 35mm print poorly scanned at low resolution**: faded texture, dust, tiny scratches, scan noise and compression softness.

**Almost a failed photograph — tense, blurry, grainy, unevenly exposed and poorly scanned, yet believable and nostalgic.**

**Avoid:** looking at camera, smiling, glamour posing, finger-gun gestures, oversized handgun, semi-automatic pistol, long-barrel revolver, modern tactical gear, body armor, modern light-blue Hong Kong Police uniforms, crisp digital sharpness, HDR, polished cinematic grading, studio lighting, perfect autofocus, excessive bokeh, pristine film scan, plastic skin, CGI cleanliness or obvious AI aesthetics.

以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

写实主义垂直90年代香港夜间快照。

一位明确成年的20岁香港女性虚构角色，穿着受历史启发、具有1990年代风格的皇家香港女警角色扮演制服。大而富有表现力的眼睛，写实的玩偶般面部特征，细微的妆容，自然的皮肤纹理，柔美的沙漏型身材，可信的人体解剖结构。

她穿着一件合身的、色调柔和的橄榄色/卡其绿色短袖警察衬衫，带有尖领、两个胸前口袋、肩章、深色纽扣、黑色哨绳和简单的黑色皮革勤务腰带，搭配一条配套的膝盖以上短款裁剪制服裙，其灵感源自1980年代后期至1990年代中期的皇家香港警察女性制服。

她戴着一顶深蓝色女性圆顶帽风格的警帽，帽顶紧凑圆润，配有短黑帽檐和居中的银色英殖时期警察徽章。一个紧凑的年代感无线电对讲机夹在她的胸前附近。没有现代战术装备。

她紧张地站在夜晚的香港街道上，身体微微侧向镜头。她双手持有一把史密斯威森10型短枪管左轮手枪，双臂完全向前伸出，呈现预备射击姿态。

她的肩膀和姿态展现出受控的紧张感。她表情严肃、专注，没有注视镜头；她的眼睛紧盯着框架外沿着左轮手枪方向的某个地方，仿佛正在应对夜间巡逻中的不确定情况。

场景感觉应该像是一个在行动前被捕捉到的瞬间，而不是一张魅力摆拍。

她身后有一辆符合年代感的1990年代香港警察巡巡逻车和一辆香港警察摩托车，均部分可见。巡逻车的车灯亮着，红蓝车顶灯正在闪烁，在她的脸部、制服、左轮手枪和看起来湿漉漉的柏油路上投射下不规则的彩色反光。

黑暗的香港车道、路边护栏、高压钠路灯、模糊的年代感路标和远处的公寓大楼。

垂直牛仔镜头，从大腿中部到帽子上方，主体占据画面约75–80%。轻微低角度，接近28–35mm傻瓜相机透视，不完美的手持构图和略微倾斜的地平线。

真实的1990年代后期至2000年代初期低保真消费级35mm快照摄影。廉价紧凑型傻瓜相机，柔和且不完美的焦距，轻微的自动对焦失误，微妙的手持抖动，轻微的运动模糊和微弱的细节。

沉重粗糙且不规则的35mm颗粒，不均匀的曝光，褪色或过曝的高光，阴暗褪色的阴影和朦胧的中间调。柔和的老化色彩，不完美的白平衡，青绿色的阴影，暖黄色的路灯高光，低饱和度和轻微的模拟色彩溢出。

红蓝警灯在她的帽子、脸部、手臂和制服上柔和地晕染和溢出。大灯变成部分过曝的发光斑块。柔和褪色的对比度，微弱的光晕，轻微的薄雾，轻微的色差和廉价镜头的柔和感。

看起来像是在药店冲洗的老旧35mm照片被低分辨率糟糕扫描后的样子：褪色的质感、灰尘、微小的划痕、扫描噪点和压缩模糊。

几乎是一张失败的照片——紧张、模糊、多颗粒、曝光不均且扫描粗糙，但却真实且令人怀旧。

避免：注视镜头、微笑、魅力摆拍、指枪手势、过大的手枪、半自动手枪、长管左轮手枪、现代战术装备、防弹衣、现代浅蓝色香港警察制服、锐利的数字清晰度、HDR、抛光的电影级调色、摄影棚灯光、完美的自动对焦、过度的焦外虚化、原始的胶片扫描、塑料皮肤、CGI般的整洁感或明显的AI美学。

items.title: 豪宅花园晚宴粉色高定社论
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的水晶流苏礼服、天鹅绒沙发和奢华花园晚宴时装社论模板。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main adult woman; match facial identity only. Create an ultra-realistic luxury evening fashion editorial photograph at an exclusive outdoor garden soiree in a private mansion. An elegant adult woman reclines effortlessly on a deep olive-green velvet sofa, both legs extended along the cushions with one naturally overlapping the other. Turn her body slightly toward the camera and tilt her head gently backward; intentionally crop the upper face so only the lower half is fully visible, with a subtle effortless smile as if laughing with friends. Her left arm drapes over the backrest, while her right hand rests near the collarbone and displays sparkling diamond cocktail rings. Give her luminous champagne-toned skin with visible real texture, long honey-blonde hair in loose Hollywood waves falling naturally over one shoulder, and soft glamorous makeup with champagne shadow, feathered lashes, warm blush, glossy nude lips and naturally sculpted cheekbones. Dress her in a blush-pink couture evening gown covered in delicate crystal embroidery, glass beads, sequins and hand-sewn fringe. The gown has a high draped neckline of shimmering beaded mesh, one elegantly exposed shoulder and a naturally fitted bodice flowing into thousands of long silk-beaded fringe strands. Let the fringe cascade over the sofa's front edge and pool softly onto the grass; every strand follows gravity, with overlaps, slight twists and tiny reflections from nearby lights. Add oversized diamond floral cocktail rings, a diamond bracelet and delicate diamond earrings, with no necklace. Retain a second adult woman behind her in a white off-the-shoulder embroidered floral couture gown, softly out of focus and purely atmospheric, with no identity-bearing face. Set the reception among fresh grass, dark manicured hedges, the deep green sofa, soft candlelight and warm string lights hidden in trees; keep the mood quiet, intimate and luxurious. Combine soft ambient evening light with gentle diffused event light, no hard spotlight or studio lighting. Use wraparound illumination for creamy skin tones and tiny natural specular highlights on every crystal and bead. Render a medium-format photographic feel with natural depth of field and an XCD 90mm f/2.5 lens character, showing fabric, velvet fibers, fringe, pores and reflections as genuinely photographed rather than AI artifacts. Draw on luxury couture evening and fashion-editorial visual language without visible brand logos. No text or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中主要成年女性的面部身份参考，仅匹配面部身份。创作极致写实的奢华晚间时尚社论摄影：在私人豪宅的独家户外花园晚宴中，一位优雅成年女性随性斜倚在深橄榄绿天鹅绒沙发上，双腿沿靠垫伸展，一腿自然叠在另一腿上；身体略转向镜头，头部轻轻后仰，只有下半张脸完整可见，带仿佛与朋友谈笑般含蓄自然的微笑。左臂随意搭靠背，右手停在锁骨附近并展示闪烁钻石鸡尾酒戒指。她有香槟色调、保留真实纹理的肌肤，蜂蜜金色长发为松散好莱坞波浪并自然垂于单肩；妆容柔和迷人，香槟眼影、羽毛状睫毛、暖腮红、亮泽裸唇和自然修容颧骨。她穿粉红色高定晚礼服，满布水晶刺绣、玻璃珠、亮片和手缝流苏；高领垂坠珠片网布，一侧肩膀露出，胸衣自然贴合后流成数千条长丝绸珠片流苏，流苏越过沙发前缘并柔和堆在草地上，每根受重力自然运动、重叠、微扭并反射周围灯光。佩戴大号钻石花卉戒指、钻石手链和精致钻石耳环，不戴项链。身后保留另一位穿白色露肩刺绣花卉高定礼服的成年女性，但柔和虚焦、仅用于氛围而不抢主角，面部不具身份性。环境为新鲜草地、修剪树篱、深绿沙发、柔和烛光和树间暖串灯的安静昂贵花园招待会。使用柔和傍晚环境光与漫反射活动光，无硬聚光或影棚光；环绕光营造奶油肤色，水晶珠子出现细小自然高光。以中画幅摄影质感、自然景深和XCD 90mm f/2.5镜头拍摄，细致呈现面料、天鹅绒、流苏、皮肤毛孔和反射，保持真实高定社论而非AI伪影。可参考奢华高定晚宴与时装摄影语汇，但不要显示品牌标志、文字或水印。

items.title: 昭和复古CCD粉发水手服敬礼人像
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的1980年代昭和复古、室内自然光与旧CCD快照人像模板。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the only visible adult woman; match facial identity only. Create a realistic 9:21 vertical portrait photograph of an unmistakably adult young Taiwanese woman with short-to-medium pink hair, fair translucent skin, delicate features and a naturally playful yet languid expression. She wears a classic light-blue sailor-style uniform: pale-blue short-sleeve top, white sailor collar, dark neckerchief and matching pleated skirt. Stand her in a relaxed but upright pose with the right hand raised to the forehead in a crisp formal salute; keep the body naturally elongated, long legs visible beneath the skirt and any sensual undertone restrained and never exaggerated. Use a Showa 1980s Japanese retro portrait style with summer dreamcore atmosphere, soft CCD light, low-saturation cool tones and real indoor natural light. Make it feel like a candid lived-in moment captured on a quiet summer afternoon. Soft upper-side window light creates gentle overexposure, highlight bloom, hazy luminous edges and soft shadows. Preserve old-school CCD low-resolution texture, fine film grain, slight optical imperfections and a pleasingly off-kilter composition. Keep the background simple and clean, with a soft sofa and cushions only subtly visible. Preserve natural skin and photographic detail. No stiff pose, plastic skin, excessive beautification, anime, CGI, text or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中唯一可见成年女性的面部身份参考，仅匹配面部身份。创作9:21竖幅写实人像摄影：一位明显成年的台湾年轻女性，留中短粉色头发，皮肤白皙通透、五官精致，神情自然俏皮而慵懒。她穿经典浅蓝色水手服风格制服：浅蓝短袖上衣、白色水手领、深色领巾和配套百褶裙；以放松但挺拔的姿势站立，右手抬至额头做干脆正式的敬礼，身体线条自然修长，裙下长腿可见，感官气息克制而不夸张。采用昭和1980年代日系复古人像、夏日梦核和低饱和冷色调，真实室内自然光拍摄。画面像安静夏日午后随手捕捉的生活瞬间，柔和上方窗光造成轻微过曝、高光晕染和朦胧边缘，阴影柔和；保持旧式CCD低分辨率质感、细微胶片颗粒、轻微光学瑕疵和略偏但舒服的构图。背景简洁干净，柔和沙发和靠垫隐约可见但不喧宾夺主。保持自然皮肤与真实摄影细节，不要僵硬、塑料感、过度美化、动漫、CGI、文字或水印。

items.title: ASTERON PULSE 纯电GT声波雨雾海报
items.description: ASTERON虚构纯电GT商业海报：巨型PULSE字样化为穿过雨雾的声波，与深钴蓝跑车在同一空间互动。
items.prompt: Create a bold 9:16 editorial campaign key visual for the fictional automotive brand ASTERON and its FLUX ELECTRIC GRAND TOURING campaign. Use realistic commercial product photography, oversized typography, high-contrast color, and contemporary editorial design. The main word PULSE fills 50-75% of the frame, extends beyond the canvas, and interacts directly with a fictional electric grand touring coupe. Make the letters expand like sound waves through rain mist: distort only the affected portions while preserving PULSE as clearly recognizable letterforms. Integrate the deep cobalt-blue coupe and oversized word in one physical space using realistic lighting, wet reflections, shadows, perspective, mist displacement, and foreground-background layering. Use deep cobalt blue as the dominant color with restrained acid-yellow accents. Render only the following accurate campaign text: ASTERON; FLUX ELECTRIC GRAND TOURING; PULSE; FLUX GT / 420 KM RANGE / 2026. The finished key visual must feel bold, colorful, concept-driven, premium, and complete. Avoid people, generic product-plus-big-text composition, random distortion, meaningless filler text, excessive UI, heavy 3D letters, decorative sparkles, clutter, unrelated effects, real-world car logos, signatures, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 为虚构汽车品牌 ASTERON 及其 FLUX ELECTRIC GRAND TOURING 活动创作一张大胆的9:16编辑式商业主视觉。使用写实商业产品摄影、超大字体、高对比色彩与当代编辑设计。主词 PULSE 占画面50-75%，延伸出画布，并与一辆虚构纯电豪华旅行轿跑直接互动。让字母像声波一样穿过雨雾向外扩张；仅扭曲受力部分，同时保持 PULSE 字形清晰可辨。通过真实照明、湿地反射、阴影、透视、雾气位移与前后景分层，将深钴蓝轿跑和超大文字置于同一物理空间。以深钴蓝为主色，仅用克制的酸性黄色点缀。只准确呈现以下活动文字：ASTERON；FLUX ELECTRIC GRAND TOURING；PULSE；FLUX GT / 420 KM RANGE / 2026。成品应大胆、多彩、概念驱动、高级且视觉完整。避免人物、通用产品加大字构图、随机变形、无意义填充文字、过多UI、厚重3D字母、装饰闪光、杂乱、无关效果、真实汽车品牌标志、签名和水印。

items.title: 日系成年女性酒店床边近距离自拍特写
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

864×1536px, 9:16. Ultra-realistic private smartphone selfie. An adult Japanese woman in her early 20s, sitting on the edge of a bed in a hotel-style room with calm tones, taking a selfie with the front camera just after touching her loosely tied back hair with her fingers. Arms are not fully extended, the distance is quite close. The entire face is the main subject, a close-up from the head to the neck and near the collarbone. The frame is slightly tilted, with the face positioned slightly to the left of the center. Not a symmetrical frontal shot like an ID photo.

Large, deep natural brown eyes, slightly upturned eyes with naturally drooping corners, and plump, thick tear bags on the lower eyelids. The tear bags are not artificially emphasized white lines, but naturally present three-dimensionality through soft protrusion, blood color, indoor light reflections, and faint shadows on the underside. Round and gentle eyes, a slender and clean bridge of the nose, small and soft lips, and a slightly long oval facial contour. The front camera lens naturally meets the eyes, with a subtle smile as if just about to take a photo.

The hair is long dark brown hair loosely tied into a bun at the back of the head, keeping thin bangs and wisps of hair around the face. Thin strands of hair fall at the temples and cheeks, and the tied hair has a slightly messy feel. Translucent pink-beige makeup. Pale mauve-brown eyelids, thin eyeliner, distinct natural lashes, extremely faint light and shadow on the tear bags, thin pink cheeks, and natural glossy pink-beige lipstick.

Light gray soft knit top. The background includes beige walls, a slightly messy bed, indirect lighting by the bedside, half-closed curtains, a small bag and a plastic bottle placed by the bed. In the warm indirect lighting at night, extremely weak bluish outdoor light from the window is mixed in. There is soft contrast between light and dark on the cheeks, tear bags, bridge of the nose, and lips, and subtle light enters the wisps of hair.

Retains the slight wide-angle feel characteristic of the front camera, the intimacy of close range, slight frame tilt, and soft focus, but facial features and expressions are clearly visible. The skin retains natural texture with non-exaggerated pores, blood color, and subtle color differences, not homogenized like an applied beauty filter. Not like cutting out the person alone, but integrated with the same lighting, color temperature, and resolution as the background. Avoid AI-style smooth skin, plastic texture, excessive beauty processing, overly neat image quality like advertising photos, mass-produced face shapes, and unnatural fixed poses.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

864×1536px，9:16。超真实的私人智能手机自拍。20多岁前半的成年日本女性，在色调平静的酒店风格房间里坐在床边，刚刚用手指触碰松散扎起的头发后发丝后，用前置摄像头自拍。手臂没有完全伸展，距离相当近。整个脸成为画面主角，从头部到颈部、锁骨附近的近距离特写。画面稍微倾斜，脸部配置在中央稍偏左的位置。不做证件照那种正面对称的拍摄。

大而有深度的自然棕色眼睛，眼尾自然微微下垂的微吊眼，下眼睑有丰满厚实的泪袋。泪袋不是人工强调的白线，而是通过柔和的隆起、血色、室内灯反射、下侧的淡影自然呈现立体感。圆润温柔的眼部，纤细清爽的鼻梁，小巧柔软的嘴唇，略带长脸的椭圆形轮廓。前置摄像头的镜头与眼睛自然对视，像刚准备拍照前的含蓄微笑。

头发是深棕色的长发在脑后松散扎成丸子头，保留薄薄的刘海和脸周的后发丝。太阳穴和脸颊有细小的发束垂落，扎发稍带点凌乱感。透明感的粉米色系妆容。眼睑淡莫维棕色，细眼线，一根根分明的自然睫毛，泪袋上极淡的光影，脸颊薄粉色，自然光泽的粉米色唇膏。

浅灰色的柔软针织上衣。背景有米色系墙壁、稍带凌乱的床铺、枕边的间接照明、半闭的窗帘、床边放着的小包和塑料瓶。夜晚温暖的间接照明中，混入窗边极弱的带青外光。脸颊、泪袋、鼻梁、嘴唇有柔和的明暗对比，发丝后发也有细微的光线进入。

保留前置摄像头特有的轻微广角感、近距离的亲密感、轻微的画面倾斜和柔焦，但脸部特征和表情清晰可见。皮肤保留不夸张毛孔的自然纹理、血色、细微色差，不像套了美肌滤镜那样均匀化。不像只抠出人物那样，而是与背景相同的照明、色温和分辨率融合。避免AI式的光滑皮肤、塑料质感、过度美肌加工、广告照般过于整齐的画质、量产型脸型、不自然的固定姿势。

items.title: 32宫格分镜头测试_
items.description: GPT2.5,没什么好说的，完美！
items.prompt_zh:
一张 6×6 的分镜头网格图，共 36 格，6 行 6 列，每格等大，格与格之间严丝合缝、无缝相接。

【关于线条的硬性要求，优先级最高】
不要画任何分割线、网格线、格线、分隔条、边框、描边，格与格之间也不要留白色或黑色间隙。
36 格必须像马赛克一样直接拼接成一整张完整画面，
格与格的区分只依靠各格画面自身的构图边界、明暗和景深差异，绝不依靠任何线条。

统一设定（36 格全部遵守）：
- 主体：同一个年轻东亚女性，亮黄色雨衣，黑色短发，撑一把透明雨伞
- 场景：夜晚的东京十字路口，地面湿滑反光，霓虹招牌，细雨
- 光线：夜晚，冷暖霓虹混合，地面积水有彩色反射
- 风格：写实电影剧照，35mm 胶片颗粒，浅景深
- 角色外观、服装、雨伞在 36 格中必须完全一致

双轴约束（每格唯一，不可重复）：
- 列 = 景别，从左到右依次收紧：
  第1列 大远景 → 第2列 远景 → 第3列 全景 → 第4列 中景 → 第5列 近景 → 第6列 特写
- 行 = 机位角度，从上到下：
  第1行 正上方鸟瞰 → 第2行 高角度俯拍 → 第3行 平视 → 第4行 低角度仰拍 → 第5行 过肩镜头 → 第6行 荷兰角倾斜构图

36 个格子必须是 36 个互不相同的「机位 × 景别」组合。
画面干净，不要文字说明，不要水印，不要边框装饰。

再次强调：整张图中不允许出现任何形式的分割线、网格线、边框、白边或分隔条，
一格都没有。36 格是无缝拼贴的一整张图。

Use refined editorial illustration, clean geometric shapes, delicate textures, muted pastel colors, cinematic depth, elegant luxury travel aesthetic, and balanced negative space. Add large sophisticated typography reading “PARIS”, smaller text “CITY OF LIGHT”, Japanese text “光あふれる街、パリ”, and “WHERE ELEGANCE MEETS INSPIRATION”, with all typography crisp, correctly spelled, beautifully aligned, and integrated into the composition.

items.title: 复古室内窗边象牙白时尚人像
items.description: 10A身份绑定的25岁成年东亚女性身穿象牙白蕾丝饰边套装，在温暖复古室内窗边拍摄85毫米电影感时尚人像。
items.prompt: Use ref-10a-v1 only for the facial identity of the sole visible 25-year-old adult East Asian woman. Frame her from the top of her head to mid-thigh as she stands by a window in a warm vintage interior, slightly right of center, body at a gentle three-quarter angle toward frame left, waist naturally shifted, shoulders relaxed, and arms resting behind her back or hanging naturally. She looks calmly into the camera with a very faint smile, gentle confidence, and restraint. Give her long dark-brown hair in a loose low ponytail with natural crown volume and softly curled wisps at the forehead and cheeks, plus gold-and-pearl teardrop earrings. Use clear natural makeup: fine eyeliner, warm-brown eyeshadow, soft pink blush, and muted coral nude-pink lips. Dress her in a fully opaque ivory-white sleeveless blouse with wide secure shoulders, a modest neckline, and delicate floral lace trim, paired with a high-waisted tailored ivory midi skirt. Preserve realistic proportions and natural skin with pores, fine vellus hair, subtle tonal variation, and gentle highlights. The cozy apartment or vintage cafe has a large black-framed window and beige-brown curtains at right, small potted flowers on the sill, and dark-wood shelves, glass cups, ceramics, green plants, a wooden table, and a reddish-brown upholstered chair at back left. Keep the tidy background softly blurred. Soft afternoon window light enters from the right, with gentle ambient fill and soft shadows. Use an ivory, caramel, warm-skin, dark-wood, and plant-green palette. Shoot as an 85mm f/2.0 photorealistic cinematic apartment fashion portrait from eye level to slightly high, with medium-shallow depth, creamy bokeh, clear eyes, lips, lace trim, earrings, and hair strands, subtle ISO 400 grain, and Black Pro-Mist 1/8 softness. Avoid lingerie, revealing or transparent clothing, erotic posing, extra people, deformed hands, extra limbs, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, strong HDR, oversharpening, clutter, CG, anime, text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 仅将 ref-10a-v1 用于唯一可见25岁成年东亚女性的面部身份。画面从头顶拍至大腿中部；她站在温暖复古的室内窗边，位置中央略偏右，身体以轻微三分之二角度朝向画面左侧，腰部自然偏向一边，肩膀放松，双臂收于身后或自然垂落。她平静直视镜头，嘴角带极淡微笑，神情温柔、自信而克制。她留深褐色长发并扎成松散低马尾，头顶自然蓬松，额前与脸侧垂落几缕微卷碎发，佩戴金色与珍珠水滴耳环。妆容清透自然，包含细眼线、暖棕眼影、淡粉腮红和低饱和珊瑚裸粉唇。她穿完整不透明的象牙白无袖上衣，宽肩部稳固、领口端庄并带细腻花卉蕾丝饰边，下身搭配高腰剪裁象牙白中长裙。保持真实匀称比例与自然皮肤，呈现毛孔、细小绒毛、细微肤色变化和轻柔高光。温馨公寓或复古咖啡馆室内右侧有大面积黑框窗户与米棕色窗帘，窗台摆小盆花；左后方为深木置物架、玻璃杯、陶瓷器皿、绿植、木桌与红棕色软垫木椅。背景整洁并柔和虚化。柔和午后窗光从右侧照入，以轻微环境反光补光并形成柔和阴影。色调以象牙白、焦糖棕、暖肤色、暗木色和植物绿为主。采用85毫米、f/2.0、平视略高机位的照片级电影感室内时尚人像，中浅景深与奶油散景，眼睛、嘴唇、蕾丝饰边、耳环和发丝清晰，带轻微ISO 400胶片颗粒与Black Pro-Mist 1/8柔化。避免内衣、暴露或透明服装、色情姿势、额外人物、畸形手部、多余肢体、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、强HDR、过度锐化、杂乱背景、CG、动漫、文字、标志和水印。

items.title: 春日植物园的田园风人像
items.description: 固定参考身份的成年女性穿柔和碎花连衣裙，在明亮春日植物园中整理发丝，呈现宁静优雅的田园时尚肖像。
items.prompt: Use the fixed reference image to preserve the facial identity of the sole adult woman. Full-body cottagecore fashion portrait in a botanical garden on a bright spring afternoon: the adult woman has long dark-brown hair with wispy bangs and a black ribbon bow, and wears a loose pastel floral sleeveless sundress with delicate ruffled trim, pearl necklace and earrings, carrying a woven wicker handbag with pearl-beaded handles. She gently tucks her hair behind one ear while gazing calmly into the distance. Behind her are green lawns, blooming wildflowers, pine trees, rolling hills, and a soft blue sky; a light breeze moves her hair and dress. Warm natural daylight, cinematic composition, shallow depth of field and creamy bokeh, photorealistic DSLR travel-fashion photography, Korean cottagecore aesthetic, soft pastel grading. No extra people, text, garbled lettering, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 使用固定参考图保持唯一成年女性的面部身份。明亮春日下午的植物园田园风全身人像：成年女性有深棕色长发与轻薄刘海，黑色蝴蝶结发饰，穿宽松柔和的粉彩碎花无袖连衣裙，带细褶边，佩戴珍珠项链和耳饰，手提带珍珠手柄的编织藤篮包。她一手将发丝别到耳后，平静优雅地望向远方。背景为绿色草坪、野花、松树、起伏山丘和淡蓝天空，微风吹动头发与裙摆。温暖自然光，电影感构图，柔和景深与奶油色散景，超写实 DSLR 旅行时尚摄影，韩系 cottagecore 美学，柔和粉彩调。不要额外人物、文字、乱码或水印。

items.title: 国家连续一笔画复古旅行海报
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的连续手绘线稿、国家文化元素和复古旅行海报模板。
items.prompt: Create a premium 4:5 vertical travel poster for JAPAN, illustrated as one elegant continuous, uninterrupted hand-drawn line-art composition. Do not place landmarks separately; let them flow organically into one another as if the entire country were drawn in a single travel sketch. Combine the most recognizable architecture, landscapes, culture, food, transportation, nature and tiny everyday details of JAPAN into one balanced complete scene. Use bold black ink outlines, delicate cross-hatching, playful imperfect hand-drawn details, subtle vintage-poster typography and a mostly warm off-white paper background, adding only 2–3 signature accent colors inspired by JAPAN. Include one dominant iconic landmark, a second architectural landmark integrated subtly into the skyline, a famous natural landscape in the background, local transportation, a traditional clothing or cultural detail, one recognizable food or drink, small street-life moments, birds, clouds, plants and tiny decorative elements, plus handwritten labels pointing to selected elements. If people appear, render them only as small faceless, unidentifiable environmental cultural silhouettes with no identity-bearing role. At the top, use a large playful hand-lettered title “JAPAN”; below it add the tiny elegant subtitle “A little world to discover”. Make the composition collected, whimsical, editorial, nostalgic and handcrafted, like a beautifully illustrated travel journal rather than a generic tourist poster. Keep clean white space around the illustration, highly detailed ink work, charming imperfections, premium stationery aesthetics and screen-print texture. Avoid photorealism, gradients, 3D rendering, excessive colors, clutter, identifiable faces or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 为 JAPAN 创作一张高端4:5竖幅旅行海报，采用一幅优雅、连续、不间断的手绘线稿构图。不要把地标分开放置，而要让它们像一次连续旅行素描一样有机流入彼此；将 JAPAN 最具辨识度的建筑、景观、文化、美食、交通、自然和微小日常细节组合成平衡完整的场景。使用粗黑墨水轮廓、精致交叉排线、俏皮的不完美手绘细节、微妙复古海报字体和大面积暖米白纸张背景，仅加入2—3种受 JAPAN 启发的标志性强调色。必须包含一个主导性标志地标、一个巧妙融入天际线的第二建筑地标、背景中的著名自然景观、当地交通工具、传统服饰或文化细节、一种可辨识的食物或饮料、微小街头生活瞬间、鸟类云彩植物等小元素，以及指向选定元素的手写标签。若出现人物，将其处理为小型、无脸且不可识别的环境性文化剪影，不承担身份主体。顶部放巨大俏皮手写标题“JAPAN”，下方放微小优雅副标题“A little world to discover”。整体应有收藏感、奇思妙想、编辑感、怀旧感和手工旅行日志气质，而非普通旅游海报；插图四周保留干净留白，线稿高度细致，带迷人手工瑕疵、高端文具审美和丝网印刷纹理。避免照片写实、渐变、3D、过多颜色、杂乱、可辨识人物面孔或水印。

items.title: 户外仰拍成年东亚女性俏皮自拍人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

A photorealistic close-up selfie of a young East Asian woman in her early 20s, taken from a low outdoor angle looking slightly upward. She has long, silky, wavy chestnut-brown hair cascading over her shoulders with soft natural volume and subtle highlights catching the sunlight. Fair skin with a natural glow, light freckles across the nose, delicate makeup featuring soft pink blush, defined yet natural brows, and glossy pink lips. She is winking her left eye playfully while sticking her tongue out slightly in a cute, cheeky expression, smiling with visible upper teeth. Her right hand is raised near her face making a classic peace/V-sign with index and middle fingers extended.

She wears a fitted beige/camel ribbed knit long-sleeve sweater under blue denim overalls (dungarees) with visible straps and metal buttons. Soft natural daylight with bright sunlight creating gentle lens flare and warm highlights on her hair and face. Background is a clear vivid blue sky with soft green leafy trees framing the upper edges, shallow depth of field keeping the subject sharp while the foliage is softly blurred. High-resolution, sharp facial details, natural skin texture, cinematic outdoor lighting, shot on a high-end smartphone camera, vibrant yet natural color grading.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

一张20岁出头的年轻东亚女性的写实近距离自拍，从户外低角度稍微向上拍摄。她留着如丝般顺滑的长波浪栗棕色头发，如瀑布般披散在肩头，带有柔和的自然蓬松感，细微的高光捕捉着阳光。皮肤白皙并带有自然光泽，鼻梁上有淡淡的雀斑，精致的妆容包括柔和的粉色腮红、清晰而自然的眉毛以及有光泽的粉色嘴唇。她调皮地眨着左眼，同时微微吐出舌头，表情可爱俏皮，微笑着露出上排牙齿。她的右手举在脸部附近，伸出食指和中指，做出经典的和平/V字手势。她在蓝色牛仔背带裤（工装裤）内穿着一件贴身的米色/骆驼色罗纹针织长袖毛衣，可见背带和金属纽扣。柔和的自然日光，明亮的阳光产生柔和的镜头光晕，并在她的头发和脸上形成温暖的高光。背景是清澈生动的蓝天，上方边缘有柔和的绿色枝叶环绕，浅景深使主体保持锐利，而枝叶则被柔和模糊。高分辨率，锐利的面部细节，自然的皮肤纹理，电影般的户外照明，使用高端智能手机摄像头拍摄，色彩分级鲜艳而自然。

items.title: 大胆超大排版品牌活动编辑风海报模板
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的可复用品牌活动海报模板，已将原始占位字段整理为有边界的变量，并提供一组可执行默认示例。保留人物参考图变量、超大排版、主体与文字交互、单主色和 9:16 海报结构。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity anchor for the main visible person. Create a bold editorial campaign poster in which oversized typography becomes part of the composition rather than background text.

Brand: NOVA MOTION
Product / Campaign: City Pulse Running 2027
Main Word: MOVE
Subject: one athletic adult woman in a modern running outfit
Action: running forward through the typography
Main Color: electric blue
Type Interaction: cut through and overlap
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Use contemporary editorial design, realistic commercial photography, bold typography, and strong graphic composition. Make the main word extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the frame; let parts of the letters extend beyond the canvas, overlap the subject, or shift in perspective. The subject must actively interact with the typography rather than simply stand in front of it. Build clear foreground, subject, and background layers, with some letterforms behind the subject and others crossing in front.

Organize the pose, typography, perspective, and graphic elements around one clear visual direction. Use one dominant color with black, white, and only a small accent color. Add meaningful restrained campaign information such as the brand name, product or campaign name, a short slogan, date, specs, labels, crop marks, or small editorial text. Keep the information organized and never use random filler words.

Keep the subject realistic, with natural proportions, believable lighting, authentic skin and material textures, and dynamic body language. The final image should feel like a finished brand-campaign key visual: bold, layered, energetic, and complete. The default example is recorded through the variables NOVA MOTION, City Pulse Running 2027, MOVE, one athletic adult woman in a modern running outfit, running forward through the typography, electric blue, cut through and overlap, and 9:16. Avoid generic “person plus big title” layouts, meaningless text, excessive UI graphics, too many colors, heavy 3D typography, stiff poses, and cluttered composition.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图绑定主可见人物的面部身份。创建一张大胆的编辑风品牌活动海报，其中超大排版成为构图主体而不仅是背景文字。

品牌：NOVA MOTION
产品 / 活动：City Pulse Running 2027
关键词：MOVE
主体：one athletic adult woman in a modern running outfit
动作：running forward through the typography
主色：electric blue
文字交互：cut through and overlap
画幅比例：9:16

使用当代编辑设计、真实商业摄影、大胆排版和强图形构图。使关键词极其巨大，占据画面约 50–75%，字母部分可越出画布、与主体重叠或产生透视偏移。主体必须与排版积极互动，而不是简单站在文字前面；建立清晰的前景—主体—背景层级，让部分字母位于主体后方，部分字形从主体前方穿过。

围绕一个明确视觉方向组织姿势、排版、透视和图形元素。使用一种主导颜色，配合黑色、白色和少量点缀色。添加有意义且克制的活动信息：品牌名、产品或活动名、简短口号、日期、规格、标签、裁切标记或小型编辑文本；保持信息有序，禁止随机填充词。

主体保持真实自然的比例、可信光照、真实皮肤与材料纹理和动态肢体语言。最终图像应像完整的品牌活动主视觉，具有大胆、分层、充满活力且视觉完整的品质。变量默认示例为：品牌“NOVA MOTION”、产品活动“City Pulse Running 2027”、主词“MOVE”、主体“one athletic adult woman in a modern running outfit”、动作“running forward through the typography”、主色“electric blue”、文字交互“cut through and overlap”、画幅“9:16”。避免通用的“人物加大标题”布局、无意义文字、过多 UI 图形、过多颜色、沉重 3D 排版、僵硬姿势和杂乱构图。

items.title: 色彩缤纷的成年烹饪课学员合影
items.description: 三名成年学员在明亮烹饪教室正面合影，中央10A身份讲师与两名辅助学员分别穿陶土红、鼠尾草绿和钴蓝色围裙套装。
items.prompt: Create a cheerful high-resolution editorial group portrait in a bright modern cooking classroom. Show exactly three clearly adult women facing forward in one row. Use ref-10a-v1 only for the facial identity of the centered 25-year-old adult instructor; create two distinct supporting adult classmates on the left and right. Each participant wears a coordinated apron, triangular head scarf, comfortable closed-toe kitchen slippers, and a modest opaque top, with a different color set: terracotta for the center instructor, sage green for the left classmate, and cobalt blue for the right classmate. Each person holds one cooking item in each hand: the center holds a wooden spoon and whisk, the left holds a mixing bowl and spatula, and the right holds a rolling pin and measuring cup. Place them in a welcoming cooking-class kitchen with counters, shelves, bowls, pans, and softly lit preparation stations. Keep all faces, hands, utensils, and garments fully visible with balanced front-facing composition and natural friendly expressions. Include no foxes, fox motifs, animals, extra people, duplicated utensils, text, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张明亮现代烹饪教室中的欢快高分辨率编辑合影。画面恰好有三名明确成年的女性，排成一列并全部正面朝向镜头。仅将 ref-10a-v1 用于中央25岁成年讲师的面部身份；左右两侧各生成一名身份不同的成年辅助学员。每人都穿与主题协调的围裙、三角头巾、舒适包头厨房拖鞋和端庄不透明上衣，并采用不同配色：中央讲师为陶土红，左侧学员为鼠尾草绿，右侧学员为钴蓝色。每人双手各持一件烹饪用品：中央拿木勺和打蛋器，左侧拿搅拌碗和刮刀，右侧拿擀面杖和量杯。背景为温馨烹饪课堂厨房，包含操作台、置物架、碗具、锅具和柔和照明的备餐区。保持所有面部、手部、厨具和服装完整可见，构图平衡正面，表情自然友好。不得出现狐狸、狐狸图案、动物、额外人物、重复厨具、文字、标志、签名或水印。

items.title: 霓虹雨夜豪华跑车时尚大片
items.description: 10A身份绑定的25岁成年女性身穿黑色剪裁裤装，在霓虹都市雨夜斜倚豪华跑车拍摄电影感全身时尚大片。
items.prompt: Use ref-10a-v1 only for the facial identity of the sole visible adult woman, age 25. Create an ultra-realistic cinematic full-body fashion editorial portrait with a luxury lifestyle mood on a modern metropolitan street at night. Give her an elegant athletic build, long sleek glossy jet-black hair worn perfectly straight and tucked behind her ears, sharp winged eyeliner, and bold matte red lipstick. She looks directly at the camera with a stoic, confident, piercing gaze; oversized black-tinted designer sunglasses rest on the bridge of her nose. Dress her in a fully opaque tailored black trouser suit with a refined high-neck top and pointed black heels. She leans elegantly against the polished side of a luxury sports car, one hand lightly touching the roof and the other holding a designer clutch, with one leg slightly crossed over the other. Wet pavement reflects city lights. Use cinematic teal-and-orange mood lighting, soft bokeh from distant neon signs, and a sharp rim light around her silhouette. Preserve believable anatomy, natural skin texture, polished reflections, and a commanding editorial presence. Avoid extra people, revealing clothing, malformed hands, distorted car geometry, readable text, logos, signatures, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 仅将 ref-10a-v1 用于唯一可见成年女性的面部身份，人物明确为25岁。创作一张超写实电影级全身时尚大片人像，场景位于现代高端都市夜间街道，呈现奢华生活方式氛围。她身形优雅而富有运动感，留有乌黑亮丽、完美顺直且别在耳后的长发，搭配犀利猫眼眼线和大胆哑光红唇。她直视镜头，神情沉着自信、目光锐利，鼻梁上架着黑色大镜框设计师墨镜。她穿完整不透明的黑色剪裁裤装套装，内搭精致高领上衣和黑色尖头高跟鞋。她优雅斜倚在豪华跑车的抛光车侧，一只手轻触车顶，另一只手持设计师手拿包，一条腿略微交叉。湿润路面反射城市灯光。使用电影感青橙氛围灯、远处霓虹灯的柔和散景与勾勒轮廓的锐利边缘光。保持可信解剖、自然肤质、精致反射与具有掌控力的编辑气场。避免额外人物、暴露服装、畸形手部、变形车体、可读文字、标志、签名和水印。

items.title: 楼梯间东亚女性超写实手机自拍
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

3:4 vertical ultra-realistic smartphone selfie of a  adult East Asian woman in an old apartment stairwell. She holds the phone at arm’s length and gives a soft, natural closed-lip smile. items.title: 真实摄影与治愈积木解构高级海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please make each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output individually. The overall composition adopts a 3:4 vertical layout, with the upper and lower two areas strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper part preserves the original photo, maintaining the main structure, spatial relationships, real materials, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, only performing slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine, independent publication, and exhibition photography. To adapt to the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable **subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship** from the photo, following the logic of "deconstruction—screening—refining—reconstruction," and transforms it into a **healing block sculpture with a 3D / isometric sense of space**. Focus on preserving the subject's most unique volume proportions, axes, curves, interspersions, layering, occlusion, and negative space, re-organized with rounded, simple, tactile modular blocks; do not fully replicate details, but it must be immediately felt as corresponding to the original image above.

The composition is adaptively designed according to the subject's own visual center of gravity, posture direction, and spatial relationships, establishing rhythm through large and small blocks, high and low staggered layers, front and back interspersing, local suspension, density changes, and large areas of white space. Blocks can be spliced, stacked, nested, crossed, or naturally misplaced, so that the subject retains its identity while having the sculptural sense and relaxed imagination of contemporary art toys, avoiding mechanical disassembly and simple pixelation.

**Color schemes must be generated by analyzing the original image above.** First identify the most vital and recognizable main color relationships in the photo, as well as the comprehensive color temperature, brightness levels, cold-warm echoes, and key point colors, then re-modulate these colors into a softer, clearer, brighter, and more airy healing color system. Preserve the hue identity and emotional memory of the original image, but moderately increase brightness, reduce harsh contrasts, and purify grayish or dirty colors, making the colors present a gentle, childlike, light, and high-end feel. Different photos should naturally result in different color schemes; do not use any fixed preset color cards, and do not forcibly add colors that do not exist in the original image for the sake of a "healing feeling."

Color establishes rhythm through **main color area, auxiliary color layers, homologous light and dark, and a very small amount of vivid point colors**, making the subject look rich but not cluttered, cute but not cloying, soft but spirited. The block material uses a fine matte, soft diffuse reflection texture, with a slight touch like pulp, wood, pastel, or flexible materials, with rounded corners and soft shadows, avoiding plastic highlights, metallic feel, heavy CG, and cheap toy textures.

The text establishes a light, high-end editorial-style micro-typography system, extracting a 2–5 word title from the photo's light and shadow, action, space, emotion, or symbolic meaning, and matching it with a small number of status words, locations, numbers, direction words, or micro-annotations, without using years. Text can be arranged along block edges, module gaps, visual axes, or negative spaces, and can also form interspersing, occlusion, and alignment with the blocks, making the text naturally part of the block composition.

Overall presentation is a visual temperament of **real photography × healing blocks × isometric space × original color translation × high-end editorial design**, gentle, light, childlike, quiet, exquisite, imaginative but not naive. Whether the subject is a person, animal, plant, building, object, food, vehicle, or natural landscape, it should develop a unique block combination and color scheme from the original image's own structure and colors, avoiding fixed color cards, Lego-style copying, children's cartoons, e-commerce toy display feel, and template feel.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体结构、空间关系、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系**，按照“解构—筛选—提炼—重构”的逻辑，转化为具有 **3D / isometric 空间感的治愈系积木雕塑**。重点保留主体最独特的体量比例、轴线、曲线、穿插、层叠、遮挡与负空间，以圆润、简洁、具有触感的模块化体块重新组织；不完整复刻细节，但必须一眼感受到与上方原图的对应。

构图根据主体自身的视觉重心、姿态方向和空间关系自适应设计，通过大小体块、高低错层、前后穿插、局部悬浮、疏密变化与大面积留白建立节奏。积木可以拼接、叠放、嵌套、穿越或自然错位，使主体既保留身份，又具有当代艺术玩具般的雕塑感和轻松想象力，避免机械拆件和简单像素化。

**配色必须从上方原图本身分析产生。** 先识别照片中最有生命力、最有辨识度的主色关系，以及综合色温、明度层级、冷暖呼应和关键点色，再将这些颜色重新调制为更柔和、清澈、明亮、有空气感的治愈色彩体系。保留原图的色相身份与情绪记忆，但适度提高明度、降低刺眼对比、净化灰脏杂色，使颜色呈现温柔、童趣、轻盈而高级的感觉。不同照片应自然得到不同配色，不固定使用任何预设色卡，也不要为了“治愈感”强行加入原图不存在的颜色。

色彩通过**主色面积、辅助色层次、同源深浅与极少量鲜活点色**建立节奏，让主体看起来丰富但不杂乱、可爱但不甜腻、柔和但有精气神。积木材质采用细腻哑光、柔和漫反射的质感，带轻微纸浆、木质、粉蜡或柔性材料般的触感，边角圆润、阴影轻柔，避免塑料高光、金属感、厚重CG和廉价玩具质感。

文字建立轻盈的高级编辑式微排版系统，从照片的光影、动作、空间、情绪或象征意义中提炼一个2–5词的标题，并搭配少量状态词、地点、编号、方向词或微型注释，不使用年份。文字可沿积木边缘、模块缝隙、视觉轴线或负空间排列，也可与体块形成穿插、遮挡与对齐，让文字自然成为积木构图的一部分。

整体呈现 **真实摄影 × 治愈积木 × isometric空间 × 原图色彩转译 × 高级编辑设计** 的视觉气质，温柔、轻盈、童趣、安静、精致、有想象力但不幼稚。无论主体是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、食物、交通工具或自然景观，都应从原图自身的结构与色彩中发展出独特的积木组合和配色方式，避免固定色卡、乐高式复制、儿童卡通、电商玩具展示感和模板感。

items.title: 水宫莲池中的古风祈愿肖像

She has long black hair tied low and wears an ornate champagne-gold crown, white-jade lotus hair ornaments, pearl tassels, and warm-gold earrings. Her fully covered layered palace gown uses apricot white, milky white, and champagne gold, with lotus, cloud, and water-ripple embroidery, soft drape, and clear fabric layers. The lotus lamp emits warm light reflected on her face. Background: softly blurred lotus pond, jade steps, palace-pillar silhouettes, floating lamps, and broad lamp bokeh. Bright, translucent, sacred dreamlike atmosphere; photorealistic digital portrait with refined makeup, jewelry, and textile highlights; the woman is the absolute visual center. No extra people, text, garbled lettering, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 使用固定参考图保持唯一成年女性的面部身份。9:16竖幅古风仙侠人物海报：成年东方女性跪坐在水宫莲池的玉阶旁，双手在胸前轻托一盏莲花灯，神情温柔克制、宁静虔敬。她有长黑发低束，佩戴香槟金发冠、白玉莲花发饰、珍珠流苏与温暖金色耳坠；穿层次清晰的杏白、乳白与香槟金宫廷礼服，带莲花、流云与水纹刺绣，面料柔软垂坠且覆盖得体。莲灯发出柔和暖光，水面反射映亮面部。背景为虚化莲池、玉阶、宫柱剪影、漂浮莲灯和大面积灯光散景。明亮通透、神圣梦幻、写实数字人像，细腻妆容、珠宝和织物高光，角色为绝对视觉中心。不要额外人物、文字、乱码或水印。

items.title: 薄纱刺绣礼服数字秀场目录海报
items.description: 将来源中的人物/产品与材质占位符落地为一名明确成年女性展示雾蓝薄纱刺绣褶裥礼服的3:4数字秀场编辑海报；设置确定的三级文字并绑定10A。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded ref-10a-v1 image as the facial identity reference for the only visible person. Design a 3:4 vertical Digital Runway Catalogue editorial poster featuring one clearly adult woman modeling a fog-blue tulle gown with fine embroidery and sculptural pleats. Use a warm ivory background and an invisible 12-column grid.

Create an asymmetrical two-column composition. On the left, place one full-body main visual occupying about 55% of the frame and preserve the complete silhouette of the model and gown. On the right, place only one garment-detail close-up occupying about 20%, showing tulle, embroidery, and pleats without a second face or second person. Stagger the two images vertically and avoid a same-sized collage.

Set the subject in a clean studio with soft overcast light and slight backlighting to emphasize tactile realism. Preserve a natural movement instant, with restrained motion blur in the hem and a few hair strands as if a runway photograph were suddenly frozen; keep the face and main gown sharp.

Render exactly three levels of English copy: brand title AERIFORM, collection name VEIL STUDY 2026, and micro-parameters LOOK 01 • TULLE • EMBROIDERY. Use an elegant high-contrast serif with moderate size and loose tracking for the title, and a neutral sans serif for the other levels. Place all copy near the edges without covering the subject, spell it exactly, and add no other text.

Limit the palette to warm white, ink black, fog blue, and one low-saturation petal-pink accent, with color covering no more than 15%. Keep over 40% white space and add extremely light paper texture and photographic grain. Blend the quiet, airy character of a Nordic fashion catalogue, contemporary art-museum album, and premium e-commerce editorial. Include no additional people, identity duplication, cropped body silhouette, malformed hands or feet, gold luxury symbols, dense product arrays, ornate borders, sweet filters, uniform grids, promotional tags, extra text, logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的 ref-10a-v1 图像作为唯一可见人物的面部身份参考。设计一张3:4竖版“数字秀场式陈列”编辑海报：一名明确成年的女性展示雾蓝色薄纱礼服，礼服带精细刺绣与立体褶裥。使用暖象牙白背景和隐形12列网格。

采用非对称双栏构图。左侧放置一张约占画面55%的全身主视觉，完整呈现人物与礼服轮廓；右侧只放一张约占20%的礼服局部材质特写，表现薄纱、刺绣和褶裥，不出现第二张脸或第二个人。两张影像上下错位，不做等大拼贴。

主体位于纯净影棚，使用柔和阴天光与轻微逆光突出真实触感。保留自然动作瞬间，让衣摆和少量发丝出现克制运动模糊，如秀场摄影突然定格；面部和礼服主体仍清晰。

仅呈现三级英文文字：品牌标题 AERIFORM，系列名称 VEIL STUDY 2026，微型参数 LOOK 01 • TULLE • EMBROIDERY。标题采用优雅高对比衬线字体、适中字级和宽松字距；其余使用中性无衬线字体。全部文字靠近画面边缘，不遮挡人物，准确拼写且不添加其他文字。

配色仅限暖白、墨黑、雾蓝和一处低饱和花瓣粉，彩色面积不超过15%；留白超过40%，加入极轻纸张纹理和摄影颗粒。整体融合北欧时装目录、当代美术馆画册与高级电商的安静、轻盈、呼吸感。不得出现额外人物、身份重复、截断人体、畸形手脚、金色奢华符号、密集商品阵列、花哨边框、甜美滤镜、均匀宫格、促销标签、额外文字、logo或水印。

一位东亚年轻女性的近距离侧脸肖像。她抬头望向明亮自然的阳光。深色细发被风轻轻吹过脸颊，在金色逆光中显出发丝轮廓。皮肤保留自然纹理与微妙腮红，颧骨下方有一颗小美人痣，柔润有光的嘴唇微微分开。

背景以虚化的黄色花朵或树叶围绕画面上方与前景，形成柔和散景，营造温暖、通透、梦幻的春日氛围。使用 35mm 镜头、f/1.8 浅景深、电影感暖色调、写实摄影和电影式光线。画幅为 9:16。

items.title: 奇幻女猎人与巨兽3D封面级渲染
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Preserve the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting, and visual style unless they conflict with that reference.

Create a premium same-source restoration using the image as the only visual reference. Preserve the original subject type, tall composition, camera angle, pose, perspective, color hierarchy, lighting, materials, mood, and spatial relationships. Keep it as stylized fantasy 3D key art with flagship AAA game-cover finish, smooth sculpted anatomy, cinematic forest haze, premium fur, and collectible polish. Do not redesign, reinterpret, change style, add scenery or creatures, or alter the huntress, roaring snow-leopard-like beast, rune sword, forest, or their arrangement. Only improve clarity, silhouette, anatomy, material fidelity, edge cleanup, depth separation, and heroic cover impact. Remove watermarks and unnecessary text.

COMPOSITION AND FLOW: An adult female fantasy huntress stands upper-middle, slightly turned left with chin proudly raised and one hand firmly on the beast's head. A huge upright sword rises behind her on the right. The giant roaring snow-leopard-like beast dominates the lower foreground; its open mouth fills the lower center. Read the hierarchy as huntress first, beast second, sword third, teal forest last. Hair streams left, the sword is a vertical anchor, the mouth thrusts forward, and fur, whiskers, mist, and grass form one forceful eye path from face to hand to jaws and back up the glowing blade.

HUNTRESS: Mature, agile, fearless, calm and slightly aloof; never childish. Keep coherent stylized anatomy, strong shoulders, believable waist and pelvis, toned abdomen, strong hips, and natural hands with five fingers. Preserve the identity: short charcoal-black hair with magenta ends swept left, sharp brows, golden-amber eyes, slightly parted lips, and cool warrior confidence. Do not change hair shape, face proportions, or expression. Keep the torn mustard-yellow cropped top with rough hem and dark underlayer, fitted brown leather belt and waist harness, wrapped forearm bandages, engraved metal arm cuff, large gold hoops, and exposed midriff. Do not add heavy armor or unrelated accessories.

SWORD AND BEAST: Keep the sword's exact right-rear position, angle, scale, and role: broad metal blade with circular/crescent cutouts near the top and controlled orange rune-like insets. Improve its silhouette, metal scratches, engraving, and glow without making it primary. Keep the foreground predator pale gray with dark spots, dense premium fur, strong whiskers, huge open jaws, long fangs, wet gums, visible tongue, moist nose, and intense roar. Preserve believable mouth anatomy, saliva highlights, and the powerful scale contrast beneath the huntress.

FOREST, LIGHT, AND MATERIALS: Retain the misty forest with soft teal-blue atmospheric haze, blurred vertical trees, restrained vegetation, and clean depth separation; no buildings, new props, or extra creatures. Keep cold teal ambient light, soft frontal illumination, and restrained warm orange accents from the sword and selective skin/fur highlights. Make the face, hair edge, upper body, planted hand, fangs, and mouth most legible; keep the sword glow elegant and the mist clean. Use smooth stylized 3D skin with slight warmth, layered semi-gloss hair, worn matte cloth, rugged stitched brown leather, engraved scratched steel, dense spotted fur, wet controlled mouth surfaces, and soft volumetric fog. Preserve the palette: teal forest, mustard top, brown leather, dark steel, orange runes, warm skin, charcoal/magenta hair, gray-white spotted fur, and warm pink mouth; use bold but controlled anchors.

RESTORATION AND CLEANUP: Keep the exact original visual language, not a redesign or style conversion. Improve facial and eye clarity, hand anatomy, abdomen definition, cloth edges, earring and cuff detail, sword contour, rune cleanliness, fur separation, fangs, mouth texture, whiskers, and forest depth. Remove watermark, signature, copied text, noise, muddy shadows, blown highlights, blur, compression artifacts, style drift, and low-resolution detail. Final image must be high-resolution, clean, sharp, commercially polished, and faithful to the original composition, style, and mood.

NEGATIVE: watermark, signature, readable text, logo, changed pose or composition, changed sword design or beast species, changed costume, added armor, scenery, creatures, photoreal live action, anime cel shading, thick-paint illustration, malformed or extra/missing/fused fingers, distorted torso, warped beast jaw, fake mouth anatomy, unrealistic fur, oversaturated glow, muddy teal fog, dead black patches, blurry edges, low-resolution details, redesigned character.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

使用图像作为唯一的视觉参考，创建一个优质的同源清洗与修复重制版。严格保留原有的风格、主体类型、构图、摄像机角度、姿势、透视、颜色层级、光影氛围、材质表现和视觉情绪。风格必须保持为具有旗舰级AAA游戏封面品质的程式化奇幻3D渲染，拥有平滑的雕刻解剖结构、电影感的森林薄雾、优质的皮毛渲染以及收藏级的关键艺术完成度。不要重新设计，不要重新解释，不要切换风格，不要添加无关元素，也不要改变女主角、咆哮的类雪豹巨兽、符文剑、森林设置或它们的空间关系。仅增强清晰度、轮廓力量、解剖精度、材质忠实度、边缘整洁度、深度分离和英雄封面冲击力。移除水印和所有不必要的文字。

风格锁定：
程式化奇幻3D渲染，旗舰级游戏封面关键艺术，优质奇幻猎人海报，平滑的雕刻形态，电影感的青色森林氛围，优质生物皮毛渲染，受控的橙色符文光芒，非写实真人版，非动漫赛璐璐着色，非厚涂插画。

核心构图：
使用相同的竖向长构图，一名成年女性奇幻女猎手站在中上部，一只巨大的咆哮类雪豹巨兽占据下部前景。保留确切的排列：女猎手站在巨兽后上方，躯干略微向左转，下巴以骄傲的向上角度抬起，一只手牢牢地放在巨兽头上，而一把巨大的竖直奇幻剑在右侧身后升起。巨兽张开的嘴必须充满底部中央，作为最强的前景形状。保留确切的层级，但将其强化为旗舰封面读感：女猎手第一，巨兽第二，剑第三，青色森林氛围最后。图像必须立即被解读为一个标志性的超级符号：一位独自征服了残暴顶级掠食者的女猎手。

轨道运动逻辑：
在不改变原始姿势的情况下加强统一的英雄流向。让女主角被风吹动的头发向左后方飘动，剑作为强有力的垂直锚点，巨兽咆哮的嘴有力地向前冲，皮毛、胡须、薄雾和细微的草缘支撑着一个连续的力量循环。视线路径应清晰地穿过女主角的面部，沿着抬起的下颌线和头发，向下穿过按下的手，进入巨兽巨大的张开的颚部和尖牙，然后沿着发光的剑向上返回。整个画面应感觉像是一张凝固的终结时刻封面图，具有最大的英雄张力和清晰度。

主要女主角：
描绘一名具有程式化但连贯的解剖结构、强壮的肩膀、自然的身形位置、纤细但可信的腰部、紧致的腹部、写实的骨盆、强壮的臀部以及形态正确、有五个手指的手的成年女性奇幻战士。保留确切的态度：冷静、统治、无畏且略显冷漠，目光自信地向上看，从容地控制着下方的巨兽。她必须显得成熟、敏捷且危险，绝非孩子气。她是图像的情感和象征核心。

面部和头发：
保留确切的身份：短炭黑色头发，发梢为洋红色，动态向左扫过，眉毛锐利，金色琥珀色眼睛，嘴唇微微张开，展现出冷酷的战士自信。精炼轮廓清晰度，使面部和头发在远处更易识别，但不要改变发型形状、面部比例或表情。面部必须保持优雅、凶猛且一眼就能认出。

服装与配饰：
保留确切的服装结构：撕裂的芥末黄短款上衣，边缘粗糙磨损，下方有深色内层，修身的棕色皮革腰带和腰部背带细节，缠绕的前臂绷带，刻有图案的金属护臂，以及大的金耳环。保持相同的露脐设计，相同的粗犷女猎手造型，以及布料、皮革和金属之间的相同平衡。不要重新设计成重型盔甲，也不要添加无关的配饰。

剑：
保留确切的剑位置和轮廓：在女主角右侧身后的一把巨大的竖直奇幻大剑，宽阔的金属剑身，顶部附近有圆形和新月形的镂空形状，沿着剑身有发光的橙色符文状镶嵌。剑必须更清晰地作为封面图标，具有更强的轮廓清晰度、更干净的发光控制和更优质的金属质感，同时保持作为女主角和巨兽的次要地位。保持确切的角度、比例和视觉角色。

巨兽：
保留确切的前景生物，作为一只巨大的类雪豹掠食者，具有浅灰色的皮毛、黑色的斑点、巨大的张开的颚部、长长的尖牙、湿润的牙龈、可见的舌头、湿润的鼻子和强烈的咆哮表情。巨兽必须占据下半部分，并感觉非常接近相机，在女猎手下方创造出强大的比例对比。它的头部应被视为封面的第二个主要符号：原始、暴力，且完全受控于女猎手的存在。皮毛必须感觉浓密且优质，具有强大的形状可读性和清晰度。

环境：
保持确切的迷雾森林设置，带有柔软的青蓝色大气层薄雾、模糊的垂直树木形状、微弱的植被深度和最少的环境杂乱。森林必须保持次要和支持地位，作为女猎手与巨兽图腾的干净电影背景。没有添加的建筑，没有额外的生物，没有新的道具。

 lighting：
精确保留原始灯光逻辑：冷青色的环境森林光，女主角和巨兽身上柔和的前方照明，以及来自符文剑和选择性的皮肤及皮毛高光的温暖橙色点缀。将灯光提炼为更具旗舰封面感的层级：女主角的面部、头发边缘、上身、按下的手、巨兽的尖牙和巨兽的嘴部获得最清晰的可读性；剑的发光保持受控且优雅；背景薄雾保持干净且有氛围感。不要引入新的戏剧性光源或改变既定的冷暖平衡。

材质：
皮肤：光滑的程式化3D皮肤着色，带有细微的暖意、轻微的红晕和干净的主角级完成度。
头发：分层的半光泽发丝，具有强大的轮廓分解感和粉色发梢。
布料上衣：哑光磨损织物，边缘磨损，有轻微的张力和自然的褶皱逻辑。
皮革背带：粗犷的棕色皮革，带有缝线、褶皱和旅途磨损的纹理。
金属护臂和剑：刻有图案的钢材，带有划痕、细微的磨损、冷色反射和克制的橙色自发光镶嵌。
巨兽皮毛：浓密的斑点雪豹皮毛，柔软的成簇感，强壮的胡须，清晰的吻部纹理。
口腔内部：湿润的牙龈，舌头纹理，尖牙顶端的半透明感，唾液光泽保持受控。
森林空气：青色体积雾，柔软的深度光晕，干净的大气分离。

调色板：
严格保留原始调色板：青蓝色森林薄雾、芥末黄上衣、棕色皮革、深色钢剑、橙色符文光芒、浅暖色皮肤、带洋红色点缀的炭黑色头发、灰白色斑点巨兽皮毛以及暖粉红色的口腔内部。保持色调大胆但有节制，女主角、巨兽的嘴和发光的剑作为三个最强的色彩锚点。

渲染与完成度：
保持确切的原始视觉语言：精致的程式化奇幻3D渲染，优质旗舰游戏封面完成度，电影感的猎人对决巨兽构图，平滑的雕刻解剖结构，高端皮毛渲染，收藏级奇幻关键艺术。这不是重新设计，也不是风格转换。这是一次忠实于同源的修复，并提升为更强大的封面图像。

图像质量与清理：
增强面部清晰度、眼睛锐利度、手部解剖、腹部定义、布料边缘精度、耳环细节、护臂雕刻、剑的轮廓、符文发光整洁度、巨兽皮毛分离、尖牙写实度、口腔纹理、胡须锐利度以及森林深度。移除水印、签名、复制的文本、噪点、模糊的阴影、过度曝光的高光和压缩伪影。保持最终图像高分辨率、干净、锐利、具有商业磨光感，并完全忠实于原始构图、风格和氛围。

负面提示词：
水印，签名，可读文本，徽标，改变的姿势，改变的构图，改变的剑设计，改变的巨兽物种，改变的服装，增加的盔甲，增加的风景，额外的生物，写实真人版，动漫赛璐璐着色，厚涂插画，畸形的手，多余的手指，缺失的手指，融合的手指，扭曲的躯干，变形的巨兽下颚，不真实的皮毛，虚假的口腔解剖，过度饱和的发光，浑浊的青色雾气，死黑斑块，模糊的边缘，低分辨率细节，风格偏移，重新设计的角色。

items.title: 现代公寓温馨自然镜中自拍
items.description: A natural modern indoor mirror-selfie portrait of an adult woman in a contemporary apartment, with a relaxed angled pose, cropped light-gray knit sweater, loose blue jeans, smartphone near the shoulder, warm wood and piano details, distant skyline, soft warm diffused light and calm lifestyle-editorial atmosphere.
items.prompt: A natural, modern indoor mirror-selfie portrait of a young woman inside a stylish contemporary apartment. The image is captured at mid-to-full body length from a slightly angled side profile, reflected in a mirror. She holds a smartphone near her shoulder while taking the photo, gently turning her head back toward the mirror with a subtle, confident smile that feels relaxed and intimate. Her expression is calm and self-assured, with relaxed eyes and softly lifted lips, conveyingeffortless confidence. She has a light-to-medium skin tone with natural texture, soft blush on the cheeks, and minimal makeup—defined brows, lightly enhanced eyes, and natural nude-toned lips. Her long dark brown hair is worn loose and straight with a slight natural wave, parted near the center, falling smoothly down her back with a few soft strands framing her face. She wears a cropped light gray knit sweater with long sleeves, paired with high-waisted, loose-fitting blue denim jeans, creating a casual yet flattering silhouette. Her posture is relaxed and candid, body angled sideways with one shoulder slightly raised, reinforcing an authentic lifestyle feel. The background features a clean, modern interior with warm wooden flooring, dark wood-paneled walls, a door and light switches, and subtle details such as a piano and a large window revealing a distant city skyline. The background remains softly out of focus to keep attention on the subject. Lighting is warm, natural, and evenly diffused, illuminating her face and body without harsh shadows and creating a cozy, lived-in atmosphere. The color palette blends warm wood tones, soft grays, denim blues, and natural skin hues for a calm, contemporary, aesthetically balanced look. The overall mood is intimate, modern, stylish, and effortlessly cool—like a quiet personal moment captured at home. Use the uploaded image as the only and exact face reference. Preserve identical facial identity, structure, proportions, and expression with no alterations.
items.prompt_zh: 一张自然、现代的室内镜面自拍肖像，一位年轻女性身处时尚的现代公寓中。照片以中景到全身的长度拍摄，从略微倾斜的侧面角度，通过镜面反射呈现。她将智能手机举到肩膀附近自拍，头部轻轻转向镜子，脸上带着一丝微妙而自信的微笑，显得轻松而亲密。 她的表情平静而自信，眼神放松，嘴角轻柔上扬，流露出毫不费力的自信。她肤色介于浅色到中等之间，带有自然纹理，脸颊上泛着淡淡的红晕，妆容极简——眉毛清晰，眼部略微修饰，唇部是自然的裸色调。她一头深棕色长发自然垂落，直发中带有一点自然的波浪，发际线靠近中央，柔顺地披在背部，几缕发丝轻柔地修饰着脸庞。 她身穿一件 短款浅灰色针织毛衣，搭配高腰宽松蓝色牛仔裤，打造出休闲而修身的效果。她的姿态放松而自然，身体侧向一边，一侧肩膀略微抬起，更添真实的生活气息。 背景是一个干净、现代的室内空间，铺设着温暖的木地板，深色木质护墙板，一扇门和电灯开关，以及一些微妙的细节，如一架钢琴和一扇大窗户，窗外是远处的城市天际线。背景保持柔和的虚化，以将注意力集中在主体上。 光线温暖、自然且均匀柔和，照亮了她的脸部和身体，没有生硬的阴影，营造出一种舒适、有生活气息的氛围。色彩搭配融合了温暖的木色调、柔和的灰色、牛仔蓝和自然的肤色，呈现出一种平静、现代、美学平衡的视觉效果。 整体氛围亲密、现代、时尚，毫不费力地散发着酷感——就像在家中捕捉到的一个安静的私人时刻。 请使用上传的图片作为唯一且精确的面部参考。保持完全相同的面部特征、结构、比例和表情，不做任何改动。

items.title: 金色长发复古直闪时尚人像
items.description: 10A身份绑定的25岁成年女性以金色长发、黑色宾迪与白色荷叶边上衣拍摄复古直闪时尚半身像。
items.prompt: Use ref-10a-v1 only for the facial identity of the sole visible adult East Asian woman, age 25. Create a 9:16 mid-shot photorealistic fashion portrait. Give her long golden-blonde hair flowing down her back and a small black bindi centered on her forehead. Dress her in a fully opaque white ruffled sleeveless blouse with wide secure straps and a modest neckline, paired with high-waisted tailored trousers. She stands with a gentle natural curve, one hand on her hip, looking directly at the camera with a warm smile. Use direct on-camera flash, soft vintage color, detailed natural skin texture, realistic shadows, and candid lifestyle-photography character. Preserve correct anatomy and hands. Avoid revealing clothing, distortion, extra limbs, crossed eyes, blur, text, logo, watermark, cartoon styling, pixelation, oversaturation, and missing fingers.
items.prompt_zh: 仅将 ref-10a-v1 用于唯一可见成年东亚女性的面部身份，人物明确为25岁。创作9:16写实时尚半身像。她留金色长发，发丝垂至背部，额头中央点缀小巧黑色宾迪。她穿完整不透明的白色荷叶边无袖上衣，宽肩带稳固、领口端庄，并搭配高腰剪裁长裤。她以自然轻柔的曲线站立，一只手叉腰，温暖微笑并直视镜头。使用机顶直闪、柔和复古色调、细腻真实肤质、可信阴影和随性生活摄影质感。保持正确解剖与手部。避免暴露服装、畸变、多余肢体、斗鸡眼、模糊、文字、标志、水印、卡通风、像素化、过饱和和缺失手指。

items.title: 纪实感黑白女性坐姿人像摄影提示词
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:

Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographed portrait. 一张高完成度、真实摄影质感的中国年轻成年女性极近景美容肖像。人物视觉年龄约 20–26 岁，具有自然明确的中国女性特征，整体气质清纯、漂亮、白净、柔和、灵动、耐看，成年感明确，不幼态，不欧美化，不网红化，不复制任何参考人物的具体骨相，仅借鉴理想中的皮肤净度、眼睛明亮度、粉润美妆关系、近景镜头语言与柔光美容摄影氛围。

人物采用 B｜明眸电影脸。脸型与骨相为偏长柔和鹅蛋脸，额头饱满，颧骨轻支撑，面中自然饱满，下颌线清晰柔和。整体保持真实合理的东方柔和骨相：额头自然饱满，太阳穴平滑，颧骨具有轻微支撑但不过度外扩，面中自然饱满，下颌线清晰柔和，下巴精致但不过尖，脸部线条柔和流畅，保持中国年轻女性的美型化真人结构。

眼部设计为偏大的明亮东方杏眼，茶棕至茶琥珀棕渐变虹膜，清晰卧蚕，大面积窗型眼神光。人物拥有偏大的明亮东方杏眼，横向舒展，纵向开合偏大但保持真人比例，自然柔和的双眼皮褶皱与清晰柔软的卧蚕；虹膜为通透的茶棕至茶琥珀棕渐变色，具有细密真实的放射状纹理、清晰的瞳孔边界与自然深棕外缘环，在正面大面积柔光照明下，虹膜受光区呈现轻微蜂蜜棕和琥珀棕层次。眼白明亮清澈但不纯白，角膜湿润透明，内眼角微湿，下眼睑保留极细真实的泪线。两只眼睛均具有较大面积的窗型或矩形柔光反射高光，使眼睛整体明亮、通透、湿润、有神、清澈，成为整张肖像的第一视觉中心。

鼻唇设计为清秀顺直鼻梁，小巧圆润鼻尖，柔和樱桃唇，下唇略饱满。鼻根自然，鼻梁纤细顺直但不过分刀削，鼻尖小巧圆润，鼻翼收敛但保留真实结构；嘴唇自然柔软，唇峰温和，下唇略饱满，保留轻微真实唇纹，具有柔润而不过分玻璃化的细腻水光。

皮肤采用低频高净度冷白瓷感美容真人肌，整体呈现低频高净度冷白瓷感美容真人肌。肤色为高明度、低饱和、中性偏冷的瓷白基底，整体白净、纯净、明亮，明显降低黄调、灰调、土色与肉色感；大面积面颊、额头与下巴保持低频、平整、安静、细腻的皮肤表面，几乎看不到明显毛孔、粗糙颗粒和高频皮肤噪声。皮肤真实感不依赖大面积毛孔和纹理，而主要通过自然面部结构、皮下透光、连续明暗变化以及鼻翼、眼周与唇周极轻微的真实微结构来体现。脸部大面积保持冷净瓷白，仅在眼周、眼下、苹果肌中心小范围、鼻尖和嘴唇保留极低浓度淡粉血色，形成“白是主体、粉是点缀”的色彩关系。额头、鼻梁、苹果肌与唇峰具有宽而柔和的微水光，皮肤显得白净、细腻、柔润、通透，但绝不塑料、绝不蜡像、绝不 CG 化。

妆容采用低浓度粉润美容近景妆，粉色集中在眼周、眼下和唇部，整体为低浓度粉润美容近景妆。眼周使用淡粉杏、蜜桃粉或浅茶粉进行轻柔晕染，上下眼睑之间存在柔和的粉润呼应，眼尾以极细的自然眼线轻微延展；睫毛为黑褐色或深棕黑，纤长、根根分明、自然卷翘，具有足够存在感以形成眼睛局部对比。腮红仅轻柔集中在眼下与苹果肌中心小范围，不大面积覆盖脸颊。嘴唇使用低饱和嫩粉、豆沙嫩粉或水蜜桃粉，呈现细腻柔润、轻反光、轻真实唇纹的效果。

发型为深棕黑色柔顺长发，自然中分，耳侧少量碎发。发丝保持真人摄影质感与适量高频细节，单根发丝自然可辨，不出现塑料发丝、假发感和发片式 CG 边缘；头发整体不应喧宾夺主，而是作为人物面部的柔和陪衬。

摄影采用 100mm 极近景正面美容肖像，高调柔光，冷灰蓝背景。使用 100mm 长焦美容人像镜头语言，避免广角透视畸变。人物脸部占据画面约 70%–90%，双眼位于视觉中心偏上区域。焦点优先锁定双眼、虹膜与睫毛，嘴唇次清晰，耳部和后侧头发可轻微虚化。画面整体遵循“低频皮肤 + 高频五官”的摄影呈现原则：皮肤大面积区域局部反差较低，五官关键位置——尤其睫毛、虹膜、瞳孔、眼线、唇纹和发丝——保持较高真实度与清晰度。

光线采用高调正面美容柔光系统：一个超大面积柔光源位于摄影机正前方、略高于人物眼睛并靠近人物，柔和向下照射，同时存在低强度的柔和补光，使人物面部整体明亮均匀，眼窝、鼻翼、眼下与下颌阴影非常浅且干净。皮肤高光宽而柔和，白净通透但不死白过曝，阴影保持中性或轻微冷调，不发黄、不发灰绿、不发脏。背景采用低饱和冷灰蓝色，亮度低于人物脸部约半档到一档，并保持高度简洁和弱化，以衬托人物肤色更显白净、通透、纯净。

画幅比例为 9:16。整体效果应呈现：一位具有真人摄影真实性的高净度中国瓷白清纯美人，皮肤安静、白净、细腻、低频，眼睛明亮、湿润、通透、富有光学层次，妆面轻盈粉润，整体既真实又带有高完成度美容近景的高级感，但不产生塑料感、CG 感、网红感和全脸统一高清棚拍感。

一位面向镜头微笑的东亚年轻女性，肤色白皙，面部精致，拥有柔和的大棕色眼睛和温和笑容。栗棕色长卷发扎成高马尾，柔软刘海修饰脸部，黑色太阳镜架在头顶。她坐在现代咖啡馆中，身体略微前倾，右手轻触下巴，呈现俏皮自然的姿势。

她穿一件时髦宽松的半透感长袖上衣，横向条纹由不同深浅的蓝色和白色组成。上衣一侧采用不对称露肩设计，露出下方黑色背心肩带；另一侧腰部带有打结细节。下身搭配白色高腰短裤。配饰包括细金项链、小圆环耳环以及右手腕上的细手链。

背景是明亮的当代咖啡馆室内，有木桌、棕色皮椅、咖啡机和墙上的黑板菜单。使用柔和自然光、浅景深和高分辨率真实摄影，整体呈现时装画册风格。

The model sits elegantly beside the seaside café table. One leg crosses naturally over the other beneath the chair while the upper body leans slightly forward. One elbow rests on the table with fingertips supporting the chin, while the opposite hand loosely holds a chilled cocktail glass. The shoulders remain relaxed as the ocean breeze moves the hair gently.

Expression:
Chic.
Romantic.
Timeless.

Camera:
Very low angle.
Environmental portrait.
35mm lens.
Natural golden-hour lighting.

items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的通用钩针定格动画玩偶模板。将恐怖电影反派、重金属乐队、汽车等输入主题转译为高端工艺玩偶；已恢复为可配置的主题变量，不再错误要求人物参考图。
items.prompt:
Subject: a fictional scary-movie villain

Render a fictional scary-movie villain as an ultra-premium stop-motion crochet amigurumi figure. Infer thick premium merino wool, subtle fuzz and halo, shiny plastic safety eyes when appropriate, visible crochet stitches, stuffed plumpness, sewn seams, handmade warmth, chunky proportions, and tactile button details. Remove smooth plastic, realistic hair or fur, and flat textures.

Place the cute, high-quality crochet toy on a simple wooden surface in a clear product-style composition. Use macro craft photography, warm studio lighting, and a cozy but sophisticated juxtaposition between the subject and the handmade medium. Render hyper-realistic yarn texture and physically believable material detail.

Negative: no glowing magic, no real human skin, no messy unspooled yarn, no cheap synthetic textures.
items.prompt_zh:
主题：a fictional scary-movie villain

将 a fictional scary-movie villain 渲染为超高级的定格动画风格钩针编织玩偶。根据需要推断粗厚优质美利奴羊毛、微妙的绒毛与光晕、闪亮的塑料安全眼睛、可见的钩针针脚、饱满的填充感、缝制接缝、手工温暖感、厚实比例和触感纽扣细节。去除光滑塑料、真实头发或皮毛以及扁平纹理。

将可爱且高质量的钩针玩偶放在简单的木质表面上，采用清晰的产品式构图。使用微距工艺摄影和温暖的工作室灯光，让主题与手工媒介之间形成舒适而精致的并置。渲染超真实的纱线纹理和物理上可信的材质细节。

负面：无发光的魔法，无真实人类皮肤，无凌乱的未缠绕纱线，无廉价合成纹理。

He has short, thick curly black hair, a neatly groomed salt-and-pepper beard and mustache, expressive dark eyes, and a warm confident smile.

Seated in a relaxed wide-legged pose, elbows resting naturally near his knees and hands loosely clasped together. Strong graphic composition, full-body portrait, centered framing, low-angle perspective, bold orange-and-black color palette, clean silhouette, dramatic directional lighting, crisp linework, realistic facial details combined with premium comic-book illustration aesthetics.

Highly polished digital artwork, vibrant saturated colors, subtle textured brushwork, sharp edges, intricate clothing folds, realistic skin texture, dramatic shadows, editorial streetwear fashion aesthetic, poster-quality composition, 4K, ultra-high detail, professional character illustration, vertical 9:16 composition. 他以放松的宽腿姿势坐着，手肘自然地靠在膝盖附近，双手轻轻握在一起。强烈的构图，全身肖像，居中构图，低角度透视，鲜明的橙黑配色方案，干净的剪影，戏剧性的定向光照，清晰的线条，写实的面部细节与高级漫画插图美学相结合。
