items.title: 红色背景高端时尚动感拉伸男性人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的概念时装摄影提示词，已按本地图库整理并使用统一人物参考图生成。修正原先的修图分类为人像，保留红色无缝影棚、奶油色罗纹卫衣、运动短裤、墨镜、全身构图和向左拉伸的动态纤维效果。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity anchor for the main visible person. Preserve the conceptual fashion theme, clothing, pose, composition, lighting, and motion effect from the source. The subject is an adult man; create an original surreal street-fashion photograph without requiring a second target image, readable text, logo, or watermark.

Subject and styling:
A stylish adult man stands confidently against a seamless vivid red studio backdrop and red floor. He wears an oversized cream ribbed sweatshirt, loose knee-length distressed denim shorts, black crew socks, chunky black sneakers, a minimalist necklace, and dark futuristic sunglasses. His arms are folded across his chest, his legs are slightly apart, and his expression is calm and self-assured.

Motion effect:
Create an extreme horizontal time-stretch effect pulling the entire left side of the figure toward the left edge. Stretch the sweatshirt sleeves, torso fabric, denim shorts, hair, and silhouette into long flowing translucent textile fibers, layered fine strands, and subtle motion trails. The stretched areas should feel like real fabric dragged rapidly through space, with believable folds, moderate transparency, and fibers dissolving into motion blur. Keep the face, sunglasses, crossed arms, central torso, both legs, and shoes sharp, clean, anatomically coherent, and correctly proportioned.

Studio light and finish:
Use strong controlled studio lighting over a unified red background and floor, with dramatic but physically coherent shadows. Render clear ribbed knit, distressed denim, shoe material, skin texture, and motion fibers, with refined analog film grain and cinematic contrast. Use a vertical 4:5 dynamic full-body composition. Experimental high-fashion street photography, surreal in effect but photorealistic in materials. Avoid low quality, blur, extra people, duplicate limbs, deformed fingers, plastic skin, warped perspective, cluttered effects, text, logos, and watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图绑定主可见人物的面部身份。保留来源的概念时装主题、服装、姿势、构图、光线和动态效果；人物为成年男性，呈现原创超现实街头时装摄影，不要求额外目标图，不出现可读文字、logo或水印。

主体与服装：
一位时髦的成年男性自信地站在无缝鲜艳红色影棚背景与红色地面前，身穿超大号奶油色罗纹运动衫、宽松膝长做旧牛仔短裤、黑色中筒袜和厚底黑色运动鞋，佩戴简约项链与深色未来感太阳镜。双臂交叉抱在胸前，双腿略微分开，表情冷静、自信。

动态效果：
构建极端水平时间拉伸效果，将人物左侧的卫衣袖子、躯干面料、牛仔短裤、头发和身体轮廓向画面左侧拖拽，形成长而流动的半透明织物纤维、叠层细丝和细微运动轨迹。拉伸部分应像真实织物被高速拖过空间，带有自然褶皱、适度透明度和融入运动模糊的纤维；人物脸部、墨镜、交叉双臂、中央躯干、双腿和鞋子必须保持锐利、干净、比例正确。

影棚光线与质感：
强而受控的影棚照明，红色背景和地面保持单色统一，形成戏剧性但物理合理的阴影。清晰呈现罗纹织物、牛仔做旧纹理、鞋面、皮肤和运动纤维，保留高端模拟胶片颗粒与电影级对比度。竖版 4:5 动态全身构图，实验性高级街头时装摄影，超现实但写实。避免低质量、模糊、额外人物、重复肢体、变形手指、塑料皮肤、错误透视、杂乱效果、文字、logo和水印。

items.title: 柔和粉色系宁静午后时尚杂志封面
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

A soft, serene editorial magazine cover in a calm pastel aesthetic, titled “Soft silence!! Quiet Afternoon”. 

Centered young East Asian woman in her early 20s with a short, slightly messy bob haircut (soft brown with lighter ends), gentle calm expression, soft natural makeup, looking directly at the camera. She wears a light blue-gray ribbed knit V-neck sweater and holds a pair of thin metal-framed glasses in both hands near her chest. Soft natural daylight, gentle breeze slightly moving her hair.

Background: outdoor balcony or bridge with ornate black metal railing, soft out-of-focus cityscape and water across a river under a muted overcast sky. Soft, diffused lighting, quiet afternoon atmosphere, pastel color palette (soft blues, grays, creams, muted pastels).

Magazine layout and typography:
- Large bold white title “Afternoon” across the upper center, with “Soft silence!! Quiet” in elegant script above it.
- Small Korean text at top left, Japanese vertical text on the left side, Chinese text on the right side.
- English descriptive phrases: “Calm in motion”, “Gentle breeze”, “Soft silence”, “A quiet moment where soft light meets gentle thoughts. Calm, natural, and effortlessly present.”
- Bottom left “PERSONALITY” section with a short descriptive paragraph about a calm, introspective personality.
- Small design elements: soft white sparkles, thin white curved lines, color dots (beige, dark gray), “EN / JP / CH / KR” language tags, timestamp “15:34 08.01.2026”, vertical “Design by / Alias style”.
- Clean, elegant, minimalist magazine typography with soft overlays, light pastel background tones, high-quality editorial photography style.

Overall mood: quiet, introspective, soft silence, gentle emotional depth, natural and effortlessly present. Soft focus on the subject, high detail on fabric texture and hair, cinematic soft lighting, aesthetic of quiet thoughts. 

Style: realistic editorial photography + clean modern magazine graphic design, soft pastel color grading, dreamy yet natural atmosphere.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

一张柔和、宁静的时尚杂志封面，采用平静的淡雅色调审美，标题为“Soft silence!! Quiet Afternoon”。

中心是一位20岁出头的年轻东亚女性，留着略显凌乱的短波波头（柔和的棕色，发梢颜色较浅），表情温和冷静，妆容自然柔和，直视镜头。她穿着一件浅蓝灰色的罗纹针织V领毛衣，双手在胸前握着一副细金属框眼镜。柔和的自然日光，微风轻轻吹动她的头发。

背景：户外阳台或桥梁，带有华丽的黑色金属栏杆，背景是河对岸模糊的城市景观和水面，天空阴沉。柔和的漫反射光，安静的午后氛围，淡雅的调色板（柔和的蓝色、灰色、奶油色、暗淡的粉彩）。

杂志布局和排版：
- 上方中心有大号加粗白色标题“Afternoon”，上方有优雅手写体的“Soft silence!! Quiet”。
- 左上角有小型韩文文本，左侧有日文垂直文本，右侧有中文文本。
- 英文描述性短语：“Calm in motion”，“Gentle breeze”，“Soft silence”，“A quiet moment where soft light meets gentle thoughts. Calm, natural, and effortlessly present.”
- 左下角有“PERSONALITY”板块，包含一段关于冷静、内省性格的简短描述。
- 小型设计元素：柔和的白色闪烁、细白色曲线、彩色圆点（米色、深灰色）、“EN / JP / CH / KR”语言标签、时间戳“15:34 08.01.2026”、垂直的“Design by / Alias style”。
- 干净、优雅、极简的杂志排版，带有柔和的叠加层、浅粉色的背景色调、高质量的时尚摄影风格。

整体氛围：安静、内省、柔和的沉默、温柔的情感深度、自然且轻松的存在。主体软焦，织物纹理和头发细节清晰，电影感柔和光影，宁静思绪的审美。

风格：写实时尚摄影 + 简洁现代杂志平面设计，柔和淡雅色调调整，梦幻且自然的氛围。

items.title: 盛唐宫廷清晨卸妆冷暖光超写实人像
items.description: A 9:16 hyper-realistic Guofeng portrait of an adult East Asian classical beauty at a dressing table after a long night banquet, with a loose phoenix crown, gold hairpins, lotus-pink Tang dress, cold dawn light, residual candle warmth, quiet expression, and richly detailed period objects.
items.prompt:
9:16 vertical version, single independent image, no collage, no text. Guofeng hyper-realistic CG illustration, High Tang court aesthetics, an intimate makeup removal portrait with the interplay of cold dawn light and warm residual candle light.

A clearly adult East Asian classical beauty sits at a dressing table, half-body close-up composition, the character is in the center of the frame, body turned slightly to the left, with the left shoulder closer to the camera. She looks down toward the lower left, with a quiet, tired, and soft expression, as if having a brief moment of emptiness after a long night banquet. Her right hand is raised to behind her right ear, five fingers naturally inserted between loose long hair, lightly supporting a horizontal gold hairpin that has not yet been removed, not a posed touch.

She has a soft oval face, narrow phoenix eyes, a slender bridge of the nose, and naturally full rouge-colored lips. The eyelids have low-saturation peach-pink and warm-brown residual makeup, the ends of the eyes are slightly smudged, eyes are downcast, not looking at the camera. The skin is cold-white and translucent but realistic, retaining pores, vellus hair, slight fatigue under the eyes, natural flush, and small skin tone differences; the luster on the forehead, cheeks, and neck is restrained, with no plastic-like continuous highlights.

Her black long hair is piled into a magnificent high bun, but the structure is already loose, with several slender hair strands scattered on the sides of her face and chest. She wears a large gold-plated phoenix crown, the crown body is located towards the back of the top of the head, the phoenix wings extend to the upper left and right, equipped with flower branches, pearls, small gold bells, and dense hanging chains. Several gold hairpins are inserted horizontally on the right side, one of which is lightly supported by her fingers; pearl tassels fall naturally behind the ears and the side of the neck.

She wears a low-saturation lotus-pink Tang-style tube top dress, with a transparent pink gauze large-sleeved robe draped over it, featuring very delicate gold thread floral embroidery on the chest, placket, and cuffs. The fabric is soft and thin, the sleeves naturally pile up on the edge of the dressing table, showing real gauze texture and small folds.

The foreground dressing table is a dark wood or leather-edged tabletop. At the bottom left is a short, thick candle that has clearly melted and is about to burn out; in the center are two stacked circular rouge boxes, one open to reveal dark red rouge; on the right lies a long gold hairpin that has already been removed and a few small gold ornaments. A blurred black-gold mirror stand or incense burner appears in the bottom right corner as a foreground obstruction.

Cold dawn light enters from between the curtains and lattice windows on the upper left, forming a distinct but soft cold blue-gray light band, illuminating the character's left forehead, bridge of the nose, cheeks, shoulders, and hair outlines. The residual candle at the bottom left provides warm gold fill light, illuminating the inner arm, the gold threads of the sleeves, the rouge box, and some gold ornaments. Cold light dominates, candle light only serves as small warm color accents, creating a sense of time as the night is about to end.

85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, face, fingers behind the ear, and the main body of the phoenix crown are clear, items on the table are slightly blurred, and background curtains and court space are completely soft focus. The screen colors are mainly low-saturation lotus pink, old gold, cold blue-gray, and dark brown, slight film grain, soft high dynamic range, details in the shadows, highlights not overexposed. Overall atmosphere is quiet, cold, restrained, fragile, and noble, the visual focus is the huge phoenix crown and loose hair strands in the cold morning light.

Avoid minors or juvenile characters, cheap ancient costume photo studio feel, modern accessories, modern makeup, internet celebrity plastic surgery faces, anime eyes, plastic skin, excessive exposure, wrong hands, abnormal number of fingers, hairpins penetrating the head, jewelry sticking together, floating phoenix crown, extra limbs, extra characters, multiple faces in the mirror, cluttered background, overexposure, over-saturation, text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
9:16 竖版，单张独立图片，不要拼图，不要文字。国风超写实 CG 插画，盛唐宫廷美学，黎明冷光与残烛暖光交织的私密卸妆人像。

一位明确成年的东亚古典美人坐在梳妆台前，半身近景构图，人物位于画面中央，身体略微朝左侧转动，左肩更靠近镜头。她低头望向左下方，神情安静、疲惫、柔和，像是在漫长夜宴结束后短暂放空。右手抬至右侧耳后，五指自然插入松散长发之间，轻轻扶住一支尚未取下的横向金簪，并非摆拍式触碰。

她拥有柔和鹅蛋脸、狭长凤眼、纤细鼻梁与自然饱满的胭脂色嘴唇。眼皮带有低饱和桃粉和暖棕色残妆，眼尾略微晕染，眼睛低垂，不看镜头。肌肤冷白透亮但真实，保留毛孔、绒毛、眼下轻微疲态、自然红润和细小肤色差异；额头、脸颊和肩颈的光泽克制，不出现塑料般连续高光。

乌黑长发堆叠成华丽高髻，但结构已经松动，脸侧和胸前散落多根细长发丝。头戴大型鎏金凤凰冠，冠体位于头顶偏后方，凤凰双翼向左右上方延伸，配有花枝、珍珠、小型金铃和细密垂链。右侧横向插着数根金簪，其中一支被她的手指轻轻扶住；珍珠流苏沿耳后和颈侧自然垂落。

她穿低饱和藕粉色唐风抹胸长裙，外披透明粉纱大袖衫，胸前、衣襟和袖口带有非常细腻的金线花卉刺绣。衣料柔软、轻薄，袖子自然堆叠在梳妆台边缘，展现真实纱织纹理与细小褶皱。

前景梳妆台为深色木质或皮革包边台面。左下方是一盏融化明显、即将燃尽的粗短蜡烛；中央放置两只叠放的圆形胭脂盒，一只打开并露出暗红色胭脂；右侧平放一支已经取下的长金簪与少量细小金饰。右下角出现虚化的黑金色镜架或香具作为前景遮挡。

黎明冷光从左上方的帷幔与格窗之间进入，形成明显但柔和的冷青灰光带，照亮人物左侧额头、鼻梁、脸颊、肩膀和发丝轮廓。左下方残烛提供暖金色补光，照亮手臂内侧、衣袖金线、胭脂盒和部分金饰。冷光占据主导，烛光仅作为细小暖色点缀，营造夜晚即将结束的时间感。

85mm 人像镜头，f/1.8，浅景深，面部、耳后手指和凤冠主体清晰，桌面物品略微虚化，背景帷幔和宫廷空间完全柔焦。画面色彩以低饱和藕粉、旧金、冷青灰、深棕为主，轻微胶片颗粒，柔和高动态范围，暗部有细节，高光不过曝。整体氛围安静、清冷、克制、脆弱而尊贵，视觉重点是冷晨光中的巨大凤冠与松散发丝。

避免未成年或幼态人物、廉价古装影楼感、现代饰品、现代妆容、网红整容脸、动漫眼睛、塑料皮肤、过度裸露、错误手部、手指数量异常、发簪穿透头部、首饰粘连、凤冠悬浮、多余肢体、多余人物、镜中多脸、背景杂乱、过曝、过饱和、文字、标志和水印。

items.title: 韩系Y2K时尚杂志甜酷拼贴海报
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的暖白留白、玫红模块和四画面人物拼贴海报模板。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the same adult female model in every photo frame; match facial identity only. Create a 4:5 vertical Korean Y2K fashion-magazine collage poster with a pure cream-white background, 2000s pop fashion, star-archive and lookbook editorial design. Keep it clean, young, sweet-cool, designed and spacious. The adult East Asian model has a small refined face, fair translucent skin, long straight black hair naturally loose with smooth airy strands, and a relaxed natural expression. Dress her in summer Y2K sweet-cool sports streetwear: a fitted cropped white crew-neck T-shirt with a colorful vintage racing-letter graphic and slightly curled hem; light blue-gray vintage-washed high-waisted ultra-short denim with layered wide waistband, double metal buttons, curved stitching and slightly cuffed legs; beige-gray platform dad sneakers; white or off-white mid-calf slouch socks; silver mirrored sports sunglasses hanging at the waist; and a black smartwatch. Some frames may include a light-brown or khaki wide-brim hat. Set the scene at a summer-evening golden-hour countryside sunset with warm natural light, blue sky, soft clouds, grass, wooden fences, wooden houses and sheds, old boards and rattan or woven chairs; give it a retro countryside editorial feeling while keeping the subject a Korean fashion poster hero. Use an irregular modular grid of magenta or peach rectangular color blocks and photo frames of varied sizes, maintaining strict geometric order and generous white space. Keep every rectangle horizontal or vertical, with no rounded corners, complex borders or gradients. At upper left place small bold black English “SUMMER GIRL”; immediately below, place the oversized saturated-magenta geometric sans title “ECLIPSE” with slight glitch, worn and broken-brush texture. Add left auxiliary text “#01.”, “낮의 태양 아래,” and “빛나는 네 스타일”; use white Korean text in magenta middle/lower modules: “여름의 온도.”, “지금, 나답게”, “빛나는 순간”, “Y2K 감성으로 완성한” and “스윗 쿨 썸머 룩”. Add three black bold English lines at lower left: “THE ICONIC”, “SUMMER”, “PROFILE”. Add a small vertical magenta module at lower right or middle with white English “SUNSHINE”, “ON MY MIND”, “-”, “GOOD VIBES”, “ONLY”. Arrange four views of the same model: one complete full-body or near-full-body central image, one large close-up portrait upper right, one partial clothing detail upper-left or middle-left, and one half-body or seated image lower right. Let the character burst in front of the background frames with clear front-to-back overlap and slight natural shadows. Export one complete poster per output, never a seven-grid collection. Keep realistic photography, polished commercial print quality, a lightly glitched title and a natural non-stiff model. No logo, watermark, brand identification, low quality, strange facial features, extra fingers, abnormal limbs or garbled text.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为所有照片框中同一位成年女性模特的面部身份参考，仅匹配面部身份。创作4:5竖版韩系Y2K时尚杂志拼贴海报，暖白纯色背景、2000年代流行时装、明星档案和时装lookbook编辑设计，画面干净、年轻、甜酷、有明显留白。主角为成年东亚女性，脸小、五官精致、白皙通透皮肤、长直黑发自然披散，发丝顺滑带空气感，神态自然松弛，时尚而不僵硬。穿夏日Y2K甜酷运动街头装：白色修身短款圆领赛车字母印花T恤且衣摆微卷，浅蓝灰复古水洗高腰牛仔超短裤，宽腰头叠层、双金属纽扣和弧形车线、裤脚微卷，米灰厚底老爹鞋，白或米白中筒堆袜，腰间银色镜面运动太阳镜，黑色智能运动表；部分画面可有浅棕/卡其宽檐帽。场景为夏日晚间金色时刻乡野日落：暖金自然光、蓝天柔云、草地、木围栏、木屋木棚、旧木板和藤/编织椅，带复古乡野大片感但主体仍是韩系时尚海报。采用不规则模块化网格，由多个玫红/桃红矩形色块和不同尺寸照片框组成，矩形保持水平垂直，无圆角、复杂边框或渐变，严格几何秩序与大量留白。左上放小号黑色粗体英文“SUMMER GIRL”，其下放高饱和玫红超大极粗几何无衬线标题“ECLIPSE”，带轻微故障、磨损和断裂刷擦纹理。左侧加入“#01.”、“낮의 태양 아래,”、“빛나는 네 스타일”；中下玫红模块用白色韩文“여름의 온도.”、“지금, 나답게”、“빛나는 순간”、“Y2K 감성으로 완성한”、“스윗 쿨 썸머 룩”；左下三行黑色英文“THE ICONIC / SUMMER / PROFILE”；右下或中下竖向玫红模块用白色英文“SUNSHINE / ON MY MIND / - / GOOD VIBES / ONLY”。四个照片框分别为中央完整全身或近全身主图、右上大幅近景肖像、左上或左中局部服装细节、右下半身或坐姿图；同一人物从背景框前方穿出，形成清晰前后叠压和轻微自然投影。每次输出一张独立完整海报，不拼成七宫格合集。整体为真实摄影、商业高级印刷质感、轻微故障标题和自然不僵硬的模特。不要logo、水印、品牌标识、低质感、诡异五官、多余手指、奇怪肢体或文字乱码。

items.title: 韩国天气主播后台手机纪实全身照
items.description: 10A身份绑定的成年天气主播在韩国新闻直播后台指向天气地图屏幕的手机纪实全身照。
items.prompt: Use ref-10a-v1 only for the facial identity of the sole visible adult East Asian woman, age 25. Create a 9:16 full-body realistic iPhone 16 Pro-style mobile photograph backstage in a Korean weather-news studio. The adult Korean weather presenter has long curly black hair and a gentle professional smile. She stands naturally and points with one hand toward the large LED weather map behind her. Dress her in a fully opaque white tailored blouse with a modest neckline, a high-waisted taupe gray-beige knee-length pencil skirt with no high slit, and white pointed-toe heels. Keep natural adult proportions and professional posture without body emphasis. The LED map clearly labels 서울, 부산, and 제주 with simple weather symbols. Show blue technology lighting, broadcast cameras, control consoles, and a few softly blurred staff areas. Use natural eye-level handheld mobile perspective, Apple Smart HDR character, realistic exposure and white balance, authentic skin texture, fine pores, slight phone noise, and lively backstage documentary quality. Preserve believable pointing-hand anatomy and full-body framing. Avoid low-angle body emphasis, revealing clothing, distorted limbs, extra fingers, unrelated text, logo, signature, and watermark.

items.title: FRESH BLEND 双饮品极简社交媒体菜单
items.description: 将两张可追溯的 FRESH BLEND 饮品参考图整合为 4:5 高端菜单海报：右上为芒果百香果冰沙，左下为草莓抹茶拿铁，并完整呈现固定英文品牌、品名、描述、价格和社交账号。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for mango_poster; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.
Image 2 is the generated supporting image for matcha_poster; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Use the two uploaded beverage reference images as exact product-identity guides. Image 1 is the FRESH BLEND CAFÉ Mango Passion Smoothie; preserve its transparent dome-lid cup, clear straw, mango-yellow crushed-ice body, passion-fruit seeds, fresh mango cubes, mint garnish, cup proportions and logo placement. Image 2 is the FRESH BLEND CAFÉ Strawberry Matcha Latte; preserve its transparent flat-lid cup, realistic ice, distinct bottom strawberry-puree layer, central creamy-milk layer, upper green matcha layer, cup proportions and logo placement. Do not invent a person or change either drink identity.

Create one premium 4:5 vertical Instagram beverage menu campaign on a bright white-to-soft-cream background with generous negative space. Place the Mango Passion Smoothie near the upper-right and the Strawberry Matcha Latte near the lower-left. Give both products equal visual importance without overlap. Put each drink on a minimal pale circular pedestal. Add only restrained ingredients: mango slices, half a passion fruit and mint near the mango drink; two strawberries, a light dusting of matcha powder and a few ice cubes near the matcha drink. Use bright professional studio lighting, refined transparent reflections, crisp highlights, soft grounded shadows and realistic liquid, fruit, ice and foam textures.

Use elegant modern sans-serif typography with charcoal-black text and restrained mango-orange and strawberry-pink accents. Render all of the following text exactly, preserving capitalization, accents, bullet symbols and prices:
FRESH BLEND CAFÉ
Fresh Favorites
Handcrafted • Fresh • Premium
Mango Passion Smoothie
Sweet mango blended with tropical passion fruit and crushed ice
$5.99
Strawberry Matcha Latte
Premium matcha layered with fresh strawberry puree and creamy milk
$6.49
Made Fresh Every Day
@freshblendcafe

Keep the composition bright, clean, airy, minimal, modern, premium, realistic, commercial and photo-first. No person, hand, extra drink, overlapping cups, changed layers, missing garnish, illegible or misspelled copy, extra text, substituted brand, busy pattern, dark background, distorted cup, logo duplication, watermark, collage edge or interface graphic.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为mango_poster生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。
图2是为matcha_poster生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

使用上传的两张饮品参考图作为精确产品身份依据。图 1 是 FRESH BLEND CAFÉ 芒果百香果冰沙；保留其透明圆顶盖杯、透明吸管、芒果黄色碎冰饮体、百香果籽、新鲜芒果块、薄荷装饰、杯体比例和标志位置。图 2 是 FRESH BLEND CAFÉ 草莓抹茶拿铁；保留其透明平盖杯、真实冰块、底部草莓果泥层、中部奶油牛奶层、顶部绿色抹茶层、杯体比例和标志位置。不得引入人物，也不得改变两款饮品身份。

在明亮白色至柔和奶油色背景上创作一张高级 4:5 竖版 Instagram 饮品菜单海报，保留宽裕负空间。将芒果百香果冰沙放在右上区域，将草莓抹茶拿铁放在左下区域；两款产品视觉权重相等且互不重叠。每杯饮品下方使用简约浅色圆形底座。只加入克制的配料装饰：芒果饮品旁放芒果片、半个百香果与薄荷；抹茶饮品旁放两颗草莓、少量抹茶粉和几块冰。使用明亮专业影棚灯光、精致透明反光、清晰高光、柔和落地阴影，以及写实的饮体、水果、冰块和泡沫质感。

采用优雅现代无衬线字体，主体文字为炭黑色，仅用克制的芒果橙和草莓粉点缀。必须逐字呈现以下全部英文文字，并保留大小写、重音符号、圆点符号和价格：
FRESH BLEND CAFÉ

整体保持明亮、整洁、通透、简约、现代、高级、写实、商业化并以产品摄影为主。不得出现人物、手部、额外饮品、杯体重叠、分层改变、装饰缺失、不可读或拼错文案、额外文字、替换品牌、繁忙图案、深色背景、畸形杯体、重复标志、水印、拼贴边缘或界面图形。

items.title: 成年女性英式学院食堂写实人像
items.description: 成年参考人物在受牛津启发的历史学院食堂里享用午餐的超写实学院风人像，结合高马尾、海军蓝学院装、牛奶盒、哥特拱顶和暖金自然光。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the clearly adult main subject. Create an ultra-realistic candid vertical 3:4 editorial portrait of one adult East Asian woman seated at lunch in a grand historic British collegiate dining hall inspired by Oxford architecture. She has long silky black hair in a high ponytail with soft face-framing strands, natural skin texture, light makeup with subtle pink blush, glossy lips, expressive dark eyes, and a bright genuine laugh while looking left. Dress her in a refined academic outfit: tailored navy blazer with a tasteful generic gold embroidered collegiate crest motif, crisp white button-up shirt, navy-and-silver striped bow tie, navy-and-gray plaid pleated skirt, and polished brass buttons. Keep the styling adult, tasteful, and non-sexualized. She holds a green-and-white milk carton with a white straw in both hands on a polished wooden dining table. Other adult students in smart collegiate clothing may appear softly blurred in the background. Show Gothic stone arches, aged oak paneling, stained-glass windows, vaulted ceilings, wrought-iron chandeliers, polished tables, and warm golden daylight from tall windows. Use full-frame DSLR 85mm f/1.8 portrait perspective, sharp focus on the subject, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and hair, cinematic HDR, premium color grading, and authentic editorial photography. Avoid underage appearance, nudity, sexualized framing, real institutional logos or copied crests, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, text, watermarks, borders, and collages.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为明确成年主要人物的面部身份依据。创建一张超写实的竖版 3:4 编辑人像，画面中只有一位成年东亚女性，在一座受牛津建筑启发的宏伟历史英国学院食堂里午餐。她留柔滑乌黑长发并扎高马尾，脸侧有柔软碎发，保留自然皮肤纹理、淡妆、微妙粉色腮红、亮泽嘴唇和富有表现力的深色眼睛；她向左看并自然开怀大笑。她穿精致学院装：合身海军蓝西装外套，带有得体的通用金色学院风刺绣纹样，挺括白色纽扣衬衫，海军蓝与银色条纹领结，海军蓝与灰色格子百褶裙和抛光黄铜纽扣。整体保持成年、得体且不性化。她双手握着带白色吸管的绿白牛奶盒，放在抛光木餐桌上。背景可有身着干练学院服的成年学生被柔和虚化。展示哥特式石拱门、古老橡木镶板、彩色玻璃窗、拱形天花板、锻铁吊灯、抛光餐桌和高窗射入的暖金自然光。使用全画幅单反 85mm f/1.8 人像透视，主体清晰对焦，浅景深，真实皮肤与发丝，电影级 HDR，高级调色和真实编辑摄影。避免未成年外观、裸露、性化取景、真实机构标志或复制徽章、畸形手部、多余手指、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、文字、水印、边框和拼图。

items.title: 90年代日系职场杂志纸带超现实双人写真
items.description: A 4:5 cold gray-blue CCD editorial featuring two clearly adult East Asian women in a surreal night office, with vintage continuous computer paper winding between chairs and bodies, one woman analyzing paper and the other peering through a torn sheet, restrained professional styling, direct flash and realistic photographic texture.
items.prompt: 4:5 vertical, 90s Japanese office magazine editorial, night office studio shoot, CCD direct flash, slight high-angle close-up composition, cold gray-blue tone, absurd office surreal photography, realistic photographic texture. Two distinctly 20–26-year-old fictional adult East Asian women, not corresponding to any real people or artists. Clear cold-white professional makeup, natural semi-matte skin, retaining pores, fuzz, and slight skin tone variations, thin black eyeliner, low-saturation dusty rose moist lips, no excessive highlights on cheeks and forehead. One woman wearing black square-frame glasses, black hair tied up slightly messily, wearing a gray suit, white shirt, dark narrow tie, sitting in an office chair, looking down seriously studying the continuous computer paper in her hands, expression like analyzing important data. The other woman has long straight black hair, wearing the same series of gray professional suits, surrounded by a large amount of extra-long continuous computer paper, showing half a face and one eye through an irregular paper tear, looking directly at the camera, expression quiet and alert. A large amount of vintage continuous computer paper with perforated tractor-feed edges naturally winds between two chairs, figures' shoulders, arms, bodies, and the desk, forming flowing arcs of paper ribbons. The paper has only very faint table borders, grids, and blank structures, without any readable text, numbers, or garbled code. Paper is the only main prop; do not add a large amount of stationery. The camera shoots slightly from above the desk, with a gray-white office desk occupying the lower foreground of the frame, printing paper extending from the foreground to around the figures, creating a strong sense of layering and envelopment. The background only retains blurred blinds, gray filing cabinets, and dark office chairs. On-camera direct flash illuminates from the camera direction, creating clear hard highlights on glasses, eyes, the bridge of the nose, paper creases, hair strands, and suit fabric, with short and clear shadows. No readable report text, real brands, company names, logos, watermarks, extra characters, excessive stationery, plastic skin, incorrect fingers, paper passing through bodies, paper floating without gravity, or duplicated limbs.
items.prompt_zh:
4:5 竖版，90 年代日系职场杂志 editorial，夜间办公室棚拍，CCD direct flash，轻俯拍近距离构图，冷灰蓝色调，荒诞办公室超现实写真，真实摄影质感。

两位明确 20–26 岁的虚构成年东亚女性，不对应任何真实人物或艺人。清透冷白职感妆，自然半哑光皮肤，保留毛孔、绒毛和轻微肤色变化，细黑眼线，低饱和豆沙色水润唇，脸颊和额头不过度高光。

一位女性戴黑色方框眼镜，黑发略凌乱地盘起，穿灰色西装、白色衬衫、深色窄领带，坐在办公椅上，低头认真研究手中的连续打印纸，表情像在分析重要数据。另一位女性留黑色长直发，穿同系列灰色职场套装，被大量超长连续打印纸环绕，从一处撕开的不规则纸张破口中露出半张脸和一只眼睛，直视镜头，神态安静而警觉。

大量带有圆孔齿边的老式连续打印纸在两把椅子、人物肩部、手臂、身体和桌面之间自然缠绕，形成流动的纸带弧线。纸张只有极浅的表格框线、网格和空白结构，不出现任何可读文字、数字或乱码。纸张是唯一主道具，不能加入大量文具。

镜头从桌面上方略微俯拍，灰白办公桌占据画面下方前景，打印纸从前景向人物周围延伸，制造强烈层次和包围感。背景只保留模糊的百叶窗、灰色文件柜和深色办公椅。机顶直闪从镜头方向照射，在眼镜、眼睛、鼻梁、纸张折痕、发丝和西装面料上形成清晰硬质高光，阴影短而明确。

不要可读报表文字、真实品牌、公司名称、Logo、水印、额外人物、过多文具、塑料皮肤、错误手指、纸张穿过身体、纸张无重力悬浮或重复肢体。

items.title: 浅灰挂颈上衣与深靛牛仔裙穿搭
items.description: 以配置的人物参考图绑定主角身份的干净全身时装穿搭展示：浅灰针织挂颈上衣、深靛色弧线拼接牛仔束身裙、白色皮革渔夫凉鞋、靛蓝月牙包与银色粗圈耳环。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the sole visible adult woman. Create a clean, realistic full-body fashion outfit photograph that presents the clothing clearly. Keep the styling simple and let the outfit remain the subject.

Outfit: a pale-gray jersey halter top; a dark-indigo denim corset skirt with curved panel seams and a front slit; white leather fisherman sandals; a compact indigo crescent bag; and chunky silver hoop earrings. Preserve the fabrics, colors, silhouette, seam lines, slit, bag shape, sandal construction, and jewelry scale accurately.

Use a natural relaxed standing pose, neutral uncluttered fashion backdrop, soft even daylight, realistic skin and fabric texture, and a straightforward editorial/catalog composition with the complete outfit visible from head to shoes. Avoid adding jackets, extra layers, logos, text, props, dramatic scenery, or unrelated accessories.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物参考图作为画面中唯一可见成年女性的面部身份参考。创作一张干净写实的全身时装穿搭照片，清楚展示服装，不加入复杂叙事，让穿搭本身成为主体。

穿搭包括：浅灰色针织挂颈上衣；深靛色牛仔束身裙，带弧线拼接缝线和前开衩；白色皮革渔夫凉鞋；小巧靛蓝色月牙包；以及银色粗圈耳环。准确保留面料、色彩、轮廓、拼接线、开衩、包形、凉鞋结构和配饰尺度。

使用自然放松的站姿、简洁不杂乱的中性时装背景、柔和均匀的日光、真实皮肤与面料纹理，以及直接清楚的编辑/目录式构图，完整拍到头部至鞋子。不要添加外套、额外叠穿、Logo、文字、道具、戏剧化场景或无关配饰。

items.title: 被海风吹散的夏日海边时尚人像
items.description: 10A身份绑定的成年女性在晴朗海岸公路旁扶着电线杆迎风后仰，象牙白上衣、浅水蓝短裤和腰间白衬衫构成清爽夏日时尚全身像。
items.prompt:
Use ref-10a-v1 only for the facial identity of the sole visible adult East Asian woman, in her mid-20s. Create one realistic 3:4 vertical full-body summer fashion photograph on a clear seaside road. She stands slightly left of center with one hand making believable contact with a thick utility pole at the right edge, her torso arched gently backward, face lifted, eyes peacefully closed, lips slightly parted, other arm relaxed, and legs lightly crossed. Wind blows her long bright-chestnut layered hair and the white shirt tied around her waist.

Give her a soft oval face, clean jawline, slender nose, light-brown brows, delicate lashes, pale-beige eye makeup, moderate cheek color, and natural coral-pink glossy lips. Dress her in an ivory draped-neck sleeveless top, light-aqua high-waisted tailored shorts with full opaque coverage, a lightweight white long-sleeved shirt tied securely at the waist, white ribbed knee socks, and lace-up white square-toe heels.

Behind her, show a continuous white guardrail, calm blue sea, lush distant coastline, and small town. Let a vast deep-clear blue sky occupy most of the upper frame, with thin low clouds. Strong summer sunlight from diagonally above creates bright highlights on skin, hair, and white clothing and a clean natural shadow at her feet. Use a subtle low-angle wide perspective that emphasizes sky and elegant silhouette without distorting anatomy. Keep the subject sharp and the distance softly blurred. Render natural skin, wind-blown hair, thin fabric, ribbed socks, metal pole, and asphalt with restrained blue, white, and pale-aqua color. Avoid excessive HDR, beauty filters, malformed hands or legs, poor pole contact, missing waist shirt, extra people, text, logo, signature, and watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
仅将 ref-10a-v1 用于唯一可见成年东亚女性的面部身份，人物为二十多岁。创作一张写实3:4竖版夏日海边时尚全身照。她位于画面中央略偏左，一只手在头部高度真实接触右侧粗壮电线杆，上身轻柔后仰，脸庞抬起，双眼安静闭合，嘴唇微启；另一只手臂自然下垂，双腿轻微交叉。海风吹起明亮栗棕色层次长发和腰间系着的白衬衫。

面部为柔和鹅蛋形轮廓、干净下颌线、纤细鼻梁、浅棕眉、细腻睫毛、淡米色眼妆、适度红润和自然珊瑚粉光泽唇。服装包括象牙白垂褶领无袖上衣、完整不透明的浅水蓝高腰合体短裤、稳固系在腰间的轻薄白色长袖衬衫、白色罗纹及膝袜和系带白色方头高跟鞋。

背景有连续白色护栏、平静蓝海、远处葱郁海岸线和小镇。浓郁清澈的蓝天占画面上部大部分空间，低处有薄云。强烈夏日阳光从斜上方照射，在肌肤、头发和白衣上形成明亮高光，并在脚下留下轮廓清晰的自然阴影。使用轻微低角度广角透视，强调天空和优雅轮廓但不扭曲人体。人物清晰，远景柔和虚化；真实表现肌肤、迎风发丝、薄布料、罗纹袜、金属杆和柏油路，以蓝、白、浅水蓝为克制主色。避免过度HDR、美颜、手腿畸形、手与电线杆接触不良、腰间白衬衫缺失、额外人物、文字、标志、签名和水印。

items.title: 成年女性高端医美五联屏轮廓海报
items.description: 一张国际化高端医美五联屏海报，以成年参考人物讲述颈部与下颌轮廓护理：人物肖像、侧面轮廓规划、专业注射近景、自然结果和温暖咨询收束。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the clearly adult main subject. Create an ultra-premium vertical medical-aesthetics campaign poster with an exact five-panel editorial story for a fictional luxury clinic brand, AURELIA FACE LAB. Use English as the main headline system and Chinese as the smaller subtitle layer. Keep the visual system calm, spacious, clinically persuasive, tactile, de-AI, and internationally premium, with blush nude, warm rose beige, champagne, pearl cream, soft taupe, ivory, and natural skin neutrals. Panel 1 top-left: a healthy clearly adult woman in a refined close-up, head gently tilted upward, long neck visible, slight natural smile, realistic pores, peach fuzz, lip texture, tonal variation, neck tension, hydrated sheen, and restrained tracing light along jaw and neck. Panel 2 top-right: the same woman in side profile with several very fine anatomically accurate professional contour-guideline lines along lower face, jaw, and neck; no decorative doodles. Panel 3 middle-left: a discreet medically accurate treatment close-up with the woman reclining while a trained professional performs a precise neck or jaw treatment; anatomically correct gloved hand, believable syringe angle, finger placement, skin contact, and minimal guide points. Panel 4 middle-right: a natural result portrait with firmer jaw and neck contour, healthy radiant skin, believable refinement rather than dramatic transformation, and only subtle pearl-like atmosphere. Panel 5 bottom full width: a warmer consultation-invitation portrait of the same adult woman touching her neck or jaw with graceful fingers, with minimal premium typography. Unify all panels with ultra-soft editorial-clinical lighting, delicate highlight rolloff, realistic skin pores, neck folds, droplets, glove surfaces, contour traces, and subtle particles. Keep typography airy and restrained: AURELIA FACE LAB, headline NECK LIFT, Chinese subtitle 颈部紧塑提拉, and a minimal consultation block. Maintain consistent spacing, alignment, palette, realism, and negative space. Avoid underage appearance, nudity, sexualized framing, unlicensed real-person identity, unsafe injection technique, incorrect hands, extra fingers, clutter, bulky copy, neon medical glow, harsh flash, plastic skin, uncanny beauty, distorted faces, watermarks, borders, and collages.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为明确成年主要人物的面部身份依据。创建一张超高端竖版医美活动海报，使用虚构奢华诊所品牌 AURELIA FACE LAB，严格讲述五联屏社论故事。以英文作为主标题系统，以中文作为较小副标题层。整体保持安静、宽松、临床可信、触感真实、去 AI 感和国际化高级感，使用裸粉、暖玫瑰米色、香槟、珍珠奶油、柔和灰褐、象牙白和自然肤色中性色。左上第一屏：一位明确成年的女性精致近景，头部轻轻上扬，长颈可见，带自然微笑；保留真实毛孔、面部绒毛、唇纹、肤色变化、颈部张力、保湿光泽，并沿下颌和颈部加入克制描边光。右上第二屏：同一女性侧面轮廓，沿下脸、下颌和颈部绘制几条极细且符合解剖的专业轮廓规划线，不要装饰涂鸦。中左第三屏：克制的医学治疗近景，女性平躺，由专业人员进行精确的颈部或下颌治疗；手套手部解剖正确，注射器角度、手指位置和皮肤接触可信安全，只保留极少引导点。中右第四屏：自然结果肖像，下颌与颈部轮廓更清晰紧致，皮肤健康有光泽，变化可信克制，不要戏剧性改造，只加入极细珍珠般氛围。底部全宽第五屏：同一成年女性以优雅手指轻触颈部或下颌，呈现更温暖的咨询邀请情绪，搭配极简高级排版。所有屏幕统一使用超柔和医美编辑光线、细腻高光过渡、真实毛孔、颈部褶皱、液滴、手套材质、轮廓线和微粒。排版保持疏朗克制：AURELIA FACE LAB、英文主标题 NECK LIFT、中文副标题“颈部紧塑提拉”和极简咨询信息块。保持各屏幕间距、对齐、色彩、写实度和留白一致。避免未成年外观、裸露、性化取景、未经授权的真实身份、不安全注射手法、错误手部、多余手指、杂乱、过多文案、笨重字体、霓虹医疗光、硬闪光、塑料皮肤、诡异美颜、变形面部、水印、边框和拼图。

items.title: 浮世绘超现实和服少女侧颜肖像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Hyper detailed portrait, beautiful Japanese woman, profile view facing right, head tilted back, eyes closed, lips slightly parted, serene expression. Flawless porcelain skin, soft red eyeshadow, deep vermilion lipstick, elegant elongated neck. Nihongami updo, glossy black hair with loose strands. Elaborate kanzashi on left: antique gold filigree, white chrysanthemum, crimson camellia, white blossoms, dark green leaves, turquoise/coral beads, crimson silk tassel, bira bira gold chain dangles. Single long red tassel earring with gold filigree cap. Layered silk kimono: ivory outer robe with gold leaf florals, indigo/teal peacock feather motifs, silver/gold embroidery; navy brocade inner with gold arabesque, white under collar, vermilion trim; crimson sash. Background: aged cream washi paper, mottled ink stains, gold leaf flecks, deep vermilion rising sun, gold cloud/wave drawings, white/black cranes with red crowns, red seal stamps. Ukiyo e meets hyperrealism, neo traditional Japanese, museum quality, dramatic soft studio lighting from right, cinematic color grading, antique ivory/gold/indigo/vermilion palette, 8K. No watermark, text, modern clothing, hanfu, frontal view, open eyes, extra hands, distorted face, blur. --ar 9:16 --raw --stylize 700 --hd
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

极度详细的肖像，美丽的日本女性，右侧面视图，头部后仰，闭眼，嘴唇微张，表情安详。无暇的瓷肌，柔和的红色眼影，深朱红色唇膏，优雅修长的脖子。日本发髻，光泽的黑发，带有散落的发丝。左侧精致的发簪：古董金丝花卉，白菊花，深红山茶花，白色小花，深绿色叶子，绿松石/珊瑚珠，深红丝绸流苏，bira bira 金链挂饰。单只长款红色流苏耳环，带有金丝帽。叠穿丝绸和服：象牙色外袍，饰有金箔花卉，靛蓝/青色孔雀羽毛图案，银/金绣；深蓝色锦缎内衬，饰有金色蔓草纹，白色内领，朱红色饰边；深红色腰带。背景：陈旧的乳白色和纸，斑驳的墨迹，金箔碎片，深朱红色的旭日，金色云彩/波浪图画，红顶白黑鹤，红色印章。浮世绘结合超现实主义，新传统日本风格，博物馆质量，右侧戏剧性的柔和摄影棚灯光，电影级调色，古董象牙色/金色/靛蓝色/朱红色色调，8K。无水印，文字，现代服装，汉服，正面视图，睁眼，多余的手，扭曲的面部，模糊。 --ar 9:16 --raw --stylize 700 --hd

items.title: 唐风仙侠星河观星女主角色海报
items.description: 10A身份绑定的成年仙侠女主在高台观象台俯身感应古风星盘，身穿淡紫银白层叠纱裙与珠链银饰，呈现冷亮星河角色海报。
items.prompt:
Use ref-10a-v1 only for the facial identity of the sole visible adult East Asian woman, age 25. Create one 9:16 high-precision Xianxia galaxy character poster with Tang-inspired fantasy aesthetics: dreamy, mysterious, intelligent, agile, ethereal, and fully polished. Place the adult astrology heroine on a high observatory platform studying an ancient star-map instrument. Preserve natural East Asian features, smooth facial contours, rounded almond eyes with slender outer corners, a clear contemplative gaze, graceful nose, soft defined lips, and cool luminous skin with realistic texture and starlight glow; avoid Westernized, childlike, or influencer styling.

Use ethereal cold-white moonlight makeup: thin translucent base, light gray-purple and cool-brown eye shading, pale silver pearl highlights, a trace of misty purple, fine extended eyeliner, defined lashes, subtly brightened lower eyes, minimal blush, and restrained low-saturation cool rose lips. Add dimensional highlights on nose bridge and tip, under-eyes, central face, cheekbones, and cupid's bow. Place an intricate silver-white or silver-purple Huadian and tiny star-like forehead ornaments.

Style smooth black long hair half-up and half-down with moderate crown volume and fine strands over the shoulders and back. Interweave thin silver chains. Add an ornate silver crown, delicate Buyao chains, pale-purple gems, pearl tassels, white-jade details, star motifs, and long cold-silver pearl-and-gem earrings, all refined without overwhelming the face.

Dress her in a layered light-gauze Xianxia gown with a pearl-chain overlay. Use misty pale purple only in the dress and eye-makeup accents; use silver white, moon white, and pearl white as supporting colors, with cool silver, pearls, pale-purple gems, and white jade. The moon-white inner gown is fully opaque and securely covers the body; outer translucent drapes and soft gauze layers add movement. Cover shoulders, neckline, upper arms, or waist with decorative bead chains. Embroider stars, flowing clouds, orbital lines, small flowers, or Baoxiang motifs.

Frame a close view from the front-side angle. She leans slightly toward the star map, one hand hovering above it with naturally spread or gently curved fingers as if sensing moving orbits; the other rests near a sleeve, waist, or map edge. Keep her face the absolute focal point and the star map a supporting story prop. Blur the galaxy, clouds, observatory stone pillars, and star-map lights behind her. Use a deep blue-black night sky, silver starlight, pale cold-lit clouds, and visible distant pillar silhouettes; do not let the sky become broadly purple. Combine cold star-map light with soft facial illumination, producing crisp highlights on fingers, jawline, bead chains, silver ornaments, and hair chains. Show exactly one adult person, correct anatomy, no text, logo, signature, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
仅将 ref-10a-v1 用于唯一可见成年东亚女性的面部身份，人物明确为25岁。创作一张9:16高精度古风仙侠星河角色海报，采用唐风幻想审美，整体梦幻、神秘、聪慧、灵动、仙气且完成度高。成年星象女主位于高台观象台，正在研究古风星盘仪器。保留自然东方五官、流畅面部轮廓、圆润杏眼与细长眼尾、清亮而若有所思的眼神、秀挺自然鼻型、柔软清晰唇形，以及带真实纹理和星辉柔光的冷白通透肌肤；不要欧美化、幼态化或网红化。

妆容采用仙气冷白月光妆：轻薄通透底妆、浅灰紫与冷棕眼影、淡银白珠光、少量极浅雾紫、纤细轻拉长眼线、清晰睫毛、轻微提亮的卧蚕、极弱腮红和克制的低饱和冷玫瑰唇。鼻梁、鼻尖、眼下、面中、颧骨上方与唇峰形成星盘冷光下的立体高光。额间加入精致银白或银紫花钿和细小星点式额饰。

黑色柔顺长发半披半挽，发顶适度蓬松，细腻发丝自然垂落肩侧与身后，发间穿插银色细链。佩戴华丽但不压脸的银饰发冠、细链步摇、淡紫宝石、珍珠流苏、白玉小饰和星纹结构件，并搭配冷银、珍珠与淡紫宝石长坠耳饰。

服装为带珠链罩层的轻纱仙侠层叠裙。雾紫与淡紫仅用于服装和眼妆呼应；银白、月白与珍珠白为辅助色，冷银、珍珠、淡紫宝石和白玉作点缀。月白内层主裙完整不透明并稳固遮盖身体，外层叠加半透明披层和柔和雾纱。肩颈、上臂或腰侧覆盖装饰珠链，衣身绣星纹、流云纹、星轨纹、小花或宝相花纹。

镜头从侧前方近景拍摄。她微微俯身看向星盘，一只手悬停在星盘上方，手指自然展开或轻收，仿佛感应星轨运行；另一只手靠近袖边、腰侧或星盘边缘。人物脸部是绝对视觉中心，星盘只作剧情道具。背景虚化星河、云层、观象台石柱与星盘光点，夜空为深蓝黑色，配银白星辉、柔和冷光云层和可见的远景石柱轮廓；夜空不得大面积泛紫。星盘冷光与柔和面光结合，手指、下颌、服装珠链、银饰和发间细链高光清晰。只出现一名成年人，解剖正确，无文字、标志、签名或水印。

items.title: 夏日洗衣店奶油粉彩胶片人像
items.description: 10A身份绑定的成年女性穿完整不透明的浅色碎花及膝夏裙，在明亮洗衣店窗边地面拍摄奶油粉彩35毫米胶片人像。
items.prompt:
Use ref-10a-v1 only for the facial identity of the sole visible adult East Asian woman, explicitly age 25. Create one independent 3:4 vertical image with no collage, grid, or readable text. Make a fresh romantic summer portrait in a bright laundromat using low-saturation creamy pastels, a quiet soft natural mood, and authentic 35mm film photography with natural grain, gentle contrast, slight warm color shift, realistic skin micro-texture, and minimal retouching.

Give the adult woman peach-pink makeup, clear berry lips, and long chestnut curls tied into a loose low ponytail, with stray hairs falling naturally along both cheeks. Dress her in a fully opaque, wide-strap, light-colored floral knee-length summer dress with a modest neckline and white ribbed knee-high socks. The fabric must provide complete secure coverage and fall naturally around the seated pose.

She sits on the laundromat floor beside the window. One leg bends naturally and the other extends forward; her left hand lightly touches hair beside her ear, her right palm supports her on the floor, and her torso leans slightly toward the camera. She looks quietly and directly into the lens with a soft thoughtful expression. Use a close medium composition from a natural eye-to-chest-height perspective, avoiding low-angle emphasis. Keep a blurred circular washing-machine door frame in the left foreground, a row of bright windows on the right, and repeating stainless-steel washers in the background. Diagonal sunlight enters from the right windows and makes soft reflections on her cheek, arms, knee, and white socks.

Show exactly one adult person with correct hands, feet, limbs, and natural proportions. Avoid underage cues, infantilization, revealing clothing, transparency, sexualized posing, exaggerated perspective, plastic skin, wet-looking face, clutter, malformed anatomy, readable text, logo, signature, and watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
仅将 ref-10a-v1 用于唯一可见成年东亚女性的面部身份，人物明确为25岁。创作一张独立3:4竖版图片，不要拼图、网格或可读文字。在明亮洗衣店拍摄清新浪漫的夏日人像，使用低饱和奶油粉彩色系和安静、柔和、自然的氛围；呈现真实35毫米胶片摄影，包括自然颗粒、柔和反差、轻微暖色偏移、真实皮肤微纹理和低磨皮。

成年女性采用桃粉妆容与清透莓果唇，栗色长卷发扎成松散低马尾，碎发自然垂落脸颊两侧。她穿完整不透明的浅色碎花及膝夏裙，采用宽肩带、端庄领口，并搭配白色罗纹及膝长袜。裙装完整稳固遮盖，面料随坐姿自然垂落。

她坐在洗衣店窗边地面，一条腿自然弯起，另一条腿向前舒展；左手轻触耳边碎发，右手撑地保持平衡，身体微微朝镜头倾斜。她安静直视镜头，神情柔和、若有所思。使用自然平视至胸部高度的近距离中景，不用低角度突出身体。左前景保留虚化的滚筒洗衣机圆形门框，右侧为整排明亮窗户，背景是不锈钢洗衣机的重复节奏。阳光从右窗斜落，在脸颊、手臂、膝部和白袜上形成柔亮反射。

只出现一名成年人，手脚、四肢和人体比例正确。避免未成年特征、幼态化、暴露服装、透明面料、性化姿势、夸张透视、塑料皮肤、全脸湿亮、杂乱背景、解剖畸形、可读文字、标志、签名和水印。

items.title: 奶油墙混合媒介时尚肖像与黑墨涂鸦
items.description: A premium editorial collage pairing a full-body adult portrait using the fixed identity reference on the left with a same-pose expressive black-ink fashion doodle on a cream studio wall at right, using a fresh modest pastel outfit, a leaf umbrella pose, natural daylight, and whimsical flower details.

Use the uploaded character reference image as the strict identity reference.

Preserve exactly:

face identity

facial proportions

eye shape

eyebrows

nose

lips

skin tone

hairstyle

hair color

hairline

facial expression

body proportions

Do not change, beautify, stylize, or redesign the face in any way.
Keep the person 100% recognizable with zero facial drift.

The clothing should be COMPLETELY DIFFERENT from the uploaded image.
Generate a fresh fashionable outfit that fits a modern lifestyle editorial while keeping the person's identity unchanged.

Create a premium mixed-media fashion editorial portrait.

Scene:

A clean cream-colored studio wall with a minimal editorial aesthetic.

The composition contains two versions of the same person.

LEFT:
A realistic full-body photograph of the uploaded person.

RIGHT:
A loose black hand-drawn fashion doodle of the same person drawn directly on the wall.

The doodle is NOT another real person.

Outfit:

Editorial collage layout.

Real person on the LEFT.

Doodle illustration on the RIGHT.

Show both figures from head to shoes.

Keep generous spacing exactly like a magazine fashion editorial.

The doodle should be approximately the same height as the real person.

Background:

Minimal cream wall.

Clean studio floor.

No clutter.

No furniture.

Lighting:

Soft natural daylight.

Luxury editorial photography.

Bright clean shadows.

Natural realistic skin.

Style:

Luxury fashion editorial.

Mixed-media illustration.

Realistic photography combined with expressive black ink fashion sketch.

Instagram aesthetic.

Cute.

Elegant.

Stylish.

Magazine quality.

Ultra realistic.

Negative Prompt:

identity drift, face change, hairstyle change, different person, duplicated person, realistic second person, anime, colored doodle, monster shadow, horror, clutter, text, watermark, logo, cropped body, cropped feet, extra limbs, extra fingers, bad anatomy, low quality, AI artifacts.

items.title: 顶级旗舰甜品KV奶油旋涡动感视觉海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium global flagship dessert advertising key visual. Preserve the source reference's slightly top-down commercial perspective. Place one original fictional dessert cup in the lower center of a tall vertical frame, viewed slightly from above so the opening and dessert surface are visible. From the cup, make a silky vanilla-cream vortex rise on the central axis and expand into a controlled crown in the upper half. Suspend glossy caramel rings, chocolate-coated wafer bites, crisp biscuit fragments and fine crumbs in a deliberate orbital rhythm. The result must be iconic, legible, premium, physically believable and irresistibly edible. Use no real brand name, copied logo, slogan or readable packaging text.

COMPOSITION AND BRAND TOTEM
Use a strict centered vertical composition with the cup as the absolute hero and brand anchor. Keep its silhouette clean and instantly recognizable, with bold original red-and-ivory graphic blocking and a simple abstract, non-readable insignia. Make the cup-to-vortex relationship feel like a complete fictional visual identity system: global and flagship, more iconic than decorative or playful.

SCULPTURAL ORBIT
Make the cream column dynamic, tensile and sculptural, with clear upward acceleration and a dramatic but elegant crown. Wrap smooth caramel ribbons around it in layered elliptical orbits. Let wafers and crumbs follow a deliberate rising trajectory as if drawn into a refined dessert cyclone. Keep the shape explosive yet controlled and commercially disciplined.

NATURAL EDIBLE MATERIALS
The cream must look dense, whipped and aerated, with realistic extrusion ridges, soft folds, rounded peaks, gravity and subtle micro-air structure. Caramel is smooth, glossy, elastic translucent amber-gold with believable viscosity and thickness variation. Chocolate-coated wafers have satin milk-chocolate shells, crisp wafer layers and creamy filling. Crumbs vary naturally and show toasted biscuit realism. Give the cup matte printed-paper texture, premium finish and clean edges. No hard splash simulation, synthetic foam, plastic CGI edges, waxy chocolate or greasy highlights.

LIGHTING AND COLOR
Use high-end studio lighting: warm top-front key, soft lateral fill and refined specular accents on caramel, chocolate and selected cream ridges. Create a warm, indulgent, modern palette of vanilla ivory, cream white, caramel amber, toasted biscuit gold, milk-chocolate brown and copper warmth against a smooth caramel-to-mocha gradient studio background with a subtle center glow. Keep a clean minimal environment with only fine crumbs and particles for depth. No spoon, table, extra packaging or redundant props.

CAMERA, MOOD AND FINISH
Maintain the slightly top-down view; keep the cup opening, first cream folds and full cup-to-crown vortex clearly readable. Use poster-ready negative space, clean silhouette separation and immediate product recognition. Mood: iconic, flagship, silky, sculptural, craveable, polished, indulgent, globally premium and luxurious. Style: ultra-premium dessert advertising photography, global flagship fast-dessert KV, refined retouching and high detail.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
No eye-level or low-angle view, real brands, copied logos, readable slogans, messy splash, fake CGI cream, plastic chocolate, oily highlights, chaotic crumbs, weak cup presence, clutter, low-detail wafers, dirty shadows, cheap fast-food look, distorted perspective or oversaturated colors.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张超高级、面向全球旗舰市场的甜品广告 KV。保留参考图略微俯拍的商业视角。将一个原创虚构甜品杯置于高挑竖幅的下方中央，从略高处观看，清楚看到杯口与内部甜品表面。让丝滑香草奶油从杯口沿中央轴线向上形成旋涡，并在上半区扩展为受控的皇冠状奶油结构。周围以有秩序的轨道节奏悬浮光泽焦糖环、巧克力脆皮威化块、酥脆饼干碎片和细小面包屑。成品应具有标志性、清晰可读、高级、符合物理且极具食欲。不得使用真实品牌名称、复制 logo、口号或可读包装文字。

构图与品牌图腾
使用严格居中的竖向构图，让杯体成为绝对主角与品牌锚点。杯身轮廓必须干净、强烈且一眼可辨，采用大胆原创的红色与象牙白图形分区，并加入简单、不可读的抽象标记。杯体与奶油旋涡应像完整的虚构视觉识别系统：全球化、旗舰级、标志性强，不要装饰化或过度 playful。

雕塑旋涡
让奶油柱具有动态、拉伸和雕塑感，向上加速明显，在顶部形成戏剧性但优雅的扩张。用平滑焦糖丝带围绕奶油形成有空间层次的椭圆轨道。让威化块与碎屑沿明确的上升轨迹运动，仿佛被精致的甜品旋风吸引。形态可以有爆发力，但必须受控并符合商业设计纪律。

自然可食材质
奶油必须像浓稠、蓬松、充气充分的真实奶油，具有自然挤出纹理、柔软褶皱、圆润尖峰、重力感和细微气孔结构。焦糖呈平滑、有光泽、有弹性的半透明琥珀金色，体现可信的黏度与厚度变化。巧克力威化具有缎面牛奶巧克力外壳、清晰威化层和奶油夹心。碎屑大小与位置自然变化，表现烘烤饼干质感。杯身使用哑光印刷纸材质、轻微高级涂层与清晰边缘。不得出现硬质飞溅模拟、合成泡沫、塑料 CG 边缘、蜡质巧克力或油腻高光。

光线与色彩
采用高级影棚光：温暖的前上方主光、柔和侧向补光，以及落在焦糖、巧克力和部分奶油纹理上的精致高光。使用香草象牙白、奶油白、焦糖琥珀、烘烤饼干金、牛奶巧克力棕和铜色暖意，配合平滑的焦糖到摩卡渐变影棚背景，并在旋涡后方设置微妙中心光晕。环境必须干净极简，只保留少量细小碎屑和悬浮颗粒增强空间感。不得出现勺子、桌子、额外包装或多余道具。

镜头、氛围与完成度
始终保持略微俯拍；杯口、奶油起始褶皱以及从杯体到皇冠的完整旋涡都要清楚可辨。使用适合海报的留白、干净轮廓分离和即时产品识别。氛围应标志性、旗舰级、丝滑、雕塑化、诱人、精致、放纵、高级且奢华。风格为超高级甜品广告摄影、全球旗舰快餐甜品 KV、精致商业修图和高细节渲染。

负面约束
不得使用平视或仰拍、真实品牌、复制 logo、可读口号、混乱飞溅、虚假 CG 奶油、塑料巧克力、油腻高光、杂乱碎屑、弱化杯体、拥挤背景、低细节威化、脏阴影、廉价快餐感、透视变形或过度饱和色彩。

人物颈部延展、肩线舒展，回眸自然；眼神柔软、疏离，带未说出口的情绪，嘴唇微启。保留可信的东方骨相、狭长凤眼、自然眉形、冷白通透肌肤，以及可见毛孔、细小绒毛和轻微肤色变化；眼下略带疲惫，双颊呈克制的微醺胭脂色。乌黑长发盘成华丽高髻，佩戴鎏金凤凰冠，包含凤凰羽翼、缠枝花叶、珍珠和红宝石。多组金链、珠串与宝石流苏从发冠侧面和额前自然垂落，随转身轻微摆动。

items.prompt:

Give her a classic chin-length 1990s French bob with blunt ends and no bangs: rich chestnut-brown hair with warm undertones, natural volume, and softly inward-curving tips. Use a soft dreamy expression with relaxed direct gaze, slightly parted lips, natural confidence, and playful candid body language. Keep the atmosphere intimate and editorial. Add pronounced motion blur around the body and wind-tossed hair while keeping the face sharply recognizable as the primary focal plane.

Light the scene with warm ambient tungsten mixed with soft golden candlelight: a golden-pink atmosphere, creamy skin highlights, gentle shadows, and no harsh flash. Set it in a cozy dim hotel room with beige curtains, a warm bedside lamp, and soft city lights through the window. Blur the background into creamy bokeh with extremely shallow depth of field.

Simulate a vintage 35mm camera, 50mm lens at f/1.8, eye-level close-up, authentic candid framing, and Kodak Portra 400. Use muted nostalgic golden-pink grading, creamy highlights, rich warm shadows, subtle amber glow, faded blacks, natural skin tones, visible fine grain, analog noise, soft bloom, practical-light halation, gentle vignette, slight lens softness, very subtle chromatic aberration, and organic color. Avoid extra people, CGI, plastic or wax skin, beauty-filter smoothing, excessive sharpening or HDR, anime, distorted face, altered identity, duplicate features, crossed eyes, malformed hands, extra or missing fingers, excessive facial blur, unnatural hair or color, flat light, smartphone look, text, logo, signature, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
仅将 ref-10a-v1 用于唯一可见成年东亚女性的面部身份。创作一张夜间室内超写实电影感时尚特写，呈现复古35毫米模拟胶片拍摄的90年代标志性奢华编辑风格。保留优雅鹅蛋脸、可见毛孔、真实肌肤纹理与立体感，以及健康自然光泽。

发型为经典90年代法式波波头：齐下巴长度、发尾整齐、无刘海；浓郁栗褐色带暖调，自然蓬松，发尾柔和内扣。零散细发越过额头、脸颊和嘴唇，部分遮住一只眼睛，外围头发像被微风轻吹。妆容为带透亮玻璃肌效果的自然轻柔淡妆：羽毛感上梳眉、利落上扬眼线、浓密黑色睫毛、柔和晕染的暖桃色腮红、克制修容，以及带真实纹理的水润裸色哑光唇。

她穿宽松毛绒针织衫，带醒目的黑色与奶油色抽象条纹，深度露出一侧肩膀和锁骨。表现高级舒适纤维与自然褶皱。加入自然落在上胸位置的玫瑰金Alhambra项链、第二条精致玫瑰金细链、Pandora手镯，以及透明底配黑白水钻装饰的长方形指甲。

items.title: 2000 年代初卧室网络摄像头暂停帧人像

items.prompt:

Show the same clearly adult East Asian woman from the 10A identity reference sitting very close to the camera. Preserve her recognizable face, mature adult appearance and natural facial asymmetry. Both forearms rest on a desk just below the lens, bringing her face naturally forward; one cheek rests lightly in her palm while she gives a relaxed, slightly amused closed-lip smile and soft direct eye contact. Use a camera position slightly below eye level so the mild wide-angle facial distortion feels like an authentic old webcam rather than a professional portrait.

She wears a simple opaque white spaghetti-strap camisole with secure coverage. Her ultra-long natural black hair falls over both shoulders with soft volume, lightly tousled bed-hair texture, loose flyaways, individual strands and natural shine. Render realistic pores, fine peach fuzz, subtle tonal variation, tiny imperfections and gentle shine around the nose and cheeks. Her oval face has softly defined lips, fluffy individual eyebrow hairs and warm hazel-green eyes with realistic reflections. Use restrained Korean-inspired makeup: lightweight satin complexion, muted pink blush across cheeks and nose bridge, neutral taupe shadow, subtle liner, separated black wispy lash clusters, minimal contour and glossy natural pink lips. Avoid plastic skin and beauty filtering.

Illuminate her face with one direct, slightly harsh built-in camera flash, mixed with cool blue monitor light and weak warm room light. Allow bright specular highlights, deep natural shadows, rapid falloff into the background and slight highlight clipping. The softly defocused lived-in bedroom contains an unmade bed with rumpled soft blankets and only a few simple furnishings, creating a dark cozy late-night atmosphere.

Emulate an early-2000s Logitech webcam and Sony Handycam MiniDV DCR-series CCD: low dynamic range, strong digital luminance noise, visible chroma noise, JPEG compression blocks, analog softness, subtle pixelation, slight chromatic aberration and blue-tinted automatic white balance. Overlay the exact uppercase text “REC” in the upper-left with a small red dot, and the exact timestamp “2004.08.16 23:47” in the lower-right, using a simple blocky consumer-camcorder font. Keep the very close face-and-shoulders framing spontaneous, intimate and clearly non-editorial. No second person, youthful childlike appearance, duplicate arm, malformed hand, revealing neckline, transparent fabric, suggestive pose, glamour studio light, clean modern digital sharpness, extra text, misspelled overlay, logo, watermark, collage or interface outside the two required camera overlays.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一幅超写实自然的 4:3 网络摄像头人像，使其像 2000 年代初家用 MiniDV 摄像机在深夜昏暗卧室中录制的 640×480 暂停帧。画面中为 10A 身份参考里的同一位明确成年的东亚女性，她坐得非常靠近相机。保持她可辨识的面部身份、成熟成年外观与自然的面部不对称。双前臂靠在镜头正下方的桌面上，使脸部自然向前靠近；一边脸颊轻轻枕在手掌中，她以轻松、略带笑意的闭嘴微笑柔和直视镜头。相机略低于眼平线，让轻微广角面部变形呈现真实旧网络摄像头感，而非专业人像。

她穿一件简单、不透明且覆盖稳妥的白色细肩带吊带背心。超长自然黑发垂落在双肩，具有柔和蓬松感、轻微凌乱的刚睡醒质地、松散碎发、清晰单根发丝和自然光泽。真实呈现毛孔、细小汗毛、轻微肤色变化、微小瑕疵，以及鼻翼和脸颊周围的柔和油光。她的脸型为椭圆形，嘴唇轮廓柔和，眉毛根根分明且蓬松，温暖的琥珀绿色眼睛带真实反光。使用克制的韩系妆容：轻盈缎面底妆、横跨脸颊与鼻梁的低饱和粉色腮红、中性灰褐色眼影、细微眼线、分束黑色灵动睫毛、极简修容与有光泽的自然粉唇。避免塑料皮肤与美颜滤镜。

使用单一直接且略显刺眼的机载闪光照亮面部，并混合冷蓝显示器光与微弱暖色房间灯。允许明亮镜面高光、深沉自然阴影、背景方向快速光线衰减和轻微高光溢出。柔和失焦的生活化卧室内有一张未整理的床、凌乱柔软的毯子和少量简洁家具，营造黑暗舒适的深夜氛围。

模拟 2000 年代初罗技网络摄像头与索尼 Handycam MiniDV DCR 系列 CCD：低动态范围、强烈数字亮度噪声、可见色彩噪声、JPEG 压缩块、模拟视频柔化、轻微像素化、细微色差和偏蓝自动白平衡。左上角以简洁方块式家用摄像机字体叠加精确大写文字“REC”和一个小红点，右下角叠加精确时间戳“2004.08.16 23:47”。保持非常贴近的脸部与肩部取景，自然随意、亲密且明确不是时尚编辑摆拍。不得出现第二个人物、幼态儿童外观、重复手臂、畸形手部、暴露领口、透明面料、暗示性姿势、影棚艳丽灯光、干净现代数码锐度、额外文字、拼写错误叠字、标志、水印、拼贴，或两处规定摄像机叠字之外的界面。

她穿一件修身无袖的奶油象牙色针织迷你连衣裙，设计简洁，面料纹理真实。她肩膀放松、躯干略微前倾，正在穿一只闪亮银色尖头细跟鞋，鞋跟约 9–10 厘米。一只手轻轻扶住鞋跟，让对应的脚部分滑入鞋内；另一只手臂自然放在腿侧。另一只赤脚自然落在地毯上，配对的另一只银色高跟鞋整齐放在沙发旁的地面。双腿以优雅放松的方式交叠，手部、脚部与鞋子结构必须完整可信，不使用强制前景夸张。

她身后是干净白墙，墙上恰好三幅抽象框画，只使用低饱和米色、蓝绿色与金色形状，不含字母。画面还包含浅色瓷砖地面和几何薰衣草灰地毯。采用平衡的平视构图，人物居中，并在完整呈现全身的同时保留足够室内环境。柔和漫射日光带来均匀的高调照明、轻柔面部阴影、自然皮肤高光、克制浅景深和高端生活方式编辑质感。真实呈现皮肤毛孔、细密针织纤维、皮革簇绒、金属闪粉和合理衣料褶皱，使用自然色彩分级与清晰对焦。不得出现第二个人物、重复肢体、畸形手指或脚趾、缺失鞋子、额外鞋子、脚部放大、夸张曲线、暴露视角、透明面料、浓重美颜滤镜、蜡质皮肤、可读文字、标志、水印、拼贴或界面图形。

She has long straight glossy black hair over her shoulders and back, natural skin texture, and a gentle relaxed smile with softly closed eyes. Her legs are bent with both feet resting on the grass, her body turns slightly toward camera, and her head tilts naturally. Dress her in a plain white short-sleeve T-shirt, light-gray denim shorts with restrained frayed hems, and white New Balance sneakers with green accents, black N marks, and small orange sole details. In the foreground show patchy green grass and textured white concrete. Behind her are dark gray rocky shoreline stones, gentle ocean waves under an overcast sky, distant green forested hills and mountains, and large palm fronds and leafy trees framing the upper left. Use soft natural daylight and slightly muted cloudy-weather tones, with sharp focus on the subject and realistic hair, skin, fabric, concrete, grass, rock, and water texture. Keep the adult styling casual and non-sexualized. Avoid underage appearance, nudity, accidental exposure, extra people, distorted anatomy, deformed hands or feet, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, text, watermarks, borders, and collages.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为明确成年主要人物的面部身份依据。创建一张照片级真实的竖版全身海边人像，机位略低，画面中只有一位成年东亚女性，随意坐在海边低矮的白色混凝土防波堤上。她留着披在肩膀和背部的长直黑色亮发，保留自然皮肤纹理，双眼温柔闭着并带轻松自然的微笑。双腿弯曲，双脚落在草地上，身体略微转向镜头，头部自然倾斜。她穿纯白短袖 T 恤、浅灰色牛仔短裤，裤脚保留克制的毛边，并穿带绿色点缀、黑色 N 标志和鞋底少量橙色细节的白色 New Balance 运动鞋。前景展现斑驳绿草和有纹理的白色混凝土；背景是深灰色岩石海岸、阴云天空下的温柔海浪、远处绿色森林丘陵与山脉，以及左上方构图的大棕榈叶和繁茂绿树。使用柔和自然日光和阴天略显柔和的色调，主体清晰对焦，保留发丝、皮肤、布料、混凝土、草地、岩石和水面真实纹理。整体保持成年、日常且不性化。避免未成年外观、裸露、意外暴露、额外人物、人体结构变形、畸形手脚、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、文字、水印、边框和拼图。

items.title: 海滩度假风白色连衣裙年轻女子

items.prompt:

items.prompt_zh:

场景与环境

items.title: 极简手绘涂鸦静物转换
items.description: 将上传的非人物静物照片转换为极简、童真、略带不完美笔触的手绘涂鸦；示例输入固定为蓝绿色露营水壶、两颗柠檬与一枝尤加利叶的写实照片。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Use the uploaded source photo as the exact subject and composition reference. The example source is a realistic non-person still life showing one cerulean-blue enamel camping kettle centered on a pale oak tabletop, two whole yellow lemons resting beside it, and one short eucalyptus sprig extending diagonally behind the lemons. Preserve the number, placement, silhouette and overlap of these objects while transforming the image into a minimalist hand-drawn doodle illustration.

Use simple brush-pen outlines with varied line weight and slightly wobbly, intentionally imperfect strokes. Reduce the kettle, lemons and eucalyptus leaves to cute, childlike shapes while keeping every object immediately recognizable. Give the kettle a gently rounded body, a simple arched handle, a tiny curved spout and one small lid knob; render the lemons as loose oval contours and the eucalyptus as a few simplified round leaves on one thin stem. Add only a handful of tiny playful motion marks or sparkle accents around the still life.

Place the doodle on a clean white background with generous empty space. Use sparse watercolor-ink touches in cerulean blue, sunny yellow and muted sage green inside selected outlines while leaving most areas unfilled. Keep the overall appearance naive, whimsical and handmade, like a charming sketchbook cartoon with expressive simplicity and appealing imperfections. No person, human body part, extra kettle, extra fruit, added furniture, busy scenery, photorealistic rendering, hard geometric vector lines, heavy shading, readable text, logo, watermark or frame.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

使用上传的源照片作为精确的主体与构图参考。示例源图是一张写实的非人物静物照片：一只蓝绿色珐琅露营水壶位于浅色橡木桌面中央，两颗完整的黄色柠檬放在水壶旁，一小枝尤加利叶从柠檬后方向斜上方伸展。将图像转换为极简手绘涂鸦插画，同时保留这些物体的数量、位置、轮廓和遮挡关系。

使用简单的毛笔轮廓，线条粗细有变化，并带有轻微晃动和刻意保留的不完美笔触。将水壶、柠檬与尤加利叶简化为可爱的童真形状，同时让每件物体都一眼可辨。水壶采用柔和圆润的壶身、简洁拱形提手、小巧弯曲壶嘴和一个小圆盖钮；柠檬以松弛的椭圆轮廓呈现；尤加利则画成一根细茎上数片简化的圆叶。静物周围只添加少量俏皮动作线或闪烁点缀。

将涂鸦置于干净白色背景上，保留宽裕留白。只在部分轮廓内部使用稀疏的水彩墨色，颜色为蓝绿色、明亮黄色与低饱和鼠尾草绿，其余大部分区域保持不填色。整体呈现天真、奇趣、手工绘制的外观，像一幅迷人的素描本卡通，强调表现力的简约感和讨喜的不完美。不得出现人物、人体部位、额外水壶、额外水果、新增家具、繁忙景物、照片写实效果、生硬几何矢量线、浓重阴影、可读文字、标志、水印或边框。

items.title: 橡胶冲击动漫社论海报

items.prompt: Create a bright high-impact vertical 9:16 anime editorial poster featuring one fictional adult-presenting rubber-powered pirate captain lunging from a sunny ship deck. Use clean 2D shonen anime illustration, bold ink outlines, vivid cel shading, expressive features, exaggerated but coherent perspective, and crisp saturated colors on a white or cool off-white background. Build the composition around one oversized English word, IMPACT, with letters occupying most of the frame and extending beyond the canvas. Place blue sky, bright ocean, sails, clouds, and distant islands inside the letterforms, connecting the typography naturally to the deck with consistent ground perspective and shadows. Keep the character in the middle layer while one dramatically stretched fist breaks into the foreground toward camera; preserve clear anatomy, hands, clothing, and power-effect details. Add the series label GRAND LINE FRAGMENTS and year 2026 as small editorial metadata. Avoid multiple characters, muddy vintage filters, yellowed paper, muted colors, stiff anatomy, malformed hands, excessive effects, random extra limbs, unreadable typography, logos, watermarks, and collages.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张明亮、高冲击力的竖版 9:16 动漫社论海报，展示一名虚构、成年感明确的橡胶能力海盗船长从阳光明媚的船甲板上向镜头冲来。使用干净的 2D 少年动漫插画、粗体墨线、鲜艳赛璐璐着色、富有表现力的面部特征、夸张但连贯的透视和清晰饱和的颜色，背景保持白色或冷米白色。围绕一个超大的英文单词 IMPACT 构建构图，字母占据大部分画面并延伸出画布。将蓝天、明亮海洋、船帆、云朵和远处岛屿放入字母内部，使排版通过一致的地面透视线和阴影自然连接到甲板。角色位于中间层，一只戏剧性拉伸的拳头强烈突入前景并朝向镜头；保持人体、手部、服装和能力特效细节清晰。加入 GRAND LINE FRAGMENTS 和 2026 作为小型社论元数据。避免多角色、浑浊复古滤镜、发黄纸张、暗淡颜色、僵硬人体、畸形手部、过度特效、随机多余肢体、不可读排版、标志、水印和拼图。

items.title: 公寓玄关猫耳成年女性黑裙全身像
