items.prompt:
Use the uploaded ref-10a-v1 image as the facial identity reference for the only visible person. Create a 3:4 vertical, photorealistic full-body smartphone portrait of one clearly adult East Asian woman standing before a reddish-brown wooden door in an ordinary apartment entryway. Keep natural body proportions. Style her long black hair half-up with soft volume and loose waves behind her shoulders. Add a playful black cat-ear headband with small white fluffy feather decorations and medium silver hoop earrings. Use light natural glamour makeup with fine black eyeliner, eyelashes, subtle rosy blush, and rose-pink lips.

Dress her in a fitted, fully opaque black sleeveless camisole with a modest, securely covering standard V neckline and delicate floral lace trim. Pair it with an elegant high-waisted black satin midi skirt whose semi-sheer black lace hem has complete opaque lining underneath. Hang a small structured tan canvas shoulder bag from her left shoulder at hip level. Add a pale-green jade bangle on one wrist and a delicate gold bracelet on the other.

Reproduce the pose precisely: torso facing the camera, shoulders relaxed, waist gently and naturally curved. Extend both arms outward symmetrically at waist height with softly bent elbows, palms facing upward, and fingers naturally separated to form a playful “What can I say?” shrug. One leg supports her weight while the opposite knee bends backward and lifts the foot behind her, creating slight motion in the satin skirt. She looks directly into the camera with a calm, confident, playful expression.

The background must show the reddish-brown apartment door with a silver handle and lock. A dark-gray over-door hook rack runs across the upper door, with several empty hooks visible behind her head. Use plain off-white walls and only a small amount of everyday household clutter at the far-left edge, preserving a real residential entryway rather than a studio.

Use strong direct smartphone light from slightly camera-right to illuminate her face and black outfit and cast recognizable arm and hand shadows onto the wall. Shoot handheld at eye level with a straightforward frontal composition. Create the feel of an authentic Chinese social-media video still with subtle softness, mild digital compression, slightly imperfect focus, and faint motion softness in the moving skirt, while keeping the face recognizable. Preserve realistic skin, lace, satin, hair, and canvas textures. Maintain correct anatomy with exactly two arms, two hands, five natural fingers per hand, correctly oriented palms, and a structurally correct bag and strap. Include no additional people, extra limbs, fused fingers, transparent or revealing clothing, exaggerated anatomy, plastic skin, anime style, luxury interior, studio lighting, cinematic grading, text, logos, or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的 ref-10a-v1 图像作为唯一可见人物的面部身份参考。创作一张3:4竖幅、照片级写实的全身智能手机人像：一名明确成年的东亚女性站在普通公寓玄关的红褐色木门前。她身材比例自然，长黑发采用蓬松半扎造型，松散波浪垂在肩后；头戴带小型白色绒羽装饰的黑色猫耳发箍，佩戴中号银色圆环耳环。妆容轻盈自然，有细黑眼线、睫毛、淡粉腮红和玫瑰粉双唇。

她穿合身、完整不透明的黑色无袖吊带上衣，采用端庄稳妥的普通V形领口和精致花卉蕾丝边，搭配高腰黑色缎面过膝中裙，裙摆带半透明黑色蕾丝装饰但内层覆盖完整。左肩自然挂一个小型结构化黄褐色帆布单肩包，包体位于胯侧。一侧手腕戴浅绿色玉镯，另一侧戴细金手链。

精确呈现姿势：躯干正对镜头，肩膀放松，腰部轻微自然弯曲。双臂在腰部高度对称向外伸展，手肘微屈，掌心向上，手指自然分开，形成俏皮的“我能说什么呢？”耸肩手势。一条腿支撑体重，另一条腿屈膝向后抬脚，使缎面裙产生轻微摆动。她直视镜头，表情平静、自信而俏皮。

背景必须是带银色把手和门锁的红褐色公寓木门，门上方横跨深灰色门后挂钩架，人物脑后可见几个空挂钩。周围为普通米白墙面，最左边缘只保留少量家庭杂物，保持真实住宅玄关而非摄影棚。

使用从相机右侧稍强的直接手机光，清晰照亮面部和黑色服装，并在白墙上投下可辨识的手臂与手部阴影。眼平高度手持拍摄、正面构图，呈现真实中国社交媒体视频截帧感、轻微柔化、数字压缩、略不完美焦点和裙摆运动柔化；面部仍需清晰可辨。保持皮肤、蕾丝、缎面、头发和帆布纹理真实，人体结构准确，两臂两手、每手五指、掌心方向和包带结构正确。不得出现额外人物、多余肢体、畸形手指、透明或走光服装、夸张人体、塑料皮肤、动漫风、奢华室内、影棚光、电影调色、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 复古东亚女性镜面人像与樱桃静物
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

1:1 square ratio, East Asian female, warm dark vintage indoor mirror close-up portrait, deep brown-black medium-to-long hair naturally and loosely falling, figure leaning low on the edge of a table or dressing table, upper body close to the mirror, one forearm extended horizontally, hands naturally stacked near the upper edge of a classical oval mirror, head tilted forward, real person looking down towards the mirror surface or the lower left of the frame, not looking directly at the camera, quiet, immersive, slightly tranced.

A heavy classical oval table mirror is placed in the lower half of the frame, with an old silver or dark gold carved metal frame, acanthus and floral patterns are obvious, the mirror must accurately reflect the same person, same face, same hairstyle, same moment, the inverted face in the mirror is complete and recognizable, the mirror reflection direction is strictly consistent with the real person's posture, the occlusion relationship between hands, face, and mirror frame is realistic, no extra characters or a third face appear; about 6 to 10 bright red cherries are naturally scattered on the mirror surface, some with thin green stems, loosely and irregularly distributed, the red fruits form a small visual rhythm around the face in the mirror.

Warm soft light from the upper left front illuminates the real person's face, back of the hands, and the edge of the mirror frame, dark long hair and background are pressed into warm brown shadows, the mirror surface maintains low-brightness soft reflection, small areas of moist highlights appear on the cherry surfaces, warm brown, soft skin tone, old gold beige, and cherry red as main colors, 50 to 85mm close-up feel, soft focus, warm diffusion, low contrast, film grain, slight halation, slight bloom, vintage lens softness, soft highlight roll off, old movie, old magazine, vintage still life portrait texture, real face, face in the mirror, hands, mirror surface and cherries are unified and softened.

Clearly readable Soran integrated into the antique mirror's carved frame near the person's hand, naturally curved along the curvature of the oval mirror frame in old silver or dark gold metal engraving; hidden Soran integrated into the frame's acanthus patterns, long hair strands, cherry stem directions, tabletop wood grain, mirror highlights; microscopic Soran composed of mirror frame wear points, cherry highlights, hair intersections, fine metal scratches, and stem nodes.

Negative: Different person in the mirror, multiple faces, a third face, wrong reflection direction, misaligned mirrored facial features, hands not corresponding to reflection, mirror frame passing through face or hand, extra fingers, webbed fingers, too many cherries, cherries arranged neatly, modern frameless mirror, LED makeup mirror, figure looking up and staring directly at the camera, sweet smile, reflection in mirror too sharp, commercial studio shoot, overall orange-yellow filter too heavy, HDR, 8K ultra-sharp, plastic skin, commercial skin smoothing, external watermark, sticker logo, floating text, subtitles, unreadable Soran.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

1:1方幅，东亚女性，暖暗复古室内镜像近景人像，深棕黑中长至长发自然松散垂落，人物低伏在桌面或梳妆台边缘，上身贴近镜子，一条前臂横向伸展，双手自然叠放在古典椭圆镜上缘附近，头部侧向前伸，现实人物低头看向镜面或画面左下，不直接看镜头，安静、沉浸、略微出神。

下半画面放置一面厚重古典椭圆桌镜，旧银或暗金雕花金属镜框，卷草纹与花卉纹明显，镜中必须准确反射同一个人物，同一张脸、同一发型、同一瞬间，镜中倒置人脸完整可辨，镜面反射方向与现实人物姿态严格一致，双手、脸部与镜框遮挡关系真实，不出现额外人物或第三张脸；镜面自然散落约6至10颗鲜红樱桃，部分带绿色细果梗，分布松散不规则，红色果实围绕镜中脸形成小面积视觉节奏。

左前上方暖色柔光照亮现实人物脸部、手背和镜框边缘，深色长发与背景压入暖棕暗部，镜面保持低亮柔反射，樱桃表面出现小面积湿润高光，暖棕、柔肤色、旧金米色、樱桃红主色，50至85mm近景感，soft focus，warm diffusion，low contrast，film grain，轻halation，slight bloom，vintage lens softness，soft highlight roll off，旧电影、旧杂志、复古静物肖像质感，现实脸、镜中脸、手、镜面与樱桃统一柔化。

清晰可读Soran融入靠近人物手部的古镜雕花边框，以旧银或暗金金属刻字沿椭圆镜框曲率自然弯曲；隐藏Soran融入镜框卷草纹、长发发丝、樱桃果梗走势、桌面木纹、镜中高光；微观Soran由镜框磨损点、樱桃高光、发丝交叉、金属细划痕、果梗节点组成。

负向：镜中不同人物，多张脸，第三张脸，倒影方向错误，镜像五官错位，手与倒影不对应，镜框穿过脸或手，多指，手指粘连，樱桃数量过多，樱桃整齐排列，现代无边框镜，LED化妆镜，人物抬头强直视镜头，甜笑，镜中倒影过锐，商业棚拍，整体橙黄滤镜过重，HDR，8K超锐，塑料皮肤，商业磨皮，外贴水印，贴纸logo，漂浮文字，字幕，不可读Soran。

items.title: 欧洲街头成年女性高踢腿纪实人像
items.description: 成年东亚女性在安静欧洲街道完成武术高踢腿的 9:16 手机纪实人像，背景有两名成年男性旁观者与准确的 Share Prompt Free 店铺标牌。示例绑定统一 10A 身份并采用明确的日常运动街装。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity basis for the main visible person. Preserve the recognizable face of the 10A adult East Asian woman while applying the following European street, action and wardrobe treatment.

Create a bright, clear 9:16 vertical documentary-style smartphone portrait on a quiet ordinary street in a European city during the afternoon. Soft sunlight falls across old buildings, small shops and clean sidewalks; keep vehicles and other pedestrians sparse. The main woman stands in the street wearing an ivory casual bomber jacket over a fitted black crew-neck top, charcoal athletic trousers and clean white sneakers. Keep her dark hair loose and practical for movement.

Capture a controlled martial-arts high kick: one supporting foot stays firmly on the ground while the other leg lifts high toward the sky, with the raised shoe fully visible. Her torso remains balanced, her face tilts slightly upward toward the camera, and she gives a restrained teasing smile while her eyes follow the kick direction. Frame her from the supporting-leg knee upward while still including the entire raised leg and foot. Use an eye-level, close smartphone perspective that makes the action feel immediate without distorting anatomy.

Place two clearly adult male onlookers several meters behind her near the shops. They watch the kick with surprised but cheerful expressions, remaining secondary and slightly softer than the main subject. On a nearby shop wall, include one clean sign whose exact readable English text is “Share Prompt Free”.

Use an iPhone 17-style mobile-camera look with soft natural afternoon light, realistic skin texture, moderate smartphone HDR, sharp focus on the main woman's face and action, believable human expressions and a candid slice-of-daily-life quality. Keep skin tones natural and neutral, never yellow. Photorealistic real people only, not anime, 3D or illustration. No exposed underwear, accidental revealing angle, deformed leg, extra limb, malformed foot, duplicated person, misdirected gaze, misspelled sign, unrelated text, logo, watermark or interface graphic.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在应用以下欧洲街道、动作和服装处理时，保持 10A 成年东亚女性可辨识的面部身份。

创作一张明亮清晰的 9:16 竖版手机纪实人像，地点为下午时分欧洲城市中一条安静普通的街道。柔和阳光洒在古老建筑、小商店与干净人行道上，车辆和其他行人稀少。主要女性站在街道中，穿象牙白休闲飞行夹克、修身黑色圆领上衣、炭灰色运动长裤和干净白色运动鞋；深色头发自然披散，适合动作。

捕捉一个受控的武术高踢腿动作：一只支撑脚稳固落地，另一条腿高高踢向天空，抬起的鞋履完整可见。身体保持平衡，脸部微微仰向镜头，露出克制而略带调侃的微笑，视线跟随踢腿方向。构图从支撑腿膝盖以上纳入人物，同时完整呈现抬高的腿与脚。使用眼平近距离手机透视，让动作具有临场感而不扭曲人体。

在她身后数米、靠近商店处安排两名明确成年的男性旁观者。他们带着惊讶但愉快的神情观看踢腿，作为次要人物并比主体略柔化。附近商店墙面设置一块简洁标牌，英文必须准确清晰写出“Share Prompt Free”。

采用 iPhone 17 风格手机影像、柔和自然下午光、真实皮肤纹理、适度手机 HDR，主角面部和动作清晰对焦，表情可信，具有日常生活切片的随性纪实感。肤色自然中性、不发黄。只呈现照片级真人，不是动漫、3D 或插画。不得出现内衣外露、意外暴露角度、腿部畸形、多余肢体、脚部畸形、人物复制、视线错位、拼错招牌、无关文字、标志、水印或界面图形。

items.title: 写实高端学院风女性穿搭拼贴
items.description: 9:16 写实高端学院风女性穿搭拼贴：同一名成年女性以五个实例出现，中央全身主角与四个带白色虚线人体轮廓的小型服装变体，右下留白。
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical screen, realistic high-end Coser photography style college-themed character outfit collage first frame. 

Only 5 character instances of the same adult female character can appear in the scene. The character's facial features strictly refer to the input photo, maintaining a small and soft face shape, large eyes, a slender nose shape, natural pink glossy lips, and the original character's recognizability; an adult female, aged 22 to 25. Maintain light brown shoulder-length short hair and thin air bangs. All character instances have the exact same face, age, skin tone, hairstyle, and body proportions. 

A large full-body main character is placed center-right, occupying about 60% to 65% of the screen width, with the head and shoes fully entering the frame. The main character wears a burgundy slim-fit college suit, gold piping, an ivory white shirt, a black silk ribbon bow tie, charcoal gray and burgundy plaid pleated skirt, dark knee-high socks, and black-brown loafers. The body faces slightly to the left, with the weight on the left leg, the right foot slightly outward, and hands naturally relaxed, leaving space for subsequent spinning movements. The central character has no white dashed outline. 

The four small characters are all complete human outline silhouette stickers, and an independent white dashed human outline is added to the periphery of each character; square or rectangular photo frames must not be used: 

Top-left small character: cream-colored cable-knit vest, white puff-sleeve shirt, burgundy bow, beige-gray plaid pleated skirt, brown loafers; one hand holding a dark red book, the other hand slightly raised. 

Top-right small character: dark blue double-breasted college suit, white shirt, red and blue striped tie, gray pleated skirt, black knee-high socks, black loafers; the body is in the starting pose of a clockwise turn, with arms slightly spread. 

Middle-left small character: black short college jacket, burgundy lapels, thin gold piping, ivory white turtleneck shirt, black with red trim pleated skirt, black short boots; the right hand is making a clear V-shaped victory sign near the eye. 

Bottom-left small character: burgundy college varsity jacket, ivory white sleeves, white college Polo shirt, black and red tennis pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, dark sneakers; both hands forming a complete heart in front of the chest. 

The bottom-right area of the screen is left blank, with no sixth character placed. 

All five sets of clothing use original college designs, only the clothing can be changed, not the character's facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, age, body proportions, and fixed accessories. Fixed accessories are a burgundy bow hair clip, small gold star stud earrings, and an abstract college gold badge without text. 

Light gray-white seamless studio background, soft diffused studio lighting, real fabric texture, realistic skin texture, clear hair strands, high-end college fashion pictorial style, full-body composition, no text, no identifiable brand logos, no watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
制作一张9:16竖屏、写实高端Coser摄影风格的学院主题人物穿搭拼贴首帧。

画面中只能出现同一名成年女性角色的5个人物实例。人物五官严格参考输入照片，保持小巧柔和的脸型、大眼睛、纤细鼻型、自然粉色亮泽嘴唇以及原人物辨识度；成年女性，年龄感22至25岁。保持浅棕色齐肩短发、轻薄空气刘海。所有人物实例拥有完全相同的面部、年龄、肤色、发型和身体比例。

中央偏右放置一个大型全身主人物，占画面宽度约60%至65%，头部和鞋子完整进入画面。主人物穿酒红色修身学院西装，金色滚边，象牙白衬衫，黑色丝带领结，炭灰酒红格纹百褶裙，深色及膝袜，黑棕色乐福鞋。身体微微朝左，重心放在左腿，右脚略微向外，双手自然放松，为后续转圈动作预留空间。中央人物没有白色虚线轮廓。

四个小型人物均为完整的人体轮廓剪影贴纸，每个人物外围分别添加独立的白色虚线人体轮廓，不得使用方形或矩形照片框：

左上小人物：奶油色麻花针织背心、白色泡袖衬衫、酒红蝴蝶结、米灰格纹百褶裙、棕色乐福鞋；一只手抱着深红色书本，另一只手微微抬起。

右上小人物：深蓝色双排扣学院西装、白衬衫、红蓝条纹领带、灰色百褶裙、黑色及膝袜、黑色乐福鞋；身体处于顺时针转身起始姿态，双臂稍微展开。

左中小人物：黑色短款学院外套、酒红翻领、金色细滚边、象牙白高领衬衫、黑色红边百褶裙、黑色短靴；右手在眼睛附近做清晰的V形剪刀手。

左下小人物：酒红色学院棒球夹克、象牙白衣袖、白色学院Polo衫、黑红网球百褶裙、白色及膝袜、深色运动鞋；双手在胸前组成完整爱心。

画面右下区域留白，不放置任何第六个人物。

五套服装均使用原创学院设计，只能改变服装，不改变人物五官、发型、肤色、年龄、身体比例和固定配饰。固定配饰为酒红色蝴蝶结发夹、小金色星星耳钉、无文字的抽象学院金色徽章。

浅灰白色无缝摄影棚背景，柔和漫射棚拍光，真实布料纹理，写实皮肤质感，清晰的头发丝，高级学院时装画报风格，完整全身构图，无文字，无可识别品牌标志，无水印。

items.title: 成年女性珊瑚粉游艇码头 CCD 度假人像
items.description: 成年参考人物在晴日游艇码头白色栏杆旁的清亮 CCD 度假生活照，强调珊瑚粉上衣、回头姿态、海面反光和明亮高光。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the clearly adult main subject. Create a realistic vertical 9:16 vacation lifestyle portrait with bright clear CCD digital-camera color and light natural grain. Show one adult East Asian woman in a yacht-marina rest area beside white railings, a pale deck, and distant boats. Frame from mid-shot to above the thighs, with her body slightly turned, one hand resting on the railing, and her head looking back toward the camera with a relaxed refreshing expression. Dress her in a bright coral-pink fitted halter-style vacation top with secure coverage and white high-waisted shorts; keep the styling adult, tasteful, and non-sexualized. Use strong sunny front-side light, natural reflective fill from the white railing, deck, and sea, and only a very subtle soft flash for catchlights and gentle facial shadows. Preserve clean white highlights, clear midtones, stable blacks, realistic skin and fabric texture, a bright coral-pink top without muddy or gray color, and believable anatomy. Avoid underage appearance, nudity, accidental exposure, sexualized framing, cold white grading, muddy pink, whole-face overexposure, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, text, logos, watermarks, borders, and collages.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为明确成年主要人物的面部身份依据。创建一张真实的竖版 9:16 度假生活方式人像，采用明亮清晰的 CCD 数码相机色彩和轻微自然颗粒。画面中只有一位成年东亚女性，位于游艇码头休息区的白色栏杆旁，环境包括浅色甲板和远处船只。取半身到大腿上方构图，身体轻微侧转，一只手扶着栏杆，回头看向镜头，神情松弛清爽。她穿鲜亮珊瑚粉修身挂脖度假上衣并保持得体覆盖，搭配白色高腰短裤；整体造型成年、得体且不性化。使用晴天侧前方强日光，白色栏杆、甲板和海面提供自然反射补光，只用极弱柔闪补充眼神光和柔和面部暗部。保留干净白色高光、清楚中间调、稳定黑位、真实皮肤与面料纹理，珊瑚粉上衣保持鲜亮不脏不灰，人体结构可信。避免未成年外观、裸露、意外暴露、性化取景、冷白色调、灰脏粉色、全脸过曝、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、文字、标志、水印、边框和拼图。

items.title: 居家成年女性手机直出抓拍
items.description: 明确成年东亚女性斜倚白色床铺的9:16居家手机抓拍，穿白色T恤与粉色居家短裤，采用暖室内光、26mm前置镜头、自然HDR和轻微手持质感；人物绑定10A。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded ref-10a-v1 image as the facial identity reference for the only visible person. Create an ultra-photorealistic 9:16 vertical candid smartphone snapshot at home. One clearly adult East Asian woman lounges comfortably on a soft white bed in a clean modern bedroom, gently resting her cheek against one hand and looking into the phone's front camera with a quiet, relaxed, natural expression.

Give her naturally fair skin with realistic fine pores, dark-brown eyes, natural brows, a petite nose, and nude-pink lips. Her long dark-brown hair is slightly tousled with airy bangs for a casual at-home look. Dress her in a loose, fully opaque white T-shirt and securely covering soft-pink lounge shorts, with natural fabric drape and a comfortable everyday posture.

Include white bedding, gray curtains, minimal decor, and warm indoor light. Make the picture feel casually captured with a 26mm-equivalent smartphone front camera, including slight handheld character, authentic mobile HDR, automatic exposure, natural shadows, subtle digital noise, and informal framing. Preserve an unedited social-photo aesthetic with no studio setup or beauty filter while keeping clear detail and realistic RAW mobile-camera quality. Include no additional people, transparent or revealing clothing, exaggerated anatomy, malformed hands, plastic skin, heavy filters, text, logos, watermark, social-media interface, or obvious generation artifacts.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的 ref-10a-v1 图像作为唯一可见人物的面部身份参考。创作一张超写实的9:16竖幅智能手机居家抓拍：一名明确成年的东亚女性舒适地斜倚在干净现代卧室的柔软白色床上，脸颊轻轻靠在一只手上，以安静、放松而自然的神情看向手机前置摄像头。

她有自然白皙的皮肤、真实细腻毛孔、深棕色眼睛、自然眉形、小巧鼻子和裸粉色嘴唇。深棕色长发略显蓬松，带轻盈空气刘海，形成随意居家造型。她穿一件宽松、完整不透明的白色T恤和覆盖稳妥的柔粉色居家短裤，面料自然垂落，姿态舒适日常。

房间包含白色床品、灰色窗帘、极简装饰和温暖室内照明。画面像用26mm等效的手机前置镜头随手拍摄，带轻微手持感、真实移动HDR、自动曝光、自然阴影、细微数字噪点和随意构图。保持未经影棚布置和未经美颜滤镜处理的社交照片质感，同时拥有清晰细节和真实RAW手机画质。不得出现额外人物、透明或走光服装、夸张人体、畸形手部、塑料皮肤、重度滤镜、文字、标志、水印、社交媒体界面或明显生成伪影。

items.title: 斜向势能文化展览海报模板
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的当代艺术出版物视觉与文化展览海报工作流模板。
items.prompt: Theme: Echo of Tides. Chinese title: 潮痕回声. English title: Echo of Tides. Key visual: black-and-white organic tide and mineral forms. Auxiliary pattern: indigo Moiré concentric sound waves. Primary color: ink black. Secondary color: indigo and warm paper white. Date / institution: 2026 / Museum of Material Culture. Design a 9:16 vertical cultural exhibition poster with contemporary Editorial Graphic Design and art-publication character. Use a diagonal-potential-energy composition without drawing obvious diagonal lines: establish a hidden diagonal visual axis so the visual weight of the key visual, Chinese title, pattern, date information and white space progresses along one direction. Let black-and-white organic tide and mineral forms carry the main weight. Make the large 潮痕回声 participate in the layout through misalignment, vertical setting, partial cropping or slight interweaving with the subject; scale down the English title, 2026 / Museum of Material Culture and auxiliary information and concentrate them in 2–3 areas for a clear type hierarchy. Use exactly one auxiliary pattern language related to the theme, namely indigo Moiré concentric sound waves; do not add multiple decorative systems for richness. Let the background participate through art-paper texture, extremely faint pattern afterimages, drawings, specimen information or material texture, adding layers to the white space while remaining clear from a distance. Keep medium-to-high information density with a three-level reading order: first see composition and subject, second see Chinese title and pattern, third read English, date and auxiliary information. Control the palette to 3–4 main colors, creating tension through scale, cropping, overlap, density and white space. Aim for a mature cultural exhibition poster, editorial design and printed art-publication finish: rich but orderly, with diagonal energy arising naturally rather than from forced diagonal placement. Replacement examples include Echo of Tides with black-and-white organic tide/mineral forms and indigo Moiré concentric sound waves; Folded Scenes in the City with a folded booklet of city pen sketches and mustard map folds plus a faint city road network; Oriental Vessel Rhyme with a large bronze vessel and taotie, cloud-thunder and inscription rubbings extending from its surface; and Night Flight Among Branches with old branches, a black blackbird and large light-ochre plant-leaf rubbings.
items.prompt_zh: 主题：Echo of Tides；中文标题：潮痕回声；英文标题：Echo of Tides；主视觉：black-and-white organic tide and mineral forms；辅助纹样：indigo Moiré concentric sound waves；主色：ink black；辅助色：indigo and warm paper white；日期/机构：2026 / Museum of Material Culture。设计一张9:16竖版文化展览海报，整体为当代Editorial Graphic Design与艺术出版物视觉。使用“斜向势能”构图，但不要直接绘制明显斜线：先确定隐藏的对角视觉主轴，让主视觉、中文标题、纹样、日期信息和留白的视觉重量沿同一方向逐步递进。black-and-white organic tide and mineral forms承担主要重量，大型潮痕回声参与版式，可错位、纵排、局部裁切或与主体轻微穿插；英文标题、2026 / Museum of Material Culture及辅助信息缩小并集中在2—3个区域，形成清晰字号层级。只使用一套与主题相关的辅助纹样语言，即indigo Moiré concentric sound waves，不要为丰富而混入多套装饰。背景也参与设计，可用艺术纸纹理、极淡图案残影、图纸、标本信息或材料纹理给留白增加层次，但远看必须清楚。信息量中高且有三层阅读顺序：第一眼看构图与主体，第二眼看中文标题和纹样，第三眼读英文、日期和辅助信息。色彩控制在3—4种主色，通过尺度、裁切、叠压、疏密和留白制造张力。整体应有文化展览海报、编辑设计和成熟印刷出版物质感，丰富但不凌乱，斜向势能自然出现，不为“斜”而硬排元素。可替换案例包括：潮痕回声（黑白有机潮汐/矿物形态，靛蓝Moiré同心声纹）；城中折景（城市钢笔速写折叠观察册，芥末黄地图折页与极淡城市路网）；东方器韵（大型青铜器，饕餮纹、云雷纹和铭文拓印从器物表面延展）；枝间夜航（老树枝与黑色乌鸫，淡赭色大型植物叶片拓印）。

items.title: 成年女性暖调侧逆光针织衫人像
items.description: 成年参考人物在暖橙色侧逆光与奶油散景背景中的 3:4 半身时装人像，强调金色轮廓光、举臂姿态和自然织物质感。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the clearly adult main subject. Create a realistic vertical 3:4 half-body fashion portrait of one adult East Asian woman, cropped from above the thighs and positioned center-left. Use warm-toned side backlighting with soft golden rim light along the hair and neck/shoulder edges; highlights should be gently diffused while facial features remain clear and not overexposed. Set the camera at chest height with shallow depth of field and creamy bokeh. The left background is a clean warm-beige wall block; the right background has blurred glass-curtain reflections and dark vertical lines. She has a rounded refined face, warm fair skin with natural blush, dark-brown long hair in a low half-up style with wispy strands, and a delicate pendant necklace. Turn her body about 30 degrees toward camera. Raise both arms and overlap them behind her head, elbows open into a relaxed asymmetrical triangular outline; her eyes look toward the lower-left camera direction and her expression is casual and unforced. Dress her in a tasteful white loose open-knit sweater over a fully covered black camisole, black high-waisted distressed denim shorts, and a dark-brown chain shoulder bag. Keep the styling adult, fashionable, and non-sexualized. Preserve realistic skin, hair, knit, denim, bag, and jewelry texture, warm orange-yellow grading, clear facial focus, and believable anatomy. Avoid underage appearance, nudity, accidental exposure, sexualized framing, cold white tones, whole-face overexposure, stiff symmetrical arms, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, text, logos, watermarks, borders, and collages.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为明确成年主要人物的面部身份依据。创建一张真实的竖版 3:4 半身时装人像，画面中只有一位成年东亚女性，从大腿上方裁切，位于画面中央偏左。使用暖调侧逆光与柔和金色轮廓光，沿发丝和肩颈边缘形成光晕；高光局部柔和扩散，但五官保持清晰不过曝。机位与胸口平齐，浅景深形成奶油状散景。左侧背景是干净的暖米色墙面色块，右侧是模糊玻璃幕墙反光与深色竖线。她脸型圆润精致，肤色白皙偏暖并带自然腮红，深棕色长发低位半扎，两侧有碎发，颈戴纤细坠饰。身体约向镜头侧转 30 度。双臂上举并交叠置于脑后，肘部向两侧打开形成放松且略不对称的三角轮廓；眼睛朝左下方镜头方向看，神情随性自然。穿着得体的白色宽松镂空针织衫，内搭完全覆盖的黑色吊带背心，黑色高腰做旧牛仔短裤和深棕色链条单肩包。整体保持成年、时尚且不性化。保留真实皮肤、发丝、针织、牛仔、包袋和首饰纹理，使用暖橙黄色调，面部清晰对焦，人体结构可信。避免未成年外观、裸露、意外暴露、性化取景、冷白色调、全脸过曝、双臂僵硬对称、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、文字、标志、水印、边框和拼图。

items.title: 古风仙侠叙事感东方幻想人像摄影
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

9:16 vertical, high-precision ancient style Xianxia narrative portrait, realistic Oriental fantasy portrait photography. Young adult Oriental female, visual age about 20–28 years old, soft oval face, clear almond eyes, soft lip shape, quiet and thoughtful expression, with a slight sense of journey, light melancholy, and storytelling, temperament is soft, moist, restrained, and natural.

Transparent immortal makeup, light and moist base makeup, skin is transparent with a slight dewy feel, eye makeup finely blended with light gray-pink, soft brown, and low-saturation water blue neutral colors, lip makeup is soft moist light bean paste pink or petal pink, overall makeup is light and clean, not heavy or gaudy. Black long hair half-down and half-up, hair strands are smooth, with a slight wind feel; exquisite light gold, white jade, and pearl small hair accessories and delicate earrings, headwear is light and restrained.

Light gauze Xianxia layered dress, medium luxury, water blue and white gold series, mainly water blue, light celadon, soft white, and creamy white, with light gold and white jade as accents. Clothing is light layered tulle, soft silk-like inner layer, fine light gold floral patterns and flowing cloud embroidery, the silk shawl hangs naturally, overall clear and agile, do not be overly gorgeous, do not lose the natural feel.

The character sits on the edge of a Magnolia boat, one hand lightly touching the boat's side, one hand naturally pressing down the silk shawl blown by the morning wind, half-body close-up composition, body slightly tilted towards the camera, posture is quiet and soft, like a brief stop during a journey, looking down or slightly glancing at the distant water surface and shore, emotions are subtle and thoughtful.

The scene is morning mist Magnolia boat / waterbank ferry / light waves distant mountains. Foreground shows wooden boat side, light-colored silk shawl, and water ripples; midground is a quiet ferry, waterbank wooden piles, light ripples; background shows the outline of distant mountains in thin mist and the end of the water surface. Background is moderately blurred, but retains the spatial layers of the boat side, ferry, distant mountains, and thin mist.

Lighting is morning thin mist daylight, overall bright and soft, water reflection lightly brightens the character's face, chin, hair strands, and lapel, the face is transparent and spirited, the mist is transparent and not dirty or gray. Overall image requirements: sense of journey, storytelling, naturalness, transparent makeup, soft wind feel, clear water color, narrative poster texture.

Negative prompt:
Underage feel, juvenile face, Western face, internet celebrity plastic face, heavy modern makeup, overly sweet feel, exaggerated blush, heavy eye makeup, heavy CG feel, 3D rendered face, plastic skin, cheap cosplay, photo studio style, overly gorgeous clothing, overall blue-ish tint, dirty gray background, thick mist covering face, overly miserable emotion, sickly feel, lifeless eyes, stiff movements, hand deformity, boat deformation, low resolution, low-level AI feel.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

9:16 竖版，高精度古风仙侠叙事感写真，偏写实东方幻想人像摄影。年轻成年东方女性，视觉年龄约 20–28 岁，柔和鹅蛋脸，杏眼明净，唇形柔软，神情安静若有所思，带轻微旅途感、轻愁感与故事感，气质柔婉、清润、克制、自然。

清透仙气妆，底妆轻薄水润，肌肤通透有轻微水光感，眼妆以浅灰粉、柔棕、低饱和水青中性色细腻晕染，唇妆为柔润浅豆沙粉或花瓣粉，整体妆面轻透干净，不浓艳。黑色长发半披半挽，发丝顺滑，带轻微风感；精致浅金、白玉、珍珠小发饰与细巧耳饰，头饰轻盈克制。

轻纱仙侠层叠裙，中等华丽度，水青白金系，以水青、浅青玉、柔和白色、乳白为主，浅金与白玉为点缀。服装为轻盈层叠薄纱、柔软绢感内层、细致浅金花纹与流云纹刺绣，披帛自然垂落，整体清润灵动，不要过度华丽，不要失去自然感。

人物坐在兰舟边缘，一只手轻扶船舷，一只手自然压住被晨风吹起的披帛，半身近景构图，身体轻微侧向镜头，姿态安静柔和，像在旅途中短暂停留，低头或微偏视线看向远处水面与岸边，情绪含蓄、若有所思。

场景为晨雾兰舟 / 水岸渡口 / 轻波远山。近景可见木质船舷、浅色披帛与水面波光；中景为安静渡口、水岸木桩、轻微涟漪；远景可见淡雾中的远山轮廓与水面尽头。背景适度虚化，但保留船舷、渡口、远山与薄雾的空间层次。

光线为清晨薄雾天光，整体明亮柔和，水面反光轻轻提亮人物面部、下颌、发丝与衣襟，脸部清透有神，雾气通透不脏灰。整体画面要求：旅途感、故事感、自然感、轻透妆面、柔和风感、清润水色、叙事海报质感。

负面提示词：
未成年感，幼态脸，欧美脸，网红整容脸，浓艳现代妆，甜妹感过强，夸张腮红，厚重眼妆，CG感过重，3D渲染脸，塑料皮肤，廉价cosplay，影楼风，服装过度华丽，整图泛青，背景灰脏，浓雾遮脸，情绪过度苦情，病弱感，无神眼神，动作僵硬，手部畸形，船体变形，低清晰度，低级AI感。

items.title: 日系成年女性四分之三侧后方人像
items.description: 明确20岁成年东亚女性的9:16室内手机人像，采用肩后略高视角、低发髻、黑色针织开衫与白色碎花吊带，结合暖窗光与冷色环境光；人物绑定10A。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded ref-10a-v1 image as the facial identity reference for the only visible person. Preserve the source's clearly adult subject, Japanese idol-inspired styling, three-quarter rear profile, clothing, hand gesture, 9:16 framing, and window light.

Create a photorealistic upper-body portrait of one clearly 20-year-old adult East Asian woman in a minimal modern interior. Give her fair, natural skin with fine realistic texture and glossy dark-brown hair gathered into a loose low bun, with a few wispy strands framing her cheek. Turn most of her face away from the camera in a soft three-quarter rear profile so that only part of her cheek and lips are visible. She gently raises one hand near her mouth, showing long almond-shaped nails with glossy black-and-white nail art, creating a quiet candid moment.

Dress her in a soft black knit cardigan that has slipped only slightly from one shoulder over a fully opaque, securely covering white floral camisole with delicate lace trim. The clothing remains modest and stable, with realistic knit texture, natural folds, fabric weight, and believable drape.

Use a 9:16 vertical close upper-body crop from the top of the head to just below the chest, photographed from slightly behind and above the shoulder. Emphasize the elegant line of the neck, shoulder, and collarbone. Warm late-afternoon sunlight enters through a nearby window as the key light, forming golden rim light on the hair, shoulder, collarbone, and cheek. Cool indoor ambient light gently fills the shadows and preserves realistic warm-cool separation. Keep most skin naturally matte and textured, with restrained highlights only on illuminated areas, and fine glossy reflections along individual hair strands.

Use a softly blurred gray wall and doorway in the background. Give the photograph the natural look of a 26mm-equivalent smartphone camera with slight handheld framing, shallow depth of field, restrained HDR, realistic skin texture, fine baby hairs, and an authentic indoor atmosphere. Include no additional people, nudity, transparent clothing, wardrobe malfunction, exaggerated anatomy, plastic skin, excessive shine, heavy beauty filters, logos, watermark, readable text, social-media interface, or obvious generation artifacts.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的 ref-10a-v1 图像作为唯一可见人物的面部身份参考。保留来源中的明确成年身份、日系偶像风造型、四分之三侧后方角度、服装、手势、9:16构图和窗边光线。

创作一张照片级写实的上半身人像：一名明确20岁的成年东亚女性位于简约现代室内。她有白皙自然且保留细腻纹理的皮肤，深棕色亮泽头发挽成蓬松低发髻，几缕碎发沿脸颊垂落。脸部大部分背向镜头，以柔和的四分之三侧后方轮廓呈现，只露出部分脸颊和嘴唇。她轻轻抬起一只手靠近嘴边，长杏仁形指甲采用黑白亮面美甲，形成安静自然的抓拍瞬间。

她穿柔软的黑色针织开衫，开衫自然地从一侧肩膀略微滑下，内搭完整不透明、覆盖稳妥的白色碎花吊带上衣，带细腻蕾丝边。衣物必须保持端庄安全，表现真实针织纹理、自然褶皱、面料重量和可信垂感。

采用9:16竖幅，从头顶到胸部下方的紧凑上半身裁切，镜头从肩后稍高位置拍摄，突出颈部、肩部和锁骨形成的优雅线条。暖色午后阳光从附近窗户照入作为主光，在头发、肩部、锁骨和脸颊形成金色轮廓光；冷色室内环境光柔和填充阴影，保留真实冷暖分离。大部分皮肤保持自然哑光和细腻纹理，仅在受光区域呈现克制高光，发丝具有细微光泽。

背景为柔焦的灰色墙面和门洞。使用26mm等效手机摄影质感、轻微手持构图、浅景深和克制HDR，保持真实皮肤、细小绒毛和自然室内氛围。不得出现额外人物、裸体、透明服装、走光、夸张人体、塑料皮肤、过度高光、重度美颜滤镜、标志、水印、可读文字、社交媒体界面或明显生成伪影。

items.title: 高端时尚人像与立体字母交互海报
items.description: 高端时尚社论海报：真实人物与具有重量和空间层次的巨型 3D 字母互动，默认执行为攀爬石质 R 字母。
items.prompt: Use the supplied identity reference as the only visible person. Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster titled GRIP THE FORM: an athletic woman climbs a monumental stone 3D letter R, gripping its top edge, stepping on its strokes, and threading one leg through the inner opening. The letter is a real sculptural structure with believable weight, contact shadows, depth and front-to-back layering. Preserve the reference identity with natural anatomy, skin and fabric. Controlled studio lighting, refined stone texture, strong negative space, cobalt blue, warm stone and charcoal palette. Minimal readable typography only: GRIP THE FORM, TYPE CONTACT, 2026. No extra people, logos or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 仅使用所提供的身份参考图作为画面中唯一可见的人物。创建一张 9:16 高端时尚社论海报，标题为 GRIP THE FORM：一位运动型女性攀爬巨大的石质 3D 字母 R，抓住顶端边缘，踩在字母笔画上，并将一条腿穿过内部开口。字母是真实雕塑结构，具有可信重量、接触阴影、深度和前后分层。保留参考图身份，使用自然解剖结构、皮肤和织物。受控摄影棚灯光、精致石材纹理、强负空间，采用钴蓝、暖石色和炭黑配色。画面只保留 GRIP THE FORM、TYPE CONTACT、2026，不要额外人物、标志或水印。

items.title: 欧洲古典画室中的静谧成年女性
items.description: 仿19世纪欧洲画室中的明确成年女性纪实人像，强调暖象牙色垂坠亚麻、旧纸与灰泥、自然晨光、真实皮肤纹理和9:16手机摄影质感；人物绑定10A。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded ref-10a-v1 image as the facial identity reference for the only visible person. Preserve the source's European classical atelier styling, clothing, composition, morning light, and photorealistic documentary approach.

Create a 9:16 vertical, ultra-photorealistic documentary lifestyle portrait. One clearly adult East Asian woman stands in a quiet classical studio that feels suspended between a nineteenth-century Florentine morning and a still Parisian atelier, as if she has stepped from an old master's drapery sketch. Aged paper, linen, and a subtly weathered plaster wall create a calm historical atmosphere. She looks directly into the camera with a peaceful, steady, mature expression. Keep fair skin with realistic fine texture and natural pores, naturally parted lips, and clear, gentle eyes.

Dress her in warm-ivory and pale-beige classical European draped linen. Wrap and tie the fabric securely and modestly across the upper torso in the manner of an academic drapery study; it is fully opaque, loose, and never tight. Heavy cloth falls from the upper body in long natural vertical folds with deep shadows and delicate highlights. Pull soft, naturally wavy hair gently back in a timeless style that clears the neck, leaving a few loose strands to catch the morning light.

Use a soft, muted classical European studio or quiet home corner as the background. Natural morning light enters from a high window at one side, creating atmospheric depth and gentle shadows. Place a faint classical sketch on the wall or a half-hidden drawing board, together with one small handwritten English phrase: either “Quiet Form” or “Still Light.” Give the image the authentic texture of phone-camera documentary photography with natural HDR: extremely clear, bright, sharp, clean daylight tones with no yellow cast. Frame from mid-thigh upward, with the subject facing the lens and natural focus on her real facial texture and the linen folds. It must look like a real human photograph, never anime, 3D, 2D, or illustration. Include no additional people, transparent clothing, wardrobe malfunction, exaggerated anatomy, plastic skin, malformed hands, logos, watermark, or garbled text.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的 ref-10a-v1 图像作为唯一可见人物的面部身份参考；保留来源中的欧洲古典画室造型、服装、构图、晨光和写实摄影风格。

创作一张 9:16 竖幅、超写实的纪实生活人像。一名明确成年的东亚女性站在仿佛介于19世纪佛罗伦萨与巴黎画室之间的静谧古典工作室里，像从旧大师的衣褶素描中走出。空气和陈旧纸张、亚麻布、带细微老化痕迹的灰泥墙共同营造安静历史感。她直视镜头，神情平和、沉静而成熟；皮肤白皙但保留真实细纹和自然毛孔，双唇自然微启，眼神清澈柔和。

她穿暖象牙色与淡米色的古典欧洲垂坠亚麻服装。面料以学院派衣褶研究的方式端庄、稳妥地围合并系在上身，完整不透明，宽松而不紧绷；厚重布料从上身向下形成长而自然的垂直褶皱，带深色阴影和细腻高光。柔软自然的波浪发简单向后拢，露出颈部，少量碎发在晨光中发亮。

背景为柔和、低调的古典欧洲画室或安静居家角落。高窗一侧的自然晨光温柔照入，形成空气透视和柔和阴影。墙面或半隐藏画板上自然出现一幅淡淡的古典素描，以及小型手写英文短语“Quiet Form”或“Still Light”中的一个。采用手机纪实摄影与自然 HDR 质感，画面极清晰、明亮、锐利，日光色调干净且无黄色偏色。取景从大腿中部以上，人物正面看镜头，焦点落在真实面部与亚麻衣褶上。必须是真实人类摄影感，不得为动漫、3D、2D或插画；不得出现额外人物、透明服装、走光、夸张人体、塑料皮肤、畸形手部、标志、水印或乱码。

items.title: 攀岩大墙阿尔卑斯绳索真实摄影
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible climber. Keep the source scene, climbing clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a 2x2 grid in a 16:9 final canvas showing four different subjects and scenes, each rendered as an honest alpine big-wall climbing instant. Treat the input dimensions as climber(s), wall context, move beat, capture medium, and rope-and-gear law. Give each panel a strong vertical 4:5-feeling frame that emphasizes the drop while the full output remains a clear 2x2 grid.

SUBJECT AND MOMENT
Show a climber mid-move with hips pressed to rock, heel raised on a tiny edge, fingers crimped or jammed in a crack, visible forearm tendons and veins, chalk on hands and holds, taped knuckles, possibly a bloodied fingertip, and real strain in the face. Each panel captures a committing move with a causal action: reaching for a hold, placing a cam, or weighting a foot that might slip. The posture should feel exposed, focused and deeply committed, awkward and real rather than heroic or effortless.

ROCK AND SCALE
Infer granite, limestone or alpine mixed terrain, but show real rock structure: cracks, flakes, chickenheads, lichen and water streaks. Never use a smooth blank wall. Place a vast void below, with hundreds of metres of air and ground lost in haze or absent; a partner or portaledge may appear as a tiny scale reference.

CAMERA AND LIGHT
Shoot from a fixed line above or a drone at the climber's height, 24–50mm equivalent, deep depth of field, fine grain and hard high-altitude light. Keep the hand on the hold or gear placement tack-sharp while the void below dissolves. Use extreme dynamic range: deep unfilled shadow in corners and cracks, warm bounce from sunlit granite, cool shadow side and thin clear air. Allow a rope to swing out of frame, wind to lift a jacket, a slightly awkward body position and untidy gear rack.

ROPE AND GEAR PHYSICS
Every rope must attach to a real point: through the harness belay loop, down to the last protection piece when leading, or up to an anchor when top-roping. Slack rope forms a catenary curve; loaded rope is straight, thin and taut. Cams and nuts sit in constrictions that could hold them, quickdraws hang under gravity, and the harness visibly bears weight. The image must feel like one truthful instant created by real rope physics and real equipment.

FORBIDDEN
No rope attached to nothing, missing harness or anchor, invented gear, featureless wall, rigid weightless rope, rope floating away from the body, relaxed effortless posture on hard terrain, gym-flat lighting on an alpine face, absent exposure below or clean unchalked hands.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见攀岩者的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的攀岩服装、姿势、场景、构图、光线和视觉风格。

在 16:9 的最终画布中制作 2×2 四格网格，展示四个不同主体与场景中的真实高山大岩壁攀岩瞬间。输入维度包括攀岩者、岩壁环境、动作节点、拍摄媒介以及绳索与装备规律。每格采用强调坠落空间的纵向 4:5 感构图，同时保持整体清晰的四格布局。

主体与动作
表现一名正在动作中的攀岩者：臀部贴近岩壁，脚跟踩在微小岩点上，手指抓住小点或卡入裂缝，前臂肌腱与静脉明显，手和支点上有镁粉，指关节缠胶带，手指可有轻微擦伤或血迹，面部呈现真实用力。每格捕捉一个有决断性的动作，并给出因果提示，例如伸手抓点、放置机械塞或给可能打滑的脚加压。姿势应暴露、专注、投入，允许真实而略显笨拙，不要英雄式或轻松无力感。

岩石与尺度
从花岗岩、石灰岩或高山混合地形中合理推断，但必须显示真实岩石结构：裂缝、岩片、鸡头状突起、地衣和水痕。不得使用平滑空白岩壁。下方保留数百米空气与巨大虚空，地面被雾化或完全看不见；可让队友或吊帐以极小比例出现，作为尺度参照。

镜头与光线
从上方固定绳路或与攀岩者同高度的无人机拍摄，等效 24–50mm，深景深、细微颗粒和强烈高海拔光线。抓点上的手或装备放置处必须极锐，下方虚空逐渐溶解。使用极高动态范围：角落和裂缝有深而未填充的阴影，向阳花岗岩产生暖色反光，背光面偏冷，空气清薄通透。允许绳索摆出画外、风吹起外套、身体姿态略显不协调以及装备排列不整齐。

绳索与装备物理
每条绳索都必须连接真实受力点：穿过安全带保护环，先锋攀登时向下连接最后一个保护点，顶绳时向上连接锚点。松弛绳索形成悬链曲线，受力绳索变得笔直、细且绷紧。机械塞和岩石塞必须位于确实能够承重的收缩裂缝中，快挂受重力自然下垂，安全带明确承受身体重量。画面必须像由真实绳索物理和真实装备共同形成的一个诚实瞬间。

负面约束
不得出现连接到空处的绳索、缺失安全带或锚点、虚构装备、没有岩点的空白岩壁、僵硬而无受力的绳索、飘离身体的绳子、高难地形上轻松松弛的姿势、健身房式平光、缺少下方暴露感或完全没有镁粉的双手。

items.title: AUREN巨型皮革托特包时尚编辑海报
items.description: AUREN虚构奢侈品牌的9:16时尚编辑海报：10A成年女性以可信力量感推靠建筑尺度的酒红色皮革马鞍托特包，配凝缩黑色标题与极简影棚建筑线。
items.prompt:
Use ref-10a-v1 only for the facial identity of the main visible adult East Asian woman. Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster for the fictional luxury brand AUREN and its MONUMENT 01 collection. Transform one structured saddle tote into a giant wearable-object installation at architectural scale. Place the oversized tote on the left and the full-body model on the right in an asymmetrical composition.

Show most of the tote and preserve its complete recognizable silhouette. Build it from deep oxblood full-grain leather with precise saddle stitching, polished black edges, brushed-brass handle mounts, articulated structural hinges, a sculpted top handle, controlled reflections, and premium surface finishing. It must look like a real luxury product enlarged to monumental scale, not a rough prop or simplified 3D object.

Style the adult model in a cobalt tailored trouser suit, ivory high-neck blouse, black square-toe boots, and small brass earrings. She leans one shoulder and both hands into the giant top handle as if pushing it, with planted feet, believable contact, visible weight, and real body tension. Preserve accurate hands, natural adult proportions, and realistic fabric.

Use a clean warm-ivory studio background with subtle black perspective lines, sparse architectural outlines, and soft directional light. Set a large black condensed headline behind both subjects reading exactly CARRY THE IMPOSSIBLE, partially overlapped by the model and tote but still readable. Add faint oversized outline lettering AUREN farther back in perspective. Place the small subtitle Architecture, carried. and collection label MONUMENT 01 near the lower left. Use an oxblood, cobalt, warm-ivory, brushed-brass, and black palette with premium magazine polish. No extra people, misspelled required text, unrelated logos, signatures, or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
仅将 ref-10a-v1 用于主要可见成年东亚女性的面部身份。为虚构奢侈品牌AUREN及其MONUMENT 01系列创作一张9:16高端时尚编辑海报。把一个结构化马鞍托特包转化为建筑尺度的巨大可穿戴物体装置。采用不对称构图，将超大托特包放在左侧，全身模特放在右侧。

清楚展示托特包的大部分区域，并保持完整、可辨识的轮廓。包身使用深酒红色全粒面皮革，带精确马鞍缝线、抛光黑色边缘、拉丝黄铜提手底座、可见结构铰链、雕塑感顶部提手、受控反光和高级表面处理。它必须像被放大到纪念碑尺度的真实奢侈品，而不是粗糙道具或简化三维物体。

成年模特穿钴蓝色剪裁长裤套装、象牙白高领衬衫、黑色方头短靴和小巧黄铜耳饰。她用一侧肩膀和双手抵住巨大顶部提手，仿佛正在推动它；双脚稳稳着地，呈现可信接触、重量感和真实身体张力。保持准确手部、自然成年人体比例和写实衣料。

使用干净的暖象牙白影棚背景，加入细微黑色透视线、稀疏建筑轮廓和柔和定向光。在两个主体后方放置大型黑色凝缩字体标题CARRY THE IMPOSSIBLE，人物和托特包可部分遮挡标题，但仍须可读。背景更深处以透视方式放置淡化的超大轮廓字AUREN。左下角加入小号副标题Architecture, carried.和系列标签MONUMENT 01。使用酒红、钴蓝、暖象牙白、拉丝黄铜和黑色配色，呈现高级杂志质感。不要增加其他人物、拼错指定文字、添加无关标志、签名或水印。

items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the clearly adult main subject. Create a photorealistic vertical 9:16 handheld smartphone portrait of an adult Japanese woman with a gentle warm airy appearance, subtle natural smile, small heart-shaped face, soft eyes, light-brown irises, natural medium-brown hair loosely tied with fine flyaway strands, and natural makeup. Frame her from the chest upward, front-facing, with the camera clearly above and angled down. Capture a casual imperfect smartphone photograph before posting to social media, with a natural hair-tying gesture that tastefully reveals only the neckline, realistic skin texture and pores, subtle uneven tone, natural asymmetry, believable anatomy, gravity, cloth physics, and restrained 4K-like detail. items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为明确成年主要人物的面部身份依据。创建一张照片级真实的竖版 9:16 手持手机人像，主体是一位成年日本女性，呈现柔和温柔的成年外貌、温暖轻盈的氛围、微妙自然的微笑、小巧心形脸、柔和眼睛、浅褐色虹膜、自然中棕色头发；头发松散扎起并带有细碎飞发，妆容自然。穿着得体、完全覆盖的室内睡衣，面料自然垂坠，保持成年身体比例自然且不采用性化表现，不得出现意外暴露。画面从胸部以上取景，正对镜头，摄像头明显位于人物上方并向下倾斜。场景设定为夏季夜晚、睡前不久的朴素卧室，整洁但有生活气息，床品自然褶皱，使用普通环境光。捕捉一张发布到社交媒体前拍摄的随意、不完美的手机照片；人物自然做出扎头发的动作，仅得体地露出颈部线条，并保留真实皮肤纹理与毛孔、微妙不均匀肤色、自然不对称、可信人体结构、重力和织物物理以及克制的 4K 细节。保持非显性、穿着妥当或覆盖严实的呈现。避免未成年外观、裸露、意外暴露、性化取景、夸张身体比例、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、人工影棚光、文字、标志、水印、边框和拼图。

items.title: 浓缩咖啡馆外亮粉衬衫成年女性街拍
items.description: 极简欧式浓缩咖啡馆外的奢华街拍时尚人像：成年东亚女性穿亮粉色宽松衬衫、黑色短上衣与百褶短裙，搭配链条包和层叠项链；背景清楚保留 Espresso Bar 招牌。示例绑定统一 10A 身份。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity basis for the only visible person. Preserve the recognizable face of the 10A adult East Asian woman while applying the following café setting, outfit and fashion-editorial treatment.

Create an ultra-realistic luxury street-style portrait of an adult East Asian woman in her 20s standing outside a charming minimalist espresso café. She wears an oversized hot-pink button-up shirt open over a black crop top and a black pleated mini skirt. Style her dark hair in a soft messy bun with loose face-framing strands. Add delicate layered necklaces, subtle earrings and natural luminous makeup. Place a glossy black leather shoulder bag with a silver chain strap on her shoulder, and pose her elegantly with both hands gently clasped. Keep her anatomy and hand placement natural.

Behind her, show a cream-colored café entrance with the clearly readable sign “Espresso Bar”, a warm vintage wall lamp, a wooden table holding coffee cups, and clean European-inspired architecture. Soft overcast daylight creates flattering diffuse illumination and warm neutral tones.

Use an 85mm portrait-lens perspective around f/1.8 with shallow depth of field and soft bokeh. Render highly detailed hot-pink shirt fabric, black pleats, leather gloss, silver chain links and natural skin tones. Finish as candid yet polished luxury fashion editorial photography with subtle cinematic color grading and a premium lifestyle mood. No extra person, malformed hands, duplicate fingers, plastic skin, unrelated text, misspelled required sign, logo, interface graphic, border or watermark.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为画面中唯一人物的面部身份依据。在应用以下咖啡馆场景、服装和时尚编辑处理时，保持 10A 成年东亚女性可辨识的面部身份。

创作一张超写实的奢华街头时尚人像。一位 20 多岁的成年东亚女性站在迷人的极简主义浓缩咖啡馆外。她外穿亮粉色超大号纽扣衬衫，敞开露出黑色短款上衣，下装为黑色百褶短裙。深色头发盘成柔软凌乱的发髻，保留修饰脸型的松散碎发。搭配精致叠戴项链、含蓄耳环和自然透亮妆容。肩背带银色链条的亮面黑色皮革单肩包，双手轻轻交握，以优雅姿态站立；人体结构和手部位置自然。

人物身后是奶油色咖啡馆入口，招牌必须清晰、准确地写出“Espresso Bar”，并布置温暖复古壁灯、摆有咖啡杯的木桌和简洁欧式建筑元素。柔和阴天自然光形成悦目的漫射照明与温暖中性色调。

使用 85mm 人像镜头透视、约 f/1.8 浅景深与柔和散景。细致表现亮粉衬衫面料、黑色裙褶、皮革光泽、银色链节和自然肤色。成片呈现随性但精致的奢华时尚社论摄影，配合含蓄电影调色和高级生活方式氛围。不得出现额外人物、畸形手部、重复手指、塑料皮肤、无关文字、拼错的必要招牌、标志、界面图形、边框或水印。

items.title: 成年女性复古学院风珊瑚粉沙发人像
items.description: 成年参考人物坐在珊瑚粉复古沙发前的地毯上，以酒红色有线电话、棋盘静物和暖阳光斑构成精致复古学院风生活方式人像。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the single clearly adult main subject. Create a realistic vertical 3:4 retro-preppy indoor lifestyle portrait in an exquisite living room with soft warm sunlight. Show one adult East Asian woman sitting naturally and stably on the light-colored carpet in front of a coral-pink suede vintage loveseat, positioned center-right. Her legs fold to the right; one hand lightly holds the burgundy corded telephone handset by her leg while the cord naturally connects to the telephone on the sofa seat; her other hand rests on the sofa edge. Her head turns slightly left and her gaze looks out of frame, with a quiet restrained waiting expression. She has long dark hair and wears a white collared shirt, black tweed pinafore dress, black bow, white tights, and black low-heel Mary Janes. In the foreground include a wooden chessboard with scattered pieces, an open magazine, a small white cup and saucer, two red cherries, and a light orange-pink cushion. Behind the sofa are off-white shutters and light wall panels. Use warm soft geometric-edged sunlight from front right, mainly across the carpet, magazine, sofa edges, and near the legs, while keeping the face readable and not overexposed. Use restrained off-white, coral gray-pink, warm beige, black-gray, and burgundy tones with slight retro film warmth and fine grain; keep the face, clothing texture, phone, chessboard, and suede clear. Integrate a tasteful, readable Soran mark naturally as embroidery, a woven label, or a small phone nameplate, with additional subtle Soran forms embedded in tweed yarn, suede texture, cord spiral, chessboard grain, magazine print, glaze lines, stitching nodes, and object arrangements. The markings must follow material, perspective, lighting, and occlusion rather than appearing pasted on. Preserve the pink vintage sofa, black-and-white preppy styling, floor-sitting pose, phone-to-sofa connection, chessboard and magazine still life, and warm indoor light. Avoid multiple people, messy or modern-minimalist interiors, neon or oversaturated pink, standing or sofa-sitting pose, broken anatomy, deformed hands, extra fingers, broken or floating phone cord, chess perspective errors, floating pieces, forced direct gaze, exaggerated smile, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, hard flash, extreme contrast, blur, low-definition face, external watermark, sticker-like logo, detached letters, captions, misspelled Soran, duplicated logo, or watermark covering the face.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中唯一明确成年主要人物的面部身份依据。创建一张真实的竖版 3:4 复古学院风室内生活方式人像，场景是一间精致客厅，带柔和暖阳。画面中只有一位成年东亚女性，自然稳定地坐在珊瑚粉绒面复古双人沙发前的浅色地毯上，位于画面中央偏右。她双腿向右侧折叠；一只手轻握酒红色有线电话听筒放在腿边，电话线自然连接到沙发座面上的电话机；另一只手搭在沙发边缘。她头部略向左转，视线看向画外，神情安静克制，带有等待感。她留深色长发，穿白色翻领衬衫、黑色粗花呢背心裙、黑色蝴蝶结、白色连裤袜和黑色低跟玛丽珍鞋。前景加入木质棋盘与散落棋子、打开的杂志、白色小杯碟、两颗红樱桃和浅橙粉靠垫。沙发后方是乳白色百叶窗与浅色墙板。使用从右前方进入的温暖柔和几何边缘光斑，主要落在地毯、杂志、沙发边缘和人物腿部附近，同时保持脸部清晰可读不过曝。整体使用克制的乳白、珊瑚灰粉、暖米色、黑灰和酒红色，带轻微复古胶片暖感与细颗粒；人物脸部、服装纹理、电话、棋盘和绒面必须清楚。将一个有品味且可读的 Soran 标记自然融入刺绣、织标或电话小铭牌，并把其他细微 Soran 形态嵌入粗花呢纱线、沙发绒面、电话线螺旋、棋盘木纹、杂志印刷、釉面细线、缝线节点和物件排列中。所有标识都应随材质、透视、光影和遮挡自然变化，不得像外贴文字。保留粉色复古沙发、黑白学院风造型、坐地姿态、电话与沙发的连接、棋盘和杂志静物以及暖阳室内光斑。避免多人、杂乱或现代极简室内、霓虹色或过饱和粉色、站立或坐在沙发上的姿势、人体结构错误、畸形手部、多余手指、断裂或漂浮电话线、棋盘透视错误、漂浮棋子、强行直视镜头、夸张笑容、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、硬闪光、极端对比、模糊、低清面部、外部水印、贴纸式 logo、脱离材质的字母、字幕、Soran 拼写错误、重复标识或遮挡面部的水印。

items.title: 超写实东亚女性角色设计三视图
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please generate a character design three-view sheet (front close-up bust / front full body / back full body) based on the two reference images I provided, pure white background, no text allowed. Image 1 is the character identity reference, and Image 2 is the clothing reference. The overall style is hyper-realistic live-action photography, a young East Asian adult female, realistic and natural, high-definition details, soft studio lighting. Strictly maintain consistency with the character identity features in Image 1, including face shape, facial feature proportions, eye shape, nose shape, lips, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, hair length, and overall temperament; do not turn into another face. On the left is a front close-up bust, clearly showing the face, hairstyle, shoulders, neck, and upper body clothing details; in the middle is a standard front full-body standing pose, showing body proportions and the complete outfit, with the face weakened to a featureless state but retaining the complete head shape, hairstyle silhouette, ears, jawline, and neck; on the right is a standard back full-body standing pose, showing the length of the back of the hair, back silhouette, and the back structure of the clothing. The clothing strictly references Image 2, including style, color, material, cut, neckline, shoulder straps, sleeve type, patterns, decorations, and overall coordination; if the clothing reference image does not fully show the lower body, naturally complete it according to the same clothing style to ensure unity between front and back. The overall look is clean, professional, and unified, suitable as a live-action character card for video generation and character consistency control. No anime style, illustration style, 3D feel, AI influencer face, excessive skin smoothing, heavy makeup, Westernization, infantilization, complex backgrounds, text, logos, or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请基于我提供的两张参考图生成角色设计三视图（正面近景胸像 / 正面全身 / 背面全身），纯白色背景，禁止出现文字。图1为人物身份参考，图2为服装参考。整体为超写实真人摄影风格，东亚年轻成年女性，真实自然，高清细节，柔和棚拍光线。严格保持图1中的人物身份特征一致，包括脸型、五官比例、眼型、鼻型、嘴唇、肤色、发型、发色、头发长度和整体气质，不要变成另一张脸。左侧为正面胸像近景，清晰展示脸部、发型、肩颈与上半身服装细节；中间为正面全身标准站姿，展示身体比例与完整服装，面部弱化为无五官状态，但保留完整头型、发型轮廓、耳朵、下颌线和脖子；右侧为背面全身标准站姿，展示头发后部长度、背部轮廓与服装背面结构。服装严格参考图2，包括款式、颜色、材质、版型、领口、肩带、袖型、图案、装饰和整体搭配；如果服装参考图没有完整展示下半身，则根据同一套服装风格自然补全，保证正面和背面统一。整体干净、专业、统一，适合作为视频生成和人物一致性控制的真人角色卡。不要动漫风、插画风、3D感、AI网红脸、过度磨皮、浓妆、欧美化、幼态化、复杂背景、文字、logo、水印。

items.title: 怀旧东亚旅行海报摄影与极简插画结合
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a refined editorial travel-poster composition inspired by nostalgic East Asian travel photography and minimalist contemporary illustration.

Upper section: A cinematic, photorealistic riverside scene in a historic town. Traditional wooden sightseeing boats with warm honey-orange frames and small covered roofs float on calm green water. A graceful old stone arch bridge spans the river, surrounded by enormous mature trees with dense foliage. Misty karst mountains rise softly in the background. Include subtle human activity and authentic architectural details. Warm natural daylight, slightly faded film colors, gentle haze, soft contrast, analog film grain, peaceful and nostalgic atmosphere.

Lower section: Beneath the photograph, transition into a minimalist hand-drawn illustration on a warm ivory/off-white background. Reduce the scene into simple delicate shapes: a curved dark stone bridge, abstract trees in muted olive, ochre, beige and rust tones, tiny simplified boats and horizontal reflections on the water. Use sparse lines, imperfect brush textures and lots of negative space.

Overall design: premium independent travel magazine aesthetic, understated Japanese/Korean editorial poster design, muted earthy palette, soft vintage photography, minimal graphic illustration, elegant composition, generous white space, subtle paper texture, quiet contemplative mood. Keep typography extremely minimal and small, with tiny date/location-style text near the corners. No logos, no watermark, no excessive text, no saturated colors.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创建一个精致的编辑旅行海报构思，灵感来自怀旧的东亚旅行摄影和极简主义当代插画。上半部分：一个具有电影感的、写实的古镇河畔场景。带有温暖蜂蜜橙色框架和小型遮篷屋顶的传统木制观光船漂浮在平静的绿色水面上。一座优美的古老石拱桥横跨河流，周围环绕着枝叶茂盛的巨大成年树木。薄雾笼罩的喀斯特山脉在背景中隐约升起。包含微妙的人物活动和真实的建筑细节。温暖的自然日光，略显褪色的胶片色彩，柔和的薄雾，柔和的对比度，模拟胶片颗粒，宁静而怀旧的氛围。下半部分：在照片下方，过渡到温暖象牙色/米白色背景上的极简手绘插画。将场景简化为简单的精致形状：一个深色的石制弯桥，橄榄色、赭石色、米色和锈色的抽象树木，微型简化的船只以及水面上的水平倒影。使用稀疏的线条、不完美的画笔纹理和大量的负空间。整体设计：优质独立旅行杂志审美，低调的日式/韩式编辑海报设计，柔和的土色调，柔和的复古摄影，极简图形插画，优雅的构图，大面积留白，微妙的纸张纹理，安静沉思的情绪。保持排版极其极简且微小，角落附近带有微小的日期/地点风格文本。无标志，无水印，无过多文字，无饱和色彩。

items.title: 几何剪纸雕塑标题海报
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的卡纸浮雕、几何主视觉与奢华标题设计海报工作流模板。
items.prompt: Input topic: A ceremonial vessel and mountain wind. Input title: Wind Vessel. Input subject: A tall ceramic vessel with a cut-paper mountain silhouette. Display title token: WIND VESSEL. Hero form: a faceted folded-paper ceremonial vessel. Secondary shapes or symbols: angular wind lines and cropped mountain shards. Accent color: vermilion #C84B31. Create a 9:16 vertical editorial poster combining paper-cut sculpture, geometric constructivism, restrained luxury title design and negative space. Use only a base palette of ink black, warm paper white and one accent color semantically relevant to the topic. Compose the title typography as the dominant left/center structure, with a faceted folded-paper ceremonial vessel on the right integrated into a paper architecture; connect them with geometric shards, rules and fragments, and use cropped shapes or framing motifs below as visual ballast. Construct WIND VESSEL from custom angular paper-cut letterforms that feel physically assembled from layered cardstock. Use sharp wedges, diagonal cuts, clipped terminals and inset shadows; selectively fracture glyphs into geometric extensions pointing toward the hero, while preserving strong title readability despite abstraction. Translate the hero form into a faceted folded-paper sculpture, building its object geometry from planar shards rather than smooth surfaces. Integrate its silhouette with the same graphic system as the typography, allowing hero fragments to invade title space and title fragments to enter the hero. Use vermilion #C84B31 only on strategic interior planes or semantic focal regions. Light the shallow relief with studio light, crisp paper-edge shadows, tactile thickness and subtle elevation from the background. Preserve physical layered cardstock, folded paper, cut-paper relief and sharp polygon facets. Keep generous restrained negative space, clear hierarchy and clean graphic construction. Forbid a hardcoded generic subject, generic font, smooth plastic 3D, rainbow palette, a separate illustration sitting beside the text, busy realistic background, unreadable title or watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 输入主题：A ceremonial vessel and mountain wind；输入标题：Wind Vessel；输入对象：A tall ceramic vessel with a cut-paper mountain silhouette；显示标题：WIND VESSEL；主视觉形态：a faceted folded-paper ceremonial vessel；辅助形状/符号：angular wind lines and cropped mountain shards；强调色：vermilion #C84B31。创建一张9:16竖幅编辑海报，融合剪纸雕塑、几何构成主义和克制的奢华标题设计。整体色板只使用墨黑、暖纸白和一个与主题有语义关联的强调色。画面结构为：标题排版主导左侧/中心，a faceted folded-paper ceremonial vessel位于右侧并融入纸质建筑；几何碎片、线条和视觉碎片连接两者，下方用裁切形状和框架图案形成视觉重心。标题 WIND VESSEL 必须由定制的棱角剪纸字形构成，像由分层卡纸物理组装而成；使用锋利楔形、对角切口、剪切末端和内嵌阴影，选择性将字形破碎成指向主视觉的几何延伸，但即使抽象也要高度清晰易读。将主视觉转化为刻面折叠纸雕塑，从平面碎片而非光滑表面构建对象几何；让其剪影与排版处于同一图形系统，允许主视觉碎片侵入标题空间，标题碎片也可反向侵入主视觉。强调色 vermilion #C84B31 只用于内部关键平面或语义焦点。使用浅浮雕摄影棚光效、清脆纸边阴影、可触摸的厚度和略高于背景的抬升感。保留分层卡纸、折纸、剪纸浮雕和锋利多边形刻面的真实物理质感。保持克制留白、清楚层级和干净的图形结构。不要硬编码主题、通用字体、光滑3D塑料、彩虹色板、与文字并排的独立插图、繁杂写实背景、难以辨认的标题或水印。

items.title: 日本斯堪的纳维亚极简纪念邮票版张
items.description: 以日本为目的地的 A4 纵向收藏级纪念邮票版张，采用当代斯堪的纳维亚极简邮政设计和官方邮资示例。
items.prompt:
Create a premium commemorative postage-stamp collection inspired by Japan, presented as a complete A4 vertical stamp sheet shown straight-on on a clean white background. Include 7–9 individual collectible stamps with varied physical sizes and the same elegant 3:4 portrait proportion, arranged with gentle asymmetry, visual rhythm, and comfortable white space rather than a rigid grid.

Use sophisticated contemporary Scandinavian minimalism: elegant geometric forms, clean silhouettes, restrained details, subtle graphic abstraction, and refined editorial composition. Use a fresh limited palette inspired by Japan, with a warm-white or pure-white sheet background. Avoid vintage sepia, excessive decoration, cartoon illustration, photorealism, and generic tourist-poster styling.

Give each stamp one distinctive Japan-related subject, mixing landmarks and architecture, local food, transportation, nature, cultural objects, flora, and small everyday symbols. Make every stamp feel physically collectible with crisp perforated edges, printed paper texture, the destination name JAPAN or 日本, subtle typography, and plausible current Japanese postage denominations such as ¥85, ¥110, ¥430, and ¥600 based on Japan Post domestic postage examples. Keep each stamp visually different but within one coherent art direction.

Show only the complete stamp sheet: no mockup frame, hands, envelopes, or extra objects. Preserve an A4 vertical presentation, tactile printed-paper realism, and a sophisticated limited-edition postal-release character.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一个受日本启发的优质纪念邮票收藏集，以完整的 A4 纵向邮票版张形式呈现；正面直拍，置于干净的白色背景上。包含 7–9 枚独立的收藏级邮票，物理尺寸各不相同，但都保持优雅的 3:4 纵向比例；在版面中以柔和的不对称、视觉韵律和舒适留白自由排列，而不是呆板网格。

采用精致的当代斯堪的纳维亚极简主义：优雅几何形状、干净剪影、克制细节、微妙图形抽象和精致编辑构图。使用受日本启发的清新有限调色板，版张背景为暖白或纯白。避免复古棕褐色、过度装饰、卡通插图、写实摄影和普通旅游海报风格。

每枚邮票只呈现一个独特的日本主题，混合地标与建筑、当地美食、交通工具、自然、文化物品、植物和日常小符号。每枚邮票都应具有真实收藏邮票的感觉：清晰齿孔、印刷纸张质感、JAPAN 或 日本 的目的地名称、微妙排版，以及合理的当前日本邮资面值示例，如 ¥85、¥110、¥430 和 ¥600；这些数值参考日本邮便国内邮资档位。各枚邮票视觉上不同，但保持统一艺术方向。

只展示完整邮票版张：不要样机框、手、信封或额外物体。保持 A4 纵向呈现、可触摸的印刷纸张真实感和精致限量邮政发行气质。

items.title: 四款独特经典汽车爆炸结构图
items.description: 四种真实而独特的经典汽车以2×2网格呈现，每格展示焦点堆栈的零重力爆炸结构、剖面机关和真实材质。
items.prompt:
Create a 16:9 technical product visualization arranged as a precise 2x2 grid. Each quadrant presents one real unusual classic car as an elegant zero-gravity exploded view: top left, 1955 Citroën DS 19; top right, 1956 BMW Isetta 300; bottom left, 1955 Messerschmitt KR200; bottom right, 1961 Amphicar Model 770. Print the exact model name as a small, clean heading inside its quadrant. Do not include people.

For each car, separate and identify the major body panels, chassis structure, suspension, steering, powertrain, wheels, cabin fittings, and the distinctive mechanism that reveals how that model works. Arrange components in correct assembly order along one clean exploded axis or a disciplined orbit around the central vehicle. Keep deliberate spacing, make the complete car body the largest forward hero element, and let secondary components recede without becoming scattered. Include one carefully cut away or cross-sectioned component per car to reveal its defining engineering story: the DS hydropneumatic suspension, the Isetta front-opening door and compact rear engine, the KR200 tandem cockpit and rear drivetrain, and the Amphicar's land-and-water drivetrain with twin propellers.

Use one seamless muted cobalt background across all four panels. Suspend every component without visible wires. Unify the grid with soft directional studio light; each floating piece casts an honest soft shadow. Apply focus stacking so every suspended element is sharp, with controlled reflections, consistent scale, and materially accurate painted steel, chrome, rubber, glass, upholstery, and machined parts. Render raw internal components as beautifully as the finished vehicles. Maintain clear quadrant borders, technical readability, and a premium museum-catalog finish. Avoid mismatched lighting, inconsistent scale, invented parts, extra vehicles, logos, signatures, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张16:9技术产品可视化图，以精确的2×2网格排列。每个象限用优雅的零重力爆炸图呈现一种真实而独特的经典汽车：左上为1955 Citroën DS 19，右上为1956 BMW Isetta 300，左下为1955 Messerschmitt KR200，右下为1961 Amphicar Model 770。在各自象限内以小号整洁标题准确写出对应车型名称。不要出现人物。

对每辆车分离并识别主要车身面板、底盘结构、悬架、转向系统、动力总成、车轮、座舱部件，以及揭示该车型运作方式的独特机构。部件按照正确装配顺序，沿一条干净的爆炸轴线或围绕中心车辆进行有纪律的环绕排列。保持刻意而清晰的间距，让完整车身成为最大、最靠前的核心元素，次要部件依次后退且不得散乱。每辆车包含一个细致的剖切或横截面部件，揭示其代表性工程故事：DS的液气悬架、Isetta的前开门与紧凑后置发动机、KR200的串列式座舱与后置传动系统，以及Amphicar兼顾陆地和水上行驶并带双螺旋桨的传动系统。

四格统一使用无缝的低饱和钴蓝色背景。所有部件悬浮且不得出现支撑线。柔和定向影棚光统一整个网格，每个悬浮零件都投下真实柔和阴影。使用焦点堆栈，使所有部件清晰锐利；控制反光，保持比例一致，并真实表现喷漆钢材、镀铬、橡胶、玻璃、内饰和机加工零件。原始内部部件应与完成的车辆同样精美。保持明确的象限边界、技术可读性和高级博物馆目录质感。避免光照不一致、比例冲突、虚构零件、额外车辆、标志、签名和水印。

items.title: 雨后欧洲石阶广场上的成年女性旅行时尚人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的雨后欧洲历史城市旅行时尚人像模板。主体为明确的成年女性，保留水桶帽、红框眼镜、灰色外套、裹裙、石阶广场与雨后冷暖光线；英文提示词已在 5000 字符限制内完成语义压缩。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Subject: A single fictional adult Japanese woman standing on a historic stone step square after rain, her body facing near the front of the frame, while her face is turned only to the left of the frame. Paired with a beige bucket hat, red glasses, a pale blue ribbed top, a gray long coat draped from the shoulders, and a gray wrap skirt. Expressing the quiet expectation contained in the moment of stopping during a journey and discovering the next destination.

Location · Time · Background: A European historical city after rain transitioning from cloudy to evening. Behind her are wide stone steps, with handrails and spherical stone ornaments extending on both sides, a white sculptural church facade, reddish-brown old buildings, and elegant collective buildings. The cobblestone road is wet from the rain, reflecting the light of street lamps or the sky in thin strips. Lighted street lamps and tall palm trees appear slightly in the distance.

Clothing · Accessories: Pale smoky blue sleeveless high-neck ribbed knit, charcoal gray high-waisted wrap mini skirt, thick light gray long coat. Ensure the frames fit correctly on the eyebrows, eyes, and temples.

Slender light reflections form on the wet cobblestone road, conveying the dampness of the air.

Although low in saturation, layers remain where the boundaries between the top and coat, and the difference between the hair and hat, are discernible.
