items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中可见人眼所属人物的身份参考，仅匹配可兼容的自然眼部与皮肤特征。创建4:5竖幅超写实电影感人类眼睛肖像，以极致微距捕捉惊人细节。眼睛必须是绝对主体，成为通往 JAPAN 的魔幻窗口：在仍像真实虹膜的前提下，把 JAPAN 的地理与文化无缝嵌入虹膜纤维自然纹理，形成一个微缩生活世界，包含该国标志性地标、传统建筑、景观、当地文化、辨识度高的街道、自然和细微文化细节。地标应在虹膜内微小而梦幻，被符合该国的山脉、河流、建筑、树木和发光城市灯光环绕；效果像国家神秘地生活在眼睛里，而不是贴图。画面底部附近优雅而克制地加入变量 JAPAN，下方加入英文诗意标语“Where light remembers every journey”。呈现超详细虹膜纤维、真实睫毛、自然皮肤纹理、微观眼部细节、真实反射折射、柔和电影光、微妙金色高光、浅景深、戏剧而优雅的气氛、高级旅行宣传美学、照片级写实、超现实但可信、平滑构图、精致调色和8K细节。不要杂乱、扭曲解剖、多余眼睛、过多文字或水印。

items.title: 窗边整理头发的真实感女性纵向胶片人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographed portrait. Subject and action: Upper body held still beside the window while both hands gather and secure hair above and behind the head. Hair and styling: Render an adult woman's hair as a collarbone-length layered lob with clear cheek and jaw framing, in jet black with a soft matte finish, only within jaw-to-collarbone bob, lob, or compact-tie geometry. Composition: Tight vertical upper-body portrait cropped from mid-torso upward; both raised elbows and forearms are partially cut by the left, right, and top edges; subject slightly left of center with the bright window filling the upper-right background; modest headroom is obscured by the raised arms. Camera: Eye-level camera at conversation distance, natural 50mm-like perspective, softly focused close portrait with shallow background definition. Pose: Standing upright close to the window, torso facing nearly forward with a slight turn toward camera-left. Wardrobe: Studio Nicholson heavyweight white tee, slate barrel trousers, gum-sole sneakers. Setting: Indoors directly beside a tall sunlit window, with a heavy warm-brown curtain along the left edge and a pale translucent curtain over the bright window on the right. Lighting: Strong daylight backlight from behind and camera-right, heavily overexposing the window and creating milky flare across the upper head and raised right arm; face and torso remain softly underexposed with warm reflected light from the curtain. Natural snapshot details: Keep the uneven backlit exposure: the window and upper-right arm wash into clipped white flare while the face stays dim, with slight softness and cropped limbs rather than corrected studio balance. Finish: Soft consumer color-negative-film fingerprint with a warm amber cast, low-to-moderate contrast, muted saturation, lifted brown shadows, visible fine grain across the frame and fine grain sitting on visible skin, natural pores and faint under-eye texture retained, gentle focus softness, mild halation around the window. Rendering constraints: keep the exact crop, body-to-camera relationship, hand task, gaze direction, light direction, foreground obstruction, and background placement; preserve believable anatomy and natural hands; avoid beauty-filter skin, studio-clean restaging, generic fashion posing, text, logos, borders, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创建一个真实的 9:16 纵向拍摄肖像。主体与动作：上半身在窗边保持静止，双手在头后上方聚集并固定头发。发型与造型：将成年女性的头发呈现为锁骨长度的分层波波头（lob），具有明显的脸颊和下颌轮廓，纯黑色，带有柔和的哑光质感，仅限于下颌到锁骨的波波头、长波波头或紧凑绑扎的几何形状。构图：紧凑的纵向半身肖像，从中躯干向上裁剪；抬起的双肘和前臂被左、右和顶边部分切断；主体稍微位于中心偏左，明亮的窗户占据右上方的背景；较小的头部空间被抬起的手臂遮挡。相机：与视线平齐的相机，处于对话距离，自然的 50mm 视角，带有浅背景定义的柔焦近距离肖像。姿势：直立站在窗户附近，躯干几乎正对前方，略微向相机左侧转动。衣着：Studio Nicholson 重磅白色 T 恤，石板色筒裤，生胶底运动鞋。环境：室内，紧邻一扇高大的阳光直射窗户，左边缘有一层厚重的暖褐色窗帘，右侧明亮的窗户上覆盖着淡色半透明窗帘。光线：来自后方和相机右侧的强烈日光背光，使窗户严重过曝，并在头顶上方和抬起的右臂上产生乳白色的光晕；面部和躯干保持柔和的欠曝状态，带有来自窗帘的温暖反射光。自然抓拍细节：保持不均匀的背光曝光：窗户和右上臂冲蚀成剪影白光，而脸部保持昏暗，带有轻微的柔和感和被裁剪的肢体，而不是经过修正的影棚平衡。修饰：带有暖色琥珀色调的柔和消费级彩色负片胶片特征，低到中等对比度，低饱和度，提升的褐色阴影，画面中可见细腻颗粒，皮肤上也有细腻颗粒，保留自然毛孔和淡淡的眼下纹理，轻柔的焦距柔和感，窗户周围有轻微的光晕。渲染约束：保持确切的裁剪方式、身体与相机的关系、手部动作、注视方向、光线方向、前景遮挡和背景位置；保留可信的解剖结构和自然的手部；避免美颜滤镜皮肤、影棚级别的洁净重拍、通用的时尚摆拍、文字、标志、边框和水印。

items.title: 高端饮品垂直爆炸分解信息图
items.description: A reusable premium beverage exploded-view infographic template for layered product visualization with clean labels, realistic glass and controlled studio shadows.
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical 3:4 exploded-view beverage infographic for a chocolate coffee drink with cocoa powder, chocolate sauce, whipped cream, roasted coffee beans, sugar crystals and ice. Center the empty transparent glass cup at the bottom and suspend each component above it in a clean vertical alignment with clear spacing: garnish or powder at the top, toppings and cream in separate layers, the liquid beverage in the middle, ice or inclusions below, and the cup at the bottom. Use a near-black graphite-to-charcoal studio background with controlled studio lighting and soft layered shadows under every component. Show thin guide lines and concise English labels on the right, with no invented brand, logo or extra text. Use ultra-sharp macro realism, accurate glass reflections, appetizing material detail, restrained premium product design and balanced negative space. No people, hands, watermark, clutter or malformed objects.
items.prompt_zh: 为含可可粉、巧克力酱、打发奶油、烘焙咖啡豆、糖晶体与冰块的巧克力咖啡饮品制作一张写实的3:4竖版饮品爆炸分解信息图。底部放置空的透明玻璃杯，各组成部分沿中心垂直排列并保持清晰间距：顶部为装饰物或粉末，中间依次为配料、奶盖或奶油、饮品液体、冰块或内含物，杯子位于最底部。使用近黑色石墨至木炭色的影棚背景，配合受控影棚光和每层下方柔和清晰的分层阴影。右侧加入细指示线和简洁英文标签，不虚构品牌、logo或额外文字。呈现超锐利微距写实、准确玻璃反射、诱人的材质细节、克制的高级产品设计和均衡留白。不得出现人物、手部、水印、杂乱元素或畸形物体。

items.title: 治愈系手绘童书插画角色转换
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Use the single uploaded photo as the only visual reference. Transform the person into an adorable hand-drawn 2D children’s storybook character, while keeping their identity immediately recognizable.

Preserve exactly from the photo:
- Facial features and skin tone
- Real hairstyle, length, texture, and color
- Exact clothing, colors, patterns, and layering
- Glasses, jewelry, headwear, bags, and all visible accessories

Do not invent or copy hairstyles, outfits, accessories, braids, pigtails, bows, bonnets, or headscarves from any reference artwork.

### Character
Use an oversized rounded head, tiny compact body, short arms, narrow shoulders, soft rounded silhouette, and cute childlike proportions. Keep the head visually dominant. Avoid realistic anatomy.

### Face
Simplify into tiny dot/oval eyes, minimal nose, tiny smiling mouth, rounded cheeks, and soft peach/pink blush. Keep recognizable facial characteristics. No realistic eyes, detailed lips, anime features, glossy 3D rendering, or heavy shading.

### Hair & Clothing
Recreate the exact hairstyle and outfit from the uploaded photo, simplified into chunky hand-drawn shapes. Preserve important colors, patterns, jewelry, glasses, and other recognizable details.

### Style
Handmade 2D picture-book aesthetic using soft gouache, wax crayon, colored pencil, and dry pastel. Use slightly irregular dark-brown linework, subtle paper grain, uneven pigment, soft brush marks, and imperfect painted edges. Avoid clean vector art, CGI, anime, or photorealism.

### Composition
Square 1:1 portrait, chest/waist-up, centered and facing mostly forward, with balanced negative space. Use a relaxed, charming pose.

### Background
Simple warm mustard, butter yellow, ochre, or cream background with subtle paper texture. No scenery, objects, text, borders, or distractions.

Final feeling: the same person lovingly redrawn as an extremely cute, warm, wholesome, nostalgic, handcrafted children’s-book character—same identity, same hair, same clothes, same accessories, completely simplified and adorable.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

使用唯一上传的照片作为视觉参考。将人物转换为可爱的手绘2D儿童故事书角色，同时保持其身份特征能够被立即识别。

从照片中精确保留：
- 面部特征和肤色
- 真实的发型、长度、纹理和颜色
- 确切的服装、颜色、图案和分层
- 眼镜、首饰、头饰、包袋以及所有可见的配饰

不要从任何参考作品中虚构或复制发型、服饰、配件、辫子、双马尾、蝴蝶结、软帽或头巾。

### 角色
使用超大的圆头、极小的紧凑身材、短手臂、窄肩膀、柔和圆润的轮廓以及可爱的童稚比例。保持头部在视觉上占据主导地位。避免写实的人体解剖。

### 面部
简化为微小的点状/椭圆眼睛、极简的鼻子、微小的微笑嘴巴、圆润的双颊以及柔和的桃红色/粉色腮红。保留可识别的面部特征。不要使用写实的眼睛、细节丰富的嘴唇、动漫特征、光滑的3D渲染或厚重的阴影。

### 头发与服装
从上传的照片中重现确切的发型和装束，并将其简化为块状的手绘形状。保留重要的颜色、图案、首饰、眼镜和其他可识别的细节。

### 风格
使用柔和的水粉、蜡笔、彩色铅笔和干粉彩的纯手工2D绘本美学。使用略显不规则的深棕色线条、细腻的纸张纹理、不均匀的色素、柔和的笔触以及不完美的绘画边缘。避免干净的矢量艺术、CGI、动漫或写实主义。

### 构图
方形1:1肖像，身形/腰部以上，居中且主要面向前方，具有平衡的负空间。使用轻松、迷人的姿势。

### 背景
简单的暖芥末色、奶油黄、赭色或奶油色背景，带有细微的纸张纹理。无风景、物体、文字、边框或干扰项。

最终感受：同一个人被充满爱意地重绘为一个极其可爱、温暖、健康、怀旧的手工艺儿童书角色——相同的身份，相同的头发，相同的衣服，相同的配饰，完全简化且可爱。

items.title: 四种珍奇节肢动物宏观生物信息图
items.description: 一张16:9的2×2宏观生物信息图，每格分别展示孔雀跳蛛、兰花螳螂、蓝闪蝶和彩虹吉丁虫，并以解剖引线、能力与栖息地统计、显微细节和科幻实验室UI解释它们鲜艳外表下的捕食或防御适应。
items.prompt:
Create an ultra-clean modern macro-biology infographic on a 16:9 canvas divided into a clear 2x2 grid. The theme is four famous rare-looking arthropods whose predatory or defensive adaptations are more formidable than their colorful appearance suggests. Put exactly one hyper-detailed macro specimen in each cell, in this fixed reading order: top left, a peacock jumping spider, Maratus volans; top right, an orchid mantis, Hymenopus coronatus; bottom left, a blue morpho butterfly, Morpho menelaus; bottom right, a rainbow jewel beetle, Chrysochroa fulgidissima. Do not substitute generic bugs or repeat a species. Show every specimen as the hero visual in an angled three-quarter or slight 3D floating view, with realistic anatomy and striking iridescent natural color.

Around each specimen, build a compact but airy editorial information system. Use glowing vector leader lines to point to relevant anatomy, supported by small function illustrations or microscopic scan insets. For the peacock jumping spider, emphasize the principal eyes, chelicerae, and jumping legs; for the orchid mantis, the compound eyes, raptorial forelegs, and petal-like leg lobes; for the blue morpho, the iridescent wing scales, underside eyespots, and proboscis; for the rainbow jewel beetle, the armored elytra, compound eyes, and gripping legs. Arrange the callouts in a radial flow that visibly connects them to the correct specimen.

Add behavioral and habitat statistics around each hero using clean data graphs, numbered panels, progress bars, holographic bubbles, or badges. Compare only appropriate capabilities such as jump range and visual tracking for the spider, camouflage and strike speed for the mantis, flash coloration and evasive flight for the butterfly, and armor and flight performance for the beetle. Include habitat, lifespan, ecosystem role, and predator or prey relationships where useful. Frame danger as ecological predation or defense rather than claiming that every specimen is dangerous to humans. Add small leaf, web, sun, and moon icons where relevant, keeping a logical reading flow from specimen to anatomy to abilities and habitat.

Combine National Geographic-style macro photography with a polished sci-fi bio-lab interface. Use vibrant iridescent specimen colors, subtle bioluminescent drop shadows, crisp neon-cyan or bio-lab-green vector lines, modern typography, dark frosted-glass data panels, and a deep forest-green-to-black minimal textured gradient background. Light each specimen with cinematic rim light and controlled macro highlights while retaining believable material texture and legibility. Preserve generous negative space and a clear hierarchy: specimen first, anatomy second, statistics third. Keep all four cells visually related but individually readable.

Set the overall title exactly as “MORE DANGEROUS THAN THEY LOOK”. Label the four cells with the exact common names and scientific names “PEACOCK JUMPING SPIDER — MARATUS VOLANS”, “ORCHID MANTIS — HYMENOPUS CORONATUS”, “BLUE MORPHO BUTTERFLY — MORPHO MENELAUS”, and “RAINBOW JEWEL BEETLE — CHRYSOCHROA FULGIDISSIMA”. Use the recurring section labels “ANATOMY”, “ABILITY”, and “HABITAT”. Render the typography sharply and correctly. Finish as an ultra-crisp premium laboratory infographic optimized for a social feed. No people, human faces, identity reference, watermark, signature, unrelated logo, unrelated text, malformed anatomy, duplicated specimen, or cluttered unreadable data.
items.prompt_zh:
在16:9画布上创作一张超清现代宏观生物学信息图，并明确分成2×2网格。主题是四种著名且外观稀有的节肢动物，它们的捕食或防御适应比鲜艳外表所暗示的更强。每格只放一种细节极丰富的宏观标本，并固定按阅读顺序排列：左上为孔雀跳蛛 Maratus volans，右上为兰花螳螂 Hymenopus coronatus，左下为蓝闪蝶 Morpho menelaus，右下为彩虹吉丁虫 Chrysochroa fulgidissima。不得替换成泛称虫子，也不得重复物种。每个标本都是该格核心视觉，以倾斜三分之四视角或轻微3D漂浮视角呈现，解剖结构真实，天然虹彩鲜明醒目。

在每个标本周围建立紧凑但通透的编辑信息系统。用发光矢量引线指向相关解剖部位，并配合小型功能插图或显微扫描嵌图。孔雀跳蛛突出主眼、大颚和跳跃足；兰花螳螂突出复眼、捕捉足和花瓣状足叶；蓝闪蝶突出虹彩翅鳞、翅背眼斑和喙管；彩虹吉丁虫突出坚硬鞘翅、复眼和抓握足。标注围绕主体形成放射状信息流，并清楚连接到正确标本。

在各核心标本周围用干净的数据图表、编号面板、进度条、全息气泡或徽章呈现行为与栖息地统计。只比较恰当的能力，例如跳蛛的跳跃距离与视觉追踪、螳螂的伪装与出击速度、蝴蝶的闪光色与规避飞行、吉丁虫的护甲与飞行表现。可补充栖息地、寿命、生态角色以及捕食者或猎物关系。将危险性限定为生态捕食或防御能力，不宣称每种标本都对人类危险。按需加入叶片、蛛网、太阳和月亮小图标，使阅读逻辑从标本依次流向解剖、能力和栖息地。

把《国家地理》式宏观摄影与精致的科幻生物实验室界面结合。使用鲜艳的虹彩标本色、微妙的生物发光投影、清晰的霓虹青色或实验室绿色矢量线、现代字体、深色磨砂玻璃数据面板，以及深森林绿到黑色的极简纹理渐变背景。每个标本以电影感轮廓光和受控的微距高光照亮，同时保留可信材质纹理与清晰可读性。保持充足留白和明确层级：标本第一、解剖第二、统计第三。四格视觉系统统一，同时各自易读。

总标题必须准确写为“MORE DANGEROUS THAN THEY LOOK”。四格使用准确的英文常用名和学名：“PEACOCK JUMPING SPIDER — MARATUS VOLANS”、“ORCHID MANTIS — HYMENOPUS CORONATUS”、“BLUE MORPHO BUTTERFLY — MORPHO MENELAUS”和“RAINBOW JEWEL BEETLE — CHRYSOCHROA FULGIDISSIMA”。重复使用栏目标签“ANATOMY”、“ABILITY”和“HABITAT”。文字必须锐利且拼写正确。最终呈现超清晰、高级实验室质感、适合社交媒体信息流的成品。不要人物、人脸、身份参考、水印、签名、无关标志、无关文字、畸形解剖、重复标本或拥挤难读的数据。

items.title: VELCARA奢华珠宝石榴概念广告海报
items.description: VELCARA 高级珠宝静物广告：完整深红石榴作为雕塑底座，18K 黄金多吊坠手链沿果实形成加冕弧线，中央马眼形水晶为视觉锚点，配合深石榴红至黑色背景、微距珠宝光效和克制英文排版。
items.prompt:
Create a luxury flagship advertising poster for the original fine-jewelry brand VELCARA. Preserve an iconic dark still-life structure: one whole mature pomegranate centered in the lower-middle as a sculptural pedestal; one exquisite yellow-gold charm bracelet draped across its upper front in a graceful horizontal arc; a refined English headline centered above; and a slim premium feature strip along the bottom. Use a deep garnet-to-black gradient background with cinematic depth. The campaign must feel minimal, sensual, commanding, symbolic, and instantly memorable, with the bracelet as the absolute commercial focus.

Style: ultra-realistic luxury-jewelry macro photography, dark editorial still life, premium fashion-house campaign design, refined negative space, high-end print sharpness, rich romantic restraint, and a clear product-led hierarchy.

Place the pomegranate large enough to read as a monumental jewel altar without overwhelming the bracelet. Let the chain follow the fruit's natural curvature from left to right like a coronation band. Suspend six or seven clearly separated charms with varied silhouettes, including pear drops, medallions, celestial motifs, and one elongated marquise-cut crystal hanging lowest at the exact center. Keep attachment points and spacing physically credible. Preserve generous negative space around the centered headline, and make the bottom strip thin, elegant, and subordinate.

Build a clear semicircular eye path: headline to pomegranate crown, along the bracelet from left charms through the central marquise pendant to the right charms, down to the bottom strip, then back upward through the fruit's round silhouette. Use chain curvature, charm spacing, highlight rhythm, and fruit volume to make this orbit controlled and inevitable. The single crimson pomegranate wearing the gold bracelet must become VELCARA's ownable super-symbol: a crowned relic whose dark red mass and luminous gold arc remain recognizable at thumbnail size.

Use soft upper-front-left studio light, subtle right fill, and delicate rim separation. Create smooth highlight rolloff on the fruit, rich micro-specular glints on the gold links, and crisp premium sparkle in the crystals. Keep shadows feathered and clean, without dead black patches or muddy transitions.

Render the pomegranate with taut leathery texture, natural pores, slight dryness, detailed crown, organic mottling, crimson-to-wine variation, and irregular believable sheen. 风格为超写实奢侈珠宝微距摄影、暗色编辑静物、高端时装屋广告设计、精致负空间、高级印刷锐度、浓郁而克制的浪漫气质，以及清晰的产品主导层级。

建立清晰的半圆视线路径：从标题落到石榴顶冠，沿手链由左侧吊坠经过中央马眼形吊坠到右侧吊坠，再落到底部条带，最后借石榴圆形轮廓返回上方。以链条曲率、吊坠间距、高光节奏和水果体积形成受控而自然的循环。佩戴黄金手链的深红石榴必须成为 VELCARA 独有的超级符号，如一件被加冕的圣物；缩略图尺寸下仍能辨认深红体量和发光金色弧线。

石榴需呈现紧致皮革般表皮、自然毛孔、轻微干燥、清楚顶冠、有机斑驳、深红至酒红变化和可信的不规则光泽。手链为抛光 18K 黄金，具有真实重量、精确链节、牢固吊坠连接和精致手工饰面；水晶反射、透明度和亮度符合真实物理。

色板以深石榴红、勃艮第红、黑化酒红和深樱桃阴影为主，以浓郁黄金、古董琥珀和低调青铜暖色为辅，以清透水晶白和柔和香槟高光点缀。整体暗、庄严、温暖、克制，让珠宝成为最明亮的视觉标点。

只使用原创英文排版。上方中央标题固定为“CROWN THE RARE”，底部条带固定为“FINE CHARMS  •  18K GOLD  •  HAND-FINISHED”，并让原创品牌名 VELCARA 清晰可读。字体需优雅、极简、适合全球市场并融入海报；不得复制现有品牌、口号或广告版式。

不要额外道具、切开的水果、果汁、飞溅或杂乱。画面应唤起丰盈、加冕、稀有和神圣装饰感。最终达到超细节奢侈印刷质感、微距级珠宝锐度、无瑕黄金、真实水晶火彩、统一光照物理、优雅色调纵深和强烈符号识别。避免手链不突出、石榴过大、黄金暗淡、水晶塑料感、链条模糊、吊坠间距破碎、吊坠扭曲、反射不一致、文字难读、背景浑浊、死黑斑块、低清细节、复制文案或廉价电商风。不要无关文字、标志、签名或水印。

使用24mm全画幅广角镜头，从极近的低角度（大约膝盖高度）捕捉场景，并略微向上倾斜，以创造戏剧性的透视感和身临其境的场所感。保持主体完美居中，同时保持自然的解剖结构和写实的比例。

明亮的自然午后阳光，清脆写实的阴影，头发上的微妙轮廓光，鲜艳而自然的色彩，电影感旅行摄影，真实的纪实氛围，时尚社论美学，超写实的皮肤纹理，写实的毛孔，细致的织物和服装，符合物理规律的精准光照，自然的头发丝，真实的材料，受Leica Q3启发的摄影特性，HDR，极锐利的主体对焦，柔和的景深，高级旅行美学，照片级真实，超细节，UHD 8K。

地点、建筑、街道细节、标识和周围环境应自然适应所选的城市或国家，同时保留相同的构图、姿势、蝴蝶概念、视觉风格和摄影质量。不出现人工感的面部、扭曲的解剖结构、多余的手指、重复的肢体、变形的建筑、塑料感的皮肤、过度修饰或卡通化的主体渲染。

items.prompt:

Her left arm rests horizontally on the counter and her right hand supports her cheek, with fingers naturally near the ear and jaw. She wears a white thin-strap ribbed camisole under a dark gray cotton-linen apron with wide neck straps, realistic wrinkles, stitching, and slight wear. In the foreground, place a white ceramic bowl containing green grapes and one deep red apple on the island.

Use a tidy but lived-in modern white kitchen with pale gray cabinets, a microwave, small counter items, and a softly blurred green plant. Soft daylight enters diagonally from the front right, creating gentle directional shadows and natural counter projections. Use low saturation, low contrast, balanced warm-cool tones, Japanese lifestyle-magazine and film-still texture, 50mm lens, f/2.2, slightly high eye-level camera, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on both eyes, subtle ISO 200 grain, and realistic pores, hair, cotton-linen, stone, and fruit texture. Ultra-realistic oriental ancient style cinematic portrait, a young adult East Asian woman standing alone in a deep and damp primeval forest canyon, the environment surrounded by dense green vegetation, mossy rock walls, ferns, and moist trees, the overall sense being mysterious, quiet, and like a Xianxia movie.

The character is about 20–25 years old, East Asian female, slim and natural figure, oval face, small and soft face shape, clean jawline, exquisite but real features, light and natural makeup, fair skin tone leaning warm, retaining real skin texture and slight pores, eyes quiet, alert, with a slight sense of detachment.

Long black hair tied into a loose ancient-style bun, fixed horizontally with a simple wooden hairpin at the back of the head, the bun is not neat, with a natural messy feeling. Several strands of slightly curled wet hair fall in front of the forehead and on both sides, some strands close to the cheeks and ears, creating a realistic state after just passing through a damp forest and stream.

The character wears loose off-white, light linen-colored ancient-style robes, the fabric has a coarse-spun linen or natural linen texture, the color is naturally distressed, not pure white, not gorgeous. The garment structure is simple, wide sleeves, cross-collar or naturally open layered neckline, the fabric is soft, with slight wrinkles and a sense of moisture, overall like an oriental swordswoman or practitioner secluded in the mountains and forests.

The camera position is behind the character and slightly to the left, the character's body faces away from the camera by about two-thirds, then turns back to look at the camera, the face forming a clear profile plus looking-back composition. The character is located in the right third of the frame, the head and shoulders are the visual focus, and the body naturally extends to the lower right.

Use approximately 50mm to 85mm cinematic portrait lens, medium-close shot composition, shallow depth of field, background highly blurred but still recognizable as forest, rock walls, ferns, and canyon space.

There are large patches of dark green mossy rocks and blurred branches on the left and right sides of the foreground, forming a natural framing, making the character look surrounded by the forest.

Above the center of the background, a strong but soft natural sunlight shines diagonally down from the gaps in the canopy, forming obvious volumetric light beams and Tyndall effect, with fine dust, water vapor, petals, or leaf debris floating in the air, illuminated by the light.

Light shines from the upper left rear of the character, forming beautiful hair rim light, highlights on the side of the ear, and a warm-colored halo on the edge of the cheek.

Most of the character's face is in soft shadow, with local natural highlights only forming near the eyes, bridge of the nose, cheeks, and lips.

The overall background is dark green, ink green, moss green, and black-green, while the character's clothing is warm off-white, forming a strong but high-end contrast between light and dark, cold and warm.

The image has a real cinematic lens texture, slight air mist, forest moisture, soft highlights, dark shadows, low-saturation green tones, and local warm golden sunlight.

The composition is quiet, restrained, mysterious, not posed, doesn't look like a studio ancient costume photo, but like a frame from a real movie.

人物约20–25岁，东亚女性，身材纤细自然，鹅蛋脸，脸型小巧柔和，下颌线干净，五官精致但真实，浅淡自然妆容，肤色白皙偏暖，保留真实皮肤纹理和轻微毛孔，眼神安静、警觉、略带疏离感。

背景中央上方有一道强烈但柔和的自然阳光从树冠缝隙斜射下来，形成明显体积光束和丁达尔光，空气中漂浮细小灰尘、水汽、花瓣或树叶碎屑，被光线照亮。

Create an ultra-photorealistic LIVE-ACTION iPhone 17 Pro vertical 4:5 indoor fashion gravure-style snapshot of the same clearly ADULT Japanese woman in her 20s sitting cross-legged on a light wooden floor inside a bright, elegant cream-and-white apartment.

SUBJECT / FACE / HAIR

* airy wispy see-through bangs
* long face-framing strands around both cheeks
* small ivory / pale cream bow hair clip on one side

CAMERA / COMPOSITION

items.title: 高密度实验字体文化海报
items.description: 可执行的 9:16 实验字体文化海报模板：以默认字段解析主标题、主题、系列名、深色背景、单一强调色、点线机制、辅助文字和活动信息，形成密集而有秩序的编辑版式。
items.prompt:
Resolve the design fields first: Main Title = 动势文字 / KINETIC TYPE; Subject = 视觉文化 / VISUAL CULTURE; Series Name = 点・线・运动 / POINT / LINE / MOTION; Background Color = 深炭黑 / deep charcoal; Accent Color = 酸黄 / acid yellow; Point/Line Mechanism = 点阵 -> 弧线 -> 波线 -> 放射网格 / dot matrix -> arc -> wave -> radial grid; Secondary Text = 形态 / 信号 / 节奏 / FORM / SIGNAL / RHYTHM; Event Information = 2026 / 字体文化 / TYPE CULTURE / 09:16; Aspect Ratio = 9:16.

Design one complete high-density experimental typography culture poster in the resolved 9:16 format. Do not merely apply effects to ordinary fonts: reconstruct the resolved 动势文字 / KINETIC TYPE directly through the resolved 点阵 -> 弧线 -> 波线 -> 放射网格 / dot matrix -> arc -> wave -> radial grid, using related but changing dot, arc, wave, radial, and grid systems for different glyphs. The main title should occupy about 65-70% of the poster. Form glyphs through density, line spacing, curvature, compression, stretching, and partial disappearance; a small controlled sacrifice in readability is acceptable for stronger design impact.

Build a distinct hierarchy from the huge Chinese-and-English main title, large 视觉文化 / VISUAL CULTURE and 点・线・运动 / POINT / LINE / MOTION keywords, micro editorial text, and complete 2026 / 字体文化 / TYPE CULTURE / 09:16. Text at different scales must participate in the composition rather than act as explanatory labels. Use 深炭黑 / deep charcoal for the field, light primary graphics, and only the restrained local 酸黄 / acid yellow for nodes and keywords.

Create a complete editorial information area at the bottom with varied column widths, slight misalignment, partial vertical layout, and dividers of different lengths. Avoid a balanced four-column grid, PPT layout, or UI-card feel. The result must be dense but orderly, with continuous point-and-line movement, rich text hierarchy, distant impact, and close-up detail. Do not add photography, people, 3D, neon, random gibberish, QR codes, watermarks, four-pointed stars, or frame numbering. Output exactly one complete poster.
items.prompt_zh:
先解析设计字段：主标题 = 动势文字 / KINETIC TYPE；主题 = 视觉文化 / VISUAL CULTURE；系列名 = 点・线・运动 / POINT / LINE / MOTION；背景色 = 深炭黑 / deep charcoal；强调色 = 酸黄 / acid yellow；点线机制 = 点阵 -> 弧线 -> 波线 -> 放射网格 / dot matrix -> arc -> wave -> radial grid；辅助文字 = 形态 / 信号 / 节奏 / FORM / SIGNAL / RHYTHM；活动信息 = 2026 / 字体文化 / TYPE CULTURE / 09:16；画幅比例 = 9:16。

设计一张完整的高密度实验字体文化海报，使用解析后的 9:16 比例。不要只给普通字体添加效果，而要直接使用解析后的 点阵 -> 弧线 -> 波线 -> 放射网格 / dot matrix -> arc -> wave -> radial grid 重构解析后的 动势文字 / KINETIC TYPE，让不同字形分别使用相关但持续变化的点阵、弧线、波线、放射线和网格系统。主标题约占海报 65% 至 70%，通过密度、字距、曲率、压缩、拉伸和局部消失形成字形；允许为更强的设计冲击力而适度牺牲少量可读性。

建立清晰的多层 Typography 层级：巨大的中英文主标题、大号 视觉文化 / VISUAL CULTURE 与 点・线・运动 / POINT / LINE / MOTION 关键词、微型编辑文字，以及完整的 2026 / 字体文化 / TYPE CULTURE / 09:16。不同尺度的文字必须真正参与构图，而不是只作为解释标签。使用 深炭黑 / deep charcoal 作为底色和浅色主图形，只用克制的 酸黄 / acid yellow 点缀局部节点与关键词。

在底部建立完整的编辑式信息区，使用不同栏宽、轻微错位、局部竖排和长度不一的分隔线，避免平衡的四栏、PPT 或 UI 卡片感。最终画面要密集但有秩序，点线运动连续，文字层级丰富，远看有冲击力，近看有细节。不要加入摄影、人物、3D、霓虹、随机乱码、二维码、水印、四角星、边框编号。只输出一张完整海报。

items.title: 超广角强迫透视写实人像提示词
items.description: 以成年参考人物为主体，在城市篮球场完成低机位 0.5× 超广角互动人像；默认使用白色运动夹克、前伸球鞋和日光场景。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the single main visible person. Create a photorealistic 0.5x ultra-wide vertical 9:16 portrait with strong but believable forced perspective.

Subject: an adult East Asian woman with long dark hair and natural makeup. Outfit: a white athletic jacket, black tapered track pants, and clean white sneakers. Scene: an outdoor urban basketball court with painted lines, railings, and mid-rise architecture. Foreground element: one white sneaker extended toward the lens. Pose: leaning forward in a dynamic step, one arm reaching toward the camera. Lighting: bright natural daylight with soft directional shadow. Mood: playful, sporty, and cinematic.

Place the camera very low and close to the ground. Make the foreground element dramatically enlarged while keeping the adult subject's face clear and near the center, with realistic depth from the foreground to the face, body, court lines, railings, and background architecture. Preserve natural skin texture, hair movement, accurate fabric folds, believable perspective, and coherent anatomy.

Show only one clearly adult person. Avoid extra fingers, distorted hands, warped facial features, duplicated limbs, plastic skin, stiff posing, text, logos, and illustration or CG styling.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的参考图作为画面中唯一主要人物的面部身份依据。创建一张写实的 0.5× 超广角竖版 9:16 人像，具有强烈但可信的强迫透视效果。

主体：一位留着深色长发、妆容自然的成年东亚女性。服装：白色运动夹克、黑色收口运动裤和干净的白色运动鞋。场景：带有彩色场地线、栏杆和中层建筑的城市户外篮球场。前景元素：一只伸向镜头的白色运动鞋。姿势：以动态迈步姿势向前倾身，一只手伸向镜头。光照：明亮的自然日光与柔和的方向性阴影。情绪：俏皮、运动感和电影感。

将相机放在非常低且靠近地面的位置，使前景元素戏剧性放大，同时保持成年主体的面部清晰并靠近画面中央。从前景到面部、身体、球场线、栏杆和背景建筑建立真实的空间深度。保留自然皮肤纹理、头发运动、准确的面料褶皱、可信的透视和连贯的人体结构。

画面中只能有一位明确成年的主体。避免多余手指、扭曲的手、变形五官、重复肢体、塑料皮肤、僵硬姿势、文字、标志以及插画或 CG 风格。

items.title: 日漫与真人写实分屏对比
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Positive Prompt

9:16 vertical version, top and bottom split-screen contrast composition, the upper part is classic Japanese detective anime style, the lower part is real-life realistic version, a comparison image of the same character, same pose, and same scene between 2D and 3D.

Upper part:
A young adult female, long straight black hair, fragmented bangs on the forehead, cold and elegant features, serious and restrained expression, slightly bowing her head to read a book, wearing a dark blue suit jacket, a light blue shirt inside, holding a black hardcover book with both hands, standing in an indoor position against a wall, the background is an off-white wall and a dark wood door frame, overall classic 90s Japanese detective animation style, clean and sharp lines, cel shading, sharp facial contours, long and narrow spirited eyes, restrained colors, stable composition, half-body portrait.

Lower part:
The real-life realistic version of the same character, a young adult Asian female, long black hair, light bangs, exquisite and three-dimensional features, fair and delicate skin, calm and focused eyes, serious expression, wearing a dark blue suit jacket and a light blue shirt, holding the same black book with both hands, the pose is consistent with the anime image above, standing in the same indoor scene, the background is also an off-white wall and a dark wood door, soft natural light, cinematic realistic photography, clear details, realistic hair strands, transparent skin texture, overall strong sense of high quality, half-body composition.

Overall requirements:
The character's actions, clothing, camera angles, and background layout of the upper and lower parts are highly unified, forming a strong contrast effect of "anime version vs. live-action version"; the screen is clean, high-end, and has a strong sense of reality; top is anime, bottom is live-action; no extra decorations, no subtitles, no progress bars, no watermarks.

---

Simplified Version Prompt

9:16 vertical version, top and bottom split screen, top is classic Japanese detective anime style, bottom is real-life realistic style, the same black-haired adult female, wearing a dark blue suit and light blue shirt, holding a black book reading, indoor off-white wall and dark wood door background, half-body composition, upper and lower character poses, clothing, and scenes completely correspond, forming a comparison effect between anime and live-action versions, clean image, cinematic, high-definition details, no subtitles, no watermarks.

---

Negative Prompt

Low resolution, blurry, deformed hands, extra fingers, collapsed facial features, perspective errors, cluttered background, disordered clothing, mismatched character age, childish feel, cartoonish exaggerated expressions, excessive skin smoothing, plastic skin, low-quality light and shadow, subtitles, watermarks, player progress bars, cluttered borders, inconsistent character poses, inconsistent content between upper and lower split screens
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

正向提示词

9:16竖版，上下分屏对比构图，上半部分是经典日系侦探动漫风，下半部分是真人写实版，同一人物、同一姿势、同一场景的二次元与三次元对照图。

上半部分：
一位年轻成年女性，黑色长直发，额前碎刘海，五官冷艳，神情严肃克制，微微低头看书，穿深蓝色西装外套，内搭浅蓝色衬衫，双手拿着一本黑色硬壳书本，站在室内靠墙位置，背景是米白色墙面和深色木质门框，整体为90年代经典日漫侦探动画画风，线条干净利落，赛璐璐上色，面部轮廓锐利，眼睛细长有神，色彩克制，构图稳定，半身像。

下半部分：
同一人物的真人写实版本，年轻成年亚洲女性，黑色长发，轻薄刘海，五官精致立体，皮肤白皙细腻，眼神冷静专注，神情认真，穿深蓝色西装外套和浅蓝色衬衫，双手拿着同一本黑色书本，姿势与上方动漫图保持一致，站在相同的室内场景中，背景同样是米白色墙面与深色木门，柔和自然光，电影感写实摄影，细节清晰，发丝真实，肤质通透，整体高级感强，半身构图。

整体要求：
上下两部分人物动作、服装、镜头角度、背景布局高度统一，形成“动漫版 vs 真人版”的强对比效果；画面干净，高级，真实感强；上方动漫、下方真人；无多余装饰，无字幕，无进度条，无水印。

⸻

精简版提示词

9:16竖版，上下分屏，上方经典日系侦探动漫风，下方真人写实风，同一位黑长发成年女性，穿深蓝色西装和浅蓝衬衫，手持黑色书本阅读，室内米白墙面与深色木门背景，半身构图，上下人物姿势、服装、场景完全对应，形成动漫与真人版对照效果，画面干净，电影感，高清细节，无字幕无水印。

⸻

反向提示词

低清晰度，模糊，畸形手部，多余手指，五官崩坏，透视错误，背景杂乱，服装错乱，人物年龄不符，儿童感，卡通夸张表情，过度磨皮，塑料皮肤，低质感光影，字幕，水印，播放器进度条，边框杂乱，人物姿势不一致，上下分屏内容不统一

items.title: 手绘旅行手帐立体水彩插画
items.description: 以护照页、立体纸艺地标和旅行物件构成的可复用手工旅行手帐水彩插画模板。
items.prompt:
Create an open travel journal for “Kyoto” on a textured tabletop as a handcrafted 3D pop-up watercolor illustration. Include a passport page carrying “KYOTO / 2026”, plus layered paper-and-watercolor scenes of “a red torii gate and a hillside temple”, “wooden machiya houses”, “maple trees and a quiet river”, and “small festival figures and lanterns”. Add the main header “旅途有光”, subtitle “A Quiet Walk Through Kyoto”, and a few vintage cultural icons around the journal header. Arrange “a vintage boarding pass”, “a compact film camera”, “a small olive suitcase”, “pressed maple leaves”, and “a ceramic charm and woven fan” around the open journal as travel objects.

Keep the warmth of a handmade travel scrapbook: rich yet transparent watercolor, delicate ink lines, visible paper texture, soft contact shadows, paper-layer edges, and believable folded pop-up depth. Clearly separate the passport, terrain, architecture, plants, cultural details, and surrounding objects into readable layers, creating a nostalgic and elegant travel story. Text should be accurate, sparse, and hierarchically designed, with no random gibberish, invented brands, or author information. Do not turn it into a flat map, glossy CGI, ordinary photograph, cartoon sticker, or cluttered collage.
items.prompt_zh:
在有纹理的桌面上创作一本打开的“Kyoto”旅行手帐立体水彩插画。画面包含一页带“KYOTO / 2026”的护照，以及展示“a red torii gate and a hillside temple”、“wooden machiya houses”、“maple trees and a quiet river”和“small festival figures and lanterns”的分层 3D 立体纸艺水彩场景。页眉加入主标题“旅途有光”、副标题“A Quiet Walk Through Kyoto”和少量复古文化图标。手帐四周摆放“a vintage boarding pass”、“a compact film camera”、“a small olive suitcase”、“pressed maple leaves”和“a ceramic charm and woven fan”作为旅行物件。

保持手工旅行剪贴簿的温度：浓郁但透明的水彩、细腻墨线、可辨认的纸张纹理、柔和接触阴影、纸层边缘和真实立体折叠深度。让护照页、立体地貌、建筑、植物、文化细节和周围物件清晰分层，形成怀旧、优雅且可读的旅行故事。文字应准确、少量、有设计层级，不出现随机乱码、虚构品牌或作者信息。不要把画面做成平面地图、光滑 CGI、普通照片、卡通贴纸或复杂拼贴。

items.prompt: Create a vertical 3:4 commercial campaign poster for a fictional premium fruit beverage brand. Brand: AUREL FRESH PRESS. Product: Citrus Bloom Cold Press. Main word: BLOOM. Tagline: Freshness in Layers. Palette: citrus yellow, ivory and leaf green. Model: an adult woman in a clean contemporary editorial outfit. Key features: cold-pressed / real fruit / lightly sweetened / chilled freshness. Use oversized bold typography with a strong one-point or diagonal perspective. Integrate the main word into the scene as a giant wall, corridor, street, stage or spatial structure, with clear depth and readable letterforms. Place the adult character near center holding the product and extending that hand toward camera for an exaggerated foreground and strong 3D wide-angle effect. The product is the closest, largest and sharpest element, the adult character is midground, and giant typography is background. Keep product shape accurate, realistic and clearly branded; use controlled condensation, ice, bubbles, fruit, sauce, steam or packaging details. Include brand name, feature icons, vertical side text, campaign number, release date, product details, barcode and micro typography, distributed across lower corners and side margins without a thick footer covering the character. High-resolution commercial photography, realistic skin and materials, dynamic pose, polished brand design and high visual impact. No nudity, sexualized pose, extra people, malformed hands, watermark or unrelated logos.

items.title: 夏日鲜果茶手持广告视觉
items.description: A bright 3:4 fruit-tea advertisement using open-sky negative space, a small hand-held drink, white typography and restrained iconography.
items.prompt:
Create a bright 3:4 vertical advertising visual for a clear cup of fresh citrus fruit tea, a summer fruit-tea takeaway drink. Let a large area of clean open sky occupy the main space, with high brightness, medium-high saturation, slight natural grain and soft distant cloud shadows. Keep scenery minimal and airy. Place the small physical drink precisely on a real palm or theme-appropriate supporting surface in the lower middle, extending from one side to form a stable horizontal line. Sunlight illuminates the top of the cup and leaves a clear shadow beneath it. Make the solemn act of holding up the drink the first-glance memory; keep the object small rather than turning it into a conventional product poster.

Use high-contrast pure-white typography without boxes on the sky: a large geometric sans-serif English or theme title at upper left, a heavier Chinese theme name below enclosed by oversized parenthesis-like arcs, one line of tiny auxiliary text above, and only three small relevant information points at the bottom. On the right, add three vertical sets of thin circular line icons with short labels; keep all lines white, simple and restrained. Add a small circle-arrow direction symbol at lower left.

Theme name: SUMMER FRUIT TEA. Background color: bright citrus yellow. Information points: fresh-brewed tea / real fruit / lightly sweetened. Derive the freshest bright color from the fruit tea for the background; use white for type and icons, and only a small amount of intrinsic drink or label color for identification. Preserve natural warmth in the supporting palm and realistic drink texture. Sunny, hygienic, light and direct, with clean sharp edges and real-shot texture. Avoid complex scenery, oversized product treatment, crowded text, decorative stacking, text boxes, cold mood, logos and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
生成一张 3:4 竖版明亮广告视觉，主题为一杯清透鲜果茶夏日鲜果茶外带饮品。让大面积干净开阔的天空占据主要空间，保持高亮度、中高饱和度、轻微自然颗粒与柔和远处云影，背景简洁通透，不加入复杂场景。将小型真实饮品精准放在画面下方中部的真实手掌或符合主题的承托表面上，承托面从一侧延伸形成稳定水平线。阳光照亮杯顶，并在手部下缘留下清晰阴影。让“庄重举起饮品”的动作成为第一眼记忆；饮品保持小巧，不要放大成普通产品海报。

在天空上使用无底框、高对比纯白文字：左上放大型几何无衬线英文或主题标题，下方放较重的中文主题名，两侧用超大的括号式弧线围合；上方叠一行极小辅助外文，底部只保留三条相关信息点。右侧加入三组纵向排列的细线圆形图标与短标签，线条统一为白色、简洁克制。左下加入小型圆圈箭头方向符号。

主题名：夏日鲜果茶。背景色：明亮柑橘黄。信息点：鲜煮茶底 / 真实水果 / 低甜配方。从鲜果茶中提取最新鲜明亮的颜色作为背景，文字与图标使用白色，只用少量饮品本色或标签色完成识别。承托手掌保持自然暖感，饮品纹理真实。整体阳光、卫生、轻盈、直接，边缘清晰，具有真实拍摄质感。避免复杂背景、放大产品、文字拥挤、装饰堆叠、文字框、冷漠氛围、logo与水印。

items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create an ultra-detailed macro poster built around one fixed iconic visual system: a neon-lit pollinating insect suspended over a saturated flower core, a giant white condensed title embedded behind the subject, and a deep cobalt-to-ultraviolet background with soft floral bokeh. Use premium commercial macro-photography aesthetics with extreme micro-texture detail, controlled high saturation, and sharp editorial poster hierarchy.

Core composition:
vertical poster layout, one bee-like pollinator positioned slightly above the flower center, body angled diagonally from upper-left toward lower-right, legs gripping the stamens, wings partially open. A large five-petal magenta-violet flower occupies the lower-middle and central frame. One oversized blurred petal mass enters from the lower-right foreground, and one soft out-of-focus bloom enters from the upper-left background. The insect and flower core remain the sharp focal zone. Place one huge condensed white uppercase headline across the upper-middle to center background, partially obscured by the insect and flower, functioning as a structural design block.

Port logic:
turn this composition into the unmistakable super-symbol of the poster series. The permanent identity must be built from four fixed codes: one hyper-detailed pollinating insect, one glowing central flower core, one giant white title block behind the subject, and one deep blue-violet macro background with soft floral blur. The image should feel instantly ownable, repeatable, and scalable across a full visual series by changing only the insect species and flower type.

Orbit logic:
build a strong closed visual loop across the poster. The eye should move from the giant white headline into the insect head and antennae, travel across the luminous thorax fur and front legs, drop into the pollen-rich flower center, sweep across the lower petals and foreground blur, then rise back through the insect wing and body contour into the title block again. The antennae, leg placement, pollen dust, stamen direction, wing angle, and petal framing must all reinforce one continuous circulation path.

Typography structure:
retain text as a compositional object, not as editorial article text. Use original wording only.
Main title:
WILD SIGNAL
Top small line:
VISUAL FIELD STUDY
Side micro lines:
COLOR / POLLEN / IMPACT
Bottom-left small block:
EDITORIAL OBJECT 07
All text must feel bold, white, condensed, and integrated behind the subject.

Subject design:
use a bee-like pollinator with dense visible thorax fur, segmented abdomen, iridescent cyan-blue and warm amber transitions across the body, translucent pink-lilac wings, articulated legs coated with pollen grains, sharply defined antennae, glossy compound eyes, and visible mouthparts contacting the flower center. The anatomy must remain biologically coherent and physically believable.

Flower design:
use one five-petal blossom in saturated pink-violet with a dense central stamen cluster in hot orange-yellow. Petal surfaces should show powdery pollen dust, subtle translucency at thinner edges, fine veining, and tiny reflective particles. The flower must visually anchor the lower half of the poster.

Lighting:
soft but directional macro lighting from upper-left front, with strong chromatic separation. Main highlights should strike the insect thorax, eye edge, antennae, wing membrane, and upper petals. Add a secondary cool fill from the right to preserve blue-violet shadow information. Maintain readable shadows, high luminous contrast, and no crushed blacks.

Color system:
dominant deep electric blue and ultraviolet background, saturated magenta-violet petals, hot yellow-orange pollen, cyan-blue reflective accents on the insect, and pure white typography. Maintain strong warm-cool separation and high saturation without muddy blending.

Materials and texture:
extreme macro detail on insect fur, pollen grains, wing veins, petal dust, flower filaments, and micro-reflections. Preserve realistic subsurface scattering in petals, translucent wing physics, and granular pollen buildup on legs and flower center. Everything must obey real optical macro-photography behavior.

Depth of field:
very shallow macro depth of field. The insect head, thorax, front legs, and central stamens must be critically sharp. Foreground petals, background petals, and outer wing edges should soften progressively with premium optical falloff.

Style and rendering:
hyper-real macro photography fused with bold editorial poster graphics, neon botanical design language, premium poster finish, no flat illustration, no cartoon simplification, no low-detail CGI look. Keep the image dense, sharp, luminous, and tightly controlled.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创建一个围绕一个固定的标志性视觉系统构建的超详细微距海报：一个悬浮在饱和花芯上方的霓虹照明传粉昆虫，一个嵌入在主体后面的巨型白色紧致标题，以及一个带有柔和花卉虚化的深钴蓝色至紫外线背景。使用具有极端微观纹理细节、受控的高饱和度和锐利编辑海报层级的优质商业微距摄影美学。

核心构图：
垂直海报布局，一只类似蜜蜂的传粉者位于花朵中心略上方，身体从左上向右下呈对角线倾斜，腿部抓握雄蕊，翅膀部分张开。一朵巨大的五瓣品红紫色花朵占据中下部及中心框架。一团超大的模糊花瓣从右下角前景进入，一朵柔和的失焦花卉从左上角背景进入。昆虫和花芯保持锐利的焦点区域。在背景中上部至中心横放一个巨大的紧致白色大写标题，部分被昆虫和花朵遮挡，作为结构性设计块发挥作用。

接口逻辑：
将此构图转化为该海报系列中辨识度极高的超级符号。永久身份必须由四个固定代码构建：一只超详细的传粉昆虫，一个发光的中央花芯，一个位于主体后面的巨型白色标题块，以及一个带有柔和花卉模糊的深蓝紫色微距背景。图像应感觉立即可识别、可重复，并能通过仅更改昆虫种类和花卉类型在整个视觉系列中扩展。

轨道逻辑：
在海报上建立一个强大的封闭视觉循环。视线应从巨型白色标题移动到昆虫的头部和触角，穿过发光的身形细毛和前腿，落入富含花粉的花芯，扫过下方的花瓣和前景模糊，然后再次通过昆虫翅膀和身体轮廓升回标题块。触角、腿部摆放、花粉尘、雄蕊方向、翅膀角度和花瓣构图都必须强化一条连续的流通路径。

排版结构：
保留文本作为构图对象，而非编辑文章文本。仅使用原始措辞。
主标题：
WILD SIGNAL
顶部小字：
VISUAL FIELD STUDY
侧面微型行：
COLOR / POLLEN / IMPACT
左下角小块：
EDITORIAL OBJECT 07
所有文本必须感觉大胆、白色、紧致，并融合在主体之后。

主体设计：
使用一只具有密集可见身形细毛、分节腹部、遍布全身的虹彩青蓝色和温暖琥珀色过渡、半透明粉紫丁香色翅膀、涂有花粉粒的关节腿、定义清晰的触角、光滑复眼以及与花心接触的可见口器的类蜂传粉者。解剖结构必须保持生物学上的连贯性和物理上的可信度。

花卉设计：
使用一朵饱和粉紫色的五瓣花，中心有密集的橙黄色雄蕊群。花瓣表面应显示出粉状花粉尘、较薄边缘处微妙的半透明感、细致的脉络以及微小的反射颗粒。花朵必须在视觉上固定海报的下半部分。

光照：
来自左上前方的柔和但有方向性的微距照明，具有强烈的色彩分离。主要高光应击中昆虫身形、眼睛边缘、触角、翅膀薄膜和上部花瓣。从右侧添加辅助冷光填充，以保留蓝紫色阴影信息。保持可读的阴影、高亮度对比，且无死黑。

色彩系统：
主导的深电蓝和紫外线背景，饱和的品红紫色花瓣，亮黄橙色花粉，昆虫上的青蓝色反射亮点，以及纯白色排版。保持强烈的冷暖分离和高饱和度，无浑浊融合。

材料与纹理：
昆虫细毛、花粉粒、翅脉、花瓣尘、花丝和微反射上的极端微距细节。保留花瓣中真实的次表面散射、半透明的翅膀物理特性，以及腿部和花芯上的颗粒状花粉堆积。一切必须遵循真实的微距摄影光学行为。

景深：
极浅的微距景深。昆虫头部、身形、前腿和中央雄蕊必须极其锐利。前景花瓣、背景花瓣和翅膀外缘应随着优质的光学衰减逐渐柔化。

风格与渲染：
超现实微距摄影与大胆的编辑海报图形相结合，霓虹植物设计语言，优质海报质感，无扁平插画，无卡通简化，无低细节 CGI 外观。保持图像密集、锐利、明亮且受到严格控制。

背景：
深钴蓝色到紫色的渐变，仅带有柔和的抽象焦外散景和扩散的花卉模糊。无景观，无额外环境，无杂乱。

图像质量和物理约束：
8k 海报清晰度，极其锐利的焦点主体，干净的排版边缘，真实的昆虫解剖，真实的花粉行为，无额外的腿，无破损的翅膀，无浑浊的阴影，无黑斑，无难以阅读的文本块，无重复的花瓣，无随机碎屑，无水印。

负面提示词：
卡通昆虫，扁平插画，低细节细毛，断腿，多余的腿，融合肢体，扭曲的翅膀，浑浊的霓虹，死黑背景，难以阅读的标题，杂乱构图，虚弱的花芯，褪色的花粉，塑料花瓣纹理，低分辨率，水印，复制的文字。

上方场地的照明作为柔和的主光源。白色的冰面、青色和黄色的场地板、昏暗的观众席以及模糊的观众。均匀的场地照明使人物明亮，背景则柔和地变暗。

构图・镜头：
镜头焦点置于人物身上，将全身纳入画面，自然模糊背景。让人物在中央显得较大。2:3的纵向构图，从溜冰刀刃到高高举起的鞋子，全身镜头不被裁切。人物置于中央，将伸展的手臂和高举的腿向画面左上方展开。从接近冰面高度的远摄视角压缩背景。

质感・风格：
照片级真实写实照片。竞赛照片般的高清写实风格。清晰保留冰面、白色鞋子、金线、透明面料、头发的动态。

负面提示：
不要让举起的鞋子和双手脱离接触；不要让腿的位置过低

items.title: 高级感建筑销售海报模型展示
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的虚构房地产品牌建筑销售海报提示词。保留 AERLITH HABITAT 品牌、桌面实体住宅模型、建筑图纸系统、技术覆盖图、垂直层级、灰褐背景和右上方斜射阳光。原文为非人物建筑展示，不需要人物身份参考。
items.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium architectural sales poster for a fictional real-estate brand called AERLITH HABITAT, combining more refined Transit polish with stronger Orbit generation flow. Vertical format, soft taupe-beige studio background, elegant diagonal sunlight from the upper-right, and one central tabletop concept presentation where an architectural maquette and white technical overlays become one unified product story. The image must feel like a flagship launch visual for a boutique residential project: calm, luxurious, intelligent, and globally editorial.

Main composition:
Keep a strict vertical hierarchy. In the lower-middle, place one exquisitely crafted physical house maquette on a square site plinth, with warm timber construction, pitched roof, fine glazing, and clean miniature landscape integration. In the upper half, float a sparse architectural drawing system: one floor plan, one small elevation or axonometric study, and a few elegant annotation clusters. Strengthen the Orbit direction by making the relationship between upper diagrams and lower model feel more actively connected, as if the concept above is descending and materializing into the maquette below. Use delicate white strategy lines, arrows, and environmental curves to visually bridge upper and lower zones with a more continuous generative flow.

Architecture:
Design a compact high-end retreat house or boutique nature residence with a steep double-pitched roof, warm timber structure, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and one cleanly articulated entry volume. The model must feel fully buildable and coherent. Around the lower model, include a few translucent abstract trees, tiny white scale figures, airflow and sunlight path arrows, and subtle topographic or water-path lines, all highly restrained and elegant.

Transit direction:
Make everything cleaner, lighter, and more internationally premium. Reduce annotation density, increase breathing room, soften any unnecessary visual noise, and keep typography and graphics more editorial than explanatory. The image should feel closer to a luxury architecture monograph cover or global real-estate launch poster than a technical board. The technical overlays must remain precise but visually airy.

Lighting:
Use soft natural directional light from the upper-right, with visible but restrained sunlight beams crossing the upper and middle area. Let the light create long elegant shadows over the table, subtle glow on the roof edges, and a precious warmth across the wooden model. Keep contrast sculptural but clean. The light should also reinforce the Orbit feeling, guiding the eye diagonally from the upper diagrams down into the physical model.

Material realism:
Render the maquette with exceptionally refined tactile detail: warm basswood or pale oak surfaces, crisp cut-card edges, thin acrylic glazing, subtle paper textures, matte site base, miniature landscaping, and a neat stack of wood or material samples at the lower-right edge of the table. The white overlay drawings must feel like fine architectural drafting, crisp and precise against the warm background.

Typography and branding:
Add one small original English project title in the upper-left, such as “SOLEN HAVEN,” with a tiny supporting subtitle and a few lines of refined architectural copy, all fully original. Keep all typography white, elegant, sparse, and secondary. Small original diagram labels may appear near the plan and environmental arrows, but they must remain minimal.

Graphic system:
Only white technical overlays: floor plan, tiny elevation/axon sketch, solar path icons, airflow arrows, circles, contour lines, and micro-annotations. Strengthen the sense that these graphics are not just hovering, but actively shaping and explaining the lower model. Keep them beautifully spaced and never cluttered.

Color system:
Warm taupe-beige background, honey wood tones, white drafting lines, pale translucent trees, soft gray shadows, and a subtle golden sunlight wash. Keep everything restrained, premium, and coherent.

Negative prompt:
no copied project title, no existing architect names, no Chinese title, no cluttered diagrams, no fantasy architecture, no distorted roof geometry, no messy material samples, no muddy shadows, no black blotches, no watermark, no existing logos, no noisy background, no random furniture clutter.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一个名为 AERLITH HABITAT 的虚构房地产品牌的超高级建筑销售海报，将更精致的 Transit 磨光效果与更强的 Orbit 生成流相结合。竖版格式，柔和的灰褐色工作室背景，来自右上方的优雅对角阳光，以及一个中央桌面概念展示，其中建筑模型和白色技术覆盖图融为一体，形成统一的产品故事。图像必须感觉像是一个精品住宅项目的旗舰发布视觉：宁静、奢华、智能且具有全球编辑感。

主要构图：
保持严格的垂直层级。在中下方，在一个方形场地底座上放置一个制作精美的实体房屋模型，采用温暖的木结构、坡屋顶、精美的玻璃窗和干净的小型景观融合。在上半部分，漂浮一个稀疏的建筑图纸系统：一个平面图，一个小型立面或轴测研究，以及一些优雅的注释簇。通过增强 Orbit 方向，让上方图表与下方模型之间的关系感觉更加活跃地连接，仿佛上方的概念正在下降并具象化为下方的模型。使用精致的白色策略线、箭头和环境曲线，以更连续的生成流在视觉上桥接上下区域。

建筑：
设计一个紧凑的高端避世住宅或精品自然住宅，拥有陡峭的双坡屋顶、温暖的木结构、落地玻璃窗和一个清晰表达的入口体量。模型必须感觉完全可建造且连贯。在下方模型周围，包括一些半透明的抽象树木、微小的白色比例人偶、气流和阳光路径箭头，以及微妙的地形或水路引导线，所有这些都高度克制且优雅。

Transit 方向：
让一切变得更干净、更轻盈、更具国际化高级感。减少注释密度，增加呼吸空间，弱化任何不必要的视觉噪音，让排版和图形更具编辑感而非解释性。图像感觉应该更接近豪华建筑专著封面或全球房地产发布海报，而不是技术板。技术覆盖层必须保持精确，但在视觉上显得轻盈。

光影：
使用来自右上方的柔和自然定向光，在上方和中部区域有可见但克制的阳光束穿过。让光线在桌面上创造出长而优雅的阴影，在屋顶边缘产生微妙的光泽，并在木制模型上散发出珍贵的温暖。保持对比的雕塑感但干净。光线还应强化 Orbit 感觉，引导视线从上方的图表对角线下移到实体模型。

材质真实感：
以极其精致的触感细节渲染模型：温暖的椴木或浅色橡木表面、干脆的切卡边缘、薄压克力玻璃、微妙的纸质纹理、哑光场地基座、微型景观，以及桌子右下角整齐堆放的木材或材料样本。白色覆盖图必须感觉像精美的建筑绘图，在温暖的背景下清晰而精准。

排版与品牌：
在左上方添加一个小的原创英文项目标题，例如“SOLEN HAVEN”，并配有微小的辅助副标题和几行精致的建筑文案，全部为原创。保持所有排版为白色、优雅、稀疏且处于次要地位。平面图和环境箭头附近可能会出现小的原创图表标签，但必须保持极简。

图形系统：
仅限白色技术覆盖图：平面图、微型立面/轴测草图、太阳路径图标、气流箭头、圆圈、等高线和微型注释。加强这些图形不仅是在悬浮，而且是在积极塑造和解释下方模型的感觉。保持它们间距美观，绝不拥挤。

色彩系统：
温暖的灰褐色背景、蜂蜜木色调、白色绘图线、浅色半透明树木、柔和的灰色阴影和微妙的金黄色阳光洗礼。保持一切克制、高级且连贯。

负面提示词：
无复制的项目标题，无现有建筑师名字，无中文标题，无杂乱图表，无幻想建筑，无扭曲的屋顶几何形状，无杂乱的材料样本，无模糊的阴影，无黑色污渍，无水印，无现有徽标，无嘈杂背景，无随机家具杂乱。

items.title: 棒球风格高调时尚人像摄影
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a 3:4 vertical, high-key lifestyle fashion portrait against an almost pure seamless white background. A young adult woman wears a casual baseball-inspired outfit and is photographed from a rear three-quarter angle, with her body positioned toward the left side of the frame and a generous field of clean white negative space on the right. Her hips remain turned away from the camera while her waist, ribcage and head twist naturally toward frame right. She looks sideways past her shoulder rather than into the lens, her lips slightly parted and her expression quiet, relaxed and subtly aloof, as though she has just heard someone call her from behind.  She wears a bright cobalt or royal-blue baseball cap with a broad brim and only a very small orange-red embroidered detail. The brim creates a soft, physically believable shadow near her eyes. Her hair is deep black to black-brown, tied into a low ponytail, with a few loose face-framing strands. The long ponytail ends fall into broad, relaxed curves and flick slightly outward, retaining natural weight, movement and a few imperfect flyaways rather than looking perfectly styled.  Preserve a slim, soft facial structure, delicate jawline, natural side-profile nose and small relaxed lips. Makeup is extremely light and translucent, inspired by clean East Asian fashion-editorial beauty: sheer foundation with faint natural texture still visible, soft apricot-peach blush, very subtle eyeliner, light lashes, nearly invisible eyeshadow, and muted nude-pink or pale coral lips. No heavy contouring and no exaggerated influencer-style facial redesign.  She wears a white short-sleeve baseball jersey with thin blue vertical pinstripes, slightly loose through the upper torso and gathered, rolled or lightly tied around the waist to create a cropped effect. Add a small red-and-blue baseball-inspired letter patch on the chest without reproducing legible brand typography. The pinstripes must bend realistically around the torso twist, and the fabric should bunch and wrinkle naturally around the waist.  Pair it with deep indigo frayed denim cut-off shorts, featuring golden-brown stitching, curved rear-pocket seams, distressed rolled edges and irregular loose fibers. The denim should feel thick and real, lightly creased and naturally shaped around the hips without looking vacuum-tight.  Visible skin includes the face, ear, side of the neck, forearms, hands, a narrow strip of side and lower-back skin, and most of the thighs below the shorts. The shoulders, chest and most of the back remain covered, and the buttocks remain covered by denim, with only the upper-thigh edges visible near the frayed hems. Use a bright warm-ivory skin tone with subtle peach and natural circulation. The skin should look fine and soft yet retain faint real texture and tonal variation; visually it should suggest skin that would feel warm, clean and lightly supple to the touch rather than smooth plastic.  The pose should feel caught during a real movement. Most of the body weight rests on one straighter leg while the other leg extends diagonally toward the lower right of the frame, producing a relaxed S-shaped flow through the waist, hips and legs. One hand hangs loosely beside the outer thigh with naturally separated fingers. The other arm reaches toward frame right while lightly holding a white takeaway drink cup with a thin black straw. Tiny minimalist markings may appear on the cup, but they should remain indistinct rather than turning into obvious AI-generated text.  Photograph from slightly behind and to the subject's left, with the camera around chest-to-waist height and only a very mild upward angle. Use the visual character of a full-frame 50-70mm equivalent lens at approximately f/3.5-f/5.6. Frame from the complete top of the cap down to around the mid-to-lower thighs, keeping the extended hand and drink entirely within the composition. Keep the framing slightly off-center and imperfect rather than mathematically balanced.  Use an extremely large diffused white key light positioned roughly 30-45 degrees in front of the subject toward frame right. The seamless white studio and large white bounce surfaces should strongly fill the shadows, pushing the backdrop close to pure white with occasional slight overexposure. Broad, milky, diffused highlights should appear across the cheek, forearms, hand, waist and thighs. Keep only a faint realistic shadow beneath the cap brim. No hard light, no strong rim light, no colored lighting and no dramatic cinematic backlight.  The image should be high resolution without aggressive sharpening or HDR. Retain extremely fine digital softness or subtle grain, natural flyaway hairs, garment bunching, irregular denim frays, imperfect finger alignm
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创建一张 3:4 纵向、高调的生活方式时尚肖像，背景几乎是纯净的无缝白色背景。一名年轻成年女性穿着休闲的棒球灵感装束，从后方四分之三角度拍摄，身体位于画面左侧，右侧留有大量的纯白负空间。她的臀部保持背对镜头，而腰部、肋骨和头部自然地向画面右侧扭转。她斜视肩膀后方，而不是直视镜头，嘴唇微张，表情安静、放松且微妙地冷淡，仿佛刚刚听到有人从身后叫她。她戴着一顶明亮的钴蓝色或皇家蓝色棒球帽，帽檐宽大，只有一个非常小的橙红色绣花细节。帽檐在她的眼睛附近投下柔软、物理上可信的阴影。她的头发是深黑色到黑褐色，扎成低马尾，有几缕松散的面部修饰发丝。长马尾的末端呈现出宽大、放松的曲线并微微向外翘起，保留了自然的重量感、动感和一些不完美的碎发，而不是看起来被完美打理过。保留纤瘦、柔和的面部结构，精致的下颚线，自然的侧面轮廓鼻子和微小的放松嘴唇。妆容极轻且透明，灵感来自纯净的东亚时尚杂志美学：薄透的粉底，仍可见微弱的自然肌理，柔和的杏桃色腮红，非常微妙的眼线，轻盈的睫毛，几乎看不见的眼影，以及柔和的裸粉色或淡珊瑚色嘴唇。没有浓重的修容，也没有夸张的网红风格面部重塑。她穿着一件白色短袖棒球球衣，带有细小的蓝色垂直细条纹，上身稍显宽松，在腰部聚集、卷起或轻轻系住以营造出短款效果。在身形添加一个小巧的红蓝棒球灵感字母贴片，不要复制可辨识的品牌文字。细条纹必须随着躯干的扭转而真实地弯曲，面料应在腰部周围自然地聚集和起皱。搭配深靛蓝色的磨损牛仔超短裤，具有金棕色缝线、弧形后口袋接缝、磨损的卷边和不规则的松散纤维。牛仔布应感觉厚实真实，有轻微的褶皱，并自然地贴合臀部形状，而不是看起来紧得像真空包装。可见的皮肤包括脸部、耳朵、脖子侧面、前臂、双手、侧腰和下背部的一小条皮肤，以及短裤下的大部分大腿。肩膀、身形和大部分背部保持遮盖，臀部由牛仔布遮盖，仅在磨损边缘附近可见大腿上部边缘。使用明亮的暖象牙色肤色，带有微妙的桃红色和自然循环感。皮肤看起来应细腻柔软，但保留微弱的真实纹理和色调变化；在视觉上，它应该暗示着摸起来温暖、干净且略带弹性的皮肤，而不是光滑的塑料。姿势应该感觉是在真实动作中捕捉到的。大部分体重落在一条较直的腿上，而另一条腿向画面右下方对角延伸，使腰部、臀部和腿部产生轻松的 S 形流动。一只手松散地垂在侧大腿旁，手指自然分开。另一只手臂向画面右侧伸出，轻握着一个带有细黑吸管的白色外带饮料杯。杯子上可能会出现微小的极简标记，但它们应保持模糊，而不是变成明显的 AI 生成文字。从主体左后方略低的位置拍摄，相机高度约在身形到腰部之间，仅有非常轻微的向上倾斜。使用全画幅 50-70mm 等效镜头的视觉特征，光圈约为 f/3.5-f/5.6。取景范围从帽子顶部到大腿中下部，保持伸出的手和饮料完全在构图之内。构图保持轻微偏离中心且不完美，而不是数学上的平衡。在主体前方约 30-45 度朝向画面右侧的位置使用一个极大的扩散白色主灯。无缝白色影棚和大型白色反射面应强烈填充阴影，使背景接近纯白色，偶尔有轻微过度曝光。宽大、乳白色的扩散高光应出现在脸颊、前臂、手、腰部和大腿上。帽檐下仅保留微弱的真实阴影。没有硬光，没有强烈的轮廓光，没有彩色照明，也没有戏剧性的电影背光。图像应为高分辨率，没有过度的锐化或 HDR。保留极细微的数字柔软感或微妙的噪点，自然的碎发，衣物聚集，不规则的牛仔磨损，不完美的手指排列和体重的细微偏移。整体美学是 90 年代/00 年代棒球灵感的休闲时尚与纯净的东亚杂志造型相结合：明亮、充满夏日气息、运动且毫不费力，与相机保持轻微的情绪距离。她刚刚转身；手中的饮料仍在微微晃动。此刻她的身体悬停在那短暂的转身瞬间，下一秒她似乎准备继续走。负向提示：塑料皮肤，过度修饰的脸，浓妆，直接眼神接触，正面姿势，夸张的曲线，解剖错误，多余的手指，僵硬的手，扭曲的杯子，杂乱的文字，广角畸变，硬阴影，强烈的轮廓光，霓虹灯照明，电影调色，强烈的虚化，HDR，过度锐化，完美对称，杂乱的背景。

Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographed portrait. Subject and action: one woman seated among the plants, leaning subtly toward the light while holding the apple near her chest. Composition: vertical full seated figure from a very low ground-level viewpoint, subject slightly right of center, one bent knee entering from the lower left, dense foreground leaves partially obscuring the lower body, abundant sky and tree canopy above. Camera: close-range wide-angle phone camera, upward tilt with mild perspective distortion and deep focus. Color and depth relationships: vivid leaf green surrounding cool sky blue and pale grey-blue clothing, with warm sunlit skin as the restrained warm note. Pose: seated low on the forest floor with both knees bent; the nearer knee rises toward the lower-left edge while the other leg folds beneath the body; torso upright and turned three-quarters left, shoulders slightly hunched and uneven; both elbows bent close to the torso, both hands gently cradling a bitten pale-green apple just below the chin. Wardrobe: fitted pale grey sleeveless camisole-style top and a blue lower garment covered in a tiny white floral print; barefoot or footwear fully concealed by plants and crop, no visible jewelry, bag, or accessories; fabric naturally creased and compressed at the seated waist and hips. Setting: dense sunlit woodland undergrowth with tall grass, broad leaves close to the lens, dark tree trunks and layered canopy around an opening of blue sky and white clouds. Lighting: strong natural backlight from the upper left, sun bursting through foliage, broad veiling flare across the left half, clipped white highlights, dappled sunlight and deep green shadows. Finish: ordinary wide-angle phone photograph in intense midday daylight: bright cool cyan-blue sky, saturated fresh greens, slightly warm skin, aggressive backlit haze, partially clipped highlights around the sun, deep but softened foliage shadows, restrained phone sharpening, low-to-moderate contrast through the flare, soft. Skin and material texture: unretouched photographed skin with visible pores, vellus hair, under-eye/lip texture, tonal variation, and faint grain on face, neck, ears, and hands, including flash, monochrome, and low light; global grain or noise alone does not satisfy this constraint. Typography should be spacious, balanced, high-end, and clearly subordinate to the architecture.

items.title: 传统服饰露背镜像分屏自拍复古胶片感
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Do not change her face or original features—100% authentic, with perfect facial symmetry. She should have a youthful, feminine appearance and an hourglass figure.

1. Pose & Composition

Camera angle: Close-up split mirror selfie with creative partial cropping, combining an extremely close view of the face in the foreground with a full reflection of the back in the mirror.

Body pose: A beautiful young woman stands with her back facing the mirror to highlight the outfit and back details, while the front of her body is positioned close to the phone camera.

Head movement: Her head is partially cropped in the foreground, showing only the left side of her face, while in the reflection her head is raised and elegantly tilted backward.

2. Face & Makeup

Expression: A calm, attractive side glance directed toward the camera or phone screen.

Eye makeup: Soft makeup emphasizing eyeliner and eyelashes, with naturally defined eyebrows.

Skin: Smooth skin with a subtle classic finish under the influence of a soft filter.

3. Hair & Accessories

Hairstyle: Dark hair completely pulled back into an elegant low traditional bun, with one soft strand of hair falling gently beside the face in the foreground.

Hair decoration: The bun is surrounded by jasmine or white flower garland (Gajra) to enhance the traditional aesthetic.

Jewelry: Prominent, delicate silver/crystal stud or cluster earrings with a noticeable sparkle.

4. Clothing & Fashion

Design: Traditional kimono/saree blouse with a wide open back (backless/cut-out design), featuring thin back ties (Dori) that end in a soft knot/bow at the bottom.

Color & details: Ivory/off-white or very light silver outfit, decorated with shimmering embroidery and beaded embellishments along the neckline and saree waist border.

5. Lighting & Background

Lighting: Soft, dim indoor lighting with subtle warm tones and low contrast.

Background: The mirror reflection shows a simple corner of an indoor room without distracting details.

Retro ambience & timestamp: The image has a soft, slightly hazy texture resembling analog film-camera quality or a retro filter (soft vintage filter).

Printed date: In the lower-left corner, a classic vertical digital timestamp appears in bright white, displaying: “25年 3月11日” (March 11, 2026).

Ratio: 9:16

items.title: 奢华现代别墅模型房地产销售海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a premium vertical real-estate sales poster for a fictional boutique developer brand called AUREN CASA, refined with stronger Orbit reveal energy and more polished Transit luxury. Preserve the original structural logic exactly: a soft warm beige luxury interior background in shallow depth of field, a large central modern villa maquette floating between two realistic human hands, the upper hand lifting a thin roof slab upward, the lower hand supporting the architectural model from beneath, a clean logo-and-headline zone at the top, and a compact branded contact-information strip at the bottom. The whole image must feel like a flagship property-launch visual: elegant, emotionally warm, and internationally premium.

Main visual:
At the center, place one ultra-refined two-story modern villa maquette with fully visible cutaway interiors. Strengthen the Orbit direction by making the lifted roof plane and the supported house body feel more dynamically related, as if the act of opening the roof is actively releasing the living experience inside. The gap between roof slab and model should feel deliberate and slightly more dramatic, while remaining realistic and controlled. The house model must feel handcrafted, valuable, and architecturally believable: slim dark metal frame, floor-to-ceiling glass, warm walnut or oak surfaces, recessed lighting, elegant living room, dining zone, upper private suite, indoor greenery, and clean layered floor plates.

Architecture and interiors:
The villa must read as a premium product, not a conceptual toy. Lower floor: open-plan living and dining with refined furniture, warm shelves, art piece, and subtle residential luxury. Upper floor: softer intimate bedroom or lounge suite. Materials must be rendered with great care: timber, glass, matte slabs, metal framing, upholstery texture, ambient light glow, and miniature lifestyle elegance. The interior should feel warm, inviting, and globally premium.

Hands and realism:
Both hands must be realistic, elegant, and anatomically correct, with natural finger spacing, believable grip pressure, fine skin texture, and beauty-commercial lighting. The upper hand should feel graceful and intentional, delicately lifting the roof slab. The lower hand should feel stable and supportive, reinforcing craftsmanship and care. No hand distortion, no extra fingers, no awkward pose.

Transit direction:
Refine the whole page toward a more international, more editorial, and more luxurious launch-poster standard. Reduce graphic noise, keep the top branding cleaner, make the contact strip more understated, soften any excessive contrast in the background blur, and allow the central model to carry more of the emotional and commercial weight. The image should feel like a flagship collaboration between a top-tier developer and a premium interior design house.

Lighting and mood:
Use soft warm daylight with subtle architectural interior glow. Let the model receive elegant directional light from upper-right or upper-front, with delicate highlights on the roof slab, glass edges, timber interiors, and the hands. Strengthen light-shadow relationships enough to give the model genuine volume and make the lifted-roof action feel more dramatic. The background should remain creamy, blurred, and luxurious, with no distraction.

Typography and branding:
Top zone: one original minimal logo mark, one original developer name, and one short English headline such as “OPEN TO ELEVATED LIVING” or “WHERE SPACE BECOMES HOME,” fully original and not copied. Add one small supporting line beneath.  
Bottom strip: one elegant branded contact bar with original fictional phone number, city text, and website, cleaner and more restrained than a brochure banner.  
All typography must be original, modern, premium, and secondary to the architectural model.

Style:
Luxury real-estate launch poster, premium architecture-and-interior branding, boutique residential campaign, design-build property marketing, hyper-real commercial rendering with emotional warmth, Cannes-level developer advertising polish.

Color system:
Warm beige, soft taupe, cream, walnut brown, muted charcoal frame lines, amber interior glow, restrained dark text, and one subtle brand accent if needed. Keep everything calm, polished, and globally premium.

Negative prompt:
no copied brand names, no copied slogans, no cluttered background, no toy-house feel, no distorted roof geometry, no warped hands, no extra fingers, no malformed anatomy, no muddy shadows, no black blotches, no watermark, no existing logos, no noisy layout, no cheap brochure feel.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

为一个名为 AUREN CASA 的虚拟精品开发商品牌制作一张高级垂直房地产销售海报，并以更强的 Orbit 揭示能量和更精美的 Transit 奢华感进行完善。精确保留原始结构逻辑：背景为浅景深的柔和暖米色奢华室内，一个大型中央现代别墅模型悬浮在两只真实的人手之间，上方的手向上提起薄薄的屋顶板，下方的手从下方托住建筑模型，顶部是干净的标志和标题区域，底部是紧凑的品牌联系信息条。整个图像必须感觉像是一个旗舰物业发布视觉效果：优雅、情感温暖且具有国际高端感。

主视觉：
在中心放置一个极其精美的两层现代别墅模型，内部剖面完全可见。通过使升起的屋顶平面和被支撑的房屋主体之间的联系更具动态感，增强 Orbit 方向，仿佛打开屋顶的动作正在积极释放内部的居住体验。屋顶板与模型之间的间隙应该是刻意的，且稍微更具戏剧性，同时保持真实和可控。房屋模型必须感觉是手工制作的、有价值的且在建筑上令人信服：纤细的深色金属框架、落地玻璃、温暖的核桃木或橡木表面、嵌入式照明、优雅的客厅、用餐区、上层私人套房、室内绿植和干净的分层楼板。

建筑与室内：
别墅必须被视为高端产品，而不是概念玩具。底层：开放式起居和用餐区，配备精美的家具、温暖的架子、艺术品和微妙的住宅奢华感。上层：更柔和亲密的卧室或休息套房。材料的渲染必须非常用心：木材、玻璃、哑光板、金属框架、室内装潢纹理、环境光光泽和微型生活方式的优雅感。室内应感觉温暖、诱人且具有全球高端感。

手部与写实：
两只手都必须真实、优雅且解剖结构正确，具有自然的指缝、可信的握持压力、细腻的皮肤纹理和美容广告级的照明。上方的手应感觉优雅且有目的性，精致地提起屋顶板。下方的手应感觉稳定且具有支撑力，强化工艺和关怀。没有手部畸形，没有多余的手指，没有尴尬的姿势。

Transit 方向：
将整个页面向更国际化、更具编辑感和更奢华的发布海报标准精炼。减少图形噪音，保持顶部品牌更简洁，使联系条更含蓄，软化背景模糊中任何过度的对比，并让中央模型承担更多的情感和商业分量。图像应该感觉像是顶级开发商与高端室内设计事务所之间的旗舰合作。

灯光与氛围：
使用柔和的温暖日光和微妙的建筑室内光泽。让模型接受来自右上方或正前方的优雅定向光，在屋顶板、玻璃边缘、木质室内和手上产生精致的高光。加强光影关系，足以给模型真实的体积感，并让提起屋顶的动作感觉更具戏剧性。背景应保持奶油色、模糊且奢华，没有干扰。

排版与品牌：
顶部区域：一个原始简约的标志符号，一个原始开发商名称，以及一个简短的英文标题，如“OPEN TO ELEVATED LIVING”或“WHERE SPACE BECOMES HOME”，完全原创且非复制。在下方添加一行小的辅助线。
底部条带：一个优雅的品牌联系栏，带有原始虚构的电话号码、城市文字和网站，比手册横幅更简洁、更克制。
所有排版必须是原创的、现代的、高级的，并且次于建筑模型。

风格：
奢华房地产发布海报，高端建筑与室内品牌，精品住宅宣传活动，设计建造物业营销，带有情感温暖的超写实商业渲染，戛纳级别的开发商广告磨砂感。

色彩系统：
暖米色、柔和的灰褐色、奶油色、核桃棕、柔和的木炭色框架线、琥珀色室内光泽、克制的深色文字，以及如果需要的话，一个微妙的品牌强调色。保持一切平静、精致且具有全球高端感。

负面提示词：
无复制的品牌名称，无复制的标语，无杂乱的背景，无玩具屋感，无扭曲的屋顶几何形状，无扭曲的手，无多余的手指，无畸形的解剖结构，无浑浊的阴影，无黑色斑块，无水印，无现有标志，无嘈杂的布局，无廉价的手册感。

9:16 vertical full-body fantasy character illustration, dark samurai gothic aesthetic, high-fashion warrior design, painterly concept art with expressive ink-brush energy.

A beautiful young East Asian female warrior standing in a powerful three-quarter pose against a minimal warm pale beige-gray background. She has delicate refined facial features, porcelain-pale realistic skin, narrow dark eyes, subtle muted-red eye makeup, soft natural lips, and thin understated eyeglasses. Her expression is calm, cold, detached and quietly dangerous.

Her extremely long black hair explodes upward and outward in the wind, individual strands dissolving into loose ink-like strokes. A striking silver-white streak of hair sweeps horizontally across her face, partially crossing one eye, creating strong directional movement.

She wears elaborate black-and-antique-silver samurai-inspired gothic armor, combining Japanese armor construction with dark fantasy haute couture. Huge sharply raised black shoulder plates, sculptural high collar, layered lacquer-black arm guards, engraved silver fittings, ornate skull-like metallic motifs, fitted black armored corset, asymmetrical hip armor, black thigh-high armored boots and intricate silver knee guards.

The armor is glossy but weathered, with subtle scratches, tarnished silver edges, engraved ornamental metalwork and restrained reflections. Beneath the armor are torn charcoal-gray fabric layers and long sweeping black-gray skirt panels.

Several pieces of vivid saturated crimson-red cords, knots and torn tassels hang from her waist and thigh armor. The red is exceptionally intense and clean — almost cinnabar / blood-crimson — becoming the strongest chromatic accent in an otherwise nearly monochromatic image. Small restrained crimson accents also appear around the eyes and armor details.

She holds a long slender black katana downward in one hand while the other hand grips the dark wrapped hilt of another sword at her hip. The weapons are elegant, extremely elongated and understated rather than oversized.

Her enormous black-gray cloak and skirt dissolve outward into broad, energetic dry-brush ink strokes, sweeping dramatically around the lower half of the composition. Fabric edges partially disappear into abstract painterly gestures, creating the feeling that the warrior herself is emerging from a traditional ink painting.

Strong visual contrast between highly resolved face and armor details and deliberately unresolved expressive brushwork around the silhouette. Sophisticated controlled chaos, localized areas approaching visual abstraction while the character remains perfectly legible.

Minimal background, generous negative space, no scenery, no typography, no symbols, no logo, no watermark, no star icon.

Palette dominated by lacquer black, charcoal gray, gunmetal, antique silver and warm pale gray, punctuated exclusively by brilliant deep crimson-red accents.

Japanese dark-fantasy concept art, contemporary Asian fashion illustration, sumi-e inspired gestural brushwork, elegant gothic samurai aesthetic, extremely intricate armor craftsmanship, realistic metallic reflections, delicate skin rendering, dynamic wind movement, sophisticated composition, cinematic character design, painterly realism, information-dense but visually controlled, masterpiece character concept art.

Aspect ratio 9:16.

9:16 纵向全身奇幻角色插画，暗黑武士哥特美学，高级时装战士设计，具有表现力水墨笔触能量的绘画风格概念艺术。

一位美丽的年轻东亚女战士，以强有力的四分之三姿态站在极简的温暖浅米灰色背景前。她拥有精致优雅的面部特征，瓷白写实的皮肤，狭长的黑眼睛，微妙的暗红色眼妆，柔软自然的嘴唇，以及细致简约的眼镜。她的表情冷静、冷酷、超然且透着危险。

她极长的黑发在风中向上向外爆发，发丝溶解成松散的墨迹笔触。一缕醒目的银白色头发横向扫过她的脸部，部分穿过一只眼睛，创造出强烈的方向感。

她穿着精致的黑色与仿古银色武士启发哥特盔甲，结合了日本盔甲结构与暗黑奇幻高级定制时装。巨大的尖锐升起黑色肩甲，雕塑感的高领，分层的漆黑色护臂，雕刻的银色配件，华丽的类骷髅金属图案，贴身的黑色铠甲束身衣，不对称的髋部盔甲，黑色过膝装甲靴和复杂的银色护膝。

盔甲光泽但有磨损感，带有细微划痕、晦暗的银色边缘、雕刻装饰金属制品和克制的反射。盔甲之下是撕裂的炭灰色织物层和长长的飘逸黑灰色裙摆。

几根鲜艳饱和的深红色绳索、结和撕裂的流苏挂在她的腰部和大腿装甲上。红色异常强烈且纯净——几乎是朱砂/血红色——成为在原本几近单色的图像中最强的色彩重点。眼睛周围和盔甲细节处也出现了少量的克制红色点缀。

她一只手向下握着一把细长的黑色武士刀，另一只手紧握腰间另一把剑的黑色缠绕剑柄。武器优雅、极其修长且简约，而非夸张巨大。

她巨大的黑灰色斗篷和裙子向外溶解成宽阔、充满活力的干笔水墨笔触，在构图的下半部分剧烈扫动。织物边缘部分消失在抽象的绘画手势中，营造出战士本人仿佛正从传统水墨画中走出的感觉。

高度精细的面部和盔甲细节与轮廓周围刻意未完成的表现主义笔触之间形成强烈的视觉对比。精致且受控的混沌，局部区域接近视觉抽象，而角色保持完美清晰。

极简背景，大量的负空间，无风景，无排版，无符号，无标志，无水印，无星星图标。

调色板以漆黑、炭灰、炮铜色、仿古银色和温暖的浅灰色为主，仅由亮丽的深红色调点缀。

日本暗黑奇幻概念艺术，当代亚洲时尚插画，水墨启发的手势笔触，优雅哥特武士美学，极度复杂的盔甲工艺，写实的金属反射，细腻的皮肤渲染，动态的风力运动，精致的构图，电影感角色设计，绘画写实主义，信息密集但视觉受控，杰作级角色概念艺术。

纵横比 9:16。

items.title: Small Emergencies 三联漫画墨线海报
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的陈旧纸张、密集墨线和小危机叙事海报模板。
items.prompt: Create a 9:16 tall poster titled Small Emergencies on aged cream paper #EFE3CE with heavy print grain and distressed edges. Use dense seinen-manga inking in near-black #1A1714: crosshatching, speed lines, spray dots and screentone patches over slightly misregistered flat fills of hot pink #E85D8A, sky cyan #6FC3D6, signal yellow #E8B33A and copper orange #D96B2E. Pink may take exactly one impossible role per poster: water spray, dawn sky or a ghosted second self. Build three stacked panels separated by tilted diagonal gutters with thin paper-colored gaps; the order may shuffle, but all three must appear, and the masthead never tilts. Use the same adult worker in every panel, with the uploaded reference image as facial identity reference for that character only. Panel one is an extreme close-up of the job's instrument, such as a tuning dial, lantern striker, pressure gauge or kitchen timer, with markings readable. Panel two shows the same worker full-body at the peak of a genuinely minor crisis in a strong diagonal pose with a fully drawn environment. Panel three is a tight portrait of the same character showing effort, relief or joy, optionally with a ghosted second emotion in one flat color. The replaceable crisis may be carrying a dawn radio signal, lighting a storm lantern in rain, fixing a burst pipe in dry season or catching over-rising dough at 3am; render the small emergency as life-or-death in the ink while keeping it materially minor. Include diegetic world text on tape labels, shop signs, flour bags, buoy numbers or warning plates. Set a two-word masthead in two typefaces: word one in massive distressed cream slab caps, word two in ornate circus Tuscan on or filled with a color block. Add one yellow footer info bar in bold black caps with place or season, slash and log or batch number. Scatter only three or four checkerboard patches, lightning bolts, starbursts or tiny waveforms. Use no gradients; create depth through line density. Preserve believable anatomy and natural hands. No extra people, incorrect lettering, borders, watermarks or modern clean illustration polish.
