items.title: 影像衍生品牌包装视觉识别海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-photo stitching, each photo output individually. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, with the upper and lower areas strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the frame. The upper half preserves the original photo, maintaining the subject identity, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of art magazines, independent publications, and exhibition photography. To adapt to the frame, the sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed. The lower half extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, transforming it into a complete brand packaging and material visual system. Do not simply copy the photo; instead, refine the subject's characteristics into reusable core graphics, illustration symbols, patterns, color blocks, or identification elements, and then apply them to packaging carriers of different sizes and purposes, making all materials instantly belong to the same visual family. Automatically select the most suitable 5–8 carriers based on the original image's theme, such as paper bags, packaging boxes, gift sets, labels, tags, tickets, cards, stickers, sleeves, cup packaging, key pendants, wrapping paper, or other related materials, without forcing the use of fixed categories. Use 1–2 main packages as the visual focus, with the remaining materials forming modular combinations based on size, horizontal/vertical ratios, and function; use a clear grid, edge alignment, scale contrast, spacing rhythm, and large areas of white space to organize the frame, like a professional brand design studio's packaging identity presentation board, rather than product displays or messy mockup collages. The color palette remains soft, transparent, and slightly desaturated in high-end tones, mainly light pink-blue, mist blue, sky blue, and airy cool-toned blue, paired with ivory white, cream white, light beige, soft gray-green, and architectural neutral colors, using only a small amount of dusty rose or muted blush as visual accents. Different packaging can change the color area and combination method, but must maintain the same color system to form a rich yet unified sense of series. The material emphasizes realistic and exquisite paper and packaging craftsmanship, showing matte paper, fine-grained paper, thick cardstock, translucent paper, embossing, die-cutting, folding, stickers, partial printing, and slight layering relationships; lighting is soft and natural, only used to express paper thickness, creases, and material differences, avoiding plastic feel, strong reflections, exaggerated 3D, and cheap product rendering. Text is also designed uniformly as part of the entire packaging system. Extract a short English main title from the subject's name, theme, mood, function, or symbolic meaning of the original image, and extend a very small amount of sub-titles, short sentences, numbers, category names, or micro-descriptions. Text can change naturally according to different carriers: vertically arranged on tags, extending along packaging edges, surrounding circular labels, crossing box surfaces, hidden between graphics, or becoming part of the packaging closure structure, so that fonts, graphics, and materials together form a complete brand language, rather than repeating the same title on every item. The overall presentation is a high-end brand packaging system / visual identity proposal board: rich but not crowded, lively but orderly, showing both the complete series and the design logic between graphics, text, materials, and different carriers. Whether the original image is a person, animal, plant, architecture, object, food, vehicle, or natural landscape, a unique packaging language should be established from the original image itself, avoiding fixed product combinations, repetitive templates, e-commerce display feel, and ordinary brand mockup templates.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，将其转化为一套完整的品牌包装与物料视觉系统。不要简单复制照片，而是把主体特征提炼成可重复使用的核心图形、插画符号、纹样、色块或识别元素，再分别应用到不同尺寸和用途的包装载体中，使所有物料一眼属于同一个视觉家族。

根据原图主题自动选择最合适的 5–8 种载体，例如纸袋、包装盒、套盒、标签、吊牌、票券、卡片、贴纸、封套、杯具包装、钥匙挂件、包装纸或其他相关物料，不强行使用固定品类。以 1–2 个主包装作为视觉重心，其余物料按大小、横竖比例和功能形成模块化组合；使用清晰网格、边缘对齐、尺度反差、间距节奏和大面积留白组织画面，像专业品牌设计工作室的 packaging identity presentation board，而不是商品陈列或杂乱 mockup 拼贴。

配色保持柔和、通透、略微去饱和的高级色系，以浅粉蓝、雾蓝、天空蓝、空气感冷调蓝为主，搭配象牙白、奶油白、浅米色、柔和灰绿和建筑中性色，仅用少量 dusty rose 或 muted blush 作为视觉跳点。不同包装可以改变颜色面积和组合方式，但必须保持同一套色彩系统，形成丰富而统一的系列感。

材质强调真实而精致的纸张与包装工艺，可表现哑光纸、细纹纸、厚卡、半透明纸、压纹、模切、折叠、贴纸、局部印刷与轻微层叠关系；光线柔和自然，只用于表现纸张厚度、折痕和材质差异，避免塑料感、强反光、夸张3D和廉价商品渲染。

文字也作为整个包装系统的一部分统一设计。从原图的主体名称、主题、情绪、功能或象征意义中提炼一个简短英文主标题，并延展出极少量副标题、短句、编号、品类名称或微型说明。文字可以根据不同载体自然变化：竖排于吊牌、沿包装边缘延伸、环绕圆形标签、跨越盒面、隐藏在图形之间或成为包装封口结构的一部分，使字体、图形和材质共同形成完整品牌语言，而不是每件物料重复贴上同一个标题。

整体呈现为一张高级品牌包装系统 / 视觉识别提案板：丰富但不拥挤，活泼但有秩序，既展示完整系列，也能看到图形、文字、材质与不同载体之间的设计逻辑。无论原图是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、食物、交通工具或自然景观，都应从原图本身建立独特的包装语言，避免固定产品组合、重复模板、电商展示感和普通品牌 mockup 套版。

items.title: 悬挂纸卡地形旅行记忆海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的非人物旅行照片编辑模板。以必填 travel_photo 为唯一来源，将一张具体的安静湖泊旅行照片制作成 3:4 真实摄影与悬挂纸卡微缩地形海报；示例源图由审计化 synthetic supporting_material 提供。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for travel_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Use the uploaded travel_photo as the sole source photograph. It is a quiet non-person lake scene. Turn this one travel photo into one independent high-end poster; never combine several photos in one frame.

Use a 3:4 vertical composition with a clearly separated photographic area and paper-art conversion area. Divide them with a straight, clear, restrained horizontal boundary without blurred blending, tearing, infiltration, or material overlap.

The upper photographic area occupies about 45%–50% of the full image. Faithfully preserve the source lake, shoreline, mountain or tree silhouettes, water direction and reflections, terrain relationships, viewpoint, real materials, natural light, and original colors. Apply only slight travel-magazine, independent-publication, or photography-exhibition grading and very thin film grain. Keep it unmistakably a real photograph. Do not move, replace, mirror, stretch, redesign, or illustrate any source feature.

The lower 50%–55% reconstructs the same scene as SUSPENDED PAPER CARD TERRAIN. On warm off-white matte paper, suspend one small open handmade paper card or terrain slice. The card occupies about 35%–50% of the lower area and sits centrally, lower-central, or slightly offset according to the source direction; preserve about 40%–60% continuous blank paper around it. Connect it with one extremely thin vertical suspension line, paper pin, or nearly invisible hanging point that remains entirely below the horizontal boundary and never enters the photograph.

The card is not a flat print of the scenery. Let the lake edge, shoreline, ridge, trees, pier, or other core visible geometry grow from the card's own slots, folded paper surfaces, and shallow relief layers. Extract only one most recognizable landmark or subject, one spatial clue that defines the scene, two or three necessary terrain layers, and a few plant or wave fragments for scale. Delete, merge, and shrink complex surroundings instead of proportionally copying the whole photo. Build the structure with two or three thin paper layers, continuous narrow cuts, shallow indentations, natural fibers, slight curls, open paper edges, and restrained short shadows.

Preserve the source's critical outlines, directions, relative positions, and signature colors so the lake scene remains immediately recognizable. Extract four to seven colors from travel_photo and soften them. Off-white paper dominates; keep only one distinctive accent color.

In the continuous whitespace outside the card, render exactly these three readable English strings and no other text: main title “LAKE STILL”; number “CARD NO. 01”; observation “Morning rests on quiet water”. Use shallow debossing, letterpress, a narrow serif, or restrained sans serif as though the typography and card were crafted together on a collection page. Keep LAKE STILL legible at chat preview size; smaller lines must remain crisp rather than collapsing into gray marks.

The mood is light, quiet, poetic, and restrained, like a travel memory held above paper by a fine thread. Its poetry comes from scale, whitespace, paper, and soft gravity. Avoid round miniature planets, fairy-tale asteroids, generic floating islands, realistic sandboxes, thick foam board, plastic toys, smooth 3D, heavy shadows, dense paper-cut plants, busy scrapbook collage, full-photo material repainting, proportional same-composition conversion, missing original photo, decorative photo thumbnails, blurred boundaries, suspension lines crossing the photo, author names, book titles, quotations, logos, brands, URLs, watermarks, gibberish, or any extra text.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为travel_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

使用上传的 travel_photo 作为唯一来源照片；示例为一处安静、无人物的湖泊旅行场景。将这一张照片独立制作成一张高级海报，不得把多张照片拼接在同一画面。

采用 3:4 竖版，由清楚分离的摄影区和纸艺转绘区组成。两区之间使用平直、清晰、克制的水平边界，不做模糊渐融、撕裂渗透或材质重叠。

上方摄影区占约 45%–50%。忠实保留源图中的湖面、岸线、山体或树林轮廓、水流方向与倒影、地形关系、观察角度、真实材质、自然光线和原有色彩。只做轻微旅行杂志、独立出版物或摄影展级调色，并加入极薄胶片颗粒；上方必须仍是清楚可辨的真实照片。不得移动、替换、镜像、拉伸、重设或插画化任何源图要素。

下方 50%–55% 将同一场景重构为 SUSPENDED PAPER CARD TERRAIN。在温暖米白哑光纸面上悬挂一枚小型开放式手工纸卡或地形切片。纸卡占下方约 35%–50%，位于中央、中下部或依源图方向轻微偏置，四周保留约 40%–60% 连续空白。使用一根极细垂直悬线、纸钉或几乎不可见的悬点连接纸卡；悬线只能留在下方，绝不能穿过水平边界进入照片。

纸卡不是印有风景的平面卡片。让湖岸、水线、山脊、树林、栈桥或其他核心可见结构从纸卡自身的切槽、折起纸面和浅浮雕层中生长。只提取一个最具识别度的主体或地标、一条决定叙事的空间线索、两至三层必要地形和少量植物或浪花碎片作为尺度提示。主动删除、合并和缩小复杂环境，不等比例复制整张照片。用两三层轻薄纸片、连续窄切口、浅压痕、天然纤维、轻微翘角、开放纸边和克制短投影表现结构。

保留源图最关键的轮廓、方向、相对位置和标志性色彩，使湖泊场景仍可一眼识别。从 travel_photo 提取四至七种颜色并柔化，以米白纸为主要面积，只保留一处最具辨识度的强调色。

在纸卡外的连续留白中逐字呈现以下三条清晰英文文字，且不得出现其他文字：主标题“LAKE STILL”；编号“CARD NO. 01”；观察句“Morning rests on quiet water”。采用浅凹压印、铅字、窄体衬线或克制无衬线字体，像与纸卡共同制作在收藏页上。LAKE STILL 在聊天预览尺寸必须清晰，较小文字也不能缩成模糊灰线。

整体轻盈、安静、诗意、克制，像被细线悬在纸面上的旅行记忆；诗意来自尺度、留白、纸张和柔和重力感。避免圆形小星球、童话小行星、通用悬浮岛、写实沙盘、厚泡沫板、塑料玩具、光滑 3D、重阴影、密集纸雕植物、繁忙手账拼贴、整张照片换材质重画、相同构图等比例转绘、缺失原照片、装饰性照片缩略图、模糊分界、悬线穿过照片、作者名、书名、引用、Logo、品牌、网址、水印、乱码或任何额外文字。

items.title: 花丛中阅读的成年女性高端生活方式人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的成年女性高端生活方式人像提示词。保留野花草地、打开的复古书、白色蕾丝夏装、棕色波浪发、象牙色雪纺蝴蝶结、午后阳光、45°俯拍和 4:5 胶片摄影质感。使用时需上传人物参考图，主可见人物的面部身份以该参考图为准。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Original high-end lifestyle photo of an adult woman peacefully reading an open vintage book in a lush wildflower meadow. White lace summer top, lightweight white skirt, soft wavy brown hair with golden highlights, and a large ivory chiffon bow. Warm late-afternoon sunlight, natural shadows, rich greens, golden highlights, realistic skin and fabric textures, candid 45° top-down composition, vertical 4:5, 35mm, f/2.8, subtle film grain. No CGI, plastic skin, distorted hands, logos, text.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

原始高端生活方式照片，一位成年女性在郁郁葱葱的野花草地中安静地阅读一本打开的复古书。白色蕾丝夏装上衣，轻盈的白色裙子，柔顺的波浪状棕色头发带金色挑染，以及一个巨大的象牙色雪纺蝴蝶结。温暖的傍晚阳光，自然阴影，浓郁的绿色，金色高光，真实的皮肤和织物纹理，自然的45°俯拍构图，纵向4:5，35mm，f/2.8，细微的胶片颗粒感。无CGI、塑料皮肤、扭曲的手、标志、文字。

items.title: 雏菊田野少女动感胶片摄影
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Do not change the facial features, proportions, hair color, or hair type. 100% likeness.

A spontaneous, candid shot captured by chance. Medium shot, a dense field of white daisies, bright sunny day.

The girl stands in a three-quarter profile, with one hand under her chin. At the moment of capture, her head suddenly turns to the side — her gaze shifts sideways, capturing a lively expression in motion. Strong motion blur on the face and hair, while the face remains recognizable through the blur.

White lace bandana with fringe. Voluminous white layered dress made of batiste and tulle with lace, oversized sleeves, and ruffles.

Daisies in the foreground are slightly blurred with bokeh, creating depth. A dense field of daisies surrounds her — sharp and detailed, serving as the visual anchor of the frame.

Hard, warm sunlight, contrasting shadows, deep shadows on the dress and face. Slightly underexposed.

Natural makeup, thin eyeliner, thick eyelashes, nude lips, subtle blush. Natural skin with visible pores. No plastic look, no AI appearance. Strong film grain, muted warm color palette.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

不要更改面部特征、比例、发色或发型。100% 相似。

一张偶然捕捉到的、自发的、抓拍的照片。中景，密集的白雏菊田，阳光明媚的日子。

女孩以四分之三侧面站立，一只手托在下巴下。在捕捉的瞬间，她的头突然转向侧面——她的目光转向一侧，捕捉到运动中生动的表情。脸部和头发上有强烈的动态模糊，而脸部在模糊中仍然可辨。

带有流苏的白色蕾丝头巾。由细平布、薄纱和蕾丝制成的蓬松白色多层连衣裙，带有超大袖子和荷叶边。

Over it, she wears a soft white lightweight knit cardigan correctly on both shoulders and both arms; both sides stay in place and form gentle layered folds. The clothing is ordinary morning knitwear, fully worn and naturally fitted. Do not use a camisole, narrow shoulder straps, a slipped or draped-off cardigan, transparent fabric, cleavage emphasis, exposed underwear, or body-focused styling. Add no accessories.

Keep the head tilted slightly right, gaze gentle and direct, lips closed, and smile subtle. The mood is calm, safe, and leisurely.

Face and hair: use a slightly rounded oval face, naturally arched brows, dark-brown eyes, a short neat nose bridge, pale-pink lips, a light rose tone on the cheeks, and softly defined beige-brown eye makeup. Preserve realistic adult skin texture. Comb dark-brown shoulder-length hair behind the ears, with inward-curving ends, a natural hairline and part, and a few fine strands near the cheeks picked out by window light.

Lighting and palette: use a large area of soft daylight from a window on frame-left, wrapping around the face and clothed shoulders. Reflected light from the white bedding gently opens the shadows; retain delicate shadows under the chin and within the cardigan folds. Keep low contrast with white and ivory dominant, accented by sage green, warm natural skin color, and light beige. Keep the eyes, hair, ribbing, and clothing edges distinct.

Textures and finish: render recognizable skin texture, eyebrows, eyelashes, mild lip sheen, individual hair strands, sage ribbing, soft white cardigan fibers, small pillow wrinkles, and the smooth sheet weave. Finish as a soft morning smartphone photograph with restrained warm color correction, fine detail in the eyes, lips, ribbing, and cardigan, and slightly softer bedding.

Composition: use a vertical 9:16 bedroom selfie-style frame. Place the face center at about 51% of frame width and 34% from the top; align the eyes at about 35% from the top and the shoulders' visual center at about 49% horizontally. Leave about 7% space above the head and crop the lower portrait around 80% of frame height, with the bed and table lamp visible to the left and right. Keep the close, intimate camera distance as a normal portrait, without body emphasis.

Avoid minors or a minor-looking subject, multiple people, other clothing, exposed or slipping garments, excessive exposure, anatomy emphasis, accessories, text, logos, watermarks, mirrors, split screens, distorted eyes or teeth, malformed clothing layers, missing pillows or lamp, plastic skin, or aggressive beauty retouching.

items.title: 旅游照片高级丙烯厚涂海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的旅行照片编辑模板。将每张上传的 travel_photo 独立制作成 3:4 真实照片与厚涂记忆微缩对照海报；travel_photo 是必填文件输入，示例素材由受审计的 synthetic supporting_material 提供，不绑定人物身份。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for travel_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Use the uploaded travel_photo as the sole source photograph for this edit. Turn each travel photo into one independent high-end design poster and output it separately; never stitch multiple photos together.

Use a 3:4 vertical composition with a real-photo area and a stylized transformation area. The real photo occupies about 40%–50% of the frame and the transformation occupies the other main area. Separate them with a straight, clear horizontal boundary without feathering or bleeding. Proportions may respond to the subject, but the comparison between source and transformation must remain obvious.

Use travel_photo faithfully in the real-photo area. Preserve subject identity and count, architecture, terrain, people or vehicles, viewpoint, spatial relationships, authentic materials, natural light and shadow, and original colors. Apply only restrained art-publication or photography-exhibition grading and very thin film grain. Never distort, mirror, move, add, remove, or reshape a subject.

Use warm ivory natural paper in the transformation area and retain about 38%–55% continuous paper whitespace. Do not redraw the full source framing proportionally. Extract only one most recognizable subject, architectural group, vehicle, or terrain relationship from the photo and reorganize it as an “impasto memory miniature” resting on the paper.

Embed the subject in an irregular mass of heavy-body acrylic paint as though it grows from the pigment. Show a visual paint thickness of about 5–15 mm, with clear palette-knife ridges, blunt bulges, deep grooves, scratches, raised thick edges, paint sidewalls, accumulation cross-sections, tiny paint debris, local wet reflections versus dry matte areas, and short real contact shadows on the paper. Thickness must come from acrylic volume, sidewalls, and knife marks, never layered paper, torn paper, papier-mâché, plasterboard, embossed paper, or an ordinary miniature model.

Choose the paint-island shape from the photo: towers, churches, or building groups may form vertically stacked paint mountains; lakes, roads, coasts, or vehicles may form low horizontal islands; a single person, boat, or small subject may be reduced and embedded in a few paint strokes. Keep only the minimum structure required for location identity and story. Let the subject edges dissolve into knife-applied color blocks, paint debris, and bare paper without becoming a rectangular landscape painting. Extract the palette entirely from travel_photo and compress it to 1–3 main colors, one dark color, and one small accent.

Add clearly readable editorial text: a 1–3 word English location or theme title, the fixed archive field “STUDY NO. 01”, and one original 5–12 word English observation sentence. Derive all text only from subjects, weather, action, or spatial feeling visibly present in travel_photo. Keep the title readable at ordinary preview size; it may look pressed into the paint edge by a palette knife. Put auxiliary text on bare paper in a narrow humanist sans serif or gentle serif with slight dry-brush gaps.

The result is quiet, restrained, poetic, physically handmade, and collectible like an art publication. Avoid layered paper, torn paper, papier-mâché, plaster sheets, flat appliqué, flat paint patches, smooth digital brushes, ordinary miniature models, plastic CGI, resin, same-crop repainting, full-background painting, rectangular duplicate photos, missing source-photo comparison, tiny unreadable text, floating digital typography, cartoons, logos, watermarks, frames, and wall mockups.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为travel_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

使用上传的 travel_photo 作为本次编辑的唯一来源照片。每张旅行照片分别制作一张独立高级设计海报并单独输出，不得多图拼接。

采用 3:4 竖版，由真实照片区与风格化转绘区组成。真实照片约占全画面 40%–50%，转绘区占另一主要部分；两区使用笔直、清楚、无羽化和渗透的水平边界。可依主体适当调节比例，但必须清楚呈现原图与转绘的对照。

真实照片区忠实使用 travel_photo，准确保留其中主体的身份与数量、建筑结构、地形、人物或交通工具、观察角度、空间关系、真实材质、自然光影与原有色彩。仅做克制的艺术出版物或摄影展调色，并加入极薄胶片颗粒；不得扭曲、镜像、移动、增删或重塑主体。

转绘区使用温暖象牙色天然纸张，保留约 38%–55% 连续纸面留白。不要按原照片完整取景等比例重画；只提取照片中一个最具识别度的主体、建筑组合、交通工具或地形关系，重组为安放在纸面上的“厚涂记忆微缩”。

主体必须嵌入一块不规则重体丙烯颜料中，像从颜料内部生长。颜料呈现约 5–15 毫米视觉厚度，清楚表现调色刀峰脊、圆钝隆起、深沟、刮痕、抬起的厚边、颜料侧壁、堆积断面、微小颜料碎屑、局部湿润反光与干燥哑光差异，并在纸面投下短而清楚的真实接触影。厚度来自真实丙烯颜料体积、侧壁和调色刀痕，不得做成叠纸、撕纸、纸浆、石膏板、浮雕纸片或普通微缩模型。

依据照片主体选择颜料岛：高塔、教堂或建筑群可形成垂直堆积的颜料山体；湖面、道路、海岸或车辆可形成低矮横向颜料岛；单一人物、船只或小主体可缩小后嵌入少量颜料笔触。只保留地点身份与故事所需的最少结构，让建筑或主体外缘逐渐融入刮刀色块、颜料碎屑和裸纸，禁止形成矩形风景画。色盘完全从 travel_photo 提取，压缩为 1–3 个主色、一种深色和小面积强调色。

加入清楚可读的编辑文字：1–3 个英文单词的地点或主题标题、固定档案字段“STUDY NO. 01”，以及一句 5–12 个英文单词的原创观察句。文字只可来自 travel_photo 中真实可见的主体、天气、动作或空间感受。主标题在普通预览尺寸必须清晰，可像被刮刀压入颜料边缘；辅助文字放在裸纸区，使用带轻微干刷缺口的窄体人文无衬线或温和衬线字体。

整体安静、克制、诗意，具有真实手工重量和艺术出版物收藏质感。避免纸张叠层、撕纸、纸浆、石膏片、平面贴花、平涂色块、光滑数字笔刷、普通微缩模型、塑料 CGI、树脂、同裁切重画、满背景绘画、矩形重复照片、缺失原图对照、不可读小字、悬浮数字排版、卡通、Logo、水印、画框或墙面样机。

身体重心主要落在一条腿上，另一条腿自然向侧前方微微交叉，两膝保持自然放松，脚尖方向略有差异，形成轻松、随意的站姿。

右手弯曲放在腰腹附近，自然握住黑色手机；左手自然下垂并轻轻停留在裙腰附近，五指放松，手指结构清晰自然。

头部轻微转向画面右侧约 20–30°，视线看向车厢侧前方，而不是直视摄影机。嘴唇自然微张，表情安静、清甜、略带若有所思的感觉。

场景环境

现代亚洲城市地铁/轨道交通车厢内部，人物位于列车车门与金属扶手之间的角落区域。

背景包含银灰色金属车门、白灰色车厢内饰板、深色车窗、弧形不锈钢扶手、纵向金属立柱、门框结构以及少量真实安全警示标识。

画面左侧前景有一根距离镜头很近的银色金属扶手，因浅景深形成自然虚化，制造明显的前景遮挡与纵深层次。

右侧为地铁车门和深色玻璃窗，窗外环境较暗，形成明暗对比。

地面为深灰色细颗粒防滑地板，能够看到人物双脚与地面的真实接触关系和轻微鞋底阴影。

环境保持整洁、现代、安静，不出现拥挤人群，不增加抢眼广告或杂乱物品。

时间与氛围

时间设定为夜晚或晚间通勤时段。

列车内部灯光明亮，而车窗外呈深蓝黑色，因此形成“明亮车厢 × 黑暗窗外”的视觉反差。

整体氛围安静、私密、略带孤独感，如同夜晚乘坐末班地铁时偶然捕捉到的一帧城市少女写真。

光影设计

主要光源来自地铁车厢顶部大面积冷白色 LED 灯。

主光为柔和漫射顶光，强度中等偏高，色温约 4300–5000K，从人物头顶前方约 30–45°方向均匀落下。

脸部保持明亮柔和，避免明显黑眼圈与硬阴影；鼻翼、下颌线、颈部和锁骨区域保留轻微自然阴影以增强立体感。

车门右侧产生少量冷色环境补光，左侧金属结构反射出柔和高光。

皮肤高光柔和不过曝，黑色服装仍然保留暗部纹理。

整体动态范围较高，高光不过曝、暗部不死黑、肤色通透但真实。

镜头语言与构图

9:16 竖版全身环境人像。

摄影机位于人物正前方略偏左位置，距离人物约 2.5–3.5 米。

使用约 45–55mm 全画幅等效焦段，避免超广角造成头小脚大、腿部拉伸和车厢结构变形。

采用接近平视、略微低机位拍摄，摄影机高度约位于人物腰腹至身形之间，仅产生非常轻微的仰拍效果，以自然强化腿长和人物高挑比例。

人物占画面高度约 80–88%，头顶保留少量安全空间，鞋底与画面底部之间保留适当余量。

人物位于画面中央略偏右，左侧利用虚化金属扶手形成前景框架，右侧利用地铁车门形成纵向结构线。

负面约束

禁止动漫脸、二次元、CG脸、3D建模脸、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、夸张大眼、畸形五官；禁止头部过大、身体比例异常、腰部断层、腿部扭曲、长短腿、多余肢体、多手多脚；禁止手指融合、六指、断指、手机与手掌融合；禁止膝盖异常、脚踝扭曲、左右脚颠倒、鞋子变形或悬空。

必须完整显示双腿、脚踝、袜子与两只鞋，不裁脚，不让前景扶手遮挡人物脸部和关键身体结构。

禁止过度广角、鱼眼、强透视拉伸、过度仰拍、过度俯拍；禁止强烈背景虚化导致地铁环境完全消失；禁止过曝白皮、死白肤色、油腻高光；禁止错误文字成为视觉主体、明显 AI 水印、Logo、字幕和边框。

items.title: IVORY BLOOM 奢华时装白牡丹广告海报
items.description: 以配置的人物参考图绑定主角身份的高端时装广告海报：中央成年女性肖像、象牙色高领礼服与一朵巨型白牡丹，保留唯一主标题 IVORY BLOOM。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a Cannes-level luxury fashion advertising poster for an original couture house named "IVORY BLOOM". Use 100% live-action ultra-realistic editorial photography. Preserve the exact structural logic of the composition: a tall vertical poster, one adult female model in a soft close-up portrait placed centrally, her head slightly tilted and turned with a calm distant editorial expression, wearing a high-neck ivory dress, and a single oversized white peony blooming beside one side of her head as the key visual counterbalance. Set the entire image against a clean warm butter-cream background with no environmental clutter. The final image must feel like a collectible high-fashion magazine cover: poetic, aristocratic, soft, cinematic, and unforgettable.

Style lock: ultra-real luxury fashion portrait photography, soft vintage editorial realism, prestige couture beauty campaign, clean studio-art background, no illustration, no CGI look, no plastic skin, no over-retouched beauty-filter effect.

Core composition: tight upper-body portrait, model centered, face and flower occupying most of the frame, gentle negative space above for one oversized elegant master title only. No secondary text, no body copy, no footer, no side notes, no editorial paragraph, no logo block. Keep only one large refined English headline across the upper area as part of the composition. Suggested headline: "IVORY BLOOM".

Model styling: adult woman with naturally pale luminous skin, soft auburn or light brown wispy hair loosely framing the face, refined red-brown lips, minimal couture makeup, and a high-neck ivory dress with smooth premium fabric and subtle sculptural folds. The body and face must remain elegant, natural, and anatomically correct.

Flower styling: one large white peony with dense layered petals and a rich golden center, placed beside the model's head like a couture floral ornament. The flower must feel fresh, luxurious, soft, and monumental, acting as the main visual symbol after the face.

Lighting: soft diffused frontal light with slight side shaping, delicate shadow transitions, gentle cheekbone definition, luminous skin, and creamy floral highlights. Keep the atmosphere airy, warm, and expensive, with no harsh shadows, no muddy darks, and no dead-black areas.

Skin and realism: real human skin only, visible fine pores, subtle facial microtexture, faint vellus hair, realistic lip texture, natural tonal variation, slight under-eye translucency, delicate capillary warmth, soft semi-matte sheen, authentic live-action detail. No poreless skin, no waxy texture, no silicone appearance.

Color strategy: restrained palette of butter cream, warm ivory, soft beige, petal white, muted auburn, and warm golden pollen tones. Keep the image minimal and harmonious, with the face and flower as the dominant focal points.

Art direction goals: model-first hierarchy, couture floral symbolism, elegant title-driven poster composition, premium realism, flagship fashion impact, no clutter, no extra props, no copied branding, no watermark.

Negative prompt: copied luxury brand name, copied masthead, copied paragraph text, any secondary text, body copy, footer copy, logo duplication, watermark, AI look, CGI skin, plastic skin, waxy skin, poreless face, over-retouched beauty filter, distorted facial anatomy, fake flower texture, low-resolution petals, muddy shadows, dead-black patches, black blotches, cluttered composition, cheap fashion poster look, cartoon rendering.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物参考图作为画面中主要可见人物的面部身份参考。除身份适配外，保留原场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线与视觉风格。

为名为 “IVORY BLOOM” 的原创高级定制品牌创作一张坎城级奢华时装广告海报。使用百分之百实景拍摄的超写实编辑摄影。严格保留构图结构：高挑的竖版海报，一名成年女性模特居中，以柔和近景肖像呈现，头部略微倾斜并转向一侧，神情平静而疏离；她穿高领象牙色礼服，头部一侧盛开一朵巨大的白牡丹，作为关键视觉平衡。全画面置于干净的暖黄油奶油色背景，没有环境杂物。最终应像一张值得收藏的高端时尚杂志封面，诗意、贵族感、柔和、电影感且令人难忘。

风格锁定：超写实奢华时装肖像摄影、柔和复古编辑写实感、高级定制服装美容广告、干净的工作室艺术背景。不要插画感、CGI 感、塑料皮肤或过度磨皮的美容滤镜。

核心构图：紧凑的上半身肖像，模特位于中央，面部和花朵占据画面主要区域；上方保留温和留白，只放置一个超大的优雅主标题。不要副标题、正文、页脚、侧边注释、编辑段落或 logo 区块。画面只保留一个精致的大号英文标题，准确写为 “IVORY BLOOM”。

模特造型：成年女性，天然白皙有光泽的皮肤，柔软的赤褐色或浅棕色轻盈碎发自然围绕面部，精致的红棕色嘴唇，极简高级定制妆容；穿高领象牙色礼服，面料高级平滑，带有细微的雕塑感褶皱。身体与面部必须优雅、自然且解剖结构正确。

花朵造型：一朵巨大的白牡丹，花瓣层层密集展开，中心带浓郁金色花蕊，置于模特头部一侧，像高级定制花饰。花朵应新鲜、奢华、柔软而具有纪念碑般的尺度，成为仅次于面部的主要视觉符号。

光线：柔和漫射的正面光，带轻微侧向塑形，阴影过渡细腻，轻轻勾勒颧骨，皮肤明亮，花瓣高光呈奶油质感。整体通透、温暖而昂贵，不要硬阴影、浑浊暗部或死黑区域。

皮肤与写实度：只使用真实人类皮肤，能看到细小毛孔、微妙面部纹理、淡淡汗毛、真实唇纹、自然色调变化、轻微眼下半透明感、细腻毛细血管暖色与柔和半哑光光泽，保持真实实景细节。不要无毛孔皮肤、蜡质纹理或硅胶感。

色彩策略：克制使用黄油奶油色、暖象牙色、柔和米色、花瓣白、低饱和赤褐色和温暖金色花粉色。画面极简和谐，面部与花朵为主导焦点。

艺术指导目标：模特优先的层级、高级定制花卉象征、由标题驱动的优雅海报构图、奢华写实质感与旗舰时装冲击力；不要杂物、额外道具、仿冒品牌、水印。

负面约束：仿冒奢侈品牌名、仿冒报头、仿冒段落文字、任何副文字、正文、页脚、logo 重复、水印、AI 感、CGI 皮肤、塑料皮肤、蜡质皮肤、无毛孔面孔、过度磨皮美容滤镜、面部解剖变形、虚假花瓣质感、低分辨率花瓣、浑浊阴影、死黑块、黑色污渍、杂乱构图、廉价时装海报感、卡通渲染。

items.title: 实体红色线绳节点关系映射系统海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output individually. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, with the top and bottom areas strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The top half retains the original photo, maintaining the subject's identity, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition image. To adapt to the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The bottom half extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, structure, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, translating it into a realistic and touchable Physical String-based Systems Map / Tangible Node-link Visualization. Do not directly depict the original object; instead, dismantle the subject into a small number of meaningful nodes and relationships: key outlines, structural transitions, movement directions, spatial positions, or environmental clues become pin-style Nodes, using real string as Edges / Links between each other, so that the visual relationships of the original photo are manifested again as a physical network, while the identity and structure of the original subject remain faintly recognizable.

The composition uses a clear core node or core relationship as the visual hub, with other nodes naturally unfolding around the main structure. The strings are not randomly wound but should establish relationships based on the direction, proportion, distance, connection, and narrative logic of the original image; some nodes form radial, convergent, triangular, polygonal, and cross-regional connections, causing a large number of simple relationships to naturally produce emergent geometry. The whole is both complex and orderly, with denser central relationships and gradually sparser peripheries, retaining sufficient negative space to avoid filling the entire layout.

Materials must have a sense of a real physical installation: use tiny pushpins, stitches, cotton thread or twine, paper labels, handwritten marks, and real cardboard surfaces, preserving slight differences in string tension, node height, cross-occlusion, stitch shadows, and manual errors. The whole looks like an art-directed research wall, system design experiment, or information art installation, rather than a computer-drawn network diagram, and should not have cyber UI, digital glowing lines, or cheap detective board effects.

The string uses a vivid but restrained cinnabar red, coral red, or warm red as the primary relational color, creating visual tension against a large amount of natural white, warm white, light gray, or very light backgrounds coordinated with the comprehensive color temperature of the photo above; pushpins, paper tags, and a small number of marks can extract local characteristic colors from the photo above for low-area correspondence. The overall color is clean, modern, and vibrant, avoiding dark brown, dirty old, blood-red horror, and excessive retro distressing.

Text intervenes freely as Hand-lettered Annotation in the system, without pre-setting fixed titles, locations, years, or menu-style information. Based on the subject, action, position, emotion, relationship, or metaphor in the photo, freely generate a small number of keywords, short phrases, arrows, circled notes, or miniature descriptions, and write them directly near nodes, string intersections, or white space areas. The font uses small, loose, handwritten annotation fonts with a slight sense of research notes and writing deviations, letting the text be like natural traces of thought left during the observation process, while maintaining the restraint and readability of high-end editorial design.

Overall, it presents a high-end experimental visual composed of physical nodes, red strings, relationship mapping, emergent geometry, handwritten annotations, and a large amount of white space. Whether the subject is a person, animal, plant, building, object, vehicle, natural landscape, or complex scene, it should further translate 'what it is' into 'how its parts relate', forming a physical information visualization with a sense of research, art, systematicity, and manual warmth. Avoid random red lines, meaningless nodes, full-page chaos, horror crime boards, digital network UI, cartoon pushpins, templated mind maps, and ordinary flowcharts.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、结构、姿态与叙事关系**，将其转译成一张真实可触摸的 **Physical String-based Systems Map / Tangible Node-link Visualization**。不要直接描绘原物，而是把主体拆解为少量具有意义的节点与关系：关键轮廓、结构转折、动作方向、空间位置或环境线索成为图钉式 Nodes，彼此之间使用真实线绳作为 Edges / Links，使原照片的视觉关系重新以实体网络显形，并仍能隐约辨认出原主体的身份与结构。

构图以一个明确的**核心节点或核心关系**作为视觉枢纽，其余节点围绕主体结构自然展开。线绳不是随机缠绕，而应根据原图的方向、比例、远近、连接与叙事逻辑建立关系；部分节点形成放射、聚合、三角、多边形与跨区域连接，使大量简单关系自然产生 **emergent geometry**。整体既复杂又有秩序，中心关系较密，外围逐渐疏松，保留充足负空间，避免把整个版面铺满。

材质必须具有真实实体装置感：使用细小图钉、针脚、棉线或细绳、纸质标签、手写痕迹和真实纸板表面，保留轻微线绳松紧差异、节点高度、交叉遮挡、针脚阴影与手工误差。整体像一件经过艺术指导的研究墙、系统设计实验或信息艺术装置，而不是电脑绘制的网络图，也不要出现赛博UI、数字发光线或廉价侦探板效果。

线绳以**鲜明但克制的朱红、珊瑚红或暖红色**作为主要关系色，在大量自然白、暖白、浅灰或与上方照片综合色温协调的极浅背景中形成视觉张力；图钉、纸签与少量标记可从上方照片提取局部特征色进行低面积呼应。整体颜色干净、现代、有生命力，避免暗褐、脏旧、血红恐怖感和过度复古做旧。

文字作为系统中的**Hand-lettered Annotation** 自由介入，不预设固定标题、地点、年份或菜单式信息。根据照片中的主体、动作、位置、情绪、关系或隐喻，自由生成少量关键词、短句、箭头、圈注或微型说明，并直接写在节点附近、线绳交汇处或留白区域。字体使用**细小、松弛、略带研究笔记感与书写偏差的手写注释字体**，让文字像观察过程中自然留下的思考痕迹，同时保持高级编辑设计的克制与可读性。

整体呈现**实体节点、红色线绳、关系映射、涌现几何、手写注释与大量留白**共同构成的高级实验视觉。无论主体是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、交通工具、自然景观或复杂场景，都应把“它是什么”进一步转译为“它的各部分如何发生关系”，形成具有研究感、艺术感、系统性与手工温度的实体信息可视化。避免随机红线、无意义节点、满版混乱、恐怖犯罪板、数字网络UI、卡通图钉、模板化思维导图和普通流程图。

items.title: 柔媚明眸中国女性电影感美容肖像
items.description: 基于 10A 身份参考的 9:16 中国年轻成年女性极近景电影感美容肖像，完整保留柔媚明眸骨相、焦糖至琥珀虹膜、冷白珍珠瓷肌、玫瑰雾粉妆、105mm 长焦构图、正面高调柔光和冷蓝灰背景约束。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity basis for the only visible person. Preserve her recognizable facial identity while applying the following scene, makeup, composition, lighting, and photographic treatment.

Create a highly finished, realistic 9:16 extreme close-up beauty portrait of one young adult Chinese woman, visually age 20–26. Her mood is pure, charming, soft, romantic, restrained, and clearly adult, without infantile, Westernized, influencer-style, or generic beauty-filter styling.

Use the “B | Charming Bright-eyed Movie Face” treatment: a soft oval-to-melon-seed face, naturally full forehead and temples, full mid-face, softly supported cheekbones, refined but gentle jawline, and a small rounded chin that is delicate rather than sharp. Maintain believable East Asian anatomy and balanced movie-heroine elegance.

Make the eyes the first visual focus: large elongated East Asian almond eyes with slightly lifted outer corners, natural soft double lids, and visible but restrained under-eye fullness. Irises transition transparently from caramel tea to amber tea, with fine radial texture, clear pupil boundaries, and a natural dark-brown outer ring. Keep eye whites clear but not dead white, corneas moist, inner corners subtly dewy, and lower lids showing a very fine tear line. Large soft window-shaped catchlights must enter both irises, producing bright, transparent, lively eyes while retaining real proportions.

Give her a slender straight nose with a natural root, small rounded tip, and restrained realistic nostrils. Lips are naturally full with clear but soft peaks, a slightly fuller lower lip, faint real lip lines, and a moist finish that never becomes glassy.

Skin is high-brightness, low-saturation neutral-cool pearl white: clean, quiet, soft, translucent, and dominated by low-frequency tonal continuity. Avoid yellow, gray, earthy, or fleshy casts. Preserve realism through facial structure, continuous light transitions, slight subsurface translucency, and extremely subtle micro-texture around the nose, eyes, and lips rather than coarse pores across the face. Retain only very light pink circulation around the eyes, beneath the eyes, at the center of the cheeks, nose tip, and lips. Use broad soft micro-highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, cheek centers, and lip peaks. Never render plastic, wax, CGI, or uniformly over-sharpened skin.

Makeup is restrained light rose mist: low-concentration rose pink, gray-rose, and tea pink softly blended around both lids, with slightly deeper outer corners but no heavy or smoky effect. Use slender, separated, naturally curled black-brown lashes; confine blush to a small area beneath the eyes and at the cheek centers. Lips use a low-saturation moist dusty-rose bean-paste shade with subtle reflection and visible fine lip texture.

Hair is long, smooth dark brown-black with a soft side part. A few strands on one side lightly frame the face without obscuring eyes, nose, or lips. Show natural individual strands and slight brown tonal variation, avoiding plastic hair, wig texture, or cutout-like CG edges.

Use 105mm telephoto beauty-portrait language to avoid wide-angle distortion. The face occupies about 70–90% of the frame; both eyes sit slightly above center and look directly into the lens. Lock critical focus on eyes, irises, and lashes; keep lips secondarily sharp while ears and rear hair may soften slightly. Follow “low-frequency skin, high-frequency features”: calm low local contrast on broad skin areas, with realistic detail in lashes, irises, pupils, eyeliner, lip lines, and hair strands.

Light with an extra-large frontal soft source placed close to the subject and slightly above eye level, angled gently downward, plus low-intensity soft fill. The face remains bright and even; shadows in eye sockets, beside the nose, beneath the eyes, and under the jaw are very shallow and clean. Highlights are broad and soft without dead-white clipping; shadows remain neutral to slightly cool, never yellow, dirty, gray-green, or muddy. Use a simple low-saturation cool blue-gray background about half to one stop darker than the face.

The finished photograph should feel authentic yet refined: clean pearl skin, bright moist optically layered eyes, light pink mist makeup, and a cold romantic cinematic atmosphere. Avoid extra people, childish styling, influencer aesthetics, wide-angle distortion, blocked facial features, sharp angular bone structure, heavy makeup, smoky eyes, excessive blush, plastic or wax skin, CGI, uniform full-face oversharpening, text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为画面中唯一人物的面部身份依据，在应用以下场景、妆容、构图、光线与摄影处理时，保持她可辨识的身份特征。

创作一张高完成度、真实摄影质感的 9:16 中国年轻成年女性极近景美容肖像，视觉年龄 20–26 岁。气质清纯、柔媚、温柔、浪漫、克制，成年感明确；避免幼态、欧美化、网红化或通用美颜风格。

采用“B｜柔媚明眸电影脸”：瓜子脸与鹅蛋脸之间的柔和脸型，额头和太阳穴自然饱满，面中丰润，颧骨柔和支撑而不外扩，下颌线细致但不过硬，下巴小巧圆钝而不尖，保持可信的东方骨相和电影女主般的平衡感。

眼睛是第一视觉中心：偏大而修长的东方杏眼，外眼角轻扬，双眼皮自然柔和，卧蚕清晰但克制。虹膜从焦糖茶色通透过渡到琥珀茶色，具有细密放射纹理、清晰瞳孔边界和自然深棕外缘环。眼白清澈但不死白，角膜湿润，内眼角微润，下眼睑保留极细泪线。双眼都有面积明显、边缘柔和并进入虹膜的窗型高光，使眼神明亮、通透、有神，同时保持真人比例。

鼻根自然，鼻梁纤秀顺直，鼻尖小巧圆润，鼻翼收敛但结构真实。嘴唇自然饱满，唇峰清晰柔和，下唇略丰润，保留细微真实唇纹和轻柔水光，不能玻璃化。

皮肤为高明度、低饱和、中性偏冷的珍珠冷白：白净、安静、柔润、通透，以低频连续明暗为主，避免黄调、灰调、土色和肉色感。真实感来自自然面部结构、连续光影、轻微皮下透光，以及鼻翼、眼周、唇周极细微的微结构，而不是全脸粗大毛孔。只在眼周、眼下、苹果肌中心、鼻尖和嘴唇保留极低浓度淡粉血色。额头、鼻梁、苹果肌和唇峰呈宽而柔和的微水光；禁止塑料、蜡像、CG 或全脸统一过度锐化。

妆容为克制的淡玫瑰雾粉妆：低浓度玫瑰粉、灰玫粉和浅茶粉轻柔晕染上下眼睑，眼尾略深但不浓艳、不烟熏。睫毛为黑褐或深棕黑色，纤长、根根分明、自然卷翘。腮红只轻柔集中于眼下和苹果肌中心小范围。嘴唇使用低饱和、柔润轻反光的灰玫豆沙色，并保留细微唇纹。

发型为乌黑偏棕的柔顺长发，柔和偏分，一侧少量发丝轻贴脸侧形成框景，但不得遮挡眼、鼻、唇。发丝应有真人摄影质感、自然单根细节和轻微棕色层次，避免塑料发丝、假发感和抠图式 CG 边缘。

采用 105mm 长焦美容人像镜头语言，避免广角畸变。脸部占画面约 70%–90%，双眼位于视觉中心偏上并直视镜头。焦点优先锁定双眼、虹膜和睫毛，嘴唇次清晰，耳部与后侧头发可轻微虚化。遵循“低频皮肤、高频五官”：大面积皮肤局部反差较低，睫毛、虹膜、瞳孔、眼线、唇纹和发丝保持真实清晰。

使用靠近人物、位于相机正前方且略高于眼睛的超大柔光源向下柔和照射，并加低强度柔和补光。面部明亮均匀，眼窝、鼻翼、眼下和下颌阴影极浅且干净。高光宽而柔和但不死白过曝；阴影保持中性或轻微冷调，不发黄、不脏、不灰绿。背景为简洁、低饱和冷蓝灰色，亮度比脸部低约半档至一档。

最终效果兼具真人摄影真实性与高级美容近景质感：珍珠冷白皮肤安静细腻，眼睛明亮湿润且具有真实光学层次，妆面轻盈粉润，氛围清冷、浪漫、电影感。避免额外人物、幼态造型、网红审美、广角畸变、五官遮挡、尖锐骨相、浓妆、烟熏眼、大面积腮红、塑料或蜡像皮肤、CG、全脸统一过锐、文字、标志和水印。

items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Use my uploaded original image as the sole editing basis for local modification, do not regenerate or redesign the entire screen. Maximize retention of the original person, background, composition, lens distance, perspective, camera angle, light, shadow, tone, spatial structure, and original photography style. Retain the original person herself and her original face, sense of age, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, body proportions, body type, clothing, position, and main posture; do not swap faces, do not re-beautify, do not change the identity of the original person. Naturally add another woman next to the original person, set as her identical twin sister. The newly added person must be based on the original person herself, maintaining the same face shape, facial structure, sense of age, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, body type, body proportions, and overall temperament; the two must look like real twins at first glance, not two similar models. Do not simply copy and paste. The newly added person can have very slight changes in head angle, gaze, hand movements, and body orientation to make the twin relationship more real and natural. The two are close together, showing a slight snuggle or a slight hug. The contact between the two people's arms, shoulders, hair, clothes, and bodies must comply with real physical relationships; no clipping or incorrect overlapping allowed. The final effect should look as if these twins existed in the original scene from the start of the shoot. Maintain a realistic photography feel, natural skin texture, real hair strands, correct human body structure, and real perspective. Avoid anime faces, CGI, plastic skin, copy-paste feel, mirror-image feel, wrong fingers, wrong limbs, body fusion, wrong perspective, major background changes, major clothing style changes, and obvious AI synthesis traces.

保留原图人物本人以及她原来的脸、年龄感、发型、发色、肤色、身材比例、体型、服装、位置和主要姿势，不要换脸、不要重新美化、不要改变原人物身份。

在原人物旁边自然增加另一位女性，设定为她的同卵双胞胎姐妹。新增人物必须基于原人物本人，保持相同的脸型、五官结构、年龄感、肤色、发型、发色、体型、身体比例和整体气质，两人一眼看上去必须是真实双胞胎，而不是两个相似模特。

不要简单复制粘贴。新增人物可以在头部角度、眼神、手部动作和身体朝向上有非常轻微的变化，使双胞胎关系更加真实自然。

两人距离较近，表现轻微依偎或轻微拥抱。可以让新增人物轻轻靠向原人物，肩膀贴近，手臂轻轻搭在肩部、上臂或腰侧，动作柔和、克制、自然，不要过度拥抱，不要夸张肢体动作。

新增人物的服装必须保持与原人物相同的设计、剪裁、材质、结构和风格，只改变颜色。根据原服装颜色自动选择柔和的视觉补色，例如蓝色对应橙色或琥珀色、粉色对应薄荷绿、紫色对应黄绿色。补色要低饱和、协调、时尚，不要荧光或过度抢眼。

新增人物必须完全匹配原图光线，包括主光方向、阴影、皮肤高光、头发高光、衣服反光、环境反射和接地阴影。两个人的手臂、肩膀、头发、衣服和身体接触必须符合真实物理关系，不允许穿模或错误重叠。

最终效果应像这对双胞胎从拍摄开始就同时存在于原场景中。保持真实摄影感、自然皮肤纹理、真实发丝、正确人体结构和真实透视。避免动漫脸、CGI、塑料皮肤、复制感、镜像感、错误手指、错误四肢、人体融合、错误透视、背景大改、服装款式大改和明显 AI 合成痕迹。

items.title: 街头石板路坐姿成年女性背影抓拍
items.description: 成年女性在城市石板路上短暂休息时的高位背面手机抓拍，突出蜷坐姿态、露背系绳上衣、浅蓝牛仔裤与冷灰地面纹理。使用时上传人物参考图。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the identity reference for the main visible adult woman. Create a realistic candid smartphone street-fashion photograph of her taking a short rest while sitting low on cool gray stone pavement. Photograph from behind and slightly to her left, from a high diagonal overhead angle of about 55-70 degrees, not a flat 90-degree top view. Her face is mostly outside the frame; show only the back of her head, ears, neck, and a small cheek contour. She wears a black ultra-thin tie-style backless halter top with crossed strings and a small knot, light ice-blue low-rise loose-leg jeans with natural folds and a slight back sag, a tiny understated necklace and studs, and a matte black quilted bag at lower left.

Her dark brown to black hair is in a slightly messy bun with loose strands. Her torso curls forward toward both bent knees, shoulders naturally rounded and asymmetrical. One arm bends toward the upper left; the other overlaps the body. Keep the pose relaxed and weighted, never a straight-backed model pose. Use a low-saturation urban daily-life mood, overcast or building-shadow natural light, softly warm skin against cool bluish-gray paving, gentle shadows, subtle smartphone sharpness and sensor noise, and ordinary detail across both person and pavement. Frame her slightly right of center in a vertical portrait, with the head near the top, back dominant in the middle, jeans near the lower quarter, and toes outside the frame. Keep the pavement's joints, scratches, stains, and grain visible. No front-facing portrait, direct gaze, studio lighting, strong sun, excessive retouching, extreme proportions, plastic skin, heavy blur, logos, UI, or text.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见成年女性的身份依据。创作一张真实的手机街头时装抓拍：她在冷灰色石板路上低坐休息。相机从她背后略偏左的位置，以约 55-70 度的高位斜俯角拍摄，不是完全 90 度的正上方。她的脸大部分在画面外，只显示后脑勺、耳朵、颈部和少量脸颊轮廓。她穿黑色极细系绳露背挂脖上衣，细绳交叉并在背部打一个小结；下身是浅冰蓝色低腰宽松牛仔裤，保留自然褶皱和背部轻微松垮；佩戴低调的细项链和耳钉，画面左下放一个哑光黑色绗缝包。

她将黑色至深棕色头发随意扎成略微凌乱的丸子头，留有碎发。躯干向前蜷曲靠近弯曲的双膝，肩膀自然前卷且左右不对称；一只手臂向左上方弯曲，另一只与身体重叠。姿势要有身体重量带来的自然下沉感，不能是背部挺直的模特姿势。整体为低饱和都市日常氛围，使用阴天或建筑阴影下的大面积自然光，让略暖的皮肤与偏蓝的冷灰石板形成色温差；保留柔和阴影、轻微手机锐度、细微传感器噪点，以及人物和地面的普通细节。竖幅构图，人物略偏画面右侧，头部靠上，背部占据中央最大面积，牛仔裤位于下四分之一，脚尖在画面外。清楚保留石板接缝、擦痕、污渍和颗粒感。不要正面肖像、直视镜头、棚拍光、强烈阳光、过度修图、极端比例、塑料皮肤、强烈虚化、标志、界面或文字。

items.title: 压角构图文化展览海报设计
items.description: 以压角构图把边缘文字与图形压力引向中心主体的可复用文化展览海报模板，支持主题、标题、颜色和机构信息替换。
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical cultural-exhibition poster with a mature editorial graphic-design temperament. Set the theme to “Lotus Lantern Gathering” (a traditional lotus-lantern exhibition), the Chinese main title to “莲灯映古城”, the English title to “Lotus Lantern Gathering”, and the central subject to “a complete lotus-lantern installation” (a complete lotus-lantern installation). Use “dual-corner diagonal pressure” as the edge-pressure method; place “large Chinese characters and archival information panels” in the corners; use one auxiliary pattern genuinely related to the theme, “subtle lotus-petal archival linework”; set the main palette to “warm ivory, vermilion, and charcoal”, accent color to “jade green”, and date/organization line to “2026 / CITY CULTURE ARCHIVE”.

The idea is not merely to put text in four corners: large Chinese typography, color blocks, information panels, or patterns at the edges should apply inward visual pressure and naturally squeeze out the central subject. Keep the central subject complete, stable, and responsible for about 40%-60% of the visual weight; never tilt or deform it to fit the layout. For four-corner pressure, establish hierarchy with 1-2 dominant corners; for diagonal pressure, make two diagonal corners primary and keep the other two informational; for a three-corner wrap, deliberately release one corner; for single-corner heavy pressure, let a smaller diagonal element respond. Large Chinese type may crop at an edge or lightly overlap the subject, but must remain clearly legible. Concentrate the English title, date, organization, and theme description in 2-3 areas, creating hierarchy through extra-large Chinese type, medium English type, and tiny information. The background must not be completely blank: add only very faint theme patterns, archival information, structural diagrams, material textures, or explanatory traces, never competing with the subject. Keep information density medium-high but ordered: first read subject and corner pressure, second the Chinese title, third the English, date, and supporting information. The poster must remain a valid visual work even if small text is removed.
items.prompt_zh:
制作一张 9:16 竖幅、具有成熟文化展览与编辑平面设计气质的压角构图海报。主题为“Lotus Lantern Gathering（传统莲花灯展）”，中文主标题为“莲灯映古城”，英文标题为“Lotus Lantern Gathering”，中心主体为“a complete lotus-lantern installation（完整的莲花灯装置）”。采用“dual-corner diagonal pressure”的边缘压迫方式，角部使用“large Chinese characters and archival information panels”；只使用一套与主题真实相关的辅助纹样“subtle lotus-petal archival linework”，主色调为“warm ivory, vermilion, and charcoal”，强调色为“jade green”，日期/机构信息为“2026 / CITY CULTURE ARCHIVE”。

核心不是简单把文字放进四角，而是利用边缘的大型中文字体、色块、信息区或图案向内施加视觉压力，自然“夹”出中心主体。中心主体保持完整、稳定并承担约 40%-60% 的视觉重量，不为配合构图故意倾斜或变形。四角压迫时要有主次，1-2 个角承担主要重量；对角压迫时两个对角为主、另外两角只放小信息；三角围压时保留一个轻角；单角重压时由对角小元素回应。大型中文标题可局部裁边、贴边或与主体轻微叠压，但必须清晰可读。英文标题、日期、机构和主题说明集中在 2-3 个区域，以超大中文、中号英文和极小信息形成清晰层级。背景不可完全空白，可加入极淡的主题纹样、档案信息、结构图、材料纹理或说明残影，但不抢主体。信息密度中高而不杂乱：第一眼读主体与压角关系，第二眼读中文标题，第三眼读英文、日期和辅助信息。即使移除小字，画面仍应是一张成立的文化展览海报。

items.title: 黑底东方古典白衣红花俯拍肖像
items.description: 以配置的人物参考图绑定主角身份的黑底东方古典白衣红花俯拍时装肖像，强调三朵深红花、黑白红配色与自然的 Soran 微型文字细节。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

3:4 vertical ratio, realistic Oriental classical fashion portrait, a young East Asian woman lying on a pure black background, the camera is vertically overhead for a top-down shot, the body naturally unfolds along the diagonal of the frame, the head is at the bottom of the frame and inverted facing the camera, the neck is slightly tilted back, eyes quietly look near the lens, lips are slightly parted, expression is dazed, restrained, and sleepwalking.

The character has deep brown-black ultra-long straight hair, the hair naturally spreads from the back of the head to the left, right, and bottom, with some edges blending into the black background, retaining only the highlights of real hair strands. Wearing multi-layered ancient-style long clothing in ivory white and cool white, thin translucent gauze layers, soft satin inner layers, wide sleeves and large areas of natural folds spreading outwards, retaining only very few light gold patterns; wearing several layers of creamy white pearl chain jewelry at the shoulders and neck, dense but restrained.

Only three huge realistic deep red flowers are placed around the character, visually close to giant camellias, herbaceous peonies, or peonies, with heavy petals unfolding layer by layer, a combination of deep vermilion, crimson, and dark scarlet, with realistic stamens. The three flowers form an irregular triangular composition, one near the character's lower left shoulder, one in the upper right, and one partially entering from the edge of the upper left frame, huge in size but strictly controlled in quantity, avoiding even arrangement.

Pure black textureless background, soft overhead spotlight, soft top directional light only illuminates the character's face, white clothes, and red flowers, the background remains deep black, the white clothes retain gauze transparency and wrinkle details, and the red flowers maintain dark layers without being over-saturated. 50 to 85mm top-view photography, overhead fashion portrait, top-down composition, white sheer historical dress, giant red flowers, low-key studio photography, deep blacks, soft directional light, natural skin texture, subtle film grain, slight film softness, live-action photography, minimalist combined colors of black, white, and red, quiet, eerie and beautiful, classical, installation art sense.

Soran three-layer natural watermark: Clearly readable "Soran" micro-engraved on the small old silver connection of the pearl shoulder decoration near the side of the face; hidden Soran integrated into the pearl arcs, white clothing folds, black hair scattering tracks, and red flower petal textures; micro Soran naturally formed by pearl highlight nodes, yarn intersections, hair strands, stamen arrangements, and film grain.

Negative prompts:
Standing figure, sitting posture, eye-level camera, oblique overhead shot, complex scene, floor texture, bed, palace background, sea of flowers, a large number of small flowers, more than three main flowers, flowers arranged equidistantly, fluorescent red, high-saturation composite colors, complex gold jewelry, gorgeous phoenix crown, white clothes fully embroidered, magic light effects, petal rain, smoke, hard flash, ultra-wide-angle body distortion, plastic flowers, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, anime style, CG style, external watermark, sticker-like logo, detached letters, captions, subtitles.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物参考图作为画面中唯一主要可见人物的面部身份参考。除身份适配外，保留原场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线与视觉风格。

3:4 竖幅，写实东方古典时装肖像。一名年轻东亚成年女性躺在纯黑背景上，镜头垂直俯拍，身体沿画面对角线自然展开；头部位于画面下方，倒置朝向镜头，颈部略微后仰，双眼安静地看向镜头附近，嘴唇微张，神情迷离、克制，像在梦游。

她有深棕黑色、超长、笔直的头发，头发从后脑向左、右和下方自然散开，部分发梢融入黑色背景，只保留真实发丝的高光。她穿多层古典长衣，颜色为象牙白与冷白，包含轻薄半透明纱层、柔软缎面内层、宽袖和向外铺展的自然褶皱，只保留极少量浅金色纹样；肩部和颈部佩戴数层奶油白珍珠链饰，层次丰富但克制。

人物周围只放置三朵巨大的写实深红色花朵，可接近山茶、草本牡丹或牡丹，花瓣厚重并逐层展开，颜色由深朱红、深红和暗猩红组成，带有真实花蕊。三朵花构成不规则三角形：一朵靠近人物左下肩部，一朵位于右上方，另一朵从左上边缘部分进入画面；花朵尺寸很大，但数量严格限定为三朵，避免均匀排列。

背景保持纯黑且无纹理。使用柔和的顶部聚光和柔和的顶向光，只照亮人物面部、白色服装与红花，背景保持深黑；白衣保留纱层透明感和褶皱细节，红花保留暗部层次，避免过度饱和。50至85毫米俯拍摄影，自然皮肤纹理，细微胶片颗粒，轻微胶片柔化，真实摄影质感，安静、诡谲而优雅的古典装置艺术氛围，整体只使用黑、白、红三种主色。

Soran 三层自然微型文字：在面部侧旁珍珠肩饰的小型旧银连接件上，清晰可读地微雕 “Soran”；将隐藏的 Soran 自然融入珍珠弧线、白色衣褶、黑发散落轨迹和红花花瓣纹理；再由珍珠高光节点、纱线交叉、发丝、花蕊排列和胶片颗粒自然形成微型 Soran。

避免：站立、坐姿、平视镜头、斜向俯拍、复杂场景、地面纹理、床、宫殿背景、花海、大量小花、超过三朵主花、等距排列的花朵、荧光红、高饱和混合色、复杂金饰、华丽凤冠、满幅刺绣白衣、魔法光效、花瓣雨、烟雾、硬闪、超广角造成的身体变形、塑料花、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、动漫风、CG 风、外部水印、贴纸式标志、脱离语境的字母、字幕或标题。

items.title: NOVA SELF 极简主义黑白时尚海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a flagship fashion-poster campaign for an original youth style brand named "NOVA SELF". Use an ultra-realistic editorial portrait style fused with bold graphic typography and minimal grayscale poster design. Preserve the core structural logic exactly: a tall vertical poster, a clean soft-gray background, one central young woman in a slightly low-angle mid-shot, two oversized hands thrust close to the lens from the upper left and upper right creating dramatic foreshortening and soft motion blur, one sharp geometric outline frame around the face, one huge condensed English hero word dominating the lower half, one smaller elegant headline block above it on the left, one tiny sparkle icon accent near the text, and one thin micro-copy line along the bottom. The final image must feel like a Cannes-level youth-fashion identity poster: bold, self-possessed, graphic, contemporary, and instantly memorable.

Style lock:
High-end youth fashion editorial, grayscale poster photography, graphic-design-led campaign, minimal studio background, strong typographic hierarchy, subtle magazine energy, premium print finish, self-expression branding, clean visual aggression.

Core composition:
Keep the woman centered slightly above the midpoint, facing the viewer with calm confidence and a faint half-smile. Her upper body must remain sharp while the hands closest to the lens become oversized, blurred, and spatially dominant, framing the face without hiding it. Place a thin angular polygon outline around the face area, tilted slightly for tension and modernity. The lower half must be anchored by one giant condensed uppercase word stretching vertically and occupying most of the width. Above it, place a smaller two-line headline aligned left. Preserve generous breathing room and a clean poster field.

Model direction:
Use one adult young woman with natural anatomy, realistic head-neck-shoulder proportion, slim youthful build, correct arm length, natural hands with five fingers each, clear knuckle logic, subtle skin texture, authentic lips, and softly tousled short-to-medium dark brown hair. Expression should feel self-assured, direct, cool, and quietly rebellious. No exaggerated glamour, no doll-like face, no distorted limbs.

Pose and motion:
The woman leans slightly forward toward the camera. Both arms extend aggressively into the foreground so the hands become the nearest objects, creating a pressure-frame around the face. The head stays centered and sharp while the hands and fingers carry slight motion blur, as if she is pushing through the poster plane. The pose must communicate self-definition, energy, and personal agency.

Lighting:
Use soft frontal studio lighting with a gentle upper-left bias, subtle fill from the right, and low-contrast shadow behavior. Keep the face clear, luminous, and naturally dimensional. Let the hands fall slightly softer due to lens depth and motion blur. Maintain a clean editorial grayscale tonality with soft highlight rolloff and no muddy blacks.

Materials and realism:
Render skin with natural pores, mild tonal variation, realistic lip texture, soft peach-fuzz subtlety, and no plastic retouching. Render hair with fine strand separation and light movement. Clothing should feel like a soft fitted ribbed tee with a slightly worn premium cotton texture. The geometric outline should feel like a clean vector overlay, crisp and modern, not hand-drawn.

Color strategy:
Base palette should be monochrome and desaturated: soft gray, charcoal, off-white, and muted black. Add one restrained cool accent color only in the geometric face outline, such as pale electric blue. Keep the poster elegant and minimal so the accent line feels intentional and sharp.

Typography and layout:
Use original English text only. Suggested text direction:
small headline: "OWN / YOUR LIGHT"
hero word: "UNBOUND"
bottom micro-line: one short original statement in tiny sans serif.
The giant hero word must be tall, condensed, bold, and architectural. The smaller headline should use a refined serif or fashion-display type. Keep all wording original, globally marketable, and never copied from any existing poster.

Graphic atmosphere:
The image should feel like self-expression breaking through structure. The oversized blurred hands create energy and disruption; the polygon frame stabilizes the face as the identity core. The typography must work as part of the composition, not as an afterthought.

Quality target:
Hyper-detailed, high-resolution fashion print finish, sharp facial focus, believable depth-of-field falloff, premium grayscale control, crisp typography integration, clean vector overlay, no visual clutter, strong poster readability.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

为名为“NOVA SELF”的原创青年风格品牌创作一套旗舰级时尚海报。使用超现实的编辑肖像风格，融合大胆的图形排版和极简的灰度海报设计。精确保留核心结构逻辑：一张高窄的垂直海报，干净的浅灰色背景，一名中心位置的年轻女性的中景低视角镜头，两只巨大的手从左上角和右上角靠近镜头冲出，产生戏剧性的透视收缩和柔和的运动模糊，脸部周围有一个锐利的几何轮廓框，一个巨大的压缩英文核心单词占据下半部分，左上方有一个较小的优雅标题块，文字附近有一个微小的星光图标点缀，底部有一条细微的微型文字行。最终图像必须感觉像是戛纳级别的青年时尚身份海报：大胆、沉着、图形化、现代且令人过目不忘。

风格锁定：
高端青年时尚编辑风格，灰度海报摄影，图形设计主导的宣传活动，极简工作室背景，强大的排版层次，微妙的杂志感活力，优质印刷质感，自我表达品牌化，干净的视觉冲击力。

核心构图：
保持女性略高于中点居中，以冷静自信的神情和淡淡的半微笑面对观众。她的上半身必须保持清晰，而靠近镜头的双手变得巨大、模糊并在空间上占据主导地位，框架住脸部但不遮挡。在脸部区域放置一个细长的多边形轮廓框，略微倾斜以增加张力和现代感。下半部分必须由一个巨大的压缩大写单词锚定，垂直拉伸并占据大部分宽度。在其上方，放置一个靠左对齐的较小的两行标题。保留充足的呼吸空间和干净的海报区域。

模特指导：
使用一名成年年轻女性，具有自然的解剖结构，写实的头颈肩比例，纤细青春的体态，正确的臂长，各有五根手指的自然双手，清晰的指节逻辑，微妙的皮肤纹理，真实的嘴唇，以及柔顺凌乱的深棕色中短发。表情应感到自信、直接、酷炫且带有安静的叛逆。没有夸张的魅力，没有洋娃娃般的脸庞，没有扭曲的肢体。

姿势与动态：
女性向相机微微前倾。双臂积极地伸向前台，使双手成为最近的物体，围绕脸部形成一个压力框架。头部保持居中且锐利，而手和手指带有轻微的运动模糊，仿佛她正在冲破海报平面。姿势必须传达自我定义、能量和个人代理感。

灯光：
使用柔和的正面工作室照明，带有温和的左上方偏置，右侧有微妙的补光，以及低对比度的阴影表现。保持面部清晰、明亮且具有自然的立体感。由于镜头深度和运动模糊，让手部显得稍微柔和。保持干净的编辑灰度色调，具有柔和的高光衰减，没有浑浊的黑色。

材质与写实度：
渲染具有自然毛孔、轻微色调变化、真实唇部纹理、柔软细微汗毛且没有塑料感修图的皮肤。渲染具有纤细发丝分离和轻微动感的头发。服装应感觉像一件带有略微磨损的优质棉纹理的柔软合身罗纹 T 恤。几何轮廓应感觉像干净的矢量叠加，锐利且现代，而非手绘。

色彩策略：
基础色调应为单色和去饱和度：浅灰色、炭灰色、米白色和柔和的黑色。仅在几何脸部轮廓中添加一种克制的冷色调点缀，如淡电光蓝。保持海报优雅极简，使点缀线显得刻意且锐利。

排版与布局：
仅使用原始英文文本。建议的文本方向：
小标题：“OWN / YOUR LIGHT”
核心单词：“UNBOUND”
底部微型行：一行简短的原始陈述，采用微小的无衬线字体。
巨大的核心单词必须高大、压缩、加粗且具有建筑感。较小的标题应使用精致的衬线体或时尚展示字体。保持所有措辞原创，具有全球市场竞争力，且绝不抄袭任何现有海报。

图形氛围：
图像应感觉像自我表达突破了结构。巨大的模糊双手创造了能量和破坏力；多边形框稳定了作为身份核心的脸部。排版必须作为构图的一部分，而不是事后的想法。

质量目标：
超详细，高分辨率时尚印刷质感，清晰的面部焦点，可信的景深衰减，优质灰度控制，脆爽的排版集成，干净的矢量叠加，无视觉杂乱，强大的海报可读性。

负面提示：
抄袭的标语，抄袭的标题，混乱的布局，微弱的面部焦点，变形的手，多余的手指，缺失的手指，融合的手指，断裂的手腕，扭曲的手臂，塑料皮肤，过度平滑的脸，浑浊的灰度，肮脏的背景，难以阅读的排版，廉价的杂志感，微弱的运动模糊，面部过度模糊，低分辨率细节，杂乱的图形，随机道具，黑色斑块

items.title: 奢华欧洲水城时尚旅行街拍大片提示词
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

VIRAL LUXURY TRAVEL + FASHION IMAGE

Create an ultra-photorealistic, scroll-stopping luxury travel fashion scene set in a breathtaking [EUROPEAN CANAL CITY / HISTORIC OLD-TOWN WATERFRONT / ROMANTIC EUROPEAN STREET] during [GOLDEN HOUR / BLUE HOUR / SUNSET].

Show a beautiful canal flowing through elegant historic architecture, charming narrow buildings, decorative balconies filled with flowers, warm glowing café windows, vintage street lamps, small bridges, subtle bicycles, stylish outdoor seating, lush greenery, and realistic reflections shimmering across the water.

MAIN SUBJECT:
Place one extremely attractive and photogenic [FEMALE / MALE] fashion model on the [LEFT SIDE / RIGHT SIDE / FOREGROUND CORNER].

The model should have:
[HAIR STYLE]
[HAIR COLOR]
[ELEGANT FACIAL LOOK]
[NATURAL PREMIUM MAKEUP]
[OUTFIT STYLE]
[OUTFIT COLOR]
[ACCESSORIES]
[FOOTWEAR]

STYLE THE MODEL:
Dress the model in a sophisticated [LUXURY COUTURE / MODERN EUROPEAN FASHION / TAILORED SMART-LUXURY / HIGH-END STREET FASHION] outfit with premium fabrics, realistic folds, refined tailoring, tasteful jewelry, and a fashionable editorial appearance.

POSE:
[NATURALLY WALKING BESIDE THE CANAL / STANDING NEAR A RAILING / LOOKING TOWARD THE WATER / ADJUSTING A COAT / HOLDING A SMALL DESIGNER-STYLE HANDBAG / RELAXED CANDID POSE]

The pose should feel elegant, effortless, confident, and natural — like a luxury global fashion campaign.

COMPOSITION:
Create a cinematic wide composition with a rich foreground, layered middle ground, and deep atmospheric background.

Use [CANAL / BRIDGE / COBBLESTONE STREET / RAILING / BUILDING LINES] as strong leading lines.

Add premium foreground details such as [FLOWER-FILLED BICYCLE / CAFÉ TABLE / VINTAGE LAMP / DECORATIVE RAILING / FLOWER PLANTERS / WET COBBLESTONES].

LIGHTING:
Beautiful cinematic lighting with [WARM GOLDEN SUNLIGHT], soft cool shadows, subtle rim light around the model, glowing windows, realistic reflections, soft atmospheric haze, and natural skin illumination.

COLOR PALETTE:
Rich but realistic [CHAMPAGNE GOLD], [DEEP TEAL], [SOFT BLUSH PINK], [WARM AMBER], [RICH GREEN], and [SUBTLE CINEMATIC BLUE].

CAMERA:
High-end full-frame photography, [35MM / 50MM] lens, realistic perspective, professional fashion editorial framing, high dynamic range, crisp details, natural depth of field, realistic background separation.

VISUAL STYLE:
Luxury travel photography × high-fashion editorial × cinematic lifestyle photography × premium social-media aesthetic × viral Pinterest-style imagery.

MOOD:
[ROMANTIC / DREAMY / LUXURIOUS / SOPHISTICATED / PEACEFUL / CINEMATIC]

QUALITY:
Ultra-realistic skin texture, natural facial proportions, realistic hair strands, anatomically correct hands, believable clothing texture, authentic architecture, natural reflections, realistic shadows, and true-to-life lighting.

No text.
No logos.
No watermark.
No social media UI.
No screenshot borders.
No duplicated people.
No distorted face.
No deformed hands.
No plastic-looking skin.
No obvious CGI appearance.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

病毒式奢华旅行 + 时尚图像

创建一个超逼真、令人屏息的奢华旅行时尚场景，背景设在[黄金时刻 / 蓝调时刻 / 日落]期间令人惊叹的[欧洲运河城市 / 历史悠久的旧城海滨 / 浪漫的欧洲街道]。

展示一条流经优雅历史建筑的美丽运河、迷人的窄楼、开满鲜花的装饰性阳台、发出温暖光芒的咖啡馆窗户、复古路灯、小桥、细微的自行车、时尚的户外座椅、茂盛的绿植，以及水面上闪烁的逼真倒影。

主体：
在[左侧 / 右侧 / 前景角落]放置一位极具吸引力且上镜的[女性 / 男性]时尚模特。

模特应具有：
[发型]
[发色]
[优雅的面部表情]
[自然的高级妆容]
[服装风格]
[服装颜色]
[配饰]
[鞋类]

模特造型：
为模特穿上精致的[奢侈高定 / 现代欧洲时尚 / 定制精英奢华 / 高端街头时尚]服装，采用优质面料、逼真的褶皱、精细的剪裁、雅致的珠宝，呈现时尚杂志编辑风。

姿势：
[在运河边自然行走 / 站在栏杆旁 / 望向水面 / 整理外套 / 提着一个小巧的设计师风格手提包 / 放松的抓拍姿势]

姿势应显得优雅、毫不费力、自信且自然 —— 就像一场奢华的全球时尚运动。

构图：
创建一个电影般的宽幅构图，具有丰富的前景、层次分明的中景和深邃的大气背景。

使用[运河 / 桥梁 / 鹅卵石街道 / 栏杆 / 建筑线条]作为强有力的引导线。

添加高级的前景细节，如[装满鲜花的自行车 / 咖啡桌 / 复古灯 / 装饰性栏杆 / 花盆 / 湿润的鹅卵石]。

光影：
美丽的电影级光效，带有[温暖的金色阳光]、柔和的冷色调阴影、模特周围微妙的边缘光、发光的窗户、逼真的倒影、柔和的大气薄雾和自然的皮肤光泽。

调色板：
丰富且写实的[香槟金]、[深青色]、[柔和的粉红色]、[琥珀色]、[浓郁的绿色]和[微妙的电影感蓝色]。

相机：
高端全画幅摄影，[35MM / 50MM]镜头，逼真的视角，专业的时尚杂志排版，高动态范围，锐利的细节，自然的景深，逼真的背景分离。

视觉风格：
奢华旅行摄影 × 高端时尚编辑 × 电影感生活方式摄影 × 高级社交媒体美学 × 病毒式 Pinterest 风格影像。

氛围：
[浪漫 / 梦幻 / 奢华 / 精致 / 宁静 / 电影感]

质量：
超逼真的皮肤纹理、自然的面部比例、真实的头发丝、符合解剖学的双手、可信的服装质感、真实的建筑、自然的倒影、逼真的阴影和真实的光影。

无文字。
无徽标。
无水印。
无社交媒体界面。
无截图边框。
无重复的人员。
无扭曲的面部。
无变形的手。
无塑料感皮肤。
无明显的 CGI 外观。

items.title: 邮政几何建筑邮票生成指令
items.description: 16:9的2x2邮政几何建筑板，以1899东京、1925巴黎、1950新德里和1960巴西利亚四个具体通信文化场，分别展开齿孔邮票、火漆、邮资戳与麻绳标签空间。
items.prompt:
Create a 16:9 architectural concept board in a clean 2x2 grid. Each quadrant is a complete room-scale postal diorama derived from one specific country, era and correspondence culture. Show no people; communicate each writing or sending ritual through arranged furniture, tools, letters and parcels. Keep all four rooms equally sized and fully visible.

Correspondence culture field: translate pen strokes, folded paper and the imagined walk to a postbox into directional room geometry; translate wax-seal swirls, twine loops and postmark rings into curved circulation; translate the density of ink, stamps, paper and sealing tools into the visual density of each interior. Avoid generic nostalgia and select exactly the four gates below.

Gate 1 — Japan, Tokyo, Meiji era, 1899; perforated postage-stamp geometry. Create a serrated-edge writing room in which stamp perforations become rhythmic timber wall pillars and a stylized Mount Fuji stamp vignette becomes the main window mural. Furnish it with a low writing desk, brush rest, inkstone, washi envelopes and a red cylindrical street postbox visible outside. Imply the ritual of folding and addressing a letter through the ordered objects. Use cedar, dark lacquer, cream washi and vermilion accents in clear early-morning light.

Gate 2 — France, Paris, Art Deco era, 1925; wax-seal geometry. Create a domed correspondence salon in which an enlarged seal impression forms the ceiling relief and a flowing burgundy ribbon becomes a curved stair rail. Include a walnut writing bureau, brass letter tray, fountain pen, cream envelopes, sealing wax and a small parcel. Through the window show a geometric Paris boulevard at dusk. Use walnut, brass, burgundy velvet, ivory paper and warm amber lamps to imply the ritual of sealing a formal letter.

Gate 3 — India, New Delhi, early post-independence era, 1950; meter and frank-mark geometry. Create a grid-modular post office in which horizontal franking bars become structural ceiling beams and postmark circles become service-window openings. Include a terrazzo counter, teak sorting cabinet, manual franking machine, canvas mailbag, ink pad and neatly stacked aerogrammes. Through the window show a railway mail platform in bright midday haze. Use sandstone, terrazzo, teak, brass and faded blue-green paper tones to imply weighing, franking and sorting outgoing mail.

Gate 4 — Brazil, Brasília, modernist era, 1960; twine-and-shipping-tag geometry. Create a suspended parcel house in which taut twine becomes rafters and rigging, while an oversized shipping-tag hole becomes the arched doorway. Include a molded plywood packing table, kraft-paper parcels, cotton twine, scissors and blank routing tags. Through the opening show Brasília's new civic skyline in golden late-afternoon light. Use raw concrete, pale plywood, kraft cardboard, cotton rope and cobalt-blue accents to imply wrapping, tying and dispatching a parcel.

Render all four gates as highly detailed miniature architectural models with tactile paper fibers, ink, wood grain, metal patina, cloth, wax, rope and concrete. Use a consistent slightly elevated three-quarter camera angle, controlled product-photography lighting and crisp separation between quadrants. Preserve each postal geometry transformation exactly. No people, faces, hands, extra gates, mixed countries or eras, random objects, legible brand names, logos, watermarks, gibberish text, cropped rooms or decorative outer border.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一块 16:9 建筑概念板，采用整洁的 2x2 网格。每个象限都是由一个具体国家、时代和通信文化推导出的完整房间尺度邮政微缩场景。不得出现人物；仅通过布置好的家具、工具、信件和包裹表现书写或寄送仪式。四个房间大小相等并完整入镜。

通信文化场：把笔触、折叠纸张和想象中走向邮筒的路径转化为定向空间几何；把火漆漩涡、麻绳环和邮戳圆环转化为曲线动线；把墨水、邮票、纸张和封装工具的密度转化为室内视觉密度。避免泛化怀旧，并只采用下列四个明确 gate。

Gate 1——日本东京，明治时代，1899 年；齿孔邮票几何。创建锯齿边缘写信室：邮票齿孔变成有节奏的木质墙柱，富士山邮票插图变成主窗壁画。布置矮书桌、笔搁、砚台、和纸信封，窗外可见红色圆柱邮筒。通过有序物件暗示折信和写地址的仪式。使用雪松、深色漆器、米白和纸与朱红点缀，采用清澈晨光。

Gate 2——法国巴黎，装饰艺术时代，1925 年；火漆几何。创建圆顶通信沙龙：放大的封印压痕形成天花浮雕，流动的酒红丝带形成弧形楼梯扶手。加入胡桃木写字台、黄铜信盘、钢笔、米白信封、火漆和小包裹。窗外是黄昏时分的几何化巴黎街道。使用胡桃木、黄铜、酒红天鹅绒、象牙纸和暖琥珀灯光，暗示封缄正式信件的仪式。

Gate 3——印度新德里，独立初期，1950 年；邮资机印与邮资戳几何。创建网格模块化邮局：水平邮资条纹变成天花结构梁，邮戳圆环变成服务窗口。加入水磨石柜台、柚木分拣柜、手动邮资机、帆布邮袋、印台和整齐叠放的航空邮简。窗外是明亮正午薄雾中的铁路邮件站台。使用砂岩、水磨石、柚木、黄铜和褪色蓝绿色纸张，暗示称重、盖资和分拣外寄邮件的流程。

Gate 4——巴西巴西利亚，现代主义时代，1960 年；麻绳与货运标签几何。创建悬吊包裹屋：绷紧麻绳变成椽子和索具，放大的货运标签孔变成拱形门洞。加入模压胶合板打包桌、牛皮纸包裹、棉绳、剪刀和空白路由标签。门外是金色午后光中的巴西利亚新城天际线。使用清水混凝土、浅色胶合板、牛皮纸板、棉绳和钴蓝点缀，暗示包裹的包装、捆扎与发运。

将四个 gate 渲染为高度精细的微缩建筑模型，清楚表现纸纤维、墨水、木纹、金属包浆、织物、火漆、绳索和混凝土触感。统一采用略高的四分之三视角、受控产品摄影光和清晰象限分隔。严格保留每项邮政几何转换。不得出现人物、面孔、手、额外 gate、国家或时代混用、随机物件、可读品牌名、标志、水印、乱码文字、被裁切房间或装饰性外边框。

items.title: 东方女性清纯生活照写实人像花房咖啡馆
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Generate a 3:4 vertical, pure lifestyle photo style realistic female portrait, to be used as an X visual illustration. The subject is a 24–28 year old Oriental female with a clear sense of adulthood, featuring a realistic and attractive Oriental "light-featured" face, clear apricot eyes, soft eyebrow shapes, natural nose and lips, transparent light makeup, and natural skin texture; the temperament is gentle, bright, natural, and approachable, mature but not old-fashioned. On a spring afternoon, she sits naturally in a sun-drenched glass flower house cafe, her body slightly facing the tabletop, with relaxed shoulders and neck. Her hands have just gently pushed a plate of strawberry cake toward the center of the cream-colored tabletop, the movement being continuous and natural; her head is slightly turned toward the window, her gaze passing over the camera to look at the light pink flower shadows outside the window, like a moment accidentally captured in real life. The figure is natural and coordinated, the sitting posture is relaxed, and curves are not intentionally emphasized. She wears a cream-white soft knit low-collar cardigan, the inner layer is a complete, opaque mist-pink undergarment, and the bottom is paired with a light apricot skirt; the knit texture is delicate and realistic, and the hem of the clothes stacks naturally with the sitting posture. Cream-white is the main color, mist-pink is the auxiliary color, and sage green is used only as a small amount of environmental accent, with an overall low saturation, clean and soft feel. Adopting a waist-up natural sitting posture and an eye-level perspective, the subject is located on the right side of the frame, with a clear subject and visual memory points; the left side retains the glass of the flower house, white gauze curtains, and mottled light and shadow to create a sense of breathing space. The foreground is a cream-colored tabletop and strawberry cake, the middle ground highlights the character, and the background consists of light pink flower shadows blurred by a shallow depth of field; the image is concise and eye-catching, suitable for X feed display. Using a cream warm white lifestyle movie still filter, the skin tone is realistic and natural, highlights are soft, shadows are transparent, with slight film grain and a sense of airiness; the overall look is aesthetic but resembles a real camera photo, without excessive retouching. Negative Constraints: Do not include text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, borders, collages, or multi-grid layouts; avoid studio photography feel, commercial headshot feel, influencer-style posing, exaggerated filters, excessive soft focus, plastic skin smoothing, mask-like makeup, childish or underage appearance; avoid vulgar postures, suggestive expressions, transparent inner layers, or exposure of private parts; do not center the subject, do not fill the left-side white space, and avoid cluttered backgrounds; avoid finger deformities, extra fingers, fused palms, incorrect joints, deformed cake plates, incorrect clothing structure, misaligned facial features, wax-like skin, CG feel, illustration style, overexposure turning white, or dirty yellow skin tones.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

生成一张 3:4 竖版、清纯生活照风格的写实女性人像，用作 X 视觉配图。人物是一位 24–28 岁、成年感明确的东方女性，真实耐看的东方淡颜，清亮杏眼，柔和眉形，自然鼻唇，清透淡妆与自然肤质；气质温柔、明亮、自然、亲近，成熟但不老气。    春日下午，她自然坐在洒满阳光的玻璃花房咖啡馆里，身体微微朝向桌面，肩颈放松。双手刚把一盘草莓蛋糕轻轻推向奶油色桌面中央，动作连贯自然；头部略转向窗边，视线越过镜头望向窗外淡粉色花影，像真实生活中被偶然捕捉的一瞬。    人物身形自然协调，坐姿舒展，不刻意强调曲线。穿奶油白柔软针织低领开衫，内层是完整、不透明的雾粉色内搭，下身搭配浅杏色短裙；针织纹理细腻真实，衣摆随坐姿自然堆叠。奶油白为主色，雾粉为辅色，鼠尾草绿仅作为少量环境点缀，整体低饱和、干净柔和。    采用大半身自然坐姿、平视视角，人物位于画面右侧，主体清晰、有视觉记忆点；左侧保留花房玻璃、白色纱帘与斑驳光影形成呼吸感。前景是奶油色桌面与草莓蛋糕，中景突出人物，后景为浅景深虚化的淡粉花影；画面简洁抓眼，适合 X 信息流展示。    午后柔和侧逆光从窗外斜落，在发丝、脸侧与针织边缘形成细腻金色轮廓光，面部保持柔和明亮，阴影过渡自然。采用奶油暖白生活剧照滤镜，肤色真实自然，高光柔和，暗部通透，带轻微胶片颗粒与空气感；整体唯美但像真实相机照片，不过度精修。    负面约束    不要文字、字幕、Logo、水印、边框、拼图、多宫格；不要影楼棚拍感、商业硬照感、网红摆拍、夸张滤镜、过度柔焦、塑料磨皮、假面妆、幼态或未成年感；不要低俗姿态、挑逗表情、透明内搭、暴露重点部位；不要人物居中、不要遮满左侧留白、不要杂乱背景；避免手指畸形、多余手指、融合手掌、错误关节、蛋糕盘变形、衣服结构错误、五官错位、蜡像皮肤、CG 感、插画感、过曝发白、脏黄肤色。

items.title: 贵州非遗服饰东方极繁主义时尚人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的明确成年女性高定时尚人像提示词。已压缩超长英文，同时保留贵州非遗服饰、花饰银饰、半身构图、姿势、镜头、建筑背景、光线、材质和负面约束。使用时需上传人物参考图，主可见人物的面部身份以该参考图为准。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Preserve the source styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting, and visual direction unless they conflict with identity.

9:16 vertical close-up half-body, ultra-high-definition photorealistic fashion editorial inspired by Guizhou ethnic intangible-heritage clothing and Oriental maximalism. Clearly adult East Asian woman, 18-20, tall slender model proportions, relaxed shoulders, slim waist, natural full but proportionate figure. Delicate realistic East Asian face with small head, oval shape, clear jaw and slightly pointed chin, balanced features, lively eyes, sweet playful high-end Oriental expression; no anime, CG, or generic influencer face.

Very fair cool-white porcelain skin with a subtle healthy pink glow, unified face/neck/shoulders/chest/arms, real pores, fine vellus hair and natural texture; no gray dead skin or plastic smoothing. Jet-black long hair in an orderly Guizhou-inspired updo with abundant white, pale-pink and light-cyan floral hairpins, traditional pins, silver jewelry, bead strings, tassels, pearls and handmade heritage accessories. Keep real chased metal texture, slight oxidation, restrained reflections, and detailed petals.

Wear Guizhou heritage-inspired clothing in white, moonlight white and light cyan-green, combining traditional embroidery, handmade brocade, silver ornaments, bead embroidery, frog buttons, tassels, tulle and floral decoration with high-end editorial tailoring. The upper garment has a clear deep V neckline and naturally fitted fabric with believable thickness, wrinkles, embroidery and tension. Relaxed front-to-three-quarter pose with an elegant curve: one hand lightly touches flowers, jewelry or tassels by the ear; the other rests lightly at the chest or waist. Look near the camera with a slight sweet smile, lazy playful high-fashion energy.

Frame the complete headpiece to near the waist, subject filling 75-85% of the frame. Use a 70-105mm portrait-lens perspective to avoid wide-angle distortion. Softly blurred Guizhou ethnic architecture remains recognizable: wooden stilt houses, traditional eaves, flagstone paths, distant green mountains and faint mist. Use soft cinematic side-front light, natural fill and a subtle rim light; keep face and eyes bright without overexposure, with delicate highlights on petals, jewelry, hair and embroidery and moist eye reflections.

Use a low-saturation Morandi palette of cool white, moonlight white, light cyan, pale pink, silver gray and restrained soft gold, with blue-gray green in the background. Shallow depth of field, soft aerial perspective, slight cinematic glow, fine film grain, high dynamic range, 8K photorealism.

Avoid full-body or distant framing, small figure, anime/2D/CG/3D face, oversized head or face, unbalanced proportions, severe wide-angle distortion, messy jewelry, floating hairpins, flowers covering eyes, cropped headpiece, cheap costume, plastic flowers, clothing clipping, limb deformity, extra arms/hands/fingers, yellow or dead skin, plastic skin, over-smoothing, overexposure, soft face focus, distracting background, low resolution, artifacts, text, logos or watermarks.
