9:16 竖版，近距离半身构图，超高清真人摄影 × 民族非遗服饰 × 东方极繁主义美学 × 高级时尚 Editorial。一位 18–20 岁、明确成年的漂亮东亚女性，身高约 1.70 米，拥有高挑纤细的模特比例、舒展肩颈与纤细腰身。胸部视觉约为自然 D 罩杯，丰满但不过度夸张，与整体身材自然协调。

人物拥有精致清秀的东亚女性真人脸，头部偏小、脸型小巧，精致鹅蛋脸，流畅清晰的下颌线与微尖下巴，三庭五眼比例协调，眉眼灵动，鼻梁精致自然。神态甜美、俏皮又带有高级东方美人的气质，避免动漫脸、CG脸和过度网红化面容。

肌肤强调超级白皙、极度通透的冷白瓷肌，属于非常明亮的冷白肤色。脸部、颈部、肩部、锁骨、胸前与手臂肤色自然统一，几乎没有明显黄调；在柔和光线下呈现晶莹细腻的瓷感与淡淡粉润血色，同时保留真实毛孔、细小绒毛和自然皮肤纹理，避免灰白、死白与塑料磨皮。

乌黑长发梳成具有贵州民族特色的精致盘发，重点强化极繁簪花头饰：大量白色、浅粉、淡青色花朵与传统发簪、银饰、珠串、流苏、珍珠、手工非遗饰件层层组合，造型华丽繁复但结构有序。银饰具有真实錾刻纹理、轻微氧化质感与细腻金属反光，花瓣纹理清晰真实。

人物身穿以白色、月白与浅青绿色为主体的贵州民族非遗灵感服饰，融合传统刺绣、手工织锦、银饰、珠绣、盘扣、流苏、薄纱与花卉装饰，并加入高级时装 Editorial 剪裁。

上身采用明显的深 V 低领设计，领口自然向下延伸，露出较多上胸、肩颈与清晰锁骨线条，自然呈现 D 罩杯视觉的丰满曲线。腰部适度收束，服装贴合身体但保持真实织物厚度、褶皱、刺绣与受力关系。

采用正面至轻微侧转的自然姿态，肩膀放松，上半身轻微转动形成优雅曲线。一只手自然抬起轻触耳侧簪花、银饰或流苏，另一只手可轻放胸前或腰侧。人物视线自然看向镜头附近，嘴角带轻微甜美笑意，呈现慵懒、俏皮、灵动又具有高级时尚感的状态。

采用 9:16 竖版近距离半身构图，从完整簪花头饰拍摄至腰部附近，人物占据画面约 75%–85%。重点突出真人面容、超级白皙肌肤、眼神、华丽簪花、银饰、肩颈锁骨、深 V 领口与上半身非遗服饰工艺。使用约 70–105mm 人像镜头视觉，避免广角造成头部、脸型或身体比例失真。

背景仍为贵州少数民族传统建筑群，可见自然虚化的木质吊脚楼、传统屋檐、石板路、远处青山与淡淡薄雾。由于采用半身近照，背景明显柔化，仅保留足够的贵州地域文化辨识度与空间层次。

采用电影级柔和侧前光 + 自然环境补光 + 极轻轮廓光。面部与眼睛精准明亮，冷白肌肤保持通透不过曝；侧光穿过簪花、银饰与发丝，在花瓣、珠串、肩颈与刺绣边缘形成细腻高光。眼睛具有真实湿润反光，银饰产生精致但克制的闪耀效果。

整体采用莫兰迪低饱和东方配色，以冷白、月白、浅青、淡粉、银灰与少量柔金为主体，背景加入青灰绿色。浅景深、柔和空气透视、轻微电影光晕、极细腻胶片颗粒，高动态范围。

超高清 8K 真人摄影，真实东亚女性面孔，小头小脸，超级白皙冷白瓷肌，自然 D 罩杯视觉，深 V 民族服饰，极繁簪花，大量精致非遗银饰，真实毛孔，清晰睫毛与发丝，真实花瓣、刺绣、织锦、薄纱与金属材质，高级贵州非遗文化 × 东方极繁主义 × 时尚杂志 Editorial 质感。

负面提示词： 全身照，远景，人物过小，动漫脸，二次元脸，CG脸，3D建模脸，大头，大脸，宽脸，胸部过度夸张，身体比例失衡，严重广角畸变，银饰结构混乱，簪花悬浮，花朵遮挡眼睛，头饰裁切，廉价影楼民族服装，塑料花朵，衣物穿模，肢体畸形，多余手臂，多手多指，肤色偏黄，灰白死皮，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，严重过曝，面部失焦，背景抢镜，低分辨率，AI 伪影，文字，Logo，水印。

items.title: 品牌条带放射渐变视觉海报设计
items.description: 3:4 抽象条带放射视觉海报：以 BRAND SYSTEM 为具体示例主题，右下单一放射中心向左上展开 16 条边界清晰、宽度递增的橄榄绿与雾白色带，结合纸艺、建筑遮阳与现代主义光学实验；使用英文主标题 RADIAL STRIPE STUDY、副标题 OPTICAL STRUCTURES / 01 和微参数 3:4 / 16 BANDS / 65% FIELD。
items.prompt:
Design a quiet, premium vertical 3:4 visual poster for BRAND SYSTEM. Use a low-saturation sage or gray-green background with restrained modern paper texture.

Place one radial center at the bottom right. From it, extend 16 fan-shaped stepped color bands, a representative value within the source range of 12–18 of increasing width toward the upper left, occupying about 65% of the frame. Keep every band boundary crisp and intentional; this is a graphic stripe system, not a soft diffuse gradient. Curve selected bands into concentric arcs to suggest folded paper, architectural shutters and optical ripples. Use deep olive green, gray-green and mist white in controlled stepwise transitions, keeping adjacent brightness differences subtle at about 5–10%. Add only a small warm yellow or light-apricot highlight at the radial center, no more than 5% of the image, as a physically motivated light cue.

Represent the bands as matte coated paper, translucent resin flakes, screen-print ink or thin layered paper structures with slight thickness, tiny projections and fine surface grain. Light arrives obliquely from the bottom right; all shadows share one direction and no element glows without a source.

In the upper-left negative space, set the exact main title "RADIAL STRIPE STUDY" in a medium-weight geometric sans-serif. If present, arrange "OPTICAL STRUCTURES / 01" along a restrained circular arc. Set "3:4 / 16 BANDS / 65% FIELD" in a small monospaced font. Keep only three information levels: main title, core graphic and micro-parameters. Use original English typography only and avoid dense copy.

The result should combine modernist optical experimentation, architectural shading structures and high-end paper art. Avoid rainbow gradients, liquid blur, metallic glare, random ripples, complex characters, dense text, unstructured abstract noise, extra logos and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
为 BRAND SYSTEM 设计一张安静、高级的 3:4 竖版视觉海报。使用低饱和鼠尾草绿或灰绿色背景，并加入克制的现代纸张纹理。

在画面右下方设置唯一放射中心，从中心向左上方延伸 16 条宽度递增的扇形阶梯色带（该具体值位于来源要求的 12–18 条范围内），占据画面约 65%。所有色带边界必须清晰且有意控制；这是图形化条带系统，不是柔软弥散的渐变。将部分色带弯曲为同心圆弧，形成纸张折叠、建筑百叶和光学波纹的空间暗示。使用深橄榄绿、灰绿色和雾白色进行受控的逐级变化，相邻色带明度差保持细微，约为 5–10%。仅在放射中心加入不超过画面 5% 的暖黄色或淡杏色高光，作为有物理来源的光线提示。

将色带表现为哑光涂层纸、半透明树脂薄片、丝网印刷油墨或薄层纸艺结构，具有轻微厚度、细小投影和表面颗粒。光线从右下方斜射，所有阴影保持同一方向，禁止没有来源的发光。

在左上方留白区使用中等粗度几何无衬线字体放置精确主标题“RADIAL STRIPE STUDY”。如有副标题，将“OPTICAL STRUCTURES / 01”沿克制的圆弧排列。使用小号等宽字体放置“3:4 / 16 BANDS / 65% FIELD”。信息层级只保留三层：主标题、核心图形和微型参数。仅使用原创英文排版，避免密集文案。

最终画面结合现代主义光学实验、建筑遮阳结构与高级纸艺海报。避免彩虹渐变、液态模糊、金属炫光、随机波纹、复杂人物、密集文字、无结构抽象噪声、额外标志和水印。

items.title: 工业海滨落日余晖成年女性三连帧摄影
items.description: 绑定10A身份的成年东亚女性以同一人物重复出现在9:16竖幅三连帧中，在工业海滨落日下夹挂衣物；桥体、渡轮、强逆光、负片胶片颗粒与真实皮肤纹理均完整保留。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded ref-10a-v1 image as the facial identity reference for the adult woman repeated in all three panels. Preserve the same recognizable face, skin tone and core proportions in every panel while keeping the specified haircut, wardrobe, pose and industrial-waterfront setting.

Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographic triptych made of three borderless full-width panels stacked from top to bottom. The same single adult East Asian woman appears once in each panel at a harbor edge during sunset. She maintains a calm upright side profile, looks into the distance toward frame left, keeps her mouth neutrally closed and moves with restraint. Her jet-black hair is a short bob tucked behind one ear with a soft matte finish; keep it strictly between jaw and collarbone length, allowing only bob, lob or compact tied geometry. Wind moves a few loose strands across her face and stirs the fabric.

In the top panel, use an eye-level, mildly compressed 70–100mm portrait-lens view with shallow depth of field for a close side-profile portrait. In the middle panel, use the same eye-level 70–100mm feeling for a closer waist-up view of her hands clipping a garment to a clothesline. In the bottom panel, use an eye-level 45–60mm environmental view that shows more of her body, the harbor and bridge. Keep natural perspective and no camera tilt. Preserve the precise body-to-camera relationship, leftward gaze, hand task and a subtle foreground obstruction from the clothesline or hanging garment without covering her face or working hands.

She wears a light taupe-gray knee-length coat with plain structured shoulders and natural wrinkles at the bent elbows and waist, a thick matte black scarf bunched irregularly around her neck and draped down her chest, and dark trousers visible as a low-contrast silhouette. Render wool, woven scarf and trouser materials with believable thickness, weave, folds and wind response.

Use an industrial riverfront or harbor at sunset. Calm muted blue-gray water spans the background. In the top and middle panels, place a white working ferry with an ochre-yellow lower band behind her, either moored or moving slowly. In the wide bottom panel, show a large bridge crossing diagonally from the upper left toward the distant shore, with three broad bridge spans clearly readable above the water and pale industrial structures receding into haze.

Low sunset light enters from frame right. In the top and middle panels it grazes her side profile, creating warm amber highlights along the nose, cheek and lips while the opposite side falls into soft shadow. The bottom panel is strongly backlit: reduce the woman and nearby foreground to deep charcoal silhouettes while retaining a narrow warm rim along her profile, coat and windblown fabric; keep the bridge spans, water reflections and low sun legible through haze and flare.

Maintain natural snapshot imperfections: windblown strands crossing the face in the close-up, slight softness from imperfect focus, uneven backlit exposure, hazy flare around the low sun and blurred industrial details. Finish with a soft consumer color-negative-film look: peach-amber highlights, cool blue-gray shadows, muted saturation, low-to-moderate contrast, gently lifted blacks in the first two panels and deeper silhouetted blacks in the last. Apply fine visible grain across the full frame and over the skin; retain natural pores, fine facial fuzz and faint cheek texture without smoothing them away.

Rendering constraints: keep the three stacked crops, lens changes, gaze direction, hand task, light direction, foreground obstruction, ferry and bridge placement consistent. Preserve believable anatomy and natural hands. Avoid identity drift, extra people, beauty-filter or plastic skin, studio-clean restaging, generic fashion posing, incorrect bob length, missing bridge spans, flat frontal light, artificial material gloss, text, logos, panel borders and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的 ref-10a-v1 图像作为三个面板中重复出现的成年女性的面部身份参考。每个面板都保留同一张可辨认的面孔、肤色和核心身体比例，同时保持指定发型、服装、动作与工业海滨场景。

创作一张写实的 9:16 竖幅摄影三连帧，三个无边框、全宽面板从上至下堆叠。同一名成年东亚女性在日落时的港口边缘分别出现一次。她保持冷静挺拔的侧面轮廓，望向画面左侧远方，嘴巴中性闭合，动作克制。她留深黑色塞耳短波波头，带柔和哑光质感；发长严格限制在下颌至锁骨之间，只允许波波头、长波波头或紧凑绑扎造型。风吹动几缕碎发掠过面部，也带动织物。

顶部面板采用平视、轻微压缩的 70–100mm 肖像镜头感和浅景深，表现侧面轮廓近景。中部面板保持同样的平视 70–100mm 镜头感，以近距离腰部以上构图表现她用双手把衣物夹到晾衣绳上。底部面板采用平视 45–60mm 环境视图，纳入更多身体、港口与桥体。全程保持自然透视，不倾斜相机。保留准确的身体与相机关系、向左视线、手部任务，以及晾衣绳或悬挂衣物造成的轻微前景遮挡，但不得遮住面部或工作的双手。

她身穿浅灰褐色及膝外套，肩线平整有结构，弯曲肘部和腰部出现自然褶皱；厚实哑光黑围巾不规则堆叠在颈部并垂到胸前；深色长裤仅以低对比剪影出现。羊毛外套、织物围巾和裤装都要呈现可信的厚度、织纹、褶皱与迎风反应。

场景位于日落时的工业河滨或港口。平静的低饱和蓝灰水面贯穿背景。顶部和中部面板中，一艘下部带赭黄色条带的白色作业渡轮停泊或缓慢经过人物后方。宽幅底部面板中，一座大型桥梁从左上方向远岸斜穿画面，水面上方清楚可见三个宽阔桥跨，苍白工业结构向薄雾深处延伸。

低角度落日从画面右侧射入。顶部和中部面板中，侧光掠过人物轮廓，在鼻子、脸颊和嘴唇形成温暖琥珀高光，另一侧落入柔和阴影。底部面板采用强逆光：人物和邻近前景压成深炭黑剪影，同时在侧脸、外套和迎风织物边缘保留一条狭窄暖色轮廓光；桥跨、水面反光和低位太阳仍需透过薄雾与光晕保持可辨。

保留自然抓拍的不完美：特写中碎发被风吹过面部、轻微对焦柔度、不均匀逆光曝光、低位太阳周围的朦胧光晕和模糊工业细节。整体使用柔和消费级彩色负片质感：桃琥珀高光、清冷蓝灰阴影、低饱和度、低至中等对比度；前两个面板轻抬黑位，最后一个面板使用更深的剪影黑。整幅画面与皮肤表面都保留可见细颗粒，并保留自然毛孔、面部细小绒毛和淡淡的面颊纹理，不得磨平。

渲染约束：保持三层堆叠裁切、镜头变化、视线方向、手部任务、光照方向、前景遮挡、渡轮与桥体位置一致。人体结构与双手必须可信自然。避免身份漂移、额外人物、美颜滤镜或塑料皮肤、影棚式洁净重组、通俗时尚摆拍、错误波波头长度、缺失桥跨、平坦正面光、人工材质油亮、文字、标志、面板边框和水印。

items.title: 浓彩水粉旅行静物摄影对比海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please make each of my uploaded travel photos into an independent "Rich Gouache Travel Still Life" comparison poster. Each photo is output individually, and multiple photos must not be stitched into the same work. The overall layout uses a 3:4 portrait composition. The frame is divided into two top and bottom areas with a height ratio close to 1:1, using clear, straight, and restrained horizontal boundaries; no gradients, feathering, or allowing paint to invade the photo area. The top half faithfully preserves the original photo. Accurately maintain the subject identity, quantity, posture, architectural structure, street direction, object relationships, real materials, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight travel magazine and art publication color grading and extremely thin film grain. The top half must still be clearly a real photograph and must not be illustrated, stretched, mirrored, copied, or have the subject changed. The bottom half should not completely redraw the original scene, nor should the entire photo be simply gouached. First understand the photo, then select 4–8 urban objects that best represent the location and travel memories, such as motorcycles, bicycles, plastic low stools, coffee tables, lanterns, flower baskets, tableware, awnings, window panes, road markings, or signboard outlines. Reorganize the selected objects into an asymmetrical group of travel still lifes. Allow for changes in the scale, distance, occlusion, and spatial organization of the objects, making them like urban specimens picked up from the journey and rearranged on paper. The still life group occupies about 45%–68% of the bottom area, and must be surrounded by a continuous, complete piece of warm off-white paper with no fragmented decorations invading. Do not arrange all objects evenly along the bottom edge, and do not fill the background. Use truly opaque rich gouache, combined with a small amount of acrylic and dry brush textures. Colors are completely extracted from the original photo and compressed into 4–7 primary colors. Use direct, matte, highly opaque paint blocks; outlines are done in the deepest dark brown, blue-black, or charcoal gray from the photo, completed with loose, uneven, slightly hesitant hand-drawn lines. Retain visible brush bristles, dry brush gaps, thickness variations in paint, rough edges, a few search lines, and the base paper showing through. Highlights use uncovered paper white or direct white gouache strokes. Three sets of accurate text are added by default: 1. Refine a main title of 1–3 English words based on the photo content. 2. Add numbering in the form of "STUDY NO. 01". 3. Add a short observation sentence of 5–10 English words. The main title must be clearly readable at chat preview size. Use thick, slightly narrow or slightly rounded, slightly slanted hand-drawn gouache uppercase letters, featuring matte opaque pigment, visible brush bristles, dry brush gaps, rough edges, and uneven manual kerning. The title should look like it is brushed directly onto the paper with a paintbrush, rather than a smooth digital font overlaid later. The numbering and observation sentences use clearly readable small-sized humanist sans-serif, old lead type, or relaxed handwriting, allowing for slight ink deficiency, paper tooth, and manual misalignment. Text color is extracted from the original photo and the gouache still life, echoing the subject. Text is placed in continuous white space and can slightly bite into the edges of the still life, but must not block key subjects. Only render text explicitly written in the prompt. Do not generate fictional place names, dates, brands, signs, author names, signatures, logos, QR codes, watermarks, garbled code, or extra long text. Avoid: transparent watercolor wash, full-scene tracing, same-crop redraw, photorealistic painting, smooth digital gradients, airbrush, clean vector outlines, oil impasto, plastic 3D, cartoon, anime, childish coloring-book style, copied shop signs, fake labels, tiny unreadable typography, thin polished magazine fonts, floating digital text, excessive decoration, filled negative space, missing source-photo comparison. Most important rule: The top half must preserve the real original photo; the bottom half must actively extract urban objects and recompose them, turning the same travel location into a group of travel still lifes with a rich gouache texture, hand-drawn titles, and large areas of white paper.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的「浓彩水粉旅行静物」对比海报。每张照片单独输出，不得把多张照片拼接在同一作品中。

整体采用3:4竖版构图。画面上下分为两个高度接近1:1的区域，使用清晰、平直、克制的水平边界；不得渐变、羽化或让颜料侵入照片区域。

上半部分忠实保留原始照片。准确保持主体身份、数量、姿态、建筑结构、街道方向、物件关系、真实材质、自然光影与原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微的旅行杂志与艺术出版物调色，并加入极薄的胶片颗粒。上半部分仍须明确是一张真实摄影，不得插画化、拉伸、镜像、复制或改变主体。

下半部分不要完整重画原场景，也不要将整张照片简单水粉化。先理解照片，再从中选择4–8个最能代表地点与旅行记忆的城市物件，例如摩托车、自行车、塑料矮凳、咖啡桌、灯笼、花篮、餐具、雨棚、窗格、道路标线或招牌轮廓。

将选出的物件重新组织成一组非对称的旅行静物。允许改变物件的尺度、距离、遮挡和空间组织，使其像从旅途中拾取并重新摆放在纸上的城市标本。静物团约占下半区域的45%–68%，周围必须保留一块连续、完整、没有零碎装饰侵入的温暖米白色纸张。不要把所有物件沿底边平均排列，也不要填满背景。

使用真正不透明的浓彩水粉，结合少量丙烯和干刷质感。色彩完全从原照片提取，并压缩成4–7种主色。使用直接、哑光、覆盖力强的颜料色块；轮廓采用照片中最深的深棕、蓝黑或炭灰，以松动、不均匀、略带迟疑的手绘线条完成。保留可见刷毛、干刷缺口、颜料厚薄变化、毛糙边缘、少量寻找线与底纸透出。高光使用未覆盖的纸白或直接的白色水粉笔触。

默认加入三组准确文字：

1. 根据照片内容提炼一个1–3个英文单词的主标题。
2. 加入“STUDY NO. 01”形式的编号。
3. 加入一句5–10个英文单词的简短观察句。

主标题必须在聊天预览尺寸下清楚可读。采用粗厚、略窄或略圆、轻微歪斜的手绘水粉大写字，具有哑光不透明颜料、可见刷毛、干刷缺口、毛糙边缘和不均匀手工字距。标题应像直接用画笔刷在纸上，而不是后期叠加的光滑数字字体。

编号和观察句使用清楚可读的小号人文无衬线、旧铅字或轻松手写体，允许轻微缺墨、纸齿和手工错位。文字颜色从原照片及水粉静物中提取，并与主体形成呼应。文字放置在连续留白中，可以与静物边缘产生轻微咬合，但不得遮挡关键主体。

只能渲染提示词中逐字写定的文字。不得生成虚构地名、日期、品牌、招牌、作者名、签名、Logo、二维码、水印、乱码或额外长文。

Avoid: transparent watercolor wash, full-scene tracing, same-crop redraw, photorealistic painting, smooth digital gradients, airbrush, clean vector outlines, oil impasto, plastic 3D, cartoon, anime, childish coloring-book style, copied shop signs, fake labels, tiny unreadable typography, thin polished magazine fonts, floating digital text, excessive decoration, filled negative space, missing source-photo comparison.

最重要的规则：上半部分必须保留真实原始照片；下半部分必须主动提炼城市物件并重新构图，使同一个旅行地点变成一组具有浓彩水粉质感、手绘标题和大片纸白的旅行静物。

items.title: 夏日海边薰衣草上衣日本女性人像
items.description: 明确成年的日本女性站在夏日海边甲板上微笑，薰衣草罗纹上衣、白色肩包、海风与青蓝海景构成明亮旅行肖像。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded identity reference as the facial identity basis for the only main visible adult Japanese woman, preserving recognizable features. Create a realistic 9:16 vertical summer seaside travel portrait: she stands on a bright seaside deck with a vivid blue sea behind her, body almost facing the camera with one shoulder slightly pulled back for a subtle ribcage twist. Her brown eyes look directly at the camera with an elegant bright toothy smile, expressing the joy of discovering a favorite seascape and friendly invitation to travel together. Include the face, shoulders, chest, upper waist, and the main body of a white shoulder bag; keep the head about 5% from the top and the eyes around 24% down, with face and chest first focus and bag second focus. Do not invent or expand unseen lower-body areas. One hand lightly pinches or supports the bag strap while the other hangs naturally, with fingers, arms, and strap clearly separated. She wears a lavender sleeveless top with fine vertical ribs and a rounded neckline naturally showing the collarbone; the fabric fits without being tight. A soft white shoulder bag hangs from a wide strap running from shoulder to armpit, its body slightly bulging at the outer waist; keep accessories minimal. Her dark-brown long hair reaches below the chest, with a rounded crown, thin bangs, and small cheek-side strands moved outward by a tropical sea breeze; sunlit hair has brown-gold luster while the shadow side stays deep brown. Set the scene on a tropical-feeling seaside deck at summer noon: white wall and potted plants at left, turquoise-to-ultramarine sea, pale-blue sky, straight horizon, white railings, and distant greenery; softly blur waves and reflections, with no facility or regional signage. Strong summer sun creates vivid highlights on hair, forehead, cheeks, nose, collarbone, arms, and bag; cool sea and white-deck fill light lifts shadows, with a fine rim separating hair from sea. Keep bag stitching and material without overexposure. Use lavender, white, cyan, ultramarine, natural skin, and deep-brown hair; keep skin neutral and lavender distinct from sea blue. Shoot with a realistic standard-lens photographic look, carefully rendering top ribs, bag leather, stitching, woven strap, pores, stray hair, lashes, brows, and fingers touching the bag; retain natural grain and depth of field without excessive HDR. No extra fingers, doubled arms, other people, children, brands, text, logos, watermarks, signatures, SNS UI, misaligned eyes, distorted bag, hands merging with strap, or composition expanded for exposure.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的身份参考图作为唯一主可见成年日本女性的面部身份依据，保留可辨认特征。创建 9:16 竖幅写实夏日海边旅行肖像：她站在明亮海边甲板上，背后是鲜艳蓝色大海，身体几乎正面朝向镜头，一侧肩膀略向后拉，形成轻微胸廓扭转；棕色眼睛直视镜头，露出优雅的明亮露齿笑容，表达发现心仪海景时的喜悦和邀请同行的亲切感。画面纳入脸、肩、胸口、腰部上方和白色肩包主要部分，头顶距上缘约 5%，双眼约在上方 24%，脸部与胸口为第一焦点，肩包为第二焦点，不推测或扩大未见下半身。一只手轻捏或支撑包带，另一只手自然垂在身侧，手指、手臂与包带清晰分离。她穿薰衣草色细纵向罗纹无袖上衣，圆领自然展现锁骨，面料贴合但不过紧；肩上挂柔软白色包，宽肩带从肩膀延至腋下，包身在腰外侧微鼓，饰品保持简约。黑褐色长发及胸下，顶部圆润、薄刘海和脸颊旁小发束被南国海风向肩外吹动，阳光面有茶金光泽，阴影面深棕。场景为夏日中午的热带感海边甲板：左侧白墙和盆栽，背后青绿至群青渐变海面、淡蓝天空、直地平线、白色栏杆和远处绿意；海面波浪与反射柔和虚化，不出现设施名称或地区标牌。强烈夏日太阳在头发、额头、脸颊、鼻子、锁骨、手臂与包上产生鲜明高光，海面和白色甲板提供冷调补光并以细轮廓光分离发丝；白包保留缝线和材质不过曝。色彩以薰衣草、白、青色、群青、自然肤色和深棕发为主，肤色不偏橙，衣服紫色不沉入海蓝。真实标准焦段摄影，细致呈现上衣罗纹、包的表皮缝线肩带、毛孔、飞发、睫毛、眉毛和触包手指，保留自然颗粒与景深但不过度 HDR。禁止额外手指、双臂、其他人物、儿童、品牌、文字、标志、水印、签名、SNS UI、眼球偏移、包变形、手与肩带融合，不以暴露为目的扩大构图。

items.title: 跨时代网红潮流迷你收藏盒场景
items.description: 同一名绑定10A身份的成年东亚女性以四个时代版本出现在2x2微缩收藏盒中，具体呈现1998早期网络、2007博客、2016移动视觉社交和2026 AI创作者经济。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference as the facial identity basis for all four visible adult East Asian female influencer avatars. They are four era-specific versions of the same adult person, so preserve the same recognizable face, skin tone and core proportions in every capsule while changing only the hairstyle, clothes and props required by each era.

Create a 16:9 collectible diorama board about the evolution of internet influencer aesthetics. Use a clean 2x2 grid containing four equally sized miniature memory boxes, viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Each capsule contains exactly one adult avatar and must be visually readable through its fashion, technology, media objects, color palette and background motifs.

Top left — 1998 Web 1.0 and Y2K pioneer: center the avatar beside a translucent desktop computer, dial-up modem, compact disc player and wired headphones. Give her butterfly hair clips, a fitted graphic-free top and relaxed cargo trousers. Use icy blue, silver and translucent plastic motifs with one small exact slogan note: “LOG ON”. The generic brand-era language is optimistic early-web electronics and portal culture, with no real logos.

Top right — 2007 blog-era millennial: place the same adult avatar with a compact digital camera, flip phone, blogging notebook and wired earbuds. Style her with layered casual clothes, a skinny scarf and side-swept hair. Use chocolate brown, hot pink and cream with scrapbook and pixel motifs, plus the exact slogan “POST IT”. Suggest personal-blog and indie lifestyle sponsorship through generic unbranded packaging.

Bottom left — 2016 mobile visual-social era: show the same avatar with a smartphone on a small tripod, ring light, takeaway drink and neat direct-to-consumer parcels. Use long polished hair and minimalist streetwear in millennial pink, white and pale gray, with rounded app-like motifs and the exact slogan “CURATE”. Keep all product design generic and unbranded.

Bottom right — 2026 AI-native creator economy: show the same avatar with a wireless microphone, pocket camera, foldable phone, editing tablet and modular creator merchandise. Use a contemporary layered outfit and sleek hairstyle, cobalt blue, lime and black accents, dynamic interface-like shapes and the exact slogan “CREATE”. Keep the future-facing brand language premium, modular and generic, without third-party marks.

Render the board as a tactile handmade clay collectible miniature set with softly molded vinyl-like avatars, tiny crafted props, realistic material variation and high detail. Use playful, nostalgic and premium art direction, clean panel separation and soft product-photography lighting with gentle shadows. Avoid random nostalgia clutter. Use only the four exact slogan notes specified above; no other legible text.

Negative constraints: no children, no additional people, no identity drift between panels, no duplicated avatar within a capsule, no mixed-era props, no real company logos or trademarks, no gibberish text, no malformed faces, hands or limbs, no floating objects, no messy layout, no cropped capsule, no watermark and no unrelated background elements.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的身份参考图作为四名可见成年东亚女性网红虚拟形象的面部身份依据。她们是同一名成年人物在四个时代中的版本，因此所有收藏盒都要保留相同且可辨认的面容、肤色与核心身体比例，只改变各时代所需的发型、服装和道具。

创作一块表现网络网红审美演变的 16:9 收藏级微缩场景板。采用整洁的 2x2 网格，放置四个等大的微型记忆盒，并以略高的四分之三视角观看。每个收藏盒恰好包含一名成年虚拟形象，并通过时装、科技设备、媒体物件、配色和背景图案让时代特征自然可辨。

左上——1998 年 Web 1.0 与 Y2K 先驱：人物位于半透明台式电脑、拨号调制解调器、CD 播放器和有线耳机旁。她佩戴蝴蝶发夹，身穿无图形贴身上衣与宽松工装裤。使用冰蓝、银色和透明塑料图案，并加入唯一的小型准确标语“LOG ON”。品牌时代语言体现乐观的早期网络电子产品和门户文化，不出现真实标志。

右上——2007 年千禧一代博客时代：同一成年人物搭配便携数码相机、翻盖手机、博客笔记本和有线耳塞。她采用层叠休闲服、窄围巾和侧分发型。使用巧克力棕、亮粉与奶油色，配合剪贴簿和像素图案，并准确呈现标语“POST IT”。用通用无品牌包装暗示个人博客与独立生活方式赞助。

左下——2016 年移动视觉社交时代：同一人物搭配小三脚架上的智能手机、环形灯、外带饮品和整齐的直面消费者包装盒。她留精致长发，身穿极简街头服装；使用千禧粉、白色和浅灰色、圆角应用图案，并准确呈现标语“CURATE”。所有产品设计保持通用且无品牌。

右下——2026 年 AI 原生创作者经济：同一人物搭配无线麦克风、口袋相机、折叠手机、编辑平板和模块化创作者周边。她采用当代层叠服装与利落发型，使用钴蓝、荧光绿和黑色点缀、动态界面形状，并准确呈现标语“CREATE”。未来品牌语言应高端、模块化且通用，不出现第三方标记。

items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的写实人像发型拼图提示词，保留同一人物身份、12 种明确发型、4×3 专业摄影棚拼图及完整摄影约束。使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:

Use the provided reference image as the strict identity reference. Create a single 12-image collage featuring the exact same girl in every image. Her facial identity must remain perfectly consistent across all 12 variations. Do not create a different person or reinterpret her appearance.

Arrange the result as a clean 4×3 professional studio portrait collage, with one hairstyle per panel. Keep the same framing, camera angle, pose, expression, clothing, makeup, accessories, background, and lighting in every panel. The only difference between the 12 images should be the hairstyle.

Hairstyle variations

1. High ponytail — Sleek high ponytail with a smooth crown and long flowing length.

2. French bob — Jaw-length bob with a soft blunt micro-fringe across the forehead.

3. Long straight middle-part hair — Very long, sleek, pin-straight brown hair falling well below the shoulders, parted in the middle.

4. Shaggy wolf cut — Medium-length heavy layers, choppy fringe, textured volume, and a slightly wild finish.

5. Elegant updo — Polished high chignon with soft face-framing tendrils.

6. Short curly crop — Short, voluminous natural curls with tapered sides and a textured top.

7. Side-swept Hollywood waves — Long glamorous hair with a deep side part and sculpted vintage waves cascading over one shoulder.

8. Sleek low bun — Smooth center-parted hair gathered into a clean, polished low bun at the nape.

9. Long layered waves — Long brown hair with soft cascading layers and natural, loose waves.

10. Shoulder-length blunt cut — Straight, sleek shoulder-length hair with clean blunt ends and a middle part.

11. Curtain bangs — Long natural brown hair with soft curtain bangs framing the face and subtle movement through the lengths.

12. Textured pixie cut — Short modern pixie with textured volume on top, softly tapered sides, and a natural finish.

Identity and consistency rules

Hair color: Keep exactly the same natural brown hair color as the reference image.

Only change: hair length, hair shape, hair texture, and hair styling.

Never change: facial structure, face, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, makeup, clothing, accessories, pose, expression, or overall identity.

The girl must look unmistakably like the same person in all 12 panels. Maintain identical facial proportions and recognizable features throughout the entire collage.

Professional studio portrait photography, Canon EOS R5, 85mm f/1.4 lens, soft key light with subtle fill, sharp focus on the face, natural shallow depth of field, realistic skin pores, individual hair strands, realistic hair texture.

items.title: 复古旅行摄影蒙太奇海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please turn each travel photo I upload into an independent high-end travel stylized poster. One photo corresponds to one finished product; do not combine multiple photos into a grid or collection.

The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical poster layout, clearly maintaining the contrast between the original photo and the stylized transformation.

The top portion occupies about 40%—45% of the frame, faithfully preserving the original photo. Accurately maintain the subject identity, quantity, posture, architectural structure, vehicle direction, topographical relationships, observation angle, real materials, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere of the photo, only performing minor travel magazine and artistic publication color grading, and adding a very thin layer of film grain. The top must remain a clearly identifiable real photo, not illustrated, redesigned in terms of the subject, or have the location replaced.

The bottom portion occupies about 55%—60% of the frame, reconstructing the same photo into a "vintage travel mask montage."

This is not about adding a halftone filter to the entire photo, nor is it about redrawing it according to the same composition. First, analyze the photo to lock onto one core subject that best represents the location or event, then extract 4—7 auxiliary elements with distinct outline differences.

Extractable elements include:
- Main landmark or building spire
- Secondary roofs, towers, doors/windows, or sculptures
- Boats, vehicles, bicycles, or other transportation
- People, animals, or local artifacts
- Trees, flags, umbrellas, signboards, or market goods
- Directional structures such as roads, water surfaces, railings, or horizons

All elements must come from the same original photo; do not add Buddha statues, lanterns, elephants, people, buildings, or any regional symbols unrelated to the original scene out of thin air.

Make the extracted objects into independent photographic mask layers. Use outline cutouts, coarse-grain black and white halftones, partial cutouts, monochromatic ink plates, screen printing color plates, ink shortages, paper fibers, rough edges, and slight color registration offsets.

Reposition and resize these objects, changing their cropping, front-to-back positioning, and overlapping relationships:
- The largest subject occupies about 55%—95% of the stylized area height and can be boldly cropped by the frame edges.
- The second subject uses a significantly different scale, passing in front of or behind the main element.
- Small vehicles, roofs, plants, flags, or artifacts serve as rhythmic connections.
- At least 5—8 identifiable photo elements must appear.
- Do not arrange elements evenly like a material board, cards, or a regular grid.
- Do not follow the complete perspective and original scale relationships of the original photo.

Add 1—2 translucent or opaque rectangular or irregular color blocks, passing behind some objects and creating overprinting and masking relationships with the halftone layers. Color blocks are used to separate space and establish hierarchy; they cannot simply cover the entire background.

The color palette is extracted entirely from the original photo and compressed into 3—5 vintage printing ink colors:
Warm cream white or old ivory paper color, the deepest shadow color, and 2—3 local colors most representative of the original scene. You can use black-brown, deep indigo, brick red, ochre yellow, grey-green, faded pink, or colors that actually exist in the photo. Overprinting to form mixed colors is allowed, but avoid rainbow-like effects, high-saturation clashing colors, and fixed orange-blue templates.

The bottom image can be dense and impactful, but must retain about 15%—25% of continuous old paper or solid color fields. Negative space should form a clear contrast of weight and density with the dense objects and provide a stable position for text.

Extract the following text based on the location, subject, and mood of the photo:
1. A readable main title of 1—3 English words.
2. A short printed field, such as "EDITION 01" or "TRAVEL STUDY".
3. One observation sentence of 5—10 English words, describing only the scenery, actions, colors, or spatial relationships actually visible in the photo.

Concentrate text in continuous old paper empty spaces, solid color blocks, or quieter gaps between objects; do not distribute them evenly to the four corners. Use condensed old serif, compressed sans-serif capitals, or bold lead type. The text and images should use the same ink language, with slight ink shortages, paper teeth, halftones, and color registration offsets. The main title must be clearly readable at chat preview size.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级旅行转绘海报，一张照片对应一张成品，不得将多张照片拼成九宫格或合集。

整体采用3:4竖版编辑海报构图，并清楚保留原始照片与风格化转绘之间的对比。

上方约占画面40%—45%，忠实保留原始照片。准确保持照片中的主体身份、数量、姿态、建筑结构、交通工具方向、地形关系、观察角度、真实材质、自然光线和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微的旅行杂志与艺术出版物调色，并加入极薄的胶片颗粒。上方必须仍然是一张清楚可辨的真实照片，不得插画化、重新设计主体或替换地点。

下方约占画面55%—60%，将同一张照片重新构建为“复古旅行遮罩蒙太奇”。

这不是给整张照片添加网点滤镜，也不是按照相同构图重新画一遍。首先分析照片，从中锁定一个最能代表地点或事件的核心主体，再提取4—7个轮廓差异明显的辅助元素。

可提取的元素包括：

- 主地标或建筑尖顶
- 次级屋顶、塔楼、门窗或雕塑
- 船只、车辆、自行车或其他交通工具
- 人物、动物或地方器物
- 树木、旗帜、雨伞、招牌或市场商品
- 道路、水面、栏杆或地平线等方向结构

所有元素必须来自同一张原始照片，不得凭空加入佛像、灯笼、大象、人物、建筑或任何与原场景无关的地域符号。

将提取出的对象分别制作成独立的摄影遮罩图层。使用轮廓抠图、粗颗粒黑白网点、局部镂空、单色墨版、丝网印刷色版、缺墨、纸纤维、剪裁毛边和轻微套色偏移表现。

重新改变这些对象的大小、裁切、前后位置与遮挡关系：

- 最大主体占转绘区域高度约55%—95%，可以被画面边缘大胆裁切
- 第二主体使用明显不同的尺度，从主元素前方或后方穿过
- 小型交通工具、屋顶、植物、旗帜或器物作为节奏连接
- 至少出现5—8个可识别的照片元素
- 不得把元素平均排列成素材板、卡片或规则网格
- 不得沿用原照片的完整透视和原始尺度关系

加入1—2块半透明或不透明的矩形、不规则色版，从部分对象后方穿过，并与网点图层发生套印和遮罩关系。色版用于分隔空间与建立层级，不能简单覆盖整个背景。

配色完全从原照片中提取，并压缩为3—5种复古印刷墨色：

暖米白或旧象牙纸色、最深阴影色，以及2—3种最能代表原场景的地点色。可以使用黑褐、深靛蓝、砖红、赭黄、灰绿、褪色粉色或照片中真实存在的颜色。允许叠印形成混合色，但避免彩虹化、高饱和撞色和固定橙蓝模板。

下方画面可以密集、有冲击力，但必须保留约15%—25%的连续旧纸或纯色色场。留白应与密集对象形成明确的轻重和疏密对比，并为文字提供稳定位置。

根据照片的地点、主体和情绪提炼以下文字：

1. 一个1—3个英文单词的可读主标题
2. 一个简短印刷字段，例如“EDITION 01”或“TRAVEL STUDY”
3. 一句5—10个英文单词的观察句，只描述照片中真实可见的景物、动作、颜色或空间关系

文字集中放在连续旧纸空场、纯色色版或较安静的对象间隙中，不要平均分散到四角。使用窄体旧衬线、压缩无衬线大写或粗铅字，文字与图像使用相同油墨语言，带有轻微缺墨、纸齿、网点与套色偏移。主标题在聊天预览尺寸下必须清楚可读。

整体呈现旧旅行刊物、复古文化海报、粗网点摄影蒙太奇与当代编辑设计相结合的气质。画面应密集但层级清楚，粗粝但不廉价，具有鲜明地点识别度和收藏感。

强制避免：

完整照片滤镜、相同构图重画、单一地标版画、只提取两三个元素、平均大小排列、规则网格、九宫格、每个对象独立装框、剪贴簿胶带、现代光滑矢量、透明水彩、卡通插画、3D拼贴、文化符号模板、跨地点地标混合、背景全覆盖色块、没有连续留白、不可读小字、假中文、乱码、作者名、签名、Logo、网址、二维码和水印。

最重要的规则：必须从同一张旅行照片中提取多个真实对象，将它们分别制成不同颜色、不同尺寸的遮罩网点图层，再通过放大、裁切、压叠、套印和色版穿插，重建一张密集而有秩序的旅行蒙太奇。

items.description: 一张以“潮汐回声”为代表性默认主题的 9:16 展览编辑海报：左侧 40% 呈现绑定 ref-10a-v1 身份的海岸女性半身像，右侧 60% 放大同一人物的眼睛、面颊与发丝细节，并用发丝、海浪泡沫和珊瑚橙轨迹跨越中轴。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

【Subject / Work Name】: Tidal Echo: Coastal Portrait in Sea Breeze
【Left Content】: In the left 40% of the poster, show a complete waist-up coastal portrait of one adult woman whose facial identity is bound to the uploaded reference image, with wind-swept hair and a deep-blue sea background.
【Right Content】: In the right 60%, show an enlarged detail of the same woman's eye, cheek, and flowing hair strands merging into sea-foam textures, with spacious title typography.
【Left-Right Relationship】: Whole and Part; dense image and open white space.
【Cross-region Connection Method】: Let hair strands cross the central boundary and translate into sea-foam texture, joined by a coral-orange trajectory.
【Chinese Title】: 潮汐回声
【English Title】: TIDAL ECHO
【Auxiliary Text】: COASTAL PORTRAIT · 2026
【Main Color】: Deep marine blue #163A5F
【Secondary Colors】: Seafoam white #E8F1EF and coral orange #E9785B
【Aspect Ratio】: 9:16

Generate an editorial graphic design poster with a left-right composition, featuring mature visual texture for an exhibition. Render the visible title text exactly as “潮汐回声”, “TIDAL ECHO”, and “COASTAL PORTRAIT · 2026”; do not add placeholder copy or unrelated words.

The core is not to mechanically divide the screen into two equal halves, but to establish two visual areas with different functions and visual weights that have a clear relationship with each other. Use the specified 40:60 unequal ratio: the portrait occupies the narrower left area and the detail-plus-typography field occupies the wider right area. Complete visual weight balance through subject size, color depth, information density, and white space.

The left side shows the complete waist-up portrait of the single reference-bound woman. The most important thing is the middle boundary. Do not use a hard vertical line to divide columns. Let the woman's wind-swept hair naturally cross from the left portrait into the right detail area, gradually translating into sea-foam textures. Extend one coral-orange trajectory across the regions so the central axis becomes the place where the relationship happens rather than a simple dividing line.

Typography is organized around the coastal portrait. Place less text over the image-heavy left side and place the exact titles “潮汐回声” and “TIDAL ECHO”, plus “COASTAL PORTRAIT · 2026”, in the more open right side. The title may cross the boundary and intersperse with the hair and foam, but it must remain legible. Do not use templated placeholder text such as “Left-right composition,” “Design case,” or “Visual research.”

Control the palette to deep marine blue #163A5F, seafoam white #E8F1EF, and coral orange #E9785B. Use the deep blue and white contrast to differentiate the two visual weights, while the coral-orange trajectory, repeated hair texture, and consistent typography connect them into one work.

Maintain sufficient breathing space through the 40:60 proportion, visual weighting, subject crossing the boundary, hair-to-foam material translation, density changes, and typography interspersion.

The final reading order should be clear: first glance feels the contrast between the complete portrait and the enlarged detail; second glance follows the crossing hair, foam, and coral trajectory at the central axis; third glance understands the whole-to-part relationship; finally, reads the exact title and work information.

Overall requirements: The left-right relationship is clear but not rigid; the two areas each have a function and belong to the same coastal portrait work; there is visual hierarchy, content logic, and a mature Editorial Poster texture.

【主题 / 作品名】：潮汐回声：海风中的海岸人像
【左侧内容】：海报左侧 40% 呈现一名成年女性的完整半身海岸人像，其面部身份绑定用户上传的参考图；发丝被海风吹动，背景为深蓝色海面。
【右侧内容】：右侧 60% 放大同一人物的眼睛、面颊与流动发丝细节，让发丝融入海浪泡沫纹理，并为标题排版保留充足空间。
【左右关系】：整体与局部；密集图像与开放留白。
【跨区连接方式】：让发丝跨越中间边界并转译为海浪泡沫纹理，以一条珊瑚橙色轨迹贯穿两区。
【中文标题】：潮汐回声
【英文标题】：TIDAL ECHO
【辅助文字】：COASTAL PORTRAIT · 2026
【主色调】：深海蓝 #163A5F
【辅助色】：海沫白 #E8F1EF 与珊瑚橙 #E9785B
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟 Editorial Graphic Design 与展览视觉质感的左右构图海报。可见标题必须准确呈现为“潮汐回声”“TIDAL ECHO”和“COASTAL PORTRAIT · 2026”，不要添加占位文案或无关文字。

核心不是把画面机械地平均分成左右两半，而是建立两个功能不同、视觉重量不同，但彼此存在明确关系的视觉区域。采用明确的 40:60 不等比例：人像位于较窄的左侧，局部细节与文字区域位于较宽的右侧；通过主体大小、色彩深浅、信息密度和留白完成视觉配重。

左侧展示绑定参考身份的单一女性完整半身人像。右侧放大她的眼睛、面颊与发丝纹理，同时以海沫白留白容纳准确的中英文标题和辅助文字。两处图像表现的是同一人物与同一个海岸瞬间。

最重要的是“中间边界”。不要使用生硬竖线直接分栏。让女性被风吹动的发丝从左侧人像自然跨入右侧细节区域，并逐渐转译成海浪泡沫纹理；再让一条珊瑚橙色轨迹跨越两区，使中轴成为“关系发生的位置”，而不是简单的分隔线。

Typography 围绕海岸人像组织。图像较重的左侧减少文字，在留白较多的右侧排布准确标题“潮汐回声”“TIDAL ECHO”以及“COASTAL PORTRAIT · 2026”。标题可以跨越边界，与发丝和泡沫产生穿插，但必须保持清晰可读。不要使用“左右构图”“设计案例”“视觉研究”等模板化占位文字。

色彩限定为深海蓝 #163A5F、海沫白 #E8F1EF 和珊瑚橙 #E9785B。用深海蓝与海沫白的对比区分左右视觉重量，以珊瑚橙轨迹、重复的发丝纹理和一致的文字系统把两侧连接成同一件作品。

通过 40:60 不等比例、视觉配重、主体越界、发丝到泡沫的材质转译、疏密变化与 Typography 穿插保留足够呼吸空间。

最终阅读顺序应清晰：第一眼感受到完整人像与局部放大的反差；第二眼沿着跨越中轴的发丝、泡沫和珊瑚橙轨迹找到连接；第三眼理解整体与局部的关系；最后阅读准确的标题与作品信息。

整体要求：左右关系明确但不生硬，两个区域各有作用又属于同一件海岸人像作品，有视觉层次、有内容逻辑、有成熟 Editorial Poster 质感。

items.title: 溪边冰蓝纱衣古风女子赤足全身人像
items.description: 一名绑定 10A 身份的成年东亚女性身穿冰蓝与月白纱质古装长裙，赤脚在山间浅溪中自然戏水；采用完整 9:16 全身构图、斑驳自然光与清冷梦幻手机摄影质感。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded ref-10a-v1 image as the facial identity reference for the only visible person, preserving her recognizable facial features. Create a photorealistic 9:16 full-body environmental portrait of one clearly adult East Asian woman playing in a clear mountain stream. She has long black hair, partly loose and partly arranged in an elegant historical updo with layered silver, jade, pearl, pale-blue floral ornaments and fine tassels; a few strands move in the stream breeze.

Dress her in an elaborate ice-blue and moon-white gauze ancient-style dress with silk, embroidery, beadwork, layered translucent overskirts and long floating ribbons. The outfit is graceful and securely fitted, with realistic fabric thickness, fine weave, soft drape and natural folds. She is barefoot with no shoes or socks. Both ankles, insteps and feet remain visible and make believable contact with wet stones and shallow water.

Show her gently playing with the stream: one leg bears her weight, the other steps slightly forward into the water; one hand lightly lifts the gauze skirt above the water while the other touches the stream or a hanging ribbon. Her pose is relaxed, playful and natural. Add small ripples, reflections, refraction and crystal-like droplets around her feet.

Place her among transparent stream water, rocks of varied depth, moss, trees and distant mountain forms. Use a near-eye-level to slightly low mobile-phone viewpoint with a slight informal tilt. Include the complete hairstyle, head, face, dress, legs and both feet; keep the figure about 75–85% of the frame height with space above the hair ornaments and below the feet. Do not crop the head, legs or feet, and avoid extreme wide-angle stretching.

Use soft natural daylight filtered through trees from the upper side, creating dappled highlights across her hair ornaments, face, ice-blue and white gauze dress, legs and water. Let reflected stream light provide gentle fill. Keep facial and body details clear while the cool highlights remain luminous.

Finish with a cool, dreamlike mobile-photography look: low contrast, pale ice-blue and moon-white palette, slight soft focus and halo, restrained highlight bloom, natural grain, and very subtle motion blur only on ribbon tips, loose hair and splashes. Preserve realistic skin texture, fabric, water and anatomy; no artificial beauty-filter finish.

Negative constraints: no additional people; no shoes, socks or stockings; no hidden, floating, cropped or malformed feet; no extra toes, fingers, hands, legs or limbs; no distorted anatomy, unbalanced proportions, severe wide-angle distortion, clothing intersections, floating ornaments, plastic skin, plastic accessories, severe overexposure, heavy blur, cluttered background, text, logo, watermark or other AI artifacts.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的 ref-10a-v1 图像作为唯一可见人物的面部身份参考，保留她可辨认的面部特征。创作一张照片级写实的 9:16 全身环境人像：一名明确成年的东亚女性正在清澈的山间溪流中玩水。她留乌黑长发，部分自然披散，部分梳成雅致古风盘发，搭配层叠银饰、玉石、珍珠、淡蓝花饰和精细流苏；几缕发丝随溪边微风飘动。

她身穿华丽的冰蓝与月白色纱质古装长裙，融合丝绸、刺绣、珠饰、层叠半透明外裙和修长飘带。服装优雅且稳妥贴合，呈现真实厚度、细腻织纹、柔软垂坠和自然褶皱。她全程赤脚，不穿鞋袜；双侧脚踝、脚背和双脚保持可见，并与湿润岩石和浅水形成可信接触。

表现她轻柔戏水的动作：一条腿承担重心，另一条腿稍向前踏入溪水；一只手轻提纱裙使其离开水面，另一只手触碰溪水或垂落飘带。姿势松弛、俏皮而自然。双脚周围出现细小涟漪、倒影、折射和晶莹水珠。

场景包含透明溪水、深浅不一的岩石、青苔、树林和远处山体。采用接近平视至轻微低机位的手机视角，并保留轻微随手拍倾斜感。完整纳入发型与头饰、头部、面容、长裙、双腿和双脚；人物约占画面高度的 75%–85%，发饰上方与脚底下方都留有空间。不得裁切头部、双腿或双脚，并避免极端广角拉伸。

使用从侧上方穿过树林的柔和自然光，在发饰、面容、冰蓝与月白纱裙、双腿和水面形成斑驳高光；溪水反射提供柔和补光。人物面部与身体细节保持清晰，冷色高光明亮通透。

整体采用清冷梦幻的手机摄影质感：低对比、冰蓝与月白浅色调、轻微柔焦和光晕、克制的高光溢出、自然颗粒；仅在飘带末端、飞扬发丝和水花上保留极轻微动态模糊。皮肤、织物、水体和人体结构保持真实，不使用人工美颜滤镜质感。

负面约束：不得出现其他人物；不得出现鞋、袜或丝袜；不得遮挡、悬浮、裁切或扭曲双脚；不得出现多余脚趾、手指、手、腿或肢体；不得出现人体畸形、比例失衡、严重广角变形、衣物穿模、发饰悬浮、塑料皮肤、塑料配饰、严重过曝、重度失焦、杂乱背景、文字、标志、水印或其他 AI 伪影。

items.prompt: Use the uploaded identity reference as the facial identity basis for the only main visible person, preserving recognizable features. Her makeup is Marigold Morning Dew Warm Light: clean translucent skin with natural texture, warm golden-apricot, pale peach-apricot, and a little soft-brown gradient eye makeup, fine warm-gold shimmer at the center, soft apricot-orange blush, restrained dewy highlight on the bridge and tip of the nose, and moist milk-tea apricot-pink lips. Her black long hair is loosely tied with natural volume at the crown, a soft full back bun, and smooth lengths falling behind; add a marigold hairpin, small white-jade hairpin, a few pearl tassels, and long slim pearl earrings, all elegant and controlled. Dress her in a pine-flower-yellow high-waisted ruqun with a bean-green embroidered upper robe and an ivory-white shawl, with pale floral embroidery and fine gold-thread patterns; the shawl is light and naturally draped. Keep the palette bright and warm while her facial skin remains clean and natural, never yellow. In the half-body frame, one hand rests lightly near the collarbone and garment front while the other hangs naturally before the waist and abdomen, creating a relaxed graceful posture. Set the scene in a morning garden with marigold bonsai, wooden pillars and corridor, warm-white lanterns, and a softly blurred garden. It can be: by the window of a countryside wooden house, by the wooden window of an old house, by a field, open grassland, under a tree, on white steps, by a balcony railing, in a courtyard, by a quiet outdoor building, at the entrance of an old-style house. Elements such as blue sky, white clouds, tree shadows, distant mountains, fields, wooden window frames, railings, stone steps, and old houses can appear in the background. The environment must be real and natural, not a studio feel.

Character movements are natural and relaxed, no deliberate posing. Can be: sitting on a wooden floor looking into the distance, standing quietly holding a wooden window frame, holding a glass bottle beverage, gently turning the face to look into the distance, walking slowly on white steps, leaning against the window with chin in hand, letting the wind blow hair and skirt. The character may not look at the camera, or may look slightly at the camera, but the expression must be restrained, soft, and quiet, like a moment captured by chance.

Photography style is dreamy cinematic portrait photography. Using the visual effect of a 135mm f/1.8 telephoto lens, the character occupies about 60% to 70% of the frame, shallow depth of field, obvious background compression, strong creamy bokeh, background blur is soft and delicate. The composition is natural, not rigidly symmetrical, not fashion-blockbuster posing, must be like authentic candid photography.

Lighting is bright summer natural light, prioritizing transparent sunlight around noon or bright golden sunlight in the evening. Sunlight shines on the character's face, hair, shoulders, and clothes, creating natural highlights and slight shadows. Highlight areas can have slight overexposure, with soft halation and luminous highlight bloom, making white clothes, skin, and sky appear transparent and bright, but the overall is still soft, not harsh.

Color reference Fuji Pro 400H inspired colors, overall low saturation but bright, leaning towards transparent cool tones. Main colors tend towards: creamy white, light sky blue, soft cyan-green, pale grass green, denim blue, natural skin tone. White is clean and transparent, black hair is rich but not dead black, shadows are soft, the overall picture is light, refreshing, and clean, with a bit of faded feel and old film feel.

Picture texture adds subtle atmospheric haze, fine film grain, soft optical softness, slight nostalgic film rendering. Carries a slight 1990s to early 2000s Japanese photography mood, also a bit of Sony Handycam MiniDV aesthetic nostalgic atmosphere, but do not make it look like rough video, maintain portrait-level transparency and beauty.

The overall atmosphere is not an "exquisite posed beauty photo," but "a memory that truly existed in a certain summer." The picture should make people feel: quiet, gentle, light, bright, youthful, nostalgic, like an old travel photo found many years later.

Avoid:
No internet celebrity AI face, no over-sharpening, no plastic skin, no HDR, no strong orange-teal color grading, no commercial advertising feel, no studio lighting, no complex and gorgeous clothing, no too many accessories, no exaggerated poses, no obvious AI-generated traces.

Final effect: Real East Asian girl portrait + white light-colored outfit + summer transparent sunlight + telephoto shallow depth of field + creamy bokeh + Fuji Pro 400H film colors + soft halation + nostalgic travel photo vibe.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请创作一张具有强烈日系夏日写真气质的人物摄影作品，整体风格清透、明亮、安静、轻盈，像夏天旅行途中偶然拍下的一张旧照片。

主体是一位年轻东亚女生，黑色或深棕色自然长发，五官清秀，脸型自然，皮肤白皙通透但不过度磨皮，气质干净、柔和、安静，带一点青春感和淡淡文艺气息。不要网红脸，不要浓妆，不要欧美化轮廓，不要夸张表情，不要商业模特感。

服装以白色或浅色系为主，简单自然，具有生活感。可穿白色棉质T恤、宽松白衬衫、浅色连衣裙、米白色长裙、牛仔短裤、浅灰或米色宽松长裤。可搭配草帽、细带凉鞋、简约手提包、玻璃瓶饮料等轻生活感配饰。整体穿搭要干净、轻盈、自然，不要复杂设计，不要强烈时尚品牌感。

场景设定在夏日真实环境中，带有清新而略微怀旧的生活气息。可以是：乡间木屋窗边、老房子的木窗旁、田野边、开阔草地、树下、白色台阶上、阳台栏杆旁、庭院里、安静的户外建筑边、老式房屋门口。背景中可以出现蓝天、白云、树影、远山、田野、木窗框、栏杆、石阶、老房子等元素。环境要真实自然，不要摄影棚感。

人物动作自然松弛，不要刻意摆拍。可以是：坐在木地板上望向远方、扶着木窗框安静站立、握着玻璃瓶饮料、轻轻侧脸看远处、在白色台阶上慢慢走动、托腮倚在窗边、让风吹起头发和裙摆。人物可以不看镜头，也可以轻微看向镜头，但神态必须克制、柔和、安静，像被偶然抓拍到的瞬间。

摄影风格为 dreamy cinematic portrait photography。使用 135mm f/1.8 telephoto lens 的视觉效果，人物占画面约 60% 到 70%，浅景深，明显 background compression，strong creamy bokeh，背景虚化柔软细腻。构图自然，不要僵硬对称，不要时尚大片式摆拍，要像 authentic candid photography。

光线为明亮的夏日自然光，优先表现中午前后的清透阳光或傍晚偏亮的金色日光。阳光照在人物脸部、头发、肩膀和衣服上，产生自然的高光和轻微阴影。高光区域可以有 slight overexposure，带有 soft halation 和 luminous highlight bloom，让白衣、皮肤和天空显得通透发亮，但整体仍然柔和，不要刺眼。

色彩参考 Fuji Pro 400H inspired colors，整体低饱和但明亮，偏清透冷感。主色倾向于：奶油白、浅天空蓝、柔和青绿色、淡草绿色、牛仔蓝、自然肤色。白色干净通透，黑发浓郁但不死黑，阴影柔和，画面整体轻盈、清爽、干净，有一点褪色感和旧胶片感。

画面质感加入 subtle atmospheric haze、fine film grain、soft optical softness、slight nostalgic film rendering。带有轻微的 1990s to early 2000s Japanese photography mood，也有一点 Sony Handycam MiniDV aesthetic 的怀旧氛围，但不要做成粗糙录像感，要保持写真级别的清透与美感。

整体氛围不是“精致摆拍美女图”，而是“某个夏天真实存在过的一段记忆”。画面应该让人感觉：安静、温柔、轻盈、明亮、青春、怀旧，像很多年后翻到的一张旧旅行照片。

避免：
不要网红AI脸，不要过度锐化，不要塑料皮肤，不要HDR，不要浓烈橙青调色，不要商业广告感，不要棚拍布光，不要复杂华丽服装，不要太多配饰，不要夸张姿势，不要明显AI生成痕迹。

最终效果：真实东亚少女写真 + 白色浅色系穿搭 + 夏日清透阳光 + 长焦浅景深 + 奶油虚化 + Fuji Pro 400H 胶片色彩 + 柔和光晕 + 怀旧旅行照片气质。

items.title: 极简工作室女性手持金属球棒写实肖像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographed portrait. Subject and action: one adult woman standing close to the seamless backdrop while leaning away from the camera, extending the bat directly toward the lens and maintaining direct eye contact; the face stays unobstructed and readable. Hair and styling: Render an adult woman's hair as a shoulder-length lob with loose waves beginning below the cheekbones, in deep chocolate brown, only within jaw-to-collarbone bob, lob, or compact-tie geometry. Composition: Strict vertical upper-thigh portrait with the subject centered slightly right, modest headroom, lower legs and feet cut off; The rounded end of a silver metal bat fills the lower-left foreground and is cropped by the frame. Camera: Low, close camera aimed slightly upward with strong wide-angle perspective. Color and depth relationships: Off-white background, a dark nearly black outfit, and cool silver metal form the restrained three-color relationship. Pose: Torso leaned backward and angled diagonally, chest facing the camera, waist curved, hips shifted toward frame right; Head held nearly upright, eyes looking directly into the lens, eyelids relaxed, lips softly parted, expression neutral and intent. Wardrobe: Dark charcoal Toteme ribbed sleeveless knit dress with a close, simple silhouette; the ribbing stretches slightly across the leaned torso and forms small gravity wrinkles at the waist and hip; Toteme ribbed sleeveless knit dress, flat leather sandals, canvas tote. Setting: Plain off-white studio seamless with no visible furniture or decoration. Lighting: Large soft diffused frontal light from slightly above, even across the face and torso, with gentle shadows and a pale studio background. Natural snapshot details: Keep the bat end heavily out of focus and disproportionately large from being inches from the lens; its blurred circular tip and shaft dominate the lower-left foreground, while the abrupt upper-thigh crop cuts off. Finish: Clean modern studio digital photograph with neutral-to-slightly-cool whites, restrained saturation, medium contrast, smooth but not clipped highlight roll-off on the silver bat, softly held blacks, low fine sensor grain, restrained sharpening, visible skin pores and faint natural unevenness around the cheeks and torso. Rendering constraints: keep the exact crop, body-to-camera relationship, hand task, gaze direction, light direction, foreground obstruction, and background placement; preserve believable anatomy and natural hands; avoid beauty-filter skin, studio-clean restaging, generic fashion posing, text, logos, borders, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

创建一张写实的竖屏 9:16 摄影肖像。主体与动作：一名成年女性站在无缝背景墙附近，身体向后倾斜远离镜头，将球棒直接伸向镜头并保持直接的目光接触；面部保持无遮挡且清晰可辨。发型与造型：将成年女性的头发呈现为齐肩长波波头（lob），从颧骨下方开始有松散的波浪，深巧克力褐色，仅限下颌至锁骨的波波头、长波波头或紧凑型几何形状。构图：严格的竖向大腿中部以上肖像，主体略微偏右居中，上方留有适度空间，下半身腿部和脚部被截断；银色金属球棒的圆端占据左下角前景并被画框切割。相机：低角度、近距离拍摄，镜头略微向上，具有强烈的广角透视。颜色与深度关系：米白色背景、深色近乎黑色的服装以及冷银色金属形成了克制的三色关系。姿势：躯干向后倾斜并呈对角线角度，身形面向镜头，腰部弯曲，臀部向画面右侧偏移；头部几乎竖直，眼睛直视镜头，眼睑放松，双唇微张，表情中性且专注。衣橱：深炭灰色 Toteme 罗纹无袖针织连衣裙，廓形简洁修身；罗纹在倾斜的躯干上轻微拉伸，在腰部和臀部形成细小的重力皱褶；Toteme 罗纹无袖针织连衣裙，平底皮革凉鞋，帆布托特包。场景：纯米白色无缝工作室背景，没有可见的家具或装饰。光效：上方略微投射的大型柔和漫射正面光，均匀分布在面部和躯干，带有柔和的阴影和苍白的工作室背景。自然快照细节：保持球棒末端严重失焦，由于距离镜头仅几英寸而显得比例过大；其模糊的圆形尖端和球杆占据了左下角前景，而突然的大腿中部裁剪将其切断。润饰：干净的现代工作室数字照片，具有中性至略微偏冷的白色、克制的饱和度、中等对比度、银色球棒上平滑但未溢出的高光衰减、柔和的黑色调、低细微感光元件噪点、克制的锐化，可见皮肤毛孔以及脸颊和躯干周围淡淡的自然不均匀感。渲染约束：保持确切的裁剪、身体与相机的关系、手部动作、注视方向、光线方向、前景遮挡和背景放置；保留可信的解剖结构和自然的手部；避免美颜滤镜皮肤、工作室化的刻意布景、通用的时尚摆拍、文字、标志、边框和水印。

items.title: 粉黑白格纹地雷系比基尼设计
items.description: 粉色、黑色与白色格纹的地雷系夏季比基尼设计，强调长款结构、黑色花卉蕾丝、交叉装饰带与分层荷叶裙边细节。
items.prompt: Create a clean fashion-design presentation of a playful Jirai-kei inspired summer bikini in pink, black, and white plaid. Show a structured longline bikini top with shaped cups, black floral lace tracing the neckline, slim shoulder straps, decorative crossing straps above the bust, and vertical black corset-style accents. Pair it with matching high-waisted bikini bottoms finished with a layered plaid ruffle skirt and coordinated black edging. Keep the garment construction, plaid alignment, lace texture, strap placement, ruffle layers, and trim clearly visible. Use a polished studio fashion-board presentation with realistic fabric texture, crisp even lighting, a restrained playful mood, and no model, body, nudity, text, logos, or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh: 制作一张干净的服装设计展示图：粉色、黑色与白色格纹的俏皮地雷系夏季比基尼。上装为结构化长款比基尼上衣，带成型罩杯、沿领口分布的黑色花卉蕾丝、细肩带、胸部上方的装饰性交叉带，以及垂直黑色束身衣风格装饰。下装搭配同款高腰比基尼泳裤，并加入分层格纹荷叶裙边和协调的黑色包边。清楚呈现服装结构、格纹对齐、蕾丝纹理、肩带位置、荷叶层次与包边细节。采用精致的棚拍服装设计板展示方式，布料纹理真实，光线均匀清晰，整体俏皮但克制；不要人物、身体、裸露、文字、logo或水印。

items.title: 掌中微缩城市超写实旅行明信片
items.description: 参数化4:5掌中微缩城市超写实旅行明信片模板，默认示例为Santorini、Greece；真实人手仅作为托举平台的物件细节，不进行人物身份绑定。
items.prompt:
Create a premium ultra-realistic 4:5 vertical miniature travel postcard for Santorini, Greece, using the defaults when no replacement is supplied. Design it as a cinematic city-in-your-hand scene: a realistic human hand gently holds a thick weathered stone or concrete rectangular platform carrying a highly detailed miniature of Santorini's iconic landmarks and recognizable cityscape. The hand is only an object-detail element, with no identity reference required.

Build the miniature with believable architecture, roads, waterfronts, greenery, boats, beaches and local details, arranged as an aerial diorama with clear foreground, middle ground and background depth. Add exactly 2–4 distinctive cultural elements specific to Santorini, such as traditional food, transport, crafts or objects.

Use warm golden-hour sunlight, soft atmospheric haze, shallow depth of field, realistic miniature scale, natural shadows, tactile stone texture, cinematic composition and subtle tilt-shift photography. Render believable hand and skin texture, intricate materials and sophisticated premium travel-advertising realism.

Add elegant raised or engraved lettering on the platform's front edge reading exactly “Santorini - Greece”. No other readable text, logos, watermarks, illustration, cartoon styling or plastic materials.
items.prompt_zh:
为 Santorini、Greece 创作一张高级超写实4:5竖版微缩旅行明信片；没有替换值时使用默认示例。将其设计为电影感的掌中城市场景：一只真实的人手轻轻托着厚实、风化的石制或混凝土矩形平台，平台上呈现 Santorini 标志性地标与高辨识度城市景观的精细微缩版。人手只是物件细节，不需要身份参考图。

用可信的建筑、道路、滨水区、绿化、船只、海滩和本地细节构建微缩城市，形成前景、中景和背景层次清晰的鸟瞰透视模型。加入恰好2–4个专属于 Santorini 的独特文化元素，例如传统食物、交通工具、手工艺品或物件。

使用温暖金色时刻阳光、柔和大气薄雾、浅景深、真实微缩比例、自然阴影、触感石材纹理、电影级构图和微妙移轴摄影。呈现可信的人手与皮肤纹理、精细材质和高级旅行广告摄影质感。

在平台前缘添加优雅的浮雕或雕刻文字，内容必须准确为“Santorini - Greece”。不要其他可读文字、标志、水印、插图、卡通风格或塑料材质。

items.title: 高级设计感稚拙手绘海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Please process each photo I upload into an individual high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo separately. Use a 3:4 vertical composition overall, with the top and bottom areas strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper part retains the original photo, maintaining the subject's identity, structure, posture, real texture, natural light and shadow, and the original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition image. To adapt to the frame, the environment background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable **subject, local elements, action clues, object details, and narrative relationships** from the photo, reconstructing them into a visual system of **3×3 modular icon grid + hand-drawn naive doodle illustration + crayon/colored pencil grainy texture + handwritten text**. Do not fully trace the original image or make realistic illustrations; instead, compress complex information into the 9 most memorable visual units: these can be the subject itself, local features, personal belongings, plants, food, modes of transportation, postures, emotional symbols, or small memory points in the scene. Each unit should be a semantic extension of the same scene above, making people feel at a glance that they belong to the "memory list" of the same photo.

The composition uses an **implicit 3×3 loose grid**. The nine-square grid only serves as the underlying order and does not need to be drawn too neatly; the position, size, angle, and placement of each icon can be slightly shifted, forming a **loose grid / organic grid** feel that is both orderly and not mechanical. A short handwritten title can be added at the top, accompanied by a few relaxed small wavy lines, star dots, or symbols; a tiny handwritten caption can be added at the bottom, making the whole thing look like a private journal page, visual diary, or collection sheet. White space must be sufficient, and the layout should be relaxed, cute, restrained, and not cluttered.

The art style adopts **Naïve Hand-drawn Doodle Illustration**: simple shapes, a slight sense of naivety, slightly shaky outlines, uneven thickness, not completely closed, retaining intentional imperfections. Coloring should not be too full, allowing paper texture, white particles, and rough edges to be seen. A mixture of thin black outlines, colored pencil/crayon coloring, and a few local color blocks can be used, not relying on real light and shadow shaping, but establishing graphic relationships through flat color / spot color. If grid auxiliary lines appear, they should be extremely light, like a draft lightly drawn with a pencil, rather than a regular table drawn by a computer.

The color scheme uses a **low-saturation vintage candy color palette**, with overall warm off-white textured paper as the base. The colors remain soft, light, friendly, and high-end. Comprehensive color relationships such as sage green, mint green, pastel blue, cobalt blue, cream yellow, grey pink, strawberry pink, and coral orange-red can be extracted and translated from the original image: usually blue-green as the main color, yellow-pink as the object fill color, and orange-red used only for a tiny amount of emphasis. The overall control is a large area of off-white background, a moderate amount of blue-green main color, a small area of yellow-pink auxiliary color, and a tiny amount of orange-red finishing touch, making the screen rich but not cluttered.

Add a layer of a small amount of **hand-drawn annotation-style red comment elements**, such as circles, arrows, hearts, starbursts, small crosses, wavy lines, or emphasis marks, transforming the work from a common icon page into a more editorial and private visual diary. However, these annotations must be few and precise, only serving as a secondary finishing touch, and must not overshadow the main subject.

Text is not limited to fixed content and language. A small amount of truly meaningful words should be freely generated based on the theme, emotion, location, action, or sense of life of the photo. Use **light, small, relaxed handwritten fonts with slight writing pauses and letter spacing drift** for titles and captions, making the text look like casual notes naturally written on paper, rather than commercial typography titles. The overall text should remain small in quantity, tiny in size, with sufficient white space, forming a natural graphic-text mixed layout with icons and annotations.

Overall, it presents a **naive, relaxed, vintage, healing, light, friendly, and editorially designed** vis
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、局部元素、动作线索、物件细节与叙事关系**，重构为一套 **3×3 模块化图标网格 + 手绘稚拙涂鸦插画 + 蜡笔/彩铅颗粒质感 + 手写文字** 的视觉系统。不要完整描摹原图，也不要做写实插画，而是将复杂信息压缩为 9 个最值得被记住的视觉单元：可以是主体本身、局部特征、随身物件、植物、食物、交通方式、姿态、情绪符号或场景中的小记忆点。每个单元都应来自上方同一画面的语义延伸，使人一眼感到它们属于同一张照片的“记忆清单”。

构图采用**隐性的 3×3 松散网格**。九宫格只作为底层秩序，不必画得过于工整；每个图标的位置、大小、角度和落点都可轻微偏移，形成既有秩序又不机械的 **loose grid / organic grid** 感。顶部可加入一个简短手写标题，并配少量轻松的小波浪线、星点或符号；底部可加入一句极小的手写 caption，使整体像一页私人手帐、视觉日记或 collection sheet。留白必须充足，版面要松弛、可爱、克制而不凌乱。

画风采用**Naïve Hand-drawn Doodle Illustration**：形体简洁、略带稚拙感，轮廓轻微抖动、粗细不均、不完全闭合，保留有意识的不完美。填色不要铺得太满，允许看到纸纹、白色颗粒和边缘毛糙感。可混合黑色细线轮廓、彩铅/蜡笔填色和少量局部色块，不依赖真实光影塑造，而以 flat color / spot color 的方式建立图形关系。网格辅助线若出现，应极淡，像铅笔轻轻打出的底稿，而不是电脑绘制的规则表格。

配色采用**低饱和复古糖果色系**，整体以温暖米白粗纹纸为底，色彩保持柔和、轻快、亲切而高级。可从原图中提炼并转译为鼠尾草绿、薄荷绿、蜡笔蓝、钴蓝、奶油黄、灰粉、草莓粉、珊瑚橘红等综合色关系：通常以蓝绿为主色，黄粉作为物体填色，橘红仅用于极少量强调。整体控制为大面积米白背景、适量蓝绿主色、小面积黄粉辅助色与极少量橘红点睛，使画面丰富却不杂乱。

加入一层少量**手绘批注式红色注释元素**，如圈圈、箭头、爱心、星芒、小叉号、波浪线或强调记号，使作品从普通图标页转化为更有编辑感和私人感的视觉日记。但这些注释必须少而准，只作为二次点睛，不可喧宾夺主。

文字不限制固定内容与语种，应根据照片的主题、情绪、地点、动作或生活感，自由生成少量真正有意义的字词。标题与说明文字使用**轻小、松弛、略带书写停顿与字距漂移的手写字体**，让文字像自然写在纸上的随手记录，而不是商业排版标题。整体文字保持少量、细小、留白充足，与图标和注释形成自然的图文混排关系。

整体呈现一种**稚拙、松弛、复古、治愈、轻快、亲切又有编辑设计感**的视觉气质，像一本被认真收藏的私人手帐、幸福清单或生活观察页。避免整洁矢量感、真实光影、复杂纹理、厚重阴影、过度工整的UI图标感、商业模板感和儿童卡通化。

items.title: 仪式感克制宣告式视觉海报
items.description: 可复用的仪式感宣告海报模板：以主题、核心影像、日期、地点和短说明变量生成大面积明亮留白、中央低饱和模糊影像及边缘压叠巨型衬线文字的高级印刷邀请视觉。
items.prompt:
Create a restrained, ceremonial announcement poster in a vertical 4:5 format for the theme THE QUIET HOUR and subject A CEREMONIAL GATHERING. Use a large area of bright, clear, clean blank space to carry information. Add extremely light flowing textures and a barely visible paper surface sheen only for air and layering, never as decorative noise.

Establish the first visual focus with a large high-contrast serif title THE QUIET HOUR centered at the top. Tightly overlap a small line of original Chinese information derived from A CEREMONIAL GATHERING with the title, using tightened letter spacing and restrained line spacing so it falls like a formal invitation or important announcement.

In the middle, place a clean-bordered main image field showing a folded white invitation beside one dark flower on a pale stone table as a close-up, low-saturation, slightly motion-blurred cinematic still life. Keep the image hazy, intimate and memory-like, with no identifiable person, face or crowd. Press one oversized serif line reading THE QUIET HOUR against the bottom edge of the image so the image partially crops or obscures the letters. The text and image must feel embedded into each other rather than separated into ordinary columns.

Below the image, build an axis-centered information hierarchy with visible original text: a small heading A CEREMONIAL GATHERING, a main name THE QUIET HOUR, the date 2026.10.18, the short description An evening of quiet attention and shared memory, and the location NORTH HALL. Reduce each level step by step and leave generous breathing space, creating a reading rhythm from declaration to witnessing, time and place.

Extract color from the subject materials and emotional signals while maintaining a high-brightness clean base, a small amount of low-saturation image color, clear dark information text and one very small thematic accent. Use dark tones only for structure and reading weight. Keep textures and shadows transparent, light and clean. The result should feel like a high-end printed invitation: precise whitespace, rhythmic typography and memorable central imagery.

Use original text only. Avoid muddy gray-yellow tones, smoky aging, distressed noise, decorative clutter, generic text blocks, copied logos, unrelated words, external watermarks, people, faces, crowds, commercial advertising style and glossy 3D rendering.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张竖幅 4:5 的克制、具有仪式感的宣告式海报，主题为 THE QUIET HOUR，核心主题内容为 A CEREMONIAL GATHERING。画面使用大面积明亮、清透、干净的空白承载信息。背景只加入极淡的流动纹理和几乎不可见的纸面光感，用于营造空气感和层次，不形成装饰噪音。

第一视觉焦点为顶部居中的高反差大号衬线标题 THE QUIET HOUR。让一行由 A CEREMONIAL GATHERING 派生的原创中文信息与标题紧密叠压，使用收紧字距和克制行距，像正式邀请或重要公告一样清晰落下。

中段放置边界干净的主影像场，近距离呈现 a folded white invitation beside one dark flower on a pale stone table，使用低饱和、轻微动态模糊的电影感静物影像。保持朦胧、亲密和瞬间记忆感，不出现可识别的人物、脸部或人群。将一行写有 THE QUIET HOUR 的超大衬线文字压在影像底部边缘，让影像局部裁切或遮挡文字，使文字与影像互相嵌入，而不是普通的图文分栏。

影像下方按轴线居中建立信息层级，显示原创文字：小标题 A CEREMONIAL GATHERING、主体名称 THE QUIET HOUR、日期 2026.10.18、简短说明 An evening of quiet attention and shared memory 和地点 NORTH HALL。各层级逐步缩小，留出充足呼吸间距，形成从宣告、见证到时间和地点的阅读节奏。

从主题的材质和情绪信号中提取色彩，同时维持高明度洁净底色、少量低饱和影像色、清晰深色信息文字和极少量主题强调色的角色关系。深色只用于结构与阅读重量，纹理和阴影保持透明、轻盈、干净。整体应像一张高级印刷邀请视觉：留白精确、字体有节拍、中央影像具有记忆性。

只使用原创文字。避免浑浊灰黄色调、烟熏做旧、磨损噪声、装饰性杂乱、泛化文字块、复制徽标、无关词语、外部水印、人物、脸部、人群、商业广告风和光滑的 3D 渲染。

items.title: 极简主义独立杂志海报设计提示词
items.description: 参数化3:4极简独立杂志海报模板，默认以单件雕塑感陶瓷器物为核心主体；提供主体、2–6词标题、低饱和强调色与少量辅助信息变量，保留瑞士网格、非对称编辑版式、暖白留白和轻微印刷质感。
items.prompt:
Design a 3:4 vertical minimalist magazine poster for a single sculptural ceramic vessel, using the defaults when no replacement is supplied. Make the single core subject the clear visual focus; it may be fully shown, boldly cropped, bleed beyond an edge or placed asymmetrically, but do not introduce a second core subject.

Use the cover language of an independent design publication: restrained, quiet, avant-garde and contemporary. Set the background in warm white, off-white or a very low-saturation solid tone, preserving generous clean negative space. Use a strict Swiss grid with an asymmetric editorial layout and a hierarchy limited to three levels: the oversized main title, the single core subject, and a small amount of auxiliary information.

Set the large bold sans-serif title to “QUIET FORM”. Keep it between 2 and 6 words, clearly readable while allowing partial occlusion by the subject, edge extension or asymmetric placement. Use ISSUE 01 / OBJECT STUDY in a small neutral sans-serif font as issue, date, column or short-description information. Do not add dense copy.

Control the palette to black, white, gray and one low-saturation accent color, using gray-blue as the accent. Add slight paper fibers, ink grain and restrained printing-registration deviation without heavy aging. The result should feel like a limited-edition cover from an independent design studio, not a common promotional poster.

Avoid stacked decorative elements, complex backgrounds, multiple core subjects, fancy fonts, gradient glows, metallic effects, cheap tech styling, decorative stickers, meaningless graphics, extra readable text, logos and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
为 a single sculptural ceramic vessel 设计一张3:4竖版极简杂志海报；没有替换值时使用默认示例。让唯一核心主体成为清晰的视觉焦点，可以完整展示、大胆局部裁切、出血到边缘或非对称摆放，但不要引入第二个核心主体。

采用独立设计刊物封面语言：克制、安静、前卫并具有当代感。背景使用暖白、灰白或极低饱和纯色，保留充足干净留白。使用严格的瑞士网格和非对称编辑版式，信息层级限定为三级：超大主标题、唯一核心主体和少量辅助信息。

将大号粗体无衬线主标题设为“QUIET FORM”。标题控制在2–6个词以内，必须清晰可读，同时允许被主体部分遮挡、延伸到边缘或非对称排列。使用小号中性无衬线字体呈现 ISSUE 01 / OBJECT STUDY，作为期号、日期、栏目名或简短说明，不添加密集文案。

将调色控制在黑、白、灰和一种低饱和强调色之间，并使用 gray-blue 作为强调色。加入轻微纸张纤维、油墨颗粒和克制的印刷套色偏差，但不要过度做旧。整体应像独立设计工作室制作的限量刊物封面，而不是普通宣传海报。

避免装饰元素堆叠、复杂背景、多核心主体、花哨字体、渐变发光、金属特效、廉价科技感、装饰性贴纸、无意义图形、额外可读文字、标志和水印。

items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

为名为“LUNAVERA”的原生植物奶品牌创建一张高端双版商业活动海报。使用超写实俯拍美食摄影风格，搭配整洁、高端的社论广告布局。保持精确的结构逻辑：在同一个水平活动板上并排放置两个相等的垂直面板，每个面板都建立在质朴的饱经风霜的木制桌面上，每个面板上方都有一行巨大的流动白色手写标题，中间有一个超大的圆形分割食物构图，中下方有一条简短的弧形支撑线条，右下角有一个相同的产品纸盒包装图，底部有一个极简的营养声明。整个活动必须感觉像戛纳级别的快消品视觉系统：新鲜、多变、优雅且过目难忘。

风格锁定：
高端植物基食品活动，超写实静物摄影，质朴桌面造型，整洁的产品优先层级，现代有机品牌推广，柔和的日光写实感，精细的超市旗舰店质感。

核心构图：
使用严格的双面板布局，面板宽度相等，视觉权重相等，顶部间距相等，包装图大小相同，且相机角度一致。两个主要的碗或玻璃杯在直径、高度、裁剪大小、透视和视觉权重上必须完全匹配。该活动应被视为一个统一的系统，而不是两个独立的广告。

端口超级符号逻辑：
将一个相同的植物奶纸盒与两个完美匹配的圆形食物应用相结合的理念转化为品牌独特且不容错过的超级符号。同一产品必须清晰地连接两个世界：咸味的舒适感和清新的早餐活力。重复的圆形形状和重复的纸盒放置应成为品牌的视觉识别代码。即使在缩略图比例下，观看者也应能通过一个产品、两个相等的圆圈、两种生活方式立即识别出该系统。

轨道运动逻辑：
在两个面板之间创建一个强大的从左到右并返回的阅读循环。视线应从左侧上方标题开始，移动到左侧圆形咸味菜肴，通过弧形支撑线下降到左侧纸盒，跳跃到右侧纸盒，上升到右侧圆形早餐构图，然后向上穿过右侧标题并穿过这对组合回到起点，形成一个完整的视觉回路。利用容器的弧形边缘、圆弧状的文案、食材的摆放以及匹配的纸盒位置来创建一个优雅的整个活动范围内的轨道。

左侧面板：
创建一个咸餐应用场景。使用一个与右侧面板裁剪方式完全相同的圆形大碗构图。一半应显示带有可见绿豆、豆腐块和红辣椒片的奶油色金黄蔬菜咖喱；另一半应显示淡奶油色的泥状物或谷物泥。质地必须感觉温暖、光滑、丰富且舒适。将产品纸盒保留在右下角，大小和角度与右侧面板完全一致。

右侧面板：
使用完全相同的容器比例和透视创建一个早餐应用场景。一半应在圆形容器中显示淡粉色的浆果奶昔或类似酸奶的混合物，而另一半则显示装有麦片、桃子切片、蓝莓、燕麦和种子的早餐碗。质地必须感觉凉爽、新鲜且天然健康。再次将相同的产品纸盒放置在右下角，尺寸和对齐方式完全相同。

产品设计：
为“LUNAVERA Almond Coconut Blend”设计一个原创的杏仁椰子植物奶纸盒，带有优雅的奶油色、柔和的绿色和椰子杏仁插画细节。纸盒必须感觉高端、可上架、写实且具有全球市场竞争力。两个包装图必须完全一致。

光照：
使用来自左上方的柔和漫射日光，并带有柔和的环境填充。保持食物表面明亮、整洁且令人垂涎，具有细微的阴影衰减和自然的纹理细节。在两个面板上保持完全一致的光照逻辑，使它们感觉像是一个高端活动系统的一部分。

材质与写实感：
将咖喱渲染出奶油般的粘稠度、柔和的油脂光泽、写实的蔬菜、豆腐的孔隙和诱人的酱汁深度。将泥状物或谷物泥渲染出平滑的打发质感和细微的表面纹理。将奶昔渲染出混合泡沫的柔软感和水果密度。将早餐碗渲染出清脆的燕麦、多汁的水果质感、种子细节和天然新鲜感。将纸盒渲染出清晰的折痕、亚光涂层纸板和整洁的印刷细节。将木制桌面渲染出真实的木纹、划痕和细微的老化感。

色彩策略：
使用自然的植物基色调：柔和的漂流木灰色、暖奶油色、杏仁米色、椰子白、叶绿色、浆果粉、桃金色和金黄色咖喱色。保持整个活动明亮、健康且高端。让左侧面板感觉更温暖，右侧面板感觉更清新，同时保持整体和谐。

排版与布局：
仅使用原创英文文本。建议跨两个面板的上方标题方向为：
“One Blend, Every Table”
使用简短的弧形支撑线，例如：
“made for savory comfort”
和
“made for bright mornings”
使用一条极简的底部声明，例如：
“30% lighter than dairy milk”
不要从任何源图像中复制任何现有的品牌名称、口号或措辞。

质量目标：
超细节、高分辨率商业印刷效果，纯净的美食写实感，准确的等大容器比例，清晰的包装图，整洁的质朴背景，强大的符号可读性，不杂乱，没有浑浊的颜色，没有廉价的超市传单感。

负面提示词：
抄袭的品牌推广，抄袭的口号，不匹配的碗尺寸，不匹配的玻璃杯尺寸，不一致的透视，不平等的视觉权重，低细节的食物纹理，模糊的纸盒，杂乱的桌面，浑浊的木纹纹理，过饱和的颜色，难以辨认的排版，薄弱的产品层级，随机的道具，黑色斑块，廉价的超市宣传册美学

items.title: 极致奢华商业风饼干与牛奶飞溅的视觉盛宴
items.description: 参数化高端饼干牛奶飞溅微距商业广告模板，默认主体为奶油夹心黄油饼干，保留3:4动态悬浮堆叠、奶油或黄油层、牛奶曲线飞溅、碎屑液滴和深色影棚渐变背景。
items.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic 3:4 premium commercial macro-food photograph of cream-filled butter biscuits, using the default when no replacement is supplied. Stack the biscuits dynamically in mid-air, with a few pieces slightly broken to reveal rich texture and visible creamy filling or buttery layers. Surround the stack with a dramatic splash of milk forming elegant artistic curves. Suspend soft biscuit crumbs and freeze glossy milk droplets in motion.

Use a dark studio gradient background, cinematic professional lighting, ultra-sharp macro focus, high contrast and a polished luxury-advertising finish. Make the biscuit surface, filling, crumb structure, milk translucency and splash edges hyper-detailed and photorealistic. Keep the composition clean and product-focused, with the floating stack and milk motion as the sole visual subject. Do not add people, packaging, brand marks, logos, readable text or watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张照片级真实的3:4高端食品商业微距广告图，主体为 cream-filled butter biscuits；没有替换值时使用默认的“奶油夹心黄油饼干”。让饼干动态堆叠并悬浮在半空，少量饼干略微破裂，展现丰富质地以及清晰可见的奶油夹心或黄油层。让牛奶飞溅在饼干周围形成戏剧性的艺术曲线，同时让柔软饼干碎屑悬浮，让有光泽的牛奶液滴凝固在运动瞬间。

使用深色影棚渐变背景、电影级专业布光、超锐利的微距对焦、高对比度和精致奢华的商业广告质感。细致写实地呈现饼干表面、夹心、碎屑结构、牛奶的通透感与飞溅边缘。保持构图干净并聚焦产品，让悬浮饼干堆和牛奶动态成为唯一视觉主体。不要人物、包装、品牌标记、标志、可读文字或水印。

items.title: 现代食品社论排版海报
items.description: 围绕主食物或饮料的自然形状构图的 9:16 写实食品社论海报模板。
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical modern food editorial poster. Brand: Citrus Studio; food or drink: sparkling lemon soda; main campaign line: Bright Break; supporting copy: sparkling lemon soda | 330 ml | chilled; background color: soft warm white; accent colors: lemon yellow and cobalt blue; typography word: ZEST; composition direction: vertical.

Build the entire poster around the natural shape and direction of the food, using one clear hero product. Use highly realistic food photography with appetizing product-appropriate textures, natural highlights, shadows, moisture, crumbs, glaze, melted cheese, glass reflections, or fresh ingredients. Avoid CGI, plastic textures, excessive retouching, and generic e-commerce photography. Let product shape drive the layout: a tall drink can be vertical, a pizza slice strongly diagonal, a round bowl can guide circular typography, and crossed products can form an X structure.

Use oversized editorial typography as an active compositional element. Make ZEST very large and, according to product geometry, crop it by the canvas, hide part behind the food, split it across areas, rotate or curve it, or extend it beyond the frame. Food and typography must genuinely overlap and interact, never merely place text beside food: let the food cover letters, cross typographic boundaries, break through color blocks, or interrupt the grid so photography and graphic design are integrated.

Keep a clear hierarchy: oversized display typography, hero food photography, Bright Break, and sparkling lemon soda | 330 ml | chilled. Supporting copy must be concise and meaningful; never use Lorem Ipsum or random filler. Use a light soft warm white background, realistic food colors, and one or two restrained accents from lemon yellow and cobalt blue. Add only a few thin lines, dots, open frames, geometric blocks, soft organic shapes, or small information labels. Make the composition energetic and asymmetric but carefully art-directed, with enough negative space for readability. Final style: bold modern food editorial design, dynamic composition, photorealistic food photography, retro-modern branding, clean spacing, playful and professional.
items.prompt_zh:
创建一张 9:16 竖幅现代食品社论海报。品牌为 Citrus Studio；主食物或饮料为 sparkling lemon soda；主宣传语为 Bright Break；辅助文本为 sparkling lemon soda | 330 ml | chilled；背景色为 soft warm white；强调色为 lemon yellow and cobalt blue；排版主词为 ZEST；构图方向为 vertical。

围绕食物本身的自然形状和方向构建整个海报，只使用一个清晰的主角产品。采用高度写实的食品摄影，呈现适合产品的诱人纹理、自然高光、阴影、水分、面包屑、釉面、融化奶酪、玻璃反射或新鲜食材。不要 CGI、塑料质感、过度修饰或通用电商摄影。让产品形状驱动版式：高饮料适合垂直构图，披萨切片可形成强对角线，圆碗可引导圆形排版，交叉产品可形成 X 形结构。

使用超大社论排版作为活跃构图元素。将 ZEST 做得很大，并依产品几何关系被画布裁切、部分藏在食物后、分布在不同区域、旋转、弯曲或延伸出画面。食物与文字必须真正重叠互动，不可只是文字放在食物旁边；让食物覆盖部分字母、跨越排版边界、冲破色块或打破网格，使摄影与平面设计融为一体。

文字层级必须清晰：超大展示排版、主角食品摄影、Bright Break、sparkling lemon soda | 330 ml | chilled。辅助文案有意义且简洁，不使用 Lorem Ipsum 或随机填充。使用 soft warm white 的浅色背景、真实食品色彩及 lemon yellow and cobalt blue 中 1 至 2 种克制强调色；只加入少量细线、点、开放框、几何色块、柔和有机形状或小信息标签。构图富有活力和不对称性，同时经过精心艺术指导，并留有足够负空间确保文字可读。最终呈现大胆排版、动态构图、写实食品摄影、复古现代品牌感、整洁间距且有趣专业的设计。

items.title: 同一人物稳定再现说明书
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Based on the character in the attached image, please create a 'Character Instruction Manual' in a wide single-page format for the stable reproduction of the same character in the future.

Using the attached image as the sole standard, unify the face, sense of age, body type, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and skin texture across all panels. It is forbidden to turn into someone else, over-beautify, or make them look younger.

Contents to be included in the sheet:

・Full body: Front, side, back, diagonal front, diagonal back
・Face: Front, profile, 45-degree angle, above, below
・Expressions: Normal, smiling face, serious, surprised, shy, bitter face, thinking, sad, calm
・Details: Eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, ears, contour, skin, hands
・Hair: Bangs, side hair, back hair, hair ends, hair flow direction
・Other angles of the hair and face
・Short characteristic memo
・Color samples for hair, pupils, skin, lips, clothing, and shadows
・Fixed points for regeneration

Landscape 16:9, white or light gray background. Create with a clean document-style design organized with thin horizontal lines and boxes. Please place the full body and face in the center, expressions and other angles on the right, and part details at the bottom.

Text within the image is limited to short Japanese labels; do not add names, age numbers, personality, hobbies, profiles, etc. Please also keep the expression style of the original image, such as photorealistic or illustration, as it is.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

基于附图中的人物，今后为稳定再现同一人物而制作的“人物取扱说明书”，请以横长1页的形式创建。

以附图为唯一标准，在所有面板中统一面容、年龄感、体型、发型、发色、服装、皮肤质感。禁止变成他人、过度美化、年轻化。

放入シート的内容：

・全身：正面、侧面、后方、斜前方、斜后方
・脸部：正面、侧脸、斜45度、上方、下方
・表情：通常、笑脸、认真、惊讶、害羞、苦脸、思考中、悲伤、平静
・细节：眼睛、眉毛、鼻子、嘴巴、耳朵、轮廓、皮肤、手
・头发：刘海、侧发、后发、发梢、发流向
・头发和脸部的其他角度
・简短特征备忘
・头发、瞳孔、皮肤、嘴唇、服装、阴影的颜色样本
・再生成时的固定要点

横长16:9，白色或浅灰色背景。以细薄的横线和方框整理的、干净的资料用设计来制作。请将全身和脸部置于中央，表情和其他角度置于右侧，部件细节置于下方。

图像内的文字仅限于简短的日语标签，不要加入姓名、年龄数字、性格、爱好、简介等。原图的实拍、插图等表现形式也请保持原样。

items.title: 暗黑浪漫哥特芭蕾时尚摄影
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的图像提示词，已按本地图像分类和站点 gpt-image-2.5 归类整理。 使用时需上传人物参考图；本流程使用统一参考人物生成示例。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

A darkly romantic, gothic-ballet fashion photograph of a clearly adult young woman with long black hair and cool pale skin. Her hair is styled in a loose, thick braid woven with deep burgundy satin ribbons. Deep burgundy satin ribbons are also wrapped around the back of her neck and both arms, lightly spiraling around the forearms and ending in a burgundy bow tied at each wrist. She wears a white ballet-inspired corset mini dress with thin shoulder straps, a clearly visible lace-up corset back, and a voluminous, airy tulle skirt.
She is seated on the floor or on the spread of her skirt with her back facing the camera. Her upper body is upright with a slight backward lean, her hands placed behind her and gently overlapping, and her head tilted upward to reveal a long elegant neck and defined jawline. One eye looks toward the viewer. Her pose is quiet, elegant, dreamy, and emotionally tense.
The setting is an abandoned rehearsal room or an old theater backstage corridor, with a dim, blurred background and a vintage theatrical atmosphere. Vertical composition, 3:4 aspect ratio. The camera is positioned behind her, slightly to the left, at eye level or slightly lower. The subject is placed slightly right of center. Emphasis on the shoulders, neck, back, long braid, red ribbons, and corset dress.
A hard flash from the front-left illuminates the subject, making her bright while the background falls into darkness, creating strong contrast. Overall palette: gray-white, cool white, burgundy, and deep black. Subtle film grain, a slight softness or haze, and a vintage fashion-photography texture. Avoid a modern ultra-HD studio look.
