items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

a concrete visual subject, preserve the character's most recognizable facial structure, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, main clothing colors, and iconic accessories, and reorganize the character's clothing into a sleeveless high-neck style with a new Chinese-style formal dress language, maintaining the character's core color scheme, while adding fine sequins, bead embroidery, translucent tulle, or slight mirror-like materials.

The character adopts a vertical upper-body central composition, with the upper body kept upright, the rib cage slightly rotated to one side, the shoulder line naturally extended, the head slightly turned back in the opposite direction, and the chin slightly tucked; the eyes do not completely face the center of the camera but look slightly toward the front-side, with the corners of the mouth maintaining a very slight, relaxed smile. Both hands are positioned below the chest, jointly and lightly holding an oriental folding fan that echoes the character's color scheme, with one hand supporting the fan handle and the other hand lightly covering it, fingers naturally extended, making the shoulders, arms, and folding fan form a stable lower triangular structure.

Use a 70–100mm medium-telephoto portrait perspective, keeping the camera at a normal upper-body shooting distance from the character, with the camera position at eye level, facing forward, using slight spatial compression to keep facial feature proportions natural, without using wide-angle distortion. The background is fixed as a pure deep blue-grey studio, with no extra decorations in the space, and the character maintains a certain distance from the background.

Use a large area of soft light from slightly to one side above and in front of the character as the main light, coupled with uniform front fill light, low lighting ratio, with shadows on the side of the nose, eye sockets, jawline, and neck all kept soft; skin tone is controlled as bright cool white or slightly adjusted according to the character's natural skin tone, with clothing sequins, jewelry, and hair accessories forming small specular highlights. The overall color is based on the deep blue-grey background, with the character's own main color as an auxiliary color, supplemented by silver-white highlights and dark outlines. Post-processing adopts medium-to-low contrast, slightly crushed blacks, blue-grey cool-toned shadows, low-noise digital texture, and makeup-grade skin softening, while preserving the fine sharpness of eyes, hair strands, jewelry, and sequins, ultimately maintaining a stable visual style of New Chinese-style high-end studio portrait × Oriental evening gown styling × Medium-telephoto beauty photography × Cool-toned refined digital portrait.

items.title: 蔚蓝海边回头微笑的日系女性夏日写真
items.description: A single adult Japanese woman on a bright beach, body turned to the sea and gaze over the shoulder toward camera, in an elegant summer fashion portrait with white floral camisole and dark jeans.
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting and visual style.

Subject: one fictional adult Japanese woman. White floral camisole top, exposed back, dark blue jeans.

Location and background: summer noon on a bright blue-sea coast with a color progression from turquoise to ultramarine, white waves, and a clear blue sky; avoid extra buildings or signage.

Pose and framing: the body faces the sea while the shoulder and face turn back toward camera with a natural over-the-shoulder smile.

Clothing and details: floral camisole with subtle blue-purple flowers and thin ribbons at the neck and back.

Lighting: strong top-down summer sunlight with cool-white reflections from sea surface.

Composition: 9:16 vertical, three-quarter-like cinematic style portrait framing from upper torso through waist and legs.

Negative/constraints: adult-only, no children, avoid text, watermark, logos, or other overlays.

items.title: 文字走廊透视黑白摄影海报
items.description: 单点透视建筑空间中的黑白摄影海报；维护动词沿真实表面递进，并以唯一红色作为文字强调。上传人物参考图可用于行走者身份。
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 tall photographic poster titled Word Corridors: a one-point-perspective marble archive hall rendered in black and white with a fine-grain photographic finish. Use the full tonal range, allowing only a subtle warm or cool cast. Red #B5211A is the only color in the entire frame, used only for the word, tiny wall-text accents, and one small glyph; use no second accent color.

Place the word RENEW as real red paint distributed through the architecture in true perspective. The largest R is on the floor nearest the viewer; E, N, E, and W recede in walking order along the floor toward the vanishing point, with the final letter allowed to wrap onto the far wall or ceiling vault. The word must remain spellable at thumbnail size. Its letters crease at real floor joints, follow vault curvature, and dim naturally with the available light; never place flat graphic type over the image.

One adult archive conservator walks away from the camera along the exact centerline, carrying a rolled document. Keep this walker sharp and use the uploaded reference image only if facial identity becomes visible. Other distant visitors are motion-blurred by a long exposure. Use available light from pendant lamps and work lamps near the vanishing point. Write the small technical wall microcopy TEMP 18-20C / RH 45-50% / LUX < 50 on a wall surface in correct perspective, never flat on the image plane. Add one small red crossed-box glyph on another wall. The carried document should establish the archive trade without a caption. Maintain a restrained, physically coherent architectural photograph: one word, one walker, one accent color, real surface-bound text, and no detached graphic elements.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张名为“文字走廊”的 9:16 竖幅摄影海报：单点透视的大理石档案馆长廊，以具有细微颗粒的黑白摄影效果呈现。使用完整黑白灰层次，可带极轻微冷暖偏色。红色 #B5211A 是全画面唯一颜色，只用于单词、少量墙面微文字强调和一个小符号；不使用第二种强调色。

将单词 RENEW 作为真实的红色油漆文字，按照真实透视分布在建筑表面。最大的 R 位于最靠近观者的地面，E、N、E、W 按行走顺序沿地面向消失点递进，最后一个字母可以延伸到远墙或拱顶。缩略图尺寸下仍能拼读完整单词。字母应在真实地面接缝处折转、顺随拱顶弧度，并随环境光自然变暗；绝不在图像平面上叠加扁平图形文字。

一名成年档案修复员沿精确中心线背对镜头向前行走，手持一卷文件。只有当脸部可见时才使用上传的参考图绑定其身份。其他远处来访者因长曝光呈现运动模糊。光源仅来自吊灯和消失点附近的工作灯。将小型技术墙面文字 TEMP 18-20C / RH 45-50% / LUX < 50 以正确透视写在墙体表面，不能平贴在画面上；另一面墙上加入一个小红色交叉方框符号。卷起的文件应在没有说明文字的情况下暗示档案修复工作。保持克制且物理连贯的建筑摄影效果：一个单词、一个行走者、一种强调色，所有文字附着于真实空间表面，不出现游离的平面图形元素。

items.title: 2x2 网格 16:9 四本非版权书籍平铺
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的四本非版权书籍平铺构图提示词。保留 2x2 网格、16:9 比例、书籍比例与轮廓、无手部和无眩光等明确约束。
items.prompt:
2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 non-copyrighted books: type Share = Float

data Constituent = C a concrete visual subject      -- Σ shares = 1  (R₃)

-- R₁+R₂: a partition of the shape region that preserves measure and conforms to the boundary

partition :: Region -> [Constituent] -> [SubRegion]

--   |Ω_i| = share_i · |Ω|   (area‑preserving)

--   disjoint Ω_i ; ∪Ω_i = Ω ; ∂(∪Ω_i) = ∂Ω   (shape‑conforming, clean edge)

reads_as :: Image -> (Silhouette, Recipe)                  -- far = the SHAPE, near = the proportions

forbidden :: [Regex]

forbidden = [ /equal_sized_parts/ , /wrong_proportions/ , /missing_component/ , /broken_silhouette/ ,

              /overlap/ , /tilt/ , /hands/ , /glare/ ]

render :: Subject -> Shape -> Image

render s sh = let d = constituents s; Ω = region sh

              in  assert (sum(share  d)==1 && measure_preserving (partition Ω d) Ω) $

                  flat_lay (partition Ω d) overhead_softbox matte soft_shadows (tiny_pct d)
items.prompt_zh:
2x2 网格，16:9，对 4 本非版权书籍执行此操作：type Share = Float

data Constituent = C a concrete visual subject      -- Σ shares = 1  (R₃)

-- R₁+R₂: 形状区域的一个划分，保持测度并符合边界

partition :: Region -> [Constituent] -> [SubRegion]

--   |Ω_i| = share_i · |Ω|   (面积保持)

--   互不相交 Ω_i ; ∪Ω_i = Ω ; ∂(∪Ω_i) = ∂Ω   (符合形状，边缘整洁)

reads_as :: Image -> (Silhouette, Recipe)                  -- 远 = 形状，近 = 比例

forbidden :: [Regex]

forbidden = [ /等大部分/ , /错误比例/ , /缺失组件/ , /破碎轮廓/ ,

              /重叠/ , /倾斜/ , /手/ , /眩光/ ]

render :: Subject -> Shape -> Image

render s sh = let d = constituents s; Ω = region sh

              in  assert (sum(share  d)==1 && measure_preserving (partition Ω d) Ω) $

                  flat_lay (partition Ω d) 顶置柔光箱 哑光 柔和阴影 (极小占比 d)

items.title: 极简手工纸艺微缩咖啡馆
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的极简手工纸艺与黏土风格微缩咖啡馆场景模板。
items.prompt: Create a 4:5 vertical realistic miniature-craft coffee-shop scene: place a tiny refined handmade café in the lower center of a large tactile off-white paper background, leaving generous clean negative space around it. The café has a cream storefront, warm wood counter, miniature espresso machine, coffee cups, pastries, coffee beans, small menu board, hanging sign, potted plants, stools, and restrained café decorations. A few tiny figurines with no recognizable faces may make coffee behind the counter or enjoy coffee in front, serving only as scene scale rather than identity-bearing subjects. Use ivory, beige, warm brown, muted sage green, and small terracotta accents with realistic soft shadows and gentle natural light. Add small black hand-drawn doodles around the café: hearts, steam lines, stars, coffee beans, arrows, and simple decorative marks. The result is cozy, playful, refined, handmade, and uncluttered, with tactile paper-and-clay miniature depth, soft 3D detail, and a peaceful café mood. No watermark, logo, extra large people, or cluttered readable text.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张4:5竖幅、写实微缩工艺风格的咖啡馆场景：在大面积带触感纹理的乳白色纸张背景下部中央，放置一间精致小巧的手工微缩咖啡店，四周保留大量干净留白。咖啡店有奶油色店面、温暖木质柜台、微型浓缩咖啡机、咖啡杯、糕点、咖啡豆、小菜单板、挂牌、盆栽、凳子和克制的咖啡馆装饰。少量无可识别面孔的微缩人物模型可在柜台后制作咖啡或在店前享用咖啡，只作为场景尺度，不突出身份。使用象牙色、米色、暖棕、低饱和鼠尾草绿和少量陶土色，真实柔和阴影与温和自然光。咖啡馆周围有小型黑色手绘涂鸦：爱心、蒸汽线、星星、咖啡豆、箭头与简单装饰标记。整体温馨、俏皮、精致、手作且不杂乱，呈现纸张与黏土的微缩立体质感、柔和3D细节与宁静咖啡馆氛围。不要水印、logo、额外的大型人物或杂乱文字。

鬼戏感加强的古典舞妆造，黑红白三色华丽古装，黑色刺绣束身内搭，白色半透明宽大长水袖，暗红色飘带与层叠裙摆，红黑金发饰、流苏、珠串、铃铛元素、古典耳坠。妆容精致诡艳，额心红色符纹花钿，眼尾与下眼睑带淡红晕染，唇色红润，整体华美、灵异、妖冶，同时保留清透真实的皮肤质感。

人物与镜头有强烈互动，一只手朝镜头伸出，形成明显近大远小的透视效果，另一只手抬起做舞蹈手势。直视镜头，眼神明亮有神，带甜美自然笑容，表情灵动亲近。动作要有明显舞蹈张力，水袖、飘带、裙摆与长发在空中飞舞，形成强烈动态感。

场景为昏暗传统戏台或古风室内舞台，红色帷幕、暖色灯笼、木质结构、少量烟雾，黑红色背景。顶部与侧后方暖色聚光灯穿过薄雾，形成明显轮廓光、发丝高光和戏剧感氛围。面部清晰明亮，眼睛锐利，对焦准确。

真实摄影质感，动态抓拍感，细节丰富，轻微运动模糊只出现在水袖和飘带边缘。保留真实毛孔、细小皮肤纹理、自然发丝。避免塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、冷脸、无神眼睛、僵硬手指、重复姿势、站桩感。

items.title: VELORA SIPS 番茄罗勒汤商业海报
items.description: 原创 VELORA SIPS 速食番茄汤的高端商业海报，以汤锅、单个挤压包装与马克杯组成可辨识的垂直产品转化符号。
items.prompt:
Create a premium vertical commercial poster for an original instant tomato-soup brand, VELORA SIPS. Use ultra-realistic food-advertising photography with a warm cinematic kitchen-still-life mood. The center must be a clear vertical conversion symbol that reads at thumbnail size: a red enamel pot full of rich tomato soup is centered above with both handles visible; one narrow upright VELORA SIPS squeeze-soup pack is centered directly below it; and a branded ceramic mug centered below receives the soup stream. The stream connects pot, pack, and mug in one continuous vertical axis, expressing a complete ritual in which a homemade pot becomes an instantly drinkable serving through an elegant pack.

Use a softly blurred dark kitchen background. On the lower wooden tabletop, arrange only a controlled few fresh tomatoes and basil leaves as secondary accents. Build a clear circular reading path around the central axis: from the pot rim down the soup stream through the pack to the mug surface, outward through tomatoes and basil, then upward along steam and side highlights to the pot. The product is the absolute hero; the composition is clean, appetizing, and iconically readable as a mature FMCG campaign.

Give the pack and mug one coherent original brand system. The only readable English on the packaging may be "VELORA SIPS" and "Tomato & Basil"; add no poster headline or other text outside the pack and mug. Use soft warm studio key light from upper left with gentle frontal fill: appetizing highlights on the soup, soft enamel reflections, crisp package printing, and a warm glow plus faint steam on the ceramic mug; keep the background darker and diffused.

Render tactile realism: glossy dense tomato soup with a natural continuous pour, a clean glazed red pot, flexible packaging with credible folds and tension, a thick-rimmed glossy ceramic mug with a handle, fresh tomatoes with stem detail, resilient basil with fine veins, and a warm matte refined wood table. Use tomato red, warm terracotta, deep kitchen brown, and cream white, with basil green and amber highlights. Do not imitate existing brands or slogans, add extra headlines, blur packaging, warp the mug, make an unrealistic soup flow, use a cheap grocery-flyer look, add greasy clutter, dirty black blotches, watermarks, or unreadable labels.
items.prompt_zh:
为原创速食番茄汤品牌 VELORA SIPS 创作一张高端竖版商业海报。采用超写实食品广告摄影与温暖电影感厨房静物氛围。画面中心必须是一个清晰、可缩略图识别的垂直转化符号：上方居中是一只装满浓郁番茄汤的红色搪瓷锅，双耳可见；锅下正中是一包窄而竖直的 VELORA SIPS 挤压汤包；下方居中是一只盛接汤流的品牌陶瓷马克杯。汤流将锅、包装和杯子连成一条连续竖轴，表达自制汤锅经优雅包装转为即时饮用的一次完整仪式。

背景为柔焦的深色厨房，前景下部木质台面上整齐点缀少量新鲜番茄和罗勒叶，均为次要元素。围绕中轴形成明确环形视线路径：从锅沿沿汤流向下经过汤包到杯面，扫过番茄和罗勒，再顺蒸汽和侧面高光回到锅。产品必须是绝对主角，构图干净、食欲感强、具有成熟 FMCG 广告的标志性可读性。

汤包与杯子使用同一原创品牌系统，包装上可读英文仅为“VELORA SIPS”和“Tomato & Basil”；除产品包装与杯身外不添加海报标题或额外文字。使用左上方柔和暖色棚拍主光与轻微正面补光：汤面有食欲高光，搪瓷锅有柔和反射，包装印刷清晰，陶瓷杯带暖光和少量蒸汽，背景较暗而扩散。

写实材质：浓稠有光泽的番茄汤和连续自然的倾倒，干净釉面红锅，具有可信褶皱和张力的柔性包装，厚边有把手的亮釉陶瓷杯，带果蒂细节的新鲜番茄、柔韧叶脉的罗勒和温暖哑光木桌。配色为番茄红、暖陶土、深厨房棕、奶油白，辅以罗勒绿和琥珀高光。不要模仿已有品牌或口号、额外标题、包装模糊、畸形杯子、不真实汤流、廉价超市传单感、油腻杂物、脏黑斑、水印或不可读标签。

items.title: 影棚写实人像九宫格索引照
items.description: 一张严格身份锁定的3x3影棚人像索引照：同一参考人物以九个角度、相同服装和稳定灯光背景呈现。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as strict facial identity reference and create a highly realistic 3x3 photographic portrait contact sheet. All nine panels must show the same person, preserving exact recognizable facial structure, face shape, eye shape, brows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, real skin texture, hairstyle, hair color, age appearance and overall likeness; never change, excessively beautify, stylize or replace identity. Separate panels with thin subtle dividers. In every panel wear the same simple dark navy or black crew-neck top and small subtle earrings.

Use these nine poses: 1 front neutral direct gaze; 2 right profile; 3 left profile; 4 three-quarter front turned slightly right; 5 three-quarter front turned slightly left; 6 relaxed front portrait with soft genuine smile; 7 looking upward with head slightly back; 8 looking downward relaxed; 9 three-quarter upward look with head slightly side-turned. Keep professional studio head-and-shoulders framing, natural proportions and eye-level camera, varying only head angle for pose. Use soft even studio light, warm off-white/light-cream plain background, gentle natural shadows, realistic skin and balanced exposure for clean professional portrait documentation. Maintain same person, identity, hairstyle/length, clothing, lighting, background and realism across all panels, with no identity drift. Use 85mm portrait-lens appearance, natural shallow depth, sharp eyes, pores and hair strands, soft cinematic realism and premium editorial quality. Add no text, numbers, labels, captions, logos, watermarks, UI, buttons, icons or graphic overlays. Avoid different people, facial distortion, asymmetrical eyes, altered features, beauty filters, plastic skin, cartoon/painting/CGI, blur, duplicated poses, inconsistent hair/clothes, extra limbs or malformed anatomy.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的身份参考图作为严格的面部身份依据，创建一张高度写实3x3人像摄影索引照。九格必须始终是同一个人，精确保留其可辨认的面部结构、脸型、眼型、眉眼、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、真实皮肤纹理、发型、发色、年龄外观和整体相似度；不更改、过度美化、风格化或替换身份。每格均穿同一简单深海军蓝或黑色圆领上衣和细小耳环，以细微分隔线分开。

九个姿势依次为：1正面中性直视；2右侧面；3左侧面；4脸微向右的四分之三正面；5脸微向左的四分之三正面；6放松正面并真诚轻笑；7抬头略后仰；8低头放松；9头偏一侧的四分之三仰视。每格保持专业影棚头肩构图、真实比例、自然姿态和标准人像视平高度，只随姿势轻微改变头部角度。使用柔和均匀影棚灯、暖白或浅米纯背景、轻柔自然阴影、真实皮肤与平衡曝光，形成整洁专业的肖像记录。九格保持完全一致的人、身份、发型/长度、衣服、灯光、背景和写实外观，不得身份漂移。采用85mm人像镜头感、自然浅景深、清晰眼睛、真实毛孔和发丝、柔和电影写实及高端编辑质感。不要任何文字、数字、标签、说明、Logo、水印、UI、按钮、图标或图形叠加；避免不同人物、面部变形、不对称眼睛、改变特征、美颜、塑料皮肤、卡通绘画CGI、模糊、重复姿势、衣发不一致、多余肢体或畸形解剖。

items.title: 韩系夜桥慢门自拍肖像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的 3:4 夜桥手机自拍肖像模板。以慢门城市灯光、直闪人脸和近镜手部形成真实、轻松的韩系夜景摄影质感。
items.prompt:
Create a 3:4 vertical Korean-style night slow-shutter mobile selfie portrait. Use the uploaded reference image as the visible facial identity reference for the only adult woman in frame, preserving the visible facial structure, skin tone, eyes, nose, lips, and facial proportions. She has cool-toned rose makeup, natural semi-matte skin, and long straight black hair.

She wears a black off-the-shoulder top with a gray coat casually draped over her shoulders. The setting is a night bridge with a city background, where distant lights form horizontal trails. She gently puffs her cheeks with a relaxed, playful expression; one hand comes close to the lens and creates slight, natural motion blur.

Use authentic mobile-photography character: direct flash is locked primarily on her eyes and face while the background retains slow-shutter movement. The framing feels like a close, casual observer's perspective, but only this one adult may appear; no second face or person. Keep fingers, body, and facial structure correct. No text, watermarks, logos, excessive skin smoothing, low-quality blur, or cartoon rendering.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张 3:4 竖向的韩系夜晚慢门手机自拍肖像。使用上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年女性的可见面部身份依据，保留可见脸部结构、肤色、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇和五官比例。她有冷调玫瑰色妆容、半哑光自然肌肤和黑色长直发。

她穿黑色露肩上衣，灰色外套随意搭在肩上。场景是夜晚桥面与城市背景，远处灯光形成横向拖尾。她微微鼓起脸颊，带有轻松俏皮的表情；一只手靠近镜头，带来轻微而自然的运动模糊。

使用真实移动设备摄影质感：直闪主要锁定眼睛和面部，背景保留慢门动态。构图像亲近的随手观察视角，但画面中只能有这一位成年人，不出现第二张脸或第二个人。保持手指、身体和面部结构正确；不要文字、水印、标志、过度磨皮、低质量模糊或卡通渲染。

items.title: Bathroom Frosted Glass Door Portrait
items.description: A 3:4 bathroom lifestyle portrait with one adult woman behind a half-open frosted-glass door; the architectural glass silhouette, two-hand door pose, and off-camera gaze are retained with complete opaque lounge clothing.
items.prompt:
Create a realistic 3:4 vertical bathroom lifestyle portrait. Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the sole adult woman. Preserve her recognizable face shape, eyes, nose, lips, and facial proportions; do not copy the reference clothing or background.

She stands behind a half-open frosted-glass bathroom door, holding the door with both hands. Her body leans gently and she turns her head in the same direction as her body to look toward activity outside the bathroom, not at the camera. Frame the clear upper-head-and-shoulders view at the door opening while the translucent glass shows a naturally aligned, non-explicit silhouette down to mid-thigh. She wears a complete opaque, lightweight long-sleeved lounge top and knee-length lounge shorts; their silhouette remains understated behind the frosted glass.

Use a clean, believable contemporary bathroom, soft diffused daylight, neutral warm materials, realistic glass diffusion, natural skin tone, and restrained photographic texture. Keep the two hands, door edge, head direction, visible shoulders, and glass silhouette physically aligned. No nudity, transparent clothing, towels, text, watermark, extra people, misaligned silhouette, duplicated limbs, distorted fingers, or plastic skin.
items.prompt_zh:
生成一张写实的 3:4 竖幅浴室生活方式人像。以用户上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年女性的面部身份依据，保留可辨的脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇和五官比例；不要复制参考图的服装或背景。

她站在一扇半开的磨砂玻璃浴室门后，双手握住门。身体轻微倾斜，头部与身体朝同一方向，望向浴室外的动静而不直视镜头。门缝中清楚呈现头部与肩膀，半透明玻璃中自然可见到大腿中部的非裸露轮廓。她穿完整、不透明的轻薄长袖居家上衣和及膝居家短裤；衣物轮廓在磨砂玻璃后保持克制。

使用干净可信的现代浴室、柔和漫射日光、中性暖色材质、真实玻璃扩散、自然肤色和克制摄影纹理。双手、门边、头部朝向、可见肩膀与玻璃轮廓应在物理关系上自然对齐。不要裸露、透明服装、毛巾、文字、水印、额外人物、错位轮廓、重复肢体、畸形手指或塑料感皮肤。

items.title: 大胆多人编辑风格视觉海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的可复用多人编辑海报模板。通过主题、人物、布局、标题和配色变量，组织 5 至 8 位成年人形成具有明确层级的 9:16 文化或时尚视觉海报。
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical multi-person editorial poster about an independent creative team shaping a shared cultural project. Feature six distinct adults: one lead portrait and five collaborators with varied fashion, age-appropriate styling, and confident but natural expressions. Use the uploaded identity reference image as the visible facial identity reference for one lead adult, preserving the visible facial structure, skin tone, eyes, nose, lips, and facial proportions. Every other adult must be a distinct original adult and must not duplicate the reference face.

Use an irregular mosaic of angled narrative slices and overlapping portrait blocks so the people themselves become the composition. Do not give every person equal space: establish one or two dominant subjects, several supporting portraits, and a few cropped details. Let faces, shoulders, hands, or hair break outside image areas so the layout feels alive rather than like a neat photo grid. Use only a few portrait treatments, such as close-ups, side profiles, hard light, soft shadow, slight motion blur, or one intentionally out-of-focus portrait, to create rhythm; do not layer every effect at once.

Build the whole poster around one strong organizing idea, with an intentional but slightly unpredictable structure. Use the meaningful large headline "COMMON GROUND" across several portraits, allowing people to partly cover it or appear through its negative space. Limit small text to one series label and one short supporting line; avoid meaningless, misspelled, or repeated text.

Use cobalt blue, vermilion red, warm off-white, and neutral photographic skin tones: start with neutral, realistic photographic skin tones, then use a dominant accent and optional secondary accent to connect the modules, background, and title. Create strong contrast between crowded overlapping portrait areas and open breathing room. Keep faces realistic, skin natural, hair detailed, and every adult visually distinct. The finished image should feel like a mature cultural, fashion, or editorial key visual rather than an event template; no watermarks, brand logos, copyrighted characters, or extra text.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张 9:16 竖向多人编辑海报，主题为 an independent creative team shaping a shared cultural project。画面包含 six distinct adults: one lead portrait and five collaborators with varied fashion, age-appropriate styling, and confident but natural expressions。使用上传的身份参考图作为一位主视觉成年人的可见面部身份依据，保留其可见面部结构、肤色、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇和五官比例；其余成年人必须是彼此不同的原创成年人，不能复制该参考脸。

采用 an irregular mosaic of angled narrative slices and overlapping portrait blocks 来让人物本身成为构图。不要平均分配所有人物空间：建立一个或两个占主导的主体、数个辅助肖像和少量裁剪细节。允许面部、肩膀、手或头发越出图像区域，让布局具有活力而非整齐照片网格。用近景、侧面、硬光、柔和阴影、轻微运动模糊或一张有意失焦的肖像中的少数几种来形成节奏，不要同时叠加所有效果。

将整张海报围绕一个明确的组织概念构建，结构有意且略带不可预测性。使用具有真实含义的大标题“COMMON GROUND”，让标题跨越多个肖像，并可被人物局部遮挡或穿过其留白。小型文字仅限一个系列标签和一行简短支持文字，避免无意义、拼写错误或重复文字。

配色使用 cobalt blue, vermilion red, warm off-white, and neutral photographic skin tones：以中性、真实的摄影肤色为基础，用主强调色和可选次强调色连接模块、背景与标题。让拥挤的重叠肖像区域与留白区域形成鲜明对比。保持面部真实、皮肤自然、发丝细节清晰且每位成年人在视觉上独特。成品应是成熟的文化、时尚或编辑主视觉，而不是活动模板；不要水印、品牌标志、侵权角色或额外文字。

items.title: 白色针织衫托腮成年女性近景肖像
items.description: 以 85mm 柔光浅景深呈现的肩部以上静谧写实肖像。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the single visible adult woman in her early twenties. Create a soft intimate shoulder-up close-up portrait. She has long silky slightly wavy dark brown-black hair cascading over her shoulders, partly framing her face, with soft curtain bangs across the forehead. Give her a gentle contemplative gaze directed softly toward the viewer, large expressive dark-brown eyes, natural long lashes, subtle soft makeup, a delicate nose, and softly full pink-coral lips that are slightly parted in a calm neutral expression. Preserve fair luminous skin with natural dewy glow and realistic texture.

She rests both hands beneath her chin in a classic thoughtful pose, fingers gently curled and nails clean and natural. She wears a cozy fluffy white knit sweater with a soft high collar framing her neck and shoulders. Use soft diffused natural side light to create gentle highlights on hair, cheekbones, and sweater texture, with warm airy quality and subtle shadows. The background is a clean minimalist off-white or light-gray wall, slightly out of focus. Render cinematic photorealistic portrait photography with an 85 mm lens look, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, fine flyaways, high resolution, and an elegant serene atmosphere. Avoid extra people, artificial beauty filtering, plastic skin, distorted hands, text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为画面中唯一可见、二十岁出头成年女性的面部身份依据。生成一张柔和亲密的肩部以上近景肖像。她有垂落在肩上的丝滑、略带波浪的深棕黑色长发，部分勾勒脸庞，额前有柔和的帘式刘海。她以略带沉思的温柔目光轻轻看向观者，拥有富有表现力的深棕大眼睛、自然长睫毛、淡雅柔和的妆容、精致鼻型，以及微微张开的粉珊瑚色柔润嘴唇，表情平静中性。保留白皙透亮的自然水润感和真实肌肤纹理。

她双手托在下巴下，呈经典沉思姿势，手指轻轻卷曲，指甲干净自然。她穿舒适蓬松的白色针织毛衣，柔软高领衬托颈部和肩膀。使用来自侧面的柔和散射自然光，在头发、颧骨和毛衣质感上形成温暖轻盈的柔和高光与细微阴影。背景是一面略微虚化的干净极简米白或浅灰色墙。采用 85mm 镜头感、浅景深、柔和散景、细微碎发和高分辨率的电影写实人像摄影，气氛优雅宁静。避免其他人物、人工美颜滤镜、塑料感肌肤、扭曲双手、文字、标志和水印。

items.title: 末班地铁后的剪贴簿人像海报
items.description: 将原始可配置剪贴簿工作流具体化为一位成年女性在深夜地铁出口整理票根与钥匙、准备回家的电影化生活章节。
items.prompt:
Use the face identity from the identity reference image to create a 9:16 cinematic scrapbook-style portrait poster based on one specific everyday moment: going home after the last train. The main visual is one highly realistic full-body adult woman, occupying about 80% of the composition with natural anatomy, real skin, hair and clothing texture, and believable night light. She does not look directly at the camera; beside a late-night subway exit, she looks slightly down while sorting a paper train ticket and a ring of keys, a spontaneous moment after leaving the last train rather than a fashion pose. She wears a dark ink-green short trench coat, cream knit sweater, faded-blue straight-leg denim, white canvas shoes, and a worn brown canvas crossbody bag. Cut out her whole figure with a clearly visible, slightly irregular white paper-sticker border.

Build the story on a clean off-white rough-paper background with only meaningful evidence: one larger environmental photo of the night subway entrance; two smaller snapshots, one of yellow-lit tracks at the end of a platform and one of reflections on a rainy pavement; the ticket, keys, a folded convenience-store receipt, a small note reading “call mom when home”, a short partial subway-line diagram, and a fabric key charm on the canvas bag. Use torn paper, two small pieces of translucent tape, handwritten annotations, fine arrows, and restrained print texture without filling the page with random decoration. Every object should feel like proof that this night happened.

Make the large headline clearly readable: “LAST TRAIN HOME”. Below it, include the short line: “Rain on the pavement, keys in hand.” Keep every other word minimal and meaningful. Use black typewriter lettering with slightly faded handwritten pencil annotations. The accent palette is ink green, rainy-night indigo, ticket beige, warm-yellow platform light, and a small amount of rust red. The final image feels like a realistic full-body portrait, a personal scrapbook, and a cinematic chapter from a life.
items.prompt_zh:
使用身份参考图中的人物面部身份，创作一张 9:16 电影感剪贴簿风格人像海报，主题是“末班地铁后的回家瞬间”。主视觉是一位成年女性的高度写实全身人像，约占构图 80%，保留自然人体比例、真实皮肤、头发与服装质感、可信的夜间光线；她不直视镜头，而是在深夜地铁出口旁微微低头整理一张纸质车票和一串钥匙，动作像刚下末班车准备回家的自然瞬间，而不是时尚摆拍。她穿深墨绿色短风衣、奶油色针织衫、褪色蓝色直筒牛仔裤和白色帆布鞋，斜挎一只磨旧棕色帆布包；整个人物被略不规则的白色纸质贴纸边缘完整剪出。

在干净的米白色粗纸背景上，以少量有意义的拼贴元素建立故事证据：一张较大的夜间地铁入口环境照片、两张较小快照（一张是站台尾端的黄灯轨道，一张是雨后人行道的倒影）、车票、钥匙、折起的便利店收据、写着“call mom when home”的小便签、地铁线路的简短局部示意和帆布包上的布质钥匙扣。使用撕纸、两小段半透明胶带、手写注释、细箭头和克制印刷纹理，但不堆满随机装饰。让每件物品都像这个夜晚真实发生的证据。

大标题清晰可读：“LAST TRAIN HOME”。其下保留短句：“Rain on the pavement, keys in hand.”。其他文字极少且有意义。标题与短句使用黑色打字机字体和略褪的手写铅笔注释，配色为深墨绿、雨夜靛蓝、票根米黄、暖黄灯光和少量锈红。整体像真实全身人像、个人剪贴簿和生活中一章电影化回忆的结合。

items.title: 暖冬午后街道薰衣草蓝衬衫人像

items.prompt:

Create a highly photorealistic full-body outdoor portrait on a quiet urban street in soft winter sunlight, vertical 4:5.
