Render natural smartphone photography with a candid travel-fashion feeling, realistic skin, detailed hair and fabric, soft pastel grading, shallow depth of field, subtle vintage film grain, natural proportions, and a dreamy peaceful atmosphere.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的人物参考图作为画面中唯一成年女性的面部身份依据。制作一张高度写实的全身户外人像：她站在寂静城市街道上，沐浴柔和冬日阳光，竖幅 4:5。她有自然垂落至肩头的深褐色长直发，双眼轻轻闭着，神情温柔愉悦，头微微偏向一侧，形成俏皮随性的抓拍姿态。她穿宽松淡薰衣草蓝纽扣衬衫，内搭精致白色蕾丝边上衣，下穿飘逸白色短款层叠裙，穿白色运动鞋；一侧肩膀背米白色小背包。她双臂自然交叉，一只腿轻轻向后抬起。

背景包含带几何正方形细节的老旧质感奶油色墙面、枯萎攀爬藤蔓、小型深色标志、停放的汽车和城市街道。柔和午后阳光在发丝边缘形成微妙暖光、轻柔阴影和淡淡镜头光晕。呈现自然手机摄影与随性旅行时尚美学：真实皮肤、细腻发丝和织物、柔和淡色调色、浅景深、轻微复古胶片颗粒、自然比例和梦幻宁静氛围。

items.title: 蓝色颁奖舞台西装女性全身肖像
items.description: 写实颁奖典礼活动摄影：成年女性在蓝色 LED 舞台的落地麦克风前双手持奖杯。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible person. Keep the source scene, styling, clothing, pose, composition, lighting, and visual style unless they conflict with the identity reference.

Photorealistic full-body live-event stage photography. A young adult East Asian woman stands centered at a formal awards ceremony behind a floor-mounted microphone, angled slightly toward the camera while looking forward with a composed, confident, elegant expression. She has fair natural skin, delicate features, dark-brown eyes, and center-parted dark-brown hair with one thick long braided ponytail, secured by a pale ribbon, falling below her waist down the right side of her body.

She wears a structured black single-breasted formal blazer with notched lapels, long sleeves, fitted shoulders, flap pockets, and a hem below the hips approaching mid-thigh, over a crisp white pointed-collar shirt and a narrow black necktie. She wears semi-sheer black hosiery and black pointed-toe heels with subtle glitter texture. With both hands, she naturally holds a rectangular dark formal trophy at chest-to-waist height: a dark rectangular base with a distinctive vertical gold or brass textured face. A slim freestanding microphone is directly in front of her, its head around chest height, with the stand and cable visibly reaching the stage floor. One leg rests subtly forward as her body balances naturally behind the microphone.

Behind her is a luminous blue LED backdrop with soft gradients and oversized abstract circular graphics. The dark blue-gray stage floor has thin geometric illuminated lines and realistic reflections; dark lighting fixtures along the rear edge remain softly out of focus. Use bright cool blue/purple stage lighting with subtle pink-white highlights at the stage edge. Keep the subject and trophy sharp, moderate background depth of field, a slightly compressed telephoto event-photography perspective, and balanced central full-body framing. Preserve realistic skin, hair, fabric, and hosiery texture, natural optical depth, subtle stage-light bloom, accurate exposure, and fine photographic detail.

No illustration, CGI, anime, or 3D rendering. Do not crop the head, braid, legs, feet, shoes, trophy, microphone, or microphone base. Maintain natural anatomy, hands, fingers, legs, and posture; avoid excessive retouching, plastic skin, exaggerated makeup, distorted limbs, extra fingers, duplicate objects, warped microphone stands, or artificial-looking hair.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为主要可见人物的面部身份依据。在不与身份参考冲突的情况下，保留来源的场景、造型、服装、姿势、构图、光线和视觉风格。

写实全身活动舞台摄影。一位年轻成年东亚女性居中站在正式颁奖典礼舞台的落地式麦克风前，略面向镜头、目视前方，表情沉着、自信、优雅。她有白皙自然皮肤、精致五官、深褐眼睛与中分深褐长发，一条用淡色丝带固定的粗长编织辫子沿身体右侧垂至腰部以下。

她穿结构化黑色单排扣西装外套，平驳领、长袖、合肩、下摆至臀下接近大腿中部并带翻盖口袋；内搭挺括白色尖领衬衫和窄版黑色领带。她穿半透明黑色丝袜和带细微闪粉纹理的黑色尖头高跟鞋。她双手在胸至腰部高度自然持握长方形深色正式奖杯，奖杯为深色长方形底座配独特的竖向金色或黄铜色纹理正面。纤细立式麦克风位于正前方，麦克风头约在胸部高度，支架和线缆延伸至舞台地面清晰可见。一条腿微妙前置，身体在麦克风后自然平衡。

背景是带柔和渐变和超大抽象圆形图形的蓝色发光 LED 屏；深蓝灰舞台地面有细长几何发光线和真实反射。后缘深色灯光设备剪影柔和失焦。使用明亮冷蓝/紫色舞台光，舞台边缘有细微粉白高光。保持主体和奖杯清晰、中等背景景深、略压缩长焦活动摄影视角与平衡居中全身构图。保留真实皮肤、发丝、织物和丝袜纹理、自然光学景深、轻微舞台灯晕、准确曝光与精细摄影细节。

不要插画、CGI、动漫或 3D 渲染；不要裁掉头部、长辫、腿、脚、鞋、奖杯、麦克风或底座。保持准确自然的人体、手指、腿和姿态；避免过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、夸张妆容、变形肢体、额外手指、重复物体、变形麦克风架或人造头发。

items.title: 高级简约上下分区旅行海报编辑
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的通用照片编辑模板。每张实际上传的源照片单独生成一张 3:4 上下分区旅行海报：上半部分保留原图，下半部分重构为独立的高级扁平矢量旅行海报。源照片为必填文件输入；来源示例图不被冒充为用户原图，未生成或绑定任何辅助素材。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Use the uploaded source photo as the sole source input. Process this photo independently and output one poster; do not claim that any source image has been supplied until the file is actually uploaded.

Please turn each photo I upload into a separate, independently designed high-end poster. Do not make a collage or combine multiple images—each photo should be processed and output individually. Use an overall **3:4 vertical composition**, with the canvas divided into **two equal sections top and bottom**, in a strict **1:1 height ratio**, each occupying **50% of the image**.

The **upper half** should preserve the original photo, maintaining the subject’s identity, structure, pose, authentic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere. Only apply subtle, refined photographic color grading to give it the feel of an **art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition photography**. To fit the format, the sky, ground, or environmental background may be naturally extended if needed, but the main subject must **not** be stretched, distorted, or altered.

The **lower half** should extract the most recognizable **subject, silhouette, pose, and narrative relationship** from the photo, and reconstruct them into a **premium minimalist flat-vector travel poster** style illustrated scene. Do not mechanically trace the photo. Instead, based on the original image’s visual personality, distill the most representative main visual focal point, and build around it with **2–4 supporting elements** that best express the atmosphere of the environment, the way of everyday life, the sense of place, or the state of living. Whether the original image contains a city, architecture, people, animals, plants, objects, vehicles, or natural scenery, the lower half should feel like a **custom-designed high-end travel visual poster** made specifically for that subject, rather than a fixed template applied to everything.

Reorganize each lower-half scene around the source subject with one clear focal point, foreground/background layering, negative space, and a calm rhythm. Add only 2–4 supporting elements that express the place or situation. Avoid landmark stacking, postcard lists, repetitive layouts, or a single protagonist; if people are needed, use only 3–6 small integrated figures.

The overall style should be **high-end minimalist flat vector illustration**: inspired by **Japanese stationery aesthetics, boutique sticker illustration, and modern editorial travel branding**. Use **clean geometric forms, soft contours, consistent line weight, flat color blocks, and restrained detailing**. The overall feeling should be **fresh, quiet, delicate, and contemporary**. Avoid realism, heavy shadows, watercolor textures, paper textures, complex brushwork, gradients, crowded backgrounds, and excessive detail.

The color palette should be based on a **soft, airy, slightly desaturated premium palette**, which may be adjusted by extracting and harmonizing the overall color temperature from the original image, while keeping the final result light and cohesive. Use **light pink-blue, misty blue, sky blue, and airy cool blues** to build the main atmosphere; balance them with **ivory white, creamy white, light beige, soft gray-green, and architectural neutrals**. Only allow a small amount of **dusty rose or muted blush** as subtle accents—for flowers, clothing, small signs, awnings, or local decorative details—so the image feels breathable yet still refined and layered.

The **text logic** should also become part of this style. Do not simply apply a city-name template. Instead, extract a **short title** from the original image’s **location, object name, theme, condition, or atmosphere**, and place it in the **upper left corner** or another area with generous negative space. Pair it with a **brief, restrained, tasteful tagline**. Typography should remain **understated, editorial, spacious, and premium**, never overpowering the visual. If necessary, add a small amount of secondary text, coordinate-style annotations, or tiny descriptive notes, so the text feels like a natural visual identity element from a **high-end travel brand or boutique postcard**, rather than a title bar added afterward.

The result should feel like a fresh, elegant, quiet, modern, refined travel poster or boutique lifestyle postcard designed for this specific source photo. Preserve the source photo faithfully in the upper half and give the lower half an independent visual identity. Do not reuse the same lower-half composition, foreground, or object arrangement across different photos. Avoid templated, repetitive, generic, or formulaic tourism-poster results.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

使用上传的源照片作为唯一的源输入。独立处理这张照片并输出一张海报；在文件实际上传前，不声称已经提供任何源图。

请将我上传的每张照片转换为一个单独的、独立设计的高级海报。不要制作拼贴画或合并多张图像——每张照片都应单独处理和输出。使用整体的 3:4 纵向构图，画布分为上下两个相等的部分，采用严格的 1:1 高度比例，各占图像的 50%。

上半部分应保留原始照片，保持主体的身份、结构、姿势、真实的纹理、自然的光线和原始的色彩氛围。仅应用细微、精致的摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物或展览摄影的感觉。为了适应格式，如果需要，可以自然延伸天空、地面或环境背景，但主体不得被拉伸、扭曲或改变。

下半部分应从照片中提取最具辨识度的主体、轮廓、姿势和叙事关系，并将它们重构为一个高级简约扁平矢量旅行海报风格的插画场景。不要机械地描摹照片。相反，根据原始图像的视觉个性，提炼出最具代表性的主要视觉焦点，并围绕它构建 2–4 个辅助元素，以最好地表达环境的氛围、日常生活方式、地方感或生活状态。无论原始图像包含城市、建筑、人物、动物、植物、物体、车辆还是自然风光，下半部分都应感觉像是专门为该主体定制设计的高级旅行视觉海报，而不是套用在所有事物上的固定模板。

构图应根据主体自身的性格重新组织，而不是重复相同的布局。使用一个明确的焦点、清晰的前景-背景层次、适当的留白和冷静、有序的视觉节奏来构建图像。根据原始图像，场景可能会自然地转化为街道、广场、水边、庭院、通道、平台、植物环境、室内角落、开阔景观或带有日常生活痕迹的环境片段。主体必须始终保持为主要的视觉中心；所有其他元素应仅加强“这个地方 / 这个物体 / 这种情境”的独特性。避免拼贴式的地标堆砌、明信片式的罗列或过于叙事性的安排。如果场景中需要人物，仅包含 3–6 个小比例人物，自然地融入环境中，没有单一的主角。

整体风格应为高级简约扁平矢量插画：灵感来自日本文具美学、精品贴纸插画和现代编辑类旅行品牌设计。使用干净的几何形状、柔和的轮廓、一致的线宽、扁平色块和克制的细节。整体感觉应是清新、宁静、细腻且具有现代感。避免写实主义、厚重的阴影、水彩纹理、纸张纹理、复杂的笔触、渐变、拥挤的背景和过多的细节。

色调应基于柔和、轻盈、略显低饱和度的高级色板，可以通过提取并协调原始图像的整体色温进行调整，同时保持最终结果轻盈且凝聚。使用浅粉蓝、雾霾蓝、天蓝和轻盈的冷蓝色来构建主要氛围；用象牙白、奶白色、浅米色、柔和的灰绿色和建筑中性色来平衡它们。仅允许少量的灰粉色或柔和的浅粉色作为微妙的点缀——用于花朵、服装、小招牌、遮阳篷或局部装饰细节——使图像感觉透气但仍精致且富有层次感。

文字逻辑也应成为这种风格的一部分。不要简单地套用城市名称模板。相反，从原始图像的地点、物体名称、主题、状况或氛围中提取一个简短的标题，并将其放置在左上角或其他有大量留白的区域。为其配上一个简短、克制、有品位的标语。排版应保持低调、编辑风格、空间感和高级感，永远不要压过视觉效果。如有必要，添加少量的辅助文字、坐标式注释或微小的描述性说明，使文字感觉像是来自高级旅行品牌或精品明信片的自然视觉识别元素，而不是事后添加的标题栏。

整体效果应感觉像是专门为该主体设计的高级旅行海报 / 精品生活方式明信片：清新、优雅、宁静、现代且精致，具有大量的留白和轻松的临场感。每张海报的下半部分必须具有其独立的视觉身份——你绝不能在重复使用相同构图、相同前景或相同物体排列的同时仅仅更改名称。避免任何感觉像模板化、重复、通用或公式化的东西，如标准的旅游海报。

items.title: 伦敦大本钟地标档案海报
items.description: 2:3 伦敦建筑艺术海报：上半真实黄昏伦敦摄影，下半温暖象牙纸上的二维建筑解构，两部分严格对应伊丽莎白塔、英国议会大厦与泰晤士河。
items.prompt:
Create a premium 2:3 vertical London architectural art poster in the ICONIC LANDMARK SERIES. The upper 45% is real city photography from near the South Bank looking toward the Palace of Westminster; the lower 55% is a minimalist 2D architectural deconstruction of the exact same landmarks on warm ivory art paper. The two halves must visibly correspond. Upper half: Elizabeth Tower/Big Ben sits slightly right of visual center, fully visible from base through spire with real proportions, pale-gold clock face, Gothic Revival spire, stone facade, vertical panes, and top tip. The Palace of Westminster extends horizontally beside it into the classic skyline, in warm beige stone with gentle sunset-gold highlights. The wide Thames occupies about 20–25% of the photographic area, low-saturation blue-gray with fine ripples and a slight reflection; a tiny tour boat is optional and distant modern buildings are subdued. Set it in London evening transitioning from Golden Hour to Blue Hour, with pale gray-blue, misty purple, light peach-pink, and faint warm-gold sky gradients; a few British stratiform and soft cumulus clouds feel slightly overcast but not gloomy. Side-back light through clouds gives the tower a fine gold rim. Use 50–85mm architectural photography, medium-telephoto compression, straight verticals, no fisheye or exaggerated wide angle. Lower half: warm ivory/cream premium paper and large clean negative space, turning the same buildings into a minimalist 2D archive illustration. Keep Big Ben on the same visual axis, with tall rectangular body, four clock faces, restrained pale-gold circles, Gothic panes, spire, and slender tip, simplified into rectangles, fine verticals, triangles, pointed arches, and ultra-fine geometry in light sandstone, warm beige, taupe, low-saturation gold, and deep gray-blue, with no heavy black outlines. Extend a shorter Palace of Westminster to its left, retaining continuous spires, rectangular body, towers, pointed-arch windows, and horizontal base. Add one giant translucent dusty-rose/pale-peach geometric sun behind and left of Big Ben, partly obscured by the buildings, never textured like a real sun. Establish the Thames with one ultra-fine dark gray-blue baseline and 5–7 varying-length misty-blue, gray-blue, and pale-navy lines below; an ultra-small red double-decker bus silhouette may be hidden within 1% of the frame. Use architectural-firm archive and museum-catalog typography. Required exact text: lower left “LONDON” then “BIG BEN”, thin modernist sans-serif in deep navy with wide tracking and a very fine short rule; small “LONDON, UNITED KINGDOM”. Upper left “ICONIC
LANDMARK
SERIES
—
No.001”; upper right “EST.
1859”; lower right “51.5007° N
0.1246° W”; bottom “PALACE OF WESTMINSTER”. Blend Swiss International Style, British modernism, Bauhaus, mid-century travel poster, architectural editorial, Japanese and Scandinavian minimalism. Keep warm ivory paper, precise grid, ultra-fine lines, low-saturation Morandi palette, accurate proportions, calm British architectural-magazine restraint, and museum-quality collector-poster finish. Avoid cartoon Big Ben, children's illustration, cyberpunk, neon, future city, 3D, clay, oil, watercolor, thick black outlines, oversaturation, strong HDR, incorrect tower proportion or clock face, wrong Gothic structure, repeated towers, perspective errors, dense tourists or cars, clutter, London Eye stealing focus, gibberish text, or cheap postcard styling.
items.prompt_zh:
创作一张高级 2:3 竖幅伦敦城市地标建筑艺术海报，属于 ICONIC LANDMARK SERIES。上半约 45% 是从泰晤士河南岸望向英国议会大厦的真实城市摄影；下半约 55% 是同一组地标在温暖象牙白艺术纸上的极简二维建筑解构。上下必须清楚对应同一套伦敦地标。上半：伊丽莎白塔/Big Ben 位于视觉中心略右，完整塔身从底到尖塔不裁切，保持真实比例，清楚表现淡金钟面、哥特复兴尖塔、石材立面、垂直窗格和顶部尖顶。英国议会大厦横向紧邻展开，形成典型天际线；暖米黄色石材带柔和夕阳金色高光。宽阔的泰晤士河占摄影区约 20–25%，低饱和蓝灰水面有细密波纹和轻微倒影；可有极小游船，远处现代建筑弱化。时段为 Golden Hour 进入 Blue Hour 的傍晚，天空自然渐变为淡灰蓝、雾紫、浅桃粉和微暖金色，带少量英国层状云与柔软积云，轻微阴天但不阴沉；侧后阳光穿云给塔边缘细金色轮廓光。使用 50–85mm 建筑摄影、中长焦压缩、笔直垂线、无鱼眼或夸张广角。下半：暖象牙白/奶油白高级纸张与大量干净留白，把上半建筑变为极简二维建筑档案插画。Big Ben 保持上方相似视觉轴线，保留高矩形塔身、四面钟盘、淡金钟面、哥特窗格、尖塔与细塔尖；用矩形、细竖线、三角、尖拱和极细几何线简化，色彩为浅砂岩、暖米色、灰褐、低饱和金和深灰蓝，无粗黑描边。左侧延伸低于 Big Ben 的议会大厦，保留连续尖顶、矩形主体、塔楼、尖拱窗和水平基座。Big Ben 后方偏左放一枚巨大半透明雾粉/玫瑰灰/浅桃色几何圆形太阳，部分被建筑遮挡，不使用真实太阳纹理。建筑基部用极细深灰蓝水平线，下面加 5–7 条雾蓝、灰蓝、浅海军蓝的不同长度细线，抽象代表泰晤士河；可在不超过画面 1% 处藏一个极小红色双层巴士剪影。排版必须是建筑事务所档案与博物馆展览图录风格：左下主文字精确为“LONDON”与“BIG BEN”，细字重现代主义无衬线、深海军蓝、明显字距和极细短横线；小字“LONDON, UNITED KINGDOM”。左上小字“ICONIC
LANDMARK
SERIES
—
No.001”；右上“EST.
1859”；右下“51.5007° N
0.1246° W”；最下方“PALACE OF WESTMINSTER”。整体融合 Swiss International Style、British modernism、Bauhaus、中世纪旅行海报、建筑社论、日式与斯堪的纳维亚极简；温暖象牙纸、大留白、精确网格、超细线、低饱和莫兰迪配色、准确建筑比例，上真实摄影下二维解构，安静克制的英伦建筑杂志和博物馆收藏质感。避免卡通 Big Ben、儿童插画、赛博朋克、霓虹、未来城、3D、黏土、油画、水彩、粗黑描边、过饱和、强 HDR、错误比例/钟面/哥特结构、重复钟楼、透视错误、密集游客车辆、杂乱背景、伦敦眼抢主体、乱码文字和廉价明信片风。

items.title: 四层递进式多风格照片海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的通用照片编辑工作流。以每张实际上传的源照片为唯一依据，输出四层等高的 3:4 海报：原始摄影、多色橡皮章田野笔记、格式塔正负形丝网版画、黑白越界插画与单点彩色。源照片为必填文件输入，来源示例图不被冒充为用户原图。
items.prompt:
Image 1 is the generated supporting image for source_photo; use it as the actual input for the corresponding slot in this editing workflow.

Use the uploaded source photo as the only input. Process each uploaded photo independently and output one high-end poster per photo. Create a seamless 3:4 vertical composition divided into four equal horizontal bands, each exactly 25% of the height, with no gaps, lines, borders, logos, or watermarks. All four bands must show the same subject, moment, spatial relationships, proportions, and visual center from the same source photo; align their major contours and let the styles evolve continuously.

Band 1 | Original photography: preserve the source photo’s identity, quantity, structure, pose, perspective, occlusion, environment, lighting, and core colors. Only extend or lightly crop the background horizontally to fit the approximately 3:1 band; never stretch or crop key subjects.

Band 2 | Multicolor rubber-stamp field notes: distill the source into a refined small-scale stamp using recognizable silhouettes, 2–4 extracted spot colors, carved lines, layered ink, paper grain, imperfect pressure, broken ink, and slight registration shift. Keep generous paper negative space. Add only a short English title and minimal archival notes derived from the source; avoid postcard lists, circular stamp clichés, sticker collage, and excess text.

Band 3 | Gestalt positive/negative screen print: rebuild the subject and one closely related environmental or symbolic idea into a single interlocking graphic. Let shared boundaries, cutouts, and figure-ground reversal hide the second reading until closer inspection. Use 2–4 soft low-saturation colors, clean flat shapes, subtle paper and screen-print grain, and minimal type integrated with the silhouette. Avoid simply stacking two objects.

Band 4 | Black-and-white boundary-crossing illustration: use a pure black geometric field on white paper, with the recognizable subject mostly inside it and one key contour naturally breaking the boundary. Draw with clean black lines, white negative space, and gray blocks, plus one tiny accent color extracted from the source. Add restrained handwritten or editorial microtype near the boundary. Do not create a second focal subject.

Overall result: each band fills its quarter, remains faithful to the same source, and has its own visual identity while reading as one progression from photograph to memory, optical idea, and editorial drawing. Keep the layout calm, precise, and collectible. Avoid generic tourism templates, repeated compositions, complex scenes, heavy decoration, gradients, garbled text, or unrelated subjects.
items.prompt_zh:
图1是为source_photo生成的配套素材，作为本次编辑工作流对应位置实际使用的输入图像。

使用上传的源照片作为唯一输入。每张上传照片独立处理，每张单独输出一张高级海报。创建无缝的 3:4 竖向构图，从上到下严格分为四个等高横向区域，每层恰好占总高度 25%，层间无缝，不要分隔线、边框、标志或水印。四层都必须来自同一张源照片，保持同一主体、瞬间、空间关系、比例和视觉重心；主要轮廓上下对齐，让风格连续演化。

第一层｜原始摄影：保留源照片的身份、数量、结构、姿势、视角、遮挡、环境、光线和核心色彩。为适配约 3:1 横幅，只允许自然横向延展或轻微裁切背景；不得拉伸主体或裁掉关键对象。

第二层｜多色橡皮章田野笔记：将源照片提炼为精炼的小型多色章印，使用可辨识剪影、从原图提取的 2–4 种专色、刻线、套色、纸张颗粒、压力变化、断墨和轻微套色错位。保留大面积纸面留白。只添加从源图提炼的简短英文标题和少量档案式注释；避免明信片罗列、圆形印章陈词、贴纸拼贴和过多文字。

第三层｜格式塔正负形丝网版画：将主体与一个紧密相关的环境或象征意象重构为相互咬合的单一图形。通过共用边界、负形镂空和图底反转隐藏第二重阅读，让近看才发现另一层含义。使用 2–4 种柔和低饱和色、干净平面形状、细微纸张与丝网颗粒，以及融入剪影的极少量文字。不要简单堆叠两个物体。

第四层｜黑白越界插画：在白纸上使用纯黑几何色域，让可辨识主体大部分位于色域内部，并让一个关键轮廓自然突破边界。使用干净黑线、白色负形和灰色块面，再加入从源图提取的一处极小强调色。在边界附近添加克制的手写或编辑类微型排版，不要制造第二个焦点主体。

整体效果：每层完整填满自己的四分之一，忠于同一源照片，同时拥有独立视觉身份，形成从摄影到记忆、视觉概念和编辑线稿的连续递进。保持安静、精确、具有收藏感。避免通用旅行模板、重复构图、复杂场景、厚重装饰、渐变、乱码或无关主体。

items.title: 硬闪湿润泪感韩系美妆特写
items.description: 使用指定人物身份参考制作一张 1:1 的极近微距硬闪美妆肖像，保留泪感妆效、深黑背景、手势与右下角 ChenLin 署名。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference as the facial identity reference for the only visible adult East Asian woman, preserving her recognizable facial features. Create a 1:1 extreme close-up macro hard-flash Korean beauty portrait in an avant-garde fashion beauty editorial style. Her black hair is tied back slightly messily, with fine strands naturally crossing the forehead, eye corners, and cheeks. Use high-concentration tear-like pink blush, pearlescent watery under-eyes, pink-brown eyeshadow, thick yet natural eyelashes, moist nude-pink glass lips slightly parted, and a subtly moist gaze. Real skin texture, pores, and small imperfections must remain clearly visible.

Keep her nearly frontal, with her head turned slightly toward the left of the frame and eyes looking directly into the camera. Her right hand enters from the lower right, with the index finger lightly touching the lower-lip edge and the middle finger close to the cheek, in a natural casual-snapshot gesture. Show a black thin strap and a small piece of ivory knit fabric on the left shoulder, with layered silver ear clips and jewelry.

Use a deep black background and direct macro hard flash, creating sharp highlights on the gaze, tear-like aegyo-sal, nose bridge, lips, and silver accessories. Let stray hairs make fine reflected lines under the flash and retain distinct side-of-face shadows. Avoid all-over watery glow, wet oily film, plastic skin smoothing, exaggerated pearlescent powder, finger deformities, extra fingers, or abnormal mouth structure. adult woman only. Add no other people, extra text, extra logos, or watermark; retain a white artistic handwritten “ChenLin” signature at the lower right.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物参考作为画面中唯一可见成年东亚女性的面部身份参考，保留她可辨识的面部特征。生成一张 1:1 极近微距硬闪韩系美妆肖像，前卫时装美容大片风格。她将黑发略凌乱地向后束起，细碎发丝自然横过额头、眼角和脸颊；高浓度泪感粉红腮红、眼下珠光水亮、粉棕眼影、浓密但自然的睫毛、水润裸粉玻璃唇微张，眼神带轻微湿润感。真实皮肤纹理、毛孔和小瑕疵必须清晰可见。

人物近乎正面，头部稍向画面左侧偏转，直视镜头。右手从画面右下进入，食指轻触下唇边缘，中指靠近脸颊，保持随意抓拍般的自然动作。左肩可见黑色细肩带和一小块象牙白针织面料，耳部佩戴层叠银色耳夹与耳饰。

背景为深黑色。微距硬闪正面直打，在眼神、泪感卧蚕、鼻梁、唇部与银色饰品上形成锐利高光；碎发在闪光下呈现细线反光，脸侧阴影分明。避免全脸水光、湿亮油膜、塑料磨皮、夸张珠光粉、手指畸形、多指或异常嘴部结构。仅限成年女性，不添加其他人、额外文字、额外标志或水印；右下角保留白色艺术手写“ChenLin”署名。

items.title: 足球球衣运动时尚沙发自拍
items.description: 以指定人物身份参考拍摄一张室内米色沙发上的写实运动时尚自拍，保留球衣、牛仔裤、帽子、配饰和来源指定的可见品牌文字。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference as the facial identity reference for the only visible adult East Asian woman, preserving her recognizable facial features. Create an ultra-realistic professional DSLR indoor fashion selfie: an Asian woman in her twenties reclines casually on a beige sofa with visible fabric texture, lightly holds the cap brim with her right hand, extends her left arm to hold the phone for a selfie, tilts her head slightly left, and looks directly into the camera with an intense yet slightly playful expression.

She wears a black-and-white cropped short-sleeve football-jersey athleisure top with an oversized boxy dropped-shoulder fit, wide elbow-length sleeves, a white ribbed or mesh V-neck, a curved white chest panel, and white mesh sleeve stripes; the chest has clearly readable bold black “PUMA” lettering and a white Puma Cat logo. Pair it with high-waisted light-wash denim jeans, lowered slightly at the waist to reveal a bright red underwear waistband with clearly readable white “DIESEL” lettering. Keep shoes out of frame.

Her makeup has sharp black cat-eye eyeliner, voluminous curled lashes, subtle inner-corner shimmer, naturally groomed brows, soft red-pink matte ombre lips, fresh blush, and subtle cheekbone highlight. Her long dark-brown wavy hair has scattered pink highlights. She wears an olive-green baseball cap with leopard-print side panels and clearly readable white embroidered text, “SPORTY & RICH / S.R Wellness Club / WELLNESS CLUB”, with a tennis-themed graphic; thin black wire-frame glasses rest low on her nose, with layered delicate silver key and heart pendant necklaces and a simple silver bracelet.

Use an eye-level first-person medium selfie composition with shallow depth of field, a softly blurred home or cafe interior, soft natural indoor light, sharp facial focus, realistic skin and fabric textures, natural colors, and subtle bokeh. adult woman only. Add no other people, extra text, extra logos, or watermark. No anime, illustration, CGI, plastic skin, or obvious AI artifacts.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物参考作为画面中唯一可见成年东亚女性的面部身份参考，保留她可辨识的面部特征。创作一张超写实专业 DSLR 室内时尚自拍：一位二十多岁的成年亚洲女性躺靠在带清晰织物纹理的米色沙发上，右手轻扶帽檐，左臂伸出拿手机自拍，头微微向左倾，直视镜头，表情强烈又略带俏皮。

她穿黑白短款短袖足球球衣式运动休闲上衣，宽松箱型落肩剪裁、宽大及肘袖、白色罗纹或网眼 V 领、弧形白色胸前面板、白色网眼袖条纹；胸前清晰可读的黑色“PUMA”字样和白色 Puma Cat 标志。搭配高腰浅水洗牛仔裤，腰部略低，露出亮红色内裤腰带及清晰可读的白色“DIESEL”字样，鞋子不入镜。

妆容为锐利黑色猫眼眼线、浓密卷翘睫毛、细微内眼角提亮、自然眉形、柔和红粉色哑光渐变唇、清新腮红和细腻颧骨高光。深棕色长卷发带散落粉色挑染。戴橄榄绿色棒球帽，帽侧为豹纹面板，白色刺绣文字清晰可读：“SPORTY & RICH / S.R Wellness Club / WELLNESS CLUB”，并带网球主题图案；细黑线框眼镜低架鼻梁，叠戴银色钥匙和心形吊坠项链及简约银手链。

采用眼平第一人称中景自拍与浅景深，背景为柔化的家庭或咖啡馆室内环境，使用柔和自然室内光、锐利面部对焦、真实皮肤与布料纹理、自然色彩和细腻散景。仅限成年女性，不添加其他人、额外文字、额外标志或水印；无动漫、无插画、无 CGI、无塑料感皮肤、无明显 AI 伪影。

items.title: 巷弄奔跑大笑成年女性胶片肖像
items.description: 在狭窄城市服务巷弄中，以褪色彩色负片美学拍摄的动态全身肖像。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the single visible adult woman. Create a realistic vertical 9:16 full-body photographed portrait in a narrow urban service alley. She is centered and running or skipping directly toward the camera mid-stride, with uneven shoulders, loose hands, and an authentic candid in-between moment. Her face is straight toward the camera, eyes squeezed nearly closed in a spontaneous broad laugh with visible teeth and raised cheeks. Keep her torso upright with a buoyant lean, both arms spread for balance: her right arm reaches diagonally down toward frame-left and her left arm reaches toward frame-right with a slightly bent elbow and loose fingers.

Give her a straight deep chocolate-brown shoulder-length lob, within jaw-to-collarbone length, with an open face. She wears an oversized off-white crewneck sweatshirt with a large faded multicolor rectangular non-text graphic across the chest, long loosely bunched sleeves, high-waisted plain black short shorts, white ribbed crew socks, and worn off-white chunky athletic sneakers.

Set the scene among dark-brown and rust-colored building walls, recessed doorways, pavement seams, shadowed utility clutter, and a partially visible parked car far back on the left. Shoot from eye level several meters away with a natural 50-85 mm lens feel, mild background compression, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, fully visible shoes near the lower edge, modest headroom, and the narrow alley receding behind her. Uneven warm daylight from the front-left lights her face and upper body while the alley remains substantially darker. Use a warm faded consumer color-negative film look: brown-amber cast, muted saturation, lightly green-gray shadows, lifted but dense blacks, low-to-moderate contrast, soft highlight roll-off, fine-to-medium grain, and mild motion softness around the moving hands and feet. Preserve unretouched skin with visible pores, vellus hair, lip and under-eye texture, and tonal variation. Avoid beauty-filter skin, studio-clean staging, generic fashion posing, malformed hands, extra fingers, distorted anatomy, readable text, logos, borders, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为画面中唯一可见成年女性的面部身份依据。生成一张逼真的 9:16 纵向全身摄影肖像，场景为狭窄的城市服务巷弄。她位于画面中央，正对相机奔跑或轻快跳步，处在跨步瞬间：双肩略不平齐、双手放松，保留自然抓拍的中间状态。她的脸正对相机，因自发的大笑而微微眯眼，露出牙齿、脸颊抬起。躯干挺直并带轻微轻盈前倾，双臂张开保持平衡：右臂斜向下伸向画面左侧，左臂伸向画面右侧、手肘略弯且手指放松。

她留深巧克力棕色齐肩直长波波头，长度限定在下巴到锁骨之间并露出面部。她穿超大号米白色圆领运动衫，胸前有一幅大面积褪色的多色矩形非文字图案，长袖自然松散起褶；搭配高腰纯黑短裤、白色罗纹中筒袜和磨损的米白色厚底运动鞋。

环境包括深褐和锈色建筑墙、凹进门洞、路面接缝、阴影中的管线杂物，以及远处左侧部分可见的停放车辆。相机位于平视、数米外的位置，呈现自然 50-85mm 镜头感、轻微背景压缩和浅至中等景深；鞋子在下边缘完整可见，头顶留适度空间，身后小巷向远处延伸。左前方不均匀暖日光照亮脸和上半身，小巷整体明显更暗。使用温暖褪色的消费级彩色负片效果：棕琥珀色偏色、低饱和、轻微绿灰阴影、抬起但浓郁的黑色、中低对比度、柔和高光衰减、细至中等颗粒，移动的手脚周围有轻微动感柔化。保留未经修饰的真实肌肤毛孔、汗毛、嘴唇和眼下纹理、色调变化。避免美颜滤镜肌肤、影棚式干净摆拍、通俗时尚姿势、畸形手、多余手指、扭曲人体、可读文字、标志、边框和水印。

items.title: 九宫格橡皮章风格透明表情包贴纸页
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的人物参考九宫格透明表情包贴纸模板；需上传人物参考图。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference as the same person in all nine stickers. Create a 1:1 square transparent PNG sticker sheet in a 3x3 grid. Make nine independent, non-overlapping cutout stickers with wide, completely transparent gaps and no extra background or continuous illustration. Preserve this person's facial identity, face shape, features, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, key clothing traits, and overall temperament; do not swap faces or make the stickers look like different people.

The center (fifth) sticker is a realistic cutout of the referenced person, with only slight cleanup and no stylization. The surrounding eight are separate stylized meme/reaction stickers of that same person. Each must have a clearly different expression, pose, gesture, or reaction, with dramatic, expressive variety rather than minor facial changes; keep the person complete, clearly edged, and the only character in each sticker. Do not add people, duplicate or fragment the person, or arbitrarily break body direction, structure, or relationships to important props.

Render the eight surrounding stickers as refined multicolor handmade rubber stamps: retain the most recognizable silhouette, pose, spatial relationship, and narrative cues; simplify only non-identity details into restrained spot-color blocks, carved lines, and slight overprinting. Use uneven carved lines, broken ink, paper-show-through, grainy ink, edge nicks, pressure variation, and slight registration shifts. Warm pale fiber paper, a color block, or a local substrate may appear only as a partial element within an individual surrounding sticker; everything outside each cutout and every grid gap stays transparent. Avoid smooth vector/filter looks, cartoon craft style, circular seals, tourist-souvenir styling, dense decoration, or sticker collage effects. Optional tiny, readable field-note text may appear inside one sticker only when needed; it must never cross grids or fill transparent gaps. The result contrasts one realistic central cutout with eight collectible rubber-stamp reaction stickers.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的人物参考图作为九张贴纸中同一人物的身份依据。制作一张 1:1 正方形透明 PNG 贴纸页，按 3x3 网格放置九个彼此独立、不重叠的抠像贴纸；贴纸间保留较宽且完全透明的间隔，不生成额外背景，也不做成连续插画。严格保留人物的脸型、五官、发型、发色、肤色、服装关键特征和整体气质；不得换脸，也不得让不同贴纸像不同人物。

中间第 5 格为该人物的真实感抠像，仅做轻微精修，不做风格化。周围八张是同一人物各自独立的风格化 meme/反应贴纸。每张必须呈现明显不同的表情、姿势、手势或反应，具有戏剧化、夸张的反应差异，不能只是轻微表情变化；每张内人物完整、边缘清楚且是唯一人物。不得添加他人、复制或拆分人物，也不得随意破坏人物朝向、身体结构或与关键道具的空间关系。

周围八张统一为精炼的多色手工橡皮章风格：保留最具辨识度的轮廓、姿态、空间关系和叙事线索，仅将非身份性细节概括为克制的专色色块、刻线和少量套印。呈现粗细不均刻线、断墨、纸张透底、颗粒油墨、边缘缺口、压力变化及轻微套色错位。暖浅色纤维纸、色块或局部衬底只能作为单张周围贴纸内的局部元素；每张抠像之外与所有格间区域必须透明。避免平滑矢量或滤镜感、儿童手工感、圆形印章、旅游纪念品感、密集装饰和贴纸拼贴。仅在确有必要时，可在单张贴纸内部加入极少量清晰可读的田野注释文字；不得跨格或占据透明间隔。成品应形成一张真实中心抠像与八张可收藏橡皮章反应贴纸的对比。

items.title: 深夜洗衣阳台生活抓拍
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的夜间公寓洗衣阳台生活人像模板：一位成年女性在洗衣机旁整理衣物，回头望向手机镜头。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the only visible adult East Asian woman; match facial identity only and do not change the nighttime laundry balcony, loungewear, laundry action, look-back pose, casual phone-snapshot composition, ambient lighting, or realistic style. Create a 9:16 vertical real-life photo casually taken with a standard iPhone main camera: on a narrow apartment laundry balcony at night, one adult woman stands beside a front-loading washing machine while sorting freshly washed clothes. The lived-in space must visibly include the washing machine, detergent, drying rods, white and light-colored laundry, a plastic laundry basin, slippers, tiled walls, and a blurred but identifiable city-residential night view outside the window. She is quiet, gentle, relaxed, and slightly tired from nighttime housework; retain realistic pores, slight uneven skin tone, and natural texture with only light makeup. Her black long hair is casually tied in a slightly messy high bun with loose strands at the forehead and face. She wears a misty-blue fitted short-sleeve ribbed lounge top and creamy-white soft lounge shorts, both complete and naturally worn with small wrinkles and drawstrings. Both feet are fully on the floor; one bears her weight and the other rests half a step back, knees relaxed. Pelvis, chest, and shoulders face the same direction with only a slight side turn. The hand nearest the washer rests lightly on its top; the other holds a stack of clean white and pale-blue clothes close to her abdomen. Keep her spine naturally upright and shoulders relaxed, without an exaggerated pose. Her head turns independently and gently toward the camera in a natural look back with a quiet, slightly tired gaze. Ensure normal hands, fingers, wrists, elbows, limb proportions, and stable weight-bearing. Use slightly warm ordinary balcony ceiling or wall lighting, allowing mildly uneven facial illumination, local highlights, natural shadow, slight highlight clipping, and low-light noise while the city outside remains dark. Use an approximately 24-28mm equivalent wide-angle, ordinary auto exposure, and realistic auto white balance; the woman, washer, drying rack, clothes, and tiles remain identifiable in a casually framed snapshot. No studio or commercial-fashion look, movie-poster treatment, soft-light filter, large-aperture blur, excessive skin smoothing, CGI, text, watermark, extra people, extra limbs, malformed hands or feet, floating posture, or implausible weight distribution.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年东亚女性的面部身份参考；只匹配面部身份，不改变夜间洗衣阳台、居家服装、整理衣物动作、回眸姿态、手机抓拍构图、环境光线或写实风格。创作一张 9:16 竖幅、真实 iPhone 普通主摄随手拍的生活照片：夜晚狭窄的公寓洗衣阳台内，一位成年女性站在前开门洗衣机侧前方整理刚洗好的衣物。空间真实有人居住，画面应可辨洗衣机、洗衣液、晾衣杆、正在晾晒的白色和浅色衣物、塑料洗衣盆、拖鞋、瓷砖墙面，以及窗外模糊但可识别的城市住宅夜景灯光。她气质安静、温柔、放松，带有夜间家务时轻微疲惫与独处感；皮肤保留真实毛孔、轻微肤色不均和自然纹理，仅有淡妆。黑色长发随意挽成略微凌乱的高丸子头，额前和脸侧留自然碎发。她穿雾蓝色短袖修身罗纹家居上衣和奶白色柔软家居短裤，衣物完整、自然、有轻微褶皱和抽绳。她双脚完整踩地，一脚承重，另一脚自然向后错开半步，膝盖放松；骨盆、胸腔与肩膀方向一致，只轻微侧转。靠近洗衣机的一只手轻搭洗衣机顶面，另一只手抱一叠白色和浅蓝色的干净衣物靠近腹部；脊柱自然直立、肩膀放松，不做夸张摆姿。头部独立轻轻转向镜头，形成自然回看，眼神安静略疲惫。确保双手、手指、手腕、手肘与四肢比例正常，重心稳定。使用略暖的普通阳台顶灯或墙灯，允许脸部轻微受光不均、局部高光、暗部真实阴影、轻微高光溢出和低照度噪点，窗外保持较暗。采用约 24-28mm 等效广角、普通自动曝光和真实自动白平衡；人物、洗衣机、晾衣架、衣物与瓷砖都清晰可辨，构图随手自然。不要影棚、商业时尚、电影海报、柔光滤镜、大光圈虚化、过度磨皮、CGI、文字、水印、额外人物、额外肢体、畸形手脚、悬空或不合理受力姿态。

items.title: 陶艺工作室成年女性写实肖像
items.description: 在温馨陶艺工作室中制作小陶碗的单人写实生活方式肖像。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the single visible adult woman. Create a highly photorealistic vertical 3:4 candid lifestyle portrait in a warm, attractive ceramic studio. She sits naturally behind a real electric pottery wheel, leans slightly forward while looking directly at the camera, and shapes a small unfinished clay bowl. One bare hand steadies the bowl's outside wall and the other shapes its inner rim; both hands are visibly coated with wet beige clay and have natural, anatomically correct fingers.

She has long straight dark-brown hair over one shoulder, light wispy bangs, realistic skin texture, subtle natural makeup, gentle peach blush, and a warm attentive expression. She wears a fitted ivory lace camisole with both camisole straps correctly on her shoulders, covered by a loose taupe canvas pottery apron with caramel-brown straps. One apron strap stays on her shoulder and the other rests naturally around her upper arm; do not make the camisole off-shoulder.

Show authentic wet clay marks on the white splash tray. Behind her, use rustic wooden shelves with handmade cups, bowls, vases, and small sculptures in cream, pale blue, and muted glazes. Use warm window light mixed with soft indoor studio light, creamy natural color, a shallow depth of field, and smartphone-style 35 mm photographic realism. Keep sharp focus on her face and hands, with realistic skin pores, individual hair strands, wet clay texture, natural fabric folds, and modest background blur. Avoid extra people, malformed hands, extra fingers, gloves, shifted camisole straps, plastic skin, anime or CGI rendering, excessive beauty filtering, motion blur, readable text, logos, subtitles, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
以用户上传的参考图作为画面中唯一可见成年女性的面部身份依据。生成一张高度写实的 3:4 纵向生活方式抓拍肖像：温馨、美观的陶艺工作室中，她自然坐在真实电动陶轮后，微微前倾并直视相机，正在塑造一个小小的未完成粘土碗。一只裸手轻扶碗的外壁，另一只手塑造内缘；双手明显沾有湿润的米色粘土，手指自然且解剖正确。

她有一侧垂落的深棕色长直发、轻盈刘海、真实肌肤纹理、淡雅自然妆容、柔和桃色腮红和温柔专注的神情。她穿象牙白蕾丝吊带背心，两条背心肩带均正确留在肩上；外搭灰褐色宽松帆布陶艺围裙和焦糖棕色肩带。一条围裙肩带留在肩上，另一条自然搭在上臂；不要把背心做成露肩。

白色陶轮防溅盘带有真实湿粘土和手工痕迹。背景为摆放手作杯、碗、花瓶和小雕塑的质朴木架，釉色包括奶油白、淡蓝和低饱和综合色。使用温暖窗光与柔和室内影棚灯，奶油般自然色彩、浅景深和智能手机 35mm 写实摄影语言。焦点清晰落在脸和双手，保留真实毛孔、发丝、湿粘土质感和自然布料褶皱，背景适度虚化。避免其他人物、畸形手、多余手指、手套、背心肩带移位、塑料感皮肤、动漫或 CGI 效果、过度美颜、运动模糊、可读文字、标志、字幕和水印。

items.title: 抽象色块微缩景观社论海报
items.description: 9:16 极简社论海报模板：以大面积矿物颜料色块、一个强图形结构和微缩景观组成留白丰富的纸张质感画面。默认主题为海岸风。
items.prompt: Create a refined minimalist 9:16 vertical editorial poster for COASTAL WIND. Use warm ivory fine-art paper with subtle natural paper texture. Let one irregular pale mineral blue field occupy about 40–55% of the composition with soft silkscreen, gouache, and mineral-pigment texture rather than a flat digital block. Make a long wind path sweeping across the page the main visual hook. Add a thin black coastal cliff horizon with very small a lone survey marker and tiny shore birds details to create a strong sense of scale. Set the title “COASTAL WIND” in sophisticated editorial typography and add the subtitle “FIELD STUDY / NORTH COAST”. Include a few brief meaningful field notes related to the theme, such as route, altitude, wind speed, temperature, time, distance, or survey data, plus one natural handwritten note: “Wind holds the line.”. Keep the hierarchy clear: a huge color field, strong structural gesture, tiny scene, refined typography, and micro information. From far away it should feel minimal and graphic; up close it should reveal paper texture, measurements, and narrative detail. Avoid flat vector blocks, cheap gradients, oversized scenery, random text, dense UI, dirty grunge texture, logos, watermarks, numbering, starbursts, and sparkle symbols.
items.prompt_zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖幅精制极简社论海报，主题为 COASTAL WIND。在暖象牙色美术纸上呈现微妙自然纸张纹理。让一块不规则的 pale mineral blue field 占据约 40–55% 构图，具有柔和丝网印刷、水粉和矿物颜料质感，而不是扁平数字色块。以 a long wind path sweeping across the page 作为主要视觉钩子；加入细黑色 coastal cliff horizon，其中有极小的 a lone survey marker and tiny shore birds 细节，以建立强烈尺度感。将画面标题“COASTAL WIND”使用精致社论排版，并加入副标题“FIELD STUDY / NORTH COAST”。加入几条与主题相关、简短且有意义的现场数据，例如路线、海拔、风速、温度、时间、距离或测量信息；再加一条自然的手写笔记“Wind holds the line.”。层次必须清晰：巨大色彩区域、强有力结构姿态、微小场景、精制排版与微缩信息。远看极简且图形化，近看能看到纸张纹理、测量信息和叙事细节。避免扁平矢量块、廉价渐变、过大景观、随机文字、密集 UI、脏污颗粒、logo、水印、编号、星爆和闪烁符号。

items.title: 日系蜡笔情侣牵手散步插画
items.description: 柔和的日系手绘 Q 版插画：一对成年情侣在纯白留白背景前牵手散步。彩色铅笔与蜡笔的手工质感、淡彩和微小装饰营造温馨浪漫的绘本氛围。
items.prompt: Use the face identity from the identity reference image to create a cute hand-drawn Japanese chibi illustration. Show two adult partners holding hands while walking in a sweet, playful moment. The female character uses the face identity from the reference image; she has medium-length black hair and wears a pale-pink knit cardigan, white skirt, and light loafers. The male character has short brown hair and wears a soft-blue shirt, beige trousers, and brown casual shoes. They walk side by side, holding hands with their inner hands while their free hands swing naturally, both wearing relaxed smiles. Use a soft traditional colored-pencil and crayon drawing style with visible sketchy pencil strokes, slightly rough imperfect outlines, gentle pastel coloring, and a handmade children's-storybook feeling. Give both characters oversized heads, tiny bodies, simple oval black eyes, tiny smiling mouths, rosy cheeks, and expressive innocent faces. Keep the full-body, centered composition clean and minimal on a plain white background with abundant negative space. Add a few hand-drawn pink hearts, small sparkles, and gentle motion lines around them. Use a soft pastel palette, subtle paper texture, delicate linework, slightly imperfect coloring, and a cozy wholesome romantic atmosphere.
items.prompt_zh: 使用身份参考图中的人物面部身份，创作一幅可爱的日系手绘 Q 版插画。画面是两位成年情侣在甜蜜俏皮的时刻牵手散步：女性角色使用身份参考图的面部身份，留中长黑发，穿淡粉色针织开衫、白色半身裙和浅色乐福鞋；男性角色留短棕发，穿柔和蓝色衬衫、米色长裤和棕色休闲鞋。他们并肩迈步，内侧双手相牵，另一只手自然摆动，彼此带着轻松微笑。采用柔和传统彩色铅笔与蜡笔绘画风格，保留可见的素描铅笔笔触、略显粗糙的不完美轮廓、温柔淡彩和手工儿童绘本感。两人拥有夸张的大头、小身体、简单黑色椭圆眼睛、小小笑嘴、红润脸颊和富有表现力的纯真面孔。构图在纯白背景上保持简洁极简，并留出大量负空间；全身、居中构图。在角色周围添加少量手绘粉色爱心、细小闪光和轻微动态线条。呈现柔和粉彩、细微纸张纹理、细腻线条、略不完美的上色，以及温馨治愈的浪漫气氛。

items.title: 夜间昏暗酒吧电影感人像
items.description: 一位成年女性在深夜昏暗酒吧中轻握鸡尾酒、撩拨头发，呈现带有望远镜头压缩、钨丝灯与霓虹反射的梦幻电影感编辑快照。
items.prompt: Use the face identity from the identity reference image to create a 9:16 vertical low-light cinematic portrait in a dim bar at night. One adult Korean woman is in the bar with a cool porcelain-like complexion, a sleek black off-shoulder or thin-strap outfit, and minimal jewelry. In a relaxed, slightly tipsy candid pose, she loosely holds a cocktail while brushing her hair with her other hand; half-lidded eyes, parted lips, and a distant seductive gaze create a restrained but tense moment. Use warm tungsten light, deep shadows, and subtle neon reflections, with frosted glass and blurred figures in the background. Apply telephoto compression, shallow depth of field, soft focus, slight motion blur, haze, highlight bloom, and heavy film grain. The mood is moody, dreamy, mysterious, sensual but restrained, like an imperfect editorial snapshot capturing “the moment before something happens.”
items.prompt_zh: 使用身份参考图中的人物面部身份，创作一张 9:16 竖幅的低光电影感夜间酒吧人像。一位成年韩国女性置身昏暗酒吧，肤色呈冷白瓷感，穿干练黑色露肩或细肩带装束，搭配极简首饰。她以放松、略带醉意的自然姿态松松握着一杯鸡尾酒，另一只手正在撩拨头发；半睁的眼睛、微张的嘴唇和望向远方的疏离诱惑目光构成克制而有张力的瞬间。环境使用温暖钨丝灯、深邃阴影与微妙霓虹反射，背景有磨砂玻璃和模糊的人影。采用望远镜头压缩、浅景深、柔焦、轻微动态模糊、薄雾、高光溢出和浓重胶片颗粒。整体氛围忧郁、梦幻、神秘、性感但克制，像一张不完美的社论快照，捕捉“某件事发生前的瞬间”。

items.title: 户外咖啡馆四格拼贴写真
items.description: 一位成年女性在自然采光的户外咖啡馆中呈现四个不同的轻松抓拍瞬间。四格保持同一面部身份、发型与服装，以冰咖啡和柔和韩系时尚氛围作为场景线索。
items.prompt: Use the face identity from the identity reference image to create a photorealistic four-photo collage. The subject is the same adult Korean woman in all four panels, with fully consistent face identity, long black hair, soft bangs, and outfit: a cream top, dusty-blue knit cardigan, and navy pleated midi skirt. Set the collage at an outdoor cafe in natural daylight, with iced coffee as a prop. Capture a different cute, candid moment in each photo: panel one, holding coffee and winking; panel two, blowing a kiss toward the camera; panel three, making a peace sign; panel four, naturally laughing while holding coffee. Use realistic smartphone photography, a soft K-fashion aesthetic, and high detail, while keeping the woman's face, hairstyle, clothing, and overall lighting coherent across all four panels.
items.prompt_zh: 使用身份参考图中的人物面部身份，创建一张由四张写实照片组成的四格拼贴画。主角是同一位成年韩国女性，四格中保持完全一致的面部身份、黑色长发、柔和刘海和服装；她穿乳白色上衣、灰蓝色针织开衫和海军蓝百褶中长裙。场景是自然日光下的户外咖啡馆，并有一杯冰咖啡作为道具。四张照片各自捕捉不同的可爱自然瞬间：第一格手拿咖啡并眨眼；第二格向镜头吹吻；第三格比剪刀手；第四格手拿咖啡自然大笑。采用真实智能手机摄影质感、柔和的韩系时尚美学和高细节，四格人物的面部、发型、服装和整体光线保持连贯。

items.title: 草莓大福巨物时尚海报
items.description: 将原始可配置的美食时尚工作流具体化为草莓大福主题的竖幅商业海报：巨型甜点作为建筑舞台，成年模特与其自然互动，并配以原创社论式标题与短文案。
items.prompt: Use the face identity from the identity reference image to create a 4:5 vertical premium food-fashion campaign poster. At the center is one enormous strawberry mochi: a soft white glutinous-rice skin with a faint translucent pink cast, sliced open to reveal bright red strawberry, cream, and fine red-bean filling. It occupies about 60% of the frame and serves as both the primary visual focus and an architectural stage. The subject is one adult woman wearing an ivory cropped jacket, cherry-red pleated mini skirt, and cream platform ankle boots. She stands on a low step at the front of the mochi, lightly touching the soft outer skin with one hand while one boot rests on the edge of the cut surface, turning slightly back toward the camera; make the contact, weight, hands, feet, proportions, and perspective believable. Set it in a clean pale-pink and cream studio, with strawberries, rice flour, red beans, and a cream piping bag limited to the edges and foreground in selective natural blur so they do not compete with the giant dessert and model. Use bright commercial studio lighting, subtle surface reflections, crisp realistic materials, polished editorial styling, and a strong sense of scale. Behind the mochi and model, place one oversized original headline, “STRAWBERRY MOCHI”, with letters made of translucent mochi and strawberry-jelly material; let parts of the lettering overlap naturally in front of and behind the dessert and model to create spatial depth. Add four short original English editorial lines: “SOFT SCALE”, “BITE THE LIGHT”, “CREAM, BERRY, WONDER”, and “EDITION: SWEET FORM”. Keep the typography asymmetrical, refined, and integrated with the image. Do not include “VOL.1”, “01”, “ISSUE”, decorative numbering, or generic placeholder text.
items.prompt_zh: 使用身份参考图中的人物面部身份，创作一张 4:5 竖幅高端美食时尚商业海报。画面中心是一颗巨大的草莓大福：柔软白色糯米外皮微带半透明粉感，切开的边缘露出鲜红草莓、奶油和细腻红豆馅；它占画面约 60%，既是主视觉也是可站立的建筑舞台。主体是一位成年女性，穿象牙白短款夹克、樱桃红百褶迷你裙和奶油色厚底短靴；她站在大福前侧较低的台阶上，一只手轻触柔软外皮，另一只脚踏在切面边缘，身体微微回望镜头，接触、重量、手脚比例与透视都可信。背景为干净的浅粉与奶油色影棚空间，边缘和前景散落草莓、糯米粉、红豆和奶油裱花袋，选择性自然虚化且不抢主体。以明亮商业影棚灯光、细微台面反射、清晰材质、精致社论造型和强烈比例对比呈现。大福和人物后方放置一行巨大的原创标题“STRAWBERRY MOCHI”，字母采用半透明糯米与草莓果冻质感，部分字母自然穿插于甜点与人物前后，形成空间层次；配套放置四行简短原创英文社论文案：“SOFT SCALE”, “BITE THE LIGHT”, “CREAM, BERRY, WONDER”, “EDITION: SWEET FORM”。排版不对称、精致并与画面融为一体；不要出现“VOL.1”、“01”、“ISSUE”、装饰性编号或通用占位文字。

items.title: 黑色晚礼服红毯到场时装摄影
items.description: 2:3 竖幅全身时装纪实照：成年女性身着黑色高开叉晚礼服，在欧洲石材建筑旁的亮黑豪华轿车边优雅到场，摄影师与围观人群形成背景层次。使用时需上传人物参考图。
items.prompt: A realistic 2:3 vertical full-body fashion-event photograph. Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the main visible adult woman in the central foreground. She walks naturally from left to right, photographed from a side-front eye-level position in a profile-to-three-quarter view. Show her complete body from head to pointed black stiletto shoes, with no cropped limbs or feet and adequate space around her. She has a calm, poised expression with her gaze slightly toward the camera; dark-brown center-parted hair is styled into a neat low bun. Her tall elegant physique has naturally graceful curves, long legs, and balanced proportions. She wears a sleeveless black floor-length evening gown with a high halter neckline and wide black neckband, fitted through the torso and hips with a streamlined silhouette and a dramatic high side slit revealing one leg. She carries a small black handbag with a delicate chain strap and wears small earrings and rings. Set the arrival beside a glossy black luxury sedan outside a pale weathered European-style stone building; show dark tinted windows, chrome trim, and large multi-spoke alloy wheels. Behind the car is a small crowd of onlookers and photographers with phones and cameras. A male photographer in dark clothing holding a professional DSLR with a large white telephoto lens is clearly visible but secondary. Use natural soft diffused daylight, balanced exposure across the person, car, architecture, and crowd, with natural highlights on hair and glossy paint. Keep the background gently softened but recognizably detailed. Deliver a high-end photoreal fashion-event and editorial street-photography image rather than a studio pose: realistic skin texture, natural hair strands, accurate fingers and anatomy, physically plausible black fabric and vehicle reflections, restrained natural bokeh, and cinematic yet documentary color. Avoid excessive retouching, beauty-filter effects, CGI, illustration, anime styling, exaggerated proportions, text, watermarks, and logos.
items.prompt_zh: 2:3 竖幅全身写实时装活动摄影。使用上传参考图作为中央前景主要可见成年女性的面部身份依据。她从左向右自然行走，镜头在与眼睛平齐的侧前方拍摄，呈现侧面至四分之三视图；从头到尖头黑色细跟鞋完整可见，肢体和双脚均不裁切，身体周围留出适度空间。她神情冷静从容，略微看向镜头，深棕色中分头发梳成整洁低发髻；高挑、曲线优雅、长腿且比例自然。她穿无袖黑色拖地晚礼服，高挂脖领口配宽黑色颈带，躯干和臀部贴合、线条流畅，侧面高开叉露出一条腿；提带精致链条的小黑色手包，佩戴小耳环和戒指。场景是欧洲风格浅色风化石材建筑外，旁边停着一辆亮黑色豪华轿车，深色贴膜车窗、镀铬饰条和多辐合金轮毂清晰可见。车后有一小群旁观者和摄影师，有人拿着手机和相机；一名穿深色衣服的男摄影师持大型白色远摄镜头的专业单反，相对清楚但不抢主体。自然柔和漫射日光，人物、车辆、建筑和人群曝光平衡，车漆和头发有自然高光；背景略微柔化但保留可辨环境细节。画面应是高端真实时装活动和街头纪实摄影，而非影棚摆拍：真实皮肤纹理、自然发丝、准确手指与身体比例、真实布料和车漆反射、克制自然虚化、电影感但具纪录片色彩。避免过度磨皮、美颜滤镜、CGI、插画、动漫、夸张比例、文字、水印或 logo。

items.title: 山湖叶绿素标本印相
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的叶绿素印相编辑工作流。本静态衍生版本以固定山湖影像替代未提供的上传图像，保留单叶标本、五条纸带和植物色素摄影效果。
items.prompt: Create a real botanical-herbarium still-life photograph: one large dried European beech leaf is pinned to an aged off-white herbarium card. The leaf is slightly curled and held at its edges by five small glued paper strips. The leaf's own chlorophyll forms a photographic image of a dawn mountain lake, distant snow peaks, dark conifer forest, and faint water reflection, with the complete composition naturally contained inside the leaf shape. Do not apply a green filter to a normal photo; the image must look truly grown in the leaf tissue from its own pigment. Faded chlorophyll highlights are pale yellow-green, shadows stay deep green, clear veins run through the image, and edges have slight natural fading. The card has a restrained printed header "HERBARIUM ARCHIVE", a handwritten Latin species name "FAGUS SYLVATICA", collection date "12 SEP 2026", and a small typed lower-corner label "SPECIMEN 014". Soft daylight illuminates the card and makes a faint shadow beneath the leaf. The result is a real, delicate, fragile, temporary photographic object with dry-leaf fibers, aged paper texture, and subtle pigment unevenness; no illustration, vector, digital texture, smooth compositing, extra leaves, people, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 制作一张真实的植物标本馆静物照片：一片巨大的干燥山毛榉叶被固定在陈旧米白色标本卡上。叶片略微卷曲，边缘由五条小纸带粘住。叶片自身的叶绿素形成一幅摄影影像，画面是清晨的高山湖泊、远处积雪山峰、深色针叶树林和水面的微弱倒影，完整构图被自然限制在叶片形状内部。不要把普通照片加绿色滤镜；影像必须像真正由叶片自身色素在叶肉中生长出来。褪色的叶绿素高光为淡黄绿色，阴影保持深绿色，清晰叶脉穿过影像，边缘有轻微自然褪色。标本卡有低调印刷抬头 "HERBARIUM ARCHIVE"，手写拉丁学名 "FAGUS SYLVATICA"，采集日期 "12 SEP 2026"，右下角小型打字标签 "SPECIMEN 014"。柔和日光照亮卡纸，在叶片下方形成微弱阴影。照片质感真实、细腻、脆弱而短暂，呈现干叶纤维、纸张老化纹理和植物色素的细微不均；不要插画、矢量、数字纹理、光滑合成感、额外叶片、人物、水印或 logo。

items.title: 阳光都市公园绿系穿搭生活方式人像
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的阳光都市公园生活方式人像模板。使用时上传人物参考图；示例以统一参考人物的面部身份呈现。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the only visible adult woman; match facial identity only and do not change the source-defined low ponytail, green outfit, burgundy shoulder bag, pose, park environment, composition, lighting, or natural smartphone-photography style. Create a 4:5 vertical photorealistic sunny-afternoon urban-park candid portrait of an adult woman standing beside a quiet paved walkway, gazing softly to the side with a calm, thoughtful expression. She has long dark-brown hair in a loose low ponytail, with a few wispy face-framing strands; she wears an olive-green cardigan over a white textured ruffle camisole with a long dark-green skirt, and a deep burgundy shoulder bag hanging naturally at her side. One hand rests gently near her neck and the other relaxes in front of her. The walkway is surrounded by green grass, mature leafy trees, and subtle distant urban buildings. Strong warm sunlight filters through leaves for highlights in her hair, soft shadows, and a subtle lens flare in an upper corner. Natural smartphone photography with a candid lifestyle feeling, real skin, fine hair strands and fabric texture, soft atmospheric contrast, shallow depth of field, gentle vintage film grain, muted earthy color, and a peaceful summer mood; no extra people, incorrect anatomy, plastic skin, studio setup, text, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年女性的面部身份参考；只匹配面部身份，不改变来源设定的低马尾、绿系服装、酒红色单肩包、姿态、公园环境、构图、光线或自然手机摄影风格。制作一张 4:5 竖幅、写实的阳光午后都市公园抓拍人像：一位成年女性站在安静的铺装步道旁，目光柔和地望向一侧，神情平静而若有所思。她有深棕色长发，梳成蓬松的低马尾，几缕轻薄碎发自然垂在脸侧；她穿橄榄绿开衫，内搭白色纹理褶边吊带背心和深绿色长裙，深酒红色单肩包自然垂在身侧。一只手轻放在颈侧，另一只手放松地置于身前。步道周围有绿草、成熟阔叶树和远处低调的城市建筑。强烈暖阳穿过树叶，在头发上形成高光、柔和阴影，并在上方角落形成细微镜头光晕。自然手机摄影、生活方式抓拍感，真实皮肤、细发丝和布料纹理，柔和大气对比、浅景深、轻微复古胶片颗粒、低饱和泥土色调和宁静夏日气氛；不要额外人物、错误解剖、塑料皮肤、影棚布置、文字、水印或 logo。

items.title: 江边夜晚仙女棒光绘肖像
items.description: 以人物参考图绑定主角身份的 9:16 成年夜景光绘肖像：单人站在江边步道，以仙女棒和护栏串灯作为主光，脸部清楚、肢体边缘有轻微长曝光重影。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference as the facial identity for the only main visible adult East Asian woman. Create a 9:16 casual night riverside long-exposure light-painting portrait; long-exposure light painting is the only imaging mechanism in this version. She is alone in the frame. Holding a sparkler, she leaves continuous warm-golden bright lines in the air. Expose her slowly through weak ambient light, with slight ghosting at arm and body edges while her face remains basically clear.

Give her sweet peach-pink makeup, light pink blush beneath the eyes, naturally moist lips, real skin texture, and a semi-matte low-light look. Her long hair falls naturally with a few stray strands at the side of her face; preserve the uploaded reference's recognizable facial features. She wears a loose white shirt, dark shorts, and black-and-white canvas shoes.

Set the scene on a night riverside walkway with metal railing, scattered distant city lights, dark water reflections, and a small amount of warm string lights on the railing. Use a fixed front-side camera position framing upper body to mid-thigh. Keep the environment nearly black, with sparkler and railing string lights as the primary light, gently warming face, arms, and white shirt. She leans forward toward the camera and extends one hand holding the sparkler directly to the lens; enlarge the foreground hand slightly through perspective and draw one large curved light trail before the lens. She looks gently at the camera. Avoid plastic skin, overall subject blur, excessive smoothing, deformed face or fingers, extra limbs, a second person, extra text, or watermarks. The lower-right corner must carry the artistic handwritten signature “ChenLin.”
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物参考图作为画面中唯一主要可见成年东亚女性的面部身份依据。生成一张 9:16 夜晚江边随手拍的长曝光光绘肖像；长曝光光绘是本版唯一成像机制。画面只有她一人。她手持仙女棒，在空气中留下连续的暖金色亮线；人物由微弱环境光缓慢曝光，手臂和身体边缘带轻微重影，但脸部基本清晰。

她有甜美的桃粉妆、眼下淡粉腮红、自然润泽的嘴唇、真实皮肤纹理和低光下半哑光质感；长发自然披散，少量碎发落在脸侧，保留参考图可辨认的面部特征。她穿白色宽松衬衫、深色短裤和黑白帆布鞋。

场景是夜晚江边步道：金属护栏、远处零星城市灯光、水面暗色反光，护栏上少量暖色串灯。侧前方固定机位拍摄上半身到大腿近景；环境几乎全黑，仙女棒与护栏串灯作为主光，暖光轻柔照亮脸、手臂和白衬衫。她身体向镜头前倾，一只手将仙女棒直接伸向镜头，前景手掌因透视略大，仙女棒在镜头前画出大幅弯曲光轨；她温柔看向镜头。不要塑料皮肤、人物整体模糊、过度磨皮、五官或手指畸形、多余肢体、第二人物、额外文字或水印。右下角必须有艺术性手写署名“ChenLin”。

items.title: 元气街头穿搭拆解编辑海报
items.description: 以人物参考图绑定主角身份的 3:4 写实街头穿搭编辑拼贴海报。主图为成年夏日街拍，搭配单品拆解、细节胶片条、包内平铺和更多角度的小版块。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference as the facial identity for the only main visible 20-year-old adult Asian woman. Create a vertical 3:4 realistic “fashion editorial outfit breakdown board” with asymmetric editorial collage, whitespace, torn-paper edges, tape stickers, and slightly misaligned overlapping image borders. Keep it light, bright, young, sunny, energetic, fashionable, and not vulgar. The page may contain a small number of short Chinese labels, short phrases, numbers, arrow doodles, circles, handwritten marks, highlighter underlines, and tiny hearts or stars; do not use dense long text, brands, logos, or watermarks.

At upper left, the exact main title must read “元气街头搭配” in thick marker handwritten graffiti lettering, rotated slightly two to five degrees, with uneven stroke thickness, cursive speed, lemon-yellow or electric-blue highlighter smudge, white outline, and a light shadow like a casually applied premium sticker. The nearby small sticker must read exactly “2026 Summer / LOOK 01 / Trend Notes” in small handwritten style.

Let the main image occupy about 75% to 85% of the page and show the woman head to toe. Preserve the uploaded reference's recognizable facial features. Give her a low side ponytail with rose-gold hair and moving strands, honey wheat skin, real skin detail, sunny makeup, and a sweet open smile; avoid influencer-face styling or excessive contour. She wears an electric-blue cropped baseball jacket with unbranded sleeve or letter patches, a bright-white midriff-baring short sport top, a high-waisted loose denim mini skirt, lemon-yellow platform canvas shoes, and a silver-chain small shoulder bag, plus large silver hoops, a colorful anklet, and a baseball cap. She makes an energetic turning motion and throws a kiss, with skirt hem and side ponytail moving.

Photograph a summer city street in daytime natural light with blurred background, sun highlights, slight lens flare, shallow depth of field, creamy blur, moderate film grain, clear fabric texture, and real folds and stitching. Use bright white and electric blue with lemon-yellow and silver accents; materials are cotton, stretch nylon, mesh, and denim.

At upper right, create a small “Item Breakdown” panel with ghost-mannequin displays of jacket, sport top, denim skirt, platform shoes, silver-chain bag, hoops, anklet, and cap, using only short Chinese labels and arrows. Add a “Detail Close-up” film strip with two to four macro images of jacket sleeve patch, sport-top edge and mesh, denim hem, and shoe laces/platform. Add a small corner “Bag Essentials/EDC” flat lay with smartphone, keys, card holder, wireless earphones, lip oil, sunscreen, perfume, small mirror, hair clip, and bracelet. At lower right, add two to four “More Angles” images: half-body sweet smile, blowing-kiss hand action, shoe-and-bag detail, and back view; allow misaligned stacking and tape effects. Avoid anime, illustration, plastic skin smoothing, deformed limbs, table-manual regularity, standard printed title fonts, overexposure, or excessive grain/noise.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物参考图作为画面中唯一主要可见 20 岁成年亚洲女性的面部身份依据。生成一张竖版 3:4 写实“街拍杂志感穿搭拆解版面”：不对称编辑拼贴、留白、撕纸边缘、胶带贴纸与轻微错位重叠的图片边框。整体轻盈明亮、年轻阳光、有活力、时髦但不低俗。全页可出现少量中文短标签、短句、编号、箭头涂鸦、圈点、手写笔触、荧光笔划线、爱心或星星小涂鸦；禁止大段密集长文、品牌、标志或水印。

左上角固定主标题必须逐字为“元气街头搭配”，采用略微倾斜 2 至 5 度的粗马克笔手写涂鸦字，笔画粗细不均、有连笔速度感、柠檬黄或电光蓝荧光底色、白描边和轻微阴影，像随意贴上的高级贴纸。标题旁的小贴纸标签必须逐字为“2026 Summer / LOOK 01 / Trend Notes”，用小号手写风。

主图占画面约 75% 至 85%，完整拍到人物从头到脚。她保留参考图可辨认的面部特征，低侧马尾、玫瑰金发色与动态发丝，蜜色小麦肤，真实皮肤细节、阳光妆感和甜美大笑，避免网红脸或过度修容。穿电光蓝短款棒球夹克（可有无品牌袖标或字母章）、亮白露脐短款运动背心、高腰宽松牛仔短裙、柠檬黄厚底帆布鞋和银色链条小肩包；配大圈银耳环、彩色脚链和棒球帽。她活力转身并手抛飞吻，裙摆和侧马尾随动作摆动。

白天自然光拍摄夏日城市街头，背景虚化，保留日光高光、轻微镜头光晕、浅景深、奶油散景、适度胶片颗粒、清楚的面料纹理、真实褶皱与缝线。主色亮白与电光蓝，点缀柠檬黄和银色，材质为棉、弹力尼龙、网眼与牛仔。

右上做“单品拆解”小栏：鬼模特挂拍展示夹克、运动背心、牛仔短裙、厚底帆布鞋、银链包、大圈耳环、脚链和棒球帽，配少量短中文标签和箭头。加入“细节特写”胶片条，2 至 4 张微距展示夹克袖标、背心边缘与网眼、牛仔裙摆、鞋带与厚底。角落做小型“包内物品/EDC 平铺”：手机、钥匙、卡包、无线耳机、唇油、防晒、香水、小镜子、发夹、手环。右下做 2 至 4 张“更多角度”小图：半身甜笑、手部飞吻、鞋包细节、背影，可用错位叠放与胶带固定。避免动漫、插画、塑料磨皮、畸形肢体、表格说明书式规整布局、标准印刷标题、过曝、过度颗粒或噪点。

items.title: 舞蹈教室硬闪抓拍人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的 9:16 超写实舞蹈教室抓拍模板，单一成年女性在镜面舞室内做优雅动作，采用近机位硬直闪与真实生活质感。
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical photorealistic dance-studio snapshot. Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the single adult woman, preserving the visible face shape, eyes, nose, lips, and facial proportions. Follow this template for hairstyle, wardrobe, movement, and photographic style; do not copy the reference-image outfit or background. She has a high long-hair ponytail, white spaghetti-strap camisole, lightweight black short skirt, and gold earrings, performing an elegant natural dance movement in a mirrored studio with a naturally turned waist and hips, extended arms, and soft eyes. Other students in the studio remain blurred, non-identity background people.

Use close bare flash from roughly the 11 o'clock direction beside the lens, with a hard direct-flash effect: facial highlights are bright but controlled, a short hard shadow sits below the nose, and small circular catchlights appear in the eyes, with cool-white skin tone carrying a natural hint of pink. Keep the image clear and sharp, with real skin and garment texture plus the imperfection and everyday feeling of a dance-studio snapshot. Avoid AI-plastic skin, excessive commercial retouching, malformed limbs, duplicated people, random text, logos, and watermarks.
items.prompt_zh:
生成一张 9:16 竖向超写实舞蹈教室抓拍。使用用户上传的参考图作为画面中单一成年女性的面部身份依据，保留可见脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇和五官比例；发型、服装、动作和摄影风格按以下模板执行，不复制参考图服装或背景。她留长发高马尾，穿白色细肩带吊带、黑色轻盈短裙与金色耳环，在镜面舞室中做优雅自然的舞蹈动作，腰胯自然扭转、手臂舒展、眼神柔和。背景中的其他学员只作为模糊的非身份背景人物。

items.title: 奥运体育水墨字形构图
items.description: 将一项奥运运动词汇转化为留白充足的水墨字形海报：运动员姿态、动作轨迹与反应介质融入单词笔画。示例使用 SWIMMING；如画面出现可见运动员，需上传人物参考图。
items.prompt: Create a 2x2 grid of four minimalist 16:9 ink-typography posters for SWIMMING. Make the topic word itself the central image: infer an adult athlete or fitting symbol, one defining action, and an appropriate reactive medium from the sport. Integrate a visible athlete's body part naturally into a letter stroke, curve, or counter; make an action letter express the motion trajectory; and transform the lower typographic zone into the shared baseline of the reactive medium. When a clearly visible athlete is present, use the uploaded reference image as that athlete's facial identity reference. Show collision and energy propagation through pool ripples, impact ink bursts, or an equivalent reaction that fits the topic. Preserve expansive white negative space with restrained asymmetric brushwork, pressure-varying stroke width, velocity-driven dry and wet texture, and sparse splatter. Include only the literal detail needed to understand the sport and action; do not preassign a letter, athlete action, or medium; no watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 以 SWIMMING 为主题，制作四幅 16:9 极简水墨字形海报组成的 2x2 网格。把主题词本身设计为画面主体：从该运动推导一名成年运动员或对应符号、一个标志性动作，以及相应的反应介质。让可见运动员的身体局部自然融入某个字母的笔画、曲线或封闭空间；让动作字母成为运动轨迹；将地面或反应介质融入整词底部基准线。若画面出现清晰可见的运动员，使用上传参考图作为其面部身份依据。以泳池水纹、冲击墨点或与主题相符的等效反应表现碰撞和能量扩散。保留大面积白色负空间，采用不对称而克制的毛笔笔触、随压力变化的粗细、速度带来的干湿变化与稀疏飞溅。只保留理解运动与动作所需的少量具象细节；不要预先指定某个字母、人物动作或介质；不要添加水印。

No text, logo, watermark, extra people, childlike appearance, distorted fingers, plastic skin, cluttered background, or excessive contrast.
items.prompt_zh:
生成一张 3:4 竖版、写实的 2000 年代粉彩梦幻胶片成人人像。以用户上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年女性的面部身份依据，保留参考人物可见的脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇和五官比例；不要以来源对泛化族裔外貌的描述替代参考身份。发型、服装、姿势、背景、镜头与色彩风格按本模板执行，不复制参考图服装或背景。

items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the sole visible adult woman. Shallow depth of field, dreamy bokeh, warm pastel palette, natural skin texture, soft cinematic lighting, candid winter fashion photography, photorealistic high detail. adult woman only; no child, no plastic skin, no distorted hands, no extra fingers, no cartoon, no text, no logo, and no watermark.
items.prompt_zh: 以用户上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年女性的面部身份依据。创建一张温暖的竖版冬日街头人像：一位成年女性站在现代城市户外，穿柔软宽松的腮红粉色针织毛衣和毛茸茸的白色耳罩。她有深棕色亮丽长发，打造成蓬松自然的波浪卷。她带温柔自然的微笑，双眼轻轻闭上，一只手举在脸部附近，动作俏皮优雅。温暖冬阳落在她的脸上和毛衣上，形成柔和金色光芒。背景为现代玻璃和石材建筑及细微城市倒影。浅景深、梦幻虚化、温暖柔和色调、自然皮肤纹理、柔和电影光效、随性冬日时尚摄影、照片级真实和高细节。仅限成年女性；无儿童、无塑料皮肤、无畸形手部、无多余手指、无卡通、无文字、无标志、无水印。

items.title: 纽约瑞士国际主义流行音乐肖像海报
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的瑞士国际主义城市肖像海报工作流。本静态衍生版本固定为纽约，并将人物作为原创流行音乐社论形象处理；使用时上传人物参考图以呈现其面部身份。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the only visible adult woman; match facial identity only, do not imitate any real celebrity, and do not change the strictly frontal waist-up portrait, clothing, New York city system, composition, lighting, or Swiss graphic-design style. Create a 4:5 vertical premium Swiss International Typographic Style poster that fuses an original, elegant, charismatic global-pop editorial woman with enormous geometric text reading "NEW YORK". She is a strictly frontal waist-up portrait making direct eye contact, with an unobstructed sharp face, natural facial proportions, and real skin texture; she remains visually dominant while integrated into the letter structure. She wears a logo-free dark structured cropped jacket and minimalist warm-gray top for polished New York urban fashion. Render "NEW YORK" in enormous geometric sans-serif letters occupying most of the frame, perfectly spelled, clearly legible, following a strict modular grid, and functioning as architectural structures. Within and between selected letters, reveal a specific Manhattan cityscape with believable Midtown skyscrapers, an Empire State Building silhouette, layered street canyons, and bridge structure, never a generic skyline. Portrait, type, cityscape, geometry, and grid form one unified system: asymmetric but balanced composition, precise alignment, strong hierarchy, generous negative space, circles, squares, rectangles, thin rules, and diagonal lines. Add restrained, clearly legible micro editorial text: "CITY STUDIES 01", "40.7580 N 73.9855 W", and "MANHATTAN", all secondary. Use an 85 mm frontal portrait-lens feeling, soft cinematic daylight, controlled directional contrast, realistic shadows, and natural highlight roll-off. The palette is black, white, and warm gray with sparse international red, deep royal blue, and mustard-yellow accents. Add fine film grain, matte paper texture, and extremely subtle dust and micro-scratches for a refined print finish. Ultra-photorealistic fashion photography and museum-level Swiss graphic design must feel organically fused; no blur, bad anatomy, extra fingers, duplicate faces, plastic skin, misspelled text, generic city, clutter, oversaturation, noise, watermark, logo, real-celebrity imitation, cartoon style, or AI artifacts.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年女性的面部身份参考；只匹配面部身份，不模仿任何真实名人，也不改变严格正面半身肖像、服装、纽约城市系统、构图、光线或瑞士平面设计风格。制作一张 4:5 竖幅、高品质瑞士国际主义排版海报，将一位原创、优雅、有魅力的全球流行音乐社论女性形象与巨大的几何字 "NEW YORK" 融合。人物为腰部以上的严格正面肖像，直接注视镜头，面部清晰无遮挡、真实皮肤纹理与自然比例，在字母结构中仍保持视觉主导。她穿无品牌的深色结构化短外套与极简暖灰上衣，呈现精致纽约都市时尚。"NEW YORK" 采用巨大几何无衬线字，占据大部分画面，完全拼写正确、清晰易读，遵循严格模块网格并作为建筑结构；部分字母内部和字母间露出可信的曼哈顿中城摩天楼、帝国大厦剪影、分层街道峡谷和桥梁结构，形成具体的纽约城市深度而非通用天际线。肖像、字母、城市景观、几何图形和网格是一个统一设计系统：不对称但平衡的构图、精确对齐、强层级、大量留白、圆形、正方形、长方形、细线与斜线。加入克制且清晰的微型编辑文字 "CITY STUDIES 01"、"40.7580 N 73.9855 W"、"MANHATTAN"，保持次要地位。使用 85mm 正面肖像镜头感、柔和电影日光、受控方向对比、真实阴影和自然高光衰减。配色以黑、白、暖灰为主，少量国际红、深皇家蓝和芥末黄点缀。融入细腻胶片颗粒、哑光纸张纹理、极少灰尘和微划痕的高级印刷饰面。超写实时尚摄影与博物馆级瑞士平面设计自然融合；不要模糊、错误解剖、额外手指、重复面部、塑料皮肤、错拼文字、通用城市、杂乱、过饱和、噪点、水印、logo、真人明星模仿、卡通或 AI 瑕疵。

items.title: 潮线纸质信息设计海报
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的可执行双语纸质信息设计海报模板。围绕河口低潮主题，以明亮象牙纸、靛青版画线描、朱红强调色、中文短语和大数字构成克制而庄重的田野记录海报。
items.prompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical, restrained solemn paper informational-design poster with human warmth, themed as a low-tide estuary field record. The background is bright near-white warm-ivory uncoated fine-art paper, with fine uniform paper fiber, a slight scanned feel, and soft ink-absorption edges. No stains, heavy creases, gloss, dimensional shadows, decorative gradients, or UI styling.

Build modules on one vertical reading axis: set extremely small, thin, widely letterspaced "FIELD NOTE / 03" and "21 JUN 2026" at opposing top sides, separated by remote spacing and slight asymmetry. Beneath, set the horizontal extended, high-contrast Latin serif headline "TIDELINE" in deep vermilion ink, with dramatic hairline-versus-stem contrast, elongated letters, and sharp terminals. Center three slender Song-style Chinese lines beneath it: "河口低潮", "回落水位", and "东风微凉", with generous leading in warm indigo-black.

At the center, make a monochrome woodcut/printmaking line drawing of an estuary: clear coast contours, continuous tidal arcs, layered channels, and a few flat fills expand from the middle. Keep foreground lines longer and open, middle forms heaviest, and distance as fine short strokes. Draw in indigo-near-black with slight hand-drawn line-weight variation and softened absorbent edges; use wide blank paper areas for monumentality without heaviness. Clearly set "水位回落" beneath the illustration. Anchor the bottom with huge high-contrast numerals "18 KM"; place "LOW TIDE" and "EAST WIND" apart to left and right, connected at center by an ultra-fine horizontal rule marked "06:40". Finish with a hairline rule at the bottom edge, lifted at center by a small symmetric tidal emblem, with the widely letterspaced micro wordmark "TIDELINE ARCHIVE" beneath it.

Use clean deep vermilion with a slightly mineral-pigment character as the accent, roughly 10–20% of the composition, concentrated in headline, a few tide markers, and bottom fine lines. Keep paper near-white warm ivory and body text/numerals warm indigo-near-black. Maintain asymmetric color area contrast: the more vivid the vermilion, the more restrained the paper and dark areas. It must feel bright, quiet, and orderly at distance, revealing fibers, tide lines, markers, and printed edges close up. Every specified text item must be complete, accurate, and clearly readable. No random text, logo, watermark, extra numerals beyond the specified information, starbursts, or sparkle symbols.
items.prompt_zh:
生成一张 9:16 竖版、克制庄重且带有人文温度的纸质信息设计海报，主题为河口低潮田野记录。背景是高亮近白的暖象牙无涂层艺术纸，可见精细均匀的纸纤维、轻微扫描感和油墨吸收形成的柔软边缘；不要污渍、强折痕、光泽、立体投影、装饰渐变或 UI 样式。

沿单一垂直阅读轴建立模块：顶部两侧分别放极小、纤细、字距很宽的“FIELD NOTE / 03”和“21 JUN 2026”，保持遥远间距和轻微不对称。其下设置横向延展、极高对比拉丁衬线大标题“TIDELINE”，使用深朱红色油墨，细发丝与粗笔画反差强烈、字形修长、端点锐利。标题下方居中放三行纤细宋体短语“河口低潮”“回落水位”“东风微凉”，行距舒展、深靛近黑。

中心是单色木刻/版画式河口线描：从中心向外展开清晰海岸轮廓、连续潮汐弧线、层叠水道和少量平涂，前景线条更长开放，中景最重，远景为细短笔触。线描使用靛青近黑，允许轻微手绘线宽变化与吸墨钝边；用大量纸面留白制造稳定而不沉重的尺度感。主图下方清晰写“水位回落”。底部用超大高对比数字“18 KM”锚定视觉重量，左右分别放“LOW TIDE”和“EAST WIND”，中间用极细水平线连接并标注“06:40”。最底边是一条细规则线，中心有小型对称潮汐徽记，下面是字距极宽的微型文字“TIDELINE ARCHIVE”。

强调色为干净略带矿物颜料感的深朱红，约占画面 10–20%，集中在大标题、少量潮位标记和底部细线；背景保持暖象牙近白，正文和数字为同样偏暖的靛青近黑。色彩面积保持不对称，朱红越鲜明，纸面和深色区域越克制。远观应安静、明亮、秩序清晰；近看可发现纸纤维、潮线、潮位标记与印刷边缘。所有指定文字必须完整、准确、清晰可读。不要随机文字、logo、水印、编号外的额外数字、星爆或闪烁符号。

items.prompt_zh:

items.title: 雪檐冰铃月白仙侠古风写真
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的雪景仙侠古风人像模板。使用时上传人物参考图；示例以统一参考人物的面部身份呈现。
items.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the only visible adult East Asian woman; match facial identity only and do not change the source-defined historical costume, hairstyle, pose, snowy-eave corridor, composition, lighting, or photorealistic ancient-style photography. Create a 9:16 vertical, close half-body high-quality Oriental xianxia portrait of an alert, quiet, restrained adult woman beneath the eaves of a snow-covered ancient corridor. Her body turns slightly toward the camera while her head turns sideways to watch ice bells hanging under the eaves; one hand is raised elegantly, with relaxed fingertips gently touching or approaching an ice-crystal pendant. She has smooth black long hair, half down and half tied, with the back falling naturally and a few soft face-framing strands; she wears a cool-silver hair crown, ice-crystal floral ornaments, transparent crystals, white jade, pale-blue gemstones, slender silver-chain tassels, and long silver-white drop earrings. Her cold-white moonlight makeup has a sheer light base that retains natural skin texture, cool gray-brown, pale gray-pink, and very light ice-blue-gray eye makeup with a small silver-white pearl accent, fine natural eyeliner and defined long lashes, very restrained cool-pink blush, and a soft low-saturation cool-pink or pale-rose lip. Delicate snow-reflection highlights appear on the nose bridge and tip, under eyes, and cheekbones. She wears a moon-white, ice-blue, and cold-white cross-collar historical robe with a light cloak-like outer layer, accented in pale silver, misty blue-gray, cold silver, ice crystal, and white jade. Soft silk, dense embroidered gauze, semi-transparent layers, and light overlapping fabric feature ice-flower, snow, flowing-cloud patterns, and fine silver-thread embroidery. The elegant open cross collar reveals collarbones, neck and shoulder lines, and a small natural upper-chest line while stable fabric fully covers the body. Transparent ice-crystal bells, small silver bells, long crystal pendants, and thin chains under the eaves catch fine clear cold highlights; dark-wood flying eaves and carved beams in foreground contrast with the cold-white figure. The softly blurred background retains outlines of a bright clean snowy courtyard, ancient roofs, snow trees, and winter corridor. Use snowfield cold-white reflected fill and soft side-back light to rim black hair, ornaments, shoulder gauze, and bell edges; cold but never gray, bright but never overexposed, and without greenish skin. 85 to 105 mm portrait-lens feeling, real skin, hair strands, embroidery, gauze, and ice refraction, high-end refinement without excessive smoothing; no extra people, sickly or sad expression, beauty filter, malformed fingers, text, watermark, or logo.
items.prompt_zh: 使用上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年东亚女性的面部身份参考；只匹配面部身份，不改变来源设定的古装、发型、姿态、雪檐长廊、构图、光线或写实古风摄影风格。制作一张 9:16 竖幅、近距离半身的高品质东方仙侠古风写真：一位精神清醒、安静克制的成年女性站在积雪覆盖的古风长廊檐下，身体微微侧向镜头，头部侧转看向檐下悬挂的冰铃；一只手优雅抬起，放松指尖轻触或接近冰晶垂饰。她有黑色柔顺长发，半披半挽，后发自然垂落，两侧留少量碎发；佩戴冷银发冠、冰晶花饰、透明水晶、白玉、淡蓝宝石、细银链流苏和银白长坠耳饰。妆容为冷白月光妆：轻薄通透的冷白底妆保留自然皮肤质感，冷灰棕、浅灰粉与极浅冰蓝灰眼妆，少量银白珠光，纤细自然眼线与清晰长睫毛，极浅冷粉腮红，低饱和冷粉或淡玫瑰粉柔润唇色；鼻梁、鼻尖、眼下和颧面有如雪地反光的细腻冷白高光。她穿月白、冰蓝和冷白配色的交领古风长袍与轻薄披风式外层，淡银与雾蓝灰为辅，冷银、冰晶和白玉点缀；柔软绢感、细密刺绣纱、半透明薄纱和轻盈层叠面料上有冰花、雪纹、流云纹与细银线刺绣。优雅开放的交领露出锁骨、颈肩和少量自然上胸线条，但衣料稳定完整覆盖主体。檐下有透明冰晶铃、银色小铃、长冰晶坠饰和细链，在冷光下呈细碎透明高光；近景深色木飞檐与雕花梁架形成冷白人物和深木结构的对比。背景为明亮洁净的积雪庭院、古建筑屋檐、雪树与冬日长廊，以浅景深柔化但保留东方建筑轮廓。使用雪地冷白反射光和柔和侧逆光，勾勒黑发、发饰、肩部薄纱与冰铃边缘；画面冷而不灰、亮而不过曝，肤色不发青。85 至 105mm 人像镜头感，真实皮肤、发丝、刺绣、纱料和冰晶折射，高级精修但不过度磨皮；不要额外人物、病弱或悲伤表情、过度美颜、错误手指、文字、水印或 logo。

items.title: 里斯本复古电车旅行海报
items.description: 源自 OpenNana 的复古城市旅游海报工作流。本静态衍生版本以里斯本、有轨电车和具体地标替代未填城市变量，不包含人物参考绑定。
items.prompt: Create a 4:5 vertical, museum-quality premium vintage travel poster for Lisbon, Portugal. The viewpoint is inside a classic yellow tram: the foreground is a stylized wood-lined interior and one large rectangular window that acts as a portal into the city. Through the window, naturally reveal Lisbon's character: climbing Alfama lanes, aged buildings with blue-and-white azulejo facades, the distant silhouette of Castelo de Sao Jorge, the Tagus River, and a far view of the 25 de Abril Bridge; do not arrange them as a generic skyline. Outside the window, the middle ground includes a winding incline, another yellow tram, warm windows, and subtle glass reflections, while the distance has soft clouds and river atmospheric perspective. Use sophisticated mid-century vintage travel-poster illustration: clean geometric shapes, simplified architecture, elegant silhouettes, layered flat colors, controlled negative space, authentic screen-print texture, slightly imperfect ink edges, and aged paper grain. Use warm ivory, faded blue, deep navy, dusty terracotta, soft beige, and Lisbon yellow as an accent, all slightly faded and harmonious. Set the elegant uppercase title "LISBON" at the top, "PORTUGAL" beneath it, and the poetic line "THE CITY UNFOLDS IN GOLDEN LIGHT"; integrate a small vintage transit ticket clearly reading "TRAM 28". Nostalgic, cinematic, adventurous, sophisticated, timeless, and collectible; no photorealism, modern 3D rendering, people, real trademarks, watermark, gibberish, or cluttered layout.
items.prompt_zh: 制作一张 4:5 竖幅、博物馆品质的高级复古旅行海报，主题为里斯本，葡萄牙。视角位于一辆经典黄色电车内部：前景是风格化木质车厢内饰和一扇巨大的矩形车窗，车窗如同通往城市的入口。透过车窗自然展示里斯本的城市性格：起伏的阿尔法玛街巷、带蓝白瓷砖立面的老建筑、远处圣乔治城堡的轮廓、特茹河和四月二十五日大桥的遥远身影；不要拼成通用天际线。车窗外的中景有蜿蜒坡道、另一辆黄色电车、暖色窗户和玻璃上的细微反射，远景带柔和云层与河面空气透视。采用精致的中世纪复古旅游海报插画语言：干净几何形状、简化建筑形式、优雅剪影、分层平面色彩、受控留白、真实丝网印刷纹理、略不完美的墨边与陈旧纸张颗粒。调色使用暖象牙色、褪色蓝、深海军蓝、灰尘陶土红、柔和米色和里斯本黄色作为强调色，整体和谐微褪。顶部用大写优雅排版写 "LISBON"，下方写 "PORTUGAL"，并加入诗意标语 "THE CITY UNFOLDS IN GOLDEN LIGHT"；将一张小复古车票融入构图，清晰写 "TRAM 28"。画面怀旧、电影感、冒险、精致且具有收藏价值；不要照片写实、现代 3D 渲染、人物、真实商标、水印、乱码或杂乱排版。

items.title: 湖畔青提野餐智能手机生活人像
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的可执行双语湖畔野餐生活方式人像模板。使用人物参考图保持唯一成年女性身份，保留白色吊带背心与雪纺短裙、青提、奶油色野餐垫、夏日湖光和旗舰手机抓拍质感。
items.prompt:
Create a 2:3 vertical, ultra-photorealistic smartphone lifestyle photograph. Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity reference for the single adult woman in the frame, preserving the visible face shape, eyes, nose, lips, and facial proportions; do not replace her identity with the source's generic ethnicity or face-shape description. Follow this template for hairstyle, wardrobe, pose, lakeside environment, and photographic style; do not copy the reference image clothing or background.

The adult woman has a natural, refined, realistic appearance, with delicate skin showing real pores and natural texture and restrained makeup. She has a short black bob with soft wispy curtain bangs, a delicate white lace ribbon tied behind it, and small black square earrings. Her figure is naturally proportionate and elegant; her clothing drapes naturally with believable fabric tension. She wears a fitted white ribbed spaghetti-strap camisole with delicate lace trim at the neckline, paired with a light layered white chiffon mini skirt with naturally moving ruffles.

She stands naturally on grassy lakeside ground beside a cream picnic blanket, holding a shallow bowl full of fresh green grapes with both hands at waist height. Her shoulders are relaxed and she looks toward the camera with a soft calm expression, as though casually asked to pause during the picnic. Set it in a peaceful lakeside park on a warm summer afternoon: large green trees surround a calm lake with soft reflections, fresh green grass fills the foreground, and a cream picnic blanket behind her holds a wicker basket, fruit, flowers, folded cloth, and casually arranged picnic accessories.

Capture the scene handheld from eye level several steps away, full-body framing from head to upper calves. The woman occupies about 45–55% of the frame so she and environment share equal visual importance; no dramatic close-up or fashion-editorial crop. Use the authentic perspective, natural automatic exposure, white balance, and HDR of a modern flagship phone main rear camera, with medium smartphone depth of field: environment mostly sharp and only subtly softened behind her. Use warm yet neutral late-afternoon sunlight, gentle skin highlights, real clothing shadows, balanced exposure, and a light summer breeze moving her short bob and chiffon skirt. No text, logo, watermark, extra people, plastic skin, distorted limbs, or obviously staged feeling.
items.prompt_zh:
生成一张 2:3 竖版、超写实的智能手机生活方式照片。以用户上传的参考图作为画面中唯一成年女性的面部身份依据，保留参考人物可见的脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇和五官比例；不要用来源对族裔或具体脸型的泛化描述替代她的身份。发型、服装、姿势、湖畔环境与摄影风格按本模板执行，不复制参考图服装或背景。

这位成年女性有自然、精致而真实的外观，细腻皮肤可见真实毛孔与自然纹理，妆容克制。她留黑色短波波头，轻盈空气刘海，后方系一条精致白色蕾丝丝带，戴黑色小方形耳环。她身形自然匀称、比例优雅，衣物随身体自然垂坠并呈现可信的面料张力。她穿白色罗纹细肩带背心，领口有精致蕾丝边，搭配轻盈的白色雪纺层叠短裙和自然飘动的荷叶边。

她站在湖畔草地上、奶油色野餐垫旁，双手在腰部高度端着一只盛满新鲜青提的浅碗，肩膀放松，姿势自然。她以柔和、平静的神情望向相机，像是在野餐中被随口请停一下。暖夏午后，大片绿树围绕平静湖面，水面有柔和倒影；前景是新鲜绿草。她身后清晰可见奶油色野餐垫、编织野餐篮、水果、鲜花、折叠布料和随意摆放的野餐配件。

从数步外的视平线自然手持拍摄，从头部到小腿上部完整入镜。人物占画面约 45–55%，人与环境同等重要，不要戏剧性特写或时尚杂志裁切。使用现代旗舰手机主后置摄像头的真实透视、自然自动曝光、白平衡和 HDR，中等景深，环境基本清晰、只有轻微背景柔化。暖而中性的午后日光、柔和肤色高光、真实衣物阴影与均衡曝光；微风轻动她的短发和雪纺裙。不要文字、logo、水印、额外人物、塑料皮肤、畸形肢体或明显摆拍感。

items.title: 高端咖啡馆饮品海报设计
items.description: 来自 OpenNana 的可复用高端咖啡馆饮品海报模板。替换饮品与标题变量即可保持玻璃杯、木桌、原料、温暖阳光和优雅衬线排版的同一视觉语言。
items.prompt: Create a premium cafe poster featuring layered iced peach tea in a stylish glass on a wooden table, with beautiful layered colors and fresh ingredients that naturally match the drink around it. Use a cozy cafe background, warm natural sunlight, soft shadows, and a clean composition with minimal decorative elements. Display the exact title PEACH TEA in elegant serif typography with luxury cafe-branding restraint. Photorealistic food and drink photography, high detail, no extra visible text, no watermark, no clutter, and no generic stock-photo look.
items.prompt_zh: 创建一张高端咖啡馆海报：在木桌上的时尚玻璃杯中展示 layered iced peach tea，周围搭配与饮品自然呼应的新鲜原料和富有层次的色彩。使用舒适咖啡馆背景、温暖自然阳光、柔和阴影，以及干净构图和极简装饰元素。以优雅衬线排版准确呈现标题 PEACH TEA，整体保持奢华咖啡馆品牌的克制感。写实美食与饮品摄影、高细节、无额外可见文字、无水印、无杂乱、无普通素材照感。

items.title: 可配置东方人物编辑海报
items.description: 以人物参考图绑定主角身份的 9:16 东方文化编辑海报模板。可配置角色、真实动作、核心器物、中文标题、短文案、主色与主题线条来源。
items.prompt:
Use the uploaded identity reference as the facial identity for the only main visible East Asian person. Create a 9:16 premium Oriental character editorial poster. The character is a 古琴演奏者, is 在窗边拨动古琴琴弦, and uses 一张深色古琴 as the core object.

Make the subject realistic, elegant, and full of lived-in presence. Preserve the uploaded reference's recognizable facial features, natural delicate skin texture, and a clear healthy complexion without yellowing, grayness, or over-smoothing. The action must look real and natural rather than stiffly posed. Combine real-person photography, Chinese calligraphy, partial hand-drawn character outlines, and theme-derived graphic lines.

The main color tone is 墨黑、米白与沉静朱红. The exact Chinese main title must read “琴语” in running script, running regular script, or calligraphic lettering with real ink character, natural pressure changes, varied stroke thickness, and expressive endings; do not render everything as computer type. The exact short copy must read “弦音入梦” and remain concise. Add no numbers, dates, page numbers, long placeholder text, other brands, or watermarks.

Add about three to four clearly visible hand-drawn outline segments around the hair bun, side of the face, shoulders, sleeves, wrists, or hem. Each segment follows the person briefly, interrupts, leaves the figure, then naturally becomes theme lines sourced from 古琴琴弦与拨弦轨迹. Do not fully outline the person, and do not make the outlines too faint to see. Keep lines moderately rich with hierarchy, direction, and a clear source. They must connect to the character outline rather than becoming random doodles. Let person, type, object, and lines form a natural visual path with appropriate whitespace and breathing room. The result should feel like high-end Oriental cultural curation, an independent magazine, and a character editorial poster.
items.prompt_zh:
使用上传的人物参考图作为画面中唯一主要可见东亚人物的面部身份依据。生成一张 9:16 高级东方人物编辑海报。人物身份为 古琴演奏者，正在 在窗边拨动古琴琴弦，核心器物是 一张深色古琴。

主角真实、优雅且富有生活感，保留参考图可辨认的面部特征、自然细腻的皮肤纹理和清透干净的肤色，不发黄、不发灰、不过度磨皮；动作真实自然，不僵硬摆拍。整体结合真实人物摄影、中文书法、人物局部手绘轮廓线和由主题衍生的图形线条。
